articles.title: Flexible hydrogel fiber-coupled SERS sensor for remote in situ food inspection
articles.title_zh: 用于远程原位食品检测的柔性水凝胶光纤耦合 SERS 传感器
articles.abstract: Optical fiber-based surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) sensors offer efficient signal transmission and stable Raman enhancement, showing great potential for food safety. However, the rigidity of conventional silica fibers limits direct in situ detection on curved food surfaces, making it challenging to integrate remote signal readout and conformal sampling into a single SERS sensor. This study presents a flexible hydrogel fiber-coupled optical fiber SERS sensor. A sodium alginate-based hydrogel fiber was formed at the optical fiber tip through in situ crosslinking with calcium ions, enabling conformal contact with irregular surfaces while maintaining efficient optical transmission. The porous hydrogel structure promoted dense loading of silver nanoparticles and analyte enrichment, thereby enhancing Raman signals. The fabricated 1 cm hydrogel fiber showed excellent detection performance, with an enhancement factor of 2.65 × 109 and a limit of detection of 8.63 × 10− 12 M. It also exhibited good reproducibility and stability, showing a relative standard deviation of 5.41% and retaining 88.27% signal intensity after 40 days. Using thiram as a model pesticide, remote in situ detection of pesticide residues on apple surfaces was achieved with a detection limit of 1.6×10− 3 mg/L. In addition, a one-dimensional convolutional neural network was further employed for the intelligent identification of thiram concentrations, achieving an accuracy of 98.04%. This work provides a new strategy for developing flexible, remotely readable, and conformal sampling SERS sensors, thereby improving the efficiency of food safety inspection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种柔性水凝胶光纤耦合表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）传感器，用于弯曲或不规则食品表面的远程原位检测。作者在光纤端部通过钙离子原位交联形成海藻酸钠水凝胶纤维，使其兼具贴合采样和光信号传输能力。多孔水凝胶结构有利于银纳米颗粒负载和待测物富集，传感器表现出高增强因子、低检测限以及较好的重复性和长期稳定性，并以福美双农药为模型验证了食品检测潜力。

articles.title: Quantum-Accelerated Nonlinear Seismic Simulation for Megathrust-Prone Urban Environments: A Three-Order-of-Magnitude Speedup via HHL-Embedded Newton–Raphson Integration
articles.title_zh: 面向易发生大型逆冲断层地震城市环境的量子加速非线性地震模拟：嵌入 HHL 的牛顿–拉夫森积分实现三数量级加速
articles.abstract: Background: Nonlinear Time-History Analysis (NLTHA) is the most rigorous procedure for evaluating seismic structural performance, yet its O(N³) computational complexity confines its use to single-building studies, precluding real-time city-scale risk assessment in regions of high seismic hazard. Objective: This study formulates a quantum-enhanced Newton–Raphson (QNR) integration framework that embeds the Harrow–Hassidim–Lloyd (HHL) quantum linear solver within the classical Hilber–Hughes–Taylor (HHT-α) time-stepping scheme, targeting a three-order-of-magnitude reduction in wall-clock computation time. Methods: The effective tangent stiffness matrix KT ∈ ℝN×N is decomposed into Pauli operator products and mapped to a quantum Hamiltonian Ĥ. At each Newton–Raphson iteration, the residual force vector is encoded as quantum state |b⟩; the HHL algorithm returns |x⟩ ∝ KT⁻¹|b⟩, reducing per-step complexity from O(N³) to O(s²κ² log N). Accuracy is measured by MSE against a full-precision classical reference. A 1,000-run Monte Carlo study on a 64-DOF nonlinear shear-building model provides statistical confidence bounds. Results: The QNR framework achieves mean speedup μ = 1,002.5× (95% CI: [980.2, 1,024.8]; t = 2,814.5; p < 0.0001) with MSE = 1.2×10⁻⁴. Free Body Diagrams formalise physical mappings. The comparison matrix documents exponential space-complexity reduction from O(N²) to O(log N). Conclusion: The framework transitions NLTHA from a single-building tool to a viable real-time city-scale seismic risk platform. Applied to Lima, Peru—a megalopolis on soft-soil basins within the Nazca–South American subduction system—it enables simultaneous nonlinear evaluation of thousands of structures, supporting NTE E.030 compliance and CENEPRED disaster-risk mandates
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对非线性时程分析在城市尺度地震风险评估中计算成本过高的问题，提出将 HHL 量子线性求解器嵌入经典 HHT-α 时程积分与牛顿–拉夫森迭代的量子增强框架。方法将有效切线刚度矩阵映射为量子哈密顿量，并用量子态编码残余力向量，以降低每步求解复杂度。基于 64 自由度非线性剪切建筑模型的蒙特卡洛实验表明，该框架可在保持与经典高精度结果较小误差的同时获得约三数量级的平均计算加速。

articles.title: Probabilistic Liquefaction Hazard Assessment in Highly Stratified Alluvial Deposits Integrating Continuous In-Situ Profiling and Depth-Dependent Seismic Demand
articles.title_zh: 结合连续原位剖面与深度相关地震需求的高度层状冲积沉积物概率液化危险性评估
articles.abstract: This study evaluates the liquefaction potential of Holocene deposits at two sites in Kolkata: Jessore Road (22° 36' 35.87" N, 88° 24' 14.55" E) and Lake-town (22° 36' 10.53" N, 88° 23' 52.89" E). Because the broader study area sits on the seismotectonic boundary between Seismic Zone III and Zone IV according to the active IS 1893 (Part 1): 2016 hazard map, the analysis considers peak ground accelerations (PGA) of 0.16g and 0.24g. These values correspond directly to the Maximum Considered Earthquake (MCE) design zone factors for both respective zones under an Mw 7.0 scenario. Field investigations included Standard Penetration Testing (SPT), Cone Penetration Testing (CPT), Flat Dilatometer Testing (DMT), and Seismic Dilatometer Testing (SDMT). Initial empirical estimates using a constant surface PGA and standard shear stress reduction factors (rd) suggested a relatively low hazard, with the Probability of Liquefaction (PL) generally below 15%. To better account for kinematic wave propagation and local stratigraphy, one-dimensional total-stress nonlinear ground response analyses (NGRA) were performed in DEEPSOIL v7.1.9. When the conventional rd parameters were replaced with NGRA-derived, depth-dependent horizontal accelerations (amax/g), the computed seismic demand increased significantly. This depth-dependent approach identified severe vulnerability in loose granular layers, raising the PL above 85% for the 0.24g scenario. Additionally, continuous profiling from CPT and DMT proved more effective than SPT for detecting thin liquefiable lenses and evaluating cyclic mobility in fine-grained cap soils. The findings demonstrate that relying on uniform PGA assumptions can be highly unconservative in stratified alluvial basins, highlighting the need for site-specific ground response analysis and continuous in-situ testing in regional hazard assessments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估印度加尔各答两个全新世沉积场地的液化潜势，考虑处于地震 III 区与 IV 区边界条件下的不同峰值地面加速度。现场测试包括标准贯入、静力触探、扁铲侧胀及地震扁铲侧胀试验。初始经验法在采用恒定地表 PGA 和常规剪应力折减系数时显示液化概率较低；进一步采用一维非线性场地反应分析后，研究更细致地反映了波传播、局部地层和深度相关地震需求对液化危险性的影响。

articles.title: By-Layer Covalent Organic Structure as a Metal-Free PCET Catalyst for Efficient Oxygen Evolution in Alkaline and Neutral Media
articles.title_zh: 双层共价有机结构作为无金属 PCET 催化剂在碱性和中性介质中高效析氧
articles.abstract: The delayed evolution of proton transfer (PT) as the sluggish component of proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) represents a critical limitation in the design of biomimetic artificial leaves. Here, we report a simple metal-free PCET catalyst for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) operating in both neutral and alkaline media, realized through successive evolutionary stages of a bilayer covalent superstructure. Graphite/graphene oxide hosts a repetitive porphyrin-based covalent organic structure (COS) assembled via bidentate ethylenediamine (EDA) linkages, functioning as a PCET catalyst in both alkaline and neutral environments. The experimentally detected unusual Gerischer impedance signature demonstrates the overwhelming dominance of interfacial proton exchange over natural diffusion, revealing a distinct chemical electrochemical chemical reaction pathway in OER. The H/D isotope and proton inventory studies provide direct and compelling mechanistic insight. The results show a secondary isotope effect, confirming that O–H bond cleavage is not involved in the rate-determining step of the water oxidation reaction. For the first time, this study elucidates how a robust interfacial covalent organic structure (COS), acting as an in situ heterogeneous stimulus, actively reorganizes the hydrogen-bonding network of water. Reflective infrared spectroscopy unequivocally reveals the role of COS in disrupting and agitating interfacial hydrogen-bonded water clusters, liberating free water molecules and thereby promoting adsorption events during OER.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了一种用于析氧反应的无金属质子耦合电子转移（PCET）催化剂，可在中性和碱性介质中工作。催化剂由石墨/氧化石墨烯负载的卟啉基共价有机结构构成，并通过乙二胺双齿连接形成双层共价超结构。阻抗、氢/氘同位素及质子清点实验表明，界面质子交换在反应中占主导，且 O–H 键断裂并非水氧化反应的决速步骤，为人工叶片中 PCET 催化设计提供了机制依据。

articles.title: Functionally graded auxetic sub-surfaces for misalignment-tolerant polymer plain bearings
articles.title_zh: 用于容忍错位的聚合物滑动轴承的功能梯度负泊松比亚表面结构
articles.abstract: Rigid polymer plain bearings (machined HDPE or UHMWPE) are widely used in slow, heavily loaded, dust-exposed pivots such as solar-tracker torque tubes, where their dominant failure is edge loading: when the shaft misaligns, a rigid bore cannot conform, the contact patch collapses onto one axial edge, and the local pressure spikes far above nominal, driving localized wear. We propose a single-piece bearing that keeps the sliding surface smooth but replaces the solid sub-surface with a functionally graded re-entrant (auxetic) lattice, engineered so the bore deforms elastically to follow a misaligned shaft. The concept is evaluated with a reproducible simulation pipeline: numerical homogenization of the lattice, a two-dimensional plane-stress contact model, pressure-dependent Archard wear, viscoelastic creep over a 25-year horizon, and NSGA-II multi-objective optimization with Sobol sensitivity analysis. An optimized graded design reduces the peak contact pressure at misalignment by ( to MPa) and raises retained contact area from to ; the solid baseline reaches wear-skin breakthrough within 250 oscillation cycles whereas the graded design does not. A matched-stiffness experiment isolates a peak-pressure benefit from negative-Poisson in-drawing, and global sensitivity shows that graded radial compliance, set by lattice density, is the dominant lever. A three-dimensional finite-element model, validated against the Lamé thick-cylinder solution, confirms the mechanism ( reduction) and shows the plane-stress model to be conservative. Graded compliance does most of the work, with the auxetic grading a secondary gain that matters when stiffness must be held against creep.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对刚性聚合物滑动轴承在轴错位条件下易发生边缘载荷集中和局部磨损的问题，提出一种单体式功能梯度内凹负泊松比晶格亚表面设计。该轴承保持光滑滑动表面，同时通过可弹性变形的梯度晶格使内孔更好贴合错位轴。作者建立了包括晶格均匀化、二维接触、压力相关 Archard 磨损、长期黏弹蠕变、多目标优化和敏感性分析的仿真流程，结果显示优化结构可降低峰值接触压力、保持更大接触面积并推迟磨损失效。

articles.title: Ultra-fast light-shaping technology could be 'game-changer' for future imaging
articles.title_zh: 超高速光场调控技术或将成为未来成像的“变革性”突破
articles.abstract: Scientists have developed a new type of "virtual" metasurface—capable of controlling light in ways traditional lenses and optics can't—which they say is superior to the current approach, which relies on ultrathin engineered materials. The Nottingham Trent University team says the work will help fully optimize metasurface potential for a range of real-world applications and paves the way for a move from physical to virtual platforms in nanotechnology.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员开发了一种新型“虚拟”超表面，可用传统透镜和光学元件难以实现的方式控制光。相较依赖超薄工程材料的现有物理超表面方案，该方法有望更充分释放超表面在实际应用中的潜力，并推动纳米技术从实体平台向虚拟平台转变。

articles.title: Seven exotic quantum phases predicted in ultracold magnetic atoms, including topological superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 超冷磁性原子中预测出七种奇异量子相，包括拓扑超导态
articles.abstract: Strongly interacting quantum particles are key to some of the most fascinating phenomena in modern physics—from magnetism and superconductivity to topological states. Yet the complexity of such systems makes many of their properties difficult to understand even today. A research team from Innsbruck and Turin has now proposed a new theoretical framework for generating and studying these exotic states of matter in ultracold magnetic atoms in a one-dimensional lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 强相互作用量子粒子是磁性、超导和拓扑态等现代物理现象的核心，但其复杂性使许多性质仍难以解析。来自因斯布鲁克和都灵的研究团队提出了一种新的理论框架，用于在一维晶格中的超冷磁性原子体系中产生和研究多种奇异物质态。

articles.title: Hour-scale response of low-Earth-orbit satellite altitude to extreme geomagnetic storms revealed by the NinjaSat CubeSat during the 2024 solar maximum
articles.title_zh: NinjaSat立方星揭示2024年太阳活动峰年极端地磁暴对低轨卫星高度的小时尺度影响
articles.abstract: Extreme geomagnetic storms accelerate LEO satellite decay by inflating the thermosphere, yet the hour-scale pathway from solar-wind energy to atmospheric heating is poorly understood. Using the GNSS receiver of the NinjaSat X-ray CubeSat (∼ 500 km, 97◦ sun-synchronous, 10-min cadence), we tracked orbital altitude through solar-maximum 2024. After removing the secular drag trend and EUV-driven background, we cross-correlated the storm-time altitude-change rate with geomagnetic indices during the two largest geomagnetic storms of 2024. The residual correlates with the polar-cap (PC) index at r ≳ 0.8, with PC leading the altitude response by ∼ 2 h (combined 95 % CI [−4.8, +0.4] h; October event: −3.2 ± 3.2 h), consistent with the Joule-heating transport timescale. It also correlates with the Dst index (r ≈ 0.82–0.84), but the altitude drop precedes the Dst minimum by ∼ 3 h, attributing the correlation to a common solar-wind driver rather than ring-current heating. Comparison with XRISM (31◦, ∼ 560 km) shows that in May 2024 heating extended to low latitudes (both satellites decayed), whereas in October 2024 only NinjaSat responded, indicating polar-localised heating. Polar Joule heating, indexed by PC, is thus the dominant storm-time drag driver, and the ∼ 2–3 h PC lead provides a natural operational window for drag forecasting.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用约500千米高度的NinjaSat X射线立方星GNSS数据，跟踪2024年太阳活动峰年期间两次强地磁暴中的轨道高度变化。在剔除长期阻力衰减和EUV背景后，结果显示高度变化率与极冠PC指数高度相关，且PC指数约提前2小时，符合焦耳加热向热层传输的时间尺度。与XRISM卫星比较表明，2024年5月加热影响可扩展至低纬，而10月事件更偏向极区局地化加热。

articles.title: Expertise shifts predictive motor control from execution to error-corrective dynamics
articles.title_zh: 专业技能将预测性运动控制从执行过程转向误差校正动力学
articles.abstract: Skilled motor behaviour relies on complex predictive control and error processing. Despite its indispensable position in our everyday lives, neurobiological mechanisms of motor skill acquisition remain poorly understood. The presented study evaluates the functional dynamics and microstructural substrate of expertise-related reorganisation in predictive timing circuits using multimodal functional and quantitative magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data. Forty-one baseball/softball players, representing a natural model of optimised motor timing programs, were compared against forty-six non-athletic controls using a structural connectome-informed hierarchical Bayesian framework jointly modelling task-based functional MRI dynamics of feedforward predictive control and error-driven modulation. The associated expertise-driven tissue reorganisation was then characterised using neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging and adiabatic T₁ρ mapping. In non-athletic controls, predictive control was found to engage a distributed cortico-subcortical sensorimotor, visuospatial, attentional and frontoparietal loops, while higher-order associative systems were relatively down-regulated. However, quantitative deviation from the task optimum was associated with progressive down-modulation of this predictive network. Expertise was characterised by higher behavioural performance but also by attenuated prediction-related functional engagement alongside enhanced error-related modulation. Furthermore, neurite density and orientation dispersion indices were higher in experts across distributed cortical networks, while the cerebellum exhibited a divergent profile characterised by higher neurite density, lower orientation dispersion and faster T₁ρ relaxation. These findings indicate that expertise involves a transition towards more efficient neural dynamics within an established architecture with coordinated rebalancing of fibre coherence, neurite compartment contribution and macromolecular environment, allowing for the reallocation of processing resources from task execution towards the management of unexpected information.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用多模态功能与定量MRI，比较棒球/垒球运动员和非运动对照者，以评估运动专长如何重组预测性计时回路及其微结构基础。结果表明，非运动者的预测控制涉及广泛的皮层-皮层下感觉运动、视觉空间、注意和额顶网络，而运动专长可能改变这些网络在前馈预测和误差驱动调节中的功能分配。研究为理解熟练运动行为形成中的神经生物学机制提供了影像学证据。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Structural Stability and Bandgap Engineering in Lead-Free Sn–Ge Perovskites for Photovoltaic Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向光伏应用的无铅Sn–Ge钙钛矿结构稳定性与带隙工程的物理信息机器学习研究
articles.abstract: To explore solar materials that balance high performance with environmental safety is presently a top priority in materials science. There is a need to move away from toxic lead-based perovskites but the slow pace of manual lab testing remains a bottleneck. In this study, a Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) strategy is implemented for the systematic mapping of the stability–bandgap trade-off in lead-free Sn–Ge perovskites. A stability window is identified to define compositions that concurrently satisfy structural stability as well as optimal bandgap conditions. By anchoring AI in concept of physics, this approach moves beyond the limits of conventional experimentation. About 1000 lead-free Sn-Ge mixed-cation compositions are systematically screened. Here, basic crystallographic descriptors like the Goldschmidt tolerance factor (t) and the octahedral factor (µ) are considered to be included in the study and thereby incorporated in a Random Forest model. Using this model, a predictive fidelity having R2 value of 0.96 and a mean absolute value MAE of 28.3 meV is achieved. This predictive accuracy demonstrates high computational robustness. The result is able to provide a strategic stability window in the Sn-Ge alloyed space. The chemical pressure created by mixing Cs and cations effectively reduced the oxidation of Sn²⁺. Overall, this research study has provided a robust and non-toxic roadmap for the next generation of perovskite photovoltaics and supports the global sustainability goals. The identified stability window provides a direct roadmap for the experimental synthesis of high-performance, lead-free semiconductor thin films. The validated Physics-Informed Machine Learning framework demonstrates the high efficacy of data-driven materials acceleration for advanced optoelectronic device simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种物理信息机器学习策略，用于系统筛选兼具环境安全性、高结构稳定性和合适带隙的无铅Sn–Ge钙钛矿材料。作者将Goldschmidt容忍因子和八面体因子等晶体学描述符纳入随机森林模型，对约1000种混合阳离子组成进行预测筛选。模型取得较高预测精度，为加速无铅钙钛矿太阳能材料发现提供了计算框架。

articles.title: Coherent control of interacting solid-state spins below the diffraction limit
articles.title_zh: 衍射极限以下相互作用固态自旋的相干控制
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 26 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03319-y Interacting electron spins in solid-state devices could be used for quantum networks, but such spins are often too closely spaced to be individually addressed. Single-spin control has now been demonstrated for interacting rare-earth dopants.
articles.abstract_zh: 固态器件中的相互作用电子自旋有望用于量子网络，但这些自旋往往间距过小，难以逐个寻址。该研究展示了对相互作用稀土掺杂自旋的单自旋相干控制，表明在低于光学衍射极限的尺度上操控固态自旋成为可能。详情仍需结合原文了解具体实验体系与控制方案。

articles.title: Space‐Confined Chemical Vapor Deposition of 2D FeS With Crossover Magnetoresistance and Ultra‐High Conductivity
articles.title_zh: 空间限域化学气相沉积制备具有交叉磁阻和超高电导率的二维 FeS
articles.abstract: Advanced Materials, EarlyView.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕二维 FeS 的空间限域化学气相沉积制备展开，并关注其磁输运与高电导特性。题名表明材料表现出交叉磁阻行为和超高电导率，可能为二维磁性或电子器件材料提供新的制备与性能调控路径。由于摘要仅提供 EarlyView 元数据，具体实验条件、结构表征和机理解释需查阅原文。
authors: Tong Zhou, Jialong Wang, Lingmiao Ma, Xiaoqi Liu, You Peng, Yahuan Huan, Yujin Cheng, Xinhang Ji, Yuhang Jing, Yuxue Zhou, Haoxuan Ding, Fanqi Meng, Li Lin, Jun Ge, Jian Wang, Yanfeng Zhang
articles.journal: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents

articles.title: Continuous SUN (stable, unique, and novel) metric for generative modeling of inorganic crystals
articles.title_zh: 用于无机晶体生成建模的连续 SUN（稳定、唯一且新颖）指标
articles.abstract: To address pressing scientific challenges such as climate change, increasingly sophisticated generative models are being developed to efficiently sample the large chemical space of potential functional materials. The proliferation of these models has necessitated the establishment of rigorous evaluation metrics. While uniqueness (U), novelty (N), and stability (S) of samples serve as standard metrics, their current formulations show several limitations. U and N rely on binary comparisons of crystals, rendering them dependent on heuristic thresholds, incapable of quantifying the degree of similarity, sensitive to atomic coordinate perturbations, and not invariant to sample permutation. Similarly, the binary assessment of S risks a premature exclusion of marginally unstable yet potentially novel candidates. These limitations are addressed by making the aforementioned metrics continuous. Furthermore, we integrate them into a unified metric ‘continuous SUN’ (cSUN), which offers a smoother score distribution and greater tunability than the conventional binary SUN metric. Experimental results demonstrate that our continuous metrics provide granular insights into sample distributions and secondarily serve as a soft screening score for selecting samples for further analysis. Finally, the use of cSUN as a reward signal in reinforcement learning is explored, showing that its adjustable weighting scheme effectively enhances sample diversity and convergence to a better optima in a Chemeleon2 case study.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对无机晶体生成模型的评价问题，指出传统稳定性、唯一性和新颖性指标依赖二元判定，存在阈值敏感、无法量化相似程度以及对扰动和排列不够稳健等局限。作者将这些指标连续化，并整合为统一的连续 SUN（cSUN）指标，以获得更平滑的评分分布和更强的可调性。实验结果表明，连续指标可更细致地揭示生成样本分布特征，从而改进对材料生成模型的评估。
authors: Masahiro Negishi, Hyunsoo Park, Kinga Oliwia Mastej and Aron Walsh

articles.title: The fate of odd-parity magnetism in one dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维体系中奇宇称磁性的命运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a one-dimensional model for a p-wave magnet within the bosonization framework. The model consists of itinerant electrons described by an extended Hubbard model coupled to a chain of localized moments through the Kondo exchange. The classical ground state of the local-moment system captures the salient features of an odd-parity magnet. By bosonizing the coupled system, a description in terms of coupled Luttinger liquids follows, giving rise to a rich weak-coupling phase diagram. It is shown that the spin chain develops quasi long-range order consistent with the combined time-reversal and translation symmetry defining the p-wave magnet. We highlight the peculiar role played by this order in establishing a commensurability condition on the electronic filling under which additional interactions appear in the bosonic field theory. It is demonstrated that these interactions endow the electron spectral function with a pronounced p-wave character. Away from commensurate filling, these interactions are rendered irrelevant and the ensuing p-wave character is lost.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在玻色化框架下研究一维 p 波磁体模型，其中扩展 Hubbard 模型描述的巡游电子通过 Kondo 交换与局域磁矩链耦合。研究发现自旋链形成与 p 波磁体的时间反演和平移复合对称性一致的准长程有序，并由此对电子填充施加特殊的公度条件。在公度填充下，额外相互作用使电子谱函数呈现明显 p 波特征；偏离公度填充时这些相互作用变得无关，p 波特征随之消失。
authors: Kasper Rettedal Eikeland, Sondre Duna Lundemo, Asle Sudbø

articles.title: Anomalous Hall viscosity of altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体的反常霍尔黏度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the phonon Hall viscosity at zero magnetic field is a natural probe of altermagnetism. First, we demonstrate that the finite elements of the Hall viscosity tensor unambiguously distinguish altermagnets from ferromagnets and conventional antiferromagnets. We then microscopically compute the Hall viscosity in models for d-wave and g-wave altermagnets, and find a strong sensitivity to electronic spectrum features such as gapped Dirac points and Lifshitz transitions. This sensitivity reflects a strain-space Berry curvature monopole, which contrast to the multipolar character of the standard momentum-space Berry curvature in altermagnets. Since the Hall viscosity can be probed experimentally through magneto-acoustic measurements, it provides a compelling method to probe the broken symmetries and topology of insulating altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者指出零磁场下的声子霍尔黏度是探测交替磁性的自然手段，其张量非零分量可明确区分交替磁体、铁磁体和常规反铁磁体。通过对 d 波和 g 波交替磁体模型的微观计算，研究发现霍尔黏度对能谱特征如有能隙的狄拉克点和 Lifshitz 转变高度敏感。这种敏感性源于应变空间中的 Berry 曲率单极子，并为通过磁声测量探测绝缘交替磁体的对称性破缺和拓扑性质提供了途径。
authors: Iksu Jang, Rui Aquino, Jörg Schmalian, Rafael M. Fernandes

articles.title: Bobkingite, a new coupled sawtooth chain platform
articles.title_zh: Bobkingite：一种新的耦合锯齿链平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26243v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the mineral bobkingite, ȩCu5(OH)8Cl2(H2O)2, as a potential realization of the sawtooth chain. Using ab initio methods, we estimate the magnetic exchange couplings and find that bobkingite hosts quasi-one-dimensional sawtooth chains, with residual three-dimensional interactions strongly suppressed by the crystal geometry. Examining the full exchange network, we find that the classical model exhibits an extensive manifold of nearly degenerate states with emergent two-dimensional character, which spin-wave theory shows to persist to leading order in quantum fluctuations as Ising degrees of freedom. Unlike other sawtooth candidates, bobkingite has negligible vertical interchain coupling, preserving a one-dimensional degeneracy even in the presence of ordering, suggesting that any long-range order is weak. Thermal fluctuations may thus stabilize a finite-temperature classical spin liquid regime, with a cascade of transitions upon cooling into successively lower-dimensional degenerate states, making bobkingite a compelling platform for exploring sawtooth chain physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察矿物 bobkingite 作为锯齿链物理实现平台的可能性，并用从头算方法估算其磁交换耦合。结果表明，该材料包含准一维锯齿链，残余三维相互作用因晶体几何而受到强烈抑制。完整交换网络的分析显示经典模型具有大量近简并态并呈现涌现二维特征，而量子涨落一阶近似下这种特征可作为 Ising 自由度保留，使其成为探索有限温度经典自旋液体和低维简并态级联转变的有吸引力平台。
authors: P. Peter Stavropoulos, Aleksandar Razpopov, Harrison LaBollita, Michael R. Norman, Antia S. Botana, Roser Valentí

articles.title: New Superconductors in the PtPb₃Bi Structure Type
articles.title_zh: PtPb₃Bi 结构类型中的新型超导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26258v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quest for new superconductors is of both fundamental and technological importance. Recently, an artificial intelligence method correctly predicted PtPb₃Bi to be a superconductor. In this work, we find superconductivity in the newly synthesized MPb₄₋ₓBiₓ (M = Au, Pd, and Rh), of which PtPb₃Bi is a member. When M = Ni, whose radius is considerably smaller, the structure instead collapses into the different, Pb-substituted NiBi₃ type. Interestingly, the stoichiometric parameter x shifts across the three compounds to keep the total valence electron count close to 20 per formula unit. The superconducting transitions occur at 4.9, 4.2, and 3.4 K, for M = Au, Pd, and Rh, respectively. Using electrical resistivity, magnetization, and specific heat measurements, we establish the bulk nature of the superconducting state and determine the critical fields, characteristic length scales, and anisotropy ratios. All three compounds are moderately anisotropic type-II superconductors, with modest upper critical field anisotropies of Hc₂parallel c/Hc₂perp c approx 1.2 to 1.5. These results establish MPb₄₋ₓBiₓ as a family of anisotropic superconductors and a platform for studying how site disorder and Pb-Bi mixing govern superconductivity in heavy-element intermetallics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在 PtPb₃Bi 结构类型相关体系中合成并发现了 MPb₄₋ₓBiₓ（M = Au、Pd、Rh）的超导性，而半径更小的 Ni 则形成不同的 Pb 取代 NiBi₃ 型结构。三个化合物的超导转变温度分别约为 4.9 K、4.2 K 和 3.4 K，并通过电阻、磁化率和比热测量确认其体超导性质。研究进一步确定了临界场、特征长度和各向异性比，表明这些材料为中等各向异性的 II 类超导体家族。
authors: Lior Verbitsky, Amira Merino, Scott B. Lee, Jaime M. Moya, Sigalit Aharon, Fatmagül Katmer, Sudipta Chatterjee, Grigorii Skorupskii, Josh Leeman, Gabrielle Carrel, Leslie M. Schoop

articles.title: Fluctuation-Induced Magnetoelectric Effect in Noncentrosymmetric Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 非中心对称超导体中的涨落诱导磁电效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26261v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the effect of superconducting fluctuations on the spin susceptibility and NMR relaxation rate in noncentrosymmetric two-dimensional materials above the superconducting transition temperature, considering arbitrary strength of impurity scattering. Employing a microscopic model with linear Rashba spin-orbit coupling, we show that superconducting fluctuations give rise to a direct contribution to the spin susceptibility through fluctuation-induced Cooper pairs. This fluctuation-driven magnetoelectric effect is possible even for purely s-wave singlet pairing, a mechanism that is forbidden in centrosymmetric systems. It competes with the reduction of the susceptibility below the Pauli value arising from the combined effects of the suppression of the density of states and quantum-interference localization processes. In contrast, superconducting fluctuations enhance the NMR relaxation rate above its normal-state Korringa value, with spin-orbit coupling providing an additional amplification of this effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析非中心对称二维材料在超导转变温度以上的超导涨落对自旋磁化率和核磁共振弛豫率的影响，并考虑任意强度的杂质散射。基于含线性 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的微观模型，作者发现涨落诱导的 Cooper 对可直接贡献自旋磁化率，即使在纯 s 波单重态配对中也能产生磁电效应。该效应与态密度抑制和量子干涉局域化导致的磁化率降低相竞争，同时超导涨落会增强 NMR 弛豫率，且自旋轨道耦合进一步放大这一增强。
authors: Jaglul Hasan, Daniel Shaffer, Maxim Dzero, Alex Levchenko

articles.title: Challenging the p-type Paradigm: Intrinsic n-type Mobility in Antiferromagnetic Cr₂O₃
articles.title_zh: 挑战 p 型范式：反铁磁 Cr₂O₃ 中的本征 n 型迁移率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chromium oxide (Cr₂O₃₎ is widely considered a p-type transparent conducting oxide despite ongoing debate regarding its intrinsic transport character. Here, we resolve this question by computing phonon-limited electron and hole mobilities using the ab initio Boltzmann transport equation. We find that electron mobility systematically exceeds hole mobility over a wide temperature range, demonstrating that Cr₂O₃ is intrinsically n-type. Analysis of scattering mechanisms reveals that scattering with phonons affects electrons and holes similarly, and that the mobility asymmetry originates from the electronic structure, namely the larger effective mass and multi-valley character of the valence band. The intrinsic n-type character, combined with moderate hole mobility, enables bipolar transport and revises the role of Cr₂O₃ in transparent electronics. Additionally, our results on mobility complement previous studies on defect formation indicating that the commonly observed p-type behavior is extrinsic. These insights provide a complete chemical-transport paradigm for Cr₂O₃, re-evaluating its role in functional transparent electronic and magneto-optoelectronic applications
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过从头算 Boltzmann 输运方程计算 Cr₂O₃ 中声子限制的电子和空穴迁移率，以澄清其本征输运类型。结果显示在较宽温度范围内电子迁移率系统性高于空穴迁移率，表明 Cr₂O₃ 本征上更接近 n 型。散射机制分析指出，电子与空穴受声子散射影响相近，迁移率差异主要来自价带较大的有效质量和多谷特征；这也支持常见 p 型行为主要源于外因缺陷的观点。
authors: Á. A. Carrasco Álvarez, S. Poncé

articles.title: Nanoscale Phase Distribution Governs Exchange Bias in Multiphase Magnetic Nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 纳米尺度相分布支配多相磁性纳米颗粒中的交换偏置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exchange bias at ferromagnet-antiferromagnet interfaces underpins magnetic memory, spintronic devices, and nanoscale electromagnetic technologies, yet its behaviour in complex nanoscale heterostructures remains poorly understood. Here we uncover how exchange bias emerges in functional multiphase metal-oxide nanoparticles by combining gas-phase synthesis, advanced magnetic characterisation, and first-principles-informed spin-dynamics simulations. Using Ni-Cr/NiO nanoparticles as a model system, we show that exchange bias is governed not simply by the presence of ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic phases, but critically by their nanoscale spatial distribution and interfacial topology. At 10 K, significant negative exchange bias (0.8 kOe) and coercivity enhancement (1.4 kOe) was exhibited; both decreased due to either Cr-segregation (at low Cr content) or to Cr accumulation inside the core (at high Cr content). The resulting competition between magnetic phases produces a temperature-driven inversion from negative to positive exchange bias and a crossover from exchange-dominated to dipolar interactions. By linking density-functional-theory calculations directly to spin-dynamics simulations of nanoparticle ensembles, we establish a predictive framework for designing exchange-coupled nanomagnets capable of operating beyond the superparamagnetic limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合气相合成、先进磁性表征和第一性原理辅助的自旋动力学模拟，探讨多相金属氧化物纳米颗粒中交换偏置的起源。以 Ni-Cr/NiO 纳米颗粒为模型，作者发现交换偏置不仅取决于铁磁和反铁磁相的存在，更关键地受其纳米尺度空间分布和界面拓扑控制。实验观察到低温下显著负交换偏置和矫顽力增强，并揭示 Cr 的偏析或核心富集会削弱该效应，同时相竞争可导致随温度变化的交换偏置反转及相互作用机制转变。
authors: Murtaza Bohra, Stefanos Giaremis, Vidyadhar Singh, Joseph Kioseoglou, Stephan Steinhauer, Panagiotis Grammatikopoulos

articles.title: Quantum Hall effect in three-dimensional lattice induced by Wannier-Stark-Landau localization
articles.title_zh: Wannier-Stark-Landau 局域化诱导的三维晶格量子霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the quantum Hall effect in a cubic lattice subjected to parallel electric and magnetic fields aligned along a crystal axis. The dual fields confine electrons in three dimensions with their classical orbits residing on the surface of a finite-size cylinder. In the quantum limit, the spectrum yields a three-dimensional generalization of the Hofstadter butterfly, featuring equidistant resonances near the spectral center and discrete levels near the boundaries. When the Fermi energy lies within these spectral gaps, the Hall conductance in the plane normal to the fields is quantized while other components of the conductance tensor vanish. Under open boundary conditions, this quantum Hall state exhibits topological chiral hinge modes protected by bulk Chern numbers. Our results offer a novel platform for studying the quantum Hall effect in both solid-state heterostructures and synthetic lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究立方晶格在沿晶轴方向平行电场和磁场作用下的量子霍尔效应。双场使电子在三维中受限，其经典轨道位于有限尺寸圆柱表面；在量子极限下，能谱形成三维推广的 Hofstadter 蝴蝶结构。费米能位于谱隙中时，垂直于场方向平面内的霍尔电导量子化，而其他电导张量分量消失；开放边界下该状态具有由体 Chern 数保护的拓扑手性铰链模。

articles.title: Ductility Design Rules for Tungsten based Refractory High Entropy Alloys from Sparse Experimental Datasets
articles.title_zh: 基于稀疏实验数据的钨基难熔高熵合金延展性设计规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tungsten-based refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) are promising materials for fusion applications but often remain brittle at room temperature because of tungsten's high ductile-to-brittle transition temperature (DBTT). To identify alloying strategies that improve ductility, we compiled a curated dataset of experimentally reported tungsten-containing alloys and developed composition-based, physics-informed descriptors for machine learning. Three classifiers were evaluated using nested cross-validation, and a support vector classifier (SVC) showed the best generalization for this sparse dataset. Shapley additive explanations identified the exchange-correlation parameter, valence electron concentration, pressure field, and electronegativity mismatch as the most influential features governing ductile-brittle behavior. Synthetic compositions generated within the convex interpolation domain of the training data were evaluated and visualized on pseudo-ternary diagrams to map predicted ductility trends. The model predicts that moderate additions of Ti, Ni, and Co increase the likelihood of room-temperature ductility, whereas high Cr contents promote brittle behavior. These predictions agree with published experimental observations, including Ti-assisted ductility through solid-solution and electronic effects and embrittlement in Cr-rich refractory alloys. Agreement between DFT-derived elastic descriptors and SVC decision-function margins further supports the physical relevance of the learned classification boundary. Although the available mechanical dataset remains limited and heterogeneous, the model captures experimentally consistent trends and provides an interpretable, physics-informed framework for screening tungsten-based RHEAs for targeted simulation and experimental validation in fusion environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向聚变应用中的钨基难熔高熵合金，针对其室温脆性问题，汇编了含钨合金的实验数据集并构建了基于成分的物理启发机器学习描述符。通过嵌套交叉验证比较多种分类器后，支持向量分类器在稀疏数据上表现出较好的泛化能力。Shapley 解释表明交换关联参数、价电子浓度、压力场和电负性失配是影响韧脆行为的重要特征，模型预测适量 Ti、Ni 和 Co 添加有助于提高室温延展性概率，而高 Cr 含量趋势上不利。

articles.title: Topological phase transition driven by in-plane spin rotation
articles.title_zh: 由面内自旋旋转驱动的拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The intrinsic coupling between magnetism and nontrivial band topology in magnetic topological insulators makes external magnetic fields a powerful tool for manipulating topological states. However, conventional magnetic control mechanisms, such as driving magnetic phase transitions or fully reversing magnetization, typically demand large magnetic fields and lack continuous tunability. Here, we establish a symmetry framework for the reversible switching of topological states via continuous in-plane spin rotation, governed by magnetic point group constraints on the Berry curvature distribution. Using a two-dimensional kagome ferromagnetic Chern insulator as a prototype, we demonstrate that a 60degin-plane magnetization rotation reverses the sign of the Chern number, transitioning through a topologically trivial state. Crucially, micromagnetic simulations confirm that this spin-reorientation-driven switching operates under exceptionally small magnetic fields and on ultrafast timescales. This work provides a highly efficient, low-energy paradigm for the manipulation of topological states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种通过连续面内自旋旋转可逆切换拓扑态的对称性框架，强调磁点群约束对贝里曲率分布的控制作用。以二维 kagome 铁磁陈绝缘体为原型，作者表明 60 度面内磁化旋转可使陈数反号，并经过拓扑平庸态。微磁模拟显示，这种自旋重取向驱动的切换可在极小磁场和超快时间尺度下实现，为低能耗操控拓扑态提供了新途径。
authors: Xinyue Zhu, Yu Xie, Yifei Hao, Fei Gao, Yue Li, Junting Zhang

articles.title: Binary Dipolar Condensates of Dysprosium Isotopes with Tunable Spatial Order
articles.title_zh: 具有可调空间有序性的镝同位素二元偶极凝聚体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26606v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dipolar quantum mixtures provide a unique route to interaction-driven many-body phases, where long-range anisotropic interactions intertwine the density, spin and spatial order. Here we realize binary Bose--Einstein condensates of the highly magnetic isotopes ¹⁶²Dy and ¹⁶⁴Dy in a technically minimal, single-species-like apparatus. Their nearly identical single-particle properties yield naturally matched trapping potentials, while dense intra- and inter-species Feshbach spectra provide strong interaction tunability. We use this platform to drive an interaction-controlled miscibility transition of a dipolar binary condensate, accompanied by a reconfiguration of the condensate interface from core--shell-like to side-by-side and exchanged core--shell-like geometries. At fixed interactions, population imbalance provides a second control knob by reshaping the effective mean-field pressures and continuously tuning the phase-separated order. These results establish dysprosium isotope mixtures as a compact platform for engineering miscibility, interfaces, and spatial order in dipolar quantum matter, with direct connections to coupled density--spin physics and binary supersolidity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作实现了由强磁性同位素 ¹⁶²Dy 和 ¹⁶⁴Dy 组成的二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，并利用其相近的单粒子性质获得自然匹配的囚禁势。借助丰富的种内和种间 Feshbach 共振，作者驱动了偶极二元凝聚体的相容性转变，并观察到从核壳状到并列状以及交换核壳状的界面重构。在固定相互作用下，粒子数不平衡还可作为第二调控旋钮，连续改变相分离空间有序性。
authors: Shenshuang Nie, Zibin Jiang, Junrong Huang, Xiao Luo, Fucheng Qin, Kaiyue Wang, Mingyang Guo

articles.title: Photon-Assisted Tunneling in Double Quantum Dot: Application of Scattering Theory
articles.title_zh: 双量子点中的光子辅助隧穿：散射理论的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically examine the photon-assisted tunneling (PAT) in a double quantum dot (DQD) in parallel when one of the quantum dots (QDs) is irradiated by an AC field. First, we formulate the PAT in a single QD by solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation using the scattering theory. The QD has an oscillating energy level, ǎrepsilon(t)=ǎrepsilon₀₊ₑVACo̧sømega t, and is connected to two leads by the tunnel coupling Γ. We show that the resonant tunneling takes place through energy levels of the polariton, ǎrepsilon₀₊Nhbarømega (N=0,± 1, ± 2, ḑots), when Γ łl hbarømega (PAT) and through the energy level ǎrepsilon(t) when Γ gg hbarømega (adiabatic transport). Then, the scattering theory is applied to the PAT in the DQD in the presence of magnetic flux penetrating between the QDs. We observe the Aharonov--Bohm effect not only in the main peak (N=0) but also in subpeaks (N ne 0), indicating coherent transport through the polariton states. Our theory is also applicable to the DQD in the three-terminal geometry. We demonstrate the phase measurement through the irradiated QD and show that the measured phase shift changes continuously from 0 to π around both the main peak and subpeaks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从理论上研究并联双量子点中一个量子点受交流场照射时的光子辅助隧穿，并首先用散射理论求解单量子点的含时薛定谔方程。作者区分了弱耦合下通过极化激元能级发生的光子辅助隧穿与强耦合下的绝热输运。进一步考虑双量子点中的磁通后，主峰和旁峰均显示 Aharonov-Bohm 效应，表明极化激元态参与相干输运；该理论也可用于三端几何中的相位测量。

articles.title: Floquet-Engineered Chern Insulator in two-dimensional dₓ^₂₋y^₂-Wave Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 二维 dₓ²₋y² 波交替磁体中的 Floquet 工程陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate Floquet-engineered topological phases in two-dimensional dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave altermagnets irradiated by circularly polarized light in the off-resonant regime. These materials exhibit large momentum-dependent spin-splitting governed by distinctive magnetic symmetries. Using a lattice model combined with Floquet theory, we demonstrate that irradiation induces the light-tunable quantum anomalous Hall phases with the Chern numbers up to ± 3. The resultant phase diagram is verified by calculating the anomalous Hall conductivity and also the edge modes inside the band gap of a nanoribbon version of the altermagnet. Our findings establish d-wave altermagnets as promising platforms for realizing nonequilibrium topological states of matter. The low-energy continuum limit of the lattice-based Floquet Hamiltonian results in a linear and higher-order-in-momentum spin-orbit couplings, and also a Zeeman-like magnetization, all arising from light-induced virtual photon processes. The resulting higher-order spin-orbit coupling generates the additional gapless Dirac points which, together with the high-symmetry gap-closings, yield enhanced Berry curvature and high Chern numbers. The light irradiation effectively breaks the static dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave magnetic symmetry mixing in an isotropic photo-induced s-wave correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察二维 dₓ²₋y² 波交替磁体在非共振圆偏振光照射下的 Floquet 拓扑相。基于晶格模型和 Floquet 理论，作者发现光照可诱导可调的量子反常霍尔相，陈数最高可达 ±3，并通过反常霍尔电导和纳米带边缘态计算加以验证。低能连续极限显示，虚光子过程可产生线性及高阶动量自旋轨道耦合和类 Zeeman 磁化，从而带来额外 Dirac 点和增强的贝里曲率效应。

articles.title: Lattice Reconstruction and Orbital Hybridization Suppress Magnetism in TaCo₂Te₂
articles.title_zh: 晶格重构与轨道杂化抑制 TaCo₂Te₂ 中的磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26644v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural reconstruction in low-dimensional quantum materials can strongly modify electronic symmetry and magnetic stability through orbital hybridization. Here, we investigate the interplay between lattice reconstruction, electronic structure, and magnetic instability in the layered van der Waals compound TaCo₂Te₂ using scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/STS), non-contact atomic force microscopy (nc-AFM), angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and density functional theory (DFT). While nc-AFM resolves a distorted hexagonal Te surface lattice, STM/STS reveal a pronounced square-like electronic symmetry that does not directly follow the atomic structure. ARPES further shows a strongly anisotropic Fermi surface and reconstructed low-energy states. Spatially resolved spectroscopy and orbital-projected DFT demonstrate that the bias-dependent STM contrast does not arise from a simple reversal between occupied and unoccupied states, but from the energy-integrated local density of states dominated by electronic states exhibiting opposite spatial contrast at selected energies. DFT calculations further show that reconstruction suppresses the magnetic instability present in the undistorted structure, stabilizing a nonmagnetic ground state through enhanced orbital hybridization. These results establish TaCo₂Te₂ as a model system in which lattice reconstruction reorganizes electronic symmetry and suppresses magnetism, highlighting structural reconstruction as a route for controlling correlated and magnetic phases in low-dimensional quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用 STM/STS、非接触原子力显微镜、ARPES 和密度泛函理论研究范德华层状化合物 TaCo₂Te₂ 中晶格重构、电子结构与磁不稳定性的关系。实验显示，Te 表面原子晶格呈畸变六角结构，而电子态却表现出显著的类方形对称性，并伴随各向异性的费米面和重构低能态。结合空间分辨谱学和轨道投影计算，作者指出 STM 对比主要源于能量积分局域态密度及特定能量处相反空间对比的电子态，晶格重构和轨道杂化共同削弱了磁性稳定性。
authors: Ulysse Chazarin, Bharat C. Bathu, Zuned Ahmed, Marta Zonno, Chiara Bigi, Francois Bertran, Adolfo O. Fumega, Orlando J. Silveira, Shawulienu Kezilebieke

articles.title: Dynamic heterogeneity in sodium silicate melts via machine-learning potential
articles.title_zh: 基于机器学习势的钠硅酸盐熔体动力学异质性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a comprehensive characterisation of dynamic heterogeneity in sodium silicate melts using molecular dynamics simulation with machine-learning potentials. By studying sodium disilicate, tetrasilicate, and hexasilicate melts across a range of temperatures, mean squared displacement and a time-correlation function computed up to the nanosecond timescale provide a detailed account of how spatial mobility disparities emerge in a realistic multicomponent oxide glass. Within these timescales, the self-part of the van Hove function for sodium displays a bimodality, demonstrating that alkali transport is mediated by discrete displacement events consistent with a hopping mechanism. This distinct hopping allows sodium ions to decouple from the sluggish relaxation of the silicate matrix. Furthermore, evaluation of the non-Gaussian parameter reveals that, although all constituent species exhibit dynamic heterogeneity, the non-Gaussian behaviour is most pronounced for oxygen atoms. This trend reflects the intermittency of structural rearrangements, where framework atoms undergo rare and stochastic events compared to the frequent displacements of mobile ions. Our findings elucidate the microscopic mechanism of ion transport and its connection to dynamic heterogeneity in silicate melts, offering a new avenue to study fundamental glassy physics in realistic vitreous materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用机器学习势分子动力学模拟，系统表征钠二硅酸盐、四硅酸盐和六硅酸盐熔体在不同温度下的动力学异质性。均方位移和纳秒尺度时间相关函数揭示了多组分氧化物玻璃中空间迁移率差异的形成过程。钠的自 van Hove 函数呈双峰特征，表明碱金属输运通过离散跳跃事件进行，并可与缓慢的硅酸盐网络弛豫解耦；非高斯参数分析还显示氧原子的动力学异质性尤为显著。
authors: Kumpei Shiraishi, Rikuta Nozawa, Emi Minamitani

articles.title: Floquet Topological Phases and Anomalous Hall Signatures in Irradiated Two-dimensional dₓy-Wave Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 受光照二维 dₓy 波交替磁体中的 Floquet 拓扑相与反常霍尔特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26667v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study Floquet topological phases in two-dimensional dₓy-wave altermagnets driven by off-resonant circularly polarized light and subject to an out-of-plane magnetization induced via extrinsic exchange coupling from a proximate ferromagnet. Using a lattice Floquet formulation, we show that the system is governed by a driving parameter β that controls the emergence of distinct gap-closing points and associated topological phases. For |β|>1, topology is dominated by anisotropic Dirac points at high symmetry points, leading to Chern phases with |C|=2. For |β|<1, light-induced off-symmetry G points appear in four families in the Brillouine zone, enabling higher Chern phases up to |C|=4. Low-energy analysis reveals that high symmetry points host anisotropic massive Dirac fermions, while G points realize generalized two-dimensional anisotropic Dirac points with fully momentum-dependent pseudospin structure, leading to distinct Berry curvature distributions. In the metallic regime, the anomalous Hall conductivity provides an experimental signature of these Floquet topological phases, exhibiting sharp features associated with Berry curvature accumulation near local gap-closing regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究二维 dₓy 波交替磁体在非共振圆偏振光驱动及邻近铁磁体诱导的面外磁化作用下的 Floquet 拓扑相。晶格 Floquet 分析表明，驱动参数 β 控制不同能隙闭合点及其拓扑相：当 |β|>1 时，高对称点各向异性 Dirac 点主导 |C|=2 的陈相；当 |β|<1 时，布里渊区中出现光诱导的非对称 G 点，可产生最高 |C|=4 的高陈数相。低能理论揭示不同闭合点具有不同的贝里曲率分布，金属区的反常霍尔电导可作为实验识别信号。

articles.title: Preconditioning Magnetic Systems in Kohn-Sham Density Functional Theory
articles.title_zh: Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论中磁性体系的预条件处理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The convergence of the self-consistent field iterations in Kohn-Sham density functional theory can be significantly hindered by the presence of small eigenvalues in the dielectric matrix, which are often associated with electronic phase transitions in magnetic systems. In this work, we study this type of convergence issues and propose a new preconditioning scheme to mitigate them. Our preconditioning scheme is inspired by the Stoner model and based on a non-interacting susceptibility that neglects orbital variations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a range of ferromagnetic systems, showing that it can significantly reduce the number of iterations required to achieve convergence in the vicinity of magnetic phase transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注 Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论自洽场迭代在磁性体系中因介电矩阵小本征值而收敛困难的问题，这类问题常与电子相变相关。作者提出一种受 Stoner 模型启发的新型预条件方案，基于忽略轨道变化的非相互作用磁化率构建。多个铁磁体系测试表明，该方法可在磁相变附近显著减少达到收敛所需的迭代次数。
authors: Clémentine Barat, Antoine Levitt, Marc Torrent

articles.title: Hydrogen segregation around a straight screw dislocation in bcc iron
articles.title_zh: 体心立方铁中直螺型位错周围的氢偏聚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interaction between hydrogen and screw dislocations in bcc iron is central to understanding hydrogen embrittlement. A major challenge lies in the high-dimensional parametric landscape governing this interaction. In this work, we perform a comprehensive set of molecular simulations using a reliable neural network interatomic potential, systematically exploring hydrogen binding across dislocation core structures (easy and hard cores), site types, and concentrations. From these energetics, we construct a thermodynamic framework that quantifies the statistical relevance of the various trapping configurations, thereby significantly reducing the complexity of the problem. Our results show good agreement with the limited density functional theory data available in the literature. We further delineate the validity domain of an elastic dipole description of hydrogen-dislocation interactions, providing a simplified yet physically grounded modeling approach. Finally, we demonstrate that the easy-core configuration plays a key role in rationalizing experimental hydrogen solubility limits. These findings establish a consistent multiscale foundation for incorporating hydrogen-dislocation interactions into larger-scale models of plasticity and embrittlement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用可靠的神经网络原子间势，对体心立方铁中氢与螺型位错的相互作用进行了系统分子模拟，覆盖不同位错芯结构、占位类型和氢浓度。作者基于结合能建立热力学框架，用以量化不同俘获构型的统计重要性，从而降低问题复杂度。结果与已有有限的密度泛函理论数据吻合，并进一步界定了氢-位错相互作用弹性偶极描述的适用范围，指出易芯构型对解释实验氢溶解度极限具有关键作用。
authors: Margot Lucas, Marie Landeiro Dos Reis, Sylvain Queyreau, Xavier Feaugas

articles.title: Giant and Broadband Circular Dichroism from Particle-Hole Symmetry Breaking in Weyl Semimetals
articles.title_zh: Weyl 半金属中由粒子-空穴对称性破缺产生的巨宽带圆二色性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circular dichroism originates from symmetry breaking of material structure, leading to differential absorption of left- and right-circularly polarized light. However, circular dichroism in most materials is inherently weak and spectrally narrow, especially in the mid-to-far infrared. Here, we uncover giant infrared circular dichroism in the magnetic-field-forced Weyl semimetal Mn(Bi,Sb)2Te4, driven by extreme particle-hole symmetry breaking. Helicity-resolved magneto-infrared spectroscopy reveals circular dichroism exceeding 3000 mdeg (~130 mdeg/nm) with above-degree response extending over the 6-13 μm spectral range. The optical resonances are enhanced by a strong band nesting effect intrinsic to the Landau levels of type-II Weyl dispersion. A symmetry-based kp model reproduces these magneto-infrared responses and demonstrates that magnetization-induced asymmetric spin-orbit coupling generates particle-hole symmetry breaking, suppressing spin-up, parity-even wavefunction components in the valence Landau band and thereby producing pronounced optical helicity selectivity. Our findings establish particle-hole symmetry breaking as an effective route toward helicity-resolved optical control in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在磁场强制形成的 Weyl 半金属 Mn(Bi,Sb)2Te4 中发现了由强粒子-空穴对称性破缺驱动的巨红外圆二色性。螺旋度分辨磁红外光谱显示，圆二色性超过 3000 mdeg，并在 6–13 μm 光谱范围内保持显著响应。作者指出，II 型 Weyl 色散朗道能级中的强能带嵌套增强了光学共振，而磁化诱导的非对称自旋轨道耦合造成波函数成分不对称，从而产生强烈的光学螺旋选择性。
authors: Xiangyu Jiang, Zeping Shi, Yuhan Du, Haonan Chen, Jiayu Wang, Wenbin Wu, Guangyi Wang, Congming Hao, Mingfan Yao, Mingsen Zhou, Xin Chen, Chenyao Xu, Zhongbo Yan, Cheng Zhang, Hai-Zhou Lu, Junhao Chu, Xiang Yuan

articles.title: A Hybrid Quantum Mechanics Machine Learning Forcefield (QM/ML) Framework for Accurate Solute-Dislocation Interaction Simulations
articles.title_zh: 用于精确溶质-位错相互作用模拟的混合量子力学/机器学习力场框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solute-dislocation interactions play a central role in controlling microstructural evolution and mechanical behaviour of structural materials, yet conventional atomistic modelling approaches struggle to combine the chemical accuracy with computational scalability. In the nuclear industry, these challenges become particularly acute, as experiments reveal strong correlations between solute segregation and irradiation-induced dislocation loops. However, theoretical insight remains limited because density functional theory (DFT) simulations are prohibitively expensive at relevant length scales, while traditional semi-empirical interatomic potentials lack the chemical fidelity required for predictive solute-defect calculations. Here, we introduce a hybrid quantum-mechanics/machine-learning (QM/ML) simulation framework that couples DFT with neural-network machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), enabling accurate atomistic dislocation simulations at reduced computational cost. We demonstrate the QM/ML framework's capability by reproducing the experimentally observed Sn and Fe segregation to dislocation loops in Zr and investigating magnetically complex solute-dislocation interactions in steel. These results establish the approach as a transferable, high-fidelity tool for modelling irradiation-induced defect structures and benchmarking emerging MLIPs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种混合量子力学/机器学习模拟框架，将密度泛函理论与神经网络机器学习原子间势结合，以兼顾溶质-位错相互作用模拟中的化学精度和计算可扩展性。该问题在核工业材料中尤为重要，因为实验显示溶质偏聚与辐照诱导位错环之间存在强相关。作者以锆中 Sn 和 Fe 向位错环偏聚的实验现象为示范，展示了该 QM/ML 框架在较低计算成本下开展准确原子尺度位错模拟的能力。
authors: Junting Zhang, Colleen Reynolds, Ryan S. Stroud, Jana Smutna, Daniel J. M. King, Andrew P. Horsfield, Mark R. Wenman

articles.title: Rashba and Electrostatic Control of Charge-Visible Spin Demons in Two-Dimensional d-Wave Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 二维 d 波交错磁体中电荷可见自旋恶魔的 Rashba 与静电调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26871v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin demons in d-wave altermagnets are acoustic collective modes formed by nearly out-of-phase oscillations of spin-split quasiparticle populations. Their weak net charge fluctuation makes them long lived, but also makes them difficult to access with charge-sensitive probes. We propose a route to tune and brighten these modes in a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet by combining Rashba spin-orbit coupling with electrostatic gate screening. Rashba coupling converts the spin-conserving problem into a generalized charge-spin response problem, in which mixed susceptibilities between density and spin channels become finite. As a result, the originally charge-dark longitudinal spin demon acquires finite charge spectral weight while remaining predominantly spin-like. Electrostatic gate screening provides an independent control of the Coulomb feedback and tunes the collectivemode dispersion and quality factor. Within a Rashba-altermagnetic continuum model and randomphase approximation, we show that the spin-demon ridge survives moderate spin-orbit mixing, develops a finite charge-visibility ratio, and retains dominant Sz character over the relevant control range. Parameter scans in Rashba strength and gate distance reveal a trade-off between charge visibility and mode quality, identifying regimes where the excitation remains underdamped while becoming more accessible to charge probes. These results establish Rashba spin-orbit coupling and electrostatic screening as control mechanisms for tunable, charge-visible spin demons in twodimensional altermagnetic platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出在二维 d 波交错磁体中结合 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合与静电栅极屏蔽，以调控并增强自旋恶魔模式的电荷可见性。Rashba 耦合使密度与自旋响应通道发生混合，使原本对电荷探针近乎“暗”的纵向自旋恶魔获得有限电荷谱权重，同时仍主要保持自旋特征。栅极屏蔽则独立调节库仑反馈，从而影响集体模色散与品质因子。
authors: Muhammad Irfan Sarwar, Mohsin Raza, Kashif Sabeeh

articles.title: Quasiclassical theory of nonlinear response in d-wave superconductors
articles.title_zh: d 波超导体非线性响应的准经典理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use a self-consistent Keldysh--Nambu quasiclassical theory to study two related nonlinear phenomena in clean d-wave superconductors: the photo-induced static correction to the order parameter -- the Eliashberg effect -- and third-harmonic generation. Both follow from a systematic perturbative solution of the out-of-equilibrium Eilenberger equation for the Keldysh propagator. For the steady-state correction to the pairing amplitude we find that at temperatures close to the critical temperature and to leading order in the gap magnitude Δ, the photo-induced change of the order parameter is zero at all drive frequencies: in contrast to s-wave superconductors, a clean d-wave superconductor exhibits no Eliashberg enhancement at this order. The gap-enhancing quasiparticle-redistribution channel that drives the effect in the s-wave case is suppressed by an additional power of Δ in the d-wave case. For third-harmonic generation we find that the charge-density-fluctuation (particle--hole) channel significantly dominates the Schmid--Higgs amplitude-mode contribution over a broad frequency range, the two becoming comparable only in a narrow window near the resonance frequency ømegaapprox 2sqrt2,Δ if one neglects the diamagnetic part of the current in the normal state. We trace this to the nonequilibrium dynamics of nodal quasiparticles, which must be retained explicitly and which also makes the response sensitive to the orientation of the driving field.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用自洽 Keldysh–Nambu 准经典理论研究洁净 d 波超导体中的光诱导序参量静态修正和三次谐波产生。在接近临界温度且按能隙主导阶展开时，作者发现 d 波超导体在所有驱动频率下均不表现出 s 波情形中的 Eliashberg 增强。对于三次谐波产生，电荷密度涨落通道在较宽频率范围内显著强于 Schmid–Higgs 振幅模贡献。
authors: Aidan Steineman, Samuel Awelewa, Maxim Dzero

articles.title: Coexistence of static order and spin dynamics in an S = 5/2 frustrated triangular antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: S=5/2 受挫三角反铁磁体中静态有序与自旋动力学的共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frustrated triangular-lattice antiferromagnets in the classical high-spin limit provide a paradigmatic setting in which the interplay of competing exchange interactions, anisotropy, and collective degrees of freedom can lead to unconventional low-energy excitations, anomalous criticality, and persistent dynamical responses. Here, we present comprehensive thermodynamic, μSR, and neutron diffraction experiments, along with first-principles calculations, on a triangular-lattice antiferromagnet, MnSnB₂O₆, where Mn²⁺ (S=5/2) moments form a nearly perfect 2D triangular network without any anti-site disorder. The Curie-Weiss fit to the magnetic susceptibility yields a moderate Curie-Weiss temperature of -12 K, indicating dominant antiferromagnetic interactions between Mn²⁺ moments, which is supported by first-principles calculations. Specific-heat measurements reveal the onset of long-range magnetic order at Tₘ̊ Napprox 1 K, which is ascribed to intraplane exchange interactions. The specific heat exhibits pronounced short-range correlations above Tₘ̊ N and an unconventional power-law behavior, Cpropto T¹.³⁷, deep in the ordered state, suggesting the presence of non-trivial low-energy excitations. Zero-field μSR experiments down to 50~mK confirm the presence of magnetic ordering below Tₘ̊ N, in agreement with thermodynamic and neutron diffraction experiments. The μSR measurements detect persistent spin dynamics coexisting with static magnetic order. The temperature evolution of the order parameter down to 50~mK from neutron diffraction suggests that the ordered state is consistent with a 3D Ising-like antiferromagnet. This family of archetypal frustrated magnets offers a promising venue for the experimental realization of emergent phenomena governed by competing exchange interactions and exotic low-energy excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合热力学、μSR、中子衍射和第一性原理计算，考察三角晶格反铁磁体 MnSnB₂O₆ 中高自旋 Mn²⁺ 磁矩的有序与动力学行为。磁化率和计算结果表明体系以反铁磁相互作用为主，比热显示约 1 K 处出现长程磁有序，并在有序温度以上存在明显短程关联。低温比热呈非常规幂律行为，指向受挫磁体中静态磁序与持续低能自旋涨落的共存。
authors: U. Jena, B. Sana, Satish Kumar, M. Pregelj, A. Bandyopadhyay, P. Manuel, J. S. Lord, D. T. Adroja, P. Khuntia

articles.title: Electric-Field Switchable Magnetic Spin Hall Effect
articles.title_zh: 电场可切换的磁性自旋霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is established that the polarity of a time-reversal-odd (T-odd) physical quantity can be reversed under the T operation. Here, we use the spin-group analysis to directly demonstrate that the T-odd magnetic spin Hall effect in ferroelectric altermagnets can be switchable by electric fields beyond the T operation. This arises from the ferroelectric switching of the nonrelativistic spin splitting, which swaps the roles of spin up and down channels in the reciprocal space. As a result, the T-odd spin conductivity that are proportional to the spin-polarized conductivity difference reverses its polarity upon polarization switching. We identify spin-group operations to switch both the polarization and the magnetic spin Hall effect simultaneously for non-centrosymmetric spin point groups. Then, we exemplify those phenomena in the ferroelectric altermagnet VOI₂ monolayer based on density functional theory calculations and an effective Hamiltonian analysis. Our findings not only provide novel strategies to switch the magnetic spin Hall effect using the dissipation-free electric field but also open a promising avenue for electrically programmable spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用自旋群分析表明，在铁电交错磁体中，时间反演奇的磁性自旋霍尔效应不仅可由时间反演操作反转，也可通过电场切换铁电极化来反转。其机制源于铁电切换导致非相对论自旋劈裂翻转，从而交换倒易空间中自旋上下通道的角色。作者以 VOI₂ 单层为例，结合密度泛函理论和有效哈密顿量展示了电场可编程调控磁性自旋霍尔响应的可能性。
authors: Mingbo Dou, Xu Chen, Qin Zhang, Xianjie Wang, Xue-Zeng Lu, Jia Zhang, L. L. Tao

articles.title: Local and nonlocal STM transport signatures of spin polarization in second order topological superconductors
articles.title_zh: 二阶拓扑超导体中自旋极化的局域与非局域 STM 输运特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26992v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate numerically the spin and transport properties of two-dimensional second-order topological superconductors (2D SOTSCs) hosting a pair of Majorana corner states (MCSs). First, we show that MCSs in the considered setup are characterized by a distinct spatial distribution of electronic spin polarization in the direction perpendicular to an applied in-plane magnetic field, with opposite signs for each MCS. Such a property can be used to label MCSs in a pair by their electronic spin. We propose a comprehensive spin-resolved transport protocol for measuring such a spin texture and further detecting the braiding (exchange) of a pair of MCSs, a crucial prerequisite for topological quantum computing. To be specific, we show that the magnitude of local conductance and the sign of nonlocal conductance are precisely linked to the sign of the electronic part of the MCS spin density and the spin polarization of the probe. Moreover, we show that the proposed technique can be used to detect the spin density profile of higher-energy quasiparticle states, e.g., edge states hosted in the SOTSC. We showed that all analyzed features are highly robust to strong static disorder , which makes our findings a clear experimental pathway to verify the spin structure of MCS and other quasiparticles hosted in SOTSCs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究数值分析二维二阶拓扑超导体中一对 Majorana 角态的自旋与输运性质。结果表明，角态在垂直于面内磁场方向上具有符号相反的电子自旋极化分布，可用于区分一对 Majorana 角态。作者提出自旋分辨的局域与非局域输运测量方案，其中局域电导大小和非局域电导符号与角态自旋密度及探针自旋极化直接相关，并可推广到探测边缘态等高能准粒子态的自旋纹理。
authors: Paweł Szumniak, Daniel Loss, Jelena Klinovaja

articles.title: Spin-orbit coupling driven topological superconductivity in twisted bilayer graphene-WSe₂ heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 扭转双层石墨烯–WSe₂ 异质结构中由自旋轨道耦合驱动的拓扑超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Commencing from the low-energy Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model of twisted bi-layer graphene (tBLG) with proximity-induced Ising, Rashba, and intrinsic spin-orbit couplings (SOCs), we construct the corresponding Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian with conventional s-wave pairing and theoretically investigate the emergence of topological superconductivity in it. The latter can possibly be experimentally demonstrated in tBLG, Niobium and tungsten diselenide heterostructures. The topological superconducting phases, bearing an effective p-wave pairing profile and exhibiting inverted band dispersion, are protected by a bulk gap and are topologically characterized by Chern numbers. In the absence of intrinsic SOC, variation of the twist angle and other SOC strengths yield extended gapless, trivial, and topological phases, with phase boundaries exactly matching the closing of direct band gaps. The topological regime exhibits clear band inversion in the combined particle-hole and spin space, along with distinct Bloch localization profiles compared to the trivial phase. Including intrinsic SOC generates additional topological phases and eliminates the gapless phase, indicating the enhanced stability of the gapped topological superconducting regime in tBLG.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从含 Ising、Rashba 和本征自旋轨道耦合的扭转双层石墨烯低能连续模型出发，引入常规 s 波配对构造 Bogoliubov–de Gennes 哈密顿量，研究拓扑超导相的形成。结果显示，体系可产生具有有效 p 波配对特征、能带反转和非零陈数表征的拓扑超导相，并由体能隙保护。在无本征自旋轨道耦合时，扭角和自旋轨道耦合强度可调控无能隙、平庸和拓扑相；加入本征耦合后还会产生额外拓扑相并改变相图。
authors: Kamalesh Bera, Arijit Saha, Tanay Nag

articles.title: High temperature transitions in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates Laₙ₊₁NiₙO₃ₙ₊₁
articles.title_zh: Ruddlesden–Popper 镍酸盐 Laₙ₊₁NiₙO₃ₙ₊₁ 的高温相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of superconductivity at 15,K in the infinite-layer nickelate (Nd,Sr)NiO₂, followed by superconductivity at 80,K in the Ruddlesden--Popper phase La₃Ni₂O₇, has ushered in a new era of nickelate research. Despite this progress, large discrepancies between reports exist. Here, we investigate the complete series of bulk-stable Laₙ₊₁NiₙO₃ₙ₊₁ compounds using a comprehensive set of experimental techniques, including PXRD, single-crystal XRD, electron microscopy, heat capacity, differential scanning calorimetry, magnetic susceptibility, and transport measurements, over a broad temperature range from 2 to 1000,K. By studying high-quality single crystals, we identify a previously underappreciated high-temperature phase transition in Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates Laₙ₊₁NiₙO₃ₙ₊₁ distinct from the one going to a tetragonal phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察块体稳定的 Laₙ₊₁NiₙO₃ₙ₊₁ 系列 Ruddlesden–Popper 镍酸盐，背景是无限层和双层镍酸盐超导发现后相关材料研究的迅速发展。作者利用粉末和单晶 X 射线衍射、电子显微、热容、差示扫描量热、磁化率与输运等手段，在 2–1000 K 范围内研究高质量单晶。结果识别出一种此前未被充分重视的高温相变，该相变不同于进入四方相的转变。
authors: P. Reiss, A. Shevchenko, P. S. Lizama, J. Nuss, R. Dinnebier, P. A. van Aken, M. Hepting, M. Isobe, Y. E. Suyolcu, H. Takagi, B. Keimer, P. Puphal

articles.title: Low-energy model for doped graphene nanoribbons
articles.title_zh: 掺杂石墨烯纳米带的低能模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analyse in this article the many-body behavior of free-standing doped graphene nanoribbons where the chemical potential lies inside the bulk single-particle bands. We perform an exact mapping from both an extended and an on-site Hubbard model of the ribbons to a Kanamori model, which includes ferromagnetic exchange and pair-hopping interactions. We determine the resulting Coulomb matrix elements analytically, and identify their scaling behavior as a function of ribbon width and length. We propose a low-energy version of the Kanamori Hamiltonian to address the response of the ribbons to external fields, with a view to their use as transport channels in nanoelectronics. We find that the model and the proposed ribbon parameters can produce open-shell, high-spin many-body states that can lead to shell- and spin-blockade responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文分析自由悬置掺杂石墨烯纳米带在化学势位于体单粒子能带内时的多体行为。作者将扩展 Hubbard 模型和在位 Hubbard 模型精确映射到包含铁磁交换与成对跃迁相互作用的 Kanamori 模型，并解析给出库仑矩阵元及其随纳米带宽度和长度的标度关系。所提出的低能模型显示，合适参数下纳米带可形成开壳层高自旋多体态，可能导致壳层阻塞和自旋阻塞输运响应。
authors: J. Ferrer, A. García-Fuente, Y. Yang, S. Volosheniuk, H. S. J. van der Zant

articles.title: Magnetoresistance in chiral systems driven by inter-band spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: 由带间自旋轨道耦合驱动的手性体系磁阻
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27121v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS), in which electrons transmitted through nonmagnetic chiral materials exhibit strong spin-dependent transport, has attracted growing interest for spintronic applications. However, a quantitative understanding of CISS remains elusive, partly because most previous studies rely on single-band models. In this work, we theoretically investigate multi-band effects on magnetoresistance (MR)-CISS, which is typically observed in experiments using magnetic conductive atomic force microscopy. To evaluate the spin polarization in MR-CISS, we simulate the nonequilibrium steady-state current using the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad master equation. We find that spin polarization exceeding 25% can be achieved for realistic inter-band spin-orbit coupling strengths in the presence of on-site Coulomb interactions. These findings highlight the crucial role of inter-band spin-orbit coupling in the mechanism of CISS.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对手性诱导自旋选择性现象，重点考察多能带效应对磁阻型 CISS 的影响。作者使用 Gorini–Kossakowski–Sudarshan–Lindblad 主方程模拟非平衡稳态电流，以评估输运中的自旋极化。在存在在位库仑相互作用且带间自旋轨道耦合取现实强度时，模型可产生超过 25% 的自旋极化，表明带间自旋轨道耦合在 CISS 机制中具有关键作用。

articles.title: Phase-Shifted Planar Hall and Magnetoresistive Responses in Weyl Semimetals
articles.title_zh: Weyl 半金属中相位偏移的平面霍尔与磁阻响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The planar Hall resistivity and magnetoresistivity of Weyl semimetals are conventionally expected to exhibit sin 2φ and o̧s2φ angular dependences, respectively, where φ is the angle between electric and magnetic fields. However, experiments reveal shifted extrema in the planar Hall signal and sign reversals in magnetoresistivity at φ < π/4. Here, using a diagrammatic Kubo-formula approach, we identify an intrinsic quadratic magnetic-field contribution to the planar transport response that is absent in conventional semiclassical description. This contribution introduces an additional term proportional to o̧s 2 φ and sin 2φ, respectively, in transverse and longitudinal conductivities. Consequently, both planar Hall and magnetoresistive responses acquire a phase-shifted form sin 2(φ+φᵣ₎ and o̧s 2(φ+φᵣ₎, respectively. The same phase shift extracted independently from longitudinal and transverse responses quantitatively describes available experimental data. Our results establish a microscopic origin of the anomalous angular dependence observed in Weyl semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文解释 Weyl 半金属平面霍尔电阻率和磁阻中偏离传统 sin2φ 与 cos2φ 角依赖的实验异常。作者基于图形化 Kubo 公式方法发现，平面输运响应中存在传统半经典描述未包含的本征二次磁场贡献。该贡献使横向和纵向电导分别出现额外角依赖项，从而导致平面霍尔和磁阻呈现统一的相位偏移形式，并可定量描述已有实验数据。

articles.title: Organic Semiconductor Alignment via Confinement in Vapor-Guided Droplets
articles.title_zh: 通过蒸汽引导液滴限域实现有机半导体取向排列
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27207v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organic semiconductors are lightweight, solution-processable materials with strong potential for printed and flexible electronics, from deformable displays to wearable sensors. Despite significant advances in materials synthesis and manufacturing, controlling molecular and mesoscale alignment during deposition remains a central challenge, as film morphology critically governs charge transport and device performance. Here, we demonstrate that flows developing within the intrinsically confined volume of microliter vapor-guided droplets can be harnessed to produce highly aligned organic semiconductor films. As droplets move in response to an external vapor source, internal flows align organic semiconducting nanowires within the droplet prior to deposition, yielding films with pronounced directional order. Organic field-effect transistors fabricated with this approach exhibit approximately 40% enhancement in saturation current relative to spin-coated controls. Beyond improved device performance, the contactless and compact nature of our method enables the deposition and alignment of organic semiconductors on curved and flexible surfaces. More broadly, vapor-guided droplets offer a scalable framework for the confinement-induced alignment of functional soft materials, with potential for integration into existing additive manufacturing platforms for flexible electronics and beyond.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用微升尺度蒸汽引导液滴中的内流，在沉积前对有机半导体纳米线进行取向排列。液滴在外部蒸汽源作用下运动，其受限体积内的流动可产生具有显著方向有序性的有机半导体薄膜。基于该方法制备的有机场效应晶体管相较旋涂对照样品饱和电流约提高 40%，且该接触式要求低、结构紧凑的方法适用于曲面和柔性基底。
authors: Robert Malinowski, Alessandro Rossi, Lewis M. Cowen, Peter A. Gilhooly-Finn, Michael A. Parkes, Ming-Hao Chang, Yu-Cheng Chiu, Ioannis Papakonstantinou, Matthew O. Blunt, Bob C. Schroeder, Giorgio Volpe

articles.title: Light-driven active phase separation and droplet division
articles.title_zh: 光驱动的主动相分离与液滴分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase separation organizes matter across scales, yet how it operates under sustained energy input remains poorly understood. Experimental approaches to driven phase separation have largely relied on chemically fueled systems, in which reaction fluxes are intrinsically coupled to fuel consumption and reaction-network complexity. Here we show that continuous molecular switching alone is sufficient to generate active phase behavior in a minimal two-phase system. Using light-responsive DNA-azobenzene coacervates confined in microfluidic droplets, we modulate intermolecular interactions with spatiotemporal precision and quantitatively track phase separation dynamics under illumination. Light-driven azobenzene isomerization controls both thermodynamics and kinetics, setting phase boundaries and regulating dissolution and nucleation rates. Under single-wavelength illumination that couples forward and backward isomerization into a dynamic photostationary state, coarsening is arrested and micron-sized coacervates are stabilized. When the two photoisomerization pathways are driven independently, spatially unbalanced reaction fluxes generate sustained interfacial instabilities, including surface undulations, budding, and division. These behaviors arise from a physical coupling between reaction kinetics and phase separation, without chemical fuels or biochemical regulation. Our results show that non-equilibrium phase behavior is governed by how opposing reaction fluxes are imposed, establishing reversible molecular switching as a minimal route to active materials from equilibrium building blocks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了持续分子光开关过程本身即可在最小两相体系中产生主动相行为。作者利用限域于微流控液滴中的光响应 DNA–偶氮苯复凝聚体，以时空可控的光照调节分子间相互作用并追踪相分离动力学。偶氮苯光异构化同时控制热力学相边界和溶解、成核速率；在特定照明条件下可阻止粗化并稳定微米级凝聚体，而独立驱动两条光异构化路径时可产生空间不平衡反应通量并诱导更复杂的液滴行为。
authors: Zi Lin, Thomas Beneyton, Suzanne Lafon, Edison Rafael Jimenez Granda, Liangfei Tian, Alexandre Baron, Jean-Christophe Baret, Nicolas Martin

articles.title: Investigation on the temperature dependence of substrate-induced in-plane uniaxial magnetic anisotropy in Ni thin films grown on 128deg Y-cut LiNbO3
articles.title_zh: 128° Y切 LiNbO3 衬底上 Ni 薄膜中衬底诱导面内单轴磁各向异性的温度依赖性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27255v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the temperature dependence of the substrate-induced magnetic anisotropy in continuous Ni thin films deposited at room temperature using magnetron sputtering on a 128deg Y-cut LiNbO3 substrate. Ultrathin films exhibit a pronounced temperature dependence in magnetization, with as-grown films showing isotropic behavior and an unconventional hysteresis branch crossing at relatively low temperatures, whereas no branch crossing is observed in annealed films over the investigated temperature range, indicating suppression of the underlying mechanism. Temperature-dependent magnetization measurements show that post-deposition annealing establishes uniaxial anisotropy with well-defined easy and hard axes, whose strength evolves with temperature due to the nature of residual strain governed by both lattice mismatch and coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) mismatch between the Ni film and the 128deg Y-cut substrate, independent of film thickness for both 5 nm and 100 nm films. The emergence of this anisotropy following annealing indicates enhanced magnetoelastic coupling at the film-substrate interface, as the magnetic response begins to follow the anisotropic strain imposed by lattice mismatch and CTE mismatch.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了室温磁控溅射沉积在 128° Y 切 LiNbO3 衬底上的连续 Ni 薄膜中，衬底诱导磁各向异性随温度的变化。结果显示，未退火超薄膜在低温下表现出近各向同性及非常规磁滞支交叉，而退火后薄膜形成明确的易轴和硬轴，且在研究温区内不再出现支交叉。作者认为退火增强了薄膜—衬底界面的磁弹耦合，残余应变由晶格失配和热膨胀系数失配共同决定，并在 5 nm 与 100 nm 薄膜中呈现相似的厚度无关特征。
authors: Kalani Perera, Morton Greenslit, Luke Doucette, Mauricio Pereira da Cunha, Nicholas S Bingham

articles.title: Strong coupling between propagating spin wave and microwave photons in a superconducting resonator
articles.title_zh: 超导谐振器中传播自旋波与微波光子的强耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate strong coupling between propagating spin wave modes and microwave photons in superconducting resonator-magnetic thin film hybrid circuits. By fabricating the resonator directly on yttrium iron garnet thin films grown on rare-earth-free Y₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂ substrates, we achieve strong coupling of both Damon-Eshbach and backward-volume spin wave modes to the resonator, with coupling strengths exceeding both the magnon and photon damping rates.
