However, the literature presents conflicting findings on the actual improvements in energy efficiency (EE) and throughput of RIS-assisted UAV systems. This paper presents a systematic review of 47 peer-reviewed studies published from 2020 to 2026. This review analyzes system models, optimization objectives, optimization algorithms, and reported performance improvements. The key findings indicate that RIS-assisted UAV systems achieve reported throughput gains of 15% to 55% over baseline systems, and energy efficiency improvements of 12% to 58%. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based optimization algorithms demonstrate superior performance, achieving up to 34.48% throughput gain and 40% EE improvement over conventional methods. Optimal performance requires 128–256 RIS elements; in urban settings, the optimal UAV altitude is between 100 and 120 meters. However, methodological issues were noted: 68% of studies did not report standard deviations, and 91% did not report independent replication counts, which prevented quantitative meta-analysis. This review provides evidence-based design guidelines and identifies research gaps, including the need for standardized reporting protocols and experimental validation. The findings serve as a comprehensive reference for energy-efficient UAV-RIS communication systems for 6G networks and future research and development.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文系统综述了 2020 至 2026 年发表的 47 项关于可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助无人机系统的研究，重点分析系统模型、优化目标、算法和性能提升。综述显示，RIS 辅助无人机系统相较基线方案通常报告了吞吐量和能效的明显提升，其中深度强化学习方法表现更优。文章还总结了 RIS 元件数量和城市环境中无人机高度的经验性最优范围，同时指出许多研究缺乏标准差和独立重复次数报告，限制了严格的定量荟萃分析。

articles.title: Telecom-band quantum memory with chlorine defects in silicon carbide
articles.title_zh: 基于碳化硅中氯缺陷的电信波段量子存储
articles.abstract: Realization of quantum memory with a photonic interface in the telecommunication bands in a wafer-scalable platform is a central requirement for long-distance quantum networks. Silicon carbide (SiC) provides a technologically mature host for integrated quantum photonics, yet only a limited number of defects combine spin functionality with telecom emission. Here we report on chlorine-based defects in 4H-SiC as a platform for telecom-band quantum memory. The emission of these defects spans the entire telecommunication range with zero-phonon lines in the O- and C-bands and a Debye-Waller factor of up to 39 %. Time-resolved photoluminescence measurements reveal a short excited-state lifetime in the sub-nanosecond range. We demonstrate that these defects are spin-active even at room temperature, exhibiting optically detected magnetic resonances (ODMR) in the sub-GHz frequency range. Using ODMR spectroscopy and Ramsey interferometry, we resolve the hyperfine structure arising from the interaction with Cl-35 nuclear spins. The ODMR spectra exhibit complex behaviour in an external magnetic field due to mixing of electron-nuclear spin states, which is well reproduced by our simulations. The spin relaxation and coherence times are in the sub microsecond range, limited by rapid quenching of the ODMR contrast and attributed to charge-state metastability. The combination of telecom-band emission, coherent spin control and compatibility with wafer-scale fabrication positions Cl-related defects in SiC as a promising platform for chip-scale quantum memories with spin-photon interfaces operating in the fiber-optic telecommunication windows.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道 4H-碳化硅中氯基缺陷作为电信波段量子存储平台的潜力。该类缺陷发光覆盖电信范围，在 O 波段和 C 波段具有零声子线，并表现出较高 Debye-Waller 因子和亚纳秒量级激发态寿命。实验还显示这些缺陷在室温下具有自旋活性，可观测到亚 GHz 频率范围的光探测磁共振，并通过 ODMR 与 Ramsey 干涉解析了与氯-35 核自旋相互作用相关的超精细结构。

articles.title: Joint Generative Modeling of EEG and fMRI for Cognitive Task Simulation Using Adversarial Learning
articles.title_zh: 利用对抗学习联合生成 EEG 与 fMRI 以模拟认知任务
articles.abstract: Realistic simulation of human brain activity is a critical enabler for data augmentation, pri-vacy preservation, methodological benchmarking, and virtual experimentation in cognitiveneuroscience and neuroimaging-based machine learning. Most existing generative approachesfocus on unimodal signal synthesis, either electroencephalography (EEG) or functional mag-netic resonance imaging (fMRI), and therefore fail to capture the cross-modal dependenciesinherent to human cognition. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal neural activitypattern simulator based on a joint EEG-fMRI generative adversarial network (GAN) for syn-thesizing task-evoked cognitive brain activity. The proposed framework is evaluated usingtask-based recordings from the PEARL-Neuro database, using a 20-case multimodal analysiscohort for attention switching (Multi-Source Interference Task, MSIT) and working mem-ory (Sternberg task). Frequency-domain EEG band-power features and fMRI functionalconnectivity features are extracted following a robust preprocessing pipeline, where Inde-pendent Component Analysis (ICA) is applied using the frontal electrode Fp1 as an EOGproxy for artefact removal. These features are jointly modelled within a unified adversariallearning framework to preserve cross-modal structure. Evaluation using a balanced dataset(19 real plus 19 synthetic samples for attention, 18 real plus 18 synthetic samples for mem-ory) with 5-fold stratified cross-validation reports Accuracy of 0.833 and 0.909, F1-Score of0.800 and 0.889, RMSE of 0.2022 and 0.1593, and R-squared of 0.5148 and 0.7123 for theattention and memory tasks respectively. The proposed framework demonstrates that jointadversarial modelling can generate statistically plausible multimodal brain signals, support-ing privacy-preserving data augmentation and reproducible cognitive neuroscience research.These findings establish joint adversarial modelling as a powerful paradigm for multimodalbrain signal synthesis, with significant potential for adaptive human-computer interactionsystems and virtual cognitive experimentation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种联合 EEG-fMRI 生成对抗网络，用于合成任务诱发的人脑认知活动模式，以服务于数据增强、隐私保护、方法基准测试和虚拟实验。与仅生成单一模态信号的方法不同，该框架旨在捕捉脑电与功能磁共振之间的跨模态依赖。作者基于 PEARL-Neuro 数据库中注意转换和工作记忆任务的多模态记录，提取 EEG 频域带功率特征和 fMRI 功能连接特征，并采用包括独立成分分析伪迹去除在内的预处理流程进行评估。

articles.title: Machine Learning Research in India: Institutions, Citation Patterns, and Research Trajectories Among Top-Cited Scholars on Google Scholar
articles.title_zh: 印度机器学习研究：Google Scholar高被引学者的机构分布、引用模式与研究轨迹
articles.abstract: We present Scholar-India-ML, a bibliometric dataset of 480 Indian machine-learning researchers identified via the Google Scholar author-search interface using the query label:machine learning india, sorted by lifetime citation count. After excluding two anomalous accounts (one high-energy-physics researcher with citation counts inflated by large-collaboration papers, one suspected gaming account), the clean cohort comprises 478 researchers with a combined 1.52 million citations, a mean of 3,173, a median of 1,642, and a Gini coefficient of 0.53 indicating moderate-to-high concentration. Contrary to popular perception, the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) outperforms the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) in citation share (8.9% vs. 4.1%), while the Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) contributes a disproportionate 6.1% of citations from only eight researchers. Industry laboratories—principally Microsoft Research India and Google Research India—account for 5.9% of researchers and 7.7% of citations, signaling a nascent but visible industrial research presence. We discuss the implications for understanding India’s AI research ecosystem, the role of legacy statistical-computing institutions, and the ongoing tension between elite institutional concentration and national research capacity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 Scholar-India-ML，一个基于 Google Scholar 作者搜索构建的印度机器学习研究者文献计量数据集。清洗后的样本包含478名研究者，总引用量约152万次，呈现中高程度的引用集中。研究发现，印度科学理工学院在引用份额上超过印度理工学院体系，印度统计研究所虽人数较少但贡献突出，产业研究机构也显示出正在形成的影响力。

articles.title: Shape-Constrained Bayesian Active Learning of Self-Limiting Saturation Curves
articles.title_zh: 自限制饱和曲线的形状约束贝叶斯主动学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26577v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-limiting saturation curves, monotone responses that rise from zero to a plateau, govern gas adsorption, enzyme kinetics, dose-response pharmacology, and the growth per cycle of atomic layer deposition (ALD), yet mapping each curve from a handful of costly measurements is a shared bottleneck. The standard surrogate, a stationary-kernel Gaussian process, enforces no shape constraint: on sparse, noisy data it produces unphysical dips that corrupt both the inferred curve and the uncertainty used to choose the next experiment. We present an active-learning platform built on Bayesian monotonic I-spline regression, in which every posterior curve rises from exactly zero and never decreases, the plateau is set by a measurement at maximum exposure rather than a prior, and the input at any saturation level is read from the posterior by level crossing with no kinetic model assumed. Benchmarked isotherm by isotherm on five kinetically distinct families (Langmuir, dissociative Michaelis-Menten, sigmoidal Sips, logarithmic Elovich, and dispersive Kohlrausch-Williams-Watts), with ALD process development as the working example, the same fixed surrogate recovers every curve to within measurement noise without a single non-monotone posterior draw, and noise-free sweeps show the basis itself is near-exact across each family's regimes, locating its single capacity boundary at the sharpest sigmoidal onset. Driven by ordinary uncertainty sampling, the platform reaches noise-floor accuracy within a 20-measurement budget in every regime, in as few as seven measurements, whereas random sampling succeeds in only two of the five; the predicted pulse times err only on the conservative side, toward longer pulses, near saturation. Because the basis privileges no kinetic form, the platform applies wherever a self-limiting response must be learned from scarce data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对从少量昂贵实验数据中学习自限制饱和曲线的问题，提出基于贝叶斯单调I样条回归的主动学习平台。与常规平稳核高斯过程不同，该方法显式保证曲线从零开始且单调不降，并通过最大暴露量测量确定平台值，而不依赖特定动力学模型。作者以原子层沉积工艺开发为示例，并在多类动力学等温线族上进行基准测试，旨在提高曲线推断和下一步实验选择的物理可靠性。

articles.title: Magnetic Cloud Boundary Identification Using a Local-Normalized Magnetic Field Parameter
articles.title_zh: 利用局部归一化磁场参数识别磁云边界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Due to the lack of quantitative and reproducible criteria for identifying magnetic cloud (MC) boundaries, we propose a parameter that characterizes short-timescale variability in magnetic field strength. The parameter, referred to as the Local-Normalized Magnetic field parameter (LNM), is defined as LNM(t)=łog₁₀łeft(B(t)/łangle B ångleₘₐₜₕᵣₘ₅ₘ₋ₘₑd(t)i̊ght), where B(t) is the total magnetic field strength and łangle B ångleₘₐₜₕᵣₘ₅ₘ₋ₘₑd(t) is its 5-minute running median ending at time t. This parameter measures the deviation of the magnetic field magnitude from its local background and reveals a clear contrast between the coherent magnetic structure inside MCs and the more variable ambient solar wind. Based on this parameter, we develop a semi-automated method for MC boundary identification, supported by Time Series Scalogram visualization. We further analyze 76 MC events using power spectral density (PSD) and slab fraction diagnostics. The results show that the dissipation-range spectral index inside MCs (sim f⁻².²¹) is systematically smaller than that outside (sim f⁻².⁵⁹ and f⁻².⁸⁹), and the slab fraction is reduced, indicating suppressed small-scale variability and enhanced anisotropy. These results support the applicability of the proposed parameter for MC boundary identification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出局部归一化磁场参数LNM，用于表征磁场强度在短时间尺度上的变化，从而为磁云边界识别提供更定量、可复现的依据。该参数比较瞬时磁场强度与其局部背景，能够区分磁云内部相干磁结构和外部更剧烈变化的太阳风环境。作者据此发展了半自动边界识别方法，并结合时序尺度图、功率谱密度和板状分量诊断分析多个磁云事件，结果表明磁云内部湍流特征相对受到抑制。
authors: Ziwei Huang, Zhenjun Zhou, Wei Su, Yudong Ye, Yuming Wang

articles.title: Implementation of reinforcement learning in chemical reaction networks: application to phototaxis as curiosity-driven exploration
articles.title_zh: 在化学反应网络中实现强化学习：将趋光性视为好奇心驱动的探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Living systems navigate environments using noisy and incomplete sensory signals. In unicellular algae, phototaxis is often modeled as a mechanistic run--tumble process driven by stimulus--response rules. However, such descriptions overlook how organisms actively sample their environment to reduce sensory ambiguity. From a minimal cognition perspective, we reframe this navigation as a subjective, information-driven sensorimotor process. To this end, we propose a framework linking a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with biochemical reaction dynamics. Environmental variables are hidden, while the cell updates a minimal internal state from each observation through a memoryless Bayesian step. These internal dynamics balance orienting toward light with exploratory reorientation and can be implemented through Chemical-Reaction-Network Ordinary Differential Equations (CRN--ODEs). Our model includes a biophysical observation process for photoreception and a chemically computable polynomial bound on information gain. Using Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) on 30 experimentally recorded Chlamydomonas trajectories, we infer the behavioral objective consistent with observed phototactic motion and benchmark the resulting dynamics with standard Stochastic Simulation Algorithm (SSA) baselines. Our model reproduces the empirical alignment-to-light distribution, comparable to objective SSA baselines on this dataset. Within this framework, run--tumble alternation emerges as an information-acquisition strategy: tumbling reorients the cell to sample new sensory configurations and resolve sensor ambiguity, demonstrating how intracellular biochemical networks can support adaptive information-seeking behavior in cellular navigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从最小认知视角重新解释单细胞藻类趋光行为，将其视为在不完全和噪声感知下进行的信息驱动型感知—运动过程。作者将部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程与生化反应动力学相联系，使细胞通过无记忆贝叶斯更新形成内部状态，并在趋光定向与探索性重定向之间取得平衡。模型进一步用化学反应网络常微分方程实现，并结合实验记录的衣藻轨迹通过逆强化学习推断相关行为规则。
authors: Ruyi Tang (LCQB-AG), Grégoire Sergeant-Perthuis (LCQB-AG), David Colliaux

articles.title: Ribozyme-optimized CVS-N2cΔG Rabies Virus with Hyper-diverse Barcodes for High-fidelity Single‑Neuron Projection Connectivity
articles.title_zh: 核酶优化的高多样性条形码CVS-N2cΔG狂犬病毒用于高保真单神经元投射连接解析
articles.abstract: Neural circuit mapping at single‑cell resolution relies on hyper‑diverse barcode libraries to minimize collision artifacts and topological distortion. Here, we report a minigenome‑based screening platform for systematic optimization of ribozyme configurations in the CVS‑N2c rabies virus strain. Screening of combinatorial ribozyme libraries identified 3′ Twister‑based configurations that increased CVS‑N2cΔG rescue efficiency by two orders of magnitude and expanded effective library capacity by 75‑fold relative to conventional systems. We applied these optimized hyper‑diverse barcode libraries to the mouse LGN input to V1 visual pathway and assessed both library composition and downstream biological connectivity using collision‑free, cell‑centric network topology analysis. Twister‑engineered hyper‑diverse libraries suppressed collision‑induced false‑positive spurious convergence, recovering a network architecture consistent with the sparse, parallel organization of LGN input to V1 corticothalamic feedback. Together, these results demonstrate that ribozyme‑mediated barcode diversity enhancement and collision‑free topology reconstruction act synergistically: higher library diversity maximizes the absolute yield of collision‑free cells, while cell‑centric filtering resolves residual false‑positive hubs, together enabling high‑fidelity single‑neuron projection connectivity at scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发了基于微基因组的筛选平台，系统优化CVS-N2c狂犬病毒中的核酶配置，以提升单细胞神经环路示踪所需条形码文库的有效多样性。筛选结果显示，基于3′端Twister核酶的配置可显著提高CVS-N2cΔG病毒拯救效率，并大幅扩展有效文库容量。作者将优化后的高多样性条形码文库用于小鼠外侧膝状体输入至V1视觉通路的分析，减少了条形码碰撞导致的假阳性汇聚，更好地恢复稀疏、并行的连接拓扑。

articles.title: Estimation of Wavenumber Spectra from Particle Tracking Velocimetry Data
articles.title_zh: 从粒子跟踪测速数据估计波数谱
articles.abstract: Particle tracking velocimetry (PTV) provides three-component, three-dimensional velocity field data, albeit irregularly sampled in space. Although a three-dimensional wavenumber spectrum can be computed from this data, the question arises, which estimator is most appropriate in terms of expectation and variance/variability? The present study addresses this question using synthetic two-dimensional velocity field data of a Kolmogorov flow, i.e., one-dimensional sinusoidal body force added to an unbounded flow. This spatially homogeneous velocity field was generated using a Direct Numerical Simulation (DNS) and PTV data was synthesized by placing seeding particles at random positions within the velocity field. Four different wavenumber spectral estimators are compared with the reference spectrum derived from the DNS data. The four estimators are: direct spectral estimation via a non-uniform discrete Fourier transform, a Fast Fourier Transform of an interpolation of velocity onto the DNS mesh, an estimate based on a physics-informed neural network (PINN) with interpolation onto a regular grid, and an estimator using the fuzzy slot-correlation technique. The comparison is drawn in terms of expectation and variance as a function of particle number density and number of data records over which averaging is performed. The results show that only the fuzzy slot correlation with local normalization yields bias free estimates to a wavenumber limit determined by the particle number density, although this is at the expense of considerably longer computational times.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了从空间不规则采样的粒子跟踪测速数据中估计波数谱的不同方法。作者利用Kolmogorov流的直接数值模拟生成参考二维速度场，并通过随机布置示踪粒子合成PTV数据。论文比较了非均匀离散傅里叶变换、插值后快速傅里叶变换、基于物理信息神经网络的网格化估计以及模糊槽相关技术等四类估计器，重点考察其期望和方差或稳定性表现。

articles.title: Short-time solution heat treatment of recycled A383 HPDC alloy: microstructure–property relationships and ensemble machine learning analysis
articles.title_zh: 再生A383高压压铸合金的短时固溶热处理：显微组织—性能关系与集成机器学习分析
articles.abstract: Recycled A383 (Al–Si–Cu) high-pressure die-casting (HPDC) alloys offer significant material cost advantages but contain elevated Fe-rich intermetallics and complex porosity distributions that complicate conventional heat treatment. In this study, blister-free short-time solution heat treatment (SHT) was systematically performed on recycled A383 HPDC alloy at 490°C for 15–180 min to establish the microstructure–property evolution and identify the optimal processing window. Porosity measurements confirmed that all specimens remained within the blister-free regime throughout the investigated SHT duration range. Apparent kinetic analysis using Avrami-type models applied to hardness and electrical conductivity data revealed a two-stage softening and solute redistribution behavior, with a transition at approximately 90 min. Quantitative image analysis demonstrated progressive fragmentation and spheroidization of eutectic Si, with aspect ratio decreasing from 4.0 (as-cast) to 1.9 after 15 min, followed by gradual coarsening at longer times. EDS line-scan profiles confirmed substantial Cu homogenization within the α-Al dendrites by 90 min, approaching a near-steady-state distribution. Tensile testing showed that UTS decreased from 316 MPa (as-cast) to 287 MPa, YS from 162 MPa to 124 MPa, and elongation increased from 4.6% to 14.7% after SHT for 120 min. The pronounced strength reduction and ductility enhancement observed between 90 and 120 min are attributable to enhanced Si spheroidization and a transition in Cu redistribution kinetics, as supported by microstructural evidence. To complement the experimental findings, four tree-based regression models—decision tree (DT), random forest (RF), AdaBoost, and XGBoost—were applied as interpretive tools to analyze time-dependent trends within the studied dataset. Given the limited number of experimental conditions (n = 7), the models were employed for trend interpolation and processing-window identification within the investigated domain rather than for generalizable predictive capability. Among these, AdaBoost provided the most consistent representation of the experimental data, achieving R² values of 0.98, 0.96, and 0.84 for UTS, YS, and elongation, respectively. The ML analysis corroborated the optimal SHT range of 90–120 min at 490°C, reducing the conventional solutionizing duration by approximately 80% while maintaining a favorable strength–ductility balance suitable for lightweight automotive and electronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对再生A383（Al–Si–Cu）高压压铸合金中富Fe金属间化合物和复杂孔隙对热处理的影响，在490°C下开展15–180 min短时固溶处理，以确定无鼓泡条件下的组织与性能演化规律。结果显示，试样在所考察时间范围内均保持无鼓泡；硬度和电导率的Avrami型动力学分析揭示约90 min处存在两阶段软化与溶质再分布转变。图像分析和EDS线扫表明，共晶Si快速碎化、球化并在长时间后粗化，Cu在α-Al枝晶内于约90 min趋于均匀化。

articles.title: Contributions of Water Surface Area and Evaporation Intensity to Long- Term Reservoir Evaporation Loss Changes Across China
articles.title_zh: 中国水库长期蒸发损失变化中水面面积与蒸发强度的贡献
articles.abstract: Reservoir evaporation is an operationally important but often under-accounted water loss because evaporation volume depends jointly on exposed water surface area and evaporation intensity. We quantified reservoir evaporation loss across China from 1984 to 2020 using monthly Res-CN records for 3,168 high-quality reservoirs. Annual evaporation loss, water surface area, and evaporation intensity were derived from monthly data; reservoir-level trends were assessed with the Mann-Kendall test and Sen’s slope; long-term loss changes were decomposed into area and intensity effects; and Elastic Net plus LightGBM models were used to identify dominant predictors. Reservoir evaporation showed strong spatial heterogeneity and a summer-dominant seasonal cycle, with July as the peak month for 2,031 reservoirs (64.1%) and June for 706 reservoirs (22.3%). Annual evaporation loss increased significantly in 1,764 reservoirs (55.7%), while trends in evaporation intensity and water surface area were more heterogeneous. The decomposition showed that evaporation intensity contributed 57.0% of long-term evaporation-loss change on average, exceeding the area contribution of 43.0%; among reservoirs with increasing loss, the intensity contribution was 57.8%. Machine-learning models reproduced spatial variation in evaporation loss with high skill (R2 = 0.954 for the log-transformed target), and identified reference evapotranspiration, reservoir area, topography, temperature, and sunshine as key predictors. These results indicate that limiting water surface expansion alone is insufficient: evaporation-aware reservoir management in China must also account for changing atmospheric demand on existing reservoir surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用1984—2020年中国3168座高质量水库的月尺度Res-CN数据，估算年蒸发损失、水面面积和蒸发强度，并通过Mann-Kendall检验、Sen斜率、因素分解及机器学习模型分析其变化驱动。结果显示，中国水库蒸发具有显著空间差异和以夏季为主的季节循环，多数水库蒸发峰值出现在7月或6月。长期变化中，55.7%的水库年蒸发损失显著增加，平均而言蒸发强度贡献约57.0%，高于水面面积贡献的43.0%。

articles.title: Integrating Lichen Community Structure and Lead (Pb) Bioaccumulation to Assess Atmospheric Pollution Across Anthropogenic Landscape in Sleman, Indonesia
articles.title_zh: 整合地衣群落结构与铅生物累积评估印度尼西亚斯莱曼人为景观中的大气污染
articles.abstract: Anthropogenic activities have the potential to alter air quality, necessitating efficient biological monitoring systems. Lichens serve as biomonitors for atmospheric pollution due to their structural properties and sensitivity to environmental stressors. However, integrative studies combining community structure and heavy metal bioaccumulation in tropical regions are still very limited. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of anthropogenic landscape gradients on epiphytic lichen community structure and determine the lead (Pb) bioaccumulation capacity of local lichen species in Sleman Regency, Indonesia. A stratified random sampling design was applied in three anthropogenic zones: Station 1 (Urban Traffic), Station 2 (High Elevation), and Station 3 (Industrial Zone), using three host tree species ( Polyalthia longifolia , Mangifera indica , and Roystonea regia ). Lichen community structure was analyzed using ecological indices and Canonical Correspondence Analysis (CCA). Pb concentrations in lichen thallus were measured using Inductively Coupled Plasma–Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS), and pollution severity was evaluated through Contamination Factor (CF). Twelve lichen species from eleven genera were identified. Traffic pressure acted as an ecological filter, resulting in a very simple community dominated exclusively by tolerant forms of leprose ( Lepraria finkii and L. lobificans ), while the sensitive species ( Phlyctis argena ) was restricted to the high elevation area. Host tree architecture significantly modulated lichen diversity, with P. longifolia supporting the highest diversity (H' = 2.211). CCA confirmed that particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10) and ambient temperature were the main driving forces shaping community distribution (p < 0.01). Chemical analysis showed a strong positive correlation between internal Pb concentration and CF values (r = 0.89; p < 0.001). Flavoparmelia caperata (7.27 mg/kg) and Graphis scriptaa (6.96 mg/kg) exhibited the highest bioaccumulation capacity and were categorized as "High Contamination" (CF > 0.3). Anthropogenic landscape gradients significantly disrupted lichen communities and accelerated heavy metal accumulation. The integration of ecological community metrics and CF indices serves as a robust and low-cost nature-based solution for high-resolution urban air quality monitoring in tropical ecosystems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在印度尼西亚斯莱曼县不同人为活动梯度下，结合附生地衣群落结构与铅（Pb）生物累积能力评估大气污染。研究在城市交通区、高海拔区和工业区开展分层随机采样，并以多种寄主树为基质，采用生态指数、典范对应分析和ICP-MS测定地衣体内Pb含量。结果表明，地衣群落组成与Pb累积可共同反映不同人为景观下的大气污染差异，为热带地区生物监测提供了综合方法。

articles.title: Natural and anthropogenic controls on sediment geochemistry in tropical floodplain lakes of Central Kalimantan, Indonesia
articles.title_zh: 印度尼西亚中加里曼丹热带洪泛平原湖泊沉积物地球化学的自然与人为控制因素
articles.abstract: Three oxbow and one backwater lakes located within tropical floodplains of the Kayahan-Rungan river system, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, were studied geochemically to assess the extent and distinguish provenience of heavy metal pollution (i.e., distribution of elements and identification of key geochemical processes controlling their association) in their sediments. For this purpose, 5 sediment cores were taken and studied using the Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry method, followed by statistical data treatment. Physicochemical parameters of water (temperature, pH, oxidation–reduction potential, electrical conductivity, dissolved oxygen, total dissolved solids, salinity, transparency) were measured in situ using portable tools and Secchi discs. Most elements occur at normal levels, comparable to average worldwide lacustrine sediment values. Bismuth (0.1–0.3 ppm, geometric mean of 0.21 ppm), Hg (0.02–0.24; 0.09 ppm), Se, Co (0.2–14; 1.8), Sc (0.5–12; 3.3), and Th (0.2–6.2; 1.7), and to a lesser extent V, Fe, La, As, Pb, Cu, Cd, and Sb are (locally) found elevated. Some of those elements are also typical constituents of Mid-Bornean hydrothermal ore mineralization systems, while others (Sc, Th, V, La, Fe) are naturally enriched in lateritic soils. A single Hg anomaly concerns a site located at a mouth of a channel connecting one of the lakes with the Rungan river, thus proving movement of known riverine anomalies caused by the local artisanal gold mining. However, Hg is immobilized via co-deposition with selenium, in the form of HgSe (tiemannite). Natural (detrital/weathering) and anthropogenic (i.a., mining) processes comprise the mixed geochemical background of the sediments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究对中加里曼丹Kayahan-Rungan河系热带洪泛平原中的三处牛轭湖和一处回水湖沉积物开展地球化学分析，以评估重金属污染程度并区分其来源。研究采集5根沉积岩芯，采用ICP-MS测定元素含量，并结合现场水体理化参数和统计分析识别关键地球化学过程。多数元素含量接近全球湖泊沉积物平均水平，但Bi、Hg、Se、Co、Sc、Th及部分V、Fe、La、As、Pb、Cu、Cd、Sb等元素在局部升高，可能与中婆罗洲热液矿化体系及人为活动共同相关。

articles.title: β-Hydroxybutyrate maintains energetically demanding neural functions during glucose deprivation
articles.title_zh: β-羟基丁酸在葡萄糖缺乏时维持高能耗神经功能
articles.abstract: Ketone bodies are a major source of cerebral energy during fasting and the ketogenic diet, but whether they can independently sustain brain tissue metabolism when glucose is absent remains uncertain. This question is difficult to resolve in vivo because circulating glucose is maintained, even during starvation, through endogenous production. We therefore used an ex vivo brain preparation to examine the metabolic capacity of tissue supplied with β-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) as the only exogenous fuel, isolating brain tissue from the primary endogenous glucose sources. Mitochondrial function was monitored following prolonged exposure to glucose-free, BHB-rich artificial cerebrospinal fluid, and tissue resilience was tested by inducing spreading depolarization, a severe energetic challenge that requires rapid restoration of ionic and metabolic homeostasis. Following acute reliance on BHB, mitochondria appeared to dynamically regulate electron transfer system function, utilizing lower O2 flux, while maintaining sufficient energetic reserves to preserve tissue ability to generate and recover from repeated spreading depolarizations. These findings demonstrate that BHB can independently maintain essential metabolic and functional properties of brain tissue in the absence of exogenous glucose. The results broaden our understanding of cerebral fuel flexibility and provide additional support for the use of ketogenic strategies in neurological disorders where tissue excitability, energy metabolism, or glucose availability may be altered.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用离体脑组织模型，在排除体内内源性葡萄糖补充影响的条件下，考察β-羟基丁酸（BHB）能否作为唯一外源燃料维持脑组织代谢。研究将组织长期暴露于无葡萄糖、富含BHB的人工脑脊液中，并通过诱发扩布性去极化测试其能量应激恢复能力。结果表明，在急性依赖BHB时，线粒体可动态调节电子传递系统、降低氧通量，同时维持足够能量储备，使组织仍能产生并从反复扩布性去极化中恢复。

articles.title: Nearly isotropic superconducting property revealed in trilayer nickelate
articles.title_zh: 三层镍酸盐中揭示近各向同性超导性质
articles.abstract: A research team led by Prof. Zhang Jinglei from Hefei Institutes of Physical Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, found that the trilayer nickelate La4Ni3O10-δ exhibits a nearly isotropic upper critical field under high pressure. This finding provides important experimental insight into the superconducting mechanism of nickel-based materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了中国科学院合肥物质科学研究院张敬雷教授团队关于三层镍酸盐La4Ni3O10-δ的高压超导研究。研究发现该材料在高压下表现出近各向同性的上临界场，为理解镍基材料的超导机制提供了重要实验线索。

articles.title: Laser pulses capture unexplored polaronic states
articles.title_zh: 激光脉冲捕获未被探索的极化子态
articles.abstract: In an international experiment, researchers observed Jahn–Teller polarons—quasiparticles that could play an important role in future ultrafast spintronic devices. These polarons emerged within the crystal lattice of cobalt oxide that had been activated by carefully tailored laser pulses.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一项国际实验，研究人员通过精心设计的激光脉冲激发氧化钴晶格，并观察到Jahn–Teller极化子。此类准粒子可能在未来超快自旋电子器件中发挥重要作用，相关发现有助于理解光驱动晶格与自旋相关态的形成机制。

articles.title: Scientists develop predictive roadmap to boost performance in next-gen spintronics
articles.title_zh: 科学家开发预测性路线图以提升下一代自旋电子器件性能
articles.abstract: Chiral 2D metal halide perovskites (MHPs) are among the most promising materials for future technologies that exploit the spin of electrons in spin-based optoelectronics, or spintronics, but getting them to perform consistently has proven difficult. Now scientists at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (Berkeley Lab) have developed a data-driven approach that identifies and models key synthesis parameters to optimize their performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道关注手性二维金属卤化物钙钛矿在自旋光电子学和自旋电子学中的应用潜力，以及其性能稳定性难以控制的问题。劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室研究团队提出一种数据驱动方法，用于识别并建模关键合成参数，从而为优化材料性能提供预测性路线图。

articles.title: Toric code made subsystem: a framework for topological subsystem codes using anticommuting quantum spin liquids
articles.title_zh: 将环面码子系统化：利用反对易量子自旋液体构建拓扑子系统码的框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a framework of constructing topological subsystem codes based on the class of anticommuting quantum spin liquids described in [Phys. Rev. B 113, 064402 (2026)]. A canonical model from this class can be considered as a spatial modification of the toric code that voids its stabilizer code property. Rather, these models contain an extensive set of anticommuting local conserved operators that lead to an extensive ground state degeneracy. This degeneracy forms the basis of the subsystem degrees of freedom in the associated quantum error correcting code. The code inherits the many-body topological order of the quantum spin liquid, making it a topological subsystem code. We present two concrete and detailed examples for constructing these codes on a square lattice and a kagome lattice geometry, requiring weight-4 and weight-3 local check operator measurements respectively. In contrast to other subsystem codes, a unique property of these codes is the presence of an extensive number of local gauge qubits that are left undisturbed by the check operators apart from the logical qubits. Our construction provides a template for generating this new category of topological subsystem codes on different lattice or graph geometries, suitable for implementation on various quantum hardware platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种基于反对易量子自旋液体构建拓扑子系统量子纠错码的框架。作者将一类模型视为对环面码的空间改造，其不再是稳定子码，而是包含大量反对易局域守恒算符，并由此产生广延基态简并，作为子系统自由度的基础。论文给出正方晶格和 kagome 晶格上的两个具体构造，分别需要权重4和权重3的局域校验算符测量，并指出该类码具有大量不受校验算符扰动的局域规范量子比特。

articles.title: Odd-parity electronic order near the semiconductor limit
articles.title_zh: 接近半导体极限的奇宇称电子有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying materials platforms in which dilute carriers experience strong Coulomb interactions is a central challenge in the search for interaction-driven quantum phases. In such systems, weak carrier screening can promote a variety of collective instabilities beyond the conventional Fermi liquid paradigm, including superconductivity, Wigner crystallization, and odd-parity electronic order. Experimental realizations of such dilute, strongly interacting electronic systems remain rare in crystalline materials. Here we report a spontaneous odd-parity phase transition in the phosphide semiconductor family LnCd₃P₃ (Ln = La, Ce, Pr, Nd). Using optical second harmonic generation, we observe the onset of bulk inversion and rotational symmetry breaking accompanied by the emergence of an in-plane polar axis. Second harmonic microscopy reveals three domain variants related by 120ⁱ̧rc rotations, while ultrafast transient reflectivity measurements uncover a pronounced electronic reconstruction across the transition. Remarkably, the ordered phase appears only in lightly self-hole-doped compounds and is absent in insulating SmCd₃P₃, indicating an essential role for itinerant carriers despite their extremely low concentration. Guided by density functional theory, we develop a four-band model of the valence states and show that modest interactions can stabilize odd-parity electronic order. The resulting phase combines a spontaneous Fermi surface distortion with a momentum-dependent bilayer polarization that breaks inversion symmetry. Our results establish a route to interaction-driven parity breaking in dilute-carrier semiconductors and identify honeycomb bilayer systems as a promising platform for odd-parity electronic phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了磷化物半导体族LnCd₃P₃（Ln = La、Ce、Pr、Nd）中的自发奇宇称相变，旨在探索稀疏载流子与强库仑相互作用并存的晶体材料平台。通过光学二次谐波产生，研究发现体反演对称性和旋转对称性破缺，并出现面内极轴；二次谐波显微成像显示存在三个由120°旋转相关的畴变体。超快瞬态反射测量进一步揭示相变伴随显著电子重构，且该有序相仅出现在轻微自空穴掺杂化合物中，而在绝缘SmCd₃P₃中缺失。
authors: Jack Tregidga, Dibyata Rout, Johannes Hielscher, Josiah Turner, Stephen D. Wilson, John W. Harter

articles.title: Non-ergodic dynamical phase transition via a zero-mode exceptional point in a non-Markov atomic Josephson junction
articles.title_zh: 非马尔可夫原子约瑟夫森结中由零模例外点诱导的非遍历动力学相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open quantum systems typically lose their initial memory due to the environmental decoherence resulting in thermalization. We demonstrate a striking breakdown of this paradigm in a head-to-tail Bose-Josephson junction, which is described by an intrinsically momentum-coupled Caldeira-Leggett model. Through exact non-Markov Langevin simulations, we discover a novel type of non-ergodic dynamical phase transitions into a running state, which has no counterpart in Markov limit. Crucially, we reveal that this transition is fundamentally governed by a zero-mode exceptional point emerging from the non-Markov friction. This topological origin is characterized by the winding of the response function. Finally, numerical quantum simulations of an equivalent driven XXZ spin chain confirm that this exceptional-point-induced signature robustly survives as a dynamical crossover against strong quantum fluctuations and the dynamical backreaction of the environment. This macroscopic robustness offers a promising platform for long-lived quantum memories in dissipative environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究头尾式Bose-Josephson结这一具有内禀动量耦合的Caldeira-Leggett模型，揭示开放量子系统中初态记忆丧失与热化范式的破缺。通过精确非马尔可夫Langevin模拟，作者发现一种进入运行态的非遍历动力学相变，在马尔可夫极限中没有对应物。研究指出该转变由非马尔可夫摩擦产生的零模例外点控制，其拓扑起源可由响应函数绕数表征；等效受驱XXZ自旋链的数值量子模拟表明，这一特征在强量子涨落和环境反作用下仍以动力学交叉形式稳健存在。

articles.title: Thermal Rectification from Size-Dependent Phonon Confinement in Nanoparticle Assemblies
articles.title_zh: 纳米颗粒组装体中由尺寸依赖声子限域产生的热整流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermal insulation remains an important technological challenge across the vast number of applications, from living quarters to quantum technology. Here, we exploit the size-dependent modification of the phonon density of states arising from phonon confinement in nanoparticles to fabricate a simple phonon rectifier. The smaller of the two connected nanoparticles imposes stronger phonon confinement leading to rectifying phonon transport. This concept is extended to the macroscale by constructing two overlapping layers of differently sized nanoparticles, thereby realizing a macroscopic phonon diode. Following the localized heat deposition by laser light, the temperature profiles across a phonon-diode were measured by infrared imaging. Although the rectifying strength is moderate, the abundance of optimization possibilities makes this method promising for ultra-low volume thermal insulation at both the nano- and macroscale
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用纳米颗粒中声子限域导致的声子态密度尺寸依赖变化，构建一种简单的声子热整流器。由于较小纳米颗粒产生更强声子限域，连接不同尺寸颗粒时可形成具有方向性的声子传输；这一概念进一步扩展为由不同尺寸纳米颗粒重叠层组成的宏观声子二极管。研究通过激光局域加热和红外成像测量温度分布，虽热整流强度中等，但该方法在纳米与宏观尺度超低体积热绝缘方面具有优化潜力。
authors: Megan J. Farrington, David J. Wasserman, Eden R. Josza, Alessandro Podestà, Alessio Zaccone, Mariia Sidorova, Alexej D. Semenov, Nicola Ludwig, Marcel Di Vece

articles.title: Controlled chemical vapor deposition for synthesis of emerging Mo(W)Te2 systems
articles.title_zh: 用于合成新兴 Mo(W)Te2 体系的可控化学气相沉积方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Group-VI transition metal ditellurides offer a rich platform for correlated and topological phenomena, yet their structural polymorphism and instability complicate the creation of single crystals and heterointerfaces. Here, we introduce a confined-space chemical vapor deposition (CVD) strategy that lowers the growth temperature window and, when combined with tailored precursor configurations and stepwise thermal ramps, enables the deterministic synthesis of high-quality single crystals, alloys, and lateral/vertical heterostructures. High-resolution aberration-corrected STEM provides atomic characterization of lattice-matched Mo(W)Te2 lateral heterostructure, revealing nearly atomically sharp, compositionally well-defined seamless boundaries. This approach avoids the thickness nonuniformity and structural limitations commonly associated with exfoliated samples, enabling reproducible fabrication of clean heterointerfaces and establishing a nearly ideal in-situ experimental system. Furthermore, scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM and STS) enable direct imaging of the seamless boundaries in Mo(W)Te2 lateral heterostructures, while uncovering their distinct real-space distributions of the local density of states. Our results establish a scalable pathway for engineering crystalline Te-based structures with controlled geometry and stacking, providing an essential step toward quantum and topological device platforms based on the transition metal ditellurides family.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种受限空间化学气相沉积策略，通过降低生长温度窗口，并结合定制化前驱体配置与分步升温，实现高质量单晶、合金以及横向/纵向异质结构的确定性合成。像差校正 STEM 表明，晶格匹配的 Mo(W)Te2 横向异质结构具有近原子级锐利、成分清晰且无缝的界面。该方法避免了机械剥离样品常见的厚度不均和结构限制，为可重复制备洁净异质界面及原位研究相关拓扑和关联现象提供了平台。
authors: Ya Deng, Zi-Yi Han, Yao Wu, Kongyang Yi, Ya-Ning Ren, Dundong Yuan, Chao Zhu, Lin He, Zheng Liu

articles.title: HF Etching and Silanization: Evidence for the Role of Surface Hydroxyl Groups in Silicon Nitride Resonator Loss
articles.title_zh: HF 刻蚀与硅烷化：表面羟基在氮化硅谐振器损耗中的作用证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon nitride SiNₓ nanomechanical resonators are central to sensing, quantum technologies, and fundamental physics experiments due to their exceptional mechanical quality factors (Q). However, as resonator thickness approaches the nano-scale, surface-related dissipation limits performance. Here, we investigate the role of surface chemistry in low-stress Si-rich SiNx membranes through a combination of hydrofluoric acid (HF) etching and trimethylchlorosilane (TMCS) silanization, correlated with surface characterization and mechanical measurements. Preliminary analysis by TEM-EELS, XPS, RBS/ERDA, and XRR reveals a native oxide surface layer (1-2 nm). Surface modification by HF and TMCS was subsequently evaluated using XPS, photothermal FTIR, contact-angle measurements, and intrinsic quality factor (Qᵢₙₜ) characterization. While HF etching effectively removes the native oxide and TMCS introduces hydrophobic Si-(CH₃₎₃ termination, neither oxide thickness nor surface energy correlates with mechanical dissipation. TMCS treatments produce the largest enhancements, increasing Qᵢₙₜ by up to 50%, whereas HF etching alone yields lower gains of 20-25%. These findings suggest surface hydroxyl groups as a key contributor to energy loss in SiNₓ resonators and demonstrate that chemical functionalization can substantially suppress surface dissipation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究低应力富硅 SiNx 纳米机械谐振器中表面化学对机械耗散的影响，结合 HF 刻蚀、TMCS 硅烷化以及多种表面与力学表征手段。初步分析显示样品存在约 1–2 nm 的天然氧化层；HF 可去除该氧化层，TMCS 则引入疏水的 Si-(CH3)3 端基。结果表明，氧化层厚度和表面能与机械耗散并不直接相关，而 TMCS 处理可显著提高本征品质因数，提示表面羟基等化学基团可能是限制性能的重要因素。
authors: Ariane Giesriegl, Nicola Cavalleri, Robert West, Antonius Armanious, Markus Sauer, Thomas Schachinger, Silvan Schmid

articles.title: Finite temperature precursors of Mottness in the Fermi Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 费米 Hubbard 模型中有限温度下 Mott 性的前驱现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27204v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate finite-temperature precursors of Mottness in the repulsive Hubbard model above the spin-ordering temperature, using numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo. We show that the finite-temperature crossover is accompanied by a pronounced suppression of charge fluctuations, despite the presence of a gapless single-particle spectra, demonstrating that Mottness first emerges via two-particle response in an anomalous metallic regime, before appearing in single-particle spectral functions. We further show that a gap formation in the density of states occurs through momentum-resolved redistribution of spectral weight across the Brillouin zone, that begins at the onset of anomalous metallic regime, rather than through gap formation in single-particle spectral functions at individual momenta. Upon doping, the anomalous-metallic regime generates transport and spectroscopic signatures characteristic of doped Mott insulators. This shows that the transport and spectroscopic anomalies of the doped Hubbard model do not require the presence of a fully formed Mott insulator at half-filling, but instead originate from the strong charge-response renormalization and spectral-weight redistribution that develop within the precursor anomalous metallic regime at half-filling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡罗方法，考察排斥 Hubbard 模型在自旋有序温度以上的有限温度 Mott 性前驱。作者发现，在单粒子谱仍无能隙的异常金属区，电荷涨落已显著受抑，说明 Mott 性首先体现在两粒子响应中。进一步分析显示，态密度能隙的形成源于布里渊区内动量分辨谱权重的重新分布；掺杂后，该异常金属区可产生类似掺杂 Mott 绝缘体的输运和谱学异常。
authors: Sayantan Roy, Abhisek Samanta, Nandini Trivedi

articles.title: Proactivity and pinning in the non-reciprocal XY model with vision anisotropy
articles.title_zh: 具有视觉各向异性的非互易 XY 模型中的主动性与钉扎
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a non-reciprocal XY model on a square lattice, in which spins interact with their nearest neighbors through vision-induced anisotropic interaction. Such anisotropy breaks rotational symmetry and leads to the pinning of the spin orientation along preferred lattice directions. We systematically characterize this phenomenon for different interaction kernels, including modulated, sinusoidal, von Mises, and hard vision-cone couplings, and for two classes of microscopic update rules: Glauber and Langevin dynamics. A central result of this work is the identification and detailed analysis of two distinct contributions that naturally arise in the Langevin formulation, which we refer to as the reactive and the proactive term. We derive the corresponding equations governing both local fluctuations and the global orientation, and use them to characterize the mechanisms responsible for directional pinning. We show that both reactive and proactive contributions can generate global pinning, whereas their role in determining local pinning depends on the specific interaction kernel and may differ qualitatively. Our analysis clarifies the distinction between local and global pinning, explains the emergence of preferred lattice directions in the different models considered, and reconciles apparent discrepancies reported in previous studies. More generally, it provides a microscopic framework for understanding lattice-induced orientational selection in non-reciprocal XY models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究平方晶格上的非互易 XY 模型，其中自旋通过由视觉机制诱导的各向异性交互作用与近邻耦合，从而打破旋转对称性并导致自旋取向沿特定晶格方向钉扎。作者系统比较了多种相互作用核以及 Glauber 与 Langevin 两类微观更新动力学。研究重点识别了 Langevin 表述中自然出现的“反应性”和“主动性”两种贡献，并分析它们在局域涨落、整体取向和方向钉扎机制中的不同作用。
authors: Gabriele Bandini, Asja Jelic, Andrea Gambassi

articles.title: Exact subsystem dynamics in the deterministic Floquet-PXP model
articles.title_zh: 确定性 Floquet-PXP 模型中的精确子系统动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dynamics of local subsystems in a thermodynamically large quantum many-body system can be understood as effectively open as the system produces its own effective bath. The action of this bath can be characterised in terms of the so-called influence matrices. In generic situations, the complexity of these objects grows unfavourably with time, however, there exist solvable cases where influence matrices can be characterised exactly even in the presence of non-trivial interactions. Here we show that Rule 201, a deterministic version of the Floquet-PXP model, is one of these solvable instances. Indeed, it admits influence matrices given by a finite-dimensional matrix-product operator (MPO) that solves a finite set of algebraic conditions. We provide the solution, and characterise multi-time autocorrelation functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论热力学极限量子多体系统中局域子系统的有效开放动力学，并用影响矩阵刻画系统自身形成的有效热浴作用。作者证明，Floquet-PXP 模型的确定性版本 Rule 201 属于可精确求解的情形，其影响矩阵可由有限维矩阵乘积算符表示，并满足一组有限代数条件。文中给出相应解，并刻画了多时间自相关函数。

articles.title: Complex frequency-dependent quadrature squeezing in semiconductor lasers
articles.title_zh: 半导体激光器中的复杂频率依赖正交压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26266v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a comprehensive study of quadrature squeezing in a quantum well laser based on a fully quantum Langevin approach. We compute the frequency-resolved squeezing map of the laser field and identify optimal squeezing curves, revealing, for the first time to our knowledge, both frequency-dependent squeezing and complex or hidden squeezing in a semiconductor laser. We further analyse the role of the linewidth enhancement factor (alpha factor) in the emergence of these features. Our results establish semiconductor lasers as a platform for the generation of non-classical light and open new perspectives for their application in quantum communication and sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作基于全量子 Langevin 方法，对量子阱激光器中的正交压缩进行系统研究。作者计算了激光场的频率分辨压缩图，并识别出最优压缩曲线，揭示了半导体激光器中的频率依赖压缩以及复杂或隐藏压缩现象。研究还分析了线宽增强因子在这些特征形成中的作用，表明半导体激光器可作为产生非经典光的潜在平台。
authors: Daniele Nello, Giuseppe Patera, Lorenzo Columbo

articles.title: Dissipation-Induced Deviations from Kibble-Zurek Scaling in Non-Hermitian Quantum Annealing
articles.title_zh: 非厄米量子退火中耗散诱导的 Kibble-Zurek 标度偏离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26870v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We revisit the quantum annealing problem in the non-Hermitian transverse-field Ising model. We determine, both analytically and numerically, the intrinsic transition probabilities and the resulting defect density. Our results reveal that, unlike the Hermitian case where defect production is dominated by modes near the gap-closing point, the non-Hermitian dynamics involve significant contributions from broad momentum sectors. We find that, depending on the dissipation strength, the defect density exhibits standard Kibble-Zurek scaling, anti-Kibble-Zurek behavior, and a suppression faster than the Kibble-Zurek prediction. We demonstrate that these deviations from the standard Kibble-Zurek scaling can be understood in terms of the underlying excitation probabilities. Specifically, the fast decay of the defect density originates from a vanishing excitation probability spanning a range of annealing times across all allowed modes, even at the gap-closing points. In contrast, the anti-Kibble-Zurek behavior arises from supplementary excitations facilitated by dissipation over a broad range of allowed modes, particularly those situated away from the gap-closing region.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究重新考察非厄米横场 Ising 模型中的量子退火问题，并通过解析与数值方法求得本征跃迁概率及由此产生的缺陷密度。结果显示，与厄米情形中缺陷主要来自能隙闭合点附近模式不同，非厄米动力学会从更宽的动量区间获得显著贡献。随耗散强度变化，缺陷密度可表现出标准 Kibble-Zurek 标度、反 Kibble-Zurek 行为以及比 Kibble-Zurek 预言更快的抑制，原因可追溯到各动量模式激发概率的不同结构。
authors: H. Najafzadeh, S. Sadeghizade, R. Jafari, A. Langari

articles.title: Quantum statistics on atom-ion Feshbach resonances
articles.title_zh: 原子-离子 Feshbach 共振中的量子统计效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26995v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate three-body recombination in a hybrid atom-ion system consisting of a single trapped Ba⁺ ion immersed in a two-component Fermi gas of Li atoms near an atom-ion Feshbach resonance. By tuning the spin composition at constant density and temperature, we isolate the role of quantum statistics in atom-atom-ion collisions. The measured ion loss rate exhibits a pronounced nonlinear dependence on spin polarization, revealing a reduced contribution of recombination pathways involving identical fermions already at the level of experimental observables. The observations are consistent with a two-step recombination picture and an adiabatic hyperspherical approach, where antisymmetrization restricts the available entrance channels and gives rise to interference between indistinguishable recombination pathways. Our work establishes atom-ion systems as a platform for controlling three-body collisions via quantum statistics and demonstrates that exchange-symmetry effects remain robust even under thermal averaging that obscures the underlying threshold-law behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在由单个俘获 Ba+ 离子和双组分 Li 费米气体构成的混合原子-离子体系中，考察接近原子-离子 Feshbach 共振时的三体复合。通过在恒定密度和温度下调节自旋组分，作者分离出量子统计在原子-原子-离子碰撞中的作用。测得的离子损失率对自旋极化呈显著非线性依赖，表明涉及相同费米子的复合通道受到抑制；结果与两步复合图像和绝热超球方法相符。
authors: Joachim Siemund, Fabian Thielemann, Jonathan Grieshaber, Wei Wu, Patrick Mullan, Panagiotis Giannakeas, Krzysztof Jachymski, Tobias Schaetz

articles.title: Observation of Non-Hermitian Skin Dynamics in the Liouvillian Regime
articles.title_zh: Liouvillian 区域中非厄米皮肤动力学的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27043v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open quantum systems generally do not perfectly preserve phase coherence: coupling to uncontrolled environments requires a density-matrix description based on the Liouvillian framework beyond pure-state wave evolution. Realizing and probing such dynamics in a programmable platform is therefore essential for connecting coherent physics to realistic dissipative settings. Here we implement a tunable open-system quantum walk in a photonic mesh lattice, where controlled phase noise produces adjustable dephasing and non-reciprocal gain-loss imbalance provides an independently tunable non-Hermitian drive. This allows us to continuously interpolate between coherent quantum walks and incoherent classical walks, and to observe how directional transport evolves in the Liouvillian regime. Using non-Hermitian skin dynamics as a probe, we measure the center-of-mass drift over both the coherence and non-Hermiticity parameters, revealing a crossover from coherence-enhanced to decoherence-enhanced transport in quantitative agreement with quantum-channel simulations. We further program spatial and temporal interfaces to demonstrate interface accumulation and a long-time drift governed by the instantaneous channel. Our results establish a controllable photonic platform for simulating open quantum dynamics and show that decoherence can actively reshape non-Hermitian transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在光子网格晶格中实现可调开放系统量子行走，通过受控相位噪声引入可调退相干，并通过非互易增益-损耗不平衡提供可独立调节的非厄米驱动。该平台可在相干量子行走与非相干经典行走之间连续过渡，并观测 Liouvillian 动力学下定向输运的演化。作者利用非厄米皮肤动力学作为探针，测量质心漂移随相干性和非厄米参数的变化，揭示了从相干增强输运到退相干增强输运的交叉行为。
authors: Shu Yang, Yeyang Sun, Lingrui Hong, Yi Yang

articles.title: Measurement-Induced Crossover of Quantum Jump Statistics in Postselection-Free Many-Body Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 无后选择多体动力学中测量诱导的量子跃迁统计交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.02418v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We reveal a nontrivial crossover of subsystem fluctuations of quantum jumps in continuously monitored many-body systems, which have a trivial maximally mixed state as a steady-state density matrix. While the fluctuations exhibit the standard volume law propto L following Poissonian statistics for sufficiently weak measurement strength, anomalous yet universal scaling law propto L^α :(αsim 2.7 up to L=20) indicating super-Poissonian statistics appears for strong measurement strength. This drastically affects the precision of estimating the rate of quantum jumps: for strong (weak) measurement, the estimation uncertainty is enhanced (suppressed) as the system size increases. We demonstrate that the anomalous scaling of the subsystem fluctuation originates from an integrated many-body autocorrelation function and that the transient dynamics contributes to the scaling law rather than the Liouvillian gap. The measurement-induced crossover is accessed only from the postselection-free information obtained from the time and the position of quantum jumps and can be tested in ultracold atom experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示连续监测多体系统中量子跃迁子系统涨落的非平凡交叉现象，尽管其稳态密度矩阵是平凡的最大混合态。弱测量下涨落遵循泊松统计的标准体积律，而强测量下出现超泊松统计的异常普适标度，从而显著影响量子跃迁率估计精度。作者指出该异常标度源于积分多体自相关函数，主要由瞬态动力学而非 Liouvillian 能隙决定，并且可通过无需后选择的跃迁时间和位置数据观测。

articles.title: Tomographic imaging of superconducting order using particle-hole interference
articles.title_zh: 利用粒子-空穴干涉对超导序进行层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.16168v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconducting phases with exotic symmetries that differ from the underlying crystalline lattice are at the focus of superconductivity research. Yet, despite intense interest, detecting the order parameter symmetry and topology remains a major challenge. Real-space imaging near atomic impurities with scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) has been highly successful in revealing nodes of the superconducting gap, in particular in cuprate superconductors, however the order parameter phase winding has so far remained inaccessible by STM techniques. We demonstrate that STM can access this phase information by exploiting Young-type quasiparticle interference patterns generated by pairs of impurities acting as beam splitters. Superconducting order parameter tomography (SOPT), a technique proposed here, utilizes the response of real-space interference patterns of Bogoliubov quasiparticles to the controlled rotation of impurity configurations, allowing us to reconstruct the momentum space structure of the gap function Δ(ěck). As a concrete example, we consider Strontium Ruthenate, whose superconducting order remains a subject of ongoing debate, and demonstrate how SOPT can distinguish between competing order parameter candidates. The Young's interference fringes, nodal directions, and rotating beams, detected by SOPT, encode information about both the nodes and phase winding of the superconducting order parameter. This method provides a broadly applicable route to identifying unconventional and topological superconductivity and establishes particle-hole interference as a new imaging modality for superconducting order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种超导序参量层析成像方法，利用成对杂质作为类似 Young 干涉的准粒子分束器，使扫描隧道显微镜能够获取超导序参量的相位信息。通过控制杂质构型旋转并分析 Bogoliubov 准粒子实空间干涉图样的响应，可重建动量空间中的能隙函数结构。作者以钌酸锶为例说明该方法的适用性，该材料的超导序性质仍存在争议。
authors: Archisman Panigrahi, Vladislav Poliakov, Leonid Levitov

articles.title: Bosonization and Kramers-Wannier dualities in general dimensions
articles.title_zh: 一般维度中的玻色化与 Kramers-Wannier 对偶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.20167v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It is well known that the noninteracting Majorana chain is dual to the one-dimensional transverse-field Ising model, either through the Jordan-Wigner transformation or by gauging fermion parity. In this correspondence, the minimal translation of the Majorana chain maps to the celebrated Kramers-Wannier (KW) duality of the spin model, with the critical point mapped to the self-dual point. In this work, we generalize this mapping to two and higher dimensions by constructing a unitary equivalence between the parity-gauged fermionic system and a spin system defined on arbitrary polyhedral decompositions of space. Imposing the flatness condition on the gauge field yields a bosonization duality between the original (ungauged) fermionic system and a gauged spin system obeying a Gauss law. The dependence of the Gauss law in the spin system on the Kasteleyn orientation (and the discrete spin structure) of the fermionic system is made explicit. Applying this bosonization to one or two copies of Majorana fermions on translationally invariant lattices, we derive higher-dimensional analogs of KW (self-)dualities in spin systems arising from fermionic minimal translations. The KW (self-)dualities are non-invertible due to projections onto eigenspaces of higher-form symmetries in the associated symmetry operators. The bosonization framework we present is intuitive, general, and systematic, encompassing other known exact bosonization methods while offering a novel approach to establish new connections between fermionic and spin systems in arbitrary dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将 Majorana 链与一维横场 Ising 模型之间的已知对偶关系推广到二维及更高维。作者在任意空间多面体分解上构造了费米子宇称规范化系统与自旋系统之间的酉等价，并在施加规范场平坦性条件后得到原始费米系统与满足 Gauss 定律的规范化自旋系统之间的玻色化对偶。文中明确了自旋系统 Gauss 定律对 Kasteleyn 定向和离散自旋结构的依赖，并由此推导出高维自旋系统中的 Kramers-Wannier 型自对偶。

articles.title: Free-Fermion Measurement-Induced Volume- to Area-Law Entanglement Transition in the Presence of Fermion Interactions
articles.title_zh: 存在费米子相互作用时自由费米子测量诱导的体律到面积律纠缠转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.23706v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: At a generic volume- to area-law entanglement transition in a many-body system, quantum chaos is arrested. We argue that this tends to imply the vanishing of a certain "mass" term in the field theory of the measurement-induced phase transition (MIPT) for monitored, interacting fermions. To explore this idea, we consider the MIPT with no conserved quantities that describes 1D monitored, interacting Majorana fermions in class DIII. This is the most general problem of interacting fermions with weak fermion parity measurements. Without interactions, it is known that a noninteracting MIPT separates the area-law phase from a log-enhanced "thermal metal" phase at sufficiently weak monitoring. We conjecture that the MIPT with interactions is the same as the noninteracting one in this case; the volume-law phase arises through the dangerously irrelevant mass. The physical picture is that the mass represents a local Fermi's golden rule interparticle scattering rate density that is tantamount to the entangling rate density. The latter must vanish continuously at a continuous MIPT. On the other hand, the field theory capturing the MIPT for monitored fermions with additional continuous symmetries is expected to be different, because the interactions introduce additional terms associated to conserved Noether currents. We propose numerical tests of our conjecture. In addition, we analytically identify a candidate noninteracting critical point representing the MIPT, using a controlled ϵ-expansion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究受监测相互作用费米子体系中的测量诱导相变，重点讨论一维 DIII 类相互作用 Majorana 费米子的体律到面积律纠缠转变。作者提出，在连续的测量诱导相变处，与局域粒子散射率和纠缠生成率相关的场论“质量”项应连续消失，并猜想相互作用情形的临界行为可与无相互作用相变相同。体律相则被解释为由危险无关质量项产生，体现了热化和纠缠增长在临界点附近被抑制的物理图像。
authors: Matthew S. Foster, Haoyu Guo, Chao-Ming Jian, Andreas W. W. Ludwig

articles.title: Thermal effects on density-modulated phases in a dipolar Bose--Einstein condensate
articles.title_zh: 偶极玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体中密度调制相的热效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.24419v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Density-modulated phases in dipolar Bose--Einstein condensates arise from the competition between contact repulsion, long-range dipole--dipole interactions, and beyond-mean-field fluctuations. We examine finite-temperature stationary states of a harmonically trapped dipolar Bose gas using a temperature-dependent extended Gross--Pitaevskii equation within the local-density approximation. In this framework, the thermal correction shifts some structural boundaries toward larger scattering lengths and changes the parameter region in which connected density-modulated states are obtained. The density contrast changes sharply at T = 0, whereas at finite temperature it varies more gradually, consistent with a smooth crossover-like evolution in the finite trapped system. We also use Leggett's bound to estimate a geometric upper limit on the possible superfluid response for representative density profiles. These results suggest that finite-temperature corrections can reshape pattern formation in dipolar quantum gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用局域密度近似下含温度修正的扩展 Gross–Pitaevskii 方程，考察谐振俘获偶极玻色气体的有限温度定态。结果表明，热修正会将部分结构边界推向更大的散射长度，并改变连通密度调制态出现的参数区域。有限温度下密度对比度的变化比零温时更平滑，符合有限俘获体系中类交叉演化的特征；作者还用 Leggett 上界估计了代表性密度分布的超流响应几何上限。
authors: Changjian Yu, Jinbin Li, Kui-Tian Xi

articles.title: Efficient computation of average subsystem Bures distance between fermionic Gaussian states
articles.title_zh: 费米高斯态平均子系统 Bures 距离的高效计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.09417v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The average subsystem trace distance has been proposed as an indicator of quantum many-body chaos and integrability. However, evaluating it presents two main difficulties: high computational cost for large systems and ambiguities in defining and ordering eigenstates in integrable systems. In this work, we develop an efficient algorithm to compute the Bures distance between fermionic Gaussian states, enabling access to larger system sizes. Using this method, we calculate the average subsystem Bures distance for eigenstates in the spin-1/2 transverse-field Ising chain and the Dirac fermion formulation of the quadratic Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (Dirac SYK₂₎ model, as well as for random pure fermionic Gaussian states. To handle degeneracy in the Ising chain, we consider simultaneous eigenstates of all local conserved charges and employ these charges to systematically order degenerate states. Our results are consistent with the earlier conjecture of a linear growth with subsystem size. We show that the distinct scaling of the average subsystem distances in chaotic versus integrable systems originates from discontinuities of local conserved charges across the spectrum in integrable models. For the Dirac SYK₂ model and random pure Gaussian states, we obtain similar results for the average subsystem distances, which do not show a linear increase.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种高效计算费米高斯态之间 Bures 距离的算法，以克服平均子系统迹距离在大体系中计算代价高、以及可积体系本征态定义和排序不明确的问题。作者将方法应用于横场 Ising 链、二次 Dirac SYK₂ 模型以及随机纯费米高斯态，并通过局域守恒荷处理 Ising 链中的简并本征态排序。结果支持平均子系统距离随子系统大小线性增长的早期猜想，并指出混沌与可积体系缩放差异源于局域守恒量的不连续性。
authors: Zhouhao Guo, M. A. Rajabpour, Jiaju Zhang

articles.title: Noninvertible Kramers-Wannier duality symmetries for the discrete-time quantum Ising chain
articles.title_zh: 离散时间量子 Ising 链的不可逆 Kramers–Wannier 对偶对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.03947v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Integrable trotterization} provides a method to evolve a continuous time integrable many-body system in discrete time, such that it retains its conserved quantities. Here we explicitly show that the first order trotterization of the critical it transverse field Ising model is integrable. The discrete time conserved quantities are obtained from an inhomogeneous transfer matrix constructed using the it quantum inverse scattering method. The inhomogeneity parameter determines the discrete time step. We then focus on the non-invertible it Kramers-Wannier duality-symmetry for the trotterized evolution. We find that the discretization of both space and time leads to a doubling of these duality operators. They account for discrete translations in both space and time. As an interesting application, we find that these operators also provide maps between trotterizations of different orders. This helps us extend our results beyond the trotterization scheme and investigate the Kramers-Wannier duality-symmetry for finite time Floquet evolution of the critical transverse field Ising chain. {Finally, we investigate how these non-invertible operators shape the phase diagram of the discrete-time evolution. This question is particularly interesting in the Floquet setting, which is known to host a richer phase structure than its undriven counterpart. We systematically construct the necessary operators which relate different phases away from criticality for both trotterized and Floquet evolutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究临界横场 Ising 模型的一阶 Trotter 化离散时间演化，并明确证明其保持可积性。作者利用量子反散射方法构造含非均匀参数的转移矩阵，从而得到离散时间守恒量，其中非均匀参数决定时间步长。研究还发现时空离散化导致不可逆 Kramers–Wannier 对偶算符加倍，这些算符对应空间和时间方向的离散平移，并可用于联系不同阶数的 Trotter 化及有限时间 Floquet 演化。
authors: Akash Sinha, Pramod Padmanabhan, Vladimir Korepin

articles.title: Refractive indices of Y₂SiO₅ in the near-infrared
articles.title_zh: Y₂SiO₅ 在近红外波段的折射率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26971v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Y₂SiO₅ is a reference birefringent material for optical quantum technologies. The refractive index is primarily known in the visible spectrum, whereas this crystal is also used in the near-infrared. We begin by analysing historical measurements, as well as the modelling proposed at the time. The absence of refractive index tabulated values in the near- and mid-infrared ranges motivated us to carry out independent measurements. Using interferometric techniques in the telecom wavelength range, we demonstrate the ability to determine the principal refractive indices and propose a model spanning a broad spectral range based on Sellmeier equations for which we explicitly give the coefficients and discuss the achievable accuracy. Conversely, as an illustration, white-light interference enables us to precisely determine the thickness of a Y₂SiO₅ thin film on the order of ten micrometers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对光量子技术中常用的双折射材料 Y₂SiO₅，补充其近红外和中红外折射率数据的不足。作者分析历史测量与模型，并在电信波段采用干涉技术独立测定主折射率，进而给出基于 Sellmeier 方程的宽谱模型及其系数。作为应用示例，研究还展示了白光干涉可精确测定约十微米量级 Y₂SiO₅ 薄膜厚度。
authors: Shijun Zhang, Jérôme Debray, Benoît Boulanger, Pierre Lemonde, Thierry Chanelière

articles.title: Quasiperiodic nondipole ionization dynamics in the x-ray stabilization regime
articles.title_zh: X 射线稳定化区域中的准周期非偶极电离动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06762v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent advances in strong x-ray laser techniques enable the study of nonlinear multiphoton ionization in extreme high-frequency fields. Although the stabilization regime in such fields is theoretically established, its modified properties in the nondipole regime for long laser pulses remains unknown. Here, we numerically investigate the strong-field ionization of an atom in a long XUV laser pulse in the nondipole regime. Our study of the time-dependent quantum dynamics reveals a quasiperiodic modulation of the ionization yield as a function of pulse duration. We demonstrate that the Coulomb-field-induced slow oscillation of the ionized electron wave packet during the interaction is responsible for the observed modulation of the ionization yield. Furthermore, we scrutinize the unusual photon momentum sharing between the photoelectron and the ion in this extreme regime. These effects are observable in upcoming x-ray free-electron laser facilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作数值研究长 XUV 强激光脉冲作用下原子在非偶极区域的强场电离动力学，面向高频强 X 射线场中的多光子非线性电离问题。时间依赖量子动力学结果显示，电离产额会随脉冲持续时间出现准周期调制。作者指出，这种调制源于相互作用过程中库仑场诱导的电离电子波包慢振荡，并进一步分析了该极端区域中光电子与离子之间异常的光子动量分配。
authors: Aleksandr V. Boitsov, Karen Z. Hatsagortsyan, Christoph H. Keitel

articles.title: Probing Qubit Noise with a Channel-Resolved Post-Markovian Master Equation
articles.title_zh: 利用通道分辨的后马尔可夫主方程探测量子比特噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.12894v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Accurate noise characterization is essential for scaling quantum processors toward fault-tolerant operation. Although reduced qubit dynamics are often modeled with Markovian master equations, present-day devices can exhibit memory effects generated by residual qubit-qubit couplings, structured environments, and finite bath correlation times. Here we develop a channel-resolved, Post-Markovian Master Equation model for non-Markovian noise and test it in superconducting qubits. Using idle-evolution tomography on IBM Quantum processors, we identify complementary operational signatures of non-Markovianity, including violations of CP-divisibility and revivals of distinguishability-based information-backflow measures. We further derive a closed-form spectator-ZZ model with local dissipation and show that it captures the observed transverse Bloch-vector revivals while leaving the longitudinal relaxation mode Markovian within the model. The fitted closed-form dynamics enable an analytical reconstruction of the transverse memory kernel, whose damped oscillatory structure captures the non-Markovian correction beyond the fitted Markovian baseline. Two-qubit tomography shows buildup and revivals of quantum mutual information on comparable timescales, supporting spectator-induced crosstalk as an important contributor to the observed memory effects. Our results connect operational non-Markovianity diagnostics, microscopic crosstalk modeling, and reduced memory-kernel reconstruction in a single experimental framework for superconducting quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种通道分辨的后马尔可夫主方程模型，用于表征超导量子比特中的非马尔可夫噪声。通过 IBM Quantum 处理器上的空闲演化层析，作者识别出非马尔可夫性的操作性特征，包括 CP 可除性破坏和基于可区分性的信息回流复现。研究还推导了含局域耗散的 spectator-ZZ 闭式模型，解释横向 Bloch 矢量复现，并从拟合动力学解析重构了具有阻尼振荡结构的横向记忆核。
authors: Chun-Tse Li, Jingming Tan, Vasil Gucev, Daniel A. Lidar

articles.title: Autoregressive Boltzmann Generators
articles.title_zh: 自回归玻尔兹曼生成器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient sampling of molecular systems at thermodynamic equilibrium is a hallmark challenge in statistical physics. This challenge has driven the development of Boltzmann Generators (BGs), which allow rapid generation of uncorrelated equilibrium samples by combining a generative model with exact likelihoods and an importance sampling correction. However, modern BGs predominantly rely on normalizing flows (NFs), which either suffer from limited expressivity due to strict invertibility constraints (discrete time) or computationally expensive likelihoods (continuous time). In this paper, we propose Autoregressive Boltzmann Generators (ArBG) -- a novel autoregressive modelling framework -- that overcomes these limitations by departing from the flow-based BG paradigm. ArBG circumvents the topological constraints of flows and enables sequential inference-time interventions, while offering enhanced scalability by leveraging architectures effective in Large Language Models. We empirically demonstrate that ArBG leads to significant improvements over flow-based models across all benchmarks, but particularly in larger peptide systems such as the 10-residue Chignolin. Furthermore, we introduce Robin, a 132 million parameter transferable model trained with the ArBG framework which improves over the previous state-of-the-art, reducing the zero-shot energy error, E-W₂, on 8-residue systems by over 60%. The code can be found at the following link: https://github.com/danyalrehman/autobg.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出自回归玻尔兹曼生成器 ArBG，用于提高分子体系热力学平衡采样效率。与主要依赖归一化流的传统玻尔兹曼生成器相比，ArBG 避免了流模型的可逆性拓扑约束，并支持推理时的序列干预，同时可借鉴大语言模型中的可扩展架构。实验结果显示，ArBG 在多个基准上优于基于流的模型，尤其在较大的肽类体系中表现更突出。
authors: Danyal Rehman, Charlie B. Tan, Yoshua Bengio, Avishek Joey Bose, Alexander Tong

articles.title: CoStream: Composing Simple Behaviors for Generalizable Complex Manipulation
articles.title_zh: CoStream：组合简单行为以实现可泛化的复杂操作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26423v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-horizon, contact-rich complex manipulation tasks, such as seating a GPU into a PCIe slot, demand both millimeter high precision and out-of-the-box generalization to new tasks. Existing paradigms struggle to satisfy both: classical pipelines use brittle, task-specific interfaces to achieve high-precision control but require costly pipeline redesigns to adapt to new tasks, whereas monolithic end-to-end policies provide better generalization but lack high precision on complex, out-of-distribution tasks unless retrained with new data. Both paradigms share an implicit assumption: once a manipulation capability is acquired, it must be deployed as a rigid pipeline or monolithic whole, rather than being freely decomposed and recomposed. In this paper, we show that complex manipulation capabilities can emerge naturally from the composition of simple, independent behaviors. Rather than deploying a monolithic policy or a rigid pipeline, we propose øurshort, a framework orchestrating foundation models and diverse sensing modalities into multiple composable core behaviors: a semantic behavior extracting spatial constraints via foundation models; a predictive behavior forecasting trajectories by tracking keypoints in imagined videos; and a reactive behavior providing high-frequency tactile and force corrections. On a shared SE(3) interface, these outputs compose by right-multiplication into a single pose command at each control step, executed by a compliant controller. We demonstrate øurshort on 8 real-world tasks spanning everyday manipulation and precision assembly, with the strongest gains in contact-rich assembly and object transfer, and show robust recovery from manual perturbations during execution. Website: https://costream-simple.github.io
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向长时程、富接触且需要毫米级精度的复杂机器人操作任务，指出传统刚性流水线和端到端单体策略分别在泛化与高精度方面存在局限。作者提出 CoStream 框架，通过协调基础模型与多种传感模态，将复杂操作分解为可组合的核心简单行为，而非固定管线或单一策略。该方法旨在通过行为的自由分解与重组，使复杂操作能力在新任务中自然泛化。
authors: Haonan Chen, Yuxiang Ma, Stephen Tian, Xiaoshen Han, Wenlong Huang, Feiyang Wu, Yunzhu Li, Jiajun Wu, Edward H. Adelson, Yilun Du

articles.title: Speaking Numbers to LLMs: Multi-Wavelet Number Embeddings for Time Series Forecasting
articles.title_zh: 对大语言模型“说数字”：用于时间序列预测的多小波数字嵌入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26487v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are attractive for context-aware time series forecasting because they can integrate heterogeneous textual signals, yet their discrete, language-oriented tokenization and embedding interfaces are misaligned with continuous numerical values, often harming numerical ordering and forecasting reliability. We propose TempoWave, a plug-and-play temporal wavelet digit interface that maps each scalar observation into digit-wise embeddings constructed from multi-wavelet, multi-scale coefficients. By directly overriding standard token representations, TempoWave seamlessly exposes both fine-grained local fluctuations and macro global structures in a transformer-compatible form, ensuring that precise numerical formatting, distinct digit identity, and robustness to common normalization operations are maintained throughout the LLM pipeline. Experiments across five context-enriched forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that TempoWave consistently improves LLM-based forecasters over standard numeric tokenization and alternative embedding interfaces, achieving a new state-of-the-art. These results highlight the numeric interface as a key bottleneck and suggest that principled multi-resolution embeddings can better couple LLMs' contextual reasoning with precise forecasting. Our code is available at https://github.com/DC-research/TempoWAVE and our model can be accessed at https://huggingface.co/Melady/TempoWAVE.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出 TempoWave，一种即插即用的时间小波数字接口，用于改善大语言模型在连续数值时间序列预测中的表示不匹配问题。该方法将每个标量观测映射为由多小波、多尺度系数构造的逐数字嵌入，并直接覆盖标准 token 表示，从而同时保留局部波动和全局结构。五个含上下文的预测基准实验表明，TempoWave 相比标准数值分词和其他嵌入接口能稳定提升 LLM 预测性能。
authors: Defu Cao, Zijie Lei, Muyan Weng, Jiao Sun, Yan Liu

articles.title: The Dice Roll Method: A StandardizedProtocol for Measuring Stochastic Bias in Large Language Model Output
articles.title_zh: 掷骰子方法：测量大语言模型输出随机偏差的标准化协议
articles.abstract: Researchers increasingly use repeated identical prompts to measure stochastic bias in large languagemodel (LLM) outputs, yet no standardized protocol exists for determining adequate iteration counts,selecting appropriate stability metrics, or establishing reliability thresholds under the conditional,non-Gaussian structure of autoregressive text generation. This paper formalizes the Dice Roll Methodas a reusable audit protocol grounded in an explicit generative model of temperature-scaled nucleussampling. We decompose total response variance into token-level sampling, prompt-phrasing, run-to-run, and model-version components, and build inference on that structure rather than on parametricassumptions the data do not satisfy. The analytical stack replaces the independent-samples t-testwith a negative-binomial generalized linear mixed model (GLMM) that treats iterations as repeatedmeasures nested within prompt, model, and language; replaces Cohen’s d with Cliff’s δ and rank-biserial correlation as primary distribution-free effect sizes; replaces ordinary bootstrap with a moving-block and parametric bootstrap that preserve the conditional dependence of sequential observations;and replaces classical power analysis with simulation-based GLMM power computed via the simrprocedure.
