Density matrix renormalization group calculations reveal that this phase is characterized by a dispersion with two minima and four Fermi points, indicating the emergence of an effective next-nearest-neighbor hopping that arises as a second-order effect to avoid magnetic frustration. The pairs appear in the spectrum as in-gap bound states with weight concentrated in the hole pockets. The low-energy physics can be understood by means of a generalized t-J model with next-nearest-neighbor hopping. Our results offer a guide for searching for experimental signatures, and for other models that can realize PDW physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过数值方法考察 Kondo-Heisenberg 链中对密度波（PDW）序的特征，重点分析不同参数区间的动量分辨谱。密度矩阵重整化群计算表明，该相具有包含两个极小值和四个费米点的色散，反映出为避免磁阻挫而由二阶效应产生的有效次近邻跃迁。谱中的成对态表现为能隙内束缚态，其权重集中在空穴口袋中，低能物理可由含次近邻跃迁的广义 t-J 模型理解。
authors: Luhang Yang, Elbio Dagotto, Adrian E. Feiguin

articles.title: Numerical Block Diagonalization and Linked-Cluster Expansion for Deriving Effective Hamiltonians: Applications to Spin Excitations
articles.title_zh: 用于推导有效哈密顿量的数值块对角化与连通团簇展开：在自旋激发中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.11167v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a numerical, non-perturbative framework for constructing effective Hamiltonians that describe the dynamics of low-energy degrees of freedom within a restricted Hilbert space in quantum many-body systems. The approach is based on block diagonalization guided by a minimal-deformation principle imposed within a selected target sector. The formulation is designed to remain compatible with the numerical linked-cluster expansion. For gapped systems, the relation between minimal deformation and cluster additivity requires careful treatment when excited eigenstates contain finite admixtures of the ground state. After establishing a cluster-additive basis that reproduces the Hörmann-Schmidt construction, the minimal-deformation criterion uniquely determines the effective Hamiltonian within each excitation sector. The same criterion also provides a practical numerical procedure for selecting relevant low-energy eigenstates, including regimes characterized by strong level mixing and avoided crossings. The framework is illustrated using two spin models: the one-dimensional transverse-field Ising model as a benchmark and the two-dimensional Shastry-Sutherland model with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, relevant to SrCu₂₍BO₃₎₂. In both cases, the resulting effective Hamiltonians accurately capture the excitation dynamics and the associated band structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种数值的非微扰框架，用于在量子多体系统受限 Hilbert 空间内构造描述低能自由度动力学的有效哈密顿量。该方法基于由最小形变原则引导的块对角化，并设计为与数值连通团簇展开兼容。作者讨论了有能隙系统中最小形变与团簇可加性之间的关系，并给出在强能级混合和避免交叉情形下选择相关低能本征态的实用程序，随后以一维横场 Ising 模型和二维自旋模型进行展示。

articles.title: Diagonal Isometric Form for Tensor Network States in Two Dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维张量网络态的对角等距形式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.08080v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Isometric tensor network states (isoTNS) generalize the isometric form of the one-dimensional matrix product states (MPS) to tensor networks in two and higher dimensions. Here, we introduce an alternative isometric form for isoTNS by incorporating auxiliary tensors to represent the orthogonality hypersurface. We implement the time evolving block decimation (TEBD) algorithm on this new isometric form and benchmark the method by computing ground states and the real time evolution of the transverse field Ising model in two dimensions on large square lattices of up to 1250 sites. Our results demonstrate that isoTNS can efficiently capture the entanglement structure of two-dimensional area law states. The short-time dynamics is also accurately reproduced even at the critical point. Our isoTNS formulation further allows for a natural extension to different lattice geometries, such as the honeycomb or kagome latice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为等距张量网络态（isoTNS）引入一种新的等距形式，通过加入辅助张量来表示正交超曲面。作者在该形式上实现了时间演化块抽取算法，并在最高约 1250 个格点的大型二维方格横场 Ising 模型中测试基态和实时演化。结果表明，isoTNS 能有效捕捉二维面积律态的纠缠结构，并在临界点附近准确再现短时动力学，同时该表述也便于推广到蜂窝、 Kagome 等其他晶格几何。
authors: Benjamin Sappler, Masataka Kawano, Michael P Zaletel, Frank Pollmann

articles.title: Multiferroic VHfO₄ with Strain-Tunable Magnetism
articles.title_zh: 具有应变可调磁性的多铁性 VHfO₄
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.10380v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The coexistence of ferroelectricity and magnetism in a single-phase oxide is rare because the electronic requirements for these two orders are often incompatible. Here, using first-principles calculations and parallel-tempering Monte Carlo simulations, we propose stoichiometric VHfO₄ as a hafnia-derived multiferroic that overcomes this constraint through ordered cation design rather than dilute magnetic doping. We found that VHfO₄ could stabilize in a polar (Pca2₁)-like structure with layered V/Hf ordering, remains dynamically stable, and preserves switchable ferroelectricity with a large spontaneous polarization. The ordered V sublattice introduces competing exchange interactions that favor an antiferromagnetic ground state at zero strain. Epitaxial strain further drives transitions into additional phases, including a noncollinear spiral-like state and a predominantly in-plane antiferromagnetic state. We also find that out-of-plane lattice distortions along the polar axis strongly modify the exchange interactions and magnetic phase stability, indicating a strain-mediated pathway for electric-field control of magnetism. These results establish VHfO₄ as a promising platform for exploring multiferroicity and magnetoelectric coupling in hafnia-based oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用第一性原理计算和平行回火 Monte Carlo 模拟，提出化学计量比 VHfO₄ 可作为一种源自氧化铪体系的多铁材料，通过有序阳离子设计而非稀磁掺杂实现铁电性与磁性的共存。结果显示，VHfO₄ 可稳定于具有层状 V/Hf 有序的类极性 Pca2₁ 结构，并保持动力学稳定和较大的可翻转自发极化。V 子晶格引入相互竞争的交换作用，使零应变下基态为反铁磁，而外延应变可进一步诱导非共线螺旋样态和主要面内反铁磁态等相。
authors: Qisheng Yu, Tianyuan Zhu, Boyu Liu, Hongjun Xiang, Shi Liu

articles.title: Radio-Frequency Method for Detecting Superconductivity Under High Pressure
articles.title_zh: 高压下探测超导性的射频方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.00563v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a contactless technique for probing superconductivity and magnetic ordering transitions in micron-sized samples under extreme pressure. Utilizing a multistage Lenz lens system, directly sputtered onto diamond anvils, we realize a radio-frequency (RF, 50 kHz - 200 MHz) transformer with a sample of 50-100 μm in diameter, as its core. This configuration enables efficient transfer and focusing of an electromagnetic field within the diamond anvil cell's chamber. Consequently, the transmitted RF signal exhibits high sensitivity to variations in the sample's surface conductivity and magnetic permeability. We validate this method by determining the critical temperatures (Tc) of known superconductors, including NbTi, MgB₂, Hg-1223, Bi-2212, YBCO, and REBCO in various magnetic fields, as well as the magnetic ordering temperatures of Gd and Tb. Notably, we apply this technique to the LaH₁₀₋ₓ, CeH₉₋₁₀, and (La,Ce)H₁₀₋₁₂ superhydrides at a pressure of about 1-1.5 Mbar. The observed superconducting transitions in Ce and La superhydrides at 90-110 K and 215-242 K, respectively, correlate with the Tc's determined via traditional electrical-resistance measurements. Moreover, we show how multiple repetitions of the RF experiment with the La-Ce superhydride make it possible to detect the increase in Tc over time up to approx 260-270 K. This finding indicates the possibility of reaching a critical Tc around 0ⁱ̧rcC in the La-based superhydrides.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍一种在极端压力下无接触探测微米尺度样品超导性和磁有序转变的射频技术。作者将多级 Lenz 透镜系统直接溅射在金刚石对顶砧上，构成以 50–100 μm 样品为核心的射频变压器，从而增强对样品表面电导率和磁导率变化的灵敏度。该方法通过 NbTi、MgB₂、Hg-1223、Bi-2212、YBCO、REBCO 以及 Gd、Tb 等材料得到验证，并被用于兆巴压力下 La、Ce 及 La-Ce 超氢化物的超导转变检测。
authors: Dmitrii V. Semenok, Di Zhou, Jianbo Zhang, Toni Helm, Wuhao Chen, Yang Ding, Ho-kwang Mao, Viktor V. Struzhkin

articles.title: General ab initio framework for electronic-order-induced lattice-dynamics symmetry breaking
articles.title_zh: 电子序诱导晶格动力学对称性破缺的通用从头算框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.09253v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Conventional ab initio approaches are unable to describe phonon time-reversal symmetry (T) breaking. Here, we develop an ab initio framework, grounded in molecular Berry curvature (MBC) theory, that captures electronic-order-driven symmetry breaking in lattice dynamics. Using Co₃Sn₂S₂ as a model system, our ab initio framework yields phonon spectra that break both T and mirror symmetries, quantitatively reproduce the observed phonon splittings observed in experiments, and reveal distinct microscopic origins for the E_g and Eᵤ modes: E_g splitting is governed by MBC and is accurately captured by our algorithm, whereas Eᵤ splitting is enhanced by the Fano resonance and matches the experimental data once the Fano-factor correction is included. Leveraging this algorithm, we predict several candidate materials with nonzero electronic-order-driven symmetry breaking in lattice dynamics, establishing a first-principles route to understand electron-phonon coupling, phonon magnetism, and related Hall-type lattice responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于分子 Berry 曲率理论的从头算框架，用于描述传统第一性原理方法难以处理的声子时间反演对称性破缺。以 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 为模型体系，作者计算得到同时破缺时间反演和镜面对称性的声子谱，定量再现实验观测到的声子劈裂，并区分了 E_g 与 Eᵤ 模式劈裂的不同微观来源。该算法还被用于预测若干具有电子序驱动晶格动力学对称性破缺的候选材料，为研究电子-声子耦合、声子磁性及相关 Hall 型晶格响应提供了第一性原理途径。
authors: Shuai Zhang, Mengqi Wang, Pan Zhang, Tiantian Zhang

articles.title: Bogoliubov quasi-particles in superconductors are integer-charged particles inapplicable for braiding quantum information
articles.title_zh: 超导体中的 Bogoliubov 准粒子是整数带电粒子，不适用于编织量子信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.09663v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a rigorous proof that under a number-conserving Hamiltonian, one-body quasi-particles generally possess quantized charge and inertial mass identical to the bare particles. It follows that, Bogoliubov zero modes in the vortex (or on the edge) of superconductors cannot be their own anti-particles capable of braiding quantum information. As such, the heavily pursued Majorana zero mode-based route for quantum computation requires a serious re-consideration. This study further reveals the conceptual challenge in preparing and manipulating braid-able quantum states via physical thermalization or slow external fields. These profound results should reignite the long-standing quest for a number-conserving theory of superconductivity and superfluidity without fictitiously breaking global U(1) symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在数守恒哈密顿量框架下给出论证，认为单体准粒子通常具有与裸粒子相同的量子化电荷和惯性质量。由此他们主张，超导体涡旋或边缘中的 Bogoliubov 零模不能作为自身反粒子来承载可编织的量子信息，并据此质疑基于 Majorana 零模的量子计算路线。文章还指出，通过热化或缓慢外场制备和操控可编织量子态存在概念性挑战，并呼吁发展不虚破缺全局 U(1) 对称性的数守恒超导与超流理论。

articles.title: Bayesian Neural Networks versus deep ensembles for uncertainty quantification in machine learning interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 用于机器学习原子间势不确定性量化的贝叶斯神经网络与深度集成比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.19180v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Neural-network-based machine learning interatomic potentials have emerged as powerful tools for predicting atomic energies and forces, enabling accurate and efficient simulations in atomistic modeling. A key limitation of traditional deep learning approaches, however, is their inability to provide reliable estimates of predictive uncertainty. Such uncertainty quantification is critical for assessing model reliability, especially in materials science, where often the model is applied on out-of-distribution data. Different strategies have been proposed to address this challenge, with deep ensembles and Bayesian neural networks being among the most widely used. In this work, we introduce an implementation of Bayesian neural networks with variational inference in the aenet-PyTorch framework. To evaluate their applicability to machine learning interatomic potentials, we systematically compare the performance of variational BNNs and deep ensembles on a dataset of 7,815 TiO₂ structures. The models are trained on both the full dataset and a subset to assess how variations in data representation influence predictive accuracy and uncertainty estimation. This analysis provides insights into the strengths and limitations of each approach, offering practical guidance for the development of uncertainty-aware machine learning interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注神经网络机器学习原子间势的预测不确定性量化问题，这对于材料模拟中判断模型在分布外数据上的可靠性尤为重要。作者在 aenet-PyTorch 框架中实现了基于变分推断的贝叶斯神经网络，并将其与深度集成方法进行系统比较。研究以 7815 个 TiO₂ 结构数据集为测试对象，考察完整数据集和子集训练条件下模型精度与不确定性表现如何受数据表征影响。
authors: Riccardo Farris, Emanuele Telari, Nongnuch Artrith, Konstantin Neyman, Albert Bruix

articles.title: Signatures of a high-temperature collective electronic phase with superconductivity-like characteristics and a giant pressure effect in networks of boron-doped ultrathin carbon nanotubes
articles.title_zh: 硼掺杂超薄碳纳米管网络中具有类超导特征的高温集体电子相及巨大压力效应迹象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.19255v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present data consistent with a high-temperature collective electronic phase with superconductivity-like characteristics in three dimensional networks of boron doped, ultrathin carbon nanotubes (CNTs) grown inside the 5 Angstrom channels of ZSM-5 zeolite. Confinement stabilizes (2,1) CNTs that are otherwise dynamically unstable, while boron doping shifts the Fermi level towards a van Hove singularity, as supported by ab-initio calculations. The resulting CNT network exhibits multiple, mutually consistent signatures of an electronic condensate with the typical characteristics of a high temperature superconductor at ambient pressure. DC magnetization and AC susceptibility measurements reveal the onset of a Meissner response between 220 and 250K, with compacted samples achieving up to 93 percent of full diamagnetic screening. Electrical transport shows a sharp resistive transition with extrapolated Tc = 239K and vanishing resistance in optimized samples. Specific heat measurements display a reproducible anomaly at 233 to 236 K that broadens under magnetic field, consistent with strong fluctuations. Point contact spectroscopy identifies three energy gaps, including a leading gap of 30 meV whose temperature dependence follows BCS expectations for Tc = 224K, and exhibits particle-hole symmetry and Andreev reflection. Remarkably, applying pressures below 0.1 kbar enhances Tc by nearly 100K and modulates the room temperature resistance by more than three orders of magnitude, suggesting a pressure driven 1D to 3D crossover in the CNT network. These results identify boron doped ultrathin CNT networks as a promising carbon-based platform for near ambient temperature superconductivity and reveal an unusually large pressure sensitivity with potential technological relevance.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者报道了在 ZSM-5 沸石 5 埃通道中生长的硼掺杂超薄碳纳米管三维网络中，出现与高温类超导集体电子相相一致的多种实验信号。限域效应稳定了通常动力学不稳定的 (2,1) 碳纳米管，而硼掺杂将费米能级推向 van Hove 奇点，第一性原理计算支持这一图像。磁化率、输运和比热测量显示出约 220–250 K 范围内的迈斯纳响应、尖锐电阻转变以及可重复的热异常，暗示该体系可能具有高温电子凝聚特征。
authors: Y. Wang, T. H. Koo, R. Huang, Y. H. Ng, T. T. Lortz, T. Zhang, W. M. Chan, Y. Hou, J. Pan, S. Krämer, A. Demuer, R. Lortz, N. Wang, P. Sheng

articles.title: Modeling Quantum Geometry for Fractional Chern Insulators with unsupervised learning
articles.title_zh: 利用无监督学习为分数量子陈绝缘体建模量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.03018v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) in moire materials present a unique platform for exploring strongly correlated topological phases beyond the paradigm of ideal quantum geometry. While analytical approaches to FCIs and fractional quantum Hall states (FQHS) often rely on idealized Bloch wavefunctions, realistic moire models lack direct tunability of quantum metric and Berry curvature, limiting theoretical and numerical exploration. Here, we introduce an unsupervised machine learning framework to model interacting Hamiltonians directly through the distribution of single-particle form factors. Using a variational autoencoder (VAE), we show that unsupervised learning can not only distinguish FCI and non-FCI states, but also generate new form factors with distinct topological character, not present in the training set. This latent space enables the generation and interpolation of form factors for topological flatbands with Chern number |C|=1, enabling the discovery of unobserved many-body states such as charge density waves. Principal component analysis (PCA) further reveals that the dominant patterns in the form factors-reflecting correlations across the Brillouin zone-can be decomposed into components with approximately quantized Chern numbers, providing new insights into the global and topological structure of quantum geometry. Our results highlight the ability of machine learning to generalize and model topological quantum systems, paving the way for the inverse design of form factors with tailored quantum geometry and many-body phases in flatband materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种无监督机器学习框架，通过单粒子形状因子的分布来直接建模相互作用哈密顿量，以研究莫尔材料中的分数量子陈绝缘体。作者使用变分自编码器表明，无监督学习不仅可区分 FCI 与非 FCI 态，还能生成训练集中不存在、具有不同拓扑特征的新形状因子。潜在空间可用于生成和插值陈数 |C|=1 的拓扑平带形状因子，并帮助发现如电荷密度波等未观测到的多体态；主成分分析进一步揭示了形状因子中的主导结构模式。
authors: Ang-Kun Wu, Louis Primeau, Jingtao Zhang, Kai Sun, Yang Zhang, Shi-Zeng Lin

articles.title: Al₁₋ₓHfₓN Thin Films with Enhanced Piezoelectric Responses for GHz Surface Acoustic Wave Devices
articles.title_zh: 用于 GHz 表面声波器件的压电响应增强 Al₁₋ₓHfₓN 薄膜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.18970v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ternary compounds obtained by alloying wurtzite AlN with transition metals have emerged as promising materials with significantly enhanced piezoelectric characteristics relative to binary AlN. The increased electromechanical coupling in these compounds boosts the performance of high-frequency acoustic devices. So far, progress has largely focused on Al₁₋ₓScₓN, which is costly and poorly compatible with complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technologies. Here, we investigate aluminum hafnium nitride (Al₁₋ₓHfₓN) as a scalable and potentially CMOS-compatible alternative to Al₁₋ₓScₓN. Using reactive co-sputtering on both Si and sapphire substrates, we demonstrate wurtzite Al₁₋ₓHfₓN thin films (x łeq 0.17) with strong c-axis texture and nearly isotropic lattice expansion upon Hf incorporation. X-ray absorption spectroscopy indicates cross-gap hybridization between N 2p and Hf 5d states, which can enhance the Born effective charge and, thereby, the piezoelectric response. Correspondingly, we observe a nearly two-fold enhancement in the piezoelectric coefficient, d₃₃, relative to AlN, despite increasing structural disorder in Al₁₋ₓHfₓN. Building on this finding, we demonstrate Al₁₋ₓHfₓN GHz surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonators that exhibit enhanced performance, as well as efficient excitation of bulk acoustic waves with low propagation losses. These results establish Al₁₋ₓHfₓN as a promising platform for next-generation high-frequency electromechanical devices, with prospects for further piezoelectric enhancements through improved epitaxy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探索铝铪氮 Al₁₋ₓHfₓN 作为 Al₁₋ₓScₓN 的可扩展、潜在 CMOS 兼容替代材料，用于高频声学器件。作者通过反应共溅射在 Si 和蓝宝石衬底上制备出 Hf 含量 x≤0.17、具有强 c 轴织构的纤锌矿 Al₁₋ₓHfₓN 薄膜，并观察到 Hf 引入导致近各向同性晶格膨胀。X 射线吸收谱显示 N 2p 与 Hf 5d 态之间存在跨带隙杂化，可能增强 Born 有效电荷；相应地，尽管结构无序增加，薄膜的 d₃₃ 压电系数仍较 AlN 近乎翻倍。
authors: Laura I. Wagner, Verena Streibel, Esperanza Luna, Katarina S. Flashar, Walid Anders, Nicole Volkmer, Doreen Steffen, Frans Munnik, Tsedenia A. Zewdie, Saswati Santra, Ian D. Sharp, Mingyun Yuan

articles.title: Coincidence detection techniques for direct measurement of many-body correlations in strongly correlated electron systems
articles.title_zh: 用于强关联电子体系多体关联直接测量的符合探测技术
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.06593v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Research on strongly correlated electron systems faces a fundamental challenge due to the complex nature of intrinsic many-body correlations. A key strategy to address this challenge lies in advancing experimental methods that can directly probe and elucidate the underlying many-body correlations. In this perspective article, we discuss the theoretically proposed coincidence detection techniques, which are designed to directly measure two-body correlations in various particle-particle and particle-hole channels, with momentum, energy, and/or spatial resolution. We also explore the prospects of these coincidence detection techniques for future theoretical and experimental developments. The successful implementation and refinement of these coincidence detection techniques promise to deliver powerful new approaches for unraveling long-standing puzzles in strongly correlated electron systems, such as the enigmatic mechanism of unconventional superconductivity and the long-sought quantum spin liquids. Furthermore, these coincidence detection techniques will offer powerful new methods to investigate novel phenomena like itinerant magnetism and electronic nematicity in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇观点文章讨论了强关联电子体系研究中的核心难题，即如何直接探测复杂的内禀多体关联。作者综述了理论上提出的符合探测技术，这些方法旨在以动量、能量和/或空间分辨率直接测量粒子-粒子与粒子-空穴通道中的二体关联。文章展望了这些技术在理解非常规超导机制、量子自旋液体以及巡游磁性等问题中的潜在作用，并指出其未来实验实现和改进可能开辟新的研究路径。
authors: Yuehua Su, Guoya Zhang, Chao Zhang, Dezhong Cao

articles.title: Competing Ordering Modes in the Distorted Quantum Kagome Material Clinoatacamite Cu₂Cl(OH)₃
articles.title_zh: 畸变量子 Kagome 材料斜绿铜矿 Cu₂Cl(OH)₃ 中的竞争有序模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.21024v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We have studied the magnetic properties of clinoatacamite Cu₂Cl(OH)₃, the parent compound of the quantum spin liquid candidate herbertsmithite and a longstanding puzzle among frustrated quantum magnets. As we reveal using density-functional theory, clinoatacamite belongs to the class of distorted kagome antiferromagnets with the kagome plane being embedded into a low-symmetry crystal structure. By means of thermodynamic measurements, muon spin rotation/relaxation as well as neutron diffraction on single crystals, we find in zero magnetic field complex behavior below T_I = 18.1 K which unfolds in three temperature regions I-III. We propose this complexity in multicritical clinoatacamite to arise from the competition of antiferromagnetic ordering modes from the underconstrained manifold of modes, which can lead to a metamagnetic texture in zero field.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了斜绿铜矿 Cu₂Cl(OH)₃ 的磁性质，该材料是量子自旋液体候选物 herbertsmithite 的母体化合物，也是受挫量子磁体中的长期难题。密度泛函理论表明，其 Kagome 平面嵌入低对称晶体结构，属于畸变 Kagome 反铁磁体。结合热力学测量、μ 子自旋旋转/弛豫和单晶中子衍射，研究发现零磁场下 T_I=18.1 K 以下存在分为三个温区的复杂行为，并将其归因于欠约束模式流形中反铁磁有序模式的竞争，可能导致零场变磁性纹理。
authors: L. Stödter, C. Kastner, H. O. Jeschke, M. Reehuis, E. Chan, M. -H. Lemée-Cailleau, K. Beauvois, B. Ouladdiaf, F. Yokaichiya, F. Bert, T. J. Hicken, J. A. Krieger, H. Luetkens, J. L. articles.title: 3d Conformal Field Theories via Fuzzy Sphere Algebra
articles.title_zh: 通过模糊球代数研究三维共形场论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15025v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fuzzy sphere models conjecturally realize 3d CFTs in small systems of spinful fermions, but why they work so well is still not fully understood. Their Hamiltonians are built from electron density operators projected to the lowest Landau level. We analyze the Lie algebra generated by these density modes and its large-s limits. Depending on how the limit is taken, the algebra approaches either the Girvin-MacDonald-Platzman algebra in a local planar limit or a semiclassical algebra for low-angular-momentum modes in a global commutative limit. With an additional restriction to a low-excitation sector above the paramagnetic state, the density modes become approximate harmonic oscillators. We also test whether the conformal algebra so(3,2) can be realized directly by density modes. Such a representation exists only in the minimal two-electron system; its natural coproduct extension does not match the physical thermodynamic limit of a single growing fuzzy sphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究模糊球模型为何能在小型自旋费米子系统中有效实现三维共形场论。作者分析了投影到最低 Landau 能级的电子密度算符所生成的李代数及其大自旋极限，指出不同取极限方式可分别得到局域平面极限下的 Girvin-MacDonald-Platzman 代数或全局交换极限下低角动量模式的半经典代数。在顺磁态上方低激发子空间中，密度模式近似表现为谐振子；作者还检验了能否直接用密度模式实现 so(3,2) 共形代数，发现这种表示仅存在于最小二电子体系，其自然余积扩展不符合单个增长模糊球的物理热力学极限。

articles.title: Giant magnetoelasticity in FeRh thin films evidenced via strong phonon-magnon coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过强声子-磁振子耦合揭示 FeRh 薄膜中的巨大磁弹性
articles.abstract: Author(s): D. Ourdani, C. Gourdon, J. A. Arregi, V. Uhlíř, Y. Roussigné, and L. Thevenard FeRh is best known for its metamagnetic transition and giant volume magnetostriction. Here, the authors reveal remarkably strong phonon–magnon coupling in epitaxial FeRh. Combining Brillouin light scattering experiments with magnetoacoustic modeling, they demonstrate giant magnetoelasticity and show that Love surface acoustic waves provide an efficient mechanism for coherent magnon-polaron formation in magnetic thin films, highlighting FeRh as a promising platform for spin-acoustic information processing. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214450] Published Tue Jun 23, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道外延 FeRh 薄膜中显著的声子-磁振子耦合，揭示其除变磁转变和巨大体积磁致伸缩之外还具有强磁弹性响应。作者结合布里渊光散射实验与磁声建模，证明 Love 型表面声波可有效促成磁性薄膜中的相干磁振子-极化声子形成。结果表明 FeRh 是自旋-声学信息处理的有前景平台。
authors: D. Ourdani, C. Gourdon, J. A. Arregi, V. Uhlíř, Y. Roussigné, and L. Thevenard

articles.title: Crystal electric field excitations and spin dynamics in the spin-orbit coupled distorted honeycomb magnet BiErGeO₅
articles.title_zh: 自旋轨道耦合畸变蜂窝磁体 BiErGeO₅ 中的晶体电场激发与自旋动力学
articles.abstract: Author(s): S. Mohanty, S. Guchhait, S. S. Islam, Surya P. Patra, M. P. Saravanan, J. A. Krieger, T. J. Hicken, H. Luetkens, D. T. Adroja, Gøran J. Nilsen, M. D. Le, and R. Nath Here, the authors report the magnetic properties, crystal electric field excitations, and spin dynamics of a distorted honeycomb magnet BiErGeO 5 . Inelastic neutron scattering and μSR experiments reveal the effect of crystal electric field leading to a Kramers doublet ground state and anisotropic interactions. Despite an anomaly at T N ≃ 0.4 K in heat capacity, μSR measurements rule out a magnetic long-range order, and instead suggest persistent spin fluctuations down to 30 mK, highlighting unconventional magnetism in this spin-orbit coupled honeycomb system. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214452] Published Tue Jun 23, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了畸变蜂窝磁体 BiErGeO₅ 的磁性质、晶体电场激发和自旋动力学。非弹性中子散射与 μSR 实验显示，晶体电场产生 Kramers 双重态基态并导致各向异性相互作用。尽管热容在 T_N≈0.4 K 附近出现异常，μSR 测量排除了磁长程有序，转而表明自旋涨落可持续到 30 mK，体现出该自旋轨道耦合蜂窝体系中的非常规磁性。
authors: S. Mohanty, S. Guchhait, S. S. Islam, Surya P. Patra, M. P. Saravanan, J. A. Krieger, T. J. Hicken, H. Luetkens, D. T. Adroja, Gøran J. Nilsen, M. D. Le, and R. Nath

articles.title: Anharmonic collective oscillations and gap generation from thermal fluctuations in isotropic classical spin systems
articles.title_zh: 各向同性经典自旋体系中由热涨落产生的非谐集体振荡与能隙生成
articles.abstract: Author(s): Anna Fancelli, Matías G. Gonzalez, Subhankar Khatua, Bella Lake, Michel J. P. Gingras, Jeffrey G. Rau, and Johannes Reuther Here, the authors reveal a general mechanism by which soft quartic spin modes in isotropic spiral magnets generate a fluctuation-induced spin-wave gap. Unlike conventional spin waves from harmonic modes, the gap in these systems grows with temperature according to a characteristic power law. The results extend the theory of soft-mode dynamics and pseudo-Goldstone modes and provide experimentally testable predictions for neutron scattering studies of magnetic materials that do not rely on fine-tuned ground-state degeneracies. [Phys. Rev. B 113, L220411] Published Tue Jun 23, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示了各向同性螺旋磁体中软四次自旋模式如何通过热涨落诱导产生自旋波能隙的一般机制。与来自谐振模式的常规自旋波不同，这类体系中的能隙随温度按特征幂律增长。该结果拓展了软模动力学和赝 Goldstone 模的理论，并为不依赖精细调控基态简并的磁性材料中子散射实验提供了可检验预言。
authors: Anna Fancelli, Matías G. Gonzalez, Subhankar Khatua, Bella Lake, Michel J. P. Gingras, Jeffrey G. Rau, and Johannes Reuther

articles.title: A dexterous soft hand exoskeleton restores intentional grasping in individuals with severe hand impairment
articles.title_zh: 灵巧软体手部外骨骼恢复重度手部障碍者的意向性抓握
articles.abstract: Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 23 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01263-3 Nassour, Berberich and colleagues present a soft robotic hand exoskeleton that restores grasping ability in individuals with severe hand paralysis, enabling meaningful tasks such as feeding. A lightweight textile glove with wrist dorsiflexion and an active opposable thumb increases hand articulations to enable more dexterous grasping.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道一种软体机器人手部外骨骼，可帮助重度手部瘫痪个体恢复抓握能力，并完成进食等有意义的日常任务。该系统采用轻量化织物手套，结合腕背伸辅助和主动对掌拇指设计，增加手部关节动作与抓握灵活性。研究展示了软体可穿戴机器人在神经运动康复和日常辅助中的应用潜力。

articles.title: Thermodynamic and transport properties of high-quality single crystals of the altermagnet CrSb
articles.title_zh: 高质量交替磁体 CrSb 单晶的热力学与输运性质
articles.abstract: Author(s): Shubhankar Paul, Atsutoshi Ikeda, Giordano Mattoni, Shingo Yonezawa, and Chanchal Sow Altermagnons are collective spin excitations in altermagnets, characterized by anisotropic magnon dispersions. The altermagnet CrSb has emerged as a compelling material owing to its substantial spin-splitting energy. Here, the authors report on the growth of high-quality CrSb single crystals and investigate their thermodynamic and transport properties. A large positive magnetoresistance of nearly 80% is observed at 3.5 K. Interestingly, the room-temperature specific heat exceeds the Dulong-Petit limit, attributed to a broad altermagnon contribution with an energy gap of ~16 ± 1 meV. These findings highlight the potential of CrSb for room-temperature magnonic and spintronic applications. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 063402] Published Tue Jun 23, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究制备了高质量 CrSb 单晶，并系统考察其热力学和输运性质。作者在低温下观察到接近 80% 的大正磁阻，并发现室温比热超过 Dulong–Petit 极限，可能源于具有约 16 ± 1 meV 能隙的宽广交替磁振子贡献。结果表明 CrSb 在室温磁振子学和自旋电子学应用中具有潜在价值。
authors: Shubhankar Paul, Atsutoshi Ikeda, Giordano Mattoni, Shingo Yonezawa, and Chanchal Sow

articles.title: Anisotropy, frustration, and saddle point in the twisted kagome antiferromagnet ErPdPb
articles.title_zh: 扭曲 Kagome 反铁磁体 ErPdPb 中的各向异性、阻挫与鞍点
articles.abstract: Author(s): Resham Babu Regmi, Sk Jamaluddin, Y. Lee, Hari Bhandari, Po-Hao Chang, Peter E. Siegfried, Abhijeet Nayak, Mohamed El Gazzah, Bence G. Márkus, Anna Nyáry, Zachary T. Messegee, Miya P. Zhao, Xiaoyan Tan, László Forró, Liqin Ke, Igor I. Mazin, and Nirmal J. Ghimire The kagome lattice has long attracted interest because its geometric frustration can give rise to unusual quantum states. When this lattice is distorted into a twisted or buckled arrangement, the resulting magnetic and electronic behavior becomes even richer. In this work, the authors synthesize and characterize single crystals of ErPdPb, a twisted kagome antiferromagnet in which the Er atoms form a frustrated magnetic network within the noncentrosymmetric ZrNiAl-type structure. Below 2.7 K, ErPdPb enters a strongly anisotropic magnetic state marked by fractional magnetization plateaus, competing exchange interactions, and pronounced directional dependence in its electronic properties. First-principles calculations in the field-polarized ferromagnetic state further reveal a spin-split saddle point close to the Fermi level and a quasi-one-dimensional Fermi surface. Together, these findings identify ErPdPb as a promising platform for investigating the interplay of magnetic frustration, electronic anisotropy, and topological band structure. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 065001] Published Tue Jun 23, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文合成并表征了单晶 ErPdPb，这是一种具有非中心对称 ZrNiAl 型结构的扭曲 Kagome 反铁磁体，其中 Er 原子形成受阻挫的磁网络。实验显示，ErPdPb 在 2.7 K 以下进入强各向异性磁态，表现出分数量子化磁化平台、竞争交换相互作用和显著的方向依赖电子性质。第一性原理计算进一步揭示了费米能级附近的自旋劈裂鞍点和准一维费米面，表明该材料是研究受阻挫磁性与电子结构耦合的有前景平台。
authors: Resham Babu Regmi, Sk Jamaluddin, Y. Lee, Hari Bhandari, Po-Hao Chang, Peter E. Siegfried, Abhijeet Nayak, Mohamed El Gazzah, Bence G. Márkus, Anna Nyáry, Zachary T. Messegee, Miya P. Zhao, Xiaoyan Tan, László Forró, Liqin Ke, Igor I. Mazin, and Nirmal J. Ghimire

articles.title: EEG-UDAF: A Novel Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Framework Leveraging Dual-view Frequency and Spatio-temporal Features for EEG-based Emotion Recognition
articles.title_zh: EEG-UDAF：一种结合双视角频域特征与时空特征的脑电情绪识别无监督域适应框架
articles.abstract: Currently, machine learning technology has been widely used in electroencephalogram (EEG) automatic emotion recognition tasks. However, the non-stationarity, individual differences, and high annotation costs in EEG signals seriously affect the generalization ability of the model. To solve these problems, we propose a new unsupervised domain adaptation framework named EEG-UDAF for EEG emotion recognition. First, we design a dual-view frequency domain feature fusion module that can extract rich EEG signals frequency domain features from two perspectives, differential entropy and power spectral density, and fuse them based on the self-attention mechanism. Second, we propose a spatio-temporal feature extraction module based on graph convolutional network and bidirectional long short-term memory. It can comprehensively consider the spatial topological structure of the brain and the dynamic characteristics of temporal changes between EEG channels to extract complex spatio-temporal features. Third, we use the unsupervised domain adaptation strategy to solve the non-stationarity and individual differences in EEG signals without manual annotation, and introduce a semantic correction mechanism to prevent incorrect class alignment. Experiments based on intra-subject and inter-subject paradigms show that EEG-UDAF can effectively alleviate non-stationarity and individual differences. Moreover, these transferable EEG representations also provide a potential foundation for LLM-augmented multimodal data fusion in large-scale affective computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对脑电情绪识别中信号非平稳性、个体差异和标注成本高导致的模型泛化问题，提出无监督域适应框架 EEG-UDAF。框架首先融合差分熵和功率谱密度两种频域视角，并通过自注意力机制提取更丰富的脑电频域特征；随后结合图卷积网络和双向长短期记忆网络建模脑区空间拓扑与时间动态。作者进一步引入无监督域适应和语义校正机制，以减少跨个体、跨域差异对情绪识别性能的影响。

articles.title: Rydberg Quasi-Contact Forces with Resonant Range Control via Fast Eigenstate Twisting
articles.title_zh: 通过快速本征态扭转实现共振范围控制的里德堡准接触力
articles.abstract: This article introduces a novel method to engineer sharply peaked, distance-selective interactions between neutral atoms by exploiting interaction-induced resonances within a resonantly driven Rydberg ladder system. By tuning laser parameters, a subsystem eigenstate twists rapidly and is brought into degeneracy with the atomic ground state at precisely defined interatomic separations, resulting in an effective fourth-order light-shift potential sharply peaked around this resonance distance. The linewidth of the resonant double excitation manifold defines the linewidth of the potential peak. Unlike previous off-resonant macrodimer-based schemes, our approach significantly enhances interaction strength, reaching MHz scales, and provides straightforward experimental tunability without requiring sub-wavelength positional control. Analytic expressions, validated through comprehensive master-equation simulations, detail the interaction profile's amplitude, width, and resonant distance and robustness to laser fluctuations. This precise control facilitates parallel entangling gates crucial for measurement-based quantum computing and enables simulation of complex lattice Hamiltonians with customizable connectivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种在中性原子之间构造尖锐峰值、距离选择性相互作用的新方法，利用共振驱动里德堡阶梯系统中的相互作用诱导共振。通过调节激光参数，子系统本征态可在特定原子间距处与基态发生简并，从而产生在该距离附近强烈峰化的四阶光移势。相较于以往基于失谐宏二聚体的方案，该方法可将相互作用强度提升至 MHz 量级，并具有较好的实验可调性和对激光涨落的鲁棒性。该机制有望用于并行纠缠门和复杂晶格哈密顿量的量子模拟。

articles.title: Compressibility and Consolidation of Peat: Effects of Organic Content and Soil Fabric
articles.title_zh: 泥炭的压缩性与固结：有机质含量和土体结构的影响
articles.abstract: Peat presents significant geotechnical challenges due to its extreme compressibility, high water content, and complex fabric. This study examines the one-dimensional consolidation behavior of fibrous and amorphous peats as well as organic silty clay soils from Southern Ontario using constant rate-of-strain (CRS) oedometer tests on undisturbed samples. The materials span organic contents of 68–86% and varying decomposition degrees, yielding substantial variability in compressibility, hydraulic conductivity (k), and coefficient of consolidation (cv). The compression index (Cc) increases strongly with porosity, while normalized parameters confirm that organic content (OC) and soil fabric govern intrinsic behavior across peat types. Both k and cv increase with porosity but decrease markedly with increasing effective stress due to structural compression and loss of pore connectivity. At a reference stress of 100 kPa, both parameters decrease systematically with increasing OC, reflecting the transition from fibrous to amorphous structures. Empirical correlations with porosity and OC are shown to be soil-specific and non-unique, reflecting the coupled influence of fabric that is not captured by these indices alone. SEM, EDS, and XRD analyses confirm that fibrous peats exhibit interconnected macropore networks, whereas amorphous peats display finer, poorly connected pore structures. Consequently, k and cv are highly stress- and state-dependent and cannot be treated as constants. Near-surface peat may exhibit high hydraulic conductivity and rapid consolidation, while deeper deposits at higher stresses may behave similarly to silts or clays, with significantly slower drainage and prolonged settlement. These findings provide a unified framework for interpreting peat behavior and improving settlement prediction in organic soils.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用恒应变速率一维固结试验，考察南安大略地区纤维状、非晶质泥炭以及有机质粉质黏土的固结行为。结果表明，压缩指数随孔隙率显著增加，而有机质含量和土体结构共同控制泥炭的内在压缩与渗流特性。渗透系数和固结系数随孔隙率增加而增大，但随有效应力升高而明显下降，并且在参考应力下随有机质含量增加而系统降低。研究强调，单纯基于孔隙率或有机质含量的经验关系具有土体特异性，难以唯一表征结构效应。

articles.title: Digital Twin Architecture for Real-TimeProcess Monitoring in Intelligent Manufacturing
articles.title_zh: 面向智能制造实时过程监测的数字孪生架构
articles.abstract: We present a rigorous mathematical framework for a Digital Twin Architecture (DTA) designed for real-time process monitoring and adaptive control in intelligent manufacturing environments. The framework integrates a hierarchical, three-scale stochastic state-space model spanning machine (µ), production-line (λ), and enterprise (η) levels with a Kalman Bayesian unscented filtering scheme that provides provably consistent state estimates under non-Gaussian measurement noise. Physics-informed deep neural networks (PI-DNN) supply a data-driven surrogate that respects governing engineering equations, while a soft-actor critic (SAC) reinforcement learning agent executes closed-loop optimal control subject to operational constraints. We establish a Lyapunov stability theorem guaranteeing mean-square boundedness of the synchronisation error between the physical system and its virtual counterpart, and prove mean-square convergence of the unscented Kalman filter under bounded process and observation noise. Anomaly detection is formalised via cumulative-sum (CUSUM) log-likelihood ratio statistics, for which closed-form detection- and false-alarm probability propositions are derived. Two detailed numerical examples a six-degree-of-freedom CNC machining cell and a tool-wear anomaly scenario demonstrate the framework's ability to achieve sub-15~nm RMS estimation accuracy and near-unity detection probability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于智能制造实时过程监测与自适应控制的数字孪生架构数学框架。该框架整合机器、产线和企业三个层级的随机状态空间模型，结合无迹卡尔曼贝叶斯滤波、物理信息深度神经网络以及软演员-评论家强化学习控制器。作者证明了物理系统与虚拟系统同步误差的均方有界性，以及滤波器在有界噪声下的均方收敛性，并基于 CUSUM 对异常检测进行了形式化建模。该研究为数字孪生在复杂制造系统中的稳定监测、预测与闭环优化提供了理论基础。

articles.title: Atomic-Scale Observation of Symmetry Breaking in Altermagnetic MnTe
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体 MnTe 中对称性破缺的原子尺度观测
articles.abstract: The recent discovery of altermagnetism has sparked growing interest in compensated magnetic systems as promising platforms for highly scalable spintronics. Altermagnetism is a distinct magnetic order where opposite spin sublattices are connected by rotation, yielding zero net magnetization but momentum‑dependent spin splitting. To date, experimental verification of altermagnetic order has been achieved predominantly through bulk-sensitive techniques, including spin-dependent electronic spectra and transport responses. However, direct atomic-scale evidence that explicitly correlates crystal symmetry, local structural distortions, and magnetic ordering has remained unexplored. Here, we report the direct atomic scale observation of coexisting polar distortions and altermagnetic order in MnTe, combining atomic resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) imaging with electron magnetic chiral dichroism (EMCD) measurements. We reveal that MnTe is not an ideal uniform P63/mmc g-wave altermagnet at the atomic scale. Instead, it hosts ubiquitous inversion-symmetry-breaking distortions that lower the spin-space-group (SSG) symmetry, admits d-wave altermagnetic components, and in lower-symmetry regimes, even allow s‑wave spin splitting (net magnetization). The coexistence of ferroelectric signatures and altermagnetic order establishes local lattice symmetry in MnTe as a control knob for altermagnetic spin splitting, spin current generation, and multiferroic memory applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过原子分辨扫描透射电子显微镜与电子磁手性二色性测量，直接观测 MnTe 中极性畸变与交替磁有序的共存。结果表明，MnTe 在原子尺度上并非理想均匀的 P63/mmc g 波交替磁体，而是普遍存在破坏反演对称性的局域结构畸变。此类畸变降低了自旋空间群对称性，并允许 d 波交替磁成分出现。该工作为理解晶体对称性、局域结构畸变与交替磁序之间的关联提供了直接原子尺度证据。

articles.title: Deterministic Out-of-Plane Spin Polarization Enabled by Altermagnetic Filtering of Critical Spin Fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 由临界自旋涨落的交替磁过滤实现确定性的面外自旋极化
articles.abstract: Spin current with out-of-plane polarization is essential for manipulating perpendicular magnetization but are typically suppressed by symmetry in conventional spin–orbit systems. Here we demonstrate a mechanism to generate and control such spin polarization by combining magnetic transitions with altermagnetic symmetry filtering. Near the Curie temperature of CrTe2, enhanced critical spin fluctuations produce a dense ensemble of angular-momentum-carrying excitations. Passing through the altermagnet CrSb, they are filtered into a spin current with a well-defined out-of-plane component, exerting a nonlinear torque on an adjacent Fe layer. The magnitude and sign of the polarization are continuously tunable via the current direction relative to the crystal lattice, reflecting Berry-curvature-driven spin textures. This approach establishes combining magnetic phase transitions with altermagnetic spin filter as tunable spin sources and provides a general route to engineering three-dimensional spin polarization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种通过磁相变与交替磁对称性过滤相结合来产生和调控面外自旋极化的新机制。在 CrTe2 的居里温度附近，增强的临界自旋涨落产生大量携带角动量的激发，这些激发通过交替磁体 CrSb 后被过滤为具有明确面外分量的自旋流。该自旋流可对相邻 Fe 层施加非线性力矩，其极化大小和符号可通过电流方向相对于晶格的取向连续调节。研究提出了利用交替磁自旋过滤构建可调三维自旋源的通用路径。

articles.title: Strong Correlation-Induced Quantum Phase Transitions in Two-Dimensional 1T-TiTe2
articles.title_zh: 二维 1T-TiTe2 中强关联诱导的量子相变
articles.abstract: The strongly correlated phase transitions in monolayer 1T-TiTe2 are investigated using CDMFT combined with a CTQMC solver. By examining the density of states, double occupancy, and spectral functions near the Fermi surface, strong electronic correlations are shown to drive the system from a metallic state to a Mott insulator, accompanied by the opening of an energy gap and the evolution of the Fermi surface from a conical structure into a localized distribution. By constructing a phase diagram based on interaction strength and temperature, the competition mechanism between paramagnetic and antiferromagnetic orders is elucidated. This study reveals the microscopic competition between bandwidth and strong correlation effects, providing a theoretical basis for understanding the diverse electronic properties of 1T-structured transition metal dichalcogenides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用团簇动力学平均场理论结合连续时间量子蒙特卡洛求解器，研究单层 1T-TiTe2 中的强关联相变。通过分析态密度、双占据数和费米面附近谱函数，作者表明强电子关联可驱动体系由金属态转变为莫特绝缘态，并伴随能隙打开和费米面局域化。基于相互作用强度与温度构建的相图揭示了顺磁序与反铁磁序之间的竞争机制。该工作为理解 1T 结构过渡金属二硫族化物多样化电子性质提供了理论依据。

articles.title: Quantum Chemical Calculations of H₂, HeH⁺, LiH, BeH₂, H₂O, NH₃, CH₄, CO₂, and N₂ Molecules Using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver(VQE): Ground State Energies,Potential Energy Surfaces, and Quantum Circuit Analysis
articles.title_zh: 使用变分量子本征求解器对 H₂、HeH⁺、LiH、BeH₂、H₂O、NH₃、CH₄、CO₂ 和 N₂ 分子进行量子化学计算：基态能量、势能面与量子线路分析
articles.abstract: We present a comprehensive quantum chemical study of nine molecules H₂, HeH⁺, LiH, BeH₂, H₂O, NH₃, CH₄, CO₂, and N₂ using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) algorithm implemented in Qiskit 2.4.1. Molecular Hamiltonians are constructed in the STO-3G minimal basis set, transformed to qubit operators via the Jordan-Wigner mapping, and optimized using the n-local hardware-efficient ansatz with the SLSQP optimizer. Ground state energies are benchmarked against Full Configuration Interaction (FCI)/STO-3G reference values from authoritative literature sources. VQE achieves accuracies from 96.46% (HeH⁺) to 99.99% (H₂), average 98.68%. Potential energy surfaces are generated for all nine molecules and compared with high level ab initio literature PES references including the Kolos-Wolniewicz H₂ curve, the Polyansky water surface, and the Bytautas-Ruedenberg N₂ FCI surface. Equilibrium bond lengths agree with experiment to within 0.000–0.006 Å. Quantum ansatz circuits are analyzed in detail for all molecules. These results confirm the viability of near-term VQE algorithms for molecular quantum chemistry across diverse bond types and geometries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用 Qiskit 2.4.1 中实现的变分量子本征求解器，对九种分子开展系统量子化学计算。研究在 STO-3G 最小基组下构建分子哈密顿量，经 Jordan-Wigner 映射转化为量子比特算符，并使用硬件高效 ansatz 与 SLSQP 优化器求解基态能量。所得结果与 FCI/STO-3G 文献基准比较，平均精度约为 98.68%，并生成了各分子的势能面，平衡键长与实验值符合良好。研究还分析了各分子的量子 ansatz 线路，表明近中期 VQE 算法在多类分子量子化学问题中具有可行性。

articles.title: RF coil for human head MRI with high sensitivity in peripheral area
articles.title_zh: 用于人头部 MRI 且在外周区域具有高灵敏度的射频线圈
articles.abstract: Objective: This study proposes a cortex radiofrequency (RF) coil based on a modified birdcage resonator with a shape conformal to the human head, tuned to its highest-order mode for enhancing magnetic resonance imaging of the cerebral cortex by maximizing the signal from these regions and minimizing the signal from deeply located brain areas. Materials and methods: We design the proposed resonator for the magnetic field penetration depth of the excited highest-order mode to match the desired depth of the region of interest, achieving specific spatial filtering at the RF level, with a meander line feed to ensure selective excitation of the highest-order mode and enable the corresponding sensitivity profile. Results: Numerical simulation with a voxel model reveals that compared to the central area, the RF magnetic field is 5 times higher in the temporal lobes, 28.8 times higher in the occipital lobe, and 51.8 times higher in the frontal lobe. Experimental studies demonstrated that the SNR at the center of the brain was suppressed by a factor of 3.1 compared to the frontal lobe and by a factor of 2.4 compared to the occipital lobe. Discussion: The proposed coil effectively suppresses central brain signals while enabling high-quality MRI of the cerebral cortex.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于改进鸟笼谐振器的皮层射频线圈，其形状贴合人头部，并调谐至最高阶模式以增强大脑皮层成像信号、抑制深部脑区信号。作者通过设计最高阶模式的磁场穿透深度与目标区域深度匹配，实现射频层面的空间滤波，并采用曲折线馈电以选择性激发相应模式。数值模拟显示外周脑区射频磁场显著高于中心区域，实验也表明脑中心信噪比相对额叶和枕叶受到抑制。该线圈有望提升皮层区域 MRI 成像的灵敏度与选择性。

articles.title: Broken time-reversal symmetry phase in kagome metals may establish conditions for superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 笼目金属中的破缺时间反演对称性相可能为超导性建立条件
articles.abstract: Physicists have long suspected that a peculiar quantum state lurks inside a class of materials known as kagome metals, but proving its existence has been elusive. Now, a team led by Yeongkwan Kim at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology has performed experiments on a kagome metal that provide the strongest evidence yet for this exotic state.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了关于笼目金属中一种特殊量子态的实验进展，该量子态长期被认为可能存在但难以被直接证明。由韩国科学技术院 Yeongkwan Kim 团队领导的实验为这一奇异状态提供了迄今较强的证据。结合标题可知，该工作关注破缺时间反演对称性相与超导出现条件之间的关系，但具体材料、测量方法和结论细节仍需查阅原文。

articles.title: Partition function zeros of quantum many-body systems: perturbative results
articles.title_zh: 量子多体系统配分函数零点：微扰结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A systematic method to find the Yang-Lee partition function zeros of quantum many-body systems based on perturbation theory at finite temperatures was recently introduced in arXiv:2504.01880. This method identifies wave-vector and temperature-dependent complex virtual energies obtainable from the thermal electronic Greens function. The collection of virtual energies over all ěck yield the Yang-Lee zeroes. We apply this approach to the one-dimensional Hubbard model for different boundary conditions. We compare the results obtained by this method up to second-order in perturbation theory with the results found by exact diagonalization. We also propose a quantity that could be used for experimental detection of these zeros of a Hubbard ring. An example of the detection method is presented using exact diagonalization of the 8-site Hubbard ring.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文应用一种基于有限温度微扰理论的系统方法，研究量子多体系统的杨-李配分函数零点。该方法从热电子格林函数中提取依赖波矢和温度的复虚能量，并由其集合确定杨-李零点。作者将该方法用于一维 Hubbard 模型的不同边界条件，并比较二阶微扰结果与精确对角化结果。研究还提出了一个可能用于实验探测 Hubbard 环中这些零点的量，并以 8 站点 Hubbard 环的精确对角化结果作为示例。

articles.title: Displacement-Field-Driven Semimetal-Superconductor Transition in Magic-Angle Twisted Trilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 魔角扭转三层石墨烯中由位移场驱动的半金属—超导体转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20849v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene(MATTG) hosts versatile displacement-field-tuned correlated phenomena. MATTG consists of a dispersive Dirac cone which hybridizes with the flat band from a twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) sector. The hybridization strength increases with the displacement field D and naively one may expect D-driven heavy fermion physics. However, the TBG Hubbard bands have a momentum-selective Mott gap, which is small at the Γ point due to the band topology, and a rigid local moment description as in the familiar Kondo lattice model is invalid. Here we show that the dominant effect of the displacement field is to induce an energy shift of the Dirac cone and self-doping into the TBG sector. We illustrate this picture in a concrete calculation using a slave-particle theory at the filling ν=± 2. We find that increasing D drives a transition from a semimetal into a superconducting state. We also discuss the enhancement of the superconductivity by D near ν=±2 and the particle-hole asymmetry of the phase diagram. Our results provide a unified picture for electric-field-tunable superconductivity, Mottness, and heavy-fermion-like behavior in MATTG.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究魔角扭转三层石墨烯中由位移场调控的关联现象，重点讨论 Dirac 锥与扭转双层石墨烯平带部门之间的杂化。作者指出，位移场的主要作用并非简单产生传统 Kondo 晶格式重费米子物理，而是引起 Dirac 锥能量位移并向 TBG 部门自掺杂。基于填充因子 ν=±2 的奴隶粒子理论计算表明，增大位移场可驱动体系从半金属态转变为超导态。该结果为电场可调超导性、莫特性和重费米子特征提供了统一图像。
authors: Bokai Liang, Jing-Yu Zhao, Ya-Hui Zhang

articles.title: Quantum Enhancement of Particle-Size Segregation
articles.title_zh: 粒径分离的量子增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Segregated states based on particle size emerge in granular materials from the competition between segregation and diffusive remixing. Here, we show that quantum coherence can enhance segregation beyond this classical limit. We introduce an open quantum cellular automaton for bidisperse mixtures that combines coherent transport and dissipative segregation. The automaton reproduces experimental and continuum-theory segregation dynamics, with segregation degrees collapsing onto a theoretical Péclet-dependent relationship. However, weakly decohering systems exhibit a coherence-driven transport regime that produces more strongly segregated steady states than classical predictions. Across a broad parameter range, the steady-state degree of segregation collapses onto two dimensionless numbers governing the competition between segregation, diffusion, and decoherence. These results identify quantum coherence as a mechanism for enhancing particle-size segregation and establish a framework for studying transport phenomena in open many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究颗粒材料中由粒径导致的分离现象，并指出量子相干性可使分离程度超越经典极限。作者提出一种用于双分散混合物的开放量子元胞自动机，结合相干输运与耗散分离，能够再现实验和连续介质理论中的分离动力学。在弱退相干条件下，体系出现由相干性驱动的输运机制，形成比经典预测更强的稳态分离。研究将稳态分离程度归结为控制分离、扩散和退相干竞争的两个无量纲数，为开放多体系统中的输运现象研究提供了框架。

articles.title: Persistent structural distortions and absent superconductivity in trilayer nickelate thin films
articles.title_zh: 三层镍酸盐薄膜中的持久结构畸变与超导缺失
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A new family of high-temperature superconductors was recently discovered in the n=2,3 Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates, where superconductivity emerges concomitant with suppression of parent density waves and structural octahedral rotations under hydrostatic pressure. Intriguingly, compressive strain mimics the structural effects of pressure in the n=2 phase, yielding ambient-pressure superconductivity. However, analogous strain-stabilized superconductivity has not been realized in the n=3. Here, we use atomically-precise synthesis, transport, picoscale electron microscopy, and synchrotron X-ray diffraction to probe n=3 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ thin films. Although compressive strain suppresses density wave order, we do not observe superconductivity even under the largest strain state. Importantly, we identify a structural distortion unique to strained n=3 thin films that may inhibit superconductivity: persistent, layer-inequivalent octahedral rotations around the c-axis. Our results highlight key differences between the n=3 and n=2 systems, suggesting that ambient-pressure superconductivity in the n=3 may require new methods beyond epitaxial strain engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对n=3 Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐La₄Ni₃O₁₀薄膜，利用原子级精确合成、输运测量、皮米尺度电子显微学和同步辐射X射线衍射探究应变对结构和电子态的影响。尽管压缩应变可抑制密度波有序，作者在最大应变条件下仍未观察到超导。研究识别出应变n=3薄膜中特有的、层间不等价且沿c轴持续存在的八面体旋转畸变，认为其可能抑制超导，表明n=3体系的常压超导可能需要超越外延应变的新途径。
authors: Abigail Y. Jiang, Maria Bambrick-Santoyo, Lopa Bhatt, Kyeong-Yoon Baek, Yi-Feng Zhao, Dan Ferenc Segedin, Ari B. Turkiewicz, Jenna Hatmin, Grace A. Pan, Suchismita Sarker, Donald A. Walko, Charles M. Brooks, David A. Muller, Berit H. Goodge, Hua Zhou, Antia S. Botana, Julia A. Mundy

articles.title: Quantum-Geometry-Induced Superconductivity near a Fractional Chern Insulator
articles.title_zh: 分数陈绝缘体附近由量子几何诱导的超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent moiré experiments and numerical studies of interacting Chern bands have revealed fractional Chern insulators, charge-density-wave order, and superconductivity as proximate correlation-driven phases in topological systems. How these phases compete or intertwine, and how quantum geometry shapes their interplay, remain open questions. Here we present an analytic study of competing correlation-driven phases in a partially filled Chern band using a coupled-wire construction and bosonization. The key ingredient is the coexistence of interaction channels that favor, respectively, a fractional Chern insulator (FCI) and a closely related anti-FCI (aFCI) state. The aFCI channel is specific to lattice Chern bands and is enhanced by the quantum geometry of the underlying band structure. We show that when both FCI and aFCI scattering channels are present, their interplay generates an effective coupling that drives a superconducting instability near the FCI phase. The same mechanism can also favor a charge-density-wave phase, depending on microscopic parameters. Using a perturbative renormalization-group analysis, we obtain the phase diagram and identify a superconducting regime adjacent to the FCI phase. We further estimate the superconducting transition temperature and show that it is enhanced by quantum geometry. Our results establish quantum geometry as an organizing principle for the interplay among FCI, aFCI, and superconducting correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究解析考察部分填充陈能带中由相互作用驱动的竞争相，包括分数陈绝缘体、电荷密度波和超导相，并关注量子几何对这些相互作用的调控。作者采用耦合线构造和玻色化方法，指出分数陈绝缘体通道与晶格陈能带中特有、受量子几何增强的反分数陈绝缘体通道可共存。两种散射通道的相互作用会在分数陈绝缘体附近产生有效耦合并驱动超导不稳定性，也可能在不同微观参数下有利于电荷密度波相。

articles.title: Importance of effective Coulomb interactions for T_c in cuprates
articles.title_zh: 有效库仑相互作用对铜氧化物超导体T_c的重要性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cuprate superconductors exhibit the highest observed superconducting T_c at atmospheric pressure. However, the magnitude of T_c varies significantly between different cuprates. At present, it is unclear what properties of the crystal structure affect T_c most strongly, yet such an understanding must underpin any efforts toward high-T_c materials design. To address this issue, we perform a large scale systematic study, employing a combination of data collection, state-of-the-art numerical methods, and statistical analysis. We identify about 40 different cuprate compounds, and we compile detailed data about their T_c's and crystal structures from literature and the available databases. Using a fully automated procedure, for each compound we compute the DFT bandstructure and downfold it to two of the most commonly studied low-energy lattice models, namely the single-band Hubbard and the three-band Emery models. The downfolding is based on the approach of MLWFs and cRPA. Finally, we apply a thorough and unbiased statistical analysis to investigate the correlations between the experimentally measured T_c's and the computed parameters of our theoretical models. Our data indicates that more sophisticated models might be needed to describe all cuprates on the same footing. Nevertheless, we find that T_c scales well with simple functions of model parameters. We confirm a previously observed trend that t' in the single-band model correlates with the experimental T_c, and we find that T_c appears to vanish below a finite value of t', in agreement with recent ground-state calculations for the Hubbard model. However, we find that the coupling strength also plays a role: throughout our entire dataset, T_c correlates the most with the Coulomb coupling on the p-orbitals in the 3-band model, highlighting the importance of the oxygen sites in the copper-oxide planes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究旨在阐明不同铜氧化物超导体中超导转变温度T_c差异的结构和电子起源。作者汇集约40种铜氧化物化合物的T_c与晶体结构数据，并通过自动化流程计算DFT能带，将其下折叠到单带Hubbard模型和三带Emery模型，参数提取基于最大局域Wannier函数和受限随机相位近似。随后通过系统统计分析，研究实验T_c与计算得到的低能模型参数之间的相关性，强调有效库仑相互作用在理解和设计高T_c材料中的作用。
authors: Jakša Vučičević, Upendra Kumar, Chia-Nan Yeh, Miguel A. Morales, Malte Rösner

articles.title: Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in Two-Dimensional Perovskite Oxides
articles.title_zh: 二维钙钛矿氧化物中的体光伏效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Perovskite oxides ABO₃ host a rich interplay of charge, spin, lattice, and orbital degrees of freedom, giving rise to diverse quantum phenomena. In low-dimensional ABO₃, reduced symmetry can induce exotic quantum effects such as the two-dimensional electron gas and unconventional superconductivity. Using first-principles density functional theory, tight-binding modeling, and symmetry analysis, we show that ultrathin two-dimensional (2D) ABO₃ films -- exemplified by SrTiO₃ -- naturally break inversion symmetry, producing a spontaneous out-of-plane bulk photovoltaic (BPV) effect. This differs from previous studies on in-plane BPV current signals and is more applicable and experimentally detectable. Such an effect is highly tunable via thickness, strain, surface termination, crystallographic orientation, and Moiré twisting. These findings are broadly applicable to a wide range of 2D perovskite and other layer-resolved oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合第一性原理密度泛函理论、紧束缚模型与对称性分析，指出超薄二维 ABO₃ 钙钛矿氧化物薄膜（以 SrTiO₃ 为例）会天然破缺反演对称性，从而产生自发的面外体光伏效应。与以往关注面内体光伏电流的研究不同，该效应更便于实验探测，并可通过厚度、应变、表面终止、晶体取向和莫尔扭转等手段调控。研究结果有望推广至多类二维钙钛矿及其他层分辨氧化物体系。
authors: Chunmei Zhang, Jian Zhou, Liang Si

articles.title: Hyperfine versus exchange interaction in the spin dynamics of spatially indirect excitons in CsPbI₃ perovskite nanocrystals
articles.title_zh: CsPbI₃ 钙钛矿纳米晶中空间间接激子自旋动力学的超精细相互作用与交换相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the dynamics of recombination, optical orientation, and optical alignment of excitons in ensembles of CsPbI₃ nanocrystals (NCs), synthesized in a glass matrix. In large NCs with size exceeding 16 nm, the low-energy photoluminescence is contributed by the emission of indirect in real space excitons formed by spatially separated electrons and holes, which are localized at the NC/glass interface. The recombination dynamics of an ensemble of such excitons extends from tens of nanoseconds to microseconds and exhibits a power-law dependence. Their optical alignment and optical orientation reveal a peculiar spin dynamics caused by excitons influenced by the exchange interaction, varying by orders of magnitude. We develop a theory of the polarized photoluminescence of triplet excitons, taking into account the interplay between the electron-hole exchange interaction, their Zeeman effect, and their hyperfine interaction with the nuclei. This model reveals that for the excitons with the smallest exchange splitting we reach the regime, where the exciton fine structure becomes dominated by the hyperfine interaction with the random nuclear spin fluctuations in the NCs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了玻璃基质中 CsPbI₃ 纳米晶集合体内激子的复合动力学、光学取向与光学排列。在尺寸超过 16 nm 的较大纳米晶中，低能光致发光主要来自位于纳米晶/玻璃界面的空间间接激子，其复合时间跨越纳秒到微秒并呈幂律行为。作者建立了三重态激子偏振发光理论，纳入电子-空穴交换相互作用、塞曼效应及与核自旋的超精细相互作用，揭示在交换劈裂很小时激子精细结构可由随机核场主导。
authors: Timur S. Shamirzaev, Nataliia E. Kopteva, Dmitry S. Smirnov, Dmitri R. Yakovlev, Elena V. Kolobkova, Maria S. Kuznetsova, Eugeniyus L. Ivchenko, Yan E. Maidebura, Evgeny A. Zhukov, Manfred Bayer

articles.title: A thermodynamic uncertainty relation for (hybrid) N--S coherent conductors
articles.title_zh: 混合正常金属—超导相干导体的热力学不确定性关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermodynamic uncertainty relations establish fundamental bounds between current fluctuations and entropy production in nonequilibrium systems. In hybrid normal superconducting conductors, transport is governed by the coexistence of quasiparticle transmission and Andreev reflection, where electron hole conversion transfers charge through the superconducting condensate. Using the Anantram Datta scattering formalism, we decompose the charge current and zero-frequency noise into Andreev, quasiparticle, and interference contributions. Although the interference term prevents a simple additive bound at the level of individual noise components, we show that the nonequilibrium excess noise admits a positive representation. This allows us to prove a hybrid quantum thermodynamic uncertainty relation valid for an arbitrary real superconducting gap. Our result extends the pure Andreev quantum TUR to regimes where quasiparticle and Andreev processes coexist, clarifying how superconducting coherence reshapes current fluctuations while preserving a universal dissipation precision constraint in hybrid quantum conductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究混合正常金属—超导导体中的电流涨落与熵产生之间的基本约束，其中输运同时包含准粒子透射与 Andreev 反射。作者基于 Anantram-Datta 散射形式，将电荷电流与零频噪声分解为 Andreev、准粒子和干涉贡献，并指出干涉项阻碍了对各噪声分量建立简单可加边界。通过证明非平衡过量噪声具有正表示，文章建立了适用于任意实超导能隙的混合量子热力学不确定性关系。

articles.title: The moving Fermi polaron
articles.title_zh: 运动的费米极化子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Fermi polaron, formed by an impurity interacting with a surrounding Fermi sea, exemplifies the canonical quasiparticle concept as a cornerstone in our description of quantum many-body systems across a wide range of energy scales. Experiments on atomic quantum gases have provided profound insights into the universal nature of the Fermi polaron. While most previous studies have focused on the case of zero impurity momentum, finite-momentum properties have remained largely uncharted. Here, we investigate the moving Fermi polaron by combining a novel Raman acceleration scheme with high-precision radio-frequency spectroscopy, exploring the quasiparticle dispersion relation over a wide range of momenta. We compare our measurements of energy shifts and spectral linewidths with a microscopic theory and reach quantitative agreement for all momenta. For low momenta, we find the energy of the moving polaron to be fully consistent with the Fermi liquid picture of a dressed particle with a constant effective mass. At high momenta, the polaron approaches the behavior of a weakly interacting bare particle, featuring small energy shifts and weak broadening. For intermediate momenta, broadening is generally larger and, most strikingly, the behavior differs for attractive and repulsive polarons. While the repulsive polaron exhibits a smooth connection between both regimes along with a monotonic change of the energy shift, the attractive case shows a peculiar non-monotonic behavior. With increasing momentum, the attractive polaron enters a regime where its energy deviates from the constant effective mass expression and broadening suddenly increases. By comparing this observation with theory, we show that this abrupt behavior coincides with the attractive polaron entering a molecule-hole continuum, where it is no longer the ground state. We interpret this as a motion-induced polaron-molecule transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过新的拉曼加速方案结合高精度射频谱学，实验探索了有限动量下费米极化子的准粒子色散关系。作者在宽动量范围内测量能量位移和谱线宽度，并与微观理论取得定量一致。低动量下，运动极化子的能量符合费米液体图像，可描述为具有近似恒定有效质量的被修饰粒子；高动量下，其行为趋近于弱相互作用的裸粒子。
authors: Johanna Hennebichler, Ruben Erlenstedt, Erich Dobler, Cosetta Baroni, Rudolf Grimm, Matteo Caldara, Georg Bruun, Pietro Massignan

articles.title: Assessing Majorana states and qubits through quantum capacitance
articles.title_zh: 通过量子电容评估 Majorana 态与量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum capacitance (QC) has recently emerged as a promising tool for parity readout in topological qubits based on Majorana bound states (MBSs). Here, we show that this capability can be extended further: by employing an auxiliary quantum dot (QD) as a sensor, we demonstrate that QC measurements simultaneously resolve two fundamental figures of merit of the device, the ground-state energy splitting and the MBS overlap, thus providing direct access to the underlying internal degrees of freedom. Using a low-energy effective model, we provide analytic expressions for these two figures of merit that can be determined from the relative position and magnitude of the QC maxima in the even and odd parity sectors as functions of the auxiliary-QD energy. We further validate these results with a microscopic model of QD-based Kitaev chains and qubits, demonstrating their applicability in a wide range of MBS-based devices. Our results establish QC as a probe of MBS quality and a tool for topological-device optimization that preserves fermion parity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用辅助量子点作为传感器，通过量子电容测量来表征基于 Majorana 束缚态的拓扑器件。作者表明，量子电容不仅可用于费米子宇称读出，还能同时解析基态能量劈裂和 Majorana 束缚态重叠这两个关键品质指标。基于低能有效模型，文章给出了从不同宇称扇区量子电容峰的位置和强度提取这些指标的解析表达式，并用量子点 Kitaev 链和量子比特的微观模型验证了适用性。
authors: Rodrigo A. Dourado, Ramón Aguado, Jeroen Danon, Martin Leijnse, Rubén Seoane Souto

articles.title: Many-body quantum geometric effects and entanglement at the 3D metal-insulator quantum phase transition
articles.title_zh: 三维金属—绝缘体量子相变中的多体量子几何效应与纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21648v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry has emerged as a unifying concept across condensed matter physics, underlying phenomena from nonlinear topological response to flat-band superconductivity. While usually formulated within band theory, quantum geometry remains meaningful in disordered interacting systems~i̧teresta1999electron. Here we show that the first negative moment of the optical conductivity -- proportional to the zero temperature quantum Fisher information as a bound on the multipartite entanglement -- provides an experimental probe of quantum geometry across the three-dimensional metal-insulator quantum phase transition in phosphorus-doped silicon. We extract a quantum geometric length ell that characterizes the local wavefunctions. Far from the transition, this length is almost coincident with the Bohr radius of the hydrogenic phosphorus donors, reflecting their atomic-scale quantum geometry. Approaching the transition, ell is enhanced, but does not diverge continuously like a correlation length; it jumps discontinuously to infinity at the critical point. This reflects the UV domination of the sum rule in three dimensions that renders it insensitive to the critical fluctuations driving the diverging dielectric constant and correlation length. Its enhancement demonstrates a ``puffing" of the donor polarizability volume of quantum geometric origin, which yields a quantum geometric corrected Clausius-Mossotti description in closer agreement with the diverging dielectric response and provides a quantum mechanical foundation for the century-old Herzfeld metallization criterion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，光学电导率的一阶负矩与零温量子 Fisher 信息相关，可作为三维金属—绝缘体量子相变中量子几何和多体纠缠的实验探针。作者以磷掺杂硅为对象，提取表征局域波函数的量子几何长度。远离相变时，该长度接近氢样磷施主的玻尔半径；接近临界点时它增强但不按通常关联长度连续发散，而是在临界点不连续跃迁至无穷大，反映出三维求和规则的紫外主导特征。
authors: Jason Y. Yan, Xiaoyu Guo, R. Bhandia, T. F. Rosenbaum, Natalia Drichko, N. P. Armitage

articles.title: Trial wavefunction for fractional quantum spin Hall insulators
articles.title_zh: 分数量子自旋霍尔绝缘体的试探波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fermions with opposite spins occupying half-filled conjugate Chern bands exhibit interaction physics distinct from their multi-component Landau-level counterparts with the same chirality. This is largely due to unavoidable inter-species collisions that preclude the Halperin-type wavefunctions available in multi-component Landau levels. In this work, we propose and evaluate a variational wavefunction for a fractional quantum spin Hall state with Z₄ topological order in a pair of conjugate Landau levels. This Z₄ topological order has previously been shown to be the minimal topological order compatible with charge conservation, S_z conservation, time-reversal symmetry, and the fractional spin Hall conductance 1/2 suggested by previous twisted MoTe₂ experiments. Our construction is based on the condensation of an anyonic exciton formed by the neutral fermionic excitations in a decoupled pair of Moore-Read Pfaffian state and its conjugate. By coupling the chiral and anti-chiral Ising conformal field theories associated with the two spin species, we introduce a variational mass parameter in the Z₄ trial wavefunction that captures the inter-spin-species s-wave pairing of composite fermions alongside the intra-spin-species p-wave pairing. We assess the energetics of this trial state using Monte Carlo sampling on a spherical geometry. Because the coupled state intrinsically involves Landau-level mixing, we explicitly evaluate the resulting kinetic energy penalty. Our phase diagram reveals that the proposed Z₄ state becomes energetically favorable in a sizable region of parameter space, over both the decoupled pair of conjugate Pfaffian states and an alternative exciton condensate state. These results provide a concrete microscopic wavefunction realization of this Z₄ fractional quantum spin Hall phase, and propose a route to constructing additional families of such states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对占据半填充共轭陈能带的反自旋费米子，提出并评估了一种具有 Z₄ 拓扑序的分数量子自旋霍尔态变分波函数。该 Z₄ 拓扑序被认为是在电荷守恒、S_z 守恒、时间反演对称性以及分数自旋霍尔电导为 1/2 条件下的最小兼容拓扑序。作者的构造基于解耦 Moore-Read Pfaffian 态及其共轭态中中性费米激发形成的任意子激子凝聚，并通过耦合两个自旋组分对应的手征与反手征 Ising 共形场论引入变分质量参数，以刻画种间相互作用效应。

articles.title: Non-BCS Pairing by a Singular Dynamical Interaction
articles.title_zh: 由奇异动力学相互作用导致的非 BCS 配对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This review examines the theory of superconductivity in systems with em singular dynamical electron-electron interaction and contrasts it with a conventional BCS superconductivity. Examples include metals near a Quantum Critical Point, quantum dots and system near a localization (Mott) transition. We show, that the singular interaction destroys the traditional separation of energy scales, invalidating the significance of Cooper logarithm, and, as the consequence, the whole BCS framework. We explore the universal model with dynamical interaction Γ (Ømega) propto 1/|Ømega|^γ (the γ-model) and analyze the competition/interplay between the tendency towards pairing and towards non-Fermi liquid behavior. We show that superconductivity still develops once the pairing interaction exceeds a certain threshold, but the origin of the pairing is qualitatively different from that in BCS theory. We show that the gap equation at T=0 has an infinite set of topologically distinct solutions. These solution disappear one by one once the pairing interaction becomes non-singular (massive). We review the physics underlying these phenomena and outline future directions.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述讨论具有奇异动力学电子—电子相互作用体系中的超导理论，并将其与传统 BCS 超导进行比较，相关体系包括量子临界点附近金属、量子点以及接近局域化或 Mott 转变的系统。作者指出奇异相互作用破坏了传统能标分离，使 Cooper 对数不再具有核心意义，从而使 BCS 框架失效。文章系统分析了相互作用形式为 Γ(Ω)∝1/|Ω|^γ 的 γ 模型，讨论配对倾向与非费米液体行为的竞争，并指出超导可在配对相互作用超过阈值后出现，但其物理起源不同于 BCS 理论。
authors: Artem G. Abanov, Andrey V. Chubukov

articles.title: Exact Accumulated-Field Determined Steady States with Boundary-Controlled Relaxation in Dissipative Quantum Link Chains
articles.title_zh: 耗散量子链环中的累积场精确决定稳态与边界控制弛豫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.22065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In open quantum lattice systems, changing the boundary condition would appear to alter both the steady state and the nonzero Liouvillian spectrum. Here we show that these two boundary-induced changes do not necessarily occur together in a globally reciprocal dissipative quantum link chain. The steady state is determined by an accumulated field defined by link-resolved dissipative asymmetries, and a gauge-generated transformation built from this field gives exact symmetry-resolved steady states with nonuniform, accumulated-field-dependent reduced matter occupations. We then construct a reciprocal cyclic boundary condition that preserves these matter occupations while changing the nonzero Liouvillian spectrum. Consequently, open and cyclic chains relax to the same reduced matter steady-occupation profile with different Liouvillian gaps, with the cyclic closure accelerating relaxation. In the strong-dissipation limit, this relaxation difference can be reduced to a spectral comparison of effective exclusion processes with open and cyclic boundaries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察开放量子晶格系统中边界条件改变对稳态和 Liouvillian 非零谱的影响，指出二者并不必然同时改变。作者在全局互易的耗散量子链环中引入由链路分辨耗散不对称性定义的累积场，并通过规范变换给出精确的、按对称性分辨的稳态，得到依赖累积场的非均匀物质占据。进一步构造的互易周期边界条件可保持相同的稳态占据分布但改变非零 Liouvillian 谱，从而使周期闭合加速弛豫。
authors: Yazhuang Miao, Weizh Ma, Yong Wang, Xiaolong Zhao, Xuexi Yi

articles.title: On the statistical theory of strong electrolytes and high-temperature plasmas: new applications of the work of Yukhnovskii and Kelbg
articles.title_zh: 强电解质与高温等离子体的统计理论：Yukhnovskii 与 Kelbg 工作的新应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.22111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Remembering here the work of two pioneers of the statistical physics of Coulomb systems, Günter Kelbg, and Ihor Yukhnovskii, we analyze their methods and give some new applications to ionic solutions and quantum plasmas. In particular, we develop applications of the theory to strong electrolytes and to thermal high-temperature plasmas at T > 0⁵ K using the exponential interaction model. We show the strong structural similarity of these two classes of Coulomb systems, which physics is determined mostly by contributions proportional to e⁴ and e⁶. We predict at higher densities a structural transition to oscillating correlations. The thermodynamic functions show a smooth transition from a quadratic root increase to a slower increase like nᵢ¹/⁴ which observes the Onsager bound. Effects of asymmetries in charges and masses are studied with applications to ionic systems with multiple charges and to high-temperature plasmas, in particular, to plasmas with He²⁺-ions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文回顾并拓展 Günter Kelbg 与 Ihor Yukhnovskii 在库仑体系统计物理方面的方法，应用于离子溶液和量子等离子体。作者利用指数相互作用模型研究强电解质及 T>10⁵ K 的热高温等离子体，指出两类库仑体系在结构上具有强相似性，其物理主要由与 e⁴ 和 e⁶ 成正比的贡献决定。文章预测较高密度下会出现向振荡关联的结构转变，并讨论电荷和质量不对称性对多价离子体系及含 He²⁺ 离子的高温等离子体的影响。

articles.title: Open-quantum-system theory of non-Markovian electron-phonon dynamics
articles.title_zh: 非马尔可夫电子—声子动力学的开放量子系统理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.22233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a non-Markovian open quantum dynamics formalism for the study of nonequilibrium electron-phonon interactions, based on a closed set of four coupled equations of motion for the electronic one-body reduced density matrix, the phonon density matrix, the coherent phonon, and the electron-phonon correlations. Memory effects in the electronic dynamics emerge naturally from the coupling between the electronic density matrix and the electron-phonon correlation equations, beyond the Markovian approximation. The formalism treats coherent-phonon dynamics and dissipative broadening on an equal footing, making it particularly suited to polaron formation and the finite lifetimes of driven electronic excitations. In appropriate limits it recovers the Fan-Migdal, polarization in random-phase-approximation, and Ehrenfest self-energies of nonequilibrium Green's function theory, as well as the Lindblad and Boltzmann equations, while avoiding the storage of two-time correlators. To drive the system out of equilibrium, we study its interaction with an external time-dependent field. As an illustrative application, we benchmark our theory against the exact solution of the Holstein dimer under a strong external perturbation, where the non-Markovian dynamics correctly captures dissipative spectral broadening and energy conservation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种用于非平衡电子—声子相互作用的非马尔可夫开放量子动力学形式，基于电子一体约化密度矩阵、声子密度矩阵、相干声子和电子—声子关联的四个耦合运动方程。电子动力学中的记忆效应由电子密度矩阵与电子—声子关联方程的耦合自然产生，超越了马尔可夫近似。该形式能够统一处理相干声子动力学与耗散展宽，适合描述极化子形成和受驱电子激发的有限寿命，并在适当极限下恢复多种非平衡格林函数、自洽场和动力学方程结果。
authors: Gabriele Riva, Jacopo Simoni, Yuan Ping

articles.title: Non-equilibrium angular momentum selectivity and filtering in chiral carbon nanotubes
articles.title_zh: 手性碳纳米管中的非平衡角动量选择性与过滤
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.22235v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Carbon nanotubes (CNTs) constitute a highly tunable platform for probing the interplay between structural chirality and quantum transport in quasi-one-dimensional systems. Here, we perform a systematic study of the non-equilibrium orbital response across a broad set of metallic and semiconducting chiral CNTs. We find that the orbital Edelstein susceptibility depends strongly on both chirality and nanotube diameter, revealing that the orbital response cannot be captured by a universal scaling law. Instead, distinct families of CNTs emerge, forming characteristic orbital-response branches uniquely determined by the chiral wrapping vector. We further investigate the role of metallic contacts on orbital-current generation and orbital selectivity. While metallic CNTs rapidly recover their intrinsic orbital response away from the contact region, semiconducting CNTs display pronounced oscillatory behavior arising from interference between transport channels carrying different angular momenta injected by wide-band metallic contacts.
