articles.title: Classical computational simulation of the FeMo-cofactor model to chemical accuracy and its implications
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.04621v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We use classical computational methods to estimate the ground-state energy to chemical accuracy in a model of the FeMo-cofactor of nitrogenase which is widely studied as a target of quantum computing. Our result relies on the insight that the ground-state problem can be characterized as one of ranking many competing, but largely simple, states. This allows a combination of systematic high-order coupled cluster and density matrix renormalization group calculations together with an extrapolation protocol to obtain an accurate energy. Within the model we identify several spin isomer candidates for the ground-state that are degenerate to chemical accuracy. Beyond this model, we characterize the impact of additional electronic excitations and the cluster and protein geometric fluctuations on the low-lying electronic landscape. We find that many features of the landscape are retained in more detailed representations of nitrogenase, which points to the complexity of spectroscopic interpretations of the electronic structure of the FeMo-cofactor.
authors: Huanchen Zhai, Chenghan Li, Xing Zhang, Zhendong Li, Seunghoon Lee, Garnet Kin-Lic Chan

articles.title: Phonon assisted absorption in Transition Metal Dichalcogenide heterostructures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.02803v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The coupling of atomic vibrations to electronic excitations - traditionally understood to be a source of energy loss in semiconductors - has recently been explored in photosynthetic light harvesting as a means to circumvent dissipation by harnessing quantum vibronic coherence. Motivated by recent photocurrent measurements of vibronic sidebands in WSe₂/MoSe₂ optoelectronic devices, we present a nonperturbative theoretical framework for phonon-assisted absorption in van der Waals heterostructures. Using a polaron transformation, a closed-form expression for the optical absorption spectrum at arbitrary temperatures is presented. Our model includes both intraband and interband electron-phonon coupling. Detailed analysis shows that the observed periodic sidebands originate from the strong coupling between interlayer excitons and nearly dispersionless optical phonon modes. Comparing two limiting cases - one involving only intraband couplings, and another incorporating coherent interband processes - we show that interband phonon-assisted transitions are needed to account for the observed data. Beyond enabling the direct estimation of vibronic coupling strengths from spectroscopic data, these findings have profound consequences for our understanding of optical and optoelectronic responses: coherent interband coupling of atomic vibrations to excitons is essential to quantifying photoresponse in transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures.

articles.title: Metallic hydrogen confined by graphene
articles.abstract: The metallization of hydrogen is a prerequisite for the emergence of superconducting properties, along with those of hydrides. Chemical precompression has enabled a class of high-transition-temperature superconductors based on hydrogen-rich hydrides, whereas direct metallization of molecular hydrides remains challenging. In this study, we demonstrate the metallization of hydrogen confined within fixed two-dimensional graphene channels, which provide a nanoscale environment for effective compression. The confined hydrogen forms compressed molecular hydrides whose intermolecular H–H separations are significantly reduced compared to those in ambient molecular hydrogen. Electronic structure calculations reveal that all the hydrogens in both stacks exhibit metallic properties. The Fermi surface of both stacks exhibits a peculiar nesting pattern, suggesting enhanced electron–phonon coupling. These results identify graphene-confined hydrogen (graphene–H 6 ) systems as a promising platform for achieving metallic hydrogen and potentially low-pressure, high- T c superconductors.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Modeling the coincident three-ion momentum imaging of diiodomethane photodissociation on reduced-dimensional potential energy surfaces
articles.abstract: We present an efficient theoretical model to simulate observables in the time-resolved coincident three-ion Coulomb explosion experiment of diiodomethane. The model employs two degrees of freedom to describe the C–I bond breaking and the CH 2 I rotation during photodissociation and three degrees of freedom to describe the coincident CH2++I2++I2+ fragmentation during the subsequent Coulomb explosion. By solving the equations of motion, the photodissociation pathways are obtained on two-dimensional potential energy surfaces of the valence excited states of the neutral molecule, and the asymptotic momenta of the three ionic fragments are determined on the three-dimensional ground-state potential energy surface of the fivefold-charged cation. The photodissociation pathways are consistent with previous ab initio molecular dynamics simulations and indicate a CH 2 I rotational period of ∼340 fs. The theoretical time-resolved kinetic energy release and the correlation between the kinetic energy release and the angle between the two I 2+ momenta show good agreement with experimental signals in part, reflecting and confirming the static CH 2 I 2 state and the CH 2 I + I dissociation channels.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: The entropic barrier around the conical intersection seam
articles.abstract: Conical intersections (CIs) are seen as the main mediators of nonadiabatic transitions; yet, mixed quantum–classical (MQC) simulations that treat nuclei as classical point particles rarely, if ever, sample geometries with exactly degenerate electronic energies. Here, we show that this behavior arises from a fundamental statistical–mechanical constraint on classical nuclear motion. Using a linear vibronic coupling model, we derive the free energy along the adiabatic energy gap and demonstrate analytically that as the gap approaches zero, the free energy diverges around the CI seam. Molecular dynamics simulations of the methaniminium cation on the S 1 surface confirm this prediction: trajectories can approach regions with small adiabatic gaps, but never reach the CI seam, even if the CI corresponds to a region of lowest potential energy. These results clarify why MQC methods successfully capture nonadiabatic behavior without sampling exact degeneracies and agree with recent findings that classical trajectories can sense the presence of CIs without visiting them.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Molecular electron transfer in optical cavities: From excitonic to vibronic polaritons
articles.abstract: Strong coupling between molecular excitations and quantized electromagnetic fields in optical cavities provides a powerful means to control the physical and chemical properties of molecular systems. Here, we study electron transfer (ET) dynamics in cavity-coupled molecules using the numerically exact hierarchical equations of motion method, which captures nonperturbative and non-Markovian effects beyond standard perturbative theories. We identify distinct resonance and collective effects associated with polariton formation and show that the ET rate saturates in the strong-coupling regime, a feature not captured by perturbative approaches. We further extend the cavity-modified ET model by incorporating the nuclear-coordinate dependence of molecular electric dipole moments, which gives rise to a three-body interaction involving molecular electronic and vibrational degrees of freedom and cavity photons. This vibronic polariton formation leads to non-monotonic, oscillatory dependencies of the ET rate on the light–matter coupling strength and cavity frequency, which we attribute to quantum interference among multiple transfer pathways. These findings establish cavity-modified electron transfer as a multichannel quantum process governed by the interplay of electronic, vibrational, and photonic degrees of freedom.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Multiconfigurational Gaussian wavepacket simulations of exciton diffusion in semiconducting polymer chains: Efficient finite-temperature simulations with Langevin driving
articles.abstract: First-principles quantum-dynamical simulations of photoinduced exciton dynamics are carried out using the variational two-layer Gaussian-based multiconfiguration time-dependent Hartree (2L-GMCTDH) method combined with stochastic Langevin dynamics. Analogously to earlier reference calculations [Binder and Burghardt, Faraday Discuss. 221 , 406 (2020)], a generalized Frenkel–Holstein Hamiltonian is constructed for a 20-site oligothiophene chain as a minimal model for intra-chain exciton migration in poly-(3-hexylthiophene) (P3HT). Here, exciton quasi-particles undergo polaronic trapping due to local high-frequency modes, while transport is induced by thermal driving due to ring-torsional modes. It is shown that the 2L-GMCTDH simulations provide a highly flexible and efficient framework where the use of multiple explicit local reservoirs can be replaced with multiple Langevin thermostats. The computation of temperature-dependent exciton diffusion coefficients is illustrated, along with the dependence on static disorder.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Dataset distillation for machine learning force field in phase transition regime
articles.abstract: Machine learning force fields (MLFFs) have emerged as powerful data-driven tools for atomistic simulations, enabling large-scale and complex atomic systems to be simulated with accuracy comparable to that of ab initio methods. However, MLFFs often suffer from low training efficiency in the phase transition regime, where structural fluctuations are significantly elevated. To address this challenge, we propose a Central-Peripheral Distillation (CPD) algorithm for training dataset distillation. By strategically integrating representative samples with critical corner cases, the CPD algorithm ensures that the distilled dataset retains maximum structural diversity. We validated the efficacy of the CPD method on the liquid–liquid phase transition of dense hydrogen. Results show that, with the CPD approach, only 150 configurations are sufficient to train a MLFF that can fully reproduce the structural and dynamical properties of liquid hydrogen in the vicinity of its phase transition regime. This work paves the way for high-fidelity labeling of the MLFF training datasets, for instance, by adopting high-level ab initio calculations beyond the standard density functional theory, thereby enhancing the predictive accuracy of MLFFs.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Exact tunneling splittings from path-integral hybrid Monte Carlo with enveloping bridging potentials
articles.abstract: A path-integral hybrid Monte Carlo approach with enveloping bridging potentials (PIHMC-EBP) is proposed for calculating numerically exact tunneling splittings in molecular systems. The central idea is to construct an approximately barrierless bridging potential that smoothly connects symmetry-related regions of ring-polymer phase space, enabling direct sampling of the free-energy profile from which the relevant splittings are obtained. Two tailored nonlocal updates are designed to enhance the sampling of slow collective motions. Compared with path-integral molecular dynamics using thermodynamic integration, PIHMC-EBP obviates the need for quadrature and time step convergence checks, thereby substantially reducing the manual effort required to analyze the results. Applications to malonaldehyde (and its deuterated isotopologue) and the HCl dimer using state-of-the-art potential energy surfaces (PESs) provide the most precise tunneling splittings reported to date for both systems, while simultaneously reducing the overall computational cost by several times and three orders of magnitude, respectively. Finally, application to the water dimer yields the first numerically exact path-integral calculations of the ground-state tunneling splittings on three different PESs, all obtained simultaneously by reweighting a single set of trajectories.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Onsager’s real cavity model near solid interfaces
articles.abstract: We develop an extended Onsager real-cavity framework to describe the Casimir–Polder interaction of small molecules dissolved in dielectric liquids near planar interfaces. By analytically resolving the geometry of the cavity opening, we derive closed-form expressions that capture the modification of the interaction as the molecule approaches a surface and connect smoothly to the asymptotic medium-assisted limit. Using experimentally established dielectric functions for water, propanol, and PTFE together with accurate molecular polarizabilities for O 2 and N 2 , we compute the full distance-dependent potential for representative molecule–liquid–surface combinations. The results reveal how local-field screening, cavity geometry, and material response jointly determine both the magnitude and shape of the interaction, including the characteristic transition between open-cavity ( z ≲ z C ) and closed-cavity ( z ≳ z C ) regimes. Beyond providing quantitative predictions, the framework offers an analytically transparent decomposition of dispersion forces in liquids, enabling a direct identification of the underlying physical contributions and an efficient exploration of parameter dependencies across different systems. The approach thus provides a useful baseline for interpreting dispersion interactions in complex environments within a continuum, local-field corrected description.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Intrinsic Raman scattering activity of OH and OD oscillators in liquid H 2 O, D 2 O, and HOD: Roles of zero-point energy and vibrational coupling
articles.abstract: Liquid water is a strongly associated and vibrationally delocalized system in which nuclear quantum effects (NQEs), particularly zero-point energy and vibrational anharmonicity, influence the structure and dynamics. Here, we examine the roles of NQE and vibrational coupling on the intrinsic Raman scattering activity of the OH (σH) and OD (σD) oscillators in liquid H 2 O, D 2 O, and HOD using polarized Raman spectroscopy. For neat H 2 O and D 2 O, σHisoσDiso = 1.35 ± 0.02, and on isotopic dilution, it decreases to 0.9 ± 0.08. This arises from a symmetric 20% drop in σHiso and 20% rise in σDiso, revealing quantitative intensity redistribution via OH-OD vibrational coupling in isotopically diluted water. In other words, even in HOD, the OH and OD stretch modes are not fully decoupled vibrationally. The corresponding ratio for the anisotropic component is σHanisoσDaniso = 1.3 ± 0.05, and it remains unchanged upon isotopic dilution. The experimental σHanisoσDaniso = 1.3 ± 0.05 closely matches the quantum harmonic oscillator predicted ratio of 1.37 corresponding to comparable polarizability derivatives in H 2 O and D 2 O. Thus, ∼30% higher scattering activity of OH primarily arises from reduced mass dependent zero-point vibrational amplitude rather than anharmonicity-driven changes in polarizability.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Coherent nonlinear optical probes for cavity-dressed vibrational mode mixing: Multidimensional double-quantum coherence and photon-echo spectroscopy
articles.abstract: Cavity dressing of molecular vibrational dynamics expands the role of characteristic vibrations as spectroscopic markers of underlying ultrafast dynamics. Interacting vibrational modes exhibit pronounced excited state delocalization due to the interaction with the cavity mode, which is reflected in the ultrafast dynamics. We characterize the ultrafast dynamics of cavity-dressed characteristic vibrations, namely vibrational polaritons, in the presence of dissipation and collective vibrational nonlinearity. Specifically, we present two complementary three-pulse coherent multidimensional spectroscopic techniques for monitoring the dynamics of cavity-dressed one- and two-quantum vibrational excitations. A microscopic theory that includes low- and high-energy phonon modes consistently describes the dissipative dynamics, including population relaxation and dephasing. The cavity coupling strengths are comparable to the vibrational mode couplings, suggesting the possibility of controlling intermolecular vibrational energy redistribution. This simulation framework is extendable to various cases of cavity-controlled nonlinear spectroscopies of dissipative molecular systems, including large ensembles.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Spectroscopic identification and structural characterization of Ag 2 H 2 − by mass-selected photoelectron velocity-map imaging
articles.abstract: Ag 2 H 2 − is identified and characterized by photoelectron velocity-map imaging and quantum chemical calculations. High-resolution mass selection unambiguously confirms the formation of Ag 2 H 2 − , yielding a vibrationally resolved spectrum with a distinct progression assigned to the Ag–H stretching mode. Comparison between experiment and theory shows that Ag 2 H 2 − adopts a distorted Y-shaped geometry with one bridging H and one terminal H, while for neutral Ag 2 H 2 , this geometry is a local minimum. Further bonding analysis of the corresponding neutral counterpart reveals that the unusually low Ag–H stretching frequency originates from synergistic donation and back-donation between the two AgH subunits.

articles.abstract_zh: 该研究发展了尖端增强纳米光学捕获光谱技术，用于确定性捕获和动态调控单个量子发射体。该方法可实现单发射体的可重构控制，并包括在弱光-物质耦合与强光-物质耦合状态之间的可逆切换。该成果为纳米尺度量子光源的可控构筑和量子光学器件集成提供了新途径。

Classically, each phase is defined by its flow pattern and how stationary sets organize phase space (e.g., fixed points and limit cycles), with transitions triggered by local bifurcations or global basin rearrangements. In… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 023319] Published Mon Jun 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究驱动-耗散系统中量子自振荡相的动力学行为。经典图像中，不同相由相空间流型及固定点、极限环等定常集合的组织方式定义，相变可由局部分岔或全局吸引域重排触发。本文探讨这些拓扑流转变在量子动力学中的可观测特征，有助于连接经典非线性动力学与开放量子系统相结构。
authors: Alejandro S. Gómez and Javier del Pino

Here, we inv… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 023321] Published Mon Jun 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注量子热力学中如何从量子系统提取有用功，尤其是在需要快速协议的有限时间情形下。作者考察封闭量子动力学中的最优功提取问题，并试图揭示功率与效率之间的基本权衡。该工作有助于为快速量子热机和有限时间量子控制协议建立理论限制。
authors: Shoki Sugimoto, Takahiro Sagawa, and Ryusuke Hamazaki

Recent conjectures suggest that avoiding barren plateaus might inherently lead to clas… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 023325] Published Mon Jun 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向变分量子算法中的可扩展性问题，重点关注 barren plateau 导致梯度随系统规模指数消失的现象。作者讨论量子代价景观的梯度行为，并研究利用泰勒替代近似来分析或模拟这些景观的可能性。该工作回应了避免 barren plateau 是否会带来经典可模拟性等近期理论猜想。
authors: Sabri Meyer, Francesco Scala, Francesco Tacchino, and Aurelien Lucchi

articles.title: PI-SONet: A Physics-Informed Symplectic Operator Network for Real-Time Optimal Control of Multi-Agent Systems
articles.title_zh: PI-SONet：用于多智能体系统实时最优控制的物理信息辛算子网络
articles.abstract: Many real-life applications involve controlling high-dimensional multi-agent systems in real-time. Existing optimal control solvers often suffer from the curse-of-dimensionality and require complete rerunning for each new problem setting. We target nonconvex, nonlinear problems in 100s of dimensions by introducing PI-SONet (Physics-Informed Symplectic Operator Network), a structure-preserving operator learning framework for solving parameterized families of optimal control problems and their Pontraygin Maximum Principle (PMP) systems. PI-SONet combines a latent right-space solver with a conditional symplectic operator to produce tractable Hamiltonian trajectories in a computationally efficient auxiliary space and transform them back to physical space. This decomposition yields a single trained operator that approximates the PMP solution map, inherently preserves Hamiltonian structure, and generalizes across unseen problem configurations. Unlike existing methods, which are fundamentally single-instance solvers, PI-SONet achieves sub-second inferences on new problem instances, equating to up to 10,000x speedup over representative baselines. These results suggest that structure-preserving neural operators provide a practical route toward reusable, real-time surrogates for high-dimensional optimal control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出 PI-SONet，一种保持结构的算子学习框架，用于求解高维多智能体系统的参数化最优控制问题及其庞特里亚金极大值原理系统。方法结合潜在右空间求解器与条件辛算子，在辅助空间中生成可处理的哈密顿轨迹，再映射回物理空间。作者称该模型经一次训练后可在未见问题配置上快速近似解映射，并在新实例上实现亚秒级推理，相比代表性基线具有显著加速。

articles.title: Sustainable Valorization of Crustacean Shell Waste via Advanced Bioprocessing for Chitosan and Edible Film Applications
articles.title_zh: 通过先进生物加工可持续高值化利用甲壳类外壳废弃物制备壳聚糖及食用膜
articles.abstract: The shells of the prawns, which is a massive by-product of seafood industry, can be used to create sustainable materials, but this remains a potential that is not fully explored. To increase the shelf life of fruits and vegetables, this study explores extraction and application of chitosan which is a biodegradable polymer derived out of prawn shells in edible coating of products. The extraction process to convert chitin to chitosan involves demineralization by use of diluted hydrochloric acid, deproteinization by use of sodium hydroxide (NaOH) and deacetylation with 50 percent NaOH. This is then followed by addition of glycerol as a plasticizer, the resulting chitosan is dissolved in 1% acetic acid and the mixture is cast in edible films at 40 °C. The chitosan films produced show excellent antifungal and antimicrobial properties with much higher efficacy at high concentrations of chitosan. These layers help to extend the shelf life of fresh foods by reducing microbial growth and loss of quality significantly. The paper highlights that edible films based on the use of chitosan are a potential, green alternative to be used in different applications such as food preservation and waste valorization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本研究将海鲜产业中大量产生的虾壳废弃物转化为壳聚糖，并用于制备可食用涂层或薄膜以延长果蔬保鲜期。制备流程包括脱矿、脱蛋白和脱乙酰等步骤，随后以甘油为增塑剂、醋酸溶液溶解壳聚糖并成膜。所得壳聚糖膜表现出抗真菌和抗菌潜力，可减少微生物生长和品质损失，为食品保鲜与废弃物资源化提供绿色替代方案。

articles.title: Synergy of Surface Oxygen Vacancies and Built-in Electric Field in 0D/2D CeO2/SnSe2 S-scheme Heterojunctions for Enhanced Photocatalytic Malachite Green Degradation
articles.title_zh: 0D/2D CeO2/SnSe2 S型异质结中表面氧空位与内建电场的协同作用及其增强孔雀石绿光催化降解性能
articles.abstract: Industrial effluents exacerbate aqueous contamination, necessitating the urgent remediation of toxic dyes such as Malachite Green (MG). In this study, a 0D/2D S-scheme heterojunction was constructed by anchoring CeO2 nanocubes onto SnSe2 hexagonal nanosheets via a precisely controlled two-step hydrothermal strategy. In-situ electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) analysis corroborates that illumination triggers the proliferation of surface oxygen vacancies. These photo-induced oxygen vacancies (Ov) empower the CeO2/SnSe2 heterostructure to sustain exceptional catalytic activity over five consecutive cycles. Moreover, the optimized 0.2 g CeO2/SnSe2 composite exhibits a remarkable degradation efficiency of over 98% for MG within 30 minutes. Such performance enhancement is attributed by the synergy between the 0D/2D dimensional matching and a potent internal electric field (IEF), which triggers an S-scheme charge transfer mechanism to preserve high redox potential while accelerating carrier separation. This work provides a sophisticated blueprint for designing dimension-matched S-scheme heterojunctions for high-performance environmental remediation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过两步水热法将CeO2纳米立方体锚定在SnSe2六方纳米片上，构筑了0D/2D S型异质结用于孔雀石绿废水降解。原位EPR表明光照可诱导表面氧空位增加，使CeO2/SnSe2在多次循环中保持较高催化活性，优化复合材料在30分钟内对孔雀石绿的降解率超过98%。性能提升归因于维度匹配结构、内建电场与S型电荷转移机制的协同作用，可促进载流子分离并保持强氧化还原能力。

articles.title: Geochemically and biologically mediated Iron Oxidation Processes for active Treatment of Acid Mine Drainage from the Nižná Slaná Mine (Slovakia) – Mineral Stability and Resource Recovery Perspectives
articles.title_zh: 斯洛伐克Nižná Slaná矿酸性矿山排水主动处理中地球化学与生物介导铁氧化过程：矿物稳定性与资源回收视角
articles.abstract: Acid mine drainage (AMD) from abandoned mine sites poses a persistent environmental hazard due to its normally high acidity, elevated sulfate concentrations and toxic concentrations of dissolved metals and metalloids. This study evaluates treatment strategies for AMD originating from the flooded Nižná Slaná siderite mine in Slovakia, following a major mine-water discharge event in 2022 that severely affected the Slaná River ecosystem. Comprehensive physicochemical analyses revealed a magnesium-sulfate water type characterized by extreme mineralization (TDS 53 g/L), elevated concentrations of iron (5 g/L), manganese (592 mg/L), arsenic (15 mg/L) and a net acidity of 160–190 meq/L. Two active strategies for AMD treatment were evaluated for the Nižná Slaná mine: Biologically mediated Fe2+ oxidation under acidic conditions enabling selective precipitation of Fe-jarosite, while retaining divalent metals (Mn, Ni, Co, Mg) in solution for potential recovery and minimizing sludge production. In contrast, conventional lime neutralization rapidly precipitates Fe and other metals as hydroxides but generates large volumes of mixed-metal sludge and offers limited opportunities for selective metal recovery. Thus, the biological approach provides a more resource-efficient and sustainable solution, while lime treatment remains a simpler, robust option for rapid remediation. Chemical-thermodynamic modelling predicted saturation with respect to Fe(III) phases, while experimental and literature-based interpretation suggests that schwertmannite, ferrihydrite or jarosite-like Fe(III)-hydroxysulfates may form depending on pH, sulfate concentration, potassium availability and aging. The interconversion between metastable (schwertmannite, ferrihydrite) and stable (goethite, jarosite) phases governs iron solubility and trace element behaviour. The integration of biological iron oxidation with targeted precipitation and selective recovery processes provides a sustainable pathway for AMD treatment, enabling the recovery of critical raw materials (Ni, Co, Mn, Mg) and supporting circular-economy-based mine water management.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了斯洛伐克Nižná Slaná菱铁矿矿山酸性矿山排水的主动处理策略，该矿山2022年发生的大规模矿水排放曾严重影响Slaná河生态系统。水化学分析显示其为高矿化度镁-硫酸盐型水，含高浓度铁、锰、砷并具有显著净酸度。研究比较了酸性条件下生物介导Fe2+氧化选择性生成黄钾铁矾与传统石灰中和法，前者有利于保留二价金属以便潜在回收并减少污泥，后者虽能快速沉淀金属但会产生大量混合金属污泥且选择性回收能力有限。

articles.title: Dip Angle–Viscosity–Rate Coupling Controls Fracture Complexity and Pressure/AE Fingerprints in Steeply Dipping Coal: Evidence from 2 m-Scale True-Triaxial Hydraulic Fracturing Experiments
articles.title_zh: 倾角–黏度–排量耦合控制急倾斜煤层裂缝复杂性及压力/声发射特征：2米尺度真三轴水力压裂实验证据
articles.abstract: Steeply dipping coal reservoirs exhibit strong structural anisotropy controlled by bedding/cleat systems, which promotes fracture deflection, branching, and network connectivity changes that complicate hydraulic fracturing design. This paper presents a focused subset of results from 2 m-scale true-triaxial hydraulic fracturing experiments, emphasizing the coupled influence of dip angle, fluid viscosity, and injection rate on fracture complexity and pressure–acoustic emission (AE) fingerprints. Large specimens (2 m × 2 m × 1 m) were fractured using active water (µ = 3 mPa·s) and a viscosified emulsion (µ = 20 mPa·s). Fracture traces were mapped on split surfaces and quantified by fractal dimension, while injection pressure and AE/microseismic event activity were recorded. Under low-rate injection (Q = 0.1 m³/min), fracture complexity shows clear dip-dependent viscosity sensitivity with fractal dimensions of D = 1.731 (active water, 45°), 1.693 (active water, 70°), 1.685 (emulsion, 45°), and 1.757 (emulsion, 70°). Pressure–AE curves further show that active water tends to produce sharper breakdown-and-decline signatures, whereas the viscosified emulsion generates plateau-like multi-peak oscillations, consistent with intermittent propagation, temporary restriction/bridging, and re-opening cycles reported in hydraulic fracture theory and diagnostics. At high dip (70°), increasing rate from 0.4 to 0.5 m³/min shifts the response from relatively stable opening to persistent multi-peak oscillatory behavior with episodic event bursts—an operational fingerprint indicative of complex fracture generation. These findings provide an engineering basis to balance stimulated reservoir volume (SRV) potential against controllability in steeply dipping coal by selecting appropriate viscosity–rate windows.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文基于2米尺度真三轴水力压裂实验，研究急倾斜煤储层中层理/割理控制下倾角、压裂液黏度与注入排量对裂缝复杂性和压力—声发射响应的耦合影响。实验采用活性水和增黏乳液，对裂缝形态进行分形维数量化，并同步记录注入压力与声发射/微震事件。结果表明低排量条件下裂缝复杂性具有明显的倾角相关黏度敏感性，活性水更易产生尖锐破裂—压降特征，而增黏乳液更倾向于形成平台式多峰压力响应。

articles.title: A Comprehensive Study on H₂SO₄ And KOH Activation Strategies For Sustainable Carbon Synthesis: A characterization approach
articles.title_zh: 面向可持续碳材料合成的H2SO4与KOH活化策略综合研究：一种表征分析方法
articles.abstract: The conversion of waste sludge into high value activated carbon materials represents a promising approach for waste valorization and sustainable materials development. This comprehensive study investigates the morphological transformations and elemental composition changes in sludge-derived carbon materials subjected to different chemical activation strategies. Initially, controlled pyrolysis at 800°C in a nitrogen environment was used to create raw carbon (RC), which was then chemically activated using H2SO4 at 450°C and KOH at 800°C to produce materials with fundamentally distinct properties. Comprehensive characterization analysis revealed fundamental differences between activation methods and their resulting material properties. KOH activation successfully created hierarchical porous structures with distinctive rod-like and plate-like morphologies, developing extensive mesopores and macropores while retaining significant potassium content (31.31 wt%) that provides beneficial basic surface functionality. In contrast, H₂SO₄ activation produced fine spherical particles with extensive agglomeration patterns, successfully incorporating sulfur-containing functional groups (18.13 wt% S) that significantly enhance surface acidity and hydrophilicity. Advanced EDX elemental mapping techniques demonstrated uniform spatial distribution of activating agents throughout the entire carbon matrix, confirming successful penetration and chemical reaction processes. The resulting KOH-activated carbon materials showed excellent potential for CO₂ capture applications and basic electrolyte supercapacitors, while H₂SO₄-activated carbon exhibited superior properties suitable for ion exchange and acidic electrolyte applications. Both activation processes effectively removed ash components while simultaneously developing enhanced porosity and introducing valuable heteroatom functionalities. This research demonstrates the technical feasibility of producing task-specific carbon materials from waste streams, contributing to circular economy principles and sustainable synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨将废污泥转化为高附加值活性炭材料的可持续路径，比较H2SO4与KOH化学活化对污泥衍生碳材料形貌和元素组成的影响。原始碳先在氮气氛围下经800°C热解制备，再分别经H2SO4和KOH活化。表征结果显示，KOH活化可形成具有棒状和片状形貌的分级多孔结构并保留较高钾含量，从而赋予碱性表面功能；H2SO4活化则产生团聚明显的细小球形颗粒，并引入含硫官能团。

articles.title: Pathways to Net Zero: Evaluating Saf, Hydrogen and Dual-Fuel Propulsion for Next-Generation Derivative Regional Aircraft
articles.title_zh: 通向净零排放的路径：面向下一代衍生型支线飞机的可持续航空燃料、氢能与双燃料推进评估
articles.abstract: While passenger numbers in air travel are projected to continue increasing, the aviation industry has set the goal to reach net zero CO2 emissions by 2050. In this paper, alternative energy carriers such as SAF, hydrogen and batteries are analysed in regard to their suitability to decarbonize regional aviation. The analysis is conducted based on the D328eco and potential derivatives: a hydrogen-burn concept, a hydrogen-fuel cell concept, a dual-fuel concept able to burn kerosene as well as hydrogen, and a battery-electric concept. The derivatives are designed for a range of 600 NM, covering a sufficient share of the regional route network. It is shown that SAF is the only near-term solution and that it will still be required after the introduction of hydrogen aircraft for airport pairs beyond the assumed design mission. The second promising concept to enable the usage of low-carbon hydrogen in aviation is the dual-fuel, exhibiting a high load-factor while enabling operations from and to airports with and without hydrogen infrastructure. Although being penalized in payload capability, the hydrogen-burn and fuel-cell concepts still have the potential to decarbonize regional aviation. It is demonstrated that the fuel-cell concept is contingent upon significant improvements in fuel cell technology and the electric powertrain. The battery-electric concept is not feasible in the foreseeable future.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文围绕航空业2050年净零二氧化碳排放目标，评估可持续航空燃料、氢能和电池在支线航空脱碳中的适用性。研究以D328eco及其潜在衍生构型为基础，比较氢燃烧、氢燃料电池、煤油/氢双燃料和纯电构型，并以600海里航程覆盖典型支线网络。结果指出，可持续航空燃料是近期唯一可行方案，并在氢能飞机投入后仍对较远航线具有必要性；双燃料方案因可兼容有无氢基础设施机场而较具应用前景，氢燃烧和燃料电池方案虽受载荷能力限制但仍有脱碳潜力。

articles.title: MSTR-PPO: A Multi-Scale Temporal Residual PPO Controller for Freeze-Prone Indoor Navigation
articles.title_zh: MSTR-PPO：用于易冻结室内导航的多尺度时间残差PPO控制器
articles.abstract: Local navigation controllers can fail to make progress in constrained indoor environments when narrow geometry and moving obstacles compress the feasible local motion space. These freeze events trigger repeated recovery behaviors and can prevent otherwise valid global paths from being executed. This paper treats freezing as a failure of local control under three observable mechanisms: insufficient path horizon, motion ambiguity in single-frame sensing, and unstable learned velocity commands. We present MSTR-PPO (Multi-Scale Temporal Residual Proximal Policy Optimization), a freeze-aware residual local controller defined at the standard sensor--path--velocity-command interface. Rather than replacing the geometric controller with an unconstrained end-to-end policy, MSTR-PPO learns a bounded correction around a Pure Pursuit nominal action. The controller uses a Multi-Scale Path Transformer for near-, mid-, and far-horizon route context, a First-Order Temporal High-Pass Filter for low-cost light detection and ranging (LiDAR) range-change cues, and a Bounded Residual Action around Pure Pursuit. We evaluate eight local-control variants across nine Gazebo worlds with dynamic obstacles, totaling 2,880 trials across all methods, and deploy the trained policy through a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS, 2) Navigation 2 (Nav2) C++ controller interface as a representative evaluation stack. In the two target freeze-prone worlds, MSTR-PPO reaches the goal in all 80 evaluated trials and triggers no stack-level recovery events, while the best default-parameter classical baseline reaches 86.2% success on the same subset. On the main seven-world evaluation suite (W1--W7), MSTR-PPO obtains 91.1% average success and runs with 5--10, ms central processing unit (CPU) control-cycle latency. Stress tests expose a limitation on continuous-curvature paths, and a preliminary Unitree Go2 test succeeds in 27 of 30 trials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对狭窄室内几何环境和动态障碍物导致局部导航控制器“冻结”、无法沿有效全局路径前进的问题，提出MSTR-PPO残差局部控制器。该方法不以端到端策略完全替代几何控制器，而是在Pure Pursuit名义动作周围学习有界修正，并结合多尺度路径Transformer、时间高通滤波LiDAR变化线索和有界残差动作。作者在含动态障碍的多个Gazebo场景中比较多种局部控制变体，以验证其缓解冻结和提升导航稳定性的能力。

articles.title: Photophysical Insights of Blue–Green Emitting Oxadiazole: Efficient Energy Transfer in Core–Shell Quantum Dot Hybrids
articles.title_zh: 蓝绿色发光噁二唑的光物理机制：核–壳量子点杂化体系中的高效能量转移
articles.abstract: The development of blue–green emitting organic chromophores with excellent optoelectronic properties remains an important issue. In this context, the synthesis of a novel blue–green emitting chromophore, 2-(4-(2-(anthracen-10-yl)vinyl)phenyl)-5-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-1,3,4-oxadiazole (AVBO), was accomplished via the donor–π–acceptor (D- π–A) strategy using a Wittig reaction. The integration of aryl-heteroaryl groups and the oxadiazole group was utilized to obtain efficient blue–green emission with excellent optical properties. AVBO exhibited stable and efficient PL in the range of 485–510 nm across diverse solvent environments. Solvatochromic analysis using multiple correlations (Lippert-Mataga, Bakhshiev, Kawski-Chamma-Viallet, and Reichardt) revealed a significantly higher excited-state dipole moment compared to the ground state (μₑ>μ_g), with a parallel orientation (φ=0⁰⁾. The values calculated using these empirical equations were compared with those calculated computationally. Kamlet-Taft and Catalán MLR analyses further identified dominant non-specific solvent interactions (π^*) alongside specific hydrogen-bonding donor contributions. To explore its potential in optoelectronic applications, AVBO was integrated into hybrid systems with ZnSe/ZnS core-shell quantum dots (7–8 nm). This assembly functioned as a efficient FRET mechanism, reaching an efficiency of 88% with Förster radii of 6.14–6.16 nm. The quenching kinetics, validated by Stern-Volmer plots, showed both static and dynamic components with super-diffusion-limited rate constants (kq  1014 /MS). Time-resolved photoluminescence (TRPL) confirmed energy transfer via dipole-dipole interactions. These findings highlight the AVBO-QDs hybrid as a promising, heavy-metal-free, and tunable emitter for light harvesting, photosensitization, and biosensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过供体–π–受体设计和Wittig反应合成了一种新型蓝绿色发光噁二唑发色团AVBO，并考察其光物理性质。AVBO在多种溶剂中于485–510 nm范围表现出稳定高效的光致发光，溶剂化变色分析表明其激发态偶极矩显著高于基态且取向平行。进一步的Kamlet-Taft和Catalán多元线性回归显示，非特异性溶剂相互作用及氢键供体作用对其发光行为具有重要影响；研究还探索了其在核–壳量子点杂化体系中实现能量转移的潜力。

articles.title: Influence of Cerium Oxide on the Structural, Optical, and Luminescent Properties of Borophosphate Glasses
articles.title_zh: 氧化铈对硼磷酸盐玻璃结构、光学和发光性能的影响
articles.abstract: A glass series based on the borophosphate system was prepared with varying additions of CeO2 (57.5–x)B2O3–15P2O5–20Na2O–7.5CaO–xCeO2 (x = 0.3–0.9 mol%). Density and molar volume show non-linear behavior across all samples, reflecting structural rearrangements induced by rare-earth ions. The incorporation of CeO2 generally leads to structural modifications. Structural parameters such as internuclear distances and boron concentration also vary, indicating changes in the glass network connectivity. X-ray diffraction confirms the amorphous nature of all samples. FTIR analysis reveals the presence of structural units including BO3, BO4, P–O–P linkages, and hydroxyl-related groups. Optical studies indicate that the indirect band gap decreases with increasing CeO2 content. Urbach energy exhibits irregular variation, suggesting changes in structural disorder. The refractive index and electronic polarizability show composition-dependent trends, with CeO2 enhancing polarizability. A red shift in the absorption edge is observed with increasing cerium content. Photoluminescence spectra reveal an excitation around 290 nm corresponding to 4f–5d transitions of Ce3+ ions. Emission characteristics are strongly influenced by both CeO2 concentration, with observed transition at 373 nm corresponds to 5D5/2 to 2F7/2 attributed to phonon-assisted relaxation and radiative recombination. The obtained structural and optical properties suggest that these glass compositions are promising candidates for future bioactivity applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究制备了不同CeO2掺杂量的硼磷酸盐玻璃系列，并系统分析其密度、摩尔体积、结构与光学发光性质。X射线衍射证实样品均为非晶态，FTIR显示玻璃网络中存在BO3、BO4、P–O–P键及羟基相关结构单元。随着CeO2含量变化，间接带隙总体降低、吸收边发生红移，折射率和电子极化率呈成分依赖趋势；光致发光谱显示约290 nm激发峰可归因于Ce3+离子的4f–5d跃迁。

articles.title: Decrease of magnetocaloric effect and magnetic susceptibility of ferromagnet due to magnetostructural phase transition
articles.title_zh: 磁结构相变导致铁磁体磁热效应与磁化率降低
articles.abstract: A theoretical model based on spin-exchange energy and the entropy of the magnetic subsystem provides a general framework for describing the temperature dependence of magnetization in systems undergoing magnetostructural phase transitions. By fitting the model to experimental magnetization curves, the key physical parameters governing these transitions are extracted. These parameters are used to calculate the magnetic-field-induced temperature change and magnetic susceptibility, including the paraprocess contribution. It is shown that, although magnetostructural transitions lead to a sharp change in magnetization, this alone is not sufficient to produce a giant magnetocaloric effect. Instead, the effect is strongly influenced by the magnetic susceptibility and the specific heat. The latter exhibits pronounced peaks in the presence of structural transitions, thereby reducing the adiabatic temperature change. The results demonstrate that large magnetization changes near first-order transitions do not guarantee strong magnetocaloric performance, in agreement with experimental observations for Ni-Mn-Ga-Cu alloys. The theory shows that materials exhibiting large peak values of magnetic susceptibility are the most promising for achieving a large magnetocaloric effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文建立了基于自旋交换能和磁子系统熵的理论模型，用于描述发生磁结构相变体系中磁化强度随温度变化的规律。通过拟合实验磁化曲线，研究提取了控制相变的关键物理参数，并据此计算磁场诱导温度变化、磁化率及顺磁过程贡献。结果表明，尽管磁结构相变可引起磁化强度突变，但这并不必然产生巨磁热效应；磁化率和比热，尤其是结构相变引起的比热峰，会显著削弱绝热温变。

articles.title: Piezoelectric manipulation and stacking-dependent magnetism in ferrovalley materials
articles.title_zh: 铁谷材料中的压电操控与堆垛依赖磁性
articles.abstract: The electronic transport characteristics of two-dimensional (2D) systems have widespread application prospects in the fabrication of multifunctional nanodevices. However, the current research for basic transport phenomena, such as anomalous valley Hall effect (AVHE) and piezoelectric response, is limited to discrete discussion. Here, we theoretically propose a valley-piezoelectricity coupling strategy beyond the existing paradigm to realize AVHE and layer Hall effect (LHE) in ferrovalley (FV) systems, and its essential principle can be extended to general valleytronic materials. Through first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the large polarized electric field of 2.8×106 (1.67×107) V/m can be induced by 0.1% uniaxial strain in FV 2H-LaHF (1T-LaHF) monolayers. In addition, the microscopic mechanism of interlayer antiferromagnetic (AFM) state of 2H-LaHF bilayer is uncovered by the spin Hamiltonian and super-superexchange (SSE) interaction. Our findings pave the way for new explorations of valley Hall-related effect involving piezoelectricity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从理论上提出一种谷-压电耦合策略，用于在铁谷体系中实现反常谷霍尔效应和层霍尔效应，并认为该原理可推广至一般谷电子学材料。第一性原理计算表明，FV 2H-LaHF和1T-LaHF单层在0.1%单轴应变下可诱导显著极化电场。研究还通过自旋哈密顿量和超超交换相互作用揭示了2H-LaHF双层层间反铁磁态的微观机制，为压电参与的谷霍尔相关效应研究提供了新思路。

articles.title: Integrated Experimental-Machine Learning Framework for the Synthesis Optimization and Predictive Modeling of Iron Oxide Nanoparticles in Dye Removal Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向染料去除应用的氧化铁纳米颗粒合成优化与预测建模：实验—机器学习一体化框架
articles.abstract: This study presents an integrated experimental and machine learning framework for optimizing the co-precipitation synthesis of iron oxide nanoparticles (IONPs) and predicting their crystal size and specific surface area. A comparative evaluation of two precipitating agents showed that ammonium hydroxide produced superior results, yielding smaller crystal size (86 Å) and higher surface area (87.23 m²/g). A central composite experimental design was applied to model the effects of temperature (30-90 °C), stirring speed (100-600 rpm), and synthesis time (15-75 min) using Response Surface Methodology (RSM). The resulting models achieved high predictive performance, with R² values of 93.94% for crystal size and 92.40% for surface area. To improve model generalization, the dataset was expanded from 15 to 44 samples using Gaussian noise addition and linear interpolation. Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) regressors trained on the augmented data showed strong predictive ability, with test RMSE values of 10.47 Å (R² = 0.749) for crystal size and 0.91 m²/g (R² = 0.587) for surface area. Compared to RSM, XGBoost demonstrated superior accuracy and robustness. These results highlight the effectiveness of combining experimental design, data augmentation, and machine learning to optimize nanoparticle synthesis for environmental applications such as dye removal.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了实验与机器学习结合的框架，用于优化共沉淀法制备氧化铁纳米颗粒，并预测其晶粒尺寸和比表面积。比较两种沉淀剂后发现，氢氧化铵可获得更小晶粒和更高比表面积；随后采用中心复合设计和响应面法分析温度、搅拌速度与合成时间的影响。为提升模型泛化能力，作者通过高斯噪声和线性插值扩充数据集，并训练XGBoost回归模型，结果显示其在预测精度和稳健性方面优于响应面模型，体现了机器学习辅助纳米材料合成优化的潜力。

articles.title: Investigating quantum and molecular plumbing in nanofluidics research
articles.title_zh: 纳米流体学研究中的量子与分子“管路”机制探索
articles.abstract: Our body contains an intricate system of tiny vessels through which blood, water and other molecules flow. When the size of the pipes shrinks to the nanoscale, where only a few molecules can fit side by side, the classical laws of physics governing the behavior of water are influenced by the atomic structure of the walls. "It's not that classical hydrodynamics breaks down, but rather that it gets mixed with the condensed matter physics of the solid walls," says Nikita Kavokine, tenure-track assistant professor and leader of the EPFL Quantum Plumbing Lab.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了纳米尺度流体输运研究的基本问题：当管道尺寸缩小到仅能容纳少数分子并排通过时，水等分子的行为会受到固体壁面原子结构的显著影响。相关观点认为，这并非经典流体力学完全失效，而是其与固体壁面的凝聚态物理效应发生耦合。该工作围绕纳米流体学中的量子效应、分子输运和界面相互作用展开，具体研究细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Quantum mechanics theory may work without imaginary numbers, new analysis suggests
articles.title_zh: 新分析表明：量子力学理论或可不依赖虚数
articles.abstract: Physicists from Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf (HHU) have examined a fundamental property of quantum mechanics in collaboration with the German Aerospace Center (DLR). In an article published in the journal Physical Review Letters, they show that this theory does not necessarily need to be formulated with imaginary numbers—real numbers can, in fact, also be used.
articles.abstract_zh: 海因里希·海涅大学杜塞尔多夫分校与德国航空航天中心的物理学家研究了量子力学的一项基本表述问题。该工作指出，量子力学并非必然需要用虚数来构建，在某些条件下也可以采用实数形式进行表述。这一结果有助于重新审视量子理论数学基础中的必要性与等价性问题。

articles.title: Electrospinning Preparation of TiO2 Fiber Membranes and the Enhancement of Photocatalytic Uranium Reduction Efficiency by One-Dimensional Morphology
articles.title_zh: TiO₂纤维膜的静电纺丝制备及一维形貌对光催化铀还原效率的提升
articles.abstract: Nuclear energy as a key low-carbon, sustainable, and clean energy source, it's proportion in the global energy structure continues to increase. However, the rapid development of nuclear energy inevitably leads to the generation of a large amount of uranium-containing wastewater, posing serious risks to environment and health. Uranium in aqueous systems predominantly exists in the form of mobile and toxic U(VI) (UO22⁺), while U(IV) has very low solubility in water and is easier to remove. Photocatalytic reduction of highly soluble U(VI) to sparingly soluble U(IV) offers a promising route for uranium recovery. However, conventional photocatalysts with typically powder material that suffer from low activity, aggregation, and poor recyclability. Therefore, we developed a TiO2 fiber membranes with a high aspect ratio, self-supporting, and non-agglomerating, demonstrating excellent performance in photocatalytic reduction of U(VI). The experimental results indicated that 400°C was the optimal heat treatment temperature, and the TiO2 fiber membranes heat-treated at this temperature exhibited the highest photocatalytic reduction efficiency. At pH 5, the membranes achieved 99.0% uranium removal within 180 minutes without sacrificial agents, which 2.47 times higher than commercial Anatase TiO2 powder. Moreover, the TiO2 membranes still demonstrates a high removal efficiency for U(VI) after five reacting cycles. In photoluminescence spectroscopy, the emission intensity of TiO2 fiber films was significantly reduced compared to that of Anatase TiO2 powder, indicating effective suppression of the recombination of photogenerated electron-hole pairs. This was attributed to its one-dimensional structure, which provides a continuous path for charge transport, thereby minimizing charge recombination and enhancing reaction efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对含铀废水中高迁移性、高毒性的U(VI)去除问题，提出利用静电纺丝制备的TiO₂纤维膜进行光催化还原。与传统粉末光催化剂相比，该纤维膜具有高长径比、自支撑和不易团聚等优势，有利于提升活性与回收性能。实验表明，400°C热处理样品表现出最佳光催化还原效果，在pH 5条件下实现了很高的铀去除效率。

articles.title: Stability of digital and analog quantum simulations under noise
articles.title_zh: 噪声作用下数字与模拟量子模拟的稳定性
articles.abstract: Quantum simulation is a central application of near-term quantum devices, pursued in both analog and digital architectures. A key challenge for both paradigms is the effect of imperfections and noise on predictive power. In this work, we present a rigorous and physically transparent comparison of the stability of digital and analog quantum simulators under a variety of perturbative noise models. We provide rigorous worst- and average-case error bounds for noisy quantum simulation of local observables. We find that the two paradigms show comparable scaling in the worst case, while exhibiting different forms of enhanced error cancellation on average. We further analyze Gaussian and Brownian noise processes, deriving concentration bounds that capture typical deviations beyond worst-case guarantees. These results provide a unified framework for quantifying the robustness of noisy quantum simulations and identify regimes where digital methods have intrinsic advantages and when we can see similar behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作系统比较了数字量子模拟器与模拟量子模拟器在多种微扰噪声模型下的稳定性。作者针对局域可观测量的噪声量子模拟给出了严格的最坏情形与平均情形误差界，发现两类方案在最坏情形下具有相近的标度行为。研究还分析了高斯噪声和布朗噪声过程，并给出刻画典型偏差的集中界，为评估含噪量子模拟的鲁棒性提供了统一框架。

articles.title: Forty years of high-temperature superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 高温超导四十年
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01801-4 The first demonstration of superconductivity at 35 kelvin drove decades of materials research and introduced a puzzle about this strange state of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文回顾了高温超导研究四十年的发展历程。自 35 K 超导首次被证明以来，该领域推动了大量材料探索，并持续围绕非常规超导态的本质提出关键科学问题。文章属于综述或评论性质，强调高温超导对凝聚态物理和材料科学的长期影响。

articles.title: Interfacial control of orbital occupancy and spin state in LaCoO₃
articles.title_zh: LaCoO₃ 中轨道占据与自旋态的界面调控
articles.abstract: Author(s): Ellen M. Kiens, Nicolas Gauquelin, Arno Annys, Emma van der Minne, Iris C. G. van den Bosch, Matthijs A. van Spronsen, Zezhong Zhang, Annick De Backer, Sandra Van Aert, Jo Verbeeck, Gertjan Koster, Bastian Mei, Frank M. F. de Groot, and Christoph Baeumer Interfacial engineering offers a powerful route to control electronic states in correlated oxides. Here, the authors demonstrate tunable Co 3 d orbital occupancy in LaCoO 3 heterostructures, spanning partial d 5 to d 7 configurations via tailored interfaces with LaTiO₃, LaMnO₃, LaNiO₃, and LaAlO₃. Combining X-ray absorption spectroscopy with multiplet calculations reveals interface-dependent charge transfer and spin-state modulation, while atomic-scale microscopy links these effects to strain and structural distortions. Notably, inserting a LaAlO₃ spacer suppresses charge transfer, stabilizing an unexpected low-spin d 6 state. These findings highlight how interfacial design governs orbital occupation and spin, providing a versatile platform for tuning functionality in oxide electronics and catalysis. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 066003] Published Mon Jun 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了通过界面工程调控相关氧化物 LaCoO₃ 中 Co 3d 轨道占据和自旋态的策略。作者构筑了 LaCoO₃ 与 LaTiO₃、LaMnO₃、LaNiO₃ 和 LaAlO₃ 等不同界面的异质结构，并结合 X 射线吸收光谱、多重态计算和原子尺度显微表征分析界面相关的电荷转移、应变和结构畸变。结果表明，插入 LaAlO₃ 间隔层可抑制电荷转移并稳定出意外的低自旋 d⁶ 态，为氧化物电子学和催化功能调控提供了平台。

articles.title: Federated Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Private Low-Power Wearable Health Monitoring
articles.title_zh: 用于隐私保护低功耗可穿戴健康监测的联邦时序 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络
articles.abstract: Battery-powered consumer electronics increasingly run on-device sensing and intelligence, but continuous inference and always-on connectivity rapidly deplete limited energy budgets. This paper introduces Priv-Fed-X, a privacy-preserving and energy-aware edge intelligence framework that combines (i) a lightweight Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (TKAN) for resource-constrained time-series inference, (ii) store-and-forward communication with adaptive SNR-aware gating to minimize unnecessary transmissions, and (iii) federated learning with differential privacy to protect user data while retaining personalization. In addition, we integrate a wake-on-alert explainability module that produces concise visual/feature attributions only when an event is detected, reducing the overhead of continuous interpretation. We provide an energy bottleneck analysis and a battery-life projection model for typical coin-cell-class deployments, and we evaluate the proposed design under realistic inference and communication schedules. Experimental results demonstrate that Priv-Fed-X improves energy efficiency while maintaining competitive predictive performance, making it suitable for always-on privacy-sensitive consumer devices such as wearables and home sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 Priv-Fed-X，一种面向电池供电可穿戴设备的隐私保护与能耗感知边缘智能框架。该框架结合轻量级时序 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络、基于信噪比自适应门控的存储转发通信、差分隐私联邦学习以及事件触发的可解释性模块，以减少连续推理和通信的能耗。实验表明，该方案在保持有竞争力预测性能的同时提升了能效，适用于始终在线的隐私敏感健康监测场景。

articles.title: A Statistical Time-Series Forecasting Approach to Coronal Mass Ejection Occurrence Rates Using ARIMA and ARIMAX Models
articles.title_zh: 基于 ARIMA 与 ARIMAX 模型预测日冕物质抛射发生率的统计时间序列方法
articles.abstract: Coronal mass ejections (CMEs) are among the most energetic solar phenomena, and their occurrence rate is modulated by the solar magnetic cycle on timescales relevant to space weather forecasting. We present a statistical time-series forecasting framework based on ARIMA and ARIMAX models applied to five CME subpopulations drawn from the SOHO/LASCO CDAW catalog (January 1996 – November 2025, Solar Cycles 23–25), with the sunspot number as the exogenous predictor, evaluated through rigorous out-of-sample testing across a solar cycle transition. Purely autoregressive ARIMA/SARIMA models systematically fail to generalize beyond the training window, yielding negative out-of-sample R² in the majority of configurations. Incorporating the sunspot number as an exogenous regressor resolves this deficiency: at annual resolution, and under a nowcasting configuration in which observed sunspot numbers are used contemporaneously, R² reaches 0.87 and 0.83 for the entire and Moderate Partial Halo subpopulations, with RMSE reductions exceeding 60% in the best cases. Monthly models show consistent but more modest improvements (R² łeq 0.43), reflecting stochastic short-term variability not captured by the linear framework. Additionally, a purely prospective forecast of fast CME occurrence rates beyond the observed record is provided, independent of any nowcasting configuration, extending the predictive horizon of the framework toward Solar Cycle 25 decline and Solar Cycle 26.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 SOHO/LASCO CDAW 星表中 1996 年 1 月至 2025 年 11 月的五类日冕物质抛射样本，构建了基于 ARIMA 和 ARIMAX 的发生率预测框架，并将太阳黑子数作为外生变量。结果显示，单纯自回归模型在跨太阳周期外推时泛化能力较弱，而引入太阳黑子数后显著改善了年尺度预测表现。月尺度模型也有一定提升，但受短期随机变化影响，改进幅度相对有限。

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence Modelling of Non-Fourier Heat Transport in Magnetite-Graphene Hybrid Nanofluid for Sensor Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向传感器应用的磁铁矿-石墨烯混合纳米流体非傅里叶传热人工智能建模
articles.abstract: Magnetite (Iron Oxide) -Graphene hybrid nanoparticles, in particular, are found to be very beneficial for sensor surface applications because of their superior thermal conductivity, magnetic responsiveness, and enhanced heat transfer capability, which enhances the thermal stability, sensitivity, and operational efficiency of contemporary biosensors, microelectronic sensing devices, and smart sensors. This work delves into the dynamics of a magnetite-graphene/water-ethylene glycol hybrid nanofluid's unsteady MHD squeezed flow across a porous sensor surface under the conditions of viscous dissipation, nonlinear thermal radiation, and the non-Fourier C-C heat flux model. Applying the right transformations reduces the system of governing partial DEs to a set of ordinary DEs. These are then resolved by use of the MATLAB BVP5C solvers. After that, we'll use the numerical dataset to train two artificial neural networks: LMBP. This study's results show that the LMBP network replicates the BVP5C solution at epoch 77 with a gradient of (:7.17.10⁻⁸), a best validation MSE of (:1.77.10⁻¹⁰), and a correlation value (:R=1). articles.title: Formation of Gradient Residual Stress in Ultrasonic Vibration-Assisted End Grinding Inconel 718: Microscopic Mechanism and Modeling
articles.title_zh: 超声振动辅助端面磨削 Inconel 718 中梯度残余应力的形成：微观机制与建模
articles.abstract: Residual stress (RS) on machined surfaces critically influences in-service performance. However, the underlying microscopic physical mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. The plastic deformation behavior under different parameters in ultrasonic vibration-assisted end grinding (UVAEG) was systematically investigated by RS characterization, in-situ grinding force measurement, and subsurface microstructure observation. An evaluation method for RS on machined surfaces was proposed. A prediction model for RS on machined surfaces was established based on dislocation pile-up theory. The microscopic mechanism of RS formation was analyzed. The effects of spindle speed and grinding depth on plastic deformation depth and the formation of gradient RS were also systematically studied. The results show that surface RS is positively correlated with dislocation density. The residual stress induced by grinding primarily originates from local stress fields generated by microstructural defects within the material. A larger plastic deformation depth is favorable for the formation of a deeper RS affected layer. Lower spindle speed and larger cutting depth can generate higher grinding forces, thereby promoting dislocation multiplication and migration, increasing the degree of lattice distortion and the depth of the affected layer, and consequently resulting in higher residual stress and a deeper affected layer. This study elucidates the microscopic mechanisms underlying internal stress formation at machined surfaces and provides a theoretical basis for optimizing machining processes to control material performance effectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕超声振动辅助端面磨削 Inconel 718 后加工表面残余应力的形成机制展开，结合残余应力表征、原位磨削力测量和亚表层微观组织观察，分析不同工艺参数下的塑性变形行为。作者提出了加工表面残余应力评价方法，并基于位错塞积理论建立预测模型。结果表明，表面残余应力与位错密度呈正相关，磨削诱导残余应力主要来源于材料内部微结构缺陷产生的局部应力场；较低主轴转速和较大磨削深度会提高磨削力并促进更深残余应力影响层的形成。

articles.title: Evaluation and Mechanism of a Novel Compound Lubricants: A Molecular Dynamics and Experimental Study
articles.title_zh: 一种新型复合润滑剂的评价与作用机制：分子动力学与实验研究
articles.abstract: Unconventional hydrocarbon reservoirs drilling involves complex and diverse wellbore structures, making it prone to downhole incidents such as stuck pipes in areas of high frictional resistance. Therefore, to ensure the safe execution of drilling operations, there is an urgent need to develop lubricants for drilling fluids. This study systematically evaluates the lubrication performance of methyl hexadecanoate, methyl oleate, and their compounded system XZM, while integrating molecular dynamics simulations to deeply reveal the adsorption behaviors and mechanisms of the lubricants at friction interfaces under varying environmental conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that the compounded lubricant XZM outperforms individual components, achieving a friction coefficient as low as 0.10 at a 1.5 wt% addition level, with lubrication efficacy becoming more pronounced as the proportion of methyl hexadecanoate increases. Molecular simulations further indicate that both high temperatures and high pressures enhance the adsorption of lubricant molecules onto iron oxide and kaolinite walls, thereby improving lubrication performance; conversely, increasing salinity weakens adsorption capacity, leading to elevated friction coefficients. This research provides a theoretical foundation and design strategies for developing efficient and environmentally friendly lubricants for drilling fluids, highlighting the promising application potential of compounded lubricants under complex operating conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对非常规油气储层钻井中高摩阻和卡钻风险，系统评估了棕榈酸甲酯、油酸甲酯及其复配体系 XZM 作为钻井液润滑剂的性能。实验显示，复合润滑剂 XZM 的减摩效果优于单一组分，在一定添加量下可显著降低摩擦系数，且棕榈酸甲酯比例增加时润滑效果更明显。分子动力学模拟表明，高温高压有利于润滑剂分子在氧化铁和高岭石表面的吸附，从而改善润滑性能，而盐度升高会削弱吸附能力。

articles.title: Universal RKKY-like Interactions Between Tilted Skyrmions in Chiral Magnets
articles.title_zh: 手性磁体中倾斜斯格明子之间的普适 RKKY 类相互作用
articles.abstract: Skyrmion-skyrmion interaction is a fundamental problem that remains inadequately understood. Here we demonstrate that the interaction between two tilted skyrmions in a chiral magnetic film is intrinsically anisotropic, non-central, and oscillatory. This interaction varies periodically from repulsion to attraction with the skyrmion-skyrmion separation along a specified direction, resembling the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction observed between localized spins in metals. Our analysis reveals the underlying physics of a previously unrecognized universal wavy tail in the skyrmion spin texture. Importantly, the resulting RKKY-like interaction is universal for all tilted skyrmions, regardless of whether the tilt arises from an external field or crystalline magnetic anisotropy. These findings introduce a novel physical principle for designing skyrmion molecules or skyrmion superstructures, which have significant potential for applications in skyrmion-based spintronics and neuromorphic computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示了手性磁性薄膜中两个倾斜斯格明子之间的相互作用具有内禀各向异性、非中心性和振荡特征。其相互作用会随特定方向上的斯格明子间距在排斥与吸引之间周期性变化，类似金属中局域自旋之间的 RKKY 相互作用。作者指出，这一现象源于斯格明子自旋纹理中此前未被充分认识的普适波状尾部，并认为该机制可用于设计斯格明子分子和超结构，服务于自旋电子学与类脑计算应用。

articles.title: A Data-Driven Actuarial Framework Integrating Statistical Modeling and Simulation for Solvency and Risk Assessment in Public Disability Insurance
articles.title_zh: 融合统计建模与模拟的公共残疾保险偿付能力和风险评估数据驱动精算框架
articles.abstract: Public disability insurance systems are becoming increasingly unpredictable as claim patterns, benefit growth, and labor market conditions change. The study creates a uniform, data-driven actuarial approach for determining the long-term solvency of a major public disability insurance scheme. Claim frequency, severity, and duration are analyzed with generalized linear models and time-series approaches, and their combined effects on fund sustainability are assessed using Monte Carlo simulation and stress testing. The paradigm accounts for overdispersion, temporal dependence, and stochastic interactions, resulting in probabilistic estimates of fund balances, ruin probabilities, and tail risk under both baseline and stressed circumstances. When applied to a multi-decade administrative dataset, the results suggest significant systemic risk, emphasizing the fund's vulnerability to sustained rises in benefit outflows. This approach to evidence-based decision-making in public insurance systems is scalable, interpretable, and policy-relevant because it combines classical statistical inference with modern computational approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种统一的数据驱动精算框架，用于评估公共残疾保险体系的长期偿付能力。框架利用广义线性模型和时间序列方法分析索赔频率、金额和持续时间，并通过蒙特卡罗模拟与压力测试评估基金可持续性。该方法考虑过度离散、时间依赖和随机相互作用，可给出基金余额、破产概率和尾部风险的概率估计；在多年代行政数据上的应用显示，福利支出持续上升可能带来显著系统性风险。

articles.title: State-resolved vibrational dynamics of Ar–Kr +
articles.abstract: We report a state-resolved study of ultrafast vibrational dynamics in the singly ionized heteronuclear dimer Ar–Kr using a femtosecond pump–probe reaction microscope. A linearly polarized pump pulse initiates the dynamics by ionizing the neutral dimer and preparing a coherent superposition of vibrational states on multiple electronic potential energy surfaces of Ar–Kr + . A time-delayed, circularly polarized probe pulse then induces further ionization and dissociation, allowing the evolving nuclear motion to be mapped onto the time-dependent kinetic-energy-release spectra of the fragments. The resulting time- and KER-resolved measurements reveal vibrational revivals at characteristic delays, each serving as a spectroscopic signature of a specific electronic state and exhibiting agreement with numerical simulations. Fourier analysis of the delay-dependent spectra further extracts the vibrational beating frequencies, which are consistent with established spectroscopic constants.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Surface and mass fractals in patchy particle aggregation
articles.abstract: The fractal study plays an important role in predicting the properties of materials and the underlying growth mechanisms in self-aggregating systems such as colloids and proteins, since such systems form highly irregular, scale-invariant structures. In this work, we performed a simulation study of the aggregation of spherical patchy particles interacting via four irreversible patches arranged in a square geometry along with an isotropic potential whose interaction strength can be varied. Structural analysis shows that at low isotropic strengths, hexagonal lattices form, whereas at higher isotropic strengths, cubic structures are more prominent locally. The slopes obtained from the calculation of the structure factor revealed the presence of both mass and surface fractals. This was independently confirmed by calculating the mass fractal dimension from the cluster size distribution and the surface fractals from the surface roughness measurements of the cluster, revealing that both mass and surface fractals are possible in irreversible patchy particle systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Electronic orbital response to static magnetic fields. II. A general theoretical method
articles.abstract: As a part of an ongoing project devoted to the development of theoretical foundations and computational methods for treating systems in external electro-magnetic fields, we present a new method here for dealing with magnetic fields of arbitrary strength and for arbitrary systems. The method is based on leaving the commonly used Coulomb gauge and instead introducing an operator gauge. We show that this method avoids the obstacles related with using the Coulomb gauge in combination with GIAOs (gauge-invariant atomic orbitals) as basis functions, i.e., complicated matrix elements and oscillatory behavior for non-magnetic terms. Moreover, our approach shares many features with the “Modern Theory of Magnetization,” which is based on the operator, ∇⃗k. However, our approach is not restricted to periodic systems and avoids many complications involved in the application of ∇⃗k. Our method is applicable for any system and field strength, and it readily provides an answer to the question of whether there is a surface/shape contribution to intensive magnetic responses for large systems. Test calculations on H2+ using a homemade ab initio program developed for small systems, and a simplified model for large systems, give mutually consistent and complementary results in support of our suggested approach, but not in complete agreement with results of GIAO calculations. We present a detailed analysis of this finding.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Spectral convergence of sum-of-Gaussians tensor neural networks for many-electron Schrödinger equation
articles.abstract: An improved version of the sum-of-Gaussians tensor neural network (SOG-TNN) architecture is presented for solving the many-electron Schrödinger equation for one-dimensional soft-Coulomb systems. Model reduction techniques are introduced to reduce the number of tensor-factorized bases under the SOG approximation of the kernel. The Slater determinant ansatz is employed so that the antisymmetric property of the wave function can be strictly preserved. Numerical results show that the SOG-TNN achieves high accuracy with remarkably small basis sizes. Robust spectral convergence with respect to the basis size is also observed, consistently characterized by a mixed algebraic-exponential model for the error decay. These findings validate that the SOG-TNN architecture provides an ultra-efficient and low-rank representation of complex multi-electron wave functions, shedding light on high-fidelity quantum calculations in larger-scale many-electron systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Shadow Hamiltonian in molecular dynamics simulations: Against a possible suggested misuse of its physical meaning
articles.abstract: Symplectic integrators are largely employed in MD due to their long-term stability and near conservation of invariants. Their numerical robustness can be rationalized by the existence of a shadow Hamiltonian H sh , exactly conserved by symplectic integrators and expressible as an asymptotic expansion with respect to the integration time steps δt around the physical Hamiltonian H . In this work, we suggest not attaching any physical meaning to H sh , based on theoretical analysis and MD simulations of a standard LJ system using the velocity-Verlet algorithm. We do not intend to optimize symplectic algorithms. Instead, we claim that the existence of H sh cannot provide better observables to estimate statistical properties. For that reason, we will also examine the behavior of trajectories integrated with large δt that are always exact integrations of their corresponding H sh ( δt ). To these trajectories, of course, we do not attach a physical meaning. Note that the stability of the energy cannot be enough to guarantee accurate estimates of statistical properties. Although symplectic integrators yield, within numerical accuracy, exact trajectories of H sh , thermodynamic quantities derived from H sh deviate from the physical ones when δt is too large. Indeed, the conventional kinetic temperature of H is wrongly estimated for large δt , while “shadow” temperature becomes unphysical for the same large δt , despite its exact meaning for H sh . We conclude that H sh lacks physical relevance for large δt , and the only remedy to perform simulations by standard integrators, such as the velocity-Verlet, is to use a short enough δt , in which case the estimated physical properties coincide.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Finite-bath open quantum systems: Exact dynamics
articles.abstract: In this study, we introduce a method for deriving exact master equations from the dynamical map for finite open quantum systems coupled to (in)finite reservoirs, using the principle of minimal dissipation. The exact dynamics of the central spin model, which models a finite-bath open quantum system, is developed for two interaction types: Heisenberg and stochastic pure-dephasing interactions. The Heisenberg interaction yields a novel phase-covariant quantum channel in the strong-coupling regime, offering a new platform for studying a range of quantum information protocols. The stochastic pure-dephasing interaction provides the microscopic derivation of the paradigmatic non-Markovian random telegraph noise (RTN) channel, establishing its quantum foundation and offering insight into stochastic couplings. We derive the closed-form master equations for both models. As a demonstration, we explore the thermodynamic performance of these systems as quantum batteries. A direct relationship between quantum heat current and charging power is revealed, and RTN quantum batteries are shown to have advantages in charge storage.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Elucidating the synergetic interplay between average intermolecular coupling and coupling disorder in short-time exciton transfer
articles.abstract: Exciton transport in molecular aggregates is a fundamental process governing the performance of organic optoelectronics and light-harvesting systems. While most theoretical studies have emphasized long-time transport behavior, recent advances in ultrafast spectroscopy have brought into focus the short-time regime, in which exciton motion remains ballistic on femtosecond-to-picosecond timescales. In this work, we develop an analytical framework for short-time exciton dynamics in a one-dimensional lattice subject to both on-site energetic (diagonal) disorder and intermolecular coupling (off-diagonal) fluctuations. Utilizing the reciprocal-space analysis, we derive closed-form expressions for the first and second spatial moments considering both localized excitation and moving Gaussian initial conditions. Our analytical and numerical results show that, while the long-time dynamics are influenced by diagonal disorder, the short-time ballistic expansion is governed primarily by off-diagonal disorder. Crucially, we reveal a synergistic interplay between the average intermolecular coupling and the off-diagonal coupling disorder strength, demonstrating that they contribute equivalently to short-time exciton transport. Moreover, we integrate this generic disorder model with a realistic molecular system within the framework of macroscopic quantum electrodynamics, thereby providing a theoretical foundation for characterizing and optimizing ultrafast energy flow of disordered molecular aggregates in complex dielectric media.

articles.title: A magnetic environment with reproducible spatio-temporal magnetic conditions at picotesla level
articles.title_zh: 一种在皮特斯拉水平实现可重复时空磁条件的磁环境
articles.abstract: Walk-in, picotesla-scale environments are essential for measurements of biomagnetism and fundamental physics. However, conventional rooms require typical active dynamic compensation, which adds complexity and magnetic noise. Here, we present a solution that achieves an absolute residual field well below 100pT within its central measurement volume. Following magnetic equilibration, this environment achieves picotesla-scale reproducibility. Consequently, optically pumped magnetometers operate at their design noise and drift performance and remain operational during sensor motion without active feedback. A key technique is robotic mapping, which resolves the ultra-low residual field patterns and demagnetization stability. We demonstrate the platform's versatility through high-fidelity adult and fetal magnetocardiography, standing magnetoencephalography, and ultra-low field magnetic resonance with polarized noble gases in the limit of strongly coupled spins in a negligible holding field. The achieved passive reproducibility turns the ultra-low magnetic background into a predictable, correctable property, establishing a novel foundation for next-generation quantum sensing and precision physics.

articles.abstract: A researcher at Kyushu University and his collaborators have shown that continuous parameters in quantum gravity may not be freely adjustable "dials" from outside the theory, but rather arise from operators within the theory itself, supporting the century-old claim by Albert Einstein about the fundamental laws of nature.
