articles.title: A Local Ontological Model of Double-Slit Fringes via Moiré Sampling and Non-Linear Detection
articles.title_zh: 通过莫尔采样与非线性探测建立双缝条纹的局域本体模型
articles.abstract: Feynman’s classic exposition of the double-slit experiment asserts that no local, particle-only ontology can reproduce quantum interference fringes without invoking wave-particle duality or nonlocal communication. We re-examine the implicit assumptions of this paradigm by constructing a strictly local, counterfactual-definite sampling model. The framework relies on four components: (i) an oscillating detector substrate that modulates single-particle detection efficiency; (ii) a geometric moir´e (beat) pattern emerging from independent slit trajectories; (iii) a finite detector relaxation memory that provides a non-linear readout; and (iv) source-detector phase coherence. We demonstrate that while linear averaging over the sub-wavelength carrier landscape washes out the signal (the “Addition Problem”), a non-linear detector memory successfully extracts the macroscopic quantum envelope, yielding an r ≈ 0.89 Pearson correlation with the Born-rule intensity profile in Monte Carlo simulations across multiple detection functions. This work isolates the passivedetection assumption as a critical, unstated premise in traditional quantum impossibility arguments and provides an operational, local-causal alternative for single-particle interference statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本重新考察双缝实验中“局域粒子图像无法产生干涉条纹”的传统论断，提出一种严格局域且反事实确定的采样模型。模型包含振荡探测器基底、由独立狭缝轨迹形成的几何莫尔拍频图样、有限探测器弛豫记忆导致的非线性读出，以及源—探测器相干性。作者称，线性平均会抹去亚波长载波信号，而非线性探测记忆可在蒙特卡洛模拟中提取接近玻恩规则的宏观包络，从而将“被动探测”假设识别为传统不可能性论证中的关键隐含前提。

articles.title: Microemulsion-Assisted Formation of P3P6T: PCBM Bulk Heterojunctions via Ultrasonic Spray Deposition for application in Organic Solar Cells
articles.title_zh: 用于有机太阳能电池的超声喷涂沉积微乳液辅助形成 P3P6T:PCBM 体异质结
articles.abstract: Aqueous-processable conjugated polymers offer an environment-friendly pathway for organic solar cell fabrication. In this work, a bulk-heterojunction(BHJ) comprising water soluble poly(3-(potassium-6-hexanoate) thiophene-2,5-diyl) (P3P6T) as donor and(6,6(-phenyl-C-61-butyric acid methyl ester)) (PCBM) as acceptor was synthesized using a microemulsion approach in combination with ultrasonic spray deposition. Two orthogonal solvents, water for P3P6T and dichlorobenzene for PCBM were used. These were mixed with isopropanol in specific proportions, to form a stable microemulsion. Use of orthogonal solvents for the donor and acceptor enabled controlled separation of donor–acceptor pure phases during spray deposition. Morphological and optical studies revealed that as-deposited films exhibited submicron sized PCBM islands. Short-time thermal annealing (120 °C, 5 min) promoted interfacial diffusion and the formation of continuous interpenetrating donor–acceptor networks, as evidenced by red-shifted absorption and strong photoluminescence quenching. Prolonged annealing led to over-coarsening and reduced interfacial areas. The optimized device, with structure ITO/PEDOT:PSS/P3HT/P3P6T:PCBM/ PCBM /Al, achieved a power conversion efficiency of 2.56% with Voc = 0.56 V, Jsc = 11.31 mA cm⁻², and FF = 40.4%. The study demonstrates that microemulsion-assisted ultrasonic spray deposition enables morphology control in aqueous-processable BHJ systems and provides a scalable route for environmentally friendly OPV fabrication. Relevance Summary: This work is focused on a novel microemulsion-assisted ultrasonic spray approach, which uses orthogonal solvents and a co-solvent to precisely control donor–acceptor morphology in aqueous-processable BHJ systems. Unlike prior studies, it allows tunable, pure and optimized submicron scale phase separation, which is an essential factor for BHJ based optoelectronic devices. This work advances scalable, eco-friendly fabrication of organic solar cells with enhanced morphology control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种更环保的水相可加工有机太阳能电池制备路线，利用水溶性给体聚合物 P3P6T 与受体 PCBM，通过微乳液策略结合超声喷涂沉积形成体异质结薄膜。研究使用水和二氯苯作为正交溶剂，并借助异丙醇形成稳定微乳液，以促进沉积过程中给受体相的可控分离。形貌和光学结果表明，短时热退火可促进界面扩散并形成连续互穿网络，而过长退火会导致相区粗化、界面面积减少。

articles.title: Synergistic Experimental and Quantum Chemical Investigation of Heavy Metal Immobilization in Industrial Soils
articles.title_zh: 工业土壤中重金属固定化的实验与量子化学协同研究
articles.abstract: Industrial discharge from the textile and dyeing industries in Tamil Nadu’s Tiruppur district has severely contaminated the soil with heavy metals, posing significant ecological and human health risks. This study assesses vermicomposting as a sustainable and eco-friendly bioremediation strategy for detoxifying these heavy metal-contaminated soils. Industrially polluted soil samples were subjected to vermicomposting using Eisenia fetida with organic amendments such as cattle dung and decomposed plant residues under controlled conditions for 45–60 days. Changes in soil properties and heavy metal concentrations were measured before and after treatment using Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometry (AAS). The results showed a substantial reduction in all analysed heavy metals with cadmium removal being the most effective (0.9516 to 0.1355 ppm) followed by chromium (0.2980 to 0.0773 ppm), nickel (0.6855 to 0.4218 ppm) and lead (0.5423 to 0.3128 ppm). To understand the molecular mechanisms behind metal immobilisation Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations and Molecular Electrostatic Potential (MEP) analysis were used to examine interactions between heavy metals and vermicompost-derived humic substances. DFT results indicated favourable binding energies and reduced HOMO-LUMO energy gaps confirming the high affinity of carboxyl, hydroxyl and phenolic groups for metal ions. MEP mapping revealed electron-rich regions as dominant metal-binding sites supporting strong adsorption and complexation. The combined experimental and computational findings suggest metal reduction occurs through synergistic mechanisms involving earthworm bioaccumulation, microbial-mediated redox transformations, humification and stable metal-organic complex formation. Crucially, the microbial reduction of toxic hexavalent chromium to the less mobile trivalent form was key to chromium detoxification. Beyond metal stabilisation, vermicomposting significantly increased soil organic carbon, nutrient availability (nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium) and microbial activity. This indicates effective soil health restoration. The final metal concentrations were well below internationally accepted permissible limits for agricultural soils. Overall, this study demonstrates that Eisenia fetida-based vermicomposting, supported by DFT and MEP insights, is a cost-effective low-energy and environmentally safe strategy for remediating and sustainably managing heavy metal-contaminated industrial soils.

articles.title: Global utility-scale photovoltaics are structurally displaced from electricity demand centres
articles.title_zh: 全球公用事业规模光伏在空间结构上偏离电力需求中心
articles.abstract: The system value of solar photovoltaics (PV) increasingly depends on effectively connecting generation to electricity demand. Here, we develop an integrated framework to diagnose this spatial constraint globally. Using Sentinel-2 imagery and deep learning, we map near-global utility-scale PV plants at 10-m resolution for 2025. Coupling this with generation models and a 1-km nighttime-light-derived electricity demand surface, we estimate ~ 1,852 TWh of annual PV generation against ~ 32.8 PWh of demand, yielding a ~ 5.65% mean penetration. Structural under-coverage is widespread: ~82% and 91% of global electricity demand lie in provinces below the 8.6% and 15.7% IEA reference thresholds, respectively. Under IEA-aligned scenarios requiring ~ 3,990 and ~ 5,910 TWh of PV supply, meeting demand relies heavily on domestic redistribution (~ 77.5%). Transfers exhibit a clear distance hierarchy, with > 80% occurring within 1,500 km and mean connection distances of ~ 593–718 km. This reveals dual infrastructure needs: expanding regional backbone networks and developing high-capacity long-distance corridors. As targets rise, the bottleneck shifts from reallocating existing production to mobilizing new potential via transmission and flexibility. We conclude the limiting factor is spatial system integration, requiring corridor-aware planning for equitable decarbonization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了一个全球尺度框架，用Sentinel-2影像、深度学习、发电模型和夜间灯光推算的电力需求数据，评估公用事业规模光伏发电与用电需求之间的空间匹配。结果显示，全球光伏年发电量约为1852 TWh，而需求约为32.8 PWh，平均渗透率约5.65%，大量电力需求所在省级区域低于IEA参考阈值。情景分析表明，实现更高光伏供给目标将高度依赖国内再分配，且多数输电发生在1500 km以内，同时也需要区域骨干电网和远距离高容量输电通道。

articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 20 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74634-4 It is possible to realize axion electrodynamics in a material with an isotropic and linear magnetoelectric response, however, such a material has thus far evaded experimental realization. Here, Mishra et al succeed in creating such a linear isotropic magnetoelectric response in powdered Chromia.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，具有各向同性线性磁电响应的材料可用于实现轴子电动力学，但这类体系此前一直缺乏实验实现。作者在粉末状氧化铬中构建出线性且各向同性的磁电响应，为在拓扑平凡反铁磁材料中研究轴子电动力学提供了实验途径。

articles.title: Design, Development and Field Evaluation of a Liquid Urea Application System for Precision Nitrogen Management
articles.title_zh: 用于精准氮素管理的液态尿素施用系统设计、开发与田间评价
articles.abstract: Efficient nitrogen management is critical for sustainable crop production and environmental conservation. This study focused on the design, development, and field evaluation of a tractor-operated liquid urea application system for precision nitrogen management in wheat cultivation. A coulter-based injection mechanism was developed to deliver liquid urea below the soil surface, thereby minimizing nitrogen losses through volatilization and surface runoff while sustaining crop yield and reducing environmental impacts associated with conventional application methods. Field experiments were conducted using five nitrogen treatments: T1 (100% recommended dose as granular urea), T2 (100% liquid urea), T3 (75% liquid urea), T4 (50% liquid urea), and T5 (control, no nitrogen application). The performance of the developed system was evaluated in terms of field capacity, fuel consumption, and agronomic response. Treatment T4, which used only 50% of the recommended urea rate, produced grain yields similar to the full-dose treatments (T1 and T2). It also reduced nitrogen input 50%, CO₂-equivalent emissions 33%, and fuel consumption (16%). The system achieved an effective field capacity of 0.24 ha/h and fuel consumption of 13.68 L/ha. The developed liquid urea application system demonstrated strong potential for precise nitrogen placement for sustainable wheat production.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究设计并田间评价了一种拖拉机牵引式液态尿素施用系统，用于小麦种植中的精准氮素管理。系统采用开沟器式注入机构，将液态尿素施入土壤表层以下，以减少挥发和地表径流造成的氮损失。田间结果显示，50%推荐尿素用量的液态尿素处理可获得与全量处理相近的籽粒产量，同时降低氮投入、二氧化碳当量排放和燃油消耗，显示出较好的节肥减排潜力。

articles.title: A new way to control tiny quantum light sources by twisting atomically thin layers of hexagonal boron nitride
articles.title_zh: 通过扭转原子级薄层六方氮化硼控制微小量子光源的新方法
articles.abstract: In a paper published in Science Advances, researchers at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) in collaboration with the University of Minnesota and Kyung Hee University have found a new way to control quantum light sources, which is one of the key elements needed before quantum technologies can be used reliably in real-world systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一项发表于 Science Advances 的研究，研究人员发现可通过扭转原子级薄层六方氮化硼来调控量子光源。量子光源是量子技术走向可靠实际应用的关键组成部分，该方法为其可控集成和器件化提供了新的思路，具体实验细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Energy-Exchange Driven Effective Field Framework (EE-DEFF): A Reproducible Variational Stochastic Model of Emergent Structures
articles.title_zh: 能量交换驱动的有效场框架（EE-DEFF）：一种可复现的涌现结构变分随机模型
articles.abstract: We propose a variational stochastic effective field framework describing emergent structures in non-equilibrium energy-exchange systems. The model introduces a continuous scalar field Φ(x,t) governed by structural relaxation, energy-gradient coupling, and stochastic fluctuations. Grounded in the fundamental premise that physical configuration states manifest through localized absorption and emission dynamics, we demonstrate that stable particle-like structures correspond to metastable extrema of an effective action functional. Incorporating numerical validation under explicit bounds, the proposed framework shows significantly enhanced convergence stability and scaling performance over classical stochastic baselines. In the diffusion limit, the model maintains mathematical consistency with stochastic formulations of quantum mechanics. The framework serves as a reproducible interpretive effective theory and establishes testable phenomenological directions via energy fluctuation scaling in high-energy regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种用于描述非平衡能量交换系统中涌现结构的变分随机有效场框架。模型引入连续标量场，包含结构弛豫、能量梯度耦合和随机涨落，并将稳定的类粒子结构解释为有效作用量泛函的亚稳极值。数值验证显示，该框架相较经典随机基线具有更好的收敛稳定性和尺度性能，并在扩散极限下与量子力学随机表述保持数学一致性。

articles.title: Responses of the macroalgae Ulva lactuca (Ulvales, Chlorophyta) and Sargassum cymosum (Fucales, Ochrophyta) to thermal stress evaluated by PAM fluorometry
articles.title_zh: 利用 PAM 荧光法评估石莼和马尾藻对热胁迫的响应
articles.abstract: There is growing concern regarding the thermal effects of global warming on benthic marine macroalgae, which are ecologically important ecosystem engineers on rocky shores. Metabolic responses to thermal stress vary among species and depend on their optimal temperature and tolerance range. Physiological studies using pulse amplitude modulated (PAM) fluorometry to assess photosystem II are essential for understanding macroalgal responses to temperature fluctuations. This study evaluated photosystem II response behavior under extreme temperature conditions in Ulva lactuca Linnaeus and Sargassum cymosum C. Agardh to detect the sensitivity of these species to temperature variation. Maximum and effective quantum efficiencies (Fv/Fm and ΔF/Fm′) and photosystem II thermal tolerance were measured under 25°C (control) and 35°C (thermal stress) conditions in the laboratory. Both species showed reduced Fv/Fm and ΔF/Fm′ values at 35°C, with Ulva lactuca being the most affected species. The thermal stability of photosystem II was not altered between the tested temperatures but was consistently lower in Sargassum cymosum. These results indicate that thermal stress resistance and exposure frequency in their natural habitats influence species-specific thermal tolerance. Ulva lactuca, which is typical of intertidal zones with frequent short-term thermal fluctuations, loses its photosystem II efficiency and biomass under prolonged thermal stress. In contrast, Sargassum cymosum, found in warm subtidal waters, exhibits greater tolerance and maintains growth despite its reduced photosystem II efficiency. Thus, photosystem II thermal stability and photosynthetic efficiency appeared to be independently selected.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注全球变暖背景下底栖海洋大型藻类对温度升高的生理响应，采用脉冲振幅调制荧光法评估石莼和马尾藻光系统 II 的表现。实验比较了25°C对照和35°C热胁迫条件下的最大及有效量子效率，结果显示两种藻类在高温下均出现光合效率下降，其中石莼受影响更明显。研究提示，不同大型藻类对热胁迫的敏感性和光系统 II 稳定性存在差异。

articles.title: Electrically tunable spin polarization in graphene opens path toward low-power spintronic devices
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯中可电调的自旋极化为低功耗自旋电子器件开辟道路
articles.abstract: Researchers at the National Graphene Institute, in collaboration with the National University of Singapore, have shown that the magnetic behavior of electrons in graphene can be precisely controlled using electricity, revealing unusually large spin signals in a carefully engineered graphene system.
articles.abstract_zh: 英国国家石墨烯研究所与新加坡国立大学合作表明，可利用电场精确调控石墨烯中电子的磁性行为。研究在经过精心设计的石墨烯体系中观测到异常强的自旋信号，为开发低功耗自旋电子器件提供了新途径。

articles.title: How to train your magnet: Excitons as a new knob for magnetic control
articles.title_zh: 如何“训练”磁体：激子作为磁性控制的新旋钮
articles.abstract: Scientists can learn a lot about a quantum material by watching how it responds to light. In magnetic semiconductors, one especially useful messenger is the exciton: a pairing of a negatively charged electron and the positively charged "hole" it leaves behind. Until now, excitons in magnetic materials have mostly been used as reporters. They could reveal how spins were arranged or how magnetic waves moved through a material. But Cornell researchers have shown that excitons can do more than observe magnetism. They can actively steer it.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注磁性半导体中激子对磁性的作用，激子由电子及其留下的空穴组成，过去主要被用作探测自旋排列和磁波传播的“信使”。康奈尔大学研究人员表明，激子不仅能表征磁性，还可主动调控磁性，为量子材料的光控磁性提供了新思路。

articles.title: Modified Synthetic Dataset-Driven Multiple Linear Regression for Industrial Production Forecasting and Cost Estimation
articles.title_zh: 基于改进合成数据集驱动的多元线性回归用于工业生产预测与成本估算
articles.abstract: In the era of fast industrialization and urbanization manufacturing sectors need sophisticated automation to guarantee effective production monitoring and cost estimation. This work presents a Python-based graphical user interface (GUI) using multiple linear regression (MLR) in machine learning to maximize decision-making in industrial production. To precisely forecast production quantity (PQ), unit production cost (PC), total PC per item, and total manufacturing expenses on a fixed profit margin (PM) set up by the industry, the proposed approach incorporates theoretical assumption data nominated as modified synthetic dataset (MSD) of proportional industrial variables based on the economics of industrial operation. Embedded with a GUI, the suggested Python-based computational model provides high-accuracy production prediction and real-time cost estimation. Precise predictions are ensured by MSD of experimental data showing an exceedingly low mean square error (MSE) of 1.210139×10–23 and coefficient of determination (R2) values close to 1.0. Moreover, a significant comparison of comparable machine learning (ML) techniques, featuring a combination of linear, regularized, kernel-based, and ensemble learning methods, was conducted on the same platform to assess the proposed MLR model as the optimal choice. By lowering hand computations and errors, this automated approach greatly improves manufacturing cost estimation and planning. For cost engineers and production managers, the GUI is a useful tool since it helps enable complex industrial decision-making and resource control in a very straightforward way. The results of this study show that the suggested GUI model is a dependable and useful tool for contemporary industrial sectors, therefore promoting better operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness in the case of the modern manufacturing sector.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于 Python 图形用户界面和多元线性回归的工业生产预测与成本估算模型。模型利用按工业经济变量构建的改进合成数据集，预测产量、单位生产成本、单项总成本以及在固定利润率下的制造总费用。结果显示，该方法在实验数据上取得极低均方误差和接近 1 的决定系数，并与多种机器学习方法进行了比较，表明其适用于实时生产决策支持。

articles.title: Anisotropy in Phonon Thermal Conductivity Reduction of Binary Zr-1%Nb Alloy: Atomistic Simulations of Point Defect Scattering
articles.title_zh: 二元 Zr-1%Nb 合金声子热导率降低的各向异性：点缺陷散射的原子模拟
articles.abstract: The thermal conductivity (κ) of the Zr-1%Nb alloy is crucial for the optimal and safe performance of VVER reactors. This paper first provides a comparative analysis of three molecular dynamics  methods: Non-Equilibrium Molecular Dynamics (NEMD) and the Equilibrium method (EMD). Within NEMD, two approaches are discussed: the Direct Thermostat Method, which enforces a temperature gradient between two regions and measures the heat flux, and the Müller-Plathe Method, which creates a small temperature gradient by swapping the kinetic energy of atoms between two defined regions and then measuring the exchanged energy. The EMD method, based on the Green-Kubo formalism, utilizes the heat flux autocorrelation function to calculate κ. The results indicate that while the Green-Kubo method requires smaller simulation boxes and is less influenced by size and statistical sample effects, it exhibits lower accuracy due to the exclusion of three-body potential contributions. The Direct Thermostat Method necessitates a large temperature gradient to achieve accurate heat flux measurements, which can distort the results. In terms of total simulation time and accuracy, the Müller-Plathe Method is more suitable for studying irradiated Zr-1%Nb alloys. Results also show centerline temperature variations due to different phonon thermal conductivity (κph) methods remain below 0.05°C, demonstrating that phonon modeling uncertainties negligibly affect steady-state fuel thermal performance. This study then employs the Müller-Plathe method to investigate the impact of anisotropic distribution of point defects on the κph in Zr-1%Nb alloy. The findings reveal that vacancy defects have a greater impact on reducing κph. Additionally, the reduction in κph varies among different defects in different directions, which can be attributed to their anisotropic distribution. It is important to note that only the phonon contribution is considered in this study.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究 Zr-1%Nb 合金热导率，这一性质对 VVER 反应堆的安全和高效运行十分重要。作者比较了非平衡分子动力学中的直接恒温法、Müller-Plathe 法以及基于 Green-Kubo 公式的平衡分子动力学方法。结果指出，Green-Kubo 法所需模拟体系较小且受尺寸和统计采样影响较小，但因未纳入三体势贡献而精度较低；直接恒温法需较大温度梯度，可能导致结果失真；综合计算时间和精度，Müller-Plathe 法更具优势。

articles.title: Design and analysis of All-Optical Digital MUX 2X1 and MUX 4x1 based on Photonic Crystals
articles.title_zh: 基于光子晶体的全光数字 2×1 与 4×1 多路复用器设计与分析
articles.abstract: The paper introduces the design, analysis, and simulation of all-optical 2×1 and 4×1 multiplexer based on photonicCcrystal structures. Photonic crystals offer precise control over light propagation through intentionally engineered defects, making them well-suited for compact and high-performance optical signal processing devices. The proposed 2×1 multiplexer occupies a dimension of 52 µm × 40 µm, while the 4×1 configuration has dimensions of 126 µm × 85 µm. Both designs are implemented using a 2-dimensional photonic crystal structure with a lattice constant of 630 nm and dielectric rods of refractive index 3.4 embedded in air. The calculated photonic bandgap spans the normalized frequency range from 0.32 to 0.43. The operational performance and functionality of the designed multiplexers are evaluated using the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method, while the photonic band structure is analyzed through the plane wave expansion (PWE) technique. The simulation results confirm the feasibility, compactness, and efficient operation of the proposed designs, highlighting their potential suitability for future photonic integrated circuits and all-optical communication systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出并仿真了基于二维光子晶体结构的全光 2×1 和 4×1 多路复用器。设计采用晶格常数 630 nm、折射率 3.4 的介质柱嵌入空气中，通过缺陷结构实现对光传播的精确控制。作者利用 FDTD 方法评估器件性能，并用平面波展开法分析光子带隙，结果验证了所提结构的紧凑性、可行性和高效运行潜力。

articles.title: Region-specific hamstring activation and its dissociation from subjective contraction sensation during leg curl exercise at different hip flexion angles
articles.title_zh: 不同髋关节屈曲角度下腿弯举运动中腘绳肌区域特异性激活及其与主观收缩感觉的分离
articles.abstract: Background Hamstring activation during resistance training may vary according to muscle region and joint position. However, the relationship between region-specific hamstring activation and subjective contraction sensation during leg curl exercise remains unclear. The purpose of this study was to investigate region-specific and longitudinally compartmentalized muscle dynamics of the hamstrings during leg curl (LC) exercise performed at different hip flexion angles (HFA), and to examine the relationship between subjective contraction sensation and objective muscle activity.Methods Nine male bodybuilders performed unilateral LC at three hip flexion angles (0°, 40°, and 80°), with knee flexion ranging from 0° to 130°. Pre- and post-exercise transverse relaxation times (T2) were measured using magnetic resonance imaging. Each LC session consisted of 5 sets of 10 repetitions at 70% of one-repetition maximum, with 1-minute rest intervals. The hamstrings were divided into proximal, middle, and distal regions for the biceps femoris long (BF-long) and short heads, semitendinosus (ST), and semimembranosus. T2 activation rates were calculated for each region. The subjective sensation of hamstrings contraction during LC exercise was evaluated using a numerical rating scale (NRS) and compared with the T2 value as an objective index.Results Across all conditions, the ST exhibited greater activation than the other hamstring muscles (p < 0.01, p < 0.05). In particular, the distal region showed higher activation than the proximal region at HFA 0° (p < 0.05). For the BF-long, greater activation was observed in the proximal region compared with the distal region at HFA 40° (p < 0.01). The NRS scores were inconsistent with the objective index.Conclusion The ST is preferentially activated during LC exercise. Hamstring activation is both region-specific and longitudinally compartmentalized, depending on muscle length as influenced by HFA. Because subjective contraction sensation was dissociated from objective muscle activity, hamstring resistance training should not rely solely on perceived muscle contraction, but should instead consider objective muscle activation characteristics when selecting exercise positions and training strategies. Optimal hip positioning should therefore be considered when designing resistance training programs to effectively target specific hamstring regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察不同髋关节屈曲角度下腿弯举训练时腘绳肌各区域的激活差异，以及这种客观肌肉活动与主观收缩感觉之间的关系。九名男性健美运动员在 0°、40° 和 80° 髋屈角下完成单侧腿弯举，研究通过磁共振成像测量运动前后 T2 值，并按近端、中部和远端区域分析股二头肌、半腱肌和半膜肌的激活率。研究旨在揭示关节位置对腘绳肌纵向分区激活的影响，以及主观感觉是否能准确反映实际肌肉活动。

articles.title: Field Evaluation of 1-Methylnaphthalene as a Performance Enhancer for Diethylamine Corrosion Inhibitor in Oil Production Facilities
articles.title_zh: 1-甲基萘作为二乙胺腐蚀抑制剂性能增强剂在油田生产设施中的现场评价
articles.abstract: This study examines the improvement in the corrosion-inhibitory efficacy of diethylamine (DEA) by incorporating 1-methylnaphthalene (1-MN) at concentrations of 2%-5% in oil production header systems. The assessment was performed in actual operational settings at an oil and gas production plant, utilizing corrosion coupons, online corrosion monitoring systems, fluid analysis, and X-ray diffraction (XRD). Corrosion performance was assessed by comparing the injection of 30 ppm DEA alone with DEA modified by the addition of 1-MN. The results demonstrated a significant reduction in corrosion rates after the addition of 1-MN. At the crude inlet to the HP Wet Separator #01, the corrosion rate decreased from 25 to 14 mpy, while at the crude outlet from LP Wet Separator #03, the corrosion rate decreased from 9 to 2 mpy. Furthermore, the corrosion rate at the crude outlet from LP Dry Separator #04 decreased from 4 mpy to less than 1 mpy. Fluid analysis also confirmed improved corrosion control performance through reductions in total iron concentration and increases in corrosion inhibitor residuals. XRD analysis showed an increase in the magnetite (Fe₃O₄) passivation layer from 50.1% to 53.9% after the addition of 1-MN. In contrast, the troilite (FeS) content decreased from 26.1% to 18.2%, while goethite, previously detected at 1.8%, completely disappeared. The findings demonstrate the synergistic effect of 1-MN in enhancing DEA's adsorption and protective film-forming behaviour under oilfield operating conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在油气生产装置的真实运行环境中，评估 2%–5% 1-甲基萘对二乙胺腐蚀抑制效果的增强作用。通过腐蚀挂片、在线腐蚀监测、流体分析和 XRD 表征，比较单独注入 30 ppm 二乙胺与加入 1-甲基萘后的腐蚀控制效果。结果显示，多处生产流程点的腐蚀速率显著降低，总铁含量下降、缓蚀剂残余量升高，且磁铁矿钝化层比例增加，说明 1-甲基萘可提高二乙胺的现场缓蚀性能。

articles.title: Performance Analysis of Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Systems with Imperfect Phase-Shift Control
articles.title_zh: 相移控制不完美条件下可重构智能表面系统的性能分析
articles.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive performance analysis of reconfigurableintelligent surface (RIS) systems subject to imperfect phase-shift control.RIS technology, composed of numerous passive elements, has the potential tosignificantly enhance wireless communication by optimizing signal reflection.However, practical limitations in phase-shift accuracy caused by hardwareimpairments, channel aging, and imperfect channel state information (CSI)degrade system performance. Under a Rayleigh fading channel model, theamplitude coefficients of both the transmitter-to-RIS and RIS-to-receiverlinks are modeled as independent Rayleigh random variables, while the residualphase-shift errors are treated as uniformly distributed random variables.Within this stochastic framework, we derive closed-form expressions for the probability density function (PDF) of the instantaneous signal-to-noise ratio(SNR), the ergodic capacity, the outage probability, and diversity. The SNR isapproximated by a Weibull distribution whose parameters are determined throughmoment matching and validated against Monte Carlo simulations. Our analyticalframework is computationally simple and avoids the use of infinite series orcomplex special functions. The results highlight the critical impact of phaseimperfections on RIS system performance and provide a practical foundation foroptimizing RIS deployment in next-generation wireless networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文系统分析了存在不完美相移控制时可重构智能表面系统的通信性能。研究在瑞利衰落信道下建模发射端至 RIS 和 RIS 至接收端链路幅度，并将残余相移误差视为均匀分布随机变量。作者推导了瞬时信噪比概率密度函数、遍历容量、中断概率和分集性能的闭式表达式，并用矩匹配得到 Weibull 近似，结合蒙特卡洛仿真验证了分析框架的有效性。

articles.title: Space-Time-Modulated Cryogenic Josephson Metasurfaces for Polychromatic Qubit Coupling and Frequency-Selective Interactions in Superconducting Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 用于超导量子系统中多色量子比特耦合与频率选择性交互的时空调制低温约瑟夫森超表面
articles.abstract: We introduce space-time-modulated cryogenic-compatible Josephson metasurfaces as a versatile platform for polychromatic qubit coupling and frequency-selective interactions. These metasurfaces, based on arrays of gated superconductor-semiconductor Josephson field-effect transistors (JoFETs), enable dynamic four-dimensional (space-time) control of microwave fields at millikelvin temperatures. Through spatiotemporal modulation of the critical current density, the metasurface generates controllable Floquet harmonics, facilitating frequency conversion, parametric amplification, and nonreciprocal propagation. Full-wave electromagnetic simulations demonstrate selective excitation and multi-frequency state transitions in superconducting qubit arrays, where a photon emitted at frequency is efficiently redirected into multiple target frequencies to mediate long-range interactions between adjacent and non-adjacent qubits. In the circuit quantum electrodynamics framework, this yields an effective polychromatic Hamiltonian supporting frequency-multiplexed exchange couplings while providing spectral isolation that suppresses crosstalk. The engineered non-Markovian environment arising from the space-time modulation offers pathways to enhance qubit coherence times and entanglement fidelity through information backflow and noise suppression. Fabrication pathways using Al-proximitized InAs quantum wells and cryogenic measurement setups are discussed. This work establishes space-time-modulated Josephson metasurfaces as promising hardware enablers for frequency-selective control, improved connectivity, and robust operation in next-generation superconducting quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种兼容低温环境的时空调制约瑟夫森超表面，用于实现多频量子比特耦合和频率选择性交互。该平台由栅控超导体-半导体约瑟夫森场效应晶体管阵列构成，可在毫开尔文温度下对微波场进行空间和时间维度的动态控制。全波电磁仿真显示，该超表面可产生可控 Floquet 谐波，实现频率转换、参量放大、非互易传播以及超导量子比特阵列中的多频态转移，从而支持频率复用交换耦合并降低串扰。

articles.title: Impact of Abiotic and Biotic Factors on the Growth of Betaphycus gelatinus and Diversity Analysis of Its Associated Epiphytic and Endophytic Microbiomes
articles.title_zh: 非生物与生物因素对 Betaphycus gelatinus 生长的影响及其附生和内生微生物组多样性分析
articles.abstract: Betaphycus gelatinus is a crucial carrageenophyte grown in tropical and subtropical coastal ecosystems. However, the environmental factors influencing its growth and the microbial community changes linked to its health status remain unclear. This study assesses the impact of selected abiotic conditions and seawater treatment on B. gelatinus growth using orthogonal experimental design. We characterized epiphytic, surface-sterilized tissue-associated bacterial communities, and ITS2-derived epiphytic eukaryotic communities in marine-cultured, bleached, and indoor-cultured thalli through amplicon sequencing. The growth experiments indicated significant associations between phosphate, iron, and seawater treatment and B. gelatinus growth, highlighting the combined effects of nutrient conditions and seawater-related factors on the richness and evenness of its microbial communities. Microbial community analysis revealed distinct host-condition-associated shifts. Marine-cultured thalli displayed higher bacterial richness but lower evenness, while bleached thalli exhibited increased bacterial evenness and distinct enrichment of bleaching-associated taxa (e.g., Ruegeria and Methylophaga). Surface-sterilized tissue-associated bacterial communities varied among host conditions, with bleached thalli showing higher richness and evenness. ITS2-derived communities demonstrated significant taxonomic shifts, notably ciliate-related taxa’s dominance in bleached samples, though functional differences were limited. Function prediction suggested that bacterial communities under different host conditions varied in metabolic potential, including terpenoid- and steroid-related pathways in marine-cultured samples, and amino acid and central carbon metabolism in bleached samples. These findings reveal that B. gelatinus health status is intimately linked to the restructuring of host-associated microbial communities, providing an initial microbial ecological basis for understanding bleaching-associated community shifts and developing future health monitoring and cultivation strategies for B. gelatinus.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究聚焦热带和亚热带海岸生态系统中重要的卡拉胶藻 Betaphycus gelatinus，评估环境因子和海水处理方式对其生长及微生物群落的影响。作者采用正交实验分析磷酸盐、铁和海水处理等因素，并通过扩增子测序比较海培养、白化和室内培养藻体的附生细菌、组织相关细菌及附生真核群落。结果表明，营养条件与海水相关因素显著影响藻体生长及微生物群落丰富度和均匀度，不同健康或培养状态的藻体呈现明显的宿主状态相关微生物群落变化。

articles.title: Investigation of adsorption performance and mechanism of phosphoric acid-KOH co-modified biochar for Mn(II) in mining area tailings soil leachate
articles.title_zh: 磷酸-KOH 共改性生物炭对矿区尾矿土壤淋滤液中 Mn(II) 的吸附性能与机制研究
articles.abstract: Using corn stover as the raw material, unmodified (A-BC-500), phosphoric acid-modified (P-BC-500), potassium hydroxide-modified (K-BC-500), and phosphoric acid-potassium hydroxide combined-modified (PK-BC-500) biochars (carbonized at 500 ℃) were prepared. The prepared biochars were characterized by analytical techniques including SEM, BET, XRD, XPS, and FTIR, and their adsorption performance for Mn(Ⅱ) in aqueous solutions and manganese tailing soil leachate was investigated. The results showed that PK-BC-500 exhibited a significantly higher specific surface area than A-BC-500, with an increase of 1121.5 %, and was rich in oxygen-containing functional groups such as hydroxyl groups (─OH) and carboxyl groups (─COOH). After adsorbing Mn(Ⅱ), deposits are observed on the surface of the pore channels, and the functional groups participate in the complexation reaction. Kinetic and isotherm fitting results indicate that the pseudo-second-order kinetic model and the Langmuir model fit the adsorption process better, reflecting the monolayer adsorption characteristics dominated by chemical adsorption with the synergy of physical adsorption, with a maximum adsorption capacity of 18.56 mg·g-1. Thermodynamic analysis confirms that the adsorption process is a spontaneous endothermic reaction (ΔH=32.507 kJ·mol-1, ΔG<0). In actual manganese tailing soil leachate, PK-BC-500 exhibits excellent performance: the adsorption capacity reaches 2.791 mg·g-1 under acid rain conditions, which is significantly superior to that of other modified biochars. The adsorption capacity reaches a peak of 1.705 mg·g-1 on the 14th day and stably remains at 1.325 mg·g-1 on the 28th day. In addition, temperature fluctuation has little effect on its adsorption performance, and its adsorption capacity stably ranges from 1.684 mg·g-1 to 1.712 mg·g-1 within the temperature range of 5~35 ℃. In conclusion, PK-BC-500 has a highly efficient and stable adsorption capacity for Mn(Ⅱ) in manganese tailing soil and exhibits great application potential in the treatment of manganese pollution in mining areas.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以玉米秸秆为原料制备未改性、磷酸改性、KOH 改性及磷酸-KOH 共改性生物炭，并考察其对水溶液和锰尾矿土壤淋滤液中 Mn(II) 的吸附能力。表征结果显示，共改性生物炭比表面积大幅提高，并富含羟基、羧基等含氧官能团，吸附后孔道表面出现沉积物且官能团参与络合反应。动力学和等温模型拟合表明，该过程更符合准二级动力学模型和 Langmuir 模型，主要表现为化学吸附主导、物理吸附协同的单层吸附特征，最大吸附量为 18.56 mg·g-1。

articles.title: Hydrogen generation promoted by single-atom-based thermochemical catalysts
articles.title_zh: 单原子热化学催化剂促进制氢
articles.abstract: Nature Reviews Chemistry, Published online: 19 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41570-026-00838-3 This Review details the fundamentals of single-atom catalysts for H2-generation technologies. We discuss the different reaction pathways, COx by-products and their potential eliminations, COx-free pathways, catalyst structure–performance relationships and the techno-economics of the different processes, including cost factors and scalability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述系统介绍了用于制氢技术的单原子催化剂基础。文章讨论不同反应路径、COx副产物及其潜在消除策略、无COx路径、催化剂结构—性能关系，以及不同工艺的技术经济性、成本因素和规模化前景。

articles.title: A photonic integrated long-distance quantum communication network
articles.title_zh: 一种光子集成的长距离量子通信网络
articles.abstract: Nature Photonics, Published online: 19 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01944-w A four-user quantum spine-leaf network over up to 540-km fibre is demonstrated using a twin-field quantum key distribution protocol. It allows the full connections between any two user pairs and is operated at a 1.25 GHz clock rate with a secret key rate of 9.38 × 10−9 bit per pulse.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一个基于光子集成技术的四用户量子骨干—叶节点网络，利用双场量子密钥分发协议在最长540公里光纤上运行。该网络支持任意两用户之间的全连接通信，并以1.25 GHz时钟频率实现每脉冲9.38 × 10−9 bit的安全密钥率。

articles.title: Electrical magnetochiral anisotropy in Rashba superconductors
articles.title_zh: Rashba超导体中的电学磁手性各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate the role of higher-order Lifshitz invariants in nonreciprocal charge transport in two-dimensional noncentrosymmetric superconductors with Rashba spin-orbit coupling. In the superconducting state, these symmetry-allowed terms give rise to critical-current nonreciprocity, while in the normal state near the superconducting transition they generate a pronounced magnetochiral anisotropy. Using symmetry-constrained group-theoretical methods, we systematically construct the allowed Lifshitz invariants and derive the corresponding vector structure of the nonreciprocal current. To describe nonlinear transport in the fluctuation regime, we apply a generalized time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory that incorporates both the Aslamazov-Larkin contribution from fluctuation-induced Cooper pairs and the Maki-Thompson contribution associated with quantum interference in the Cooper channel. We further analyze the effects of disorder scattering and dephasing on the resulting nonreciprocal response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论研究考察了具有Rashba自旋—轨道耦合的二维非中心对称超导体中，高阶Lifshitz不变量对非互易电荷输运的作用。在超导态中，这些对称性允许项导致临界电流非互易性；在接近超导转变的正常态中，则产生显著的磁手性各向异性。作者结合群论构造、推广的含时Ginzburg-Landau理论，并分析了Aslamazov-Larkin与Maki-Thompson涨落贡献以及无序散射和退相干效应。
authors: Joaquim Telles de Miranda, Maxim Khodas, Alex Levchenko

articles.title: Three-dimensional Foliated Fractional Quantum Hall Phases
articles.title_zh: 三维分层分数量子霍尔相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foliated topological orders in three dimensions are layered systems in which anyons are free to move within a layer but cannot hop between them. A simple model with such a phase is a stack of decoupled two-dimensional electron gases in a strong magnetic field, each in the same fractional quantum Hall state. By focusing on the case of filling ν=1/3 of the lowest Landau level in each layer, we show that (i) the limit of decoupled Laughlin states is stable upon introducing interlayer interactions and (ii) the system can enter a spontaneously layer-trimerized foliated non-Abelian Fibonacci phase. We support our claims by numerical exact diagonalization of up to 10 layers as well as perturbative analytical calculations. Specifically, we show that the foliated Fibonacci phase exists in the 9-layer system with pseudopotential interactions within and between neighboring layers. We identify the phase via quasihole counting and by calculating the overlap with a model wave function which we derive from the associated conformal field theory. Our numerical results suggest the possibility of realizing these phases in layered van der Waals crystals in strong magnetic fields, as well as in multilayer heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论三维分层拓扑序，其中任意子可在层内运动但不能在层间跃迁。作者以每层最低Landau能级填充因子ν=1/3的Laughlin态堆叠为例，表明解耦Laughlin态在引入层间相互作用后仍可稳定，并可能进入自发三层化的分层非阿贝尔Fibonacci相。研究通过最多10层体系的精确对角化和微扰解析计算支持结论，并指出层状范德华晶体可能为实现此类相提供平台。
authors: Sahana Das, Navketan Batra, Andrea Kouta Dagnino, Dan Mao, Nicolas Regnault, Glenn Wagner, Titus Neupert

articles.title: Odd fluids from chiral cellular automata
articles.title_zh: 来自手性元胞自动机的奇黏性流体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cellular automata are discrete dynamical systems defined on a lattice, in which each site carries a finite set of states that evolve in time according to local deterministic rules. An important application of cellular automata is in lattice gas models of fluids, where the cellular automaton framework provides a particle-based microscopic description of hydrodynamic behavior. The macroscopic fluid equations emerge after coarse-graining over many lattice sites and time steps, offering a bottom-up route to hydrodynamics. A celebrated example is the Frisch-Hasslacher-Pomeau (FHP) model, an automaton defined on a two-dimensional triangular lattice that yields the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations upon coarse-graining. In this work, we construct a parity-breaking generalization of the FHP model through two modifications: introducing chiral two-body collision rules and systematically rotating particle velocities to mimic the effect of a background magnetic field. We show that this automaton yields a hydrodynamic model with odd viscosity, a transverse transport coefficient that is a hallmark of odd fluids. We verify the analytical transport coefficients using Poiseuille-flow simulations of the chiral FHP automaton. Our results demonstrate that the chiral automaton introduced here provides a bridge between microscopic parity-breaking scattering processes and macroscopic odd-fluid hydrodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构造了Frisch-Hasslacher-Pomeau二维三角晶格流体元胞自动机的宇称破缺推广。作者通过引入手性二体碰撞规则，并系统旋转粒子速度以模拟背景磁场效应，使粗粒化后的流体模型呈现奇黏性这一横向输运系数。该工作为从微观离散动力学出发理解奇流体的流体力学行为提供了模型框架。
authors: Andrew A. Allocca, Shiva Heidari, Thomas Iadecola, Armin Rahmani, Pouyan Ghaemi, Sriram Ganeshan

articles.title: Observation of complete delocalization in disordered photonic lattices
articles.title_zh: 无序光子晶格中完全退局域化的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19436v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the exceptional phenomenon of complete absence of Anderson localization, and perfect transmission of particles, in a completely disordered diamond-dot chain. We analytically show a proof for the condition to observe this exceptional phenomenon, based on a transparent window emerging from a geometrical condition. We support our theoretical prediction by numerical simulations and direct experimental observation of the transmission probabilities of the light in a femtosecond laser-written diamond-dot photonic lattices. We additionally show that for a π effective magnetic flux, extreme localization of the light in the same system may occur, independently on the specific geometry. Our results open up an excellent platform for controlling the transmission of energy from ballistic to zero transmission, in a completely disordered lattice system..
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了完全无序的diamond-dot链中Anderson局域化完全消失以及粒子完美透射的特殊现象。作者解析给出了由几何条件导致透明窗口并产生该现象的条件，并通过数值模拟和飞秒激光直写光子晶格中的光传输概率实验观测加以验证。研究还表明，在π有效磁通下，同一系统可出现与具体几何无关的极端光局域化，从而提供了在完全无序晶格中调控能量传输的平台。

articles.title: Many-Body Protection of Topological Edge Memory in Strong Interacting Quenches
articles.title_zh: 强相互作用淬火中拓扑边缘记忆的多体保护
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum quenches drive edge states far from equilibrium, yet whether the memory of a topological initial state survives in a non-integrable, interacting system has remained largely unexplored. We study this question in the bond-alternating XXZ chain -- an interacting Su--Schrieffer--Heeger model hosting symmetry-protected topological edge modes with markedly enhanced boundary magnetization -- and analyze quenches across all combinations of single-particle and many-body initial and final Hamiltonians. The results organize by a single distinction as we rigorously establish in this work: whether the post-quench Hamiltonian is free or genuinely interacting. For a free post-quench Hamiltonian, the dynamics is solved exactly by a correlation-matrix approach; the boundary-mode return amplitude decays as t⁻³/², and initial interactions enter only through a dressed one-body density matrix. For a genuinely interacting post-quench Hamiltonian, finite-time stability bounds prove that away from local resonances the first-dimer magnetization remains stable on time windows growing as arbitrarily large powers of the inverse inter-dimer coupling. Matrix product state simulations across all four protocols show that interactions in the final Hamiltonian markedly extend finite-time boundary memory -- with local suppression near the isotropic SU(2) point -- revealing a many-body protection mechanism in a non-integrable system where scrambling would otherwise wash out initial-state memory fast.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察量子淬火后，非可积相互作用体系中拓扑初态的边缘态记忆能否保持。作者研究键交替XXZ链这一相互作用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型，比较单粒子与多体初末哈密顿量的多种淬火组合，并指出动力学行为主要取决于淬火后的哈密顿量是否真正相互作用。对于自由末态哈密顿量，边界模返回振幅按t−3/2衰减；对于相互作用末态，有限时间稳定性界表明在避开局域共振时边界磁化可在较长时间窗口内保持稳定。
authors: Yuxiao Hang, Stephan Haas, Rishabh Jha

articles.title: Collective phases in overdamped magnetic self-propelled spherocylinders
articles.title_zh: 过阻尼磁性自驱动球柱粒子的集体相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the collective dynamics of self-propelled spherocylinders carrying magnetic dipole moments in two dimensions. Magnetic interactions are modeled as two opposite monopoles ± Q separated by a distance ell along the particle director, a dumbbell model that remains well-defined at short range and introduces an explicit geometric lever arm for the magnetic torque. This approach, combined with the elongated particle geometry, produces a torque that competes with steric alignment in a manner inaccessible to point-dipole or disk models. By independently varying monopole separation and dipole strength (parameters that map directly onto the geometry and magnetization of cylindrical magnets) we show that the system navigates a rich landscape of collective states: gas, polar flock, chain, vortex-alignment, and locked-dimer phases. Our results establish that particle elongation and distributed magnetic charge together provide a minimal, experimentally accessible set of tuning knobs for controlling coherent states in magnetic active matter, with direct implications for the design of self-organized magnetic microswimmers and active colloidal assemblies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究模拟二维中携带磁偶极矩的自驱动球柱粒子的集体动力学，并用由相反磁单极组成的哑铃模型描述磁相互作用。该模型结合粒子细长几何，引入可与空间排斥诱导取向竞争的磁力矩，从而产生点偶极或圆盘模型难以捕捉的行为。通过独立调节单极间距和偶极强度，作者发现体系可形成气体、极性群聚、链状、涡旋取向和锁定二聚体等多种集体相，为设计磁性活性物质和自组织微游泳体提供了可调控思路。

articles.title: Deposition and Growth of the AlCoCuFeNi High-Entropy Alloy Thin Film: Molecular Dynamics Simulation
articles.title_zh: AlCoCuFeNi高熵合金薄膜的沉积与生长：分子动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growth of a thin film of a high-entropy AlCoCuFeNi alloy on a silicon (100) substrate was studied using molecular dynamics modeling. The simulation was carried out using the embedded atom model to describe the interactions among Al, Co, Cu, Ni, and Fe atoms. The interaction between Al, Co, Cu, Fe, Ni atoms and the Si substrate was modeled using the Lennard-Jones potential, while the interaction between silicon atoms was described using the Stillinger-Weber potential. The total simulation time was 50 ns. It was found that small clusters were formed at the first stage of deposition and that crystallization started after approximately 5 ns of simulation, when the characteristic cluster size was about 2 nm. At the end of the simulation, after 50 ns of modeling, the simulated film contained face-centered cubic, body-centered cubic, hexagonal close-packed, and amorphous phases. Analysis of the radial distribution function made it possible to determine nearest-neighbor distances and estimate the lattice parameters of these phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用分子动力学模拟考察AlCoCuFeNi高熵合金薄膜在Si(100)衬底上的生长过程，并分别使用嵌入原子模型、Lennard-Jones势和Stillinger-Weber势描述不同原子间相互作用。结果显示，沉积初期形成小团簇，约5 ns后在特征团簇尺寸约2 nm时开始结晶。50 ns模拟结束时，薄膜中同时存在面心立方、体心立方、六方密排和非晶相，并通过径向分布函数估算了近邻距离和晶格参数。
authors: Oleksandr I. Kushnerov, Valerij F. Bashev, Sergey I. Ryabtsev

articles.title: Charge-state control of carbon-related optical absorption in AlN
articles.title_zh: AlN中碳相关光吸收的电荷态调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sub-bandgap optical absorption in AlN between 2 eV and 4 eV is widely observed, but its microscopic origin remains contested. Using photo-induced electron paramagnetic resonance (photo-EPR) and optical absorption spectroscopy on the same samples, we demonstrate a correlation between this absorption band and the neutral charge state of substitutional carbon on the nitrogen site (C_N). Hybrid functional calculations of the optical absorption spectra show that a transition involving C_N and the valence band occurs near 3.3 eV, which agrees well with a peak identified within the measured optical absorption between 2 eV and 4 eV. This conclusion requires the combined ability to manipulate the charge state of carbon using photo-EPR and to use first-principles calculations of the absorption line shape that account for the dispersion of the valence band and the energy dependence of the optical matrix elements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对AlN在2–4 eV范围内常见的亚带隙光吸收来源展开分析，结合光诱导电子顺磁共振和同一样品的光吸收谱，揭示该吸收带与氮位替代碳的中性电荷态相关。混合泛函计算表明，涉及C_N与价带的跃迁出现在约3.3 eV，与实验吸收峰吻合。研究强调，通过调控碳电荷态并进行包含价带色散和光学矩阵元能量依赖的第一性原理线形计算，才能明确该吸收机制。
authors: Helen C. Robinson, Daniil Danilin, Md Shafiqul Islam Mollik, Darshana Wickramaratne, John L. Lyons, Vladimir Fedorov, Sergey Mirov, M. E. Zvanut

articles.title: Enhanced electronic correlations and altermagnetic ground state of two-dimensional CsCr3Sb5 monolayers
articles.title_zh: 二维CsCr3Sb5单层中的增强电子关联与交替磁基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19740v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, layered corrected kagome metal CsCr3Sb5 have garnered significant attention attributed to its flat bands near the Fermi level (EF) and altermagnetic ground state [ Yi Liu et al., Nature 632, 1032 (2024)]. However, the van Hove singularities (vHSs) in bulk CsCr3Sb5 are far away from the EF, while an effective modulation of VHS toward the EF is essential for exploring intriguing electron transport properties. In this work, using first-principles calculations, we investigate electronic structures of two-dimensional (2D) Cr3Sb5 and CsCr3Sb5 monolayers which may be mechanically exfoliated from bulk materials. Notably, it is revealed that both flat bands and vHSs simultaneously reside in close proximity to the EF in Cr3Sb5 monolayer, signifying enhanced electronic correlations. Importantly, a tensile strain further shifts the incipient flat bands and vHSs of two monolayers simultaneously to the vicinity of the EF, suggesting strain tunable electronic correlations and concomitant quantum effects. Furthermore, altermagnetic ground state is also revealed due to retained mirror symmetry between two sublattices in these two monolayers. Thus, this work advances understanding and modulations of electronic properties of 2D CsCr3Sb5 monolayers, strengthening their great potential for exploring unconventional quantum phenomena and altermagnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作基于第一性原理计算研究可由块体剥离得到的二维Cr3Sb5和CsCr3Sb5单层的电子结构。结果表明，Cr3Sb5单层中的平带和范霍夫奇点同时接近费米能级，意味着增强的电子关联效应；拉伸应变还能进一步将两种单层中的平带和范霍夫奇点调至费米能级附近。研究还发现，由于两个子晶格之间保留镜面对称性，这些单层具有交替磁基态。
authors: Z. H. Guan, Z. L. Peng, W. Z. Zhuo, G. Tian, Z. P. Hou, D. Y. Chen, Z. Fan, X. B. Lu, X. S. Gao, M. H. Qin, J. M. Liu

articles.title: Boltzmann-constrained extraction of spin splitting and momentum relaxation in d-wave altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 玻尔兹曼约束下d波交替磁体中自旋劈裂与动量弛豫的提取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19785v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets exhibit spin-split electronic structure without requiring spin-orbit coupling, but transport measurements generally mix intrinsic spin splitting with extrinsic scattering. We examine this identifiability problem for a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet within a unified semiclassical framework spanning ballistic to diffusive transport. The spin-dependent Fermi-surface anisotropy produces a pronounced size effect, where vastly different longitudinal velocities cause the two spin channels to exhibit markedly different effective relaxation lengths within the same device geometry. However, the altermagnetic coupling α and the momentum relaxation time τ₀ strongly compensate each other in longitudinal conductance, creating a severe parameter degeneracy. To lift this degeneracy, we formulate a physics-informed neural network (PINN) to act as a differentiable Boltzmann solver that strictly enforces contact injection, local particle conservation, and global current continuity. Driven by sparse conductance spectra, this neural solver leverages the Fermi-level dependence of transport to unlock the coupled parameters simultaneously, achieving sub-percent accuracy even under moderate measurement noise. These results show that combining the Fermi-level dependence of transport with strict physical constraints provides a robust route to separating spin splitting from scattering in altermagnetic conductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论二维d波交替磁体输运测量中本征自旋劈裂与外在散射相互混合所导致的参数可辨识性问题，并在统一的半经典框架中覆盖弹道到扩散输运区间。作者指出，自旋相关费米面各向异性会产生明显尺寸效应，但交替磁耦合参数与动量弛豫时间在纵向电导中强烈补偿，导致严重参数简并。为解决该问题，研究构建物理约束神经网络作为可微玻尔兹曼求解器，通过稀疏电导谱和费米能级依赖性同时提取耦合参数。
authors: Y. X. Gao, Z. W. Fan, Q. S. Yao, Y. D. Ji, H. Geng

articles.title: MinSurf: resolving the atomic-scale stability landscape of mineral surfaces
articles.title_zh: MinSurf：解析矿物表面原子尺度稳定性图景
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mineral surfaces govern interfacial reactivity in carbon mineralization, geo-energy storage, contaminant immobilization, heterogeneous catalysis and electrochemical interface engineering. Yet atomistic simulations often rely on commonly used facets or facet-level stability criteria, while distinct atomic terminations of the same crystallographic orientation are rarely resolved systematically because experimental characterization and density functional theory (DFT) calculations remain costly across large surface spaces. Here we present MinSurf, a high-throughput framework that resolves mineral surface selection as a surface-energy and morphology problem. MinSurf integrates surface enumeration, DFT labelling, machine-learning interatomic potentials and Wulff construction to predict stable terminations, surface-energy landscapes and equilibrium crystal morphologies. Applied to ten representative minerals, MinSurfSet comprises 764 surface slabs, with 90 corresponding oriented unit cells constructed as bulk references for surface-energy evaluation. The resulting MinNEP model predicts DFT surface energies with a mean absolute error of 0.0119 eV per Angstrom squared and achieves an overall acceleration of 1.14 x 10⁴ relative to DFT. MinNEP preserves the DFT-derived morphology-determining surface-energy hierarchy and reproduces the dominant Wulff-exposed facets, while X-ray diffraction provides an independent crystallographic consistency check for alpha-quartz benchmark. By linking atomic terminations, surface energies and equilibrium morphologies, MinSurf provides reproducible and physically representative surface models for high-throughput simulations of mineral interfaces across energy, environmental and advanced inorganic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出MinSurf高通量框架，将表面枚举、DFT标注、机器学习原子间势和Wulff构型构建相结合，用于预测矿物稳定表面终止、表面能景观和平衡晶体形貌。作者将该框架应用于十种代表性矿物，构建了包含764个表面板层和90个取向晶胞参考结构的数据集。所得MinNEP模型能够以较低平均绝对误差预测DFT表面能，为大规模解析矿物表面稳定性提供了计算途径。
authors: Fengzijun Pan, Zhoulin Liu, Pingyang Zhang, Jiaqiu Xu, Zepeng Fan, Dawei Wang, Jianzhong Pei

articles.title: Creating and Driving a Twist Soliton on a Magnetic Skyrmion Tube
articles.title_zh: 在磁性斯格明子管上产生并驱动扭转孤子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A magnetic skyrmion tube is a three-dimensional topological soliton formed by stacking two-dimensional skyrmions along the out-of-plane direction. Recent real-space observations of skyrmion tubes have stimulated growing interest in their dynamics and emergent properties. Here, we go beyond simple skyrmion stacking and investigate how a ``twist" introduced along the tube direction affects the dynamics and emergent responses of skyrmion tubes. We find that such a twist can be created as a localized texture, termed a twist soliton, through thermal quench dynamics. By complementarily combining large-scale numerical simulations with analytical calculations based on collective coordinates, we clarify its current-driven nonlinear motions that depend on its twist chirality. Remarkably, its velocity can be substantially enhanced by a magnetic-field component perpendicular to the tube. Furthermore, the associated emergent electric field enables identification of the twist soliton, including the sign of its chirality, through Hall measurements. Our results reveal the twist degree of freedom as an essential ingredient of skyrmion-tube physics and pave the way for the development of spintronic devices exploiting the three-dimensional nature of spin textures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察在三维磁性斯格明子管沿管方向引入“扭转”后对其动力学和涌现响应的影响。通过大规模数值模拟与基于集体坐标的解析计算，作者发现热淬火动力学可产生局域扭转纹理，即扭转孤子，并揭示其电流驱动的非线性运动依赖于扭转手性。研究还表明，垂直于管方向的磁场分量可显著提高孤子速度，相关涌现电场可通过霍尔测量识别扭转孤子及其手性符号。
authors: Shoya Kasai, Kotaro Shimizu, Shun Okumura, Yukitoshi Motome

articles.title: Symmetry enforced quantum spin Hall effect in Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体中对称性强制的量子自旋霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum spin Hall effect (QSHE) has attracted widespread attention due to its dissipationless transport, which is protected by non-trivial topological invariants and helical edge states. Because even weak magnetic disorder can destroy the stability of topological quantum states, current research on the QSHE has primarily focused on non-magnetic materials. In this work, we extend the research scope of the QSHE to altermagnets. We establish the relevant symmetry constraints and identify all magnetic point groups that can realize the altermagnetic QSHE. Symmetry analysis reveals that pronounced spin-valley locking or spin-valley-layer locking universally exists in these systems. The concerted interaction between band inversion and spin-valley locking collectively gives rise to the helical edge states. Using first-principles calculations and theoretical models, we demonstrate that monolayer Nb2SeTeO exhibits an altermagnetic QSHE characterized by spin-valley locking, while bilayer Hf3Se3Te2 manifests an altermagnetic QSHE featuring spin-valley-layer locking. This work clarifies the intrinsic symmetry correlation between altermagnetism and quantum spin Hall topological phases, providing a brand-new theoretical perspective and research platform for exploring magnetic topological systems and developing next-generation spintronic devices
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将量子自旋霍尔效应的研究范围扩展到交替磁体，建立相关对称性约束并识别可实现交替磁量子自旋霍尔效应的磁点群。对称性分析表明，此类体系普遍存在显著的自旋-谷锁定或自旋-谷-层锁定，且能带反转与这些锁定效应共同导致螺旋边缘态。第一性原理和模型计算显示，单层Nb2SeTeO和双层Hf3Se3Te2分别可作为具有不同锁定特征的交替磁量子自旋霍尔候选体系。
authors: Fanzheng Chen, Lixin Zhang, Shuaishuai Niu, Junfeng Ren, Weijiang Gong, Xiangru Kong

articles.title: Shear-Induced Electrophoretic Migration Perpendicular to the Electric Field
articles.title_zh: 剪切诱导的垂直于电场方向的电泳迁移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments combining electrophoresis with pressure-driven flows in microchannels have revealed that microparticles undergo lateral migration perpendicular to the applied electric field. Although fluid inertia has been proposed as a possible explanation, inertial effects are negligibly small in these regimes, leaving the underlying physical mechanism an open question. In this study, we address these observations by extending previous theoretical work on concentration polarization,i.e., the external-field-induced modification of the ionic concentration field surrounding a dielectric object. We consider a dielectric particle with surface conductance subjected simultaneously to an external electric field and a shear flow. We show that the shear flow breaks the symmetry of the ionic concentration around the particle in the direction perpendicular to the applied field, thereby driving lateral migration. We demonstrate that the resulting migration velocity comprises two distinct contributions: an electrophoretic and a diffusiophoretic component. Our theory yields an explicit expression for the velocity magnitude as a function of the zeta potential and the Dukhin number, predicting typical speeds on the order of μm/s for representative experimental parameters. Notably, the model also predicts a reversal in the migration direction for Dukhin numbers of order unity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究解释了微通道中电泳与压驱流共同作用时微粒出现垂直于外加电场的横向迁移现象，并指出在相关实验条件下流体惯性很小，难以作为主要机制。作者扩展浓度极化理论，考虑具有表面电导的介电颗粒同时处于外电场和剪切流中。结果表明，剪切流破坏颗粒周围离子浓度场在垂直电场方向上的对称性，从而驱动横向迁移，其速度包含电泳和扩散泳两部分贡献。
authors: Andrés Rodríguez-Galán, Raúl Fernández-Mateo, Pablo García-Sánchez, Antonio Ramos

articles.title: Strain- and Electric-Field-Tunable Valley Polarization in Mo0.75V0.25Te2(Mo3VTe8) for Valleytronic Application
articles.title_zh: 面向谷电子学应用的Mo0.75V0.25Te2（Mo3VTe8）中应变与电场可调谷极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Valley polarization in 2D TMDs is promising for low-power valleytronic and spin-valley information processing, but time-reversal symmetry in pristine nonmagnetic TMDs keeps the K+ and K- valleys degenerate, limiting device applications. In this work, we investigated the structural stability, electronic properties, and tunable valley polarization of V-alloyed MoTe2 monolayer, Mo0.75V0.25Te2, using first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Substitutional alloying of MoTe2 with V introduced magnetic exchange interaction, which, together with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), lifted the valley degeneracy at the unequal valleys. The alloyed structure was found to be energetically and dynamically stable due to the absence of imaginary phonon modes. In pristine MoTe2, SOC produced spin splittings of 34.0 meV and 218.9 meV in the conduction bands and valence bands, respectively, but no valley polarization was observed. In contrast, Mo0.75V0.25Te2 exhibited spontaneous valley polarization of 37.3 meV in the conduction band and 78.2 meV in the valence band. The valley polarization was further enhanced by external electric fields and biaxial strain. A transverse electric field along the crystal c axis produced the maximum valley splitting of 132.8 meV in the valence band, whereas biaxial tensile strain increased the valence band valley splitting up to 160.8 meV. The maximum conduction band valley splitting reached 54.4 meV under 2% biaxial compressive strain. These results demonstrated that V alloying, combined with electric-field and strain engineering, provides an effective strategy for achieving large and tunable valley polarization in MoTe2. Thus, Mo0.75V0.25Te2 can be considered a promising 2D platform for tunable valleytronic device applications, such as transistors and sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用第一性原理DFT计算考察V合金化MoTe2单层Mo0.75V0.25Te2的结构稳定性、电子性质和可调谷极化。V替代引入磁交换作用，并与自旋轨道耦合共同打破不等价谷的简并；声子谱无虚频表明该结构具有动力学稳定性。相比原始MoTe2仅出现自旋劈裂而无谷极化，Mo0.75V0.25Te2表现出自发谷极化，且可通过外加电场进一步增强。
authors: Md. Mostaqul Islam, Vivek Chowdhury, Md. Nure-Alam-Dipu, Ahmed Zubair

articles.title: Interplay of Altermagnetism and Coupled Quasi-Altermagnetic states in Sliding Two-dimensional Square Lattice
articles.title_zh: 滑移二维方晶格中交替磁性与耦合准交替磁态的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19977v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of non-relativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in altermagnetic systems has introduced a new paradigm in antiferromagnets with vanishing net magnetization. Although sliding-induced valley-polarized phases have recently been demonstrated in two-dimensional altermagnets, the observed valley-polarized state represents only a partial manifestation of altermagnetism, and a comprehensive classification based on spinsplitting characteristics remains lacking. Here, using first-principles calculations, general stacking theory, and spin-Laue symmetry analysis, we propose a coupled quasialtermagnetic state representing a distinct subclass of altermagnetism, in which reversible type-IV NRSS is controlled through interlayer sliding. Accordingly, the sliding-induced phases are classified into two categories: altermagnetic and quasi-altermagnetic states. We establish a direct correspondence between reciprocal-space spin splitting and real-space switching between the two quasi-altermagnetic states. Importantly, the spin-polarized bands in these states remain spin split at Γ point even in the absence of spin-orbit coupling (SOC), distinguishing them within the proposed classification framework. To demonstrate the interplay between altermagnetic and quasi-altermagnetic states, we investigate the two-dimensional Lieb-lattice material Mn2WS4 and its Janus derivative Mn2WS2Se2, analysing how changes in the local environment influence the different magnetic phases. Importantly, the underlying mechanism is broadly applicable to a wide class of twodimensional square-lattice systems. We further investigate the effects of SOC, focusing on spin texture and transport signatures in coupled quasi-altermagnetic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕二维交替磁体中由层间滑移诱导的非相对论自旋劈裂展开，提出“耦合准交替磁态”作为交替磁性的一类新子类。作者结合第一性原理计算、通用堆垛理论和自旋Laue对称性分析，将滑移诱导相分为交替磁态和准交替磁态两类，并建立了倒空间自旋劈裂与实空间两种准交替磁态切换之间的对应关系。研究指出，这些态中的自旋极化能带即使在无自旋轨道耦合条件下也可在Γ点保持自旋劈裂。
authors: Bhautik R Dhori, Deepak Upadhyay, Prafulla K Jha

articles.title: Quantitative prediction of excitons in lattice-mismatched van der Waals heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 晶格失配范德华异质结构中激子的定量预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20039v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate modeling of dielectric screening in van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures is essential for predicting photonic and optoelectronic properties - yet conventional first-principles methods are often hindered by incommensurate lattices and prohibitive computational costs. In this work, we introduce the microscopic Quantum Electrostatic Heterostructure (mQEH) method. mQEH employs a hierarchical and systematically improvable basis set to describe potentials and induced densities, eliminating the need for arbitrary geometric cutoffs and ensuring accurate screening descriptions at all length scales. The mQEH method is combined with a layer projected Bethe-Salpeter Equation (BSE) to enable calculations of optical spectra of experimentally relevant lattice-mismatched vdW heterostructures. Applying the mQEH-BSE framework to a series of transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterobilayers, we obtain absorption spectra and momentum-indirect exciton energies in excellent agreement with experiment. The framework provides a computationally efficient route to predictive modeling and design of vdW heterostructures with tailored optical properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出微观量子静电异质结构方法（mQEH），用于在晶格失配的范德华异质结构中高效、准确描述介电屏蔽。该方法采用分层且可系统改进的基组表示势和诱导电荷密度，避免任意几何截断，并与层投影Bethe-Salpeter方程结合以计算实际异质结构的光谱。应用于一系列过渡金属二硫族化物异质双层时，该框架得到的吸收谱和动量间接激子能量与实验符合良好。
authors: Jakob Kjærulff Svaneborg, Mikkel Ohm Sauer, Amalie Helena Svaneborg, Kristian Sommer Thygesen

articles.title: Electrostatic effects in nano-reactor-confined charge regulated macroions
articles.title_zh: 纳米反应器限域电荷调节大离子中的静电效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a thermodynamic model of a nano-reactor containing charge-regulated macroions within an electrolyte-permeable enclosure. The model is then formalized within the Poisson-Boltzmann electrostatics augmented by the consistent inclusion of the charge dissociation of molecular groups residing on the surface of the entrapped macroions via charge regulation formalism. By solving the basic equilibrium equations in the linearized Debye-Hückel type approximation, we analyze the salient features of the inhomogeneous electrolyte distribution and macroion charge. We found that the surface charge asymmetry/symmetry of the macroions strongly affects the spatial profile of electrostatic potential. The effective screening length shows the non-monotonic behavior, arising from the complex interplay between the bathing external solution and macroion effective charges, which govern charge regulation equilibria. The total pressure at the nano-reactor enclosure boundary decreases monotonically as the enclosure radius and the ionic bulk salt concentration increase. Also, the resulting pressure is strongly influenced by the surface charge densities of the nano-reactor and the number of confined macroions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了含电荷调节大离子的纳米反应器热力学模型，并在Poisson-Boltzmann静电框架中一致纳入被困大离子表面分子基团的电荷解离。通过线性化Debye-Hückel近似求解平衡方程，作者分析了非均匀电解质分布和大离子电荷的主要特征。结果表明，表面电荷对称性显著影响静电势空间分布，有效屏蔽长度呈非单调行为；纳米反应器边界总压力随封闭半径和体相盐浓度增大而单调降低，并受表面电荷密度强烈影响。
authors: Manit Klawtanong, Petch Khunpetch, Huaqiong Li, Shigeyuki Komura

articles.title: Terahertz frequency upconversion by coherently driving charge dynamics in the InSb/CdTe heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 通过相干驱动 InSb/CdTe 异质结构中的电荷动力学实现太赫兹频率上转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate terahertz (THz) harmonic generation in the InSb/CdTe heterostructure, demonstrating, for the first time, efficient in-plane magnetic field-induced second-harmonic generation (SHG). We also achieve significant third-harmonic generation (THG), rivalling Dirac materials such as graphene and Cd3As2. Our theoretical analysis identifies the primary SHG mechanism as the orbital-Zeeman correction to Drude conductivity, while the dominant THG contribution also shows Drude-like behavior. The results provide a general route to efficient THz harmonic generation in high mobility materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了 InSb/CdTe 异质结构中的太赫兹谐波产生，首次展示了由面内磁场诱导的高效二次谐波产生，并实现了显著的三次谐波产生，其强度可与石墨烯和 Cd3As2 等狄拉克材料相媲美。理论分析表明，二次谐波的主要机制是 Drude 电导率中的轨道-塞曼修正，而三次谐波的主导贡献也表现出类 Drude 行为。结果为在高迁移率材料中实现高效太赫兹谐波产生提供了通用路径。
authors: Pai Peng, Mingxiang Pan, Jiuming Liu, Yi Yang, Lei Wang, Hao Lin, Zehao Hu, Jianlin Luo, Tao Dong, Xufeng Kou, Xinbo Wang, Huaqing Huang, Luyi Yang

articles.title: Hartree-Fock Limit for Energies in Solids
articles.title_zh: 固体能量的 Hartree-Fock 极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study establishes a route to the Hartree--Fock (HF) limit for molecules and solids within the linearized augmented plane wave (LAPW) framework. We remove current limitations of the standard LAPW approach to nonlocal exchange by constructing radial basis functions and core orbitals consistently with the HF Hamiltonian. The presented method yields total energies of molecules and solids with a precision of a few μHa, and we use it to provide reference data for 14 semiconductors and insulators. For the systems considered in this study, the standard approach based on (semi)local potentials for constructing radial basis functions and core orbitals remains highly precise for practical relative energies, including molecular and solid-state formation energies and Si self-interstitial defect formation energies. More broadly, the results provide stringent all-electron benchmarks for basis-set and pseudopotential assessment, improve error control in hybrid-functional calculations within LAPW, and open the way to X-ray spectroscopy simulations within LAPW based directly on hybrid-functional core orbitals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在线性缀加平面波框架内建立了分子与固体达到 Hartree-Fock 极限的一条途径。作者通过以 Hartree-Fock 哈密顿量一致构造径向基函数和芯态轨道，克服了标准 LAPW 方法处理非局域交换时的限制，并获得微哈特里量级精度的总能量。研究还为 14 种半导体和绝缘体提供了参考数据，可用于全电子基组、赝势和混合泛函计算的严格基准评估。

articles.title: Direct Observation of Channelised Supercurrents in a Kagome Superconductor
articles.title_zh: Kagome 超导体中通道化超电流的直接观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductors are many-body quantum states in which current flows without dissipation. Theory predicts that supercurrents follow a relatively simple spatial pattern in both conventional and unconventional superconductors. Recent studies into the AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, K, Rb) family of Kagome superconductors indicate that CsV3Sb5 has unconventional transport properties that cannot be accounted for with these simple theories, including reports of intrinsic Josephson junctions, higher order Cooper pairing and the zero field diode effect. Attempts to interpret these findings have focused on the interplay of superconductivity with the unconventional charge density wave (CDW) order in these materials, with which superconductivity competes. A current roadblock to understanding how these kagome superconductors give rise to their intriguing properties is the lack of spatially resolved information about transport. Here we show, using a recently developed superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) microscope, that flakes of CsV3Sb5-xSnx host a network of narrow supercurrent channels. These supercurrent channels emerge at the critical temperature and remain stable for all temperatures and currents. Their non-linear behaviour is consistent with a network of Josephson junctions linked by narrow supercurrent filaments, which naturally leads to the observed transport anomalies. Intriguingly, these observations are much weaker in undoped samples, which suggests links to the physics of charge density waves, disorder, and electronic correlations, all of which are greatly influenced by the doping strength. These results establish new frontiers for the local investigation of charge transport and competing orders in strongly correlated electron systems, and shine a new light on the anomalous transport properties of the AV3Sb5 kagome superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用新近发展的扫描 SQUID 显微镜，对 Kagome 超导体 CsV3Sb5-xSnx 薄片中的超电流空间分布进行了直接成像。结果显示样品中存在由狭窄超电流通道构成的网络，这为理解 AV3Sb5 家族中异常输运、内禀约瑟夫森结、高阶 Cooper 配对和零场二极管效应等现象提供了关键的空间分辨信息。研究强调超导性与非常规电荷密度波序之间的相互作用可能是这些通道化输运行为的重要背景。
authors: Matthijs Rog, Tycho J. Blom, Reinier Q. Regter, Andrea Capa Salinas, Dalal Benali, Jinwon Lee, Daan B. Boltje, Mark H. Fischer, Titus Neupert, Stephen D. Wilson, Milan P. Allan, Kaveh Lahabi

articles.title: Electric-field-driven magnetic switching and tightly bound interlayer excitons in bilayer CrSBr
articles.title_zh: 双层 CrSBr 中电场驱动的磁开关与紧束缚层间激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric field control of magnetic order in two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals magnets is a central goal for low-power spin-based technologies. In the ambient-stable antiferromagnet CrSBr, strong magnetic anisotropy and robust exciton-spin coupling provide a favorable platform, yet deterministic electric field control of its magnetic phases has not been achieved. Here we demonstrate electric-field-driven reversible switching between antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic states in dual-gated bilayer CrSBr without intentional carrier doping. In parallel, photoluminescence measurements resolve a tightly bound interlayer exciton with an intrinsic dipole moment of only ~1 e angstrom. The electric field dependence of the magnetic phase transition reveals two coexisting mechanisms: a linear magnetoelectric effect in the antiferromagnetic state and an electric-field-modulated interlayer exchange coupling. Their interplay accounts for the asymmetric evolution of the critical magnetic field. Our results establish bilayer CrSBr as a promising 2D material for electrically controlled spin-optoelectronic functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在双栅控双层 CrSBr 中实现了无有意载流子掺杂条件下反铁磁态与铁磁态之间的电场可逆切换。光致发光测量同时分辨出具有约 1 e·Å 本征偶极矩的紧束缚层间激子。磁相变随电场的变化揭示了反铁磁态中的线性磁电效应与电场调制的层间交换耦合两种机制共存，为电控二维自旋-光电子功能奠定了材料基础。
authors: Xiubin Li, Yu Sun, Xuanji Wang, Chunyan Wang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Sheng Liu, Ting Yu, Liang Li, Tao Zhang, Jing Li

articles.title: Transient triplet blockade in Andreev junction
articles.title_zh: Andreev 结中的瞬态三重态阻塞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the time-dependent triplet configuration, appearing under nonequilibrium conditions in a nanoscopic junction with two quantum dots coupled in series between superconductor and normal metallic lead. We show that in the situation, when both quantum dots are singly occupied by identical spin electrons, the on-dot electron pairing is suppressed what substantially affects the subgap charge transport. We investigate processes in which such configuration can be temporarily encountered, either due to the initial conditions or by imposing the external magnetic field. Our analytical and numerical calculations provide estimations for the temporal scales, characterizing evolution of the triplet configuration which could be manifested in the time-resolved tunneling measurements. Such nonequilibrium features of the triplet configuration might be relevant to operations on superconducting qubits, in their conventional and/or topological realizations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了由两个串联量子点连接超导体与正常金属电极构成的纳米结中，非平衡条件下出现的时间依赖三重态构型。当两个量子点均被相同自旋电子单占据时，点内电子配对被抑制，从而显著影响亚能隙电荷输运。作者分析了由初始条件或外加磁场诱发的瞬态过程，并估算了三重态构型演化的时间尺度，这些特征有望在时间分辨隧穿测量中观测到。
authors: R. Taranko, J. Baranski, A. Jankiewicz, K. Wrzesniewski, I. Weymann, T. Domanski

articles.title: Large spin splitting at ferromagnetic surfaces of bulk antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 体反铁磁体铁磁表面上的大自旋劈裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20178v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use density functional theory and model Hamiltonians to reveal large spin splitting of bands localized at low-symmetry, ferromagnetic surfaces of bulk antiferromagnets (AFMs). There is great interest in finding new material platforms combining the robustness and ultrafast dynamics of AFMs with large, functional spin splitting which is often restricted to ferromagnets. Here, we show that a subset of AFM surfaces which have symmetry-allowed magnetization can host large spin splitting via bulk degeneracy lifting of sublattice-resolved exchange splittings. Using model Hamiltonians, we show that the spin splitting is maximized for two ferromagnetic surface motifs: terminations with single uncompensated magnetic sublattices, and two-sublattice surfaces whose sublattices are magnetically and electronically compensated in the bulk, but acquire distinct crystal field environments via surface truncation. The latter case can yield FM-like spin splitting magnitudes while also having vanishingly small uncompensated magnetization. In contrast, when surface magnetization arises from relativistic canting on symmetry-connected sublattices, the spin splitting is expected to be small.
