articles.title_zh: 用于高效可扩展数据同化的流匹配方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.13313v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Data assimilation (DA) estimates a dynamical system's state from noisy observations. Recent generative models like the ensemble score filter (EnSF) improve DA in high-dimensional nonlinear settings but are computationally expensive. We introduce the ensemble flow filter (EnFF), a training-free, flow matching (FM)-based framework that accelerates sampling and offers flexibility in flow design. EnFF uses Monte Carlo estimators for the marginal flow field, localized guidance for observation assimilation, and utilizes a novel flow path that exploits the Bayesian DA formulation. It generalizes classical filters such as the bootstrap particle filter and ensemble Kalman filter. Experiments on high-dimensional benchmarks demonstrate EnFF's improved cost-accuracy tradeoffs and scalability, highlighting FM's potential for efficient, scalable DA. Code is available at https://github.com/Utah-Math-Data-Science/Data-Assimilation-Flow-Matching.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出集合流滤波器 EnFF，一种无需训练、基于流匹配的数据同化框架，用于从噪声观测中估计动力系统状态。EnFF 使用边缘流场的蒙特卡罗估计、局部化观测引导，并设计了利用贝叶斯数据同化结构的新型流路径。该方法可推广若干经典滤波器，并在高维基准实验中展示了更优的成本—精度权衡和可扩展性。
authors: Taos Transue, Bohan Chen, So Takao, Bao Wang

articles.title: eCNNTO: A Highly Generalizable ConvNet for Accelerating Topology Optimization
articles.title_zh: eCNNTO：一种用于加速拓扑优化的高泛化卷积神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work proposes an element-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to accelerate density-based Topology Optimization (TO), termed eCNNTO. TO generally undergoes a large number of iterations, where finite element analysis is performed in every iteration, leading to the efficiency bottleneck especially when dense meshes are used to achieve high-resolution designs. To address this limitation, eCNNTO is proposed to build upon Kallioras et al. (2020), where a Deep Belief Network (DBN) was trained for every element to predict its near-optimal density from its early history, thereby skipping the great majority of iterations and significantly accelerating the TO procedure. However, the method lacks spatial correlations among neighboring elements and may lead to disconnected features in the final structure. The proposed method employs CNN with residual connections to address this issue. On top of it, a novel training strategy is introduced to further enhance the optimization efficiency, where the training dataset consists of the final stage density histories rather than early ones. This change can also help reduce the required training data size. eCNNTO requires only a small dataset to train and yet it can be generalized to problems with largely different boundary conditions, loading cases, design domain geometries, mesh resolutions, as well as non-design domains. In the end, the generalization capabilities and efficiency of eCNNTO are demonstrated through a variety of examples in two and three dimensions, achieving up to 90% and 97% reduction of iterations, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出基于单元的卷积神经网络 eCNNTO，用于加速密度型拓扑优化过程。传统拓扑优化每轮迭代都需有限元分析，在高分辨率网格下计算成本很高；既有逐单元深度置信网络方法虽能提前预测近优密度，但缺乏相邻单元间的空间相关性，可能导致结构不连通。eCNNTO 通过带残差连接的 CNN 引入空间相关建模，并采用基于最终阶段密度历史的训练策略，以提升优化效率并减少训练数据需求。

articles.title: The Tao of Agency: Autotelic AI, Embedded Agency and Dissolution of the Self
articles.title_zh: 能动性之道：自成目的人工智能、嵌入式能动性与自我的消解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most artificial intelligence systems are built on the assumption that goals are exogenous and specified by the designer. Exploring what happens when an agent begins generating its own goals opens the field of autotelic AI. Agents are expected not merely to pursue objectives but to discover them. In this article, we trace its consequences through intrinsic motivation, resource-driven priors, causal-interventional learning, homeostasis, and embeddedness; the last of which is found to be a necessary but not sufficient condition for autotelic agency. Embeddedness individuates the agent at the cost of revealing that the individuation is non-unique, such that the same dynamics admit many valid partitions, each defining a different candidate self. The deepest problem with autotelic AI is therefore not how the agent generates goals, but how it generates and relativizes the self to which the goals are assigned. The agent must believe in its own boundary in order to act, and see through that boundary in order to understand. We consolidate these developments into a single framework and extend it along three directions: a quantum formulation in which the agent-environment cut becomes physical, a philosophical reading against non-dual contemplative traditions, and a concrete LLM-based agentic instantiation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文章讨论自成目的人工智能，即智能体不只是执行设计者给定目标，而是能够生成或发现自身目标。作者从内在动机、资源驱动先验、因果干预学习、稳态调节和嵌入性等角度分析其理论后果，并指出嵌入性虽是自成目的能动性的必要条件，但并不足以唯一界定智能体自身。文章的核心观点是，自成目的 AI 的深层问题不仅在于如何生成目标，更在于如何生成并相对化承载这些目标的“自我”边界。

articles.title: Modularity-Free Conflict-Averse Training for Generalized PINNs
articles.title_zh: 面向广义物理信息神经网络的无模块化冲突规避训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have become a powerful framework for solving PDEs by embedding physical laws into differentiable objectives. Despite their advances, training PINNs remains fragile: recent conflict-averse optimization schemes alleviate gradient interference between residual and boundary losses, but we show that their effectiveness deteriorates as model capacity increases. In this paper, we identify a capacity-induced failure mode, where overparameterized networks undergo functional modularity, self-partitioning into task-exclusive modules that suppress cross-objective interaction and hinder convergence toward Pareto-stationary points. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework, Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync), which integrates structural optimization into conflict-averse training by penalizing task-exclusive connections while preserving interaction-promoting pathways. Extensive experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks demonstrate that ModSync consistently prevents capacity-driven failures, sustains robust cross-objective coupling, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. Codes are available at r̆lhttps://github.com/heejokong/ModSync.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注物理信息神经网络在求解偏微分方程时的训练不稳定问题，尤其是残差损失与边界损失之间的梯度冲突。作者指出，现有冲突规避优化方法在模型容量增大时效果会下降，原因是过参数化网络可能出现功能模块化，自发分化为任务专属模块，从而削弱多目标交互。为此，论文提出 Modular-Sparsity Synchronization 框架，通过惩罚任务专属连接并保留促进交互的路径来防止容量诱发失效，并在多类 PDE 基准上取得更稳健的精度表现。
authors: Heejo Kong, Beomchul Park, Sung-Jin Kim, Seong-Whan Lee

articles.title: Exposing the Unsaid: Visualizing Hidden LLM Bias through Stochastic Path Aggregation
articles.title_zh: 揭示未言之物：通过随机路径聚合可视化大语言模型隐藏偏见
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19344v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit representational and syntactic biases that are difficult to evaluate due to the stochastic nature of text generation. Standard auditing methods rely on a single output inspection or static automated metrics. These approaches obscure the underlying probability distributions and fail to capture biases hidden in lower-probability generation branches. This paper introduces TreeTracer, a visual analytics tool designed to evaluate LLM bias through aggregated comparison. Using a systematic perturbation analysis pipeline, the tool replaces ontology-defined terms in each input prompt, aggregates hundreds of stochastic generations into a syntax-aligned hierarchical structure, and then performs classification-aware node merging with an auxiliary language model. The resulting structure is visualized through a custom Sankey diagram. By juxtaposing two ontology-driven trees, the workspace enables direct comparison between semantic contexts and supports systematic bias detection. Because any visualization reflects only a subset of the model's learned behavior, the system further applies contrastive inference to compute and directly display counterfactual token probabilities across contexts, reducing the risk of misinterpreting the presence of bias. We validate the workspace through case studies comparing an unaligned baseline model GPT-2 XL against the constitutionally aligned Apertus models. The visual aggregation successfully exposes hidden representational harms, such as counterfactual pronoun suppression and conversational marginalization of individuals. A preliminary user study confirms that the aggregated comparative interface reduces cognitive load and effectively supports analysts in detecting systemic biases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 TreeTracer，一种用于分析大语言模型偏见的可视分析工具，旨在捕捉单次输出检查或静态指标难以发现的低概率生成分支中的偏见。该工具通过系统性扰动输入提示中的本体术语，聚合大量随机生成结果，并构建语法对齐的层级结构，再借助辅助语言模型进行分类感知的节点合并。最终结果以定制的桑基图呈现，使用户能够并列比较不同语义语境下的生成路径，从而支持更系统的偏见检测。
authors: Matteo Pelossi, Rita Sevastjanova, Thilo Spinner, Mennatallah El-Assady

articles.title: A Tool for the Synthesis of Adaptive Probabilistic Processors Based on the Ising Model
articles.title_zh: 一种基于伊辛模型的自适应概率处理器综合工具
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work presents a tool for the synthesis and simulation of probabilistic architectures for solving combinatorial optimization problems by mapping them to the Ising model. The proposed approach automatically constructs the Ising Hamiltonian and determines the number of probabilistic elements (p-bits) based on problem characteristics such as size and topology. Furthermore, the tool introduces an adaptive strategy for selecting the most suitable update algorithm among Gibbs Sampling, Simulated Annealing (SA), Simulated Quantum Annealing (SQA), and cluster-based methods. Experimental results using benchmark problems demonstrate improved convergence behavior and flexibility compared to fixed approaches. The proposed framework enables systematic evaluation of probabilistic computing strategies and supports the development of future hardware implementations based on MTJs and p-bits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种用于综合和仿真概率计算架构的工具，可将组合优化问题映射到伊辛模型。该工具能够根据问题规模、拓扑等特征自动构建伊辛哈密顿量并确定所需概率比特数量。它还引入自适应策略，在 Gibbs 采样、模拟退火、模拟量子退火和基于簇的方法之间选择合适的更新算法；基准实验显示其相较固定策略具有更好的收敛行为和灵活性。
authors: Jonathan Juracy Carneiro da Silva, Leonardo R. Gobatto, Jose Rodrigo Azambuja

articles.title: Review of Machine Learning Models for Solar Energetic Particle Prediction
articles.title_zh: 太阳高能粒子预测机器学习模型综述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19539v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Solar energetic particle (SEP) events have attracted increasing attention due to their significant radiation hazards for aviation, spacecraft electronics, and human missions beyond Earth's magnetosphere. From a scientific perspective, SEP events are intriguing because they arise from a set of physical processes extending from the solar surface and corona through the heliosphere, offering insight into particle acceleration and transport mechanisms that are widely applicable across astrophysics. Therefore, advancing our ability to understand and predict SEP events is essential both for deepening our knowledge of such mechanisms and for safeguarding space technologies and exploration. Traditionally, researchers have modeled SEPs using physics-based simulations and empirical methods. More recently, machine learning (ML) has emerged as a new tool for understanding and predicting SEP events. The purpose of this manuscript is to review the currently available ML models for SEP prediction, identify the datasets used for training, compare their architectures, inputs, and outputs, and, based on these insights, outline good practices and recommendations for future research.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述聚焦太阳高能粒子事件的机器学习预测模型，这类事件对航空、航天器电子设备以及地球磁层外载人任务具有重要辐射风险。文章概述了 SEP 事件的科学背景和传统物理、经验建模方法，并梳理近年来机器学习在 SEP 理解与预测中的应用。其目标是比较现有模型所用数据集、模型架构、输入与输出设置，并据此总结实践建议和未来研究方向。
authors: Spiridon Kasapis, Pouya Hosseinzadeh, Kathryn Whitman, Ricky Egeland, Manolis Georgoulis, Angelos Vourlidas, Athanasios Papaioannou, Eleni Lavasa, Anastasios Anastasiadis, Giorgos Giannopoulos, Andres Munoz-Jaramillo, Bala Poduval, Irina N. articles.title: Beyond Static Endpoints: Tool Programs as an Interface for Flexible Agentic Web Services
articles.title_zh: 超越静态端点：作为灵活智能体式网络服务接口的工具程序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19992v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In the agentic web era, LLM-based agents increasingly invoke web services as tools, yet most interfaces remain emphstatic endpoints that poorly express long-horizon workflows with loops, conditionals, joins, and retries. We present ToolPro, which represents an agent's tool intent as an emphexecutable tool program that compactly encodes multi-step service interactions with explicit effect types. ToolPro combines constraint-guided program construction, effect-aware replay for exactly-once state-modifying calls, and a profile-driven policy that decides when program execution outperforms stepwise calling. We instantiate ToolPro over MCP-style services with WebAssembly sandboxing and evaluate it on diverse workflows of real-world applications. ToolPro reduces end-to-end latency by up to 53.4% and client-side traffic by up to 96.1%, with larger gains under higher network latency and workflow complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ToolPro，将智能体的工具调用意图表示为可执行的“工具程序”，用于表达包含循环、条件、汇合与重试的多步骤网络服务工作流。该方法结合约束引导的程序构建、面向效应类型的重放机制以及基于画像的执行策略，并在 MCP 风格服务与 WebAssembly 沙箱中实现。实验表明，ToolPro 可显著降低端到端延迟和客户端流量，尤其在网络延迟更高、工作流更复杂时收益更明显。
authors: Mugeng Liu, Shuoqi Li, Yixuan Zhang, Yun Ma

articles.title: Institutional Readiness and Governance Alignment: A Readiness Spine and Adaptive Loop for Sustaining Organisational Change in Developing Contexts
articles.title_zh: 制度准备度与治理协同：发展中情境下维持组织变革的准备度主干与自适应循环
articles.abstract: Purpose This paper develops the Readiness Spine and Adaptive Readiness Loop (ARL) to explain how institutional readiness supports sustained organisational alignment and change.Design/methodology/approach: The study employs theory building grounded in longitudinal action research and integrative synthesis of governance, institutional, organisational learning, and adaptive governance scholarship.Findings: Institutional readiness emerges through alignment among intent, capability, evidence, and authority, sustained through recurring cycles of variance detection and recalibration.Originality/value: The paper reconceptualises readiness as an emergent governance condition and introduces the Readiness Spine and ARL as complementary explanations of sustained organisational effectiveness.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出“准备度主干”和“自适应准备度循环”框架，用以解释制度准备度如何支撑组织持续协同与变革。研究基于纵向行动研究和对治理、制度、组织学习及适应性治理文献的综合理论建构。文章认为，制度准备度源于意图、能力、证据和权威之间的协同，并通过反复识别偏差与重新校准得以维持。

articles.title: Physical modelling composite magnetic fabrics using Big Coil Anisotropy meter and standard-sized palaeomagnetic specimens
articles.title_zh: 利用大线圈各向异性仪和标准古地磁样品对复合磁组构进行物理建模
articles.abstract: Magnetic fabric of rocks is often composite, i.e. consisting of two or more subfabrics either carried by different minerals or being oriented differently. To better understand the nature of such fabrics, composite magnetic fabric was modelled through simultaneous measurement of two specimens possessing different magnetic fabrics. Both the specimens were also measured separately, and the theoretical composite magnetic fabric was calculated from these separate measurements. Both in-phase and out-of-phase components of susceptibility were investigated. The experimental and theoretical AMS tensors are very similar differing only by measuring errors. We can conclude that using the technique volume weighted summing of susceptibility tensors in modelling composite magnetic fabric is fully justified not only for in-phase component, for which it was made many times by various authors in the past, but also for out-of-phase component, for which it is new. This approach can also be used in modelling magnetic fabric development during various geological processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过同时测量具有不同磁组构的两个样品来模拟岩石中的复合磁组构，并将实验结果与由单独测量张量加权求和得到的理论结果进行比较。研究同时考察了磁化率的同相与异相分量，发现实验与理论 AMS 张量高度一致，差异主要来自测量误差。结果表明，按体积加权叠加磁化率张量的方法不仅适用于同相分量，也可用于异相分量，并可用于模拟地质过程中磁组构的演化。

articles.title: Quantum Generative Intelligence for rare-event anomaly discovery under severe data scarcity: Applications to Glacier Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Risk Reduction
articles.title_zh: 严重数据稀缺条件下用于稀有事件异常发现的量子生成智能：在冰湖溃决洪水风险降低中的应用
articles.abstract: Glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs) are destructive cryosphere-related hazards shaped by nonlinear interactions among hydroclimatic forcing, glacier morphology, lake evolution, and geomorphological instability. Reliable precursor screening remains difficult because documented GLOF events are sparse, triggering mechanisms are heterogeneous, and pre-event hydroclimatic signals may appear as subtle changes in temporal organization rather than simple amplitude extremes. This study proposes a hybrid quantum-classical framework for rare hydroclimatic anomaly screening that integrates conditional multivariate sequence generation, quantum expectation-based latent anomaly scoring, and supervised rare-event classification. Hydroclimatic dynamics are modeled using conditional Wasserstein generative adversarial networks with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP), temporal convolutional sequence learning, and latent representations derived from parameterized quantum-circuit expectation values. Compared with Gaussian and sign latent baselines under identical WGAN-GP settings, the quantum latent formulation achieved lower errors in cross-feature correlation, Wasserstein distance, Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic, autocorrelation distance, and power spectral density distance in the present experimental setting. The anomaly-scoring module further identified cross-variable temporal correlation mismatch and autocorrelation deviation as precursor-relevant signals. Because the number of positive GLOF samples is limited, the supervised outputs are interpreted as high-recall anomaly-screening and ranking indicators rather than deterministic forecasts of GLOF occurrence. Explainability and ablation analyses indicate that quantum-derived temporal anomaly representations were more discriminative than compact hydroclimatic and static descriptors within the evaluated models. These results suggest that quantum expectation-based latent representations can improve hydroclimatic sequence realism and support rare-event anomaly prioritization for GLOF risk reduction under severe data imbalance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对冰湖溃决洪水事件稀少、触发机制复杂且前兆信号隐蔽的问题，提出一种量子—经典混合的罕见水文气候异常筛查框架。该框架结合条件多变量序列生成、基于量子期望值的潜在异常评分和监督式稀有事件分类，并使用 WGAN-GP、时间卷积序列学习和参数化量子线路表示水文气候动态。摘要显示，相较若干基线潜在表示，量子潜在形式在相关结构和分布度量等方面表现更优，但完整结果需参阅原文。

articles.title: HKUST-1@Co(OH)₂@rGO Nanocomposite as a High-Performance Electrode for Hybrid Supercapacitor and HER Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于混合超级电容器和析氢反应的高性能 HKUST-1@Co(OH)₂@rGO 纳米复合电极
articles.abstract: This research focuses on the invention of the HKUST@Co(OH)₂@rGO nanocomposite, which was successfully fabricated through a facile hydrothermal-assisted growth approach. The HKUST framework focused on the uniform integration of Co(OH)2 nanosheets onto conductive rGO sheets. The synergistic integration of porous HKUST and rGO significantly enhances conductivity and electrochemical performance compared with Co(OH)2, creating numerous redox-active sites and effective charge transport, resulting in an improved specific capacity (Qs) of 2640.35 C g⁻¹. For an asymmetric supercapacitor, the nanocomposite exhibited a high specific capacity of 463.22 C g⁻¹ at 1 A g⁻¹, attaining an energy density of 45.35 Wh kg⁻¹ at a power density of 2775.65 W kg⁻¹, while maintaining 97% capacitance over 10,000 charging/discharging cycles, confirming exceptional reliability. Except for energy storage, the material displayed notable hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) activity (overpotential of 46 mV), characterized by stable performance, reproducibility, and durable current response. These outcomes emphasize the dual potential of HKUST@Co(OH)₂@rGO composite as a multifunctional platform for next-generation supercapacitors and sustainable electrocatalysts, contributing a practicable pathway toward scalable energy and hydrogen technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过简便的水热辅助生长方法制备了 HKUST@Co(OH)₂@rGO 纳米复合材料，实现了 Co(OH)₂ 纳米片在导电 rGO 片上的均匀集成。多孔 HKUST 与 rGO 的协同作用提升了导电性、氧化还原活性位点数量和电荷传输性能，使材料在非对称超级电容器中表现出高比容量、较高能量密度和优异循环稳定性。该复合材料还表现出良好的析氢反应活性和耐久性，显示出面向储能与电催化的双功能应用潜力。

articles.title: Comparative Evaluation of Cytotoxicity of Zno-eugenol, Calcium Hydroxide, Resin and Bioceramic Endodontic Sealers After the Incorporation of Magnetic Nanoparticle- an in Vitro Study
articles.title_zh: 掺入磁性纳米颗粒后氧化锌丁香酚、氢氧化钙、树脂和生物陶瓷根管封闭剂细胞毒性的比较评价：一项体外研究
articles.abstract: Aim To evaluate and compare the cytotoxicity of four endodontic sealers epoxy resin-based (AH Plus), calcium hydroxide-based, zinc oxide-eugenol (ZOE)-based, and bioceramic, following the incorporation of magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs), using dental pulp stem cells (DPSCs) as the biological model.Methodology: 36 specimens were prepared and divided into four groups (n = 9 per group), each representing one sealer formulation modified with MNPs. Specimens were set in standardised cylindrical moulds (5 mm × 5 mm) at 37°C under 95% relative humidity for 48 hours, followed by UV sterilisation. DPSCs were seeded in 96-well plates at 10,000 cells/well and exposed to the respective sealer groups for 48 hours. Cytotoxicity was quantified using the MTT assay, with absorbance measured at 570 nm. Cellular morphology and adherence were assessed by phase-contrast microscopy. Data were analysed using one-way ANOVA with Tukey's post-hoc test (p < 0.05).Results The bioceramic sealer demonstrated the highest mean percentage cell viability among all experimental groups. A statistically significant difference in cell viability was observed between the AH Plus and bioceramic groups (mean difference: −428.1; 95% CI: −833.5 to − 22.65; p = 0.034). No statistically significant differences were identified among the remaining pairwise comparisons.Conclusion Within the limitations of this in vitro study, the bioceramic sealer incorporated with MNPs demonstrated superior biocompatibility compared to the epoxy resin-based sealer. All tested formulations exhibited acceptable cytotoxicity profiles relative to the control. Further in vivo investigations are warranted to validate these findings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究以牙髓干细胞为模型，比较四类掺入磁性纳米颗粒的根管封闭剂的细胞毒性，包括环氧树脂基、氢氧化钙基、氧化锌丁香酚基和生物陶瓷封闭剂。研究通过标准化试样制备、细胞暴露、MTT 检测及显微形态观察评估细胞活性和黏附情况，并采用方差分析进行统计比较。摘要显示，生物陶瓷封闭剂具有最高的平均细胞存活率，且与 AH Plus 组之间存在显著差异。

articles.title: Radical Cations vs Cations: A Comparative Study of Retinyl Cation and Retinol Radical Cation
articles.title_zh: 自由基阳离子与阳离子：视黄基阳离子和视黄醇自由基阳离子的比较研究
articles.abstract: The reactivity of cationic and radical cationic intermediates has been extensively studied using both theoretical and experimental approaches. In the present study, the structurally related retinyl cation (Ret+) and retinol radical cation (retinol•+) were employed as models to compare the intrinsic reactivities of cations and radical cations within a common structural framework. Using laser flash photolysis (LFP) technique, these intermediates (λmax = 580–590 nm) were generated and their reactivities toward a variety of substrates were examined, including substrates undergoing exclusively electron-transfer reactions (e.g., ABTS2− and vitamin E), nucleophilic addition (e.g., Cl− and Br− anions), deprotonation (e.g., DBU), and multiple concurrent pathways (e.g., phenols, and aniline derivatives). Our results showed that all tested substrates reacted more rapidly with retinol•+ than with Ret+, with rate enhancements of up to 3–4 orders of magnitude for substrates such as ABTS2−, vitamin E, and certain phenols. For example, in methanol, the rate constants for the reactions of retinol•+ and Ret+ with ABTS2− were < 4.4×107 and 2.14×1010 M− 1 s− 1, respectively. The enhanced reactivity of retinol•+ was attributed to its higher reduction potential, which enabled an additional electron-transfer pathway alongside the nucleophilic addition and deprotonation pathways. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations further supported the greater electron affinity of retinol•+ relative to Ret+. Overall, the present findings indicated that radical cations generally exhibit higher reactivity than their corresponding cations. Finally, the potential photocytotoxicity of retinoids, which are widely used in cosmetic formulations, is discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以结构相关的视黄基阳离子和视黄醇自由基阳离子为模型，在共同结构框架下比较阳离子与自由基阳离子的内在反应性。研究利用激光闪光光解生成中间体，并考察其与电子转移底物、亲核试剂、碱以及可能发生多路径反应的酚类和苯胺衍生物的反应。结果表明，测试底物普遍与视黄醇自由基阳离子反应更快，部分快速反应的速率提升可达数个数量级，说明自由基阳离子具有显著增强的反应活性。

articles.title: Conjugated Ferrocenes: Structure–Redox–Activity Relationships from Synthesis, Electrochemical, Computational, and Biological Studies
articles.title_zh: 共轭二茂铁：来自合成、电化学、计算和生物学研究的结构—氧化还原—活性关系
articles.abstract: The synthesis and characterization of conjugated ferrocenes 1–4, namely 1,1′-bis[2-(4-formylphenyl)ethenyl]ferrocene (1), 1,1′-bis[2-(4-ethenylphenyl)ethenyl]ferrocene (2), 1,1′-bis[2-(4-ethenylphenyl)ferrocen-1-ylethenyl]ferrocene (3), and 1,1′,2,2′-tetrakis[2-(ferrocen-1-ylethenyl)]ferrocene (4), is presented. The preparation of 3 and 4 follows a Heck C–C cross-coupling protocol, while 2 was obtained via a Wittig reaction. The electrochemical behavior of 1–4 was investigated by cyclic voltammetry, revealing reversible Fc/Fc⁺ redox couples for all compounds. Compound 1 exhibits an anodic shift, whereas compound 2 shows a cathodic shift relative to ferrocene. Compound 3 displays closely spaced redox events, while compound 4 shows distinct oxidation processes corresponding to core and peripheral ferrocenyl units, reflecting weak to moderate electronic coupling through the ethylene bridges. Cell viability assays indicate dose-dependent cytotoxic effects against PANC1 and U87 cell lines, with compound 3 showing the highest activity while maintaining low toxicity toward HDF cells. DFT calculations reveal that variations in substituents (benzaldehyde vs vinyl) modulate HOMO–LUMO gaps and correlate with observed electrochemical trends. These results highlight the role of ferrocenyl multiplicity and conjugation in tuning redox behavior and biological response.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了四种共轭二茂铁化合物的合成与表征，其中部分化合物通过 Heck 交叉偶联或 Wittig 反应制备。循环伏安结果显示这些化合物均具有可逆的二茂铁/二茂铁鎓氧化还原对，不同取代基和分子结构导致氧化电位发生阳极或阴极移动，并反映出乙烯桥连接下弱至中等的电子耦合。细胞活性实验显示其对 PANC1 和 U87 细胞具有剂量依赖性细胞毒性，其中化合物 3 活性最高且对 HDF 细胞毒性较低；DFT 计算进一步揭示取代基对前线轨道能隙和电子结构的调控作用。

articles.title: The Convective Switch: Unveiling Alpine Landslide Triggers via High-Resolution Topography and Deep Learning
articles.title_zh: 对流开关：利用高分辨率地形与深度学习揭示阿尔卑斯滑坡触发机制
articles.abstract: Background: Data-driven models, particularly deep learning, have increasingly dominated Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (LSM). However, regional studies often rely on coarse-resolution data and "black-box" architectures. Objective: This study proposes a physics-aware, Dual-Branch Deep Learning framework to predict rainfall-induced landslides in the Tyrolean Alps, bridging the gap between empirical algorithms and geomorphology. Methods: 30-day dynamic antecedent precipitation arrays were processed via an advanced Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, fused with static 5-meter resolution morphometric derivatives. To achieve robust interpretability, an Integrated Gradients (IG) framework was implemented. Results: The model achieved a robust performance (AUC = 0.768). IG revealed the precise spatiotemporal triggers, while a physics-informed geomorphological constraint (slopes ≤ 15° = 0 probability) eliminated false-positive artifacts in valley bottoms. Conclusions: The results prove that integrating dynamic meteorological memory with high-resolution topographic constraints is essential for the next generation of predictive hazard systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种具有物理意识的双分支深度学习框架，用于预测蒂罗尔阿尔卑斯地区降雨诱发滑坡。模型将 30 天动态前期降水序列经 LSTM 处理后，与 5 米分辨率静态地貌形态指标融合，并利用积分梯度方法解释触发因素。结果显示模型具有较稳健的预测性能，且引入坡度约束可减少谷底误报，表明动态气象记忆与高分辨率地形约束的结合对下一代滑坡灾害预测系统具有重要意义。

articles.title: The microscopic origin of a hesitant world: Quadrangular holes govern path multiplicity in complex networks
articles.title_zh: 犹豫世界的微观起源：四边形洞控制复杂网络中的路径多重性
articles.abstract: Complex networks provide a unified framework for describing interacting complex systems, from cells and brains to power grids and social media. As a foundational concept in graph theory, paths that link nodes through edges play a central role in network analysis and computation. Recent work has revealed substantial heterogeneity in shortest path multiplicity across synthetic and empirical networks. However, the core structural mechanisms that give rise to such path multiplicity remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we show that path multiplicity is governed by chordless 4-cycles, namely quadrangular holes. We first investigate topological features of extremal graphs that maximize path multiplicity and, surprisingly, find that these graphs are enriched with chordless 4-cycles, suggesting a plausible microscopic mechanism underlying path multiplicity. We then validate this hypothesis across 140 empirical networks and eight classical synthetic networks. Furthermore, we verify the connection between chordless 4-cycles and path multiplicity through target-oriented optimization and theoretical derivations. Our findings reveal how local motifs shape global path multiplicity, with significant potential applications in network design and optimization in various fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究复杂网络中最短路径多重性差异的结构来源，指出无弦 4-环即“四边形洞”是控制路径多重性的关键局部结构。作者首先分析使路径多重性最大化的极值图，发现其中富集无弦 4-环，进而在 140 个真实网络和 8 类经典合成网络中验证这一假设。研究还通过目标导向优化和理论推导确认了无弦 4-环与路径多重性之间的联系，揭示了局部网络模体如何影响全局路径结构。
