articles.title: Record nonlinear conversion efficiency in the production of high spectral purity vacuum ultraviolet laser at 148 nm
articles.title_zh: 148 nm 高光谱纯度真空紫外激光产生中的创纪录非线性转换效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) lasers are indispensable for precision measurement, quantum optics, and materials science. Recent high-resolution spectroscopy of the Th-229 nuclear clock transition near 148 nm highlights the urgent demand for intense, narrow-linewidth VUV lasers for advancing metrology and testing fundamental physics. However, existing VUV generation schemes typically require enhancement cavities [C. Zhang et al., Opt. Lett. 47, 5591-5594 (2022)], atomic resonances [Q. Xiao et al., Nature 650, 852-856 (2026)], or random quasi-phase-matched nonlinear crystals [V. Lal et al., Optica 12, 1971-1974 (2025)]. Here, we demonstrate a VUV frequency comb via cascaded frequency doubling of a 2400 nm Cr:ZnS comb to its 16th harmonic in nonlinear crystals. The final stage employs a bulk-grown, spatially uniform quasi-phase matched (QPM) crystal developed by IPG, combining VUV transparency, high ḩi² nonlinearity, and power scalability. Using this QPM crystal we generate a VUV frequency comb with 40 μW average power (1 nW per mode at 80 MHz mode spacing) with a conversion efficiency order of magnitude higher than other known methods. These results establish a scalable route to compact VUV sources via direct frequency doubling, opening a path toward a robust continuous-wave nuclear clock laser.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种用于产生 148 nm 附近高光谱纯度真空紫外激光的高效非线性频率转换方案，服务于精密测量、量子光学和材料科学等需求，尤其与 Th-229 核钟跃迁光谱相关。作者通过将 2400 nm Cr:ZnS 频率梳在非线性晶体中级联倍频至第 16 次谐波，产生真空紫外频率梳。最终级采用体生长、空间均匀的准相位匹配晶体，兼具真空紫外透明性、较强二阶非线性和功率可扩展性。实验获得平均功率 40 μW、80 MHz 模间隔下每模约 1 nW 的真空紫外频率梳，转换效率较已知方法提高约一个数量级。
authors: Sergey Vasilyev, Tian Ooi, Igor Moskalev, Mike Mirov, Andrey Muraviev, Dmitrii Konnov, Victor Churikov, Viktor Sukharev, Evgeny Galenin1, Jack F. Doyle, Chuankun Zhang, Kai Li, Georgiy Seryogin, Dan Perlov, Igor Samartsev, Konstantin Vodopyanov, Jun Ye

articles.title: μ-MOPA Architecture for Photonic Integrated Solid State Laser
articles.title_zh: 用于光子集成固体激光器的 μ-MOPA 架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diode-pumped solid-state (DPSS) lasers play a central role in modern photonics owing to their exceptional efficiency and ability to extend spectral coverage beyond the reach of semiconductor diodes. These attributes have enabled breakthroughs in precision metrology, quantum optics, and coherent communications. However, bringing the proven advantages of DPSS gain media such as Nd:YAG onto an integrated photonic platform has remained difficult, largely due to inefficient pump utilization and limited power-scaling in chip-scale implementations. Here, we demonstrate the first photonic-integrated Nd:YAG laser-amplifier system that overcomes these challenges with a micro-chip based master-oscillator-power-amplifier (μ-MOPA) architecture. The seed laser, employing a double-resonant microring resonator, could reach a threshold as low as 2.9 μ W. The single-pass waveguide amplifier, when optimized separately, provides up to 46.6 dB small-signal gain. Combining the low-threshold seed with cascaded waveguide amplifiers, the integrated μ-MOPA delivers more than 12 dBm of amplified continuous-wave output power. These results establish Nd:YAG waveguide integration as a practical route to compact and high-performance solid-state light sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了首个光子集成 Nd:YAG 激光—放大器系统，采用基于微芯片的主振荡功率放大器（μ-MOPA）架构，以解决芯片级固体增益介质中泵浦利用率低和功率扩展受限的问题。种子激光器使用双谐振微环谐振器，阈值低至 2.9 μW。单程波导放大器在单独优化时可提供最高 46.6 dB 的小信号增益。将低阈值种子源与级联波导放大器结合后，集成 μ-MOPA 实现了超过 12 dBm 的连续波放大输出功率。
authors: Yu Guo, Yubo Wang, Haoqi Zhao, Fengyan Yang, Guangcanlan Yang, Hao Xie, Hong X. Tang

articles.title: Efficient classical representation and quantum state preparation of complete active space wavefunctions
articles.title_zh: 完全活性空间波函数的高效经典表示与量子态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19457v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum computers promise to solve the electronic structure problem for a large class of molecules. However, the performance of relevant quantum algorithms hinges on preparing initial states with substantial overlap with the target eigenvector. For classically challenging molecules with strong electron correlation, starting from multi-reference states, such as complete active space (CAS) wavefunctions is necessary. Unfortunately, the most advanced state preparation protocols applied to such states result in a gate complexity that scales exponentially with the active space size d. In fact, even encoding a CAS state classically is traditionally believed to be intractable for chemically relevant systems. Here, we draw insights from the recently introduced Quantum Paldus Transform (QPT) to show that there exists an efficient classical representation of CAS states and to design a new state preparation routine outperforming previous ones. The QPT represents a transformation from the Fock basis to a friendlier symmetry-adapted basis. Our main contribution consists in showing that CAS states expanded in this basis can efficiently be represented as a matrix product state (MPS) with a bond dimension scaling as O(d²⁾. One can then efficiently load the MPS on a quantum computer and use the inverse QPT to transform the state to the Fock basis. Moreover, our method can easily be extended to the efficient preparation of CAS states in first quantisation with similar complexity. Crucially, we demonstrate that the complexity of both state preparation protocols only grows polynomially as O(d³⁾ , which constitutes to the best of our knowledge an exponential improvement over the state of the art.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作关注量子计算求解电子结构问题时的初态制备，尤其是强电子关联分子所需的完全活性空间（CAS）多参考波函数。传统观点认为，CAS 态的经典编码以及现有量子态制备协议通常随活性空间大小呈指数复杂度。作者借鉴量子 Paldus 变换，将 Fock 基变换为更便于处理的对称适应基，并指出 CAS 态在该基下存在高效经典表示。基于此，论文设计了新的量子态制备例程，旨在优于此前用于 CAS 态的制备方法。

articles.title: Electrical Noise Produced by Micron-Sized Particles above a Surface Paul Trap
articles.title_zh: 表面 Paul 阱上方微米级颗粒产生的电噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19585v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electric field noise produced by the surface of ion trap electrodes reduces the fidelity of quantum computing operations. Despite decades of investigation its microscopic origins remain unclear. Here, we measure electric field noise at trapping locations along the symmetry axis of a linear surface Paul trap. We find that noise levels vary by three orders-of-magnitude in one 600,μm section of the trap. Optical and scanning electron microscope images show micron-sized particles close to the trapping locations with the highest noise levels. We find that modeling the particles as a lossy dielectric with a effective loss tangent tanθ=0.33(0.06) describes the magnitude of the noise, as well as its spatial and frequency dependence. Our observations may explain the large variation of reported noise levels in literature.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究离子阱电极表面产生的电场噪声，这类噪声会降低量子计算操作保真度，但其微观来源长期不明。作者沿线性表面 Paul 阱对称轴测量俘获位置处的电场噪声，发现同一 600 μm 区段内噪声水平可相差三个数量级。光学显微镜和扫描电子显微镜图像显示，噪声最高的俘获位置附近存在微米级颗粒。将这些颗粒建模为具有有效损耗角正切 tanθ=0.33(0.06) 的有损介质，可解释噪声的幅值及其空间和频率依赖性，并可能说明文献中噪声水平差异巨大的原因。
authors: Ben Saarel, Ozgur Sahin, Hartmut Häffner, Alpha T. N'Diaye

articles.title: Optimized Quantum States for Sensing in the Presence of Loss and Phase Noise
articles.title_zh: 存在损耗与相位噪声时用于传感的优化量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19649v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Squeezed vacuum lets gravitational-wave detectors and other quantum sensors surpass the standard quantum limit, and is optimal in the loss-limited regime; phase noise breaks this optimality. Numerically optimizing the quantum Fisher information across the loss and phase-noise landscape, we identify non-Gaussian states that outperform any Gaussian state. These fall into three classes: Fock-like, cubic-phase-like, and states with discrete rotational symmetry. Limiting the average number of photons in the input state to barn=5, with 1-η = 5% photon loss and 200 mrad phase noise, the non-Gaussian advantage reaches up to 2.2 dB. Furthermore, we observe that the non-Gaussian advantage can persist even when the measurement strategy is homodyne detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对引力波探测器等量子传感场景，考察在光子损耗和相位噪声共同存在时的最优输入量子态。虽然压缩真空可突破标准量子极限，并在损耗受限情形下最优，但相位噪声会破坏这种最优性。作者通过数值优化量子 Fisher 信息，发现若干优于任意 Gaussian 态的非 Gaussian 态，包括类 Fock 态、类三次相位态以及具有离散旋转对称性的态。在平均光子数限制为 5、5% 光子损耗和 200 mrad 相位噪声下，非 Gaussian 优势最高可达 2.2 dB，并且在同相探测测量策略下仍可能保持。
authors: Shruti Maliakal, Zachary Mann, Christopher Wipf, Rana X Adhikari, Su Direkci, Yanbei Chen

articles.title: Multi-objective design of photon blockade for bright single-photon sources
articles.title_zh: 面向高亮度单光子源的光子阻塞多目标设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-quality single-photon sources, realized through saturable emitters, photon blockade, or heralded pair generation, are indispensable building blocks for photonic quantum platforms. Although these mechanisms suppress multiphoton emission through distinct principles typically captured by analytical models, their practical implementation is constrained by conflicting requirements for purity, brightness, and indistinguishability, which must be balanced within high-dimensional design landscapes. Here, we propose a computational framework for optimizing competing metrics of single-photon sources. Building on a Liouville-space adjoint formulation that efficiently evaluates multiple objectives in Markovian open quantum systems, we develop a Jacobian-based update, which ensures first-order monotonic reduction of multi-objective costs. By incorporating simulated annealing to escape gradient-vanishing plateaus, our framework achieves a design success rate of nearly 60 % for photon blockade with g2(0) smaller than 0.1 and theoretically bounded brightness across a broad parameter space, without any analytical guidance. This framework provides a general recipe for multi-objective design of open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于优化单光子源竞争指标的计算框架，面向纯度、亮度和不可区分性之间的权衡。该方法基于 Liouville 空间伴随公式，可在 Markov 开放量子系统中高效评估多个目标，并引入基于 Jacobian 的更新以保证多目标代价的一阶单调降低。作者还结合模拟退火来摆脱梯度消失平台。该框架在无解析指导的情况下，在广泛参数空间内实现了近 60% 的光子阻塞设计成功率，可得到 g2(0) 小于 0.1 且亮度受理论界限约束的方案。
authors: Sunkyu Yu, Xianji Piao, Namkyoo Park

articles.title: Tracking Representation Dynamics in Large Language Models with Persistent Homology
articles.title_zh: 用持久同调追踪大型语言模型中的表示动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are commonly aligned through supervised fine-tuning, yet little is known about how their internal representations evolve during this process. We study alignment dynamics using persistent homology by tracking the topology of activation spaces throughout fine-tuning. Across four transformer language models ranging from 1B to 7B parameters and three alignment objectives corresponding to helpful, harmless, and mixed training data, we find that the majority of topological reorganization occurs during the earliest stages of training. A dense checkpoint analysis reveals a transient peak in topological activity followed by rapid stabilization. We further show that different alignment objectives induce distinguishable topological trajectories, while instruction-tuned and pretrained models exhibit qualitatively different patterns of evolution. Our results suggest that persistent homology provides a complementary perspective on alignment, revealing representation-level changes that are not apparent from behavioral metrics alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用持久同调分析监督微调过程中大型语言模型内部表示空间的拓扑演化，以补充传统行为指标对对齐过程的理解。作者考察了四个 1B 至 7B 参数规模的 Transformer 语言模型，以及有帮助性、无害性和混合数据三类对齐目标。结果显示，大部分拓扑重组发生在训练最早阶段，密集检查点分析揭示了拓扑活动的短暂峰值及随后的快速稳定。不同对齐目标会诱导可区分的拓扑轨迹，而指令微调模型与预训练模型表现出定性不同的演化模式。
authors: Naman Malhotra, Jay Ambadkar, Abhinav Gupta, Kushal Kasivel, Abbas Schwarz, Kamillo Ferry, Anthea Monod

articles.title: Human Universal Grasping
articles.title_zh: 人类通用抓取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.17054v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Humans can grasp objects effortlessly, whereas multi-fingered robots are far from this level of generality. We argue that the most natural source of robot grasping data is from humans, who pick up thousands of objects every day. We present HUG, a flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps for any user-specified object in a single RGB-D image captured from a stereo camera. Using smart glasses, we first collect 1M-HUGs, an egocentric dataset of human grasps spanning 1M frames (27.8 hrs) and 6,707 object instances across 41 buildings. Next, to model the distribution of natural human grasps, our novel flow-matching model fuses RGB and depth observations to output a grasp parameterized by wrist translation, wrist rotation, and MANO hand pose. Predicted grasps can be retargeted to various robot hands, enabling zero-shot grasping in everyday scenes. To standardize evaluation, we build a new simulated benchmark, HUG-Bench, of 90 unseen objects from five geometric categories and various sizes, with metric-scale 3D meshes. We evaluate HUG in the real world on the 30-object test set of HUG-Bench across multiple stereo cameras, robot embodiments, and household environments. HUG outperforms the state-of-the-art grasping baselines by +23% and +34% on our challenging object set. Code, data, benchmark, checkpoints, and an interactive demo are released on our website: https://grasping.io/
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 HUG，一个基于流匹配的模型，可根据双目相机拍摄的单张 RGB-D 图像，为用户指定物体生成多样化的人类抓取姿态。作者使用智能眼镜采集了 1M-HUGs 第一视角数据集，包含 100 万帧、27.8 小时数据、6707 个物体实例，覆盖 41 栋建筑。模型融合 RGB 与深度观测，输出由手腕平移、手腕旋转和 MANO 手部姿态参数化的抓取，并可重定向到多种机器人手，实现日常场景中的零样本抓取。作者还构建了 HUG-Bench 模拟基准，包含 90 个未见物体及公制度量三维网格，并在真实环境中使用多个双目相机对 30 个测试物体进行了评估。
authors: Kevin Yuanbo Wu, Tianxing Zhou, Isaac Tu, Billy Yan, Irmak Guzey, David Fouhey, Dandan Shan, Lerrel Pinto

articles.title: GLARE: A Natural Language Interface for Querying Global Explanations
articles.title_zh: GLARE：用于查询全局解释的自然语言接口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While global explanations are crucial for understanding vision models across datasets, classes, and decision contexts, their complex and monolithic nature often hinders practical exploration. Because users typically seek targeted answers to specific questions rather than static artifacts, we present an LLM-based interactive interface that provides natural language access to global explanations for black-box image classifiers. The system's core LLM acts as a mediator, translating natural language questions into structured SQL queries over local explanation data. This enables flexible aggregation without exposing users to low-level representations. For each query, the interface outputs statistics-augmented natural language responses, supporting local explanations, and intent-aligned visualizations. We evaluate the system on intent interpretation, query mapping accuracy, generalization to novel queries and datasets, and robustness to linguistic errors. Our results demonstrate that LLM-mediated querying substantially improves the accessibility and usability of global explanations for human-centered XAI.
articles.abstract_zh: 全局解释有助于理解视觉模型在数据集、类别和决策情境中的行为，但其复杂且整体化的形式往往不便于实际探索。本文提出一种基于大语言模型的交互式接口，使用户能够用自然语言查询黑箱图像分类器的全局解释；核心模型将问题转换为针对局部解释数据的结构化 SQL 查询，并生成带统计信息的自然语言回答和可视化。实验从意图理解、查询映射准确性、对新查询和新数据集的泛化以及语言错误鲁棒性等方面评估，表明该方法提升了面向人的可解释 AI 的可访问性与可用性。

articles.title: Grounded Inference: Principles for Deterministically Encapsulated Generative Models
articles.title_zh: 扎根推理：确定性封装生成式模型的原则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The incorporation of generative models into traditional computational systems presents both enormous opportunity and tremendous peril. Although many early adopters have realized these perils at great expense, the field still requires foundational frameworks to de-risk incorporation of AI into traditional systems. This manuscript establishes this foundation through the definition of four specific primitives of AI blended architecture, designed to enable deterministic encapsulation of probabilistic models. It further establishes two overarching anti-patterns broadly represented across industry to serve as warnings for engineers in this field. This framework was designed to enable successful integration of AI into traditional systems while providing a foundation upon which generative model providers could build the next generation of generative model interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 将生成式模型嵌入传统计算系统既带来巨大机遇，也带来可靠性和安全风险。本文提出用于 AI 融合架构的四个基础原语，旨在对概率生成模型进行确定性封装，从而降低其在传统系统中的集成风险。文章还总结了两个在工业实践中常见的反模式，为工程人员提供警示，并为生成式模型接口的下一代设计提供框架基础。

articles.title: How LLMs Fail and Generalize in RTL Coding for Hardware Design?
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型在硬件设计 RTL 编码中如何失败与泛化？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19347v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Translating sequential programming priors into the parallel temporal logic of hardware design remains a crucial bottleneck for large language models(LLM). To investigate this, we introduce a new error taxonomy grounded in problem solvability, inspired by cognitive theory. Our taxonomy categorizes failures into syntactic, semantic, solvable functional, and unsolvable functional types. Evaluations reveal a strict empirical ceiling on the VerilogEval benchmark, as frontier models plateau at a 90.8% initial pass rate. These plateaus are defined by unsolvable functional errors, exposing persistent knowledge gaps immune to test time compute scaling. Furthermore, we expose a striking surface convergence gap: optimization readily eliminates syntax errors but concurrently exacerbates deeper functional failures. Our findings demonstrate that alignment techniques merely teach models to compile. While repeated sampling strategies can patch solvable errors, register-transfer level(RTL) coding capacity remains strictly bounded by pretraining knowledge. Addressing challenges in the current LLM based hardware generation pipeline requires more studies in model reasoning rather than alignment interventions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究大语言模型将顺序编程先验迁移到硬件设计中并行时序逻辑时的能力瓶颈。作者提出基于问题可解性的错误分类法，将失败划分为语法、语义、可解功能和不可解功能等类型，并在 VerilogEval 基准上观察到前沿模型初次通过率的经验上限。结果显示，优化可减少语法错误，却可能加深功能性错误；重复采样可修补部分可解问题，但 RTL 编码能力仍受预训练知识限制。
authors: Guan-Ting Liu, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Chenhui Deng, Zhongzhi Yu, Brucek Khailany, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang

articles.title: DynAMO:Dynamic Asset Management Orchestration via Topological Multi-Agent Scheduling
articles.title_zh: DynAMO：通过拓扑多智能体调度实现动态资产管理编排
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19382v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While LLM-powered agents offer end-to-end automation for industrial asset lifecycles, real-world Industry 4.0 deployment is hindered by latency, concurrency instability, and safety risks. We present DynAMO (Dynamic Asset Management Orchestration), a deployment-ready engine using a Plan-then-Execute architecture to generate verifiable workflow graphs. DynAMO supports both SequentialWorkflow (topological execution) and ParallelWorkflow (dependency-aware concurrency). By dynamically identifying independent tasks, DynAMO preserves structural correctness and safety while significantly improving efficiency through controlled reasoning overlap. Across six controlled experiments on the AssetOpsBench industrial benchmark, DynAMO demonstrates substantial performance and robustness gains. Parallel execution reduces end-to-end latency by a median of 1.6x over sequential orchestration, rising to 1.8x on highly parallelizable workflows. After instrumenting external tool calls with realistic latencies, a latency decomposition shows that LLM reasoning and orchestration still account for more than 90% of execution time, identifying model inference as the primary system bottleneck. Structured context pruning reduces inference latency by approximately 30%, and DynAMO maintains correct functional behaviour (task completion, agent sequencing, and output quality) while exhibiting graceful degradation under controlled fault injection. Reproducibility analysis further confirms stable execution under repeated runs, with parallel scheduling reducing latency variance. These findings establish DynAMO as a practical blueprint for scalable, safe, and latency-aware agent deployment in Industry 4.0 automation pipelines. Code is available at: https://github.com/kushwaha001/DynAMO
articles.abstract_zh: 面向工业 4.0 的资产生命周期自动化中，LLM 智能体仍面临延迟、并发不稳定和安全风险。本文提出 DynAMO，一种采用“先规划后执行”架构的部署级引擎，可生成可验证的工作流图，并支持拓扑顺序执行与依赖感知的并行执行。基于 AssetOpsBench 的实验表明，并行编排在保持结构正确性和安全性的同时降低端到端延迟；延迟分解还显示模型推理和编排仍是主要耗时来源。
authors: Kanishk Kushwaha, Vikrant Vinod Bansode, Harsh Vardhan, Dhaval C. Patel

articles.title: Spatial Distribution and Controlling Factors of Vanadium and Chromium in a Vanadium- Titanium Magnetite Tailings Reservoir and Surrounding Soils in the Panxi Region
articles.title_zh: 攀西地区钒钛磁铁矿尾矿库及周边土壤中钒和铬的空间分布与控制因素
articles.abstract: Vanadium (V) and chromium (Cr) in soils surrounding vanadium-titanium magnetite tailings reservoirs represent important environmental risks, especially after reservoir closure and soil covering. This study investigated a closed, soil-covered tailings reservoir in the Panxi region using surface soils and S-series vertical profiles. ArcGIS interpolation, BCR sequential extraction, Visual MINTEQ scenario simulation and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM)-SHAP modeling were combined to characterize spatial distribution, chemical fractionation, potential aqueous speciation and controlling factors. V and Cr concentrations ranged from 25.87 to 621.05 and from 13.03 to 385.07 mg kg− 1, with maxima 4.53 and 4.62 times regional background values, respectively. V enrichment was relatively widespread, whereas Cr enrichment was more localized. Hotspots occurred mainly near the dam toe and in sedimentary zones, indicating coupled effects of tailings input, runoff transport and local deposition. Vertical profiles showed profile-specific enrichment without consistent depth trends. Sequential extraction indicated that V and Cr were mainly residual, suggesting limited short-term mobility, although non-residual fractions still indicated potential release risks. Under an oxidized Visual MINTEQ scenario, V(V) was predicted mainly as H2VO4−, whereas Cr(VI) was mainly CaCrO4(aq). Correlation and LightGBM-SHAP analyses identified amorphous Fe/Al, exchangeable Ca/Mg, pH, CEC, SOM, texture and dam-toe proximity as major controls. Overall, V and Cr contamination around the closed and soil-covered tailings reservoir was controlled by coupled processes of tailings input, runoff transport, mineral fixation and soil physicochemical regulation. Future risk assessments should focus on dam-toe sedimentary zones and integrate total concentrations, chemical fractions, landform conditions and machine-learning results.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以攀西地区一座已闭库并覆土的钒钛磁铁矿尾矿库为对象，分析周边表层土壤及垂向剖面中钒和铬的污染特征。作者结合 GIS 插值、BCR 连续提取、Visual MINTEQ 情景模拟和 LightGBM-SHAP 建模，评估其空间分布、化学形态、水相物种及控制因素。结果显示钒富集较广泛、铬富集更局部，热点主要位于坝脚和沉积区；两者以残渣态为主，短期迁移性相对有限。

articles.title: Reversible chirality switching in MoS₂ generates spin currents without magnets
articles.title_zh: MoS₂中的可逆手性切换可在无磁体条件下产生自旋电流
articles.abstract: A newly developed method allows researchers to dynamically switch chirality—a particular lack of mirror symmetry—to generate spin currents in semiconductors, researchers from Science Tokyo report. Their approach relies on the reversible insertion and removal of small chiral molecules from the interlayer gaps of a layered, nonchiral semiconductor material using electrochemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: Science Tokyo研究人员报道了一种可动态切换半导体手性的方法，用于在无需磁体的情况下产生自旋电流。该方法通过电化学手段，在层状非手性半导体的层间间隙中可逆地插入和移除小型手性分子，从而实现手性调控。

articles.title: AI-Guided Design of Oral Insulin Analogs Using GNN and ADME Modeling
articles.title_zh: 基于图神经网络与ADME建模的口服胰岛素类似物AI引导设计
articles.abstract: Oral insulin delivery remains a critical unsolved challenge in diabetes therapeutics, primarily due to rapid gastrointestinal (GI) proteolytic degradation and negligible epithelial permeability of native insulin. We present a ten stage automated computational pipeline for rational design of oral insulin B-chain analogs integrating graph neural networks (GNNs), molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) estimation, GI stability modeling, nanoparticle delivery assessment, ADME profiling, and PI3K/AKT pathway safety evaluation. From the wild-type B-chain (UniProt: P01308), 300 unique mutant sequences were generated via guided stochastic mutagenesis and scored using a two-layer graph convolutional network (GCN) with 29 dimensional residue-level node features. The top-ranked candidate, MUT₂₇₁ (L6W;S9A;V12W;G20F), achieved a composite score of 0.762, docking energy of − 8.386 kcal/mol, RMSD of 0.057 nm, and GI score of 0.602. Of 300 candidates, 93.3% satisfied PI3K/AKT safety thresholds. Validation yielded binding-docking Spearman r = 0.696 (p = 2.86 × 10⁻²²) and stability-RMSD r = 0.875. Transcriptomic GSEA identified PI3K/AKT as the dominant enriched pathway (ES = 1.254, p = 10⁻⁸). This work constitutes the first unified pipeline jointly addressing GNN-based sequence-property learning, GI delivery modeling, transcriptomic pathway context, and multi-objective safety aware ranking for insulin B-chain analog design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对口服胰岛素易被胃肠道蛋白酶降解且上皮通透性极低的问题，提出了一个十阶段自动化计算流程，用于理性设计胰岛素B链类似物。流程整合图神经网络、分子对接、分子动力学估计、胃肠稳定性建模、纳米颗粒递送评估、ADME分析及PI3K/AKT通路安全性评价。研究从野生型B链生成300个突变序列并筛选出候选MUT₂₇₁，显示出较优的综合评分、结合能和稳定性指标，同时多数候选满足PI3K/AKT安全阈值。

articles.title: Preparation of high-performance fluororubber composites via in situ synthesis of bead-like carbon nanotube/nanosilica composite fillers
articles.title_zh: 通过原位合成珠状碳纳米管/纳米二氧化硅复合填料制备高性能氟橡胶复合材料
articles.abstract: This study proposes the in situ deposition of nanoscale silica spheres onto carbon nanotube surfaces to form bead-like binary composite fillers (CNTs@SiO₂). The silica spheres act as anchor points that connect adjacent carbon nanotubes, upgrading the constraint on fluororubber (FKM) molecular chains from point-like to linear and thereby significantly enhancing the mechanical reinforcement of fluororubber. At a loading of 15 phr, the tensile strength, stress at 300% strain, tear strength, hardness, room-temperature storage modulus, and electrical conductivity of the composites increased by 186%, 131.1%, 82.4%, 19.6%, 66.8%, and 880%, respectively. In addition, wear resistance and thermal properties were also significantly improved; the wear index was reduced by 82.9%, and the FKM/15-CNTs@SiO₂ composite exhibited a rapid thermal response during heating and cooling cycles. In conclusion, the bead-like nanofiller-filled FKM demonstrated excellent mechanical reinforcement and heat resistance, expanding its application potential in semiconductor packaging, aerospace, new energy vehicles, and the petrochemical industry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出在碳纳米管表面原位沉积纳米二氧化硅球，形成珠状二元复合填料CNTs@SiO₂。二氧化硅球作为锚点连接相邻碳纳米管，使其对氟橡胶分子链的约束由点状增强为线状，从而显著提升力学增强效果。在15 phr填充量下，复合材料的拉伸强度、撕裂强度、储能模量、电导率、耐磨性和热响应性能均明显改善，显示出在半导体封装、航空航天、新能源汽车和石化工业中的应用潜力。

articles.title: Ferroelectric tunable dielectric Materials: Response mechanisms and applications
articles.title_zh: 铁电可调介电材料：响应机制与应用
articles.abstract: Publication date: September 2026 Source: Materials Today, Volume 98 Author(s): Ruitao Li, Diming Xu, Chao Du, Zhaochen Xi, Zongquan Gu, John Wang, Di Zhou
articles.abstract_zh: 该文发表于Materials Today，围绕铁电可调介电材料的响应机制及应用展开。由于原始摘要仅提供出版信息和作者信息，具体材料体系、调控机理和应用场景需查阅原文；从题名看，文章可能是一篇关于铁电介电可调控行为及其器件应用的综述或专题论文。

articles.title: akaitools: A Python package for parsing and analyzing AkaiKKR electronic structure calculations
articles.title_zh: akaitools：用于解析和分析AkaiKKR电子结构计算的Python软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Korringa-Kohn-Rostoker (KKR) Green's function method is a first-principles electronic structure approach well suited to substitutionally disordered alloys through the Coherent Potential Approximation (CPA). AkaiKKR is a widely used implementation, known for efficient treatment of metallic systems and their magnetic properties. Its output, however, is unstructured plain text with no programmatic interface, leaving data extraction entirely to the user and making systematic or high-throughput studies impractical. akaitools is a Python package that parses AkaiKKR output files into structured, type-annotated Python objects. The package covers three output types: self-consistent field (SCF) results, which capture convergence history and per-atom electronic and magnetic properties; spin-resolved, orbital projected density of states for each CPA component; and Bloch spectral functions on a user-defined k-point path. Results come back as immutable dataclasses backed by NumPy arrays. Energy quantities are available in both Rydbergs and electronvolts, and results can be exported to Pandas DataFrames. A built-in plotting module produces Matplotlib figures for DOS curves and SCF convergence. A command-line interface provides file summaries and JSON export without any Python scripting. The package also includes a programmatic input file generator, so full calculation pipelines from input preparation to output analysis can be run in Python.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文介绍了akaitools，一个用于将AkaiKKR输出文件解析为结构化、带类型标注Python对象的软件包。AkaiKKR基于KKR格林函数方法并适用于结合相干势近似研究替位无序合金，但其纯文本输出缺乏程序化接口，不利于系统化和高通量分析。akaitools支持自洽场结果、自旋分辨轨道投影态密度和Bloch谱函数等输出类型，并提供NumPy数组、Pandas导出及绘图功能，以提升电子结构数据处理效率。

articles.title: Magnetotransport Measurements on Isolated Polycrystalline Grains of Type-II Silicon Clathrate
articles.title_zh: II型硅笼合物孤立多晶晶粒的磁输运测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The first low-temperature electronic transport characterization of individual polycrystalline grains of type-II silicon clathrate (NaₓSi₁₃₆, x łl 1), isolated using microfabrication techniques, is reported. Structural characterization via Raman spectroscopy confirms that the isolated grains are largely devoid of amorphous silicon (a-Si). Temperature-dependent resistivity reveals multiple conduction regimes, including thermally activated freeze-out behavior and a transition to low-activation-energy transport at cryogenic temperatures, consistent with hopping conduction mechanisms. Hall measurements from 290 K to 3.5 K yield carrier concentration and mobility trends that correlate with the extracted activation energies, verifying n-type conduction. Additionally, gate-dependent conductivity measurements demonstrate electrostatic tunability at room temperature. Collectively, these results establish the magnetotransport parameters of single, isolated grains of type-II silicon clathrate and demonstrate the potential of this material for future quantum and optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究首次报道了利用微加工技术分离的II型硅笼合物NaₓSi₁₃₆单个多晶晶粒的低温电子输运表征。拉曼光谱表明孤立晶粒中非晶硅含量很低，温度依赖电阻率揭示了热激活冻结和低温低激活能输运等多个导电区间，符合跳跃导电机制。霍尔测量证实其为n型导电并给出载流子浓度和迁移率趋势，栅压调控实验还显示其室温电导具有静电可调性，表明该材料在量子和光电子器件中具有潜力。
authors: Sam Saiter, Joseph P. Briggs, Yinan Liu, Audrey Faricy, Gavin Sher, Carolyn A. Koh, Reuben T. Collins, Meenakshi Singh

articles.title: Persistent current and orbital magnetization along a valley-contrasting junction in bilayer graphene in a magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中双层石墨烯谷对比结上的持久电流与轨道磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a magnetic field bilayer graphene hosts an octet of pseudo-zero-mode electron levels nearly degenerate in orbitals n=(0,1), valleys and spins. They split in valleys by electrostatic gating. In gated bilayer graphene, in which the interlayer bias is set up to flip sign across a line, one has a line junction that traps a portion of pseudo-zero-mode electrons inside the insulating bulk band gap, giving rise to electron states localized along the junction, known as kink states. A close look is made into the spectra and electromagnetic response of such kink states. There are two species of valley current associated with them, a drift current driven by the bias gradient and a circulating current coming from cyclotron motion. It turns out that they both flow in essentially the same direction, with the circulating current exhibiting a magnetic character distinct from those of other higher levels. In equilibrium they spatially circulate within the kink states, creating a quasi-one-dimensional channel of orbital magnetization. The electric control of the orbital magnetization and valley currents via a network of gated junctions will find useful applications in valley electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了磁场下栅控双层石墨烯中谷对比线结的电子谱和电磁响应。当层间偏置在线两侧反号时，体能隙中会俘获赝零能级电子并形成沿结局域的kink态。作者指出这些态包含由偏置梯度驱动的漂移谷电流以及源于回旋运动的环流，两者基本同向流动，并在平衡态下形成准一维轨道磁化通道。该机制有望通过栅控结网络实现对轨道磁化和谷电流的电学调控。

articles.title: Magnetic field induced transition from nodeless to nodal superconductivity in β-PdBi₂
articles.title_zh: β-PdBi₂中磁场诱导的无节点到有节点超导转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent tunneling measurements on β-PdBi₂ reported a magnetic field induced phase transition from a fully gapped to a nodal superconducting state. We develop a microscopic theory of superconductivity in this multi-band material, taking into account spin-orbit coupling and Zeeman splitting. We show that there are two attractive pairing channels in this system: an s-wave and a p-wave. At zero magnetic field, s-wave superconductivity wins. At a finite field, this channel becomes less favorable because Fermi surfaces split, and the gap symmetry changes to p-wave. We show that at a higher field, the excitation spectrum of a p-wave multi-band superconductor becomes gapless, with nodal points located in between the split Fermi surfaces. We argue that this behavior accounts for the experimentally observed field-induced nodal superconductivity in β-PdBi₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对β-PdBi₂中隧穿实验观察到的磁场诱导全能隙超导态向有节点超导态转变，建立了考虑自旋轨道耦合和Zeeman劈裂的多能带微观理论。研究表明体系中存在s波和p波两个吸引配对通道，零磁场下s波占优，而有限磁场下费米面劈裂削弱s波配对，使p波配对成为优势。进一步地，在更高磁场下，多能带p波超导的激发谱会变为无能隙，并在劈裂费米面之间形成节点，从而解释实验观测。
authors: Emmanouil K. Kokkinis, Joseph J. Betouras, Andrey V. Chubukov

articles.title: Magnon-dislon hybridization in magnetic insulators
articles.title_zh: 磁绝缘体中的磁振子-位错量子杂化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin dynamics in ordered magnets with topological lattice defects is investigated. Using fracton--elasticity duality, we develop an effective field theory of magnons coupled to quantized lattice dislocations (dislons) in magnetic insulators. Within this framework, an elastic gauge field mediates a nonlocal interaction between dislocations and magnetization gradients. The resulting magnetoelastic coupling gives rise to coherent magnon-dislon hybridization whose properties are dictated by dislocation topology. Screw dislocations exhibit helicity-selective hybridization and symmetry-protected dark dislon sectors, while edge dislocations generate anisotropic hybrid excitations with finite spin-precession ellipticity through the glide constraint. Our results establish dislocations as dynamical topological defects with directly observable polarization fingerprints in magnon spectra, and reveal magnon-dislon hybridization as a new route to control spin dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了具有拓扑晶格缺陷的有序磁体中的自旋动力学，并利用分形子-弹性对偶性建立了磁振子与量子化晶格位错（dislon）耦合的有效场论。模型中弹性规范场介导位错与磁化梯度之间的非局域相互作用，产生受位错拓扑性质支配的相干磁振子-disblon杂化。研究发现螺型位错可表现出螺旋性选择杂化和对称保护的暗位错量子扇区，而刃型位错会产生各向异性杂化激发和有限自旋进动椭圆率，为调控自旋动力学提供了新途径。
authors: Carlos Saji, Nicolas Vidal-Silva, Roberto E. Troncoso

articles.title: Chemical Vapor Deposition of Ni-doped Iron Germanium Telluride Nanosheets
articles.title_zh: Ni掺杂铁锗碲纳米片的化学气相沉积制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Iron germanium telluride (FGT; FemGenTe2) compounds have attracted significant interest due to their layered van der Waals structure, relatively high Curie temperature, and tunable magnetic properties. Chemical vapor deposition (CVD) is a particularly promising synthesis route owing to its simplicity, low cost, potential for scalability, and widespread adoption in the semiconductor industry, yet it has not been used previously to synthesize FGT with dopants. Here, we report CVD synthesis of both undoped and Ni-doped FGT nanosheets on SiO2/Si substrates. By adjusting precursor molar ratios, we synthesized Ni-doped FGT with multiple Fe concentrations and a 4% Ni-to-Fe ratio. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy depth profiling further demonstrates that Ni is present in the bulk of the crystals. This straightforward, low-cost, and CMOS-compatible approach demonstrates a route to Ni-doped FGT nanosheets, establishing a foundation for future characterization of Ni-doped FGT and its potential integration into spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了在SiO₂/Si衬底上通过化学气相沉积制备未掺杂和Ni掺杂铁锗碲（FGT）纳米片的方法。FGT因其层状范德华结构、较高居里温度和可调磁性而受到关注，但此前尚未使用CVD合成掺杂FGT。作者通过调节前驱体摩尔比获得不同Fe含量和约4% Ni/Fe比例的Ni掺杂FGT，并通过X射线光电子能谱深度剖析证明Ni存在于晶体体相中，为其在自旋电子器件中的集成奠定了基础。
authors: Matthew Metcalf, Jesse Martinez, Armella Mushfique, Alexander Riou, Lutfun Nahar, Bamidele Onipede, Hui Cai

articles.title: Time-resolved synchronization analysis of stacked intrinsic Josephson junctions of a cuprate superconductor with frequency-modulated terahertz radiation spectra
articles.title_zh: 具有频率调制太赫兹辐射谱的铜氧化物超导体堆叠本征约瑟夫森结的时间分辨同步分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18563v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Terahertz radiation from Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ intrinsic Josephson junctions (IJJs) provides an ideal platform to study the synchronization of a macroscopic quantum system. Here, we present a spectral analysis of a frequency-modulated Josephson plasma emitter coupled with patch antennas. In the unmodulated intensity distribution as a function of radiation frequency IUM(ømega), we observe a double Gaussian peak structure. Crucially, double-peak spectra obtained at a constant bias voltage imply either a rapid temporal distribution of resonances or their simultaneous excitation, driven by the mutual electromagnetic coupling between the IJJ mesa and the antennas. At low modulation frequencies fₘ, the spectra are well reproduced by the products of IUM(ømega) and frequency combs, yielding a synchronized relaxation time τₛ simeq 0.28 ns. Incorporating τₛ quantitatively reproduces a drastic spectral transformation observed around fₘ sim 1 GHz, unveiling the sub-nanosecond non-equilibrium dynamics of coupled Josephson plasma.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了与贴片天线耦合的Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ本征约瑟夫森结频率调制等离子体发射器的太赫兹辐射谱。未调制强度随频率分布呈现双高斯峰结构，在恒定偏压下的双峰谱暗示由结台面与天线之间电磁耦合引起的快速时间分布共振或同步激发。低调制频率下，谱线可由未调制分布与频率梳乘积再现，并得到约0.28 ns的同步弛豫时间；引入该时间尺度后，可定量解释约1 GHz附近的剧烈谱形转变，揭示耦合约瑟夫森等离子体的亚纳秒非平衡动力学。
authors: Masashi Miyamoto, Keisuke Mizoguchi, Ryota Kobayashi, Nozomi Yagyu, Manabu Tsujimoto, Itsuhiro Kakeya

articles.title: Strain induced magnetic phase transition and anomalous transport phenomena in RuO₂ and MnF₂
articles.title_zh: RuO₂和MnF₂中的应变诱导磁相变与反常输运现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collinear antiferromagnets with broken time-reversal symmetry have emerged as a fertile platform for spintronics. Using a general tight-binding model and first-principles calculations, we show that strain engineering provides a simple route to control magnetic phase transition and activate transverse responses in representative altermagnets RuO₂ and MnF₂. For pristine RuO₂ and MnF₂ with Néel vector nparallel [001], symmetry constrains the off-diagonal elements of the Hall conductivity tensor to vanish, thereby forbidding anomalous transport and magneto-optical responses. Shear strain applied along the ac direction preserves the spin symmetry relating the two spin-opposite magnetic sublattices and therefore maintains the altermagnetic phase. By contrast, shear strain applied along the ab direction breaks this spin symmetry and drives a transition from an altermagnetic phase to a partially compensated ferrimagnetic phase in metallic RuO₂ and to a fully compensated ferrimagnetic phase in semiconducting MnF₂. In addition, the lowered symmetry enables finite anomalous Hall, anomalous Nernst, and anomalous thermal Hall conductivities, as well as magneto-optical rotation angles, which are prohibited in the pristine systems. These responses exhibit a clear strain dependence and become progressively stronger as the strain amplitude increases. Our results establish strain engineering as an effective route to manipulate magnetic phases and functional responses in unconventional antiferromagnets, thereby expanding opportunities for antiferromagnetic spintronics and magneto-optical applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用通用紧束缚模型和第一性原理计算，考察了应变工程对代表性交错磁体RuO₂和MnF₂磁相变及横向输运响应的调控。对于Néel矢量沿[001]方向的未应变体系，对称性限制使霍尔电导张量非对角元为零，从而禁止反常输运和磁光响应。作者发现ac方向剪切应变保持交错磁相，而ab方向剪切应变打破自旋对称性，可分别诱导RuO₂和MnF₂向部分补偿或完全补偿的亚铁磁相转变，并激活反常霍尔、反常能斯特和反常热霍尔响应。
authors: Xiuxian Yang, Zhangqi Wu, Xiangju Wang, Shifeng Qian, Ping Yang, Xiaodong Zhou, Jian Hao, Wanxiang Feng

articles.title: Trion Hall effect in electron-hole double layers
articles.title_zh: 电子-空穴双层中的三激子霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The realization of Coulomb coupled electron-hole double layers in 2D semiconductor heterostructures has enabled the thermodynamic and transport studies of equilibrium exciton fluids without a magnetic field. By doping the exciton fluid with additional electrons/holes, an equilibrium fluid of trions - three particle bound states of electrons and holes - further emerge, providing the platform to explore new transport phenomena associated with such composite particles. Here we report the observation of a Hall effect for trions in MoSe2/WSe2 heterobilayers, which support Coulomb-coupled electron and hole fluids with tunable densities. The Hall effect arises from a Lorentz force on trions under a perpendicular magnetic field. It is manifested in both Hall drag measurements and standard Hall effect measurements on just one of the semiconductor layers. For negatively charged trions, an electron Hall effect is observed even in a hole doped WSe2 monolayer due to the presence of trion drags. The trion Hall effect also disappears when the trions are ionized at elevated temperatures and/or high trion densities. Our work opens the door for realizing quantum oscillations and the quantum Hall effect for trions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 MoSe2/WSe2 异质双层中观测到三激子的霍尔效应；该体系支持库仑耦合且密度可调的电子与空穴流体。外加垂直磁场下，三激子受到洛伦兹力，其效应同时体现在霍尔拖曳测量和单层标准霍尔测量中。对于带负电三激子，即使在空穴掺杂的 WSe2 单层中也可因三激子拖曳而出现电子型霍尔响应；当温度升高或三激子密度过高导致三激子电离时，该效应消失。
authors: Raghav Chaturvedi, Phuong X. Nguyen, Patrick Knüppel, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Kin Fai Mak, Jie Shan

articles.title: Bidirectional motion of antiferromagnetic skyrmions driven by competing spin torques
articles.title_zh: 竞争自旋力矩驱动的反铁磁斯格明子的双向运动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions are swirling topological spin textures with rich dynamics and intriguing transport properties, yet their bidirectional dynamics remain largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the dynamics of antiferromagnetic skyrmions driven by current-induced spin-transfer and spin-orbit torques. We computationally demonstrate that antiferromagnetic skyrmions moving in one direction at low current densities can reverse their motion direction when the driving current is above a threshold. Based on the Thiele approach analysis, we show that this bidirectional motion originates from a change in the relative strengths of two effective forces arising from spin-transfer and spin-orbit torques. Furthermore, exploiting this bidirectional motion on a single racetrack, we design programmable logic gates. Our results not only uncover a hidden mechanism for bidirectional skyrmion motion but also facilitate the development of antiferromagnet-based logic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究了电流诱导的自旋转移力矩与自旋轨道力矩共同驱动下反铁磁斯格明子的动力学。计算结果表明，低电流密度下沿一个方向运动的反铁磁斯格明子，在驱动电流超过阈值后可反向运动。基于 Thiele 方法的分析显示，这种双向运动源于两类力矩产生的有效力相对强度发生变化；作者还利用该机制在单条赛道上设计了可编程逻辑门。
authors: Laichuan Shen, Wang Kang, Xichao Zhang, Qiuping Huang, Yalin Lu, Zhifeng Zhu, Yan Zhou

articles.title: Counterintuitive inverse superconducting transition beyond 4He-cooling limit
articles.title_zh: 超越液氦冷却极限的反常逆超导转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermally driven quantum-orders observed in exceptional instances may redefine the role of thermal-fluctuation from a source of decoherence to a resource for coherent-state engineering. While preliminary signs of counterintuitive temperature-rise-triggered superconductivity manifested in CeCu2Si2, ErRh4B4, Ho1.2Mo6S8 and (La,Ce)Al2, their critical-temperatures (Tc-inv) remain below Kelvin-range, precluding substantial applications. Here, we report field-modulated inverse-superconducting-transitions above 4He-cooling-limit in Eu-based infinite-layer nickelates (EuxNd1-xNiO2 and EuxPr1-xNiO2) grown on a substrate under both overdoped and underdoped regimes. Paradigmatically, superconductivity with zero-resistance is confined between Tc-inv (2.6-5.4 K) and another higher normal-Tc, rising and decreasing with applied magnetic-field, respectively. Starting from the resistive-state below Tc-inv, the inverse-superconducting-transition is driven by not only temperature-rising, but also current-density, while superconductivity further vanishes at higher temperature and current thresholds. The Kelvin-range inverse superconducting transition is plausibly explained by temperature-induced alternating dominance of effective magnetic-fields arising from Eu2+4f7 related compensations relative to the upper-critical-field. Furthermore, an extended-phenomenological-framework is also supported by reemerged superconductivity below 300 mK under magnetic-field, giving rise to an unprecedented temperature-induced reentrant superconductivity. Our findings establish magnetic-interaction-reconfigured high-Tc systems as fertile platforms for exploring quantum phenomena that reverse thermal-decoherence paradigm, also enabling antithetical-designs to unlock untapped application-scenarios for quantum-phase-transition devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了 Eu 基无限层镍酸盐 EuxNd1-xNiO2 和 EuxPr1-xNiO2 中高于液氦冷却温区的磁场调控逆超导转变。样品在过掺杂和欠掺杂条件下均表现出零电阻超导仅存在于较低的逆转变温度 Tc-inv 与较高的常规正常转变温度之间，且二者随磁场呈相反变化趋势。除升温外，电流密度也可从低温电阻态触发逆超导转变，而在更高温度或电流阈值下超导再次消失。
authors: Haowen Han, Yi Bian, Tong Ma, Yusong Zhao, Nuofu Chen, Chuanying Xi, Ze Wang, Binghui Ge, Hongliang Dong, Jia-Cai Nie, Ho-Kwang Mao, Jikun Chen

articles.title: d-wave altermagnetism revealed by resonant inelastic X-ray scattering
articles.title_zh: 共振非弹性 X 射线散射揭示 d 波交替磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism defines a third fundamental class of collinear magnetic order, featuring compensated magnetic moments with antiparallel spin alignment, yet lifted Kramers degeneracy without the need for relativistic spin-orbit coupling. Its ability to host spin-polarized electronic bands and unconventional chiral magnons makes it a promising platform for functional materials. However, experimental verification has proven challenging; while circular dichroism in resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) has been suggested as a signature of chiral magnons, it remains controversial whether this effect is an intrinsic property of altermagnetism or an artifact of experimental geometry. In this work, we resolve this debate and provide unambiguous experimental evidence of d-wave altermagnetism in the strongly correlated Lieb-lattice magnet La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂. The RIXS spectra exhibit a d-wave-symmetry circular dichroism in the magnetic excitations that vanishes in the paramagnetic phase. Through RIXS-operator symmetry analysis and exact-diagonalization calculations, we prove that the observed dichroism is a direct consequence of altermagnetic symmetry constraints, independent of magnon branch splitting. Our results provide definitive evidence for the experimental realization of d-wave altermagnetism in La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂ and establish circularly polarized RIXS as a highly symmetry-sensitive spectroscopic framework for detecting magnetic phases that evade conventional probes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用共振非弹性 X 射线散射为强关联 Lieb 晶格磁体 La2O3Mn2Se2 中的 d 波交替磁性提供了实验证据。实验发现磁激发中的圆二色性具有 d 波对称性，并在顺磁相中消失。通过 RIXS 算符对称性分析和精确对角化计算，作者证明该二色性直接源于交替磁对称性，而非实验几何伪影。
authors: Guangkai Zhang, Yuehong Li, Xubin Ye, Vincent C. Morano, Sze Tung Li, Jaewon Choi, Rebecca Scatena, Shuai Tang, Maocai Pi, Mengqi Ye, Mirian Garcia-Fernandez, Alessandro Bombardi, Xiaomei Qin, Zhao Pan, Daniel G. Mazzone, Qisi Wang, Yi Lu, Yao Shen, Youwen Long

articles.title: Polarized neutron scattering as a probe for vortex-type spin correlations in iron oxide multicore assemblies
articles.title_zh: 偏振中子散射探测氧化铁多核组装体中的涡旋型自旋关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report an experimental investigation of the magnetic microstructure of iron oxide multicore assemblies by means of polarized small-angle neutron scattering (SANS). Guided by a recently developed analytical theory for vortex-state magnetic nanoparticles, we provide a quantitative comparison between the measured and calculated cross sections, revealing signatures that are consistent with vortex-type magnetization configurations at low applied magnetic fields. In particular, the field evolution and the characteristic isotropic ring-type feature of the spin-flip scattering intensity at intermediate momentum transfers are in line with the formation of flux-closure states. The latter are stabilized by the interplay of exchange, Zeeman, and magnetostatic energies. The methodology allows for a statistically significant characterization of vortex states in densely packed nanoparticle systems, thereby complementing surface-sensitive techniques that are commonly limited to the observation of spin structures in individual particles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用偏振小角中子散射实验考察氧化铁多核组装体的磁微结构。结合涡旋态磁性纳米颗粒的解析理论，作者将实测与计算散射截面进行定量比较，发现低外磁场下存在与涡旋型磁化构型一致的特征。中等动量转移处自旋翻转散射强度的各向同性环状特征及其随磁场演化，支持由交换能、塞曼能和磁静能共同稳定的闭合磁通态形成。
authors: Venus Rai, Ivan Titov, Elizabeth M. Jefremovas, Štefan Liščák, Sivarenjini Shan, Nina-Juliane Steinke, Jonathan Leliaert, Álvaro Gallo-Córdova, María P. Morales, Davide Peddis, Pierfrancesco Maltoni, Luis Fernández Barquín, Andreas Michels, Michael P. Adams

articles.title: Classical dissipative search of unstructured database
articles.title_zh: 非结构化数据库搜索的经典耗散实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18835v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a physical realization of the unstructured database search that works via classical, dissipative model of spherical spins. The database is implemented via spin-spin couplings, where the selected coupling refers to a larger ferromagnetic interaction between two selected spins. The low-temperature equilibrium of this model leads to magnetization strongly concentrated on the selected spins, which means that the search is complete. The search time refers to the relaxation time to equilibrium from a homogeneous initial state, and is described via Langevin equations. This time scales as a̧l O(M^a) with a<1/2, where M is the database volume. This is faster than Grover's search, showing how a dissipative, classical analog computer can overcome the quantum unitary computer.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种基于经典耗散球形自旋模型的非结构化数据库搜索物理实现方案。数据库由自旋-自旋耦合编码，其中被选中的耦合对应两个特定自旋之间更强的铁磁相互作用；在低温平衡态下，磁化强度集中于被选中自旋，从而完成搜索。由 Langevin 方程描述的弛豫搜索时间随数据库规模 M 呈 O(M^a) 标度且 a<1/2，作者据此认为该经典耗散模拟计算框架可快于 Grover 搜索。

articles.title: On the emergence of molecular tilt in a ferroelectric smectic liquid crystal with broken director-inversion symmetry
articles.title_zh: 具有破缺指向矢反演对称性的铁电近晶液晶中分子倾斜的产生机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18870v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The origin of some mesophases of the ferroelectric nematic realm is not yet well understood. In this work we study the highly polar liquid crystal MIO, a close structural analogue of the prototypical ferroelectric nematogen DIO, which exhibits a ferroelectric smectic A to ferroelectric smectic C (SmAF-SmCF) phase transition. Calorimetric, dielectric and light-scattering experiments reveal that it is a second-order phase transition with mean-field behavior, and is driven by the softening of the tilt elastic constant accompanied by the divergence of the amplitude of the associated dielectric mode.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究高极性液晶 MIO 中铁电近晶 A 相到铁电近晶 C 相的相变，MIO 是典型铁电向列材料 DIO 的近结构类似物。量热、介电和光散射实验表明，该 SmAF-SmCF 相变为具有平均场行为的二级相变。相变由倾斜弹性常数软化驱动，并伴随相关介电模振幅发散。
authors: Aitor Erkoreka, Mauricio Vera-Arévalo, Alberto Concellón, Sergio Diez-Berart, Jordi Sellarès, Adrià Gràcia-Condal, Ibon Alonso, Josu Martinez-Perdiguero

articles.title: Theory of In-Plane Orbital Magnetization with Layer Hybridization
articles.title_zh: 具有层间杂化的面内轨道磁化理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The modern theory of orbital magnetization successfully describes the response of Bloch electrons to magnetic fields in fully periodic crystals, but it does not directly address the distinct regime of an in-plane field in multilayer systems with layer hybridization. Coherent interlayer tunneling allows electrons to form circulating current loops, producing an in-plane orbital response that is absent in a strictly two-dimensional limit and qualitatively different from the conventional three-dimensional one. Here we develop a theory of in-plane orbital magnetization for this it transdimensional regime, where the layer thickness is comparable to the vertical mean free path. Starting from the current-loop picture, we construct the in-plane orbital angular momentum operator and derive exact expressions for the orbital magnetic moment and the in-plane orbital magnetic susceptibility. As an application, we predict a gate-tunable in-plane orbital magnetoelectric effect in layered materials. Our framework establishes a general foundation for in-plane orbital responses and suggests new opportunities for orbitronics in layer-hybridized quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文发展了适用于多层体系中面内磁场响应的轨道磁化理论，重点考虑层间相干隧穿和层杂化效应。与严格二维极限不同，层间隧穿可形成环流电流回路，从而产生面内轨道响应；该响应也不同于常规三维晶体中的轨道磁化。作者从电流回路图像出发构造面内轨道角动量算符，并推导轨道磁矩和面内轨道磁化率的精确表达式，同时预言了层状材料中可由栅压调控的面内轨道磁电效应。
authors: Jin-Xin Hu, Zi-Ting Sun, Yugui Yao

articles.title: Thermodynamics of photonic nonlinear Aharonov-Bohm cages
articles.title_zh: 光子非线性 Aharonov-Bohm 笼的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18896v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate equilibrium and non-equilibrium thermodynamics of one-dimensional photonic diamond lattices with Kerr nonlinearity. The equilibrium phase diagram is obtained as a function of the synthetic magnetic flux acting on each plaquette. In the linear regime, the magnetic flux can induce Aharonov-Bohm caging, flattening all Bloch bands and suppressing particle and energy currents. In this caging regime, non-vanishing currents are enabled by nonlinearity. By imposing stationary temperature- and chemical potential- imbalances at the system boundaries, we show that at weak nonlinearity fine tuning the flux at the Aharonov-Bohm caging transforms the system from a conductor to an insulator. For intermediate nonlinear strength, the system remains conducting for all magnetic fluxes; however, the caging condition significantly enhances the Seebeck coefficient and thermoelectric figure of merit, improving the thermoelectric features of the system. Our results give evidence of a novel route towards optimization of coupled transport devices, based on the control of linear versus nonlinear conduction channels via a synthetic magnetic flux.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察具有 Kerr 非线性的一维光子金刚石晶格的平衡与非平衡热力学，并给出随合成磁通变化的平衡相图。在线性情形下，磁通可诱导 Aharonov-Bohm 笼效应，使所有 Bloch 能带变平并抑制粒子和能量流；而在笼化条件下，非线性可重新开启非零电流。在弱非线性下，精细调节磁通可使系统由导体转为绝缘体；中等非线性下系统在所有磁通下保持导电，但笼化条件显著提高 Seebeck 系数和热电优值。

articles.title: Spin-orbit coupling renormalization of the natural optical activity of Pb5Ge3O11 from first-principles
articles.title_zh: 第一性原理研究 Pb5Ge3O11 自然光学活性的自旋轨道耦合重整化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a first-principles study of the natural optical activity of the gyroelectric Pb₅Ge₃O₁₁ crystal, explicitly accounting for spin-orbit coupling (SOC) effects. We derive a new analytical expression for the gyration coefficients within the recent framework of long-wavelength density-functional perturbation theory [Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 086902 (2023)], which significantly improves computational efficiency by reducing the number of required response functions and includes spin-orbit coupling effects. We use this implementation to investigate the evolution of Pb₅Ge₃O₁₁'s optical rotation across the ferroelectric double-well, from the paraelectric Pbar6 phase to the ferroelectric P3 phase. Our results demonstrate that, in addition to the substantial renormalization of the double-well energy, spin-orbit coupling contributions play an equally crucial role in the natural optical activity, largely through purely electronic contributions, while SOC-induced structural relaxation effects are minor.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从第一性原理出发研究旋电晶体 Pb5Ge3O11 的自然光学活性，并显式纳入自旋轨道耦合效应。作者在长波长密度泛函微扰理论框架内推导了新的旋光系数解析表达式，减少所需响应函数数量并提高计算效率。应用结果显示，在从顺电 Pbar6 相到铁电 P3 相的双阱演化过程中，自旋轨道耦合不仅显著重整化双阱能量，也通过主要为电子性的贡献对自然光学活性起关键作用，而其引起的结构弛豫影响较小。
authors: Asier Zabalo, Massimiliano Stengel, Eric Bousquet

articles.title: Suppression of Extrinsic Anomalous Hall Conductivity in Disordered Parity Anomalous Semimetal
articles.title_zh: 无序宇称反常半金属中外禀反常霍尔电导的抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18945v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an analytical investigation of the extrinsic contributions to the anomalous Hall conductivity in the context of the half-quantized Hall effect observed in disordered parity anomalous semimetal emerged from semi-magnetic topological insulator thin films. The gapless Dirac cone surface state, which embodies the quintessence of the half-quantized Hall effect, exhibits remarkable robustness against disorder scattering. Two primary extrinsic mechanisms, the side-jump and skew-scattering, are deemed irrelevant and make no contributions. These results establish the parity anomalous semimetal as a disorder-resilient quantum phase, thereby providing insights into Dirac fermion physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究解析考察了无序宇称反常半金属中反常霍尔电导的外禀贡献，背景是半磁性拓扑绝缘体薄膜中出现的半量子化霍尔效应。体现半量子化霍尔效应核心特征的无能隙 Dirac 锥表面态对无序散射表现出显著鲁棒性。作者发现侧跳和偏斜散射两类主要外禀机制均无关且不产生贡献，从而支持宇称反常半金属作为抗无序量子相的图像。
authors: Shi-Hao Bi, Bo Fu, Shun-Qing Shen

articles.title: Projected altermagnetism by symmetry reduction at surfaces and in thin films
articles.title_zh: 表面与薄膜中由对称性降低投影出的交替磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are a newly identified class of magnetic materials that combine vanishing net magnetization within the unit cell with spin-split electronic states. Their theoretical description relies on symmetry properties of the bulk band structure. Surfaces and thin films, however, inherently break these symmetries. Here, we investigate the consequences of such symmetry reduction for the electronic structure of bulk altermagnets near the surface and of thin films. When the surface coincides with a symmetry plane of the bulk altermagnetic order, the resulting two-dimensional Brillouin zone exhibits spin-degenerate bands, corresponding to conventional antiferromagnetic behavior. In all other cases, the symmetry of the altermagnetic order is reduced, leading to modified spin splitting. Remarkably, we discover a thin-film geometry of a g-wave altermagnet with a particular surface orientation that enables a d-wave spin splitting, which is commonly accompanied by the spin-splitter effect, suggesting the functionalization of non-d-wave altermagnets by surfaces. Our findings demonstrate that symmetry breaking at surfaces and in thin films fundamentally reshapes altermagnetic spin textures, providing a tunable platform for controlling spin-dependent electronic phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究体相交替磁体在表面附近及薄膜几何中因对称性降低而产生的电子结构变化。若表面与体相交替磁序的某一对称面重合，所得二维布里渊区中能带保持自旋简并，表现为常规反铁磁行为；其他取向则会降低交替磁序对称性并改变自旋劈裂。作者还发现一种 g 波交替磁体薄膜取向可产生 d 波自旋劈裂，通常伴随自旋分离器效应，表明表面工程可功能化非 d 波交替磁体。
authors: Sopheak Sorn, Charanpreet Singh, Lukasz Plucinski, Gustav Bihlmayer, Yuriy Mokrousov, Wulf Wulfhekel

articles.title: Room-Temperature Calcium Intercalation into Graphite Catalyzed by Sodium
articles.title_zh: 钠催化的室温钙嵌入石墨
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Calcium (Ca) insertion into graphite (C) has been considered to require elevated temperatures, and its occurrence at room temperature (RT) has been regarded as highly unlikely. Here, we demonstrate that sodium (Na) catalysis enables the formation of superconducting CaC₆ even at RT. In mixtures of Ca, Na, and graphite, the gradual development of superconducting diamagnetism and the emergence of X-ray diffraction peaks confirm the formation of CaC₆ during storage at RT. The superconducting transition temperature increases with storage time, and the amount of CaC₆ scales proportionally to the square root of storage time. These findings provide new insights into the mechanism of superconductivity and Na-catalyzed formation of CaC₆, and highlight the potential of this RT intercalation process for practical applications such as electrode materials in Ca-ion batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙嵌入石墨通常被认为需要高温，室温发生的可能性很低。该研究表明，在钙、钠与石墨的混合体系中，钠可催化室温形成超导 CaC₆，证据包括随储存时间增强的超导抗磁信号和相应 X 射线衍射峰。CaC₆ 的生成量与储存时间平方根成正比，提示该室温嵌入过程有望用于钙离子电池电极等实际应用。
authors: Akira Iyo, Shigeyuki Ishida, Hiroshi Eisaki, Hiraku Ogino, Kenji Kawashima

articles.title: Large-deviation tails of critical order-parameter distributions
articles.title_zh: 临界序参量分布的大偏差尾部
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-deviation tails of critical probability distributions provide a sensitive probe of universality beyond standard finite-size scaling. We study these tails for critical percolation and Fortuin--Kasteleyn Ising models on two-dimensional lattices, three-dimensional lattices, and complete graphs. We consider two rescaled order parameters: the magnetization-like variable xₘ₌|M|/łangle |M|ångle, including a signed cluster-mass analogue for percolation, and the largest-cluster variable x_C=C₁/łangle C₁ångle. For xₘ, we test the expected stretched-exponential large-deviation tail and show that the same form applies to the percolation analogue. For x_C, guided by the exact complete-graph result and scaling arguments, we propose universal scaling forms for both tails of the cumulative distribution and test them by extensive Monte Carlo simulations. In the complete-graph FK-Ising model, the left tail is governed by rare configurations with percolation-like scaling rather than by the typical Ising scaling. Our results show that the tails of order-parameter distributions reveal universal features of critical fluctuations that are not captured by averaged observables alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察临界概率分布的大偏差尾部，用以探测超出常规有限尺寸标度的普适性。作者研究二维、三维晶格及完全图上的临界渗流与 Fortuin–Kasteleyn 伊辛模型，分析磁化类变量和最大团簇变量的重标度分布。通过解析启发、标度论和大规模蒙特卡罗模拟，工作提出并检验了累积分布尾部的普适标度形式，显示序参量分布尾部能揭示常规分析难以捕捉的临界涨落特征。
authors: Jinhong Zhu, Yihao Xu, Abbas Ali Saberi, Youjin Deng

articles.title: Controlling magnetic domain walls with supercurrents
articles.title_zh: 利用超电流控制磁畴壁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Establishing a versatile, fast and reliable magnetic memory technology is a giant bottleneck for cryogenic computing since present-day room-temperature solutions either cease to work or consume too much power. The long-term goal of superconducting spintronics has been to overcome this bottleneck by generating magnetic memories with equal-spin triplet supercurrent driven through them to control their magnetization direction. This path has been hampered by the short spin relaxation length and strong anisotropy in ferromagnets. Here we show how the supercurrent driven generation of spin accumulation in a superconductor/magnetic insulator bilayer, together with Gilbert damping of magnetization lead to a motion of magnetic domain walls. This manifests as a local voltage across the wall, which allows its position to be identified. Associated with this voltage and the current, there is Joule power which is dissipated via the Gilbert damping. The power required to maintain domain wall motion is orders of magnitude smaller than in the normal state, where most of the power is wasted in producing the current.
articles.abstract_zh: 面向低温计算的磁存储需要快速、可靠且低功耗的控制方案，而传统室温技术在低温下存在失效或功耗过高问题。该研究提出在超导体/磁绝缘体双层结构中，由超电流诱导自旋积累并结合 Gilbert 阻尼来驱动磁畴壁运动。畴壁运动伴随可用于定位的局域电压，其维持功耗比正常态低数个数量级，为超导自旋电子学存储器提供了新的控制思路。
authors: Tim Kokkeler, Risto Ojajärvi, F. Sebastian Bergeret, Tero T. Heikkilä

articles.title: Pore-shape and its spatial organization control intrinsic permeability of porous media
articles.title_zh: 孔隙形状及其空间组织调控多孔介质的固有渗透率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structure of a porous material, and in particular its spatial variability, is known to control the intrinsic permeability of the system. We investigate how dead-end pores influence the intrinsic permeability of a porous medium beyond their contribution to total pore volume. Dead-end pores are ubiquitous in porous media, yet they are often treated as hydraulically inactive regions whose influence is assumed to be negligible or absorbed into effective-porosity descriptions. We perform pore-scale flow simulations across different dead-end pore structures, including heterogeneous arrangements, controlled granular assemblies, and a minimal single-channel model to study their impact on the system macroscopic permeability. This strategy allows us to isolate the effects of dead-end pore density, depth, and orientation while preserving the transmitting network. We find that dead-end pores can influence intrinsic permeability: increasing the density of dead-end pores along percolating flow paths enhances permeability, whereas pore depth and junction orientation have negligible effects. The observed permeability enhancement originates from localized hydrodynamic interactions at junctions between transmitting and dead-end pores. Based on these results, we propose an effective formulation that relates the density and spatial organization of dead-end pores relative to the transmitting network to macroscopic permeability. Our findings show that dead-end pore architecture provides an additional geometric control on intrinsic permeability beyond porosity and pore-size statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注死端孔隙对多孔介质固有渗透率的影响，而不仅仅将其视为对总孔隙体积的贡献。作者通过孔尺度流动模拟比较不同死端孔结构，包括非均匀排列、受控颗粒组装体和最小单通道模型，以分离孔密度、深度与取向的作用。结果表明，沿贯通流路增加死端孔密度可提高渗透率，而孔深和连接取向影响较小，说明死端孔并非总是水力惰性区域。
authors: Wenqiao Jiao, Isaac Pincus, Chiara Recalcati, Alberto Guadagnini, Pietro de Anna

articles.title: Evidence for Multiband Superconductivity in 2H-NbSeS
articles.title_zh: 2H-NbSeS 中多带超导性的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nature of superconductivity in 2H-NbSe2 has generated sustained debate in the recent past. While angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy data have been interpreted as evidence for multiband superconductivity, the data from scanning tunneling microscope experiments relate to strongly anisotropic single-band superconductivity. In the later case, the charge density wave (CDW) order mimics the multigap character. Because the CDW reconstructs the Fermi surface and modifies the superconducting gap distribution, disentangling intrinsic multiband pairing from CDW-related effects is challenging. To address this issue, we investigate single-crystalline 2H-NbSeS, a mixed-chalcogen analogue of 2H-NbSe2 in which random Se/S substitution suppresses long-range CDW order while preserving the layered crystal structure P63/mmc. The material becomes superconducting below 6.0 K with moderate magnetic anisotropy. The upper critical field exhibits a pronounced upward curvature that cannot be described within a single-band framework but is well captured by a dirty-limit two-band model with a large diffusivity ratio. This indicates strong band-dependent scattering. The in-plane upper critical field exceeds the weak-coupling Pauli limit. Measurements of the lower critical field, superfluid density, and electronic specific heat are consistent with an interpretation of a fully gapped superconducting state with two nodeless gaps of different magnitudes.
articles.abstract_zh: 2H-NbSe₂ 的超导本质长期存在多带超导与各向异性单带超导之争，且电荷密度波会干扰对能隙结构的判读。该研究选择随机 Se/S 取代、长程电荷密度波受抑而层状结构保持的单晶 2H-NbSeS 作为研究对象。材料在 6.0 K 以下超导，并表现出中等磁各向异性；其上临界场的明显上弯无法由单带模型解释，却可由脏极限双带模型较好描述，支持存在强带依赖的超导行为。
authors: K. Yadav, M. Lamba K. Bhattacharya, M. Majumder, S. Patnaik

articles.title: Generalized deformation potential and machine-learning approaches for electron-phonon coupling and thermoelectric transport in semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 用于半导体电子-声子耦合与热电输运的广义形变势和机器学习方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19130v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ability to compute electron-phonon coupling from first principles, using density functional perturbation theory and interpolation techniques, has enabled predictive calculations of electronic transport coefficients in crystalline materials. However, these methods are still computationally expensive. Here we present two inexpensive methods to obtain thermoelectric transport properties of semiconductors using a small number of electron-phonon matrix elements calculated from first principles. The first method combines models for coupling of electrons with different phonon modes whose parameters are obtained from sim 10 matrix elements per electronic band and phonon mode calculated from first principles. Within this method, we formulate the acoustic deformation potential model for arbitrary crystal symmetries and band extrema locations. The second method uses machine learning to interpolate sim 100 electron-phonon matrix elements per electronic band and phonon mode on dense reciprocal space grids in the parts of the Brillouin zone relevant for transport. We apply both methods to two-dimensional MoS₂ and show very good agreement with the state-of-the-art method. The calculated thermoelectric properties also agree well with experiments. We find that the machine-learning method is more accurate and straightforward to implement compared to the model approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 第一性原理计算电子-声子耦合已能预测晶体材料输运性质，但计算成本仍然较高。该研究提出两种低成本方法：一种用少量第一性原理矩阵元参数化不同声子模的耦合模型，并将声学形变势模型推广到任意晶体对称性和能带极值位置；另一种用机器学习在与输运相关的布里渊区区域内插电子-声子矩阵元。作者将这些方法应用于二维 MoS₂，并显示其与更完整计算具有良好一致性。

articles.title: Controllable Growth and Characterization of α- and β-phase MnSe by Chemical Vapor Deposition
articles.title_zh: 化学气相沉积可控生长与表征 α 相和 β 相 MnSe
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Manganese selenide (MnSe) is a promising air-stable two-dimensional magnetic semiconductor for which theory predicts robust ferromagnetism in monolayers with Curie temperatures approaching 250 K. However, the crystallographic phases and magnetic properties of thin-film MnSe grown by scalable methods remain poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate the controllable growth of α- and β-phase MnSe on C-face sapphire using a three-zone chemical vapor deposition process with elemental Se and MnCl₂ precursors in an Ar/H₂ atmosphere. Using Raman spectroscopy, atomic force microscopy, scanning electron microscopy, and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, we show that our process yields phase-pure α-MnSe nanorods and β-MnSe triangular flakes with lateral sizes up to 20 μm and thicknesses of 15-30 nm. Low-temperature photoluminescence of the β-phase films reveals a bandgap of approximately 2.0 eV. Systematic variation of growth parameters shows that precursor vapor pressure, rather than H₂ partial pressure, is the dominant factor controlling lateral flake size. Vibrating-sample magnetometry measurements reveal a Néel temperature of 53 K in the β-phase films, providing clear evidence of antiferromagnetism in the multilayer regime and establishing MnSe as a tunable platform for 2D spintronic and optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: MnSe 是一种有前景的空气稳定二维磁性半导体，理论预言其单层可能具有较高居里温度的铁磁性，但可扩展制备薄膜的相结构和磁性质仍不清楚。该研究利用三温区化学气相沉积，在 C 面蓝宝石上以 Se 和 MnCl₂ 为前驱体可控生长 α 相和 β 相 MnSe。表征显示可获得相纯 α-MnSe 纳米棒和 β-MnSe 三角薄片，β 相低温光致发光显示约 2.0 eV 带隙；生长参数分析表明前驱体蒸气压主导横向尺寸，磁测量揭示 β 相存在约 53 K 的 Néel 温度。
authors: Jennifer E. DeMell, Elias Kallon, Michael Pedowitz, Jimmy C. Kostakidis, Ihteyaz Aqaeed Avash, Kevin M. Daniels

articles.title: Cavity Enhanced Superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 腔增强超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19171v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vacuum electromagnetic fluctuations have recently emerged as a promising means of controlling collective quantum phases. Although cavity-induced modifications of superconductivity have been widely predicted, experimental studies have so far reported only suppression of superconducting properties. Here, by carefully tuning a terahertz cavity to resonate with key phononic modes in few-layer niobium diselenide (NbSe2), we demonstrate cavity-enhanced superconductivity in few-layer NbSe2 coupled to a complementary split-ring resonator. In trilayer NbSe2, the superconducting transition temperature increases by ~10%, from 3.02 K to 3.41 K, when coupled to a cavity resonant at 2.04 THz. The enhancement exhibits a clear spatial dependence following the cavity field profile and a non-monotonic frequency dependence, with maximal enhancement near 2 THz. These results provide experimental evidence that vacuum electromagnetic fields can enhance superconductivity and establish cavity engineering as a powerful platform for tailoring quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 真空电磁涨落被认为可调控集体量子相，但此前实验多报道腔对超导性质的抑制。该研究将太赫兹腔调谐至少层 NbSe₂ 的关键声子模附近，并与互补开口环谐振器耦合，观察到腔增强超导。三层 NbSe₂ 的超导转变温度在约 2.04 THz 共振腔耦合下由 3.02 K 提高至 3.41 K，增强效应随腔场空间分布变化并呈非单调频率依赖，证明真空电磁场可用于调控量子材料超导性。
authors: Hanxiang Zhang, Zexin Feng, I-Te Lu, Zhiwei Li, Songhao Guo, Qiuyu Shang, Dening Luan, Mingcheng Panmai, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Angel Rubio, Weibo Gao

articles.title: Constriction-induced modulation of charging energy in a quantum Hall cavity
articles.title_zh: 量子霍尔腔中收缩结构诱导的充电能调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic Fabry-Pérot interferometers (FPIs) operating in the fractional quantum Hall regime are a key platform for probing anyonic braiding statistics, yet interpreting their interference signals is complicated by Coulomb charging effects, which are commonly treated as parasitic, static properties governed by the cavity's geometry and electrostatics. Here, using a gate-defined quantum Hall cavity tuned to the Coulomb-dominated regime, we demonstrate that the charging energy is in fact strongly and non-monotonically modulated by the magnetic field, varying by up to 60% over a range of only 100 mT. The effect appears exclusively when the quantum point contacts (QPCs) forming the cavity are weakly pinched off, i.e., in the strong cavity-to-lead coupling regime. By correlating the charging energy modulation with the QPC magneto-conductance, we attribute this behavior to field-dependent changes in local compressibility and electrostatic screening between the cavity and the leads, driven by the formation of incompressible fractional quantum Hall states within the constrictions. This result establishes QPC constrictions of quantum Hall cavities as active electrostatic elements rather than passive boundaries, revealing a dynamic screening mechanism, with direct consequences for the interpretation of interference measurements and the extraction of anyonic statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数量子霍尔区的电子 Fabry–Pérot 干涉仪是研究任意子编织统计的重要平台，但库仑充电效应会复杂化干涉信号解释。该研究在门控量子霍尔腔的库仑主导区发现，充电能会随磁场强烈且非单调变化，在 100 mT 范围内变化可达 60%。这种效应仅在形成腔的量子点接触弱夹断、即腔与引线强耦合时出现，作者将其归因于收缩区域内不可压缩分数量子霍尔态形成导致的局域可压缩性和静电屏蔽变化。
authors: Emily Hajigeorgiou, Arup Kumar Paul, Mario Di Luca, Vladimir Umansky, Moty Heiblum, Mitali Banerjee

articles.title: Mapping the non-equilibrium interacting Anderson Impurity Model to an effective Gaussian theory
articles.title_zh: 将非平衡相互作用 Anderson 杂质模型映射为有效高斯理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19206v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum impurity models with strong electron correlations, such as the paradigmatic Anderson Impurity Model (AIM), are central to our understanding of a range of physical phenomena including local moment formation, Coulomb blockade and Kondo screening. They describe magnetic atoms and molecules on surfaces, quantum dot circuits, and correlated materials through dynamical mean field theory. The physics of such systems in strongly non-equilibrium conditions is particularly complex and challenging to capture, whereas Gaussian models of free fermions can be easily solved. Here we show that the time-evolving dynamics of the AIM after a quench can be described by a completely non-interacting version of the model, at the expense of coupling to additional static auxiliary degrees of freedom. Starting from the full solution of the quenched AIM using ED and DMRG, we study the properties of this mapping using numerical optimization, and uncover intriguing structure in the auxiliary system. The method allows us to understand interacting non-equilibrium dynamics through the simpler lens of an effective non-interacting system of larger dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 强关联量子杂质模型，尤其是 Anderson 杂质模型，是理解局域磁矩、库仑阻塞和 Kondo 屏蔽等现象的核心工具，但其强非平衡动力学难以处理。该研究表明，淬火后 Anderson 杂质模型的时间演化可由一个完全非相互作用模型描述，代价是引入额外静态辅助自由度。作者基于精确对角化和 DMRG 的完整解，通过数值优化研究该映射，显示相互作用非平衡动力学可在更高维有效自由费米体系中得到理解。
authors: Emmanuel Bogacz, Graham Kells, Andrew K. Mitchell

articles.title: Spin point group symmetry and classification of non-relativistic spin splitting in non-collinear magnetic structures: Identification of high-order spin splitting types (l=5,7, and 9)
articles.title_zh: 非共线磁结构中非相对论自旋劈裂的自旋点群对称性与分类：高阶自旋劈裂类型（l=5、7 和 9）的识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19254v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A comprehensive study of the possible types of non-relativistic spin splitting of electronic bands in coplanar and non-coplanar magnetic structures is presented on the basis of spin-group theory. First, we tabulate all non-equivalent spin point groups (SpPGs) which can be expressed as a direct product of a nontrivial part and a spin-only group limited to be the intrinsic (trivial) one, or augmented by the time-reversal (TR) operation. This tabulation, which includes the listing of symmetry operations for 1249 nonequivalent SpPGs, is now available as an online database SPGENPOS in the Bilbao Crystallographic Server (BCS). This extends previous enumerations, in which the possible presence of TR in the magnetic point group was not taken into account, thus overlooking the full SpPG symmetry associated with the numerous magnetic structures which have a magnetic space group of type IV. For each of the listed coplanar and non-coplanar SpPGs, the spin-splitting that is symmetry allowed is analyzed in detail using the program STENSOR also in the BCS. Except for the SpPGs that include the operation 1', i.e., the combined operation of TR and space inversion, all other coplanar and non-coplanar SpPGs allow spin splitting at some order in a power expansion of the electron wave vector components. We find that, depending on the SpPG, spin-splitting terms can appear with the lowest-order monomials ranging from l=0 to 9, with the exception of l=8. This contrasts with the collinear case, where the lowest order is not higher than l=6, and where TR forbids any spin splitting. For the newly identified spin textures with powers l=5, 7, and 9, which are possible in some noncentrosymmetric SpPGs, the functional form of the spin splitting in terms of the components of the crystal momentum is given. One example of a real material, LaMnAu5, showing l=5 spin splitting is identified.
