articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对圈量子引力中Ashtekar-Lewandowski体积算符通常依赖稠密有限重耦矩阵谱分解、难以扩展到大希尔伯特空间或高价顶点的问题，提出一种在标准重耦基中的无矩阵作用方法。该方法利用Brunnemann-Thiemann形式局部生成定向体积密度的矩阵元，并通过Balakrishnan-Stieltjes表示和移位预解式求积近似体积算符。作者证明了体积核的精确保留，给出误差估计，并在小自旋截断的嵌入K5图上与精确稠密局部块算符进行了数值验证。

articles.title: Towards Entanglement-Enhanced Atom Interferometry Using Bow-Tie Cavities
articles.title_zh: 迈向利用蝴蝶结腔实现纠缠增强原子干涉测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18552v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Atom interferometers are among the most sensitive instruments for precision measurements and tests of fundamental physics. Their performance, however, is ultimately limited by quantum projection noise when uncorrelated atomic ensembles are employed. Cavity-assisted generation of entangled states has proven to be a promising route toward quantum-enhanced interferometry beyond the standard quantum limit. In this work, we present the realization and characterization of a monolithic bow-tie cavity developed to achieve a strong collective atom-light coupling with strontium atoms. Unlike conventional standing-wave Fabry-Pérot resonators, the traveling-wave geometry of the bow-tie cavity provides homogeneous atom-light coupling over the entire atomic ensemble, making it particularly suitable for entanglement-enhanced atom interferometry with freely falling atoms. The monolithic cavity architecture presents several scientifically relevant features such as high mechanical stability, high finesse, robustness against mirror misalignment, optical and atomic access and the option of generating squeezed states through different strategies. The cavity was realized for operation on the strontium (5s²⁾ ¹S₀₋₍₅ₛ₅ₚ₎ ³P₁ transition at 689 nm and achieves a finesse of F=5.7× 10⁴ while keeping the transmission of a single mirror sufficiently large to allow for efficient atomic information extraction. In this geometry, the cavity supports two foci with waists of 164 μm and 31 μm which gives access to different regimes of atom-cavity coupling. For ensembles containing up to 10⁵ atoms, the cavity is expected to enable metrological gains approaching 24 dB of spin squeezing through cavity-feedback squeezing, and 28 dB through quantum non-demolition measurements, demonstrating its potential as a platform for next-generation quantum-enhanced atom interferometers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作介绍并表征了一种单片式蝴蝶结光学腔，旨在增强锶原子与光场的集体耦合，以服务于超越标准量子极限的纠缠增强原子干涉测量。与传统驻波Fabry-Pérot腔不同，蝴蝶结腔的行波几何可在整个原子团中提供更均匀的原子-光耦合，尤其适合自由下落原子体系。该单片腔结构具有高机械稳定性、高精细度、抗镜面失准能力以及良好的光学和原子通道，并可支持多种压缩态生成策略。
authors: Christian Mancini, Marco Malitesta, Tommaso Mariani, Annalisa Pappalardo, Giuseppe Vinelli, Paolo Vezio, Gabriele Rosi, Enrico Meli, Leonardo Salvi, Guglielmo Maria Tino

articles.title: Trainable Photonic Measurement for Physics-Informed PDE Learning
articles.title_zh: 用于物理信息偏微分方程学习的可训练光子测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18713v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Photonic quantum machine learning offers a route to trainable physical representations built from phase, interference and measurement. However, its role in scientific machine learning remains largely unexplored. Physics-informed neural fields provide a natural setting, because differential equations require trial spaces that preserve phase, frequency and derivative structure. Here we introduce a photonic quantum neural field in which coordinates become trainable optical phases, are mixed by multi-photon Fock-space interference and are decoded from photon-number measurements. The photonic circuit is optimized as the neural-field representation itself, not as a fixed feature map or hardware accelerator. Photonic measurement is therefore a trainable representation on which the physics-informed residual is minimized. Across seven elliptic, wave, nonlinear dispersive and inverse PDE benchmarks, we observe a phase-complexity transition: classical coordinate and Fourier-feature networks suffice in smooth regimes, whereas the photonic field is most accurate when residual derivatives amplify phase mismatch. In the hardest regimes it gives the lowest errors, with margins reaching an order of magnitude and about one quarter of the trainable parameters of classical baselines. Frozen and shuffled controls, together with noise stress tests, attribute this gain to learned interference and stable Fock-probability readout under compound perturbations. These results identify photonic quantum measurement as a representation-learning principle for scientific machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种光子量子神经场，将坐标编码为可训练的光学相位，经多光子 Fock 空间干涉混合，并通过光子数测量解码。与固定特征映射或硬件加速器不同，光子线路本身作为神经场表示进行优化，在其上最小化物理信息残差。作者在多类椭圆型、波动型、非线性色散和反问题 PDE 基准上观察到相位复杂度转变：平滑情形中经典坐标或傅里叶特征网络已足够，而在残差导数放大相位失配的困难情形中，光子场表现更具优势。
authors: Jiale Linghu, Hao Dong, Yangshuai Wang

articles.title: Sensitive endoscopic diamond magnetometer for non-contact sensing in confined environments
articles.title_zh: 用于受限环境非接触传感的高灵敏内窥式金刚石磁强计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18871v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Transitioning quantum magnetometry from laboratory environments to real-world applications has been limited by a persistent trade-off between sensor miniaturization and magnetic sensitivity. While bulky systems can achieve high sensitivity, endoscopic probes commonly suffer from inefficient fluorescence collection and reduced performance. Here we resolve this trade-off and present a miniaturized diamond quantum magnetometer with a 6 mm diameter endoscopic sensor head, achieving a magnetic-field sensitivity of 91 pT/sqrt(Hz) with a 2 kHz measurement bandwidth in a magnetically unshielded environment. The fluorescence collection bottleneck is overcome by separating excitation and collection into different cores of a fused multi-core fiber bundle, coupled to the diamond through a custom high-numerical-aperture micro-objective. A compact FPGA-based backend performs microwave control, lock-in detection and real-time resonance tracking, enabling robust operation during magnetic-field imaging. To demonstrate the practical utility of the miniaturized sensor, we image the magnetic field of a commercial lithium-ion pouch cell during charge and discharge and reconstruct depth-integrated current-density maps of the current flow. These results show that endoscopic diamond magnetometers can combine high sensitivity with a probe geometry suitable for confined, unshielded measurements, opening new avenues in battery technology and beyond.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种小型化金刚石量子磁强计，传感头直径为 6 mm，并在无磁屏蔽环境中实现了 91 pT/√Hz 的磁场灵敏度和 2 kHz 测量带宽。其关键设计是利用熔融多芯光纤束的不同纤芯分别进行激发与荧光收集，并通过定制高数值孔径微物镜与金刚石耦合，从而缓解小型探头中的荧光收集瓶颈。系统还集成了基于 FPGA 的紧凑后端，用于微波控制、锁相检测和实时共振跟踪，并以商用锂离子软包电池充电过程中的磁场成像展示了应用潜力。

articles.title: A Hybrid LSTM--Vision Transformer Architecture for Predicting HRRR Forecast Errors
articles.title_zh: 用于预测 HRRR 预报误差的混合 LSTM—视觉 Transformer 架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19026v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Forecast errors in high-resolution numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems are often linked to unresolved planetary boundary layer (PBL) processes, convection, terrain-induced circulations, and other vertically structured atmospheric phenomena. Previous work demonstrated that Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks can successfully predict forecast errors in the High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR) model using mesonet observations, but we believe performance degradation is linked to periods of complex vertical atmospheric evolution. To address this limitation, we develop a hybrid LSTM-Vision Transformer (LSTM-ViT) framework that combines temporal sequence learning from surface observations with atmospheric profiles from the New York State Mesonet profiler network. The LSTM-ViT framework is trained to predict HRRR hourly precipitation, 10 m wind speed, and 2 m temperature forecast errors at individual mesonet stations. Across all three predictors, incorporation of profiler-derived atmospheric structure improves forecast error prediction skill relative to the baseline LSTM architecture, with the largest gains occurring at shorter forecast lead times and during periods of enhanced PBL activity. Improvements are particularly pronounced for precipitation forecast error, where the LSTM-ViT framework achieves approximately a twofold increase in predictive skill relative to the baseline LSTM while better capturing convectively driven error evolution and reducing degradation associated with PBL processes. These results demonstrate that combining temporal sequence learning with vertically informed attention mechanisms provides a physically meaningful pathway for improving forecast error prediction in operational NWP systems. Our research offers forecasters enhanced guidance regarding model bias and forecast confidence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对高分辨率数值天气预报中与边界层过程、对流、地形环流及垂直结构演变相关的误差，提出混合 LSTM-ViT 框架。该框架将地面观测的时间序列学习与纽约州 Mesonet 探空/廓线网络提供的大气垂直剖面信息结合，用于预测单站点 HRRR 的逐小时降水、10 m 风速和 2 m 气温预报误差。结果表明，加入廓线导出的垂直大气结构后，相比基线 LSTM，在三类预报量上均提升了误差预测能力，尤其在较短预报时效上收益更明显。
authors: David Aaron Evans, Jay C. Rothenberger, Kara J. Sulia, Nick P. Bassill, Chris D. Thorncroft

articles.title: Charged excitations made neutral: N-centered ensemble density functional theory of Fukui functions
articles.title_zh: 使带电激发中性化：Fukui 函数的 N 中心系综密度泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.02985v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An in-principle exact working equation to compute electronic affinity and ionization Fukui functions is derived within the N-centered (Nc) ensemble extension of density functional theory (DFT). It circumvents the kernel derivative discontinuity problem of DFT for fractional electron numbers, whose contribution is recovered through weight derivatives of the ensemble density functional potential. Thus, it allows for the design of alternative and effective approximations, such as the weight-dependent scaling of regular functionals or the interpolation between known limits of Nc ensembles
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在 N 中心系综密度泛函理论框架下，推导了原则上精确的电子亲和与电离 Fukui 函数工作方程。该方法绕开了分数电子数 DFT 中核导数不连续的问题，并通过系综密度泛函势的权重导数恢复相应贡献。研究还指出，该形式有助于构造替代性有效近似，例如对常规泛函进行权重依赖缩放，或在 N 中心系综的已知极限之间插值。

articles.title: Scattering at Space-Time Interfaces between Dispersive Media
articles.title_zh: 色散介质之间时空界面处的散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.00893v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dynamic modulation of material properties in space and time enables powerful control over wave propagation, yet existing theories largely rely on idealized, nondispersive models. In realistic media, frequency dispersion can strongly reshape wave dynamics, especially near resonances in highly dispersive platforms such as epsilon-near-zero materials. Here, we develop a general frequency transition theory for electromagnetic scattering at moving interfaces between dispersive media. From phase continuity, we derive nonlinear frequency transition relations and show that dispersion fundamentally reshapes the space-time scattering landscape, enabling additional propagating solutions with no counterpart in nondispersive systems. Applied to Drude, Lorentz and double-Drude media, the theory reveals how resonant dispersion, material loss and negative-index branches reorganize the scattering channels. For the two-wave scattering class, we further introduce a mixed-domain formulation that combines time-domain interface kinematics with frequency-domain constitutive relations, yielding closed-form scattering coefficients. These results establish a unified framework for dispersive space-time scattering and open opportunities for dispersion-based transition engineering in realistic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究发展了电磁波在色散介质运动界面处散射的一般频率跃迁理论，以弥补现有理论多依赖理想无色散模型的不足。作者从相位连续性出发推导非线性频率跃迁关系，表明色散会根本性改变时空散射图景，并产生无色散系统中不存在的额外传播解。将理论应用于 Drude、Lorentz 和双 Drude 介质后，研究揭示了共振色散、材料损耗和负折射率分支对散射通道的重组作用，并为双波散射情形给出了混合域闭式散射系数公式。

articles.title: Pressure gradient-driven plasma flows and magnetogenesis
articles.title_zh: 压力梯度驱动的等离子体流动与磁场生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.09194v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a self-consistent two-fluid theory demonstrating that pressure gradients simultaneously generate plasma flows and magnetic fields. We show that compatibility between ion momentum balance and mass conservation imposes a previously unrecognized constraint on plasma evolution: the total pressure must satisfy the Laplace equation, nabla² p = 0. This condition yields a class of exact analytical solutions in which pressure-driven flows and Biermann-type magnetic fields emerge together. Application of the model to a galactic gas clump reveals that, under thermal pressure, electrons and ions move almost together, giving rise to weak currents and consequently very small seed magnetic fields. Ion dynamics are also important for determining the seed magnetic-field generation time τ_B and for estimating the ion flow velocity. The model is further applied to laser-produced plasma to describe its short-time evolution. The present theory provides a unified, self-consistent description of pressure-driven flow generation and magnetogenesis in both astrophysical and laboratory plasmas.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种自洽双流体理论，说明压力梯度可同时产生等离子体流动和磁场。作者指出，离子动量平衡与质量守恒的相容性要求总压力满足拉普拉斯方程，从而得到一类压力驱动流动与 Biermann 型磁场共同出现的精确解析解。模型应用于星系气体团和激光产生等离子体，表明在热压作用下电子和离子近乎共同运动，电流和种子磁场较弱，同时离子动力学对磁场生成时间和离子流速估计具有重要影响。

articles.title: Parametric Operator Inference to Simulate the Purging Process in Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.title_zh: 用于模拟半导体制造吹扫过程的参数化算子推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.03990v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This work presents the application of parametric Operator Inference (OpInf) -- a nonintrusive reduced-order modeling (ROM) technique that learns a low-dimensional representation of a high-fidelity model -- to the numerical model of the purging process in semiconductor manufacturing. Leveraging the data-driven nature of the OpInf framework, we aim to forecast the flow field within a plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD) chamber using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation data. Our model simplifies the system by excluding plasma dynamics and chemical reactions, while still capturing the key features of the purging flow behavior. The parametric OpInf framework learns nine ROMs based on varying argon mass flow rates at the inlet and different outlet pressures. It then interpolates these ROMs to predict the system's behavior for 25 parameter combinations, including 16 scenarios that are not seen in training. The parametric OpInf ROMs, trained on 36% of the data and tested on 64%, demonstrate accuracy across the entire parameter domain, with a maximum error of 9.32%. Furthermore, the ROM achieves an approximate 142-fold speedup in online computations compared to the full-order model CFD simulation. These OpInf ROMs may be used for fast and accurate predictions of the purging flow in the PECVD chamber, which could facilitate effective particle contamination control in semiconductor manufacturing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将参数化算子推断（OpInf）这一非侵入式降阶建模方法应用于半导体制造中 PECVD 腔体吹扫过程的数值模型。研究利用 CFD 数据学习低维模型，以预测腔体内流场；模型简化时不包含等离子体动力学和化学反应，但保留吹扫流动的关键特征。参数化 OpInf 在不同氩气入口质量流量和出口压力下学习多个降阶模型，并对未见参数组合进行插值预测，在较少训练数据下于整个参数域保持较好精度。
authors: Seunghyon Kang, Hyeonghun Kim, Boris Kramer

articles.title: Formation and Localization of Four-wing Attractor in Phase space
articles.title_zh: 相空间中四翼吸引子的形成与局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.07577v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A chaotic attractor is formed in a finite region in phase space by the long-term trajectory of a three or higher-dimensional dissipative system. The attractor is a fractional-dimensional geometry, whose dimension is a fraction but less than the dimension of the phase space. The geometry of an attractor can be as complex as a multi-wing geometry. The emergence and confinement of such a complex geometrical attractor can be understood by the Nambu mechanics without numerically solving the governing equations of the dynamics. In this article, we show that the four-wing geometry of an attractor appears in the phase space by the intersection of two energy-like Hamiltonian functions. We further show that the dynamical equations require the localization range of these surfaces so that their intersection is confined to a certain region of the phase space. We analytically find the required conditions based on the system parameters for the localization of the attractor.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究三维或更高维耗散系统中复杂多翼混沌吸引子的形成与限制机制。作者借助 Nambu 力学说明，四翼吸引子的几何形态可理解为两个类能量哈密顿函数在相空间中的交线。进一步地，文章从动力学方程出发给出这些曲面必须满足的局域化范围，并基于系统参数解析推导吸引子被限制在有限区域内的条件。

articles.title: Experimental measurement of quantum first-passage-time distributions
articles.title_zh: 量子首次通过时间分布的实验测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.21790v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Classical First-Passage-Time Distributions (FPTDs) have been extensively studied both theoretically and experimentally. Their quantum counterparts-Quantum First-Passage-Time Distributions (QFPTDs)-remain largely unexplored and have deep implications for both fundamental physics and the development of emerging quantum technologies. We measure the first QFPTDs using a motional mode of a single trapped ion. We develop a novel composite-phase laser pulse sequence to perform tunable stroboscopic single-shot projective measurements of the motional state of a trapped ion. We measure QFPTDs of the ion energy when coupled to electric-field noise. The measurement protocol developed here is broadly applicable to other quantum systems and provides a powerful method for exploring a broad range of QFPTD phenomena. With these results we open a new field of experimental investigations of QFPT processes with potential future relevance to quantum search algorithms, unraveling connections between classical and quantum dynamics, and study of the quantum measurement problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用单个俘获离子的运动模首次测量了量子首次通过时间分布。作者开发了一种复合相位激光脉冲序列，可对俘获离子的运动态执行可调谐的频闪式单次投影测量，并在离子耦合到电场噪声时测量其能量的量子首次通过时间分布。该测量方案有望推广到其他量子系统，为研究量子首次通过过程、量子搜索、经典—量子动力学联系以及量子测量问题提供实验工具。
authors: Joseph M. Ryan, Simon Gorbaty, Thomas J. Kessler, Mitchell G. Peaks, Stephen W. Teitsworth, Crystal Noel

articles.title: Hybrid quantum memory leveraging slow-light and gradient-echo duality
articles.title_zh: 利用慢光与梯度回波对偶性的混合量子存储器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.02810v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We demonstrate a hybrid quantum memory that combines Gradient Echo Memory (GEM) and Electromagnetically Induced Transparency (EIT) protocols for reversible mapping between light and atomic coherence. By leveraging GEM and EIT complementarity, we realize time-to-frequency and frequency-to-time conversion mechanisms for spectro-temporal modes. This capability provides a versatile tool for quantum communication, where coherent frequency-time conversion enhances network interoperability. In addition, the protocol may enable fundamental studies of atomic coherence, including investigations of Rydberg polaritons and mapping of single Rydberg excitations and ionic impurities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作演示了一种结合梯度回波存储（GEM）和电磁感应透明（EIT）协议的混合量子存储器，实现光与原子相干之间的可逆映射。通过利用 GEM 与 EIT 的互补性，该方案可对谱—时间模式进行时间到频率以及频率到时间的转换。该能力可用于量子通信中的相干频时转换和网络互操作，并可能支持对原子相干、Rydberg 极化激元、单个 Rydberg 激发及离子杂质映射的基础研究。
authors: Stanisław Kurzyna, Mateusz Mazelanik, Wojciech Wasilewski, Michał Parniak

articles.title: Sampling two-dimensional isometric tensor network states
articles.title_zh: 二维等距张量网络态的采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.02245v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sampling a quantum system's underlying probability distributions is an important computational task, e.g., for quantum advantage experiments and quantum Monte Carlo algorithms. Tensor networks are an invaluable tool for efficiently representing states of large quantum systems with limited entanglement. Algorithms for sampling one-dimensional (1D) tensor networks are well-established and utilized in several 1D tensor network methods. In this paper we introduce two novel sampling algorithms for two-dimensional (2D) isometric tensor network states (isoTNS) that generalize existing 1D tensor networks sampling algorithms. Our first proposed algorithm performs independent sampling and yields a single configuration together with its associated probability. The second algorithm employs a greedy search strategy to identify K high-probability configurations and their corresponding probabilities. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of these algorithms across quantum states with varying entanglement and system size.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出两种用于二维等距张量网络态（isoTNS）的新采样算法，将一维张量网络中的成熟采样思想推广到二维情形。第一种算法执行独立采样，输出单个构型及其对应概率；第二种算法采用贪婪搜索以识别 K 个高概率构型及其概率。数值结果显示，这些算法在不同纠缠强度和系统尺寸的量子态上均具有有效性。
authors: Alec Dektor, Eugene Dumitrescu, Chao Yang

articles.title: Gaussian Mixture Attention: Linear-Time Sequence Mixing via Probabilistic Latent Routing
articles.title_zh: 高斯混合注意力：通过概率潜在路由实现线性时间序列混合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18283v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dense token-to-token interaction pattern of standard dot-product attention remains a central bottleneck in scaling Transformer architectures to long contexts. We introduce Gaussian Mixture Attention (GMA), a probabilistic attention-style sequence mixer that replaces explicit pairwise query--key comparison with routing through K learned Gaussian mixture components. Queries and keys are mapped to posterior responsibility vectors over a shared latent routing space; their overlap defines an implicit responsibility-space affinity, while values are written into and read from a K-slot latent memory. By exploiting the associativity of matrix multiplication, GMA avoids materializing the induced N× N affinity matrix and instead uses two responsibility matrices whose dominant activation storage scales as O(NK) rather than O(N²⁾ for fixed K. We formulate bidirectional and causal variants of GMA, provide an end-to-end differentiable parameterization of the Gaussian mixture components, and analyze its responsibility-modulated gradient structure, constrained non-negative low-rank affinity interpretation, and local routing stability. Empirically, GMA exhibits the intended fixed-K linear memory scaling and is competitive with attention-style baselines on long-context classification, while causal GMA improves over tested linear/random-feature attention variants on WikiText-103 but remains behind optimized causal SDPA and Mamba in the current implementation. Analysis of learned responsibilities further shows broad component usage and moderate alignment with surface-form token categories, supporting GMA as a probabilistic, interpretable, fixed-K linear-time attention-style alternative rather than a universal replacement for optimized softmax attention or state-space models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出高斯混合注意力（GMA），用K个可学习高斯混合成分的潜在路由替代标准注意力中的显式查询—键两两比较。查询与键被映射为共享潜在空间中的后验责任向量，值则写入并读取自K槽潜在记忆，从而在固定K时将主要激活存储从O(N²)降至O(NK)。论文给出双向与因果版本，并分析其梯度结构、非负低秩亲和解释与局部路由稳定性。

articles.title: TRIDENT: Breaking the Hybrid-Safety-Physics Coupling for Provably Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: TRIDENT：打破混合动作—安全—物理耦合的可证明安全多智能体强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Safe coordination in networked cyber-physical systems forces learning algorithms to simultaneously handle hybrid discrete-continuous actions, hard training-time safety constraints, and physics-governed dynamics. We show that these three features form a directed cycle of biases that defeats any naive composition of off-the-shelf modules, and formalize this as a three-way coupling lemma. We then introduce TRIDENT, the first MARL framework whose three components are co-designed to cancel each leak: a Richardson-Romberg gradient correction reducing Gumbel-Softmax bias from O(tau) to O(tau²⁾, a Lyapunov-constrained sequential trust-region update enforcing per-iterate feasibility, and a physics-informed residual critic that decomposes value rather than reward. We prove an O~(1/sqrt(K)) convergence rate to a constrained Nash equilibrium and an O(sqrt(K)) cumulative-violation bound. On multi-UAV mobile-edge computing, autonomous intersection management, and a hybrid SMAC variant, TRIDENT cuts training-time violations by 95.5% over MADDPG and 76.3% over MACPO, while improving reward by 13.5% over the strongest unconstrained baseline.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究网络化信息物理系统中的安全多智能体强化学习，指出离散—连续混合动作、训练期硬安全约束与物理动力学会形成相互放大的偏差耦合。作者提出TRIDENT框架，结合Richardson-Romberg梯度校正、Lyapunov约束的顺序信赖域更新和物理信息残差评论器，以减少偏差并保证逐步可行性。理论上证明其收敛到约束纳什均衡的速率和累计违规界，实验中在多无人机边缘计算、自动路口管理和混合SMAC任务上显著降低训练期违规并提升回报。
authors: Zijie Meng, Ziwei Li, Yufei Liu, Zhiyu Li, Jiyuan Liu, Wenhua Nie, Bingcai Wei, Miao Zhang

articles.title: Quantum Annealing Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Accurate Remaining Useful Lifetime Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于精确剩余使用寿命预测的量子退火增强强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) estimation is central to predictive maintenance, where an unplanned failure can cost far more than the asset itself. Statistical degradation models miss the strong nonlinearity of real systems, and data-driven models often converge to suboptimal solutions in high-dimensional, non-convex search spaces. We propose a Quantum Annealing enhanced Q-Learning (QAQL) framework that couples the sampling behaviour of quantum annealing with the sequential decision making of Q-learning. Each Q-value update is encoded as a small quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) whose ground state is the greedy action; rather than acting as a deterministic optimizer, the annealer returns a distribution over near-optimal actions across many reads, and this stochastic action selection supplies the exploration that curbs premature convergence on nonlinear degradation trajectories. The QUBO is solved on the D-Wave Advantage system using minor embedding, with the annealer woven into the reinforcement-learning loop rather than bolted on after training. We validate QAQL on two public benchmarks: the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan engine datasets and a device-fleet predictive maintenance dataset. Averaged over many independent runs and across six error metrics, QAQL outperforms the classical and quantum baselines considered in this study, with statistically significant improvements. The results indicate that quantum annealing is a usable, not merely theoretical, optimizer inside a reinforcement-learning loop for industrial predictive-maintenance applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出量子退火增强Q学习（QAQL）框架，用于预测性维护中的剩余使用寿命估计。方法将每次Q值更新编码为小规模QUBO问题，并利用D-Wave量子退火器返回近优动作分布，为强化学习过程提供随机探索，从而缓解高维非凸退化轨迹中的过早收敛。作者在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机等公开基准上验证该方法，重点展示量子退火与序贯决策学习的深度结合。
authors: Manoranjan Gandhudi, Arunkumar V., G. R. Anil, Gangadharan G. R

articles.title: Dual-Channel Grounded World Modeling (DCGWM): Structural Prevention of Objective Interference Collapse via Heterogeneous External Grounding with Inward-Only Gradient Flow
articles.title_zh: 双通道具身世界建模（DCGWM）：通过异质外部锚定与仅向内梯度流从结构上防止目标干扰坍缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18688v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are a leading approach to world model representation learning. We identify a failure mode in JEPA-based world models grounded against two qualitatively distinct external signals: physical dynamics (sparse, high-magnitude, constraint-satisfying gradient corrections) and social-behavioral dynamics (diffuse, distribution-matching corrections). We term this Objective Interference Collapse (OIC): we argue that joint learning in a shared latent space causes the dominant channel to systematically collapse the subordinate channel's representational subspace, in a manner not resolvable by loss weighting alone. We propose Dual-Channel Grounded World Modeling (DCGWM), designed to structurally prevent OIC through a partitioned latent space (physical subspace Zₚ, behavioral subspace Z_b) with inward-only gradient flow. A Physical Grounding Channel updates only Zₚ via VICReg-style alignment to physical measurements; a Social-Behavioral Grounding Channel updates only Z_b via alignment to trajectories from an emergent multi-agent simulation. An Inter-Channel Interface Module couples the subspaces at the task level without cross-subspace gradients. An Asymmetric Grounding Adherence Loss penalizes rollout drift with a hard hinge for physical violations and a soft KL for behavioral divergence. A Generative Rendering Layer is architecturally isolated from the latent world model. We present three theoretical results: the partition removes the gradient-interference pathway implicated in OIC; each grounded subspace inherits anti-collapse guarantees from its alignment objective; and generative isolation is necessary under a stated assumption on the generative objective's geometry. This manuscript establishes the problem formulation and architecture; experimental validation is ongoing and will be reported in a future revision.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注联合嵌入预测架构世界模型在同时对齐物理动力学与社会行为动力学信号时可能出现的目标干扰坍缩问题。作者认为共享潜在空间中的联合学习会使占优信号压制次级通道的表征子空间，且仅靠损失加权难以解决。为此提出DCGWM，将潜在空间划分为物理子空间和行为子空间，并通过仅向内的梯度流分别进行物理测量对齐与多智能体行为轨迹对齐，同时用通道接口模块进行受控耦合。

articles.title: Stealthy World Model Manipulation via Data Poisoning
articles.title_zh: 通过数据投毒对世界模型进行隐蔽操纵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model-based learning agents use learned world models to predict future states, plan actions, and adapt to new environments. However, the process of updating world models from collected experience creates a training-time attack surface: adversarially poisoned fine-tuning trajectories can manipulate the learned dynamics and thereby corrupt downstream planning. In this paper, we propose SWAAP, the first two-stage data poisoning framework for learned world models. In the first stage, SWAAP identifies a harmful target world model that induces low-return behavior under planning while remaining close to clean dynamics, using first-order bilevel optimization enabled by a transition-gradient theorem. In the second stage, SWAAP realizes this target through stealth-constrained gradient matching, modifying only a limited fraction of fine-tuning transition targets so that the induced training gradients steer the victim model toward the adversarial target, while a prediction-error regularizer encourages the poisoned targets to remain close to the world model's natural approximation error. To assess attack stealthiness, we evaluate defenses and detectability across three stages of the poisoning pipeline: pre-training detection of poisoned transitions, robust training during fine-tuning, and test-time monitoring of the resulting world model. Across diverse continuous-control tasks, SWAAP causes substantial performance degradation while keeping poisoned transitions close to clean data and evading the evaluated non-adaptive residual/CUSUM/TRIM-style defenses. These results reveal a practical vulnerability in world-model adaptation pipelines and highlight the need for robustness methods that protect both world-model training data and learned dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究基于模型的学习智能体在用收集经验微调世界模型时面临的训练期数据投毒风险。作者提出SWAAP，两阶段地寻找会诱导低回报规划行为且接近干净动力学的目标世界模型，并通过带隐蔽约束的梯度匹配修改有限比例的微调转移目标。方法利用预测误差正则使投毒样本保持在模型自然近似误差附近，以增强隐蔽性，并评估相关防御与检测手段。
authors: Yibin Hu, Xiaolin Sun, Zizhan Zheng

articles.title: GrapNet: A Programmable Dynamic-Architecture Neural Graph Substrate
articles.title_zh: GrapNet：一种可编程的动态架构神经图基底
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Programmability is a missing first-class interface in fixed-tensor neural networks: editing a relation, freezing a subgraph, auditing a local function, or changing the execution backend should be an operation on the neural program rather than ad-hoc parameter surgery. GrapNet studies this graph-as-network setting. The graph is the architecture and executable program, not an input data graph. Each compute node owns its next-layer child references and a trainable allocation vector aligned with those references; deleting a relation physically removes both the child reference and the corresponding allocation coordinate. Structural rules and execution policies live outside the node core, so the same child-owned graph can be grown, frozen, structurally edited, grouped into trainable family blocks, routed by attention over active relations, or lowered to dense snapshots after topology stabilizes. GrapNet composes with conventional modules through a vector-valued parent interface: dense layers, CNN encoders, ResNet feature extractors, attention blocks, and transformer representations can all feed one sensory GrapNode per coordinate. The evaluation is organized as a programmability stress suite rather than as a new replay benchmark. In a matched ten-seed Split Fashion-MNIST study, a plastic GrapNet+ER head reaches 63.16 percent seen-class accuracy versus 51.08 percent for a parameter-larger dense MLP+ER under the same seen-class loss and replay memory, with paired delta 12.08 points and p=1.3e-5. On Split CIFAR-10 with a frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 encoder, the same substrate improves the online head over MLP-256 by 3.81 points, with p=0.0026. These results support GrapNet as an editable neural graph substrate whose core value is structural programmability with faithful execution views.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出GrapNet，将图本身视为神经网络的架构与可执行程序，而非输入数据图。每个计算节点维护下一层子节点引用及对应的可训练分配向量，关系删除会同时移除结构连接与参数坐标，从而支持编辑关系、冻结子图、审计局部函数和切换执行后端等可编程操作。GrapNet还能通过向量化父接口与常规模块组合，使CNN、ResNet、注意力块和Transformer表征等输入到图节点中。

articles.title: Geometric and Stochastic Analysis of Discontinuities in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
articles.title_zh: 稀疏混合专家模型中不连续性的几何与随机分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) architectures are now widely deployed in state-of-the-art language and vision models, where conditional routing allows scaling to very large networks. However, this very Top-k expert selection that enables conditional routing also renders the SMoE map inherently discontinuous. In the vicinity of these discontinuity surfaces, even inputs that are arbitrarily close may activate substantially different sets of experts resulting in significantly different outputs. In this work we give a rigorous geometric and stochastic analysis of these discontinuities. We first classify them by order, determined by the number of tied experts at a switching event. Using measure-theoretic slicing arguments, we establish asymptotic volume estimates for the thickened discontinuity surfaces, showing that lower-order discontinuity sets dominate, whereas higher-order ones occupy a vanishingly small relative volume. Next, modeling random perturbations in the input space via a diffusion process, we prove that the path eventually encounter a discontinuity, and moreover that the first hit almost surely occurs on an order-1 discontinuity with explicit finite-time probability bounds. We further derive occupation-time bounds that quantify the duration the random path spend in the neighborhoods of each discontinuity order. These theoretical results imply that inputs are more likely to lie near lower order discontinuities. Motivated by this insight, we propose a simple smoothing mechanism that can be directly applied to existing SMoEs, softly incorporating experts near discontinuities; our analysis guarantees that the added computational overhead remains small while providing localized smoothing near discontinuities, and experiments across language and vision tasks show that smoothing not only enforces continuity of the SMoE map but also enhances empirical performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文对稀疏混合专家模型中由Top-k专家选择引入的不连续性进行严格的几何与随机分析。作者按切换事件中并列专家数量对不连续性进行阶数分类，并用测度论切片方法估计加厚不连续面体积，说明低阶不连续集占主导而高阶集合相对体积趋于消失。进一步地，论文用扩散过程建模输入扰动，证明路径最终会遇到不连续面，且首次命中几乎必然发生在一阶不连续处。
authors: Tho Tran Huu, Huu-Tuan Nguyen, Thien-Hai Nguyen, Nhat-Tri Ho, Viet-Hoang Tran, Tho Quan, Tan Minh Nguyen

articles.title: AGDN: Learning to Solve Traveling Salesman Problem with Anisotropic Graph Diffusion Network
articles.title_zh: AGDN：利用各向异性图扩散网络学习求解旅行商问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) is a cornerstone of combinatorial optimization and arises in many practical scenarios. Although graph-based learning approaches have been explored for TSP, the question of how to exploit graph structure more effectively remains open. We present the Anisotropic Graph Diffusion Network (AGDN), a new Graph Neural Network framework designed to solve TSP. Our method tackles two central difficulties: (1) the lack of informative topological prior in fully connected TSP graphs, and (2) losing connected nodes in the optimal solution after the commonly used graph sparsification techniques. To overcome these issues, we construct a MixScore transition matrix that merges node similarity with pairwise distance, and we develop an anisotropic graph diffusion strategy that supports efficient information exchange across multiple hops. Comprehensive experiments spanning diverse instance sizes and node distributions show that AGDN consistently outperforms existing methods while keeping computation time competitive. Furthermore, AGDN generalizes well to problem sizes and distributions beyond those seen during training. The implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/AGDN.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出各向异性图扩散网络（AGDN）用于学习求解旅行商问题。针对完全连接TSP图缺乏有效拓扑先验以及常见稀疏化可能丢失最优解边的问题，作者构造融合节点相似性与成对距离的MixScore转移矩阵，并设计多跳各向异性图扩散策略以提升信息交换效率。实验表明，AGDN在不同规模和节点分布上优于现有方法，同时保持有竞争力的计算时间，并能泛化到训练外规模与分布。
authors: Bolin Shen, Ziwei Huang, Zhiguang Cao, Yushun Dong

articles.title: P-K-GCN: Physics-augmented Koopman-enhanced Graph Convolutional Network for Deep Spatiotemporal Super-resolution
articles.title_zh: P-K-GCN：用于深度时空超分辨率的物理增强Koopman图卷积网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-fidelity simulation of spatiotemporal dynamics is computationally prohibitive, necessitating efficient super-resolution techniques to reconstruct high-resolution data from coarse-grained inputs. Traditional data-driven methods often lack physical constraints, and simple physics-informed learning struggles with irregular spatial geometries and intricately evolving temporal dynamics. To tackle these challenges, we propose a Physics-augmented Koopman-enhanced Graph Convolutional Network (P-K-GCN) for spatiotemporal super-resolution on irregular geometries. Specifically, a continuous spline-based GCN is first designed to extract spatial dependencies directly from coarse graph, and Koopman operator theory is incorporated to project the nonlinear dynamics into a compact latent space where temporal progression is linearized. Second, we augment the optimization objective with a physics-based loss to force the data-driven reconstructions to adhere to physical laws for improving predictive fidelity and robustness. Finally, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis, establishing that the physics augmentation and Koopman regularization mathematically guarantees a reduction in super-resolution error by diminishing Rademacher complexity and tightening generalization bounds. We evaluate our framework on reconstructing spatially high-resolution cardiac electrodynamics across a 3D heart geometry from sparse low-resolution measurements. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy compared to baseline models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出物理增强Koopman图卷积网络（P-K-GCN），用于在不规则几何上从粗粒度输入重建高分辨率时空动力学。方法先用连续样条图卷积网络提取粗图空间依赖，再引入Koopman算子理论将非线性动力学投影到紧凑潜在空间中以线性化时间演化。作者还在优化目标中加入物理损失以增强对物理规律的遵循，并给出关于物理增强与Koopman正则化作用的理论分析。
authors: Xizhuo (Cici), Zhang, Zekai Wang, Fei Liu, Bing Yao

articles.title: Modeling Doppler Shifts in Radial-Velocity Data with Deep Learning toward Earth-mass Exoplanet Detection
articles.title_zh: 面向地球质量系外行星探测的径向速度数据多普勒位移深度学习建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18464v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Detecting the tiny Doppler shifts induced by Earth-mass planets in stellar radial-velocity measurements remains extremely challenging due to stellar activity. Many deep-learning methods performing well on simulated data remain difficult to apply reliably on real stellar spectra. The aim of this work is to develop a deep-learning framework that generalizes to real, unseen spectra and improves the detectability of Earth-mass planets in radial-velocity data. We train artificial neural networks on HARPS-N solar spectra with injected planetary signals, using physics-motivated spectral representations based on flux and line-formation temperature, together with their velocity gradients. Two training strategies are explored: hold-out testing and cross-validation. Model robustness is enhanced through genetic-algorithm-based hyperparameter optimization, and predictive uncertainty is quantified using Monte Carlo dropout. Our most precise neural network model reliably retrieves, under the cross-validation strategy, the amplitudes, phases, and orbital periods of planetary signals with amplitudes greater than or equal to 25 cm/s and periods between 10 and 550 days. In addition, in all cases tested here, the successfully recovered signals correspond to the most significant peaks in the periodograms of the Doppler-shift predictions. Temperature-based spectral-shell representations consistently outperform flux-based shells. We also release doppleriann, a Python package implementing the proposed framework. Our results demonstrate that combining physically motivated spectral representations with deep learning provides a promising pathway toward the detection of Earth-mass planets in radial-velocity data from real observations, supported by a modeling framework that is both physically grounded and statistically rigorous, incorporating uncertainty quantification and optimized training strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文旨在用深度学习提升恒星径向速度数据中地球质量行星所诱发微弱多普勒信号的可探测性，尤其应对恒星活动带来的干扰。作者在注入行星信号的HARPS-N太阳光谱上训练神经网络，采用基于通量、谱线形成温度及其速度梯度的物理启发式光谱表示，并结合遗传算法超参数优化和蒙特卡洛dropout不确定性估计。结果表明，在交叉验证策略下，最优模型能较可靠地恢复一定振幅和周期范围内行星信号的振幅、相位与轨道周期。
authors: Isidro Gómez-Vargas, Xavier Dumusque, Yinan Zhao, Khaled Al Moulla, Michael Cretignier

articles.title: Leveraging Energy Features for Surface Classification with Deep Learning: A Comparative Analysis Across Three Independent Datasets
articles.title_zh: 利用能量特征进行深度学习地表分类：三个独立数据集上的比较分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18698v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The energy-based method remains a comparatively underexamined approach for surface classification in mobile robotics, despite promising results in constrained environments. This study evaluated the viability of using energy-derived features as either a standalone classification modality or as supplementary input to inertial data. A comprehensive evaluation was conducted across three publicly available datasets, comparing the performance of modern deep learning architectures including recurrent neural networks, convolutional neural networks, encoder-only transformers, and Mamba state-space models, under automated hyperparameter tuning and input sequence length optimization. The models achieved higher accuracy than previously reported values on all evaluated datasets, with the convolutional neural network yielding the highest overall performance. When relying exclusively on energy-based features, the models attained classification accuracies in the range of 85-90%, approximately 5-10% lower than those achieved when combined with inertial features (96-99%). Augmenting inertial data with energy features resulted in a consistent mean accuracy improvement of 1-2%. These findings indicate that classifiers relying solely on energy features offer sufficient accuracy for standalone deployment, while also providing a consistent gain when used in combination with other sensing modalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文评估移动机器人地表分类中能量派生特征作为独立模态或惯性数据补充输入的可行性。作者在三个公开数据集上比较循环神经网络、卷积神经网络、仅编码器Transformer和Mamba状态空间模型，并进行自动超参数调优与输入序列长度优化。实验显示，仅使用能量特征可达到约85%至90%的分类准确率，低于与惯性特征结合时的96%至99%，而在惯性数据中加入能量特征能带来稳定的平均提升。

articles.title: Point-Cloud-Assistant Localized Statistical Channel Prediction by Tangent Gaussian Splatting
articles.title_zh: 基于点云辅助切平面高斯溅射的局部统计信道预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18734v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate, site-specific channel information is crucial for optimizing next-generation wireless networks. Among various approaches, localized statistical channel modeling (LSCM), which models the channel multipath angular power spectrum (APS) from the reference signal received power (RSRP) measurement, has emerged as a state-of-the-art method tailored for efficient network optimization. However, despite its effectiveness, LSCM cannot predict APS at the vast majority of locations where no measurements are available, which significantly restricts its applicability in large-scale, real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we present emph{point-cloud-assisted tangent Gaussian splatting} (PC-TGS), the first framework to emphextrapolate APS to unmeasured outdoor grids by integrating sparse radio measurements with dense LiDAR-based geometry. PC-TGS represents environmental scatterers as anisotropic 3D Gaussians, initialized and refined through a relaxed-mean reparameterization of the raw point cloud. A tangent-plane projection accurately maps each Gaussian into the local angular domain, while a depth-aware electromagnetic splatting process aggregates their contributions. To ensure practical deployment, we derive a closed-form Gaussian-weighted average (GWA) for APS bin integration and provide a provable error bound. { Evaluations on a LiDAR-scanned city-scale dataset (5M points, 6,310 RSRP samples) demonstrate that PC-TGS achieves better APS and RSRP prediction performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines and faster inference time for APS extrapolation task. These results highlight the potential of PC-TGS to enable geometry-aware and data-efficient channel prediction in large-scale wireless digital twins.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对局部统计信道建模难以在无测量位置预测角功率谱的问题，提出点云辅助切平面高斯溅射框架 PC-TGS。方法将稀疏无线测量与密集 LiDAR 几何信息结合，用各向异性三维高斯表示环境散射体，并通过切平面投影映射到局部角域，从而外推未测室外网格的信道角功率谱。该框架旨在提升大规模真实无线网络优化中的场景特定信道预测能力。
authors: Ye Xue, Yiheng Wang, Xinhua Shao, Qi Yan, Shutao Zhang, Tsung-Hui Chang

articles.title: A Neural Network Framework for Geodesic-Like Curve Computation on Parametric Surfaces
articles.title_zh: 用于参数曲面上类测地曲线计算的神经网络框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18759v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The concept of geodesic-like curves was introduced by Chen in 2010 as a method for estimating shortest paths (geodesics) on parametric surfaces, with its convergence established theoretically. However, an efficient numerical computational framework has not yet been developed. In this paper, we propose an elegant and efficient approach for computing geodesic-like curves by leveraging deep learning and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). Under the proposed framework, not only can single parametric surfaces be handled efficiently, but a broad class of complex parametric surfaces including multi-surface systems with C⁰ or higher continuity and surfaces of revolution can also be robustly addressed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种基于深度学习和物理信息神经网络的高效框架，用于计算参数曲面上的类测地曲线。类测地曲线此前被用于估计曲面最短路径并已有理论收敛性证明，但缺乏高效数值实现。所提方法不仅适用于单一参数曲面，也可稳健处理具有 C⁰ 或更高连续性的多曲面系统以及旋转曲面等复杂情形。

articles.title: Lifecycle-Aware Dynamic Analysis for Secure ML Model Execution
articles.title_zh: 面向安全机器学习模型执行的生命周期感知动态分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19023v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The growing reliance on pre-trained Machine Learning (ML) models has introduced new attack surfaces. Recent vulnerabilities demonstrate that malicious behavior can be embedded within model artifacts, often bypassing existing defenses. Current model-scanning solutions primarily rely on static, format-specific rules or known attack signatures, which limit their ability to generalize across frameworks and to detect novel exploitation paths. In contrast, we propose a solution that focuses on the effects an attack has on the host system executing the model and builds on foundational intuitions about ML model execution. In particular, we observe that ML models operate within well-defined lifecycle phases and that, within each phase, interactions with the host system are highly structured and predictable. We translate these intuitions into Moat, a dynamic lifecycle-aware approach for securing ML model execution, and instantiate this design in Re-Moat, our reference implementation. We evaluate Re-Moat across multiple ML frameworks using 77,974 real-world model artifacts from the Hugging Face Hub, 31 Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) from CVEs, and 334 models from a state-of-the-art dataset, and compare it against state-of-the-art model-scanning solutions. Our results show that our approach detects all evaluated attack classes while maintaining a close-to-zero false-positive rate, validating our intuitions and motivating dynamic analysis for securing ML model execution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注预训练机器学习模型制品中嵌入恶意行为所带来的新型攻击面，指出现有静态扫描方法依赖格式规则或已知签名，难以跨框架泛化并发现新型利用路径。作者提出 Moat，一种基于模型执行生命周期阶段的动态安全方法，并实现参考系统 Re-Moat。该方法利用不同生命周期阶段中模型与主机系统交互高度结构化和可预测的特点，对多种机器学习框架、Hugging Face 真实模型制品以及 CVE 概念验证样例进行评估。
authors: Gabriele Digregorio, Marco Di Gennaro, Francesco Pastore, Stefano Zanero, Stefano Longari, Michele Carminati

articles.title: Unreduced Persistence Diagrams for Topological Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 用于拓扑机器学习的未约化持久性图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.07156v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Supervised machine learning pipelines trained on features derived from persistent homology have been experimentally observed to ignore much of the information contained in a persistence diagram. Computing persistence diagrams is often the most computationally demanding step in such a pipeline, however. To explore this dynamic, we introduce several methods to generate topological feature vectors from unreduced boundary matrices and investigate their theoretical and computational properties. We compared the performance of pipelines trained on vectorizations of unreduced PDs to vectorizations of fully-reduced PDs across several data and task types. Our results indicate that models trained on PDs built from unreduced diagrams can perform on par and even outperform those trained on fully-reduced diagrams on some tasks. We also benchmarked the computational performance of an algorithm for computing unreduced diagrams, which was implemented as a heavily modified version of Ripser. These computations are parallelizable and required an order of magnitude less memory on average compared to computing full persistence diagrams. Our results suggest that machine learning pipelines which incorporate topology-based features may benefit in terms of computational cost and performance by utilizing information contained in unreduced boundary matrices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究监督学习中由持久同调特征构建的模型往往未充分利用完整持久性图信息的问题，并提出从未约化边界矩阵生成拓扑特征向量的多种方法。作者比较了基于未约化持久性图和完全约化持久性图向量化特征的学习管线，在多类数据与任务上发现前者可达到相当甚至更好的性能。其改造自 Ripser 的未约化图计算实现具有可并行化特点，并在平均内存消耗上显著低于完整持久性图计算。
authors: Nicole Abreu, Parker B. Edwards, Francis Motta

articles.title: Regular Fourier Features for Nonstationary Gaussian Processes
articles.title_zh: 非平稳高斯过程的正则傅里叶特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.23006v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulating a Gaussian process requires sampling from a high-dimensional Gaussian distribution, which scales cubically with the number of sample locations. Spectral methods address this challenge by exploiting the Fourier representation and treating the spectral density as a probability distribution suitable for Monte Carlo approximation. Although this probabilistic interpretation is valid for stationary processes, it is overly restrictive for the nonstationary case, where spectral densities are generally not probability measures. We propose regular Fourier features for harmonizable processes to avoid this limitation. Our method discretizes the spectral representation directly, preserving the correlation structure among spectral weights without requiring probability assumptions. Under a finite-spectral-support assumption, this yields an efficient low-rank approximation that is consistent and positive semi-definite by construction. When the spectral density is unknown, the framework extends naturally to kernel learning from data. We demonstrate the method on locally stationary and harmonizable mixture kernels, the latter with a complex-valued spectral density, and apply the kernel-learning extension to real and synthetic data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对高斯过程模拟中高维高斯采样计算复杂度高的问题，提出适用于可调和过程的正则傅里叶特征方法。与将谱密度视为概率分布的传统谱方法不同，该方法直接离散化谱表示，保留谱权重之间的相关结构，因而更适合非平稳情形。在有限谱支撑假设下，该方法给出一致且天然半正定的低秩近似，并可在谱密度未知时扩展到数据驱动的核学习。
authors: Arsalan Jawaid, Abdullah Karatas, Jörg Seewig

articles.title: Ultrafast On-chip Online Learning via Spline Locality in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
articles.title_zh: 通过 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络中的样条局部性实现超快速片上在线学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.02056v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ultrafast online learning is essential for high-frequency systems, such as controls for quantum computing and nuclear fusion, where adaptation must occur on sub-microsecond timescales. Meeting these requirements demands low-latency, fixed-precision computation under strict memory constraints, a regime in which conventional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are both inefficient and numerically unstable. We identify key properties of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that align with these constraints. Specifically, we show that: (i) KAN updates exploiting B-spline locality are sparse, enabling superior on-chip resource scaling, and (ii) KANs are inherently robust to fixed-point quantization. By implementing fixed-point online training on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), a representative platform for on-chip computation, we demonstrate that KAN-based online learners are significantly more efficient and expressive than MLPs across a range of low-latency and resource-constrained tasks. To our knowledge, this work is the first to demonstrate model-free online learning at sub-microsecond latencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向量子计算控制、核聚变控制等需要亚微秒级自适应的高频系统，研究低延迟、定点精度和严格内存约束下的在线学习。作者指出 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络可利用 B 样条局部性实现稀疏更新，并对定点量化具有内在鲁棒性。通过在 FPGA 上实现定点在线训练，研究表明 KAN 在线学习器在多种低延迟、资源受限任务中比多层感知机更高效且表达能力更强。
authors: Duc Hoang, Aarush Gupta, Philip Harris

articles.title: Effects of drawing rate on microstructure and tensile properties of directionally solidified Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb alloys
articles.title_zh: 抽拉速率对定向凝固 Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb 合金显微组织和拉伸性能的影响
articles.abstract: In the present study, Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb alloy specimens were prepared by an electromagnetic cold crucible directional solidification device. Then the solidification microstructures in the transition and steady-state zones were observed at different drawing rates. The results show that as the drawing rate increases, the content of α2-phase increases and the lamellar structure is significantly refined. Moreover, the parallel and 45° lamellae decrease, while the 90° lamellae increase. In this case, the alloy is dominated by α-solidification at high drawing rates so that in the final microstructure, the lamellae are partly perpendicular to the growth direction. At high drawing rates, especially 1.5 mm/min, high-angle lamellae of 60–90° became dominant. Furthermore, the tensile properties of the Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb alloy are mainly affected by the lamellar orientation. The specimen with fewer high-angle lamellae showed the highest tensile strength and elongation of 535 MPa and 1.96%, respectively, which are higher than those obtained at the other drawing rates. The fracture morphology reveals that as the drawing rate increases, the fracture mode of the alloy changes gradually from translamellar to interlamellar.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用电磁冷坩埚定向凝固装置制备 Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb 合金试样，并考察不同抽拉速率下过渡区和稳态区的凝固组织。结果表明，随着抽拉速率升高，α2 相含量增加，片层组织明显细化，片层取向也发生变化，高抽拉速率下 60–90°高角度片层占优。拉伸性能主要受片层取向影响，高角度片层较少的试样表现出最高抗拉强度和延伸率；断口形貌显示断裂模式随抽拉速率增加逐渐发生转变。

articles.title: Risk-Aware Hybrid Reinforcement Learning and Robust Optimization for Reliable PV–Battery Scheduling Under Uncertainty
articles.title_zh: 不确定性下可靠光伏—电池调度的风险感知混合强化学习与鲁棒优化方法
articles.abstract: The increasing penetration of photovoltaic (PV) generation and battery energy storage systems (BESSs) has intensified the need for intelligent scheduling strategies that can simultaneously reduce operating cost, preserve battery health, and ensure operational reliability under significant uncertainty. In practical grid-connected PV–battery systems, the stochastic nature of solar power, load demand, and electricity prices often leads to constraint violations and high tail-risk costs when conventional optimization or purely data-driven methods are used. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a risk-sensitive hybrid framework that integrates Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), conformal uncertainty estimation (CUE), and robust optimization (RO) in a unified energy management architecture. The SAC agent learns a stochastic dispatch policy, while CVaR explicitly penalizes unfavorable cost outcomes and CUE provides distribution-free uncertainty bounds for uncertain inputs. These bounds are then embedded into a robust optimization layer to guarantee feasibility under adverse operating conditions. In addition, an adaptive fusion mechanism combines the outputs of the learning-based and robust controllers to balance economic performance and reliability. Simulation results for a typical residential PV–battery system demonstrate that the proposed method achieves the best trade-off among cost, risk, and constraint satisfaction. Compared with a rule-based baseline, the full model reduces the SOC violation rate from 4.8% to below 1%, while also lowering the total operating cost and CVaR. Moreover, the proposed framework outperforms the RO-only variant by achieving a lower average cost without sacrificing robustness, and it consistently provides the highest reliability across independent runs. These results confirm that the proposed hybrid approach offers a practical and scalable solution for secure and economical PV–battery scheduling under uncertainty.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对并网光伏与电池储能系统在太阳能出力、负荷需求和电价不确定性下的调度问题，提出一种兼顾成本、可靠性和电池健康的风险敏感混合框架。框架结合软演员-评论家强化学习、条件风险价值、保形不确定性估计和鲁棒优化：强化学习智能体学习随机调度策略，CVaR 惩罚不利尾部成本，CUE 提供分布无关的不确定性边界，并由鲁棒优化层保障恶劣条件下的可行性。该架构旨在减少约束违背和高尾部风险成本。

articles.title: Polynomial Geometric Reduction of Quantum Entanglement Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子纠缠动力学的多项式几何约化
articles.abstract: We introduce a geometric framework for representing quantum entanglementthrough reduced entanglement coordinates derived from the Schmidt decompo-sition. For pure two-qubit states, the framework yields an entanglement conein which separability corresponds to geometric collapse to the cone apex. Thisconstruction extends naturally to higher-rank bipartitions through Schmidt-simplex geometries associated with Schmidt-rank reduction. For multipartitesystems, we introduce entanglement-graph coordinates that use pairwise bipar-tite reductions as geometric probes of global quantum states. The resultingrepresentation defines a local-unitary-invariant reduced geometry whose dimen-sion scales quadratically with subsystem number, compared with the exponentialscaling of the underlying pure-state space. Although not a complete invariantof multipartite entanglement, the graph geometry preserves important rela-tional and connectivity structure while remaining computationally tractable.Building on this representation, we develop a geometric interpretation of vari-ational quantum dynamics in which optimization trajectories evolve throughstructured regions of entanglement-graph space. We introduce Hamiltonian-selected entanglement-graph sectors, establish exact and perturbative sectorconstructions, derive local graph-distance energy relations near nondegenerateoptima, and develop learned geometric diagnostics for variational optimization.Numerical experiments on molecular and spin-chain Hamiltonians support thehypothesis that low-energy states concentrate near Hamiltonian-dependent graphsectors and demonstrate predictive information in the resulting geometric rep-resentations. Together, these results provide a unified geometric framework foranalyzing entanglement structure, quantum dynamics, and variational quantumoptimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种基于 Schmidt 分解的量子纠缠几何表示框架，用约化纠缠坐标描述纠缠结构。对于纯两量子比特态，该框架形成纠缠锥，其中可分性对应于几何上坍缩至锥顶；对于更高秩二分系统，则扩展为与 Schmidt 秩约化相关的单纯形几何。面向多体系统，作者引入纠缠图坐标，以成对二分约化作为全局态的几何探针，使表示在保持局域酉不变量和重要关系结构的同时，将维度扩展控制在关于子系统数的二次规模。

articles.title: Programmable morphing of topological modes in non-Hermitian elastic continua: continuum characterization and physical realization
articles.title_zh: 非厄米弹性连续体中拓扑模态的可编程变形：连续体表征与物理实现
articles.abstract: Non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) can dramatically reshape topological edge modes (TEMs), but experimental demonstrations and theoretical characterization have so far been predominantly limited in discrete lattice platforms. Here we report the first experimental observation of programmable morphing of TEMs in a non-Hermitian continuous elastic metabeam, where the morphing is controlled through nonreciprocal and nonlocal coupling implemented via an in-cell piezoelectric sensing–actuation scheme. First, we theoretically construct a reduced Dirac Hamiltonian with effective boundary conditions for open active continuum structures. This non-Hermitian continuum characterization can define a Chern number on a synthetic torus and link wavefunction- and spectral-based bulk-boundary correspondences, yielding explicit phase-transition conditions for the controllable non-Hermitian morphing. Second, 1D experiments in active metabeams confirm non-Hermiticity-controlled transitions between localized, extended, and relocalized TEMs, and two-dimensional experiments in stacked active metaplates demonstrate programmable 2D morphing. The non-Hermitian continuum-to-effective framework and underlying programmable mechanism provide a general route to reconfigurable control of topological modes and energy transport across active wave systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文报道了非厄米连续弹性超梁中拓扑边缘模态可编程变形的实验观察，变形由单元内压电传感—驱动方案实现的非互易、非局域耦合控制。作者建立了适用于开放主动连续结构的约化 Dirac 哈密顿量和有效边界条件，并在合成环面上定义 Chern 数，从而联系波函数与谱意义下的体-边对应并给出相变条件。一维主动超梁实验验证了局域、扩展和再局域拓扑模态之间的可控转变，二维堆叠主动超板实验展示了可编程二维变形。

articles.title: Green Synthesis of Copper Oxide Nanoparticles Using Glycyrrhiza glabra Extract: Structural Characterization, Antioxidant Activity, and Catalytic Application in 1,2,3-Triazole Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 利用甘草提取物绿色合成氧化铜纳米颗粒：结构表征、抗氧化活性及其在 1,2,3-三唑合成中的催化应用
articles.abstract: In this study, copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO NPs) were synthesized using an aqueous extract of Glycyrrhiza glabra (licorice) as a natural reducing and stabilizing agent. The synthesized CuO/GLY nanoparticles were thoroughly characterized using UV–Vis spectroscopy, FT-IR, XRD, FE-SEM-EDS, BET, and TGA analyses. The CuO/Gly nanoparticles exhibited mesoporous structure, spherical morphology, and good thermal stability. The CuO/Gly nanoparticles were applied as an efficient heterogeneous catalyst for the synthesis of substituted 1,2,3-triazoles under mild and environmentally benign conditions. The catalytic system demonstrated high efficiency, operational simplicity, low cost, and good recyclability. In addition, the antioxidant activity of the CuO/Gly nanoparticles was evaluated using the DPPH radical scavenging assay. The nanoparticles exhibited moderate free radical scavenging activity, indicating potential applications beyond catalysis. Overall, this study presents a sustainable and cost-effective strategy for the synthesis of biologically relevant triazole derivatives using a green nanocatalyst.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以甘草水提取物作为天然还原剂和稳定剂，绿色合成氧化铜纳米颗粒，并通过 UV–Vis、FT-IR、XRD、FE-SEM-EDS、BET 和 TGA 等技术进行表征。所得 CuO/Gly 纳米颗粒呈介孔结构、球形形貌并具有良好热稳定性。其作为非均相催化剂可在温和、环境友好条件下高效催化取代 1,2,3-三唑的合成，同时在 DPPH 自由基清除实验中表现出中等抗氧化活性。

articles.title: National Identity-Seeded Verified Relationship Graphs: A Graph Neural Network Framework for Population Estimation in Data-Scarce Sub-Saharan Africa
articles.title_zh: 国家身份标识种子化验证关系图：用于数据稀缺的撒哈拉以南非洲人口估计的图神经网络框架
articles.abstract: Reliable population data are essential to equitable governance and development planning. Nigeria, Africa's most populous nation, has operated without a nationally accepted census for nearly two decades, producing a substantial demographic knowledge deficit affecting an estimated 220 to 235 million persons. Existing methodological responses, including satellite-based population modelling and microcensus extrapolation, estimate aggregate distributions rather than verifying individual existences and remain vulnerable to systematic over- and undercounting incentives. This paper introduces the National Identification Number-Seeded Verified Relationship Graph (NS-VRG), a novel computational demography framework designed to estimate national population through biometrically verified kinship-network traversal. The framework transforms Nigeria's National Identification Number infrastructure, administered by the National Identity Management Commission, into the anchor population of a directed relationship graph. Graph nodes are classified into three tiers: biometrically confirmed Anchor Nodes, relationally declared Semi-Verified Nodes, and Graph Neural Network-inferred Ghost Nodes. A population estimation formula integrates all three tiers with a satellite-derived coverage adjustment factor. The framework addresses seven structural limitations of the existing National Identification Number database: absent relational structure, underage under-enrolment, lack of continuous updating, duplicate records, and absence of mortality tracking. A federated privacy-preserving storage model, citizen-facing application interface, and required API extension endpoints are fully specified. NS-VRG positions Nigeria as the first country globally to estimate national population through a verified biometric kinship graph. This paper advances computational demography by demonstrating that biometric identity infrastructure can serve as the foundation of a living national population register, with assessed replication potential across African Union member states operating biometric identity systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对尼日利亚长期缺乏全国认可人口普查所造成的人口数据缺口，提出国家身份号码种子化验证关系图 NS-VRG 计算人口学框架。该框架以生物特征验证的国家身份号码体系为锚点，将人口表示为有向亲属关系图，并将节点划分为生物特征确认的锚节点、关系声明的半验证节点和由图神经网络推断的幽灵节点。研究旨在从个体存在验证和亲属网络遍历角度补充传统卫星建模与微普查外推方法，但具体实施细节和评估结果需结合原文进一步查阅。

articles.title: Determining Dielectric Constant and Loss Factor of Concrete Panels from GPR A-scan Curves – Theory, Numerical Simulation, and Experimental Validation
articles.title_zh: 基于 GPR A 扫描曲线确定混凝土板介电常数与损耗因子：理论、数值模拟与实验验证
articles.abstract: Electromagnetic (EM) sensors such as ground penetrating radar (GPR) have been widely used in the inspection of concrete structures (e.g., buildings, bridges) for condition assessment and health monitoring. To fully understand the GPR result, the EM property (dielectric constant and loss factor) of concrete should be known for account for changing phase velocity and amplitude attenuation of GPR signals inside concrete. The objective of this paper is to present an approach to extract both the dielectric constant and the loss factor of concrete panel specimens from A-scan curves. An analytical derivation is first provided as the theoretical basis of our approach. Numerical simulations using the finite different time domain (FDTD) method are applied to generate GPR A-scan curves of homogeneous concrete panel models with a varying dielectric constant in the range of 5 to 25 at a constant electrical conductivity 0.1 S/m. A 1.6GHz Ricker wavelet function signal was used in generating all simulated A-scan curves containing two wave packets (the front reflection and the back reflection of a concrete panel model). Continuous wavelet transform (CWT) was applied to determine the center of two wave packets in the time domain. Spectral amplitude of A-scan curves was used to quantify signal attenuation from the front reflection to the back reflection. A modification factor was proposed to account for geometric scattering effects in the estimation of loss factor. Proposed approach was applied to an experimentally measured 1.6GHz GPR A-scan curve and verified by the coaxial probe measurement (0.4~2.9 GHz).  From our result, it is found that our estimated dielectric constant and loss factor are bounded by Debye’s model and coaxial probe measurement. Our predicted dielectric constant is very close to the probe measurement, while our predicted loss factor is very close to the theoretical value of Debye’s model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种从探地雷达 A 扫描曲线中提取混凝土板介电常数和损耗因子的方法，以支持混凝土结构无损检测结果的准确解释。作者首先给出解析推导，并采用 FDTD 数值模拟生成不同介电常数条件下均质混凝土板的 GPR A 扫描信号。研究利用包含前表面反射和背面反射的双波包信号，并结合连续小波变换定位波包中心，为后续实验验证和电磁参数反演提供理论与数值基础。

articles.title: Influence of Sm³⁺ Substitution on the Structural, Magnetic, and Dielectric Properties of SrFe₁₂O₁₉ Hexaferrites
articles.title_zh: Sm³⁺取代对SrFe₁₂O₁₉六角铁氧体结构、磁性与介电性能的影响
articles.abstract: In this study, the sol-gel auto-combustion technique has been employed to synthesize M-type strontium hexagonal ferrite nanoparticles with the chemical composition Sr1−xSmxFe12O19, where x = 0.0, 0.02, 0.04, 0.06, 0.08 and 0.1. The samples were sintered for 4 h at 1200°C for the reaction to occur and investigate the effects of Sm3+ substitution on the host material’s structural, magnetic and dielectric properties. These properties were characterised by XRD, FESEM, FTIR, Magnetic, and impedance analysis. XRD patterns confirmed the formation of crystalline M-type hexagonal ferrites, identified as pure hexagonal with space group 167: R-3c and symmetry group P63/mmc. FESEM images revealed a nano-sized, speck-like morphology. FTIR analysis validated the synthesis of hexaferrite, showing bands in the 413 to 421–586 to 593 cm− 1 range attributed to the stretching vibrations of oxygen atoms and metal ions (M–O), specifically Fe–O bonds. The saturation magnetization decreases with increasing concentrations and reaches a low value at x = 0.10. The concentration of Sm3+ increases the coercivity also increases. Dielectric analysis indicated frequency-dependent behaviour, with the sample exhibiting the highest dielectric constant among the synthesized samples and a low dielectric loss. The polarization and conduction mechanisms were interpreted using Koop’s theory, the Maxwell-Wagner, and the Verwey hopping model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用溶胶-凝胶自燃法合成了Sr1−xSmxFe12O19（x=0.0至0.1）M型锶六角铁氧体纳米颗粒，并在1200°C烧结以考察Sm³⁺取代效应。XRD确认样品形成晶态M型六角铁氧体，FESEM显示纳米级斑点状形貌，FTIR验证了Fe–O等金属—氧键振动特征。磁性结果表明，随Sm³⁺含量增加，饱和磁化强度降低而矫顽力升高；介电分析显示材料具有频率依赖行为。

articles.title: Fermat's Spiral-Based Characterization of Squeezed Nonlinear Motional States of Levitated Nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 基于费马螺线的悬浮纳米颗粒压缩非线性运动态表征
articles.abstract: A nanoparticle optically levitated in vacuum represents a macroscopic mechanical oscillator that can be virtually decoupled from its thermal environment, providing a unique testbed for exploring the transition between classical and quantum dynamical regimes. It is generally assumed that such a levitated particle is confined and oscillates in a parabolic optical potential where its state is described by a Gaussian distribution in the phase space. However, real-world experiments are performed in optical potentials with weak nonlinear distortions that drive the motion into a non-Gaussian state. Such a state requires additional parameters for the full characterization, and direct quantitative comparison with the ideal Gaussian states is not straightforward. Here, we focus on the most common weak nonlinearity of Duffing type, in which the oscillation frequency decreases with the square of the amplitude of nanoparticle's oscillations. This dependence gives rise to spiral-shaped, squeezed non-Gaussian states. Given the particular observed symmetry of the phase-space distributions, we use the concept of Fermat's spiral and propose a nonlinear transformation of normalized phase-space coordinates that transforms this spiral state into a squeezed Gaussian-like state, which can be directly compared with the states of a stochastic harmonic oscillator. For comparison, we evaluate a nonlinear squeezing metric that can be used also in quantum regimes. The proposed approach can be extended to other nonlinearities of the confining potential with an explicit dependence of the oscillation frequency on the amplitude of the motion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注真空中光悬浮纳米颗粒在弱非线性光势中的运动态表征问题，尤其是Duffing型非线性导致的非高斯相空间分布。作者指出，振荡频率随振幅平方降低会产生螺旋状压缩非高斯态，使传统高斯态参数难以充分描述。研究利用费马螺线的对称性思想，提出对归一化相空间坐标进行非线性变换，以便更定量地刻画并比较这类非线性运动态。

articles.title: Unsupervised Representation Learning for Surface Variability Discovery in Natural Cork Stoppers
articles.title_zh: 用于发现天然软木塞表面变异性的无监督表征学习
articles.abstract: Quality control of natural cork stoppers is essential in the wine industry, as aesthetic grading dictates market value. Current pricing relies heavily on visual quality, defining market classes ranging from premium “flor” to low-grade “quintos”. While traditional manual inspection is subjective, the application of supervised learning is strictly hindered by the high natural heterogeneity of cork and the unreliability of subjective ground-truth labels. To address this, we shift from rigid classification to an exploratory data analysis approach, proposing an unsupervised representation learning framework based on a Vision Transformer Autoencoder (ViTAE). The model leverages transformer-based feature extraction to obtain rich, multiview embeddings of cork surfaces. Evaluated on a large-scale industrial dataset (80,000 training and 40,000 test samples), the ViTAE latent space was compared against handcrafted descriptors (LBP and HOG) and autoencoder baselines (CAE and VAE). Performance was assessed via internal clustering metrics, statistical significance tests, and computational feasibility for real-time inspection. Results demonstrate that while classical descriptors like HOG produce statistically compact clusters, ViTAE yields a robust feature space with a critical operational advantage: spatial interpretability. Through image reconstruction, ViTAE acts as a visual auditing tool, where the reconstruction behavior naturally highlights atypical structural variations. This establishes ViTAE not merely as an automated classifier, but as a highly descriptive feature extractor capable of mapping raw material variability to support human-in-the-loop quality assessment systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对葡萄酒行业天然软木塞外观分级中主观标注不可靠、表面异质性强的问题，提出从固定分类转向探索性数据分析。作者构建了基于视觉Transformer自编码器的无监督表征学习框架，用于提取软木表面的多视角潜在嵌入。该方法在大规模工业数据集上与LBP、HOG及卷积/变分自编码器等基线比较，并通过聚类指标、统计检验和实时检测可行性评估其表现。

articles.title: Simulation-informed deep learning for estimating material parameters from microstructural morphology
articles.title_zh: 用于从微观结构形貌估计材料参数的仿真引导深度学习
