articles.abstract: Field-theoretic models of neural computation face an observability problem: their latent variables are not directly mapped onto standard experimental recordings. Here we introduce FIELD, a mesoscopic computational architecture and we propose a FIELD-MEA observation framework for testing it against multielectrode-array (MEA) data. The framework maps latent FIELD trajectories to synthetic MEA-like signals through explicit observation operators and evaluates both empirical and synthetic signals in a shared space of mesoscopic metrics. Using the public Kapucu/TUNI/G-Node MEA dataset as a spontaneous reference, we show that a constrained FIELD regime can enter partial compatibility with empirical envelopes for burst timing, synchrony, local coherence and phase-gradient structure. We then use structured pulse perturbations as model-side predictions. Energy-matched A/B pulses applied at the same location are separable in post-stimulus trajectories and latency, but not in final-state or phase-trajectory readouts. Likewise, the order A◊B versus B◊A is robustly expressed across seeds in windowed trajectories, event profiles, latency, and global dynamics, while final states remain non-discriminative. As paradigm-level controls, we further applied the same observation pipeline to a Wilson–Cowan neural-field baseline and to a Izhikevich spiking-network baseline with MEA-kernel observation. These controls did not reproduce the robust trajectory-carried identity and order effects observed in FIELD, supporting the discriminative role of the mesoscopic observation layer. These results do not biologically validate FIELD but establish a research program in which field-theoretic neural architectures can be made observable, constrained and testable at the mesoscopic level.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对场论神经计算模型的潜变量难以与实验记录直接对应的可观测性问题，提出 FIELD 介观计算架构及 FIELD-MEA 观测框架。该框架通过显式观测算子将 FIELD 潜在轨迹映射为类似多电极阵列的合成信号，并在共同的介观指标空间中比较经验信号与模拟信号。基于公开 MEA 数据集的分析显示，受约束的 FIELD 模型在爆发时序、同步性、局部相干和相位梯度结构等方面可与经验包络部分相容，同时脉冲扰动实验给出模型侧预测。

articles.title: Development and Adsorption Performance of CTAB-Functionalized Clinoptilolite Microbeads for Congo Red Removal from Aqueous Solution
articles.title_zh: CTAB 功能化斜发沸石微珠的制备及其去除水溶液中刚果红的吸附性能
articles.abstract: The discharge of wastewater from industrial activities containing dye pollutants is a problem that is still of great concern to the environment. The dyes are stable, and do not biodegrade easily within the environment. Congo Red is one such dye pollutants that is especially problematic for the environment due to its solubility, chemical structure, and potential to cause harm to the environment and its inhabitants. In the study that is discussed in this article, microbeads were prepared with clinoptilolite, which had been functionalized with cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB). These microbeads were created by mixing the functionalized clinoptilolite with alginate, which was then cross-linked with calcium to create microbeads. These microbeads are easier to handle than powdered materials. The techniques used to characterize the microbeads in the study were FTIR, XRD, SEM, and EDX. These methods verified that the clinoptilolite had been successfully functionalized with CTAB. The performance of these microbeads was assessed by determining the impact of initial Congo Red dye concentration, the dosage of the microbeads used, and the amount of time the microbeads were allowed to remain in contact with the dye. With the functionalized microbeads, the researchers were able to remove 76.93% of the Congo Red dye from an initial dye concentration of 50 mg/L, using 0.075 g of the adsorbent, and a contact time of 15 hours.These microbeads achieved a maximum Congo Red dye adsorption capacity of 51.69 mg/g when exposed to a 50 mg/L dye solution. Furthermore, the adsorption kinetics of the Congo Red dye removal were determined to follow the pseudo-second order kinetic model. Additionally, although the diffusion of the dye into the particle interior played a role in the Congo Red adsorption process, it was not the only process that influenced the rate of dye removal.Finally, when an isotherm of Congo Red adsorption was constructed, the data was better explained by the Langmuir isotherm following the functionalization of the clinoptilolite microbeads with CTAB. Therefore, the study's findings indicated that the CTAB-functionalized clinoptilolite microbeads could be utilized as an adsorbent in order to remove Congo Red dye from water.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究制备了十六烷基三甲基溴化铵（CTAB）功能化斜发沸石，并与海藻酸盐复合、经钙交联形成便于操作的微珠吸附材料，用于去除水中刚果红染料。作者采用 FTIR、XRD、SEM 和 EDX 等手段表征材料，确认斜发沸石成功功能化。研究进一步考察初始染料浓度、微珠投加量和接触时间等因素对吸附性能的影响，以评估其处理含染料工业废水的潜力。

articles.title: Physics-informed operator learning for simultaneous homogenization and localization in multiscale nonlinear composite microstructures without labeled data
articles.title_zh: 无标注数据条件下用于多尺度非线性复合材料微结构同时均匀化与局部化的物理信息算子学习
articles.abstract: Computational homogenization bridges microstructure and macroscopic behavior in heterogeneous materials, but its practical deployment remains constrained by the high cost of repeatedly solving boundary value problems on representative volume elements (RVEs). Data-driven surrogates reduce inference cost but require extensive and expensive labeled datasets, while existing physics-informed methods reduce data dependence but must be retrained for every new microstructure or loading condition. No existing framework simultaneously achieves generalization across microstructures, handles arbitrary loading conditions within a single model, and operates without any labeled training data. Here, we introduce PI-HomNO, a physics-informed neural operator framework for computational homogenization that satisfies all these requirements. A double-encoder architecture encodes the microstructure field and the macroscopic loading condition to separate latent vectors, which a neural operator then maps to the continuous full-field solution; homogenized effective properties are then recovered by volume averaging. In doing so, PI-HomNO simultaneously solves both the localization problem, i.e., yielding the complete microscale displacement, strain, and stress fields throughout the RVE, and the homogenization problem of extracting effective properties, two tasks that have conventionally been treated as separate modeling efforts~i̧teyang2019establishing; here they emerge as natural byproducts of a single physics-informed operator trained without any labeled data for either. PI-HomNO is validated on three benchmarks of increasing complexity, including effective thermal conductivity, linear elasticity, and nonlinear elastic homogenization. It consistently achieves high accuracy in both full-field responses and effective property predictions, while offering substantially faster inference than FEM. The results further demonstrate strong generalization to microstructural variations and loading conditions beyond the training distribution, as well as direct transfer to higher spatial resolutions without retraining. In multiscale simulations, PI-HomNO integrates seamlessly into standard pipelines and produces macroscopic predictions that closely match full-resolution FEM at a fraction of the computational cost. These results establish PI-HomNO as a unified, scalable, data-free, and resolution-independent surrogate for multiscale simulation, with broad applicability to accelerated materials discovery, predictive multiscale modeling, and inverse design of heterogeneous systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 PI-HomNO，一种用于计算均匀化的物理信息神经算子框架，旨在避免反复求解代表性体元边值问题和依赖昂贵标注数据。该方法采用双编码器分别表征微结构场和宏观加载条件，再由神经算子映射到连续全场解，并通过体平均获得有效均匀化性质。该框架可在无标注训练数据条件下同时处理局部化问题和均匀化问题，并力图实现跨微结构与任意加载条件的泛化。

articles.title: Revisiting Chemical Kinetics for H + CH4 → H2 + CH3 Using Variational Transition State Theory: Comparison with Global Dynamics Calculations
articles.title_zh: 利用变分过渡态理论重新研究 H + CH4 → H2 + CH3 的化学动力学：与全局动力学计算的比较
articles.abstract: Context For both the forward and reverse reaction, there are no accurate rate constants at the VTST/MT level using potential energy surfaces built with the density function theory (DFT) approach. Calculations of rate constants in function of the temperature are carried out for the elementary reaction H + CH4 → H2 + CH3 using variational transition state theory with multidimensional tunneling corrections (VTST/MT) with density functional theory (DFT) and are compared with previous global dynamics calculations reported in the literature. Calculations show that the dual-level method based on a M06-2X PES is capable to provides an accurate framework to compute thermal rate constants in comparison with global dynamics methods. Methods The CCSD(T) method with the aug-cc-pnZ (n = 3-5) basis set are employed to characterize the stationary states for the forward and reverse reactions and the M06-2X and wB97X-D DFTs are used to generate potential energy surfaces (PESs) in the VTST/MT calculations. At the CVT/mOMT level and using the M06-2X PES, the rate constants at 300 and 600 K are 2.54 ´ 10-19 and 2.92 ´ 10-15 cm3 molecule-1s-1, which are in excellent agreement with the Multi-Configurational Time-Dependent Hartree (MCTDH) calculations (1.9 ´ 10-19 and 2.9 ´ 10-15 cm3 molecule-1s-1).  For the reverse H2 + CH3 reaction, CVT/mOMT shows good agreement with results using CCSD(T) and analytical PESs. The kinetic isotope effect (KIE) (kCH4+H/kCH4+D) at 500, 600 and 700 K are 0.65, 0.71, and 0.77 in good agreement with experimental data, respectively equal to 0.8 ± 0.2, 0.9 ± 0.2, and 1.0 ± 0.2.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用含多维隧穿校正的变分过渡态理论（VTST/MT）重新计算 H + CH4 → H2 + CH3 及其逆反应的温度依赖速率常数，并与文献中的全局动力学结果比较。作者使用 CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pnZ 方法表征正、逆反应的驻点，并采用 M06-2X 和 ωB97X-D 密度泛函构建势能面用于 VTST/MT 计算。结果表明，基于 M06-2X 势能面的双层方法能够较准确地给出热速率常数，例如在 300 K 和 600 K 下与已有高水平动力学结果符合良好。

articles.title: Benchmarking Open-Access Quantum Hardware Through Many-Body Dynamics in the 1D Tilted-Field Ising Model
articles.title_zh: 通过一维倾斜场 Ising 模型多体动力学评测开放访问量子硬件
articles.abstract: Hamiltonian simulation is one of the main proposed applications of near-term quantum computers, but its practical value depends on whether real hardware can preserve intended Hamiltonian dynamics once sampling limits, gate noise, decoherence, and circuit depth are taken into account. This study investigates whether the IBM quantum backend textttibmₘₐᵣᵣₐₖₑₛₕ can reproduce the many-body dynamics shown by ideal simulation, using a 15-qubit one-dimensional tilted-field Ising chain as the benchmark system. The system was initialized with all qubits spin-up except for a localized spin-down excitation at the central qubit, q₈, and evolved using a second-order Trotterized circuit with timestep Δ t=0.1. The reference case, h_z=0, was compared with the tilted-field case, h_z=hₓ₌₀.35625, across three interaction regimes: J=0.90hₓ, J=hₓ, and J=1.40hₓ. Local magnetization, total magnetization, and connected spin correlations were used to track magnetization memory and finite-speed correlation spreading from the central excitation. The ideal simulation shows clear local and total magnetization evolution, as well as connected-correlation spreading outward from q₈, giving a baseline for the intended Hamiltonian dynamics. The IBM hardware results reproduce the broad early-time magnetization trend but show compressed local-magnetization values, reduced separation between qubits, and weaker long-range connected-correlation structure. These differences indicate that the open-access quantum hardware preserves some early-time features of the intended dynamics, while longer-time correlation spreading is increasingly obscured by finite sampling, two-qubit gate errors, readout error, decoherence, and circuit depth. Overall, the study uses this spin-chain system as a direct benchmark for testing how much physically meaningful many-body behavior can still be extracted from noisy open-access quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以 15 量子比特一维倾斜场 Ising 链为基准，评估 IBM 开放量子后端 ibmₘₐᵣᵣₐₖₑₛₕ 在采样限制、门噪声、退相干和线路深度影响下重现实验目标哈密顿量动力学的能力。系统初态为除中心量子比特 q8 存在局域自旋向下激发外其余均自旋向上，并采用二阶 Trotter 线路演化。作者比较无纵场与倾斜场情形下不同相互作用强度的局域磁化、总磁化和连通自旋关联，以检验磁化记忆和从中心激发出发的有限速度关联传播。

articles.title: Passive quantum error correction doubles qubit lifetime, reaching break-even point
articles.title_zh: 被动量子纠错使量子比特寿命翻倍并达到盈亏平衡点
articles.abstract: A team of U.S. researchers has designed a passive quantum error correction technique that enables qubits to correct their own errors. Demonstrated by Shruti Shirol and colleagues at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, the protocol transforms the inevitable dissipation of energy in qubit systems from a hindrance into an advantage, offering a promising route toward practical quantum computing outside the lab. The research has been published in Physical Review X.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道介绍了一种由美国研究团队提出的被动量子纠错技术，该方法使量子比特能够在一定程度上自行纠正错误。研究将量子比特系统中不可避免的能量耗散从不利因素转化为可利用机制，并据称实现了量子比特寿命翻倍、达到纠错盈亏平衡点。该成果被认为为实验室外的实用量子计算提供了有前景的路径，详情需参见原始论文。

articles.title: Digital programming of spin correlations in a fermionic lattice quantum simulator
articles.title_zh: 费米子晶格量子模拟器中自旋关联的数字化编程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13772v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Analog quantum simulation provides a highly controlled platform to study diverse quantum many-body phenomena. However, current methods for state initialisation are limited to thermal ensembles or uncorrelated product states. Here we present a hybrid approach that complements analog preparation with a digital quantum-gate protocol. This approach enables the engineering of target states with specific, long-range spin-correlations from the same initial resource state. By applying collisional gates to adiabatically prepared and filtered four-fermion singlet chains, we program diverse spin-correlation patterns, including that of a Heisenberg chain. We measure the spin correlations using a sequence of quantum gates followed by singlet-pair measurements. Our method paves the way to the targeted preparation of strongly correlated states of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种将模拟量子制备与数字量子门协议相结合的混合方法，用于在费米子晶格量子模拟器中工程化具有特定长程自旋关联的目标态。作者从绝热制备并筛选的四费米子单态链出发，通过碰撞门编程多种自旋关联图样，包括类似 Heisenberg 链的关联结构。随后利用量子门序列和单态对测量读取自旋关联，该方法为有针对性地制备强关联物质量子态提供了新途径。
authors: Yann Kiefer, Lars Fischer, Zijie Zhu, Konrad Viebahn, Tilman Esslinger

articles.title: Observation of intertwined charge density wave order and superconductivity in Janus monolayer
articles.title_zh: Janus 单层材料中交织的电荷密度波有序与超导性的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13828v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) provide an ideal platform for studying the emergence of charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity. The discovery of emergent CDW order in 1T ZrTe₂ monolayer raises an important question: does this instability persist when one Te chalcogen layer is substituted by Se? In the present work, we investigate the CDW (2×2×1) and superconducting instability in 1T ZrSeTe Janus monolayer using first-principles calculations. The phonon spectrum exhibits a pronounced anomaly at the M point of the irreducible Brillouin zone, arising from enhanced electron-phonon interaction together with electronic instabilities originating from both interband and intraband scattering. The resulting lattice distortion reconstructs the electronic structure, opening a small indirect band gap, driving the system from a semi-metallic to a semiconducting state. The energy gain associated with the distortion is significantly smaller than that of ZrTe₂ monolayer, indicating that the replacement of one Te chalcogen layer with Se weakens the CDW instability. We have further investigated the effects of electronic correlation and biaxial strain, both acts as effective tuning parameters for the instabilities concerened. In the high temperature undistorted phase, ZrSeTe exhibits phonon mediated two-gap superconductivity. It originates primarily from the robust coupling between the soft phonon mode at M point and the electronic bands predominantly derived from Zr d and Te p orbitals crossing the Fermi level. Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) further modifies the electronic states and reduces the superconducting transition temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作基于第一性原理计算研究了 1T ZrSeTe Janus 单层中的 2×2×1 电荷密度波（CDW）与超导不稳定性。声子谱在布里渊区 M 点出现显著异常，源于增强的电子-声子相互作用以及带间、带内散射导致的电子不稳定性。由此产生的晶格畸变重构电子结构并打开小的间接带隙，使体系由半金属性转为半导体性；与 ZrTe₂ 单层相比，其畸变能量增益更小，表明 Se 取代削弱了 CDW 不稳定性。
authors: Subhajit Pramanick, Shubham Patel, Sudip Chakraborty, A. Taraphder

articles.title: Thinning-by-spinning: shear rheology of dense chiral fluids
articles.title_zh: 旋转致稀化：致密手性流体的剪切流变学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14311v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the linear and nonlinear rheology of dense chiral fluids composed of self-spinning particles under external shear. Using particle-based simulations of a two-dimensional Lennard-Jones model with transverse interactions, we show that chirality acts as an intrinsic source of fluctuations and shear. In the solid regime, spinning fluidizes the system, weakening hexatic order. In the liquid regime, the viscosity is quantitatively described by a Green-Kubo relation upon replacing the temperature by a chirality-dependent effective temperature. Beyond linear response, flow curves collapse when expressed in terms of the ratio between imposed shear and spinning rates, revealing a thinning-by-spinning mechanism. At large forcing, this correspondence breaks down and a pronounced handedness asymmetry emerges: when transverse interactions oppose the imposed shear, stresses relax through the formation of string-like flow channels. Our results identify chirality as a generic mechanism for fluidization and provide a unified framework for understanding the rheology of dense chiral suspensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者通过二维 Lennard-Jones 粒子模拟研究了由自旋粒子组成的致密手性流体在外加剪切下的线性与非线性流变行为。结果表明，手性可作为内禀涨落和剪切源：在固态区会流化体系并削弱六角有序，在液态区黏度可由引入手性相关有效温度的 Green-Kubo 关系描述。非线性响应中，流动曲线可按外加剪切率与自旋率之比塌缩，揭示“旋转致稀化”机制；强驱动下则出现明显手性不对称和丝状流道形成。
authors: Lucio Mauro Carenza, Giuseppe Gonnella, Demian Levis, Giuseppe Negro

articles.title: On-chip superconducting GHz RF reflectometry of the capacitance response in bilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 片上超导 GHz 射频反射法测量双层石墨烯的电容响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In dual-gated bilayer graphene, a perpendicular displacement field opens a band gap that modifies both the channel conductance and the electronic compressibility, motivating measurements that resolve resistive and capacitive responses on the same device. We integrate an hBN-encapsulated bilayer graphene heterostructure with an on-chip superconducting Nb lumped-element LC resonator and carry out RF reflectometry near 4.25 GHz. DC transport and finite-bias spectroscopy on the same device provide a transport reference. Top and bottom gates independently set the carrier density and displacement field. The DC and RF gate maps share the same gate-dependent features, with finite-bias measurements revealing a region of suppressed conductance whose bias extent grows with the displacement field, consistent with a field-induced gap. The gate-dependent resonance-frequency shift is converted to the effective capacitance seen by the resonator using an equivalent-circuit model. The capacitance shows a minimum near the conductance-suppressed region, consistent with reduced electronic compressibility in the gapped bilayer graphene, and exhibits an electron-hole asymmetry. The on-chip configuration probes the gate-dependent admittance of a dual-gated van der Waals heterostructure, providing capacitance-sensitive information that complements DC transport within a single device.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将 hBN 封装的双层石墨烯异质结构与片上超导 Nb 集总元件 LC 谐振器集成，在约 4.25 GHz 进行射频反射测量，并与同一器件的直流输运和有限偏压谱进行对照。顶栅和底栅独立调控载流子密度与垂直位移场，直流与射频栅图呈现一致的门控特征，有限偏压测量显示随位移场增大的电导抑制区，符合场诱导带隙。通过等效电路模型将谐振频率位移转换为有效电容，发现电容在电导受抑区域附近出现最小值，反映带隙双层石墨烯电子可压缩性的降低。
authors: Sung Jin An, Minseo Cho, Minjun Park, Dohun Kim, HyeonJeong An, Seung-Bo Shim, Hakseong Kim, Sunghun Lee, Myoung-Jae Lee, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Jungpil Seo, Myunglae Jo, Youngwook Kim, Minkyung Jung

articles.title: Extending Covariant Fluctuation Theorems into Quantum Regime through Quasiprobability Approach
articles.title_zh: 通过准概率方法将协变涨落定理拓展到量子区域
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14519v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The covariant formulation of stochastic thermodynamics requires treating the stochastic work as a 4-vector, posing significant challenges for quantum systems due to the non-commutativity. We introduce a new quasiprobability distribution for the work 4-vector, which combines the Wigner and Margenau-Hill quasiprobabilities. This extends the covariant fluctuation theorems from classical to quantum regime. We illustrate our findings with a scalar field driven by classical particles with a generalized version of trace formula. Our work establishes a quasiprobability approach to studying relativistic quantum thermodynamics in a covariant way.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对随机热力学协变表述中需将随机功视为四矢量、而量子非对易性带来困难的问题，提出了一种新的功四矢量准概率分布。该分布结合了 Wigner 与 Margenau-Hill 准概率，从而把协变涨落定理由经典情形推广到量子区域。作者以受经典粒子驱动的标量场为例，并利用广义迹公式展示了该框架，为相对论量子热力学的协变研究提供了准概率途径。
authors: Ji-Hui Pei, Tingzhang Shi, Jin-Fu Chen, H. T. Quan

articles.title: First-principles calculations of internal conversion processes in spin defects
articles.title_zh: 自旋缺陷内转换过程的第一性原理计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14545v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optically active spin defects are foundational for quantum technologies, yet common approximations underestimate their internal conversion (IC) rates by orders of magnitude. We propose a broad, predictive framework to compute IC rates that incorporates multi-configurational effects via many-body wavefunctions in TDDFT, and includes all-phonon-mode contributions via analytical non-adiabatic couplings. Our approach resolves discrepancies with experiment, achieving quantitative agreement for the NV⁻ center in diamond, and identifying a previously overlooked non-radiative channel in the divacancy triplet lifetime in SiC.
articles.abstract_zh: 光活性自旋缺陷是量子技术的重要基础，但常用近似往往会将其内转换速率低估数个数量级。作者提出了一个可预测的通用计算框架，在 TDDFT 中通过多体波函数纳入多构型效应，并借助解析非绝热耦合包含所有声子模贡献。该方法解决了与实验之间的偏差，对金刚石 NV⁻ 中心获得定量一致性，并指出了 SiC 中双空位三重态寿命中此前被忽略的非辐射通道。
authors: Stefano Paolo Villani, Yu Jin, Giulia Galli

articles.title: Tailoring the properties of YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ thin films by 30 keV He⁺ irradiation: An enabling route to superconducting device nanopatterning
articles.title_zh: 利用 30 keV He⁺ 辐照调控 YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ 薄膜性质：实现超导器件纳米图案化的途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14588v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Focused helium ion beam (He-FIB) irradiation with 30 keV ions is a key tool for nanoscale patterning and defect engineering in high transition temperature (Tc) cuprate superconducting devices, yet its usable fluence window is constrained by the competing requirements of reliable superconductivity suppression and minimal structural degradation. In this work, we provide a comprehensive dataset on the effects of large-area 30 keV He+ ion exposure on the electric transport and superconducting properties of epitaxial YBa2Cu3O7 (YBCO) thin films. X-ray diffraction shows a fluence-driven loss of crystalline order accompanied by an out-of-plane lattice expansion and an orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition, culminating at predominant amorphization at the highest fluence of 1 x 10¹⁶ cm⁻². Raman spectra exhibit increasing disorder while lacking signatures of oxygen depletion, indicating that irradiation mainly generates oxygen-related Frenkel defects rather than changing the carrier concentration. Consistently, with increasing fluence, the normal-state resistivity h̊o_N(T) at temperature T above Tc increases strongly, while d h̊o_N/d T remains nearly unchanged at moderate fluence. The suppression of Tc is accurately described by Abrikosov-Gor'kov pair breaking and reaches complete quenching of superconductivity at 4.5 x 10¹⁵ cm⁻². The anisotropic upper critical fields decrease approximately exponentially with increasing fluence, the vortex activation energy is reduced, and the anisotropy drops, in contrast to oxygen-depleted YBCO. Hall-angle analysis confirms a nearly constant carrier density but a systematic increase in defect scattering and reduced mobility, consistent with a crossover toward the dirty limit at high fluence. These results establish quantitative fluence thresholds and a practical operational window for He-FIB nanopatterning of YBCO quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察了 30 keV 聚焦氦离子束大面积辐照对外延 YBCO 薄膜电输运和超导性质的影响，以界定高温超导器件纳米图案化中的可用剂量窗口。X 射线衍射显示随辐照通量增加，晶体有序性降低、面外晶格膨胀，并发生正交到四方结构转变，高通量下趋于非晶化；拉曼谱表明无明显氧亏损，而主要产生与氧相关的 Frenkel 缺陷。随通量升高，正常态电阻率显著增加，说明氦离子辐照可有效调控超导抑制与结构损伤之间的平衡。
authors: Bernd Aichner, Simon Koch, Philipp A. Korner, Max Karrer, Katja Wurster, Christoph Schmid, Ulrich Kentsch, Reinhold Kleiner, Edward Goldobin, Dieter Koelle, Wolfgang Lang

articles.title: Monolithic hybrid quantum dot devices in superconducting twisted bilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 超导魔角扭转双层石墨烯中的单片混合量子点器件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14685v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gate-tunable superconductivity in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) has enabled the realization of superconducting devices, such as Josephson junctions, within a single crystal. This interface-free platform provides a reconfigurable and scalable architecture that overcomes limitations of conventional superconducting-semiconducting systems. Incorporating single-electron control enables access to regimes in which flat-band superconductivity competes with strong Coulomb repulsion, providing a platform for studying correlated physics phenomena. Here, we report a new class of quantum devices that combines electrostatic confinement with tunable superconductivity in a monolithic MATBG architecture. Within a single device, we demonstrate two complementary hybrid systems: superconducting islands and proximitized quantum dots. The superconducting island exhibits 2e-periodic transport, indicating a well-defined gap protected against quasiparticle poisoning. The proximitized quantum dot hosts subgap Andreev states together with a strongly parity-modulated supercurrent.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在单片魔角扭转双层石墨烯（MATBG）架构中结合静电限域与可调超导性，构建了一类新的混合量子器件。作者在同一器件中实现了两种互补体系：超导岛和受近邻效应影响的量子点。超导岛表现出 2e 周期输运，说明其具有明确能隙并能抵抗准粒子中毒；近邻量子点则承载亚能隙 Andreev 态，并呈现强烈奇偶调制的超电流。
authors: Alexandra Mestre-Torà, Marta Perego, Clara Galante Agero, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Thomas Ihn, Klaus Ensslin, Artem O. Denisov

articles.title: Tantalum as a base material for superconducting integrated circuits
articles.title_zh: 钽作为超导集成电路基础材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13750v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The performance of superconducting integrated circuits for quantum applications is fundamentally limited by material-related losses. Tantalum, as an emerging material for next-generation quantum circuits, has attracted considerable attention in recent years after demonstrating breakthrough performance in both superconducting microwave resonators and qubits. Concurrently, a growing body of work is devoted to the operation of tantalum-based circuits and related fabrication techniques. This interest is further stimulated by tantalum thin films polymorphism resulting in a variety of its crystalline structure, superconducting properties, coherence, etc. Furthermore, tantalum circuits exhibit distinctive features in cryogenic experiments, which have not been observed in aluminum- or niobium-based ones. In this review, we summarize the recent research of tantalum thin films growth and phase selection mechanisms on various substrates, key aspects of fabrication and performance of superconducting circuit, including a material first-principles theoretical study. In conclusion, we address a number of open issues, including the role of beta-phase impurities, the effect of hydrofluoric acid solutions on chain characteristics, and the anomalous behavior of α-tantalum chains at cryogenic temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述聚焦钽作为下一代量子超导集成电路基础材料的研究进展，讨论其在微波谐振器和量子比特中展现出的低损耗与高性能潜力。文章总结了钽薄膜在不同衬底上的生长、相选择机制、多晶型对超导性质和相干性的影响，以及钽基超导电路的制备与性能。作者还概述了第一性原理材料研究和低温实验中的独特现象，并指出包括 β 相作用等仍待解决的问题。
authors: Evgeniy V. Zikiy, Nikita S. Smirnov, Stanislav A. Kotenkov, Ilya A. Stepanov, Julia A. Agafonova, Daria A. Moskaleva, Aleksei R. Matanin, Anton I. Ivanov, Dmitry O. Moskalev, Julia A. Kurochkina, Aleksander V. Andriyash, Ilya A. Rodionov

articles.title: Resurgence of the Thermal Transition between Bounce and Sphaleron
articles.title_zh: 反弹解与鞍点解之间热跃迁的复兴理论研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13778v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the thermal transition between the bounce and the sphaleron in quantum mechanics with a metastable vacuum from the viewpoint of Borel resurgence. For two models representing a second-order and a first-order transition, we compute the perturbative expansion of the thermal free energy to high orders and extract the leading Borel singularity data (A,b,S) as functions of temperature. The Borel singularity location A reproduces the on-shell action of the dominant saddle on both sides of the transition, joining smoothly in the second-order case and developing a kink in the first-order case. The characteristic exponent b jumps between 0 and 1/2 across the transition, counting the zero modes of the corresponding saddle. The Stokes constant S matches the one-loop determinant around the saddle. The perturbative expansion around the false vacuum thus determines the transition temperature, the order of the transition, and the decay rate including the one-loop prefactor without relying on semiclassical inputs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作从 Borel 复兴角度研究具有亚稳真空的量子力学体系中反弹解与鞍点解之间的热跃迁。作者针对分别代表二阶和一阶跃迁的两个模型，高阶计算热自由能的微扰展开，并提取随温度变化的主导 Borel 奇点数据。结果显示，Borel 奇点位置再现跃迁两侧主导鞍点的在壳作用量，二阶情形平滑连接而一阶情形出现折点；特征指数的跳变反映零模数目，Stokes 常数则对应鞍点一圈行列式。
authors: Shaun D. Hampton, Kyungsun Lee, Sungjay Lee

articles.title: RG Dynamics of Irrelevant Fermion Operators and the Drag Coupling Mechanism
articles.title_zh: 无关费米子算符的重整化群动力学与拖曳耦合机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13792v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the renormalization-group flow of higher-dimensional fermionic interactions (ψ^dagger ψ)²ⁿ in the presence of a Fermi surface. We show that the growth of the BCS four-fermion coupling induces a drag mechanism whereby higher-order fermionic couplings are driven to strong coupling in the infrared. We derive the corresponding beta functions and show that the drag effect applies generically to the whole tower of fermionic operators. Remarkably, although all couplings are driven toward the same strong-coupling scale, the renormalization-group flow preserves a hierarchy in which higher-dimensional operators remain parametrically suppressed relative to the BCS interaction. We then investigate this mechanism in a 2+1-dimensional non-Fermi liquid coupled to a critical boson. While higher-order fermionic interactions are similarly enhanced along the flow, we show that they do not destabilize the IR stable non-Fermi-liquid fixed point, present for sufficiently large N. We briefly discuss possible implications for multicomponent superconductors and other strongly correlated metallic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了存在费米面的体系中高维费米相互作用 (ψ†ψ)²ⁿ 的重整化群流。研究表明，BCS 四费米耦合的增长会产生拖曳机制，使整塔高阶费米耦合在红外被推向强耦合；尽管这些耦合趋向相同强耦合尺度，高维算符相对于 BCS 相互作用仍保持参数上的层级抑制。作者还将该机制推广到 2+1 维、耦合临界玻色子的非费米液体，发现高阶费米相互作用虽被增强，但在足够大 N 下不会破坏红外稳定非费米液体不动点。
authors: Jeremias Aguilera-Damia, Diego Rodriguez-Gomez, Jorge Russo

articles.title: Universal Crossovers of Stabilizer Entropy Beyond Criticality
articles.title_zh: 临界性之外稳定子熵的普适交叉行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13810v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stabilizer Rényi entropy has emerged as a probe of nonstabilizerness in quantum many-body systems, but its scaling structure beyond critical points remains poorly understood compared with entanglement entropy. Recent field-theory approaches indicate that stabilizer entropy contains universal critical data and boundary-sensitive terms, raising the question of how these structures extend into massive and crossover regimes. We address this problem for a broad class of finite-range spin chains at Rényi index one-half. We derive exact finite-size formulas for both full periodic chains and finite intervals of the infinite chain, making the universal crossover from critical to noncritical behavior analytically accessible. In periodic geometry, the entropy obeys a volume law away from criticality and exhibits a universal finite-size crossover controlled by the competition between system size and correlation length. We also show that the large-scale SRE density develops a cusp across the field-tuned critical line, while the XX endpoint is governed by a distinct scaling regime associated with the saturation point. In the subsystem geometry, the interval entropy separates bulk critical behavior from boundary contributions generated by the way the finite region cuts the infinite chain. The crossover from critical to massive behavior is then encoded in boundary constants and universal functions controlled by the correlation length. Through exact stabilizer-entropy correspondences, the scaling theory extends to internal XY reductions, Finite-range spin chains, and Cluster--Ising representatives. Our results provide an exact lattice benchmark for the emerging QFT description of stabilizer entropy beyond isolated conformal points.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察稳定子 Rényi 熵在量子多体系统临界点之外的标度结构，重点关注 Rényi 指数为 1/2 的有限程自旋链。作者推导了周期全链和无限链有限区间两种几何中的精确有限尺寸公式，使从临界到非临界行为的普适交叉可解析研究。在周期几何中，熵在偏离临界时服从体积律，并表现出由系统尺寸与关联长度竞争控制的普适有限尺寸交叉；其大尺度密度在场调临界线两侧形成尖点，而 XX 端点对应不同的饱和点标度机制。
authors: Reyhaneh Khasseh, E. A. Ramirez Trino, M. A. Rajabpour

articles.title: An integrated ultrahigh vacuum cluster tool for diamond surface science and single nitrogen-vacancy center measurements
articles.title_zh: 用于金刚石表面科学和单氮-空位中心测量的一体化超高真空集群设备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13961v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a custom-designed ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) cluster tool developed for studying shallow nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, enabling in situ diamond surface preparation, characterization, and single NV center dynamics measurements within a single connected platform. The system combines a surface science chamber for controlled surface modification and analysis with a cryogenic confocal microscope chamber dedicated to NV spin and optical measurements. This integrated approach enables a direct correlation between diamond surface chemistry and the resulting NV spin and charge properties. The instrument provides a versatile platform for systematic studies of surface-induced decoherence mechanisms and charge dynamics for shallow NV centers, and establishes a pathway toward reproducible surface engineering for quantum sensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作介绍了一套定制的超高真空集群设备，用于研究金刚石浅层氮-空位（NV）中心，可在同一连通平台内实现原位表面制备、表征以及单 NV 中心动力学测量。系统结合了用于受控表面改性和分析的表面科学腔体，以及用于 NV 自旋和光学测量的低温共聚焦显微镜腔体。该集成方案可直接关联金刚石表面化学与 NV 自旋、 charge 性质，为研究浅层 NV 中心的表面诱导退相干和电荷动力学、以及可重复表面工程提供平台。
authors: Zhiyang Yuan, Sorawis Sangtawesin, Lila V. H. Rodgers, Kalliope Zervas, James J. Allred, Jared Rovny, Patryk Gumann, Nathalie P. de Leon

articles.title: All about quantum error correction: distillation, mitigation, self-correction and beyond
articles.title_zh: 量子纠错全景：蒸馏、误差缓解、自校正及更多
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14034v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this work, it is shown that many quantum error-manipulating techniques, such as distillation, error mitigation, and dynamical decoupling, are special cases of the most general framework for quantum error correction. This unifying perspective is achieved by extending quantum error correction to include state-adaptive and channel-adaptive settings, as well as multi-stage coding scenarios. Based on this insight, a model of self-correcting quantum memory is also proposed. This work clarifies the relationship among these techniques and illustrates, through explicit constructions, how the unified perspective can guide the design of reliable quantum information systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，量子态蒸馏、误差缓解、动态去耦等多种量子误差处理技术都可视为广义量子纠错框架的特例。作者通过将量子纠错扩展到状态自适应、信道自适应以及多阶段编码情形，建立了统一视角，并据此提出一种自校正量子存储模型。该工作澄清了相关技术之间的关系，并通过显式构造展示其对可靠量子信息系统设计的指导意义。

articles.title: Synchronization of Quasi-Particle Excitations in a Quantum Gas with Cavity-Mediated Interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有腔介导相互作用的量子气体中准粒子激发的同步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.17731v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Driven-dissipative quantum systems can undergo transitions from stationary to dynamical phases, reflecting the emergence of collective non-equilibrium behavior. We study such a transition in a Bose-Einstein condensate coupled to an optical cavity and develop a cavity-assisted Bragg spectroscopy technique to resolve its collective modes. We observe dissipation-induced synchronization at the quasiparticle level, where two roton-like modes coalesce at an exceptional point. This reveals how dissipation microscopically drives collective dynamics and signals a precursor to a dynamical phase transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了与光学腔耦合的玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体中由耗散驱动的非平衡动力学相变。作者发展了腔辅助布拉格谱技术以分辨体系的集体模式，并观测到准粒子层面的耗散诱导同步：两个类 roton 模式在例外点处并合。结果揭示了耗散如何在微观层面驱动集体动力学，并可作为动力学相变的先兆信号。
authors: Gabriele Natale, Alexander Baumgärtner, Justyna Stefaniak, David Baur, Simon Hertlein, Dalila Rivero, Tilman Esslinger, Tobias Donner

articles.title: Electron-phonon-coupled Langevin dynamics for strongly-correlated insulators
articles.title_zh: 强关联绝缘体的电子—声子耦合朗之万动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.19764v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equations are widely used to study spin dynamics in Mott insulators. However, because energy damping is typically introduced phenomenologically, their validity for describing nonequilibrium processes and their connection to the microscopic origin of dissipation in real materials remains unclear. In this paper, we derive generalized stochastic LLG equations from first principles for spin-orbital coupled Mott insulators, explicitly incorporating the coupling between electronic degrees of freedom and lattice vibrations. Our approach is based on a path-integral formalism formulated along the Keldysh contour, which naturally accounts for dissipation and thermal fluctuations through interactions with a phonon bath and emergent stochastic noise. We benchmark our theoretical framework by numerically integrating the equations of motion for a two-orbital spin chain coupled to Einstein phonons. The resulting energy relaxation mimics realistic cooling dynamics, exhibits nontrivial transient behavior during thermalization, and accurately reproduces thermodynamic properties upon equilibration. We further demonstrate how electron-phonon coupling induces hybridization between electronic and phononic modes in the excitation spectrum and show that the conventional LLG equations are recovered as a limiting case of our microscopic theory. These results establish a robust and reliable framework for capturing dissipative spin dynamics in strongly correlated systems, both in and out of equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从第一性原理推导了适用于自旋—轨道耦合莫特绝缘体的广义随机 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程，显式纳入电子自由度与晶格振动之间的耦合。该方法基于 Keldysh 轮廓上的路径积分形式，自然描述由声子热浴引起的耗散与热涨落。作者通过含爱因斯坦声子的双轨道自旋链数值积分验证框架，发现其能再现实istic冷却动力学、热化过程中的非平凡瞬态行为以及平衡后的热力学性质。
authors: Rico Pohle, Yukitoshi Motome, Terumasa Tadano, Shintaro Hoshino

articles.title: Fast and Continuous Detection of Single Microwave Photons via Photo-assisted Quasiparticle Tunneling to a Superconducting Island
articles.title_zh: 通过光辅助准粒子隧穿至超导岛实现单个微波光子的快速连续探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.17470v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate a single-photon detector operating in the microwave domain, based on photo-assisted quasiparticle tunneling events that poison a superconducting island. The detection relies on continuously monitoring the island's charge parity using microwave reflectometry. This scheme achieves 10% detection efficiency with sub SI50ns time resolution and short dead time (sim SI1s̆), for microwave photons at SI10GHz. The detector features three junctions connected to a superconducting island, which together carry out photoelectric conversion and charge readout. The enhanced light--matter coupling, crucial to photon to quasiparticle conversion, is provided by a granular aluminum-based high-impedance microwave resonator. The time resolved detection of itinerant microwave photon opens up new perspectives in quantum sensing, microwave quantum optics and mesoscopic physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者演示了一种工作于微波频段的单光子探测器，其机制是光辅助准粒子隧穿事件导致超导岛“中毒”。探测过程依赖微波反射测量对超导岛电荷宇称的连续监测，在约 10 GHz 微波光子下实现了 10% 的探测效率、低于 50 ns 的时间分辨率和约 1 μs 的短死时间。该器件利用三结超导岛结构完成光电转换和电荷读出，并借助颗粒铝高阻抗微波谐振器增强光—物质耦合，为微波量子光学和量子传感提供新工具。
authors: Julien Basset, Ognjen Stanisavljević, Julien Gabelli, Marco Aprili, Jérôme Estève

articles.title: Emission of time-ordered photon pairs from a coherently-driven Kerr microcavity
articles.title_zh: 相干驱动 Kerr 微腔中的时间有序光子对发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.06468v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Weakly-interacting many-body systems possess remarkable quantum properties that are essential components of quantum technologies, and constitute a topic of fundamental interest. Here we show that in a solid-state nonlinear microcavity embedding discrete modes of exciton-dressed photons, we can isolate a single eigenmode of quantum fluctuations from the much brighter coherent fraction of the field. In this regime, we perform frequency- and time-resolved correlations measurements between photons on the red and blue side of the fluctuations spectrum. When the average number of fluctuation quanta is smaller than one, we observe the formation of large pairwise time-ordered correlations: red photon first and blue photon second. We show that this peculiar time-ordering correlation emerges spontaneously from the interplay between frequency-resolved detection, and the non-trivial internal quantum structure of the elementary fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究含有离散激子修饰光子模式的固态非线性微腔中弱相互作用多体体系的量子涨落。作者能够从强得多的相干场分量中分离出单个量子涨落本征模，并对涨落谱红侧与蓝侧光子进行频率和时间分辨的相关测量。在平均涨落量子数小于 1 时，实验观测到显著的成对时间有序关联，即红光子先出现、蓝光子随后出现，源于频率分辨探测与基本涨落内部量子结构的相互作用。
authors: Ferdinand Claude, Yueguang Zhou, Sylvain Ravets, Jacqueline Bloch, Martina Morassi, Aristide Lemaître, Alberto Bramati, Anna Minguzzi, Iacopo Carusotto, Irénée Frérot, Maxime Richard

articles.title: Computation and properties of the Epstein zeta function with applications to quantum systems
articles.title_zh: Epstein ζ 函数的计算与性质及其在量子系统中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.16317v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Epstein zeta function generalises the classical Riemann zeta function to oscillatory lattice sums in higher dimensions and has recently emerged as a key tool in the simulation of long-range interacting classical and quantum many-body systems. Its computation and analytic properties are therefore of significant interest, yet a rigorous and comprehensive treatment has been lacking. We address this gap by introducing a superexponentially convergent algorithm, complete with error bounds, for computing the Epstein zeta function in any dimension with arbitrary real parameters. Our approach is accompanied by a detailed analysis of the analytic properties of the Epstein zeta function. We first present a concise reformulation of its meromorphic continuation, functional equation, and symmetries. We then establish, for the first time, its joint holomorphic continuation in all parameters and offer a complete characterization of the resulting complex singularity structure, which governs convergence rates in numerical algorithms based on the function. Recognizing that the function can be decomposed into power-law singularities and a regularised analytic part, we provide an algorithm for removing singularities without cancellation error. This facilitates the evaluation of integrals and enables fast precomputations through interpolation methods. We present the first high-performance implementation for arbitrary real arguments in EpsteinLib, a C library with Python and Julia bindings, and rigorously benchmark its performance and accuracy, achieving full-precision evaluation against known analytic results in dimensions 1,2,3,4,6, and 8 and against an arbitrary precision implementation across the entire parameter range. Finally, we apply our methods to the computation of quantum dispersion relations in spin systems and Casimir energies in three-dimensional geometries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了 Epstein ζ 函数的数值计算与解析性质，该函数是黎曼 ζ 函数在高维振荡晶格和中的推广，并已成为模拟长程相互作用经典与量子多体系统的重要工具。作者提出了一种适用于任意维度和任意实参数的超指数收敛算法，并给出误差界。工作还重述了其亚纯延拓、函数方程和对称性，并首次建立所有参数的联合全纯延拓及相应复奇点结构表征，为相关数值算法的收敛分析提供基础。
authors: Andreas A. Buchheit, Jonathan Busse, Ruben Gutendorf

articles.title: The Magic Barrier before Thermalization
articles.title_zh: 热化之前的魔性势垒
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.11681v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate the time dependence of anti-flatness in the entanglement spectrum, a measure for non-stabilizerness and lower bound for non-local quantum magic resource, on a subsystem of a linear SU(2) plaquette chain during thermalization. Tracing the time evolution of a large number of initial states, we find that the anti-flatness exhibits a barrier-like maximum during the time period when the entanglement entropy of the subsystem grows rapidly from the initial value to the microcanonical entropy. The location of the peak is strongly correlated with the time when the entanglement exhibits the strongest growth. This behavior is found for generic highly excited initial computational basis states and persists for coupling constants across the ergodic regime, revealing a universal structure of the entanglement spectrum during thermalization. We conclude that quantitative simulations of thermalization for nonabelian gauge theories require quantum computing. We speculate that this property generalizes to other quantum chaotic systems, a conjecture supported by analogous behavior observed in real-time simulations of the mixed-field Ising model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察线性 SU(2) plaquette 链在热化过程中子系统纠缠谱反平坦度的时间演化，该量可衡量非稳定子性并给出非局域量子魔性资源的下界。通过跟踪大量初态，作者发现当子系统纠缠熵从初值快速增长到微正则熵时，反平坦度会出现类似势垒的峰值，且峰位置与纠缠增长最强时刻高度相关。这一现象在遍历区域内多种耦合常数和高激发计算基初态中均存在，表明热化过程中纠缠谱具有某种普适结构。
authors: Lukas Ebner, Berndt Müller, Andreas Schäfer, Leonhard Schmotzer, Clemens Seidl, Xiaojun Yao

articles.title: Engineering Photoluminescence with Mie Voids
articles.title_zh: 利用 Mie 空洞调控光致发光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.19420v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Spontaneous emission, as a fundamental radiative process and a versatile information carrier, plays a vital role in light-emitting devices, optical information modulation and encryption, super-resolution fluorescence imaging. Engineering the photonic environment surrounding photon emitters enables control over their emission properties. However, simultaneously achieving precise engineering of both excitation enhancement and quantum-yield modulation at the nanoscale remains elusive, highlighting substantial room for advancing the precise orchestrating of photoluminescence. Here, we introduce silicon Mie voids - air-defined cavities that invert the conventional solid-particle geometry - to achieve independent tuning of photoluminescence within a single subwavelength unit, while minimizing optical losses. Full-wave simulations and experiments on both gradient and uniform Mie-void arrays jointly validate this quantitative framework for spontaneous emission tuning, which disentangles excitation enhancement arising from local field confinement in air and quantum-yield enhancement resulting from strengthened emitter-resonator coupling, while confirming the accelerated radiative decay enabled by the modified optical LDOS. Leveraging this flexible mechanism, we realize a multimodal nanophotonic pattern with near-diffraction-limited pixels that encode the EPFL logo in the bright field and the SJTU logo in both dark field and photoluminescence maps. These results establish Mie voids as a powerful platform for high-density multimodal encrypted displays and open new avenues for advancing state-of-the-art nanophotonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出以硅 Mie 空洞作为亚波长光子环境来调控自发辐射和光致发光；这种由空气定义的腔体反转了传统实心颗粒几何，并有助于降低光学损耗。作者旨在在单个亚波长单元内独立调节激发增强与量子产率调制，从而实现更精确的纳米尺度发光控制。全波模拟以及梯度和均匀 Mie 空洞阵列实验共同验证了该自发辐射调控框架，可区分由空气局域场约束带来的激发增强和由发射体—谐振器耦合增强带来的量子产率提升。
authors: Yuchao Fu, Ilia Lykov, Sergejs Boroviks, Nai-Quan Zhu, Tianyue Li, Siarhei Zavatski, Makhlad Chahid, Olivier J. F. Martin

articles.title: Efimov Effect in Ultracold Microwave-Shielded Polar Molecules
articles.title_zh: 超冷微波屏蔽极性分子中的 Efimov 效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.21433v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A quantum-mechanical description is presented for the three-body physics of shielded dipolar molecules, including a prediction of observable Efimov physics. Despite the anisotropic and long-range nature of the interaction, shielding enables a regime in which universality emerges already at the two-body level and extends to the three-body sector, where Efimov physics emerges. On the negative side of the scattering-length resonance, computed trimer binding energies display the characteristic scaling expected for Efimov resonances. Finally, the sudden approximation can be used to create trimer bound states, starting from positive energy trap states as a way to create or detect these molecular trimers. Moreover, the three-body parameter expressed in dipolar units is found to be universal.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文给出了微波屏蔽偶极分子三体物理的量子力学描述，并预言了可观测的 Efimov 物理。尽管相互作用具有各向异性和长程性质，屏蔽机制仍使体系在二体层面出现普适性，并延伸到三体扇区。在散射长度共振的负侧，计算得到的三聚体束缚能呈现 Efimov 共振的特征标度；作者还提出可用突然近似从正能陷阱态制备或探测分子三聚体，并发现以偶极单位表示的三体参数具有普适性。

articles.title: Fast and accurate simulation of Raman spectra of gold-organic systems
articles.title_zh: 金—有机体系拉曼光谱的快速准确模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14207v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resolving the spectral Raman signature of molecules grafted on a metallic support is often a difficult task, in which quantum chemistry methods allow for precious additional rationalization and signal attributions, especially to probe the formation of a bond with the support. In the specific case of gold-organic architectures based on a Au-C bond, only a limited amount of experimental and theoretical reference data are available in the literature, and Raman simulations based on quantum mechanics quickly become unaffordable with the size of the system. In this work, we evaluate the precision of a cost-efficient DFTB method to simulate Raman spectra of gold-organic systems at different scales, from gold complexes to functionalized gold surfaces. After a validation of the method through a careful comparison of DFTB Raman spectra of organometallic gold(I) and (III) complexes to DFT and experimental reference data, we discuss the case of molecules grafted on gold aggregates. For these simulations, the choice of the model (cluster or periodic surface) appears to be critical, and significant differences arise (positions and intensities of the peaks) when considering a full metallic slab, as allowed by the low computational cost of the method.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作评估了低成本 DFTB 方法用于模拟金—有机体系拉曼光谱的精度，研究对象从金配合物扩展到功能化金表面。作者首先将有机金(I)和金(III)配合物的 DFTB 拉曼谱与 DFT 及实验参考数据进行比较，以验证方法可靠性。随后讨论分子接枝在金团簇上的情形，指出模型选择（团簇或周期表面）对谱峰位置和强度具有关键影响。
authors: Auguste Tetenoire, Vijaya Raghavan Kannan, Mikaël Kepenekian, Arnaud Fihey

articles.title: Large Language Model Based Agent for Automated Discovery in Computational Physics
articles.title_zh: 用于计算物理自动发现的大语言模型智能体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14266v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific discovery in computational physics can often be framed as the optimization of quantitatively evaluable objectives subject to physical constraints. While researchers excel at formulating such problems, they frequently devote substantial effort to iterative refinement of methods and solution strategies. To accelerate this process, we introduce PhyNex, an autonomous agent that systematically explores the solution space of scorable scientific tasks by coupling large language model (LLM)-guided search with domain-specific computational tools that enforce physical consistency. PhyNex operates via progressive local search, accumulates reusable knowledge from both successful and failed attempts, and produces interpretable exploration trajectories that reveal which algorithmic components drive performance improvements. We validate PhyNex on three representative and scientifically important problems: predicting frequency-dependent dielectric spectra of semiconductors from crystal structure, designing probabilistic-circuit heuristics for Max-Cut on graphs, and optimizing charging protocols for Dicke quantum batteries in the chaotic coupling regime. Across the three tasks, PhyNex autonomously identifies solutions that match or exceed state-of-the-art approaches designed by human scientists, yielding search-averaged improvements of up to 3.8% in spectral similarity, up to 15.0% in normalized mean cut for Max-Cut, and 5.9% in ergotropy at the 80k training checkpoint in open exploration. These findings demonstrate that LLM-based agents with structured, feedback-driven exploration can substantially accelerate the path from problem specification to effective implementation, suggesting a practical division of labor in which scientists define objectives and constraints while automated systems navigate the methodological search space.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 PhyNex，一种面向计算物理中可定量评分科学任务的自主智能体，将大语言模型引导的搜索与保证物理一致性的领域计算工具相结合。该智能体通过渐进式局部搜索运行，并从成功与失败尝试中积累可复用知识，同时生成可解释的探索轨迹以揭示性能提升来源。作者在半导体频率相关介电谱预测、图上 Max-Cut 概率电路启发式设计以及混沌 Dicke 量子电池充电协议优化等代表性问题上验证了该方法。
authors: Hang Lin, Chongwen Liu, Gang Yan

articles.title: Implementation of two-qubit Rydberg operations on neutral Rb-87 atoms in systems with different intermediate states
articles.title_zh: 在采用不同中间态的系统中实现中性铷-87原子的双量子比特 Rydberg 操作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13975v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work presents an experimental setup for implementing two-qubit operations on neutral atoms (⁸⁷Rb) with the possibility of using two different Rydberg excitation schemes. One of them uses 5P₁/₂ as the intermediate level and applies the second-stage beam locally to the addressed atoms. The second scheme uses the 6P₃/₂ level; in this scheme, the particles to be entangled are moved to a separate zone through which both Rydberg beams pass. The advantages and limitations of both schemes are analyzed. Based on numerical modeling performed with a Julia package developed by the authors, it is demonstrated that the spatial configuration has a greater effect on quantum-operation fidelity than the choice of intermediate level. An experimental implementation of the scheme using the 6P₃/₂ level is demonstrated, making it possible to achieve a two-qubit operation fidelity of 94%.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于在中性 ⁸⁷Rb 原子上实现双量子比特操作的实验平台，可采用两种不同的 Rydberg 激发方案。第一种方案使用 5P₁/₂ 作为中间能级并对目标原子局域施加第二阶段光束；第二种方案使用 6P₃/₂ 能级，并将待纠缠原子移动到两束 Rydberg 光共同通过的独立区域。作者分析了两种方案的优缺点，并基于自研 Julia 数值模拟表明空间构型对量子操作保真度的影响大于中间能级选择；实验上采用 6P₃/₂ 方案实现了 94% 的双量子比特操作保真度。
authors: I. V. Iukhnovets (Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology, P. N. Lebedev Physical Institute), O. V. Bychkova (P. N. Lebedev Physical Institute), I. B. Bobrov (Quantum Technology Centre and Faculty of Physics, M. V. Lomonosov Moscow State University), A. P. Gordeev (P. N. Lebedev Physical Institute, Quantum Technology Centre and Faculty of Physics, M. V. Lomonosov Moscow State University), M. Y. Goloshchapov (Technical University of Munich, Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München), G. I. Struchalin (Quantum Technology Centre and Faculty of Physics, M. V. Lomonosov Moscow State University), S. S. Straupe (Russian Quantum Center, Quantum Technology Centre and Faculty of Physics, M. V. Lomonosov Moscow State University)

articles.title: Quantum-Classical Hierarchical Equations of Motion
articles.title_zh: 量子—经典分层运动方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14363v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a quantum-classical hierarchical equations of motion (QC-HEOM) approach for simulating non-Markovian open quantum systems. The method combines the ensemble-averaged classical path reference of the quantum-classical path integral formalism with a hierarchy of auxiliary quantum influence functionals. By incorporating thermal fluctuations through an ensemble average over reference trajectories, the hierarchy is required to represent only the residual quantum memory associated with the imaginary part of the bath response function. Consequently, unlike conventional hierarchical equations of motion, QC-HEOM does not require Matsubara or Padé expansions of the thermal kernel and exhibits only weak temperature dependence of the hierarchy size. Furthermore, because thermal fluctuations are supplied through reference classical trajectories, the framework naturally extends beyond harmonic baths and enables the incorporation of anharmonic and molecular environments through externally generated trajectories. We derive the formalism and demonstrate its exactness for a harmonic bath. Applications to an asymmetric spin-boson model and the seven-site Fenna--Matthews--Olson complex illustrate the accuracy of QC-HEOM. It reproduces benchmark quasi-adiabatic path integral and hierarchical equations of motion results while requiring substantially fewer auxiliary objects, particularly at low temperatures. These results establish QC-HEOM as an efficient framework for treating residual quantum memory in quantum-classical descriptions of open-system dynamics. The separation of thermal fluctuations from residual quantum memory through the use of Wigner trajectories provides an approximate route toward hierarchical treatments of complex anharmonic environments that are inaccessible to conventional HEOM approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种量子—经典分层运动方程（QC-HEOM）方法，用于模拟非马尔可夫开放量子系统。该方法将量子—经典路径积分中的系综平均经典参考路径与辅助量子影响泛函层级相结合，使层级主要刻画浴响应函数虚部所对应的残余量子记忆。与传统 HEOM 不同，该方法无需对热核进行 Matsubara 或 Padé 展开，层级规模对温度依赖较弱，并可通过外部生成轨迹扩展到非谐和分子环境。作者推导了形式体系，并证明其在谐振子浴情形下的精确性。

articles.title: Certification of the genuine resolution of photon number resolving detectors
articles.title_zh: 光子数分辨探测器真实分辨率的认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14365v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Photon-number-resolving (PNR) detectors are essential components of photonic quantum technologies, yet thus far, no practical metric exists to certify how many photons they can genuinely resolve in a single measurement. Here we introduce an operational framework for quantifying the capability of a PNR detector to distinguish between different numbers of photons, i.e. its genuine resolution. In turn, we develop a practical and scalable protocol for certifying the genuine resolution of a detector, which is based on coherent state probes. We apply the method to a 28-pixel photon-number-resolving superconducting nanowire single-photon detector (PNR-SNSPD) and certify genuine four-outcome resolution. Our work highlights the critical requirements in terms of detector efficiency towards achieving high genuine resolution. This approach provides an operational benchmark for PNR detectors and fills a crucial gap in the characterization of photonic quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子数分辨探测器是光子量子技术的重要器件，但此前缺乏实用指标来认证其在单次测量中真实区分光子数的能力。本文提出一个操作性框架来量化探测器的“真实分辨率”，并发展了基于相干态探针的可扩展认证协议。作者将该方法应用于 28 像素光子数分辨超导纳米线单光子探测器，认证了真实四结果分辨能力。该工作为光子数分辨探测器提供了操作性基准，并强调了探测效率对高真实分辨率的关键作用。
authors: Jef Pauwels, Towsif Taher, Roope Uola, Boris Korzh, Nicolas Brunner, Pavel Sekatski

articles.title: Scaling native entanglement generation in layered semiconductors with quasi-phase matching
articles.title_zh: 利用准相位匹配扩展层状半导体中的本征纠缠产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14553v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Efficient generation of entangled photons typically relies on spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in phase-matched macroscopic nonlinear media. However, generating entanglement under phase-matching constraints requires additional bulk optics or interferometers. In contrast, ultrathin van der Waals semiconductors - such as transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) - exhibit strong enough optical nonlinearities for SPDC to be observed from subwavelength-thick media, thereby bypassing conventional phase-matching constraints. In this microscopic domain, the intrinsic crystal symmetry governs the nonlinear optical response, enabling the native generation of polarization-entangled photon pairs. However, generating these states efficiently has been fundamentally restricted by the material's coherence length (L_c), which limits the attainable conversion efficiency. Here, we investigate periodically-poled TMDs (PPTMDs) designed to scale up this interaction via quasi-phase matching. We demonstrate that mechanically flipping the sign of the nonlinearity at precise intervals of L_c introduces quasi-phase matching, that scales the pair-production rate while preserving the pristine, symmetry-generated polarization entanglement, with fidelities exceeding 99%. Backed by a rigorous theoretical model, our work clarifies the interplay between crystal symmetry and propagation effects in thin nonlinear media, providing a new avenue for engineering quantum light in nanophotonic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 高效纠缠光子产生通常依赖宏观非线性介质中的相位匹配自发参量下转换，而超薄范德华半导体可在亚波长厚度下产生非线性响应，从而绕开传统相位匹配限制。本文研究周期极化过渡金属二硫族化物，通过在相干长度间隔处机械翻转非线性符号来实现准相位匹配。该设计旨在放大薄层材料中的参量相互作用，提高本征偏振纠缠光子对的产生效率。研究展示了在保持晶体对称性所赋予的本征纠缠机制的同时，突破相干长度对转换效率的限制。
authors: Benjamin Braun, Andrea Alessandrini, Josip Bajo, Philipp K. Jenke, Leone di Mauro Villari, Birui Yang, Zhi Hao Peng, P. James Schuck, Cory R. Dean, Andrea Marini, Philip Walther, Chiara Trovatello, Lee A. Rozema

articles.title: Geometric mechanisms enabling spin- and enantio-sensitive observables in one photon ionization of chiral molecules
articles.title_zh: 手性分子单光子电离中产生自旋与对映体敏感可观测量的几何机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02735v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We examine spin-resolved photoionization of randomly oriented chiral molecules via circularly polarized light, and revisit earlier predictions of Cherepkov (J. Phys. B: Atom. Mol. Phys. 16, 1543, 1983). We will show that the dynamical origin of spin- and enantio-sensitive observables arise from two intrinsic mechanisms that are quantified by two pseudovectors stemming from the geometric properties of the photoionization dipoles in spin space and in real space, and an extrinsic mechanism which is a directional bias introduced by the well-defined direction of light polarization. These mechanisms arise solely from electric dipole interactions. Consequently, this means that the ten independent parameters that was earlier predicted by Cherepkov to fully describe spin-resolved photoionization of chiral molecules can be reduced as moments of these three pseudovectors. We also find that the molecular pseudoscalars describing the spin- and enantio-sensitive components of the yield can be described by the flux of these pseudovectors through the energy shell, which changes sign upon switching enantiomers. Our results provide compact expressions for these observables which provide an intuitive picture on what determines the strength of these spin- and enantio-sensitive observables. The approach can be readily generalized to photoexcitation, multiphoton processes, and arbitrary field polarizations. Regardless of the specific driving conditions, the resulting spin- and enantio-sensitive observables are still controlled by the same three pseudovectors, underscoring their universal role as the primary generators of chirality-induced spin asymmetries, emphasizing their fundamental geometric origin and the universality of the mechanism identified here.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究随机取向手性分子在圆偏振光作用下的自旋分辨光电离，并重新审视 Cherepkov 早期关于该过程的理论预测。作者指出，自旋与对映体敏感可观测量的动力学来源可归结为两个由自旋空间和实空间中光电离偶极几何性质定义的内禀赝矢量，以及由光偏振方向引入的外禀方向偏置。该机制仅源于电偶极相互作用，并可将早期所需的十个独立参数化约为这些赝矢量的矩。研究还表明，相关分子赝标量可由这些赝矢量穿过能壳的通量描述，并在更换对映体时变号。
authors: Philip Caesar M. Flores, Stefanos Carlström, Serguei Patchkovskii, Misha Ivanov, Andres F. Ordonez, Olga Smirnova

articles.title: Experimental violation of a Bell-like inequality for causal order
articles.title_zh: 因果顺序贝尔型不等式的实验违背
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.20516v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum mechanics is compatible with scenarios where physical processes happen in an indefinite order. In theory, this feature could be detected through violations of inequalities on the observed correlations, analogous to Bell inequalities. However, experimental demonstrations of such violations have been missing until recently due to the complexity of the required setup. Here we report an experimental violation of a Bell-like inequality involving the correlations of four parties, one of which is spacelike separated from the others. Our demonstration employs 3 km fiber spools to simulate spacelike separation, and achieves high-speed operations in photonic time-bin encoding, nanosecond synchronization, and accurate temperature stabilization. These experimental advances enable a violation by 5.7 standard deviations and open a path towards a certification of indefinite order in conditions that guarantee spacelike separation with existing state-of-the-art devices. However, the certification is not device-independent, as it relies on knowledge about the setup to exclude bidirectional signaling--a loophole inherent to implementations in classical acyclic spacetimes, which may be resolved in future quantum-spacetime tests.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子力学允许物理过程处于不确定因果顺序中，理论上可通过类似贝尔不等式的相关性违背加以探测。本文报告了一个涉及四方相关性的贝尔型不等式实验违背，其中一方与其他各方类空间隔。实验利用 3 公里光纤盘模拟类空间隔，并结合光子时间仓编码的高速操作、纳秒同步和精确温度稳定，实现了 5.7 个标准差的违背。作者指出，该认证并非设备无关，因为仍依赖对实验装置的了解来排除双向信号传递这一漏洞。
authors: Yu Guo, Hao Tang, Bo-Xuan Wang, Min-Yu Lv, Jia-Wen, Fan, Xiao-Min Hu, Yun-Feng Huang, Chuan-Feng Liu, Guang-Can Guo, Giulio Chiribella, Bi-Heng Liu

articles.title: Decoupled Latent Optimization of Diffusion Models for Full Waveform Inversion
articles.title_zh: 用于全波形反演的扩散模型解耦潜空间优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Full waveform inversion (FWI) recovers subsurface velocity from seismic recordings by solving a severely ill-posed, nonconvex PDE-constrained optimization. Classical regularizers stabilize the inversion but fail to reproduce realistic geological structures; recent diffusion-prior methods improve realism at the cost of a fragile trade-off between data fidelity and prior consistency. We propose Decoupled Latent Optimization (DLO), which relaxes the standard latent-optimization formulation into a quadratic-penalty objective over an auxiliary physical variable and a latent variable. The data-fidelity gradient acts in physical space, the diffusion sampler contributes only through a decoded prior sample, and the standard smoothed-velocity initialization of classical FWI is preserved. On the OpenFWI benchmark, DLO outperforms classical regularizers and existing diffusion-based methods under clean, noisy, and missing-trace acquisitions. The prior, trained on 70*70 OpenFWI models, transfers directly to the Marmousi and Overthrust benchmarks, where DLO recovers intricate fault structures and remains robust to initialization smoothing and measurement noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 全波形反演通过求解强病态、非凸的偏微分方程约束优化问题来恢复地下速度结构，传统正则化难以重现真实地质结构，而扩散先验方法又面临数据保真与先验一致性的脆弱权衡。本文提出解耦潜空间优化（DLO），将标准潜变量优化松弛为包含辅助物理变量和潜变量的二次罚函数目标。该方法使数据保真梯度在物理空间中作用，扩散采样器仅通过解码先验样本提供约束，并保留经典 FWI 的平滑速度初始化。在 OpenFWI 及迁移到 Marmousi、Overthrust 等基准上的结果表明，DLO 在干净、含噪和缺失道采集条件下均优于传统正则化和已有扩散方法。

articles.title: Aligning Quantum Operators with Large Language Models
articles.title_zh: 利用大语言模型对齐量子算符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13811v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Can Large Language Models (LLMs) understand and reason about quantum operators? Despite their remarkable capabilities in mathematics and symbolic reasoning, LLMs remain inherently blind to quantum representations such as unitary matrices. In this work, we take a step toward bridging this gap by introducing an approach that maps unitary operators into the latent space of an LLM, enabling unified modeling over quantum and linguistic inputs. We instantiate this idea on Clifford+T circuit synthesis over a Pauli rotation gate set, where our model achieves results competitive with state-of-the-art methods and scales consistently with training data, with no signs of saturation. Our approach further enables language-conditioned synthesis, allowing gate constraints unseen during training to be specified directly in natural language. This work suggests a path toward quantum--aware foundation models that can natively interpret and reason about quantum operations, which could have broader implications reaching across quantum compilation and algorithm discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨大语言模型能否理解并推理量子算符，尤其是其对酉矩阵等量子表示的固有限制。作者提出将酉算符映射到大语言模型潜空间的方法，从而实现对量子输入与语言输入的统一建模。该方法在基于 Pauli 旋转门集的 Clifford+T 线路综合任务中取得了与先进方法相竞争的结果，并随训练数据规模稳定提升。研究还展示了语言条件综合能力，使模型能够根据自然语言指定训练中未见的门约束。
authors: Rogerio Feris, Yunchao Liu, Pengyuan Li, Hang Hua, David Kremer

articles.title: Study of Optical, Structural, Morphological, and Charge Transport Properties of thin films of PM6 (PBDB-T-2F) for Organic Solar Cells
articles.title_zh: 用于有机太阳能电池的 PM6（PBDB-T-2F）薄膜光学、结构、形貌与电荷输运性质研究
articles.abstract: Organic solar cells (OSCs) are emerging as promising candidates for sustainable, flexible photovoltaic technologies due to their lightweight nature, mechanical flexibility, and solution-processability. In this work, we present a comprehensive study on the PM6(PBDB-T-2F) polymer donor to understand the influence of spin-coating speed on its optical, structural, charge transport, and stability characteristics, and we also investigate Ag–V₂O₅-modified PM6 (PBDB-T-2F) thin films to elucidate how processing-induced morphology governs interfacial electronic coupling, optoelectronic properties, and charge transport. Systematic analyses reveal that higher spin-coating speeds yield smoother and more continuous thin films which provide better charge transport pathways; however, they also reduce film thickness, leading to diminished optical absorption and increased thermal stress, which results in partial degradation of the PM6 polymer chains. In contrast, films processed at lower spin speeds exhibit enhanced optical absorption, improved structural integrity, and superior morphological stability. For optimization, various characterization techniques, including UV–visible spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, photoluminescence spectroscopy, atomic force microscopy (AFM), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM) were employed to investigate the optical, structural, and morphological properties of the films. These findings provide critical insights into processing–structure–performance relationships and offer practical guidelines for optimizing scalable fabrication of high-efficiency OSCs. Films incorporating Ag–V₂O₅ on PM6 exhibit a marked enhancement in absorption intensity along with a pronounced red-shift and spectral broadening, resulting in an effective optical band-gap reduction from 1.86 eV (pristine PM6) to 1.62 eV in Ag–V₂O₅–PM6 films. Raman spectroscopy shows suppression and broadening of vibrational modes, indicating strong interfacial coupling, restricted molecular vibrations, and reduced disorder. Photoluminescence (PL) analysis further confirms stabilization of excited states and suppression of non-radiative decay pathways. Correlated UV–Vis, Raman, and PL analyses indicate that these effects originate from intrinsic interfacial modification induced by Ag–V₂O₅, rather than film thickness or processing artifacts, providing direct evidence of band-gap engineering, molecular stabilization, and enhanced electronic properties. The correlated optical and spectroscopic analyses indicate that these improvements originate from intrinsic interfacial modification induced by Ag–V₂O₅ rather than film thickness or processing artifacts, indicating band-gap engineering, molecular stabilization, and enhanced electronic properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了 PM6（PBDB-T-2F）聚合物给体薄膜中旋涂速度对光学、结构、电荷输运和稳定性特征的影响，并考察了 Ag–V₂O₅ 修饰薄膜的界面电子耦合与光电性质。结果表明，高旋涂速度可形成更平滑、连续的薄膜并改善电荷传输通道，但同时降低膜厚、削弱光吸收并增加热应力，可能导致 PM6 链的部分退化。较低旋涂速度制备的薄膜则表现出更强光吸收、更好的结构完整性和形貌稳定性。研究通过紫外—可见光谱、拉曼等多种表征手段为有机太阳能电池中 PM6 薄膜工艺优化提供依据。

articles.title: A Use-Case-Oriented Benchmark Framework for Classical, Quantum, Hybrid, and Quantum-Inspired Optimization
articles.title_zh: 面向用例的经典、量子、混合与量子启发优化基准框架
articles.abstract: As interest in quantum and related optimization paradigms continues to grow, fairly and systematically comparing their performance across practical problem settings remains challenging. This challenge arises because these approaches often target different problem classes, use different mathematical representations, and  are affected differently by modeling choices. As a result, observed performance depends not only on the solver itself, but also on how a problem is formulated, reformulated, and translated into a solver-specific input language.  This work presents a publicly available and extensible benchmarking framework that unifies advances in quantum, quantum-hybrid, quantum-inspired, and classical optimization by enabling consistent comparison across use cases, solvers, and models. We address the diversity of solver “languages”—from mixed-integer programming (MIP) formulations for branch-and-bound methods over quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) models for quantum annealers to constrained quadratic models (CQM) for hybrid approaches — as well as the influence of modeling choices, such as binary encodings and penalty formulations, on both performance and solution fidelity. By supporting systematic variation across the three dimensions of use case, solver, and model, the framework reveals trade-offs that single-dimension benchmarks overlook, clarifies when native formulations are preferable, and enables rigorous evaluation of practical combinatorial optimization problems. The two case studies, vehicle routing and maximum cut, illustrate this principle: their contrasting outcomes show that the effectiveness of a solver depends strongly on how well the chosen model representation matches the solver backend and the use case.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着量子及相关优化范式受到关注，如何在实际问题设置中公平、系统地比较不同方法仍然具有挑战性。本文提出一个公开且可扩展的基准测试框架，用于在不同用例、求解器和模型之间统一比较量子、量子混合、量子启发和经典优化方法。该框架考虑了不同求解器语言之间的差异，如混合整数规划、无约束二次二元优化和约束二次模型，以及二进制编码、惩罚项构造等建模选择对性能和解质量的影响。该工作旨在将算法性能评估从单一求解器比较扩展为对问题建模、转换和求解全流程的系统评估。

articles.title: Quantum error correction with the toric code
articles.title_zh: 基于环面码的量子纠错
articles.abstract: Quantum computing platforms based on arrays of tweezer-confined neutral atoms have recently emerged as a competitive modality thanks to a direct path toward high qubit count, rapidly ad- vancing operation fidelities, and their ability to execute circuits with arbitrary qubit connectivity. These features will enable the use of efficient error correction schemes with high encoding-rates, time-efficient decoding, and resource-efficient architectures based on transversal gates. With these goals in mind, recent state of the art neutral atom demonstrations focus on the transition from the use of physical qubits to error-corrected logical qubits, but to date there has been no demonstra- tion of repeated error correction scalable to arbitrary depth. Here, we demonstrate many cycles of syndrome extraction in a toric quantum error correcting code, using mid-circuit measurement and replacement of lost qubits, including reloading of a qubit reservoir for indefinite coherent operation. We characterize the logical error rate after up to 90 cycles, showing that logical information can be preserved through multiple rounds of qubit reloading. Comparing two distances of the code up to 8 rounds of syndrome extraction shows a lower absolute logical error rate for the larger distance code.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了在镊控中性原子量子计算平台上实现环面量子纠错码的多轮综合征提取。该平台具有可扩展量子比特数量、提升中的操作保真度以及任意连接电路能力，有望支持高编码率和资源高效的纠错架构。作者利用中途测量和丢失量子比特替换，包括重新装载量子比特储备，实现了面向任意深度相干运行的关键步骤。实验表征了多达 90 个循环后的逻辑错误率，并展示了在多轮量子比特重装载后保持逻辑信息的能力。

articles.title: Boosted magnetic fluctuations at the onset of superconductivity in UTe₂ beyond 40 T
articles.title_zh: UTe₂ 在 40 T 以上超导起始处增强的磁涨落
articles.abstract: Author(s): T. Thebault, K. Somesh, G. Lapertot, M. Nardone, A. Zitouni, M. Barragan, J. Béard, J. Billette, F. Lecouturier-Dupouy, S. Tardieu, D. Aoki, G. Knebel, D. Braithwaite, and W. Knafo Multiple triplet-candidate unconventional superconducting phases have been reported in the heavy-fermion compound UTe 2 . Here, the authors find an enhancement of the electrical resistivity Fermi liquid coefficient A at a metamagnetic transition preceding the onset of superconductivity in magnetic fields higher than 40 T. The enhancement of A is attributed to a magnetic fluctuation mode probably in play for the mechanism of this superconducting phase. [Phys. Rev. B 113, L220503] Published Mon Jun 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究重费米子化合物 UTe₂ 在高磁场下的非常规超导行为，特别关注 40 T 以上超导相出现前后的输运特征。作者发现，在超导起始之前的变磁转变附近，电阻率费米液体系数 A 出现增强。该增强被归因于可能参与该高场超导相形成机制的磁涨落模式。研究为理解 UTe₂ 中多个三重态候选非常规超导相提供了重要线索。

In this article, using density functional theory calculations, we investigate the interlayer exchange coupling of two-dimension… [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 064411] Published Mon Jun 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文围绕二维磁体中层间交换耦合的调控展开，该问题与居里温度控制密切相关。作者采用密度泛函理论计算，研究含自旋插层物的双层 CrX₃（X=Cl、Br、I）体系中的层间交换相互作用。该工作旨在揭示插层物及其自旋特性如何影响双层卤化铬的磁耦合，为调控二维磁性材料的磁有序和功能性质提供理论依据。具体计算细节和定量结论需查阅原文。
