Pálsson We demonstrate that thin metallic glasses of VₓZr₁₀₀−ₓ, deposited by direct current magnetron sputtering, closely approximate the structural characteristics of theoretically predicted maximally amorphous materials. Experimentally, x-ray reflectometry reveals atomically … [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 065605] Published Mon Jun 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，通过直流磁控溅射沉积的 VₓZr₁₀₀−ₓ 薄金属玻璃，在结构上接近理论预测的最大非晶材料。实验中，X 射线反射等表征揭示了其接近原子尺度平整的薄膜特征，并用于关联非晶结构与力学性质。该工作为理解和制备高度非晶化过渡金属合金提供了实验依据。
authors: Kristina Komander, Johan Bylin, Lennart Spode, Tuan Tran, Maciej Kaplan, Sohal Sondarva, Paulius Malinovskis, Ralph H. Scheicher, and Gunnar K. Pálsson

articles.title: Glimpse into the ultrametric spectrum
articles.title_zh: 窥探超度量谱
articles.abstract: Author(s): An Huang and Christian Baadsgaard Jepsen p-adic string theory asks how much of string physics really depends on ordinary spacetime geometry. Quantum gravity may replace smooth short-distance geometry with more primitive or nonlocal structures; p-adic models provide a laboratory where the notion of distance is very different. This manuscript tests whether one of the most basic stringy signatures – the rapid high-energy growth of states – survives in such a setting. Simple tree models fail, but a natural p-adic spectrum on the unit circle reproduces the usual coarse string entropy growth, with log-periodic corrections. The result probes which aspects of string thermodynamics are geometric and which are more universal. [Phys. Rev. D 113, 126021] Published Mon Jun 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从 p 进弦理论出发，探讨弦物理中有多少性质真正依赖通常的时空几何。作者检验了弦论中高能态密度快速增长这一基本特征在非通常距离结构中是否仍然存在。结果显示，简单树模型无法再现该行为，而单位圆上的自然 p 进谱可以给出通常的粗粒化弦熵增长，并伴随对数周期修正。
authors: An Huang and Christian Baadsgaard Jepsen

articles.title: Beyond trotterization: Variational product formulas for quantum simulation
articles.title_zh: 超越特罗特化：用于量子模拟的变分乘积公式
articles.abstract: Author(s): Ibsal Assi, Michael Vogl, Meenu Kumari, and J. P. F. LeBlanc The authors introduce here a variational splitting scheme for the time-evolution operator that surpasses standard Trotter-Suzuki decompositions. Unlike typical variational methods, this framework works directly in operator space, providing globally valid results irrespective of the targeted initial state. The method generalizes naturally to a wide range of applications in condensed matter physics and beyond. In particular, it enables quantum circuits with lower gate counts and higher accuracy than Trotter-based formulas, making it useful for near-term quantum computing. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214314] Published Mon Jun 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出了一种用于时间演化算符的变分分裂方案，可超越标准 Trotter-Suzuki 分解。该方法直接在算符空间中工作，因此不依赖特定初态，并可在凝聚态物理等广泛场景中推广。研究表明，该框架有望构造比传统特罗特公式门数更少、精度更高的量子线路，适用于近期量子计算。
authors: Ibsal Assi, Michael Vogl, Meenu Kumari, and J. P. F. LeBlanc

articles.abstract: Author(s): Kazuki Nakazawa, Terufumi Yamaguchi, and Ai Yamakage In recent years, counterparts of phenomena studied in spintronics have been actively explored in the orbital sector. The relationship between orbital degrees of freedom and crystal chirality has also been intensively investigated, although the distinction from gyrotropic properties has not been full… [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 064603] Published Mon Jun 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，自旋电子学中许多现象的轨道对应物受到关注，轨道自由度与晶体手性的关系也成为研究热点。该工作以 Cu₂WSe₄ 为对象，讨论与轨道相关的旋光响应，并试图区分手性相关效应与一般旋光性质。研究旨在提出或评估可表征晶体手性的指标。

articles.title_zh: 非相对论自旋劈裂：特征与功能
articles.abstract: npj Quantum Materials, Published online: 15 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41535-026-00899-z Non-relativistic spin splitting: features and functionalities

articles.title: Inverse design and discovery of high entropy alloy catalysts for efficient oxygen evolution reaction
articles.title_zh: 用于高效析氧反应的高熵合金催化剂的逆向设计与发现
articles.abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) consisting of earth-abundant elements can serve as replacement for expensive, industrial grade catalysts, such as iridium dioxide IrO 2 , for oxygen evolution reactions (OERs). However, navigating the exponential configuration space of possible HEAs and unknown inverse structure–property relationship has hindered the development of HEAs for efficient electrocatalytic applications. In this paper, using OH adsorption energy as a descriptor of optimal catalyst property, machine-learning-based frameworks are utilized for discovering HEA catalysts. Each designed HEA is composed of 5 elements chosen from Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, and Mo specific to OER. Calculated theoretical overpotential for one HEA catalyst composed of MnCoNiCuZn is found to be η theor = 0.67 V. However, deviations from scaling results can be as high as 0.99 V when compared to explicit calculations. After screening more than 163 × 10 9 HEA configurations using a regression model, MnCoNiCuZn with a stoichiometric ratio of 2, 2, 8, 12, and 12 displayed the highest likelihood of positive OH binding energy/active sites. To investigate the intrinsic catalytic activity of the MnCoNiCuZn HEA in an operational OER environment, a computational hydrogen electrode model was constructed to represent the oxyhydroxide layer of OER catalysts, with the MnCoNiCuZn placed at the surface. Analysis indicates that upon consistent comparison, the most stable rutile IrO 2 ( η = 0.33 V) exhibits superior performance relative to the proposed MnCoNiCuZn catalyst ( η = 0.57 V). However, the present methodology, which resulted in statistically favorable adsorption sites, could be successfully used to discover highly active sites within a compositional space.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用机器学习框架，以 OH 吸附能作为催化性能描述符，在由 Mn、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu、Zn 和 Mo 等丰产元素组成的五元高熵合金中筛选析氧反应催化剂。作者指出，MnCoNiCuZn 体系具有较有希望的催化表现，并在大规模构型空间中筛选出特定化学计量比候选物。研究同时强调，仅依赖标度关系可能与显式计算存在显著偏差，因此需要更精细的结构—性能建模。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Quantum sensing with triplet pair states: A theoretical study
articles.title_zh: 利用三重态对态进行量子传感：理论研究
articles.abstract: Molecular quantum sensors represent a promising frontier for the detection of nuclear magnetic resonance signals and alternating current magnetic fields at the nanoscale, potentially reaching single-proton sensitivity. Although the triplet states T̂ of molecular pentacene provide a viable sensing architecture, the triplet pair states T̂T̂ produced by singlet fission of pentacene dimers could enable more flexible quantum manipulations through entanglement. In this work, we model the quantum sensing efficacy of a spin-polarized quintet manifold 5T̂T̂0,±1 in a photoexcited pentacene dimer generated via intramolecular singlet fission. Using a Lindblad master equation approach, we simulate the evolution of the triplet-pair state under standard dynamical decoupling sequences—including spin echo, XY4, and XY8—and provide a direct performance comparison to the traditional pentacene monomer benchmark. While both architectures exhibit comparable sensitivity for isolated single-spin detection, our findings indicate that the dimer architecture provides a superior interaction cross section for detecting small ensembles of nuclear spins. Analytical expressions derived for fluorescence modulation demonstrate that sensitivity is optimized in the low-magnetic field regime (≤0.01 T) and scales with the number of pulses in the sensing protocol. This study establishes a theoretical baseline for utilizing high-spin multi-excitonic states as chemically tunable, high-sensitivity quantum probes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论研究考察由并五苯二聚体单线态裂分产生的三重态对态在分子量子传感中的潜力。作者采用 Lindblad 主方程模拟自旋极化五重态流形在自旋回波、XY4 和 XY8 等动力学解耦序列下的演化，并与传统并五苯单体传感架构进行比较。结果表明，两种体系在孤立单自旋探测中灵敏度相近，而二聚体架构对小规模核自旋集合可能具有更大的相互作用截面。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Efficient simulation of non-Markovian path integrals via imaginary time evolution of an effective Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 通过有效哈密顿量的虚时间演化高效模拟非马尔可夫路径积分
articles.abstract: Accurately simulating the non-Markovian dynamics of open quantum systems remains a significant challenge. While the recently proposed time-evolving matrix product operator (TEMPO) algorithm based on path integrals successfully circumvents the exponential scaling associated with memory length, its reliance on layer-by-layer tensor contractions and compressions leads to steep scaling with respect to the system Hilbert space dimension. In this work, we introduce the effective Hamiltonian-based TEMPO (EH-TEMPO) algorithm, which reformulates the calculation of the Feynman–Vernon influence functional as an imaginary time evolution governed by an effective Hamiltonian. We demonstrate that this effective Hamiltonian admits a highly compact matrix product operator representation, enabling substantial compression with negligible loss of accuracy. Combining a one-shot global evolution with a backward retrieval approach, EH-TEMPO significantly reduces algorithmic complexity and is naturally suited for GPU acceleration. We benchmark the method by simulating the energy transfer dynamics in the 7-site Fenna–Matthews–Olson complex model and 4-site perylene bisimide model. The results demonstrate that EH-TEMPO achieves numerically exact accuracy with superior efficiency, delivering speedups of up to 17.5× on GPU hardware compared to standard CPU implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出基于有效哈密顿量的 TEMPO 算法，用于高效模拟开放量子系统的非马尔可夫动力学。方法将 Feynman–Vernon 影响泛函的计算重写为由有效哈密顿量控制的虚时间演化，并利用紧凑的矩阵乘积算符表示实现高压缩率和较低精度损失。作者在 Fenna–Matthews–Olson 复合体和苝双酰亚胺模型中进行了基准测试，显示该方法可降低复杂度并适合 GPU 加速。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Constrained Møller–Plesset perturbation theory for charge transfer states
articles.title_zh: 用于电荷转移态的约束 Møller–Plesset 微扰理论
articles.abstract: We propose a constrained Møller–Plesset second-order perturbation theory (CMP2) that incorporates electron correlation into the constrained Hartree–Fock (CHF) framework. In CMP2, the CHF solution is employed as the reference state, and a common Lagrange multiplier is introduced for both the zeroth-order and constraint Hamiltonians, enabling the inclusion of correlation effects with minimal modification to existing MP2 implementations. Two schemes are developed for determining the Lagrange multiplier: (i) CMP2-i (iterative), which iteratively updates the multiplier until the MP2 electron density satisfies the constraint, and (ii) CMP2-s (single-shot), which performs a single MP2 calculation using a CHF reference that satisfies the constraint at the Hartree–Fock level. The methods are applied to an intramolecular charge-transfer reaction of the 1,3-dinitrobenzene anion radical. CMP2-s significantly reduces computational cost while reproducing relative energy profiles comparable with CMP2-i. In addition, adiabatic energy profiles obtained with configuration interaction calculations based on CMP2 (CMP2-CI) are in good agreement with those from extended multistate complete active space second-order perturbation theory (XMS-CASPT2), demonstrating that the present approach provides a practical and efficient extension of constrained electronic structure methods to the post-Hartree–Fock level.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出约束二阶 Møller–Plesset 微扰理论，将电子相关效应纳入约束 Hartree–Fock 框架。该方法以 CHF 解为参考态，并通过公共拉格朗日乘子处理零阶哈密顿量和约束哈密顿量，从而尽量减少对现有 MP2 程序的修改。针对 1,3-二硝基苯阴离子自由基的分子内电荷转移反应，单步方案在显著降低计算成本的同时可重现实迭代方案相近的相对能量轮廓。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: How do diluent-aggregates interactions affect the structure of colloidal systems in solvent extraction?
articles.title_zh: 稀释剂—聚集体相互作用如何影响溶剂萃取中胶体体系的结构？
articles.abstract: The structure and dynamics of extractant-based aggregates strongly influence metal ion extraction and third-phase formation in liquid–liquid systems. Here, classical molecular dynamics simulations were used to study aggregates composed of Eu(NO 3 ) 3 , water, and the extractants DMDOHEMA or DMDBTDMA in two linear n -alkanes, n -heptane, and n -dodecane. Micelle organization and solvent interactions were analyzed through radial distribution functions and potentials of mean force. Polar and apolar micellar radii were similar for both extractants, but diluent penetration into the apolar region was greater in n -dodecane than in n -heptane. Extractant chains generally wrapped around the polar core, with orientations primarily driven by entropy, except for DMDBTDMA in n -dodecane, where stronger diluent–extractant interactions were observed. Penetrating diluent molecules are oriented roughly perpendicular to the micelle, following the same behavior as the extractant chains. These results reveal that the apolar regions of the aggregates are highly dynamic, with chain motions becoming nearly isotropic beyond the polar core. Solvent molecules readily penetrate the micelle interior, challenging the conventional view of reverse micelles as rigid, star-like structures. Overall, this study demonstrates how the interplay between the extractant and diluent governs aggregate structure and dynamics, offering molecular-level insights into the factors controlling ion extraction and third-phase formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用经典分子动力学模拟，考察由 Eu(NO₃)₃、水和萃取剂 DMDOHEMA 或 DMDBTDMA 组成的聚集体在正庚烷与正十二烷中的结构与相互作用。通过径向分布函数和平均力势分析，作者发现两类萃取剂形成的极性与非极性胶束半径相近，但正十二烷更容易渗入非极性区域。结果表明，聚集体非极性区域高度动态，溶剂分子能够进入胶束内部，这对传统胶束结构图像提出了修正。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: A theoretical study of molecular positron binding based on a correlation–polarization potential approach combined with position-dependent dielectric density functional theory
articles.title_zh: 结合位置依赖介电密度泛函理论与相关–极化势方法的分子正电子束缚理论研究
articles.abstract: We present an improved density functional theory with a correlation–polarization potential (DFT-CPP) for investigating positron binding in molecules. In the original DFT-CPP approach, the polarization potential is placed at the molecular center, which often leads to inaccurate descriptions of positron binding, particularly in large systems. To overcome this limitation, we develop a method that distributes the polarization potential over individual atoms by employing position-dependent electric susceptibilities within a dielectric-dependent DFT framework. This first-principles approach provides a physically grounded description of how each part of a molecule responds to an approaching positron, based directly on its electronic structure. We also compute and analyze positron affinities for normal alkanes, cyclic hydrocarbons, acenes, and siloxanes. Our results reproduce experimental data for alkanes, capture electron–positron response in cyclic hydrocarbons and acenes, which had previously been insufficiently described by polarizability alone, and extend the analysis to siloxanes, which have remained challenging for empirical methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种改进的含相关–极化势密度泛函理论方法，用于研究分子中的正电子束缚。作者将原先集中在分子中心的极化势分配到各原子上，并通过位置依赖电敏感率描述分子不同区域对入射正电子的响应。该方法在正构烷烃、环烃、并苯和硅氧烷等体系中计算正电子亲和能，能更好再现实验数据并扩展到经验方法难以处理的体系。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Fast contracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor products for equivariant graph neural networks
articles.title_zh: 用于等变图神经网络的快速收缩 Clebsch–Gordan 张量积
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.15073v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present an O(L³⁾ algorithm for evaluating contracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor products in O(3)-equivariant machine learning potentials at fixed Canonical Polyadic (CP) rank. Mapping the angular integral to a structured Gauss--Legendre and Fourier tensor-product grid decouples the radial channel contractions from the angular transforms. The antisymmetric parity-odd Clebsch--Gordan channels, unreachable by the symmetric pointwise product on a scalar S² grid, are recovered through the surface-curl pairing hat r ḑot [nablaS^₂ A × nablaS^₂ B], the spherical Poisson bracket, which supplies the L=1 angular momentum on the grid while preserving rotational equivariance. The construction extends to parity-aware equivariant message passing in atomic-cluster-expansion-style architectures and is verified by direct numerical quadrature. The full uncontracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor product remains subject to the O(L⁴⁾ output-size lower bound. A benchmark shows wall-clock scaling empirically as L² across the practical lₘₐₓ range. For the on-site contraction this is pre-asymptotic, giving way to L³ at large lₘₐₓ. For message passing it is structural and the runtime is memory-bandwidth bound on L²⁻sized grid tensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种在固定 CP 秩下以 O(L³) 复杂度计算收缩 Clebsch–Gordan 张量积的算法，面向 O(3) 等变机器学习势。方法通过结构化 Gauss–Legendre 与 Fourier 张量积网格，将径向通道收缩与角向变换解耦，并利用球面 Poisson 括号恢复奇宇称反对称通道。数值验证表明该构造保持旋转等变性，并在实际角动量截断范围内表现出接近 L² 的经验运行时间缩放。
authors: Anton Bochkarev, Yury Lysogorskiy, Ralf Drautz

articles.title: Optimising Rooftop PV Deployment through Energy Efficiency Retrofits: Evidence from Institutional Buildings in Uganda, Zambia, and Nigeria
articles.title_zh: 通过能效改造优化屋顶光伏部署：来自乌干达、赞比亚和尼日利亚机构建筑的证据
articles.abstract: Electricity access in Sub-Saharan Africa remains highly constrained, with grid instability and widespread reliance on diesel generators undermining both energy security and sustainability. As of 2023, nearly 600 million people still lack reliable electricity, while many grid-connected users experience frequent blackouts. In Nigeria, for instance, the national grid has collapsed over 140 times since 2013, forcing more than 80 million people to depend on expensive diesel power. Against this backdrop, decentralised rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) systems offer opportunities for resilience, autonomy, and emissions reduction. Yet, when deployed in isolation, PV often results in oversized and less cost-effective systems if underlying building efficiency remains poor. This study examines the integration of PV with energy efficiency (EE) retrofits in institutional buildings across Uganda, Zambia, and Nigeria. Using DesignBuilder and Energy Plus simulations, combined with techno-economic analysis and policy review, we assess energy savings, financial returns, and policy enablers. Results show that EE interventions reduced demand by 35–47%, enabling smaller, optimally sized PV systems with positive net present values and payback periods under ten years. Case studies demonstrated potential for net-zero or even surplus generation under supportive regulatory frameworks. Despite proven feasibility, adoption is slowed by policy and financing barriers. The study recommends adaptive business models, third-party solar services, energy service companies, and hybrid financing in order to accelerate decentralised energy transitions across the region.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察撒哈拉以南非洲机构建筑中屋顶光伏与能效改造的协同部署，以应对电网不稳定和柴油发电依赖问题。作者使用 DesignBuilder 和 EnergyPlus 模拟，并结合技术经济分析与政策评估，量化节能、投资回报和政策支撑因素。结果显示，能效措施可显著降低用能需求，从而使光伏系统规模更合理、经济性更优。

articles.title: Space-time dynamics of the excess of PM10 concentration over threshold levels
articles.title_zh: PM10 浓度超阈值部分的时空动态
articles.abstract: Particulate matter with aerodynamic diameter below 10~μ m (PM₁₀) is a major air pollutant regulated through concentration thresholds due to its adverse health effects. Recent revisions of European air quality standards have introduced stricter exceedance criteria, increasing the need for statistically robust methodologies capable of assessing regulatory compliance under pronounced spatio-temporal variability and sparse monitoring networks. In this context, a key inferential objective is the estimation of the probability that PM₁₀ concentrations exceed regulatory thresholds over space and time. This paper proposes a spatio-temporal geostatistical framework for modelling PM₁₀ concentrations and quantifying exceedance probabilities over a spatio-temporal domain. The methodology combines a spatially varying coefficient regression model, capturing large-scale non-stationary relationships between PM₁₀ concentrations and atmospheric covariates, with a spatio-temporal kriging model for the residual component, accounting for local spatial and temporal dependence. To coherently propagate parameter uncertainty, the framework is embedded within a Monte Carlo procedure based on spatial cluster-wise block bootstrap resampling and conditional simulations. The methodology is illustrated through an application to Northern Italy, a region characterized by strong seasonal variability and persistent particulate matter pollution. The results highlight substantial spatial disparities in regulatory compliance, with the Po Valley systematically emerging as the area at highest risk, particularly during winter. They further suggest that future regulatory thresholds may be difficult to achieve across large portions of the study region. As a byproduct, we introduce the textttEEAaq package for textttR, designed to facilitate the retrieval and preprocessing of European air quality data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对 PM10 浓度在空间和时间上的强变异性，提出一种用于估计污染物超出监管阈值概率的时空地统计框架。方法结合空间变系数回归模型与时空克里金残差模型，以同时刻画大尺度非平稳关系和局地时空依赖。研究旨在为监测网络稀疏条件下的空气质量合规评估提供更稳健的统计工具。

articles.title: Influence of Paraffin on the Structure and Pore Characteristics of Solid Organic Matter
articles.title_zh: 石蜡对固体有机质结构与孔隙特征的影响
articles.abstract: Paraffin, a naturally occurring macromolecular organic compound, is ubiquitously distributed in geological formations such as shale and coal seams. Its interaction with solid organic matter exerts a significant influence on the microstructure and pore architecture of host rocks, representing a critical geological process. To elucidate the underlying mechanisms of this interaction, this study systematically investigated the structural incorporation and pore-modifying behavior of paraffin within three representative high-molecular-weight organic geological substrates: kerogen, solid bitumen, and coal. A combined experimental approach integrating nitrogen adsorption and X-ray diffraction techniques was employed to characterize these interactions. The findings reveal that paraffin predominantly resides within the amorphous carbon fraction of host organic matter, where it enhances local crystallinity. However, its impact on pore networks varies markedly across different substrates: in kerogen, progressive pore reduction occurs via organic matrix swelling and paraffin precipitation. In contrast, excessive paraffin accumulation triggers pore segmentation in solid bitumen and, most notably, induces pore fracturing or splitting within coal, severely compromising pore connectivity. These insights bear direct implications for unconventional hydrocarbon systems. In shale gas reservoirs, the presence of asphaltene and solid bitumen may sequester paraffin, thereby mitigating damage to the porous matrix of kerogen. Conversely, in coalbed methane systems, paraffin effectively reduces the volume and connectivity of coal seam pores, resulting in significant adverse effects on gas production. Therefore, heating treatments may be required during exploitation to mitigate the detrimental impacts of paraffin accumulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨石蜡与干酪根、固体沥青和煤等高分子有机地质基质之间的相互作用及其对孔隙结构的影响。作者结合氮气吸附和 X 射线衍射技术，分析石蜡在有机质中的赋存位置、结晶效应和孔隙改造行为。结果表明，石蜡主要存在于无定形碳组分中并增强局部结晶性，但其对不同有机基质孔隙网络的影响存在显著差异。

articles.title: Cyclic Impregnation-Rapid Pyrolysis for Preparing Efficient and Durable Free-Standing Catalyst toward Oxygen and Chlorine Evolution
articles.title_zh: 循环浸渍–快速热解制备高效耐久自支撑析氧与析氯催化剂
articles.abstract: Developing efficient and durable electrocatalysts for oxygen and chlorine evolution reactions (OER and CER) is crucial for water electrolysis and chlor-alkali industries. Herein, we report a binder-free cyclic impregnation-rapid pyrolysis strategy to construct uniformly dispersed IrO2 nanoparticles anchored on titanium mesh. By directly placing the precursor-impregnated substrate into a preheated furnace, rapid pyrolysis effectively inhibits agglomeration, enabling in-situ nucleation and robust immobilization of IrO2. The resulting free-standing catalyst exhibits uniform nanoparticle coverage with abundant grain boundaries and a surface enriched with oxygen vacancies. Benefiting from these structural and surface advantages, it delivers exceptional OER performance in acidic media, achieving 10 mA cm-2 at an overpotential of only 290 mV with stability exceeding 420 h. For CER, it requires merely 101 mV overpotential to reach 10 mA cm-2 and demonstrates stability over 460 h. An AEM electrolyzer employing this catalyst as the anode achieves a low cell voltage of 2.38 V at 1 A cm-2, significantly outperforming the commercial IrO2-based device (3.17 V). This method, characterized by its simplicity, reproducibility, and scalability to 10 cm × 1 m titanium mesh, offers a promising strategy for fabricating high-performance IrO2-based electrocatalysts for energy conversion and chlor-alkali applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道一种无黏结剂的循环浸渍–快速热解策略，用于在钛网上构筑均匀分散并牢固锚定的 IrO2 纳米颗粒。快速热解抑制颗粒团聚，形成富含晶界和氧空位的自支撑催化电极。该催化剂在酸性析氧和析氯反应中均表现出低过电位和长时间稳定性，并在 AEM 电解槽中优于商业 IrO2 基器件。

articles.title: Structurally complex Al-Si eutectic structure to resist hydrogen embrittlement in 3D-printed Al alloy
articles.title_zh: 复杂 Al–Si 共晶结构提升 3D 打印铝合金抗氢脆性能
articles.abstract: The development of green hydrogen as an energy carrier is hindered by hydrogen embrittlement (HE) from materials perspective. HE phenomenon leads to premature failure of metallic materials. Reducing HE while maintaining low production costs remains a major challenge for industry. In this study, the hydrogen behavior of 3D-printed AlSi10Mg was investigated, owing to its potential as a low-cost hydrogen storage material. A unique amorphous Al–Si eutectic structure, formed during the rapid melting and solidification process of 3D printing, was identified. Both simulations and experimental results revealed that hydrogen is preferentially trapped within this amorphous Al–Si eutectic structure. The non-crystalline nature of this phase promotes a more homogeneous hydrogen distribution in AlSi10Mg, thereby enhancing its resistance to HE compared with conventional Al-based alloys. For the first time, these findings provide fully new insights into the design of and mechanical performance of HE-resistant aluminum alloys containing amorphous structures formed through additive manufacturing processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以 3D 打印 AlSi10Mg 为对象，探讨其作为低成本储氢相关材料时的氢行为和抗氢脆机制。快速熔化与凝固过程中形成的非晶 Al–Si 共晶结构被发现可优先俘获氢，并促进氢在合金中的更均匀分布。模拟和实验结果表明，该非晶结构有助于提高 AlSi10Mg 相比传统铝合金的抗氢脆能力，为增材制造抗氢脆铝合金设计提供新思路。

articles.title: SDP-RTDETR: A Real-Time End-to-End Detector for Small PCB Surface Defects
articles.title_zh: SDP-RTDETR：面向小型 PCB 表面缺陷的实时端到端检测器
articles.abstract: Automated optical inspection of surface defects on printed circuit boards (PCBs) is a critical and challenging task in PCB manufacturing. However, defects are often small, slender, and low-contrast in real industrial scenes, and are frequently embedded in dense traces, pad arrays, and complex textured backgrounds. Under non-ideal imaging conditions such as reflections and stains, these characteristics easily lead to missed detections, false alarms, and inaccurate localization. Therefore, conventional real-time detectors still show limited capability in representing tiny defects and stabilizing the regression of slender targets. To address these issues, a real-time end-to-end detector, termed Small Defect Perception Real-Time Detection Transformer (SDP-RTDETR), is developed based on Real-Time Detection Transformer (RTDETR), which has three key components to work together. First, A lightweight backbone, named Lightweight HGstem–RGCSPELAN backbone (LHG-RGC), is designed to suppress redundant texture responses while preserving shallow edge and local geometric details. Second, a Small Defect Perception Path Aggregation Network (SDP-PAN) is developed to enhance cross-scale propagation of defect-sensitive features through selective bidirectional fusion and shallow-detail enhancement. Third, a composite regression loss combining multi-point distance intersection over union (MPDIoU) and Gaussian combined distance (GCD) is adopted to improve localization stability under low-overlap or non-overlapping conditions. Experimental results on a PCB defect dataset show that SDP-RTDETR achieves 98.7% precision, 99.2% recall, and 99.3% (:mAP₅₀). In addition, (:mAP₇₅) and (:mAP₅₀₋₉₅) reach 85.5% and 69.7%, respectively, exceeding the baseline RTDETR by 8.1 and 4.6 percentage points, respectively. Meanwhile, the parameter count is reduced from 19.9 M to 13.6 M. Cross-dataset evaluations further demonstrate the robustness and generalization capability of the proposed method for industrial surface defect detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对工业场景中 PCB 表面缺陷小、细长、低对比度且背景复杂的问题，提出基于 RTDETR 的实时端到端检测器 SDP-RTDETR。模型通过轻量化骨干网络抑制冗余纹理响应，同时保留浅层边缘与局部几何细节，并设计小缺陷感知路径聚合网络以增强跨尺度信息传播。该方法旨在降低漏检和误报，提升细小及细长缺陷的定位稳定性。

articles.title: Extended Lagrangian molecular dynamics on vibronic surfaces in the nuclear–electronic orbital framework
articles.title_zh: 核–电子轨道框架中振电表面上的扩展拉格朗日分子动力学
articles.abstract: Proton transfer is central to many processes of chemical interest. The simulation of proton transfer dynamics requires the inclusion of nuclear quantum effects, such as zero-point energy, nuclear delocalization, and tunneling. Herein, we introduce methods within the nuclear–electronic orbital (NEO) framework, where specified nuclei are treated quantum mechanically on the same level as the electrons, for the simulation of proton transfer dynamics. In particular, NEO density functional theory (NEO-DFT) is used to treat the transferring protons quantum mechanically, and the other nuclei are propagated classically on the adiabatic vibronic ground-state surface. We formulate a NEO extended Lagrangian molecular dynamics (NEO-ELMD) approach to incorporate the motion of the nuclear basis function centers during such simulations. Density matrix extrapolation and purification are introduced as a means to accelerate the NEO self-consistent field procedure at each time step by reducing the number of iterations required for convergence. We demonstrate the fidelity and efficiency of NEO-ELMD through comparisons with related dynamical methods for intramolecular proton transfer in malonaldehyde. We also use these accelerated techniques to simulate the nonequilibrium single and double proton transfer dynamics of proton-coupled electron transfer in much larger benzimidazole–phenol systems. This work provides a foundation for future methodologies to efficiently simulate proton transfer dynamics within the NEO-DFT framework while incorporating nonadiabatic effects between adiabatic vibronic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在核–电子轨道框架下发展用于质子转移动力学模拟的方法，将转移质子与电子同等量子化处理，其余原子核在绝热振电基态面上经典传播。作者提出 NEO 扩展拉格朗日分子动力学方法，以纳入核基函数中心运动，并通过密度矩阵外推和纯化加速每步自洽场收敛。以丙二醛分子内质子转移为例的比较表明，该方法在精度和效率方面具有良好表现。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: SITH: A quantum-chemical framework for predicting bond destabilization in stretched molecules
articles.title_zh: SITH：用于预测拉伸分子中键去稳定化的量子化学框架
articles.abstract: Mechanical forces can selectively destabilize chemical bonds of molecular systems, particularly in biological and synthetic polymers. While experimental and theoretical methods have advanced our understanding of mechanochemical processes, predicting where energy concentrates within a molecule remains a significant challenge. To address this, we introduce SITH (Splitting Intramolecular Tension due to stretcHing), a novel method that decomposes the total electronic energy change of a stretched molecule into the contributions from its internal degrees of freedom—such as bond lengths, angles, and dihedrals—using numerical integration of the work-energy theorem. Unlike previous approaches that rely on harmonic approximations, SITH provides high accuracy and robustness for studying the distribution of energies of stretched molecules up to a first bond cleavage. Although SITH uses 3N-6 degrees of freedom for the energy decomposition, we show that it can work even for ring structures like prolines. We apply SITH to a dataset of tripeptides and demonstrate that glycine and proline exhibit significantly different energy distributions in their C α –C backbone bonds under tension: proline requires less energy to be elongated, making it more prone to rupture, while glycine has the opposite behavior. These findings reveal intrinsic differences in mechanochemical susceptibility across amino acids, offering more accurate predictions of bond rupture in proteins and other (bio)polymers. SITH thus provides a powerful, interpretable tool for understanding energy distribution at the quantum level, with possible applications in mechanochemistry and force field validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 SITH 方法，用于将拉伸分子的总电子能变化分解到键长、键角和二面角等内自由度贡献中，以预测机械力作用下能量在分子内部的集中位置。该方法基于功–能定理的数值积分，不依赖谐近似，因此可在首个化学键断裂前保持较高准确性和稳健性。作者将其应用于三肽数据集，展示了甘氨酸和脯氨酸在受拉时主链 Cα–C 键能量分布的显著差异。

articles.title: Discovery of Quasi-One-Dimensional Superconductivity in PtPb3Bi
articles.title_zh: PtPb3Bi 中准一维超导性的发现
articles.abstract: Quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) materials provide a compelling platform where reduced dimensionality stabilizes intertwined topological and superconducting phases. Here we report superconductivity in a new Bi-based quasi-1D compound, PtPb3Bi, which hosts a nontrivial electronic structure. It exhibits type-II superconductivity below 3.01(1) K. Heat capacity and transverse-field muon spin rotation/relaxation (μSR) measurements demonstrate a fully gapped isotropic s-wave state with moderate electron-phonon coupling, while zero-field μSR confirms the preservation of time-reversal symmetry (TRS). Transport measurements reveal low carrier mobility with diffusive normal-state transport. Electronic structure calculations show strong dispersion along the quasi-1D direction and relatively flatter bands in the transverse plane, giving rise to pronounced Fermi surface nesting in the kx–ky plane. Consistent with this, the compound undergoes a charge-density-wave transition at 280(1) K. The flow of Wannier charge centers, together with surface-state dispersion, establishes nontrivial band topology. These results identify PtPb3Bi as a new quasi-1D superconductor with nontrivial electronic structure and a promising candidate for topological superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道一种新的含铋准一维化合物 PtPb3Bi，并发现其在 3.01 K 以下表现出 II 型超导性。热容和横场 μSR 测量表明其为完全能隙各向同性 s 波超导态，具有中等电子–声子耦合，零场 μSR 则显示时间反演对称性保持。电子结构计算和输运结果揭示其准一维色散、费米面嵌套、280 K 附近的电荷密度波转变以及非平庸能带拓扑，使其成为兼具准一维性、超导性和非平庸电子结构的新体系。

articles.title: RAG-Based Intelligent Literature System for Renewable Energy Assessment
articles.title_zh: 用于可再生能源评估的基于 RAG 的智能文献系统
articles.abstract: The accelerating pace of renewable energy technology development solar photovoltaics, wind turbines, battery storage, green hydrogen, and smart grid systems generates a literature that outpaces the capacity of human experts to monitor, synthesize, and apply. This paper proposes and evaluates a RAG-Based Intelligent Literature System (RILS) for Renewable Energy Technology Assessment: a specialized retrieval-augmented framework integrating dense semantic retrieval over a curated renewable energy corpus with transformer-based generation to produce structured, evidence-grounded technology assessments. The system indexes 32,800 passages from IRENA cost reports, IEA technology perspectives, peer-reviewed journals (Nature Energy, Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, Energy Policy), and technology roadmaps covering six technology families from 2018 to 2024. Experimental evaluation on 900 technology assessment queries demonstrates 85% response accuracy, a 38% reduction in hallucination compared to parametric baselines, Recall@5 = 86%, MRR = 0.83, quantitative cost accuracy (QA-acc) of 79%,and knowledge freshness accuracy of 87% on rapidly evolving cost metrics. The RILS framework provides technology analysts, R&D strategists, and energy planners with a scalable, transparent, and continuously updatable intelligent literature assistant.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出并评估了面向可再生能源技术评估的检索增强生成系统 RILS，旨在帮助专家应对太阳能光伏、风电、储能、绿氢和智能电网等领域快速增长的文献。系统基于2018—2024年的报告、期刊论文和技术路线图构建语义检索语料，并结合 Transformer 生成结构化、证据支撑的评估。实验显示，该系统在技术评估查询中具有较高准确率，并相较纯参数模型降低了幻觉风险，同时在成本指标和知识时效性方面表现良好。

articles.title: Analytic gradients and geometry optimization for orbital-optimized pair coupled cluster doubles
articles.title_zh: 轨道优化成对耦合簇双激发方法的解析梯度与几何优化
articles.abstract: We introduce a reusable geometry-optimization engine in PyBEST for analytic, gradient-driven molecular structure optimization, with particular emphasis on orbital-optimized pair coupled-cluster doubles (OOpCCD/AP1roG). The engine interfaces PyBEST with the geomeTRIC optimizer, combining analytic electronic-structure gradients from PyBEST with the translation–rotation–internal coordinate (TRIC) framework, step control, and convergence machinery provided by geomeTRIC. Specificially, we present the first implementation of analytic OOpCCD nuclear gradients within a Lagrangian formalism. Our approach and implementation are generally applicable to any seniority-zero wavefunctions that feature orbital optimization and allow for the evaluation of response one- and two-particle reduced density matrices. Owing to the seniority-zero structure of pCCD and the orbital stationarity of the optimized reference, the resulting gradient equations are compact, minimizing the storage of the full two-particle reduced density matrix, and avoiding finite-difference differentiation of wavefunction parameters. Validation on representative closed-shell systems shows that the OOpCCD-based PyBEST–geomeTRIC workflow converges robustly and reproduces reference equilibrium geometries and energies within tight tolerances. Most importantly, OOpCCD produces structural parameters that deviate by ∼0.02 Å (0.01 Å) for bond lengths or less than 1° for bond angles from CCSD(F12c)(T*) (MP2) reference structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在 PyBEST 中引入了可复用的、基于解析梯度的分子几何优化引擎，并重点面向轨道优化成对耦合簇双激发方法 OOpCCD/AP1roG。作者将 PyBEST 的解析电子结构梯度与 geomeTRIC 优化器的 TRIC 坐标、步长控制和收敛机制相结合，并首次在拉格朗日形式下实现了解析 OOpCCD 核梯度。该方法适用于具有轨道优化并可计算响应约化密度矩阵的 seniority-zero 波函数，验证表明其可用于代表性闭壳层体系的结构优化。

articles.title_zh: 基于结构 MRI 形态学指标预测区域性脑蛋白质合成
articles.abstract: This study evaluates whether structural MRI morphometrics provide incremental predictive information about regional cerebral protein synthesis (rCPS) measured with L-[1-¹¹C]leucine PET. Using open-access paired MRI–PET data from OpenNeuro (ds004733), originally acquired to quantify rCPS across sleep-related experimental conditions, we repurpose the dataset for out-of-subject predictive modeling across individuals. ROI-level rCPS values were extracted separately for each session and then averaged across the three sessions to yield a single condition-averaged target (PET_Mean) per subject and region. FreeSurfer-derived regional morphometrics (cortical thickness, surface area, curvature, and volumetry) were integrated with a categorical ROI identifier in a supervised learning framework. Model generalization was assessed with leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation (N = 18) to prevent within-subject information leakage across regions. We compared an ROI-only model (region identity) against an ROI + MRI model (region identity plus morphometrics) and quantified the added value of morphology as ΔR². Under LOSO, the ROI + MRI model achieved mean R² = 0.344 (SD = 0.316), outperforming the ROI-only model (mean R² = 0.228; SD = 0.396), with a mean ΔR² = 0.116 across subjects. These results indicate that regional identity captures a strong baseline gradient in rCPS, while MRI morphometrics contribute additional subject-specific information beyond ROI identity. The sleep paradigm is treated as contextual background rather than the primary object of inference, emphasizing a reproducible methodology for integrating structural and molecular imaging in predictive modeling.

articles.title: Emergence of occupied and unoccupied electronic states driven by quantum charge fluctuations in electron doped cuprate superconductors
articles.title_zh: 电子掺杂铜氧化物超导体中由量子电荷涨落驱动的占据态与未占据电子态涌现
articles.abstract: The origin of electron–boson interactions is central to understanding high-Tc superconductivity in cuprates. While phonons and magnetic fluctuations are widely considered as candidates for mediating electron pairing, the role of charge fluctuations– one of the fundamental electronic degrees of freedom– remains unclear. Here, we investigate the electronic structure of the electron-doped cuprate Nd2−xCexCuO4 using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and angle-resolved inverse photoemission spectroscopy, which reveal the occupied and unoccupied states, respectively. We identify emergent spectral features on both occupied and unoccupied states that are consistent with excitations driven by quantum charge fluctuations. The results obtained in this study offer direct experimental insight into charge fluctuations in cuprates, thereby paving the way towards clarifying their fine electronic structure and the mechanism of high-Tc superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注铜氧化物高温超导中电子—玻色子相互作用的起源，特别是电荷涨落在其中的作用。作者利用角分辨光电子能谱和角分辨逆光电子能谱分别探测Nd2−xCexCuO4的占据态与未占据态，发现两侧均出现与量子电荷涨落激发相一致的新谱特征。结果为直接理解铜氧化物中的电荷涨落及其精细电子结构提供了实验依据，并有助于澄清高温超导机制。

articles.title: TEG-VRPTW: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Architecture with Temporal Edge-Gating and Amplitude-Encoded Quantum Bridge
articles.title_zh: TEG-VRPTW：具有时间边门控与振幅编码量子桥的混合量子—经典架构
articles.abstract: The Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows(VRPTW) remains a fundamental challenge in combinatorialoptimization. Classical Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) struggleto capture temporal feasibility constraints due to isotropicattention mechanisms that are blind to time window structureduring message passing. The primary contribution of this work isa Temporal Edge-Gating (TEG) mechanism that explicitly modelsedge traversal feasibility via temporal slack, injecting a problemspecificinductive bias into GNN message passing. As a secondaryproof-of-concept, a Quantum Bridge (QB) uses Amplitude Encodingto compress 128-dimensional embeddings into 7 qubitsvia Variational Quantum Circuits (VQC), providing regimespecificrepresentational efficiency within NISQ constraints. Noasymptotic computational speedup is claimed. Evaluated on all 56Solomon benchmark instances (N=100), TEG-VRPTW achieves1.39% average optimality gap with sub-second inference. Thequantum bridge provides a statistically significant but regimespecificbenefit (−0.20%, p=0.006), concentrated on tight-windowcategories (R1/RC1). A rigorously isolated ablation (shared GATbackbone, 5 seeds, Wilcoxon + stratified bootstrap) confirmsTEG as dominant contributor (−0.43%), with the QB providingrepresentational efficiency quantified by normalized effectivedimension ( ˜ deff = 0.875 vs. 0.728 for the best classical alternative).
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对带时间窗车辆路径问题中经典图神经网络难以捕捉时间可行性约束的问题，提出时间边门控机制，以时间松弛显式建模边遍历可行性并注入问题特定归纳偏置。作为概念验证，作者还引入基于振幅编码和变分量子线路的量子桥，将高维嵌入压缩到少量量子比特中，但不声称渐近计算加速。在Solomon基准实例上的评估显示，该方法具有较低平均最优性差距和亚秒级推理能力，量子桥在紧时间窗场景中带来统计显著但特定条件下的收益。

articles.title: A predictive modeling approach for determining optimal PPF content in concrete using ANN and RSM

articles.abstract: The incorporation of polypropylene fibers (PPF) enhances concrete’s flexural performance but often reduces workability, creating a critical trade-off in mix design. This study employs data-driven modeling using artificial neural networks (ANN) and response surface methodology (RSM) to determine the optimal PPF content by balancing flexural strength enhancement and workability retention. The ANN models achieved coefficient of determination (R2) values of 0.934 for flexural strength variation (FSV) and 0.852 for slump variation (SV), while RSM yielded R² of 0.885 and 0.896, respectively. A multi-objective optimization approach identifies PPF contents that balance strength improvement with minimal workability loss, providing practical guidance for the design of fiber-reinforced concretes in construction applications.

articles.title: A Quantum-Classical Hybrid Framework for Optimal Energy Storage Systems Planning
articles.title_zh: 用于储能系统优化规划的量子—经典混合框架
articles.abstract: The extensive deployment of power-electronics introduce spatial-temporal variability that can degrade voltage quality and operational reliability. Energy storage systems (ESS) can mitigate these effects through fast active and reac-tive power support, but their value is contingent on coordinated siting and sizing. Integrated formulations that minimize voltage deviations, reduce sub-station power-flow variability, and account for installation costs typically yield in large-scale mixed-integer optimization problems that are computationally burdensome for classical solvers and may yet not lead to the most optimum solution. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a two-stage hybrid quantum–classical planning framework that separates binary siting from continuous sizing and operation. In Stage I, the siting problem is reformulated as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization model and solved via a hybrid quantum workflow. Acting as a “quantum sieve,” stochastic sampling generates a diverse set of candidate site combinations that classical single-point methods can overlook. In Stage II, selected site sets are evaluated using a classical convex solver (SOCP) to compute optimal ESS capacities and operating setpoints subject to network constraints, ensuring physical feasibility. Experiments on IonQ Forte hardware show grid-standard accuracy with industry-standard classical 1 solvers. Although current hardware latencies limit performance in the NISQ era, the paper outlines scaling pathways and discusses key practical hurdles, including state-preparation overlap and higher-order cost couplings.
articles.abstract_zh: 大规模电力电子设备接入会带来时空波动，影响电压质量和运行可靠性，而储能系统可通过快速有功和无功支撑缓解这些问题。该文提出两阶段量子—经典混合规划框架，将储能选址的二进制决策与容量及运行的连续优化分离：第一阶段将选址重构为 QUBO 并通过混合量子流程采样候选方案，第二阶段用经典凸优化求解器评估候选站址集合。该方法旨在降低大规模混合整数优化的计算负担，并提高发现优良规划方案的可能性。

articles.title: Investigation of Laser-Induced Graphene Production with Polyethylene Terephthalate and Polyimide Substrates
articles.title_zh: 聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯与聚酰亚胺基底上激光诱导石墨烯制备的研究
articles.abstract: Laser-induced graphene (LIG) enables direct fabrication of conductive carbon on polymer substrates, with polyimide (PI) as the established precursor. The behavior of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) remains unclear. This study investigates what governs PET’s response to CO₂ laser irradiation: whether the outcome is controlled by the delivered laser energy—tunable through processing parameters—or by an intrinsic pathway set by the polymer’s backbone chemistry. PET and PI substrates were processed with a continuous-wave CO₂ laser (10–12 W) and characterized by Raman and ATR–FTIR spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy, and electrical resistance measurements. PI formed porous conductive networks with D, G, and 2D Raman bands and sheet resistances as low as 3 Ω sq⁻¹, whereas PET produced disordered, dendritic carbon with resistance above the measurable range. PET absorbed the laser efficiently; the outcome was governed not by energy but by melting and a low char yield, which favor carbonization over graphitization.
articles.abstract_zh: 激光诱导石墨烯可在聚合物基底上直接制备导电碳材料，其中聚酰亚胺是成熟前驱体，而 PET 的响应机制尚不明确。该研究比较了 PET 与 PI 在连续波 CO₂ 激光照射下的结构、形貌和电学性质，发现 PI 可形成多孔导电网络并呈现典型石墨化拉曼特征，而 PET 主要生成无序树枝状碳且电阻超出可测范围。结果表明，PET 的失效并非源于激光能量吸收不足，而是由熔融行为和低成炭率主导，倾向于碳化而非石墨化。

articles.title: Multi-Wavelength Investigation of Solar Rotational and Rieger-Type Periodicities in EUV, Sunspot, and Radio Observations Across Solar Cycles 24–25
articles.title_zh: 太阳第24—25活动周期间 EUV、黑子与射电观测中太阳自转及 Rieger 型周期性的多波长研究
articles.abstract: Periodic variations in solar emissions provide important informationregarding the dynamical processes associated with solar rotation and magneticactivity. This study investigates periodicities in solar extreme ultraviolet (EUV),soft X-ray, sunspot number (SSN), and radio flux observations during 2011–2026,covering Solar Cycle 24 and the early phase of Solar Cycle 25. The analyzeddatasets include LYRA EUV channel 3 (Al filter), LYRA soft X-ray/EUV chan-nel 4 (Zr filter), sunspot number, and radio flux measurements at 8, 10.7, 15, 30,and 32 cm wavelengths. The Lomb–Scargle periodogram was applied to identifystatistically significant periodicities, while continuous wavelet transform analysiswas employed to examine their temporal evolution and localization.The analysis reveals dominant periodicities near 26–28 days, 119–122 days, and185–194 days in multiple solar activity indicators. The 26–28-day periodicityappears consistently in EUV, soft X-ray, SSN, and radio flux measurements,indicating modulation associated with solar rotation and recurrent active re-gions. Intermediate periodicities near 119–122 days are mainly detected in softX-ray observations, whereas longer periodicities in the range of 185–194 daysare observed in EUV, soft X-ray, SSN, and 30 cm radio flux data. Waveletanalysis confirms that rotational periodicities persist throughout most of theobservational interval, while longer periods exhibit intermittent behavior andenhanced occurrence during intervals of increased solar activity. The detected185–194 day periodicity may be associated with long Rieger-type oscillationspotentially linked to magnetic Rossby-wave modulation. The observed agree-ment between Lomb–Scargle and wavelet analyses indicates that rotational andmagnetic activity-related processes jointly contribute to the temporal variabilityof solar emissions across different atmospheric layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了 2011—2026 年太阳极紫外、软 X 射线、黑子数和多波长射电通量数据，以研究太阳自转相关周期和 Rieger 型周期。作者采用 Lomb–Scargle 周期图识别显著周期，并用连续小波变换考察其时间演化与局域性。结果显示，多种太阳活动指标中存在约 26—28 天、119—122 天和 185—194 天的主要周期，其中 26—28 天周期与太阳自转及复现活动区调制密切相关。

articles.title: Explainable machine learning reveals that local structural motifs encode the thermodynamic state across the Cu Zr metallic glass-forming range
articles.title_zh: 可解释机器学习揭示局域结构基元编码 Cu-Zr 金属玻璃形成范围内的热力学状态
articles.abstract: Publication date: 25 July 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 272 Author(s): Jihe Wang, Suyue Yuan, Paulo S. Branicio
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕 Cu-Zr 金属玻璃形成体系，利用可解释机器学习研究局域结构基元与热力学状态之间的关系。由于所给摘要仅包含出版信息和作者信息，具体模型、数据来源和主要结论需查阅原文。总体来看，该研究旨在阐明金属玻璃中局域原子结构如何反映或预测材料的热力学状态。

articles.title: Exploring structural stability and bonding trends in A 2 B 2 O 7 Pyrochlores using machine learning
articles.title_zh: 利用机器学习探索 A2B2O7 烧绿石的结构稳定性与成键趋势
articles.abstract: Publication date: 25 July 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 272 Author(s): Muhammed Acikgoz, Czesław Rudowicz, Yatramohan Jana
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作以 A2B2O7 烧绿石材料为对象，利用机器学习分析其结构稳定性和成键规律。由于所给摘要仅为出版元数据，未提供具体方法、数据集和结果，相关细节需查阅原文。根据题名判断，该研究可能服务于烧绿石氧化物的稳定性预测与材料筛选。

articles.title: Hamiltonian description of non-reciprocal interactions
articles.title_zh: 非互易相互作用的哈密顿量描述
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 12 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03317-0 Many active and driven systems exhibit non-reciprocal interactions, making them hard to describe with standard methods. Now a constrained Hamiltonian embedding with auxiliary variables reproduces these dynamics in model spin systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多活性体系和受驱动体系表现出非互易相互作用，因而难以用标准理论方法描述。该研究提出一种带约束的哈密顿量嵌入方法，引入辅助变量来再现此类动力学，并在模型自旋体系中展示其有效性。

articles.title: Alternating current magnetorheometer for real-time investigations
articles.title_zh: 用于实时研究的交流磁流变仪
articles.abstract: Nature Reviews Chemistry, Published online: 12 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41570-026-00840-9 Richa Chaudhary explains how a custom alternating current magnetorheometer enables real-time rheological measurements of, for example, polymers and electromagnetic materials during exposure to alternating magnetic fields. Such measurements are not possible with conventional magnetorheometers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文介绍了一种定制的交流磁流变仪，可在交变磁场作用下对聚合物、电磁材料等体系进行实时流变测量。传统磁流变仪通常无法实现这类同步原位测量，因此该装置为研究磁场驱动下材料力学响应提供了新手段。

articles.title: Inverse Vulcanization Through Epoxide Chemistry: A Low Temperature Non‐Olefin Route to Sulfur‐Rich Polymer Networks
articles.title_zh: 通过环氧化学实现反向硫化：一种低温、非烯烃路线制备富硫聚合物网络
articles.abstract: Angewandte Chemie International Edition, EarlyView.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕反向硫化反应的替代合成策略展开，提出利用环氧化学在较低温度下构建富硫聚合物网络。与常见依赖烯烃单体的路线不同，该研究强调非烯烃反应路径的潜力；具体反应条件、材料性能和应用前景需查阅原文。

articles.title: Overcoming Data Starvation: Automated Virtual Reaction Exploration and Machine Learning Discovery of p‐Block Metal Catalysts for Borrowing Hydrogen
articles.title_zh: 克服数据匮乏：自动化虚拟反应探索与机器学习发现用于借氢反应的 p 区金属催化剂
articles.abstract: Angewandte Chemie International Edition, EarlyView.

authors: Zhe Chen, Xiaoyu Zhou, Chuanyi Xiong, Yubang Liu, Ruzhao Chen, Fuyi Yang, Huayu Liang, Jiaxin Lin, Jiaqi Su, Yinwu Li, Zhuofeng Ke

articles.title: Engineering quantum Hall stripes in 2D materials inside electromagnetic cavities
articles.title_zh: 在电磁腔中调控二维材料的量子霍尔条纹相
articles.abstract: Quantum materials, materials with properties that are governed by the laws of quantum mechanics, have proved to be highly promising for the development of ultra-efficient electronic devices, quantum processors, highly precise sensors and various other technologies. Reliably controlling these materials' quantum phases would be highly advantageous, as it would enable engineers to tailor and optimize their properties for specific applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料的性质受量子力学规律支配，在高效电子器件、量子处理器和高精度传感等方向具有重要潜力。该报道聚焦于如何在电磁腔中工程化调控二维材料的量子霍尔条纹相，从而为按应用需求定制量子相和材料性质提供可能。

articles.title: A universal vision transformer for fast calorimeter simulations
articles.title_zh: 用于快速量能器模拟的通用视觉 Transformer
articles.abstract: The high-dimensional complex nature of detectors makes fast calorimeter simulations a prime application for modern generative machine learning. Vision transformers (ViTs) can emulate the Geant4 response with unmatched accuracy and are not limited to regular geometries. Starting from the CaloDREAM architecture, we demonstrate the robustness and scalability of ViTs on regular and irregular geometries, and multiple detectors. Our results show that ViTs generate electromagnetic and hadronic showers with minimal deviations from Geant4 in multiple evaluation metrics, while maintaining the generation time in the ms on a single GPU. Furthermore, we show that pretraining on a large dataset and fine-tuning on the target geometry leads to reduced training costs and higher data efficiency, or altogether improves the fidelity of generated showers.
articles.abstract_zh: 高维且复杂的探测器响应使快速量能器模拟成为生成式机器学习的重要应用场景。该研究以 CaloDREAM 架构为基础，展示视觉 Transformer 可在规则和非规则几何、多种探测器中高精度模拟 Geant4 的电磁与强子簇射，同时在单个 GPU 上保持毫秒级生成时间。研究还表明，大规模预训练再针对目标几何微调可降低训练成本、提高数据效率，并改善生成簇射的保真度。
authors: Luigi Favaro, Andrea Giammanco and Claudius Krause

articles.title: Mixed-dimensional quantum Monte Carlo studies of M-point moiré materials
articles.title_zh: M 点莫尔材料的混合维数量子蒙特卡罗研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12508v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A new moiré-material platform has recently been proposed based on twisting two-dimensional triangular-lattice monolayers whose low-energy states lie at the three M points of the Brillouin zone. Continuum models derived from extensive ab initio simulations suggest that electrons in the conduction bands of one such M-point moiré material, twisted AA-stacked SnSe₂, realize a three-orbital Hubbard model with orbitally-selective, quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) hopping, protected by a projective mirror symmetry. Here, we show that the resulting "mixed-dimensional" limit -- in which the hopping is exactly quasi-1D in each valley, while the valleys are coupled by interactions into a fully two-dimensional network -- can be sampled with Stochastic Series Expansion (SSE) quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) without a sign problem at any filling. We develop an efficient new SSE QMC algorithm that combines custom global updates with parallel tempering to overcome the equilibration challenges posed by the mixed-dimensional setting. We then use this algorithm to explore the phase diagram of M-point twisted AA-stacked SnSe₂. Over extended and realistic ranges of twist angles and interaction strengths, we find that at integer fillings the system supports correlated insulators whose nature and strength depend strongly on angle. At certain commensurate fractional fillings, we further find evidence for Wigner-Mott insulators. We analytically account for the main features observed numerically using a strong-coupling description. Finally, we discuss perturbations away from the mixed-dimensional limit and the possibility of applying our method to other realizations of mixed-dimensional Hubbard models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察一种由三角晶格二维单层扭转形成的新型 M 点莫尔材料平台，其低能态位于布里渊区三个 M 点。作者指出，在扭转 AA 堆垛 SnSe₂ 等体系中，电子可实现具有轨道选择性、准一维跃迁的三轨道 Hubbard 模型，并在混合维极限下可用无符号问题的随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗方法在任意填充下采样。研究进一步开发了结合定制全局更新和平行回火的新算法，用于探索该类材料的相图。
authors: Dumitru Călugăru, Konstantinos Vasiliou, Haoyu Hu, B. Andrei Bernevig, Werner Krauth, S. A. Parameswaran

articles.title: Spin correlations, low-energy scales, and anisotropy scaling in kagome frustrated magnets
articles.title_zh: kagome 受挫磁体中的自旋关联、低能标度与各向异性标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutron scattering is central to identifying quantum states of magnetic materials. In the search for quantum spin liquids, broad spectral features of inelastic spectra have been cited as evidence for spinon excitations, but can also arise from magnon excitations excitations in the presence of quenched disorder and strong magnon interactions. We develop a new approach to this problem, based on the adiabatic continuity in the XXZ Heisenberg model on geometrically frustrating (GF) lattices as a function of the model's anisotropy. Using this approach, we identify universal features and energies of finite-temperature spin correlators. Focusing on the kagome lattice, we show that the low-energy spin spectral function contains robust, momentum-independent peaks with frequencies: ømega₁ approx 3.4 T^* and ømega₂ approx 6.3 T^*, where the ``hidden energy scale'' T^* is the characteristic scale of a low-temperature peak in the heat capacity, at which many GF magnets also display spin-glass freezing. We show that the spectral features at low energies ømegałesssim T^* arise from single-magnon scattering and identify the magnetizations of the respective excitations. We explore the evolution of the spectral features with temperature and discuss extensions to other GF lattices. Our results provide a sharp spectroscopic criterion for interpreting neutron scattering in kagome and other GF quantum magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 中子散射是识别磁性材料量子态的重要工具，但非弹性谱中的宽谱特征既可能来自自旋子激发，也可能源于无序和强相互作用下的磁振子激发。该研究基于几何受挫晶格上 XXZ Heisenberg 模型随各向异性变化的绝热连续性，提出分析有限温自旋关联的新方法。以 kagome 晶格为例，作者识别出低能自旋谱函数中的稳健、动量无关峰，并将其与隐藏能标及单磁振子散射联系起来。
authors: Phillip Popp, Stephan Rosenkranz, Arthur P. Ramirez, Sergey Syzranov

articles.title: Cyclotron mass-selective de Haas-van Alphen measurements using temperature modulation
articles.title_zh: 利用温度调制进行回旋质量选择性 de Haas–van Alphen 测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a temperature-modulated de Haas-van Alphen measurement technique that allows selective addressing of quantum oscillations with different effective masses mast using a non-monotonic amplitude evolution with temperature and magnetic field, governed by the temperature derivative of the Lifshitz-Kosevich factor. The technique relies on harmonic modulation of the sample temperature and phase-sensitive detection of quantum oscillations in the voltage induced in a pick-up coil. We use a set of frequencies with strong Zeeman-driven harmonic content in the compensated topological semimetal MoSi₂ as a natural linear mass comb ranging from 1mast to 13mast to demonstrate the tunability of the mass-dependent quantum oscillation amplitudes experimentally. The technique allows to reliably isolate weak contributions of heavy orbits that are inaccessible in conventional de Haas-van Alphen frequency spectra because their frequency peaks overlap with much stronger frequency peaks of lighter orbits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种温度调制的 de Haas–van Alphen 测量技术，可利用振幅随温度和磁场的非单调演化，对不同有效质量的量子振荡进行选择性探测。方法通过对样品温度进行谐波调制，并对拾取线圈中的感应电压进行相敏检测来实现。作者在补偿型拓扑半金属 MoSi₂ 中利用强 Zeeman 驱动谐波成分展示了质量依赖振荡振幅的可调性，并表明该技术可分离常规频谱中被轻质量轨道强峰掩盖的重轨道弱贡献。
authors: Michelle Hollricher, Andreas Bauer, Leo Maximov, Louw Feenstra, Christian Pfleiderer, Marc A. Wilde

articles.title: Hidden antiferromagnetism, persistent valley fluctuations, and U(6) crossovers in triangular-lattice M-point moiré materials via determinantal quantum Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 通过行列式量子蒙特卡罗研究三角晶格 M 点莫尔材料中的隐藏反铁磁性、持久谷涨落与 U(6) 交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A new moiré material platform was recently proposed based on twisting two-dimensional atomic monolayers whose low-energy states lie at the three M-points of the Brillouin Zone. Continuum and ab initio modeling suggest that electrons in the conduction bands of these materials realize three-valley Hubbard models with valley-selective, quasi-one-dimensional hopping. Remarkably, the onsite Hubbard repulsion is almost U(6)-symmetric without fine-tuning. Here, we show that this class of systems naturally admits sign-free determinantal Quantum Monte Carlo simulations at a filling of three electrons per moiré unit cell. We use these to explore the phase diagram for interactions of various strengths and U(6)-breaking anisotropies. We show that for near-isotropic interactions as relevant to, e.g., AA-stacked twisted SnSe₂, the system exhibits an extended intermediate-coupling regime in which local-moment formation and itinerancy compete, and the crossover to a putative low-temperature ordered state can be understood in terms of fluctuating U(6) local moments. We argue that many of these features persist beyond the idealized sign-problem-free limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向低能态位于布里渊区三个 M 点的新型扭转二维莫尔材料，考察其三谷 Hubbard 模型及谷选择性准一维跃迁特征。作者指出，在每个莫尔晶胞三个电子填充下，该类体系可进行无符号问题的行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟。结果用于探索不同相互作用强度和 U(6) 对称性破缺各向异性下的相图，并揭示近各向同性相互作用时局域磁矩形成、巡游性和 U(6) 局域矩涨落之间的竞争。
authors: Konstantinos Vasiliou, Dumitru Călugăru, Johannes S. Hofmann, S. A. Parameswaran

articles.title: Dynamical Control of Superconductivity in Superconductor-Ferromagnet Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 超导体-铁磁体双层中的超导电性动力学控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a simplified model of a ferromagnetic metal proximitized by a fully-gapped s-wave superconductor and integrated with a microwave resonator. The low-energy excitations in the combined system consist of ferromagnetic magnons, Bogoliubov excitations of the superconductor, and cavity photons. We show here that when the magnons and photons have comparable frequencies and are subject to an external drive, the hybridized driven magnon-polaritons induce a non-equilibrium crossover from the expected proximitized nodal p-wave superconductor to a fully gapped (pₓ₊ᵢₚ_y)-superconductor. Moreover, the characteristic crossover temperature is inversely related to the magnon-photon detuning. We compute the temperature-dependent renormalization of the cavity photon frequencies across this nodal to nodeless evolution, which modifies the kinetic inductance of the resonator, and find a number of non-trivial features tied to the non-equilibrium (i.e., driven) nature of the problem. We compare and contrast these results with a recent circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) based experiment studying a permalloy-niobium bilayer, where a non-trivial dependence of the low-temperature cavity response on the magnon-photon detuning was observed. Our results pave the way for a principled exploration of engineering novel states of matter by coupling cavity photons to electronic collective modes in correlated two-dimensional materials and interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了一个铁磁金属受全能隙 s 波超导体邻近并与微波谐振器耦合的简化模型，低能激发包括铁磁磁振子、超导 Bogoliubov 激发和腔光子。作者表明，当磁振子与光子频率相近并受外部驱动时，杂化的受驱磁振子-极化激元可诱导体系从预期的有节点 p 波超导向全能隙 pₓ+ip_y 超导发生非平衡交叉。研究还计算了这一演化过程中腔光子频率的温度依赖重整化，并讨论其与相关 cQED 实验的联系。
authors: Dimitri Pimenov, Nicholas R. Poniatowski, Charlotte G. L. Bøttcher, Amir Yacoby, Debanjan Chowdhury

articles.title: Compositional gradient engineering for enhanced ferroelectricity in ultrathin AlScN
articles.title_zh: 通过成分梯度工程增强超薄 AlScN 的铁电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric AlScN is promising for CMOS-compatible non-volatile memory, but thickness scaling is limited by leakage, premature breakdown, and defect-mediated failure. Here we show that compositional grading within a continuous wurtzite AlN-AlScN lattice mitigates these limitations by distributing structural and polarization discontinuities across the film thickness, reducing defect formation and local field concentration. In a 20 nm graded heterostructure, monotonic Sc incorporation and AlN-rich boundaries produce reversible ferroelectric switching, an as-grown metal-polar state, a 21% higher breakdown field, 10% enhanced remanent polarization, and 40x higher resistivity relative to homogeneous AlScN. Time-domain PUND measurements reveal strongly suppressed post-switching leakage, consistent with reduced defect-assisted and polarization-coupled conduction. This improved dielectric robustness enables ferroelectric functionality in 5 nm graded stacks containing only a 2 nm Al₀.₆₄Sc₀.₃₆N region, with measurable switching near 1 V. These results establish compositional grading as a defect- and field-management strategy for scalable ultrathin wurtzite ferroelectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电 AlScN 有望用于 CMOS 兼容的非易失存储器，但厚度缩放受到漏电、提前击穿和缺陷介导失效的限制。该研究表明，在连续纤锌矿 AlN-AlScN 晶格中引入成分梯度，可在薄膜厚度方向分散结构和极化不连续性，从而降低缺陷形成和局部电场集中。实验显示，梯度异质结构可提升击穿场、剩余极化和电阻率，并抑制开关后的漏电，使纳米级超薄堆叠中的铁电开关成为可能。
authors: Zekun Hu, Haiwen Zhang, Rajeev Kumar Rai, Yuhong Cao, Xiaolei Tong, Pedram Yousefian, Hyunmin Cho, Bongjun Choi, Chao-Chuan Chen, Yunfei He, Kefei Bao, Chloe Leblanc, Eric A. Stach, Roy Olsson, Deep Jariwala

articles.title: The formation of magnetic reentrancy in the Ising model on a decorated square lattice
articles.title_zh: 装饰方格子 Ising 模型中磁性重入现象的形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12572v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In our work, based on an exact solution of the Ising model on a decorated square lattice with an arbitrary number of decorating spins, we have demonstrated the fundamental possibility of describing the phenomenon of multiple magnetic phase transitions (magnetic reentrancy) in the regime of competing exchange interactions. We analyzed the magnetic behavior of the system and established the conditions for the occurrence of magnetic reentrancy. We have determined the relationships of the model parameter under which the formation of one, three, and even five magnetic phase transitions is possible, which is confirmed by a complicated magnetic phase diagram. We have also proposed a unique method for finding critical temperatures that allows for the precise determination of their number and values, including those at extremely low temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作基于具有任意数量装饰自旋的装饰方格子 Ising 模型精确解，证明了在竞争性交换相互作用条件下描述多重磁相变（磁性重入）的基本可能性。作者分析了体系的磁行为，确定了磁性重入出现的条件，并给出可产生一次、三次甚至五次磁相变的模型参数关系。研究还提出了一种寻找临界温度的方法，可精确确定极低温区域内临界温度的数量和值。
authors: A. V. Zarubin, F. A. Kassan-Ogly

articles.title: Multiband Superconductivity and Charge Density Wave in HfxZr1-xTe3 single crystals
articles.title_zh: HfxZr1-xTe3 单晶中的多带超导与电荷密度波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the bulk multiband superconductivity and charge density wave (CDW) in HfxZr1-xTe3 single crystals. The parent compound ZrTe3 is a layered van der Waals material that undergoes a CDW transition near 63 K and exhibits only filamentary superconductivity below 2.0 K. Upon the introduction of a small amount of Hf (x = 0.02), the CDW transition temperature is reduced to TCDW ~ 53 K, while a robust bulk superconducting state emerges at Tc ~ 3.3 K, underscoring a subtle competition between CDW order and superconductivity in this quasi-one-dimensional system. Electrical resistivity, magnetic susceptibility, Hall effect, Seebeck coefficient, and specific heat measurements consistently confirm the bulk nature of the superconducting phase. The temperature dependence of the upper critical field Hc2(T) deviates markedly from single-band behavior, and it is well described by a two-band model, consistent with multiband superconductivity. Analysis of the Hall effect, and thermoelectric behavior reveal pronounced electronic anisotropy, with enhanced effective carrier masses, indicating that the subtle structural modification introduced by Hf substitutions affects the Fermi surface topology, as well as electronic correlations. Measurements of electrical resistivity in hydrostatic pressures up to ~ 2 GPa reveal that pressure drives TCDW to higher temperatures while suppressing Tc. These findings show that Hf doping can be used to fine-tune the balance between the CDW instability and superconductivity, possibly by means of chemical pressure effects, stabilizing a multiband superconducting state in Hf-doped ZrTe3.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了 HfxZr1-xTe3 单晶中的体相多带超导和电荷密度波行为。母体 ZrTe3 在约 63 K 发生电荷密度波转变，并仅在 2.0 K 以下表现出丝状超导；少量 Hf 掺杂（x=0.02）使电荷密度波转变温度降低至约 53 K，同时诱导出约 3.3 K 的稳健体相超导。电阻率、磁化率、霍尔效应、塞贝克系数和比热测量共同支持超导的体相性质，上临界场的温度依赖可由双带模型描述，表明其具有多带超导特征。
authors: F. F. G. Nogueira, M. S. da Luz, M. S. Torikachvili, L. M. Ishikura, Ebrahim Dib, A. J. S. Machado

articles.title: Hall conductivity reveals the nature of quantum coherence in strongly correlated metals
articles.title_zh: 霍尔电导揭示强关联金属中量子相干性的本质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Linear-in-temperature resistivity is a hallmark for strange metallic transport, and appears universally in many strongly correlated electron systems. However, the focus on the longitudinal channel often overshadows the profound microscopic insights contained within the transverse response. Here, we utilize numerically exact determinantal quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the doped Hubbard model in a magnetic field to calculate longitudinal and transverse transport. We demonstrate that while the resistivity is robustly T-linear across parameter sets, the Hall response is highly sensitive to particle-hole asymmetry, Fermi surface topology, and many-body correlation effects. Specifically, the combination of these effects determine a crossover scale in which the system becomes quantum-coherent, and is reflected in the Hall conductivity. Our results demonstrate that while the T-linearity in resistivity appears universal, the Hall response reveals a crossover from semi-classical to quantum-coherent transport otherwise masked in the longitudinal channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用含磁场掺杂 Hubbard 模型的行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟，计算强关联体系的纵向与横向输运性质。研究发现，尽管电阻率在不同参数下稳健地呈线性温度依赖，霍尔响应却对粒子-空穴不对称性、费米面拓扑和多体关联效应高度敏感。这些因素共同决定了体系进入量子相干输运的交叉尺度，并在霍尔电导中显现出来，说明霍尔通道可揭示纵向电阻中被掩盖的半经典到量子相干输运转变。
authors: Emily Z. Zhang, Thomas P. Devereaux

articles.title: Site Preferences and "Coloring Problem" in Cu-doped BiMn₇O₁₂ Quadruple Perovskite
articles.title_zh: Cu 掺杂 BiMn₇O₁₂ 四重钙钛矿中的位点偏好与“着色问题”
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lightly Cu-doped BiMn₇O₁₂ (x = 0.05, 0.10, and 0.15) was investigated using high-pressure synthesis, single-crystal X-ray diffraction, pair distribution function (PDF) analysis, STEM, magnetic measurements, and first-principles calculations. All compositions retain an average monoclinic I2/m structure, while Cu substitution progressively suppresses the monoclinic distortion and drives the lattice toward a pseudo-cubic metric symmetry. PDF analysis reveals increasing local structural disorder and reduced medium-range coherence with increasing Cu concentration, despite preservation of the overall quadruple-perovskite framework. Single-crystal refinements indicate enhanced electron density at the octahedral Mn B sites, suggesting preferential Cu occupation within the MnO₆ network rather than the conventional square-planar sites expected for Cu²⁺. Magnetic measurements reveal two characteristic anomalies near T₁ ~ 100-120 K and T₂ ~ 50-60 K, together with pronounced magnetic irreversibility, field-dependent hysteresis, and unsaturated magnetization. Increasing Cu concentration progressively suppresses the low-temperature magnetic state and weakens the field-induced moment. First-principles calculations favor Cu occupation at the square-planar sites, contrasting with the experimental refinements and highlighting strong competitions among local bonding, short-range disorder, and metastability in this highly frustrated quadruple perovskite system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过高压合成、单晶 X 射线衍射、对分布函数分析、STEM、磁性测量和第一性原理计算，考察了轻度 Cu 掺杂 BiMn₇O₁₂ 的结构与磁性。所有样品保持平均单斜 I2/m 结构，但 Cu 掺杂逐渐抑制单斜畸变并使晶格趋向准立方度量对称；局域结构无序和中程相干性的降低也随 Cu 含量增加而增强。结构精修表明 Cu 更倾向占据八面体 Mn B 位而非 Cu²⁺ 通常偏好的方平面位点，磁性测量显示约 100–120 K 和 50–60 K 附近存在特征异常，并伴随磁不可逆性、场依赖磁滞和未饱和磁化。
authors: Cheng Peng, Mingyu Xu, Yang Zhang, Ismail El Baggari, Jie Li, Weiwei Xie

articles.title: Role of quantum confinement in semiconductor-superconductor core-shell nanowires
articles.title_zh: 量子限域在半导体-超导体核壳纳米线中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12715v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work is motivated by the experimentally observed coherence of the supercurrent in semiconductor nanowires covered by a half-shell metallic superconductor, which leads to flux dependent supercurrent oscillations with period h/2e, as expected for a tubular superconductor, i.e. Little-Parks oscillations. We perform microscopic model calculations and compare the results for full and half metallic shells. We use an effective Hamiltonian derived from the Green's function of the proximitized semiconductor nanowire, where the presence of the superconductor is represented by a self energy. Furthermore, we incorporate the electrostatic band-bending at the metal-semiconductor interface as a rectangular narrow quantum well on the semiconductor side. The properties of the eigenstates of the effective Hamiltonian are determined by the spatial profile of the corresponding transverse modes in the normal state. For half-shell wires, transverse modes with high-enough energy expand outside the interface quantum well and generate eigenstates with mixed electron-hole character that surround the entire circumference of the nanowire, similar to eigenstates of the full-shell system. We identify these states as being responsible for the observed Little-Parks effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作旨在解释半壳金属超导体覆盖半导体纳米线中观测到的超电流相干性及 h/2e 周期的 Little-Parks 振荡。作者进行微观模型计算，对比全壳与半壳金属结构，并以由近邻超导半导体纳米线格林函数导出的有效哈密顿量描述超导体的自能作用。研究还将金属-半导体界面的静电能带弯曲表示为半导体侧的窄矩形量子阱，指出有效本征态性质由正常态横向模式的空间分布决定；在半壳纳米线中，能量足够高的横向模式可扩展到界面量子阱之外，形成环绕整个纳米线周向的混合电子-空穴态。
authors: Tudor Gabriel Dumitru, Anna Sitek, Gunnar Thorgilsson, Sigurdur I. Erlingsson, Tudor Dan Stanescu, Andrei Manolescu

articles.title: Extending the La Solubility Limit in Sr₃Ir₂O₇ through High-Pressure High-Temperature Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 通过高压高温合成扩展 Sr₃Ir₂O₇ 中 La 的固溶极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: La-doped bilayer iridates provide an important platform for studying the evolution of the spin-orbit-assisted Mott state under electron doping, but the La solubility achieved by conventional ambient-pressure synthesis is limited. Here, we report the synthesis and physical properties of nominally La-doped (Sr₁₋ₓLaₓ₎₃Ir₂O₇ (x = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, and 0.20) prepared using high-pressure high-temperature techniques. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction refinements, supported by scanning electron microscopy-energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDX), reveal significantly enhanced La incorporation, with nominal x = 0.05 and 0.15 corresponding to actual compositions of approximately (Sr₀.₈₉La₀.₁₁)₃Ir₂O₇ and (Sr₀.₇₇La₀.₂₃)₃Ir₂O₇, respectively. At nominal x = 0.20, the bilayer phase is no longer stabilized and instead transforms into cubic perovskite Sr₁₋ₓLaₓIrO₃. (Sr₀.₈₉La₀.₁₁)₃Ir₂O₇ exhibits a ferromagnetic-like transition near 186 K accompanied by magnetic hysteresis and subtle lattice anomalies indicative of spin-lattice coupling. Despite its high electron-doping level, the compound remains strongly insulating, consistent with a heavily doped localized magnetic insulating state distinct from both parent Sr₃Ir₂O₇ and ambient-pressure La-doped samples. In contrast, (Sr₀.₇₇La₀.₂₃)₃Ir₂O₇ displays metal-like electronic behavior, weakened magnetic order, and enhanced carrier delocalization, although disorder-driven localization persists at low temperatures. These results demonstrate that high-pressure synthesis substantially extends the accessible doping range of bilayer iridates and reveals electronic and magnetic states inaccessible through conventional synthesis routes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用高压高温技术制备名义 La 掺杂双层铱酸盐 (Sr₁₋ₓLaₓ)₃Ir₂O₇，以突破常压合成中 La 固溶度的限制。单晶 X 射线衍射和 SEM-EDX 表明 La 实际掺入量显著提高，例如名义 x=0.05 和 0.15 分别对应约 (Sr₀.₈₉La₀.₁₁)₃Ir₂O₇ 和 (Sr₀.₇₇La₀.₂₃)₃Ir₂O₇；名义 x=0.20 时双层相不再稳定，转变为立方钙钛矿 Sr₁₋ₓLaₓIrO₃。实际 La 含量约 0.11 的样品在约 186 K 出现类铁磁转变，并伴随磁滞和细微晶格异常，表明存在自旋-晶格耦合；尽管电子掺杂较高，该化合物仍保持强绝缘性。

articles.title: Water Flow Through Polar and Non-Polar Nanopores: Insights from Multiscale Simulations
articles.title_zh: 水流穿过极性与非极性纳米孔：来自多尺度模拟的认识
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Global water stress has emerged as a critical challenge, driving the search for advanced membrane materials that enable efficient, selective water filtration and transport. In this context, two-dimensional nanoporous membranes provide an ideal platform to elucidate how atomic-scale structure and electronic polarization govern water flow under extreme confinement. In this study, we employ multiscale simulations to investigate the effect of water flow through nanopores in graphene and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) membranes. Our results reveal significantly higher water flow in hBN membranes than in graphene. This enhanced flow is attributed to the asymmetry of the hBN pores, which induces an electric dipole moment, as confirmed by quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations. Classical molecular dynamics simulations further demonstrate that water molecules exhibit a random distribution with no preferential orientation near the graphene pores, whereas hBN induces strong structuring. Furthermore, hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) simulations indicate that the dipole moment of the hBN pore increases in the presence of water, as evidenced by the average charge distribution. Conversely, the symmetric nature of graphene pores results in non-polar characteristics, as verified by both QM/MM and QM calculations. These findings provide valuable insights into the distinct water-transport properties when flowing through graphene and hBN nanopores, with potential implications for designing advanced nanofiltration membranes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过多尺度模拟考察石墨烯和六方氮化硼（hBN）二维纳米孔膜中水流的差异，以理解原子尺度结构和电子极化对受限水输运的影响。结果显示，hBN 膜中的水流显著高于石墨烯膜，这归因于 hBN 孔的不对称性诱导了电偶极矩，量子力学计算对此予以确认。经典分子动力学表明，石墨烯孔附近水分子取向随机，而 hBN 会诱导强结构化；QM/MM 模拟进一步指出水存在时 hBN 孔的偶极矩会增强。
authors: Elizane E. de Moraes, João Victor Lemos Valle, Bruno H. S. Mendonça, Ernane de Freitas Martins, Hélio Chacham, Pablo Ordejón

articles.title: Revealing nonvolatile behaviors in magneto-thermal switching using microstructure-controlled superconducting composites
articles.title_zh: 利用微结构可控超导复合材料揭示磁热开关中的非易失行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12778v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermal conductivity in a conductor changes by the application of an external magnetic field, which functions as a magneto-thermal switch. For superconductors, a large magneto-thermal switching can occur through a superconducting-to-normal conducting phase transition due to the change in the electron contribution in thermal conductivity.
