articles.abstract_zh: 本文检验隐花色素自由基对是否可作为支持量子自旋相干计算的生物量子储备池。通过求解含电子退相干的自由基对主方程，作者发现五自旋系统在理想读出下具有一定信息处理能力，且主要由自旋相干贡献，但这种优势主要体现为资源效率。研究同时指出，在生物可访问读出条件下容量近乎为零，记忆时间尺度远短于突触和行为过程，因此为相关量子脑假说的储备池路径提供了可检验的定量限制框架。

articles.title: Fate of Topological Dirac Magnons in van der Waals Ferromagnets at Finite Temperature
articles.title_zh: 有限温度下范德华铁磁体中拓扑狄拉克磁振子的命运
articles.abstract: Author(s): Rintaro Eto, Ignacio Salgado-Linares, Masahito Mochizuki, Johannes Knolle, and Alexander Mook Theoretical modeling of magnon interactions at finite temperatures demonstrates that topological magnon gaps remain surprisingly stable near the Curie point, providing a roadmap for designing robust spintronic devices. [Phys. Rev. X 16, 021053] Published Wed Jun 10, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过有限温度下的磁振子相互作用理论建模，考察范德华铁磁体中拓扑狄拉克磁振子的稳定性。结果表明，拓扑磁振子能隙在接近居里温度时仍可保持出人意料的稳定。该工作为设计在热扰动下仍可靠运行的拓扑自旋电子器件提供了理论路线图。
authors: Rintaro Eto, Ignacio Salgado-Linares, Masahito Mochizuki, Johannes Knolle, and Alexander Mook

articles.title: Inverse Design of Novel Antiferromagnets Through Symmetry-aware Generation
articles.title_zh: 通过对称性感知生成实现新型反铁磁体的逆向设计
articles.abstract: npj Computational Materials, Published online: 10 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02169-9 Inverse Design of Novel Antiferromagnets Through Symmetry-aware Generation
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕利用生成式方法进行新型反铁磁材料的逆向设计展开，并强调将晶体或磁结构的对称性信息纳入模型。研究旨在提高候选反铁磁体生成的物理合理性与材料发现效率。由于摘要信息有限，具体模型架构、筛选流程和性能验证需查阅原文。

articles.title: OpenCSP: a deep learning framework for crystal structure prediction from ambient to high pressure
articles.title_zh: OpenCSP：从常压到高压晶体结构预测的深度学习框架
articles.abstract: npj Computational Materials, Published online: 10 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02180-0 OpenCSP: a deep learning framework for crystal structure prediction from ambient to high pressure
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 OpenCSP 深度学习框架，用于在常压至高压条件下开展晶体结构预测。工作可能面向材料结构搜索中的高维构型空间与压力依赖稳定性问题，旨在提升预测效率和适用范围。摘要仅提供题名与出版信息，具体算法、数据集和验证结果需参见原文。

articles.title: Experimental realization of a discrete k-space angular filter in microwave networks
articles.title_zh: 微波网络中离散 k 空间角度滤波器的实验实现
articles.abstract: Author(s): Michał Ławniczak, Tristan M. articles.title: Superlubricity via layered solidification and molecular reconfiguration of nanoconfined liquids
articles.title_zh: 通过纳米限域液体的层状固化与分子重构实现超润滑
articles.abstract: The molecular configuration and dynamic response behavior of liquids under low-dimensional confinement deviate substantially from those in the bulk state. However, even in the simplest systems composed of hydrocarbon molecules confined by atomically smooth and inert surfaces, the migration pattern and frictional shear response of confined molecules remain unclear. Here, we demonstrated a pressure-modulated, discontinuous superlubricity phenomenon exhibited by alkanol molecular films confined within nanogeometries formed by atomically thin two-dimensional materials. This segmented superlubricity arose from a pressure-induced phase transition process of the alkanol film, during which the molecules spontaneously migrated and reconfigured into an ordered, hierarchically structured, polycrystalline molecular arrangement within the confined nanogeometry. Combined sum-frequency generation and molecular dynamics simulations revealed that a non-covalent hydrogen-bond network among alkanol molecules stabilized the highly ordered structure of the solid-phase molecular film. These findings underscore the critical role of ordered hierarchical reconfiguration in enabling superlubricity in low-dimensional nanoconfined molecular systems, providing decisive insights into the phase behavior and molecular origin of friction in nanoconfined liquid flow.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了醇类分子薄膜在由原子级薄二维材料形成的纳米几何限域中出现的压力调控、非连续超润滑现象。作者认为，这种分段式超润滑源于压力诱导的相变：分子自发迁移并重构为有序的层级多晶固相结构。和频振动光谱与分子动力学模拟表明，醇分子间的非共价氢键网络有助于稳定这种高度有序结构，从而凸显低维限域中有序层级重构对实现超润滑的重要作用。

articles.title: An Efficient Photovoltaic Power Forecasting using Adaptive Learning Rate Enhanced Gated Recurrent Unit (ALRE-GRU) network optimized with Enhanced Dynamic Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (EDGOA)
articles.title_zh: 基于增强动态蝗虫优化算法优化的自适应学习率增强GRU网络的高效光伏功率预测
articles.abstract: Accurate photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for the reliable operation of renewable energy systems due to the nonlinear and non-stationary nature of solar power generation. This study proposes a hybrid framework that integrates Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) with an Adaptive Learning Rate Enhanced Gated Recurrent Unit (ALRE-GRU) network optimized using the Enhanced Dynamic Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (EDGOA). VMD is applied to decompose PV power signals into multiple band-limited intrinsic modes, improving data quality through noise reduction and feature separation. The decomposed modes are used as inputs to the ALRE-GRU model, which employs a parameter-wise adaptive learning rate strategy based on first- and second-order gradient moments to enhance training stability and convergence speed. EDGOA is further utilized to optimally tune critical hyperparameters, particularly the hidden layer size. The incorporation of dynamic inertial motion weights and an adaptive mutation probability coefficient within the Enhanced Dynamic Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (EDGOA) effectively mitigates the risk of premature convergence to suboptimal local optima. The proposed method is evaluated using real-world PV data from the Yulara Solar System in Australia for short-term (60-hour) and long-term (300-hour) forecasting. Experimental results demonstrate superior performance, achieving an R² of 99.91%, RMSE of 11.41, MAE of 8.51, and MAPE of 0.70%, outperforming several state-of-the-art forecasting models. These results confirm the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework for photovoltaic power forecasting applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种用于光伏功率预测的混合框架，将变分模态分解、自适应学习率增强门控循环单元网络和增强动态蝗虫优化算法相结合。变分模态分解用于将光伏功率信号分解为多个带限模态，以降低噪声并分离特征；ALRE-GRU通过基于一阶和二阶梯度矩的参数级自适应学习率提升训练稳定性和收敛速度。EDGOA进一步用于优化隐藏层规模等关键超参数，并通过动态惯性权重和自适应变异概率降低陷入局部最优的风险。

articles.title: Development and Accuracy Assessment of a PMMA 3D Diamond Model Using Region-Based Adaptive Machining (RBAM) and FDM-Based Fabrication
articles.title_zh: 基于区域自适应加工与FDM制造的PMMA三维钻石模型开发及精度评估
articles.abstract: Manufacturing engineering is a combination of science and art; in modern manufacturing, additive and subtractive manufacturing are predominant. Both approaches have their pros and cons, but model-building accuracy is an influential factor in reducing post-processing in both cases. Model build accuracy is influenced by cusp height (δ); it represents the deviation between the actual surface of the CAD model and the stepped surface created in the layered part during manufacturing. The present work deals with building a diamond, and its analytical analysis reveals variation in cusp height (δ). A diamond with 12 facets, width 40 mm, and height 39 mm was generated with a uniform layer height Z = 0.25 mm, and the result showed a cusp height δ = 0.135 mm in both the negative and positive tolerance models. To improve geometric accuracy, a hybrid manufacturing methodology combining additive and subtractive principles was proposed through an innovative Region-Based Adaptive Machining (RBAM) approach. The RBAM strategy enables fabrication of complex geometries on a 2.5D CNC machine using a simple Z-level machining strategy. The developed approach significantly reduced the cusp height to δ = 0.0074 mm. Experimental validation of the RBAM approach was performed using CAD/CAM software, a 2.5D CNC machine, and PMMA sheets fabricated layer-by-layer in 5 stages, with a constant step-over of Z = 0.25 mm. The dimensional accuracy of the RBAM-fabricated and FDM-printed models was evaluated using a 3D laser scanning system. The scanning results demonstrated that the RBAM-fabricated model achieved geometric accuracy of 98.90% and a volumetric error of 1.099%, comparable to the FDM-fabricated model, which achieved 98.89% geometric accuracy and 1.101% volumetric error. The proposed RBAM approach enables faster fabrication of complex prototypes while overcoming limitations of printable materials in additive manufacturing and build-volume constraints in CNC machining and 3D printing systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注增材与减材制造中层状成形导致的尖峰高度误差对模型几何精度的影响，并以三维钻石模型为对象进行分析。作者在均匀层高条件下构建具有12个刻面的钻石模型，发现正负公差模型均存在一定尖峰高度误差。为提高几何精度，研究提出结合增材与减材思想的区域自适应加工方法，使复杂几何可通过2.5D数控机床和简单Z层加工策略实现，并显著降低尖峰高度误差。

articles.title: Temperature-Dependent Swelling Kinetics and Thermodynamic Parameters of a Xanthan/Polyacrylamide-Based Hydrogel in Different Media
articles.title_zh: 黄原胶/聚丙烯酰胺基水凝胶在不同介质中的温度依赖溶胀动力学与热力学参数
articles.abstract: Despite extensive research on hydrogel swelling, the combined effects of temperature and medium composition on the swelling kinetics and thermodynamic behavior of xanthan/polyacrylamide-based systems remain insufficiently understood. This study addresses this gap by systematically evaluating temperature and contact time, providing insights essential for optimizing hydrogel performance in applications such as controlled release and water shut-off. In this study, a hydrogel with superabsorbent properties (50–241 g/g) was synthesized via alkaline crosslinking of a homogeneous mixture of the biopolymer xanthan and polyacrylamide. The solution, characterized by a low concentration of reagents, was converted into a gel-forming material within 4–6 hours at 40°C through reaction with glutaraldehyde. The structure of the crosslinked macromolecular network was characterized by FTIR spectroscopy, revealing that crosslinking predominantly occurs through the formation of bridges by glutaraldehyde between the –NH₂ groups of polyacrylamide and the –OH groups of xanthan. The swelling behavior of the hydrogel was investigated as a function of time in different pH media, as well as in NaCl, CaCl₂, and AlCl₃ solutions. To elucidate the swelling mechanisms, first-order and second-order kinetic models, as well as the Ritger–Peppas, Weibull, and Peppas–Sahlin models, were applied. It was determined that the swelling process follows a Fickian diffusion mechanism at lower temperatures and in physiological solutions, whereas in water at elevated temperatures it proceeds via a combined diffusion–relaxation – non-Fickian mechanism. The thermodynamic parameters of swelling in water and physiological solutions were evaluated, and the activation energy was calculated. The Gibbs free energy of swelling in water within the temperature range of 293–343 K was found to be ΔG° = −18.9 to (− 36.1) kJ/mol, while in physiological solution it ranged from ΔG° = −8.04 to (− 10.11) kJ/mol. The activation energy of swelling was determined to be Ea=17.42 kJ/mol in water and Ea=8.91 kJ/mol in physiological solution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察温度、接触时间和介质组成对黄原胶/聚丙烯酰胺基水凝胶溶胀动力学及热力学行为的影响，以服务于控释和堵水等应用优化。作者通过戊二醛在碱性条件下交联黄原胶与聚丙烯酰胺的均相混合物，制备了具有高吸水性能的水凝胶，并用FTIR表征交联网络结构。结果表明，交联主要通过戊二醛在聚丙烯酰胺氨基和黄原胶羟基之间形成桥联实现，随后研究进一步比较了该水凝胶在不同pH及盐溶液等介质中的溶胀行为。

articles.title: Toward Personalized Neuroscience: Precision Functional Mapping with Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Imaging
articles.title_zh: 迈向个性化神经科学：基于近红外光谱成像的精准功能图谱绘制
articles.abstract: Personalized functional imaging using fMRI is a paradigm shift in neuroscience but demands extensive data per participant. Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a cost-effective alternative, yet its ability to capture individual-specific functional architecture with adequate precision remains unproven. To assess fNIRS for personalized mapping, we charted functional organization in nine individuals using task-based and resting-state fNIRS alongside fMRI. Each participant contributed 11.5 hours of imaging data, including 4 hours of resting-state and 4.2 hours of task-based (motor, working memory, language) fNIRS data, and 3.3 hours of matched fMRI for cross-validation. Results show fNIRS reliably identifies individual-specific resting-state networks, requiring only 20 minutes of data for stable characterization. Additionally, fNIRS captures subject-specfic activation patterns in sensorimotor and higher-order domains, including atypical right-lateralized language dominance. These personalized fNIRS profiles align strongly with fMRI, offering comparable reliability at far lower cost. fNIRS proves a reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient tool for personalized brain mapping.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估功能近红外光谱成像能否以较低成本实现个体化脑功能图谱绘制，并与功能磁共振成像进行交叉验证。九名受试者分别接受静息态和任务态fNIRS及匹配fMRI采集，每人累计提供较长时长的多模态成像数据。结果显示，fNIRS能够可靠识别个体特异性静息态网络，仅约20分钟数据即可获得稳定表征，并能捕捉感觉运动及高级认知领域的个体化激活模式，包括非典型右侧化语言优势；这些结果与fMRI具有较强一致性。

articles.title: Developmental Risk Surfaces Linking Adolescent Distress and Disinhibition to Adult Violence-Related Outcomes: A National Longitudinal Response-Surface Study
articles.title_zh: 连接青少年痛苦与去抑制行为至成年暴力相关结局的发展风险曲面：一项全国纵向响应曲面研究
articles.abstract: Abstract Objective: Adolescent depressive distress is often treated as a risk marker for violence, but it may instead index victimisation vulnerability or reflect behavioural disinhibition. We tested competing accounts by modelling the surface linking adolescent negative affect and disinhibition to violence outcomes. Method: Data came from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health. Predictors and Wave IV outcomes were analysed in 5,035 participants, including 221 violent criminal-justice events. Negative affective burden was assessed with the CES-D; disinhibition used nonviolent delinquency and rule-breaking items excluding fighting, injury, and weapon use. The primary outcome was violent arrest or conviction by Wave IV; self-reported violence and victimisation were secondary outcomes. Analyses used logistic response-surface models, additive modelling, machine-learning benchmarks, bootstrap contrasts, and 14 sensitivity checks. Results:Behavioural disinhibition predicted violent criminal-justice involvement (OR = 1.64, 95% CI [1.38, 1.96]), whereas negative affective burden did not (OR = 1.13, 95% CI [0.93, 1.36]). The N × D interaction was negligible (OR = 0.99, p = .89), and curvature terms did not improve fit. Risk increased along the disinhibition axis; high–high risk exceeded low–low risk but not reliably high-D-only risk. Additive and machine-learning models recovered no hidden nonlinear amplification surface. Results replicated across sensitivity analyses. Negative affective burden predicted violent victimisation (OR = 1.21, 95% CI [1.09, 1.35]). Conclusions: Adult violent justice involvement was more consistent with behavioural-disinhibition continuity than depressive distress–disinhibition amplification. Adolescent depressive distress should not be treated as a generalised perpetration-risk marker; its relevance may be more visible in victimisation vulnerability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用美国青少年至成年健康纵向研究数据，检验青少年负性情绪负担和行为去抑制与成年暴力相关结局之间的关系。作者采用逻辑响应曲面模型、加性模型、机器学习基准、bootstrap对比及多项敏感性分析，主要关注成年期暴力逮捕或定罪，并将自报暴力与受害经历作为次要结局。结果表明，行为去抑制能预测暴力刑事司法卷入，而负性情绪负担本身并未显示明确预测作用，两者交互效应也很小。

articles.title: A controlled human–macaque basal ganglia transfer benchmark from HMBA expression
articles.title_zh: 基于HMBA表达数据的受控人类—猕猴基底节迁移基准
articles.abstract: Cross-species brain atlases are usually compared by alignment, clustering, or shared cell-type taxonomies, which show that structure is shared without testing whether an anatomical distinction learned in one species can be recovered in another. A predictive transfer test is stricter, but apparent transfer is easy to manufacture—through reused discovery markers, donor artifacts, coarse expression magnitude, leaked target labels, or simply reporting the easiest contrast after a broad scan. We turn the ABC/HMBA aligned basal-ganglia dataset into a controlled human–macaque transfer benchmark for anatomical region-of-interest (ROI) identity. The benchmark first tests source-frozen ridge readouts trained on source-species expression and evaluated zero-shot in the target species after excluding the marker genes used for candidate discovery. Three directed caudate–subthalamic transfers survive the full baseline control battery: human caudate head versus subthalamic nucleus to macaque, human caudate tail versus subthalamic nucleus to macaque, and macaque caudate tail versus subthalamic nucleus to human. Baseline full-expression validation AUCs range from 0.834 to 0.885, while selected-gene total-expression controls are moderately predictive (AUC 0.627–0.663), giving a conservative full-pattern delta of 0.172–0.258 AUC. We then use those directions as a stress test for a learned-expression benchmark: a donor/ROI-balanced 2048-gene autoencoder with ROI-contrastive training and within-ROI species-adversarial regularization preserves all three promoted transfers in a 256-dimensional embedding. Embedding AUCs are 0.844–0.915, with nominal differences from the full-expression baseline of +0.010 to +0.030 AUC, 10/10 seed recurrence for all promoted directions, source-donor-heldout controls for 25/25 folds, and target ROI-label shuffles with maximum shuffled AUCs of 0.505–0.512. Because the encoder was trained with ROI-supervised objectives on pooled HMBA rows rather than with the target species or target donors held out, this representation result should be read as a controlled benchmark stress test rather than as independent proof of out-of-sample representation transfer. These results support a narrow representation benchmark for conserved caudate–subthalamic molecular anatomy, not a general cross-species foundation model and not broad transfer across all basal-ganglia nuclei.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一个受控的人类—猕猴基底节跨物种迁移基准，用于检验在一个物种中学习到的解剖区域身份能否在另一物种中零样本恢复。为避免由重复使用发现标记、供体伪差、表达量粗粒度差异、目标标签泄漏或选择性报告造成的虚假迁移，作者排除了候选发现所用标记基因，并设置完整基线控制。结果显示，三组尾状核—丘脑底核方向性迁移在控制检验后仍成立，表明部分解剖ROI表达特征具有可预测的跨物种保真性。

articles.title: Integrated THM–SSI Modeling Frameworks for Induced Seismicity Risk in Enhanced Geothermal Systems: A Critical Review
articles.title_zh: 增强型地热系统诱发地震风险的THM–SSI一体化建模框架：批判性综述
articles.abstract: Hydraulic stimulation of Enhanced Geothermal Systems (EGS) can trigger induced seismicity, which poses risks to both continued operation and nearby infrastructure. Although coupled thermo-hydro-mechanical (THM) reservoir models have improved considerably over the past decade, a gap remains between subsurface geomechanical simulations and dynamic structural response assessment at the surface. This review systematically evaluates peer-reviewed literature (2005–2025) across three interconnected areas: THM reservoir modeling with rate-and-state friction; fault reactivation and seismic wave propagation through heterogeneous geological media; and soil-structure interaction (SSI) for induced seismicity impact assessment. Computational platforms—including TOUGH2-FLAC3D, COMSOL Multiphysics, OpenGeoSys, MOOSE/FALCON, ANSYS, and Abaqus—are compared with respect to coupling fidelity, scalability, and fracture representation. Several recent studies indicate that thermally induced stress perturbations may, under certain geological conditions, govern fault reactivation risk over long operational periods. No currently available platform natively connects THM-derived source parameters to dynamic SSI boundary conditions. The review proposes a semi-coupled Digital Twin architecture—combining real-time reservoir monitoring, physics-informed surrogate models, and probabilistic SSI solvers—as a potential pathway toward integrated risk management. Five priority research gaps are identified: absence of multi-scale THM-SSI numerical workflows; limited real-time bidirectional coupling; sparse high-temperature cyclic fatigue data; field-scale DFN computational constraints; and insufficient Digital Twin validation against operational monitoring datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述评估增强型地热系统水力刺激诱发地震的建模与风险评估研究，重点关注地下热—水—力耦合模拟与地表结构动力响应之间的衔接缺口。文章系统梳理2005—2025年有关含速率—状态摩擦的THM储层建模、断层再活化与非均质介质中地震波传播、以及土—结构相互作用的文献。作者比较了TOUGH2-FLAC3D、COMSOL、OpenGeoSys、MOOSE/FALCON、ANSYS和Abaqus等平台在耦合保真度、可扩展性和裂缝表征方面的能力，并指出当前平台尚不能原生地将THM来源参数与动态SSI评估无缝连接。

articles.title: Majorana modes withstand disorder in atomic chains, boosting fault-tolerant quantum computing
articles.title_zh: 马约拉纳模在原子链中抵抗无序，有望提升容错量子计算
articles.abstract: Quantum computers—systems that process information and perform computations by leveraging the principles of quantum mechanics—could solve some tasks faster and more effectively than classical computers. While some studies have demonstrated the advantages of these computers for specific tasks, ensuring their reliable operation in real-world settings has proved challenging.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道围绕原子链中马约拉纳模对无序的鲁棒性展开，强调其对构建更可靠量子计算硬件的潜在意义。量子计算有望在特定任务中超越经典计算，但在真实环境中保持稳定运行仍具挑战。相关研究若能证明马约拉纳模在缺陷或无序条件下仍能存在，将有助于推进拓扑量子计算和容错量子信息处理。

articles.title: Physicists observe synchronized quantum dance of excitons and phonons
articles.title_zh: 物理学家观测到激子与声子的同步量子舞蹈
articles.abstract: An international team of researchers has reported a major advance in understanding quantum dynamics in semiconductor materials. They directly observed how excitons and phonons evolve together in perovskite nanocrystals, revealing a fully coherent quantum dance between light-induced electronic excitations and crystal lattice vibrations. They published their findings in Nature Communications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了研究人员在半导体材料量子动力学方面的进展，即直接观测到钙钛矿纳米晶中激子与声子的协同演化。研究揭示了光诱导电子激发与晶格振动之间完全相干的量子耦合过程。该发现有助于理解半导体纳米材料中光—物质相互作用和能量弛豫机制。

articles.title: Single-particle tunneling spectrum with a robust superconducting gap in La2PrNi2O7 thin films at ambient pressure
articles.title_zh: 常压下La2PrNi2O7薄膜中具有稳健超导能隙的单粒子隧穿谱
articles.abstract: Science Advances, Volume 12, Issue 24, June 2026.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕La2PrNi2O7薄膜在常压条件下的单粒子隧穿谱展开，重点关注其中是否存在稳健的超导能隙特征。由于提供的摘要仅包含期刊卷期信息，具体样品制备、测量方法和物理结论需查阅原文。该研究可能与镍酸盐薄膜超导性质及其电子能谱表征有关。
authors: Shengtai Fan, Mengjun Ou, Marius Scholten, Qing Li, Zhiyuan Shang, Yi Wang, Jiasen Xu, Huan Yang, Ilya M. Eremin, Hai-Hu Wen
articles.journal: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents

articles.title: Exploring the third dimension in quantum confinement of surface electrons
articles.title_zh: 探索表面电子量子限域中的第三维度
articles.abstract: Science Advances, Volume 12, Issue 24, June 2026.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作关注表面电子量子限域的三维特征，旨在超越传统二维表面态限域视角来理解电子结构调控。由于提供的摘要仅为期刊卷期信息，具体实验体系、测量手段和主要发现需查阅原文。该研究可能涉及表面科学、低维电子态以及量子限域效应的空间维度扩展。
authors: Lu Lyu, Tobias Eul, Wei Yao, Jin Xiao, Mostafa Ashoush, Zakaria M. Abd El-Fattah, Ignacio Piquero-Zulaica, Johannes V. Barth, Martin Aeschlimann, Benjamin Stadtmüller
articles.journal: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents

articles.title: Quantum-geometric origin of superfluid weight in quasicrystals with critical states
articles.title_zh: 具有临界态的准晶中超流权重的量子几何起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A distinctive feature of many quasiperiodic systems is the presence of critical states that are neither extended nor exponentially localized. We investigate the geometric effect on the superfluid weight in quasiperiodic systems with critical states at zero temperature. We employ both real-space and momentum-space approaches to superfluid weight in quasicrystals, which allows us to separate the conventional and quantum geometric contributions. We find that the superfluid weight is dominated by the geometric contribution in quasiperiodic systems with critical states. This finding reveals a fundamental interplay between superconductivity and critical states in quasicrystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 准周期体系常具有既非扩展态也非指数局域态的临界态。本文结合实空间与动量空间方法研究零温下准晶中的超流权重，并将常规贡献与量子几何贡献分离。结果表明，在含临界态的准周期体系中，超流权重主要由几何贡献主导，揭示了准晶中超导性与临界态之间的基本关联。
authors: Kazuma Saito, Ryo Okugawa, Yusuke Kato, Takami Tohyama

articles.title: Exactly solvable non-planar Z₂ dimer liquids on checkerboard and ruby lattices
articles.title_zh: 棋盘格与红宝石晶格上的精确可解非平面 Z₂ 二聚体液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We generalize an influential framework for exactly solvable quantum dimer models with dual Ising gauge theory descriptions realizing the Z₂ topological phase from trivalent to tetravalent parent lattices. The resulting quantum dimer models live on crossed-medial lattices and possess the remarkable feature of having crossed plaquettes, leading to transition graphs with generically intersecting loops. This non-planar structure runs counter to established templates for analytically tractable dimer liquids. As the simplest realization of the construction, we introduce an exactly solvable quantum dimer model on the checkerboard lattice that allows an exact mapping to the toric code, thus providing a particularly direct connection between the latter and Anderson's short range resonating valence bond paradigm. We further show that a corresponding crossed ruby lattice construction, dual to an Ising gauge theory on the kagome lattice, naturally falls within the same framework. More generally, the construction gives rise to a broad class of exactly solvable crossed-medial quantum dimer models and admits natural iteration, generating cascades of solvable Z₂ topological dimer liquids beyond the standard planar setting. We furthermore extend Kasteleyn methods to the relevant non-planar graphs, enabling controlled wave-function deformations away from the commuting-projector points while retaining efficient evaluation of correlation functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将一类具有对偶 Ising 规范理论描述、可实现 Z₂ 拓扑相的精确可解量子二聚体模型，从三价母晶格推广到四价母晶格。所得模型定义在交叉中介晶格上，具有交叉 plaquette，使跃迁图中通常出现相交环路，从而形成不同于传统可解析二聚体液体的非平面结构。作者构造了棋盘格晶格上的精确可解模型并将其精确映射到 toric code，同时指出交叉红宝石晶格构造也自然纳入该框架。
authors: Julia Wildeboer, Zohar Nussinov, Thomas Iadecola, Alexander Seidel

articles.title: Jittery Quantum Boomerang Effect
articles.title_zh: 抖动的量子回旋镖效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10067v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the dynamics of a spin-polarized wave packet in a disordered Rashba two-dimensional electron gas and identify a jittery quantum boomerang effect in which longitudinal and transverse motion return to the origin through fundamentally distinct mechanisms. Starting from an initial state with finite momentum along x and spin polarized along z, we calculate the time evolution by combining a Chebyshev expansion of the time-evolution operator with a disorder ensemble average. In the weak-scattering regime, equations of motion derived from the quantum kinetic equation reproduce the numerical trends and show that impurity scattering acts as a viscous damping mechanism that suppresses the transient Zitterbewegung and drives the transverse displacement back to y=0 at long times. In contrast, the longitudinal dynamics show a Drude-like saturation at weak disorder. These results are consistent with the vanishing intrinsic spin Hall conductivity in the disordered Rashba model and with experimental observations of a transient intrinsic spin Hall effect in the time-domain. As disorder increases, the longitudinal dynamics evolve to a partial return toward the origin, which signals a transition from weak antilocalization to Anderson localization in 2D.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究无序 Rashba 二维电子气中自旋极化波包的动力学，发现一种“抖动”的量子回旋镖效应：纵向与横向位移通过不同机制回到原点。作者以沿 x 方向具有有限动量、沿 z 方向自旋极化的初态为出发点，结合 Chebyshev 时间演化与无序平均进行计算。弱散射下，量子动力学方程表明杂质散射类似黏性阻尼，可抑制瞬态 Zitterbewegung 并使横向位移长期回到零，而纵向运动呈 Drude 型饱和；更强无序下纵向动力学趋向部分回返。

articles.title: Pressure-Driven Structural Phase Competition and Functional Response in Layered LiInP2S6
articles.title_zh: 层状 LiInP2S6 中压力驱动的结构相竞争与功能响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10178v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how hydrostatic pressure modifies interlayer interactions and competing ionic configurations is essential for controlling the emergent functional properties of layered quantum materials. Here, using first-principles density-functional theory calculations, we investigate the pressure-dependent structural, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties of three competing LiInP2S6 polymorphs: the monoclinic C2/c phase and the trigonal P-31c phase in both in-layer and in-gap configurations. Our results reveal a pressure-induced structural phase transition from the monoclinic ground-state C2/c phase to a trigonal P-31c in-layer phase at ~0.38 GPa, driven by enhanced interlayer coupling and anisotropic lattice compression. In contrast, the trigonal P-31c in-gap phase remains energetically unfavorable due to its stronger interlayer ionic interactions and reduced compressibility. All phases remain mechanically stable under compression (0-26 GPa) and exhibit enhanced mechanical rigidity, elastic wave velocities, and Debye temperatures with increasing pressure. Remarkably, the electronic and optical properties within each phase remain highly robust under pressure, with only moderate changes in the band gap and optical absorption edge (UV-Visible range) under pressure; however, substantial modifications emerge across the pressure-induced structural phase transition. These findings establish LiInP2S6 as a pressure sensitive ionic-vdW material in which subtle changes in interlayer interactions govern structural stability and functional properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用第一性原理密度泛函理论研究静水压力对层状 LiInP2S6 三种竞争多晶型的结构、力学、电子与光学性质的影响。结果显示，约 0.38 GPa 下基态单斜 C2/c 相会转变为三方 P-31c 层内构型，该转变由增强的层间耦合与各向异性晶格压缩驱动。相比之下，P-31c 层间构型因更强层间离子相互作用和较低可压缩性而能量上不利；所有相在 0–26 GPa 压缩范围内保持力学稳定，并随压力增大表现出更高刚性、弹性波速和 Debye 温度。
authors: Xiaochi Xie, Pegah Mohammadi, Sobhit Singh

articles.title: Higher-winding phases in one-dimensional non-Hermitian topological superconductors
articles.title_zh: 一维非厄米拓扑超导体中的高绕数相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Hermitian topological superconductors provide a setting in which point-gap topology, non-Hermitian skin effects, and Majorana zero modes are strongly intertwined. In this work, we adopt a coefficient-based approach for computing winding numbers and deriving analytical expressions for phase boundaries in one-dimensional non-Hermitian topological superconductors characterized by point-gap topology with Z invariants. We apply this approach to two non-Hermitian topological superconducting lattice models, with and without sublattice degrees of freedom, including longer-range hoppings, thereby accessing a much broader parameter space. These extensions generate higher-order polynomials and support phases with higher winding numbers, reflecting the underlying Z topology. We further clarify how a weak perturbation suppresses the non-Hermitian skin effect while preserving the sublattice-symmetry-protected invariant associated with Majorana zero modes. The predicted winding numbers are verified by open-boundary spectra, where one or multiple pairs of zero-energy boundary modes appear consistently with the bulk invariant. We also examine the stability of these modes against onsite disorder through the inverse participation ratio. Our results provide a systematic and efficient route to constructing topological phase diagrams for higher-winding non-Hermitian topological superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出基于多项式系数的方法，用于计算一维非厄米拓扑超导体的绕数并解析推导相边界，这类体系由点隙拓扑和整数不变量表征。作者将该方法应用于含或不含子晶格自由度、并包含长程跃迁的两类非厄米拓扑超导晶格模型，从而探索更广参数空间。扩展模型支持更高绕数相，并表明弱扰动可抑制非厄米趋肤效应，同时保留受子晶格对称性保护、与 Majorana 零模相关的不变量；开边界谱中的零能边界模与体不变量相一致。
authors: Yung-Yeh Chang, Xiang-Yu Li, Ken Shiozaki, Chen-Hsuan Hsu

articles.title: Superheating field of clean superconductors near the type-I--type-II boundary: the low-temperature Meissner stability limit of niobium
articles.title_zh: 接近 I 型—II 型边界的洁净超导体过热场：铌的低温 Meissner 稳定性极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We calculate the low-temperature superheating field Bₘ̊ ₛₕ of clean superconductors near the boundary between type-I and type-II superconductivity, with particular emphasis on Nb. The calculation is based on the self-consistent nonlinear nonlocal Eilenberger theory and the linear stability analysis of the Meissner state. For a Nb-like material with κₘ̊ GL=0.7, we obtain Bₘ̊ ₛₕsimeq 290,m̊ mT at T/T_c=0.2, using Bc₀simeq 200,m̊ mT. This value is substantially higher than the value obtained by naively extrapolating the Ginzburg--Landau result near T_c to Tłl T_c. For a TESLA-shaped Nb accelerator cavity, it corresponds to an intrinsic Meissner-stability limit of about 67,m̊ MV/m.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文计算接近 I 型与 II 型超导分界的洁净超导体在低温下的过热场，重点关注铌。计算基于自洽非线性非局域 Eilenberger 理论以及 Meissner 态线性稳定性分析。对于类铌材料 κGL=0.7，在 T/Tc=0.2 且 Bc0 约为 200 mT 时得到过热场约 290 mT，显著高于将临近 Tc 的 Ginzburg–Landau 结果简单外推到低温所得值；对应 TESLA 形铌加速腔的内禀稳定性极限约为 67 MV/m。

articles.title: The Two Dimensional Dynamical Bulk Boundary Correspondence: Beyond Two Band Models
articles.title_zh: 二维动力学体—边对应：超越两能带模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A dynamical equivalent of the bulk-boundary correspondence has been suggested to occur in one and two dimensional topological models following sudden quenches. Depending on the topological invariant of the time evolving and initial phases involved large boundary contributions to a dynamical free energy occur. Moreover they occur periodically between the critical times at which this dynamical free energy becomes non-analytic, emphi.e.~at dynamical quantum phase transitions. At these critical times the eigenvalue spectrum of the Loschmidt matrix which underlies the dynamical free energy closes its gap. The boundary contributions are understood to be due to zero-modes or in-gap bands of this matrix, forming a close analogy with equilibrium topological models and their edge modes. The exact cause of this phenomena and its generality remain unknown. In this article we test the dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence for a complicated two dimensional topological superconductor with a rich phase diagram, allowing quenches between many different Chern numbers. We show that there is no straightforward correspondence between the equilibrium phases quenched between and the dynamical bulk boundary correspondence. Furthermore the correspondence can depend on the orientation of the edges, suggesting a possible weak topological variant.
articles.abstract_zh: 已有研究提出，在一维和二维拓扑模型经突然淬火后，可能出现动力学形式的体—边对应，并在动力学自由能中表现为大的边界贡献。本文在一个具有丰富相图的二维拓扑超导体中检验这一观点，允许在不同 Chern 数相之间淬火。结果表明，平衡相的拓扑不变量与动力学边界贡献之间并不存在简单直接的对应关系，从而提示该动力学体—边对应的适用范围和机制比两能带模型更复杂。

articles.title: Nonequilibrium Green Functions Simulations for Large Correlated Systems
articles.title_zh: 大规模关联体系的非平衡格林函数模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Correlated real-time dynamics in large, spatially inhomogeneous quantum systems remain difficult to access with nonequilibrium many-body methods. Two-time nonequilibrium Green functions (NEGF) retain dynamical correlations but their computational runtime grows cubically with the number of time steps Nₜ. This scaling bottleneck could recently be overcome by introducing the G1--G2 scheme that is linear in Nₜ, but requires propagation of a two-particle correlation function and may suffer from numerical instabilities. This has restricted simulations to small systems with N_b sim 10² basis states. Here we introduce a quantum-fluctuation formulation of nonequilibrium Green functions, denoted δNEGF, that represents dynamical two-particle correlations through fluctuations of field-operator products, δ hat G. This guarantees stable dynamics by preserving the positivity of the reduced density matrices, avoids the explicit storage of the two-particle Green function, and reduces the propagation to a finite ensemble of Hartree-Fock-like trajectories. Combined with a stochastic low-rank decomposition of the correlation functions, the method retains time-linear scaling while extending dynamical GW and particle-particle and particle-hole T-matrix simulations to basis sizes of order N_bsim 10⁴. We benchmark δNEGF against exact and HF-GKBA results for lattice systems, finding stable correlated dynamics also at strong coupling. We further demonstrate large-scale simulations of diffusion in two-dimensional Hubbard lattices and ultrafast relaxation in graphene nanoribbon heterostructures with long-range Coulomb interactions. These results establish δNEGF as a scalable route to dynamical self-energy simulations of large, spatially inhomogeneous correlated quantum systems beyond the reach of existing NEGF implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 大尺度空间非均匀量子体系的关联实时动力学对非平衡多体方法仍具挑战。本文提出一种量子涨落形式的非平衡格林函数方法 δNEGF，用场算符乘积的涨落表示动力学双粒子关联，从而避免显式存储双粒子格林函数并提高数值稳定性。该方法保持约化密度矩阵正定性，并将传播化为有限集合的 Hartree–Fock 型轨道；结合随机低秩分解后，可面向更大基组体系并缓解传统两时 NEGF 的时间步三次标度瓶颈。
authors: Erik Schroedter, Michael Bonitz, Jan-Philip Joost

articles.title: Interplay between Aharonov-Bohm and Altshuler-Aronov-Spivak oscillations in phase-pure GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires of different lengths
articles.title_zh: 不同长度相纯 GaAs/InAs 核壳纳米线中 Aharonov–Bohm 与 Altshuler–Aronov–Spivak 振荡的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires, comprising a tubular conducting shell, interference phenomena observed under an axial field and originating from closed-loop states encircling the insulating core, provide an ideal platform for superconducting quantum devices that utilize effects such as Aharonov--Bohm or Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak-type conductance oscillations. Both effects are different in nature with respect to phase rigidity because of interference of non-time-reversed or time-reversed paths, respectively. Since their occurrence is largely governed by averaging effects, which depend on sample dimensions and the transport regime, we present a systematic study of flux-periodic oscillations of phase-pure zinc-blende GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires as a function of gate voltage for samples with different contact separation lengths. Our analysis shows that with increasing contact separation length, averaging effects result in gradual reduction of h/e-periodic Aharonov--Bohm-type oscillations, while the h/2e-periodic Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak oscillations and its h/4e-periodic higher harmonics are enhanced. The additional phase rigidity seen in the h/3e-periodic oscillations is attributed to phase rigidity propagating from the neighbouring lower harmonics. Our tight-binding transport simulations on nanowires of different lengths which contain only a few scattering centers confirm the experimental observations regarding the different harmonics and their phase rigidity. Together, our experimental and simulation findings indicate quasi-ballistic transport with persistent Aharonov--Bohm-, and phase-rigid Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak-type oscillations despite few scattering centers.
articles.abstract_zh: GaAs/InAs 核壳纳米线具有管状导电壳层，轴向磁场下闭合环绕态产生的干涉现象为研究 Aharonov–Bohm 与 Altshuler–Aronov–Spivak 型电导振荡提供了平台。本文系统研究相纯闪锌矿 GaAs/InAs 核壳纳米线在不同接触间距下随栅压变化的磁通周期振荡。分析表明，随着接触间距增大，平均效应逐渐削弱 h/e 周期的 Aharonov–Bohm 型振荡，同时增强 h/2e 周期的 Altshuler–Aronov–Spivak 振荡及其 h/4e 高次谐波。
authors: Farah Basarić, Kaiwen Wang, Tudor-Gabriel Dumitru, Andrei Manolescu, Francisco Alvarado Cesar, Ana M. Sanchez, Christoph Krause, Detlev Grützmacher, Alexander Pawlis, Thomas Schäpers

articles.title: Majorana fermions at self-generated interfaces
articles.title_zh: 自生成界面处的 Majorana 费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kitaev model describing a one-dimensional topological superconducting chain is known to support two Majorana fermions localized at the systems endpoints when the parameters are tuned to the topological phase. In this work, we investigate the possibility that Majorana fermions may also emerge away from the physical boundaries of the chain. To this purpose, we generalize the Kitaev model by incorporating a local coupling between the electronic density and a classical elastic (lattice) field. This electron-lattice interaction can induce phase separation between superconducting regions characterized by distinct topological invariants, thereby generating internal interfaces that host Majorana bound states. Under these conditions, a dilute gas of Majorana fermions can be realized in the bulk of the system.
articles.abstract_zh: Kitaev 一维拓扑超导链在拓扑相中可在端点支持两个局域 Majorana 费米子。本文通过在 Kitaev 模型中加入电子密度与经典弹性晶格场的局域耦合，研究 Majorana 费米子是否也能在链的物理边界之外出现。电子—晶格相互作用可诱导具有不同拓扑不变量的超导区域发生相分离，从而形成承载 Majorana 束缚态的内部界面；在适当条件下，体系体内可形成稀薄的 Majorana 费米子气体。
authors: Nikola Prodanov, Sergio Ciuchi, Sergio Caprara

articles.title: Fractional shot noise of an SU(N) Kondo system
articles.title_zh: SU(N) Kondo 体系的分数散粒噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider transport through a multi-level interacting quantum dot (N-QD) in Kondo regime. Using the Kotliar-Ruckentein slave boson approach (SBMFA) for N-level Anderson model we define effectively noninteracting quasiparticles of the SU(N) Kondo system (N=2,3,4,5,6). Kondo resonance transmission coefficients determine linear noise describing quasiparticle partitioning. To discuss nonlinear conductance, susceptibilities and shot noise in the strong coupling regime, we apply Fermi liquid theory with parameters expressed by susceptibilities of pseudofermions determined within SBMFA. Nonlinear shot noise is dominated by two-quasiparticle scattering. However, we demonstrate that for occupation regions distant from the electron-hole symmetry point, the role of three-body correlations must be revealed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究 Kondo 区域中多能级相互作用量子点的输运性质。作者采用 Kotliar–Ruckenstein 奴玻色子平均场方法处理 N 能级 Anderson 模型，定义 SU(N) Kondo 体系的有效非相互作用准粒子，并由 Kondo 共振透射系数描述线性噪声。对于强耦合区的非线性电导、磁化率与散粒噪声，文章结合费米液体理论分析，指出非线性散粒噪声主要由双准粒子散射主导，但在远离电子—空穴对称点的占据区域，三体关联的作用不可忽略。

articles.title: On pseudogap phase as precursor to a superconducting dome in high-Tc cuprates: Non-analytic T* as a function of doping
articles.title_zh: 作为高温铜氧化物超导穹顶前驱的赝能隙相：T* 随掺杂的非解析性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We generalize the condition under which a quantum material exhibiting a pseudogap phase is a precursor to a superconducting (SC) dome. The result reveals the non-analytic T* as a function of doping. A well-known example is the high-Tc cuprates. Essentially, the SC dome is generated under two conditions: (1) that the pseudogap T* is a decreasing function of doping, due to the decrease in size of extended pairing of doped holes with doping, and most importantly, (2) that the rate of configurational-ordering parameter is an increasing function of doping as a result of the decrease in extended length of the disordered pairs. These two conditions are provided by the new entanglement and confinement pairing mechanism of high-Tc cuprates. This is a theory that has recently been discussed in the literature by Buot et al. It hinges on a novel strong entanglement and confinement hole pairing (ECHP) mechanism that unravels the microscopic features of the entire phase diagram of both electron and hole-doped high-Tc cuprates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推广了量子材料中赝能隙相作为超导穹顶前驱的条件，并指出赝能隙温度 T* 随掺杂可能呈非解析行为，高温铜氧化物是典型例子。作者认为超导穹顶的形成需要两个条件：赝能隙温度随掺杂降低，以及构型有序参数的变化率随掺杂增大。文章将这些条件归因于近期提出的高温铜氧化物强纠缠与限域空穴配对机制，用以解释电子掺杂和空穴掺杂铜氧化物相图的微观特征。

articles.title: Quantum statistics in an extended collider coupled to a qubit
articles.title_zh: 耦合量子比特的扩展碰撞器中的量子统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11147v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mesoscopic colliders provide an effective platform for probing the mutual statistics of quantum particles. Recent experiments have successfully extracted the mutual statistics of fermions, and more exotic anyons using quantum point contacts (QPCs). Coupling a point-like collider, such as a quantum point contact, to a two-level impurity or qubit can induce statistical transmutation of fermions, causing them to display boson-like bunching tendencies. Here, we extend the analysis to an extended collider. We investigate the scattering of two incoming fermionic and bosonic wave packets in the presence of post-selection on the impurity state, and systematically analyze the possible benchmarks used to characterize bunching and infer the underlying mutual statistics. We show that only a specific benchmark faithfully captures the mutual statistics of the colliding particles, while alternative choices can produce spurious statistical signatures. Hence, the correct benchmark for probing the quantum statistics depends on the intricate details of the mesoscopic collider.
articles.abstract_zh: 介观碰撞器是探测量子粒子相互统计性质的有效平台，已有实验利用量子点接触提取了费米子及任意子的统计特征。本文将点状碰撞器耦合二能级杂质或量子比特导致的统计转变问题推广到扩展碰撞器，研究在对杂质态进行后选择时两入射费米子和玻色子波包的散射。作者系统比较了表征聚束和推断相互统计的不同基准，指出只有特定基准能忠实反映粒子的相互统计，其他选择可能产生虚假的统计信号。

articles.title: Precision measurements at the interface between unitary and non-unitary encoding
articles.title_zh: 酉编码与非酉编码界面处的精密测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10529v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate precision scaling at the interface between unitary and non-unitary encoding under generalized noise including single-particle and collective dephasing and decay. Using linear response theory and the error propagation formula, we derive analytic precision expressions for both the unitary parameter Ømega and the dissipation strength γ. For unitary encoding, when the observable commutes with a Hermitian noise operator, the optimal encoding time is independent of N, yielding the Heisenberg limit Δ Ømega propto 1 / N; otherwise the precision degrades to the standard quantum limit or ceases to improve with N. For non-unitary encoding, when [hatA, hatO] = 0, the precision is insensitive to intrinsic dynamics and encoding time, scaling as Δ γ propto sqrtγ / expval*hatL^dagger hatL. Notably, for collective decay, the Dicke state reaches the Heisenberg limit Δ γ propto 1 / N, demonstrating that entanglement can enhance non-unitary estimation. Our results provide a unified framework and practical guidance for designing quantum metrology protocols in noisy environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在包含单粒子和集体退相干、衰减等广义噪声下，酉编码与非酉编码交界处的精度标度。作者利用线性响应理论和误差传播公式，推导了酉参数和耗散强度的解析精度表达式。结果表明，在特定对易条件下酉编码可达到海森堡极限，而非酉编码中集体衰减情形下的Dicke态也可实现海森堡标度，说明纠缠能够增强非酉参数估计。

articles.title: Revealing the topology of quantum states via Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobabilities
articles.title_zh: 通过Kirkwood-Dirac准概率揭示量子态拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11002v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We discuss a theoretical approach to discriminate whether two states of a many-body quantum system belong or not to different topology classes. This approach is based on expressing a strange correlator - a recently established tool for quantum topology discrimination - between the states as a function of Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobabilities (KDQs). KDQs provide a first-principles representation of two-time quantum correlators. The link between strange correlators and KDQs allows to establish that strange correlators are weak values of an observable converting an initial trivial state into a topologically non-trivial one. We thus propose a quantum topology witness that is achievable measuring the prior and subsequent effects on a many-body system of a sudden quench transformation that realizes the transition between trivial and topological phases. The witness is evaluated on a probe quantum state whose main features are detailed within the paper. Finally, directly exploiting schemes that allows for the complete reconstruction of KDQs, we address an interferometric protocol for topology discrimination, along with a general discussion of the main lines and challenges towards its implementation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种理论方法，用于判别多体量子系统的两个态是否属于不同拓扑类别。该方法将用于拓扑判别的奇异关联函数表示为Kirkwood-Dirac准概率的函数，从而把奇异关联函数解释为将初始平庸态转换为非平庸拓扑态的可观测量弱值。作者进一步提出可通过突变淬火前后效应测量实现的量子拓扑见证，并讨论了基于准概率重构的干涉式拓扑判别方案。

articles.title: Two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy of disordered superconductors in the narrow-band and broad-band limits
articles.title_zh: 窄带与宽带极限下无序超导体的二维相干光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.03936v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically analyze two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy (2DCS) signals for disordered superconductors in two limits: One is the narrow-band limit with sinusoidal pulse waves, and the other is the broad-band limit with delta-function pulses. While the 2DCS signal in the narrow-band limit is related to the third-order nonlinear susceptibilities ḩi⁽³⁾(3Ømega; Ømega, Ømega, Ømega) (third harmonic generation) and ḩi⁽³⁾(Ømega; Ømega, Ømega, -Ømega) (ac Kerr effect), we find that in the broad-band limit the signal along the diagonal and horizontal lines in the two-dimensional frequency space is related to another nonlinear susceptibility ḩi⁽³⁾(Ømega; Ømega, 0, 0) (dc Kerr effect). We numerically evaluate those susceptibilities for a lattice model of superconductors based on the BCS mean-field theory and self-consistent Born approximation for impurities. The 2DCS signals in the narrow-band and broad-band limits show threshold and resonance behaviors at the superconducting-gap frequency, respectively, whose physical origin is discussed in light of quasiparticle and Higgs-mode excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上分析无序超导体在窄带正弦脉冲和宽带δ函数脉冲两种极限下的二维相干光谱信号。作者指出，窄带极限中的信号与三次谐波产生和交流Kerr效应对应的三阶非线性磁化率相关，而宽带极限中二维频率空间的对角线和水平线信号与直流Kerr效应相关。基于BCS平均场理论和杂质自洽Born近似的数值计算显示，两种极限下的信号分别在超导能隙频率处呈现阈值和共振行为，其物理来源与准粒子和Higgs模激发有关。

articles.title: Fast collisional sqrtSWAP gate for fermionic atoms in an optical superlattice
articles.title_zh: 光学超晶格中费米原子的快速碰撞sqrtSWAP门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.22569v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Collisional gates in optical superlattices have recently achieved record fidelities, but their operation times are typically limited by tunneling. Here we propose and analyze an alternative route to a fast sqrtSWAP gate for two fermionic atoms in an optical superlattice based on optimized, time-dependent control of the short and long lattice depths. The gate is implemented by transiently releasing the atoms into a quasi-harmonic confinement centered between the two sites. With an appropriately chosen contact interaction strength, a controlled collision accumulates the exchange phase required for sqrtSWAP and generates entanglement. We employ a continuum, time-dependent Schrödinger-equation simulation that goes beyond a two-site Fermi--Hubbard description and benchmark it against experimentally implemented tunneling-based protocols, reproducing the observed single-particle tunneling and spin-exchange dynamics. For experimentally accessible lattice depths, we find that the proposed gate operates in sim 21,μs, more than an order of magnitude faster than tunneling-based implementations, while achieving fidelities gtrsim 99%. We further analyze sensitivity to lattice-depth variations and show that a composite sequence improves robustness. Our results establish fast, collision-mediated entangling gates in superlattices as a promising building block for scalable neutral-atom quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并分析一种在光学超晶格中实现两个费米原子快速sqrtSWAP门的方案，通过优化短、长晶格深度的时间依赖控制来替代受隧穿限制的传统碰撞门。该方案将原子瞬时释放到位于两格点之间的准谐波束缚中，并利用适当接触相互作用积累实现sqrtSWAP所需的交换相位和纠缠。连续时变薛定谔方程模拟表明，在实验可达晶格深度下，该门可在约21微秒内运行，速度比隧穿方案快一个数量级以上，同时保真度可超过99%。
authors: Rafi Weill, Jonathan Nemirovsky, Yoav Sagi

articles.title: Complex dispersion lines in gapped bilayer graphene: Analytical expressions and shear-displacement effects on monolayer--bilayer--monolayer junction conductance with implications for dynamical AC--DC conversion
articles.title_zh: 有能隙双层石墨烯中的复色散线：解析表达式及剪切位移对单层—双层—单层结电导的影响与动态交流—直流转换启示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.20589v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Analytical treatments of tunneling in bilayer graphene have typically relied on minimal models including only the vertical interlayer hopping γ₁ and have been restricted to the weak interlayer bias regime 2ǎrepsilon łl γ₁. These simplifications limit the ability of analytical theories to describe lattice deformations and strong electric-field effects. In this work, we present an analytical theory of evanescent states in electrically gapped bilayer graphene that overcomes both limitations. Specifically, our approach explicitly incorporates the skew interlayer hoppings γ₃ and γ₄ and remains valid even when the interlayer bias 2ǎrepsilon is comparable to γ₁. Focusing on low-energy electronic states near the charge neutrality point, we analytically derive the complex longitudinal wave numbers, the gap width, and the sublattice pseudospin inside the electric-field-induced gap, and systematically analyze their dependence on the interlayer shear displacement ěcδ=(δₓ,δ_y). The analytical expressions quantitatively reproduce exact numerical calculations, demonstrating that skew interlayer hoppings, in particular γ₃, play an essential role. Taking the zigzag direction as the longitudinal (transport) x direction, the wave vector becomes complex along x while remaining real along the transverse y direction. For a monolayer--bilayer--monolayer junction with transport along this direction, we find that δ_y has a significantly stronger impact on the conductance than δₓ. This anisotropic response is quantitatively explained by the analytical expressions. Furthermore, we identify a shear-induced phase proportional to δ_y that appears universally in the analytical expressions for the gap width, the sublattice pseudospin, and the decay length.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了有电场诱导能隙的双层石墨烯中倏逝态的解析理论，突破以往仅含垂直层间跃迁且限于弱层间偏置的最小模型限制。该理论显式纳入斜向层间跃迁γ₃和γ₄，并适用于层间偏置与γ₁可比的强电场区域。作者在电中性点附近推导了复纵向波数、能隙宽度和子晶格赝自旋的解析式，并系统分析层间剪切位移的影响；结果与精确数值计算定量一致，强调了尤其是γ₃的重要作用。

articles.title: Quantum complexity and localization in random and time-periodic unitary circuits
articles.title_zh: 随机与时间周期酉电路中的量子复杂度和局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.03656v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the growth and saturation of complexity in Krylov basis in random quantum circuits. In Haar-random unitary evolution, we show that, for large system sizes, this notion of complexity grows linearly before saturating at a late-time value of d/2, where d is the Hilbert space dimension, at timescales sim d. Our numerical analysis encompasses two classes of random circuits: brick-wall random unitary circuits and Floquet random circuits. In brick-wall case, complexity in Krylov basis exhibits dynamics consistent with Haar-random unitary evolution, while the inclusion of measurements significantly slows its growth down. For Floquet random circuits, we show that localized phases lead to reduced late-time saturation values of the complexity enabling us to probe the transition between thermal and many-body localized phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究随机量子电路中Krylov基复杂度的增长与饱和行为。对于Haar随机酉演化，作者表明在大系统尺寸下复杂度先线性增长，并在约为Hilbert空间维数的时间尺度上饱和到d/2。数值分析涵盖砖墙型随机酉电路和Floquet随机电路；前者与Haar随机演化一致，而测量会显著减缓复杂度增长，后者中局域相会降低晚时饱和值，从而可用于探测热化相与多体局域相之间的转变。
authors: Himanshu Sahu, Aranya Bhattacharya, Pingal Pratyush Nath

articles.title: Perfect Particle Transmission through Duality Defects
articles.title_zh: 穿越对偶缺陷的完美粒子透射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.26780v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study wavepackets that propagate across (a) topological interfaces in quantum spin systems exhibiting non-invertible symmetries and (b) duality defects coupling dual theories. We demonstrate that the transmission is always perfect, and that a particle traversing the interface is converted into a nonlocal string-like excitation. We give a systematic way of constructing such a defect by identifying its Hilbert space with the virtual bond dimension of the matrix product operator representing defect lines. Our work both gives an operational meaning to topological interfaces, and provides a lattice analogue of recent results solving the monopole paradox in quantum field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究量子自旋系统中波包穿越具有非可逆对称性的拓扑界面，以及耦合对偶理论的对偶缺陷时的传播行为。作者证明透射总是完美的，并且粒子穿过界面后会转化为非局域的弦状激发。论文还给出一种系统构造此类缺陷的方法，将其Hilbert空间与表示缺陷线的矩阵乘积算符的虚键维数相联系，从而为拓扑界面提供了操作性含义。
authors: Atsushi Ueda, Vic Vander Linden, Laurens Lootens, Jutho Haegeman, Paul Fendley, Frank Verstraete

articles.title: Quantum solver for single-impurity Anderson models with particle-hole symmetry
articles.title_zh: 具有粒子—空穴对称性的单杂质Anderson模型量子求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10594v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum embedding methods, such as dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), provide a powerful framework for investigating strongly correlated materials. A central computational bottleneck in DMFT is in solving the Anderson impurity model (AIM), whose exact solution is classically intractable for large bath sizes. In this work, we develop and benchmark a quantum-classical hybrid solver tailored for DMFT applications, using the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) to prepare the ground state of the AIM with shallow quantum circuits. The solver uses a unified ansatz framework to prepare the particle and hole excitations of the ground-state from parameter-shifted circuits, enabling the reconstruction of the impurity Green's function through a continued-fraction expansion. We evaluate the performance of this approach across a few bath sizes and interaction strengths under noisy, shot-limited conditions. We compare three optimization routines (COBYLA, Adam, and L-BFGS-B) in terms of convergence and fidelity, assess the benefits of estimating a quantum-computed moment (QCM) correction to the variational energies, and benchmark the approach by comparing the reconstructed density of states (DOS) against that obtained using a classical pipeline. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of Green's function reconstruction on near-term devices and establish practical benchmarks for quantum impurity solvers embedded within self-consistent DMFT loops.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向动力学平均场理论等量子嵌入方法，开发并基准测试了一种用于求解Anderson杂质模型的量子—经典混合求解器。该方法使用变分量子本征求解器以浅量子线路制备基态，并通过统一的拟设框架和参数平移线路制备粒子与空穴激发，从而用连分式展开重构杂质Green函数。作者在不同浴大小、相互作用强度以及有噪声和有限采样条件下评估性能，并比较了COBYLA、Adam和L-BFGS-B等优化方法及量子计算矩修正的作用。
authors: Mariia Karabin, Tanvir Sohail, Dmytro Bykov, Eduardo Antonio Coello Pérez, Swarnava Ghosh, Murali Gopalakrishnan Meena, Seongmin Kim, Amir Shehata, In-Saeng Suh, Hanna Terletska, Markus Eisenbach

articles.title: Limits of Trap-assisted Photomultiplication Gain
articles.title_zh: 陷阱辅助光倍增增益的极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photodiodes based on trap-assisted current injection can exhibit internal photomultiplication with apparent quantum efficiencies far exceeding unity, raising the question of whether such gain fundamentally enhances detector sensitivity. We employ a minimal analytical framework based on a single gain-active trapped state coupling photogenerated carriers to contact injection. The gain is intrinsically self-limiting: the injection process that amplifies the current simultaneously accelerates relaxation of the gain-enabling state, producing an inherently nonlinear, operating-point-dependent response. The form of this nonlinearity is not universal -- once the trap level is generalized to an energetic distribution and recombination is allowed to be bimolecular, the same mechanism yields superlinear, linear, or strongly sublinear responses. A single chord gain is therefore not a meaningful device descriptor, and chord-gain comparisons across the literature conflate devices in different regimes. Treating trap occupancy and injection as coupled stochastic processes, we show that internal gain introduces a strictly non-negative fluctuation penalty from the dissipative dynamics that sustain the gain state. A local, small-signal detectivity exhibits a finite optimum yet cannot exceed the intrinsic thermodynamic limit of the underlying unity-gain photodiode. Gain is thus equivalent to driven stochastic amplification: it can suppress downstream readout noise, but cannot reduce the fundamental noise floor set by the primary photodetection process.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究基于陷阱辅助电流注入的光电二极管中内部光倍增是否能从根本上提升探测灵敏度。作者建立包含单个增益活性陷阱态的最小解析模型，指出增益具有内禀自限制性：放大电流的注入过程同时加速维持增益态的弛豫，导致响应依赖工作点且呈非线性。进一步考虑陷阱能级分布和双分子复合后，同一机制可产生超线性、线性或强亚线性响应，因此单一弦增益并非可靠器件描述；内部增益还会引入非负的涨落代价。

articles.title: Quantum study of ultracold atom-ion excitation exchange
articles.title_zh: 超冷原子—离子激发交换的量子研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum dynamics of ultracold collisions between rubidium atoms and excited metastable strontium ions is treated in the laboratory frame, enlightening the importance of the coupling between internal angular momenta of the particles and their mutual rotation. The study reveals a subtle competition between electronic excitation exchange and fine structure quenching, with no charge exchange, which is found to be very sensitive to the details of ion-atom interactions. The rate constant for electronic excitation exchange is found in agreement with the experimental results of Ben-Shlomi et al. (Phys. Rev. A 102, 031301(R) (2020)), while the rate for fine structure quenching is predicted to strongly depend on the initial polarization of the reactants.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在实验室参考系中研究铷原子与激发亚稳态锶离子之间超冷碰撞的量子动力学，强调粒子内部角动量与相对转动耦合的重要性。研究揭示了电子激发交换与精细结构淬灭之间的微妙竞争，且未发现电荷交换，这些过程对离子—原子相互作用细节十分敏感。计算得到的电子激发交换速率常数与已有实验结果一致，而精细结构淬灭速率预计强烈依赖反应物的初始极化。
authors: Tibor Jónás, Romain Vexiau, Nadia Bouloufa-Maafa, Eliane Luc-Koenig, Olivier Dulieu, Andrea Orbán

articles.title: Length-dependent SWIR upconversion spectral response of noncritically phase-matched KTP crystals
articles.title_zh: 非临界相位匹配KTP晶体短波红外上转换光谱响应的长度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Noncritically phase-matched KTP crystals are attractive for short-wave infrared upconversion detection because they support large-aperture bulk operation, avoid walk-off, and relax the angular-alignment requirement. Here, we characterize how the crystal length affects the external upconversion spectral response of NCPM KTP crystals. A calibrated Czerny--Turner monochromator is used to measure the normalized external responses of 0.5, 1.0, and 2.0 mm crystals, which are compared with theoretical quantum-efficiency spectra calculated from the phase-matching model. As the crystal length increases, the response evolves from a broad profile to a more pronounced double-peak profile. A representative pump-power measurement is also performed to evaluate the system-level external quantum efficiency. These results provide guidance for selecting the crystal length in SWIR upconversion detection systems using NCPM KTP crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 非临界相位匹配KTP晶体因支持大孔径体材料工作、避免走离并降低角度对准要求而适用于短波红外上转换探测。本文表征晶体长度对其外部上转换光谱响应的影响，使用校准的Czerny-Turner单色仪测量0.5、1.0和2.0毫米晶体的归一化外部响应，并与相位匹配模型计算的理论量子效率谱比较。结果显示晶体变长时响应由宽谱轮廓演化为更明显的双峰结构，并通过泵浦功率测量评估系统级外部量子效率，为相关探测系统的晶体长度选择提供依据。
authors: Xiao-Hua Wang, Chang-Hao Min, Yin-Hai Li, Zhi-Yuan Zhou, Bao-Sen Shi

articles.title: Data assimilation for subsurface flow using latent diffusion model parameterization: performance of ensemble-Kalman and Monte Carlo techniques
articles.title_zh: 利用潜在扩散模型参数化进行地下流动数据同化：集合卡尔曼与蒙特卡罗技术的性能比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data assimilation (DA) in subsurface flow entails calibrating model parameters to match observed data, typically at wells, while preserving geological realism. Latent diffusion models (LDMs) provide efficient mappings from high-dimensional geological model space to a low-dimensional latent variable, reducing the dimensionality of the inverse problem while maintaining plausibility in posterior geomodels. However, the high nonlinearity in the LDM mapping may degrade the performance of Kalman-gain-based ensemble updates. We present a systematic comparison of DA algorithms applied to large-scale 3D channelized geomodels with hierarchical geological uncertainty. We compare model-space and latent-space DA using the ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation (ESMDA), and demonstrate a key trade-off: model-space updates achieve significant uncertainty reduction but produce geologically unrealistic posterior models, while latent-space updates preserve realism but exhibit limited uncertainty reduction. Motivated by this, we explore rigorous Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) and Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) algorithms in the 3D-LDM latent space. To accommodate their high computational demands, we develop a fast surrogate flow model that approximates well-rate responses. MCMC and SMC are evaluated against ESMDA across three synthetic test cases, with DA performed in the LDM latent space. All models maintain geological realism due to the LDM parameterization. MCMC and SMC are consistent with one another and achieve lower data mismatch and more uncertainty reduction than latent-space ESMDA. Our overall results demonstrate that ensemble Kalman methods may provide overestimated posterior uncertainty with highly nonlinear parameterizations, while rigorous Monte Carlo sampling, enabled by fast surrogate models, can provide a more reliable alternative.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察地下流动数据同化中如何在匹配井点观测的同时保持地质模型真实性。作者将潜在扩散模型用于把高维地质模型映射到低维潜变量空间，并系统比较模型空间与潜空间中的 ESMDA、MCMC 和 SMC 等方法。结果显示，模型空间更新能更强地降低不确定性但易破坏地质合理性，而潜空间更新更能保持真实性但不确定性缩减有限。
authors: Guido Di Federico, Wenchao Teng, Louis J. Durlofsky

articles.title: Full-State and Reduced-Moment Encodings: A Representation-Level View of Equilibrium Quantum Many-Body Theory
articles.title_zh: 全态编码与约化矩编码：平衡量子多体理论的表征层级视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equilibrium quantum many-body methods differ not only in approximation, but in which information they represent explicitly. We formulate this distinction by fixing an equilibrium specification and viewing every representation as an encoder from admissible states to represented variables. The identity encoder gives a full-state representation, whereas a non-injective encoder gives a reduced representation whose value labels a fiber of compatible states. For a specified task, an exact decoder exists on a state class if and only if the task is constant on the encoder fibers within that class. Variational principles, reconstruction correspondences, functionals, kernels, and closures are different realizations of additional structure used to select, restrict, or approximate the task-relevant content of a fiber when the retained variable alone is insufficient. Static moments and imaginary-time correlation functions are unified as restrictions of a complete equilibrium readout functional to different probe families. Within the same principle, quantum embedding can be viewed as consistency or replacement between global and local descriptions through reduced interface encoders and their conjugate fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从“编码器”的角度重新表述平衡量子多体方法之间的差异，即不同方法显式保留哪些状态信息。全态表征对应恒等编码，约化表征则对应非单射编码，其值标记一族相容状态。作者指出，若某任务在编码纤维上保持常量，则可存在精确解码；变分原理、泛函、核、闭合关系和嵌入方法可被视为在信息不足时选择或近似任务相关内容的不同结构。

articles.title: Optomechanical system with tunable dissipative and dispersive couplings
articles.title_zh: 具有可调耗散耦合与色散耦合的光机械系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10318v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We demonstrate an optomechanical system with tunable dissipative and dispersive couplings using a Fabry-Perot cavity and a string mechanical resonator. By varying the diameter and material of the mechanical resonator, and the relative location between the mechanical resonator and the cavity, the relative strengths of dissipative and dispersive coupling could be tuned continuously from dissipation-dominated regime to dispersion-dominated regime. In our experiments, the dissipative-to-dispersive coupling ratios of 1.3 and 0.6 are achieved by using two different mechanical resonators, corresponding to a transition from dissipation-dominated to dispersion-dominated optomechanical system. Theoretically, the coupling ratio could be tuned from 25 to 0.02 by optimizing the mechanical resonator, spanning over three orders of magnitude. These two distinct coupling regimes are achieved with the same experimental platform. The capability to freely adjust the coupling ratio provides a versatile platform for exploring quantum effects of massive mechanical resonators and quantum-limited measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种基于 Fabry-Perot 腔和弦式机械谐振器的光机械系统，可连续调节耗散耦合与色散耦合的相对强度。通过改变机械谐振器的直径、材料及其相对腔的位置，系统可从耗散主导区过渡到色散主导区。实验中获得了 1.3 和 0.6 的耗散/色散耦合比，理论优化则表明该比值可跨越三个数量级，为研究大质量机械谐振器的量子效应和量子极限测量提供平台。
authors: Quansen Wang, Yuefan Wu, Doudou Wang, Genyuan Xu, Jiawei Liang, Qiang Zhang, Yongmin Li

articles.title: Equilibrating continuous-variable open quantum systems using stochastic classical trajectories in path-integral space
articles.title_zh: 利用路径积分空间中的随机经典轨线平衡连续变量开放量子系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10665v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Beyond the weak-coupling limit, open quantum systems equilibrate to a highly entangled thermal state. For continuous-variable systems, this state can be written explicitly as an imaginary-time phase-space path integral, in which the positions are directly entangled with the bath, and the momenta are correlated with the positions through a phase term. Here, we ask to what extent this state can be reached by propagating stochastic classical trajectories in path-integral phase space. Surprisingly, we find that the trajectories equilibrate to the exact quantum equilibrium state, recovering the purely imaginary momentum-position correlation in the phase term. The trajectories are generated using a recently derived Matsubara generalized Langevin equation, which produces the imaginary correlations by evolving the stochastic variables into the complex plane. This makes the dynamics numerically unstable, but we are nonetheless able to demonstrate the equilibration of a quartic oscillator coupled to a white-noise bath. These unexpected findings could lead to new approximate methodologies for simulating continuous-variable open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在弱耦合之外，连续变量开放量子系统如何达到与环境高度纠缠的热平衡态。作者考察是否可通过路径积分相空间中的随机经典轨线传播来获得该量子平衡态。结果表明，基于 Matsubara 广义朗之万方程的轨线可恢复精确量子平衡态中的虚数动量-位置关联，尽管变量进入复平面会带来数值不稳定。该发现可能为连续变量开放量子系统模拟提供新的近似方法。
authors: William H. D. Moore, Stuart C. Althorpe

articles.title: A Constrained Natural-Language Interface for Variational Multi-Physics Finite Element Simulations in FEniCS
articles.title_zh: 面向 FEniCS 中变分多物理场有限元模拟的受约束自然语言接口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10928v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models can reduce the manual effort required to set up finite element simulations, but they introduce reliability risks when generated solver code lies on the critical path. We present a constrained natural-language interface for multi-physics finite element analysis in which the LLM is limited to front-end tasks: parsing prompts into structured JSON, generating Gmsh code only for non-catalog geometries, and using retry feedback for those stages. It never writes FEniCS solver templates, derives weak forms, or writes the numerical solver core. A deterministic dispatcher maps the validated specification to five human-written FEniCS/UFL templates: linear elasticity, hyperelasticity, elastoplasticity, thermo-mechanical coupling, and phase-field fracture. We validate this deterministic template layer against analytical solutions and published 2D/3D benchmarks. Smooth cases reach sub-percent agreement on adequate meshes, while harder nonlinear cases reach the 2-5 percent range. We also evaluate the LLM-facing front end directly. In a 15-prompt parser benchmark, first-pass valid parses were obtained for 9 cases, and all remaining cases were repaired after retry, giving a final valid parse rate of 100.0 percent, 100.0 percent problem-class accuracy, and 97.1 percent field-extraction accuracy. In a 10-case custom-geometry benchmark routed through the real LLM-to-Gmsh path, first-pass and final success were both 90.0 percent, with one unrecovered invalid-geometry failure. These results show that the parser and constrained prompt/validation design are effective on these benchmarks. As an end-to-end demonstration, the system generates and analyzes a 3D elastoplastic L-bracket with a fillet and bolt hole from one natural-language prompt. The contribution is a measured architecture for natural-language-driven variational simulation, not open-ended autonomous code generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于多物理场有限元分析的受约束自然语言接口，以降低有限元建模的人工成本并减少大语言模型生成核心求解代码带来的风险。系统将大语言模型限制在提示解析为结构化 JSON、非目录几何的 Gmsh 代码生成以及相关重试反馈等前端任务，而核心 FEniCS/UFL 求解模板由人工编写并由确定性调度器调用。验证结果显示，该模板层在解析解和已发表二维/三维基准上具有较好一致性，前端解析也可通过重试机制提高有效输出率。

articles.title: The Fuel Optimizer: A Data-Driven Numerical Framework for Formulation of Aviation Turbine Fuel
articles.title_zh: Fuel Optimizer：用于航空涡轮燃料配方设计的数据驱动数值框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11099v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Fuel Optimizer is an inverse design framework for sustainable aviation fuels that starts from a user-defined merit function and identifies the optimal combination of chemical species or hydrocarbon families that optimize a combination of targets. As a case study, a database of fuel blends meeting selected property standards was simulated in a reactor model to obtain pollutant emissions at cruise conditions. A surrogate model was developed to reduce the computational cost of evaluating candidate blends, taking fuel composition as input and predicting emissions as output. A genetic algorithm was used to optimize fuel formulation according to two merit functions designed to break the nitrogen oxides - CO trade-off, and minimize pollutant emissions over the landing-and-take-off cycle. Constraints included selected property standards (including seal swelling) and composition limits. Fuel candidates from the framework outperformed the training database across all merit functions, and the optimal candidates were validated through reactor simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 Fuel Optimizer，一种面向可持续航空燃料的逆向设计框架，可根据用户定义的评价函数寻找最优化学组分或烃类族组合。作者以满足燃料性质标准的混合物数据库为案例，通过反应器模型获得巡航条件下污染物排放，并建立以燃料组成预测排放的代理模型以降低计算成本。随后使用遗传算法在性质约束、组成限制和排放目标下优化燃料配方，所得候选燃料在评价函数上优于训练数据库，并通过反应器模拟验证。
authors: Ana Larrañaga, Steven L. Brunton, Jacobo Porteiro, Dario Lopez-Pintor

articles.title: Plasmonic structure integrated superconducting nanowire single-photon detector with BSCCO stripes
articles.title_zh: 集成等离激元结构的 BSCCO 条带超导纳米线单光子探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.09630v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) were integrated with plasmonic nanostructures to enhance the absorption efficiency of superconducting BSCCO stripes. A numerical investigation of optimized nanocavity array (NCAI) and nanocavity-trench-array (NCTAI) SNSPDs has revealed that more than one order of magnitude larger absorptance can be achieved at perpendicular incidence, when compared to the corresponding meandered BSCCO pattern in a resonant optical cavity. The SNSPDs were considerably improved either via first and third quarter cavity resonances, as evidenced by the near-field maps and validated by the standard retrieval method. Although, NCAI-SNSPD exhibits slightly larger absorptance, NCTAI-SNSPD remains competitive due to its larger period and significantly smaller filling factor, thereby allowing for quicker electric response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过将超导纳米线单光子探测器与等离激元纳米结构集成，提高 BSCCO 超导条带的吸收效率。数值结果显示，优化的纳米腔阵列和纳米腔-沟槽阵列结构在垂直入射下的吸收率相比谐振光腔中的相应曲折 BSCCO 图案可提高一个数量级以上。近场分布和标准反演方法表明，第一和第三四分之一腔共振均可显著增强探测器性能；其中纳米腔-沟槽阵列虽吸收略低，但因周期更大和填充因子更小而有利于更快电响应。
authors: András Szenes, László Pothorcki, Balázs Bánhelyi, Mária Csete

articles.title: Schrödinger's Wave Mechanics: Remarkable Dates and a Place One Hundred Years Ago
articles.title_zh: 薛定谔波动力学：一百年前的重要日期与地点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.05337v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exactly a century ago, wave quantum mechanics was born in Arosa, Switzerland. Erwin Schrödinger was vacationing in this classic Swiss Alps town at Christmas 1925 when he made his breakthrough discovery of the wave equation i̧teSchrQMI.
articles.abstract_zh: 该短文围绕波动力学诞生一百周年展开，回顾埃尔温·薛定谔在 1925 年圣诞期间于瑞士阿罗萨取得波方程突破的历史背景。摘要信息较简略，主要表明文章具有科学史和纪念性质，具体论述与细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: From Confident Closing to Silent Failure: Characterizing False Success in LLM Agents
articles.title_zh: 从自信收尾到静默失败：刻画大语言模型智能体中的虚假成功
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents can fail silently by asserting task completion when the environment state shows otherwise. We study this failure mode, false success, across two agent benchmarks: 9,876 tau2-bench trajectories from 8 model families and 1,879 AppWorld trajectories from 4 model families with text-independent ground truth. False success is common but varies by setting: 45--48% of failures in single-control tau2-bench domains, 3% in dual-control telecom, and 75.8% among AppWorld self-assessing coding-agent trajectories with explicit status claims. LLM judges fail reliably: no configuration across 5 judges, 5 prompt strategies, and full task specifications exceeds AUROC 0.65 on tau2-bench, and the same judges reach only 0.54 AUROC on AppWorld API-call traces. Judges rely on surface completion proxies -- confident closing language in tau2-bench and coarse action-sequence volume in AppWorld -- rather than verified state changes. Lightweight TF-IDF detectors achieve task-disjoint AUROC 0.83 on tau2-bench and 0.95 on AppWorld, recovering 4--8x more false successes than the best judge at the same flag rate with 3,300x lower latency. These results suggest that production monitoring should use lightweight, domain-calibrated detectors as triage signals rather than relying on LLM judges as the primary monitor for false success.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究大语言模型智能体在任务实际未完成时仍声称完成的“虚假成功”现象。作者在 tau2-bench 和 AppWorld 两类基准的大量轨迹上发现，该问题在不同设置中普遍存在且比例差异显著。实验表明，多种 LLM 评审器难以可靠识别虚假成功，往往依赖自信收尾措辞或粗略动作序列等表面信号；相比之下，轻量 TF-IDF 检测器在跨任务条件下取得更高识别性能和更低延迟。

articles.title: YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale
articles.title_zh: YUBI：面向大规模双手灵巧操作的柔顺通用双指接口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10244v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface (YUBI), a finger-aligned gripper designed to enable intuitive, ergonomic, and scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation. While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yielding, finger-driven actuation that directly maps human finger movements to gripper jaw motion. Using the YUBI devices, we set up a data collection system with integrated VR-based 6 DoF tracking of the gripper, ensuring high-fidelity trajectory data acquisition. We curate a UMI-based dataset of unprecedented scale: 8,434 hours across 1.20M episodes and 119 tasks. Experiments show that YUBI offers advantages over the UMI gripper in versatility for complex bimanual tasks, dexterity, and operational efficiency. A single policy trained on the YUBI dataset transfers across multiple bimanual robots (UR, Franka, and ELEY) simply by mounting the gripper on each platform, confirming that the collected data are directly executable as policy supervision. We release the gripper hardware, data-collection software, and dataset as one integrated stack, offering the open community a reproducible path to large-scale data acquisition for advancing robotic foundation models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 YUBI，一种与手指对齐的夹爪接口，旨在为双手灵巧操作提供直观、符合人体工学且可规模化的数据采集方式。其核心设计是柔顺的手指驱动执行机构，可将人类手指运动直接映射到夹爪开合，并结合 VR 6 自由度跟踪获取高保真轨迹数据。作者构建了大规模数据集并展示 YUBI 在复杂双手任务的通用性、灵巧性和操作效率方面优于传统 UMI 夹爪，训练得到的策略还可迁移到多种双臂机器人平台。
authors: Takehiko Ohkawa, Jumpei Arima, Yuki Noguchi, Masatoshi Tateno, Makoto Sugiura, Takuya Okubo, Kengo Ikeuchi, Yuma Shin, Hiroki Nishizawa, Naoaki Kanazawa, Yuki Wakayama, Daiki Fukunaga, Koshi Makihara, Tomohiro Motoda, Floris Erich, Yukiyasu Domae, Tatsuya Matsushima, Yohishiro Okumatsu, Kei Ota

articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在MoSe₂/hBN/WSe₂电子–空穴双层中观察到双组分激子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体的宏观量子相干。体系呈现不同的自旋–谷极化相，并在磁场作用下发生量子相变。凝聚行为可稳定存在至约1.8 K，显示出二维范德华异质结构中可调控激子量子相的潜力。
