In TRL-Rbench, within-table prediction and cross-table linkage favor different training regimes, with atomic linkage performance correlating strongly with the row-matching stage of DLTE pipelines. In TRL-DLTE, the strongest pipelines combine capability-matched specialists rather than reuse a single encoder, and top end-to-end quality depends on non-additive compositional fit rather than per-stage marginal rank alone. TRL-Bench provides a common protocol for measuring reusable signal in exported tabular representations under shared downstream conditions. Code and data: https://github.com/LOGO-CUHKSZ/TRL-Bench
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出 TRL-Bench，用于在表示层面对不同训练范式的表格编码器进行标准化比较，避免仅在任务特定端到端流水线中评估造成的不一致。该基准要求编码器导出行、列或表级嵌入，并通过统一的轻量级探测头在列/表、行以及数据湖表增强等任务套件上评估。作者发布了整理后的 OpenML 表格、行对链接改写任务和大规模数据湖资源，并发现当下游条件被标准化后，编码器质量呈现能力特异性，而非可由单一排行榜概括。
authors: Wei Pang, Xiangru Jian, Hehan Li, Zhixuan Yu, Alex Xue, Jinyang Li, Zhengyuan Dong, Xinjian Zhao, Hao Xu, Chao Zhang, Reynold Cheng, M. Tamer Özsu, Tianshu Yu

articles.title: SIGA: Self-Evolving Coding-Agent Adapters for Scientific Simulation
articles.title_zh: SIGA：用于科学仿真的自演化编码智能体适配器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advanced scientific simulators expose specialized input languages that turn simulation goals into executable configurations, but learning them can cost domain scientists hours to days. We study simulator setup as a problem of agent-tool interface grounding: what minimal simulator-specific adaptations are needed for an off-the-shelf coding agent to operate real scientific software? Our intuition is that coding agents already know how to navigate files, edit code, run commands, and repair outputs, but they lack the simulator's executable contract: its vocabulary, structural constraints, validation rules, and termination conditions. We introduce SIGA, a Simulator-Interface Grounding Adapter that supplies this contract through retrieval, procedural memory, in-trajectory validation, and validation-enforced termination. We primarily evaluate SIGA on GEOS, an open-source multiphysics simulator used in subsurface science. SIGA produces a complete GEOS deck in about five minutes with TreeSim above 0.90, matching an extended-budget human expert who took about three hours, a roughly 36x wall-clock speedup. On a harder held-out set, grounding raises TreeSim from 0.720 to 0.789, a roughly 10% relative gain over the bare agent, and can reduce the across-seed standard deviation by 16x. Self-evolution further improves SIGA by rewriting adapter contents from prior trajectories, yielding the highest held-out GEOS mean and matching or outperforming the strongest hand-designed configuration. Transfers to OpenFOAM and LAMMPS show that the dominant mechanism shifts by interface: validation matters most when structural completeness is the bottleneck, while memory and retrieval matter most when domain correctness is the bottleneck. These results suggest that lightweight, self-improvable grounding layers can turn general coding agents into practical operators of scientific software.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将科学仿真器配置视为智能体—工具接口的“落地”问题，旨在让通用编码智能体以最少的仿真器特定适配操作真实科学软件。作者提出 SIGA，通过检索、过程记忆、轨迹内验证和验证约束的终止机制，为智能体提供仿真器的词汇、结构约束、验证规则与完成条件。在 GEOS 多物理场仿真器上的实验显示，SIGA 可在约五分钟内生成完整配置文件，TreeSim 超过 0.90，达到扩展时间预算下人类专家约三小时工作的水平。
authors: Matthew Ho, Brian Liu, Jixuan Chen, Audrey Wang, Lianhui Qin

articles.title: Blockchain Infrastructure for Intelligent Cyber--Physical--Social Systems:Post-Quantum Security, Interoperability, and Trustworthy Data Economies in the Era of Embodied AI
articles.title_zh: 面向智能信息—物理—社会系统的区块链基础设施：具身智能时代的后量子安全、互操作性与可信数据经济
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06895v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The deployment of embodied artificial intelligence via world-model-based robotics presents a transformative opportunity for blockchain infrastructure, establishing urgent demand for trustworthy data provenance, cross-organizational governance, and incentive-compatible sharing across decentralized ecosystems. Simultaneously, quantum computing advances recognized by the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics and the Turing Award threaten the cryptographic primitives securing these data economies, creating an interdependent imperative: long-lived verification for embodied AI depends on crypto-agile architectures capable of withstanding quantum adversaries. This tutorial examines blockchain as the coordination layer bridging this dual transition, from financial substrate to foundational Cyber-Physical-Social Systems infrastructure that simultaneously secures against quantum cryptanalysis and enables scalable, trustworthy data economies. The session opens with an immersive AWS Braket demonstration engaging participants with superconducting, trapped-ion, and neutral-atom hardware to assess cryptographic threat timelines and witness ECDSA-to-post-quantum signature transitions. Five integrated modules progress from embodied AI and world-model requirements through quantum hardware reality and evidence-based security migration, to scalable cross-shard architectures via BrokerChain protocols, trustworthy data economies implementing Croissant metadata standards and robotic learning provenance, and industry ecosystem integration for multi-modal cloud deployment. By bridging quantum hardware realities with embodied AI data requirements, this tutorial charts blockchain as unified infrastructure for next-generation decentralized intelligent environments, providing open-source frameworks and roadmaps for architecting quantum-resistant, interoperable, and data-trustworthy systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该教程论文讨论在基于世界模型的机器人与具身人工智能部署背景下，区块链如何作为可信数据溯源、跨组织治理和激励兼容共享的协调层。作者指出，量子计算的发展对现有密码原语构成威胁，因此面向具身智能的长期验证需要具备密码敏捷性和后量子安全能力的架构。文章围绕区块链从金融基础设施向信息—物理—社会系统基础设施的转变展开，并结合量子硬件演示与从 ECDSA 到后量子方案的迁移场景讨论安全威胁时间线。
authors: Song Guo, Huawei Huang, Dongping Liu, Aoyu Zhang, Luyao Zhang

articles.title: Optimal Energy Resources Scheduling for Grid-Connected and Islanded Operations of Multi-Community Active Distribution Network
articles.title_zh: 多社区主动配电网并网与孤岛运行的最优能源资源调度
articles.abstract: The rapid integration of distributed energy resources (DER) is transforming distribution networks (DN) into active distribution networks (ADN) with bidirectional power flows and complex control requirements. These developments complicate prediction, operation, and fault management, as local disturbances can escalate into widespread outages with severe socio-economic impacts. It creates a need for an optimal dispatch strategy suitable for both grid-connected and islanded ADN operation. The traditional optimal dispatch strategies are computationally inefficient for relatively large ADNs with high DER penetration. So, this study addresses these challenges by developing a community-based optimal dispatch framework that supports both grid-connected and islanded operation of ADNs. A parallel-processing architecture integrated with an OpenDSS–Python co-simulation interface is employed to distribute the computational workload, enabling simultaneous scheduling across multiple communities. The proposed framework reduces execution time, improves scalability, and ensures reliable operation under extreme conditions (such as outages) by optimally allocating resources within each islanded cluster, allowing standalone operation of communities within an islanded grid.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向高比例分布式能源接入后形成的主动配电网，提出一种同时适用于并网和孤岛运行的社区化最优调度框架。方法结合 OpenDSS–Python 联合仿真接口与并行处理架构，将计算任务分配到多个社区以实现同步调度。结果表明，该框架可降低执行时间、提升可扩展性，并在停电等极端条件下通过对各孤岛集群内资源的优化配置增强运行可靠性。

articles.title: Energy-Aware Autonomous UAV Navigation via Deep Reinforcement Learning: DQN, PPO, and SAC with Battery-Constrained Reward
articles.title_zh: 基于深度强化学习的能量感知自主无人机导航：采用电池约束奖励的 DQN、PPO 与 SAC 比较
articles.abstract: Battery endurance limits commercial quadcopter UAVs to 15–25 minutes per charge — a fundamental propulsive constraint that passive energy harvesting approaches, which recover at most 0.002% of hover power from structural vibration, cannot meaningfully address at the propulsion level. Existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) comparative studies for autonomous UAV navigation evaluate algorithms on task-success rate alone, ignoring energy expenditure. This paper proposes an energy-aware multi-objective reward function with a per-step energy penalty (wₑ = − 0.20) and a battery-scaled goal bonus (+ 200·(1 + 0.5·b/100)), creating a 43% reward differential between energy-efficient and energy-wasteful arrivals. Three algorithms — Deep Q-Network (DQN), Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO with GAE), and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC with reparameterisation trick and twin critics) — are implemented in pure NumPy and compared across five random seeds over 200,000 training steps. SAC achieves Pareto-optimality: 82.2 ± 2.7% success with 24.2 ± 1.8% battery use; PPO: 71.7 ± 3.1% / 29.2 ± 1.8%; DQN: 57.8 ± 2.6% / 36.1 ± 2.2%; A*+PID: 43.5 ± 5.2% / 48.9 ± 4.7% (with full obstacle knowledge). SAC’s 24.7 pp battery advantage over A*+PID translates to a real-world propulsive energy saving of approximately 49–69 W·h over a nominal 15–20 minute DJI F450 mission. ANOVA yields F = 93.96 (p < 0.001); all pairwise comparisons are significant after Bonferroni correction; Cohen’s d ≥ 3.6. Ablation confirms each reward component contributes independently. SAC maintains above 68.7% success under combined sensor noise and wind disturbance without retraining. All code is available in Appendix A.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对商用四旋翼无人机受电池续航限制的问题，提出一种兼顾任务成功率与能耗的多目标奖励函数，其中包含逐步能量惩罚和按剩余电量缩放的目标奖励。作者以纯 NumPy 实现 DQN、PPO 和 SAC，并在多个随机种子和训练步数下进行比较。实验显示，SAC 在成功率与电池消耗之间取得帕累托最优表现，优于 PPO、DQN 以及具有完整障碍物知识的 A*+PID 基线。

articles.title: Magnetic Field Effects on Gravitational Wave-Triggered Galaxy Formation: A 2D Numerical Study
articles.title_zh: 磁场对引力波触发星系形成的影响：二维数值研究
articles.abstract: We extend our previous study on galaxy formation triggered by gravitational waves (GWs) in primordial hydrogen clouds by including the effect of a large scale magnetic field. Using the same 2D numerical model (Mode 5: standing GW, differential rotation, and self gravity), we add a uniform vertical magnetic field B_z that is perturbed by the GW. Simulations are performed for a GW amplitude A=0.25 (amplified for clarity) and angular frequency  w=0.5π with a magnetic field strength B₀₌₁₀⁽⁻²⁾ (in code units) and perturbation amplitudes ϵ ranging from 0.1 to 2.0. The final density distribution is compared with the non magnetic case.  We find that the magnetic field reduces the mean density and standard deviation by about 5%, indicating a mild compression of matter toward the densest regions. The peak density shows a small decrease for ϵ≤1.0 (up to -0.44%) and a marginal increase (+0.045%) for ϵ=2.0. No change in the spiral arm morphology is observed. An analytical estimate of the Lorentz force in the linear regime confirms that the compression scales as ϵ² B₀². The effect is small but numerically significant, and it suggests that magnetic fields could play a secondary, compressive role in GW-induced galaxy formation, especially if the perturbation amplitude is sufficiently strong.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在作者此前关于原初氢云中引力波触发星系形成的二维模型基础上，引入大尺度均匀竖直磁场并考察其扰动效应。模拟比较了不同扰动幅度下的最终密度分布与无磁场情形，发现磁场会使平均密度和标准差约降低 5%，表现出将物质温和压缩至最致密区域的趋势。峰值密度变化较小，螺旋臂形态未见明显改变；解析估计表明线性区间内洛伦兹力导致的压缩随扰动幅度平方和磁场强度平方变化。

articles.title: The dark side of channelrhodopsins: intrinsic ion conductance of apo-opsins
articles.title_zh: 通道视紫红质的暗面：无视黄醛视蛋白的内在离子电导
articles.abstract: Opsins are known as proteins that bind retinal to form light-sensing rhodopsins, which mediate diverse forms of photoreception and are widely used for optogenetic control of cellular activity. Yet many opsins lack canonical retinal-binding features or, in their native biological contexts, are expressed where chromophore availability is limited, raising the question whether retinal-free opsins are silent. Here we show that retinal-free ion-transporting microbial opsins are not inert but adopt intrinsic, light-independent functional states alongside their canonical light-driven activity. Using developmental phenotyping in transgenic Drosophila melanogaster, electrophysiology in Xenopus oocytes and mammalian cells, together with structural and computational analyses, we demonstrate robust light-independent ion conductance in multiple channel-type opsins and an ion-pumping opsin. Structural modeling and molecular dynamics simulations reveal conformational rearrangements in transmembrane helices and internal water networks that are consistent with stabilization of apo-conductive states. Together, these findings establish apo-opsin activity as a defined functional state of microbial opsins, expand the current framework of rhodopsin biology, and highlight the need to consider chromophore-independent activity in both basic research and optogenetic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究挑战了无视黄醛视蛋白在功能上沉默的传统看法，证明多种离子转运型微生物视蛋白在缺乏视黄醛时仍可形成内在、非光依赖的功能状态。作者结合转基因果蝇发育表型、非洲爪蟾卵母细胞和哺乳动物细胞电生理实验，以及结构建模和分子动力学分析，观察到多种通道型视蛋白和一种离子泵视蛋白具有稳健的光非依赖离子电导。结构与计算结果提示跨膜螺旋和内部水网络重排可能稳定无视黄醛导电构象，从而将 apo-opsin 活性确立为微生物视蛋白的一种明确功能状态。

articles.title: Four-Arm Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting with Optimised PZT-5A Placement Coupled with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DQN, PPO, SAC) for Energy-Aware Autonomous UAV Navigation
articles.title_zh: 四臂压电能量采集与优化 PZT-5A 布置，并结合深度强化学习实现能量感知自主无人机导航
articles.abstract: Commercial quadrotor UAVs are fundamentally constrained to 15--25 minutes of flight per charge by the energy density limitations of lithium-polymer batteries, motivating concurrent advances in structural energy harvesting and energy-aware navigation. This paper presents a comprehensive, physics-coupled framework that extends single-arm to full four-arm PZT-5A piezoelectric energy harvesting on the DJI F450 platform and rigorously evaluates three deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms --- DQN, PPO, and SAC --- for energy-aware autonomous navigation. Six PZT-5A patch locations per arm are characterised via Euler--Bernoulli finite element analysis (FEA), establishing the arm-root position (P3, 15% span) as universally optimal across all four arms, yielding 0.0600 mW average power and outperforming the motor-mount location by a factor of 75. Symmetric deployment of P3 patches on all four arms produces a combined 0.2400 mW average power and 144 mJ per standard 10-minute mission. When the SAC navigation policy preferentially allocates flight time toward maximum-throttle climb phases, energy recovery increases to 153 mJ per mission. SAC achieves 82.2 ± 2.7% navigation success with 24.2 ± 1.8% battery consumption --- Pareto-optimal over PPO (71.7 ± 3.1%, 29.2 ± 1.8%) and DQN (57.8 ± 2.6%, 36.1 ± 2.2%) --- with all pairwise differences statistically significant (ANOVA: F = 93.96, p < 0.001; Cohen's d >= 3.6). The harvested energy offsets 5.1% of total eight-VL53L1X proximity sensor energy demand per mission (153 mJ harvested vs. 3,000 mJ sensor consumption over 600 s); The physics-derived reward signal improves navigation success by 10.5 percentage points over energy-blind baselines, establishing a reproducible methodology for coupling structural mechanics to DRL. Open-source code and a four-stage sim-to-real roadmap are provided. complete sim-to-real deployment roadmap and open-source codebase are provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一个物理耦合框架，将 DJI F450 四旋翼平台上的单臂压电能量采集扩展到四臂 PZT-5A 部署，并评估 DQN、PPO 和 SAC 三种深度强化学习算法的能量感知导航性能。基于 Euler–Bernoulli 有限元分析，作者比较每个机臂六个贴片位置，发现位于 15% 展长处的臂根位置 P3 在四个机臂上均最优，四臂对称部署可产生 0.2400 mW 平均功率和每 10 分钟任务 144 mJ 的能量。若 SAC 导航策略更多分配飞行时间至最大油门爬升阶段，回收能量可增至每任务 153 mJ，同时 SAC 也在导航成功率和能耗之间表现最佳。

articles.title: Ligand Mediated Magnetic Coupling Across Metamagnetic Transitions in CrPS4
articles.title_zh: CrPS4 中跨变磁相变的配体介导磁耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.16083v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chromium thiophosphate (CrPS4) is a long-known material: a layered semiconducting antiferromagnet. Its recently discovered gate-tunable metamagnetic phase transitions, the remarkable positive and oscillating magnetoresistance as a tunnel barrier, and its Fano-resonance luminescence, elusive among the multitude of Cr3+ compounds, call for revisiting the understanding of its electronic structure, especially regarding how it relates to magnetic order. Here, we employ X-ray magnetic circular dichroism, implemented in both absorption and resonant inelastic X-ray spectroscopies, together with quantum many-body calculations, to unveil the role of metal-ligand covalency in mediating the metamagnetic transitions in CrPS4, using crystal-field and charge-transfer excitations as fingerprints of the evolving magnetic order. We reveal the role of extended superexchange paths involving P and S atoms, coupling interactions between the Cr spins across the different magnetic phases: antiferromagnetic, canted, and ferromagnetic. Our results elucidate the electronic states involved in these phases and provide prescriptions for engineering the metamagnetic phase diagram of CrPS4.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究重新考察层状半导体反铁磁体 CrPS4 的电子结构及其与磁有序的关系，特别关注金属—配体共价性在变磁相变中的作用。作者结合 X 射线磁圆二色性吸收与共振非弹性 X 射线散射，以及量子多体计算，利用晶场和电荷转移激发作为磁有序演化的指纹。结果揭示了涉及 P 和 S 原子的扩展超交换路径在反铁磁、倾斜和铁磁等不同磁相中耦合 Cr 自旋的关键作用，并为调控 CrPS4 的变磁行为提供了电子结构层面的依据。
authors: Giuseppe Buccoliero, Rachel Nickel, Roberto Sant, Marli dos Reis Cantarino, Andrei Rogalev, Nathan J. Yutronkie, Tristan Riccardi, Daniel A. Chaney, Kurt Kummer, Johann Coraux, Nicholas B. Brookes

articles.title: Quantum Monte Carlo study of the metal-insulator crossover in the square-lattice Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 方格 Hubbard 模型中金属—绝缘体交叉的量子蒙特卡洛研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22705v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interaction-driven evolution from a Fermi liquid to a Mott insulator is a hallmark of strongly correlated fermion systems. In this work, we present a it numerically unbiased study of such metal-to-insulator crossover in the half-filled square-lattice Hubbard model at finite temperatures, employing auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo method. By jointly analyzing thermodynamic and dynamical observables, we establish the crossover diagram of the model in the temperature-interaction (T-U) plane. With increasing U, our numerical results reveal an extended crossover regime, which we refer to as the it Bad Metal, that separates the Fermi liquid and Mott insulator. During the crossover, we also examine the antiferromagnetic spin correlations and observe pronounced nodal-antinodal dichotomy in the momentum-resolved single-particle spectral functions. Furthermore, we investigate the temperature dependence of several commonly used observables in the model. As representative results, we achieve an accurate map of the thermal entropy across the crossover diagram, and identify the parameter regions in which the model exhibits the Pomeranchuk cooling, characterized by an adiabatic cooling with increasing U. Beyond offering a more refined understanding of the crossover phenomenon, our work also provides valuable benchmark and guideline for future optical lattice experiments on the square-lattice Hubbard model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作使用辅助场量子蒙特卡洛方法，对半填充方格 Hubbard 模型在有限温度下由费米液体向莫特绝缘体演化的相互作用驱动交叉进行数值无偏研究。通过联合分析热力学和动力学观测量，作者在温度—相互作用平面上建立了交叉图，并识别出分隔费米液体与莫特绝缘体的扩展“坏金属”区域。研究还考察了反铁磁自旋关联、动量分辨单粒子谱函数中的节点—反节点二分性，以及热熵和 Pomeranchuk 相关行为出现的参数区域。
authors: Mingzhong Lu, Yu-Feng Song, Youjin Deng, Yuan-Yao He

articles.title: Multi-fidelity Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Charged Point Defects
articles.title_zh: 面向带电点缺陷的多保真机器学习原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05238v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) can now reproduce the energy, forces and stresses of bulk materials with high accuracy compared to first-principles calculations. The description of imperfections, where coordination environments and electron counts deviate from those found in pristine reference structures, remains a challenge. We find that the current generation of foundation MLIPs do not describe the defect physics of the semiconductor Sb2Se3. We introduce global defect charge embeddings that distinguish the bonding characteristics of different charge states. We further employ a multi-fidelity approach that combines low-cost (semi-local exchange-correlation functional) reference data with high-quality (non-local hybrid functional) energies and forces that describe well the subtleties of the defect energy landscape. The resulting defect-capable force fields can find stable structural configurations and predict defect thermodynamics in quantitative agreement with direct quantum mechanical calculations, at a fraction of the computational cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，现有基础机器学习原子间势虽能高精度描述体相材料的能量、力和应力，但在处理配位环境与电子数偏离完美晶体的缺陷体系时仍存在不足。作者以半导体 Sb2Se3 为例，发现当前模型难以正确刻画其缺陷物理，并提出全局缺陷电荷嵌入以区分不同电荷态的成键特征。进一步地，研究采用多保真策略，将低成本半局域泛函数据与高质量非局域杂化泛函能量和力结合，所得缺陷适用力场能够以显著较低成本预测稳定结构和缺陷热力学，并与直接量子力学计算定量一致。
authors: Xinwei Wang, Irea Mosquera-Lois, Aron Walsh

articles.title: Quantum simulation of interlayer charge ordering in Kagome frustrated-magnet
articles.title_zh: Kagome 阻挫磁体中层间电荷有序的量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.27826v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between interlayer coupling and quantum fluctuations governs charge ordering and defect dynamics in Kagome systems, yet these parameters are intrinsically entangled in existing Kagome metals and artificial spin-ice platforms, preventing their independent control. Here we realize a bilayer Kagome frustrated-magnet simulator comprising 1,536 connected spins on D-Wave quantum annealer, in which the effective quantum drive, Γₘ̊ ₑff, and interlayer exchange, Jₚₑᵣₚ, are independently programmable. We observe an interlayer-driven transition from ferroelectric to antiferroelectric Ice-II charge order at a critical coupling (Jₚₑᵣₚ/J₁₎^*approx0.04, a phenomenon absent in single-layer geometries. Monte Carlo calculations show the transition persists in the classical limit, allowing the experimentally observed critical coupling to quantify the quantum renormalization induced by fluctuations. Applying resulting phase diagram to Kagome charge-density-wave materials places KV₃Sb₅ and RbV₃Sb₅ deep within the ordered antiferroelectric regime, while locating CsV₃Sb₅ near the phase boundary, providing a natural explanation for its metastable 2×2×4 stacking order. We further show that restricting charge-correlation measurements to ice-rule configurations resolves a systematic underestimation of ordering in conventional analyses, enabling direct reinterpretation of resonant X-ray, XMCD, STM and anomalous Hall experiments. Finally, we demonstrate that the same charge-sector reorganization framework explains near-degenerate plateau states in the metallic Kagome spin-ice HoAgGe and yields experimentally testable predictions for nanomagnetic, Kagome-metal and van der Waals frustrated systems. These results establish programmable quantum annealers as scalable simulators of emergent charge order and monopole physics in frustrated quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 D-Wave 量子退火机实现了包含 1536 个连接自旋的双层 Kagome 阻挫磁体模拟器，从而独立调控有效量子驱动和层间交换耦合。作者观察到由层间耦合驱动的从铁电型到反铁电型 Ice-II 电荷有序的转变，其临界耦合比约为 0.04，而这一现象在单层几何中不存在。蒙特卡洛计算表明该转变在经典极限下仍然存在，并据此量化量子涨落导致的重整化；相图还被用于解释 Kagome 电荷密度波材料中 KV3Sb5、RbV3Sb5 与 CsV3Sb5 的不同有序行为。

articles.title: A Practical Introduction to Tensor Network Renormalization with TNRKit.jl
articles.title_zh: 使用 TNRKit.jl 的张量网络重整化实践导论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.06922v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present TNRKit, an open-source Julia package for Tensor Network Renormalization (TNR) of two- and three-dimensional classical statistical models and Euclidean lattice field theories. Built on top of TensorKit, it provides a symmetry-aware framework for constructing tensor-network representations of partition functions and coarse-graining them using methods such as TRG, HOTRG, and LoopTNR. Beyond thermodynamic quantities, the package enables the extraction of universal conformal data -- including scaling dimensions and the central charge -- directly from fixed-point tensors. TNRKit is designed with both usability and extensibility in mind, offering a practical platform for applying, benchmarking, and developing modern tensor renormalization algorithms. This paper also serves as a self-contained introduction to the TNR framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文介绍 TNRKit，这是一个用于二维和三维经典统计模型及欧几里得格点场论张量网络重整化的开源 Julia 软件包。该软件基于 TensorKit 构建，支持具有对称性的配分函数张量网络表示，并提供 TRG、HOTRG 和 LoopTNR 等粗粒化方法。除热力学量外，TNRKit 还可从固定点张量中提取标度维数、中心荷等普适共形数据；文章同时作为张量网络重整化框架的自洽入门教程。
authors: Victor Vanthilt, Adwait Naravane, Chenqi Meng, Atsushi Ueda

articles.title: Differentiable hybrid force fields support scalable autonomous electrolyte discovery
articles.title_zh: 可微混合力场支持可扩展的自主电解质发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07979v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Autonomous electrolyte discovery demands a computational engine that satisfies a critical trilemma: it must be fast enough for high-throughput screening, accurate enough for quantitative property prediction, and calibratable enough for online refinement. Classical empirical force fields (FFs) are fast but rely on error cancellation, while standard machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are computationally expensive. In this Perspective, we highlight that differentiable hybrid FFs resolve this trilemma by fusing physically motivated functional forms with neural-network short-range corrections. Grounded in Energy Decomposition Analysis (EDA), state-of-the-art models such as PhyNEO-Electrolyte and ByteFF-Pol achieve zero-shot generalization to bulk phases, delivering throughputs on the order of tens of ns/day (up to sim50 ns/day, depending on model complexity) for 10,000-atom systems. Crucially, their physical skeletons provide a well-conditioned parameter space for differentiable molecular dynamics (dMD). This enables a dual-calibration paradigm: bottom-up ab initio parameterization combined with top-down fine-tuning from macroscopic experimental observables. We propose that this architecture meets the requirements of a ``ChemRobot-ready'' digital twin by integrating physics-grounded simulation with experimentally calibratable refinement, thereby enabling closed-loop autonomous electrolyte discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该观点文章讨论自主电解质发现所需的计算引擎应同时具备高通量速度、定量预测精度和可在线校准能力。作者指出，可微混合力场通过将物理启发的函数形式与神经网络短程修正结合，可在经验力场与机器学习势之间取得平衡。以 PhyNEO-Electrolyte 和 ByteFF-Pol 等模型为例，这类方法可实现对体相体系的零样本泛化，并为可微分子动力学中的自底向上参数化和自顶向下微调提供良好参数空间。
authors: Xintian Wang, Junmin Chen, Zhuoying Zhu, Peichen Zhong

articles.title: Chirality Transfer to the Magnetic Sublattice in the Hybrid Perovskite (R)-/(S)-3-Fluoropyrrolidinium Copper(II) Chloride
articles.title_zh: 杂化钙钛矿（R）-/（S）-3-氟吡咯烷鎓氯化铜(II)中的手性向磁性子晶格转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.22952v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Incorporating chiral organic cations into organic-inorganic hybrid materials has been shown to enable the inorganic sublattice to display chiroptical properties. We report a new two-dimensional magnetic (S=1/2) chiral metal halide material, (R)- and (S)-(C₄H₉FN)₂CuCl₄ (where (C₄H₉FN)⁺ is 3-fluoropyrrolidinium), which consists of Cu-Cl inorganic layers separated by (C₄H₉FN)⁺ organic cations. The presence of the chiral (C₄H₉FN)⁺ organic cation induces formation of chiral magnetic order, even though the inorganic sublattice itself is nearly structurally centrosymmetric. We also report the racemic variant, containing an equal amount of (R)- and (S)- cations, which shows no evidence of chiral magnetic order. When the magnetic susceptibility is measured perpendicular to inorganic Cu-Cl layer propagation direction, an antiferromagnetic phase transition at Néel temperature T_N = 2.23~K is observed in both the chiral and racemic materials, and the existence of the magnetic phase transition is supported by specific heat capacity measurements. Field-induced magnetic chirality is observed through the existence of a second-order magnetoelectric effect in the chiral variant, while no magnetoelectric signal is observed for the racemic material, indicating the absence of magnetic chirality. Our findings demonstrate that materials exhibiting chiral magnetic order can be created through the incorporation of a chiral cation into an organic-inorganic hybrid magnetic material, potentially allowing for the design of tailored materials that combine chiral magnetism with other desirable optical and electronic properties that come from structural chirality.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了一种二维自旋 1/2 手性金属卤化物（R）-和（S）-(C₄H₉FN)₂CuCl₄，其中 Cu-Cl 无机层由手性 3-氟吡咯烷鎓有机阳离子分隔。尽管无机子晶格近似具有结构中心对称性，手性有机阳离子的引入仍诱导了手性磁有序，而外消旋样品未显示该特征。磁化率和比热测量表明手性与外消旋材料均在约 2.23 K 发生反铁磁相变，并观察到与磁电响应相关的场诱导磁手性现象。
authors: Zheng Zhang (Department of Chemistry, Tulane University, New Orleans, LA, USA 70118), Mingyu Xu (Department of Chemistry, Michigan State University, East Lansing, MI, USA 48824), Jose L. Gonzalez Jimenez (Department of Chemistry, Michigan State University, East Lansing, MI, USA 48824), Stephen Zhang (Department of Chemistry, Princeton University, Princeton, NJ, USA 08544), Weiwei Xie (Department of Chemistry, Michigan State University, East Lansing, MI, USA 48824), Xianghan Xu (School of Physics and Astronomy, University of Minnesota, Twin Cities, MN, USA 55455), Daniel B. Straus (Department of Chemistry, Tulane University, New Orleans, LA, USA 70118)

articles.title: A Tensor Network Framework for Lindbladian Spectra and Steady States
articles.title_zh: 用于 Lindblad 谱与稳态的张量网络框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.07709v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum systems coupled to (non-)Markovian environments attract increasing attention due to their peculiar physical properties. Exciting prospects such as unconventional non-equilibrium phases beyond the Mermin-Wagner limit or dissipative state preparation demand a systematic analysis of quantum many-body phases out of equilibrium. Akin to the equilibrium case, this requires the computation of the low-lying eigenstates of Lindbladians, a problem challenging conventional approaches for simulating quantum many-body systems. Here, we undertake a first step to overcome this limitation and introduce a tensor-network-based framework to systematically compute not only steady states, but also low-lying excited states for large, driven quantum many-body systems. Our framework is based on recent advances utilizing complex-time Krylov spaces, and we leverage these ideas to create a toolbox tailored to solve the challenging non-Hermitian eigenvalue problem ubiquitous in open quantum systems. At the example of the interacting Bose-Hubbard model driven by dissipation-assisted hopping, we demonstrate the high efficiency and accuracy. From a reliable finite-size scaling analysis of the spectral gap, we find strong evidence for nonlinear hydrodynamic behavior consistent with Kardar-Parisi-Zhang-type superdiffusive relaxation and establish the existence of exponentially accelerated, anomalous relaxation. This method unlocks the capability of spectral analysis of generic open quantum many-body systems, suitable also for non-Markovian environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种基于张量网络的框架，用于系统计算大型受驱开放量子多体系统的稳态及低能激发态。该方法借鉴复时间 Krylov 空间的最新进展，面向 Lindblad 算符中常见的非厄米本征值问题构建数值工具。作者以耗散辅助跃迁驱动的相互作用 Bose-Hubbard 模型为例，展示了该框架在效率和精度上的优势。
authors: Philipp Westhoff, Mattia Moroder, Ulrich Schollwöck, Sebastian Paeckel

articles.title: Clifford Circuits Augmented Grassmann Matrix Product States
articles.title_zh: Clifford 电路增强的 Grassmann 矩阵乘积态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.04164v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent progress in combining Clifford circuits with tensor-network (TN) methods has shown that local Clifford disentanglers can reduce bipartite entanglement across TN bonds prior to tensor compression, thereby improving the efficiency of TN simulations. In this work, we embed local Clifford disentanglers in the Grassmann-tensor language to define a Clifford-augmented Grassmann matrix product state (CAGMPS) ansatz, and develop a density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) framework based on this ansatz while preserving locality and fermion-parity structure. We benchmark the resulting CAGMPS--DMRG method on representative fermionic lattice systems, including the tight-binding, t-V, and t-V-V' models. In all cases, Clifford augmentation systematically suppresses bipartite entanglement and improves the accuracy of the ground-state energy at a fixed bond dimension. We further show that the Grassmann-evenness condition, together with equivalence under entangling action, restricts the relevant two-site Clifford candidates to 12 inequivalent representatives, enabling a more economical disentangling search than approaches based on the standard two-qubit Clifford gate set. Our results suggest that the CAGMPS--DMRG method provides a scalable and efficient variational tool for strongly correlated fermionic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将局域 Clifford 解纠缠器嵌入 Grassmann 张量语言，提出 Clifford 增强的 Grassmann 矩阵乘积态（CAGMPS）变分形式，并发展了相应的 DMRG 框架。该方法在保持局域性和费米子宇称结构的同时，可在张量压缩前降低键上的双分区纠缠。对紧束缚、t-V 和 t-V-V′ 等费米子晶格模型的测试表明，Clifford 增强能够在固定键维数下系统改善基态能量精度，并减少解纠缠搜索空间。
authors: Atis Yosprakob, Wei-Lin Tu, Tsuyoshi Okubo, Kouichi Okunishi, Donghoon Kim

articles.title: Correlated phases of moat-band excitons in two dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维 moat 能带激子的关联相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.18194v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study dilute two-dimensional systems of interacting excitons with a moat dispersion, whose ground-state manifold consists of a set of discrete or continuously degenerate energy minima. At low densities and in the presence of contact interactions, it is known that the bosons can undergo statistical transmutation and stabilize a chiral spin liquid. Here, we show that long-range interactions such as those expected in excitonic systems introduce a rich competition between the chiral spin liquid and different kinds of Bose-Einstein condensates. The moat dispersion can favor Bose-Einstein condensation into states occupying multiple momenta, leading to inhomogeneous and supersolid phases with a highly anisotropic superfluid response. We demonstrate that a proper T-matrix renormalization of the exciton-exciton interaction is essential for describing these phases and show that they can arise even from purely repulsive interactions. This formalism is employed to obtain the phase diagram of competing homogeneous and stripe condensates with the chiral spin liquid in an electron-hole bilayer model. In addition, we show how the T matrix enters the familiar Gross-Pitaevskii framework and map extended phase diagrams within a pseudopotential approximation. We place our findings in the context of real excitonic systems by discussing the roles of finite lifetimes, disorder, band-structure warping, and finite temperatures. We conclude that moat bands can drive Bose-Einstein condensation and supersolidity already at weak coupling, in contrast to systems with a standard parabolic dispersion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究具有 moat 色散的稀薄二维相互作用激子体系，其基态能量极小值可呈离散或连续简并。作者表明，在激子体系常见的长程相互作用下，手性自旋液体与多种 Bose-Einstein 凝聚态之间会出现丰富竞争。moat 色散可促进多动量凝聚，形成非均匀和超固体相，并表现出强各向异性的超流响应；同时，正确的 T 矩阵重整化对描述这些相至关重要。
authors: L. Maisel Licerán, S. H. Boeve, H. T. C. Stoof

articles.title: Layer-Dependent Orbital Magnetization in Graphene-Haldane Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯-Haldane 异质结构中的层数依赖轨道磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.08170v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) proximity-coupled to a Haldane substrate provides a platform to investigate the interplay between band topology, layer number, and electric-field control of orbital magnetism. Using a tight-binding model and the modern theory of orbital magnetization, we study the layer-dependent magnetic response in bilayer, trilayer, tetralayer and pentalayer graphene under Haldane proximity. While monolayer graphene develops a global topological gap with quantized magnetization slope, multilayer systems remain metallic due to protected low-energy bands associated with unperturbed sublattices. Despite the absence of a global gap, finite valley-contrasting Berry curvature produces non-trivial layer-dependent Chern numbers. We decompose the total orbital magnetization into self-rotation (MSR) and center-of-mass (M_C) contributions, revealing their distinct behaviors across doping and applied interlayer bias. In bilayer graphene, magnetization remains negative and monotonic. Remarkably, trilayer and tetralayer graphene display a bias-induced sign reversal of orbital magnetization beyond critical thresholds (Δ simeq -55 meV for 3LG, -50 meV for 4LG) in the hole-doped regime, a feature completely absent in the bilayer. It is further established in the case of 5LG, that the magnetization reversal is independent of the topological transition, and depends on the direction of bias and hole doping. The effect persists across both hole and electron doping, demonstrating that layer count serves as a key tuning parameter for orbital magnetism. Our findings establish topologically proximitized multilayer graphene as a versatile platform for electric-field-manipulable orbitronic and valleytronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察菱方堆垛多层石墨烯与 Haldane 衬底近邻耦合时，能带拓扑、层数和外加电场对轨道磁性的共同影响。基于紧束缚模型和现代轨道磁化理论，作者分析了双层至五层石墨烯的层数依赖磁响应。结果显示，多层体系虽因受保护低能能带而保持金属性，但有限且谷对比的 Berry 曲率可产生非平庸的层依赖 Chern 数；轨道磁化的自旋转与质心贡献在掺杂和层间偏压下呈现不同演化，并在三层和四层体系中出现偏压诱导的符号反转。

articles.title: Watts-per-Intelligence Part II: Algorithmic Catalysis
articles.title_zh: 每瓦智能 II：算法催化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.20897v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop a thermodynamic theory of algorithmic catalysis within the watts per intelligence framework, identifying reusable computational structures that reduce irreversible operations for a task class while satisfying bounded restoration and structural selectivity constraints. We prove that any class specific speed-up is upper-bounded by the algorithmic mutual information between the substrate and the class descriptor, and that encoding this information incurs a minimum thermodynamic cost via Landauer erasure. Combining these results yields a coupling theorem that lower-bounds the deployment horizon required for an algorithmic catalyst to be energetically favourable. The framework is illustrated on an affine SAT class and situates contemporary learned systems within an information thermodynamic constraint on intelligent computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在“每瓦智能”框架下发展了一种算法催化的热力学理论，关注可复用计算结构如何在满足有界恢复和结构选择性约束时减少特定任务类的不可逆操作。作者证明，任何面向任务类的加速均受基底与任务类描述符之间算法互信息的上界限制，而编码这些信息又受到 Landauer 擦除所规定的最低热力学成本约束。由此得到的耦合定理给出了算法催化在能量上有利所需的最小部署期限，并以仿射 SAT 类作为示例。

articles.title: Competing antiferromagnetic phases in multiferroic wurtzite transition-metal chalcogenides
articles.title_zh: 多铁性纤锌矿过渡金属硫族化物中的竞争反铁磁相
articles.abstract: Author(s): Himanshu Mavani, Mohamed Elekhtiar, Kai Huang, Naafis Ahnaf Shahed, and Evgeny Y. Tsymbal Wurtzite Mn X ( X = S, Se, Te) is predicted to host multiferroic antiferromagnetic (AFM) phases featuring switchable ferroelectric polarization, with altermagnetism emerging upon Cr doping. First-principles and spin-model calculations reveal a frustrated stripe AFM ground state in pristine compounds, while Cr doping drives a transition to an A-type AFM phase exhibiting g -wave altermagnetism with large nonrelativistic spin splitting. Remarkably, polarization reversal switches the spin splitting without rotating the Néel vector. Distinct magnetic phases yield symmetry-selective linear and nonlinear Hall responses, providing clear transport fingerprints and establishing doped MnX as a platform for electrically controlled AFM spintronics. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 064408] Published Tue Jun 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究预测纤锌矿 MnX（X = S、Se、Te）可具有带可切换铁电极化的多铁性反铁磁相，并在 Cr 掺杂后出现交替磁性。第一性原理和自旋模型计算显示，本征体系倾向于受挫条纹反铁磁基态，而 Cr 掺杂可驱动其转变为具有 g 波交替磁性和显著非相对论自旋劈裂的 A 型反铁磁相。研究还指出，极化反转可在不旋转 Néel 矢量的情况下切换自旋劈裂，并产生可由线性与非线性霍尔响应识别的输运特征。
authors: Himanshu Mavani, Mohamed Elekhtiar, Kai Huang, Naafis Ahnaf Shahed, and Evgeny Y. Tsymbal

articles.title: Analysis of Mixed Radiation Fields at the MoEDAL Experiment Based on Real-Time Data from a Timepix Detector Network
articles.title_zh: 基于 Timepix 探测器网络实时数据的 MoEDAL 实验混合辐射场分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.05936v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The primary objective of this work is the determination of fluences and characteristics of fast neutrons, other hadrons, and highly ionizing particles in the environment of the MoEDAL experiment at the Large Hadron Collider. These particles constitute an experimental background for the passive Nuclear Track Detectors (NTDs) used by MoEDAL to search for tracks potentially produced by Dirac magnetic monopoles, in particular by particles indistinguishable in NTD from monopoles. The study is based on data acquired by the Timepix hybrid silicon pixel detector network, which represents the first and only active detector system installed and operated as part of the MoEDAL experiment from 2013 to 2018. The Timepix detector network enables real-time measurements of mixed radiation fields, including the composition, spectral properties, and directional characteristics of individual radiation components across different regions of the MoEDAL experimental area. The paper presents detailed results of the radiation field analysis with emphasis on neutrons and highly ionizing particles, including their directional distributions. The first results demonstrating the spatial tracking capabilities of the Timepix detectors are also reported, illustrating the reconstruction of particle direction and energy-loss profiles from individual detector frames.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究旨在测定大型强子对撞机 MoEDAL 实验环境中快中子、其他强子及高电离粒子的通量和特征，这些粒子构成被动核径迹探测器寻找磁单极子信号时的重要背景。研究基于 2013—2018 年运行的 Timepix 混合硅像素探测器网络数据，这是 MoEDAL 中首个也是唯一的主动探测系统。论文分析了不同实验区域混合辐射场的组成、能谱和方向性，重点讨论中子和高电离粒子的分布特征。
authors: Benedikt Bergmann, Petr Burian, Josef Janeček, Claude Leroy, Petr Mánek, James Pinfold, Stanislav Pospíšil, Richard Soluk, Michal Suk

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Environmental Control Systems for Reducing the Energy Performance Gap in Non-Residential Buildings: A Systematic and Critical Review (2018–2025)
articles.title_zh: 用于降低非住宅建筑能源性能差距的人工智能环境控制系统：2018—2025 年系统性与批判性综述
articles.abstract: The energy performance gap (EPG), defined as the discrepancy between predicted and actual operational energy consumption, remains a persistent challenge in non-residential buildings despite advances in simulation-based design and performance standards. Recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI), including deep learning and reinforcement learning (RL), have introduced adaptive environmental control strategies capable of dynamically optimizing building operation. However, the effectiveness, validation robustness, and real-world deplorability of these AI-driven systems remain fragmented across the literature. This study presents a systematic and critical review of AI-based environmental control systems applied to non-residential buildings between 2018 and 2025. Following a PRISMA-guided methodology, peer-reviewed studies were screened and classified according to forecasting models, control strategies, validation environments, climatic zones, and reported performance metrics. Quantitative synthesis was conducted to evaluate reported energy savings, indoor environmental quality improvements, and reductions in performance gaps. Results indicate that hybrid deep learning models (e.g., CNN–LSTM) dominate load forecasting applications, while RL-based controllers demonstrate higher adaptability compared to rule-based and model predictive control (MPC) approaches. Reported energy savings range from 12% to 28% in simulation-based studies, yet only a limited proportion of publications validate results using operational datasets. University campuses emerge as high-potential yet under-validated environments due to occupancy variability and complex HVAC dependency. The review identifies critical research gaps, including limited real-world deployment, insufficient uncertainty analysis, lack of standardized benchmarking protocols, and scalability challenges in hot-humid climates. A structured research roadmap is proposed, emphasizing digital twin integration, hybrid physics-informed AI models, federated learning across campuses, and explainable AI for operational transparency. This work provides a comprehensive framework for researchers and facility managers aiming to bridge the simulation– operation divide and accelerate the transition toward intelligent, resilient, and sustainable non-residential building systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述聚焦非住宅建筑中预测能耗与实际运行能耗之间的能源性能差距，并评估人工智能环境控制系统在缩小该差距方面的作用。研究采用 PRISMA 方法筛选 2018—2025 年相关文献，按预测模型、控制策略、验证环境、气候区和性能指标进行分类。综述重点比较深度学习、强化学习及混合模型在节能、室内环境质量改善和性能差距降低方面的效果，同时指出真实场景验证和部署可靠性仍较分散。

articles.title: An AHP-based multicriteria screening framework for preventive pesticide monitoring in data-limited tropical rice catchments
articles.title_zh: 面向数据受限热带稻作流域预防性农药监测的基于层次分析法的多准则筛选框架
articles.abstract: Preventive pesticide monitoring in tropical agricultural catchments is frequently constrained by limited analytical capacity, incomplete environmental datasets, and the large number of potentially relevant compounds requiring evaluation. To address these limitations, this study developed and applied a multicriteria screening framework for prioritizing agrochemical residues in support of preventive surface-water monitoring in a tropical rice-growing catchment in Colombia. The framework integrated four criteria associated with environmental relevance: human health concern, aquatic toxicity, transport potential, and use-based occurrence proxies. An Analytic Hierarchy Process approach was used to derive criterion weights and evaluate prioritization consistency. A total of 162 pesticides associated with rice production were evaluated. Cypermethrin, isopyrazam, 2,4-D, chlorpyrifos, oxadiazon, mancozeb, fentin hydroxide, triadimenol, permethrin, and malathion were identified as the highest-priority compounds, reflecting different combinations of toxicological relevance, transport-related behavior, mobility potential, and expected occurrence. Sensitivity analysis demonstrated stable ranking behavior under moderate weight perturbations. The prioritization generated operationally relevant outputs for monitoring design, including environmental matrix selection according to mobility and partitioning behavior, rainfall- and application-related sampling windows, and analytical targeting guidance. Overall, the framework provides a transferable screening tool for supporting preventive pesticide-monitoring strategies in tropical agricultural catchments under data-limited conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对热带农业流域中分析能力有限、环境数据不完整和待评估农药种类繁多的问题，提出用于地表水预防性监测的多准则农药优先筛选框架。框架整合人体健康关注度、水生毒性、迁移潜势和基于使用情况的出现代理指标，并利用层次分析法确定权重和检验排序一致性。对哥伦比亚稻作流域相关的 162 种农药评估后，研究识别出氯氰菊酯、isopyrazam、2,4-D、毒死蜱等高优先级化合物，敏感性分析表明排序总体稳定。

articles.title: AI-driven single-molecule lithography towards programmable molecular radical lattices
articles.title_zh: 面向可编程分子自由基晶格的人工智能驱动单分子光刻
articles.abstract: Recent advances in scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) manipulation have enabled atomic/molecular-scale fabrication of artificial quantum structures, yet scalability remains a critical challenge. Here we introduce single-molecule lithography (SML), a strategy that integrates a reinforcement-learning algorithm with STM manipulation, to achieve programmable lattices of molecular radicals. We developed an AI agent to autonomously execute tip-induced dehydrogenation of triphenylmethyl (TPM) molecules in TPM-based metal–organic frameworks self-assembled on a Au(111) substrate. Guided by the AI-optimized operating parameters, we constructed triangular, Kagome, and honeycomb lattices of molecular radicals in Fe–TPM and Ni–TPM platforms. Furthermore, we applied fully automatic SML to fabricate a 632-site triangular lattice as well as structures with programmable shape and size. These results demonstrate that the AI-driven SML provides a promising path toward programmable fabrication of artificial quantum matters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出单分子光刻策略，将强化学习算法与扫描隧道显微镜操控结合，用于构筑可编程分子自由基晶格。作者开发了能够自主执行三苯甲基分子尖端诱导脱氢的 AI 智能体，并在 Au(111) 基底上的金属有机框架中优化操作参数。基于该方法，研究构建了三角、Kagome 和蜂窝等分子自由基晶格，并实现了包含 632 个位点的大规模三角晶格及可编程形状结构，展示了人工量子物质可控制备的潜力。

articles.title: AI-Enabled Two-tiered Site Selection and Optimization Model for Waterfront Urban Air Mobility Vertiports
articles.title_zh: 面向滨水城市空中交通垂直起降场的人工智能两层选址与优化模型
articles.abstract: Site selection for urban air mobility (UAM) infrastructure is critical for building a three-dimensional multimodal transportation network. Taking the Shanghai waterfront as a case study, this study reports a two-tiered artificial intelligence–enabled optimization model for the site selection of waterfront vertiports. The first tier utilizes a random forest regression algorithm to score and recommend high-potential candidate sites, while the second tier incorporates an improved genetic algorithm to perform multiobjective topological optimization among construction costs, travel times, and service coverage. The proposed model effectively captures the nonlinear coupling relationships among site selection factors, with population density and distance from the river reflecting potential demand and physical feasibility, respectively. Site spacing influences safety and transfer efficiency, while capacity indirectly determines system coverage. The optimized UAM network exhibits a complementary core–periphery structure, with highly saturated demand at core-area sites, making them suitable for premium express lines, whereas peripheral-area sites are well-suited to serve as main hubs. This study provides a quantitative decision-making reference for planning the low-altitude economy in megacities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以上海滨水地区为案例，提出用于城市空中交通垂直起降场选址的两层人工智能优化模型。第一层利用随机森林回归对候选地点进行评分和推荐，第二层采用改进遗传算法在建设成本、出行时间和服务覆盖之间进行多目标拓扑优化。结果表明，该模型能够捕捉人口密度、滨水距离、站点间距和容量等因素之间的非线性耦合关系，并形成核心—外围互补的 UAM 网络布局。

articles.title: First sulphur-bridged organometallic compound of rhenium(I) linking deprotonation and coordination mode of 2‐mercaptopyridine‐3‐carboxylic acid derivative: Synthesis, X-ray crystallography characterisation, and DFT calculations
articles.title_zh: 首例硫桥联铼(I)有机金属化合物：2-巯基吡啶-3-羧酸衍生物的去质子化与配位模式、合成、X 射线晶体学表征及 DFT 计算
articles.abstract: Organometallic complexes of transition metals constitute promising architectural frameworks for the design of pharmaceutical products and catalytic systems that can achieve tailored reactivity and functionality. Herein, we report the synthesis of a novel dinuclear Re(I) complex, fac-[Re(CO)3(µ-mpc)]2·Et3NH (1), which has been obtained in high yields through a one-pot reaction between Re(CO)5Cl and 2-mercaptopyridine‐3‐carboxylic acid (H2mpc) in toluene followed by the addition of two drops of triethylamine. The coordination behaviour of H2mpc is linked with its deprotonation, leading to the coordinated (λ1-oxi daneyl)(2-sulfidopyridin-3-yl)methanolate (mpc2−) derivative acting as a bidentate monoanionic N∩S− thioxalato chelate, bridging two rhenium(I) ions. The bridging chelates, mpc2− in the metallacycle units of compound 1 shows a Re2S2 ring, and uncoordinated pendant acetate groups that are in turn stabilised by the cationic Et3NH+, as confirmed by X-ray crystallography analysis. The solid state of compound 1 has also been supported by elemental analysis for sulphur, oxygen, carbon, nitrogen and hydrogen. Non-intermolecular hydrogen bonding and hydrogen bonding interactions (C-H···O-C, C-H···S, and N-H···O-C) were found to promote the stability of the molecule in its solid state. Density functional theory calculations were performed to gain further insights into the electronic structure, bonding characteristics, and reactivity of H2mpc and its rhenium(I) complex. Computational analyses, including non-covalent interactions (NCI), molecular electrostatic potential (MEP), frontier molecular orbitals (FMO), conceptual density functional theory (CDFT), electron localisation function (ELF), and Hirshfeld surface analysis (HSA), rationalised experimental findings and provided detailed information on charge delocalisation, donor-acceptor interactions, and the stabilising role of the triethylammonium counter ion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了一种新型双核铼(I)配合物 fac-[Re(CO)3(µ-mpc)]2·Et3NH 的合成，该化合物通过 Re(CO)5Cl 与 2-巯基吡啶-3-羧酸在甲苯中一锅反应并加入三乙胺获得。配体的去质子化与配位行为相关，形成以 N∩S− 方式螯合并桥联两个铼(I)中心的 mpc 衍生物。X 射线晶体学和元素分析证实了含 Re2S2 环的金属环结构以及由 Et3NH+ 稳定的未配位侧基，研究还结合 DFT 计算和弱相互作用分析讨论其结构特征。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Network with Data Augmentation for Predicting Marine Atmospheric Corrosion of Carbon Steel
articles.title_zh: 结合数据增强的物理信息神经网络用于预测碳钢海洋大气腐蚀
articles.abstract: The prediction of corrosion rate of carbon steel in marine atmospheric environments faces the challenge of scarce measured data. Conventional machine learning algorithms often find it challenging to strike a balance between high prediction accuracy and strong generalization skills, and they are essentially black-box models lacking physical interpretability. To address this issue, this paper proposes a corrosion prediction method that integrates data augmentation with a Physics-informed Neural Network (PINN). The Conditional Table Generative Adversarial Network (CTGAN) is used to expand the training set, and the quality of the synthetic data is verified through K‑S test, MMD test, PCA/t‑SNE visualization, and Spearman correlation coefficient. Meanwhile, the power‑law corrosion kinetics equation is embedded as a physical constraint into the loss function to construct a PINN model for corrosion prediction. Experimental results show that the synthetic data are in good agreement with the original data in terms of statistical distribution, variable dependencies, and physical consistency. Based on the high‑quality augmented data, the PINN model achieves excellent prediction performance on the test set, with a coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.9597 and a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 3.7724 µm·a− 1, significantly outperforming benchmark models such as Support Vector Regression (SVR), eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Random Forest (RF). Ablation experiments further demonstrate that removing either data augmentation or the physical constraint significantly degrades model performance, confirming the necessity of their synergy. Moreover, the kinetic parameters autonomously learned by the model (rate constant A of 28.61 µm·a− 1, time exponent n of 0.65) are consistent with the typical marine atmospheric corrosion behavior of carbon steel, validating its physical interpretability. In summary, the proposed method provides a solution for corrosion rate prediction of carbon steel under small‑sample conditions that features high accuracy, strong robustness, and good physical interpretability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对海洋大气环境中碳钢腐蚀速率实测数据稀缺的问题，提出结合数据增强与物理信息神经网络的预测方法。作者利用条件表格生成对抗网络扩充训练集，并通过 K-S 检验、MMD 检验、PCA/t-SNE 可视化和 Spearman 相关系数验证合成数据质量。研究将幂律腐蚀动力学方程嵌入损失函数作为物理约束，结果显示合成数据在统计分布、变量依赖和物理一致性方面与原始数据吻合，PINN 模型具有较好的预测性能。

articles.title: A Comprehensive performance evaluation framework for machine learning-based oil, gas and water leak detection systems
articles.title_zh: 面向基于机器学习的油、气、水泄漏检测系统的综合性能评估框架
articles.abstract: The structural integrity of such pipeline infrastructure is of prime importance for oil, gas, and water industries, but designing an optimal Leak Detection System (LDS) remains a complex challenge due to trade-offs between sensitivity, computational costs, and hardware reliability. In this paper, a critical review and synthesis of recent developments in LDS methodologies are presented, considering the shift from deterministic models of fluid dynamics using mass balance equations to sophisticated data-driven models using Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Machine Learning classifiers. Significantly, this review extends beyond algorithmic evaluation to consider the neglected dimension of IoT hardware reliability and edge computing constraints. Recognizing that current evaluation metrics are fragmented across these fields, this study proposes a new Unified Performance Evaluation Framework. Unlike conventional evaluation metrics that consider accuracy only for leak detection systems, this framework combines physical flow dynamics, algorithmic efficiency, and hardware reliability in a unified scoring mechanism. To validate the proposed framework, a case study of a hybrid IoT gas leak detection node for residential kitchens is conducted. The case study results demonstrate that the framework captures critical multi-dimensional performance attributes often overlooked by traditional assessments, including a detection accuracy of 96%, a false alarm rate of only 3%, an ultra-low energy consumption of 50 mJ per detection, a 9.7 years estimated battery lifetime, and a response latency of 15.6 seconds dominated by physical sensor response rather than computational overhead. This paper is a significant contribution for researchers and industry practitioners in designing hybrid leak detection systems that guarantee robust performance for diverse fluid media.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述讨论油、气、水管道泄漏检测系统的发展，从基于质量守恒等流体动力学的确定性模型转向人工神经网络和机器学习等数据驱动方法。研究指出，现有评价往往侧重算法准确率，忽视物联网硬件可靠性和边缘计算约束。为此，作者提出统一性能评估框架，将物理流动特征、算法效率和硬件可靠性纳入同一评分机制，并通过混合物联网气体泄漏检测案例进行验证。

articles.title: Hybrid Deep Learning Enhanced Angstrom Framework for Global Horizontal Irradiance Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于全球水平辐照度预测的混合深度学习增强 Angstrom 框架
articles.abstract: Accurate estimation of Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) is critical in making photovoltaic energy production, renewable energy systems, and smart grids more efficient. Nonetheless, the highly non-linear and time-changing nature of atmospheric conditions poses challenges to GHI estimation via standard prediction methods. This paper presents an innovative approach towards GHI estimation based on the integration of the empirical Angstrom equation with sophisticated recurrent neural networks. In total, six predictive models, including LSTM, GRU, BiLSTM, Angstrom-LSTM, Angstrom-GRU, and Angstrom-BiLSTM, are designed and examined based on meteorological data collected from two locations in India: Panaji and Udaipur. This approach combines preprocessing, temporal learning, extraction of features based on the Angstrom radiation equation, and explainability of artificial intelligence via SHAP analysis. The experimental findings show superior performance of the hybrid Angstrom-based models compared to conventional deep learning structures. Out of all the models proposed, the Angstrom-BiLSTM model was found to have yielded the most accurate predictions with RMSE = 28.7960, MAE = 12.7803, R² = 0.9893, and Willmott 0.9973, reflecting the high level of agreement between the real and predicted irradiance values. It was also proved through the use of the SHAP value analysis that the Angstrom radiation and weather-related features played an important role in improving the accuracy of predictions. The results showed that by combining the empirical information about solar radiation with the bi-directional deep learning algorithms, it is possible to obtain a more reliable forecast.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出将经验 Angstrom 方程与循环神经网络相结合的全球水平辐照度预测方法，以应对大气条件非线性和时变性带来的建模挑战。作者基于印度 Panaji 和 Udaipur 两地气象数据，构建并比较 LSTM、GRU、BiLSTM 及其 Angstrom 混合模型，并引入 SHAP 分析增强可解释性。实验结果显示，基于 Angstrom 特征的混合模型整体优于常规深度学习结构，其中 Angstrom-BiLSTM 取得最佳预测表现。

articles.title: A Primary-Data Scope 3 Carbon and Water Footprint Inventory of the Bangladesh Ready-Made Garment Sector: Modelling Export Exposure Under the European Union Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
articles.title_zh: 孟加拉国成衣行业基于一手数据的范围三碳足迹与水足迹清单：欧盟碳边境调节机制下的出口暴露建模
articles.abstract: The European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) entered its definitive, financially binding phase on 1 January 2026, and the European Commission has signalled its intention to extend the mechanism's scope toward downstream and chemical-intensive products over the present decade, placing the ready-made garment (RMG) sector within its medium-term reach. For Bangladesh, where apparel accounts for more than four-fifths of merchandise exports and the EU absorbs more than half of those apparel shipments, the prospective inclusion of garments under CBAM represents a material threat to export competitiveness, compounded by the country's imminent graduation from least-developed-country status in November 2026 and the consequent erosion of preferential market access. Yet the empirical basis for quantifying this exposure is weak: Bangladesh lacks a sector-specific, primary-data greenhouse-gas and water-footprint inventory for its textile and RMG industries, and existing national inventories treat these industries as an undifferentiated subset of manufacturing using top-down methods. This study addresses that gap by constructing a primary-data carbon and water footprint inventory of the Bangladesh RMG sector, structured according to the Greenhouse Gas Protocol scope taxonomy, and by coupling the inventory to a scenario model of CBAM export exposure. Facility-level activity data were assembled for thirty-two representative manufacturing units spanning knit, woven and denim product lines, and characterised against the cradle-to-gate system boundary. The inventory yields a sector-weighted mean cradle-to-gate global warming potential of 16.0 kg CO₂-equivalent per kilogram of finished garment, of which Scope 3 upstream activities (principally fibre and yarn production) contribute approximately forty-two per cent, Scope 2 grid electricity twenty-seven per cent, Scope 1 onsite combustion and effluent treatment twenty-five per cent, and Scope 3 downstream export freight six per cent. The mean blue-water footprint of wet processing is 136 litres per kilogram and the grey-water footprint 119 litres per kilogram, consistent with independent Bangladeshi field studies. A Monte Carlo analysis over primary-data input ranges returns a 90 % credible interval of 12.4 to 20.1 kg CO₂-eq per kilogram. The CBAM exposure model indicates that, at a reference certificate price of EUR 100 per tonne CO₂ and under the Scope 1+2 accounting boundary, the embedded-carbon liability is approximately EUR 0.95 per kilogram of garment, equivalent to an ad-valorem exposure of approximately 4.8 per cent of free-on-board export value under business-as-usual conditions. A modelled decarbonisation pathway combining energy efficiency, rooftop photovoltaics, renewable power-purchase agreements, process-heat electrification, low-impact dyeing and recycled-fibre substitution reduces the cradle-to-gate footprint by approximately fifty-four per cent and the ad-valorem CBAM exposure to approximately 1.3 per cent. The study provides the first integrated, primary-data, scope-resolved carbon and water inventory of the Bangladesh RMG sector tied explicitly to CBAM exposure modelling, and offers an evidence base for sector decarbonisation strategy, buyer engagement and trade-policy negotiation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注欧盟碳边境调节机制可能扩展至下游和化学密集型产品后，对孟加拉国成衣出口竞争力造成的潜在影响。由于服装占孟加拉国商品出口主体且欧盟是主要市场，该机制与最不发达国家毕业后优惠准入减少共同构成重要风险。论文旨在弥补孟加拉国纺织与成衣行业缺乏基于一手数据的温室气体和水足迹清单这一缺口，并据此评估其在未来贸易规则下的出口暴露。

articles.title: Quantum memory surpasses classical limits for storing unknown quantum operations
articles.title_zh: 量子存储器在存储未知量子操作方面超越经典极限
articles.abstract: Quantum memories, systems that store and retrieve information leveraging quantum mechanical effects, can outperform classical storage systems on some existing tasks. Yet these promising memories could also complete operations that are very difficult or impossible for classical systems, including the storage and retrieval of so-called isometry channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子存储器利用量子力学效应来存储和读取信息，在某些任务上已被证明可优于经典存储系统。该报道指出，量子存储器还可能完成经典系统极难或无法实现的操作，例如存储与检索所谓的等距信道。这表明量子存储的优势不仅限于量子态信息，也可扩展到未知量子操作本身。

articles.title: Cloud-tested quantum noise model predicts superconducting qubit errors with sevenfold better accuracy
articles.title_zh: 经云端测试的量子噪声模型以七倍更高精度预测超导量子比特误差
articles.abstract: Researchers from the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) in Laurel, Maryland, and Johns Hopkins University in Baltimore have developed a practical, comprehensive noise-modeling framework for a popular class of superconducting quantum processors. Their work, published in the journal PRX Quantum, offers a sevenfold improvement in predictive accuracy over existing approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 约翰斯·霍普金斯应用物理实验室和约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的研究人员提出了一套面向常见超导量子处理器的实用、综合噪声建模框架。该工作发表在《PRX Quantum》，据称相较现有方法将误差预测精度提高约七倍。该模型有助于更准确刻画量子硬件中的噪声来源，并为量子处理器校准和纠错提供支持。

articles.title: Physicists create new family of Schrödinger-cat states
articles.title_zh: 物理学家创造出新的薛定谔猫态家族
articles.abstract: Quantum mechanics, unlike classical physics, allows objects to exist in more than one state at the same time. This idea is often illustrated by Schrödinger's cat, imagined as being both alive and dead until it is observed. In the laboratory, physicists can create less dramatic but very real versions of this effect by placing atoms, light or motion into two distinct quantum states at once. Creating and controlling these superpositions is essential for applications ranging from quantum computing to precision timekeeping.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子力学允许系统同时处于多个状态的叠加，这一概念常以“既生又死”的薛定谔猫来说明。实验室中可通过原子、光或运动模式构造较不戏剧化但真实存在的猫态叠加。该研究报道了新的薛定谔猫态家族，其制备与控制对量子计算、精密计时等应用具有重要意义。

articles.title: Newfound sound wave scattering rule may lead to less bulky, more effective soundproofing
articles.title_zh: 新发现的声波散射规则或推动更轻薄高效的隔音材料
articles.abstract: Researchers in China recently uncovered a quantum-inspired rule governing how sound is scattered by certain physical properties of a material. Their research, published in Physical Review Letters, may lead to the ability to design materials with optimal, broadband sound blocking.
articles.abstract_zh: 中国研究人员发现了一条受量子思想启发的规则，用于描述声波如何被材料的某些物理性质散射。该成果发表在《Physical Review Letters》，可能为设计宽频、高效的声阻隔材料提供理论依据。若能利用这一规则优化材料结构，未来隔音设备有望变得更薄、更有效。

articles.title: Researchers craft a new, simple recipe for highly entangled quantum states
articles.title_zh: 研究人员提出制备高度纠缠量子态的简单新方法
articles.abstract: Building useful quantum technologies—from sensors to computers—requires generating highly complex entangled states, in which the properties of particles are deeply intertwined. Producing such states has traditionally required complex tools and carefully engineered setups with many parts.
articles.abstract_zh: 从量子传感器到量子计算机，许多量子技术都依赖高度复杂的纠缠态，其中多个粒子的性质紧密关联。传统上，这类状态的产生通常需要复杂工具和精心设计的多部件装置。该研究提出一种更简单的制备方案，可能降低生成高度纠缠态的实验门槛。

articles.title: Dual enhancement of superconductivity in FeSe/SrTiO3 via orbital and correlation synergy
articles.title_zh: 轨道与关联协同作用双重增强 FeSe/SrTiO3 中的超导性
articles.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 24, June 2026. SignificanceIn iron-based superconductors, thedz2orbital band lies deep below the Fermi energy and is conventionally excluded from the superconducting pairing process. This work overturns this view. Using a scanning tunneling microscope tip to apply ...
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注铁基超导体 FeSe/SrTiO3 中超导性的增强机制。传统观点通常认为 dz2 轨道能带位于费米能级以下较深处，因而不参与超导配对过程；该工作对此提出挑战。研究利用扫描隧道显微镜针尖等手段调控体系，表明轨道效应与电子关联的协同作用可能共同提升超导行为。

articles.title: Inverse supersymmetry in finite temperature Bose-Fermi mixtures
articles.title_zh: 有限温度玻色-费米混合物中的反向超对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate nearly degenerate Bose-Fermi mixtures and show that the breaking of generalized supersymmetry (gSUSY) between bosons and fermions, with up to two internal states, manifests itself through the emergence of fermionic Goldstino modes with up to four flavors. In particular, we draw a distinction between typical supersymmetry (SUSY), where bosons have pseudospin 0 and fermions have pseudospin 1/2, and inverse supersymmetry (iSUSY), where bosons have pseudospin 1/2 and fermions have pseudospin 0. In such systems, we highlight that the Goldstino pseudospin is carried by either its constituent fermion (SUSY) or boson (iSUSY). We then distinguish between these two cases by depicting their differing effects on the spectral functions of the bosonic and fermionic atomic species. Lastly, we propose radio-frequency- or microwave-spectroscopy experiments, analogous to momentum (angular) resolved photoemission in condensed matter physics, to measure the pseudospin-dependent spectral functions and detect the emergence of Goldstino modes in mixtures of ³⁹K and ⁴⁰K.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了近简并玻色-费米混合物，指出玻色子与费米子之间的广义超对称性破缺会产生最多四种味的费米型 Goldstino 模式。论文区分了通常超对称性与反向超对称性：前者中玻色子赝自旋为 0、费米子赝自旋为 1/2，后者则相反。研究进一步通过玻色和费米原子谱函数的差异来辨别两种情形，并提出可用射频或微波谱实验在 ³⁹K 与 ⁴⁰K 混合物中探测 Goldstino 模式。
authors: Zachary Gazzillo, Carlos A. R. Sá de Melo

articles.title: Exact mean-field phase diagram for self-avoiding active particles in a lattice
articles.title_zh: 晶格中自回避活性粒子的精确平均场相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate motility-induced phase separation in a lattice gas of self-propelled particles with hard-core exclusion, where an internal director biases particle hopping along the lattice coordination directions while undergoing rotational diffusion, together with a thermal-like translational diffusion. Rather than employing stochastic simulations, we adopt a master-equation formalism within a general mean-field approximation. By linearizing the mean-field master equation around the homogeneous stationary state and applying Bloch's theorem, the stability analysis is reduced to a z-dimensional tight-binding eigenvalue problem. A perturbation expansion in the wavenumber near ǩ = 0 then yields the spinodal surface in closed analytical form for six Bravais lattices: linear, square, hexagonal, simple cubic, body-centered cubic, and face-centered cubic. The influence of lattice geometry is shown to enter exclusively through a single coefficient A which we evaluate exactly for each case. We further show that translational diffusion smooths the interface between the dense and dilute phases. Finally, we determine the rotational probability currents associated with the inhomogeneous stationary states, a distinctive signature of the broken detailed balance underlying active-system dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究具有硬核排斥的自推进粒子晶格气体中的运动诱导相分离。作者采用主方程形式和一般平均场近似，而非随机模拟，并通过线性化稳定性分析与 Bloch 定理将问题化为紧束缚本征值问题。研究为六种 Bravais 晶格解析给出自旋odal曲面，表明晶格几何的影响可由单一系数表征，并指出平移扩散会使稠密相与稀疏相之间的界面变得更平滑。
authors: Felipe Hawthorne, Cristiano F. Woellner, José A. Freire

articles.title: Phase Formation and Thermal Stability of Superconducting Platinum Silicide Thin Films on Silicon
articles.title_zh: 硅基超导铂硅化物薄膜的相形成与热稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Platinum silicide (PtSi) thin films are promising for silicon-based superconducting quantum devices due to their compatibility with CMOS fabrication, air stability, and superconducting transition temperature near 1 K. We report a systematic study of PtSi phase formation, microstructure, and interface quality as a function of annealing temperature and duration, characterizing films using grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, and electrical transport measurements. Phase-pure PtSi forms within minutes by rapid thermal processing at 600 degC and is stable under extended annealing, while 30 s anneals across 300-600 degC yield equivalent film quality with consistent microstructure and superconducting properties. X-ray reflectivity reveals that interfacial roughening is an intrinsic consequence of the Pt2Si-to-PtSi conversion step rather than a result of elevated temperature or prolonged annealing. These results establish a robust processing window for PtSi formation in silicon-based superconducting device fabrication flows.
articles.abstract_zh: 铂硅化物 PtSi 薄膜因兼容 CMOS 工艺、空气稳定且超导转变温度接近 1 K，被认为适用于硅基超导量子器件。作者系统研究退火温度和时间对 PtSi 相形成、微结构和界面质量的影响，并使用掠入射 X 射线衍射、X 射线反射率及电输运测量进行表征。结果显示，600°C 快速热处理数分钟即可形成相纯 PtSi，且较宽工艺窗口内薄膜质量与超导性质保持一致；界面粗糙化主要源于 Pt2Si 向 PtSi 的转化步骤。
authors: Tharanga R. Nanayakkara, Ananya Chattaraj, Mingzhao Liu, Charles T. Black

articles.title: Elusive Exciton Insulator States in 1T-HfTe2: Exciton softening, and Symmetry Breaking by Ab Initio Methods
articles.title_zh: 1T-HfTe2 中难以捉摸的激子绝缘态：基于从头算方法的激子软化与对称性破缺研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments have provided evidence for excitonic insulator (EI) states in 1T HfTe2. In this work, we investigate EI states in monolayer, bilayer, trilayer, and bulk 1T HfTe2 using advanced meta generalized gradient approximation (meta GGA) calculations and a model Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) approach, together with structural and electronic symmetry breaking analyses. Our results show that both the monolayer and bilayer exhibit negative exciton energies, leading to the spontaneous formation of bound excitons and EI states, whereas the trilayer and bulk display positive exciton energies and do not support EI states. Structural symmetry-breaking calculations show very small in-plane displacements of the Hf atoms from their symmetric positions in the monolayer and multilayers, consistent with experimental observations. Interestingly, electronic symmetry-breaking calculations for the monolayer, performed using a symmetric structure and a hybrid functional, show a pronounced unfolded valence-band feature at the M point and no unfolded conduction-band states near the Fermi level at Gamma, in good agreement with experimental results. Overall, our findings support the existence of EI states in low dimensional 1T HfTe2. The methodology developed here can be readily extended to investigate EI behavior in other related quantum material systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对近期实验中 1T-HfTe2 激子绝缘态的证据，利用先进的 meta-GGA 计算、模型 Bethe-Salpeter 方程以及结构和电子对称性破缺分析进行理论考察。结果表明，单层和双层体系具有负激子能，可自发形成束缚激子并支持激子绝缘态，而三层和体相体系激子能为正，不支持该态。结构对称性破缺计算显示 Hf 原子的面内位移很小，与实验相符；单层电子对称性破缺计算也再现实验观测到的能带特征。
authors: Hong Tang, Niraj Pangeni, Daniel D. Rivera, Adrienn Ruzsinszky

articles.title: Exact spectrum and anomalous relaxation in the open disorder-free Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev system
articles.title_zh: 开放无序自由 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 系统的精确谱与反常弛豫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.08079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a disorder-free variant of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model with dissipation within the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad formalism. By utilizing the integrability of the clean SYK model, we derive an exact solution in a spectrum-resolved form, i.e., the eigenvalues and corresponding projection superoperators of the Liouvillian for arbitrary system size N. We determine the scaling of the gap that governs the long-time decay of the two-point correlation functions. Importantly, the gap does not vanish in the dissipationless limit when the thermodynamic limit is taken first, despite the integrability of the model. This phenomenon, known as anomalous relaxation, suggests a possible connection with chaotic dynamics and quantum Ruelle-Pollicott resonances. We also find several spectral features, such as transitions in the Liouvillian spectrum from complex to real eigenvalues with increasing dissipation strength, as well as the convergence of the dissipative form factor to the spectral form factor in the dissipationless limit. These findings indicate that the present model offers a useful platform for exploring nontrivial open dynamics of many-body quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在 Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad 框架下研究带耗散的无无序 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型。借助清洁 SYK 模型的可积性，论文给出了任意系统尺寸下 Liouvillian 的本征值及相应投影超算符的谱分辨精确解。研究发现控制二点关联函数长时衰减的能隙在先取热力学极限再取无耗散极限时并不消失，表现出反常弛豫，并可能与混沌动力学和量子 Ruelle-Pollicott 共振相关。
authors: Soshun Ozaki, Hironobu Yoshida, Hosho Katsura

articles.title: First-Principles Insights into Surface and Ligand Effects in Stoichiometric HgTe Quantum Dots
articles.title_zh: 化学计量 HgTe 量子点中表面与配体效应的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.08399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: HgTe quantum dots are promising mid-infrared nanomaterials owing to their exceptional bandgap tunability, yet their electronic structure is strongly influenced by surface coordination and ligand passivation at ultrasmall sizes. Here, we employ atomistic simulations to systematically investigate stoichiometric HgTe nanoclusters with sizes 0.86 to 1.85 nm. The in silico exploration uncovers a transition from confinement-dominated electronic structures with delocalized frontier states in small self-passivated clusters to surface influenced characteristics in larger nanoclusters. Increased coordination and bond-length inhomogeneity in the larger nanoclusters generate localized near-gap states centered on undercoordinated surface atoms. At intermediate sizes, the band edge states become spatially separated on different regions of the cluster without forming deep gap states, marking the onset of surface induced electronic asymmetry. In larger clusters (1.8 nm), common neutral ligands like amines, thiols, phosphines, and alcohols effectively eliminate surface-derived localized states by restoring local coordination and altering the band edge electronic structure through ligand surface hybridization. The sensitivity of the bandgap to ligand identity and binding site underscores the interplay between surface coordination and ligand chemistry in shaping the electronic structure of these nanoclusters. These insights provide an atomistic understanding of size-dependent electronic structures in ultrasmall HgTe clusters. The study further establishes neutral ligands as powerful chemical handles for engineering frontier electronic states relevant to infrared optoelectronic functionality.
articles.abstract_zh: HgTe 量子点因带隙可调性优异而适用于中红外纳米材料，但在超小尺寸下其电子结构会强烈受表面配位和配体钝化影响。作者利用原子级模拟系统研究尺寸为 0.86 至 1.85 nm 的化学计量 HgTe 纳米团簇。结果显示，小团簇的电子结构主要受量子限域控制，而较大团簇中欠配位表面原子会产生近带隙局域态；常见中性配体可通过恢复局部配位并调节带边特征来削弱或消除这些表面态。
authors: Raagya Arora, Patrick J. Lohr, Dibyajyoti Ghosh, Jennifer Hollingsworth, Sergei Tretiak

articles.title: First-Principles Investigation of Electron--Phonon Coupling and Intrinsic Two-Gap Superconductivity in Hexagonal BAs3 Monolayer
articles.title_zh: 六角形 BAs₃ 单层中电子-声子耦合与本征双能隙超导性的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.08423v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional superconductors with multiband electronic structures provide an ideal platform for exploring anisotropic and multigap superconductivity in the reduced-dimensionality limit. Here, we investigate the structural, electronic, vibrational, and superconducting properties of a hexagonal BAs₃ monolayer using first-principles calculations combined with density functional perturbation theory and fully anisotropic Migdal--Eliashberg theory. The optimized structure is found to be dynamically and thermally stable, as confirmed by phonon calculations and ab initio molecular dynamics simulations. Electronic structure calculations reveal an intrinsic metallic state with multiple bands crossing the Fermi level and several disconnected Fermi-surface sheets derived primarily from hybridized B-p and As-p orbitals. The electron--phonon interaction is dominated by low-frequency As-derived phonon modes, yielding a total electron--phonon coupling constant of łambda=0.75. Solving the anisotropic Eliashberg equations predicts a superconducting critical temperature of T_c=3.4 K. The momentum-resolved superconducting gap exhibits a pronounced two-gap character with gap magnitudes of Δ₁₌₀.75 meV and Δ₂₌₀.51 meV at T=1 K. The superconducting gaps remain finite over the entire Fermi surface, demonstrating a fully gapped nodeless superconducting state. Analysis of the momentum-dependent electron--phonon coupling reveals that the two-gap superconductivity originates from sheet-dependent pairing interactions associated with distinct Fermi-surface sheets.
