articles.title_zh: GKI-Net：基于高斯溅射与 KAN 的物理约束隐式神经表示去雾网络
articles.abstract: Haze causes severe image degradation in visual sensing and obscures key physical cues. We propose GKI-Net, a physics-embedded dehazing framework that integrates Gaussian splatting with a convolutional Kolmogorov–Arnold network. Instead of relying on black-box mappings, we design a hybrid physics-informed decoder. Using multi-scale implicit neural representations, the decoder explicitly decouples the transmission map and atmospheric light in the atmospheric scattering model, thereby preserving physical consistency in the restored images. During feature encoding, we design a Gaussian feature splatting module that uses deformable Gaussian kernels to adaptively aggregate long-range spatial context. We further introduce a convolutional KAN layer (ConvKAN) to perform efficient high-order nonlinear feature transformations with a small number of parameters. Experiments show that GKI-Net outperforms state-of-the-art methods on quantitative metrics and visual quality, improving the robustness of sensing systems in complex weather conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 GKI-Net，一种嵌入物理模型的图像去雾框架，将高斯溅射与卷积 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络相结合。该方法通过混合物理信息解码器和多尺度隐式神经表示，显式解耦大气散射模型中的透射图与大气光，以保持复原图像的物理一致性。特征编码阶段引入可变形高斯核聚合长程空间上下文，并使用 ConvKAN 以较少参数实现高阶非线性变换；实验表明其在定量指标和视觉质量上优于现有方法。

articles.title: Curved Mesh Adaptation for High-Order Finite Element Simulations
articles.title_zh: 面向高阶有限元模拟的曲面网格自适应
articles.abstract: The ability to take advantage of computationally efficient high-order finite element methods to perform adaptive finite element analysis of complex engineering problems over general 3D domains requires the ability to adapt meshes with curved elements that maintain the level of geometric approximation of the domain boundary required. This paper presents a conforming curved mesh adaptation procedure aimed at effectively supporting automated adaptive analysis of problems for which the domain geometry is defined in a CAD system. The local mesh modification procedures interact with the CAD geometry to curve the mesh edges and faces representing those boundaries to the order of approximation of the high-order elements being used. The curved mesh edges and faces representing the domain boundaries are based on B´ezier approximation geometry, which provides more accurate evaluations of surface-related quantities of interest than the commonly used interpolation methods. To attain computational efficiency during mesh adaptation, the interior mesh entities have their geometric order kept as low as possible while still maintaining control of element shapes. The order of curved mesh entities is limited to no higher than cubic, which allows the definition of an effective procedure to define the shape of the limited number of interior mesh entities that must be curved. The procedures, which are fully parallelized, are demonstrated on the adaptive radio-frequency analysis of a magnetically confined fusion system containing a fully represented radio-frequency antenna.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究复杂三维工程问题中高阶有限元自适应分析所需的曲面网格自适应技术，重点是在 CAD 定义几何边界上保持足够的几何近似精度。作者提出一种保形曲面网格自适应流程，使局部网格修改操作能够与 CAD 几何交互，并将边界网格边和面弯曲到与所用高阶单元相匹配的近似阶次。该方法采用 Bézier 近似几何表示边界曲线与曲面，以提高表面相关量的计算精度，同时尽量降低内部网格实体的几何阶次以兼顾计算效率和单元形状质量。

articles.title: Health Risk Assessment of Heavy Metals in Iranian Cereal Products Using ICP-AES and a Hybrid Machine Learning Framework
articles.title_zh: 基于ICP-AES与混合机器学习框架的伊朗谷物制品重金属健康风险评估
articles.abstract: This study assesses the health risk associated with heavy metal contamination in 13 commonly consumed cereal-based products (11 pasta brands, Ash-Novin pasta, and wheat germ powder) from Arak, Iran. Concentrations of arsenic (As), cadmium (Cd), mercury (Hg), lead (Pb), and copper (Cu) were measured using inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectrometry (ICP-AES). Risk assessment was performed by calculating the daily intake (DI), hazard quotient (HQ), and the permissible daily consumption limit (CRlim). The measured concentration ranges (in mg/kg) were: As (0–0.834), Cd (0.0002–0.014), Hg (0–0.502), Pb (0–2.0), and Cu (0–1.203). The highest HQ values were found for the Tak brand (HQ = 1.657), driven by Hg, and the Zhik brand (HQ = 0.928), driven by As, indicating potential non-carcinogenic health risks. In contrast, the Zar, Mak, and Jahan brands exhibited HQ values below 0.01. A hybrid ensemble machine learning framework, combining Random Forest and Gradient Boosting, was developed to predict HQ. The model achieved high accuracy (R2 = 0.97, RMSE = 0.042) and identified Hg (34%) and As (28%) as the dominant risk factors, confirming the deterministic results. This integrated approach provides a robust method for rapid food safety screening.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了伊朗阿拉克地区13种常见谷物制品中砷、镉、汞、铅和铜污染带来的健康风险，并采用电感耦合等离子体原子发射光谱法测定金属含量。作者通过每日摄入量、危害商和允许每日消费限量进行风险表征，发现Tak品牌的风险主要由汞驱动，Zhik品牌的风险主要由砷驱动，而部分品牌危害商较低。研究还构建了结合随机森林与梯度提升的混合集成机器学习模型预测危害商，模型表现出较高准确性，并确认汞和砷是主要风险贡献因子。该综合方法可为食品安全监测和风险管理提供支持。

articles.title: Integrated Tubular Mobility System: A Utility‑Based Micro‑Grid for Zero‑Fatality, Frictionless Cities
articles.title_zh: 一体化管状出行系统：面向零死亡、低摩擦城市的公用事业型微网
articles.abstract: Urban transportation systems continue to incur high fatality rates, extensive land consumption, and persistent access friction. Here we introduce the Integrated Tubular Mobility System (ITMS), a closed, one‑way network of narrow pipelines (≈1 m diameter) conveying small automated pods. Pods access buildings directly via vertical shafts, eliminating the “last‑mile” walk. Using spatial efficiency quantification, network friction modeling, and energy efficiency quantification, we demonstrate that the ITMS reduces structural mass by 72% relative to monorails, achieves zero pedestrian‑vehicle conflict, decreases average access distance by 95%, and consumes 15–25 Wh per passenger‑kilometer – three to five times less than battery electric vehicles. All components (elevators, monorails, pipelines) already exist; the innovation lies in their integration into a utility grid. The ITMS provides a quantifiable pathway toward safe, accessible, low‑carbon urban mobility.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一体化管状出行系统（ITMS），即由约1米直径窄管道构成的封闭单向网络，用小型自动化载具运送乘客。系统通过垂直竖井直接连接建筑物，旨在消除“最后一公里”步行并避免行人与车辆冲突。基于空间效率、网络摩擦和能耗量化分析，作者认为该系统相较单轨可显著降低结构质量、减少平均接入距离，并以低于电动汽车的能耗实现城市出行。该方案的创新主要在于将电梯、单轨和管道等既有组件集成为公用事业式交通网。

articles.title: Area 55b forms a cortical transition zone for sensorimotor-semantic transformation in human language
articles.title_zh: 55b区构成人类语言中感觉运动—语义转换的皮层过渡区
articles.abstract: Human language requires seamless transformations between amodal concepts and modality-specific sensorimotor systems, yet the mediating cortical interface remains elusive. Using individualized functional mapping across word comprehension (listening and reading) and production (naming and writing) tasks, we evaluated the modality-invariant lexical network against five stringent, a priori criteria. We identified left area 55b as the exclusive sensorimotor–semantic interface. Area 55b robustly distinguished comprehension from production, exhibited production-enhanced semantic representations, and dynamically reconfigured its effective connectivity to motor-effector systems during production. Crucially, it revealed an internal anterior-posterior functional gradient: an anterior language-network component carried stronger semantic information, whereas a posterior somato-cognitive action-network component carried stronger articulatory information. This organization was supported by white matter connectivity and positioning along macroscale cortical hierarchies. Together, these findings reveal area 55b as a cortical transition zone for sensorimotor–semantic transformation, providing a mechanistic account of how language bidirectionally bridges meaning with perception and action.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注人类语言中抽象概念与特定感觉运动系统之间的转换界面，采用个体化功能定位考察词语理解和产生任务中的模态不变词汇网络。结果显示，左侧55b区是符合多项预设标准的感觉运动—语义接口，能够区分理解与产生过程，并在语言产生中表现出增强的语义表征和与运动效应系统的动态连接重构。研究还发现该区域内部存在前后功能梯度：前部语言网络成分携带更强语义信息，后部躯体-认知动作网络成分携带更强发音信息。白质连接和宏观皮层层级位置进一步支持55b区作为语言中感觉运动—语义转换过渡区的作用。

articles.title: Infomorphic Computing Enabled by Spintronic Devices Toward Localized and Interpretable Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 自旋电子器件赋能的信息形态计算：迈向局域化且可解释的机器学习
articles.abstract: Infomorphic computing, grounded in partial information decomposition, offers a unified and mathematically interpretable framework for neuron-autonomous local learning. Its neuronal units operate through dual-input, nonlinear and tunably stochastic dynamics, inherently eliminating the cross-layer error propagation and associated energy overhead of backpropagation. However, the lack of hardware primitives that natively embody these dynamics remains a critical bottleneck, preventing its intrinsic algorithmic advantages from translating into practical hardware efficiency. Here, we demonstrate, to our knowledge, the first physical infomorphic neuron using CMOS-compatible spintronic devices, specifically voltage-gated spin-orbit-torque magnetic tunnel junctions (VGSOT-MTJs). We show that the device physics maps natively onto the core information-theoretic operation, establishing what we define as Infomorphic Nonlinear Probabilistic Activation (INPA): the SOT current and gate voltage encode receptive (R) and contextual (C) signals, respectively, jointly modulating the MTJ switching probability to yield a probabilistic binary output. Using this native primitive, we build spintronic infomorphic neural networks capable of supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and associative memory tasks with fully local updates, requiring only ~ 0.5% of the update computation compared to backpropagation method in the same task. Each INPA operation consumes ~ 15.86 pJ within 1.6 ns using the VGSOT-MTJ device. At the system level, our laboratory prototype already achieves ~ 400× higher energy efficiency than GPU-based execution, with projected gains reaching up to six orders of magnitude upon spin-CMOS ASIC integration. This work establishes a scalable hardware foundation for infomorphic computing, positioning spintronics as a key enabler for next-generation energy-efficient machine intelligence with clear mathematical interpretability and minimal resource overhead.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用 CMOS 兼容的电压门控自旋轨道矩磁隧道结（VGSOT-MTJ）实现物理信息形态神经元。器件中的 SOT 电流和栅电压分别编码感受信号与上下文信号，并共同调制 MTJ 翻转概率，形成非线性概率二值输出。作者将这种硬件原语定义为信息形态非线性概率激活，为避免反向传播跨层误差传递、实现局域可解释学习提供了潜在硬件路径。

articles.title: Clustering Analysis for Corrosion Defects in a Crude Oil Pipeline
articles.title_zh: 原油管道腐蚀缺陷的聚类分析
articles.abstract: Corrosion remains one of the principal threats to the integrity of oil and gas pipelines. This case study investigates the application of clustering techniques to group corrosion defects detected in a crude oil transmission pipeline using inline inspection (ILI) data. The objective is to identify defect clusters and assess their combined influence on pipeline strength. Magnetic-flux-leakage inspection results were processed and analysed through clustering algorithms to form groups of potentially interacting defects. Each cluster’s aggregate metal loss was evaluated using widely applied industry standards (ASME B31G and DNV-RP-F101) to estimate remaining strength and burst pressure. The analysis revealed that several defect groups exhibited lower predicted burst pressures than isolated defects, indicating the significance of the defect clustering effects. However, finite element analysis (FEA) verification demonstrated that certain defect clusters classified as interacting by simplified code-based methods still retained the safe operating pressure above the MAOP of the pipeline and thus did not behave as interacting defects. This finding confirms that while Level 1 assessments provide an efficient screening tool, Level 2, 3 FEA may be required for specific clusters to avoid over-conservative results. Incorporating such validation can reduce unnecessary repairs and associated costs while improving the accuracy of integrity assessments. The lessons learned emphasize the importance of understanding defect interaction rules and their limitations when applied to real ILI data. The presented methodology offers a practical approach that combines data analytics with established engineering standards, enabling operators to refine defect evaluation, prioritize maintenance, and enhance the overall reliability of pipeline systems. An adjustment to the DNV-RP-F101 circumferential interaction distance criteria is proposed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该案例研究利用在线检测数据和聚类算法，对原油输送管道中的腐蚀缺陷进行分组，以评估相邻缺陷的相互作用及其对管道强度的影响。研究采用 ASME B31G 和 DNV-RP-F101 等标准估算缺陷簇的剩余强度和爆破压力，发现部分缺陷簇的预测爆破压力低于孤立缺陷。有限元验证显示，一些按简化规范判定为相互作用的缺陷簇仍可在最大允许工作压力以上安全运行，说明初级评估方法需结合更高保真分析谨慎使用。

articles.title: 500 Wh kg−1-Class Safe Lithium Metal Batteries Enabled by a Sequentially Responsive Localized High-Concentration Gel Polymer Electrolyte
articles.title_zh: 顺序响应型局域高浓度凝胶聚合物电解质实现 500 Wh kg−1 级安全锂金属电池
articles.abstract: Practical application of high-energy-density lithium metal batteries (LMBs) is limited by interfacial parasitic reactions and thermal runaway risks. We develop a localized high-concentration gel polymer electrolyte (LGPE) featuring a pre-programmed sequential response, enabled by an electrophilic fluorinated crosslinked network derived from perfluorophenyl acrylate (PFPA), which integrates interfacial regulation and thermal defense within a single molecular framework. During routine cycling, the electrophilic PFPA preferentially adsorbs on the lithium anode and redirects interfacial film formation from free-solvent decomposition to controlled LiFSI defluorination, in-situ forming a LiF-rich gradient solid electrolyte interphase that stable Li plating/stripping. Under thermal abuse, the low-energy-barrier C–F bonds cleave preferentially to release fluorinated reactive species for gas-phase radical scavenging, while the residual backbone promotes condensed-phase char formation, achieving staged defense against combustion-chain propagation. Therefore, LGPE achieves non-flammability, with a high limiting oxygen index of 49.10%. Li||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 cells retain 80.80% capacity after 430 cycles at 4.3 V. A 10.5 Ah pouch cell assembled with an N/P ratio of 2.6 and an E/C ratio of 1.6 g Ah−1 delivers 504 Wh kg−1 energy density, retaining 96.32% capacity after 80 cycles. This work provides a viable route toward concurrently enhancing interfacial electrochemical stability and intrinsic thermal safety in LMBs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发了一种局域高浓度凝胶聚合物电解质，通过源自全氟苯基丙烯酸酯的亲电含氟交联网络，将界面调控与热安全防护集成在同一分子框架中。常规循环中，该网络促进锂负极形成富 LiF 梯度固体电解质界面，以稳定锂沉积/剥离；热滥用下，C–F 键优先断裂并释放含氟活性物种以捕获气相自由基，同时残余骨架促进凝聚相成炭。该电解质表现出不可燃性和较高极限氧指数，并在高镍正极锂金属电池中展现出面向高能量密度应用的循环稳定性。

articles.title: A Simulation-Based Approach: Optimizing PCB Assembly Lines with ARENA
articles.title_zh: 基于仿真的方法：利用 ARENA 优化 PCB 装配线
articles.abstract: We present a simulation-based approach to increase throughput and resource utilization of Printed Circuit Board (PCB) assembly lines. We use ARENA to simulate and optimize production, ultimately reducing overall costs and maximizing throughput and resource utilization. A multifaceted simulation approach is used to assess different alternatives, providing insights into critical production parameters. Using ARENA to produce real-time simulations has proven to be an excellent, cost-effective approach for studying industrial supply chains, and the impact of various control parameters. For over a decade, Printed Circuit Board (PCB) assembly lines have been providing solutions, developing new technologies, and pioneering advancements in the semiconductor industry. Through more efficient resource allocation, production line reconfigurations, and long-term throughput analysis, PCB assembly lines can further enhance production processes and reduce costs through long-run simulations, “what-if” and uncertainty analysis. Simulation-based modeling using ARENA (by Rockwell Automation) provides invaluable insight into entire production lines from raw materials through assembly and quality control. This approach determines the root causes of downtimes, seamlessly identifying bottlenecks, and various forms waste and delays. The simulation model is also used to understand the effect of changes in operational plans, machine breakdown and downtime occurrences, resource allocation, as well as other production line disruptions. PCB assembly lines are always focused on continuous improvement, maintaining a lean supply chain, and optimizing its production lines without relying on simulations. We show that through a simulation-based approach, PCB assembly lines can redesign production schedules and resource allocation by reevaluating production processes, increasing PCB availability and production throughput, and reducing costs and defect rates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出使用 ARENA 仿真软件优化印刷电路板装配线，以提升产能和资源利用率并降低总体成本。作者通过多方案仿真、长期运行分析、“假设情景”分析和不确定性评估，考察生产线配置、资源分配与控制参数对产线表现的影响。研究表明，基于 ARENA 的建模可为从原材料、装配到质量控制的全流程优化提供成本较低且直观的决策支持。

articles.title: Competing phases and domain structures of ferroelectric perovskites: The benefit of epitaxial (110) growth
articles.title_zh: 铁电钙钛矿中的竞争相与畴结构：外延（110）生长的优势
articles.abstract: Author(s): Lan-Tien Hsu, Takeshi Nishimatsu, and Anna Grünebohm Epitaxial strain is a powerful route for engineering ferroelectric phases, yet the role of film orientation remains largely underexplored. Using first-principles-based molecular dynamics, we show that biaxial (110) strain can stabilize a rich variety of nanoscale states, including unusual domains, heterophases, superdomains, and antiferroelectric-like ordering, in the chemically simple perovskites BaTiO 3 , KNbO 3 , and PbTiO 3 . These metastable configurations, persisting across broad strain–temperature ranges, not only point to promising opportunities for large and adaptive functional responses, but also highlight the importance of symmetry breaking by film orientation in ferroelectric materials design. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 064405] Published Mon Jun 08, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用基于第一性原理的分子动力学，考察双轴（110）外延应变对 BaTiO3、KNbO3 和 PbTiO3 等铁电钙钛矿相稳定性的影响。结果显示，（110）取向应变可稳定多种纳米尺度亚稳态，包括非常规畴、异相结构、超畴以及类反铁电有序。研究强调薄膜取向引起的对称性破缺在铁电材料设计中的重要性，并提示其可能带来较大且可调的功能响应。
authors: Lan-Tien Hsu, Takeshi Nishimatsu, and Anna Grünebohm

articles.title: Probing composite structure and spin-orbit coupling with GPDs in ⁴He
articles.title_zh: 利用 ⁴He 中的广义部分子分布探测复合结构与自旋—轨道耦合
articles.abstract: Author(s): Antonio Garcia Vallejo and Matthew D. Sievert Generalized parton distributions (GPDs) encode information of all components of partonic momentum, potentially enabling three-dimensional spatial resolution of a nucleon’s substructure. The authors extend previous formulations of GPDs through a Wigner transform, and demonstrate its utility for the Helium-4 nucleus. The resulting master formula for GPDs manifests a novel spin-orbit coupling that did not appear in earlier implementations and implies additional composite structure. [Phys. Rev. D 113, 114014] Published Mon Jun 08, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕广义部分子分布（GPD）展开，旨在刻画强子或原子核内部部分子的动量与空间结构信息。作者通过 Wigner 变换扩展了既有 GPD 表述，并将其应用于氦-4 原子核。所得主公式揭示了一种此前实现中未出现的新型自旋—轨道耦合，暗示复合核结构中存在额外的内部结构信息。
authors: Antonio Garcia Vallejo and Matthew D. Sievert

articles.title: Theory of relaxation and its effects on the electronic structure in twisted systems
articles.title_zh: 扭转体系中晶格弛豫理论及其对电子结构的影响
articles.abstract: Author(s): Junxi Yu, Bingbing Wang, and Cheng-Cheng Liu Here, the authors present an analytical and physically transparent theory of lattice relaxation in twisted systems. They show how the balance between intralayer elasticity and interlayer adhesion determines the relaxation pattern, and how this pattern can be analytically embedded into moiré electronic Hamiltonians. The work reveals how relaxation reshapes flat bands and shifts topological transitions toward experimentally relevant twist angles. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 245118] Published Mon Jun 08, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种解析且物理图像清晰的扭转体系晶格弛豫理论。作者说明层内弹性与层间黏附之间的竞争如何决定弛豫图案，并展示如何将该图案解析地嵌入莫尔电子哈密顿量。研究表明，晶格弛豫会重塑平带结构，并将拓扑相变推向更接近实验可实现的扭转角范围。
authors: Junxi Yu, Bingbing Wang, and Cheng-Cheng Liu

articles.title: Controlling the Subpicosecond Coherent Spin and Valley Dynamics with Anomalous Magnetic Proximity Effect
articles.title_zh: 利用反常磁近邻效应控制亚皮秒相干自旋与谷动力学
articles.abstract: Author(s): Qian Hu, Yong Tan, Qirui Cui, Yuqing Huang, Wenkai Zhu, Xiaomin Zhang, Yujing Wang, Yue Wang, Xuan Qian, Jing Zhang, Zhongming Wei, Jingbi You, Yang Ji, Lixia Zhao, Qihua Xiong, and Kaiyou Wang Spin-and-valley-tronics explores the spin and valley degree of freedom for power-efficient and high-speed information storage and processing. A critical challenge in advancing spin-and-valley-tronic devices toward quantum operation lies in achieving coherent control over the spin and valley dynamics… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 236701] Published Mon Jun 08, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注自旋—谷电子学器件中自旋和谷自由度的相干调控问题，目标是服务于低功耗、高速信息存储与处理。文章围绕反常磁近邻效应对亚皮秒尺度相干自旋与谷动力学的控制展开。由于所给摘要主要为期刊元数据和引言性信息，具体材料体系、实验手段和定量结论需查阅原文。
authors: Qian Hu, Yong Tan, Qirui Cui, Yuqing Huang, Wenkai Zhu, Xiaomin Zhang, Yujing Wang, Yue Wang, Xuan Qian, Jing Zhang, Zhongming Wei, Jingbi You, Yang Ji, Lixia Zhao, Qihua Xiong, and Kaiyou Wang

articles.title: Layer-number-parity-dependent abnormal magnetic ordering in few-layer CrI3 on N-face AlN substrate
articles.title_zh: N 面 AlN 衬底上少层 CrI3 中依赖层数奇偶性的反常磁有序

articles.title: Spatio-temporal Neural Surrogates for Agent-Based Burn Wound Models
articles.title_zh: 用于基于智能体烧伤创面模型的时空神经代理模型
articles.abstract: Agent-based models (ABMs) of the post-burn immune response capture cell-level heterogeneity and spatially resolved cytokine dynamics, but their cost (hundreds to thousands of seconds per trajectory) limits workflows requiring repeated evaluation, such as parameter sweeps, sensitivity analysis, or Bayesian calibration. Neural surrogates promise to remove this bottleneck, but the relative merits of competing architectures remain unclear. This work benchmarks five surrogate architectures – DeepONet, Physics-Informed DeepONet (PI-DeepONet), U-Net, Spatio-Temporal Attention LSTM (STA-LSTM), and Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) – for predicting cytokine fields from a 2D burn wound ABM, and quantifies the accuracy-speed trade-off. All architectures are trained on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU at two grid resolutions (1002, 2502) and two cytokines spanning the sparsity spectrum (IL-8: <1%; IL-10: up to ∼13%), with performance assessed under temporal interpolation and extrapolation using five metrics (Dice, SSIM, spatial correlation, R2, and Masked RMSE). DeepONet achieves the highest accuracy (R2>0.99 at 2502), while U-Net retains comparable accuracy and trains 17-41× faster, giving the best accuracy-speed balance. Physics-informed variants yield no consistent improvement, reflecting a mismatch between the continuum PDE assumption and the ABM’s discrete, stochastic dynamics, and all architectures struggle on sparse cytokine fields, with the stand-alone PINN failing most severely. Surrogates yield 102-104× per-evaluation speed-ups and amortise their training cost within at most two ABM trajectories, bringing Bayesian calibration and digital-twin pipelines into reach; the binding constraint on further gains is structural, not data-driven.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对烧伤后免疫反应的基于智能体模型计算成本高的问题，比较了 DeepONet、物理信息 DeepONet、U-Net、时空注意力 LSTM 和 PINN 等五类神经代理模型。作者在不同网格分辨率和两种细胞因子场景下评估时间插值与外推性能，并使用 Dice、SSIM、空间相关、R2 和 Masked RMSE 等指标量化精度—速度权衡；结果显示 DeepONet 精度最高，而 U-Net 在保持相近精度的同时训练速度显著更快。

articles.title: Physics-Guided Natural Neighbor Reconstruction of Temperature Fields in Electromagnetic Heating Devices Based on FBG Sensing
articles.title_zh: 基于 FBG 传感的电磁加热设备温度场物理引导自然邻域重构
articles.abstract: Reconstructing the internal temperature field of electromagnetic heating appliances is difficult because the cavity is not readily accessible and the working environment contains strong electromagnetic interference. To overcome these limitations, this study develops a temperature field reconstruction approach that integrates fiber Bragg grating (FBG) temperature sensing with physics-guided interpolation. An FBG temperature sensor with electromagnetic-interference resistance is first designed, and its stability in a high-frequency magnetic field is strengthened by optimizing the encapsulation material and structural dimensions. A dedicated experimental platform is then built to collect multi-point discrete temperature data inside the appliance cavity under different operating conditions. Using these measurements, a natural neighbor interpolation scheme is further enhanced by introducing physical prior information associated with the distance from the heat source, so that a continuous internal temperature field can be reconstructed. The experiments show that the optimized FBG sensor maintains a measurement deviation within ± 2.2°C over 100–350°C and remains highly resistant to interference in high-frequency electromagnetic environments. The proposed reconstruction method also describes near-source temperature gradients more accurately. These findings offer technical support for temperature field characterization and thermal management optimization in electromagnetic heating appliances.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对电磁加热设备腔体难以进入且存在强电磁干扰的问题，提出将光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）温度传感与物理引导插值相结合的内部温度场重构方法。作者优化了 FBG 传感器的封装材料与结构尺寸，并搭建实验平台采集不同工况下的多点温度数据。通过在自然邻域插值中引入与热源距离相关的物理先验，实现连续温度场重构；实验显示优化传感器在 100–350°C 范围内测量偏差保持在 ±2.2°C 以内，并具有较强抗干扰能力。

articles.title: Design and prediction of a wide range sensor based on SPR-PCF for simultaneous measurement of temperature and magnetic field by Taguchi approach and machine learning
articles.title_zh: 基于 Taguchi 方法与机器学习的宽量程 SPR-PCF 温度与磁场同步测量传感器设计与预测
articles.abstract: A novel surface plasmon resonance–photonic crystal fiber (SPR-PCF) sensor is proposed for simultaneous measurement of temperature and magnetic field. The sensor is designed with two orthogonal polarized sensing channels filled with polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) and magnetic fluid (MF), respectively, which enables independent detection of temperature and magnetic field. Taguchi optimization method is employed to optimize the key structural parameters of the sensor. The proposed sensor is designed to operate over a wide temperature sensing range from − 20°C to 80°C, with a maximum sensitivity of 2.849 nm/°C. A magnetic field range of 0 to 50 mT is also covered, with a sensitivity of 1.42 nm/mT. Furthermore, multiple linear regression (MLR) and multilayer perceptron (MLP) machine learning models are applied to predict sensor performance. The MLP model demonstrates strong predictive performance. The mean squared errors for the resonance wavelength under different temperatures and magnetic fields are 3.7478 and 1.3392, respectively, while the coefficients of determination (R2) are 0.9955 and 0.9982, demonstrating the excellent predictive capability of neural network. This work bridges plasmonic, photonic engineering, and machine learning, offering a rapid, highly sensitive tool for industrial temperature and magnetic field monitoring. The proposed sensor exhibits excellent performance and has a wide range of applications, especially in the field of low-temperature industry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种表面等离子体共振-光子晶体光纤（SPR-PCF）传感器，用于温度和磁场的同步测量。传感器采用两个正交偏振通道，分别填充 PDMS 和磁性流体，以实现温度与磁场的相对独立检测，并利用 Taguchi 方法优化关键结构参数。结果表明其温度测量范围为 −20°C 至 80°C、最高灵敏度为 2.849 nm/°C，磁场范围为 0–50 mT、灵敏度为 1.42 nm/mT；机器学习预测中 MLP 模型表现优异，显示出良好的性能预测能力。

articles.title: The Effect of Different Bio-based Fiber Systems on the Comprehensive Performance of Thermal Insulation and Moisture-Regulating Rendering Mortar
articles.title_zh: 不同生物基纤维体系对保温调湿抹灰砂浆综合性能的影响
articles.abstract: Focusing on the need for passive moisture regulation in building materials, this paper develops a moisture-regulating mortar system reinforced with a composite of wood and bamboo fibers. It systematically investigates the mechanisms by which different fiber combinations influence the mortar’s physical capacity, pore structure characteristics, thermal performance, mechanical capacity, and moisture buffering capacity. Furthermore, a comprehensive performance evaluation model and the fiber-to-cement volume ratio (FTCR,Rfc) parameter are introduced to conduct a correlation analysis. The results indicate that the introduction of fibers significantly reduces the dry density of the mortar by approximately 67% and creates a multi-scale pore structure, increasing the specific surface area to a maximum of 54.50 m²/g and lowering the thermal conductivity to 0.097 W/(m·K). In terms of moisture response, the maximum adsorption rate of the bamboo fiber system was approximately 25.8%–40% higher than that of the wood fiber system, and the moisture buffering value (MBV) reached as high as 0.99 g/(m²·RH). Correlation analysis indicated that wood fibers primarily enhance moisture regulation by refining pore size, whereas bamboo fibers achieve this by increasing specific surface area and pore connectivity. Comprehensive performance evaluation results show that the bamboo fiber composite mortar BP-1 achieved the highest overall performance value of 85.81, significantly outperforming both the wood fiber system and ordinary mortar. Further research revealed that while the introduction of diatomaceous earth can optimize the microporous structure, its filling effect disrupts the interconnected pore network, leading to a significant decrease in adsorption capacity and MBV. Overall, bamboo fiber achieves synergistic optimization of thermal-humidity and mechanical capacity by constructing a connected, multi-level pore structure, providing a new structural regulation pathway for the design of high-performance passive humidity-regulating mortars.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向建筑材料被动调湿需求，开发了木纤维与竹纤维复合增强的调湿砂浆体系，并系统分析不同纤维组合对物理性能、孔结构、热工性能、力学性能和湿缓冲能力的影响。结果显示，纤维掺入显著降低砂浆干密度，形成多尺度孔结构，使比表面积最高达 54.50 m²/g，并将导热系数降至 0.097 W/(m·K)。在湿响应方面，竹纤维体系最大吸附速率高于木纤维体系约 25.8%–40%，湿缓冲值最高达 0.99 g/(m²·RH)，表明生物基纤维可有效改善砂浆保温与调湿性能。

articles.title: Use of Sugercane Bagasse Ash (SCBA) as a Partial Replacement of Cement in Concrete Structure: A Comprehensive Review
articles.title_zh: 甘蔗渣灰作为混凝土结构中水泥部分替代材料的应用：综合综述
articles.abstract: Concrete plays an essential role in the foundation of construction today. The production of ordinary Portland cement (OPC) is highly energy-intensive and emits uncontrolled levels of carbon dioxide. The sugar industry has produced a byproduct, the sugarcane bagasse ash (SCBA), which could be a more sustainable approach. SCBA can undergo a series of chemical treatments due to its high amorphous silica content, which can render it highly pozzolanic. This paper evaluates the production processes of SCBA, its chemical and physical properties, and their impacts on concrete. Reports suggest that SCBA replacement at 10–15% cement can increase cement compressive, tensile, and flexural strength in addition to reducing permeability, heat of hydration, and resistance to chemical attacks. There is significant concern about the depletion of natural resources, and SCBA offers a viable alternative that many Circular Economy practices support. There is no doubt that SCBA has great potential, especially in reducing the emission of biogas, however, the lack of uniform standards is a challenge which is extremely difficult to overcome.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述讨论了甘蔗渣灰（SCBA）作为普通硅酸盐水泥部分替代材料在混凝土中的可持续应用潜力。文章总结了 SCBA 的生产过程、化学与物理性质及其对混凝土性能的影响，指出其高非晶二氧化硅含量经适当处理后可表现出较强火山灰活性。已有研究表明，以 10%–15% SCBA 替代水泥可能提高抗压、抗拉和抗弯强度，并降低渗透性、水化热及化学侵蚀风险；但材料标准不统一仍是推广应用的重要挑战。

articles.title: Photoactive network formation mechanism in organic solar cells
articles.title_zh: 有机太阳能电池中光活性网络的形成机制
articles.abstract: The photoactive network in the bulk-heterojunction (BHJ) of organic photovoltaics (OPVs) is vital in determining the power conversion efficiency and long-term stability. However, controlling the morphology of the network – including molecular stacking, interfacial domain compositions, and vertical distribution of the donor and acceptor molecules – during the formation dynamics has proven challenging and has been overlooked in previous research. Here we report a photoactive network formation mechanism of the polymer donor and non-fullerene acceptors within the BHJ layer. A newly employed volatile solid additive, benzothiadiazole (BT) facilitates slower and denser molecular packing of non-fullerene acceptors, inducing uniform vertical phase separation and avoiding molecular aggregation. For the first time, the interfacial photoactive domains were visualized, revealing that the BT blend exhibited 24% and 11% larger acceptor domains in the top surface of BHJ compared to the control and DIO blends, respectively, thereby enhancing charge extraction and transport efficiency. The controlled morphology substantially increased long-term stability T80 to over 1,011 hours. This study elucidates the fundamental mechanisms underpinning the optoelectrical properties and stability of OPV devices and provides integral guidelines in selecting an additive for non-fullerene acceptor systems in BHJ OPVs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注有机光伏体异质结中聚合物给体与非富勒烯受体形成光活性网络的动态机制，该网络形貌对能量转换效率和长期稳定性至关重要。作者引入挥发性固体添加剂苯并噻二唑（BT），促进受体分子更缓慢且更致密地堆积，从而诱导均匀的垂直相分离并抑制分子聚集。研究首次可视化了界面光活性区域，发现 BT 共混体系在 BHJ 顶表面形成更大的受体畴，有助于提升电荷提取和传输效率，并将器件长期稳定性 T80 提高至超过 1011 小时。

articles.title: Median-pi-sigma artificial neural network for time series forecasting
articles.title_zh: 用于时间序列预测的中位数-π-σ人工神经网络
articles.abstract: This study proposes a novel robust artificial neural network architecture, called the Median–Π (Median–Product) Neural Network, for time series forecasting problems involving noisy observations and outliers. Unlike conventional neural network approaches that rely primarily on additive neuron structures and external robustness techniques, the proposed architecture incorporates robustness directly into the computational structure of the network. In the proposed model, a median-based hidden layer is employed to suppress the propagation of anomalous observations and reduce the sensitivity of the network to noise. To compensate for the potential loss of representational capability caused by median processing, a second hidden layer composed of multiplicative product-unit neurons is integrated into the architecture. This hybrid structure enables the model to simultaneously achieve robustness and high-order nonlinear representation capability within a unified framework. Due to the non-differentiable nature of the median operator and the highly nonlinear error surface generated by multiplicative neurons, the network parameters are optimized using a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. The forecasting performance of the proposed architecture was evaluated using ten different Financial Times Stock Exchange (FTSE) time series datasets and compared with several important neural network models in the literature, including multilayer perceptron, Pi-Sigma, multiplicative neuron, recurrent, gated recurrent neural network, Long short-term memory deep artificial neural network, and dendritic neural network architectures. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Median–Π Neural Network achieved the lowest average RMSE values in many of the datasets and generally outperformed competing methods in terms of forecasting accuracy and robustness. Statistical analyses based on the Friedman test further confirmed the superiority of the proposed approach. The findings indicate that integrating median-based robustness with multiplicative nonlinear modelling provides an effective and powerful framework for financial time series forecasting under noisy environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向含噪观测和异常值时间序列预测的鲁棒神经网络结构，称为中位数-Π（中位数-乘积）神经网络。该模型在隐藏层中引入基于中位数的计算以抑制异常观测传播，并通过乘积单元隐藏层补偿中位数处理可能造成的表达能力损失。由于中位数算子不可微且乘积神经元带来高度非线性误差面，作者采用粒子群优化算法训练网络参数，旨在同时获得鲁棒性与高阶非线性表示能力。

articles.title: Experimental and Numerical Analysis of Performance and Emission Characteristics of CI Engine Using Algae Biodiesel/ Bioethanol / SiO 2 Nanoparticles Blends With Hydrogen Addition in Diesel Engine and ANN Prediction Using MATLAB
articles.title_zh: 藻类生物柴油/生物乙醇/SiO₂ 纳米颗粒混合燃料与氢气添加在柴油机中的性能和排放特性实验及数值分析，并基于 MATLAB 的 ANN 预测
articles.abstract: This study evaluates the performance and emission characteristics of a single-cylinder compression ignition engine fueled with algae biodiesel (AB), bioethanol (BE), and silicon dioxide (SiO₂) nanoparticles, with hydrogen (H₂) fumigation as an emission reduction strategy. The objective is to assess the combined impact of these renewable fuel components and additives on engine efficiency and exhaust emissions. Experimental tests were conducted across various engine loads using a primary blend of AB with 10% BE and 50 ppm SiO₂ nanoparticles, while hydrogen was introduced at flow rates of 3 and 6 L/min through port injection. Emissions of hydrocarbons (HC), carbon monoxide (CO), nitrogen oxides (NOₓ), and smoke opacity were measured and analyzed using one-way ANOVA and Tukey’s HSD test (p < 0.05). Results showed that H₂ fumigation at 3 and 6 L/min reduced HC emissions by 33.3% and 46.66%, CO by 57.75% and 77.58%, and smoke opacity by 15.04% and 31%, respectively, compared to diesel. The AB–BE–SiO₂ blend without H₂ reduced NOₓ emissions by 11.69% versus diesel, while H₂ addition increased NOₓ by 20.71% and 39% at 3 and 6 L/min, respectively, due to higher combustion temperatures. The inclusion of SiO₂ nanoparticles enhanced combustion efficiency, resulting in more complete oxidation and lower unburned emissions. An artificial neural network (ANN) model developed in MATLAB accurately predicted engine performance and emissions (R² > 0.98, ARE < 5%), supporting the experimental results. The findings demonstrate that AB, BE, SiO₂ nanoparticles, and H₂ can be synergistically combined to improve diesel engine sustainability, although further NOₓ mitigation is required.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了单缸压燃式发动机使用藻类生物柴油、生物乙醇和二氧化硅纳米颗粒混合燃料，并辅以氢气进气时的性能与排放特性。实验采用 AB、10% BE 与 50 ppm SiO₂ 的主混合燃料，并在 3 和 6 L/min 氢气流量下测试 HC、CO、NOₓ 和烟度等排放，结合 ANOVA 与 Tukey HSD 进行统计分析。结果表明，氢气添加显著降低 HC、CO 和烟度，但因燃烧温度升高导致 NOₓ 增加；未加氢的 AB–BE–SiO₂ 混合燃料则相较柴油降低了 NOₓ 排放。

articles.title: Silicon Carbide Reinforced Bio-Based Alkyd–Polyurethane Coatings: Structure–Property Relationship and Durability Enhancement
articles.title_zh: 碳化硅增强生物基醇酸-聚氨酯涂层：结构-性能关系与耐久性提升
articles.abstract: The growing demand for sustainable materials has accelerated the development of bio-based polymeric coatings as alternatives to petroleum-derived systems. In the present study, polyurethane (PU) nanocomposite coatings were prepared using renewable feedstocks, namely Niger seed oil and itaconic acid, with silicon carbide (SiC) nanoparticles incorporated as reinforcement (1, 3, and 5 wt%). Structural characterization of Niger seed oil-based monoglyceride and alkyd resin was performed using proton nuclear magnetic resonance (¹H NMR) and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR). The prepared PU nanocomposite coatings were evaluated for durability, mechanical, optical, abrasion, and anticorrosive properties. Morphological analysis using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) confirmed uniform nanoparticle dispersion within the PU matrix, while X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis revealed enhanced crystallinity with increasing nanoparticle content. Crosslinking density was assessed through gel content analysis, indicating improved network formation with nanoparticle incorporation. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) demonstrated enhanced corrosion resistance, with nanoparticle-reinforced coatings exhibiting higher impedance, increased charge transfer resistance, and reduced coating capacitance, confirming improved barrier performance. The results further showed that SiC nanoparticles significantly improved abrasion resistance, hardness, chemical stability, hydrophobicity, and overall coating durability. The synergistic effect of long fatty acid chains and ceramic nanoparticle reinforcement contributed to improved surface properties and structural stability. The study highlights the potential of combining Niger seed oil, itaconic acid, and SiC nanoparticles to develop high-performance, sustainable polyurethane coatings as viable alternatives to petroleum-based systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以尼日尔籽油和衣康酸等可再生原料制备生物基聚氨酯纳米复合涂层，并加入 1、3 和 5 wt% 碳化硅纳米颗粒作为增强相。作者通过 ¹H NMR、FT-IR、SEM、XRD、凝胶含量和电化学阻抗谱等方法表征材料结构、分散状态、结晶性、交联密度及防腐性能。结果表明，SiC 纳米颗粒在聚氨酯基体中分散较均匀，可提高结晶度和网络形成程度，并增强涂层的耐磨、力学和抗腐蚀性能。

articles.title: Nickelate superconductors share a common electronic fingerprint
articles.title_zh: 镍酸盐超导体具有共同的电子指纹
articles.abstract: Superconductors, materials that conduct electricity with zero electrical resistance at specific temperature ranges, have proved very promising for the development of quantum computers and other cutting-edge technologies. While most of these materials become superconducting at very low temperatures, others exhibit superconductivity at higher temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道围绕镍酸盐超导体的电子结构特征展开，指出不同镍酸盐超导材料可能共享某种共同的电子“指纹”。超导体能够在特定温度范围内实现零电阻导电，对量子计算和先进电子技术具有重要潜力。原始摘要较短，具体实验方法、材料体系和结论细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Self-organized Floquet band geometry in cavity-driven quantum materials
articles.title_zh: 腔驱动量子材料中的自组织 Floquet 能带几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06579v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Floquet engineering has emerged as a powerful route to dynamically control band structure and topology in quantum materials, but most implementations rely on externally imposed laser fields that are power intensive, difficult to integrate into devices, and weakly coupled to the electronic system. We propose and analyze an alternative paradigm in which a self-generated cavity field Floquet-dresses the electronic bands and produces a geometric Hall response in an electrically driven cavity material system. We consider a semiconductor layer embedded in a cavity and coupled to external leads and a bath of acoustic phonons, where dc pumping leads to the buildup of a coherent intracavity field through light-matter coupling. We determine the resulting nonequilibrium steady state self-consistently and show that, above threshold, the coupled system settles into a stable time-periodic limit cycle with a field amplitude set by the cavity quality factor and dissipation. This emergent periodic field Floquet-dresses the electronic bands and modifies the anomalous Hall response of a material with broken time-reversal symmetry. We demonstrate that the resulting Hall conductivity can be directly probed via in-plane dc transport measurements. Our work establishes a route to self organized Floquet band reconstruction and geometric transport without external laser illumination, highlighting cavity driven steady states as a platform for electrically controlled nonequilibrium phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种不同于外加激光场的 Floquet 工程范式，即由材料-腔耦合体系自发产生的相干腔场来动态修饰电子能带。作者考虑嵌入腔中的半导体层，并将其与外部电极和声子热浴耦合，在直流泵浦下通过光-物质相互作用形成相干腔内场。自洽分析表明，超过阈值后体系进入稳定的时间周期极限环，该自发周期场可 Floquet 修饰电子能带，并改变破缺时间反演对称材料的反常霍尔响应。
authors: Christopher Yang, Gil Refael, Mark S. Rudner, Iliya Esin

articles.title: Bootstrap bounds for Quantum Spin Systems using String Operators
articles.title_zh: 利用弦算符为量子自旋系统建立 Bootstrap 界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06584v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bootstrap is a numerical many-body method that provides rigorous bounds on ground-state observables by imposing a set of necessary constraints on the expectation values of operators. The quality of the resulting bounds is sensitive to the choice of operators entering the constraints. In particular, bounds on ground-state correlations are often loose in spontaneous symmetry-breaking (SSB) phases, since local operator sets cannot exclude domain-wall excitations. In this work, we introduce non-local, string-like operators into the bootstrap and show that the program can be formulated directly in thermodynamic limit. We then apply our construction to several 1D spin models. First, we obtain a significant tightening of the bounds in the SSB phase of the 1D transverse-field Ising model. Using the 1D axial next-nearest-neighbor Ising model, we further show that this tightening allows for a quantitative estimate of the locations of phase boundaries. Finally, we generalize the string operators to the 1D Z₃ chiral clock model and track the behavior of the bounds across the phase diagram. Our results broaden the class of constraints available to the bootstrap and open a route toward bootstrapping more general symmetry-broken and topological phases, where the relevant constraints may involve non-local or extended operators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将非局域弦状算符引入量子多体 bootstrap 方法，以改进基态可观测量的严格数值界限。传统基于局域算符的约束在自发对称性破缺相中往往难以排除畴壁激发，从而导致关联函数界限较松。作者在热力学极限中构建该方法，并应用于一维横场 Ising 模型、轴向次近邻 Ising 模型和 Z₃ 手征钟模型，结果显示弦算符可显著收紧界限，并有助于估计相边界位置。
authors: Nisarg Chadha, Michael G. Scheer, Eslam Khalaf

articles.title: Matching Terahertz and Hall Mobilities as a Hallmark of Intrinsic Charge Transport in Metal-Halide Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 太赫兹迁移率与霍尔迁移率相匹配作为金属卤化物钙钛矿本征电荷输运的标志
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge-carrier transport in soft-lattice materials, including metal-halide perovskites, is often perceived to be highly heterogeneous across different length scales, and influenced by both the intrinsic (dynamic) thermal electronic disorder and extrinsic (static) disorder due to crystal defects, impurities, grain boundaries, and surface states. As a consequence, the reported carrier mobilities obtained by different electrical and optical measurement techniques frequently disagree, raising a critical question: can a truly intrinsic charge transport regime (that is, a regime not dominated by static disorder) extend across macroscopic single crystals of these materials? Here, we demonstrate such a regime in an exemplary metal-halide perovskite system, epitaxial CsPbBr₃ single crystals, where the local mobility obtained via optical pump-terahertz probe (OPTP) spectroscopy quantitatively agrees with the macroscopic transport mobility across a broad range of experimental conditions. Using a dedicated device platform that enables concurrent Hall-effect and OPTP measurements on the same single-crystalline sample, we obtain consistent room-temperature mobilities of ~ 30 cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹, among the highest reliably reported for CsPbBr₃. Both techniques reveal band-like temperature dependence of the hole mobility with similar power exponents, confirming that the same intrinsic transport mechanism governs the ultrafast/local and steady-state/macroscopic responses. These results show that defect-free charge transport is achievable in soft-lattice perovskites on millimetre length scales and establish a robust methodology for benchmarking intrinsic mobility in emerging semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨软晶格材料尤其是金属卤化物钙钛矿中的电荷输运是否能在宏观单晶尺度上进入不受静态无序主导的本征输运 regime。作者以外延 CsPbBr₃ 单晶为例，使用可在同一样品上同时进行霍尔效应和光泵浦-太赫兹探测测量的器件平台，比较局域光学迁移率与宏观输运迁移率。结果显示，在宽范围实验条件下两类迁移率定量一致，表明该材料中存在跨尺度的本征电荷输运行为。
authors: Dmitry R. Maslennikov, Ben P. Carwithen, Vladimir V. Bruevich, Yichao Cai, Davide Nodari, Navendu Mondal, Xijia Zheng, Beier Hu, Nicola Gasparini, Jarvist M. Frost, Vitaly Podzorov, Artem A. Bakulin

articles.title: Charge density waves and enhanced superconductivity in the electron-hole gas: a plausible, simple, physically intuitive model
articles.title_zh: 电子-空穴气中的电荷密度波与增强超导性：一个合理、简单且物理直观的模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A neutral degenerate plasma of equal numbers of electrons and positively charged fermions (holes) -- the electron-hole gas -- is studied using a simple, physically motivated two-parameter model (density rₛ and mass ratio M/m). Two simplifying assumptions are made but not proven: the electron-hole correlation energy is approximately independent of density and does not affect the pressure or bulk modulus, and the electron-hole contribution to the local field factors is zero, allowing use of the known electron-gas local field factors. With these assumptions the phase diagram, instabilities, and effective interactions can be calculated for all mass ratios and densities using simple formulae, reproducible on a laptop. The key new physics is the additional screening provided by the mobile holes. A single function Delta appears in the denominator of all effective interactions and response functions. Near the zeros of Delta at q = 0 (compressibility instability) and at finite q, three phenomena are simultaneously enhanced: charge density waves (for M/m >= 4.97), a large T² electrical resistivity from electron-hole scattering, and an attractive electron-electron interaction that is the purely electronic analog of BCS electron-phonon coupling. Crudely estimated superconducting transition temperatures approach room temperature, reaching approximately 275 K at M/m = 9. No claim is made that this model applies to any specific material. The aim is to provoke scrutiny of the assumptions, calculation of the unknown local field factors, and investigation of whether this minimal two-carrier framework maps onto real systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究由等量电子与带正电费米子（空穴）组成的中性简并等离子体，提出以密度参数 rₛ 和质量比 M/m 为核心的两参数模型。作者在若干简化假设下计算相图、不稳定性与有效相互作用，指出可动空穴带来的额外屏蔽是关键物理机制。模型显示，在响应函数共同分母 Δ 接近零点时，压缩率不稳定性、有限波矢电荷密度波、电子-空穴散射导致的强 T² 电阻率以及吸引相互作用均会得到增强。

articles.title: Descriptor Covariance and Correlation Hierarchy in Moiré Exciton Photoluminescence
articles.title_zh: 莫尔激子光致发光中的描述符协方差与相关层级
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a minimal theory for the spatial organization of photoluminescence spectra in moiré transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers. Motivated by hyperspectral mapping of MoSe₂/WSe₂, which reveals micron-scale correlations among nine peak-decomposition-free spectral descriptors, we propose a descriptor-based disorder-filter picture in which different descriptors probe different components of a multi-scale disorder landscape, producing a hierarchy of spatial correlation lengths. The central result is the correlation hierarchy ξ(Eₘ̊ cₑₙₜ) ge ξ(Eₘ̊ dₒₘ), derived from the decomposition of the dominant-peak energy into a smooth background contribution and a short-range trap-switching fluctuation term. The same framework explains the principal inter-descriptor Spearman correlations, including the near-perfect anti-correlation h̊oₘ̊ S(Δ Eₘ̊ cd, Rₘ̊ HL) approx -0.978 as a robust spectral-shape relation for spectra with a dominant unimodal envelope. The framework provides a peak-decomposition-free route to infer effective disorder parameters from hyperspectral data through the descriptor covariance structure, without microscopic line assignment.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为莫尔过渡金属二硫族化物异质双层中的光致发光光谱空间组织提出一种最小理论，受 MoSe₂/WSe₂ 超光谱成像中多个无峰分解光谱描述符的微米尺度相关启发。作者提出“基于描述符的无序滤波”图像，认为不同描述符探测多尺度无序景观的不同成分，从而产生空间相关长度层级。核心结果是主峰能量相关长度不小于主峰能量相关长度的层级关系，并解释了主要描述符之间的 Spearman 相关性，为无需峰分解地从超光谱数据推断有效无序参数提供路径。

articles.title: Light-tunable quantum metric non-linear Hall response in Berry dipole semimetals
articles.title_zh: 贝里偶极半金属中光可调的量子度规非线性霍尔响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the effect of light on quantum metric-mediated intrinsic nonlinear Hall conductivity in Berry dipole semimetals. We discover that light induces a tunable asymmetry in the off-diagonal part of the quantum metric, which is manifested by an asymmetry in the quantum metric dipole. We show that the nonlinear response can be tuned directly by the light amplitude. In particular, we note that the direction of the nonlinear Hall signal changes when the light amplitude is increased beyond a threshold value. Light thus emerges as a promising stimulus to control the quantum geometric response in topological semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究光照对贝里偶极半金属中由量子度规介导的本征非线性霍尔电导的影响。作者发现，光可在量子度规的非对角部分诱导可调不对称性，并表现为量子度规偶极的不对称。非线性霍尔响应可由光场振幅直接调控，且当振幅超过阈值时信号方向会发生反转，表明光是控制拓扑半金属量子几何响应的有效手段。

articles.title: Multiband superconductivity in the kagome-lattice superconductor Re2Zr
articles.title_zh: kagome 晶格超导体 Re₂Zr 中的多带超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07184v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a first-principles investigation of the electronic structure, lattice dynamics, electron-phonon coupling, and superconducting properties of the hexagonal kagome-lattice compound Re₂Zr, in which time-reversal symmetry breaking and unconventional pairing have recently been proposed. We examine whether superconductivity in Re₂Zr can be explained within a conventional phonon-mediated framework by performing fully ab initio calculations within the density functional theory for superconductors. The electronic structure is characterized by a mixture of seven two- and three-dimensional Fermi surface sheets, giving rise to multiband superconductivity with many overlapping superconducting gaps. A spin-orbit-induced van Hove singularity is identified in the density of states near E_F. The electron-phonon interaction is moderately strong, with a coupling constant łambda simeq 0.88. Superconducting gap calculations reveal significant anisotropy and a broad distribution of gap values across different Fermi surface sheets. Spin fluctuations introduce additional depairing effects and reduce the critical temperature from 7.7 K to 6.4 K, in excellent agreement with the experimental value of 6.65 K. Taken together, our results show that the superconducting energy scale in Re₂Zr can be quantitatively reproduced within a conventional phonon-mediated framework, while the resulting state exhibits pronounced multiband and anisotropic gap structure. The origin of the experimentally suggested time-reversal symmetry breaking, however, remains an open question.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于第一性原理研究六方 kagome 晶格化合物 Re₂Zr 的电子结构、晶格动力学、电子-声子耦合与超导性质，以检验其超导能否由常规声子机制解释。计算显示，该材料具有由多个二维和三维费米面片组成的复杂电子结构，并呈现多带超导与重叠的各向异性超导能隙。作者发现费米能级附近存在自旋轨道耦合诱导的 van Hove 奇点，电子-声子耦合中等偏强；自旋涨落会产生额外破对效应并降低临界温度。

articles.title: On the true low-energy excitations of the three-dimensional spin glass
articles.title_zh: 三维自旋玻璃真实低能激发的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the low-energy excitations of the three dimensional spin glass through a large-scale Monte Carlo simulation on lattices up to L=18. We find smooth extrapolations down to zero temperature, which, in the case of the energy and of the link overlap, can be directly -- and favourably -- compared with previous investigations featuring ground states (i.e., at zero temperature). The best fit for the fractal dimension of the excitations is provided by Replica-Symmetry Breaking theory, but we also consider the alternative TNT description. The P(q) is found to verify the Parisi-Toulouse temperature scaling. Our data provides a spectacular confirmation of the overlap-equivalence hypothesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过大规模蒙特卡罗模拟研究三维自旋玻璃的低能激发，系统尺寸最高达到 L=18。结果显示能量与链重叠等量可平滑外推至零温，并可与已有基态研究良好比较。激发的分形维数最佳拟合支持副本对称性破缺理论，同时作者也考察了 TNT 图像；数据还验证了 Parisi-Toulouse 温度标度和重叠等价假说。
authors: Claudio Chilin, Enzo Marinari, Víctor Martín-Mayor, Giorgio Parisi, Juan J. Ruiz-Lorenzo, David Yllanes

articles.title: Peculiarities Of Phase States In N2O-CO2 Cryoalloys According To Electron Diffraction Data
articles.title_zh: 基于电子衍射数据的 N₂O-CO₂ 低温合金相态特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structural characteristics of n2o-co2 alloys have been studied using transmission electron diffraction (THEED) across the entire range of their mutual concentrations at temperatures of 5 K and 65 K. The ranges in which regular solutions exist and intervals of alloy phase separation have been identified using the dependence of lattice parameters on composition and profile analysis of the diffraction pattern intensity distribution. It was found that maximum solubility values are up to 11 mol.% CO2 in the N2O matrix and up to 30 mol.% n2o in solid co2 at 65 K. The solubility limits for the components at 5 K are less 20 mol.% co2 in crystalline n2o and less than 35 mol.% n2o in a co2 crystal lattice. It was established that the character of n2o-co2 alloy separation corresponds to the mechanism of spinodal decomposition. The relative excess volumes that pertain to the admixture were determined for the CO2 impurity in solid n2o and for n2o impurity in co2 crystal. Conclusions regarding the character of n2o-co2 phase diagram have been made.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用透射高能电子衍射在 5 K 与 65 K 下研究 N₂O-CO₂ 合金在全浓度范围内的结构特征。通过晶格参数随组分变化及衍射强度分布轮廓分析，作者确定了规则固溶体存在范围与相分离区间。结果给出两种组分在不同基体中的溶解度限，并表明该合金的相分离符合旋节分解机制，同时据此讨论了 N₂O-CO₂ 相图特征。
authors: A. A. Solodovnik, O. P. Konotop

articles.title: How Similar Can Fractional Chern Insulators Be to Fractional Quantum Hall States? Moiré-Enhanced Gaps and Excitation-Spectrum Correspondence
articles.title_zh: 分数量子陈绝缘体能与分数量子霍尔态有多相似？莫尔增强能隙与激发谱对应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) realize fractional quantum Hall topology in lattice bands, but their excitation spectra remain far less understood than their ground states. Here we establish a theoretical principle relating the periodic electron-density modulations of flat Chern bands to the many-body gap and excitation spectrum of FCIs. Contrary to the conventional view that such density modulations are detrimental to fractional topology, we show that different reciprocal-lattice Fourier components play sharply distinct roles: components at smaller reciprocal lattice vectors suppress the FCI gap, whereas components at larger reciprocal lattice vectors enhance it. By suppressing the harmful small-wave-vector components and amplifying the beneficial large-wave-vector components, the gap enhancement can, in principle, be made arbitrarily large within the projected flat-band theory. Moreover, the same enhancement factor rescales the full low-energy spectrum, making the FCI excitation spectrum predictable from the corresponding Landau-level problem. We further generalize this correspondence to non-Abelian states. Applying this principle to moiré Chern bands, we identify these reciprocal-lattice density components as practical diagnostics for robust FCIs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了平坦陈能带中周期性电子密度调制与分数量子陈绝缘体多体能隙及激发谱之间的理论联系。与传统认为密度调制不利于分数拓扑的观点不同，作者指出小倒格矢分量会抑制能隙，而大倒格矢分量可增强能隙。通过抑制有害小波矢分量并放大有益大波矢分量，投影平带理论中能隙原则上可被显著增强，且同一增强因子会重标定低能激发谱，从而可由相应朗道能级问题预测 FCI 激发谱。
authors: Siddhartha Sarkar, Yitong Zhang, Kai Sun

articles.title: Topologically Enforced Lifshitz Multicriticality in One Dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维体系中拓扑强制的 Lifshitz 多临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07380v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances have revealed that topology can further enrich the universality classes of quantum phase transitions, thereby extending beyond the traditional paradigms of statistical and condensed matter physics. However, multicriticality between topologically distinct quantum critical lines remains insufficiently explored. In this Letter, we systematically construct and investigate a novel class of topologically enforced Lifshitz multicritical points in one dimensional chiral symmetric fermionic systems. Such multicriticality is driven solely by changes in the topology of neighboring critical lines, beyond previously recognized multicritical points that are typically induced by changes in critical exponents. More importantly, the topologically enforced multicriticality identified here can host robust topological degeneracies while surprisingly exhibiting a breakdown of the Li Haldane bulk boundary correspondence-a phenomenon we elucidate through a simple physical picture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统构造并研究一维手征对称费米子体系中一种新的拓扑强制 Lifshitz 多临界点。该多临界性并非由临界指数变化引起，而是由相邻量子临界线拓扑性质的变化所驱动。作者指出这种拓扑强制多临界点可承载稳健的拓扑简并，同时出人意料地表现出 Li-Haldane 体边对应关系的破缺，并给出相应物理图像。

articles.title: Bulk Superconductivity driven by Disorder-Induced Delocalization in 4Hb-Ta(S₁₋ₓSeₓ₎₂
articles.title_zh: 4Hb-Ta(S₁₋ₓSeₓ)₂ 中由无序诱导退局域化驱动的体超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The unconventional superconductor 4Hb-TaS₂ is a natural heterostructure that can be broadly understood as interleaving Mott-like and metallic layers. We study the properties of this material as a function of quenched disorder in the form of Se/S substitution and find that while disordered samples show bulk superconductivity, clean samples do not. We show that a disorder-driven delocalization of carriers in the Mott-like (1T-) layer forms a new Fermi surface that is absent in the cleanest samples. This suggests that one of the primary drivers for superconductivity is the fragility of the Mott state, whose delocalization brings to life a sea of strongly correlated electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究非常规超导体 4Hb-TaS₂ 在 Se/S 替代引入的淬火无序作用下的性质，该材料可视为 Mott-like 层与金属层交替的天然异质结构。实验发现，有无序的样品表现出体超导，而最洁净样品则不表现出体超导。作者指出，无序驱动 Mott-like 的 1T 层载流子退局域化，形成洁净样品中不存在的新费米面，提示 Mott 态的脆弱性及其退局域化是超导出现的重要驱动力。
authors: Lu Chen, Sae-Hee Ryu, Avior Almoalem, Yuanqi Lyu, Koh Yamakawa, Luke Pritchard Cairns, Ryan Day, Ehud Altman, Daniel Podolsky, Dung-Hai Lee, 4 Vidya Madhavan, Eli Rotenberg, James G. Analytis

articles.title: Amplitude-dependent quantum hydrodynamics from a (o̧th)-Madelung ansatz
articles.title_zh: 来自 coth-Madelung 假设的振幅依赖量子流体动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06561v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate a nonlinear extension of the Madelung transformation based on a hyperbolic phase--amplitude coupling of the form [ Ψ = R eⁱmathθ o̧th R, ] where (R) is a real amplitude field and (θ) is an auxiliary phase coordinate governed by Schrödinger's equation. In contrast to the conventional polar decomposition, this construction imposes a singular hyperbolic relation between amplitude and phase, thereby endowing the Bohmian or hydrodynamic description with an intrinsically geometric structure. We show that the associated velocity field acquires a density-gradient contribution, producing generalized continuity equations and modified quantum force terms. When interpreted as a complex macroscopic order parameter, this generalized phase structure leads to modified superconducting electrodynamics; in particular, the London equations acquire additional contributions that render the Meissner response sensitive to spatial density gradients. The proposed framework is motivated by broader developments involving complex group velocities, dissipative wave propagation, and amplitude-sensitive transport in quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一种非线性 Madelung 变换推广，其中波函数的相位与振幅通过双曲函数形式耦合，而非传统极分解。该构造在振幅与相位之间引入奇异的双曲关系，使 Bohm 型或流体动力学描述具有内禀几何结构。作者表明，相应速度场包含密度梯度贡献，从而导致广义连续性方程和修正量子力；若作为宏观复序参量解释，该相位结构还会修正超导电动力学，使 Meissner 响应对空间密度梯度敏感。

articles.title: Scalable Quantum Algorithms for Gutzwiller Projection
articles.title_zh: 用于 Gutzwiller 投影的可扩展量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06919v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum simulation requires highly accurate input states. Gutzwiller-projected Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) states provide physically motivated input states for solving strongly correlated lattice models, but their preparation on a quantum computer is hindered by the non-trivial nature of the Gutzwiller projection. We construct scalable quantum algorithms for this task by combining a circuit construction for arbitrary BCS states with the amplitude amplification for Gutzwiller projection (AAGP) procedure. AAGP yields a quadratic reduction in the number of projection queries compared with measurement-based postselection and leads to substantially improved fault-tolerant resource scaling. For projected BCS states optimized for the square-lattice t-J model, we find that the projected-state weight decreases exponentially with system size, but the quadratic improvement is still large enough at physically relevant finite sizes to make a decisive practical difference. In particular, for a 100-site benchmark, AAGP reduces the required number of projection queries by about seven orders of magnitude. These results establish AAGP as an enabling input-state preparation protocol for projected BCS states in quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出制备 Gutzwiller 投影 BCS 态的可扩展量子算法，以服务于强关联晶格模型的量子模拟。作者将任意 BCS 态的量子线路构造与用于 Gutzwiller 投影的振幅放大方法结合，使投影查询次数相较基于测量的后选择实现二次减少。对于方格 t-J 模型优化的投影 BCS 态，尽管投影态权重随系统尺寸指数下降，该方法在物理相关有限尺寸下仍显著降低资源需求；在 100 位点基准中，投影查询次数约减少七个数量级。
authors: Byungmin Kang, Hyunwoong Kwon, Vito W. Scarola, Kwon Park

articles.title: Long-range interactions assisted shortcuts to adiabaticity and battery charging in open quantum critical systems
articles.title_zh: 开放量子临界系统中长程相互作用辅助的绝热捷径与量子电池充电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07221v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this work we show that long-range interactions can be significantly beneficial for implementing shortcuts to adiabaticity (STA) in many-body open quantum critical systems driven out of equilibrium, as well as for charging quantum batteries in the presence of dissipation. In sharp contrast to short range interactions where passage through criticality may demand STA control with non-zero interactions between infinitely distant spins, using the example of a Kitaev chain with long-range couplings, we find that the corresponding control may involve involve interaction strength with decays algebraically with distance. In case of non-unitary control, the advantage of long-range interactions manifest through reduction in the cost of STA. We further propose a modified STA technique aimed at charging a quantum battery in the presence of dissipation, in which case long-range interactions may enhance the resultant ergotropy. Our results establish long-range interactions as a valuable resource for quantum control, with direct implications for quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，长程相互作用可显著有利于在非平衡开放多体量子临界系统中实现绝热捷径控制，并有助于存在耗散时的量子电池充电。以具有长程耦合的 Kitaev 链为例，作者发现相应控制只需随距离代数衰减的相互作用强度，而短程体系穿越临界点时可能需要无限远自旋间的非零控制。对于非幺正控制，长程相互作用可降低绝热捷径代价；在量子电池场景中，改进的绝热捷径技术还能提高可提取功，说明长程相互作用是量子控制的重要资源。

articles.title: Driving Exchange Interaction in Spin Qubits with Quasi-Zero Pulses
articles.title_zh: 利用准零脉冲驱动自旋量子比特中的交换相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07472v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The implementation of high-fidelity quantum gates for spin qubits requires accurate control of exchange interactions between electrons confined in quantum dots, but pulse distortions can limit this control accuracy. Although linear-dynamical distortions can be compensated for by appropriately convolving the control signal, determining the necessary convolution requires detailed knowledge of the distortion's transfer function, and therefore the calibration of numerous parameters. Alternatively, control pulses can be designed to have a net-zero time integral canceling out linear-dynamical pulse distortions. We generalize net-zero pulse designs to quasi-zero pulses allowing net-positive but reduced time integrals. Using these pulse designs, we systematically develop complete gate sets for exchange-only qubits, and study the resulting tradeoffs between pulse duration, fidelity, and the required number of tunable parameters, both in simulation and experiment. We benchmark the optimized gate pulses on Intel's Tunnel Falls six-dot device and show they achieve fidelities similar to those obtained with a full filtering approach, with identical pulse durations and fewer tuning parameters. This reduction in complexity opens the door to fast and easily automated calibration schemes compatible with large-scale commercial quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究量子点自旋量子比特中交换相互作用的高精度控制，重点应对控制脉冲畸变对量子门保真度的限制。作者将净零脉冲推广为允许较小正时间积分的“准零”脉冲，并据此为仅交换量子比特系统构建完整门集。通过模拟和在 Intel Tunnel Falls 六量子点器件上的实验基准测试，论文比较了脉冲时长、保真度和可调参数数量之间的权衡，显示其性能可接近完整滤波补偿方法。
authors: Julian D. Teske, Remy L. Delva, Shobhan Kulshreshtha, Yuval Baum, Florian Luthi, Fahd A. Mohiyaddin, Rostyslav Savytskyy, Thomas Watson, Pranav S. Mundada

articles.title: Flat-Band Driven Kondo Breakdown and Reentrant Effects in Heavy-Fermion Moiré Superlattices
articles.title_zh: 重费米子莫尔超晶格中由平带驱动的近藤崩溃与重入效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.06360v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Moiré superlattices (MSLs) in van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures have demonstrated their incredible power in driving emergent electronic phenomena, some of which are reminiscent of those usually only observed in bulk strongly correlated quantum materials. With the recent discovery of van der Waals f-electron materials, the design of novel MSLs of intrinsic strong correlation is now within the reach. Here we study the novel electron phases of two-dimensional heavy-fermion MSL with increasingly diluted f-electron local moments. By applying dynamical mean field theory (DMFT) with numerical renormalization group (NRG) as an impurity solver, we demonstrate the appearance of a new energy scale and a re-entrant Kondo breakdown in connection with the emergence of a flat band in the system. We further compare our numerical findings with predictions derived from the Lieb-Mattis theorem and show the necessity of the new energy scale to consistently reconcile the predictions with the conventional single-impurity limit for exceedingly large unit cells.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究范德华异质结构中二维重费米子莫尔超晶格在 f 电子局域磁矩逐渐稀释时出现的新电子相。作者采用动力学平均场理论并结合数值重整化群杂质求解器，发现平带的出现伴随新的能量尺度，并可诱发重入型近藤崩溃。论文还将数值结果与 Lieb-Mattis 定理的预测进行比较，指出该新能量尺度对于统一大晶胞极限与传统单杂质极限的理解是必要的。
authors: Fabian Eickhoff, Jian-Xin Zhu, Benedikt Fauseweh

articles.title: Emergent topology of flat bands in a twisted bilayer α-T₃ lattice
articles.title_zh: 扭转双层 α-T₃ 晶格中平带的涌现拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.18657v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate an interesting interplay of destructive interference due to lattice geometry and band folding due to enlargement of the Brillouin zone in generating and subsequently modifying the band topology in a twisted bilayer α-T₃ system. The pronounced degeneracy of the emergent flat band in the dice limit of the α-T₃ lattice is removed on alignment with h-BN layers, resulting in the formation of sub-bands with varying topological characteristics. Remarkably, while the sub-band near charge neutrality exhibits a trivial behavior, a topologically non-degenerate singular sub-band emerges away from charge neutrality. The topological band remains isolated from the rest of the bands for a substantial area of the α - θ plane (where α and θ correspond to the hopping ratio and twist angle respectively) while exhibiting multiple phase transitions as a function of the aforementioned parameters via hybridization with its nearest bands. We study the evolution of the hybrid Wannier charge center and the Chern number to characterize the different emergent topological phases. Finally, the degree of flatness of the topological band is studied as a function of both α and θ to explicitly show the influence of quantum interference and band folding on the width of the topological band.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察扭转双层 α-T₃ 系统中由晶格几何导致的破坏性干涉与布里渊区折叠之间的相互作用，以及它们如何生成并改变能带拓扑。在 dice 极限下涌现平带的高度简并性在与 h-BN 层对齐后被解除，形成具有不同拓扑性质的子带。作者通过杂化 Wannier 电荷中心和陈数刻画相图，发现远离电荷中性点处可出现孤立的非平庸拓扑奇异子带，并随跃迁比和扭转角发生多次拓扑相变。
authors: Gourab Paul, Srijata Lahiri, Kuntal Bhattacharyya, Saurabh Basu

articles.title: Quartic level repulsion in a quantum chaotic three-body system without symplectic symmetry
articles.title_zh: 无辛对称性的量子混沌三体系统中的四次能级排斥
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.06772v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among the fundamental symmetry classes of quantum chaotic systems in Dyson's threefold way, the symplectic class is rarely observed in nature. Characterized by the strongest possible level repulsion in the energy spectrum, the symplectic symmetry class also implies a double (Kramers) degeneracy of levels. Studying the spectral statistics of three quantum particles (identical bosons or mass-imbalanced fermions) in a harmonic trap, we find numerical evidence for strong level repulsion in the regime of weak contact interactions. While the statistical indicators are consistent with quantum chaos in systems with symplectic symmetry, the absence of Kramers degeneracy rules out this symmetry. In the strongly-interacting unitary limit either Poissonian or stick statistics are observed (depending on commensurability of the mass ratio) indicating regular dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究谐振陷阱中三个量子粒子在接触相互作用下的能谱统计，包括相同玻色子和质量不平衡费米子情形。数值结果显示，在弱相互作用区域存在强能级排斥，其统计指标类似辛对称量子混沌系统，但由于缺少 Kramers 双重简并，不能归属于辛对称类。在强相互作用的幺正极限，系统根据质量比的可公度性表现为泊松统计或“stick”统计，表明动力学趋于规则。
authors: Alex D. Kerin, Barbara Dietz, Joachim Brand

articles.title: Regularized universal topological markers for Dirac systems
articles.title_zh: Dirac 系统的正则化通用拓扑标记
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.24869v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological markers provide an efficient and powerful characterization of topological features of many systems, especially when the translation symmetry is broken. Recently, a universal topological marker applicable in different symmetry classes of topological systems is proposed. However, it suffers from irregular behaviors at the boundary and its connection to other topological indexes remains elusive. In this work, we construct regularized universal topological markers that apply to Dirac systems by utilizing position operators that are compatible with periodic boundary conditions. The regularized markers eliminate the obstructive boundary irregularities successfully and give rise to the desired global topological invariants, such as the Chern number, consistently when integrated over all the lattice sites. Furthermore, the regularized form allows us to establish an explicit connection between the markers and some other known topological indices in two dimensions. For instance, it turns out to be equivalent to the Bott index in classes A, D, and C and equivalent to the spin Chern number in classes DIII and AII. We further examine the utility and stability of this marker in disordered scenarios. We find that its variance shows peaks at the phase boundaries, which promotes it as a useful indicator for detecting disorder-induced topological phase transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对通用拓扑标记在边界处存在不规则行为以及其与其他拓扑指标关系不清的问题，构造了适用于 Dirac 系统的正则化拓扑标记。作者利用与周期边界条件相容的位置算符消除边界异常，并证明对全晶格积分可一致得到陈数等全局拓扑不变量。进一步地，论文建立了这些正则化标记与二维已知拓扑指标的联系，例如在 A、D、C 类中等价于 Bott 指数，在 DIII 和 AII 类中等价于自旋陈数。
authors: Yulin Qin, Chang-An Li, Jian Li

articles.title: Photon counting beyond the rotating-wave approximation
articles.title_zh: 超越旋转波近似的光子计数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.10950v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Open quantum systems are often described by a Lindblad master equation, which relies on a set of approximations, most importantly the rotating-wave approximation which is only valid for weak damping. In the Lindblad setting, dissipative processes are described through jump operators, distinguishing between absorption and emission of photons. This enables the simple identification of emitted photons which provides a straightforward way to obtain the radiation statistics. Outside the rotating-wave limit, the Lindblad approach does not work. Open quantum systems can then be described by, e.g., the quantum Langevin equation. However, in this framework the number of emitted photons is not easily accessible. In this work, we point out how to obtain the photon counting statistics from a quantum Langevin equation and provide an expression for the photon current operator, for arbitrary systems coupled to linear environments. As an example, we employ the method to study the radiation statistics of a damped harmonic oscillator at finite temperature beyond the rotating-wave approximation. We show that even outside the rotating-wave limit, the most important contribution to the radiation statistics can be captured by an effective Lindblad equation, thus extending the range of possible applications of the Lindblad framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论开放量子系统在旋转波近似失效时如何进行辐射光子计数。与 Lindblad 主方程中可通过跳跃算符区分吸收和发射不同，量子 Langevin 方程框架下发射光子数并不直接可得。作者给出了从量子 Langevin 方程提取光子计数统计的方法，并为耦合线性环境的任意系统推导光子流算符，随后以有限温度下阻尼谐振子为例研究超越旋转波近似的辐射统计。

articles.title: Synchronized Aharonov-Bohm Motifs via Engineered Dissipation
articles.title_zh: 通过工程化耗散实现同步的 Aharonov-Bohm 基元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.19219v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The interplay between external gauge fields and lattice geometry can induce extreme localization dynamics through complete destructive interference. We show that combining this flux-induced localization with engineered dissipation leads to robust spin synchronization in rotationally symmetric spin geometries, referred to as Aharonov-Bohm motifs, with cyclic symmetries of any order. The synchronized dynamics is independent of initial conditions and features entanglement among spins within each motif. We further demonstrate that multiple motifs can fully synchronize when coupled, which is achieved by applying additional collective dissipation acting on all intra-motif spins. These results reveal a direct connection between flux-induced localization, dissipative engineering, and collective quantum synchronization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示外部规范场与晶格几何结合所导致的通量诱导局域化，可与工程化耗散协同产生稳健的自旋同步。作者在具有任意阶循环对称性的旋转对称自旋几何结构，即 Aharonov-Bohm 基元中，展示了与初态无关且包含基元内自旋纠缠的同步动力学。论文进一步表明，通过对基元内自旋施加额外集体耗散，多个耦合基元也可实现完全同步。

articles.title: Lightfall: An API-first, LLM-addressable control platform for synchrotron beamlines
articles.title_zh: Lightfall：面向 API 优先与大语言模型寻址的同步辐射光束线控制平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synchrotron beamlines differ in hardware, technique, and workflow, making customized control interfaces necessary; bespoke per-beamline graphical user interfaces (GUIs) do not scale well, one-size-fits-all facility software forces compromises that leave most of the interface unused, and even recent component-library approaches keep per-scientist tweaks on a developer's queue. We present Lightfall, a control platform designed for facility-wide use, whose API-first architecture exposes every panel, device, and scan plan through a single uniform addressable interface. An embedded language-model agent drives experiments through that interface, from a single move-and-read to a Gaussian-process-driven autonomous scan, while beamline staff extend the interface during operation via skills: plugin modules the agent invokes to compose and modify panels in the running application. The result is a closed development loop: a beamline scientist authors a panel change in natural language, the agent emits and applies it, and the commit lands in the beamline's plugin repository as a side effect. The per-iteration cost of a scientist-driven change is then fixed in the scientist's own time rather than in developer hours the facility must supply. Lightfall is in testing at the COSMIC-Scattering beamline at the Advanced Light Source.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Lightfall，一种面向设施级部署的同步辐射光束线控制平台，旨在解决不同光束线硬件、技术和工作流差异导致的定制界面难以扩展的问题。其 API 优先架构将面板、设备和扫描方案通过统一可寻址接口暴露，并嵌入语言模型代理来执行从简单读写到高斯过程自主扫描的实验流程。平台允许光束线人员通过自然语言和插件式“技能”在运行中扩展界面，从而形成科学家驱动的快速闭环开发流程。
authors: Ronald J. Pandolfi, Damian Guenzing, Marcus M. Noack, Sophie A. Morley, Damon English

articles.title: Expanding LUME to Support Virtual Accelerators and Digital Twins
articles.title_zh: 扩展 LUME 以支持虚拟加速器与数字孪生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07250v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Virtual accelerators and digital twins are increasingly essential tools for accelerator operations, controls development and verification, and model-based optimization. However, current implementations are often tightly coupled to specific simulation codes, facilities, and applications, resulting in fragmented, ad hoc solutions that are difficult to reuse or extend. To address this, we expand the LUME Python package to include standardized implementation and deployment of virtual accelerators and digital twins across heterogeneous simulation backends and control system interfaces.
