articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical spectrometers are fundamental to scientific analysis, yet achieving high performance at low cost remains challenging because uncorrected aberrations rapidly degrade spectral resolution and typically necessitate complex, expensive optics. Moreover, to preserve spectral resolution, many compact designs remain fundamentally throughput-limited in terms of having a high f-number and a narrow slit. Here we present SHADES (Stochastic High-throughput Aberration-free Deep-Encoded Spectrometer), a general framework that mitigates the effects of optical aberrations using a stochastic grating array (SGA) coupled with physically grounded deep learning (DL), while substantially increasing optical throughput using encoded multi-slits. We develop a theoretical framework establishing aberration resilient spectroscopy in compact, highly aberrated systems, enabling miniaturization without sacrificing spectral resolution and optical throughput. SHADES utilizes an arbitrary spectrum generator (ASG) for hardware-in-the-loop calibration with a DL-based reconstruction pipeline. We further leverage transfer learning (TL) to reduce calibration data and computation for scalable deployment of SHADES. Experimentally, a micro-SHADES prototype achieves a spectral resolution of 2.4 nm over 450-700 nm and accurately reconstructs fluorescence spectra for chemical identification. Collectively, SHADES provides an aberration-free, high-throughput, low-cost spectrometer architecture suited for compact and scalable sensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 SHADES，即随机高通量无像差深度编码光谱仪框架，旨在以较低成本在紧凑且高像差系统中保持高光谱分辨率和高通量。该方法将随机光栅阵列与物理约束的深度学习结合，并通过编码多狭缝提高光通量，从而缓解未校正像差对光谱性能的影响。作者还引入任意光谱发生器进行硬件在环校准，并利用深度学习重建流程和迁移学习减少校准数据需求。
authors: Qingze Guan, Zi Heng Lim, Xinchen Wan, Yixiu Shen, Guangya Zhou

articles.title: Inverse Design of Realizable Metasurface based Absorbers using Improved Conditioning and Diversity Enhanced Progressively Growing GANs
articles.title_zh: 基于改进条件机制与多样性增强渐进增长 GAN 的可实现超表面吸收器逆向设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05849v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metasurfaces enable precise manipulation of electromagnetic waves for applications such as beam steering, sensing, and stealth technology. However, inverse design of metasurfaces with targeted EM responses remains challenging due to the computational expense of iterative full wave simulation driven optimization and the limited conditioning fidelity and diversity of existing generative approaches. To address these challenges, this paper presents a generative inverse design framework for controllable and physically consistent metasurface synthesis under continuous spectral constraints. The proposed approach employs a progressively growing Wasserstein generative adversarial network with gradient penalty integrated with feature wise linear modulation based conditioning for stable propagation of continuous spectral and fabrication constraints. EM consistency is embedded directly into the generative learning process through a surrogate assisted spectral alignment loss, enabling physics constrained generation during training. Further, a determinantal point process based diversity regularization strategy is incorporated to generate geometrically diverse yet spectrally consistent realizations for the same target response. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is demonstrated through the generation of practically realizable metasurface absorbers exhibiting diverse reflection characteristics in the frequency range of 2 to 18 GHz. EM simulations validate that the generated designs meet the target specifications with high accuracy. The final proposed framework achieved an average mean squared error of 0.0052, diversity score of 0.8730, band alignment accuracy of 0.8533, and a valid EM design generation percentage of 89.57, clearly demonstrating its capability to generate highly accurate, diverse, electromagnetically consistent and fabrication realizable metasurface configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于超表面吸收器逆向设计的生成式框架，面向连续谱约束下可控且物理一致的结构合成。方法采用带梯度惩罚的渐进增长 Wasserstein GAN，并结合基于特征线性调制的条件机制，以稳定传递连续谱目标和制造约束。作者还通过代理模型辅助的谱对齐损失将电磁一致性纳入训练过程，并引入基于行列式点过程的多样性正则化，以生成更丰富且几何可实现的候选设计。
authors: Vineetha Joy, Mohammad Abdullah, Pramit Pal, Anshuman Kumar, Amit Sethi, Hema Singh

articles.title: Towards stable and accurate electron dynamics via neural network based time-dependent variational Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 基于神经网络的含时变分蒙特卡罗实现稳定而精确的电子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time dynamics of interacting electrons lies at the interface between quantum mechanics and non-equilibrium physics, governing the microscopic origin of ultrafast phenomena of molecules and nano-materials. Though neural network variational Monte Carlo has achieved unprecedented accuracy for stationary state calculations, its extension to real-time evolution remains challenging. In this work, we introduce the neural basis time-dependent variational Monte Carlo framework, which achieves stable and highly accurate simulations of electron dynamics. By constraining the time evolution to a compact, customized manifold spanned by the neural basis, we effectively bypass instability issues and achieve long-term stable evolution. Moreover, we demonstrate that this framework yields benchmark-quality accuracy in simulating the laser-driven dipole responses of the hydrogen atom and a stretched hydrogen molecule, and accurately extracts the dynamic polarizabilities of helium and beryllium atoms. Our work reveals the vast potential of neural network wavefunctions for accurately describing real-time electron dynamics and establishes a promising new route for first-principles simulations of complex, time-dependent electronic phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出神经基含时变分蒙特卡罗框架，用于稳定且高精度地模拟相互作用电子的实时动力学。该方法将时间演化限制在由神经基张成的紧凑定制流形上，从而绕开常规实时演化中的不稳定问题并实现长时间稳定传播。作者在氢原子和拉伸氢分子的激光驱动偶极响应，以及氦、铍原子动态极化率提取中展示了接近基准质量的精度，表明神经网络波函数在实时电子动力学中的潜力。
authors: Weizhong Fu, Zhe Li, Yubing Qian, Ruichen Li, Weiluo Ren, Ji Chen

articles.title: Influence of DFT Functionals on Low-Energy Electron Scattering Cross Sections of Nitric Oxide
articles.title_zh: DFT 泛函对一氧化氮低能电子散射截面的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nitric oxide (NO) is important in biological, atmospheric, plasma, industrial, and astrophysical environments, where reliable electron-collision data support modelling charged-particle interactions with matter. Its well-known experimental properties make it suitable for assessing how the target electronic-structure description affects low-energy electron scattering calculations. In this work, NO properties were evaluated using B3LYP, M06-2X, PBE0, and ømegaB97X-D3, with basis sets ranging from minimal to quadruple-zeta quality. Bond length, dipole moment, ionisation potential, and polarisability were compared with experiment to assess the sensitivity of the target description to the functional and basis set. The aug-cc-pVQZ basis set was then used to generate target models for ab initio R-matrix calculations over 0.1--20 eV. The total cross sections show low-energy resonance features, with the strongest functional dependence around the broad peak near 0.8--1.0 eV. A sharper, higher-energy structure is also observed below 2 eV, shifting from 1.74 to 1.82 eV depending on the functional. Differential cross sections show modest functional sensitivity, with more noticeable angular differences at 7.5 and 10 eV. These results show that the DFT functional and basis set affect the target properties, with the resulting target description influencing low-energy electron-scattering observables of NO. The comparison supports ømegaB97X-D3/aug-cc-pVTZ geometry optimisation followed by aug-cc-pVQZ target-property calculations as a practical protocol for R-matrix modelling of NO.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评估不同密度泛函和基组对一氧化氮靶态电子结构描述及低能电子散射计算的影响。作者比较了 B3LYP、M06-2X、PBE0 和 ωB97X-D3 等泛函在键长、偶极矩、电离势和极化率方面与实验的差异，并使用 aug-cc-pVQZ 基组构建靶模型进行 0.1–20 eV 范围内的从头算 R 矩阵计算。结果显示总截面存在低能共振特征，其中约 0.8–1.0 eV 的宽峰对泛函选择最为敏感，2 eV 以下的较尖锐结构也随泛函发生能量位移。
authors: Ashutosh Yadav, Felipe Fantuzzi, Nigel J. Mason, Bobby Antony

articles.title: Schrodinger dynamics and Berry phase of undulatory locomotion
articles.title_zh: 波状运动的薛定谔动力学与贝里相位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2205.10725v3 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spectral mode representations play an essential role in various areas of physics, from quantum mechanics to fluid turbulence, but they are not yet extensively used to characterize and describe the behavioral dynamics of living systems. Here, we show that mode-based linear models inferred from experimental live-imaging data can provide an accurate low-dimensional description of undulatory locomotion in worms, centipedes, robots, and snakes. By incorporating physical symmetries and known biological constraints into the dynamical model, we find that the shape dynamics are generically governed by Schrodinger equations in mode space. The eigenstates of the effective biophysical Hamiltonians and their adiabatic variations enable the efficient classification and differentiation of locomotion behaviors in natural, simulated, and robotic organisms using Grassmann distances and Berry phases. While our analysis focuses on a widely studied class of biophysical locomotion phenomena, the underlying approach generalizes to other physical or living systems that permit a mode representation subject to geometric shape constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，从活体成像实验数据中推断出的基于谱模态的线性模型，可为蠕虫、蜈蚣、机器人和蛇等系统的波状运动提供精确的低维描述。作者将物理对称性和已知生物约束纳入动力学模型，发现形状动力学通常可在模态空间中由薛定谔方程支配。有效生物物理哈密顿量的本征态及其绝热变化，使得可利用格拉斯曼距离和贝里相位对自然、模拟和机器人生物体的运动行为进行高效分类与区分。
authors: Alexander E. Cohen, Alasdair D. Hastewell, Sreeparna Pradhan, Steven W. Flavell, Jorn Dunkel

articles.title: The Score Hamiltonian: Mapping Diffusion Models to Adiabatic Transport
articles.title_zh: 评分哈密顿量：将扩散模型映射到绝热输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05217v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We exhibit an exact correspondence between sampling with score-based diffusion models and adiabatic transport of ground states for a family of Schrödinger operators we call Score Hamiltonians, built from the learned score's quantum potential. We obtain novel density reconstruction bounds and principled annealing schedules via adiabatic theorems for Fokker-Planck equations with time-varying potentials. We find the fundamental limit of sampling is set by the ratio of squared score-matching error to Score Hamiltonian spectral gap - the inverse Poincaré constant of the data density.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文建立了基于评分的扩散模型采样与一族薛定谔算符基态绝热输运之间的精确对应关系，这些算符被称为评分哈密顿量，由学习到的评分函数的量子势构造。作者利用具有时变势的 Fokker-Planck 方程绝热定理，给出了新的密度重构误差界和有原则的退火调度方案。研究指出，采样的基本限制由评分匹配误差平方与评分哈密顿量谱隙之比决定，后者等价于数据密度 Poincaré 常数的倒数。

articles.title: Nonthermal Particle Acceleration by Magnetic Pumping in Pulsating Plasmas
articles.title_zh: 脉动等离子体中磁泵浦导致的非热粒子加速
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05286v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a new "pulsating box" setup to investigate particle acceleration in high-beta plasmas undergoing compression-expansion cycles. Our fully kinetic simulations show that particles are efficiently accelerated by magnetic pumping, producing nonthermal energy distributions with power-law tails. Numerical results are in excellent agreement with a generalized maximum entropy model that we derive, linking the power-law index of distributions to the injected energy. Our results are relevant for understanding the origin of high-energy particles in space and astrophysical plasmas.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种新的“脉动盒”设置，用于研究经历压缩—膨胀循环的高贝塔等离子体中的粒子加速。全动理学模拟显示，粒子可通过磁泵浦被高效加速，并形成带有幂律尾的非热能量分布。作者推导的广义最大熵模型与数值结果高度一致，并将分布幂律指数与注入能量联系起来，对理解空间和天体物理等离子体中的高能粒子起源具有意义。
authors: Giuseppe Arrò, Vladimir Zhdankin, Fabio Bacchini

articles.title: Deployed trusted-node quantum key distribution over 300 km with a multi-core fiber access link
articles.title_zh: 通过多芯光纤接入链路实现超过300公里的已部署可信节点量子密钥分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06107v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) is increasingly considered for deployment in realistic communication networks, where long distances, heterogeneous fiber infrastructure, and coexistence with classical traffic present substantial challenges. Here, we demonstrate trusted-node QKD between Linköping University and the Stockholm hub of the Swedish national quantum communication infrastructure over 270 km of deployed single-mode fiber, extended by a 33 km multi-core fiber (MCF) segment emulating a metropolitan access link, for a total distance of 303 km. The two sub-links use commercial QKD systems whose receivers are interfaced with external superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors, enabling operation at losses beyond those supported by standard internal gated-mode detectors. We operate the link while actively switching the QKD channel between two MCF cores, with co-propagating Ethernet traffic and injected broadband optical noise in the other cores. The results demonstrate the integration of commercial QKD into demanding, dynamically reconfigurable fiber infrastructure relevant to future hybrid quantum-classical networks. Finally, using the generated secret keys, we illustrate how limited and time-varying QKD throughput affects one-time-pad-protected image transmission: image fidelity depends strongly on the available QKD-generated key budget and the choice of compression algorithm, highlighting application-level challenges for QKD-based encryption in realistic scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了林雪平大学与瑞典国家量子通信基础设施斯德哥尔摩枢纽之间的可信节点量子密钥分发，使用270公里已部署单模光纤，并通过33公里多芯光纤段模拟城域接入链路，总距离达到303公里。实验采用商用 QKD 系统，并将接收端连接外部超导纳米线单光子探测器，以支持高于标准内部门控探测器能力范围的链路损耗。作者还在多芯光纤中主动切换 QKD 信道，同时在其他纤芯中共传以太网流量并注入宽带光噪声，验证了商用 QKD 与动态可重构量子—经典混合光纤基础设施的集成可行性。
authors: Martin Clason, Joakim Argillander, Didrik Bergström, Daniel Spegel-Lexne, Giulio Foletto, Ashraf El Hassan, Mohamed Bourennane, Onur Günlü, Katia Gallo, Rui Lin, Guilherme B. Xavier

articles.title: On the training of physics-informed neural operators for solving parametric partial differential equations
articles.title_zh: 用于求解参数化偏微分方程的物理信息神经算子训练研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06164v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural operators (PINOs) aim to learn solution operators for partial differential equations by using the governing physics as supervision, rather than relying solely on paired input-output simulation data. By incorporating physical constraints into the training objective, PINOs combine the cross-instance generalization of neural operators with the data efficiency of physics-informed learning. Despite this promise, how to train PINOs efficiently and robustly remains less well-understood than the training of either data-driven neural operators or physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). To bridge this gap, we examine key components of the PINO training pipeline, including architecture design, optimizer choice, loss balancing, and collocation-point sampling strategy. We study three representative operator backbones, Deep Operator Network (DeepONet), Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), and Continuous Vision Transformer (CViT), across five diverse parametric PDE systems. Our results show that CViT provides consistently strong and stable performance across the considered benchmarks. Beyond architecture, we find that several optimization pathologies previously identified in PINN training naturally arise in PINOs, including gradient conflicts and causal violation. We also find that mitigation algorithms developed for PINNs remain effective in the PINO setting. We further compare physics-informed and data-driven training under different data regimes, revealing that a carefully designed physics-informed training pipeline can match, and in some cases, outperform purely data-driven neural operators. Taken together, these findings provide a systematic empirical understanding of the optimization challenges in PINO training and inform a practical pipeline for efficient and robust physics-informed operator learning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/NanxiiChen/PI-CViT.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究物理信息神经算子（PINO）在利用控制方程作为监督、学习参数化偏微分方程解算子时的高效稳健训练问题。作者系统考察了训练流程中的关键因素，包括架构设计、优化器选择、损失平衡和配置点采样策略，并在五类参数化 PDE 系统上比较 DeepONet、FNO 和连续视觉 Transformer（CViT）等骨干模型。结果表明，CViT 在所考察基准中表现出较强且稳定的性能，同时训练策略中的若干选择也会显著影响 PINO 的效果。
authors: Nanxi Chen, Chuanjie Cui, Airong Chen, Sifan Wang, Rujin Ma

articles.title: Reactive Flux Matching: Mechanism Discovery and Adaptive Sampling of Rare Events
articles.title_zh: 反应通量匹配：稀有事件的机制发现与自适应采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06295v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Path sampling methods generate ensembles of reactive trajectories connecting metastable states, but extracting mechanistic insight from these data remains nontrivial. We introduce Flux Matching, a framework that learns two complementary objects directly from reactive trajectory data: a current velocity u(z), whose streamlines trace the dominant reaction pathways, and a scalar potential h(z), obtained from a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of the reactive current, that serves as a data-driven reaction coordinate. Both minimize quadratic functionals over the reactive path ensemble, analogous to the flow matching loss in generative modeling, and require no knowledge of the underlying dynamics or stationary distribution. Unlike committor-based methods, u and h remain well-defined under projection onto non-Markovian collective variables, and their level sets in turn provide adaptive interfaces for improved sampling with enhanced sampling methods. Flux Matching is validated through the generation of current velocity trajectories and rate constant calculations on molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出通量匹配框架，用于从连接亚稳态的反应轨迹数据中直接学习反应机制。框架同时学习电流速度场和标量势函数：前者的流线刻画主导反应路径，后者通过加权 Helmholtz-Hodge 分解得到，可作为数据驱动的反应坐标。与基于承诺概率的方法不同，这些量在投影到非马尔可夫集体变量时仍保持良好定义，其等值面还可作为自适应界面以改进增强采样；作者在分子体系上验证了该方法的轨迹生成和速率常数计算能力。
authors: Rishal Aggarwal, David Ryan Koes, Nicholas M. Boffi, Eric Vanden-Eijnden

articles.title: Variational Learning of Physical Intuition from a Few Observations
articles.title_zh: 从少量观测中变分学习物理直觉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.19537v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Humans often predict physical outcomes from only a few observations, a capability known as physical intuition. The mechanisms underlying this efficient learning remain elusive. Here, we introduce a variational learning framework in which small neural networks learn the mapping from observational parameters to optimal physical states from merely two or three similar examples. Demonstrating across classical and quantum regimes including strongly correlated molecules, networks trained this way generalize far beyond the training data. This generalization is explained by a unified theory: it arises when the network approximates a solution manifold where the Euler-Lagrange operator is stationary with respect to observation features. The theory predicts the existence of a critical network size below which robust generalization fails to emerge. Our work establishes variational learning as a principled route to acquiring artificial physical intuition and offers a theoretical perspective for understanding similar capabilities in biological intelligence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种变分学习框架，使小型神经网络能够仅从两三个相似样例中学习从观测参数到最优物理状态的映射，以模拟人类的物理直觉。作者在经典和量子体系中展示了该方法的跨分布泛化能力，包括强关联分子问题。研究给出统一理论解释：当网络近似的解流形使 Euler-Lagrange 算子相对于观测特征处于驻定状态时，泛化能力会出现；理论还预言存在一个临界网络规模，低于该规模则难以产生稳健泛化。

articles.title: Comprehensive Ab Initio Quantum Computations of COₘ̊ ₂-Hₘ̊ ₂ and COₘ̊ ₂-He Collisional Properties
articles.title_zh: CO₂-H₂ 与 CO₂-He 碰撞性质的综合从头算量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.03327v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present comprehensive textslab initio fully quantum calculations of COₘ̊ ₂--Hₘ̊ ₂ and COₘ̊ ₂--He collisional properties. Our framework combines CCSD(T) potential-energy-surface calculations with close-coupling dynamical scattering in the YUMI~framework to derive elastic and inelastic cross sections, rate coefficients, and pressure broadening parameters. We characterize the rotational dependence of the broadening coefficients up to j=25 for COₘ̊ ₂--Hₘ̊ ₂ and j=40 for COₘ̊ ₂--He, and their temperature dependence over 40--800 K. We also provide Padé fits as a function of rotational quantum number, enabling extrapolation and integration into spectroscopic databases including HITRAN and HITEMP. The resulting pressure broadening coefficients reproduce available experimental measurements on an absolute scale, without empirical correction factors, and meet the sim10% precision requirement identified for JWST-era exoplanet atmospheric studies. This represents a substantial improvement over previously available parameters, which at higher temperatures (T>400 K) can fall outside the desired precision by up to a factor of five. All derivations, computed collisional properties, and database-ready products are provided with this manuscript. Together, these results establish a comprehensive textslab initio, parameter-free, fully quantum foundation for CO₂ collisional broadening by H₂ and He, while demonstrating the transformative potential of the ab-initio approach for next-generation spectroscopic needs across planetary atmospheres, combustion, health sciences, and fusion-plasma diagnostics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文开展了 CO₂-H₂ 和 CO₂-He 碰撞性质的综合从头算全量子计算，将 CCSD(T) 势能面计算与 YUMI 框架中的紧耦合动力学散射相结合，以获得弹性和非弹性截面、速率系数及压力展宽参数。作者刻画了展宽系数随转动量子数和温度的变化，并提供 Padé 拟合以便外推和纳入 HITRAN、HITEMP 等光谱数据库。所得压力展宽系数无需经验校正即可在绝对尺度上再现实验测量，并满足 JWST 时代系外行星大气研究所需的约10%精度要求，较既有高温参数有显著改进。
authors: Prajwal Niraula, Laurent Wiesenfeld, Nejmeddine Jaïdane, Julien de Wit, Robert J. Hargreaves, Jeremy Kepner, Deborah Woods, Cooper Loughlin, Iouli E. Gordon

articles.title: A Self-Consistent Model of Kinetic Alfven Solitons in Pulsar Wind Plasma: Linking Soliton Characteristics to Pulsar Observables
articles.title_zh: 脉冲星风等离子体中动理学阿尔芬孤子的自洽模型：将孤子特征与脉冲星观测量联系起来
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.25972v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A self-consistent model is presented for the formation and propagation of kinetic Alfvén (KA) solitons in mass-loaded filaments within the pulsar wind, where a magnetized electron--positron--ion plasma flows along open magnetic field lines beyond the light cylinder. Using a reductive perturbation approach, we derive a Korteweg--de Vries (KdV) equation governing the nonlinear evolution of KA solitons in this environment. The soliton amplitude and width depend sensitively on key pulsar observables, including spin period, spin-down rate, and pair multiplicity, as well as on plasma composition and suprathermal particle distributions. Heavy ion species such as Fe²⁶⁺ produce significantly broader solitons through enhanced inertia and dispersion, while increasing pair multiplicity leads to smaller solitons through stronger screening. More oblique propagation (larger θ) yields wider but lower-amplitude solitons, whereas more thermalized pair plasmas (higher κ) support taller and broader structures. A population-level analysis of 1174 pulsars quantifies the physical scales of these nonlinear structures, showing that millisecond pulsars host the most compact solitons, whereas slower pulsars support broader structures. Within the adopted admissible finite-β regime, this work links soliton properties to measurable pulsar parameters and provides a self-consistent framework for characterizing localized nonlinear plasma structures in finite-magnetization regions of pulsar winds and for assessing their role in modulating the local plasma environment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一个自洽模型，用于描述脉冲星风中载质丝状结构内动理学阿尔芬孤子的形成与传播，其中磁化电子—正电子—离子等离子体沿光柱外开放磁力线流动。作者通过约化摄动方法推导出控制该环境中孤子非线性演化的 Korteweg-de Vries 方程。结果表明，孤子的振幅和宽度对自转周期、自转变慢率、电子—正电子对多重度、等离子体组成及超热粒子分布等观测和物理参数高度敏感；重离子会增大惯性和色散从而形成更宽孤子，而更高对多重度会因屏蔽增强而使孤子尺度减小。
authors: Manpreet Singh, Geetika Slathia, N. S. Saini, Siming Liu

articles.title: A Collimation System Baseline Design for the Electron Storage Ring at the Electron-Ion Collider
articles.title_zh: 电子—离子对撞机电子储存环准直系统的基线设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.19502v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present the baseline design of the electron ring collimation system for the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) at Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL). The system addresses beam losses in a high-current electron storage ring with superconducting (SC) final-focus magnets and sensitive detectors, where uncontrolled losses can generate heat loads, radiation, and detector backgrounds and damage. The proposed collimation insertion localizes halo particle losses through reducing interaction region beam losses from beam-gas and Touschek scattering by several orders of magnitude while keeping detector backgrounds and cryostat heat loads within acceptable limits. Multi-turn particle tracking simulations show that the collimators do not significantly impact machine acceptance or beam lifetime, and their positions and apertures can be re-optimized for future lattice configurations. Ongoing work includes incorporating crab cavities and solenoid fields into simulations, refining vacuum conditions, and optimizing collimator geometry and materials. This design establishes a robust baseline for the EIC electron ring collimation system and supports continued lattice optimization for machine operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文给出了布鲁克海文国家实验室电子—离子对撞机电子环准直系统的基线设计，旨在应对高流强电子储存环中的束流损失问题。该系统通过准直插入段将晕粒子损失局域化，可显著降低由束气散射和 Touschek 散射导致的相互作用区束流损失，并将探测器本底和低温恒温器热负荷控制在可接受范围。多圈粒子跟踪模拟表明，准直器不会显著影响机器接收度或束流寿命，且其位置和孔径可针对未来晶格配置重新优化。
authors: Andrii Natochii (Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York, USA), Elke-Caroline Aschenauer (Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York, USA), Karim Hamdi (Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York, USA), Charles Hetzel (Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York, USA), Eric Link (Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York, USA), Daniel Marx (Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York, USA), Christoph Montag (Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York, USA), Steven Tepikian (Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York, USA), Yunhai Cai (SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory, Menlo Park, California, USA), Yuri Nosochkov (SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory, Menlo Park, California, USA)

articles.title: Meltwater transport and mixing layer growth near the ice--ocean interface
articles.title_zh: 冰—海界面附近融水输运与混合层增长
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.18674v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ice melting into saline water plays a fundamental role in the dynamics near the ice-ocean interface in polar oceans. The physics of ice melting involves a non-trivial interplay between thermodynamics at the interface, hydrodynamic transport in the bulk and the properties of the ambient ocean. The key control parameters are the density ratio Rₕ̊o proportional to the ambient ocean salinity and the Lewis number Le = κ_T/κ_S, which compares the thermal and salt diffusivities. Increasing the salinity is known to slow down melting, with the melt rate transitioning from subdiffusive to diffusive as Rₕ̊o increases. Here, we ssess the role of turbulence in this transition, using highly-resolved numerical simulations of the two-dimensional Boussinesq equations with a slowly melting upper boundary. We analyse the non-stationary growth of the temperature and meltwater mixing layers, varying the Lewis number and the density ratio. While meltwater is continuously entrained by convection inside the bulk, we identify a transition from convection to diffusion close to the interface. This transition is reflected by the formation of an interfacial boundary layer that regulates the flux of meltwater pouring into the turbulent bulk for Rₕ̊o gtrsim 10. Using mixing-layer diagnostics based on meltwater-concentration thresholds, we observe that the turbulent layer grows super-diffusively propto t¹.³³, while the interfacial boundary layer expands diffusively propto t⁰.⁵ but with a non-universal prefactor. These results indicate that double-diffusive effects are here confined to the interface, and highlight potential limitations of diagnostics based on fixed concentration thresholds in oceanographic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注极地海洋中冰在盐水中融化时，冰—海界面附近的融水输运和混合层演化。作者利用高分辨率二维 Boussinesq 方程数值模拟，考察密度比和 Lewis 数对缓慢融化上边界下温度层与融水混合层非定常增长的影响。结果表明，融水虽持续被体内对流卷吸，但在靠近界面处会出现从对流主导向扩散主导的转变，并伴随界面边界层结构的形成。
authors: Sofía Allende, Louis-Alexandre Couston, Simon Thalabard, Benjamin Favier

articles.title: Microwave focusing with temporal interference for non-invasive deep brain stimulation
articles.title_zh: 利用时间干涉的微波聚焦实现非侵入式深部脑刺激
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.18477v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) is an effective treatment for neurological disorders but requires invasive surgery. This work presents a method for non-invasive DBS, based on microwave focusing of amplitude-modulated electric fields using an external antenna array of magnetic point dipoles. The proposed method combines iterative time reversal (iTR) and temporal interference (TI) optimization to jointly address electromagnetic field focusing and physiologically relevant neural stimulation. Antenna element positions, orientations, frequencies, amplitudes, and phases are optimized to localize stimulation within a target region. The method is evaluated in an anatomically realistic voxel head model with heterogeneous and lossy tissue properties. Systematic numerical studies, including perturbation analysis and statistical evaluation, demonstrate consistent spatial localization and robustness across all reported configurations. Safety is quantified using specific absorption rate (SAR), ensuring compliance with exposure limits. The study further provides insight into the influence of key parameters on field behavior and the associated trade-offs between focality, penetration, and safety in physiologically relevant stimulation. To the authors knowledge, this is the first study to combine iTR and TI optimization for microwave-based DBS in a realistic voxel head model, establishing a promising framework for safe non-invasive deep brain stimulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种非侵入式深部脑刺激方法，通过外部磁点偶极子天线阵列产生幅度调制电场并进行微波聚焦。方法结合迭代时间反演与时间干涉优化，同时优化天线位置、方向、频率、幅度和相位，以在解剖真实的非均匀有损头部体素模型中实现目标区域刺激定位。数值研究显示该方法具有较稳定的空间局域性和鲁棒性，并通过比吸收率评估其安全性以满足暴露限制。
authors: Mika Söderström, Melker Carlsson, Patrik Nicolausson, Mariana Dalarsson

articles.title: Turbulent Nature of the Quasicontinuous Exhaust Regime for Fusion Plasmas
articles.title_zh: 聚变等离子体准连续排出机制的湍流本质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.03123v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate a turbulence mechanism that reconciles high plasma confinement with efficient heat exhaust -- a central challenge for fusion energy. Global two-fluid turbulence simulations of the reactor-relevant Quasicontinuous Exhaust regime on the ASDEX Upgrade tokamak reveal that a quasicoherent mode drives mesoscopic oscillations of the pedestal boundary across the magnetic separatrix and ejects ballistic filaments (blobs), reproducing both the mean profiles and turbulent fluctuations observed experimentally. This behavior arises from a synergistic interplay between kinetic ballooning modes and resistive X-point modes straddling the separatrix. These first-principles results place extrapolations to future fusion reactors on a firm physical footing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过ASDEX Upgrade托卡马克中与反应堆相关的准连续排出机制的全局双流体湍流模拟，揭示了兼顾高约束与高效排热的湍流机制。结果表明，准相干模驱动台基边界跨越磁分界面的介观振荡，并喷射弹道式丝状结构，从而再现实验中的平均剖面和湍流涨落。该行为源于跨越分界面的动理学气球模与电阻性X点模之间的协同作用，为未来聚变堆外推提供了第一性原理依据。
authors: Kaiyu Zhang, Wladimir Zholobenko, Andreas Stegmeir, Michael Faitsch, Konrad Eder, Christoph Pitzal, Frank Jenko, ASDEX Upgrade Team

articles.title: Semiautomatic dimensional screening of plastic scintillator cubes using image analysis and robotics
articles.title_zh: 基于图像分析与机器人的塑料闪烁体立方体半自动尺寸筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26732v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large-scale particle physics detectors often contain millions of repeated components, making precise and efficient quality control essential. We have developed a semiautomatic system for dimensional screening of 1 cm³ plastic scintillator cubes for their potential use in future neutrino detectors. The system employs a motorized rotating stage, six high-resolution cameras, and image analysis software to measure cube size, surface protrusions, and the positions of holes for wavelength-shifting fibers used in optical readout. Based on these measurements, each cube is automatically classified as either acceptable or defective. We constructed and validated a prototype system, achieving a measurement precision of 10 μm and over 80% consistency with manual screening. To enable classification of cubes into 48 groups based on hole positions while preserving their orientation, we introduced a 6-axis robotic arm. The completed system achieved a rejection rate of 3.1%. Our approach contributes to scalable, precise, and efficient quality control for future large-scale particle physics detectors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发了一套用于1 cm³塑料闪烁体立方体尺寸筛选的半自动系统，面向未来中微子探测器中大规模重复部件的质量控制。系统使用电动旋转台、六台高分辨率相机和图像分析软件，测量立方体尺寸、表面凸起以及波长转换光纤孔位，并自动判定合格或缺陷。原型验证实现了10 μm测量精度，与人工筛选一致性超过80%；结合6轴机械臂后，可按孔位和方向分为48组，最终系统剔除率为3.1%。
authors: Tatsuya Kikawa, Mao Tani, Atsuko K. Ichikawa, Tsunayuki Matsubara, Tsuyoshi Nakaya, Tomohisa Ogawa

articles.title: How nonlinear spectral back transfer limits the temporal coherency of zonal modes?
articles.title_zh: 非线性谱反向传输如何限制带状模的时间相干性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.03421v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Zonal modes are central to magnetic confinement because their radial shears regulate turbulence and transport. While the generation of these flows is well understood, the mechanisms limiting their persistence in collisionless regimes remain unresolved. In this paper, we demonstrate that nonlinear spectral back-transfer of free energy from zonal modes to turbulence sets the fundamental limit on the temporal coherency of the shearing field. Back-transfer events induce stochastic phase and amplitude scattering of zonal shear that limits its auto-coherence time. Using gyrokinetic GENE simulations, we show that back-transfer is highly intermittent and occurs in bursts that co-exist with the zonal flow generation process. The probability distribution of the zonal free energy transfer is non-Gaussian, with positive triangularity (PT) exhibiting substantially higher kurtosis than negative triangularity (NT), reflecting the markedly more intermittent and heavy-tailed character of back-transfer bursts in PT. We find that NT plasmas exhibit significantly reduced back-transfer compared to PT. This suppression increases the shear auto-coherence time τE and the shearing Kubo number Kᵤ, leading to more resilient and effective turbulence regulation despite lower absolute zonal kinetic energy. These results identify back-transfer as a key nonlinear damping mechanism and suggest that it must be explicitly treated in reduced models of drift-wave zonal-flow turbulence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨无碰撞磁约束等离子体中带状模剪切场持续性的限制机制，指出自由能从带状模向湍流的非线性谱反向传输会限制其时间相干性。基于GENE陀螺动理学模拟，作者发现反向传输高度间歇，并以爆发形式与带状流生成过程共存。研究还比较了正三角形度与负三角形度等离子体，发现负三角形度下反向传输显著减弱，从而有助于提高带状剪切的自相干时间。

articles.title: Noise budget of Cryogenic sub-Hz cROss torsion bar detector with quantum NOn-demolition Speed meter (CHRONOS)
articles.title_zh: 采用量子非破坏速度计的低温亚赫兹交叉扭杆探测器CHRONOS的噪声预算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.05840v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: CHRONOS is a proposed gravitational-wave detector designed to operate in the sub-Hz frequency range (0.1 to 10 Hz), a largely unexplored band due to strong noise sources that hamper ground-based detectors. It employs cryogenic operation, a cross torsion-bar configuration, a triangular Sagnac interferometer, and a speed meter readout scheme to overcome key noise limitations, targeting a strain sensitivity of h sim 10⁻¹⁸ Hz⁻¹/² around 2 Hz and a stochastic gravitational wave background of ØmegaGW approximately 2 × 10⁻³ at 2 Hz. Using analytical and interferometric simulations with FINESSE3, we evaluate the noise budget of CHRONOS and characterize the relative contributions of quantum, thermal, and environmental noise sources. Our results demonstrate that CHRONOS achieves competitive sensitivity at low frequencies. The feasibility of using CHRONOS in an earthquake early-warning system by detecting prompt gravity-gradient signals is also investigated, and is predicted to be faster by approximately 2.92 to 6.90 seconds within 40 km. These findings highlight the scientific potential of CHRONOS, bridging gravitational-wave astronomy and geophysical monitoring, and motivating further development of low-frequency detector technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了拟议中的亚赫兹引力波探测器CHRONOS的噪声预算，该探测器工作在0.1至10 Hz频段，采用低温运行、交叉扭杆结构、三角形Sagnac干涉仪和速度计读出方案。作者结合解析计算与FINESSE3干涉仿真，分析量子噪声、热噪声和环境噪声等来源对灵敏度的贡献。结果表明CHRONOS在低频段具有竞争力，并可能通过探测即时重力梯度信号用于地震预警，在40 km范围内预计可提前约2.92至6.90秒。
authors: Mario Juvenal S. Onglao III, Hsiang-Yu Huang, Yuki Inoue, Vivek Kumar, Daiki Tanabe

articles.title: Picometer-Scale Spatial Symmetry Breaking in Active Transmissive Metasurfaces
articles.title_zh: 有源透射超表面中的皮米尺度空间对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15185v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Active transmissive metasurfaces are central building blocks for future compact, cascadable optical systems, enabling the stacking of multiple functional layers for advanced dynamic beam shaping, photonic neural networks, depth sensing, and holography. We present a transmissive electro-optic metasurface based on silicon-on-lithium-niobate, where an array of silicon waveguides with periodic perturbations, individually controlled at the 100 pm scale, supports well-defined high-Q (>2000) guided-mode resonances (GMRs). We incorporate interdigitated push-pull electrodes between subwavelength-spaced GMR elements to locally tune the refractive index in the lithium niobate substrate, thereby shifting the GMR resonance and enabling opposite phase and amplitude modulation between neighboring radiative elements. In a geometrically symmetric metasurface, this effect introduces electro-optic beam splitting via diffraction, with diffraction efficiencies as high as 3%. By introducing controlled passive resonance detuning via 100 pm scale perturbation shifts, we realize a Vernier-type enhancement mechanism through geometrical symmetry breaking, thereby increasing the efficiency of amplitude modulation six-fold , and achieving modulation depths of 40% at ±30 V. This work demonstrates the potential of active and passive resonance control enabled by high-Q GMR structures for efficient electro-optic modulation or multifunctional sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于硅-铌酸锂平台的透射式电光超表面，其中带周期扰动的硅波导阵列以100 pm尺度进行独立控制，并支持高Q值导模共振。通过在亚波长间隔的共振单元之间集成交指式推挽电极，研究者可局部调节铌酸锂折射率，从而在相邻辐射单元之间实现相反的相位和幅度调制。对称结构中该机制产生电光衍射分束，效率最高约3%；进一步引入100 pm尺度的被动共振失谐，可通过几何对称性破缺实现类似游标效应的增强。
authors: Martin Thomaschewski, Ruzan Sokhoyan, Elisabetta Schneider, Harry Atwater

articles.title: Bounding Eigenstate Overlap from Hamiltonian Moments: Success Probability Guarantees for Quantum Phase Estimation
articles.title_zh: 由哈密顿量矩界定本征态重叠：量子相位估计成功概率保证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.12224v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Estimating the overlap between a prepared state and a target eigenstate is crucial for the efficiency of quantum phase estimation (QPE), since QPE succeeds with probability equal to this overlap. We present a systematically improvable method to compute certified upper and lower bounds on such overlaps using a finite set of Hamiltonian moments. Our approach constructs optimal polynomial upper/lower bounds on an energy-window indicator and evaluates them through linear and semidefinite programs, yielding the tightest bounds consistent with the available moment and spectral-interval information. We demonstrate the method on strongly correlated molecular Hamiltonians and study the impact of approximate moments obtained from tensor-network contractions. The resulting bounds provide a practical pre-QPE screening tool for selecting initial states and can be implemented with either classical moment computation or quantum expectation estimation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种可系统改进的方法，用有限个哈密顿量矩来计算制备态与目标本征态重叠的认证上下界，因为该重叠决定量子相位估计的成功概率。方法构造能量窗口指示函数的最优多项式上下界，并通过线性规划和半定规划求解与已知矩和谱区间信息一致的最紧界。作者在强关联分子哈密顿量上进行了演示，并分析了张量网络收缩得到的近似矩的影响，为量子相位估计前的初态筛选提供了实用工具。

articles.title: PI-JEPA: Label-Free Surrogate Pretraining for Coupled Multiphysics Simulation via Operator-Split Latent Prediction
articles.title_zh: PI-JEPA：通过算子分裂潜空间预测实现耦合多物理场模拟的无标签代理模型预训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.01349v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reservoir simulation workflows face a fundamental data asymmetry: input parameter fields (geostatistical permeability realizations, porosity distributions) are free to generate in arbitrary quantities, yet existing neural operator surrogates require large corpora of expensive labeled simulation trajectories and cannot exploit this unlabeled structure. We introduce PI-JEPA (Physics-Informed Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture), a surrogate pretraining framework that trains emphwithout any completed PDE solves, using masked latent prediction on unlabeled parameter fields under per-sub-operator PDE residual regularization. The predictor bank is structurally aligned with the Lie--Trotter operator-splitting decomposition of the governing equations, dedicating a separate physics-constrained latent module to each sub-process (pressure, saturation transport, reaction), enabling fine-tuning with as few as 100 labeled simulation runs. On single-phase Darcy flow, PI-JEPA achieves 1.9× lower error than FNO and 2.4× lower error than DeepONet at Nₑₗₗ₌₁₀₀, with 24% improvement over supervised-only training at Nₑₗₗ₌₅₀₀, demonstrating that label-free surrogate pretraining substantially reduces the simulation budget required for multiphysics surrogate deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出PI-JEPA，一种物理信息联合嵌入预测架构，用于在无需完整PDE求解轨迹标签的情况下预训练多物理场代理模型。方法在无标签参数场上进行掩码潜空间预测，并对各子算子施加PDE残差正则化；其预测模块与Lie–Trotter算子分裂结构相对应，分别处理压力、饱和度输运和反应等子过程。实验显示，在少量有标签模拟下，该方法在单相Darcy流任务中相较FNO和DeepONet取得更低误差，并优于仅监督训练策略。

articles.title: TinyML-Driven Cybersecurity for Autonomous Spacecraft: Latency-Accuracy Analysis for SPARTA RF and Cyber Threat Detection
articles.title_zh: 面向自主航天器网络安全的TinyML：SPARTA射频与网络威胁检测的延迟—精度分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05779v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autonomous spacecraft require rapid, lightweight, and reliable onboard detection of cyber-RF threats. Using the SPARTA attack model, we analyze the latency-accuracy trade-offs of TinyML-compatible classical models -- Random Forest, Logistic Regression, SVM, and MLP -- for detecting uplink jamming, Fake-NR spoofing, payload manipulation, ground-segment compromise, and unauthorized command injection. We present a physics-informed theoretical analysis of each model's computational complexity, VC dimension, Lipschitz continuity, and latency scaling, supported by empirical measurements on adversarial RF spectrograms generated via BandErasure, FakeNR, and NoiseBurst corruption modes. Results show that Logistic Regression achieves microsecond-level inference with only a 1% accuracy drop relative to Random Forest, making it an effective TinyML baseline for onboard autonomy. The study also identifies opportunities for advancing spacecraft cybersecurity through richer feature encoders and multi-timescale learning architectures, building on recent progress in edge intelligence and trustworthy AI.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向自主航天器的在轨网络与射频威胁检测，基于SPARTA攻击模型比较随机森林、逻辑回归、支持向量机和多层感知机等TinyML兼容模型。作者从计算复杂度、VC维、Lipschitz连续性和延迟缩放等角度进行物理信息理论分析，并在由BandErasure、FakeNR和NoiseBurst生成的对抗射频频谱图上进行实证测试。结果表明，逻辑回归可实现微秒级推理，精度相对随机森林仅下降约1%，适合作为星载自主安全检测的轻量基线。
authors: Van Le, Trevor Tran, Tan Le

articles.title: DAS-PINNs for high-dimensional partial differential equations: extending deep adaptive sampling to spacetime domains
articles.title_zh: 用于高维偏微分方程的DAS-PINNs：将深度自适应采样扩展到时空域
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06314v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Time-dependent high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) with spatially localised and dynamically evolving solutions pose a fundamental challenge for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), as uniform collocation sampling becomes increasingly ineffective in high-dimensional spatiotemporal domains. In this work, a deep adaptive sampling framework for PINNs is extended to the time-dependent setting by treating space and time as a unified domain without any explicit time marching. A normalising flow neural network model effectively learns the distribution induced by the PDE residual and generates new collocation points concentrated in regions where the solution is most difficult to learn. Unlike conventional adaptive strategies that require explicit time stepping or moving meshes, high-residual regions are automatically identified and tracked across both space and time, driven purely by the PDE residual distribution. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is assessed on a range of benchmark problems, from sharp and moving features in two spatial dimensions to localised structures in up to eight spatial dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将面向物理信息神经网络的深度自适应采样框架扩展到含时间的高维偏微分方程，针对空间局部且动态演化解在均匀配点采样下难以学习的问题。方法将空间和时间视为统一域，不采用显式时间推进，并利用归一化流神经网络学习由PDE残差诱导的分布，以在高残差区域生成新的配点。与传统需要时间步进或移动网格的自适应策略不同，该方法可仅凭残差分布自动识别并跟踪时空中的困难区域，并在多类二维到八维空间基准问题上验证有效性。

articles.title: SentinelBench: A Benchmark for Long-Running Monitoring Agents
articles.title_zh: SentinelBench：长时运行监测型智能体基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents are increasingly asked to carry out work that spans minutes, hours, or longer. Yet the default model of agent behavior is continuous action: issuing tool calls, refreshing pages, searching for alternatives, or otherwise trying to force progress. This is the wrong approach for many long-running tasks, which are better served by a strategy of sustained attention. Instead, agents should monitor an environment, notice when an external event makes progress possible, then respond promptly without wasting resources while waiting. To measure progress on this class of tasks, we introduce SentinelBench, an open-source benchmark for time-evolving monitoring tasks. SentinelBench contains 100 tasks across 10 synthetic web environments, including email, calendars, finance, professional networking, and entertainment. Each environment exposes a live web interface and replays a scripted sequence of events, requiring agents to navigate and reason about web pages whose state shifts underfoot. SentinelBench measures task completion, reaction time, and resource use, exposing the tradeoff between responsiveness and cost. We report results across three models and two browser-agent harnesses, establishing performance baselines for future comparison and demonstrating how agent design choices can dramatically impact key metrics. Together, these results show that SentinelBench distinguishes meaningful differences in agent behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出SentinelBench，一个用于评估长时运行监测任务中AI智能体能力的开源基准。作者指出，许多长任务并不适合持续执行工具调用或反复刷新，而应采用持续关注、等待外部事件并及时响应的策略。SentinelBench包含10个合成网页环境中的100项任务，覆盖邮件、日历、金融、职业社交和娱乐等场景，并通过任务完成率、反应时间和资源消耗衡量响应性与成本之间的权衡。
authors: Matheus Kunzler Maldaner, Adam Fourney, Amanda Swearngin, Hussein Mozzanar, Gagan Bansal, Maya Murad, Rafah Hosn, Saleema Amershi

articles.title: Step-adaptive multimodal fusion network with multi-scale cloud feature learning for ultra-short-term solar irradiance forecasting
articles.title_zh: 面向超短期太阳辐照度预测的步长自适应多模态融合网络与多尺度云特征学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultra-short-term solar irradiance prediction is critical for photovoltaic system dispatch and power grid stability. Existing approaches suffer from three key shortcomings: single time-series models cannot capture the spatial dynamics of clouds under complex conditions, standard convolutions inadequately represent multi-scale cloud features, and fixed low-frequency compensation strategies fail to adapt to different prediction steps. To address these issues, this proposes a multi-source data fusion model for ultra-short-term irradiance prediction. The model first employs InceptionNeXt to extract multi-scale, multi-directional spatial features from ground-based cloud images. A step-adaptive low-frequency compensation unit is then introduced to dynamically modulate global low-frequency information based on the prediction step. Eventually, the enhanced image features are combined with meteorological time-series features, and a TempAttnLSTM network captures global temporal dependencies for multi-step prediction. Experiments on the public NREL dataset and practical photovoltaic stations in Shandong illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with several state-of-the-art approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种多源数据融合模型，用于提升超短期太阳辐照度预测，服务于光伏调度和电网稳定。模型首先利用InceptionNeXt从地基云图中提取多尺度、多方向空间特征，再引入步长自适应低频补偿单元，根据预测步长动态调制全局低频信息。随后，增强后的图像特征与气象时间序列特征融合，并由TempAttnLSTM捕捉全局时间依赖以进行多步预测；在NREL公开数据集和山东实际光伏电站数据上的实验验证了其有效性。

articles.title: Predict and Reconstruct: Joint Objectives for Self-Supervised Language Representation Learning
articles.title_zh: 预测与重构：用于自监督语言表示学习的联合目标
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05173v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Masked language modelling (MLM) has been the dominant pre-training objective for text encoders since BERT, yet it encourages representations that are strongly anchored to surface-form token identity rather than deeper semantic structure. Inspired by the success of Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) (LeCun, 2022) in vision and audio, we propose a hybrid pre-training objective that combines a JEPA-style latent-space prediction loss with a standard MLM objective over a single shared encoder. A learnable scalar parameter continuously balances the two objectives during training. We pre-train both a hybrid model and a pure-MLM baseline on English Wikipedia using identical architectures and compute budgets (NVIDIA H100). Extensive representation analysis across five GLUE benchmarks (SST-2, MRPC, MNLI, CoLA, STS-B) using four pooling strategies reveals that the hybrid encoder produces significantly more uniform embeddings (uniformity less than -0.16 vs -0.05 for MLM), exhibits richer spectral geometry under max pooling, encodes less surface-level lexical information, and achieves a better semantic-to-lexical balance. Despite similar linear-probe downstream accuracy, the geometric differences are consistent and significant, suggesting that the JEPA predictive objective reshapes the latent space in ways that standard accuracy metrics alone cannot capture.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对掩码语言建模容易使表示过度依赖表层词形的问题，提出将 JEPA 风格的潜空间预测损失与标准 MLM 目标结合，并由共享编码器和可学习权重共同训练。作者在英文维基百科上以相同架构和计算预算比较混合模型与纯 MLM 基线，并在多个 GLUE 任务和池化策略下分析表示特性。结果表明，混合编码器产生更均匀的嵌入、更丰富的谱几何结构，并减少表层词汇信息编码，从而获得更好的语义—词汇平衡。

articles.title: Agentic Monte Carlo: Simulating Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Agents
articles.title_zh: Agentic Monte Carlo：为黑箱智能体模拟强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05296v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM agents operate in two distinct regimes: open-weight agents amenable to reinforcement learning (RL) and black-box agents whose behaviour must be controlled purely at test time. Although black-box agents are often backed by state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs, API-only access precludes parameter-level optimization, rendering most RL methods inapplicable. To address this limitation, we turn to a known equivalence between RL and Bayesian inference. We propose Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC) to directly sample from the optimal policy of a black-box agent rather than training it through RL. The optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories whose prior we define as the fixed black-box LLM agent. We employ Sequential Monte Carlo to sample from this posterior by learning a value function to steer the agent while leaving the underlying black-box model unchanged. We validate AMC on three diverse environments from the AgentGym benchmark, demonstrating significant improvements over prompting baselines and even outperforming Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as we scale the test-time compute of our method. AMC demonstrates the feasibility of performing principled RL-style optimization of black-box LLM agents. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/Agentic-Monte-Carlo
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注只能通过 API 访问、无法进行参数级强化学习优化的黑箱大语言模型智能体，利用强化学习与贝叶斯推断之间的等价关系提出 Agentic Monte Carlo（AMC）。AMC 将固定黑箱智能体作为轨迹先验，通过序贯蒙特卡洛和学习到的价值函数在测试时引导采样，从而直接近似最优策略而不改变底层模型。实验在 AgentGym 的三个环境中验证了该方法相较提示基线的显著提升，并在增加测试时计算量时可优于 GRPO。
authors: Dae Yon Hwang, Raunaq Suri, Valentin Villecroze, Anthony L. Caterini, Jesse C. Cresswell, Noël Vouitsis, Brendan Leigh Ross

articles.title: The End of Software Engineering: How AI Agents Are Fundamentally Restructuring the Software Paradigm
articles.title_zh: 软件工程的终结：AI 智能体如何从根本上重构软件范式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05608v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For over half a century, software engineering has operated on a foundational premise: human engineers decompose problems, encode decision logic into static code, and manually adapt that code as requirements evolve. This paper argues that the emergence of AI agents -- systems where large language models serve as the primary reasoning engine, dynamically generating and discarding code as an instrumental resource -- constitutes not an incremental improvement but a fundamental restructuring of the software paradigm. Drawing on first-principles analysis of complexity scaling, we formalize the distinction between traditional software (where code is the carrier of decision logic) and agentic systems (where code is ephemeral tooling for an LLM-driven reasoning loop). We trace the historical arc from licensed software to SaaS to what we term Agent-as-a-Service (AaaS), showing that each shift transferred additional complexity away from end-users. We introduce the concept of Agentic Engineering as an emergent discipline -- distinct from software engineering in its core object of study, control model, and human role. Through analysis of recent benchmark evidence including SWE-bench Verified, EvoClaw, and LangChain's multi-agent coordination studies, we demonstrate both the transformative potential of the agentic paradigm and its current limitations. We conclude with a four-stage roadmap toward self-evolving agent ecosystems and concrete recommendations for practitioners navigating this transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从第一性原理出发，论证以大语言模型为核心推理引擎、动态生成和丢弃代码的 AI 智能体并非传统软件工程的渐进改良，而是软件范式的根本重构。作者区分了以静态代码承载决策逻辑的传统软件与以 LLM 推理循环为核心、代码作为临时工具的智能体系统。文章还梳理了从许可软件到 SaaS 再到 Agent-as-a-Service 的演进，并提出“智能体工程”作为区别于软件工程的新兴学科。

articles.title: Cognitive Threat Intelligence and Explainable Federated Security Analytics for distributed Infrastructure Systems
articles.title_zh: 面向分布式基础设施系统的认知威胁情报与可解释联邦安全分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05701v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The increasing adoption of distributed infrastructure systems, cloud computing, Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, and edge-based architectures has significantly expanded the cybersecurity attack surface and introduced increasingly sophisticated cyber threats. Conventional centralized intrusion detection approaches often face challenges related to scalability, data privacy, communication overhead, and limited transparency in artificial intelligence-driven decision-making processes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a Cognitive Threat Intelligence and Explainable Federated Security Analytics framework for distributed infrastructure systems. The proposed framework integrates Federated Learning (FL), Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), and cognitive cybersecurity analytics to enable collaborative and privacy-preserving cyber threat detection across distributed network environments. Instead of transmitting sensitive raw network traffic data to centralized servers, local security models are independently trained at distributed nodes, where only encrypted model parameters and updates are shared through a federated aggregation mechanism. This decentralized learning architecture improves privacy protection while reducing communication dependency and centralized security risks. To enhance intelligent threat analysis, the framework incorporates machine learning and deep learning algorithms including Random Forest, XGBoost, Autoencoder
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向云计算、物联网、边缘架构等分布式基础设施带来的网络攻击面扩大问题，提出一种结合联邦学习、可解释人工智能和认知网络安全分析的安全框架。该框架允许各分布式节点在本地训练安全检测模型，仅共享加密后的模型参数或更新，从而减少敏感流量数据集中传输带来的隐私和通信开销。其目标是在保持协同威胁检测能力的同时，提高系统的可扩展性、隐私保护水平和 AI 决策透明度。
authors: Md. Arifur Rahman, B. M. Taslimul Haque, Md. Iqbal Hossan, Md. Serajul Kabir Chowdhury Rubel

articles.title: DRIFT: A Residual Flow Adapter for Decoding Continuous Outputs in Vision-Language Models
articles.title_zh: DRIFT：用于视觉—语言模型连续输出解码的残差流适配器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05758v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many modern vision-language models (VLMs) build on autoregressive decoding of discrete tokens. While text-based output interfaces enable scalable pretraining and strong zero-shot generalization across diverse tasks, they are poorly suited for problems that require precise continuous outputs, such as localizing temporal boundaries of events or generating robotic control actions. To address this challenge, we propose DRIFT, a general framework for adapting pretrained VLMs to continuous decoding tasks. DRIFT combines a base predictor, which provides a coarse estimate of the target output, with a generative refinement module based on flow matching that iteratively improves the prediction. This residual formulation transforms the generative modeling problem from learning a global output distribution to modeling a localized residual distribution around a strong prior, substantially simplifying optimization. We evaluate DRIFT on both perception and planning tasks, including visual grounding and robotic control. Across multiple tasks and architectures spanning MLLMs, VLAs, and WAMs, DRIFT consistently outperforms a strong set of regression- and generative-based solutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，许多视觉—语言模型依赖离散 token 自回归解码，难以处理事件边界定位、机器人控制等需要精确连续输出的任务。作者提出 DRIFT 框架，将提供粗略估计的基础预测器与基于流匹配的生成式细化模块相结合，以残差形式逐步改进连续输出。该设计将全局输出分布建模转化为围绕强先验的局部残差分布建模，降低了优化难度，并在视觉定位和机器人控制等感知与规划任务中优于多种回归基线。
authors: Zhuoming Liu, Jinhong Lin, Kwan Man Cheng, Lin Zhang, Shayok Bagchi, Yin Li

articles.title: Dual-Mode Functionalization of CNT/Co-ZIF Composites for photoelectric and microwave Absorpting properties
articles.title_zh: CNT/Co-ZIF 复合材料的双模式功能化及其光电与微波吸收性能
articles.abstract: In this study, two composite materials, namely CNT/Co-ZIF-8 and CNT/Fe-ZIF-8, were successfully synthesized. Their microwave absorption and photoelectric properties were systematically characterized and analyzed. For microwave absorption performance, CNT/Co-ZIF-8 exhibits an extremely low reflection loss (RL) of -53 dB at 13 GHz with a thickness of merely 2 mm, demonstrating strong electromagnetic wave attenuation capacity. In contrast, CNT/Fe-ZIF-8 shows a broader effective absorption bandwidth, making it suitable for broadband absorption scenarios. Both composites follow the quarter-wavelength cancellation mechanism, with their absorption peaks shifting to lower frequencies as thickness increases. Regarding photoelectric performance, transient photocurrent (I-t) tests confirm that both CNT/Co-600 and CNT/Fe-600 (derived from the corresponding ZIF-8 composites) generate stable and repeatable photocurrent responses under varying light intensities. Notably, CNT/Co-600 consistently presents higher photocurrent density than CNT/Fe-600, indicating more efficient separation and transfer of photogenerated charge carriers. These findings verify that the metal center in ZIF-8 can effectively regulate the microwave absorption and photoelectric properties of CNT/ZIF-8 composites. This work provides a feasible strategy for designing and developing multifunctional materials with excellent electromagnetic wave absorption and photoelectric conversion performance, which hold broad application prospects in electromagnetic protection and optoelectronic device fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究合成了 CNT/Co-ZIF-8 与 CNT/Fe-ZIF-8 两种复合材料，并系统表征其微波吸收和光电性能。CNT/Co-ZIF-8 在 2 mm 厚度、13 GHz 下表现出低至 -53 dB 的反射损耗，显示出强电磁波衰减能力；CNT/Fe-ZIF-8 则具有更宽的有效吸收带宽。光电测试表明，由相应复合物衍生的 CNT/Co-600 和 CNT/Fe-600 均能产生稳定可重复的光电流响应，其中 CNT/Co-600 的光电流密度更高，说明 ZIF-8 中金属中心可调控电荷分离与传输行为。

articles.title: Mg-Induced Structural and Functional Property Modulation in Ba1+x/2Ti1-xMgxO3 Ceramics for High-Frequency Capacitor Applications
articles.title_zh: Mg 诱导的 Ba1+x/2Ti1-xMgxO3 陶瓷结构与功能性能调控及其高频电容应用
articles.abstract: Magnesium-doped non-stoichiometric barium titanate ceramics with nominal compositions Ba1+x/2Ti1-xMgxO3 (BMT) were synthesized via the conventional solid-state reaction route to investigate the influence of simultaneous A-site excess and B-site acceptor substitution on the structural, microstructural, optical, ferroelectric, and dielectric properties of BaTiO3. X-ray diffraction combined with Rietveld refinement confirmed the formation of a single-phase perovskite structure without detectable impurity phases, demonstrating successful incorporation of Mg2+ ions into Ti4+ lattice sites. Increasing Mg concentration resulted in lattice contraction and reduced tetragonality due to ionic size mismatch and enhanced lattice distortion. Microstructural investigations revealed a significant suppression of grain growth, where defect pinning and solute drag mechanisms reduced the average grain size from ∼2.86 µm for pure BaTiO3 to nearly 1.00 µm for highly doped compositions. Optical studies indicated a gradual widening of the bandgap up to ∼3.22 eV, suggesting improved optical transparency and suitability for optoelectronic applications. Ferroelectric characterization showed a transition from well-defined ferroelectric hysteresis loops in undoped BaTiO3 to slim relaxor-like polarization loops in Mg-substituted ceramics. Dielectric analysis demonstrated a reduction in dielectric permittivity, a downward shift in Curie temperature, and the emergence of diffuse phase transition behaviour, with the BMT3 composition exhibiting a diffuseness parameter (γ) of 3.06. The combined effect of Mg-induced defect chemistry and Ba non-stoichiometry effectively tailors lattice distortion, polarization dynamics, and dielectric stability, making these ceramics promising candidates for high-frequency capacitors and energy-storage applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过传统固相反应法制备非化学计量镁掺杂钛酸钡陶瓷 Ba1+x/2Ti1-xMgxO3，考察 A 位过量与 B 位受主取代对结构、微结构、光学、铁电和介电性能的影响。X 射线衍射与 Rietveld 精修表明样品形成单相钙钛矿结构，Mg2+ 成功进入 Ti4+ 晶格位点；随 Mg 含量增加，晶格收缩、四方性降低且晶粒生长受到明显抑制。光学结果显示带隙逐渐增大至约 3.22 eV，铁电与介电表征则揭示掺杂对高频电容应用相关性能的调控作用。

articles.title: Tiny selective perturbations control violent eruptions without stabilising fusion plasma
articles.title_zh: 微小选择性扰动在不稳定聚变等离子体的情况下控制剧烈喷发
articles.abstract: Systems driven far from equilibrium are often unstable and prone to violent bursts, from hurricanes and turbulent flows to fusion plasmas. Although stabilisation can mitigate such events, it often requires substantial energy and is not always practical. Yet guiding such systems into less destructive states without suppressing their underlying drive remains a central challenge in nonequilibrium science [1,2]. Tokamak fusion plasmas provide an important example because controlling energy release is essential for fusion power production [3, 4]. Their eruptions can impose heat loads exceeding 1 GW m-2 on reactor walls [5], yet can be suppressed by magnetic perturbations of order 0.1% of the confining field strength [6–8]. For over two decades, tokamak experiments have raised a specific question within this broader problem: can such minute perturbations change the macroscopic state without primarily reducing the drive? [8–10] Here, we show that a small spatially patterned magnetic perturbation drives state switching between violent eruptions and gradual dissipation in a fusion plasma. By coordinating the motion of interacting plasma structures, the perturbation strengthens nonlinear interaction and promotes transfer into broadband turbulence. We directly resolve this transfer pathway in a narrow spatial region, and nonlinear simulations reproduce the same structure while showing that the plasma remains unstable. These results support redistribution of energy release rather than simple stabilisation. More broadly, our results suggest a general control principle for far-from-equilibrium dynamics: rather than overpowering the instability, an appropriately structured perturbation can redirect energy release by synchronising interacting structures and strengthening their nonlinear interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注远离平衡系统中剧烈爆发的控制问题，并以托卡马克聚变等离子体中能量喷发为典型案例。作者表明，空间图案化的微小磁扰动能够驱动等离子体在剧烈喷发与渐进耗散状态之间切换，而并非主要通过削弱系统驱动力来实现稳定化。该扰动通过协调相互作用的等离子体结构运动，改变非线性相互作用和宏观状态，为低能耗控制非平衡系统中的破坏性释放提供了思路。

articles.title: Observation of a Mott quantum spin Hall phase in twisted WSe₂
articles.title_zh: 扭转 WSe₂ 中 Mott 量子自旋霍尔相的观测
articles.abstract: Quantum spin Hall (QSH) insulators and Mott insulators are conventionally regarded as distinct insulating phases, arising from band topology and strong Coulomb interactions, respectively. Here, we report the observation of QSH edge transport in a magnetic-field-stabilized Mott insulating state at half filling of the second moiré band in a 2.29° twisted WSe₂ device. This state exhibits a resistance plateau identical to that of the single-particle QSH state at full filling of the first moiré valence band, indicating the same number of helical edge channels. Electrical transport measurements reveal nearly quantized resistance that is insensitive to vertical electric field, out-of-plane magnetic field, and temperature below 5 K. Pronounced nonlocal transport and strong negative in-plane magnetoconductance further support helical edge conduction, establishing robust edge transport in the strongly correlated regime. Temperature-dependent Hall measurements reveal a characteristic temperature scale of approximately 10 K, corresponding to an energy scale of about 1 meV. Our results demonstrate that spin-conserved QSH edge states can persist in a half-filled, strongly correlated insulating phase and under external magnetic field, opening a route toward interaction-resilient topological transport in moiré quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 2.29° 扭转 WSe₂ 器件第二莫尔能带半填充处，观测到由磁场稳定的 Mott 绝缘态中的量子自旋霍尔边缘输运。该态的电阻平台与第一莫尔价带满填充时的单粒子 QSH 态相同，表明二者具有相同数量的螺旋边缘通道。输运测量显示近量子化电阻对垂直电场、面外磁场及 5 K 以下温度不敏感，非局域输运和强负面内磁导进一步支持强关联绝缘相中的稳健螺旋边缘导电。

articles.title: Rapid Multi-Hazard Assessment During Cyclonic Optical Blackouts Using a Dual-Stream SAR and Machine Learning Framework: A Case Study of Cyclone Ditwah, Sri Lanka
articles.title_zh: 气旋光学观测黑障期间基于双流 SAR 与机器学习框架的快速多灾种评估：斯里兰卡 Ditwah 气旋案例
articles.abstract: During a tropical cyclone event, the period spanning pre-landfall outer band impacts through the immediate post-landfall phase constitutes the most critical window for disaster response. This entire window is typically obscured by persistent cloud cover, producing an optical blackout that severely limits the availability of actionable intelligence, which hinders rapid hazard assessment. Cyclone Ditwah (2025) in Sri Lanka presents the most recent instance of this operational constraint. To address this challenge, this study develops a dual-stream hybrid framework for rapid compound hazard assessment by integrating active microwave remote sensing with geomorphically guided machine learning. Stream I utilised Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery to delineate lowland flood inundation under heavy cloud cover. Stream II employed a Random Forest model trained on a balanced inventory (N = 162) to predict rainfall-triggered slope instability in the Central Highlands. Model robustness was evaluated using 5-fold stratified cross-validation, achieving a mean Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.87. To transition from susceptibility to active hazard detection, the static probability surface was coupled with cumulative precipitation derived from NASA GPM IMERG data. The integrated analysis identified distinct meteorological tipping points: lowlands flooded at roughly 180 mm of cumulative rainfall (737 km² footprint), while landslide activation required rainfall exceeding 350 mm on slopes > 25°, generating a 1,077 km² active hazard zone. Spatial overlay analysis revealed a clear hydro-geomorphic divergence, as topography partitioned cyclone impacts into spatially distinct regions. By decoupling atmospheric opacity from terrestrial impact assessment, the proposed framework enables rapid, all-weather hazard intelligence capable of supporting near-real-time disaster response and early situational awareness.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对热带气旋登陆前后关键应急窗口常被持续云层遮蔽、光学遥感信息受限的问题，构建了结合主动微波遥感与地貌约束机器学习的双流混合灾害评估框架。第一流利用 Sentinel-1 合成孔径雷达影像在云下提取低地洪水淹没范围，第二流使用基于平衡样本训练的随机森林模型预测斯里兰卡中央高地降雨诱发的边坡不稳定性。模型经 5 折分层交叉验证得到平均 AUC 为 0.87，并进一步尝试将静态易发性转化为活动灾害识别。

articles.title: Electric potential in media with binomial variation of electrical resistivity
articles.title_zh: 电阻率呈二项式变化介质中的电势
articles.abstract: Instead of the conventional layered half-space model, this study presents the electric potential in a fully layered space where (1) each layer exhibits an electrical resistivity that varies binomially in the transverse direction, and (2) a point source of electric current can be located anywhere.     The analytical solution is expressed as Hankel transforms of functions    involving modified Bessel functions of the first and third kinds, whose arguments are reformulated to avoid negative values, thus allowing the resistivity of each layer to either increase or decrease with depth.     Subsequently, the model is extended to represent a half-space composed of a succession of vertical dikes, in which the binomial variation of resistivity is also transverse to the dike interfaces. The theoretical formulation is numerically stable and has been validated through consistency tests using a pole–pole array moving transversely across four-layered models.     Wenner array profiles were further evaluated for two and three-layered Earth models exhibiting binomial resistivity variation with depth.     In addition, the formulation for the electric potential in vertically stratified media was applied to simulate apparent resistivity logs in directional wells intersecting vertical dikes, using the AMN lateral configuration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种不同于传统层状半空间模型的解析电势表达，适用于各层电阻率在横向方向呈二项式变化且点电流源可位于任意位置的完全层状空间。解析解写成含第一类和第三类修正贝塞尔函数的 Hankel 变换形式，并通过重新构造函数自变量避免负值，以允许电阻率随深度增加或减小。作者还将模型扩展至由垂直岩脉序列组成的半空间，并通过极—极阵列、Wenner 阵列及垂直分层介质测试验证了理论公式的数值稳定性和一致性。

articles.title: Kinetic pathways to hidden quantum states via laser-engineered topological defects
articles.title_zh: 通过激光工程拓扑缺陷通向隐藏量子态的动力学路径
articles.abstract: The deterministic control of quantum phases via ultrafast light-matter interaction lies at the frontier of modern physics. While light can trigger hidden phases inaccessible through equilibrium pathways, these photo-induced metastable states are typically transient or highly volatile, limiting their practical utility. Here, we demonstrate a hybrid optical-thermal strategy that utilizes photo-induced topological defects as kinetic gateways to unlock a robust, hidden charge density wave (CDW) phase in the van der Waals antiferroelectric (AFE) In2Se3. Using complementary ultrafast electron diffraction and microscopy, we show that an initial optical quench induces a metastable state characterized by long-lived topological defects via the Kibble-Zurek mechanism; upon thermal cooling, these defects act as heterogeneous nucleation seeds, lowering the kinetic barrier for the system to evolve thermodynamically into a hidden CDW state. Remarkably, this phase transition is fully reversible: a single laser pulse resets the system to a defect-engineered intermediate phase, preserving the topological landscape for subsequent switching. Our results establish a paradigm for using photo-induced topological defects to imprint kinetic pathways, providing a blueprint for the discovery of hidden quantum landscapes and the development of high-speed, non-volatile memory technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探索利用超快光—物质相互作用确定性控制量子相，并提出一种光学—热混合策略，在范德华反铁电 In2Se3 中解锁稳健的隐藏电荷密度波相。超快电子衍射和显微结果显示，初始光淬火通过 Kibble-Zurek 机制产生含长寿命拓扑缺陷的亚稳态；随后热冷却时，这些缺陷作为异质成核种子降低动力学势垒，使系统进入隐藏 CDW 态。该相变可由单个激光脉冲复位到缺陷工程化中间态，展示了利用光诱导拓扑缺陷调控隐藏量子相的路径。

articles.title: A compact and efficient physics-informed architecture for reconstructing and predicting complex physical fields from low accuracy sparse data
articles.title_zh: 一种用于从低精度稀疏数据重建与预测复杂物理场的紧凑高效物理信息架构
articles.abstract: Complex physical fields are traditionally characterized through high-fidelity simulations or dense sensor networks, which provide detailed information but are often computationally or experimentally costly. Deep learning offers a promising approach for reconstructing and forecasting such fields from limited observations. However, many existing AI-based models rely on large labeled datasets and heavily parameterized architectures, making the models both data-intensive and computationally demanding to train. To overcome these limitations, we introduce compact and computationally efficient physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) designed to reduce both architectural complexity and computational overhead. We demonstrate its performance to reconstruct and forecast complex fields with limited or low-accuracy multiscale spatiotemporal dynamics using laminar and turbulent flows as representative benchmarks. We first demonstrate accurate super-resolution of lid-driven cavity flows at Reynolds numbers up to Re = 1000, where the PINNs reconstruct high-resolution, higher accuracy solutions (401 × 401) from coarse, low-accuracy inputs (40 × 40), reducing error significantly. Extending to three-dimensional Homogeneous Isotropic Turbulence (HIT), the model recovers fine-scale, highly accurate structures from coarse and inaccurate data, preserving key physical and statistical properties. We further show that the framework enables forecasting from limited temporal snapshots, with controlled error growth and accurate prediction of turbulent kinetic energy evolution. Finally, we investigate spatial domain extension, where the model reconstructs flow fields in previously unseen regions. The results reveal that while large-scale structures are recovered robustly, reconstruction fidelity depends strongly on the placement of sparse supervision, with physically informed sampling improving accuracy and energy consistency. The results also demonstrate that the proposed framework scales effectively to larger domains with increasingly complex flow structures. Across the tasks considered, the architecture contains approximately 1-1.5 million trainable parameters and our implementation requires a 3-5 hours of training stage for each task on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU. Together, these results demonstrate that the proposed compact architecture provides a unified and training-efficient route to physics-informed generalization across space and time, enabling the reconstruction and prediction of complex physical fields with multiscale spatiotemporal dynamics from limited observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种紧凑且计算高效的物理信息神经网络，用于在观测稀疏、精度较低的条件下重建和预测复杂物理场。作者以层流和湍流为基准，展示了模型可从粗网格、低精度输入中恢复高分辨率流场，并显著降低误差。该方法旨在减少对大规模标注数据和高参数量网络的依赖，从而降低训练与计算成本。

articles.title: Adsorption and Detection of Cr(VI) on Chitosan-based Fluorescent Hydrogel
articles.title_zh: 壳聚糖基荧光水凝胶对六价铬的吸附与检测
articles.abstract: A multifunctional chitosan-based fluorescent hydrogel (CFH) incorporating cellulose nanofibers (CNF) functionalized with carbon dots (CDs) was successfully fabricated via a free-radical polymerization strategy. The obtained hydrogel exhibited distinct fluorescence properties, with the optimal sample (CFH-7) achieving a quantum yield of 5.7%. CFH-7 demonstrated dual functionality as both an efficient adsorbent and a fluorescence sensor for Cr(VI) in aqueous solutions. Structural characterization confirmed the formation of a three-dimensional porous network, which provided abundant active sites and facilitated rapid ion transport. Under optimal conditions (25°C, pH = 5.0), the maximum adsorption capacity reached 126.5 mg∙g‒1. Adsorption isotherms were better fitted by the Freundlich model, while the adsorption kinetics followed a pseudo-second-order model, indicating a chemisorption-dominated process. In addition, CFH-7 exhibited high selectivity toward Cr(VI), with a linear detection range of 10–120 mg∙L‒1. Mechanistic investigations based on FTIR and XPS analyses revealed that the adsorption and detection processes were governed by electrostatic interactions, redox reactions, and the internal filter effect. The integration of CNF and CD endowed the hydrogel with a synergistic structure–function coupling, enhancing both adsorption capacity and fluorescence response. Overall, CFH-7 represents a promising multifunctional material for the simultaneous detection and removal of Cr(VI) in water treatment applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过自由基聚合制备了引入碳点功能化纤维素纳米纤维的壳聚糖基荧光水凝胶，并评估其对水溶液中Cr(VI)的吸附和荧光检测能力。最佳样品CFH-7具有三维多孔网络、较高选择性和良好的吸附性能，在25°C、pH 5.0条件下最大吸附容量达126.5 mg·g⁻¹。吸附过程更符合Freundlich等温模型和准二级动力学模型，机制主要涉及静电作用、氧化还原反应及官能团配位等。

articles.title: Low-quality food drives divergent remodeling of the gut microbiota in Eothenomys miletus and Apodemus chevrieri
articles.title_zh: 低质量食物驱动大绒鼠与齐氏姬鼠肠道微生物群的差异化重塑
articles.abstract: Small herbivorous mammals at high altitudes face the severe challenge of decreased food quality in winter. Gut microbiota, as a key interface connecting host and low-quality food, plays an important role in adapting to stress. This study investigated two sympatric rodent species, Eothenomys miletus and Apodemus chevrieri, to explore the dynamic response characteristics and adaptive strategies of their gut microbiota under low-quality food conditions. The results showed that E. miletus exhibited a 'targeted enhancement' pattern based on core dominant bacteria (such as Sporobacter, Anaerostipes, etc.). The ecological network was characterized by a simplified structure and high modularity, and the key connectors gradually decreased. A. chevrieri showed more intense community turnover, typically characterized by an increase in Muribaculaceae and a decrease in Escherichia. The ecological network showed stronger dynamic fluctuations, and key nodes were replaced more frequently. Overall, E. miletus tends to rely on a relatively stable microbiota structure to utilize low-quality food, whereas A. chevrieri depends more on dynamic microbiota adjustments to maintain community homeostasis. Our findings not only clarify how differences in resource utilization mediated by the gut microbiome support host tolerance, but also provide an important scientific basis for understanding how rodents achieve niche occupation through differentiated co-evolutionary strategies with symbionts in high-altitude environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较了同域分布的大绒鼠和齐氏姬鼠在低质量食物条件下肠道微生物群的动态响应与适应策略。结果表明，大绒鼠主要通过增强核心优势菌并维持较稳定、模块化的生态网络来利用低质量食物；齐氏姬鼠则表现出更剧烈的群落更替和关键节点替换。研究说明，不同小型高海拔草食性哺乳动物可通过不同的微生物群调控策略应对冬季食物质量下降。
