articles.abstract: Nature Photonics, Published online: 05 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01914-2 Ball lightning is not fully understood. It has been proposed that a stable lump of electromagnetic energy, known as a soliton, could be responsible, but such structures are usually microscopic. Now, high-power laser experiments have produced millimetre-scale relativistic solitons, indicating that they could indeed explain the phenomenon.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文章讨论球状闪电这一尚未完全理解的现象，并介绍其可能由稳定的电磁能量团块即孤子解释的观点。传统上这类孤子通常尺度很小，但近期高功率激光实验产生了毫米尺度的相对论孤子。该结果表明，相对论孤子机制可能为解释球状闪电提供新的物理线索。

articles.title: Time-frequency analysis of nonlinear Compton scattering via joint probability distributions
articles.title_zh: 基于联合概率分布的非线性康普顿散射时频分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interaction of charged particles with an intense laser pulse gives rise to a number of characteristic spectral features of emitted radiation, including the generation of harmonics, spectral broadening due to the phase-dependent ponderomotive red shift, and the emergence of intricate sub-harmonic structures. These effects are accumulated over the course of the interaction with the electromagnetic field and are therefore inherently nonlocal in nature. For a deeper understanding of strong-field quantum electrodynamics (SFQED) processes and their practical applications, it is desirable to employ tools that enable simultaneous analysis in the time and energy domains. In time-frequency analysis, such tools are provided by joint distributions (JDs). In this work, we demonstrate how a JD can be devised within the SFQED framework. Specifically, we focus on constructing a non-negative JD, which allows for a clear probabilistic interpretation. We study the properties of the proposed distribution and test its utility by applying it to the nonlinear Compton scattering in complex laser pulse configurations with carrier-envelope phase and variable polarization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究强激光脉冲中带电粒子相互作用导致的非线性康普顿散射谱特征，包括谐波产生、谱展宽和亚谐波结构。作者在强场量子电动力学框架下构造非负联合分布，以实现对辐射过程在时间和能量域中的同步概率解释。该方法被用于分析具有载波包络相位和复杂脉冲结构的激光场中的非线性康普顿散射。

articles.title: A Highly Sensitive Surface Plasmon Resonance Sensor for Reliable Fuel Adulteration Monitoring
articles.title_zh: 用于可靠燃料掺假监测的高灵敏表面等离子体共振传感器
articles.abstract: This work investigates the design and performance analysis of an optimized Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) sensor aimed at enhancing the detection sensitivity of fuel adulteration. A sodium-based SPR structure coated with MoS₂, Ta₂O₅, TiO₂, and AlON thin films is proposed for real-time fuel monitoring. The optical response of the sensor is analyzed using the Transfer Matrix Method (TMM), its performance is validated through Finite Element Method (FEM) simulations within the Kretschmann configuration at a near-infrared wavelength of 1550 nm. Key performance parameters, including sensitivity, figure of merit (FOM), and limit of detection (LOD), are evaluated to assess the sensing capability of the proposed structure. The optimized configuration achieves maximum sensitivities of 205.8270 deg/RIU and 524.7584 deg/RIU for petrol and diesel samples, respectively, demonstrating its strong potential for detecting low concentrations of kerosene in fuel. These results indicate that the proposed sodium-based SPR sensor offers high sensitivity, reliability, and practical applicability for fuel quality monitoring.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究设计并评估了一种用于检测燃料掺假的优化表面等离子体共振传感器。作者提出钠基 SPR 结构，并覆以 MoS₂、Ta₂O₅、TiO₂ 和 AlON 薄膜，通过传输矩阵法和有限元模拟分析其在 1550 nm 近红外波长下的光学响应。优化结构对汽油和柴油样品表现出较高折射率灵敏度，显示出检测燃料中低浓度煤油掺杂的潜力。

articles.title: First example of a CdCl2 infinite-chain hybrid grafted in an alternating fashion by quinoline-sulfonate ligands: synthesis, crystal structure and spectral analysis
articles.title_zh: 首例由喹啉磺酸盐配体交替接枝的 CdCl₂ 无限链杂化物：合成、晶体结构与光谱分析
articles.abstract: A novel cadmium-based inorganic–organic hybrid material, [Cd2Cl4(C9H5NO4S)(C9H6NO4S)(C4H7N2)3·2H2O]n (1) namely, tris(2-methyl-1H-imidazol-3-ium) poly[µ₂-chlorido-cadmium(II)-(quinolin-8-ol-5-sulfonato)-(quinolin-8-olate-5-sulfonato)], has been synthesized and structurally characterized using single-crystal X-ray diffraction, thermal analysis, vibrational spectroscopy, and photophysical studies. Compound 1, crystallizes in the triclinic space group P-1 with Z = 2, a = 9.4201(9) Å, b = 14.0776(14) Å, c = 15.7984(16) Å, α = 79.690(5)°, β = 78.935(5)°, γ = 82.090(6)° and V = 2011.3(4) Å3. The compound features a neutral one-dimensional CdCl2 infinite-chain motif alternately grafted by two quinoline-derived sulfonate ligands: the monoanionic quinolin-8-ol-5-sulfonate and the dianionic quinolin-8-olate-5-sulfonate. Each cadmium center adopts a distorted octahedral geometry and is bridged by µ₂-chlorido ligands, yielding a regularly alternating grafted architecture. Structural analyses reveal distinct geometric and electronic environments at the cadmium sites, influenced by the ligand denticity and deprotonation state. The trianionic coordination polymeric chain is stabilized by three 2-methyl-1H-imidazol-3-ium counterions and forms a dense supramolecular network via hydrogen bonding. Thermal behavior reveals a three-step decomposition profile consistent with loss of water, counterions, and ligand degradation. UV–Vis analysis shows strong ligand-centered π–π* and n–π* transitions, while fluorescence measurements display a green emission owing to the π*→π relaxation of the fully deprotonated ligand. These results underline the relevance of alternating cadmium sulfonate chains for optical applications and structural diversity in coordination polymers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究合成并表征了一种新型镉基无机—有机杂化材料，其结构包含一维 CdCl₂ 无限链骨架，并由两类喹啉衍生磺酸盐配体交替接枝。单晶 X 射线衍射显示该化合物属于三斜晶系 P-1 空间群，镉中心呈畸变八面体配位并由 μ₂-氯桥联。热分析、振动光谱和光物理研究进一步揭示了配体去质子化状态与配位方式对局部结构和电子环境的影响。

articles.title: Research on Multi-dimensional Peak Detection Algorithm for BeiDou Reflected Signals
articles.title_zh: 北斗反射信号多维峰值检测算法研究
articles.abstract: GNSS-R is a novel microwave remote sensing technology that uses the characteristics of reflected signals from navigation satellites to estimate geophysical parameters. The method has been applied to estimate parameters such as sea surface height, soil moisture, ocean wind speed, significant wave height, and snow depth. While GNSS-R receives reflected signals via a left-hand circularly polarized (LHCP) antenna, it inevitably also picks up co-channel clutter and direct signals, which complicates the purification of the reflected signals. This study investigates a peak detection algorithm for reflected and direct signals in BeiDou signal receivers. The algorithm uses the differences in the propagation paths of direct and reflected BeiDou signals to define independent search intervals. Noise suppression is achieved through preprocessing using a two-point moving average filter, while potential signal peaks are extracted using the local maximum method. An initial screening of candidate peaks is performed based on constraints such as minimum peak height, minimum peak spacing, and minimum peak width. The algorithm then verifies the signals by combining the "amplitude-position-half-width-phase" criteria, ultimately extracting key parameters including the true chip positions, amplitudes, and phases of the direct and reflected signals. This algorithm addresses the shortcomings of traditional single-threshold algorithms that rely solely on amplitude filtering. The system has been shown to effectively differentiate between direct and reflected signals, thereby ensuring the elimination of false peak interference. Consequently, it enhances peak detection accuracy and improves interference resistance in scenarios where weak reflected signals are present. MATLAB simulations of the algorithm were conducted, and the results indicate that the position detection error for BeiDou direct and reflected peaks is ≤ 0.03 code segments, with a phase deviation of ≤ 2°.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对 GNSS-R 中北斗反射信号易受同频杂波和直达信号干扰的问题，提出一种用于接收机中直达与反射信号识别的峰值检测算法。算法依据两类信号传播路径差异设置独立搜索区间，并通过两点移动平均滤波抑噪、局部极大值提取候选峰。随后结合峰高、峰间距、峰宽以及幅度—位置—半宽等特征进行筛选与验证，以提高反射信号检测的可靠性。

articles.title: Entropy-engineered perovskite heterointerfaces suppress lattice-distortion-induced carrier localization and operational fatigue
articles.title_zh: 熵工程钙钛矿异质界面抑制晶格畸变诱导的载流子局域化与运行疲劳
articles.abstract: The operational instability of metal halide perovskites stems from an intrinsic coupling between lattice distortion, carrier localization and fatigue under cyclic stress. Here we report an entropy-engineered chiral heterointerface strategy that disrupts this degradation pathway. A trifluoromethyl-substituted chiral spacer cation is introduced at the buried interface to construct a low-dimensional heterostructure with enhanced dipolar interactions. The resulting heterointerface homogenizes the electrostatic potential, suppresses localized electronic states and relaxes the orientational constraints of formamidinium cations, thereby increasing configurational entropy and enhancing lattice adaptability under repeated illumination, thermal and electrical stresses. Together with chiral-induced spin-selective transport, this strategy promotes carrier delocalization, efficient charge extraction and spatially uniform recombination. Target device achieves a power conversion efficiency of 26.91% and retains 91.3% of their initial efficiency after 1,400 h of maximum power point tracking. This work establishes entropy engineering as a general framework for designing fatigue-resistant perovskite photovoltaics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种熵工程手性异质界面策略，用于缓解金属卤化物钙钛矿中晶格畸变、载流子局域化和循环应力疲劳之间的耦合退化。作者在埋底界面引入三氟甲基取代手性间隔阳离子，构筑低维异质结构以增强偶极相互作用、均匀化静电势并提高构型熵。所得器件实现 26.91% 的光电转换效率，并在最大功率点跟踪 1400 小时后保持初始效率的 91.3%，表明该策略有助于设计抗疲劳钙钛矿器件。

articles.title: Nanoscale 0.94NBT–0.06BT near the Morphotropic Phase Boundary: Hydrothermal Design and Enhanced Ferroelectric Energy Conversion
articles.title_zh: 准同型相界附近纳米级 0.94NBT–0.06BT：水热设计与增强铁电能量转换
articles.abstract: Lead-free ferroelectric nanomaterials have attracted considerable interest for sustainable electronic and energy harvesting technologies. In this work, 0.94NBT–0.06BT nanoparticles were synthesized via a hydrothermal method and incorporated into a flexible Polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) matrix to fabricate a high-performance ferroelectric composite. X-ray diffraction confirmed the formation of a pure perovskite phase, while Rietveld refinement revealed the coexistence of rhombohedral (R3c) and tetragonal (P4mm) structures near the Morphotropic Phase Boundary region. Raman spectroscopy further verified the distorted lattice through characteristic TiO₆ vibrational modes. FESEM analysis showed uniformly distributed nanoparticles with an average size of ~ 167 nm and homogeneous dispersion within the PVDF matrix. The material exhibited strong ferroelectric behavior with a maximum polarization of 40 µC/cm2, remanent polarization of 33 µC/cm2, and coercive field of 26 kV/cm. The composite demonstrated promising energy harvesting capability, generating an open-circuit voltage of 4.47 V and a maximum power output of 2.57 µW at 35 Hz, highlighting its potential for flexible self-powered electronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用水热法合成无铅铁电 0.94NBT–0.06BT 纳米颗粒，并将其引入柔性 PVDF 基体制备铁电复合材料。结构表征显示材料形成纯钙钛矿相，并在准同型相界附近存在菱方相和四方相共存，纳米颗粒在基体中分散较均匀。该复合材料表现出较强铁电性能，并在 35 Hz 下产生开路电压和微瓦级功率输出，显示其在柔性自供能电子器件中的应用潜力。

articles.title: Cortical and Subcortical Correlates of Perceptual Responses during Sinusoidal Galvanic Vestibular Stimulation: A BOLD fMRI Study
articles.title_zh: 正弦电流前庭刺激期间知觉反应的皮层与皮层下相关机制：一项 BOLD fMRI 研究
articles.abstract: The cortical and subcortical circuitry underpinning motion sickness is poorly understood. However, certain regions – including the nucleus of the solitary tract (NTS) and the parieto-insular vestibular cortex (PIVC) – are known to be involved in the generation of nausea. The PIVC, in particular, is believed to serve an important role in the processing of vestibular inputs. We have previously used low-frequency sinusoidal galvanic vestibular stimulation (sGVS) to induce perceptions of side-to-side motion, which also induces nausea in ~ 40% of people. While sGVS has been previously used with brain imaging to investigate vestibular pathways, those studies used shorter bouts of stimulation (~ 30 s) which did not induce nausea. Here, we have used functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) to record blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signal-intensity changes at baseline (5 min), during low-frequency sGVS for a sustained period of time (± 2 mA, 0.08 Hz, 100 cycles; ~21 min) and during a recovery period (9 min) in 17 participants. Surprisingly, however, only four participants reported incipient or overt nausea during stimulation. Nevertheless, two regions displayed BOLD signal-intensity changes associated with the long-form (as opposed to previously used short-form) stimulation: the nucleus accumbens and locus coeruleus. Though sensations of nausea were not as apparent as expected (perhaps due to the necessity of participants adopting a supine position with their heads fixed in place), these regions would appear to be more associated with a longer period of vestibular stimulation, perhaps required to evoke sensations of nausea.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用功能磁共振成像考察低频正弦电流前庭刺激期间与运动感知和恶心相关的脑区活动。17 名参与者接受基线、约 21 分钟刺激和恢复期扫描，但仅有少数人在刺激期间报告初发或明显恶心。尽管如此，研究仍观察到部分脑区 BOLD 信号变化，为理解前庭输入、运动错觉及晕动症相关神经环路提供了数据。

articles.title: Superconducting Triple Point in UTe₂: Thermodynamics and Symmetry
articles.title_zh: UTe₂ 中的超导三重点：热力学与对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05210v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Three lines of second-order phase transitions between the normal phase and two distinct superconducting phases meet at a single point on the phase diagram of UTe₂. Contrary to common belief, there are no thermodynamic constraints for such triple points. The phase diagram is interpreted within Landau theory in terms of two superconducting order parameters with different gauge symmetries. Such an interpretation is unique under the assumption of spatial uniformity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文讨论 UTe₂ 相图中正常相与两个不同超导相之间三条二级相变线汇聚于一点的现象。作者指出，与通常看法不同，此类三重点并不受热力学原理禁止。文章在朗道理论框架下，将相图解释为具有不同规范对称性的两个超导序参量所致，并指出在空间均匀性假设下该解释具有唯一性。

articles.title: Fermiology and the Candidate Chiral Superconductor in Rhombohedral Tetralayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱方四层石墨烯中的费米面结构与候选手性超导态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05356v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral superconductivity, in which the phase of the superconducting order parameter winds in momentum space, has long been sought for its close link to topological superconductivity. Recent work reported a superconductor in rhombohedral multilayer graphene emerging from a time-reversal symmetry broken normal state, suggesting that it could be a chiral superconductor. However, the possibility of chirality depends on the symmetry and structure of the normal-state Fermi surface, which have not been directly measured. Here we measure quantum oscillations in rhombohedral tetralayer graphene over a broad range of the phase diagram, including the superconducting region. At densities well above the onset of superconductivity, we reproduce previously-reported oscillations consistent with a spin- and valley-polarized quarter metal with a single simply-connected Fermi pocket. As the carrier density is reduced, we find a transition to a complex "multitone" state that persists through the superconducting region. This state's spectrum of quantum oscillations is incompatible with a simply-connected quarter metal. The next-simplest candidate normal states suggested by our microscopic modeling (fully-polarized annular, nematic, and three-pocket states) are inconsistent with our measurements, albeit difficult to rule out entirely. The normal state is thus seen to be richer than previously envisaged, reshaping the search for the superconducting mechanism and the possible chirality of the pairing channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过量子振荡测量考察菱方四层石墨烯在宽广相图范围内的费米面结构，包括超导区域。作者在较高载流子密度下观察到与自旋和谷极化四分之一金属相一致的振荡特征，而在较低密度下发现延伸至超导区的复杂“多音”状态。该状态的量子振荡谱与简单连通的四分之一金属费米面不相容，为判断其候选手性超导性质提供了关键正常态信息。
authors: Sandesh S. Kalantre, Ben H. Alexander, Julian May-Mann, Jonah Herzog-Arbeitman, Marisa Hocking, Qingrui Cao, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, David Goldhaber-Gordon, Andrew J. Mannix, Trithep Devakul, Yves H. Kwan, Daniel E. Parker, Aaron Sharpe

articles.title: Superconductivity beyond band geometry: emergence of pair quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 超越能带几何的超导性：配对量子几何的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry shapes the effective mass of Bloch particles through the geometric properties of single-particle states. Here we show that this principle extends to paired states. Starting from a generic multiband Hubbard model, we derive an exact effective-mass theorem for two-body bound states and its many-body counterpart for Cooper pairs near the critical temperature within Gaussian fluctuation theory. In both cases, the inverse effective mass separates into a ``conventional'' band-structure contribution and a new geometric contribution, pair quantum geometry, governed by quantum metrics on the pairing manifold, which becomes nontrivial when pairing is non-uniform across sublattices. In the many-body setting, analytic continuation renders the fluctuation kernel non-Hermitian, producing a biorthogonal pair geometry and a generally complex Cooper-pair effective mass whose imaginary part reflects Landau damping. Exact calculations on one-, two-, and three-dimensional lattice models show that pair quantum geometry can make quantitatively significant contributions to the effective mass. These results establish pair quantum geometry as a fundamental ingredient of superconductivity beyond conventional band geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从一般多能带 Hubbard 模型出发，推导了二体束缚态有效质量的精确定理，并在高斯涨落理论下给出临界温度附近库珀对的多体对应形式。结果表明，反有效质量可分解为常规能带结构贡献与新的“配对量子几何”贡献，后者由配对流形上的量子度量控制，并在子晶格间配对不均匀时变得非平庸。在多体情形中，解析延拓会使涨落核非厄米化，产生双正交配对几何以及通常为复数的库珀对有效质量，其虚部反映朗道阻尼。多个一维、二维和三维晶格模型的精确计算显示，配对量子几何可对有效质量产生显著定量影响。

articles.title: 2.4 GHz Flip-flop Device within Nonequilibrium Superconducting Diode
articles.title_zh: 非平衡超导二极管中的 2.4 GHz 触发器器件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting diode effect exhibits asymmetric critical supercurrent and has profound implications for condensed matter physics. The technical appeals of such superconducting diodes are their ultrahigh on-off ratio and diode efficiency for superconducting electronics owing to the dissipationless supercurrent therein. However, realizing superconducting diode operation at high working frequency, which is a key requirement for practical applications, remains elusive and challenging. Here, we demonstrate a polarity-controllable superconducting diode with non-equilibrium Josephson junction and its edge-triggered flip-flop operation at a high frequency up to 2.4 GHz, within a van der Waals superconductor 2M-WS₂. By simply tuning the thickness of superconducting 2M-WS₂ nanoflakes to engineer inversion asymmetry in the junction, we achieve a high diode efficiency of 67% and an on-off ratio exceeding 10⁵. Importantly, the pulse width and duty cycle of output pulse signals in such superconducting diode flip-flop devices can be controlled in a broadband frequency range crossing 12 orders of magnitude. Theoretical analysis reveals that the non-equilibrium dynamic nature of supercurrent in these Josephson junctions enables such a high diode operating frequency and the polarity control of supercurrent. The 2.4 GHz non-equilibrium Josephson diode developed here provides a promising platform for advanced superconducting logic circuits and broadband telecommunication applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在范德华超导体 2M-WS₂ 中实现了基于非平衡约瑟夫森结的极性可控超导二极管，并展示了最高达 2.4 GHz 的边沿触发触发器操作。作者通过调控 2M-WS₂ 纳米片厚度来工程化结中的反演不对称性，获得了较高二极管效率和超过 10⁵ 的开关比。该器件输出脉冲的脉宽与占空比可在跨越 12 个数量级的宽频范围内调控，显示出面向高速超导电子学的潜力。
authors: Xiangyu Bi, Hongyi Li, Aoshen Yang, Yuqiang Fang, Ganyu Chen, Shichong Yang, Yicheng Shen, Qizheng Sun, Junwei Huang, Wei Jiang, Da Wang, Fuqiang Huang, Haijun Zhang, Qianghua Wang, Hongtao Yuan

articles.title: Revealing quantum geometry effects in magic angle twisted bilayer graphene using the circular photogalvanic effect
articles.title_zh: 利用圆偏振光电流效应揭示魔角扭转双层石墨烯中的量子几何效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06389v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a photocurrent studies of a magic angle twisted bilayer graphene device using near infrared light. Through photocurrent imaging and polarization dependence, we separate the photo-thermoelectric effect from the photogalvanic effect. We observe a circular photogalvanic effect (CPGE) over a wide range of doping and temperature. The CPGE at normal incidence constraints the symmetry of the system to C₁, and points to a Berry curvature dipole, in agreement with theoretical predictions for strained graphene. Remarkably, the CPGE vanishes for filling -2.5 < ν < -1.5, suggesting an additional symmetry breaking in that regime. Insight into this effect is obtained through Berry curvature dipole calculations, which emphasize a novel symmetry breaking effect near ν=-2.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用近红外光对魔角扭转双层石墨烯器件开展光电流研究，并通过光电流成像和偏振依赖性区分光热电效应与光伏效应。实验在宽掺杂和温度范围内观察到圆偏振光电流效应；法向入射下的该效应将体系对称性限制为 C₁，并指向贝里曲率偶极矩，这与应变石墨烯的理论预言一致。值得注意的是，在填充因子 -2.5 < ν < -1.5 区间内该效应消失，暗示该区域存在额外对称性破缺；贝里曲率偶极矩计算进一步支持了 ν=-2 附近的新型对称性破缺图像。
authors: Eylon Persky, Leonie Parisot, Minhao He, Jiaqi Cai, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Pierre A. Pantaleon, Francisco Guinea, Xiaodong Xu, Aharon Kapitulnik

articles.title: Quantum Thermal Logic Gates
articles.title_zh: 量子热逻辑门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06432v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a new concept for quantum thermal logic gates -- analogous to classical electronic logic gates -- that exploit the heat current in a coupled quantum-dot system tunnel-coupled to metallic thermal reservoirs for logic operations in quantum circuits. We obtained a remarkable one-to-one correspondence with the structure of classical electronic logic gate circuits. An experimental setup is presented that demonstrates a realizable nano-electronic quantum circuit architecture for implementing such quantum thermal logic operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出“量子热逻辑门”概念，即在耦合量子点体系中利用与金属热库隧穿耦合产生的热流来执行量子电路中的逻辑操作。作者指出，这类热逻辑门与经典电子逻辑门电路结构之间存在显著的一一对应关系。文中还给出了一种可实现的纳米电子量子电路实验架构，用于演示量子热逻辑运算。
authors: Shuvadip Ghosh, Arnab Ghosh, Bivas Dutta, Papiya Maity

articles.title: Superconducting triode effect in a quantum-dot Josephson junction with a biased top gate
articles.title_zh: 带偏置顶栅的量子点约瑟夫森结中的超导三极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-reciprocal supercurrents enable non-dissipative rectification, holding great promise for superconducting electronics. Conventionally, this non-reciprocity, termed the superconducting diode effect, requires the simultaneous breaking of time-reversal and parity symmetries. Here, we propose a superconducting triode effect in an asymmetric quantum-dot Josephson junction coupled to an additional metallic top gate, which breaks the parity symmetry while explicitly preserving time-reversal symmetry. We demonstrate that the supercurrent across this junction exhibits a strong non-reciprocal effect that can be continuously manipulated via the top gate to achieve an ideal unidirectional supercurrent, thus manifesting a superconducting triode effect. Furthermore, under radio-frequency radiation, this junction exhibits highly asymmetric Shapiro steps, realizing fully quantized supercurrent rectification. Our work not only provides an alternative physical mechanism for the superconducting diode effect observed in Josephson junctions with explicit time-reversal symmetry, but also introduces a new tuning knob to manipulate supercurrent non-reciprocity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种在非对称量子点约瑟夫森结中实现的超导三极管效应，其中额外金属顶栅打破空间反演对称性，同时显式保持时间反演对称性。作者表明，结中的超电流可呈现强非互易性，并能通过顶栅连续调控，直至实现理想单向超电流。射频辐照下，该结还表现出高度非对称的 Shapiro 台阶，从而实现完全量子化的超电流整流；该机制为理解保持时间反演对称的约瑟夫森结中的超导二极管效应提供了替代路径。
authors: Yu-Hang Li, Xiaan Du, Hua Jiang, X. C. Xie

articles.title: Coherent room-temperature dipole synchronization in nanocavity sheets
articles.title_zh: 纳米腔片中的室温相干偶极同步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06490v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasmonic nanocavities enable the synchronization of spatially distant emissive dipoles through strong near-field coupling in sub-nm gaps. We report formation of a room-temperature synchronized dipole state in locally-ordered plasmonic nanogap 2D arrays under non-resonant continuous-wave pumping. Unlike lasers, photonic Bose-Einstein condensates, or exciton-polariton condensates, this system exhibits spatial coherence across the dipoles, while rapid radiative and non-radiative emission suppresses temporal photon coherence. A change of behaviour is observed with increasing pumping, marked by the spatial spread of g(1) coherence, but without spectral narrowing or directional emission. This driven-dissipative system exhibits fast temporal coherence decay and complex spatial correlations, offering a new platform for studying synchronization at room temperature. Combining ultralow mode volumes, high Purcell enhancement, and scalable ambient operation, it opens pathways for novel photonic and quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文报道了在局域有序的等离激元纳米间隙二维阵列中，在非共振连续波泵浦下形成室温同步偶极态。与激光、光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚或激子-极化激元凝聚不同，该体系在偶极之间表现出空间相干性，而快速辐射与非辐射发射抑制了时间光子相干性。随着泵浦增强，体系出现以一阶相干函数空间扩展为标志的行为变化，但不伴随谱线变窄或定向发射。该驱动-耗散平台兼具超小模式体积、高 Purcell 增强和环境条件下可扩展运行，为室温同步及相关光子量子技术提供了新途径。
authors: Rakesh Arul, Piper Fowler-Wright, Lille Borresen, Brendon W. Lovett, Jonathan Keeling, Jeremy J. Baumberg

articles.title: Hypergroup Symmetry in Relative Quantum Field Theories and Chiral Algebras
articles.title_zh: 相对量子场论与手征代数中的超群对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05279v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A QFT is said to be relative if it lives at the boundary of a topological QFT in one higher dimension. We develop a general framework for working with noninvertible symmetries of relative theories in two spacetime dimensions, extending several well-known results for absolute QFTs. We emphasize various new features which arise in the relative setting, including the role of topological surfaces of the bulk, and the appearance of hypergroups and certain generalizations of tube algebras known as dome algebras. Our formalism is particularly well-suited for studying rational chiral algebras, where it predicts that finite symmetries are in explicit one-to-one correspondence with conformal embeddings of finite index. We describe several implications of our framework for absolute theories. First, we explain how to "glue" together symmetries of the left- and right-moving chiral algebras of a 2D CFT to produce topological line defects of the full theory. Second, we derive a precise correspondence between boundary conditions of a 2D CFT and symmetries of its chiral algebra. This correspondence has several structural corollaries: in diagonal rational CFTs, we demonstrate that the topological line defects of the theory act transitively on its boundary conditions, and further that the identity Cardy state has the smallest g-function amongst all boundary conditions, including those which only preserve Virasoro symmetry. We conclude by illustrating our results in a variety of examples. For instance, we show that, if there exists a rational chiral algebra with central charge c=8 whose modular tensor category is the Drinfeld center of the Haagerup fusion category, then it must arise as the fixed points of a rank-2 hypergroup acting on the SU(3)₁øtimes (E₆)₁ chiral algebra.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文为二维时空中相对量子场论的不可逆对称性建立了一般框架，其中相对理论被视为生活在高一维拓扑量子场论边界上的理论。作者强调了相对情形中出现的新结构，包括体相拓扑曲面的作用、超群以及管代数推广形式“穹顶代数”。该框架特别适用于有理手征代数，并预言有限对称性与有限指标共形嵌入之间存在显式一一对应。文中还讨论了对绝对理论的影响，包括如何粘合左右手征代数的对称性以构造完整二维共形场论的拓扑线缺陷，以及边界条件与手征代数对称性之间的精确对应。

articles.title: Emergent Self-Similar Quantum Revivals in Spiral Drives
articles.title_zh: 螺旋驱动中涌现的自相似量子复现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05288v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We uncover a distinct form of nonequilibrium temporal order: self-similar quantum revivals in a many-body system driven by quasiperiodic spiral kicks, where the system recurrently returns close to its initial state at a hierarchically nested sequence of times. We demonstrate that both the fidelity and entanglement entropy exhibit this self-similar temporal structure. It originates from an emergent dynamical attractor, which we identify, such that all momentum modes eventually fall into the same closed orbits at self-similar times. We analytically justify this behavior and show that, for special momentum modes, this attractor arises as a consequence of a generalized spin echo process, and more generally we prove its existence using quasiperiodic SU(2) cocycles. Interestingly, the dynamics between consecutive revivals supports either volume- or area-law entanglement scaling, tunable via the driving parameters. In the presence of integrability-breaking perturbations, the system eventually heats up, but a long-lived prethermal regime with algebraically tunable lifetime occurs before heating sets in. Our results establish self-similar quantum revivals as a new paradigm for nonequilibrium quantum matter and provide a realistic route for its observation in current quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文揭示了一种非平衡时间有序的新形式：在准周期螺旋脉冲驱动的多体系统中，系统会在层级嵌套的一系列时刻反复接近初态，形成自相似量子复现。作者表明，保真度与纠缠熵均呈现这种自相似时间结构，其根源是一个涌现的动力学吸引子，使所有动量模在自相似时刻落入相同闭合轨道。文中通过广义自旋回波过程和准周期 SU(2) 余循环给出解析论证，并指出相邻复现之间的动力学可通过驱动参数调节为体积律或面积律纠缠标度。在破坏可积性的扰动存在时，系统最终会加热，但在此之前存在寿命可代数调控的长寿命预热化阶段。
authors: Xin-Chi Zhou, Liang-Hong Mo, Hongzheng Zhao, Bastien Lapierre

articles.title: Thermalization with Gaussian Quantum Cellular Automata
articles.title_zh: 高斯量子元胞自动机中的热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05542v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the long-time dynamics of many-body bosonic lattice systems under translation-invariant Gaussian quantum cellular automata. We formulate two sets of conditions on GQCAs which separately guarantee thermalization of any state on the local Weyl algebra to the infinite temperature state, whenever the state is locally normal and has uniformly bounded particle density. Our main intermediate result is a quantum many-body generalization of the classic Riemann-Lebesgue lemma which is a bound on expectation values of local Weyl operators involving their support and the state's particle density.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究平移不变高斯量子元胞自动机作用下多体玻色晶格系统的长时间动力学。作者提出两组条件，分别保证在局域正规且粒子密度一致有界的任意态中，局域 Weyl 代数上的态会热化到无限温态。其核心中间结果是经典 Riemann-Lebesgue 引理的量子多体推广，给出了局域 Weyl 算符期望值的界，并将其与算符支撑和态的粒子密度联系起来。

articles.title: Generative Criticality in Large Language Model Temperature Scaling
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型温度缩放中的生成临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06238v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a statistical-field framework for text generated by large language models (LLMs), treating token embeddings as continuous spin variables on a one-dimensional chain. Defining a susceptibility from the connected two-point correlator and an order parameter from the ensemble-averaged embedding field, we vary the textttsoftmax temperature T and observe a sharp susceptibility peak near a characteristic T_c with power-law-like scaling, a concurrent rapid change in the order parameter, and a collapse onto a single semantic direction below T_c. The intrinsic dimension estimated by the two nearest neighbor (TwoNN) method independently corroborates these findings, reaching a minimum near T_c. Results are robust across model scales (Qwen3: 0.6B--32B) and prompt categories. While the phenomenology closely resembles a continuous phase transition, the non-equilibrium nature of autoregressive generation warrants further investigation. Our framework provides quantitative tools for probing the collective statistical structure of LLM outputs and suggests connections between decoding strategies and critical phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于分析大语言模型生成文本的统计场框架，将 token 嵌入视为一维链上的连续自旋变量。作者通过连接两点关联函数定义易感性，并由系综平均嵌入场定义序参量，发现随 softmax 温度 T 变化时，在特征温度 T_c 附近出现尖锐易感性峰、类似幂律的标度、序参量快速变化，以及 T_c 以下语义方向塌缩到单一方向。基于 TwoNN 方法估计的内禀维数在 T_c 附近达到最小值，独立支持上述结果；这些现象在不同模型尺度和提示类别中具有稳健性。作者指出，尽管现象类似连续相变，但自回归生成的非平衡性质仍需进一步研究。
authors: Huajian Ruan, Jinyang Li, Xingyu Guo, Lingxiao Wang

articles.title: Non-equilibrium thermodynamics of collapse models in the strongly non-Gaussian regime
articles.title_zh: 强非高斯区域中坍缩模型的非平衡热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06259v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Standard objective collapse models offer a unified approach to the quantum measurement problem but predict an unphysical, indefinite increase in the energy of the system. The dissipative Diósi-Penrose (dDP) model resolves this heating issue by introducing a linear friction mechanism. However, this modification induces complex, non-Gaussian phase-space dynamics. We rigorously establish the thermodynamic consistency of this friction mechanism -- extended to the CSL model -- across both weakly and strongly non-Gaussian regimes. Using the Wigner phase-space formalism, we go significantly beyond the quadratic approximation and, to bypass the failure of perturbative methods under strong dissipation, introduce a novel exact pseudo-spectral simulation approach. Our analysis reveals that the system subjected to the dDP mechanism does not thermalize, but rather settles into a non-equilibrium steady-state (NESS) where the asymptotic non-Gaussianity scales as the third power of the dissipation parameter β. By evaluating the Wigner entropy production, we confirm the thermodynamic validity of the model and demonstrate that highly sensitive information-theoretic quantities require exact numerical methods to accurately capture the key non-Gaussian tails of the distribution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究客观坍缩模型在强非高斯相空间动力学下的非平衡热力学一致性。标准坍缩模型会导致系统能量无物理地无限增长，而耗散 Diósi-Penrose 模型通过引入线性摩擦缓解加热问题；作者还将这一摩擦机制扩展到 CSL 模型。利用 Wigner 相空间形式，文中超越二次近似，并为处理强耗散下微扰方法失效的问题提出精确伪谱模拟方法。结果显示，受耗散机制作用的系统并不热化，而是进入非平衡稳态，其渐近非高斯性随耗散参数 β 的三次方标度；通过 Wigner 熵产生的评估，作者确认了模型的热力学有效性。
authors: Pedro B. Melo, Pedro V. Paraguassú, Simone Artini, Gabriele Lo Monaco, Sandro Donadi, Mauro Paternostro

articles.title: Reliability of asymptotic work extraction
articles.title_zh: 渐近功提取的可靠性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06318v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Extracting work from quantum states is a fundamental task in quantum thermodynamics. Previous studies have primarily focused on determining the best achievable rate of work extraction, and remarkably, this characterization appeared to remain unchanged regardless of the choice of allowed processes: whether one considers the operationally motivated class of energy-conserving thermal operations, or the axiomatic class of Gibbs-preserving operations, the optimal extractable work is given by the Helmholtz free energy. Here, we challenge this perspective, showing that a more refined analysis of the asymptotic performance of work extraction reveals significant differences in the performance for the two different classes of free operations. Precisely, we focus on the trade-off between the extraction rate and its reliability, characterized by the optimal asymptotic speed at which the extraction error can be suppressed. We establish that the reliability of Gibbs-preserving operations and of thermal operations are respectively characterized by the Petz and the sandwiched Rényi relative entropies, demonstrating that the former in general strictly outperforms the latter, and providing new interpretations of several information-theoretic divergences. Our analysis reveals that operational constraints such as energy conservation impose stronger limitations on the achievable precision of quantum tasks than can be inferred from their asymptotic rates, thereby questioning the use of Gibbs-preserving operations as a mathematically convenient substitute for the physically realizable thermal processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究量子热力学中从量子态提取功的渐近性能，重点不再仅限于最优提取速率，而是考察速率与误差抑制速度之间的可靠性权衡。作者表明，能量守恒的热操作与 Gibbs 保持操作虽然在一阶最优功率上都由 Helmholtz 自由能刻画，但在更精细的可靠性层面存在显著差异。具体而言，两类操作的可靠性分别由不同形式的 Rényi 相对熵表征，揭示了允许操作类别对实际渐近性能的重要影响。
authors: Kaito Watanabe, Bartosz Regula, Marco Tomamichel, Ryuji Takagi

articles.title: Energy-Modulated Time-Asymmetric Spontaneous Collapse: Forward-Backward Dynamics from Stochastic Ito Reversal and Bright Solitons
articles.title_zh: 能量调制的时间非对称自发坍缩：来自随机 Itô 反演与亮孤子的前向—后向动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06452v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a rigorous theoretical framework for symmetry breaking and quantum irreversibility arising from stochastic Ito field reversal within a cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrodinger equation (CQ-NLSE) formalism. Starting from three physically motivated considerations, forward and backward nonlinear stochastic differential equations are derived via the Ito calculus. Kinematic time-reversal is shown to be fundamentally incompatible with the Ito stochastic structure, yielding the universal asymmetry-coupling parameter of 2/3. An energy-driven collapse operator proportional to the product of noise strength, local probability density, and excitation energy squared is introduced, amplifying the collapse in high-density, high-excitation regions. Exactly bright soliton solutions are obtained for a quasi-one-dimensional BEC of attractive Li-7 atoms, with forward and backward amplitude ratio of 1.870. Heat map analysis of the parameter planes reveals that the forward collapse operator grows monotonically in time while the backward counterpart decays, achieving a ratio approximately 1030, sharply distinguishing this framework from conventional symmetric collapse models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一个基于三次—五次非线性薛定谔方程的理论框架，用于描述随机 Itô 场反演导致的对称性破缺与量子不可逆性。作者推导了前向和后向非线性随机微分方程，并指出运动学时间反演与 Itô 随机结构存在根本不相容性。文中还引入能量驱动的坍缩算符，并在吸引相互作用的准一维 Li-7 玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体中给出亮孤子解，显示前后向坍缩行为存在显著不对称。
authors: Ikechukwu C. Okoro, Mike O. Osiele, Godfrey E. Akpojotor

articles.title: Quantifying Non-Abelian Stability in Majorana Qubits through Rabi Beating Signatures
articles.title_zh: 通过 Rabi 拍频信号量化 Majorana 量子比特的非阿贝尔稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.09062v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Evaluating the stability of Majorana qubits (MQs) is a central challenge for topological quantum computation. Here we propose a simple and experimentally accessible protocol to quantify MQ stability by coupling a quantum dot (QD) to an MQ, which induces Rabi oscillations in the QD charge occupation that can be directly detected using recently developed single-shot readout techniques. In realistic systems, deviations from ideal MQ behavior lead to a characteristic beating pattern in the Rabi dynamics. We show that the beating frequency scales linearly with these deviations while remaining independent of the base Rabi frequency, thereby providing a direct and quantitative measure of MQ stability. Importantly, the beating signature is robust against weak dissipation, and we further demonstrate that the effective model remains quantitatively accurate when benchmarked against a realistic minimal Kitaev chain. Our results establish a practical and scalable route for quantitatively characterizing Majorana qubit stability in current experimental platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种实验上可行的方案，通过将量子点耦合到 Majorana 量子比特来量化其稳定性。耦合会在量子点电荷占据中诱导可直接读出的 Rabi 振荡，而实际系统偏离理想 Majorana 行为时会产生特征性的拍频图样。作者表明拍频频率与这些偏差线性相关且不依赖基准 Rabi 频率，因此可作为 Majorana 量子比特稳定性的定量指标，并且该信号对弱耗散具有鲁棒性。
authors: Yu Zhang, Jiayi Chen, Jie Liu, X. C. Xie

articles.title: Superconducting non-volatile memory based on charge trapping and gate-controlled supercurrent
articles.title_zh: 基于电荷俘获与栅控超电流的超导非易失存储器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.17241v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconducting electronics holds great promise for energy-efficient high-performance and quantum computing, yet no superconducting memory has matched the performance of conventional semiconductor memories - a long-standing bottleneck. Here we demonstrate a voltage-controlled, non-volatile superconducting memory that exploits two previously independent effects: gate-controlled supercurrent (GCS), the gate-voltage-induced suppression of the critical current I_c in a superconducting constriction, and charge trapping in an Al₂O₃ dielectric. Trapped charges shift the threshold gate voltage required for I_c suppression, defining two stable, well-separated I_c states that can be used to store binary information. We demonstrate reliable non-destructive readout and reversible write/erase cycling over nearly fifty consecutive cycles with the device remaining in the zero-resistance state throughout. Stored information survives thermal cycling well above the superconducting transition temperature T_c, confirming true non-volatility - a capability absent in all existing superconducting memories. We further discuss integration into a NAND architecture and show significant power-dissipation advantages over CMOS charge-trap flash memories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了一种电压控制的非易失超导存储器，结合了栅控超电流效应和 Al₂O₃ 介质中的电荷俘获。被俘获电荷会改变抑制超导窄桥临界电流所需的阈值栅压，从而形成两个稳定且可区分的临界电流状态用于二进制存储。实验实现了非破坏性读出和可逆写入/擦除循环，并显示存储信息可在高于超导转变温度的热循环后保持，体现出真正的非易失性。
authors: Leon Ruf, Angelo Di Bernardo, Elke Scheer

articles.title: Double-Bridge Mechanism for Enhancing Tc in Oxide Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 提高氧化物超导体 Tc 的双桥机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.03658v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a new double-bridge mechanism to significantly enhance T_c in ionic oxide superconductors. Based on our recently proposed ionic-bond-driven O/Cu-bridged (bridge-I) pairing e⁻⁻O-e⁻/h⁺⁻Cu-h⁺ formed in the pseudogap phase (T_c<0. Strengthening bridge-II attraction, minimizing mₘ̊ ₚₐᵢᵣ^*, and optimizing nₘ̊ ₚₐᵢᵣm̊ ³D are the key to maximizing T_c. This double-bridge mechanism unifies the eV-scale strong pairing at room temperature and BEC, provides a universal route toward higher T_c, and guides the design of next-generation superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于显著提高离子型氧化物超导体临界温度的“双桥”机制。作者在此前提出的由离子键驱动的 O/Cu 桥接配对基础上，引入第二类桥接吸引机制，并讨论其与赝能隙相、强配对及玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚之间的关系。论文认为增强第二桥吸引、降低有效配对质量并优化三维配对密度是提高 Tc 的关键，并将该机制作为设计高 Tc 超导体的可能路线。
authors: Jun-jie Shi, Juan Du, Yao-hui Zhu

articles.title: Optical conductivity of a dirty current-carrying superconductor
articles.title_zh: 含杂质载流超导体的光学电导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.06943v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a full microscopic theory for the optical conductivity, σ(ømega), of a dirty current-carrying superconductor. Within the Keldysh sigma model formalism, we obtain the general analytical expression for σ(ømega), applicable for arbitrary frequency ømega, temperature T, and dc supercurrent I. In addition to altering the usual Mattis-Bardeen conductivity, σ₁₍ømega), a finite supercurrent introduces two new contributions: σ₂^qp(ømega) from quasiparticle redistribution and σ₂^SH(ømega) from the amplitude (Schmid-Higgs) mode excitation by the ac field. We investigate, both analytically and numerically, the main features of the optical conductivity in the presence of a dc supercurrent. They include a peak in Re,σ(ømega) above the optical gap and a sign change of Im,σ(ømega), with both effects becoming more pronounced at higher I and lower T. We also elucidate the role of inelastic relaxation, which governs the low-frequency response, leading to a giant microwave absorption and a suppression of the apparent superfluid density at the critical current. The optical conductivity measurement of a superconductor biased by a finite dc supercurrent enables the direct observation of the Schmid-Higgs mode via transport measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了含直流超电流的脏超导体光学电导率的完整微观理论。基于 Keldysh sigma 模型，作者给出了适用于任意频率、温度和直流超电流的解析表达式，并指出有限超电流除修正 Mattis–Bardeen 电导外，还会引入准粒子重分布和振幅模激发两类新贡献。结果显示直流超电流可导致光学能隙上方实部电导峰、虚部电导变号以及低频强微波吸收等现象，其强度随电流增大和温度降低而增强。
authors: Artem V. Polkin, Mikhail A. Skvortsov

articles.title: Superconductivity from the Slater mode: Application to KTaO3 heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 源于 Slater 模式的超导性：在 KTaO3 异质结构中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10903v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconductivity has been observed for the 2D electron gas (2DEG) at the interface of KTaO3 with other oxides, with a transition temperature about an order of magnitude higher than its 3d cousin SrTiO3. The superconducting transition temperature is strongly dependent on the orientation of the interface. Motivated by this observation, we study pairing due to exchange of the soft transverse optic phonon mode characteristic of quantum paraelectrics and use the resulting theory to comment on the nature of superconductivity of this 2DEG. We find (1) an orientation dependence consistent with experiment along with an anisotropic gap function, but (2) a BCS coupling constant that is smaller than needed and so must be augmented by contributions from other phonons to be consistent with the observed values of Tc.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究 KTaO3 氧化物界面二维电子气中可能的超导配对机制，重点考察量子顺电体特有的软横向光学声子模式交换所导致的配对。作者发现该机制可给出与实验相符的界面取向依赖性，并预言各向异性的能隙函数。然而，仅由该模式得到的 BCS 耦合常数不足以解释观测到的 Tc，因此还需要其他声子贡献共同增强配对。

articles.title: Direct probing the quantum geometric tensor for bosonic collective excitations
articles.title_zh: 直接探测玻色集体激发的量子几何张量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13963v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The quantum geometric tensor (QGT), whose real and imaginary parts define the quantum metric and Berry curvature, encodes the intrinsic geometry of quantum states. While electronic QGT has recently become experimentally accessible and linked to diverse physical phenomena, its bosonic counterpart remains largely unexplored. Here we show that the dynamical structure factor encodes the momentum-space structure of bosonic wave functions and thereby provides direct access to the full bosonic QGT throughout the Brillouin zone. Applying this framework, we uncover clear geometric signatures in the twofold quadrupole-Weyl phonon of BaPtGe and the nodal-line magnon in Gd, and further generalize the formalism to multiband systems. Our results establish a general route to measuring (non-)Abelian quantum geometry in bosonic systems, a crucial step toward elucidating its impact on condensed matter phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出利用动力学结构因子直接获取玻色波函数在动量空间中的结构，从而测量整个布里渊区内的玻色量子几何张量。量子几何张量的实部和虚部分别对应量子度量和 Berry 曲率，过去主要在电子体系中得到关注，而玻色情形仍较少探索。作者将方法应用于 BaPtGe 的双重四极 Weyl 声子和 Gd 中的节线磁振子，并推广到多带体系，为测量玻色体系中的阿贝尔及非阿贝尔量子几何提供了通用途径。
authors: Chi Wu, Takashi Oka, Shuichi Murakami, Tiantian Zhang

articles.title: Thermal field theory correlators in the large-N limit and the spectral duality relation
articles.title_zh: 大 N 极限下的热场论关联函数与谱对偶关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.18074v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In Ref.~i̧teGrozdanov:2024wgo, we derived a spectral duality relation applicable to the spectra of 3d conformal field theories (CFTs) and their holographically dual 4d black holes. In this work, we further elaborate on the properties of this duality relation and argue that the same relation can be applied to certain pairs of thermal correlator spectra in large-N quantum field theories in any number of spacetime dimensions, provided the correlators are meromorphic functions with only simple poles and satisfy the thermal product formula. We discuss a rich set of properties that such retarded two-point functions must exhibit. We then show that the spectral duality relation and its implications apply to pairs of correlators in double-trace deformed CFTs and, more generally, to correlators in theories related by the Legendre transform. We illustrate, through several examples, how the spectrum of one correlator can be reconstructed from that of its dual correlation function. Notably, this includes cases relating the thermal spectra of scalar primary operators at ultraviolet and infrared fixed points, as well as current operators in a CFT₃ and its particle-vortex dual.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究进一步阐述了一种谱对偶关系，该关系最初用于三维共形场论及其全息对偶四维黑洞的谱。作者论证，在任意时空维数的大 N 量子场论中，只要热关联函数是仅含简单极点的亚纯函数并满足热乘积公式，该对偶关系也可适用于某些成对的热关联函数谱。文中讨论了这类推迟二点函数应具有的性质，并展示该关系如何用于双迹形变共形场论、Legendre 变换相关理论以及紫外和红外不动点之间谱的重构。

articles.title: Observation of flat-band skin effect
articles.title_zh: 平带趋肤效应的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.19745v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Symmetry-protected ideal flat bands in one-dimensional (1D) Hermitian lattices are populated by compact localized states (CLS) - a special class of localization with wavefunctions confined within a small region. In this work, we discover that the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) can appear in a flat band. Unlike conventional NHSEs for dispersive bands that are protected by nontrivial point-gap topology, the flat band remains a point on the complex-energy plane and is therefore always topologically trivial. We found that, intriguingly, the flat-band skin effect (FBSE) is associated with the non-trivial spectral topology of the dispersive bands enclosing the flat band on the complex-energy plane, so it only emerges within a finite range of non-Hermitian parameters and can counterintuitively disappear at large non-Hermiticity. Moreover, the gaps between the flat and the dispersive bands can close at higher-order exceptional points under both periodic and open boundary conditions. The flat-band wavefunctions are discontinuous in quantum distance across these exceptional points, signifying that the gap-closing is singular. The FBSE was experimentally observed in a non-Hermitian mechanical lattice. Our work reveals flat-band phenomena unique to non-Hermitian systems and highlights new possibilities in quantum geometry and localization control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作发现并研究了非厄米趋肤效应在一维厄米晶格的对称性保护理想平带中出现的可能性。不同于通常由非平庸点隙拓扑保护的色散能带趋肤效应，平带在复能平面上保持为一个点，本身拓扑平庸；其趋肤效应却与包围平带的色散能带的非平庸谱拓扑相关。作者指出该平带趋肤效应只在有限非厄米参数范围内出现，并可能在强非厄米性下消失，同时伴随高阶例外点和波函数量子距离的不连续变化。
authors: Xulong Wang, Dongyi Wang, Congwei Lu, Ruo-Yang Zhang, Ching Hua Lee, Kun Ding, Guancong Ma

articles.title: Accelerating qubit reset through the Mpemba effect
articles.title_zh: 利用 Mpemba 效应加速量子比特重置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.03765v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Passive qubit reset is a key primitive for quantum information processing, whereby qubits are initialized by allowing them to relax to their ground state through natural dissipation, without the need for active control or feedback. However, passive reset occurs on timescales that are much longer than those of gate operations and measurements, making it a significant bottleneck for algorithmic execution. Here, we show that this limitation can be overcome by exploiting the Mpemba effect, originally indicating the faster cooling of hot systems compared to cooler ones. Focusing on the regime where coherence times exceed energy relaxation times (T₂ > T₁₎, we propose a simple protocol based on a single entangling two-qubit gate that converts local single-qubit coherences into fast-decaying global two-qubit coherences. This removes their overlap with the slowest decaying Liouvillian mode and enables a substantially faster relaxation to the ground state. For realistic parameters, we find that our protocol can reduce reset times by up to 50% compared to standard passive reset. We analyze the robustness of the protocol under non-Markovian noise, imperfect coherent control and finite temperature, finding that the accelerated reset persists across a broad range of realistic error sources. Finally, we present an experimental implementation of our protocol on an IQM superconducting quantum processor. Our results demonstrate how Mpemba-like accelerated relaxation can be harnessed as a practical tool for fast and accurate qubit initialization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用 Mpemba 效应加速被动量子比特重置的方法，以缓解自然弛豫初始化速度远慢于量子门和测量的瓶颈。作者聚焦于相干时间长于能量弛豫时间的区域，设计了一个基于单个纠缠双量子比特门的协议，将局域单量子比特相干转化为衰减更快的全局双量子比特相干。该过程可消除系统与最慢衰减 Liouvillian 模式的重叠，从而更快到达基态；在现实参数下，重置时间相较标准被动重置最多可减少约 50%。
authors: Théo Lejeune, Miha Papič, John Goold, Felix C. Binder, François Damanet, Mattia Moroder

articles.title: Polaron Transformed Canonically Consistent Quantum Master Equation
articles.title_zh: 极化子变换的正则一致量子主方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02731v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A central challenge in the theory of open quantum systems is the development of theoretical frameworks capable of accurately describing large, strongly interacting quantum many-body systems in the regime of strong system-bath interactions. In this work, we take a step toward this goal by formulating a polaron-transformed version of the canonically consistent quantum master equation (CCQME) [T. Becker emphet~al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 129, 200403 (2022)]. The CCQME extends beyond standard weak coupling approaches while retaining the same numerical complexity as conventional quantum master equations, thereby enabling the treatment of large quantum systems. The polaron transformation further enhances the accessible system-bath interaction strengths, allowing us to move from moderate to ultra-strong interaction regimes. We present a unified and transparent derivation of these two approaches and combine them to obtain the polar-transformed CCQME (PT-CCQME). Applying our method to the paradigmatic spin boson model, we find excellent agreement with numerically exact time-evolving matrix product operator (TEMPO) simulations. Finally, we predict an initial-state-independent emphslowing down of thermalization in the strong-coupling regime of the spin-boson model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向强系统—浴相互作用下的大型强关联开放量子多体系统，提出极化子变换版本的正则一致量子主方程。正则一致量子主方程可超越标准弱耦合方法，同时保持与常规主方程相近的数值复杂度；极化子变换进一步扩展了可处理的系统—浴耦合强度范围。作者将两种方法结合得到 PT-CCQME，并在典型的自旋—玻色模型中与数值精确的 TEMPO 模拟比较，得到良好一致性。
authors: Juzar Thingna, Xiansong Xu, Daniel Manzano

articles.title: Klein--Gordon and Dirac Oscillators with an Apparent Mass Induced by the Momentum-Space Dual of the Fock--Lorentz Transformations
articles.title_zh: 由动量空间 Fock–Lorentz 变换对偶诱导表观质量的 Klein–Gordon 与 Dirac 振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a controlled momentum-space dual of the Fock--Lorentz (FL) transformations and use it to derive a deformed relativistic mass shell. Restricting the FL conformal factor to the cosmological-frame world line x̌=0, the invariant relation takes the form (E²-p̌²c²)(1+ct/R)²=m₀²c⁴, which is equivalent to the standard special-relativistic dispersion law with a time-dependent apparent mass mapp(t)=m₀/(1+ct/R). Canonical quantization then yields Klein--Gordon (KG) and Dirac equations containing a slowly varying mass scale. We show explicitly that squaring the Dirac equation reproduces the KG operator, modulo first-order corrections proportional to dotmapp that are suppressed by the ratio of the Compton wavelength to the FL scale. The construction is not presented as a unique covariant phase-space theory; rather, it is a world-line ansatz designed to isolate the spectral consequences of the FL conformal factor. As applications, we study the one-dimensional KG and Dirac oscillators. In the adiabatic regime, governed by the small parameter ϵ=c/(Rømega)łl1, closed-form instantaneous spectra are obtained. The Dirac-oscillator calculation is carried out in component form and then reduced to the physical spinor spectrum, thereby avoiding the double counting of the upper and lower component ladders. Dimensionless plots illustrate the apparent-mass drift, the induced spectral evolution, and the domain of adiabatic validity. For cosmological values of R, non-adiabatic corrections are entirely negligible; in the formal limit t→infty the apparent mass tends to zero and, for fixed quantum number, the instantaneous levels collapse toward E=0.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种受控的动量空间 Fock–Lorentz 变换对偶，并由此得到变形的相对论质量壳关系；在特定宇宙学参考系世界线上，该关系等价于具有时间依赖表观质量的标准相对论色散关系。作者进一步量子化得到含缓慢变化质量尺度的 Klein–Gordon 与 Dirac 方程，并说明 Dirac 方程平方后在小修正项范围内再现 KG 算符。作为应用，论文分析一维 KG 与 Dirac 振子，在绝热近似下给出瞬时能谱，用以揭示 FL 共形因子对谱结构的影响。
authors: Abdelmalek Boumali, N. Jafari, Manizheh Botshekananfard

articles.title: Push-Pull acousto-optic modulator based on non-suspended thin-film lithium niobate on silicon substrate
articles.title_zh: 基于硅衬底非悬空薄膜铌酸锂的推挽式声光调制器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Acousto-optic modulators (AOMs) are particularly attractive for microwave-to-optical conversion, quantum transduction, and optical frequency manipulation. For these applications, chip-scale AOMs that combine high efficiency, broad bandwidth, and low optical loss are highly desirable. Although suspended and resonant AOMs can enhance modulation efficiency, they typically suffer from stability concerns and limited bandwidth. Here, we demonstrate a non-suspended built-in push-pull AOM on a thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) on silicon substrate that simultaneously offers high efficiency and relatively broad bandwidth. We further investigate the orientation dependence of electromechanical coupling in X-cut TFLN by fabricating devices with different acoustic propagation directions and identify an optimized orientation for enhanced acousto-optic transduction. Our low-loss device achieves a half-wave voltage-length product of 1.004 V cm at 0.842 GHz with an interaction length of 400 micrometers, together with a relatively wide acousto-optic modulation bandwidth of 132.5 MHz. These results pave the way for efficient, practical integrated photonic-phononic links.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了一种集成在硅衬底薄膜铌酸锂上的非悬空内建推挽式声光调制器，旨在同时实现较高调制效率、较宽带宽和低光学损耗。作者研究了 X 切薄膜铌酸锂中机电耦合对声传播方向的依赖，并确定了有利于增强声光转换的器件取向。实验器件在 0.842 GHz 下实现 1.004 V·cm 的半波电压长度积，并获得 132.5 MHz 的声光调制带宽，为实用集成光子声光器件提供了路径。
authors: Haorui Ni, Sunil Bhave, Mengyue Xu

articles.title: Controlled generation of ultrafast vector vortex beams from a mode-locked fiber laser
articles.title_zh: 由锁模光纤激光器受控产生超快矢量涡旋光束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on a new class of mode-locked fiber laser that allows direct creation of ultrafast vector vortex beams at arbitrary positions on the higher-order Poincaré sphere. The on-demand generation of space-variant polarization patterns was realized by controlling geometric phases inside the laser resonator to map polarization to orbital angular momentum. Thanks to the ingenious cavity design, the required intracavity manipulation of the geometric phase imposed no disturbance on the passively mode-locked operation, thus demonstrating robust and flexible switching of vectorial modes with a 8.5-ps pulse duration. Analytical expressions were deduced to model the generated cylindrically-symmetric polarization profiles, and agreed exceedingly well with experimental observations. The presented fiber laser would constitute a compact light source for producing ultrafast pulses in high-purity structured modes, which may find broad applications in classical and quantum optics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文报道了一类锁模光纤激光器，可在高阶庞加莱球上任意位置直接产生超快矢量涡旋光束。通过在激光谐振腔内控制几何相位，实现了偏振到轨道角动量的映射和按需生成空间变化偏振图案。该腔设计在不干扰被动锁模的情况下完成模态切换，产生约 8.5 ps 脉冲，并通过解析模型较好地描述了实验观测到的柱对称偏振分布。
authors: Kun Huang, Jing Zeng, Jiwei Gan, Qiang Hao, Heping Zeng

articles.title: Quantum computing for accurate large-scale electronic-structure calculations: DFT-embedded, post-processed quantum-selected configuration interaction
articles.title_zh: 用于精确大规模电子结构计算的量子计算：DFT 嵌入与后处理量子选择组态相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a multilevel embedding framework for quantum chemistry calculations on a quantum computer. In our framework, a quantum algorithm treats the strongly correlated active space, while a high-level wave-function method such as coupled cluster theory or multireference perturbation theory recovers the remaining correlation in the surrounding region. A sampling-based quantum algorithm, quantum-selected configuration interaction, bridges the quantum and classical treatments. The entire calculation is embedded in a low-cost density functional theory description of the surrounding environment using Manby's projection technique. We apply the framework to organic, metal-organic, and metallic systems, computing bond dissociation energies, adsorption energies, and reaction barriers using only the subset of qubits of a 144-qubit superconducting quantum computer at the University of Osaka and achieving sim1 kcal/mol agreement with classical references for a Menshutkin S_N2 reaction inside a carbon nanotube. Our results may open the way to quantitatively reliable quantum-classical hybrid calculations for large-scale chemical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种面向量子化学量子计算的多层嵌入框架，其中量子算法处理强关联活性空间，而耦合簇或多参考微扰等高层波函数方法补偿周围区域的相关效应。该框架以基于采样的量子选择组态相互作用连接量子与经典处理，并通过 Manby 投影技术嵌入到低成本密度泛函环境描述中。论文将该方法应用于有机、金属有机和金属体系，在有限量子比特资源下计算键解离能、吸附能和反应势垒，并在碳纳米管内 Menshutkin SN2 反应中达到约 1 kcal/mol 的经典参考一致性。
authors: Tuan Minh Do, Yuichiro Yoshida, Tomoya Shiota, Wataru Mizukami

articles.title: Quantum-limited estimation of atmospheric turbulence via spatial mode decomposition
articles.title_zh: 通过空间模式分解实现大气湍流的量子极限估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06101v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish the ultimate precision limit for estimating the optical spatial coherence radius (Fried parameter) within a quantum metrological framework. In the weak field regime, we show that spatial-mode decomposition -- originally introduced for superresolution imaging -- enables substantially more precise estimation than conventional direct imaging when the receiver aperture is smaller than the coherence radius.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在量子计量框架下建立了估计光学空间相干半径即 Fried 参数的最终精度极限。作者表明，在弱光场条件下，空间模式分解方法能够显著优于传统直接成像，尤其是在接收孔径小于相干半径时。该结果将超分辨成像中的空间模式测量思想拓展到大气湍流参数估计问题。

articles.title: Tuning long-range interactions in Sr Rydberg atoms: the effect of series perturbations
articles.title_zh: 调控锶里德堡原子的长程相互作用：能级系列微扰的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:1505.07152v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the effect of series perturbation on the second-order dipole-dipole interactions between strontium atoms in the 5sns(¹S₀₎ and 5snp(¹P₁₎ Rydberg states as a means of engineering long-range interactions between atoms. The series perturbation in these atoms enables modifying the strength and the sign of the interaction by varying the principal quantum number n of the Rydberg electron. We utilize experimentally available data to estimate the importance of perturber states, and find that van der Waals interaction between two strontium atoms in the 5snp(¹P₁₎ states shows strong peaks outside the anticipated hydrogenic n¹¹ scaling. We identify this to be the result of the perturbation of 5snd(¹D₂₎ intermediate states by the 4d²⁽¹D₂₎ and 4dn's(¹D₂₎ states in the n<20 range. This demonstrates that divalent atoms offer a unique advantage for generating substantially stronger or weaker inter-atomic interactions than those that can be achieved using alkali metal atoms. This is due to the highly perturbed spectra of divalent atoms and other multivalent atoms that can persist up to high n. Such irregularities can be especially useful in engineering asymmetric Ry blockade requiring the simultaneous presence of both ``weak'' and ``strong'' interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究锶原子 5sns(¹S₀) 与 5snp(¹P₁) 里德堡态之间二阶偶极—偶极相互作用中能级系列微扰的作用，以探索长程相互作用工程。作者利用实验数据估计微扰态的重要性，发现 5snp(¹P₁) 态锶原子间范德瓦耳斯相互作用在预期氢样 n¹¹ 标度之外出现强峰。结果表明，二价及多价原子受高度微扰谱结构影响，可通过改变主量子数实现相互作用强度和符号的显著调控，具备区别于碱金属原子的优势。

articles.title: First observation of the γ-ray beam production by the backward Compton scattering of reflected synchrotron radiation in the extreme ultraviolet range
articles.title_zh: 首次观测由反射极紫外同步辐射反向康普顿散射产生的 γ 射线束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.19579v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Compton scattering of photons off high-energy electrons is a fundamental quantum mechanical process widely utilized to produce a γ-ray beam for scientific research. Instead of injecting laser light into a storage ring as a conventional way, we have developed an innovative method to achieve drastically higher energies approaching the ring energy by the backward Compton scattering of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light. In this method, 92 eV photons obtained from an undulator in a storage ring were reflected back to the original ring using a Mo/Si multilayer mirror. Consequently, γ-ray beam production through the EUV light Compton scattering using reflected synchrotron radiation was observed for the first time in a demonstration experiment conducted at the 1 GeV ring, NewSUBARU. The measured energy spectrum was well reproduced by a theoretical calculation with the maximum energy of 0.543 GeV. The production rate was 1.4 ± 0.1 kcps for the energies above 0.160 GeV. This rate was quantitatively explained by the luminosity and the scattering cross section. The present work paved the way to create a new γ-ray beam source for future applications such as hadron photoproduction experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文报道了利用极紫外同步辐射反向康普顿散射产生 γ 射线束的首次实验观测。研究中，储存环波荡器产生的 92 eV 光子经 Mo/Si 多层镜反射回原环道，并在 NewSUBARU 1 GeV 储存环上与高能电子发生康普顿散射。测得能谱与理论计算吻合，最大能量为 0.543 GeV，并给出高于 0.160 GeV 的产生率，为未来新型高能 γ 射线源奠定了基础。
authors: Norihito Muramatsu, Manabu Miyabe, Masahiro Okabe, Schin Date, Tetsuo Harada, Kazuhiro Kanda, Shuji Miyamoto, Haruo Ohkuma, Hajime Shimizu, Shinsuke Suzuki, Atsushi Tokiyasu

articles.title: Uncertainty Aware Functional Behavior Prediction and Material Fatigue Assessment for Circular Factory
articles.title_zh: 面向循环工厂的具不确定性感知功能行为预测与材料疲劳评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Returned products in circular factories re-enter production with heterogeneous degradation states, usage histories, and remaining capability. Reuse cannot be decided from the current inspection alone, because future function fulfillment and component integrity may evolve differently under the next service scenario. Existing PHM approaches support degradation prediction, but often target fixed operating conditions or isolated component benchmarks, while material-fatigue assessment is rarely linked to system-level functional prognosis. This paper addresses this gap for an angle grinder by combining uncertainty-aware functional prediction with component-level fatigue assessment in an instance-specific reliability workflow. The proposed framework combines the current tool state with recent force--torque usage windows. A convolutional encoder extracts loading patterns from spindle forces and shaft torque, and an LSTM backbone predicts nine functional variables as Gaussian mean and variance estimates. In parallel, the same loading history is translated into output-shaft fatigue information through finite-element-supported stress reconstruction, S--N/Miner damage evaluation with Haibach extension, and Paris-law crack-growth analysis. A streaming replay algorithm consolidates both branches into functional, material, and system reliability trajectories. Held-out tests show mean (2%)-tolerance accuracy of 0.9652 across nine outputs. Thermal variables are predicted near-perfectly, while drive motor current and load speed remain the most demanding dynamic outputs, with (R²) values of 0.9750 and 0.9924. Torque history is especially important for these variables, and the conventional LSTM outperforms GRU and xLSTM in the short-history setting. Reliability calibration is most informative for drive motor current, where predicted and observed exceedance probabilities ...
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向循环工厂中返修或再利用产品状态差异大的问题，提出将系统级功能预测与部件级疲劳评估结合的实例化可靠性流程。以角磨机为对象，框架融合当前工具状态与近期力—扭矩使用窗口，通过卷积编码器提取载荷模式，并由 LSTM 预测多个功能变量的均值与方差。并行地，同一载荷历史被转换为输出轴疲劳信息，从而支持在未来服役场景下对功能满足性和部件完整性的联合评估。

articles.title: Synthesis, optimization, characterization and testing of waste cooking oil Biodiesel blends on CI Engine
articles.title_zh: 废弃食用油生物柴油混合燃料的合成、优化、表征及其在压燃式发动机上的测试
articles.abstract: Study conducted on synthesis of biodiesel from used cooking oil using central composite design, the optimum yield estimated using metaheuristic optimization algorithms like Dragon fly optimization, Genetic algorithm, and Grasshopper optimization. The biodiesel and its blends were tested on a TV1 Kirloskar engine. Reusing cooking oil can lead to health and environmental issues, while using it as a feedstock for biodiesel production is cost-effective and sustainable solution for deriving energy. The transesterification process with ethyl alcohol and the use of KOH catalysts were key components of the biodiesel preparation in the present study. The present study uses bio-ethanol (instead of commonly used methanol) for transesterification of waste cooking oil and employs advanced optimization algorithms where Grasshopper optimization algorithm outperformed. The biodiesel produced demonstrated potential for use in diesel engines, and FTIR spectra analysis provided insight into the functional groups present in the biodiesel which are important from the point of view of its use as fuel. The significant reduction of CO & HC was observed for all blends across all loads while reduced NOx at low to medium loads compared to diesel. The overall emission performance for blends were better than diesel. Engine performance revealed suitable biodiesel blends can equal or surpass diesel in thermal and mechanical efficiency at reduced fuel consumption which make them attractive alternatives for CI engines without any major engine modifications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以废弃食用油为原料，采用乙醇和KOH催化的酯交换工艺制备生物柴油，并利用中心复合设计及多种元启发式算法优化产率，其中草蜢优化算法表现较好。所得生物柴油及其混合燃料在TV1 Kirloskar压燃式发动机上进行测试，结果显示各混合燃料在不同负荷下CO和HC排放显著降低。FTIR分析揭示了燃料中关键官能团，表明废弃食用油制备生物柴油是一种兼具成本效益和可持续性的能源利用途径。

articles.title: Hydrothermal-assisted microwave extraction of bioactive phenolics and saponins from Curculigo orchioides
articles.title_zh: 水热辅助微波提取仙茅中生物活性酚类和皂苷
articles.abstract: The rhizomes of Curculigo orchioides contain diverse phytochemicals associated with antioxidant and antidiabetic activities; however, efficient extraction of these compounds remains a challenge. In this study, hydrothermal pretreatment was applied prior to microwave-assisted extraction (MAE) to improve the release of intracellular metabolites from plant tissues. The extraction parameters, including solvent-to-solid ratio, microwave power, and extraction time, were optimized using response surface methodology based on a Box–Behnken experimental design with total phenolic content (TPC) and total saponin content (TSC) as response variables. The optimized MAE conditions were identified at approximately 40 mL/g, 300 W, and 30 min, resulting in TPC and TSC values of 73.15 mg GAE g⁻¹ and 55.61 mg AE g⁻¹, respectively. Extracts obtained under these conditions showed strong radical-scavenging activity in DPPH and ABTS assays together with considerable α-glucosidase inhibitory activity. Microscopic observations indicated that pretreatment combined with microwave irradiation markedly disrupted the plant cellular matrix, which may facilitate the release of bioactive constituents. Comprehensive metabolite profiling using LC–MS/MS followed by GNPS-based molecular networking allowed the tentative annotation of 44 metabolites, including phenolic acids, phenolic glycosides, fatty acid derivatives, amino acid-related compounds, and several curculigoside-type metabolites commonly reported in C. orchioides. These results provide insight into the phytochemical composition of the extract and demonstrate the effectiveness of pretreatment-assisted MAE for recovering bioactive compounds from this medicinal plant.

articles.title: SPLIT-PINN: Separable Probability Learning Technique via Physics-Informed Neural Networks for High-Dimensional Probabilistic Modeling
articles.title_zh: SPLIT-PINN：用于高维概率建模的基于物理信息神经网络的可分概率学习技术
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a probabilistic modeling framework for incorporating small-scale spatial heterogeneity into macroscopic descriptions of material behavior for polycrystalline metallic materials. Spatially heterogeneous material state fields are represented using probability density functions (PDFs), providing a principled statistical description of microstructural variability and state evolution across different computational polycrystalline realizations. The framework is built on the inverse identification of a probabilistic transport model, formulated as a Liouville equation with an unknown drift term. To enable accurate, stable, and interpretable inference of this drift field in high-dimensional, transport-dominated settings, we develop a Separable Probability Learning Technique via Physics-Informed Neural Networks (SPLIT-PINN). This method incorporates a marginal-correction drift decomposition, orthogonality constraints, and residual-based adaptive training to enhance well-posedness, numerical stability, and physical consistency without imposing restrictive parametric assumptions. Using SPLIT-PINN, the drift field governing the temporal evolution of joint state PDFs is inferred directly from data. After benchmark validation, the framework is applied to physical computational datasets describing the evolution of polycrystalline microstructural states, including von Mises stress, dislocation density, and equivalent plastic strain rate. The learned Liouville model, trained on a single dataset, is subsequently used in forward predictions of the temporal evolution of joint and marginal PDFs for multiple unseen polycrystal realizations. Quantitative comparisons with reference PDFs demonstrate that the proposed framework yields accurate and robust probabilistic predictions and generalizes effectively across datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出SPLIT-PINN框架，用于将小尺度空间非均匀性纳入多晶金属材料宏观行为的概率描述。方法以概率密度函数表示异质材料状态场，并通过带未知漂移项的Liouville方程反演概率输运模型。作者引入边缘校正漂移分解、正交约束和基于残差的自适应训练，以提高高维输运主导问题中的适定性、稳定性和物理一致性。

articles.title: Deformable Charge Dynamics in Biological Environments: An Extended Structural Dynamics Foundation for Biological Electrostatics
articles.title_zh: 生物环境中的可变形电荷动力学：生物静电学的扩展结构动力学基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The point-charge approximation is one of the most successful idealizations in molecular biophysics, but it becomes strained in strong fields, confined geometries, and crowded aqueous environments. We develop a minimal Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) model in which charged entities are treated as finite, deformable objects with an internal breathing mode rather than as structureless points. Starting from a Hamiltonian description and a controlled coarse-graining procedure, we derive an effective generalized Langevin equation for the center-of-mass motion. The reduced dynamics contain a memory kernel with three physically distinct contributions: finite-size causal delay, inertial deformation, and crowding-induced deformation. The derivation rests on explicit assumptions of small deformation, local dielectric screening, one dominant internal mode, and adiabatic elimination of the fast structural coordinate. Parameters are determined by independently measurable inputs -- ionic radius, charge, mass, and the high-frequency dielectric constant of water -- with one exception: the dimensionless coupling lambda governing crowding-induced deformation, discussed in detail in the paper. Two primary predictions follow. First, transport through confined geometries should show dynamical deviations from point-charge baselines scaling with ionic deformability, beyond static potential-of-mean-force predictions. Second, polarization response should preserve ionic-radius ordering across alkali ions. Two secondary consequences are identified: a field-dependent effective charge radius and a deformation-dependent correction to near-surface mobility. Amplification of these effects in confined settings is treated as a plausible extension rather than a derived result. The framework recovers standard electrostatic models as limiting cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，点电荷近似虽在分子生物物理中十分成功，但在强场、受限几何和拥挤水环境中可能不足。作者提出一种最小扩展结构动力学模型，将带电实体视为具有有限尺寸和内部“呼吸”模式的可变形对象。通过哈密顿量描述和粗粒化推导，得到质心运动的广义朗之万方程，其中记忆核包含有限尺寸因果延迟、惯性形变和拥挤诱导形变等贡献。

articles.title: Multiparametric Quantum Sensing of Liquids Using NV Centres and Tethered Magnetic Nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 利用NV色心与表面系留磁性纳米颗粒实现液体的多参数量子传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a new concept for non-invasive, multiparametric liquid analysis based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre magnetometry, relaxometry and surface-tethered magnetic nanoparticles. Magnetic nanoparticles are anchored to a diamond surface via DNA strands, forming nanoscale mechanical oscillators whose thermally driven motion is strongly influenced by the surrounding liquid environment. The resulting time-dependent magnetic fields couple to near-surface NV centres and are detected via optically detected magnetic resonance or changes in spin coherence time. By spatially patterning the diamond surface with regions functionalised by DNA tethers of different lengths, sequences, or chemical modifications, a single liquid is mapped onto a high-dimensional quantum response vector rather than a single scalar observable. Changes in viscosity, molecular adsorption, or chemical interactions modify the dynamics of magnetic nanoparticles in a region-specific manner, enabling differential sensing across the surface. We outline the physical transduction mechanism, discuss relevant scaling relations, and assess experimental feasibility using established wide-field NV magnetometry and relaxometry methods. The proposed platform combines quantum sensing with surface heterogeneity, offering a versatile route toward parallel, label-free liquid characterisation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于金刚石氮-空位色心磁测量、弛豫测量和表面系留磁性纳米颗粒的非侵入式液体多参数分析方案。磁性纳米颗粒通过DNA链锚定在金刚石表面，形成受液体环境影响的纳米机械振子，其热运动产生的时变磁场可由近表面NV色心探测。通过在表面构建不同DNA系链区域，单一液体可映射为高维量子响应向量，从而区分黏度、分子吸附和化学相互作用等变化。
authors: Johannes Fiedler, Martin Møller Greve, Justas Zalieckas

articles.title: Quantum String Interactions Revealed by Full Counting Statistics
articles.title_zh: 通过全计数统计揭示量子弦相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How quantum strings interact is a basic question for extended objects in quantum many-body physics. Even the simplest hard-core constraint (no crossing), can generate a nontrivial effective potential, whose microscopic form is difficult to determine because the relative distance between the strings is intrinsically nonlocal. Here we show that this nonlocality is naturally captured by full counting statistics (FCS). For two hard-core quantum strings, we derive an analytic FCS expression for the emergent interaction by identifying the virtual process in which the two strings touch and hop back. Using the FCS--entanglement relation, we find the effective potential has the entanglement-controlled asymptotic form łnΔ E(r)sim -π² r²/(12 Sₑₗₗ₎ up to subleading terms, where Sₑₗₗ is the entanglement entropy between the two halves of a quantum string. We confirm the theory using high-precision numerical calculations and finite-size FCS estimates. Our results reveal FCS as a direct route to effective interactions between quantum topological line-defects, which may also be extended to higher-form charge.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨量子多体体系中硬核量子弦之间的有效相互作用，尤其关注不可交叉约束如何产生非平凡有效势。作者指出，两条弦之间的相对距离具有内禀非局域性，而全计数统计能够自然捕捉这种非局域特征。通过识别两条弦接触并回跳的虚过程，作者推导出有效相互作用的解析表达，并利用全计数统计与纠缠的关系得到受纠缠熵控制的渐近形式。

articles.title: Moiré enabled spin pumping and preservation in MoSe2/WS2 heterobilayers
articles.title_zh: MoSe2/WS2异质双层中由莫尔结构实现的自旋泵浦与保持
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin degree of freedom is a fundamental quantum mechanical attribute with implications spanning from magnetism to quantum computing. Consequently, the relaxation of spin states for extended, Bloch electrons in solids has been studied for decades as it defines many of their properties and applications. We show that moiré patterns in layered materials can extend spin relaxation times by two orders of magnitude to 1 millisecond and beyond.
