Using side-polished optical fibers covered with single-walled carbon nanotube (SWCNT) thin films, we observe a pronounced polarization- and thickness-dependent response to NO2 exposure. For transverse electric polarization, the optical response decreases with increasing film thickness and changes sign for thicker coatings, whereas for transverse-magnetic polarization, the response increases monotonically. Numerical modeling reveals that modulation of the SWCNT complex refractive index redistributes the evanescent field, alters the mode-matter overlap integral, and controls propagation loss. These results demonstrate that evanescent-wave sensor behavior is governed not only by intrinsic material sensitivity but also by mode reshaping induced by nanomaterial coatings. The identified mechanism provides a general framework for designing fiber-optic and integrated photonic sensors based on evanescent-field interactions with tunable nanomaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在纳米材料包覆波导的倏逝波光子传感器中，气体诱导的导模重塑可能主导传感机制，而不仅是敏感层吸收变化。作者使用单壁碳纳米管薄膜覆盖的侧抛光光纤，观察到对 NO₂ 暴露具有显著的偏振和膜厚依赖响应，其中横电偏振在较厚涂层下甚至出现响应符号反转。数值模拟显示，碳纳米管复折射率变化会重新分布倏逝场、改变模式-物质重叠并控制传播损耗。
authors: Egor O. Zhermolenko, Khasan A. Akhmadiev, Aram A. Mkrtchyan, Fedor S. Fedorov, Anastasiia S. Netrusova, Aliya R. Vildanova, Dmitry V. Krasnikov, Albert G. Nasibulin, Yuriy G. Gladush

articles.title: Learning collision operators from plasma phase space data using differentiable simulators
articles.title_zh: 利用可微模拟器从等离子体相空间数据中学习碰撞算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10885v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a methodology to infer collision operators from phase space data of plasma dynamics. Our approach combines a differentiable kinetic simulator, whose core component in this work is a differentiable Fokker-Planck solver, with a gradient-based optimisation method to learn the collisional operators that best describe the phase space dynamics. We test our method using data from two-dimensional Particle-in-Cell simulations of spatially uniform thermal plasmas, and learn the collision operator that captures the self-consistent electromagnetic interaction between finite-size charged particles over a wide variety of simulation parameters. We demonstrate that the learned operators are more accurate than alternative estimates based on particle tracks, while making no prior assumptions about the relevant time scales of the processes and significantly reducing memory requirements. We find that the retrieved operators, obtained in the non-relativistic regime, are in excellent agreement with theoretical predictions derived for electrostatic scenarios. Our results show that differentiable simulators offer a powerful and computational efficient approach to infer novel operators for a wide rage of problems, such as electromagnetically dominated collisional dynamics and stochastic wave-particle interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种从等离子体动力学相空间数据中推断碰撞算子的方法，将可微动理学模拟器与基于梯度的优化相结合。作者以可微 Fokker-Planck 求解器为核心，在二维粒子-in-cell 模拟数据上学习能够描述有限尺寸带电粒子自洽电磁相互作用的碰撞算子。结果显示，学习得到的算子比基于粒子轨迹的替代估计更准确，同时无需预设相关时间尺度并显著降低内存需求，且在非相对论情形下与静电理论预测高度一致。
authors: Diogo D. Carvalho, Pablo J. Bilbao, Warren B. Mori, Luis O. Silva, E. Paulo Alves

articles.title: GradNet: A Gradient-Based Framework for Optimal Network Science
articles.title_zh: GradNet：面向最优网络科学的基于梯度框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09197v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Network science has traditionally examined how structure determines dynamics. Here we invert this paradigm: we ask how functional dynamics and resource constraints shape network architecture. We introduce GradNet, an AI-enabled optimization framework that treats network topology as a continuously differentiable object. This allows designing networks that optimize arbitrary dynamical objectives, from synchronization to communication capacity, under realistic constraints. Applying this framework across diverse systems reveals that canonical network features emerge spontaneously from constrained optimization rather than requiring explicit imposition. Optimizing Kuramoto oscillator synchronization under fixed coupling budgets produces sparse, bipartite, frequency-disassortative architectures that eliminate classical synchronization thresholds. Minimizing social tension in opinion dynamics reproduces the empirically observed factional split in Zachary's karate club network. Maximizing entanglement distribution in spatial quantum networks under distance-dependent costs recovers minimum spanning tree architectures. These results demonstrate that optimization acts as both an engineering tool for network design, scalable to networks exceeding 10⁵ nodes, and a scientific probe revealing fundamental structure-function relationships. By recasting network architecture as the solution to constrained optimization problems, this variational perspective offers a unified framework connecting network analysis, design, and inference across physical, biological, and technological systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 GradNet，一种将网络拓扑视为连续可微对象的 AI 辅助优化框架，用于在资源约束下设计满足特定动力学目标的网络。该框架可优化同步、通信容量和量子纠缠分发等目标，并显示许多典型网络结构可由约束优化自发产生。示例包括 Kuramoto 同步下形成稀疏、二分且频率异配的结构，意见动力学中再现空手道俱乐部的派系分裂，以及空间量子网络中恢复最小生成树型结构。
authors: Guram Mikaberidze, Beso Mikaberidze, Dane Taylor

articles.title: Particle Detection Using Magnetic Avalanches in Single-Molecule Magnet Crystals
articles.title_zh: 利用单分子磁体晶体中的磁雪崩进行粒子探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.02467v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The detection of a single quantum of energy with high efficiency and a low false positive rate is of considerable scientific interest, from serving as single quantum sensors of optical and infra-red photons to enabling the direct detection of low-mass dark matter. We confirm our initial experimental demonstration of magnetic avalanches induced by scattering of quanta in single-molecule magnet (SMM) crystals made of Mn₁₂-acetate, establishing the use of SMMs as particle detectors for the first time. Although the current setup has an energy threshold in the MeV regime, our results motivate the exploration of a wide variety of SMMs whose properties could allow for detection of sub-eV energy depositions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究确认了量子散射可在 Mn₁₂-乙酸盐单分子磁体晶体中诱发磁雪崩，从而首次建立单分子磁体作为粒子探测器的实验可行性。单量子能量的高效、低误报探测对光学和红外光子传感以及低质量暗物质直接探测具有重要意义。尽管当前装置的能量阈值仍处于 MeV 量级，结果鼓励进一步探索具备更低能量沉积探测潜力的多种单分子磁体材料。
authors: Bailey Kohn, Hao Chen, Rupak Mahapatra, Glenn Agnolet, Ivan Borzenets, Philip C. Bunting, Jeffrey R. Long, Minjie Lu, Tom Melia, Michael Nippe, Lok Raj Pant, Surjeet Rajendran, Anna Schmautz, Amis Sharma

articles.title: Imprints of primordial magnetic fields in gravitational collapse during early structure formation
articles.title_zh: 早期结构形成中引力坍缩对原初磁场印记的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.23263v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Context. Primordial magnetic fields (PMFs) generated in the early Universe might have left observable imprints on present-day large-scale structure. However, the spatial scales on which primordial signatures are able to survive the nonlinear processes that accompany structure formation remain unclear. Aims. The aim of this study is to investigate the evolution of the statistical properties of PMFs during the onset of gravitational collapse. Methods. We performed a suite of high-resolution direct numerical simulations of isothermal self-gravitating, magnetized gas clouds. By varying the viscosity, we probed different Reynolds-number regimes and follow the coupled evolution of gravitational collapse and magnetohydrodynamic turbulence. Results. At sufficiently high Reynolds numbers, turbulence generated during collapse triggers the onset of a small-scale dynamo, which amplifies magnetic energy below the Jeans scale and modifies the magnetic energy spectrum significantly. The question of whether dynamo amplification dominates the magnetic field evolution is determined by the competition between the dynamo growth time and the free-fall time. Conclusions. Our results highlight the importance of resolving the Jeans scale and the associated turbulent inertial range in cosmological magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) simulations to accurately capture the interplay between gravitational compression and dynamo amplification and to assess which structures retain memory of primordial fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察早期宇宙产生的原初磁场在引力坍缩初期的统计性质演化，以及其原初印记能否在非线性结构形成过程中保留下来。作者开展高分辨率等温自引力磁化气体云直接数值模拟，并通过改变黏性探索不同雷诺数下坍缩与磁流体湍流的耦合演化。结果表明，在足够高雷诺数下，坍缩诱发的湍流会触发小尺度发电机，在 Jeans 尺度以下放大磁能并显著改变磁能谱；磁场演化是否由发电机放大主导取决于发电机增长时间与坍缩相关时间尺度的竞争。
authors: Jennifer Schober, Molly Abramson, Sayan Mandal, Salome Mtchedlidze, Tina Kahniashvili

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Short-Term Flood Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于短期洪水预测的物理信息机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04143v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate flood forecasting is essential for mitigating disaster risks and protecting communities. However, purely data-driven machine learning models often struggle in data-scarce environments and may violate fundamental hydrological principles. Standard Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks can generate physically inconsistent predictions, particularly when extrapolating to extreme weather conditions. To address these limitations, we propose a Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) framework that incorporates hydrological knowledge directly into the loss function of an LSTM model. Specifically, a Trend Alignment constraint penalizes directional inconsistencies between precipitation and discharge trends, improving model robustness without requiring complex hydrodynamic equations. This regularization encourages the model to learn physically plausible hydrograph behavior, even with limited training data, while enhancing reliability during peak flood events. Experimental results show that the proposed physics-informed model outperforms a standard LSTM baseline in data-scarce settings, increasing the Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency (NSE) from 0.20 to 0.23 when trained on only 5% of the available data. Additional stress tests under simulated extreme climate scenarios demonstrate that the baseline model exhibits unstable behavior, whereas the physics-informed model maintains directional consistency and physical plausibility. Although accurately predicting extreme peak magnitudes remains challenging with limited data, the proposed approach substantially reduces unphysical fluctuations common in purely data-driven models. These findings demonstrate that simple physical constraints can significantly improve the reliability of deep learning models for real-time flood forecasting, offering a practical solution for ungauged basins and evolving climate conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种物理信息机器学习框架，将水文知识直接嵌入 LSTM 模型的损失函数，以提升短期洪水预测可靠性。核心的趋势对齐约束惩罚降水与流量趋势之间的方向不一致，从而在不引入复杂水动力方程的情况下增强物理一致性。实验表明，在训练数据有限的情形下，该物理约束模型优于标准 LSTM，并在洪峰事件预测中表现出更好的稳健性。
authors: Tewodros Syum Gebre, Jagrati Talreja, Leila Hashemi-Beni

articles.title: Derivative Informed Learning of Exchange-Correlation Functionals
articles.title_zh: 交换-相关泛函的导数信息学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned (ML) exchange-correlation (XC) functionals aim to replace human-designed density functional approximations by learning directly from reference data, but they still do not consistently outperform traditional O(N⁴⁾⁻scaling hybrid functionals. We study a hybrid-distillation setting in which O(N³⁾⁻scaling ML-XC functionals are trained to reproduce B3LYP/def2-SVP targets. We introduce Derivative Informed XC-Loss (DI-Loss), a loss that incorporates additional information from the reference hybrid functional by supervising first and second derivatives of the energy on the Grassmannian of admissible density matrices. Rather than only matching the self-consistent fixed point, DI-Loss aligns the local first- and second-order response of the learned functional with that of the target functional. Across four evaluated architectures, DI-Loss consistently improves the main energy metrics. Averaged uniformly across architectures, the total-energy MAE decreases by 66% relative to energy and density supervision alone. The density-sensitive mean-field energy metric Eₕ̊o improves from 1.2 to 0.8 mEh on average, while dipole and L₂ density errors do not improve uniformly. We further show that densities from the distilled functionals reduce hybrid-functional SCF iterations by up to 50%. In downstream TDDFT calculations, Hessian supervision improves excited-state predictions, with XCdiff reducing the mean excitation-energy MAE by 19 - 35%.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向机器学习交换-相关泛函，提出导数信息 XC 损失（DI-Loss），用于在混合泛函蒸馏设定下训练低标度 ML-XC 泛函复现 B3LYP/def2-SVP 目标。DI-Loss 不仅监督自洽定点处的能量和密度，还引入能量在可容许密度矩阵 Grassmann 流形上的一阶与二阶导数信息，以对齐目标泛函的局部响应。跨四种模型架构的评估显示，该损失一致改善主要能量指标，平均总能量 MAE 相比仅用能量和密度监督降低 66%，并改善密度敏感的平均场能量等指标。
authors: Eike S. Eberhard, Luca A. Thiede, Abdul Aldossary, Andreas Burger, Nicholas Gao, Vignesh Bhethanabotla, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, Stephan Günnemann

articles.title: Scaling Novel Graph Generation via Lightweight Structure-Guided Autoregressive Models
articles.title_zh: 通过轻量级结构引导自回归模型扩展新颖图生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generating realistic and diverse graphs is a key problem in machine learning, with applications in molecular discovery, circuit design, cybersecurity, and beyond. However, current graph generative models remain limited by scalability and novelty. Diffusion-based methods often require costly full-adjacency operations and long denoising chains, while many autoregressive and hybrid models have at least quadratic complexity. In addition, these models often imitate training graphs rather than generalize beyond them. We propose a lightweight autoregressive framework to address these issues. It uses a structure-guided topological ordering to serialize graphs into regular edge sequences, enabling near log-linear generation, and a two-phase training strategy that combines exploration-oriented augmentation with iterative refinement to reduce overfitting and promote controlled novelty. Experiments on molecular and non-molecular benchmarks show that our approach improves novelty while preserving high validity and uniqueness. The framework also supports both LSTM and Mamba-style causal sequence backbones, with large-memory accelerators enabling longer graph-sequence experiments beyond typical GPU limits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对图生成模型在可扩展性与新颖性方面的限制，提出一种轻量级自回归框架。方法利用结构引导的拓扑排序将图序列化为规则边序列，从而实现近似对数线性的生成复杂度，并通过面向探索的数据增强与迭代精炼两阶段训练减少过拟合、促进可控新颖性。在分子与非分子基准上的实验显示，该方法在保持较高有效性和唯一性的同时提升了生成图的新颖性，并支持 LSTM 与 Mamba 风格的因果序列骨干。
authors: Alessio Barboni, Massimiliano Lupo Pasini, Bishal Lakha, Edoardo Serra

articles.title: Neural Galerkin Normalizing Flows for Bayesian Inference of Diffusions with Inaccessible Boundaries
articles.title_zh: 用于不可达边界扩散过程贝叶斯推断的神经 Galerkin 归一化流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One of the primary challenges in Bayesian inference on the parameters of a diffusion model from discrete observations is the unavailability of an analytical expression for the transition density function between consecutive observation times, which is needed to derive the likelihood function. Extending previous studies that solve Fokker-Planck (FP) type partial differential equations with Normalizing Flows, we propose a new Normalizing Flow architecture to learn the transition density function of the diffusion process between two observation times. We do so by solving in a Neural Galerkin framework the associated FP equation with a Dirac mass as initial condition, over a specified training distribution of the initial datum and the coefficients of the diffusion. We specifically focus on processes whose diffusion matrix vanishes in certain inaccessible boundary regions, such as Stochastic Volatility models that satisfy a Feller condition. The product of the obtained transition densities evaluated along the observed trajectory approximates the likelihood function, thereby enabling cheap posterior sampling via Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). After the offline training phase, inference becomes significantly more efficient, as it avoids the need to solve the FP equation in real time for each parameter proposed by the MCMC sampler or to rely on other likelihood-free methods for Bayesian inference that involve repeated simulation of diffusion bridges.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对离散观测下扩散模型参数的贝叶斯推断，处理相邻观测时刻转移密度通常无解析表达的问题。作者提出一种归一化流架构，在神经 Galerkin 框架中求解以 Dirac 质量为初始条件的 Fokker-Planck 方程，以学习扩散过程的转移密度。该方法特别关注扩散矩阵在某些不可达边界区域退化的过程，如满足 Feller 条件的随机波动率模型；沿观测轨迹评估得到的转移密度乘积可近似似然，从而支持较低成本的 MCMC 后验采样。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling of Biodegradable Contaminant Transport through GCL/SL Composite Liners
articles.title_zh: 可生物降解污染物通过 GCL/SL 复合衬垫迁移的物理信息神经网络建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study develops a two-domain physics-informed neural network framework for contaminant transport through a GCL/SL composite liner system, in which the thin GCL layer is treated using a steady-state advection-dispersion-biodegradation formulation and the underlying soil liner is modeled as a transient transport domain. Two formulations are evaluated against analytical and finite-element reference solutions under different leachate-head conditions: a standard PINN with soft constraint enforcement (Std-PINN) and a hard-constrained PINN (H-PINN), in which selected boundary and initial conditions are embedded directly into the trial solutions. The Std-PINN captures the overall breakthrough behavior but shows larger errors during the early transport stage, particularly under higher leachate heads where advective transport becomes more pronounced. The H-PINN reduces the optimization burden associated with penalty-based constraint enforcement and provides more accurate and stable concentration predictions, lowering the MAE from approximately 0.058-0.067 for the Std-PINN to about 0.011-0.023 for the H-PINN, while reducing the MRE from approximately 9.10%-19.16% to about 2.08%-3.14%. Parametric analyses confirm that the H-PINN with the tanh activation function and an optimized network structure provides the best predictive accuracy. The H-PINN is further extended to inverse modeling for identifying the SL degradation half-life from limited concentration observations, showing reliable convergence toward prescribed values and acceptable robustness under low-to-moderate observation noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了用于模拟污染物通过土工合成黏土衬垫/土衬垫复合系统迁移的双域物理信息神经网络框架，其中薄 GCL 层采用稳态对流-弥散-生物降解模型，底部土衬垫作为瞬态迁移域。作者比较了软约束标准 PINN 与将部分边界和初始条件直接嵌入试探解的硬约束 PINN，并与解析解和有限元参考解对照。结果显示，标准 PINN 能捕捉总体穿透行为但早期误差较大，尤其在较高渗滤液水头下；硬约束 PINN 降低了罚函数约束带来的优化负担，并显著提高浓度预测的准确性和稳定性。
authors: Dong Li, Yapeng Cao, Haiping Zhao, Shutong Han

articles.title: Loss-Conditional PINNs for Parametric PDE Families
articles.title_zh: 用于参数化偏微分方程族的损失条件 PINN
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) approximate solutions of ODEs and PDEs by minimising a weighted combination of residual, boundary, initial, and data losses. Their performance is often dominated by the choice of loss weights: a poor weighting can drive training to a degenerate solution in which one physical constraint is satisfied while another is ignored. Existing methods select or adapt a single good set of weights. We take a different view: instead of tuning one weight vector, we explore the entire weight space during training. We introduce LC-PINN, which adapts the loss-conditional training of Dosovitskiy and Djolonga (2020) to the PDE-residual setting: the conditioning vector (either the loss weights or a scalar physical coefficient) is treated as a network input and sampled from a simple prior at every optimisation step. This turns PINN training into learning a continuous family of solutions indexed by that vector, with no solver-generated paired data. LC-PINN thus lies between classical PINNs and operator learning: it stays fully physics-informed but amortises training over a parametric family. Our contribution is not the loss-conditional construction itself, but its extension to PINNs, the unification of the loss-weight and parametric-coefficient regimes under one architecture (concatenation for loss weights, FiLM for coefficients), and a fixed-quadrature L-BFGS finishing protocol that makes the parametric-coefficient regime trainable. We give a lambda-invariance result for the conditional optimum and study LC-PINN on parametric Helmholtz, Schrodinger, viscous Burgers, and Buckley-Leverett equations. A single LC-PINN matches or improves retrained per-weight PINN baselines while parameterising the full family in one model, at a total cost that amortises favourably against per-instance retraining.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对物理信息神经网络中损失权重选择对训练效果高度敏感的问题，提出 LC-PINN：不再寻找单一最优权重，而是在训练中采样并探索整个权重空间。方法将损失权重或物理系数作为网络输入，使模型学习由条件向量索引的连续解族，且无需求解器生成的配对数据。该框架介于传统 PINN 与算子学习之间，保持完全物理约束的同时实现对参数化问题族的训练摊销。

articles.title: Learning symplectic model reduction based on a approximation theorem of symplectic embeddings
articles.title_zh: 基于辛嵌入逼近定理的辛模型降阶学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-dimensional Hamiltonian systems play a central role in many scientific and engineering disciplines, with dynamics evolving on symplectic manifolds. Although deep learning provides powerful tools for constructing low-dimensional surrogates from data, the intrinsic symplectic structure is easily destroyed during model reduction. As a result, a standard autoencoder may produce latent coordinates that do not support a Hamiltonian flow, leading to unstable long-time prediction. In this paper, we first establish a universal approximation theorem for symplectic embeddings. Based on this theory, we propose symplecticity-preserving autoencoders (SpAE), in which the decoder is parameterized as a symplectic embedding and the encoder is constructed as the corresponding symplectic projection. This architecture is expressive enough to approximate nonlinear symplectic embeddings and the associated symplectic projections, preserves the symplectic structure exactly by construction, and can be trained by standard unconstrained optimization, thereby improving both reconstruction and prediction accuracy. Extensive experiments on high-dimensional lattice and particle systems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究高维哈密顿系统的结构保持型模型降阶，指出普通自编码器容易破坏系统固有的辛结构，从而影响长期预测稳定性。作者首先建立辛嵌入的通用逼近定理，并据此提出保持辛性的自编码器 SpAE，其中解码器参数化为辛嵌入，编码器构造为相应的辛投影。该架构在构造上精确保持辛结构，同时可用标准无约束优化训练，并旨在提升重构与预测精度。
authors: Liyi Feng, Yifa Tang, Yulin Xie, Ruili Zhang, Aiqing Zhu

articles.title: Learning Long Range Spatio-Temporal Representations over Continuous Time Dynamic Graphs with State Space Models
articles.title_zh: 利用状态空间模型学习连续时间动态图上的长程时空表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04672v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) provide a richer framework to capture fine-grained temporal patterns in evolving relational data. Long-range information propagation is a key challenge while learning representations, wherein it is important to retain and update information over long temporal horizons. Existing approaches restrict models to capture one-hop or local temporal neighborhoods and fail to capture multi-hop or global structural patterns. To mitigate this, we derive a parameter-efficient state-space modeling framework for continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDG-SSM) from first principles. We first introduce continuous-time Topology-Aware higher order polynomial projection operator (CTT-HiPPO), a novel memory-based reformulation of HiPPO to jointly encode temporal dynamics and graph structure. The solution from CTT-HiPPO is obtained by projecting the classical HiPPO solution through a polynomial of the Laplacian matrix, yielding topology-aware memory updates that admit an equivalent state-space formulation for CTDGs (CTDG-SSM). Then a computationally efficient discrete formulation is obtained using the zero-order hold approach for model implementation. Across benchmarks on dynamic link prediction, dynamic node classification, and sequence classification, CTDG-SSM achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, it achieves large performance gains on datasets that require long range temporal (LRT) and spatial reasoning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向连续时间动态图表示学习中的长程信息传播问题，提出参数高效的 CTDG-SSM 状态空间建模框架。作者引入连续时间拓扑感知高阶多项式投影算子 CTT-HiPPO，将时间动态与图结构共同编码，并通过拉普拉斯矩阵多项式投影得到拓扑感知的记忆更新。该方法进一步推导出适用于连续时间动态图的等价状态空间形式，并给出计算高效的离散化实现。
authors: Ayushman Raghuvanshi, Thummaluru Siddartha Readdy, Sundeep Prabhakar Chepuri, Mahesh Chandran

articles.title: Curvature-aware dynamic precision approach for physics-informed neural networks
articles.title_zh: 面向物理信息神经网络的曲率感知动态精度方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04736v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have become a promising framework for simulating partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws directly into neural network training. However, recent studies show that PINN optimisation is sensitive to numerical precision. Existing implementations commonly use either single precision (FP32), which is computationally efficient but prone to failure modes, or double precision (FP64), which is robust but substantially expensive. This creates a trade-off between computational efficiency and numerical accuracy. To reduce the computational cost of double-precision training while retaining prediction accuracy, we propose a curvature-aware precision controller that adapts numerical precision during training rather than treating it as a fixed implementation choice. The proposed method reuses curvature information derived from the limited-memory BFGS (L-BFGS) optimiser to construct a precision controller, retaining FP32 when lower precision is sufficient and promoting computation to FP64 when the training dynamics indicate numerical sensitivity or precision-limited stagnation. We evaluate the proposed approach on four canonical PINN failure-mode benchmarks and an irradiance-driven ordinary differential equation example. We further test the proposed approach across different neural network architectures. The method consistently matches or even slightly exceeds full FP64 solution accuracy while reducing training time relative to full double-precision training on all benchmark equations. The obtained results indicate that precision sensitivity in PINN optimisation is phase-dependent, and that selectively applying higher precision only during numerically critical stages can lower computational cost without sacrificing predictive accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注 PINN 训练对数值精度的敏感性，以及 FP32 高效但不稳健、FP64 稳健但代价高的权衡。作者提出一种曲率感知精度控制器，利用 L-BFGS 优化器产生的曲率信息，在训练过程中动态决定何时使用单精度或提升至双精度。该方法旨在保留预测精度的同时降低双精度训练的计算成本，特别是在训练动态显示数值敏感或精度受限停滞时启用更高精度。
authors: Yingjie Shao, Ioannis N. Athanasiadis, George van Voorn, Taniya Kapoor

articles.title: Reconciling Causality and Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics with Hamiltonian Causal Models
articles.title_zh: 用哈密顿因果模型调和因果性与非平衡热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Causal modeling of physical temporal phenomena must handle interventions that act along trajectories, nonstationary induced laws, path-dependent effects, and feedback mediated by dynamics, all challenging in standard causal models. We introduce Hamiltonian Causal Models (HCMs), a trajectory-level framework in which observed variables interact with local environments and interventions act as controls of Hamiltonian mechanisms. HCMs separate immutable equations of motion from intervenable mechanisms and define causal effects as discrepancies between interventional path laws. A key motivation for HCMs is their natural interface with non-equilibrium thermodynamics. Entropy production quantifies the irreversibility of a process and is a central causal observable: it is estimable from data and witnesses causal effects along the system's evolution that are invisible to endpoint and cumulative versions of the standard average treatment effect. As in physics, cause and effect are not primitives of the relation between two random variables but arise from the non-invertibility of the thermodynamic arrow. With this, our paper reconciles the language of statistical causal models and non-stationary thermodynamics, offering new tools to describe causality in a wide range of physical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出哈密顿因果模型 HCM，用于刻画物理时间过程中的轨迹级因果关系，处理沿轨迹施加的干预、非平稳诱导分布、路径依赖效应以及动力学反馈等问题。HCM 将不可变的运动方程与可干预机制分离，并将因果效应定义为干预后路径律之间的差异。作者强调该框架与非平衡热力学的自然联系，尤其将熵产生视为可从数据估计、能够揭示系统演化中因果效应的核心观测量。
authors: Dario Rancati, Max Welling, Francesco Locatello

articles.title: Worker Utility as Hysteresis: A Preisach Model of Transaction Acceptance in Gig Labour Markets
articles.title_zh: 作为滞后的工人效用：零工劳动市场中交易接受的 Preisach 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Worker utility is not observed -- only its consequence is. Each gig transaction produces a single bit: accepted or rejected. We argue this structure points directly to the Preisach hysteresis model as the natural representation of latent worker preferences. The Preisach operator models aggregate output as an integral over a population of binary threshold elements -- precisely the structure that emerges when heterogeneous workers each carry a private acceptance wage. We estimate two latent utility surfaces: acceptance utility U₁₍X) and rejection utility U₀₍X), via a dual-output neural network (shared layers 256->128, margin loss enforcing U₁ >= U₀₎. Classification reduces to the Preisach gap U₁₍X) - U₀₍X), passed into an XGBoost classifier alongside clip-stabilised price-to-threshold encodings. On 36,891 gig transactions, this pipeline achieves Jaccard = 0.827 and ROC AUC = 0.799. The price-to-threshold encoding accounts for +11.0 pp AUC over raw utility features. The model confirms the directional asymmetry hysteresis predicts: price decreases depress completion rates more than equivalent increases raise them. Applied to the full dataset, the model's recommendations simultaneously reduce the total wage bill by 21.3% and increase expected fill rate by 9.7 pp. For 74.2% of transactions, P(accept) already exceeds 0.80; reducing the wage keeps it above threshold (mean post-cut P = 0.972), releasing cost savings (median 31%). For the remaining 25.4%, a median 7% wage increase recovers +43 pp acceptance. A model without an explicit indifference zone cannot execute both moves simultaneously.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文认为零工交易中只能观察到接受或拒绝这一二元结果，因此潜在工人偏好可自然表示为 Preisach 滞后模型中的异质二值阈值群体。作者通过双输出神经网络估计接受效用与拒绝效用，并将二者差值及价格—阈值编码输入分类器来预测交易完成。基于 36,891 笔交易的实验显示，该建模流程取得较好分类性能，并支持价格下降对完成率的负面影响大于等幅价格上升正面影响的滞后不对称性。

articles.title: Enhancing the MADDPG Algorithm for Multi-Agent Learning via Action Inference and Importance Sampling
articles.title_zh: 通过动作推断与重要性采样增强多智能体学习中的 MADDPG 算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate multi-agent deep reinforcement learning and propose two enhancements to the Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) algorithm. First, we introduce a novel Action Inference mechanism that enables each agent to predict other agents' intended actions, thereby improving the accuracy and stability of its own policy. Second, we apply an importance sampling strategy, using geometric distribution, in the replay buffer to prioritize more recent and informative experiences, which helps mitigate the non-stationarity inherent in multi-agent environments. We evaluate both modifications on the discrete-action Predator-Prey task provided by the PettingZoo library, a flexible Python interface for general multi-agent reinforcement learning benchmarks. Our results indicate that Action Inference is effective in improving learning stability and inter-agent cooperation and that importance sampling using geometric distribution can lead to significant improvements in exploration efficiency over standard MADDPG. Code available at https://github.com/shaashwathsivakumar/MARL_Proj
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出对多智能体深度确定性策略梯度 MADDPG 的两项改进：动作推断机制和基于几何分布的重要性采样。动作推断使每个智能体预测其他智能体的意图动作，从而提升自身策略的准确性与稳定性；重要性采样则在经验回放中优先利用较新且更有信息量的经验，以缓解多智能体环境中的非平稳性。作者在离散动作捕食者—猎物任务上评估方法，结果表明这些改进有助于学习稳定性、协作能力和探索效率。
authors: Marc Walden, Jason Liu, Shaashwath Sivakumar, Ryan Liu, Hamza Khan

articles.title: In-Context Graphical Inference
articles.title_zh: 上下文内图模型推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05042v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Marginal inference in discrete graphical models forces a choice between exactness and scalability: exact algorithms are intractable for high-treewidth graphs, while iterative approximations (Belief Propagation, variational methods) sacrifice convergence guarantees on frustrated topologies. We argue that this dichotomy stems from a mismatched inductive bias: iterative methods abandon the sequential elimination structure that makes exact inference correct. We introduce In-Context Graphical Inference (ICG-I), an autoregressive Graph Transformer that restores this structure by mimicking Variable Elimination with learned, Tensor- Train-compressed intermediate factors, paired with a Dirichlet output layer and Weighted Conformal Prediction for calibrated, distribution-free coverage guarantees under topological shift. We prove that TT compression errors propagate at most lincarly through the autoregressive chain, that the Dirichlet-Multinomial loss is a proper scoring rule, and that WCP maintains coverage with a quantifiable degradation under estimated density ratios. We conducted intensive experiments to evaluate ICG-I and achieved state-of-the-art performance across all benchmarks. ICG-I reduces MAE from 0.041 (best baseline) to 0.020 on standard instances and achieves 0.048 on N=500 frustrated spin glasses where BP diverges entirely.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对离散图模型边缘推断中精确性与可扩展性难以兼得的问题，提出上下文内图模型推断 ICG-I。该方法使用自回归图 Transformer 模仿变量消去过程，并以张量列车压缩中间因子，同时结合 Dirichlet 输出层和加权保形预测以提供校准的分布无关覆盖保证。作者还分析了压缩误差传播、损失函数的适当评分性质以及拓扑偏移下覆盖率退化，并通过实验评估该方法的表现。
authors: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun

articles.title: Covert Influence Between Language Models
articles.title_zh: 语言模型之间的隐蔽影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As language models increasingly consume one another's outputs, covert influence -- a phenomenon where a sender's payload (the behavioral disposition it is conditioned to propagate) transfers to a receiver through carriers undetectable by humans -- becomes a growing risk. We characterize this risk across three interfaces: supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and in-context learning, and find that they vary in the scale of influence achievable without leaving behind human-visible traces. Using inference-time per-sample attribution scores, we study covert influence across all three interfaces with the ability to select carriers that amplify training-time influence, unlocking payload transfers that prior work could not achieve. We further provide evidence that covert influence with natural-language carriers is a distinct phenomenon from prior studies using number carriers, as the latter is more resistant to human detection and less portable across model families. Together, these results suggest that the risk surface for covert influence is broader than previously recognized, and we study pointwise attribution scoring methods as a tool to investigate and mitigate it.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究当语言模型越来越多地消费彼此输出时可能出现的隐蔽影响风险，即发送方的行为倾向通过人类难以察觉的载体传递给接收方。作者在监督微调、在线策略蒸馏和上下文学习三种接口下刻画这种风险，并利用推理时逐样本归因分数选择能够放大训练时影响的载体。研究表明，自然语言载体下的隐蔽影响与以数字为载体的既有研究存在差异，说明相关风险面比先前认识更广。
authors: Avidan Shah, Jay Chooi, Jinghua Ou, Shi Feng

articles.title: EpiFormer: Learning Antigen-Antibody Interactions for Epitope Prediction via Geometric Deep Learning
articles.title_zh: EpiFormer：通过几何深度学习学习抗原—抗体相互作用以预测表位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04154v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Antibodies neutralize foreign antigens by binding to specific surface regions called epitopes. Computational epitope prediction is critical for understanding immune recognition and guiding antibody engineering. However, existing methods face three fundamental challenges: antibody-aware models encode each chain independently and combine them only at a late stage, failing to capture co-dependent structural features that define binding interfaces, whereas severe class imbalance and scarcity of known antibody-antigen complexes render standard training objectives ineffective. We propose EpiFormer, a general encoder-decoder framework that addresses these challenges jointly. Our key design principle is interleaved cross-attention within GNN encoding layers, enabling bidirectional antigen-antibody information flow throughout representation learning rather than only at the output. This early-fusion principle is backbone-agnostic, providing consistent gains across GNN architectures from simple GCNs to equivariant models. We further show that sparsity-aware objectives are effective when paired with early-fusion architectures for the epitope prediction task. EpiFormer improves over the previous best method by over 40% in F1 score on standard benchmarks, demonstrating generalizability and cross-dataset transferability. Notably, EpiFormer discovers known biological principles as emergent behaviors of end-to-end training, where the learned cross-attention gates favor antigen-to-antibody information flow, consistent with the asymmetric roles of the two chains at the binding interface, and the model's preference for geometric over evolutionary features aligns with the established finding that epitope residues are not evolutionarily conserved. The source code is available at: https://github.com/mansoor181/epiformer.git
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 EpiFormer，用于计算预测抗体结合抗原表面的表位区域。针对现有抗体感知模型常分别编码链并在后期融合、难以捕获结合界面共依赖结构特征，以及样本稀缺和类别极不平衡的问题，EpiFormer 在 GNN 编码层中引入交错交叉注意力，实现抗原与抗体信息的早期双向流动。作者指出这种早期融合原则与具体骨干网络无关，并可与稀疏感知训练目标结合以提升表位预测效果。
authors: Mansoor Ahmed, Huirong Chai, Haoxin Wang, Hemanth Venkateswara, Murray Patterson

articles.title: DetectZoo: A Unified Toolkit for AI-Generated Content Detection Across Text, Audio, and Image Modalities
articles.title_zh: DetectZoo：跨文本、音频与图像模态的 AI 生成内容检测统一工具包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04205v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The growing popularity and capacity of generative models have eroded the distinction between human and machine-generated content, motivating a growing body of work on detection across text, images, and audio. Most available detectors are either commercial software or, if open-source, come with incompatible codebases with bespoke preprocessing, evaluation protocols, and evaluation metrics, which make their adoption, fair comparison, and reproduction quite difficult. To address this critical gap, we introduce DetectZoo, a first-of-its-kind, extensible toolkit designed to provide a unified interface for AI-generated content detection across text, audio, and image modalities. DetectZoo standardizes the complete empirical pipeline, from data ingestion and preprocessing to model assessment, offering researchers a cohesive framework to benchmark state-of-the-art detectors systematically. By integrating diverse public datasets and baseline detection algorithms under a single, unified API, our toolkit facilitates rigorous and reproducible evaluation. DetectZoo provides reference implementations of 61 detectors, native loaders for 22 benchmark datasets, and a standardized evaluation pipeline that reports multiple metrics through a common interface. Each detector is self-contained yet accessible through the same interface, automatically caches pretrained weights, and reproduces the original published results. DetectZoo lowers the barrier to entry for multi-modal AI forensics, enabling researchers to identify performance gaps across domains and accelerating the development of robust, generalizable detection techniques. The open-source repository and comprehensive documentation are publicly available at https://github.com/sadjadeb/DetectZoo, and the package can be installed via pip install detectzoo.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文介绍 DetectZoo，一个用于文本、音频和图像模态 AI 生成内容检测的可扩展统一工具包。针对现有检测器多为商业软件或开源实现彼此不兼容、预处理和评估流程难以复现的问题，DetectZoo 标准化从数据读取、预处理到模型评估的完整实验流程。该工具包整合多种公共数据集和基线检测算法，提供统一 API 与大量参考实现，以支持系统、公平和可复现的基准评测。
authors: Sajad Ebrahimi, Nima Jamali, Bardia Shirsalimian, Kelly McConvey, Wentao Zhang, Jalehsadat Mahdavimoghaddam, Maksym Taranukhin, Maura Grossman, Vered Shwartz, Yuntian Deng, Ebrahim Bagheri

articles.title: StepPRM-RTL: Stepwise Process-Reward Guided LLM Fine-Tuning for Enhanced RTL Synthesis
articles.title_zh: StepPRM-RTL：用于增强 RTL 综合的逐步过程奖励引导大语言模型微调
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automatic generation of RTL code for digital hardware designs remains challenging due to long-horizon reasoning, multi-step dependencies, and strict correctness constraints in Verilog and VHDL. We present StepPRM-RTL, a novel framework that combines stepwise trajectory modeling, process-reward modeling (PRM), and retrieval-augmented fine-tuning (RAFT) to enhance both the functional correctness and reasoning fidelity of LLM-based RTL code generation. StepPRM-RTL constructs stepwise reasoning trajectories from canonical solutions, where each step contains a rationale and incremental code modification. A Process Reward Model (PRM) evaluates intermediate steps, providing dense feedback that guides reinforcement-style updates during RAFT fine-tuning. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative reasoning paths, enriching the training dataset with high-quality trajectories. This integration of stepwise and outcome-aware rewards allows the model to learn both how and why to construct correct RTL, improving long-horizon reasoning beyond standard supervised or outcome-based training. Experimental evaluation on benchmark Verilog and VHDL datasets demonstrates that StepPRM-RTL outperforms the best prior methods by over 10% in functional correctness and reasoning fidelity metrics. Ablation studies confirm that the combination of PRM-guided rewards and stepwise trajectory exploration is key to its performance. StepPRM-RTL generalizes across RTL languages and provides a scalable framework for high-fidelity, interpretable code generation, establishing a new standard for LLM-assisted hardware design automation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 StepPRM-RTL，用于改进大语言模型生成 Verilog 和 VHDL 等 RTL 代码时的功能正确性与推理质量。框架从规范解构建逐步推理轨迹，每一步包含理由与增量代码修改，并使用过程奖励模型对中间步骤提供密集反馈以指导检索增强微调。作者还结合蒙特卡洛树搜索探索替代推理路径，从而丰富高质量训练轨迹，使模型学习如何以及为何构造正确 RTL。
authors: Prashanth Vijayaraghavan, Apoorva Nitsure, Luyao Shi, Ehsan Degan, Vandana Mukherjee

articles.title: Parthenon Law: A Self-Evolving Legal-Agent Framework
articles.title_zh: Parthenon Law：一种自进化法律智能体框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04602v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As agents grow more capable, legal-domain LLM agents promise to turn document-heavy matters into reviewable work products -- yet reliable deployment faces three obstacles: no large-scale evidence on how today's strongest model-and-harness combinations behave on end-to-end legal matters; no agent architecture adapted to the legal vertical, only general-purpose harnesses; and, in a setting that keeps shifting with new facts, authorities, and deadlines, no mechanism for systems to learn from their own outcomes. We address each. A large-scale empirical study on Harvey LAB -- 12,510 agent trajectories -- shows that even frontier agents remain far from completing matters in a single pass: per-criterion accuracy climbs with stronger models while strict matter completion stalls. We then introduce textscParthenon, a self-evolving legal-agent framework that factors Model, Harness, Agent roles, legal Knowledge, deterministic Tools, and procedural Skills into auditable surfaces for source traceability, date and number grounding, deliverable compliance, and issue closure. Finally, an anti-leakage learning loop converts scored failures into task-agnostic edits to skills, tools, and knowledge, letting the system improve with experience -- as a firm refines its checklists and playbooks after each matter -- without touching model weights. Across our large-scale empirical analysis, textscParthenon substantially improves the performance of state-of-the-art models and harnesses on legal-matter tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对法律领域大语言模型智能体在端到端法律事务中可靠性不足、缺乏法律垂直架构以及难以随新事实和期限自我改进的问题展开研究。作者基于Harvey LAB的12,510条智能体轨迹进行大规模实证分析，发现更强模型虽能提高单项标准准确率，但严格意义上的事务一次性完成率仍停滞。随后提出Parthenon框架，将模型、执行框架、智能体角色、法律知识、确定性工具和程序性技能分解为可审计界面，并通过防泄漏学习循环将评分失败转化为后续改进任务。

articles.title: MIRAGE: Mobile Agents with Implicit Reasoning and Generative World Models
articles.title_zh: MIRAGE：具备隐式推理与生成式世界模型的移动智能体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile agents are increasingly expected to operate everyday applications from screenshots and language goals, where reliable control requires reasoning over screen affordances, multi-step navigation, and future state changes. However, many agents externalize this computation as long textual chains of thought, which slows interaction, increases supervision cost, and complicates deployment. We introduce MIRAGE, a framework that learns continuous latent reasoning representations from visible textual reasoning traces. MIRAGE transfers explicit reasoning into compact hidden states, enabling the agent to reason internally without decoding long rationales. It also incorporates a generative world-model objective: latent reasoning vectors are aligned with future screenshots, encouraging the agent to anticipate upcoming interface states before acting. This turns hidden computation into both a compressed thought representation and a forward-looking model of environment dynamics. At inference time, MIRAGE reasons in continuous latent space, reducing token generation while improving execution efficiency. On AndroidWorld, MIRAGE matches explicit chain-of-thought supervised fine-tuning in the 4B ablation with a 3-5x lower decoded-token budget and improves a comparable instruction-tuned baseline by 10.2 points; on AndroidControl, it improves action grounding while generating over 75% fewer tokens.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出MIRAGE框架，面向从屏幕截图和语言目标操作移动应用的智能体，旨在减少依赖冗长显式思维链带来的交互变慢、监督成本高和部署复杂等问题。MIRAGE从可见文本推理轨迹中学习连续潜在推理表示，将显式推理压缩到隐藏状态中，使智能体无需生成长篇理由即可进行内部推理。该框架还引入生成式世界模型目标，使潜在推理向量与未来屏幕状态对齐，从而提升对界面变化的预判能力，并在推理时降低token生成量、提高执行效率。
authors: Zhichao Yang, Yuanze Hu, Haojie Hao, Longkun Hao, Dongshuo Huang, Hongyu Lin, Gen Li, Lanqing Hong, Yihang Lou, Yan Bai

articles.title: DiffAero: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Simulation Framework for Efficient Quadrotor Policy Learning
articles.title_zh: DiffAero：用于高效四旋翼策略学习的GPU加速可微仿真框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.10247v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This letter introduces DiffAero, a lightweight, GPU-accelerated, and fully differentiable simulation framework designed for efficient quadrotor control policy learning. DiffAero supports both environment-level and agent-level parallelism and integrates multiple dynamics models, customizable sensor stacks (IMU, depth camera, and LiDAR), and diverse flight tasks within a unified, GPU-native training interface. By fully parallelizing both physics and rendering on the GPU, DiffAero eliminates CPU-GPU data transfer bottlenecks and delivers orders-of-magnitude improvements in simulation throughput. In contrast to existing simulators, DiffAero not only provides high-performance simulation but also serves as a research platform for exploring differentiable and hybrid learning algorithms. Extensive benchmarks and real-world flight experiments demonstrate that DiffAero and hybrid learning algorithms combined can learn robust flight policies in hours on consumer-grade hardware. The code is available at https://github.com/flyingbitac/diffaero.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文介绍了DiffAero，一个轻量级、GPU加速且完全可微的四旋翼控制策略学习仿真框架。该框架支持环境级和智能体级并行，集成多种动力学模型、可定制传感器栈以及多类飞行任务，并通过GPU端物理与渲染全并行消除CPU-GPU传输瓶颈。基准测试与真实飞行实验表明，DiffAero结合混合学习算法可在消费级硬件上数小时内学习鲁棒飞行策略，并可作为研究可微和混合学习算法的平台。
authors: Xinhong Zhang, Runqing Wang, Yunfan Ren, Jian Sun, Hao Fang, Jie Chen, Gang Wang

articles.title: Channel-Oriented Design for EEG-to-Music Reconstruction
articles.title_zh: 面向脑电到音乐重建的通道导向设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04040v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Brain-computer interfaces aim to decode naturalistic stimuli from neural signals, yet most progress to date has focused on vision and language. In this article, we study a more challenging but far less explored setting, EEG-to-music reconstruction, where signals are weak, distributed, and highly susceptible to noise and channel variability. Our central finding is that early channel mixing destroys weak but discriminative EEG signals. To address this, we propose a channel-oriented design with three key components. Specifically, channel-wise tokenization treats each electrode as an explicit token to retain spatially localized neural evidence, channel-wise multi-view self-distillation enforces consistency across temporal crops and random channel subsets to learn robust and distributed representations, and channel-wise data augmentation introduces structured channel dropout to improve invariance to noise, artifacts, and missing electrodes. Together, these components preserve weak yet informative signals across channels and enable stable alignment to a semantic music representation space. We integrate this channel-oriented design within an encoding-alignment-decoding pipeline for EEG-to-music reconstruction. Theoretically, we characterize when preserving channel-level structure leads to improved alignment. Empirically, we compare with a range of state-of-the-art baselines and demonstrate consistent and significant performance gains.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究从脑电信号重建音乐这一相较视觉和语言解码更具挑战且较少探索的脑机接口任务。作者发现，过早混合通道会破坏微弱但具有判别性的脑电信息，因此提出通道导向设计，包括将每个电极作为显式token的通道级标记化、跨时间裁剪与随机通道子集的一致性自蒸馏，以及结构化通道丢弃增强。该方法旨在保留各通道中的弱信息并提高对噪声、伪迹和缺失电极的鲁棒性，从而更稳定地对齐到语义音乐表示空间。
authors: Jiaxin Qing, Junwei Lu, Lexin Li

articles.title: VISTA: Vision-Grounded and Physics-Validated Adaptation of UMI data for VLA Training
articles.title_zh: VISTA：用于VLA训练的UMI数据视觉扎根与物理验证适配框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04708v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable real-world robot data collection without hardware-specific teleoperation, yet leveraging UMI data to train large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains fundamentally challenging. We identify two critical mismatches: wrist-mounted fisheye views, with severe radial distortion and local gripper-centric perspectives, are out-of-distribution for pretrained VLMs; and human-collected trajectories frequently violate kinematic limits, incur collisions, or exceed controller bandwidth, teaching VLA policies physically infeasible actions. To address the challenges, we present VISTA, a framework that bridges this dual gap through three synergistic components. (i)~UMI-VQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset tailored to wrist-mounted fisheye observations, aligns VLM representations to the distorted visual regime via auxiliary vision-language supervision. (ii)~A systematic physical-validation pipeline performs a data-completeness pre-check and scores each valid trajectory for trajectory continuity, self-collision risk, and execution fidelity before it enters training. (iii)~A two-stage co-training recipe jointly learns vision-language grounding on UMI-VQA and action prediction on validated trajectories. Our experiments empirically show that incorporating UMI-VQA consistently improves downstream policy performance, and that physical-validation scores are strongly predictive of deployment success. On diverse simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, VISTA significantly outperforms strong baselines including π₀.₅, LingBot-VLA, and Wall-X. We release the physical-validation pipeline, UMI-VQA, validated trajectory data, and the pre-trained model for the community.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文关注如何将通用操作接口采集的真实机器人数据用于训练大规模视觉-语言-动作模型。作者指出两类关键不匹配：腕部鱼眼视角存在强径向畸变且视角局部化，偏离预训练视觉语言模型分布；人类采集轨迹还可能违反运动学限制、发生碰撞或超出控制器带宽，从而引入物理不可行行为。为此，VISTA通过面向腕部鱼眼图像的UMI-VQA数据集、轨迹完整性与物理可执行性验证流程，以及后续训练适配机制来缩小视觉与物理双重差距。
authors: Siyuan Yang, Linzheng Guo, Ouyang Lu, Zhaxizhuoma, Daoran Zhang, Xinmiao Wang, Ting Xiao, Fangzheng Yan, Zhijun Chen, Yan Ding, Chao Yu, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li

articles.title: Experimental Investigation of Convective Heat Transfer in MWCNT–CeO₂–Fe₃O₄ Tri-Hybrid Nanofluids under Transitional Flow Regime
articles.title_zh: 过渡流态下MWCNT–CeO₂–Fe₃O₄三元混合纳米流体对流换热的实验研究
articles.abstract: Tri-hybrid nanofluids, comprising three distinct nanoparticles dispersed in a base fluid, have recently gained attention for advanced thermal management applications due to their potential for enhanced heat transfer performance. Despite extensive studies on mono- and hybrid nanofluids, limited research exists on the thermo-physical behavior of tri-hybrid nanofluids, particularly under transitional flow conditions. In this study, a tri-hybrid nanofluid consisting of multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNT), cerium oxide (CeO₂), and iron oxide (Fe₃O₄) was experimentally investigated under transitional flow regimes. The nanofluids were prepared at varying volume concentrations and weight composition ratios to evaluate their influence on thermal conductivity and convective heat transfer characteristics. Experimental results indicate that, in addition to nanoparticle volume concentration, the weight composition ratio significantly influences the thermal conductivity of the nanofluid. Colburn j-factor analysis was employed to identify the boundaries of laminar, transitional, and turbulent flow regimes across a range of Reynolds numbers. The tri-hybrid nanofluids exhibited enhanced convective heat transfer coefficients compared to the base fluid. Furthermore, results show that lower nanoparticle concentrations promote better dispersion stability, leading to improved heat transfer performance within the transitional regime. The findings highlight the critical role of nanoparticle synergy and composition in optimizing thermal performance. This study provides new insights into the behavior of tri-hybrid nanofluids and establishes a foundation for their application in efficient thermal systems operating within transitional flow conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究实验考察了由多壁碳纳米管、氧化铈和氧化铁分散于基液中形成的三元混合纳米流体在过渡流态下的热物性和对流换热表现。研究制备了不同体积分数和质量组成比例的纳米流体，以评估其对导热系数和对流换热特性的影响。结果表明，除颗粒体积分数外，组分质量比例也显著影响导热系数；通过Colburn j因子分析可识别层流、过渡流和湍流边界，且三元混合纳米流体表现出增强的对流换热能力。

articles.title: Structural, Morphological and Optical Properties of Cd0.7Fe2.3O4 Thin Films Deposited on Glass and Quartz Substrates and Electrical Investigation of Cd0.7Fe2.3O4/n-Si heterostructure.
articles.title_zh: 玻璃和石英基底上Cd0.7Fe2.3O4薄膜的结构、形貌与光学性质及Cd0.7Fe2.3O4/n-Si异质结电学研究
articles.abstract: Thin films of Cd0.7Fe2.3O4 were deposited by spray pyrolysis on glass, quartz, and n-type silicon substrates, and the effect of annealing temperature on their structural, optical, and electrical properties was investigated. XRD results confirm the formation of a spinel structure after annealing, accompanied by improved crystallinity. Optical measurements reveal strong absorption in the UV–visible range, with a band gap varying from 3.14 to 3.85 eV. FTIR analysis confirms the presence of Cd–O and Fe–O bonds. Electrical characterization of the Cd0.7Fe2.3O4/n-Si heterostructure shows rectifying behavior, with the ideality factor decreasing from 6 to 1 as temperature increases, indicating improved carrier transport. These results demonstrate the potential of this material for electronic and optoelectronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用喷雾热解法在玻璃、石英和n型硅基底上沉积Cd0.7Fe2.3O4薄膜，并考察退火温度对其结构、光学和电学性质的影响。XRD结果证实退火后形成尖晶石结构且结晶性改善，光学测试显示薄膜在紫外-可见区具有强吸收，带隙为3.14至3.85 eV，FTIR确认存在Cd–O和Fe–O键。Cd0.7Fe2.3O4/n-Si异质结表现出整流行为，理想因子随温度升高由6降至1，表明载流子输运改善，显示其在电子与光电子器件中的应用潜力。

articles.title: Dual-Scale Electronic Regulation via Ru–O–Fe Coupling Enables Decoupling of Activity and Stability in Acidic Oxygen Evolution
articles.title_zh: 通过 Ru–O–Fe 耦合实现双尺度电子调控，在酸性析氧反应中解耦活性与稳定性
articles.abstract: Ruthenium-based catalysts are promising alternatives to iridium for proton exchange membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE), yet their practical application is limited by the intrinsic trade-off between high activity and poor stability in acidic oxygen evolution reaction (OER). Here, we report a RuFeOx superstructure that establishes a dual-scale electronic regulation framework to overcome this limitation. The Fe2O3@RuO2 core–shell architecture introduces two synergistic Ru–O–Fe coupling motifs with distinct but hierarchical roles. At the heterointerface, energy-level alignment enables continuous electron donation from Fe to Ru, suppressing excessive oxidation of Ru active sites. Within the RuO2 lattice, the coupling motif induces orbital redistribution by increasing the filling of the Ru dz² orbital, which weakens Ru–O covalency, optimizes oxygen adsorption energetics, and promotes direct O–O coupling with reduced lattice oxygen participation. As a result, the catalyst simultaneously achieves high activity and durability, delivering an overpotential of 208 mV at 10 mA cm− 2 in 0.5 M H2SO4 and stable operation for over 300 h. In a PEM water electrolyzer, it enables continuous operation at 1 A cm− 2 for 200 h with a low Ru loading of 0.85 mg cm− 2. Combined experimental and theoretical analyses reveal that interfacial charge transfer and lattice-confined orbital modulation operate in a hierarchical manner to govern catalytic behavior across multiple scales. This work provides a generalizable strategy for decoupling activity and stability through multi-scale electronic regulation in acidic OER catalysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了一种 RuFeOx 超结构催化剂，通过 Fe2O3@RuO2 核壳结构构建双尺度电子调控框架，以克服钌基催化剂在酸性析氧反应中高活性与低稳定性之间的权衡。界面处 Fe 向 Ru 的持续电子供给抑制 Ru 活性位点过度氧化，而 RuO2 晶格内的 Ru–O–Fe 耦合调节轨道占据、削弱 Ru–O 共价性并优化氧吸附。该催化剂在 0.5 M H2SO4 中于 10 mA cm−2 下过电位为 208 mV，并可稳定运行超过 300 小时，显示出用于 PEM 水电解的潜力。

articles.title: Spintronic Neuromorphic Hardware Using Domain Wall Based Neurons and Quantized Synapses
articles.title_zh: 基于畴壁神经元与量化突触的自旋电子神经形态硬件
articles.abstract: In this work, we simulate the functionality of artificial neuron and synapse using spin-orbit torque-based spintronic devices and implemented a fully connected artificial neural netwrok (ANN). These neuro-synaptic devices are emulated using transverse domain wall dynamics in a rectangular magnetic nanotrack comprised of heavy metal/ferromagnet (HM/FM) heterostructures. The ReLU activation function of the neuron has been mimicked using the domain wall motion induced by a 3 ns current pulse. The synapse has been modelled using current-induced domain wall (DW) dynamics through a corrugated HM/FM nanotrack under the influence of a 10 ns current pulse with varying current density. The semicircular corrugations are in the form of notches, which are symmetrically located on both sides of the nanotrack. By applying 10 ns current pulses of varying densities, we achieve controlled DW pinning, revealing a step-like motion caused by temporary pauses at each pinning center. The electrical conductance of the pinned DW across various pinning points, act as stable synaptic weights for our ANN. Furthermore, we observe a threshold-dependent delay effect where each depinning event is influenced by previous ones, successfully mimicking synaptic memory and adaptability in neuromorphic systems. The fully connected ANN has been modeled using the conventional float32 synaptic weights for the MNIST and Fashion MNIST datasets with an accuracy of ∼ 97 % and ∼ 86 % respectively, which serves as a test bed of our neuromorphic simulations. With the aim of implementing a sparse and low memory footprint ANN, we quantize the trained synaptic weights into discrete quantized level and tested the network, which demonstrate an accuracy of ∼95% and ∼62%, for the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST dataset, respectively. Although direct quantization impacted performance, fine-tuning the network fully restored accuracies to near-baseline levels. These findings highlight the potential of engineered DW pinning-depinning dynamics for scalable, adaptive, and hardware-efficient neuromorphic computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用基于自旋轨道转矩的自旋电子器件模拟人工神经元和突触，并构建全连接人工神经网络。神经元的 ReLU 激活函数通过矩形重金属/铁磁体纳米轨道中的横向畴壁运动来模拟，突触权重则由带缺口纳米轨道中畴壁在不同钉扎位置的电导状态表示。研究表明，电流脉冲可实现受控畴壁钉扎和阶梯式运动，从而形成稳定的量化突触权重，并揭示了去钉扎事件中的阈值依赖延迟效应。

articles.title: UPA-MTL: Uncertainty-Aware Parameter-Efficient Adaptive Multi-Task Learning for Fraud Detection and Multimodal Analysis
articles.title_zh: UPA-MTL：面向欺诈检测与多模态分析的不确定性感知参数高效自适应多任务学习
articles.abstract: The rapid deployment of deep learning models in high-stakes domains such as financial fraud detection, multimedia forensics, and multimodal analysis has exposed a critical tension between computational efficiency and prediction reliability. Parameter-efficient transfer learning methods enable adaptation of large pre-trained models with minimal trainable parameters, yet they lack mechanisms for quantifying prediction uncertainty, leading to overconfident outputs under distribution shift. Conversely, uncertainty-aware fusion frameworks provide calibrated predictions but typically require full model fine-tuning, limiting their applicability in resource-constrained and multi-task settings. In this paper, we propose UPA-MTL, a unified framework that bridges this gap by integrating uncertainty-aware multimodal fusion with parameter-efficient multi-task adaptation. UPA-MTL introduces three key components: an Uncertainty-Aware Adapter Module that extends lightweight adapters with epistemic uncertainty estimation via Monte Carlo dropout, an Adaptive Cross-Task Fusion mechanism that enables positive knowledge transfer across tasks while preventing negative interference through task-specific modulation gates, and an Uncertainty-Gated Fusion layer that dynamically adjusts modality contributions based on per-modality uncertainty estimates. Extensive experiments on fraud detection, deepfake detection, and multi-task dense prediction benchmarks demonstrate that UPA-MTL achieves state-of-the-art performance while using only 1.5 percent of the total model parameters, with improvements of 1.6 percent F1 on fraud detection, 0.6 percent AUC on deepfake detection, and 1.1 percent mIoU on PASCAL-Context. Our results validate that uncertainty-aware parameter-efficient adaptation is both feasible and beneficial for multi-task and multimodal learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出 UPA-MTL 框架，旨在同时解决高风险应用中深度学习模型的计算效率与预测可靠性问题。该方法将参数高效的多任务适配与不确定性感知多模态融合结合起来，通过带 Monte Carlo dropout 的适配器估计认知不确定性，并利用跨任务自适应融合促进正向迁移、抑制负迁移。该框架面向金融欺诈检测、多媒体取证和多模态分析等场景，试图在资源受限条件下提供更可校准的预测。

articles.title: The AI-Driven Bio-Velocity Equilibrium Framework (BVEF): Quantifying Ecosystem Degradation as an Algorithmic Volatility Variable in Luxury Hotel Asset Valuation and GOPPAR
articles.title_zh: AI 驱动的生物速度均衡框架：将生态系统退化量化为豪华酒店资产估值与 GOPPAR 中的算法波动变量
articles.abstract: Traditional corporate real estate and hospitality asset management frameworks are fundamentally blind to the economic velocity of localized ecosystems and biodiversity collapse. This study introduces the AI-Driven Bio-Velocity Equilibrium Framework (BVEF), a universal quantitative architecture designed to translate raw biophysical field indicators directly into commercial hospitality financial metrics. By modeling localized biological decay as an algorithmic, time-variant risk multiplier, the Bio-Velocity Index, this study demonstrates that ecosystem destabilization triggers a predictable, nonlinear compression of Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR) and Total Revenue Per Available Room (TrevPOR). This compression occurs via two simultaneous vectors: shifts in luxury demand elasticity curves and the escalation of unbudgeted operational mitigation expenses. To correct this systemic blind spot, the framework utilizes an advanced Predictive AI Architecture that automates the framework into a real-time risk mitigation utility. By deploying deep-learning Neural Networks to continuously ingest multimodal biophysical streaming data and Machine Learning models to interface directly with hotel Property Management Systems (PMS), the system transitions from a passive valuation model to an active, autonomous piece of financial infrastructure. This AI core modifies classical Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) asset appraisal models by autonomously injecting a dynamic risk premium: the Biodiversity Risk Discount. Through a multi-epoch empirical simulation of a nature-dependent ultra-luxury resort asset, we prove that conventional static appraisal methodologies overvalue properties in ecologically volatile zones by up to 66.78%, representing massive unhedged corporate capital destruction events. Finally, this study outlines how institutional investors, international regulatory bodies complying with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD), and sovereign wealth entities can operationalize this global architecture to insulate real estate portfolios from biological volatility.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 AI 驱动的生物速度均衡框架（BVEF），用于将局地生态系统和生物多样性退化的生物物理指标转化为酒店资产管理中的财务风险变量。框架以“生物速度指数”建模生态衰退的时间变化风险，认为生态系统不稳定会通过奢华需求弹性变化和非预算运营缓解成本上升，非线性压缩 GOPPAR 与 TrevPOR。研究进一步设想利用深度学习和机器学习整合多模态生态数据，形成实时风险监测与资产估值辅助工具。

articles.title: Stable Phenanthrene-Fused 1,2,4-Triazinyl Radicals with Ultra-narrow Electrochemical Gap Enabled by Attenuated Fusion-Ring Aromaticity
articles.title_zh: 通过削弱稠合环芳香性实现具有超窄电化学能隙的稳定菲并 1,2,4-三嗪自由基
articles.abstract: The design of organic materials with narrow electrochemical gaps (Egap) is critical for modern electronics, yet achieving such narrow gaps while retaining robust stability and facile processability remains a fundamental challenge. Herein, we report a new strategy based on targeted attenuation of aromaticity in π-extended Blatter-type radicals that enables notable gap reduction to 0.75 eV—the lowest reported for this class. We prepare the robust Blatter radical derivatives 1 and 1-tBu, in which its triazinyl moiety is fused with the central ring of phenanthrene, creating an annulated ring system with reduced aromaticity, compared to classical Blatter radicals. Our studies indicate that reducing fusion-ring aromaticity lowers substantially the gas-phase ionization potential while moderating neutral-state solvation enhancement that typically accompanies π-extension, thereby preserving larger differential solvation stabilization and consequently a substantial Egap reduction. Experimental Egap is observed to exhibit high correlation with the DFT-computed total spin density on the triazinyl-fused ring for the studied Blatter derivatives. In addition, sublimable 1 forms well-ordered thin films of intact radicals on Au(111) surface, highlighting its practical processability. This work establishes aromaticity modulation as an effective strategy for stable, narrow-gap materials, based upon neutral radicals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种通过定向削弱 π 扩展 Blatter 型自由基中稠合环芳香性来缩小电化学能隙的策略。作者合成了三嗪基团与菲中心环稠合的稳定自由基衍生物，其较低芳香性有助于降低气相电离势并维持差异溶剂化稳定，从而实现低至 0.75 eV 的电化学能隙。实验结果还显示，电化学能隙与 DFT 计算得到的三嗪稠合环总自旋密度高度相关，并且可升华分子能够形成有序薄膜。

articles.title: Synthetic Biomolecular Condensates as Tunable Microtubule Assembly Hubs
articles.title_zh: 作为可调微管组装枢纽的合成生物分子凝聚体
articles.abstract: Phase separation of proteins and nucleic acids (NAs) into nano-to-microscale condensates can regulate biochemical processes, including assembly and organization of cytoskeletal networks such as actin and microtubules. This study examines the functional role of condensate material properties in microtubule assembly. Learning from the sequence grammar of naturally occurring intrinsically disordered regions in microtubule-associated proteins, two-component peptide-NA condensates with programmable material properties were designed. These synthetic condensates catalyze tubulin polymerization into microtubule filaments with tunable outcomes. Tubulin preferentially partitions to the condensate interface and nucleates microtubule assembly. Enhanced tubulin self-assembly produces long filaments that exhibit branching and bundling. Using a minimal stochastic chemo-mechanical model, we show that sequence-encoded condensate viscoelasticity is a tunable element that controls filament morphologies and identifies interfacial rheology as the key regulator of filament growth. Fluorescence recovery after photobleaching experiments support this model, revealing a direct correlation between interfacial tubulin mobility and condensate-directed microtubule assembly. Distinct regimes emerge due to competition between bulk adsorption and lateral diffusion of tubulin at the condensate interface, which determines whether filament tips grow or stall. Since dynamic microtubule assembly and restructuring are essential for various cellular functions, this work highlights a critical role of condensate interfacial rheology in cytoskeletal organization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨蛋白质和核酸相分离形成的凝聚体在微管组装中的功能作用，重点关注凝聚体材料性质对微管成核与生长的调控。作者借鉴微管相关蛋白内在无序区的序列规律，设计了具有可编程材料性质的双组分肽-核酸凝聚体，可促进微管蛋白聚合并调节微管形态。模型和荧光漂白恢复实验表明，序列编码的凝聚体黏弹性，尤其是界面流变性质，是控制微管丝生长、分支和成束的关键因素。

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware 3D Plant Reconstruction from Sparse Video Frames Using Neural Radiance Fields
articles.title_zh: 利用神经辐射场从稀疏视频帧进行不确定性感知的三维植物重建
articles.abstract: Automated three-dimensional reconstruction of plant architecture under- pins high-throughput crop phenotyping, yet its deployment in practical field settings is constrained by two fundamental limitations of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF): degraded geometry under sparse, unstructured image capture, and a complete absence of calibrated uncertainty estimates that would allow practitioners to distinguish reliable geometry from reconstruction artefacts. We present UA-PlantNeRF, a unified framework that resolves both limita- tions through three tightly coupled contributions. First, building on VISAR, our prior intelligent video frame-selection strategy (weights α1 = 0.4, α2 = 0.3, α3 = 0.3), the pipeline identifies maximally informative, non-redundant view- points from raw footage with as few as 15 frames. Second, a dual-head NeRF architecture augmented with Monte Carlo Dropout produces jointly decom- posed aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty alongside each reconstructed voxel, trained under a heteroscedastic negative log-likelihood objective. Third, split conformal prediction—with calibration performed on held-out plants to preserve exchangeability— yields provable, distribution-free per-ray cov- erage guarantees at any user-specified confidence level. Evaluated across three benchmarks (Pheno4D, ROSE-X, and our novel UA-Field greenhouse dataset) at sparsity levels N ∈ 15, 30, 50, UA-PlantNeRF achieves PSNR 28.7±0.6 dB and SSIM 0.89±0.01 at N = 30, outperforming all sparse-view baselines (p < 0.05, Wilcoxon signed-rank), while reducing Chamfer Distance by 31.4 % over vanilla sparse-view NeRF. Conformal calibration achieves 89.7 % empirical coverage at the 90 % nominal target, reducing ECE from 0.143 to 0.041 relative to uncalibrated Monte Carlo Dropout. A per-region uncertainty decomposition reveals that occluded zones exhibit predominantly epistemic uncertainty whereas leaf edges exhibit predominantly aleatoric un- certainty, providing actionable re-capture guidance. The total end-to-end pipeline takes approximately 4 h 10 min on a single consumer GPU.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出 UA-PlantNeRF，用于解决植物三维表型重建中稀疏非结构化图像导致的几何退化及缺乏可信不确定性估计的问题。该框架结合智能视频帧选择策略，从原始视频中选取少量高信息量视角，并采用双头 NeRF 与 Monte Carlo dropout 同时估计偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。研究还引入分割保形预测，以在植物重建体素层面提供分布无关的可靠性评估，帮助区分可信结构与重建伪影。

articles.title: From empirical growth to predictive design of 2D perovskite single crystals
articles.title_zh: 从经验生长到二维钙钛矿单晶的预测性设计
articles.abstract: Precise regulation of the out-of-plane stacking number in two-dimensional (2D) perovskite single crystals is essential for realizing stable and high-performance optoelectronic devices. However, deterministic thickness control at the atomic scale remains challenging due to the stochastic nature of crystallization and insufficient mechanistic understanding. Here, we establish a closed-loop platform integrating high-throughput experimentation and machine learning to quantitatively elucidate and regulate the stacking mechanism of 2D perovskite single crystals. Over 1,000 automated experiments were conducted to construct a comprehensive composition–environment–structure database, enabling random forest analysis to identify ligand rigidity and π-conjugation as dominant descriptors for step-edge formation energy. We reveal that aromatic π-conjugated ligands enhance molecular rigidity and drive a transition from dislocation-driven to layer-by-layer growth, achieving deterministic control of stacking, ranging from sub-unit-cell to multi-layer configurations (0.5 to more than 10 unit cells). The resulting atomically precise crystals exhibit extended exciton lifetimes and pronounced edge-state luminescence, highlighting quantum confinement and exciton-phonon coupling in the ultrathin regime. This work transforms 2D perovskite synthesis from empirical adjustment to predictive design, offering a generalizable strategy for constructing low-dimensional materials and advancing next-generation quantum and optoelectronic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了结合高通量实验与机器学习的闭环平台，用于阐明并调控二维钙钛矿单晶的层外堆叠机制。基于超过 1000 次自动化实验构建的组成–环境–结构数据库，随机森林分析识别出配体刚性和 π 共轭是影响台阶边缘形成能的关键描述符。研究表明，芳香 π 共轭配体可增强分子刚性并推动晶体从位错驱动生长转向逐层生长，实现从亚晶胞到多层尺度的确定性堆叠控制，并改善相关光电性质。

articles.title: Gyre dynamics modulate northward throughput of Gulf Stream water to subpolar latitudes
articles.title_zh: 环流动力学调节墨西哥湾流海水向副极地纬度的北向输送
articles.abstract: The northeastward transport of Gulf Stream water is a major conduit for heat in the Atlantic Ocean, shaping climate across the Arctic-Atlantic region. Variability in the amount of Gulf Stream water that is 'throughput' to subpolar latitudes gives rise to a potential for predicting temperatures further north, but is not well understood. Here, we use Lagrangian techniques to quantify the throughput of Gulf Stream water in an eddy-rich ocean model. We find distinct interannual variability related to the strength of the wind field. During transitions to negative North Atlantic Oscillation (NAO) conditions, the tilt of subsurface density-surfaces reduce due to weakened vertical Ekman velocities in the gyres. This reduces the baroclinicity of the North Atlantic Current and results in increased subsurface throughput of Gulf Stream water. The results demonstrate how gyre dynamics impact the upper-branch of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) by modulating the northward throughput of Gulf Stream water.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用富涡海洋模型中的拉格朗日方法，量化墨西哥湾流水向副极地纬度的输送及其年际变化。结果显示，在向负北大西洋涛动条件转变时，环流中垂向 Ekman 速度减弱会降低次表层密度面倾斜，从而减弱北大西洋流的斜压性并增加墨西哥湾流水的次表层北向输送。该工作揭示了环流动力学如何通过调节墨西哥湾流通量影响大西洋经向翻转环流的上分支，并为北大西洋及北极-大西洋区域气候预测提供机制依据。

articles.title: Universal scaling relation between the minimal conductivity and Hall conductivity in unpaired Dirac fermions
articles.title_zh: 未配对狄拉克费米子中最小电导率与霍尔电导率之间的普适标度关系
articles.abstract: Electrical conductivities reveal the topological and magnetic properties of band structures in solids, especially for quantum anomalous Hall effect systems. In this work, we evaluate the longitudinal and Hall conductivities for unpaired Dirac fermions in the framework of the self-consistent Born approximation, incorporating vertex and quantum-interference corrections. We discover a nearly semi-elliptic relation between the minimal conductivity and Hall conductivities across topological phase transitions. Near the charge neutrality point, disorder can drive a metal-insulator transition and enhance the longitudinal conductivity. For the massless case, the minimal conductivity σ* coexists with the half-quantized Hall conductivity frace²2h, forming an indicator for the parity-anomalous semimetal. The scaling relation reveals that the quantum anomalous Hall flow pattern in disordered Dirac fermions is distinct from the semicircle law of integer quantum Hall effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在自洽 Born 近似框架下，结合顶角修正和量子干涉修正，计算未配对狄拉克费米子的纵向电导率和霍尔电导率。作者发现，在拓扑相变过程中，最小电导率与霍尔电导率之间存在近似半椭圆关系；在电荷中性点附近，无序可驱动金属-绝缘体转变并增强纵向电导。对于无质量情形，最小电导率与半量子化霍尔电导共存，可作为奇异半金属态的指示特征，并显示其流图不同于整数量子霍尔效应的半圆定律。

articles.title: Evaluation of Permeability Damage in Tight Sandstone from Hydroxypropyl guar Fracturing Fluids After Prolonged Exposure
articles.title_zh: 长时间暴露后羟丙基瓜尔胶压裂液对致密砂岩渗透率损害的评价
articles.abstract: Hydraulic fracturing fluids used in tight gas wells may remain in the formation for extended periods before flowback because of operational and environmental constraints. This prolonged shut-in period can increase the potential for additional formation damage. This study evaluated the long-term impact, up to 6 months, of a Hydroxypropyl guar-based (HPG) cross-linked fracturing fluid on the permeability of Scioto tight sandstone under high-temperature reservoir conditions. It represents one of the first systematic investigations of such extended fluid exposure durations. Core flooding experiments were conducted to determine the initial and regained permeability after thermal aging at 145°C for 1, 3, and 6 months. FTIR, XRD, and TGA analyses were performed on the dried unbroken fluid, broken fluid, and recovered residue to characterize polymer degradation and the formation of inorganic solids. The core flooding results showed limited permeability impairment after the initial cleanup, reaching up to 11%. However, permeability continued to decline with longer aging periods, and the loss became partly irreversible, reaching an additional 38% after 6 months. SEM-EDX analysis showed that oxygen, carbon, and boron were the dominant detected elements. The residue consisted mainly of boron oxides and polymeric material. Treatment of the residue with HCl at 145°C for 40 h substantially reduced the amount of insoluble material, leaving mainly large coarse particles within two dominant size ranges, from several hundred to about 1,000 µm and around 2,000 µm, with only a minor fraction below 100 µm. Although these particles were much larger than the pore throats of tight sandstone, their size distribution in fractured formations may provide adequate coverage to mitigate damage associated with large residue slumps. Overall, the findings indicate that prolonged fluid contact promotes the accumulation of persistent inorganic residues that impair permeability, while high-temperature acid treatments can reduce this damage during post-fracturing cleanup.
