articles.title: Implementation of analytical excited state gradients for open-shell systems in time-dependent density functional theory plus tight binding (TDDFT+TB) method
articles.title_zh: 面向开壳层体系的 TDDFT+TB 方法解析激发态梯度实现
articles.abstract: Excited state potential energy surfaces are essential for understanding molecular behavior in excited states, including electronic transitions, reaction dynamics, and other photochemical and photophysical properties. When excited state minima or reaction dynamics are of interest, the gradients of the total excited state energy are required. Time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) is a widely used method, as it provides reasonably accurate excited state energies compared to experiment; however, its computational cost scales unfavorably with molecule size. To address this limitation, methods that maintain TDDFT accuracy while reducing the computational cost are needed. The time-dependent density functional theory plus tight binding (TDDFT+TB) method offers comparable accuracy to TDDFT with significantly improved efficiency. Previously, Havenridge et al. implemented TDDFT+TB analytical excited state gradients for closed-shell molecules. This was achieved using a Lagrangian-based approach by taking analytical derivatives of the excitation energies with respect to nuclear coordinates. In this study, we extend this implementation to handle open-shell molecular systems. Our unrestricted TDDFT+TB analytical gradient implementation follows the framework of the unrestricted TDDFT analytical gradient code in the Amsterdam Density Functional engine within the Amsterdam Modeling Suite. Building on the existing closed-shell implementation, we focus on key modifications to the coupling matrix and the incorporation of spin indices in the gradient expressions required for open-shell systems. We validate the method through calculations on various molecular systems, comparing gradient accuracy, emission energies, and computational cost to demonstrate that it delivers reliable results for open-shell molecular excited states with improved efficiency compared to the standard TDDFT method.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对开壳层分子体系扩展了时间依赖密度泛函理论加紧束缚方法（TDDFT+TB）的解析激发态梯度实现。激发态势能面及其梯度对于研究电子跃迁、光化学反应动力学和激发态极小值至关重要，而 TDDFT+TB 旨在保持接近 TDDFT 精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该工作在此前闭壳层分子解析梯度实现的基础上，进一步支持未成对电子体系的激发态结构与动力学研究。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: PINNfluence: Interpreting PINNs through Influence Functions
articles.title_zh: PINNfluence：通过影响函数解释物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.08958v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful deep learning approach for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in the physical sciences, yet their behavior remains largely opaque and is typically understood through failure mode analyses rather than explicit interpretability. To address this issue, we introduce PINNfluence, a training data attribution framework for interpreting PINNs based on influence functions. By extending influence functions to composite physics-informed training objectives, we enable fine-grained attribution between predictions, loss components, and training data points. Through benchmark experiments across various PDEs, we demonstrate that influence patterns provide granular diagnostics that distinguish structural characteristics across well-trained and poorly-trained PINNs. PINNfluence thus opens a new avenue for understanding and improving the reliability of PINNs through the lens of their data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 PINNfluence，一种基于影响函数的训练数据归因框架，用于解释物理信息神经网络（PINNs）。作者将影响函数扩展到包含物理约束的复合训练目标中，从而能够细粒度地分析预测结果、损失分量和训练数据点之间的影响关系。在多个偏微分方程基准实验中，影响模式可区分训练良好与训练不佳的 PINN 的结构特征，为提升 PINN 的可解释性和可靠性提供了新途径。
authors: Aleksander Krasowski, Jonas R. Naujoks, Moritz Weckbecker, Galip Ü. Yolcu, Thomas Wiegand, Sebastian Lapuschkin, Wojciech Samek, René P. Klausen

articles.title: Reporting and Hosting a Dataset of high-impedance faults in medium-voltage covered conductors
articles.title_zh: 中压覆皮导线高阻抗故障数据集的报告与托管
articles.abstract: This work presents a multimodal dataset characterizing high impedance faults (HIF) in medium voltage covered conductors under controlled ground contact conditions. Insulation reduces wildfire risks but restricts fault currents below conventional detection thresholds. This restriction causes a significant delay in the start of the fault signature. The dataset documents the temporal evolution of these events by integrating high resolution electrical waveforms sampled at 20 kS/s with power quality metrics from an IEC 61000-4-30 Class A analyzer. Complementary modalities include radiometric thermography and visual video with embedded audio available for selected cases. The experimental design covers 22 groups and 142 segments accounting for variables such as conductor tip geometry and air gaps and surface materials and moisture actions. Instrumentation uses independent acquisition platforms to minimize electromagnetic interference. Technical validation confirms a signal to noise ratio exceeding 5 to 1 at nominal voltages and metrological consistency. This repository provides a structured framework for validating physical models and developing detection algorithms by addressing incipient dielectric failure in overhead distribution networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发布了一个用于表征中压覆皮导线高阻抗故障的多模态数据集，实验在受控接地接触条件下进行。数据集包含 20 kS/s 采样的高分辨率电气波形、符合 IEC 61000-4-30 A 类分析仪的电能质量指标，并在部分案例中提供红外热成像、可见光视频和音频。实验覆盖导线端部几何、气隙、接触表面材料及湿度等变量，为物理模型验证和高阻抗故障检测算法开发提供了结构化基准。

articles.title: Meteorological Analysis of an Aircraft Accident: A Case Study of Flight 2283 (ATR 72-500)
articles.title_zh: 一起航空事故的气象分析：2283 航班（ATR 72-500）案例研究
articles.abstract: This study analyzes the meteorological environment associated with the accident of Voepass Flight 2283, involving an ATR 72–500 aircraft, which occurred on 9 August 2024 in the municipality of Vinhedo, São Paulo, Brazil. The objective was to characterize, in an integrated and multiscale approach, the atmospheric conditions favorable to severe in-flight icing, correlating meteorological evidence with the operational records described in the preliminary report issued by CENIPA. The methodology was based on ERA5 data from pressure and surface levels, GOES-16 infrared satellite imagery, polarimetric radar products, and radiosonde observations from Campo de Marte (SBMT). Temperature, relative humidity, wind, geopotential, and vertical velocity fields were analyzed between 8 and 9 August 2024, with emphasis on the critical period from 15:00 to 17:00 UTC. The results indicate that the event occurred under the influence of a frontal system associated with low-level cold-air advection, a well-defined 500 hPa trough, and upper-level dynamic support at 250 hPa, configuring a synoptic environment classically favorable to extensive cold stratiform cloud layers. The aircraft remained at the FL170 cruise level, embedded within a deep atmospheric layer characterized by temperatures between 0°C and − 20°C and high relative humidity, a critical thermodynamic range for the presence of supercooled liquid water.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了 2024 年 8 月 9 日巴西圣保罗州维涅杜市 Voepass 2283 航班 ATR 72-500 事故相关的气象环境。作者综合 ERA5 再分析资料、GOES-16 红外卫星图像、双偏振雷达产品和无线电探空观测，从多尺度角度刻画有利于严重飞行中结冰的条件。结果表明，事故时段受锋面系统、低层冷平流、500 hPa 槽以及高空动力支持共同影响，形成了有利于广泛冷性层状云发展的天气背景。

articles.title: Ultrasonic Vacuum Drying of Microwave Pretreated Coix Seeds: Drying Characteristics and Quality
articles.title_zh: 微波预处理薏苡仁的超声真空干燥：干燥特性与品质
articles.abstract: To address the low efficiency and poor quality in drying microwave pretreated coix seeds (MPC), this study applied ultrasonic vacuum drying and compared its effects on drying characteristics, moisture migration, physicochemical properties, and starch structure with those of microwave pretreated vacuum drying (MVD) to elucidate the drying mechanism and optimize the process. Results indicated that ultrasonic power was the most influential parameter, significantly shortening drying time and improving physicochemical properties. Among the five drying models, the Page model best described the drying process of MPC under ultrasonic vacuum drying. Low-field nuclear magnetic resonance and magnetic resonance imaging showed that higher ultrasonic power converted bound water to less mobile water, accelerated internal moisture migration to the surface, and improved dehydration uniformity and efficiency in coix seeds. Microstructural analysis revealed that increasing ultrasonic power induced the formation of visible pores on the surface of coix seed starch. Regarding physicochemical properties, ultrasonic vacuum drying of MPC significantly improved product quality compared with MVD: hardness decreased by 26.39%, rehydration ratio increased by 17.86%, and cooking time shortened by 35.09%. All pasting properties (peak viscosity, final viscosity, setback viscosity) were also lower than those obtained by traditional MVD. Similarly, storage modulus (G′) and loss modulus (G″) decreased by 40.00% and 24.70%, respectively. Overall, ultrasonic vacuum drying after microwave pretreatment significantly improved the efficiency and quality of coix seed processing, demonstrating its potential as an energy efficient and high quality strategy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对微波预处理薏苡仁干燥效率低和品质不足的问题，研究了超声真空干燥对干燥特性、水分迁移、理化性质和淀粉结构的影响，并与微波预处理真空干燥进行比较。结果显示，超声功率是最关键的工艺参数，可显著缩短干燥时间并改善理化品质，Page 模型最适合描述该干燥过程。低场核磁共振、磁共振成像和微观结构分析表明，较高超声功率促进内部水分向表面迁移并提高脱水均匀性，同时在淀粉表面形成可见孔隙。

articles.title: Experimental and theoretical study of Mg doped SnO nanoparticles used for the efficient photocatalytic degradation of Methyl violet dye under UV assisted light
articles.title_zh: Mg掺杂SnO纳米颗粒在紫外辅助光照下高效光催化降解甲基紫染料的实验与理论研究
articles.abstract: The treatment of wastewater with organic dyes is a crucial issue to reduce water pollution. This study modeled Mg-doped SnO nanoparticles using density functional theory (DFT) and analyzed them using the full-potential linearized augmented plane wave (FP-LAPW) employed in the WIEN2k simulation programming code. Further, the theoretically modeled nanoparticles (NPs) were synthesized via the co-precipitation method, which is an efficient photocatalyst for the photodegradation of methyl violet (MV) dye. The morphological study showed that the shape of NPs are cubic and round while the average size of agglomerated NPs is below 440 nm. Density functional calculations were also performed to investigate the role of Mg in the band gap engineering of SnO. The calculated optical band gap from UV-vis spectroscopy and DFT calculations is 3.0 eV and 2.94 eV, respectively. The calculated band structure of pristine SnO reveals the fundamental band gap value of 1.129 eV, whereas the Mg atom contributes a localized band exposed in the doped SnO. The photodegradation study illustrated that Mg-doped SnO NPs degraded 99.3% of MV dye within 25 min under UV irradiation. It was also found that the recovered and re-recovered NPs were also significantly degraded the MV dye. The recovered and re-recovered Mg doped SnO NPs photodegraded about 52 and 73% MV within 25 min. The impact of other of parameters like NPs dosage, pH of medium and initial dye concentration on the photodegradation of dye was also examined. Moreover, Kinetic analysis shows that the photodegradation of MV dye follows pseudo first order reaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合密度泛函理论和实验合成，考察Mg掺杂SnO纳米颗粒作为甲基紫染料光降解催化剂的性能。作者采用WIEN2k中的FP-LAPW方法分析能带结构，并通过共沉淀法制备纳米颗粒；形貌结果显示颗粒呈立方或近圆形，团聚体平均尺寸低于440 nm。UV-vis与DFT得到的光学带隙分别约为3.0 eV和2.94 eV，Mg掺杂引入局域能带并调控SnO带隙。光催化实验显示，在紫外照射下Mg掺杂SnO纳米颗粒可在25分钟内降解99.3%的甲基紫染料。

articles.title: A Leakage-Free Evaluation Framework for Behavioral Malware Detection: Temporal Sensitivity, Dual Pooling, and Verified Explainability
articles.title_zh: 用于行为恶意软件检测的无泄漏评估框架：时间敏感性、双池化与可验证可解释性
articles.abstract: Signature-based malware detectors are inherently vulnerable to polymorphic, metamorphic, and obfuscated variants, motivating behavioral approaches that model runtime process-state dynamics. However, deep learning studies in this domain commonly suffer from three persistent methodological issues: process-level data leakage, lack of temporal window sensitivity analysis, and insufficiently validated explainability claims.This study introduces a leakage-free evaluation framework that directly addresses these deficiencies. On a VirusTotal behavioral dataset of 100,000 millisecond-resolution Linux process observations from 100 temporally ordered process hashes, we employ hash-level GroupShuffleSplit and five-fold GroupKFold cross-validation to enforce strict process-level separation. We quantify that process-level leakage inflates accuracy by 10.06 percentage points, a significant bias in the existing literature. Leakage-free classical baselines establish a true performance floor of 61.34% (Random Forest).The proposed Bi-GRU+DualPool architecture integrates a Bidirectional GRU with parallel Global Average and Global Max Pooling to effectively capture both sustained and transient behavioral patterns. Under rigorous leakage-free five-fold cross-validation, it achieves 74.87 ± 8.56% accuracy and AUC = 0.787, outperforming the classical baseline by 13.53 percentage points. Ablation studies across temporal windows W ∈ 20, 50, 100 demonstrate that dual pooling, rather than Multi-Head Attention, drives performance at short behavioral timescales.Feature perturbability classification bounds the realistic adversarial attack surface. Post-retraining recovery reaches 99.14% (FGSM) and 98.87% (PGD). SHAP KernelExplainer identifies ctxₛwitchᵣₐₜᵢₒ as the primary discriminator with 4/5 cross-subset stability. The framework’s methodological portability is validated on the UNSW-NB15 benchmark.This work establishes rigorous, leakage-aware evaluation standards and practical architectural insights for future behavioral malware detection research.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对行为恶意软件检测中常见的进程级数据泄漏、时间窗口敏感性分析不足和可解释性验证薄弱等问题，提出一种无泄漏评估框架。作者在包含100个按时间排序进程哈希、共10万条毫秒级Linux进程观测的VirusTotal行为数据集上，采用哈希级分组划分与交叉验证，确保进程级严格隔离。结果显示，进程级泄漏会使准确率虚高10.06个百分点；在无泄漏条件下，随机森林基线准确率为61.34%。研究还提出Bi-GRU+DualPool架构，通过双向GRU结合全局平均池化和最大池化，以同时捕捉持续性与瞬态行为特征。

articles.title: Neural-network placement in physics-informed machine learning for mechanistic process-model repair: a case study in industrial coffee roasting
articles.title_zh: 物理信息机器学习中神经网络位置对机理过程模型修复的影响：工业咖啡烘焙案例研究
articles.abstract: Mechanistic process models are central to industrial simulation and control, but their rollout accuracy often depends on run-specific initialization data that archival production telemetry cannot reliably provide. This gap can leave predictions inaccurate even when the underlying physical scaffold is approximately correct. Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) can be used to repair such models from data, yet many comparisons do not isolate a key design choice: where the learned neural network is placed relative to the mechanistic ordinary differential equation (ODE). Using a 221-roast industrial coffee-roasting cohort, this study compares four PIML repair strategies and a matched-input neural baseline as a six-model placement spectrum, holding the learned network family fixed (feedforward multilayer perceptron, MLP) so that the primary design variable is neural-network placement rather than neural architecture. The four PIML strategies lift autonomous-rollout R² from -0.44 to 0.70-0.94; the matched-input neural baseline reaches 0.97 with 3-20 times fewer parameters than every PIML strategy tested. Three structural findings characterize the spectrum. First, the PIML strategies tend to share their hard roasts (per-roast Pearson r approximately 0.5-0.9), whereas the neural baseline identifies a different set of hard roasts (r approximately 0), reaching a comparable predictive ceiling through structurally different failure profiles. Second, in this benchmark a physics-motivated bound on the residual correction costs more than it buys: the unbounded variant uses 3.7 times fewer parameters while improving R² by 0.02. Third, seed stability varies by more than an order of magnitude across PIML strategies (range 0.004 to 0.117 R² across three retraining seeds). These findings suggest that, for this metadata-limited cohort, physics-informed scaffolds are effective repair mechanisms for mechanistic rollouts, but they do not automatically provide better parameter efficiency or optimization stability than a compact matched-input empirical baseline.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注工业过程机理模型在缺乏可靠批次初始化数据时预测精度下降的问题，并探讨物理信息机器学习如何利用数据修复这类模型。作者以221次工业咖啡烘焙数据为案例，比较四种PIML修复策略和一个输入匹配的纯神经网络基线，并固定神经网络为前馈MLP，以突出“网络放置位置”这一设计变量。四种PIML策略将自主滚动预测R²从-0.44提升至0.70–0.94，而匹配输入的神经网络基线达到0.97，且参数量更少。研究表明，神经网络相对于机理ODE的位置会显著影响修复效果与模型复杂度。

articles.abstract: Although the influence of an applied stress across a deformable porous medium has been well studied theoretically and using numerical simulations, direct experimental studies of how applied stress influences both the microstructure of the pore space and the fluid flow through the porous medium remain challenging due to the optically opaque nature of porous media. Of particular interest has been the observation that the rate of permeability decrease reduces with increasing applied effective stress, and that this rate of permeability decrease is associated with a critical stress state at which substantial flow re-distribution occurs. In this work, a randomly-packed bed of monodisperse elastic spheres is used to study the effect of matrix deformation on fluid flow under conditions of confined uniaxial compression. Changes in the local hydrodynamics have been identified and are associated with structural changes such as pore expansion and closing, and generation of new pores. Evidence is reported for a change in the morphology of the pore space at the highest applied effective stress studied and that this is associated with a substantial redistribution of the flow.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用单分散弹性球随机堆积床，在受限单轴压缩条件下考察多孔介质骨架变形对孔隙微结构和流体流动的影响。作者通过磁共振测速识别局部水动力学变化，并将其与孔隙扩张、闭合及新孔隙生成等结构演化相联系。结果显示，在最高有效应力下孔隙空间形貌可能发生变化，并伴随显著的流动重新分配。

articles.title: Integrating Traffic Simulation and Air Quality Modelling to Reduce Vehicle Emissions at Urban Intersections
articles.title_zh: 融合交通仿真与空气质量建模以降低城市交叉口车辆排放
articles.abstract: Estimating vehicular emissions by integrating traffic simulation and emission models has become an important area of research. This study presents four approaches to reduce vehicle emissions and improve air quality at selected intersections in the Lagos Metropolis, using the PTV VISSIM traffic microsimulation model. Traffic parameters, including volume, speed, and vehicle composition, were incorporated into a calibrated model to simulate existing conditions. Different traffic management scenarios involving changes in traffic volume, vehicle composition, and intersection signalization were assessed to determine their effects on traffic performance and emissions of carbon monoxide (CO) and nitrogen oxides (NOx). Roadside emission measurements were used to calibrate baseline conditions. In addition, GIS-based air quality modelling was applied to estimate 1-hour and 24-hour pollutant concentrations, which were validated using field measurements collected over a one-week period. The results show significant emission reductions across all scenarios. Scenario 1 achieved reductions of 41% in CO and 53% in NOx; Scenario 2 achieved 60% and 54% reductions, respectively; and Scenario 3 achieved 46% and 68% reductions, respectively. The introduction of intersection signalization improved traffic flow by reducing delays and increasing vehicle speeds, thereby lowering emission levels. Furthermore, the GIS-based modelling results demonstrate the potential of integrating detailed traffic data with instantaneous exhaust emission estimates and filtered urban background concentrations to generate accurate input data for Gaussian dispersion models applied at the urban scale. The findings provide strategies to improve traffic management, reduce congestion, and mitigate traffic-related air pollution in rapidly growing African cities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将 PTV VISSIM 微观交通仿真、车辆排放估算与 GIS 空气质量建模相结合，评估拉各斯大都市若干交叉口交通管理措施对空气质量的影响。研究纳入交通量、速度和车辆组成等参数，并利用路侧排放监测和一周现场污染物浓度观测对模型进行校准与验证。结果显示，不同交通管理情景均可显著降低一氧化碳和氮氧化物排放，其中部分情景实现了约四成至六成的减排效果。

articles.title: Magnonic Combinatorial Memory based on a network of coupled active ring circuits
articles.title_zh: 基于耦合有源环形电路网络的磁振子组合存储器
articles.abstract: Magnonic Combinatorial Memory (MCM) is a type of memory where the bits of information are encoded in the signal propagation paths in the network. In this work, we consider MCM based on the network of a coupled active ring circuit. Each circuit includes a broadband amplifier, a magnonic delay line, an adjustable frequency filter, an adjustable phase shifter, and a power detector. The coupling between the circuits is via spin waves propagating in the common delay line - ferrite film. There may or may not be auto-oscillations in the active ring circuits, depending on the combination of circuit parameters and circuit coupling. The correlation between the network parameters and the presence/absence of the auto-oscillations is the basis of MCM operation. The address of MCM is defined as the combination of the states of the phase shifters and frequency filters, while the MCM state is defined as the presence/absence of the auto-oscillations. The information is encoded in the coupling between the circuits, which is achieved by placing micromagnets on top of the ferrite film. The number of bits that can be encoded in the network increases quadratically with the number of coupled circuits. It provides a fundamental advantage over conventional memory. We present experimental data obtained for three magnonic ARCs connected via a single-crystal yttrium iron garnet Y3Fe2(FeO4)3 (YIG) film. The data illustrate an example of coding 27 bits using just one magnet in the system of three coupled circuits. The results demonstrate a robust operation of MCM with an On/Off ratio exceeding 30 dB at room temperature. The advantages and shortcomings of the proposed approach are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种磁振子组合存储器，其信息比特编码于耦合有源环形电路网络中的信号传播路径。每个电路包含宽带放大器、磁振子延迟线、可调频率滤波器、可调相移器和功率探测器，电路间通过铁氧体薄膜公共延迟线中的自旋波耦合。存储器地址由相移器和滤波器状态组合定义，存储状态由自激振荡是否出现表征；信息通过置于铁氧体薄膜上的微磁体调控耦合而写入，且可编码比特数随耦合电路数呈二次增长。

articles.title: Standardless LA-ICP-MS fission-track dating in apatite: comparison with uranium thin film and LA-ICP-MS ζ-calibration
articles.title_zh: 磷灰石无标样 LA-ICP-MS 裂变径迹定年：与铀薄膜法及 LA-ICP-MS ζ 校准的比较
articles.abstract: Over the past two decades, the fission-track community has sought to calibrate the ages with LA-ICP-MS. This technique has not only made thermochronology faster but also enabled the determination of U-Pb ages and the measurements of trace elements which support geological interpretation. In this study we present an adjusted age equation for absolute LA-ICP-MS approach, herein referred to as the 𝝍-method, and compare the pooled and grain-by-grain ages with absolute approach based on nuclear reactor (uranium-thin-film based Ø-method) using one aliquot of Durango apatite. Both methods do not require a standard to obtain fission-track ages. In the absolute approach, every parameter in the age equation must be determined with certain precision. Therefore, an experiment was carried out to determine uranium concentration using matrix-matched reference materials (apatite MT-7) and compare with NIST SRM 610, which enables us to verify if there is the potential matrix interference for uranium determination. After that, a series of apatite ages were then calculated. For this purpose, two data sets were used: 1) standard ages (Durango, FCT and Limberg) as well as Mud Tank, which represent the low annealing samples (~ 10%) and 2) samples with moderate annealing (> 10%). In both cases, track length must be considered, as the reduced track length yields proportional reduced fission-track ages. For the first set, the 𝝍-method was the only method applied once the ages are well-known, while the ages from second set were compared with LA-ICP-MS zeta calibration (ζICP). The results show a consistent age between methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕利用 LA-ICP-MS 校准和获取磷灰石裂变径迹年龄的问题，提出一种调整后的绝对年龄方程，即 ψ 方法，并将其与基于核反应堆铀薄膜的 Ø 方法进行比较。作者使用 Durango 磷灰石等样品，考察合并年龄与逐颗粒年龄，并评估不同参考材料在铀浓度测定中可能存在的基体效应。研究旨在检验无标样绝对定年方法的可靠性，并与传统 ζ 校准及相关标准样品结果进行对照。

articles.title: Configuration-Space Bayesian Optimisation for Stress-Critical Pose Identification on a Hyper-Redundant Robot
articles.title_zh: 面向超冗余机器人的应力关键位姿识别的构型空间贝叶斯优化
articles.abstract: Serial manipulators can have strongly varying internal stresses within their configuration space, making the identification of stress-critical poses important for structural design.Because each candidate configuration requires a computationally expensive Finite Element Analysis (FEA), high-fidelity simulations quickly become impractical.This paper proposes a Bayesian optimisation framework that searches directly over the robot configuration space, using peak Von Mises stress as the objective.For each candidate configuration, statically consistent interface reactions are computed and applied as boundary conditions in the structural model.A Gaussian process surrogate with an ARD Matérn 5/2 kernel models the configuration-stress relationship, while the Bayesian algorithm with Expected Improvement acquisition function selects new configurations for parallel evaluation.A case study on a cable-driven hyper-redundant robot demonstrates that the proposed workflow can identify configurations with critical stress states and accurately map the high-stress region with a limited number of simulations.The results show that the framework can support both structural verification and the detection of potentially critical robot poses during operation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种直接在机器人构型空间中搜索应力关键位姿的贝叶斯优化框架，以峰值 Von Mises 应力作为目标函数。由于每个候选构型都需要计算代价较高的有限元分析，研究采用带 ARD Matérn 5/2 核的高斯过程代理模型，并以期望改进采集函数选择新的并行评估构型。针对缆驱动超冗余机器人的案例表明，该方法能以有限仿真次数识别高应力构型并刻画高应力区域，可支持结构校核与风险位姿检测。
authors: Lorenzo De Mari Casareto Dal Verme

articles.title: All-fiber source of high-dimensional time-bin entangled photon pairs
articles.title_zh: 高维时间-bin 纠缠光子对的全光纤源
articles.abstract: High-dimensional entanglement is a valuable resource for quantum information processing and quantum communication. All-fiber implementations are particularly attractive for fiber-based quantum networks, as they offer compactness, intrinsic stability, and direct compatibility with existing fiber infrastructure. Here we demonstrate an all-fiber source of high-dimensional time-bin entangled photon pairs based on spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in a single double-pass PPLN waveguide. By precisely matching the delay of an asymmetric Faraday-Michelson interfer-ometer to the pump-pulse spacing, we obtain a two-photon interference visibility of 99.23% ± 0.31%. We obtain a lower bound on the entanglement of formation (EoF) and certify at least 4 × 4-dimensional entanglement by applying semidefinite-programming-based certification to sparse measurement data. We further demonstrate that optimizing the encoding dimension enables more efficient utilization of entanglement resources across different source brightness levels, highlighting a distinct advantage of high-dimensional sources over two-dimensional entangled sources. Our work offers a compact and stable all-fiber route to high-dimensional entanglement for fiber-based quantum communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种基于单个双程 PPLN 波导中自发参量下转换的全光纤高维时间-bin 纠缠光子对源。通过精确匹配非对称 Faraday-Michelson 干涉仪延迟与泵浦脉冲间隔，实验获得了 99.23% ± 0.31% 的双光子干涉可见度。作者利用基于半定规划的稀疏测量数据认证，给出纠缠形成量下界并证明至少存在 4×4 维纠缠，同时表明优化编码维度有助于在不同亮度水平下更高效地利用纠缠资源。

articles.title: Modeling Inertial Laminar Flow in Fractured Media: Network-Scale Consequences
articles.title_zh: 裂隙介质中惯性层流的建模：网络尺度影响
articles.abstract: Fluid flow in porous and fractured geologic media is commonly modeled with Darcy’s law, yet field and laboratory studies show systematic departures from linear pressure--flux behavior at modest Reynolds numbers where inertia distorts otherwise laminar flow. These non-Darcy effects are especially relevant in fractured systems, where constrictions, intersections, and heterogeneous apertures can amplify inertial losses and reorganize network-scale flow partitioning. In this work, we develop and implement a fully implicit Darcy--Forchheimer formulation in the sc fehm finite-volume framework, designed to incorporate inertial corrections with minimal modification to standard two-point flux assembly. The approach computes interface fluxes using a local Newton--Raphson solver for the Forchheimer relation while preserving global implicit coupling through consistent Jacobian contributions. We verify the implementation against analytical solutions for single-fracture flow across a wide range of apertures, pressure gradients, and Forchheimer coefficients, demonstrating excellent agreement. We then apply the method to (i) three-dimensional discrete fracture networks generated with sc dfnWorks, where we quantify inertia-driven redistribution of flow using a participation-ratio-based channeling metric, and (ii) a three-dimensional enhanced geothermal system heat-extraction problem represented with an upscaled discrete fracture--matrix model. Results show that increasing inertial effects (via pressure gradient or β) reduces flow channeling and can nearly double the fraction of fracture surface area actively participating in flow. In the geothermal example, accounting for inertial losses in wells and fractures decreases cumulative extracted energy by approximately 0.7 and 7.7% over 5000~days depending on β, highlighting that Forchheimer corrections can materially affect performance predictions in fractured reservoir applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对裂隙地质介质中达西定律在中等雷诺数下偏离线性压差—通量关系的问题，发展并实现了一种全隐式 Darcy–Forchheimer 有限体积模型。该方法在界面通量计算中采用局部 Newton–Raphson 求解 Forchheimer 关系，同时通过一致雅可比项保持全局隐式耦合。研究通过单裂隙解析解验证了模型，并将其应用于三维离散裂隙网络等场景，以分析惯性效应对网络尺度流量分配和非达西流动行为的影响。

articles.title: Perfluorohexanone Fire Extinguishing Agent System Enhanced by Nanomaterials and Its Application in Fire Protection of Distribution Networks
articles.title_zh: 纳米材料增强的全氟己酮灭火剂系统及其在配电网消防中的应用
articles.abstract: Fires in distribution networks have become a critical threat to the safe operation of power systems due to their strong concealment and high extinguishing difficulty. As a novel clean fire extinguishing agent, perfluorohexanone exhibits excellent environmental performance and electrical insulation properties, yet its intrinsic defects such as a high surface tension of 16.3 mN/m and a low thermal conductivity of merely 0.059 W/(m·K) restrict its fire extinguishing efficiency in distribution equipment fires. Three types of nanoparticles, namely graphene oxide, carbon nanotubes, and nano-silica, were surface-modified with the silane coupling agent KH-560 and then added to perfluorohexanone. Single-factor experiments determined the optimal modification conditions as follows: coupling agent dosage of 4%, reaction temperature of 80℃, and reaction time of 4 hours. After modification, the absolute value of Zeta potential of the nanoparticles in perfluorohexanone reached − 42.3 mV, with a 30-day sedimentation rate of less than 8%, indicating a significant improvement in dispersion stability. Thermophysical property tests showed that graphene oxide with a mass fraction of 0.12% increased the thermal conductivity of the fire extinguishing agent from 0.059 W/(m·K) to 0.0856 W/(m·K), a rise of 45.1%, reduced the surface tension from 16.3 mN/m to 11.1 mN/m, a drop of 31.9%, and refined the Sauter mean diameter from 85 µm to 62 µm. Studies on the combustion inhibition mechanism via thermal decomposition and free radical scavenging experiments revealed that nanoparticles catalyze the decomposition of perfluorohexanone, increasing the generation rate of inhibitory free radicals by 22%, and simultaneously form a 2–5 µm thick physical isolation layer on the combustion surface to block heat transfer and oxygen diffusion. Standard cup burner experiments demonstrated that the nano-enhanced fire extinguishing agent shortened the extinguishing time of n-heptane flame from 15.2 s to 9.8 s, improving the fire extinguishing efficiency by 55.1%. Numerical simulation and full-scale experimental verification for the typical fire scenario of 10kV distribution cabinets showed that under the conditions of nanomaterial mass fraction of 0.08%-0.12% and injection pressure of 0.6–0.8 MPa, the fire extinguishing time was reduced by 36.4% compared with pure perfluorohexanone, and the insulation resistance of the equipment remained above 1000 MΩ. Application in a demonstration project indicated that this system shortened the fire extinguishing time by 25.3% and increased the system investment by only 3.6% compared with the heptafluoropropane system, providing technical support for fire prevention and control in distribution networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对配电网设备火灾隐蔽性强、扑救困难的问题，探索利用纳米材料改善全氟己酮灭火剂性能。作者对氧化石墨烯、碳纳米管和纳米二氧化硅进行 KH-560 硅烷偶联剂表面改性，并确定了较优改性条件。结果显示，改性后纳米颗粒在全氟己酮中的分散稳定性显著提升；热物性测试表明，低质量分数氧化石墨烯可提高体系导热性能，从而有望增强配电设备火灾的灭火效率。

articles.title: Chirality routing non-polaritonic vacuum correlations in Landau polaritons
articles.title_zh: 朗道极化激元中手性路由的非极化激元真空关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrastrong coupling between matter and cavity vacuum fields can turn the electromagnetic vacuum into a structured quantum environment, thereby opening passive routes for modifying and manipulating material properties. Recent work has identified light--matter entanglement as an important ingredient in these property changes, which raises the question of where the relevant vacuum correlations actually reside. Landau polaritons provide chiral ultrastrong coupling systems in which one circular cavity polarization forms the bright polariton branches. Here, using a quantum information approach, we show that an exact chiral charge in a multimode Hopfield model routes the dominant anomalous correlations, squeezing, and cavity--matter entanglement into the opposite polarization. We find that, using parameters extracted from a multimode Landau polariton system, this hidden sector correlates the cyclotron resonance with finite momentum magnetoplasmons through Gaussian discord, while pairwise matter--matter entanglement remains absent. We further predict a polarization anisotropy of dressed vacuum electric field fluctuations as a signature of this chiral routing. These results identify chirality as a symmetry principle for organizing ultrastrong coupling vacua and show that quantum information tools provide a powerful framework for revealing the salient properties of Landau polaritons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨超强光—物质耦合下电磁真空作为结构化量子环境时，真空关联在朗道极化激元中的分布位置。作者基于多模 Hopfield 模型和量子信息方法指出，精确的手性荷可将主要的反常关联、压缩以及腔—物质纠缠导向与亮极化激元相反的偏振通道。研究还预测了修饰真空电场涨落的偏振各向异性，可作为隐藏关联扇区的实验信号。
authors: Ayoub EL-Amrani, Zakaria Mzaouali, Houssam Sabri, Abdelouahed El Fatimy, Dukhyung Lee

articles.title: Advances in electrical contacts to single crystals of emerging materials for transport measurements
articles.title_zh: 面向输运测量的新兴材料单晶电接触技术进展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transport measurements that probe electrical resistivity of a material under varying external stimuli, such as temperature, magnetic field, optical illumination, and gate voltage, are among the most important experimental techniques in condensed matter physics. These measurements provide critical insights into the fundamental electronic properties of materials. In recent years, they have facilitated the discovery and exploration of intriguing physical phenomena (e.g., superconductivity and quantum oscillations) and unique device functionalities (e.g., photoresponse and electrostatic gating effects) in various emerging materials, particularly in the form of single crystals. However, unlike large-scale wafers or thin films, newly synthesized single crystals often pose substantial challenges in establishing reliable electrical contacts due to their irregular geometries, limited dimensions, inherent structural characteristics, and potential susceptibility to degradation. In this review, we highlight recent technological advancements in the fabrication of high-quality, lithographically defined multi-terminal electrodes on both exfoliable and non-exfoliable single crystals for transport measurements. Our work provides a practical guide for researchers seeking to select appropriate contact-fabrication strategies tailored to unique characteristics of emerging crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述总结了在新兴材料单晶上制备高质量电接触以开展输运测量的技术进展。文章强调，单晶样品常因形状不规则、尺寸有限、结构特性复杂和易退化而难以建立可靠电极连接，并讨论了光刻定义多端电极等方法在电阻率、磁场、光照和栅压响应测量中的重要性。
authors: Huandong Chen, Abhay. N. Pasupathy, Jayakanth Ravichandran

articles.title: Photostationary Lifshitz transition in High Tc superconductor Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ
articles.title_zh: 高温超导体 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ 中的光稳态 Lifshitz 转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To date, controlling the steady-state electronic band structure in high-Tc cuprate superconductors has been achieved primarily through chemical doping or magnetic fields. Here, we present that ultrafast optical excitation can instead drive the electronic band structure of Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ into a photostationary, long-lived excited state. At sufficiently high pump fluences, this state undergoes a Lifshitz transition of the Fermi surface, characterized by a change in topology from hole-like to electron-like. Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, supported by single-band tight-binding calculations, reveals that 1.6 eV photoexcitation induces band-structure evolutions closely analogous to those produced by chemical doping. These results point to an efficient photodoping mechanism involving cooperative effects, including charge transfer, renormalization of effective electronic correlations, and defect-assisted charge trapping. Our findings raise fundamental questions regarding thermalization processes occurring on timescales comparable to the laser repetition period in cuprates. More broadly, ultrafast optical control enables access to otherwise inaccessible regions of the phase diagram by tuning the pump fluence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，超快光激发可将高温铜氧化物超导体 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ 的电子能带结构驱动到长寿命的光稳态激发态。在足够高的泵浦能量密度下，体系费米面发生 Lifshitz 转变，拓扑由空穴型转为电子型。时间与角分辨光电子能谱结合紧束缚计算显示，1.6 eV 光激发诱导的能带演化与化学掺杂效应相似，提示存在涉及电荷转移、电子关联重整化和缺陷辅助电荷俘获的光掺杂机制。
authors: Ji Dai, Lukas Hellbrück, Michele Puppin, Alberto Crepaldi, Francesco Barantani, Thomas LaGrange, Arnaud Magrez, Edoardo Martino, Neven Barisic, László Forró, J. Hugo Dil, Marco Grioni, Henrik M. Rønnow, Siham Benhabib, Fabrizio Carbone

articles.title: Aharonov-Casher Chern bands for ultracold dark state atoms
articles.title_zh: 超冷暗态原子的 Aharonov-Casher 陈能带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00207v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the Aharonov-Casher (AC) condition for ultracold atoms adiabatically following the dark-state in a Łambda-type atom-light coupling scheme. The AC condition establishes a relation between the geometric scalar potential and the synthetic magnetic field, resulting in a fully degenerate lowest Landau-level-like band even if the magnetic field is inhomogeneous but has a proper sign. We derive a general requirement for the atom-light coupling under which the AC condition applies. The requirement holds if the Rabi frequencies of the Łambda scheme are the superposition of plane waves with the appropriate amplitudes and phases. In particular, the Rabi frequencies made of N=3,,4,,6 fine tuned plane waves yield a smooth background magnetic field of definite sign, as well as an array of non-measurable Aharonov-Bohm flux singularities. Departing from the fine tuning, the latter singularities broaden into narrow subwavelength patches of the opposite magnetic field, which broaden the lowest energy band. The lowest band is broadened also for the fine tuned situation due to deviation from the adiabatic approach because of the finite atom-light coupling strength. It is shown that a proper combination of the two imperfections (departure from fine tuning and finite atom-light coupling strength) can lead to a completely flat lowest band, which furthermore is characterized by the perfect topology needed for simulating the fractional Hall states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察在 Λ 型原子—光耦合方案中绝热跟随暗态的超冷原子满足 Aharonov-Casher 条件时的能带结构。作者推导了几何标量势与合成磁场之间的关系，指出即使磁场空间不均匀，只要符号合适，也可形成类似最低朗道能级的完全简并能带。研究进一步讨论了由特定平面波叠加构成的 Rabi 频率如何产生定号背景磁场及 Aharonov-Bohm 通量奇点，以及偏离精细调谐和非绝热效应对最低能带展宽的影响。
authors: Domantas Burba, Dominykas Borodinas, Gediminas Juzeliūnas

articles.title: Vestigial Nematic Order at Zero Temperature in Two-Dimensional Frustrated Quantum Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 二维受挫量子反铁磁体零温下的残余向列序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The phase diagram of the two-dimensional quantum J₁₋J₃ Heisenberg antiferromagnet on a square lattice is a long-standing open problem. Despite recent advances in numerical techniques for quantum spin models, a detailed analytical theory is still lacking. We address this problem using a semiclassical approach based on a continuum nonlinear sigma model effective field theory, applying the nonperturbative large-N technique to map out the phase diagram and determine the magnetic correlations. We show that previously-overlooked interactions are crucial for stabilizing a vestigial nematic phase, both at finite and zero temperature. Our results reveal that the spontaneous breaking of global symmetries in the J₁₋J₃ model is controlled by the strength of infrared quantum fluctuations which are enhanced by proximity to the classical Lifshitz point.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对平方晶格二维量子 J1-J3 海森堡反铁磁体的相图问题，采用基于连续非线性 σ 模型有效场论的半经典方法，并结合非微扰大 N 技术分析磁关联与相结构。作者指出，以往被忽略的相互作用对于在有限温和零温稳定残余向列相至关重要。结果表明，J1-J3 模型中的整体对称性自发破缺受红外量子涨落强度控制，而这种涨落会在接近经典 Lifshitz 点时增强。

articles.title: Extracting central charge from ground-state overlaps of spatially deformed Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 从空间形变哈密顿量的基态重叠中提取中心荷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the conformal anomaly of a (1+1)-dimensional conformal field theory can be extracted directly from a ground-state wave-function overlap associated with a spatial conformal deformation. Focusing on the q-Möbius deformation, we derive an exact overlap formula between the deformed and undeformed ground states, whose exponent depends only on the central charge. Motivated by this result, we construct a lattice estimator based solely on ground-state overlaps and apply it to representative critical quantum chains and the gapless edge modes of a two-dimensional Chern insulator. Numerical results demonstrate that the resulting overlaps provide a simple and robust probe of the central charge in microscopic models. We further demonstrate that the deformed ground states retain universal geometric structures in their entanglement spectra and entanglement entropies. These results provide a simple wave-function-based route to probing conformal data in critical systems and topological edge modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出可通过与空间共形形变相关的基态波函数重叠，直接提取一维共形场论的共形反常信息。作者以 q-Möbius 形变为例推导出形变与未形变基态之间的精确重叠公式，其指数仅依赖中心荷。基于该结果构造的晶格估计量在临界量子链和二维陈绝缘体无能隙边缘模中表现出稳健性，并显示形变基态的纠缠谱与纠缠熵仍保留普适几何结构。
authors: Chen Bai, Xinyu Sun, Liang-Hong Mo, Hong-Hao Tu

articles.title: Electron vs. hole doping in infinite-layer nickelates: electronic structure, magnetism and correlations
articles.title_zh: 无限层镍酸盐中的电子掺杂与空穴掺杂：电子结构、磁性与关联效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The observation of superconductivity in undoped infinite-layer nickelates RNiO₂ (R = rare earth) challenges our current understanding and calls for a re-examination of the underlying electronic structure of this family of materials. In this context, it is particularly important to extend the investigation of RNiO₂ compounds from the intensively studied hole-doped regime to the almost unexplored electron-doped one. Here, we use a combination of density-functional theory and dynamical mean-field theory to study the evolution of the electronic structure of infinite-layer nickelates in these two doping regimes. We find a striking asymmetry in the self-doping of the Ni-dₓ^₂₋y^₂ band due to the R(5d) states: while this effect is strongly suppressed upon hole doping, electron doping instead leads to an increase in the size of the R(5d) electron pockets, but without effectively hole-doping the Ni-dₓ^₂₋y^₂ band. This asymmetry has an important impact on the magnetic response as antiferromagnetism is rapidly suppressed upon hole doping, whereas it remains the ground state upon electron doping. Despite these differences, electronic correlations on both sides of the phase diagram are dominated by the Ni dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbital, suggesting that a single-band description may be appropriate for infinite-layer nickelates in both the electron- and hole-doped regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用密度泛函理论与动力学平均场理论，比较无限层镍酸盐 RNiO₂ 在空穴掺杂和电子掺杂下的电子结构演化。作者发现，由 R(5d) 态导致的 Ni-dₓ²₋y² 能带自掺杂存在显著不对称性：空穴掺杂会强烈抑制该效应，而电子掺杂主要扩大 R(5d) 电子口袋，却并未有效为空穴掺杂 Ni-dₓ²₋y² 能带。这种不对称性影响磁响应，使反铁磁性在空穴掺杂下迅速被抑制，而在电子掺杂下仍保持为基态。
authors: Ezra Day-Roberts, Fabio Bernardini, Harrison LaBollita, Yi-Feng Zhao, Andres Cano, Antia S. Botana

articles.title: Microstructure-specific mechanisms define multistage relaxation dynamics in a metallic model-glass
articles.title_zh: 金属模型玻璃中由微结构特异机制定义的多阶段弛豫动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deciphering complex relaxation pathways in disordered solids is a central challenge across polymeric, oxide, and metallic glasses, which traditionally relies on the interpretation of mechanical spectroscopy and resulting damping modes. Here we demonstrate the direct observation of dominant atomic-scale relaxation mechanisms during isothermal annealing of an as-quenched binary model glass towards incipient crystallization. Assessed via simulated x-ray photon correlation spectroscopy, a multi-state structural decorrelation is uncovered via speckle-pattern analysis of the full three-dimensional diffraction sphere across the first peak of the structure factor. Over a simulation time of up to 10 μs, three distinct and subsequent decorrelation stages of thermal vibration, glassy network evolution, and structural and chemical ordering towards crystallization are identified. These findings promote a picture where specific dynamically-separated mechanisms drive the microstructural evolution during glass relaxation and suggest a much richer multi-mode relaxation behavior of metallic glasses than hitherto identified.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究淬火后二元金属模型玻璃在等温退火并趋近初始晶化过程中的原子尺度弛豫机制。通过模拟 X 射线光子相关谱和三维衍射球斑点图样分析，作者揭示了多态结构去相关行为。在最长约 10 微秒的模拟时间内，体系依次经历热振动、玻璃网络演化以及向晶化发展的结构和化学有序化三个阶段，表明金属玻璃弛豫包含比传统认识更丰富的多模态动力学。
authors: Achraf Atila, Zengquan Wang, Birte Riechers, Robert Maaß

articles.title: Imaging the Magnetically Driven Reconstruction of the Electronic States in the Antiferromagnetic Topological Insulator EuSn₂As₂
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 EuSn₂As₂ 中磁性驱动电子态重构的成像研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The realization of the axion insulator phase in magnetic topological insulators is often hindered by crystalline symmetries that protect gapless surface states, even when time-reversal symmetry is broken. Here, we use variable-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) and spectroscopy (STS), complemented with density functional theory (DFT), to investigate the local electronic structure of the antiferromagnetic (AFM) topological insulator EuSn₂As₂ across its Néel transition at T_N = 24 K. On the (001) surface, we observe a substantial density of intrinsic Sn vacancies that introduce nanoscale electronic inhomogeneity and p-type doping. Upon cooling below T_N, we resolve the emergence of two distinct magnetically driven gaps: a sim100 meV gap near the Fermi level and a sim50 meV gap at the ARPES-resolved Dirac point. We attribute the former gap to AFM Brillouin-zone folding and hybridization. The characteristics of the 50 meV gap point toward the lifting of mirror-symmetry protection by Sn vacancies and the consequent mass gapping of the Dirac point, although contributions from AFM-induced folding hybridization cannot be entirely ruled out. Our findings provide real-space evidence for strong coupling between localized moments and itinerant topological states, highlighting exfoliable EuSn₂As₂ as a potential candidate for realizing axion-insulator-based devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合变温扫描隧道显微/谱学与密度泛函理论，考察反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 EuSn₂As₂ 在 Néel 转变温度 24 K 附近的局域电子结构。作者在 (001) 表面观察到大量本征 Sn 空位，它们引入纳米尺度电子不均匀性和 p 型掺杂。降温至 T_N 以下后，实验分辨出两个磁性驱动能隙：费米能级附近约 100 meV 的能隙以及 ARPES 所见 Dirac 点处约 50 meV 的能隙；前者归因于反铁磁布里渊区折叠和杂化，后者可能与 Sn 空位破坏镜面对称保护并使 Dirac 点获得质量有关。
authors: Luka Khizanishvili, Erekle Jmukhadze, Anika Raisa, Divyanshi Sar, Mingda Gong, Tetiana Romanova, Dariusz Kaczorowski, Wei-Cheng Lee, Pegor Aynajian

articles.title: Magnetic self-frustration from spontaneous structural distortion
articles.title_zh: 自发结构畸变导致的磁自挫折
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In frustrated magnetism, lattice distortions mediated by magnetoelastic coupling are commonly invoked as an escape route from extensive degeneracy toward an ordered ground state and, in some cases, the onset of multiferroicity. Here we present a minimal classical model that illustrates the converse phenomenon, which we term ``magnetic self-frustration''. Monte Carlo simulations reveal that a kagomé lattice with trivial magnetic interactions -- namely, nearest-neighbor Ising ferromagnetism -- undergoes a magnetostructural transition into a breathing-like phase, characterized by irregular bond dimerization along the three kagomé directions. Structurally, the equilateral triangles belonging to one of the two kagomé sublattices spontaneously distort, expanding into isosceles triangles. An analysis to first order in the magnetoelastic coupling constant α shows that the shape of these triangles is remarkably robust. Acting like rigid building blocks in a puzzle, their vertices determine the geometry of the second sublattice, giving rise to contracted ferromagnetic triangles with a variety of shapes. The magnetic sector can be mapped onto an effective antiferromagnetic triangular lattice, which remains disordered down to low temperatures and retains a finite residual entropy of one third of that of Wannier. This self-frustrated phase takes place at intermediate values of α, separating the conventional undistorted ferromagnetic phase at weak coupling from a strongly coupled ordered phase characterized by a regular dimerized up-up-down-down antiferromagnetic pattern along the three kagomé directions, built from ferromagnetic triangles and hexagons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一个最小经典模型，展示与常见磁弹耦合解除挫折相反的“磁自挫折”现象。蒙特卡罗模拟表明，仅含最近邻 Ising 铁磁相互作用的 kagomé 晶格会发生磁结构相变，进入类似呼吸模式的相，其特征是沿三个 kagomé 方向出现不规则键二聚化。结构上，一个 kagomé 子晶格中的等边三角形自发畸变为等腰三角形，并像刚性构件一样决定另一子晶格的几何形态，从而形成形状多样的收缩铁磁三角形。
authors: T. Vignau Costa, G. L. Rossini, D. C. Cabra, S. A. Grigera, R. A. Borzi

articles.title: Robust control over polar skyrmion bubble density with a combined optical and electrical approach
articles.title_zh: 结合光学与电学方法稳健调控极性斯格明子气泡密度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polar skyrmion bubbles are nanoscale ferroelectric domain configurations with swirling polarization textures, and often emerge in ferroelectric oxide systems. Owing to their inhomogeneous polarization patterns, which endow them with distinct topologies and electrical responses from homogeneous monodomains, polar skyrmion bubbles are envisaged to be promising candidates for non-volatile memory devices. In such device, the recorded information density is directly proportional to the density of bubbles, underscoring the need for precise control over bubble nucleation. Here, using first-principles-based calculations, we demonstrate that when assisted with a DC electric field, twisted light, which has a spatially inhomogeneous field pattern, can robustly tune the density of polar skyrmion bubbles in ferroelectric ultrathin films between 10²sim 10⁴ m̊bit/μ m². Moreover, by modulating DC and optical field strengths together with the beam radius, the nucleation rate, which characterizes the creation and annihilation speed of polar skyrmion bubbles, can also be well controlled. These findings highlight the unique response of ferroelectric nanofilms to optical and electric fields, which is crucial for employing polar skyrmion bubbles in the next-generation of ultrahigh-density memory technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过第一性原理计算探讨铁电超薄膜中极性斯格明子气泡的成核与密度控制。作者表明，在直流电场辅助下，具有空间非均匀场分布的扭曲光可稳健调节极性斯格明子气泡密度，范围约为 10² 至 10⁴ Mbit/μm²。通过共同调节直流场、光场强度和光束半径，还可以控制表征气泡产生与湮灭速度的成核率，为基于铁电纳米拓扑结构的非易失存储提供思路。

articles.title: Microscopic origin of polytype-dependent melting in SiC revealed by machine-learning molecular dynamics
articles.title_zh: 机器学习分子动力学揭示 SiC 多型依赖熔化的微观起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting how crystal structure influences high-temperature stability remains a key challenge in materials modelling and design. Silicon carbide (SiC), one of the most thermally and chemically stable materials known, provides an ideal system for studying this problem because its many polytypes preserve similar local tetrahedral bonding while differing in long-range stacking geometry. Here, we combine phase-coexistence machine-learning molecular dynamics with finite-temperature phonon analysis, enabled by a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential that accurately describes crystalline, high-temperature, and disordered configurations across multiple SiC polytypes. We identify a clear relative stability ordering, 3C > 2H > 9R, reflected consistently in structural disordering, interlayer sliding, and finite-temperature phonon spectra. Across all polytypes, melting initiates through the formation of short C-C contacts and carbon-rich local regions, followed by a progressive loss of tetrahedral Si-C connectivity. The reduced stability of the long-period 9R polytype is traced to low-frequency transverse-acoustic shear modes associated with relative bilayer sliding, which are already present in the 0 K phonon spectra and soften further at high temperature. These modes generate larger lateral bilayer displacements, linking enhanced interlayer sliding to local chemical disordering and ultimately melting. More broadly, our results show that high-temperature stability in polytypic covalent materials is governed not only by local bond strength, but also by stacking-dependent transverse dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合相共存机器学习分子动力学与有限温声子分析，考察不同 SiC 多型的高温稳定性与熔化机制。借助经微调的 MACE 原子间势，作者得到稳定性排序 3C > 2H > 9R，并在结构无序化、层间滑移和有限温声子谱中得到一致体现。各多型的熔化均起始于短 C-C 接触和富碳局域区域的形成，随后 Si-C 四面体连接逐步丧失；长周期 9R 多型的较低稳定性与低频横声学剪切模有关。
authors: Ljiljana Stojanović, Samuel J. Magorrian, Lara Kabalan, Richard N. White, Fabian L. Thiemann, Viktor Zólyomi

articles.title: Data-Driven Discovery of Unconventional Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 数据驱动发现非常规反铁磁体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional antiferromagnets combine zero net magnetization with spin-split electronic bands, offering a distinct, important platform for spintronics. Their discovery, however, has so far depended largely on case-by-case studies and on a limited number of compounds with experimentally resolved magnetic structures. Here, we overcome these bottlenecks by resolving magnetic ground states across a broad materials database. We narrow down 37163 magnets from the Materials Project to 189 collinear antiferromagnets by combining physics-informed prescreening, high-throughput exchange calculations and Luttinger-Tisza analysis. Among these, symmetry analysis identifies 36 altermagnets and 11 Luttinger-compensated ferrimagnets (LCFs), including 22 altermagnets and 9 LCFs that have not been reported previously. The identified unconventional antiferromagnets can support nonrelativistic spin Hall effects and doping-tunable spin transport with switchable polarization and giant anisotropy. Our framework converts broad structural databases into a curated, symmetry-classified set of experimentally testable compensated spin-split magnets, establishing a scalable route for the efficient discovery of functional antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一套数据驱动框架，用于从大型材料数据库中筛选具有零净磁化但能带自旋劈裂的非常规反铁磁体。作者从 Materials Project 的 37163 个磁性材料出发，结合物理启发预筛选、高通量交换相互作用计算和 Luttinger-Tisza 分析，筛得 189 个共线反铁磁体。进一步对称性分析识别出 36 个交替磁体和 11 个 Luttinger 补偿亚铁磁体，其中包括大量此前未报道候选物；这些材料可能支持非相对论自旋霍尔效应以及掺杂可调、极化可切换且各向异性显著的自旋输运。
authors: Qirui Cui, Chenxu Liu, Anna Delin, Kaiyou Wang

articles.title: Surface Reconstruction in Low-Temperature ARPES Spectra of Charge-Ordered EuAl₄
articles.title_zh: 电荷有序 EuAl₄ 低温 ARPES 谱中的表面重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge ordering in EuAl₄ has been widely discussed in connection with band reconstruction, magnetism,and topological electronic states, yet the microscopic origin of the complex low-temperature ARPES spectra remains unresolved. Here we combine photon-energy-, temperature-, and cleavage-history-dependent ARPES with firstprinciples calculations to separate intrinsic bulk bands from surface-derived spectral weight. Spectra measured on high-temperature-cleaved surfaces, both at 160 K and after cooling to 10 K, are well described by the calculated three-dimensional bulk electronic structure, whereas low-temperature-cleaved surfaces exhibit additional electron-like bands, replica-like Fermi-surface contours, and nearly kz-independent surface-derived features that are absent from the bulk calculations. These extra features are progressively suppressed upon warming, whereas the bulk-derived bands remain largely unchanged across the charge-density-wave transition within the experimental resolution. The combined analysis of photon-energy dependence, temperature evolution, and cleavage history identifies the reconstructed low-temperature spectral weight as arising predominantly from a thermally fragile surface reconstruction rather than from intrinsic bulk CDW-induced band folding. These results resolve an important ambiguity in EuAl₄ and provide spectroscopic criteria for distinguishing surface reconstruction from bulk charge-order effects in BaAl₄₋family correlated semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合光子能量、温度和解理历史依赖的 ARPES 以及第一性原理计算，区分 EuAl₄ 中本征体能带与表面来源谱重。高温解理表面在 160 K 以及冷却至 10 K 后的谱线可由三维体电子结构较好解释，而低温解理表面出现额外电子型能带、类似复制的费米面轮廓和近乎 kz 无关的表面特征。升温会逐步抑制这些额外特征，而体能带在电荷密度波转变附近基本不变，说明复杂低温 ARPES 谱主要与表面重构有关。
authors: Hao Liu, Bo Chen, Chen Zhang, Qi-Yi Wu, Sheng-Tao Cui, Zhe Sun, Zhong-Tuo Fu, Ying Zhou, Yang Luo, Jun Liu, Yu-Xia Duan, Jian-Qiao Meng

articles.title: Complexity of tensor network simulation for noisy quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 噪声量子线路张量网络模拟的复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00474v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We aim to rigorously address how local noise affects classical simulability of quantum dynamics benchmarked by tensor-network methods. Using operator entanglement entropy (OEE), we prove the following: (1) For single-qubit depolarizing noise on arbitrary circuits, tensor networks with poly(n) bond dimension suffice for fixed absolute Hilbert-Schmidt error after ørder1 depth, while relative error demands ørderłog n depth; and this bound is optimal. (2) For single-qubit depolarizing noise on 1D local circuits, the existence of whole-trajectory error-bounded matrix product operator (MPO) of poly(n) bond dimension at all depths. (3) For general single-qubit noise in 1D brickwall circuits, random two-design gates with contraction coefficient c<1/3 yield an ørder1 OEE plateau with probability 1-Te⁻Ømega⁽ⁿ⁾, while arbitrary gates with c<1/48 give ørderłog n OEE in the worst case. (4) In higher dimensions, these bounds yield uniform-in-depth poly(n) average boundary-bond dimensions for projected entangled pair operators~(PEPO) across every cut -- under depolarizing noise at either absolute or relative accuracy, and under general noise with strong contraction at absolute accuracy. Our results establish a rigorous connection between certain noise models, circuit types, and their classical simulability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文用算符纠缠熵严格分析局域噪声如何影响基于张量网络的量子动力学经典可模拟性。结果表明，对于任意线路中的单量子比特退相干噪声，在固定绝对 Hilbert-Schmidt 误差下经过常数深度后多项式键维张量网络已足够，而相对误差需要对数量级深度，且该界是最优的。作者还证明了一维局域线路中存在全轨迹误差有界的多项式键维矩阵乘积算符表示，并将若干结论推广到一般单量子比特噪声和高维投影纠缠对算符情形。
authors: Yuguo Shao, Zishuo Zhao, Song Cheng, Zhengwei Liu

articles.title: The Uhlmann phase of Higher-Order Topological Insulators at Finite Temperature
articles.title_zh: 有限温度下高阶拓扑绝缘体的 Uhlmann 相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have studied the finite-temperature topology of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs) based on the Uhlmann phase, which is a phase angle of the Uhlmann overlap. As an example of HOTIs, the Hamiltonian of the Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes (BBH) model is constructed from Gamma matrices satisfying the Clifford algebra. This specific algebraic structure underpins the model's higher-order topological properties, including the quantization of the Uhlmann phase to 0 or π. This quantization enables us to treat the abrupt jumps of the Uhlmann phase as an indication of the nontrivial topological phase of the BBH model at finite temperature. From the disappearance of these jumps, we determine the critical temperature at which the topological transition occurs. For a special choice of parameters, the Uhlmann overlap and the critical temperature can be computed analytically.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于 Uhlmann 重叠的相位角，即 Uhlmann 相，探讨高阶拓扑绝缘体的有限温拓扑性质。作者以 Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes 模型为例，指出其由满足 Clifford 代数的 Gamma 矩阵构造，这一代数结构支撑了 Uhlmann 相取 0 或 π 的量子化。Uhlmann 相的突跳可作为有限温下非平庸拓扑相的指示，而突跳消失则用于确定拓扑转变的临界温度；在特定参数选择下，Uhlmann 重叠和临界温度可解析计算。

articles.title: Noncollinear spin textures and 90deg domain walls in twisted XY magnets
articles.title_zh: 扭转 XY 磁体中的非共线自旋织构与 90° 畴壁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted moiré magnets are promising in exploring noncollinear magnetic phases, yet current experimental studies have been restricted to uniaxial magnets, limiting the accessible phase space. Here, we demonstrate noncollinear moiré magnetism based on XY magnet CrCl3. The tunneling magnetoconductance of twisted CrCl3 exhibits multiple field-driven transitions in small-twist-angle devices, attributed to the coexisting antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic domains with distinct susceptibilities. The inferred spin configuration depends on the layer number, reflecting the interlayer coupling strength between twisted layers. This moiré magnetism is remarkably robust, persisting up to twisted double nine-layer stacks. Combined with micromagnetic simulations, we identify the ground state as the predicted "twisted-s" phase featuring 90deg domain walls. Finally, we demonstrate voltage control of these noncollinear phases, highlighting the electrically tunable twist-spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 XY 磁体 CrCl₃ 中实现并表征非共线莫尔磁性，拓展了此前主要局限于单轴磁体的扭转莫尔磁研究。小扭角器件的隧穿磁电导显示多个磁场驱动转变，作者将其归因于具有不同磁化率的反铁磁与铁磁畴共存。结合微磁模拟，研究认为基态为预测的“twisted-s”相，包含 90° 畴壁；该莫尔磁性在多层扭转堆叠中仍很稳健，并可通过电压调控。
authors: Guanghui Cheng, Shiva T. Konakanchi, Andres E. Llacsahuanga Allcca, Sanjeev Khare, Nithin Abraham, Yuqing Cao, Hechang Lei, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Pramey Upadhyaya, Yong P. Chen

articles.title: Non-Hermiticity-induced chirality imbalance of Weyl Landau levels
articles.title_zh: 非厄米性诱导的 Weyl 朗道能级手性失衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weyl semimetals obey a global chirality constraint: the net chiral topological charge and any associated chiral spectral flow must vanish, as required by the Nielsen-Ninomiya theorem. Under magnetic fields, this constraint manifests through counter-propagating zeroth Landau levels associated with Weyl nodes of opposite chirality. Here, we experimentally demonstrate how non-Hermiticity can reshape this balance in a synthetic photonic Weyl semimetal. Using engineered gauge fields in one-dimensional multilayer structures, we realize both homogeneous and axial magnetic fields and directly probe the resulting Landau-level spectra. While a homogeneous field produces the expected chirality-balanced zeroth Landau levels, an axial field spatially separates the compensating chiral channels: co-propagating bulk pseudo-Landau levels carry one chirality, whereas the opposite chirality resides in boundary-localized surface states. We show that radiative boundary loss selectively suppresses these surface states, removing them from the long-lived observable spectrum and producing an experimentally accessible chirality imbalance. By reducing boundary loss, we recover the hidden chiral channel and reveal its surface-state origin. These results show that non-Hermiticity, present naturally in photonics, can control and relax fundamental chirality constraints in topological systems, enabling access to otherwise forbidden spectral responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在合成光子 Weyl 半金属中实验展示非厄米性如何重塑 Weyl 体系的手性平衡。作者利用一维多层结构中的工程化规范场实现均匀磁场和轴向磁场，并直接探测相应朗道能级谱。均匀磁场产生预期的手性平衡零能朗道能级，而轴向磁场使补偿手性通道空间分离：同向传播的体赝朗道能级携带一种手性，另一种手性位于边界局域表面态；辐射边界损耗选择性抑制这些表面态，从而在长寿命可观测谱中产生手性失衡。
authors: Sachin Vaidya, Alaa Bayazeed, André Grossi Fonseca, Adolfo G. Grushin, Marin Soljačić, Christina Jörg

articles.title: Sliding contact creates universal self-affine fractal surfaces
articles.title_zh: 滑动接触产生普适的自仿射分形表面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00626v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface roughness evolves during sliding, a process known as run-in, and the resulting topography controls friction, leakage, and failure from machines to geological faults. Yet the physical rule selecting this state remains unclear. We show that metals, rocks, and glasses develop universal self-similar roughness at short wavelengths, while retaining a material-dependent roll-off. A two-process model explains this behavior: junction formation and rupture drive universal roughening, whereas larger-scale deformation and/or fracture limit its growth.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注滑动过程中的跑合现象，即表面粗糙度随滑动演化并影响摩擦、泄漏和失效。作者表明，金属、岩石和玻璃在短波长尺度上会形成普适的自相似粗糙结构，同时保留与材料相关的滚降特征。研究提出由接触结形成与断裂导致普适粗化、而大尺度变形或断裂限制其增长的双过程模型。
authors: Ruibin Xu, Haohao Ren, Adriane Clerc, Guilhem Mollon, Wenbo Sheng, Feng Zhou, B. N. J. Persson

articles.title: Impact of Disorder Dynamics and Multi-Domain Kinetics on the Sliding Ferroelectricity of CVD-Grown 3R-WSe2 Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 无序动力学与多畴动力学对 CVD 生长 3R-WSe2 双层滑移铁电性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sliding ferroelectricity in van der Waals (vdW) layered systems has emerged as a promising route toward non-volatile nanoscale devices, where interlayer displacement in non-centrosymmetric bilayers generates an out-of-plane polarization. In particular, 3R-stacked bilayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) grown via chemical vapor deposition (CVD) have been shown to host such polarization due to broken inversion symmetry. However, a detailed investigation of the 2D ferroelectric (FE) properties of CVD-grown 2D films, particularly the role of intrinsic disorder, such as structural defects and domain structure, remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the FE switching characteristics of CVD-grown 3R-stacked WSe2 using a graphene-based ferroelectric field-effect transistor (graphene-FE-FET) architecture, where graphene serves as a highly sensitive probe of induced charge modulation due to polarization switching of FEs. We show that the growth-induced structural disorder significantly impacts polarization switching, while multi-domain kinetics governs the evolution of the FE response. These findings provide important insights into the design and optimization of FE devices based on vdW materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究化学气相沉积生长的 3R 堆垛 WSe2 双层中的滑移铁电性，重点考察结构缺陷和畴结构等内禀无序对二维铁电响应的作用。作者采用石墨烯铁电场效应晶体管结构，以石墨烯作为极化翻转诱导电荷调制的高灵敏探针。结果表明，生长诱导的结构无序显著影响极化翻转，而多畴动力学主导铁电响应的演化。
authors: Sourav Paul, Prasenjit Ghosh, Krishna Prasad Maity, Vineet Pandey, Abhijith M. B., Premananda Chatterjee, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Nicholas R. Glavin, Ajit K. Roy, Atindra Nath Pal, Vidya Kochat

articles.title: Magnon bandstructure and topology in a periodically deformed Kagome lattice with DM interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的周期形变 Kagome 晶格中的磁振子能带结构与拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00696v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the band structure and topology of magnons for a Heisenberg model with DM interaction on a deformed Kagome lattice. For simplicity, we focus on a periodically deformed lattice with hexagonal symmetry and an enlarged unit cell. This enlarged unit cell gives rise to a richer band structure than in the undeformed case. Analyzing band topology, there is a distinction between the topologically trivial case with anti-ferromagnetic coupling and the topologically rich case with ferromagnetic coupling. In the anti-ferromagnetic case, a spin-space symmetry, also present in the classical ground state, enforces these topologically trivial states. In the ferromagnetic case, this symmetry is spontaneously broken by the classical ground state. Consequently, the band structure also hosts rich topological features. Specifically, we observe many topological transitions and bands with Chern numbers ranging from +2 to -2, which makes the system richer than in the undeformed case. This emergent rich topological structure demonstrates that deformed magnets can host new and exciting physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察形变 Kagome 晶格上含 DM 相互作用的 Heisenberg 模型中的磁振子能带与拓扑性质。周期形变和扩大晶胞使体系相较未形变情形呈现更丰富的能带结构。反铁磁耦合情形中自旋空间对称性强制产生拓扑平庸态，而铁磁耦合中该对称性被经典基态自发破缺，从而出现多次拓扑相变以及陈数从 +2 到 -2 的拓扑能带。
authors: Mohammed Abdullah Hammadi, Mohammed Salman Alsadah, Husam Abdulmajeed Noorwli, Hocine Bahlouli, Michael Vogl

articles.title: Wasserstein-2 gradient flows and the geometry of entropy production in classical and quantum stochastic thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 经典与量子随机热力学中 Wasserstein-2 梯度流及熵产生几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The second law does more than set the direction of thermodynamic evolution: it endows nonequilibrium transformations with an underlying geometry. In this work, we provide a unified geometric description of entropy production in classical and quantum thermodynamics based on Wasserstein-2 structures arising from gradient flows of free energy. We review how relaxation to equilibrium, in overdamped diffusions, discrete detailed-balanced Markov chains, and dissipative Lindblad dynamics, can be formulated as a gradient flow on the space of states. The associated Wasserstein-2 distance bounds entropy production, yielding a finite-time refinement of the second law. We extend this framework beyond purely dissipative dynamics by introducing generalized Wasserstein-2 metrics that incorporate conservative (Hamiltonian) dynamics in both classical inertial systems and open quantum systems, yielding intrinsic distances that exactly characterize minimal entropy production under fixed dissipative mobilities. We establish equivalence bounds between purely dissipative and Hamiltonian-dissipative geometries, explicitly quantifying how inertial or coherent dynamics can reduce dissipation. Finally, when restricted to equilibrium distributions, we recover the thermodynamic length of linear response-including the quantum thermodynamic length-thereby linking optimal transport, thermodynamic length, and counterdiabatic protocols within a single geometric framework. All in all, our results extend the Riemannian program of thermodynamics further from equilibrium and provide a geometric foundation for optimal protocols beyond the overdamped setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作从 Wasserstein-2 结构出发，为经典和量子非平衡热力学中的熵产生提供统一几何描述。作者回顾了过阻尼扩散、满足细致平衡的离散 Markov 链以及耗散 Lindblad 动力学如何表述为自由能在态空间上的梯度流，并由相应距离给出熵产生界限。研究进一步将框架推广到含保守 Hamilton 动力学的经典惯性系统和开放量子系统，以刻画固定耗散迁移率下的最小熵产生。
authors: Olga Movilla Miangolarra, Ralph Sabbagh, Artemy Kolchinsky

articles.title: Impact of Cu-Mn ratio on Structure and Defects in Layered Multiferroic Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3
articles.title_zh: Cu-Mn 比例对层状多铁材料 Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3 结构与缺陷的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiferroic materials exhibit the coexistence of magnetic and ferroelectric order, enabling control of magnetism through electric fields and vice versa. These properties make them attractive for spintronic and memory device applications. Recent studies on Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3 (0.04 łeq x łeq 0.26; 0.03 łeq y łeq 0.15) have revealed strong magnetoelectric coupling, with variations in Mn-to-Cu concentration leading to variations in optical, electronic, and magnetic responses. Despite these findings, the influence of nanoscale structure and defects on the observed properties remains poorly understood. In this study, we investigate the structure and nanoscale defects in Cu-deficient Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3 (Cu:Mn ratio <1, i.e., with 0.04 łeq x łeq 0.26 and 0.03 łeq y łeq 0.15) and Cu-rich Cu1+xMn1-ySiTe3 (Cu:Mn ratio >1, i.e., with 0.04 łeq x łeq 0.3 and 0.13 łeq y łeq 0.31) crystals using scanning/transmission electron microscopy and single-crystal X-ray diffraction. Cu-deficient crystals exhibit extensive stacking faults correlated with chemical inhomogeneity between Mn and Cu, along with variations in Te stacking. In contrast, Cu-rich crystals show fewer stacking faults but contain other local structural variations, such as needle-shaped precipitates and loop-like features. These distinct local structural features between Cu-rich and Cu-deficient crystals can be correlated to variations in their observed properties. Complementary density functional theory calculations confirm that the Cu-rich structure is more polar than the Cu-deficient structure. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive understanding of how subtle changes in chemistry influence the nanoscale structure, defect distribution, and functional properties in Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3, offering guidance for designing multiferroic materials with tailored performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨层状多铁材料 Cu-Mn-Si-Te 体系中 Cu/Mn 比例对纳米结构和缺陷的影响，以理解其磁电、光学和电子响应变化的微观来源。作者利用扫描/透射电子显微镜和单晶 X 射线衍射比较 Cu 缺乏与 Cu 富集晶体。结果显示，Cu 缺乏样品存在大量堆垛层错，并与 Mn/Cu 化学不均匀和 Te 堆垛变化相关；Cu 富集样品则表现出不同的结构缺陷特征。
authors: Sai Venkata Gayathri Ayyagari, Boyang Zheng, Sreekant Anil, Subrata Ghosh, Yuxi Zhang, Yu Liu, Chandan De, Ke Wang, Jeffrey Shallenberger, Weiwei Xie, Vincent H. Crespi, Zhiqiang Mao, Nasim Alem

articles.title: Edge Detection Framework Utilizing SOT-MTJ Bit-Cell Arrays
articles.title_zh: 利用 SOT-MTJ 位单元阵列的边缘检测框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traditional edge detection algorithms, foundational to computer vision, face significant challenges in energy efficiency and processing latency on conventional CMOS-based hardware. Existing algorithms, such as Canny, are computationally expensive, posing challenges in resource-constrained hardware where energy efficiency and low latency are critical. This study introduces a novel, hardware-efficient algorithm that leverages the intrinsic characteristics of magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ) devices. We present a detailed device-level analysis of an MTJ-based system for edge detection, outlining its operational cycles, including write, read, and reset methods. The algorithm's efficacy is evaluated against the standard Canny edge detection method. We provide a quantitative performance analysis, including metrics such as energy consumption and latency, which demonstrates that our proposed spintronics-based approach offers a promising solution for achieving low-power, high-speed image processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对传统 CMOS 硬件上边缘检测算法能耗高、延迟大的问题，提出一种利用磁隧道结器件内禀特性的硬件高效边缘检测方案。作者对基于 MTJ 的系统进行了器件级分析，说明其写入、读取和复位等操作周期。与标准 Canny 边缘检测方法的比较表明，该自旋电子学方案在低功耗和高速图像处理方面具有潜力。

articles.title: Energy spectra and cascade in the spin turbulence of a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate
articles.title_zh: 受驱自旋or Bose-Einstein 凝聚体中自旋湍流的能谱与级联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the spin-interaction energy spectrum of spin turbulence in a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate. Continuous spin driving of a spin-1 condensate produces a nonequilibrium steady state with spatially fluctuating magnetization. We observe a power-law scaling consistent with the -7/3 exponent predicted for spin-wave turbulence, which persists across our full range of drive strengths despite substantial changes in the spectral anisotropy. After switching off the drive, we track the free-decay evolution and find evidence consistent with a direct cascade of spin-interaction energy toward higher wavenumbers. These results establish an energy-spectral hallmark of spin turbulence and enable quantitative studies of cascade dynamics in spinor superfluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究测量受驱自旋-1 Bose-Einstein 凝聚体中自旋湍流的自旋相互作用能谱。连续自旋驱动产生具有空间涨落磁化强度的非平衡稳态，并观察到与自旋波湍流理论预言的 -7/3 指数一致的幂律标度。关闭驱动后的自由衰减过程显示，自旋相互作用能量存在向更高波数直接级联的证据。
authors: Junghoon Lee, Jongmin Kim, Donggyu Lee, Yong-il Shin

articles.title: Low-Temperature Suppression of Intertwined Orders in La₁/₃Sr₂/₃FeO₃ Thin Films
articles.title_zh: La1/3Sr2/3FeO3 薄膜中交织有序的低温抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00769v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The strong coupling between spin, charge, and lattice degrees of freedom in perovskite oxides leads to an array of exotic phenomena, giving these materials rich phase diagrams that can include coupled orders. This is exemplified by the A-site doped ferrite La₁/₃Sr₂/₃FeO₃ (LSFO), which exhibits a coupled paramagnetic-antiferromagnetic and charge ordering phase transition at sim190 K that has been well studied in thin films, bulk, and polycrystalline samples. However, the low temperature behavior of LSFO thin films below sim100 K has not been thoroughly explored. This work uses several X-ray scattering and spectroscopy techniques to directly probe LSFO's magnetic and charge order down to low temperature. Using resonant X-ray scattering, we observe a complete suppression of LSFO's known antiferromagnetic and charge order below sim25 K. Further spectroscopy and coherent scattering measurements provide insight into LSFO's electronic structure and domain dynamics in this new low temperature phase, and we propose possible explanations for the observed order suppression based on reduced dimensionality of domains in our thin films. Our findings provide insight into the effects of competing interactions in strongly correlated materials, particularly those with coupled orders.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究钙钛矿氧化物 La1/3Sr2/3FeO3 薄膜在低温下的磁有序和电荷有序行为。利用多种 X 射线散射与谱学技术，作者直接探测到其已知的反铁磁和电荷有序在约 25 K 以下被完全抑制。进一步的谱学与相干散射结果为新低温相的电子结构和畴动力学提供了信息，并提示薄膜中畴的低维化可能与该有序抑制有关。
authors: Mayia A. Vranas, Robin Glefke, Katherine Matthews, Xiaoke Li, Tianxing Wang, Henry Navarro, I-Ching Lin, Sarmistha Das, Biswajit Sahoo, Rourav Basak, Wei He, Holden Bauer, Ella Di Liberti, Jacob Butler, Elliot Kisiel, Erik Lamb, Jun-Sik Lee, Cheng-Tai Kuo, Heemin Lee, Christie Nelson, Sophie Morley, Sujoy Roy, Christoph Klewe, Fanny Rodolakis, Jessica McChesney, Oleg Shpyrko, Yimei Zhu, Eric Fullerton, Ivan Schuller, Alex Frano

articles.title: Autonomous scanning electrochemical cell microscopy enables rapid exploration of large compositionally complex material spaces
articles.title_zh: 自主扫描电化学池显微术实现大规模成分复杂材料空间的快速探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Alloying is a central strategy in electrocatalysis, enabling fine-tuning of electronic structure.
