AgentPLM achieves state-of-the-art results with a gain in antibody top-10% hit rate over the strongest passive baseline, providing mechanistic evidence of online error correction without explicit backtracking.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 AgentPLM，将预训练蛋白质语言模型从一次性生成的“被动预言机”扩展为可在生成过程中调用外部生物物理工具的智能体系统。其核心包括推理增强解码（RAD），在自回归生成中交替调用 ESMFold、FoldX、AutoDock Vina 等工具，以及对比式智能体策略优化（CAPO），用于学习何时利用外部反馈。作者在酶设计、抗体优化、热稳定性、蛋白互作界面设计和零样本适应度预测等任务上评估，报告称该方法优于强被动基线，并表现出在线纠错能力。

articles.title: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Semiconductor Visual Program Synthesis via Input Binarization
articles.title_zh: 通过输入二值化弥合半导体视觉程序合成中的仿真到现实差距
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.02434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Precise parametric control over circuit geometry is essential for semiconductor inspection, yet obtaining sufficient real training data remains costly. Although generative models such as diffusion models and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) can augment training data, they cannot guarantee the nanometer-scale geometric accuracy required for metrology tasks. We propose a visual program synthesis framework in which a Vision-Language Model (VLM) converts inspection images into editable Domain-Specific Language (DSL) code describing circuit geometries, enabling controlled generation of training data with exact parameter manipulation. Because the VLM is trained solely on synthetic DSL-rendered data, a domain gap arises when processing real Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) images. We bridge this gap with an input binarization strategy that strips SEM-specific texture and noise, letting the model focus on geometric structure. On the MIIC dataset, binarized inputs improve the mean Dice coefficient from 0.4393 to 0.5256 over the raw-input baseline, demonstrating that simple texture abstraction substantially mitigates the sim-to-real gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对半导体检测中真实训练数据昂贵且生成模型难以保证纳米级几何精度的问题，提出一种视觉程序合成框架。该框架利用视觉语言模型将检测图像转换为可编辑的领域专用语言代码，从而精确控制电路几何参数并生成训练数据。由于模型仅在合成数据上训练，作者采用输入二值化去除扫描电镜图像中的纹理和噪声，使模型聚焦几何结构；在 MIIC 数据集上，该策略将平均 Dice 系数由 0.4393 提升至 0.5256。
authors: Yusuke Ohtsubo, Kota Dohi, Koichiro Yawata, Koki Takeshita, Tatsuya Sasaki

articles.title: A Lightweight Deep Learning-based Model for Ranking Influential Nodes in Complex Networks
articles.title_zh: 一种用于复杂网络影响力节点排序的轻量级深度学习模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.19702v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Identifying influential nodes in complex networks is a critical task with a wide range of applications across different domains. However, existing approaches often face trade-offs between accuracy and computational efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose 1D-CGS, a lightweight and effective hybrid model that integrates the speed of one-dimensional convolutional neural networks (1D-CNN) with the topological representation power of GraphSAGE for efficient node ranking. The model uses a lightweight input representation built on two straightforward and significant topological features: node degree and average neighbor degree. These features are processed through 1D convolutions to extract local patterns, followed by GraphSAGE layers to aggregate neighborhood information. We formulate the node ranking task as a regression problem and use the Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) model to generate ground truth influence scores. 1D-CGS is initially trained on synthetic networks generated by the Barabasi-Albert model and then applied to real world networks for identifying influential nodes. Experimental evaluations on twelve real world networks demonstrate that 1D-CGS significantly outperforms traditional centrality measures and recent deep learning models in ranking accuracy, while operating in very fast runtime. The proposed model achieves an average improvement of 4.73% in Kendall's Tau correlation and 7.67% in Jaccard Similarity over the best performing deep learning baselines. It also achieves an average Monotonicity Index (MI) score 0.99 and produces near perfect rank distributions, indicating highly unique and discriminative rankings. Furthermore, all experiments confirm that 1D-CGS operates in a highly reasonable time, running significantly faster than existing deep learning methods, making it suitable for large scale applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 1D-CGS，一种结合一维卷积神经网络与 GraphSAGE 的轻量级混合模型，用于高效识别复杂网络中的影响力节点。模型以节点度和邻居平均度作为简洁拓扑特征，先经一维卷积提取局部模式，再通过 GraphSAGE 聚合邻域信息，并将节点排序建模为回归问题。作者使用 SIR 模型生成影响力真值，先在 Barabási-Albert 合成网络上训练，再迁移到真实网络进行评估，旨在兼顾排序精度与计算效率。
authors: Mohammed A. Ramadhan, Abdulhakeem O. Mohammed

articles.title: AEyeDE: An Attention-Based Attribution Framework for AI-Generated Text Detection
articles.title_zh: AEyeDE：一种基于注意力归因的人工智能生成文本检测框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00016v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Detecting AI-generated text is becoming increasingly challenging as modern language models approach human-level fluency and can evade detectors that rely on surface statistics or likelihood-based signals. We propose textscAEyeDE, an attribution-driven approach to human-AI authorship detection that leverages model attention as a discriminative signal. Specifically, we extract attention-based attribution matrices for both human- and AI-generated text using a emphproxy Transformer model with white-box access and train a lightweight Convolutional Neural Network to learn representations from these attribution maps. Across encoder-decoder translation settings, our method consistently outperforms a text-only baseline. In decoder-only settings, it performs strongly in generator-specific detection, remains competitive on standard benchmarks, and shows robustness under cross-dataset transfer and alternative-spelling perturbations. We further show that attention maps exhibit recurring local structures whose relative frequencies differ consistently between human- and AI-generated text across datasets and proxy models. These findings suggest that attention-based attribution maps provide a complementary and interpretable signal for AI-generated text detection. We will make the code publicly available to support future research.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 AEyeDE，一种利用模型注意力归因信号区分人类与 AI 生成文本的方法。作者通过具备白盒访问权限的代理 Transformer 提取文本的注意力归因矩阵，并训练轻量级卷积神经网络学习这些归因图中的模式。实验显示，该方法在编码器-解码器翻译场景中持续优于纯文本基线，在解码器-only 场景中对特定生成器检测表现较强，并在跨数据集迁移和拼写扰动下保持一定鲁棒性。
authors: Aria Nourbakhsh, Adelaide Danilov, Christoph Schommer, Salima Lamsiyah

articles.title: SENSE: Semantic Embedding Navigation with Soft-gated Evaluation for Retrieval-based Speculative Decoding
articles.title_zh: SENSE：用于检索式推测解码的语义嵌入导航与软门控评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00021v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens, which are verified in parallel by the target model, without compromising generation quality. While Retrieval-based Speculative Decoding (RSD) is favored for its plug-and-play versatility, its potential is impeded by rigid lexical dependencies, rendering both retrieval and verification brittle to surface-level variations. To address this, we propose SENSE (Semantic Embedding Navigation with Soft-gated Evaluation). By anchoring retrieval on the hidden states of the target model, SENSE establishes robust semantic alignment, which empowers the Soft-gated Evaluation module to validate semantic equivalence rather than surface forms. To ensure rigorous benchmarking, we deconstruct existing methods into atomic primitives within a unified framework, facilitating granular, component-level comparison. Extensive experiments across diverse domains demonstrate that SENSE outperforms multiple baselines on the LLaMA and Qwen families, attaining up to 4.09 mean acceptance length and 3.26x speedup, while preserving generation quality. Our code will be released upon publication.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 SENSE，以改进检索式推测解码在大语言模型推理加速中的鲁棒性。不同于依赖表层词形匹配的方法，SENSE 基于目标模型隐藏状态进行检索，实现语义对齐，并通过软门控评估验证语义等价而非仅匹配表面形式。作者还将现有方法分解为统一框架中的原子组件以便细粒度比较；在多个领域和 LLaMA、Qwen 系列模型上，SENSE 报告达到最高 4.09 的平均接受长度和 3.26 倍加速。
authors: Shaowen Chen, Zhicheng Liao, Hongwei Wang

articles.title: DFT Insights into the Pressure-Dependent Electronic,Optical, and Mechanical Properties of LiSrI3 for Enhanced Optoelectronic Performance
articles.title_zh: 压力依赖下 LiSrI3 的电子、光学与力学性质的密度泛函理论研究及其光电性能提升启示
articles.abstract: Photovoltaic applications of lead-free halide perovskites are gaining popularity, because of the environmental issues of lead-based ones. In this work, the systematic ﬁrst-principles density functional theory (FP-DFT) study is conducted on the structural, electronic, mechanical, thermophysical, and optical characteristics of cubic LiSrI3 at various hydrostatic pressures (0 to 30 GPa) to study the structural, electronic, mechanical, thermal, and optical properties. LiSrI3 has a direct gap of 1.67 eV at ambient pressure, although this bandgap is indirect at the R point and it decreases to 1.06 eV in high pressure of 30 GPa. According to Mulliken and Hirshfeld population analyses, the bonding is ionic with partial contribution of covalent bonding. Thermophysical parameters, e.g. the Debye temperature, melting temperature increase with applied pressure, and this indicates enhanced thermal stability. The material meets the Born–Huang requirements of mechanical stability. Even though positive Cauchy pressures and the ratios of Pugh indicate ductile character, the values of Poisson ratio indicate a tendency of being brittle, implying a complex mechanical response. Measurement of elastic constants means that it has a high resilience to deformation and would be easy to machine, almost isotropic compressibility and low shear anisotropy under pressure. Similar behavior is also exhibited by optical properties, such as the dielectric constant, absorption coeﬃcient, reﬂectivity, and refractive index. Taken together, these ﬁndings demonstrate that LiSrI3 is a promising material with an electronic structure that can be pressured, strong mechanical and thermal characteristics and good optical properties, which make this material an ideal choice in optoelectronic devices and perovskite-based solar cells.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用第一性原理密度泛函理论系统考察无铅卤化物钙钛矿 LiSrI3 在 0 至 30 GPa 静水压力下的结构、电子、力学、热物理和光学性质。结果显示，LiSrI3 在常压下具有约 1.67 eV 的直接带隙，而在 30 GPa 下带隙降至约 1.06 eV，并表现出压力调控的电子结构变化。布居分析表明其成键以离子性为主并含部分共价贡献；德拜温度和熔化温度随压力升高而增加，暗示热稳定性增强，同时材料满足 Born-Huang 力学稳定性条件。

articles.title: Experimental Investigation of Faraday’s law and Incompleteness of Maxwell’s Macroscopic Electrodynamic Theory
articles.title_zh: 法拉第定律的实验研究与麦克斯韦宏观电动力学理论的不完备性
articles.abstract: The conventional macroscopic interpretation of Faraday’s law assumes that the induced electromotive force (EMF) in a winding depends solely on the time variation of magnetic flux and is independent of magnetic material properties and core length. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate that, under quasi-static excitation conditions relevant to power magnetic components, the induced EMF exhibits a measurable dependence on both the magnetic permeability and the magnetic path length of the core. Three dedicated test configurations are presented to isolate the influence of permeability, core length, and core cross-section on the induced voltage. The results reveal that variations in these parameters produce non-negligible changes in the induced EMF, and in some cases enable voltage step-up behavior without altering the turns ratio. These findings highlight practical implications for the design and optimization of high-frequency transformers and magnetic components, suggesting that material and geometric factors play a more direct role in induction than typically assumed. The study motivates a refined examination of macroscopic electromagnetic induction laws, particularly regarding their treatment of magnetic media.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过实验考察传统宏观法拉第定律解释中感应电动势仅依赖磁通时间变化、而与磁性材料性质和磁路长度无关的假设。作者设计三类测试构型，分别隔离磁导率、磁芯长度和磁芯截面积对感应电压的影响。实验结果显示，这些参数变化会导致不可忽略的感应电动势变化，某些情况下甚至可在不改变匝数比的条件下产生升压行为，从而提示高频变压器和磁性元件设计中材料与几何因素可能具有更直接作用。

articles.title: Open-source slicing program based on filament-extrusion model: localized controlled flexibility and evaluation of cyclic loading
articles.title_zh: 基于丝材挤出模型的开源切片程序：局部可控柔性与循环载荷评估
articles.abstract: One of the greatest advantages of Additive Manufacturing today is not only the possibility of customizing manufactured parts, but also the tailoring of their mechanical properties, especially through Fused Filament Fabrication (FFF) technology. Recent approaches such as the use of lattice structures, composite filaments, multi-material printing, and 4D printing enable this customization, generally at the 3D modeling stage—through geometric design configuration—and/or during the layer-by-layer material deposition process. Alternatively, an innovative open-source slicing software called AltPrint enabled, during the digital slicing stage, the local modification of the flexibility of printed parts, allowing the customization of mechanical stiffness regardless of the material or geometric design used. This article presents an updated version of the AltPrint slicing program, incorporating the "Horizontal Gap" concept. This feature includes new user-defined parameters that enable the generation of a deposition strategy for obtaining flexibility-graded parts. In addition, a design of experiments (DOE) approach was conducted to evaluate the impact of these new parameters on the mechanical behavior of 3D-printed specimens subjected to cyclic testing. The results demonstrate that the fatigue life was significantly influenced by the number of gaps in the flexible region, but not by the relative surface area of such gaps. Conversely, the parts' stiffness presented an expressive linear decrease as the slots area increased. In addition to allowing different flexibility levels between specimens, the "Horizontal Gap" concept was successfully applied to create different flexible regions within the same part, which highlights its potential for fabricating multi-articulated mechanisms. Therefore, this feature effectively expands the design capabilities of AltPrint, enabling stiffness tailoring for compliant mechanisms fabricated via FFF.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究介绍开源切片软件 AltPrint 的更新版本，用于在熔融丝材制造过程中通过数字切片阶段局部调节打印件柔性。新版本引入“水平间隙”概念和用户可定义参数，以生成具有柔性梯度的材料沉积策略，而不完全依赖材料类型或几何设计。作者还采用实验设计方法评估这些新参数对打印件力学行为的影响，特别关注局部刚度调控及循环载荷条件下的性能表现。
authors: Alina de Souza Leão de Souza Leão Rodrigues

articles.title: A Correlation Analysis of Field Potential and Action Potential Biomarkers in Heterogeneous hiPSC-Derived Cardiac Tissues
articles.title_zh: 异质 hiPSC 来源心脏组织中场电位与动作电位生物标志物的相关性分析
articles.abstract: Human induced pluripotent stem cell–derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) provide a powerful platform for investigating human cardiac electrophysiology and for supporting safety pharmacology studies. However, their intrinsic heterogeneity, typically involving mixtures of atrial-like and ventricular-like phenotypes, and the indirect nature of multielectrode array (MEA) recordings make the interpretation of Field Potential (FP) biomarkers challenging. A quantitative understanding of how MEA-derived metrics reflect the underlying action potential dynamics, which represent the gold standard, is still limited but essential for establishing robust and translatable in-vitro readouts. In this work, we present a computational framework that couples the bidomain model with a detailed representation of MEA electrodes to perform an in-silico correlation study between FP and action potential based electrophysiological biomarkers in heterogeneous hiPSC-CM tissues. We first analyze a large set of 900 spatially distributed sampling points to explore the relationship between extracellular potentials and their corresponding cellular action potential features across varying mixtures of atrial-like and ventricular-like cells. We then simulate a full MEA platform comprising 256 electrodes to assess how realistic subsampling, spatial organization, and tissue composition affect the extraction and interpretation of FP biomarkers. Across a broad panel of biomarkers, our results identify the FP metrics that most reliably reflect action potential characteristics and demonstrate that the strength of field-action potential correlations increases as the tissue exhibits a more homogeneous ventricular-like phenotype. These findings not only clarify the mechanistic basis of MEA readouts in hiPSC-CM systems but also highlight the predictive potential of our computational tool. By integrating tissue composition, spatial sampling, and electrophysiological modeling, the framework can serve as a virtual platform to anticipate biomarker behavior, optimize MEA-based experimental designs, and ultimately strengthen the translational value of hiPSC-CM assays in preclinical research.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对人诱导多能干细胞来源心肌细胞组织的异质性以及多电极阵列场电位记录的间接性，建立计算框架分析场电位指标与动作电位指标之间的关系。作者将双域模型与多电极阵列电极的详细表示相结合，在含有不同比例心房样和心室样细胞的异质组织中开展体内模拟相关性研究。研究首先分析 900 个空间分布采样点，以探索细胞外电位特征与对应细胞动作电位特征之间的联系，为建立更可靠、可转化的体外电生理读数提供依据。

articles.title: Molecular Docking and Dynamics of Selenium-Containing Compounds Interacting with Iodothyronine Deiodinases
articles.title_zh: 含硒化合物与碘甲状腺原氨酸脱碘酶相互作用的分子对接与动力学研究
articles.abstract: Objective To characterize, through an integrated in silico pipeline, the binding interactions, conformational dynamics, and pharmacokinetic profiles of five structurally diverse organoselenium compounds against all three deiodinase isoforms.Methods Ebselen, diphenyl diselenide, 6-propyl-2-selenouracil (PSU), selenomethionine, and a selenocysteine analogue were docked against DIO2 (PDB: 9H48), DIO3 (PDB: 4TR4), and a SWISS-MODEL DIO1 homology model using SwissDock 2024, with binding affinities rescored by PRODIGY-LIG. Conformational dynamics were assessed via iMODS elastic network normal mode analysis. Pharmacokinetic profiling was performed using SwissADME and pkCSM.Results Ebselen and PSU exhibited the most favorable binding free energies across all isoforms, with PSU displaying preferential affinity for DIO1. All high-affinity compounds established Se···Se chalcogen contacts with the catalytic selenocysteine residue within geometrically consistent distances. Ligand binding markedly dampened Ω-loop deformability in all isoforms and increased correlated motions at the dimerization interface, suggesting an allosteric component. Both ebselen and PSU satisfied Lipinski's Rule of Five with no predicted CYP inhibition or mutagenicity.Conclusion Ebselen and PSU emerge as structurally informed lead candidates for isoform-selective deiodinase modulation, with the Se···Se chalcogen interaction identified as a central pharmacophoric feature warranting experimental validation and scaffold optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过整合式计算流程，分析五种结构不同的有机硒化合物与三种脱碘酶同工型 DIO1、DIO2 和 DIO3 的结合相互作用、构象动力学和药代动力学特征。作者使用 SwissDock 进行对接、PRODIGY-LIG 重新评分，并结合 iMODS 正则模分析及 SwissADME、pkCSM 进行性质预测。结果显示，依布硒啉和 6-丙基-2-硒尿嘧啶具有较有利的结合自由能，其中后者对 DIO1 表现出偏好性；高亲和力配体与催化硒半胱氨酸形成几何上合理的 Se···Se 硫属键接触，并可能影响 Ω 环和二聚化界面的构象运动。

articles.title: Linguistic Efficiency and Inhibitory Control: Evaluating the DIINA Model on Afrikaans as a Morphologically Simplified but Context-Rich Language
articles.title_zh: 语言效率与抑制控制：在形态简化但语境丰富的南非荷兰语中评估 DIINA 模型
articles.abstract: Afrikaans presents a compelling test case for computational models of negation and ambiguity resolution: it is morphologically relatively streamlined, yet it relies heavily on context, syntax, and discourse-level interpretation to disambiguate meaning. This article evaluates DIINA, an inhibitory neural architecture designed for double negation resolution and lexical ambiguity reduction in Afrikaans. DIINA operationalizes inhibitory control as a learned mechanism that suppresses competing interpretations when negation is structurally and semantically licensed. The central claim is that linguistic efficiency in Afrikaans does not arise from morphological richness alone, but from a tight coupling between local cues and broader contextual integration. Empirically, DIINA achieved 94% accuracy on double negation and reduced lexical ambiguity error to 6% (pasted-text.txt:1311– 1316; 1529; 1736). In the sentence “Ek sien nie die man nie”, the secondary negation token received an inhibition score of 0.92, and inhibitory effects intensified in the final layers of the network, indicating progressive suppression of unlicensed readings (pasted-text.txt:1241). To support interpretability, the model uses heatmaps to visualize inhibition patterns and layer wise attribution (pasted-text.txt:812–814; 835–836). The findings suggest that Afrikaans is particularly well suited for studying how neural architectures can learn to resolve semantic conflicts through inhibitory dynamics rather than only through surface form morphology. The article situates DIINA within broader work on negation, ambiguity, and neural interpretability, and argues that inhibitory modeling offers a promising route toward cognitively plausible and linguistically informed NLP for context-rich languages.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以南非荷兰语为测试对象，评估用于双重否定解析和词汇歧义减少的抑制性神经架构 DIINA。作者认为，南非荷兰语的语言效率并非主要来自复杂形态，而是来自局部线索与更广泛语境整合之间的紧密耦合。实验报告称，DIINA 在双重否定任务上达到 94% 准确率，并将词汇歧义错误率降至 6%；在示例句“Ek sien nie die man nie”中，第二个否定标记获得较高抑制分数，表明网络后层逐步压制不被许可的解读。

articles.title: Cyber-Resilient Thermal Management of Power Transformers Using Fuzzy Logic
articles.title_zh: 基于模糊逻辑的电力变压器网络韧性热管理
articles.abstract: The rapid proliferation of Electric Vehicles (EVs) has introduced complex loading profiles to distribution grids, dT/dt increasing the cyber-physical vulnerability of critical assets. Traditional power transformers lack the control mechanisms required to detect or mitigate network-layer attacks—such as False Data Injection (FDI), stealth, load alteration, and Denial of Service (DoS) attacks. While standard information technology frameworks secure data packets, they routinely overlook the physical thermal anomalies induced by these exploits. This paper addresses this gap by presenting a cyber-resilient asset-layer thermal management architecture featuring a multi-input Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC). The proposed defensive loop continuously evaluates three custom membership functions: localized temperature variations (Ths and dThs/dt), consumer charging requirement metrics, and user urgency parameters. By dynamically mapping these variables, the controller enforces smart current throttling and adaptive Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) regulation during active attacks. High-fidelity continuous-time simulations executed via an ode15s variable-step solver demonstrate that the framework successfully intercepts high-amplitude current surges. It limits the peak winding hotspot temperature from 215.8◦ C under open-loop operation to 112.4◦ C under closedloop fuzzy control and reduces exponential Arrhenius insulation degradation (14.8 p.u.) to nominal levels. This optimization safely guarantees minimum consumer energy allocation while actively securing the structural and dielectric survivability of the grid asset.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注电动汽车快速普及给配电网带来的复杂负荷特征及其对电力变压器的网络—物理安全风险。作者提出一种资产层热管理架构，采用多输入模糊逻辑控制器来应对虚假数据注入、隐蔽攻击、负荷篡改和拒绝服务等网络层攻击所引发的热异常。该控制器根据局部温度变化、用户充电需求和紧急程度等成员函数动态实施智能限流与自适应车网互动调节；仿真结果表明，该框架可在攻击期间辅助控制变压器热状态并提升运行韧性。

articles.title: Modal Frames as Resources: From formulation to simulation
articles.title_zh: 模态框架作为资源：从形式化到模拟
articles.abstract: Quantum theories relevant to resources ordinarily study the potential gain from a quantum state once the measurement basis has already been chosen. Nevertheless, in modern photonic and matter/wave science, the measurement basis can be shaped and changed. The meaning is that this basis not only corresponds to a mathematical formulation but can be a physical resource (e.g., hardware). In this work, we propose a new theory named Modal Frame Resource Theory (MFRT), which could serve as a simple framework for studying quantum measurement bases. A modal frame consists of a set of modes used by measurement apparatus like time-bin, frequency, spatial, or path modes. Specifically, modal frames are not only used for final detection, but can also be important for the distribution of quantum information across orthogonal modes. Then these can be recombined without measurement, such as in multicarrier signal processing. But stricter requirements exist, such as the preservation of quantum coherence. For the purpose of explaining the proposed complementary concept of quantum theory, we define modal frame information, free-preserving operation, and the frame conversion distance. Regarding the free frame-preserving operation, an operation that can relabel or provoke phase-shifting in the modes, it does not mix them when transforming them into a new modal frame. Each of the aforesaid is mentioned as clearly as possible using simple and comprehensible examples. The framework differentiates ideal measurement frames from noisy experimental implementations. A simple time-bin simulation (of two modes) is also presented as a proof of concept. The simulation compares a source frame ∣early⟩, ∣late⟩ with a rotated receiver frame and shows how modal-frame mismatch changes the transition and the resulting MFRT compatibility score. So, the main point is that in programmable quantum systems, the measurement basis does not correspond to a fixed setting that has been chosen before starting the experiment. In more detail, the basis can be manipulated through a full processing cycle such as measuring, comparing, optimizing, converting, and engineering it as a quantum resource.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出“模态框架资源理论”（MFRT），旨在把量子测量基底从单纯的数学表述扩展为可被塑造、转换和消耗的物理资源。作者将时间槽、频率、空间或路径等模式构成的测量框架视为量子信息分发与重组中的关键对象，并引入模态框架信息、自由保持操作和框架转换距离等概念。该理论强调在不破坏量子相干性的前提下研究测量基底的资源属性。

articles.title: Non-Abelian Holonomy Lifts Topological Obstruction to Synchronization
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔完整性解除同步的拓扑障碍
articles.abstract: Topological synchronization on simplicial complexes is known to exhibit an obstruction for odddimensional signals when couplings are Abelian. Here we show that endowing the complex with a flat SU(2) connection—a discrete non-Abelian gauge field—fundamentally alters this obstruction. The resulting dynamics are governed by a quaternionic Dirac operator whose holonomy can render the uniform state invariant even for edge signals. More importantly, the noncommutativity of quaternions splits the stability analysis into two distinct branches associated with left and right eigenspaces. We derive a generalized Master Stability Function (MSF) requiring simultaneous negativity for both branches, a feature absent in commutative theories. As a concrete example, we demonstrate stable synchronization of Stuart-Landau oscillators on the edges of a tetrahedron equipped with a suitably chosen SU(2) holonomy, a feat strictly forbidden in the Abelian case. Our framework bridges higher-order topology with the collective attitude dynamics of rigid bodies, with implications for spacecraft formation flying, chiral magnetism, and SU(2) gauge theories on networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在单纯复形上为系统引入平坦的 SU(2) 联络，即离散非阿贝尔规范场，可改变奇维信号在阿贝尔耦合下存在的拓扑同步障碍。相应动力学由四元数狄拉克算子控制，其完整性可使边信号的均匀态保持不变。作者进一步提出需要同时考察左右本征空间稳定性的广义主稳定函数，并以带 SU(2) 完整性的四面体边上 Stuart-Landau 振子为例展示了阿贝尔情形下不可能实现的稳定同步。

articles.title: Updated Determination of the Gauss–Listing Geopotential Value and a Best-Fitting Global Reference Ellipsoid
articles.title_zh: Gauss–Listing 重力位值的更新确定及最佳拟合全球参考椭球
articles.abstract: The Gauss–Listing geopotential value 𝑊0 defines the fundamental equipotential surface used as the global vertical reference datum in modern height systems. In this study, the methodology of Dayoub et al. (2012) is revisited using contemporary global datasets and models. The analysis employs the latest mean sea surface (MSS) models DTU25 and CLS22, the mean dynamic topography (MDT) from the ECCO4 ocean state estimate, and the high-resolution global gravity field model XGM2019e₂₁₅₉, all consistently reduced to the mean-tide system. Compared to earlier realisations, these datasets provide improved spatial coverage and accuracy, particularly in high-latitude and coastal regions, enabling a more robust global determination of 𝑊0. This update is timely given the availability of improved global MSS models and ocean state estimates, which enable a more consistent and comprehensive reassessment of 𝑊0. A global least‐squares adjustment of geopotential values computed from these datasets yields 𝑊0=62636853.8 𝑚2𝑠−2at epoch 2003.0. An alternative computation using the normal gravity field formulation provides the same value of 𝑊0 and produces a new best-fitting reference ellipsoid with semi-major axis 𝑎0=6378136.886 𝑚 and semi-minor axis 𝑏0=6356751.887 𝑚. Sensitivity analyses indicate that the estimated 𝑊0 is robust with respect to model selection and resolution, and that the use of the ECCO4 MDT yields results that agree with the MDT-independent formulation at the centimetre level. Random errors are negligible due to global, multi-year averaging and the large number of data points, while a realistic systematic uncertainty of ±0.3 m² s⁻² (≈3 cm in height) is attributed mainly to altimeter calibration and the input models’ biases. The resulting ellipsoid, satisfying 𝑈0= 𝑊0 provides a self-consistent surface for gravity-field modelling and geoid computation, eliminating the need for a degree-zero correction. The updated 𝑊0 value lies between that of Dayoub et al. (2012) and the IAG conventional value. The result represents a physically consistent modern realisation of 𝑊0 and a refined reference ellipsoid suitable for contemporary geodetic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用当代全球平均海面模型、海洋动力地形估计和高分辨率全球重力场模型，重新评估用于现代高程系统全球垂直基准的 Gauss–Listing 重力位值 W0。所有数据被统一到平均潮汐系统，并通过全球最小二乘平差得到 2003.0 历元的 W0=62636853.8 m²s⁻²。研究还通过正常重力场公式得到一致结果，并据此推导新的最佳拟合全球参考椭球参数。

articles.title: Isotopic Evidence of Systemic Economically Motivated Adulteration in Serbia: Empirical Loss Quantization and Bounded Macroeconomic Projections
articles.title_zh: 塞尔维亚系统性经济动机掺假的同位素证据：经验损失量化与有界宏观经济预测
articles.abstract: This study introduces a scalable macro-forensic framework to quantify the systemic economic impacts of economically motivated adulteration within transitional agricultural corridors, utilizing comprehensive multi-sector market data as an empirical baseline. To mitigate sampling biases, we integrate a Bayesian Monte Carlo Simulation with the Integrated Loss Quantization framework and forensic isotopic analysis, supplemented by a pilot phase for spirits. We identify an annualized structural market displacement of €6.46 billion (11.8% of Real GDP). Cross-sectoral analysis reveals high non-compliance thresholds: honey (79.71%), wine (57.75%), milk (39.31%), and spirits (39.50%), generating a €135.73 million deficit in unrecovered fiscal revenues. Verifying the convergence between micro-level isotopic signatures and macro-level administrative data demonstrates that cumulative 15-year sector deficits correlate with accelerated biological asset contraction and rural demographic shifts. Consequently, institutionalizing independent, high-resolution verification networks functions as a critical metric for stabilizing transitional supply chains and preserving market sovereignty across regional trade corridors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种可扩展的宏观法证框架，用于量化转型农业走廊中经济动机掺假的系统性经济影响。作者结合多部门市场数据、贝叶斯蒙特卡罗模拟、综合损失量化框架和同位素法证分析，估计了显著的结构性市场挤出和未追回财政收入缺口。跨部门结果显示蜂蜜、葡萄酒、牛奶和烈酒等领域存在较高不合规比例，并指出独立高分辨率验证网络对稳定供应链和维护市场主权具有重要作用。

articles.title: A QUBO-Based Framework with Heuristic Decomposition for Credit Scorecard Threshold Selection and Combination Optimization
articles.title_zh: 基于 QUBO 与启发式分解的信用评分卡阈值选择和组合优化框架
articles.abstract: Threshold selection in credit scoring cards determines the balance between risk and return in bank lending. As multi card portfolio strategies proliferate, the problem size grows combinatorially, rendering conventional methods computationally prohibitive. This work develops a unified framework based on quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO), in which single card, fixed three card and arbitrary three card selection problems are formulated within a common representation with fewer than 1,000 decision variables. A combinatorial encoding scheme eliminates cubic terms in fixed three card optimization, while a heuristic decomposition strategy partitions arbitrary three card problems into tractable subproblems. The QUBO model is solved using simulated annealing and validated against exhaustive enumeration. Experiments demonstrate optimal returns of 61,172.00, 27,914.82 and 43,880.97 for single card, fixed three card and arbitrary three card cases, respectively, all matching exact optima. Further analysis reveals a marginal core card contribution (0.88% reduction upon removal) and a robust solution space with a unique global optimum. This work establishes a scalable combinatorial optimization framework for credit scoring cards, with potential for deployment on emerging quantum computing hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对银行信贷中信用评分卡阈值选择及多卡组合策略带来的组合爆炸问题，构建了统一的二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）框架。作者将单卡、固定三卡和任意三卡选择问题纳入少于 1000 个决策变量的共同表示，并通过组合编码消除固定三卡优化中的三次项，利用启发式分解处理任意三卡问题。模拟退火实验与穷举枚举结果一致，表明该框架可在较大组合空间中有效找到最优收益方案。

articles.title: Structural, Energetic, Electronic, and Vibrational Properties of Boron-Substituted Tungsten Clusters
articles.title_zh: 硼取代钨团簇的结构、能量、电子与振动性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.14603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a study of the density functional theory of the structural, electronic and vibrational properties of small tungsten-boron clusters using the B3LYP exchange-correlation functional together with the QZVP basis set. A large number of possible isomeric structures were generated using the USPEX code interfaced with Gaussian 03, and the lowest-energy configurations were selected for detailed analysis. The results show that the addition of boron significantly modifies the geometry of tungsten clusters by reducing their symmetry and leading to the formation of shorter and stronger W-B and B-B bonds. With increasing boron concentration, boron atoms preferentially occupy edge and outer positions and gradually form interconnected B-B links within the clusters. These structural modifications improve the overall stability of the clusters, as reflected by the increase in binding energy, HOMO-LUMO energy gap, ionization potential, and chemical hardness with increasing boron concentration. The eigenvalue spectra show a greater separation between the occupied and unoccupied electronic states after boron substitution, indicating enhanced electronic stabilization and stronger electron localization. Vibrational analysis further reveals a gradual shift from low-frequency W-W vibrational modes in pure tungsten clusters to higher-frequency W-B and B-B stretching modes in boron-rich clusters, indicating an increase in the covalent character of bonding. Overall, the results show that boron improves the stability of tungsten clusters by modifying their bonding and electronic properties at the atomic scale
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用密度泛函理论，结合 B3LYP 泛函和 QZVP 基组，系统考察小尺寸钨—硼团簇的结构、电子和振动性质。通过 USPEX 与 Gaussian 03 生成并筛选低能异构体后，作者发现硼掺入会降低钨团簇对称性，形成更短、更强的 W-B 和 B-B 键，并使硼原子倾向占据边缘和外层位置。随硼含量增加，结合能、HOMO-LUMO 能隙、电离势和化学硬度提高，表明团簇稳定性和电子态分离增强。
authors: Akshata M. Waghmare, Gautam S. Kamat, Sajeev S. Chacko, Chetan V. Gurada, Balasaheb J. Nagare

articles.title: Elementary excitations in undoped layered cuprates
articles.title_zh: 未掺杂层状铜氧化物中的元激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20903v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using the recently proposed bond-operator technique (BOT), we discuss spin dynamics of the Heisenberg spin-frac12 antiferromagnet with the ring exchange and small interactions between the second- and the third-neighbor spins on the square lattice at T=0. This model was suggested before for description of parent compounds of high-temperature superconducting layered cuprates. BOT describes accurately short-range spin correlations in quantum systems and provides a quantitative description of elementary excitations which appear in other approaches as bound states of conventional low-energy quasiparticles. We demonstrate that besides well-known magnons (spin-1 excitations) there are three well-defined spin-0 quasiparticles in the considered model whose energies lie near the magnon spectrum. Two of them, the amplitude (Higgs) mode and the quasiparticle which we named singlon, produce pronounced anomalies observed experimentally in the Raman scattering, resonant inelastic x-ray scattering, and infrared optical absorption. We find sets of the model parameters which describe quantitatively experimental data obtained in m̊ La₂CuO₄ and m̊ Sr₂CuO₂Cl₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用近期提出的键算符技术，研究包含环交换以及二、三近邻弱相互作用的平方晶格自旋 1/2 海森堡反铁磁体在零温下的自旋动力学。该模型曾用于描述高温超导层状铜氧化物母体化合物。作者指出除已知的自旋 1 磁振子外，还存在三个定义良好的自旋 0 准粒子，其中振幅（Higgs）模和被称为 singlon 的准粒子可解释拉曼散射、共振非弹性 X 射线散射和红外吸收中的显著异常。

articles.title: PFT: Phonon Fine-tuning for Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: PFT：用于机器学习原子间势的声子微调
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.07742v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many materials properties depend on higher-order derivatives of the potential energy surface, yet machine learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) trained with a standard loss on energy, force, and stress errors can exhibit error in curvature, degrading the prediction of vibrational properties. We introduce phonon fine-tuning (PFT), which directly supervises second-order force constants of materials by matching MLIP energy Hessians to DFT-computed force constants from finite displacement phonon calculations. To scale to large supercells, PFT stochastically samples Hessian columns and computes the loss with a single Hessian-vector product. We also use a simple co-training scheme to incorporate upstream data to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. On the MDR Phonon benchmark, PFT improves Nequix MP by 55% on average across phonon thermodynamic properties and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among models trained on Materials Project trajectories. PFT also generalizes to improve properties beyond second-derivatives, improving thermal conductivity predictions that rely on third-order derivatives of the potential energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出声子微调（PFT）方法，以解决常规基于能量、力和应力误差训练的机器学习原子间势在势能面曲率和振动性质预测上的不足。PFT 直接监督二阶力常数，使模型能量 Hessian 匹配由有限位移声子计算获得的 DFT 力常数，并通过随机采样 Hessian 列和单次 Hessian-向量积实现大超胞可扩展训练。基准测试显示，PFT 显著改善声子热力学性质预测，并能泛化提升依赖三阶导数的热导率预测。
authors: Teddy Koker, Abhijeet Gangan, Mit Kotak, Jaime Marian, Tess Smidt

articles.title: Anisotropic Kitaev Spin Glass in Li₂RuₓIr₁₋ₓO₃
articles.title_zh: Li₂RuₓIr₁₋ₓO₃ 中的各向异性 Kitaev 自旋玻璃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.22280v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Kitaev iridates have emerged as an important class of spin-orbit-entangled quantum materials in which bond-directional exchange interactions generate strong magnetic frustration and unconventional correlated states. Rather than realizing simple ordered magnets, members of the alpha,beta,gamma-Li2IrO3 family exhibit fragile and highly anisotropic magnetic behavior, including incommensurate counter-rotating order, strong field sensitivity, and pressure-driven electronic reconstruction. These phenomena place the iridates in close proximity to the Kitaev quantum spin liquid (QSL) regime, while simultaneously revealing the importance of competing interactions, lattice distortions, and spin-orbit-assisted hopping processes beyond the ideal Kitaev limit. Understanding how chemical substitution perturbs these competing interactions provides a route toward probing the underlying frustrated magnetic state. Here, we study single crystals of beta-Li2RuxIr1-xO3 with dilute Ru substitution, x<~10%. Through a combination of magnetometry, resonant elastic X-ray scattering, ac-heat capacity, and muon spin relaxation/rotation, we show that weak magnetic disorder continuously suppresses the incommensurate antiferromagnetic ground state without stabilizing an alternative long-range ordered phase. Instead, the system evolves into a bulk static spin glass characterized by slow relaxation, aging behavior, and frozen local magnetic fields. Despite the loss of long-range magnetic order, the glassy state retains substantial directional anisotropy without significant distortion to the honeycomb lattice, suggesting that disorder freezes spins within a still-active bond-directional exchange environment. In this picture, dilute Ru substitution provides a controlled pathway into an anisotropic Kitaev spin glass regime that preserves essential fingerprints of the underlying Kitaev exchange network.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究稀 Ru 取代的 β-Li₂RuₓIr₁₋ₓO₃ 单晶，以探查 Kitaev 铱酸盐中受挫磁性态对化学替代的响应。作者结合磁测量、共振弹性 X 射线散射、交流热容和 μ 子自旋弛豫/旋转等手段，表征弱磁性稀释对各向异性交换、磁有序和低温动力学的影响。研究表明，该体系的脆弱磁性与键方向相互作用、晶格畸变和自旋轨道辅助跃迁密切相关，并有助于理解其接近 Kitaev 量子自旋液体区域的行为。
authors: Mayia A. Vranas, Alejandro Ruiz, Vikram Nagarajan, Erik Lamb, Gerald D. Morris, Zahir Islam, Christie Nelson, Nobumichi Tamura, Benjamin A. Frandsen, James G. Analytis, Alex Frano

articles.title: Deciphering Majorana Zero Modes in Topological Superconductor FeTe0.55Se0.45 with Machine-Learning-Assisted Spectral Deconvolution
articles.title_zh: 借助机器学习谱反卷积解析拓扑超导体 FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ 中的马约拉纳零能模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15178v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Unambiguous identification of Majorana zero modes (MZMs) in topological superconductors (TSCs) remains a challenge due to complex in-gap states that can also produce zero-bias conductance peaks (ZBPs). Here we demonstrate a data-driven workflow that integrates pixel-wise spectral deconvolution with machine-learning (ML) to analyze tunneling spectroscopy from FeTe0.55Se0.45, an intrinsic TSC. Based on the local density of states (LDOS) spectra acquired with a millikelvin scanning tunneling microscope under magnetic fields, each spectrum was decomposed into multiple Lorentzian peaks. The extracted peak parameters were assembled into a structured feature set and subsequently embedded and clustered with unsupervised ML algorithms. ML-based clustering identified distinct classes of LDOS spectra, separating superconductor vortices exhibiting ZBPs consistent with established characteristics of MZMs from vortices displaying ZBP-mimicking features of trivial origin. Furthermore, spatially resolved ZBP distributions differentiate isotropic vortex cores with well-defined ZBPs from vortices that exhibit locally distorted ZBPs. By comparing the ZBP distributions to defect locations measured without magnetic field, we found a correlation between local heterogeneity and the ZBP formation, necessitating the systematic, data-driven analysis to disentangle genuine MZM signatures in TSC. This objective and reproducible workflow advances reliable MZM detection in TSCs, providing a foundation for MZM manipulation towards quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种数据驱动流程，将逐像素谱反卷积与无监督机器学习相结合，用于分析本征拓扑超导体 FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ 的隧穿谱。基于毫开尔文扫描隧道显微镜在磁场下获得的局域态密度谱，作者将每条谱线分解为多个洛伦兹峰，并利用提取的峰参数进行嵌入和聚类。机器学习聚类区分了具有马约拉纳零能模特征的涡旋零偏压电导峰与平庸起源的相似特征，并通过空间分辨分布分析进一步识别不同涡旋核心形态。
authors: Jewook Park, Hoyeon Jeon, Dongwon Shin, Guannan Zhang, Michael A McGuire, Brian C. Sales, An-Ping Li

articles.title: Large Electron Model: A Universal Ground State Predictor
articles.title_zh: 大电子模型：一种通用基态预测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02346v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Large Electron Model, a single neural network model that produces variational wavefunctions of interacting electrons over the entire Hamiltonian parameter manifold. Our model employs the Fermi Sets architecture, a universal representation of many-body fermionic wavefunctions, which is further conditioned on Hamiltonian parameter and particle number. For interacting electrons in a two-dimensional harmonic potential, a single trained model accurately predicts the ground state wavefunction while generalizing across unseen coupling strengths and particle-number sectors, producing both accurate real-space charge densities and ground state energies, even up to 50 particles. Our results establish a foundation model method for material discovery that is grounded in the variational principle, while accurately treating strong electron correlation beyond the capacity of density functional theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出“大电子模型”，即一个能够在整个哈密顿量参数流形上生成相互作用电子变分波函数的单一神经网络。模型采用 Fermi Sets 架构表示多体费米子波函数，并以哈密顿量参数和粒子数为条件。对于二维谐振势中的相互作用电子体系，单一训练模型能在未见过的耦合强度和粒子数扇区上泛化，准确预测实空间电荷密度和基态能量，展示了面向材料发现的变分原则基础模型潜力。
authors: Timothy Zaklama, Max Geier, Liang Fu

articles.title: DFT calculations of magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy with fixed spin moment
articles.title_zh: 采用固定自旋矩的磁晶各向异性能密度泛函理论计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09502v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The development of new-generation permanent magnets is based on experimental efforts and innovative theoretical tools for modeling magnetic properties. Magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy (MAE) - one of the main intrinsic properties of permanent magnets - can be calculated using density functional theory (DFT). However, MAEs determined with different exchange-correlation potentials can vary widely. We show how these seemingly contradictory results can be reconciled using the fully relativistic fixed spin moment (FR-FSM) method. This is because the equilibrium pairs [MAE, mₛ] calculated with different exchange-correlation potentials overlap with the MAE(mₛ₎ curve determined from the FR-FSM method (mₛ denotes the spin magnetic moment). The FR-FSM method also enables the hypothetical maximum MAE value for a given material to be estimated. In the case of magnetic alloys, MAE(FSM) analysis allows the optimal alloying additions to be determined in order to improve the MAE value. The high independence of the MAE(mₛ₎ works well for exchange-correlation functionals such as LDA and GGA. However, it is not a universal measure and varies with changes in the value of the U parameter when using LDA+U or GGA+U functionals. Concluding, the framework we describe for MAE versus FSM calculations can be a useful tool in the design of new permanent magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论如何利用完全相对论固定自旋矩（FR-FSM）方法协调不同交换-关联势下磁晶各向异性能（MAE）计算结果差异较大的问题。作者指出，不同泛函得到的平衡 [MAE, 自旋磁矩] 对可落在 FR-FSM 给出的 MAE 随自旋磁矩变化曲线上，从而提供统一解释。该方法还可估计材料的假设最大 MAE，并在磁性合金中用于分析有利于提高 MAE 的合金化添加策略。
authors: Justyn Snarski-Adamski (Institute of Molecular Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences, Poznan, Poland), Joanna Marciniak (Institute of Molecular Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences, Poznan, Poland, Uppsala University, Uppsala, Sweden), Wojciech Marciniak (Institute of Molecular Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences, Poznan, Poland, Poznan University of Technology, Poznan, Poland), Justyna Rychły-Gruszecka (Institute of Molecular Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences, Poznan, Poland), Mirosław Werwiński (Institute of Molecular Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences, Poznan, Poland)

articles.title: Double Electron Attachment and Double Ionization Potential Equation-of-Motion Coupled-Cluster Approaches with Full and Active-Space Treatments of 4-Particle-2-Hole and 4-Hole-2-Particle Excitations and Three-Body Clusters
articles.title_zh: 包含4粒子-2空穴与4空穴-2粒子激发及三体簇的双电子附着和双电离势运动方程耦合簇方法：全空间与活性空间处理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.20556v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The double electron attachment (DEA) and double ionization potential (DIP) equation-of-motion coupled-cluster (EOMCC) methods including up to 4-particle-2-hole (4p-2h) and 4-hole-2-particle (4h-2p) excitations on top of coupled-cluster singles, doubles, and triples (CCSDT), denoted DEA-EOMCCSDT(4p-2h) and DIP-EOMCCSDT(4h-2p), have been efficiently implemented in full and active-space forms. The resulting methods are applied to determine the ground and low-lying excited states of methylene, the singlet-triplet gap of trimethylenemethane, and the lowest singlet and triplet DIPs of 23 atoms and molecules. In all cases considered, the active-space DEA/DIP-EOMCC approaches recover the highly accurate parent DEA-EOMCCSDT(4p-2h)/DIP-EOMCCSDT(4h-2p) data at small fractions of the computational costs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文高效实现了双电子附着和双电离势运动方程耦合簇方法，在CCSDT基础上分别纳入最高4粒子-2空穴和4空穴-2粒子激发，并给出全空间与活性空间版本。作者将方法用于亚甲基的基态和低激发态、三亚甲基甲烷的单重-三重态能隙，以及23种原子和分子的低能单重态与三重态双电离势计算。结果表明，活性空间DEA/DIP-EOMCC方法能以显著更低的计算成本恢复高精度母方法的结果。
authors: Jun Shen, Karthik Gururangan, Piotr Piecuch

articles.title: Pauli propagation enables fast classical simulation of strongly correlated quantum systems
articles.title_zh: Pauli传播实现强关联量子体系的快速经典模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.21651v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ground state energy estimation for strongly correlated quantum systems remains a central challenge in computational physics and chemistry. While tensor network methods like DMRG provide efficient solutions for one-dimensional systems, higher-dimensional problems remain difficult. Here we present a variational double bracket flow (vDBF) algorithm that leverages Pauli Propagation, a technique originally developed for classical simulation of quantum circuits, to efficiently approximate ground state energies. By combining greedy operator selection with coefficient-based fluctuation truncation and energy-variance extrapolation, we obtain results with sub-1% relative accuracy compared to DMRG benchmarks for the Heisenberg and Hubbard models in one and two dimensions. For a 10x10 Heisenberg lattice (100 qubits), vDBF obtains accurate results in approximately 1 minute on a single CPU thread, compared to over 50 hours on 64 threads for DMRG. For the 8x8 half-filled Hubbard model, corresponding to 128 qubits, vDBF reaches the 1% error regime in less than one hour, while our DMRG calculations required more than 10 hours on 64 threads. We further test vDBF on the 84-qubit π-valence active space of hexabenzocoronene, where the tighter-threshold calculations achieve sub-1% agreement with DMRG. These results demonstrate that classical simulation techniques developed in the context of quantum advantage benchmarking can provide practical tools for many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种变分双括号流算法，利用最初用于量子线路经典模拟的Pauli传播技术来近似强关联量子体系的基态能量。通过贪婪算符选择、基于系数的涨落截断和能量-方差外推，该方法在一维和二维Heisenberg与Hubbard模型中相对DMRG基准达到低于1%的误差。对于100量子比特的10×10 Heisenberg晶格，该方法在单CPU线程上约1分钟得到准确结果，显著快于文中DMRG计算。
authors: Chinmay Shrikhande, Arnab Bachhar, Aaron Rodriguez Jimenez, Edward F. Valeev, Nicholas J. Mayhall

articles.title: Ground state energy and phase transitions of Long-range XXZ using VQE
articles.title_zh: 利用VQE研究长程XXZ模型的基态能量与相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.04615v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The variational quantum eigen solver (VQE), has been widely used to find the ground state energy of different Hamiltonians with no analytical solutions and are classically difficult to compute. In our work, we have used VQE to identify the phase transition boundary for an infinite order phase transition. We use long-range XXZ (LRXXZ) chain for our study. In order to probe infinite order phase transition, we propose to utilise the ground state energy obtained from VQE. The idea rests on the argument that VQE requires an ansatz circuit; therefore, the accuracy of the VQE will rely on this ansatz circuit. We have designed this circuit such that the estimated ground state energy is sensitive to the phase it is evaluated in. It is achieved by applying the constraint that the net spin remains constant throughout the optimisation process. Consequently, the ansatz works in a certain phase where it gives relatively small random error, as it should, when compared to the error in ground state energy calculations of the other phases, where the ansatz fails. By identifying these changes in the behaviour of the error in ground state energy using VQE, we were able to determine the phase boundaries. Using exact diagonalisation, we also compare the behaviour of the energy gradient and energy gap across both the phase transition boundaries for this model. Further, by increasing the depth of the optimisation circuit, we also accurately evaluate the ground energy of the LRXXZ chain for the value of coupling constant, J equal to -1
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作使用变分量子本征求解器研究长程XXZ链，并尝试通过VQE得到的基态能量识别无限阶相变的边界。作者设计了保持总自旋不变的ansatz线路，使其在特定相中能较好估计基态能量，而在其他相中误差行为发生变化。通过分析不同相中基态能量误差的变化，该方法被用于探测相变边界。

articles.title: Andreev spin qubits based on the helical edge states of magnetically doped two-dimensional topological insulators
articles.title_zh: 基于磁掺杂二维拓扑绝缘体螺旋边缘态的Andreev自旋量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.22226v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We show that Andreev spin qubits can be realized in a Josephson junction based on the helical edge states of a two-dimensional topological insulator (quantum spin Hall system) proximized by superconducting films, in the presence of magnetic doping. We demonstrate that the electric dipole transitions between the Andreev spin states induced by the magnetic doping can be harnessed to manipulate the Andreev spin qubit by microwave radiation pulses, without applying an external Zeeman field or invoking ancillary states. We numerically simulate the realization of NOT and Hadamard quantum logic gates, and discuss implementations in realistic setups.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出在由超导薄膜邻近化的二维拓扑绝缘体螺旋边缘态Josephson结中，通过磁掺杂实现Andreev自旋量子比特。作者表明，磁掺杂诱导的Andreev自旋态之间的电偶极跃迁可由微波脉冲操控，无需外加Zeeman场或辅助态。文中数值模拟了NOT门和Hadamard门的实现，并讨论了现实器件中的可行方案。
authors: Edoardo Latini, Fausto Rossi, Fabrizio Dolcini

articles.title: From Evaluation to Design: Using Potential Energy Surface Smoothness Metrics to Guide Machine Learning Interatomic Potential Architectures
articles.title_zh: 从评估到设计：利用势能面平滑性指标指导机器学习原子间势架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.04861v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) sometimes fail to reproduce the physical smoothness of the quantum potential energy surface (PES), leading to erroneous behavior in downstream simulations that standard energy and force regression evaluations can miss. Existing evaluations, such as microcanonical molecular dynamics (MD), are computationally expensive and primarily probe near-equilibrium states. To improve evaluation metrics for MLIPs, we introduce the Bond Smoothness Characterization Test (BSCT). This efficient benchmark probes the PES via controlled bond deformations and detects non-smoothness, including discontinuities, artificial minima, and spurious forces, both near and far from equilibrium. We show that BSCT correlates strongly with MD stability while requiring a fraction of the cost of MD. To demonstrate how BSCT can guide iterative model design, we utilize an unconstrained Transformer backbone as a testbed, illustrating how refinements such as a new differentiable k-nearest neighbors algorithm and temperature-controlled attention reduce artifacts identified by our metric. By optimizing model design systematically based on BSCT, the resulting MLIP simultaneously achieves a low conventional E/F regression error, stable MD simulations, and robust atomistic property predictions. Our results establish BSCT as both a validation metric for practitioners to assess MLIP utility and as an "in-the-loop" model design proxy that alerts MLIP developers to physical challenges that cannot be efficiently evaluated by current MLIP benchmarks. The BSCT dataset and evaluation are available on https://github.com/ryanliu30/bsct.git
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，机器学习原子间势有时无法再现量子势能面的物理平滑性，导致下游模拟出现能量和力回归指标难以发现的错误行为。作者提出键平滑性表征测试，通过受控键长形变高效探测近、远平衡区域的势能面不光滑、非物理极小值和伪力等问题，并显示其与分子动力学稳定性高度相关且成本更低。作为示例，作者以无约束Transformer骨干模型为测试平台，展示可微k近邻算法和温度控制注意力等设计改进如何减少该指标识别出的伪影。
authors: Ryan Liu, Eric Qu, Tobias Kreiman, Samuel M. Blau, Aditi S. Krishnapriyan

articles.title: Process-tensor approach to full counting statistics of charge transport in quantum many-body circuits
articles.title_zh: 量子多体线路中电荷输运全计数统计的过程张量方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.28894v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a numerical tensor-network method to compute the statistics of the charge transferred across an interface partitioning an interacting one-dimensional many-body lattice system with U(1) symmetry. Our approach is based on a matrix-product state representation of the process tensor (also known as influence functional or influence matrix) describing the effect of the bulk system on the degrees of freedom at the interface, allowing us to evaluate a multi-time correlation function that yields the moment-generating function of charge transfer. We develop a scheme to truncate non-Markovian correlations which preserves the proper normalization of the process tensor and ensures the correct physical properties of the generating function. We benchmark our approach by simulating magnetization transport within the Heisenberg spin-1/2 XXZ brickwork circuit model at infinite temperature. Our results recover the correct transport exponent describing ballistic, superdiffusive, and diffusive transport in different regimes of the model. We also demonstrate anomalous transport encoded by a self-similar scaling form of the moment-generating function outside of the ballistic regime. In particular, we confirm the breakdown of Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality in higher-order transport cumulants at the isotropic point. Our work paves the way for process-tensor descriptions of non-Markovian open quantum systems to address current fluctuations in strongly interacting systems far from equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种数值张量网络方法，用于计算具有U(1)对称性的一维相互作用多体晶格体系中跨界面转移电荷的统计量。方法基于过程张量的矩阵乘积态表示，描述体系统对界面自由度的影响，并由多时关联函数得到电荷转移的矩母函数。作者设计了保持过程张量归一化和生成函数物理性质的非Markov关联截断方案，并在无限温Heisenberg自旋1/2 XXZ砖墙线路模型中验证，恢复了弹道、超扩散和扩散等不同输运指数。
authors: Hari Kumar Yadalam, Mark T. Mitchison

articles.title: Strong nonlinear thermoelectricity generation and close-to-Carnot efficient heat engines in Superconductor-Insulator-2D electron gas junctions
articles.title_zh: 超导体-绝缘体-二维电子气结中的强非线性热电生成与接近Carnot效率的热机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02123v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose and theoretically analyse a novel Superconductor-Insulator-2D electron gas tunnel junction (SI2DEG) that strongly and efficiently generates thermoelectricity via a nonlinear mechanism. By varying the position of the electrochemical potential of the 2DEG, the SI2DEG junction shows different thermoelectric generation regimes with performance exceeding state-of-the-art tunnel systems. Indeed, the generated Seebeck potential can reach 6.75Δ₀/e with a nonlinear Seebeck coefficient as high as S=5,Δ₀/em̊ K. When operated as a quantum heat engine, the system efficiency gets very close to the Carnot limit with a maximum value η=0.92η_C with a non-negligible power output. The SI2DEG junction also shows peculiar features such as bidirectional cooling controlled by the potential bias and bistability of the thermoelectric generation. These features, together with its strong temperature response, make the SI2DEG system an interesting general platform for quantum science and technology applications, such as quantum thermodynamics, ultrasensitive cosmology and dark-matter detection, and qubit refrigeration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出并理论分析一种超导体-绝缘体-二维电子气隧穿结，利用非线性机制强而高效地产生热电效应。通过调节二维电子气的电化学势位置，该结可表现出不同热电生成区域，其Seebeck电势和非线性Seebeck系数超过现有隧穿系统。作为量子热机运行时，系统效率可接近Carnot极限并保持非零输出功率，同时还具有偏压控制的双向制冷和热电生成双稳态等特征。

articles.title: Matter may entangle with light far more easily near quantum critical points
articles.title_zh: 量子临界点附近物质与光可能更容易发生纠缠
articles.abstract: Quantum entanglement is a state in which particles are entwined with each other. In this entwined state, the properties of one particle influence the other, even when they aren't physically close to each other. This phenomenon has often been observed in small quantum systems with only a few particles in them, where researchers can use it to store and process quantum information. Rice University professor Qimiao Si is interested in understanding and applying quantum entanglement to macroscopic systems with vast numbers of particles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道围绕量子纠缠在宏观多粒子体系中的表现与应用展开，重点介绍Rice大学Qimiao Si等人对量子临界点附近物质-光纠缠的研究兴趣。文章指出，纠缠通常在小型量子系统中被观测并用于量子信息处理，而该方向旨在理解其在包含大量粒子的宏观系统中的形成机制和潜在用途。具体实验或理论结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Individually tunable Si/SiGe quantum dot operating voltages via gate-biased illumination
articles.title_zh: 通过栅偏置光照实现可单独调谐的Si/SiGe量子点工作电压
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor quantum dot qubits often require very different voltages on each gate to bring them to a correct operating point. Here, we present a method by which one can controllably and repeatably alter the nanoscale trapped charge distribution at an oxide-semiconductor interface. We demonstrate this method on a Si/SiGe quantum dot device, and we find that the operating voltages can be controlled and made much more uniform. The method relies on illumination with near-infrared light in the presence of applied gate voltages, and it enables the tuning of the device operating point on a gate-by-gate basis. We present an explanation of the underlying physics using self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson simulations. As an application of this method, we tune a triple quantum dot to have uniform and small operating voltages in the (1,1,1) charge configuration. Importantly, we show that shifting the operating voltages in this way does not change the measured charge noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种在氧化物-半导体界面可控、可重复改变纳米尺度陷阱电荷分布的方法，用于调节Si/SiGe量子点器件的栅极工作电压。该方法在施加栅压时利用近红外光照，可按单个栅极调谐器件工作点，并使工作电压更均一。作者通过自洽Schrödinger-Poisson模拟解释其物理机制，并展示了将三重量子点调至均匀且较小工作电压的应用，同时表明该调节不改变测得的电荷噪声。
authors: Jared Benson, Sanghyeok Park, Owen M. Eskandari, M. A. Wolfe, Brighton X. Coe, J. P. Dodson, S. N. Coppersmith, Mark Friesen, M. A. Eriksson

articles.title: Non-equilibrium glassy arrest and discontinuous transitions at avoided quantum critical points
articles.title_zh: 避开量子临界点处的非平衡玻璃态冻结与不连续相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The non-equilibrium dynamics of an order parameter confined by an external constraint field are investigated within a spatially extended Belitz-Kirkpatrick-Vojta framework. A generic non-monotonic dissipation peak arises at avoided criticality due to the interplay between macroscopic free-energy flattening and microscopic disorder-induced trapping. Near this regime, suppressed deterministic forces enhance activated trapping, leading to an effective violation of the fluctuation-dissipation theorem and ultimate glassy arrest. At higher fields, the system undergoes a discontinuous phase transition that bypasses this flat free-energy region. These explicit analytical scalings establish a generic mechanism for non-equilibrium arrest in disordered condensed matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在空间扩展的Belitz-Kirkpatrick-Vojta框架内研究受外部约束场限制的序参量非平衡动力学。作者发现，在避开临界性附近，由宏观自由能展平与微观无序诱导俘获共同作用，会产生通用的非单调耗散峰；确定性力被抑制后，激活俘获增强，并导致有效的涨落-耗散定理违背和最终玻璃态冻结。在更高场强下，系统发生绕过平坦自由能区域的不连续相变，给出了无序凝聚态体系非平衡冻结的一般机制。

articles.title: Supersymmetric quantum criticality with discrete symmetry
articles.title_zh: 具有离散对称性的超对称量子临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Supersymmetry, originally proposed in high-energy physics, can emerge as a remarkable low-energy structure in condensed matter systems. While emergent supersymmetry at quantum critical points is widely discussed in models with continuous symmetries, real materials are constrained by microscopic discrete symmetries. To address this, we investigate (2+1)-dimensional Gross-Neveu-Yukawa theories coupling Dirac fermions to a complex order parameter with discrete Zₙ anisotropy. Using the functional renormalization group, we find that for n>3, the anisotropic perturbations are irrelevant at the fixed point, yielding a N=2 Wess-Zumino supersymmetric critical point. In the ordered phase, this dangerously irrelevant anisotropy gives rise to a second characteristic length scale, ξ', alongside the usual correlation length, ξ. By tracking mass thresholds along symmetry-broken renormalization group trajectories, we extract the exponents ν' and ν without imposing prior scaling assumptions. For the Z₄, Z₅, and Z₆ models, our results support the scaling relation ν'/ν = 1+|yₙ|/p with p=2 in the isotropic framework used here.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究在具有离散Zₙ各向异性的二维加一维Gross-Neveu-Yukawa理论中，Dirac费米子与复序参量耦合时的涌现超对称临界性。利用函数重整化群，作者发现当n>3时，各向异性扰动在固定点处无关，从而得到N=2 Wess-Zumino超对称临界点。在有序相中，这种危险无关各向异性引入第二特征长度尺度，作者通过跟踪对称破缺重整化群轨道上的质量阈值提取相关指数，并支持相应的标度关系。

articles.title: Optically programmable and erasable cryogenic flash memory on an undoped Si/SiGe heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 基于未掺杂Si/SiGe异质结构的光可编程与可擦除低温闪存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scalable cryogenic memory is a critical yet unresolved requirement for large-scale quantum computing architectures, particularly for computing-in-memory schemes. We exploit the interplay between optical excitation and gate bias in an undoped Si/SiGe heterojunction field-effect transistor (HFET) to realize non-volatile memory functionality. The device exploits a high interface trap density (Dᵢₜ > 1.6 × 10¹²~eV⁻¹cm⁻²), which, in conjunction with the oxide thickness and dielectric constant, enables effective "locking" of the threshold voltage to the applied gate bias over a wide voltage range. Two of these states can be selected for binary operation, while the availability of multiple stable states within the same device enables multibit data storage. Robust cycling endurance (>~10³ cycles) and long-term state retention (>~10⁴~s) of the memory states at 1.5 K confirm the suitability of this approach for integration into Si/SiGe-based quantum computing architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用未掺杂Si/SiGe异质结场效应晶体管中光激发与栅偏置的相互作用，实现低温非易失存储功能。器件依赖较高界面陷阱密度及氧化层参数，使阈值电压可在宽电压范围内被“锁定”到施加的栅压；其中两个稳定态可用于二进制存储，多稳定态则支持多比特存储。实验显示该存储在1.5 K下具有超过约10³次循环耐久性和超过约10⁴秒的数据保持时间，适合集成到Si/SiGe量子计算架构中。
authors: S Rastogi, S Samanta, V Jangir, L Patra, K Modi, A Jain, G Scappucci, U Mukhopadhyay, S Mahapatra

articles.title: Compressibility and High-Pressure Structure of CaMg₂Bi₂ and YbMg₂Bi₂
articles.title_zh: CaMg₂Bi₂与YbMg₂Bi₂的可压缩性和高压结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00785v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compounds with the formula AM₂X₂ in the CaAl₂Si₂ structure type have garnered increasing interest across various solid-state research domains, such as quantum topological and thermoelectric materials. Prior studies have identified high-pressure phase transitions in several compounds, including Mg₃Sb₂, Mg₃Bi₂, CaMn₂Bi₂, and SrAl₂Si₂. In this study, we investigate the structural behavior of CaMg₂Bi₂ and YbMg₂Bi₂ under varying pressure conditions. We synthesized crystals using the molten metal flux method and examined them through single-crystal synchrotron X-ray diffraction, employing diamond anvil cells to exert pressures up to 20 GPa. Our analysis reveals insights into the anisotropic compressibility of these materials, highlighting the more compressible and flexible octahedral A-Bi bonds as the primary contributors to this anisotropy. Moreover, we observed a phase transition in both CaMg₂Bi₂ and YbMg₂Bi₂ at pressures above 9.6 GPa and 8.7 GPa, respectively. The newly identified high-pressure phase exhibits a distortion of the original CaAl₂Si₂ structure with space group C2/m. This high-pressure structure is distinct from that of related compounds (e.g., CaMn₂Bi₂, MgMg₂Bi₂₎, the latter exhibiting a square pyramidal coordination for the M site.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了CaAl₂Si₂结构型化合物CaMg₂Bi₂和YbMg₂Bi₂在高压下的结构演化。作者利用金属熔剂法合成晶体，并通过金刚石对顶砧结合单晶同步辐射X射线衍射在最高20 GPa压力下进行表征。结果揭示了材料的各向异性可压缩性，主要来源于较易压缩且柔性的A-Bi八面体键；同时两种化合物分别在约9.6 GPa和8.7 GPa以上发生相变，形成具有C2/m空间群的畸变高压相。
authors: Mario Calderón-Cueva, Allison Pease, Cheng Peng, Wanyue Peng, Megan Rylko, Weiwei Xie, Susannah M. Dorfman, Alexandra Zevalkink

articles.title: Structure, Composition, and High-Field Superconductivity in Metal-Rich η-Carbide-Type Compounds
articles.title_zh: 富金属η-碳化物型化合物的结构、组成与高场超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: η-Carbide-type compounds have recently emerged as a diverse class of materials in the study of superconductivity. These phases contribute to a growing family of metal-rich quantum materials that exhibit unusual superconducting properties emerging from complex metallic bonding. Several members of the η-carbide-type phases have been found to be bulk superconductors -- such as Nb₄Rh₂C₁₋δ, Ta₄Rh₂C₁₋δ, Ti₄Ir₂O₁₋δ, and Ti₄Co₂O₁₋δ -- with transition temperatures up to Tₘ̊ c approx 10 K and upper critical fields as high as μ₀ Hₘ̊ c₂(0) approx 30 T. Whereas the transition temperatures may fall within the range typical for intermetallic superconductors, the pronounced violation of the weak-coupling Pauli limit in many of these crystallographically high-symmetry materials is noteworthy. Here, we review recent progress on superconducting η-carbide-type phases, emphasizing how crystal symmetry, synthetic challenges, transition-metal composition, and electronic structure govern their superconducting properties. Furthermore, we outline open questions and future directions, including the possible discovery of new η-carbide-type materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了η-碳化物型相在超导研究中的最新进展，这类富金属量子材料因复杂金属键合而表现出非常规超导性质。若干代表性化合物已被发现为体超导体，转变温度可达约10 K，上临界场可高达约30 T，并常显著超过弱耦合泡利极限。文章重点讨论晶体对称性、合成难点、过渡金属组成和电子结构如何调控其超导性质，并展望新η-碳化物型材料的发现方向。
authors: Manuele Balestra, KeYuan Ma, Harald O. Jeschke, Fabian O. von Rohr

articles.title: Interplay between Quantum Metric and Hybridized Collective Modes in Flat-Band Superfluids
articles.title_zh: 平带超流体中量子度规与杂化集体模的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01235v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate collective excitations in flat-band superfluids by incorporating the coupled dynamics of pairing (phase and amplitude) and density fluctuations. We demonstrate that for any time-reversal symmetric superfluid system with an isolated flat band, only a single low-energy collective mode emerges in the long-wavelength limit. In contrast to the linearly dispersive Goldstone mode in conventional superfluids, this hybridized mode is gapless at zero momentum but exhibits a quadratic dispersion (ømega propto q²⁾ at small momenta. Analytically, we reveal that the dispersion coefficient of this collective mode is governed by the normal-state quantum metric of the flat band. These analytical predictions are in excellent agreement with numerical calculations. Our results are universally applicable to any generic s-wave flat-band superfluid, provided the flat band is energetically well separated from other dispersive bands.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过同时考虑配对相位、振幅涨落与密度涨落的耦合动力学，分析平带超流体中的集体激发。作者证明，在任意具有时间反演对称性且含孤立平带的超流体系中，长波极限下仅出现一个低能集体模。不同于常规超流体的线性色散Goldstone模，该杂化模在零动量处无能隙但在小动量下呈二次色散，其色散系数由平带正常态的量子度规决定。
authors: Yi Liu, Mingyan Wang, Penghui Hu, Yao Lu

articles.title: Signatures of Rashba-Cavity-Induced Berry-curvature redistribution in the Spin-Hall Conductivity of Semiconductor Artificial Graphene
articles.title_zh: 半导体人工石墨烯自旋霍尔电导中Rashba-腔诱导Berry曲率再分布的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the combined effect of a far-infrared cavity field and Rashba spin-orbit interac- tion on the band structure and transport properties of artificial graphene composed of quazi-2D InAs/GaAs quantum dots. The coupling to cavity photons is modeled by constructing a complete basis as the tensor product of the electronic Hilbert space and the Fock space. Our calculations for the system embedded in a linear cavity predict the existence of both type-I and type-II Dirac points which can be distinguished by their response to Rashba interaction. Namely, Rashba coupling opens a gap at type-II Dirac points, while type-I Dirac points remain gapless. For both cylindrical and linear cavities, we demonstrate the formation of electron-photon hybrid states and Rabi oscillations between energy minibands. Multiple splittings, crossings, and anticrossings between Dirac-band replicas produce pronounced modifications of the spin-Hall conductivity, including strong anisotropy and oscillatory behavior controlled by cavity geometry and polarization. Our results show that the interplay between Rashba and cavity couplings governs Dirac-point physics and provides a route toward tunable polaritonic transport and topological phases in engineered nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究远红外腔场与Rashba自旋轨道耦合对由准二维InAs/GaAs量子点构成的人工石墨烯能带结构和输运性质的共同影响。计算表明，线性腔中可出现I型和II型Dirac点，二者对Rashba相互作用的响应不同：Rashba耦合会在II型Dirac点打开能隙，而I型Dirac点保持无隙。圆柱腔和线性腔中均形成电子-光子杂化态及能量微带间Rabi振荡，导致自旋霍尔电导出现由腔几何和偏振控制的强各向异性与振荡行为。
authors: Maryam Mansouri, Vram Mughnetsyan, Armen Harutyunyan, Albert Kirakosyan, Vidar Gudmundsson

articles.title: The Longest Increasing Subsequence Problem revisited
articles.title_zh: 最长递增子序列问题再探
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Longest Increasing Subsequence problem - a classic combinatorial challenge with deep connections to statistical mechanics- exhibits a rich thermodynamic landscape. Introducing a temperature we identify two distinct energy scales: A Schottky-like crossover at T_cross and a condensation transition at T_cond, below which the number of maximum-length configurations becomes sub-exponential in system size. We also show that despite the existence of polynomial-time dynamic programming algorithms for the ground state, local Monte Carlo dynamics, after sudden quenches at low temperatures, become trapped in metastable state configurations displaying characteristic glassy signatures: two-step relaxation, persistent dynamical overlaps and aging. On the other hand, logarithmic annealing tracks equilibrium down to the ground state. These results establish that thermodynamic sparsity - not energetic barriers - can render local search dynamically intractable, positioning the LIS problem as a bridge between exactly solvable optimization and glassy spin-glass phenomenology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从统计力学视角重新考察经典组合优化问题——最长递增子序列问题，并引入温度以揭示其热力学结构。作者识别出两个能量尺度：类似Schottky的交叉温度和凝聚转变温度，在后者以下最大长度构型数随系统尺寸变为亚指数增长。尽管基态可由多项式时间动态规划算法求得，低温骤冷后的局域Monte Carlo动力学会陷入亚稳态并表现出玻璃态特征，而对数退火则可跟踪平衡直至基态。

articles.title: Negative Interaction Quench Dynamics of Density-Ordered Dipolar Bosons in a One-Dimensional Optical Lattice
articles.title_zh: 一维光晶格中密度有序偶极玻色子的负相互作用淬火动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore the nonequilibrium dynamics of a density-ordered dipolar Bose gas in a finite one-dimensional optical lattice following a negative interaction quench, using the numerically exact multiconfigurational time-dependent Hartree method for bosons. The interaction sign reversal, effectively driving a crossover from long-range to short-range interactions, generates rich intra- and interwell tunneling dynamics spanning superfluid, Mott-insulating, and fragmented regimes. A striking finding is the robustness of the underlying crystal-state correlations against the quench, despite the strong dynamical response. We identify emergent excitation modes, including local breathing and dipole-like oscillations, via real- and momentum-space observables, and quantify tunneling through site-resolved position variance. One- and two-body Glauber correlation functions further uncover a direct connection between tunneling and correlation dynamics. Moreover, we show that combining interaction quenches with lattice-depth ramping enables controllable dynamical engineering, establishing dipolar lattice systems as a promising platform for nonequilibrium quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用数值精确的多组态含时Hartree玻色子方法，探讨有限一维光晶格中密度有序偶极玻色气体在负相互作用淬火后的非平衡动力学。相互作用符号反转有效推动体系从长程相互作用向短程相互作用跨越，并诱发涵盖超流、Mott绝缘和碎裂态区域的丰富阱内与阱间隧穿动力学。研究发现，尽管体系动力学响应强烈，底层晶体态关联仍具有显著稳健性，并可通过实空间、动量空间观测量及Glauber关联函数识别激发模式和关联演化。
authors: Rhombik Roy, N. D. Chavda, Barnali Chakrabarti, Arnaldo Gammal

articles.title: Role of System-Bath Interaction in Non-Markovian Quantum Brownian Otto Cycles
articles.title_zh: 系统-热浴相互作用在非马尔可夫量子布朗Otto循环中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01750v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study finite-time quantum Otto cycles whose working medium is a harmonic oscillator undergoing a quantum Brownian motion described by the Caldeira-Leggett model when the oscillator is in contact with heat baths in isochoric processes. The time evolution of the Otto cycle is studied by analytically solving the exact Heisenberg-Langevin equations for the system variables and the interaction energy between the system and the bath. This enables us to investigate non-Markovian strong-coupling effects on the quantum Otto cycle. We obtain cyclic steady states and study the thermodynamic properties of the Otto cycle for various values of the parameters describing the heat baths and the coupling between the system and the bath. We compare our results with those obtained in the Markovian limit, where the time evolution is described by the Lindblad equation. We find that the change in the interaction energy during the isochoric process contributes to both work and heat, and plays a crucial role in determining thermodynamic behavior of the cycle. In particular, we find that when the Otto cycle operates as an engine, the effect of the interaction energy is to reduce the work output. We also compare our results with the power-efficiency trade-off relation recently proposed for the Markovian quantum Otto engine. We find that the power of our non-Markovian engine for a given efficiency value falls below the Markovian power-efficiency bound.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察有限时间量子Otto循环，其工作介质为与热浴接触时服从Caldeira-Leggett模型的谐振子量子布朗运动。作者通过解析求解系统变量及系统-热浴相互作用能的精确Heisenberg-Langevin方程，研究非马尔可夫强耦合效应对循环性能的影响。结果表明，等容过程中相互作用能的变化同时贡献于功和热，并在决定循环热力学行为方面起关键作用；研究还将结果与Lindblad方程描述的马尔可夫极限进行了比较。

articles.title: Evolution of the intertwining correlated topological phases in iron-based superconductor Fe(Te,Se)
articles.title_zh: 铁基超导体Fe(Te,Se)中交织关联拓扑相的演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiple topological electronic phases can coexist within a single quantum material and induce different topological superconducting states, offering deeper insights into interplay of topological superconducting states and Majorana modes, which may also be influenced and modified by correlation effect. Iron-based superconductors, with both topological states and correlation effect, is an ideal platform to study these phenomena. Here, with high resolution angle resolved photoelectron spectroscopy, we directly resolve two distinct intertwining topological states in iron-based superconductor Co-doped Fe(Te,Se), and study their evolution with electron doping. We identify a region where both topological insulator surface states and topological Dirac semimetal states intersect the Fermi level. The topological states are affected by the strong correlation effect and are isolated from trivial bulk states. The evolution between distinct topological phases offers a good opportunity to study various Majorana modes from different superconducting phases according to theoretical analysis. Our findings establish an ideal platform for exploring the interaction between multiple topological superconducting states and the related Majorana modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用高分辨角分辨光电子能谱直接解析Co掺杂Fe(Te,Se)铁基超导体中两类相互交织的拓扑电子态，并考察其随电子掺杂的演化。作者发现存在拓扑绝缘体表面态与拓扑Dirac半金属态同时穿过费米能级的区域。强关联效应会影响这些拓扑态并使其与平庸体态分离，为研究不同超导相中可能出现的多种Majorana模式提供了理想平台。
authors: Yue Sun, Shiying He, Zhongyi Zhang, Yong Huang, Jingheng Chen, Weixiang Yan, Chunbo Yu, Yuyang Dong, Kohei Aido, Xin Zhou, Zhengtai Liu, Mao Ye, Jishan Liu, Haruhisa Kitano, Zhixiang Shi, Hong Ding, Takeshi Kondo, Xianxin Wu, Peng Zhang

articles.title: Dynamical frustration in space-time metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 时空超材料中的动力学阻挫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: From spin ice and crumpled paper to cold atoms lattices and metamaterials, geometrical frustration occurs generically whenever local constraints cannot be satisfied all at once.
