authors: Giovanni Sisorio, Alberto Cappellaro, Luca Dell'Anna

articles.title: FewBodyToolkit.jl: a Julia package for solving quantum few-body problems
articles.title_zh: FewBodyToolkit.jl：用于求解量子少体问题的Julia软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.04447v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Few-body physics explores quantum systems of a small number of particles, bridging the gap between single-particle and many-body regimes. To provide an accessible tool for such studies, we present FewBodyToolkit.jl, a Julia package for quantum few-body simulations. The package supports general two- and three-body systems in various spatial dimensions with arbitrary pair-interactions, and allows to calculate bound and resonant states. The implementation is based on the well-established Gaussian expansion method and we illustrate the package's capabilities through benchmarks and research examples. The package comes with documentation and examples, making it useful for research, teaching, benchmarking, and method development.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍FewBodyToolkit.jl，一个面向量子少体模拟的Julia软件包。该工具支持不同空间维度中的一般二体和三体系统、任意成对相互作用，并可计算束缚态与共振态。其实现基于高斯展开法，并通过基准测试和研究示例展示了在科研、教学、方法开发与性能比较中的用途。

articles.title: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev physics from the Hubbard model: A Floquet engineering approach
articles.title_zh: 从Hubbard模型实现Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev物理：一种Floquet工程方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.02755v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model has attracted widespread attention due to its relevance to diverse areas of physics, such as high temperature superconductivity, black holes, and quantum chaos. The model is, however, extremely challenging to realize experimentally. In this work, we show how a particular form of Floquet engineering, termed ``kinetic driving'', effectively eliminates single-particle processes and creates quasi-random all-to-all interactions when applied to models of Hubbard type. For the specific case of the Bose-Hubbard model, we explicitly verify that the driven system indeed reproduces SYK physics by direct comparison of the spectral form factor and out-of-time ordered correlation functions (OTOCs). Our findings indicate that a cold-atom realization of kinetic driving -- achieved through modulation of hopping amplitudes in an optical lattice -- offers a practical and accurate platform for quantum simulation of the SYK model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用一种称为“动能驱动”的Floquet工程方法，在Hubbard型模型中抑制单粒子过程并产生准随机的全连接相互作用。以Bose-Hubbard模型为例，作者通过谱形状因子和乱序时间关联函数（OTOC）验证驱动系统可再现SYK物理。结果表明，在光晶格中调制跃迁振幅的冷原子平台有望成为模拟SYK模型的可行方案。
authors: Charles Creffield, Fernando Sols, Marco Schirò, Nathan Goldman

articles.title: Experimental Demonstration of Fast Neutron Absorption Spectroscopy with Compact Laser-Driven Neutron Source
articles.title_zh: 利用紧凑型激光驱动中子源实现快中子吸收谱的实验演示
articles.abstract: Fast neutron absorption spectroscopy enables isotope-specific analysis with strong penetration and high sensitivity, but it is currently confined at traditional large size pulsed neutron sources, e.g., spallation sources and mobility electron accelerator-based neutron sources. While laser-driven neutron sources are more compact and feature shorter pulses, their use in fast neutron absorption spectroscopy has been hindered by two critical challenges: insufficient spectral energy resolution and poor in-beam γ-ray signal-to-noise ratio. To address these, we present the first experimental demonstration by integrating the single neutron counting time-of-flight technique with pulse shape discrimination. We achieved a 2% energy resolution at 0.5 MeV over an 11.3 m flight distance, thus clearly resolving magnesium (Mg) resonance peaks and their shapes at 0.268 MeV and 0.432 MeV. This experiment marks the first step toward the application of laser-driven fast neutron resonance spectroscopy for detecting low-Z elements, explosives (e.g., TNT, RDX) and flammable metals (e.g., Li, Na, K, Mg, Al), paving the way for higher-resolution nuclear data and flexible on-site nondestructive testing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究首次实验展示了基于紧凑型激光驱动中子源的快中子吸收谱测量。作者结合单中子计数飞行时间技术与脉冲形状甄别，克服了能量分辨率不足和束内伽马噪声较高的限制，并分辨出镁的共振峰。该成果为利用激光驱动快中子共振谱检测低Z元素、爆炸物和易燃金属，以及开展现场无损检测和核数据测量奠定了基础。

articles.title: Fermi energy Weyl nodes in AMTe4 (A=Ta, Nb, M=Ir, Rh)
articles.title_zh: AMTe4（A=Ta、Nb；M=Ir、Rh）中的费米能级外尔节点
articles.abstract: Key aspects of the quantum oscillations and magnetoresistance in Weyl semimetals AMTe4 (A=Nb,Ta, M=Rh, Ir) persist as open questions, obscuring the link between their topological electronic structure and practical implementations. Employing a generalised search procedure, we carry out a comprehensive scan of WPs accounting for all the subbands close to the Fermi energy, and show that this dramatically alters the WP landscape in these compounds. In particular, we predict these compounds to feature WPs within a few meV of the Fermi energy which significantly influence their properties. Remarkably, most of the considered compounds host WPs of more than one type, including NbIrTe4 which hosts type-I, II and III Weyl points. Our comparative analysis of structure and fidelity of computational parameters/models not only provides a detailed mapping of the complex electronic structure in these compounds, but also clarifies quantum oscillations and magnetoresistance observations in this family, bridging the gap between theory and experiments and offering a framework for precise tunability of WPs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统扫描了AMTe4家族外尔半金属中靠近费米能级的外尔点，纳入多个近费米子带后发现外尔点分布显著改变。作者预测这些材料在费米能级附近数meV范围内存在会显著影响性质的外尔点，且多数化合物包含不止一种类型的外尔点。研究还通过比较结构与计算模型参数，试图解释该材料家族中的量子振荡和磁阻实验现象，并为外尔点的精确调控提供框架。

articles.title: Magnetic Force Imaging of 2D Topological Insulators
articles.title_zh: 二维拓扑绝缘体的磁力显微成像
articles.abstract: Two-dimensional topological insulators are central to understanding the link between topological symmetries in a material and its band electronics. Within this class, complex quantum behaviors—such as persistent spin-polarized currents under broken time-reversal symmetry and temperature-independent topological protection—are expected. However, photoemission, spectroscopy, and transport studies lack the spatial resolution needed to probe the interplay between the physical 2D manifold and band topology. Here, we develop a magnetic force microscopy methodology to address this gap. Using well-characterized Bi₂Te₃ crystallites, we directly image the magnetic signal associated with topological edge states. The phase contrast is robust at 25 °C and consistent across crystallite sizes and shapes. Detailed analysis indicates the observed current has two components: a persistent current (IPersistent) predicted by theory and a Faraday-induced current (IFaraday). Cantilever damping during imaging further suggests the Faraday EMF arises from spin accumulation along the 1D edge channel, which converts to charge current when time-reversal symmetry is broken, producing a novel rectification mechanism. This unexpected result may inspire topology-based circuit elements with extremely low losses and power consumption.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种磁力显微镜方法，用于弥补传统光电子能谱、光谱和输运测量在空间分辨率上的不足，以探测二维拓扑绝缘体的边缘态。作者在Bi2Te3晶体中直接成像与拓扑边缘态相关的磁信号，并观察到室温下稳定且与晶体尺寸和形状一致的相位反差。分析表明观测电流可能包含理论预言的持续电流和法拉第诱导电流两部分，悬臂阻尼结果进一步支持边缘通道中自旋积累诱导电流转换的机制。

articles.title: AI-based hardware trojan generation and detection in post-quantum cryptography
articles.title_zh: 后量子密码学中的基于人工智能的硬件木马生成与检测
articles.abstract: The transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) is increasing the use of specialized hardware accelerators, creating additional attack surfaces for Hardware Trojans (HTs) in open-source and distributed design flows. This work evaluates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can be adversarially prompted to generate HTs in cryptographic hardware, including PQC cores. We propose a multi-agent framework based on Prompt Automatic Iterative Refinement (PAIR), in which attacker, target, and judge models iteratively refine prompts to induce malicious Register-Transfer-Level (RTL) modifications. Across 13 symmetric, public-key, and PQC implementations, the framework produced 1,230 successful insertions in 2,062 attempts, corresponding to a 59.65% attack success rate. The generated trojans were predominantly internal/time-triggered, denial-of-service oriented, and concentrated in Keccak/SHA-3 modules, while PQC-specific insertions targeted NTT and Barrett reduction blocks. Machine Learning (ML) detectors using BoW and TF-IDF features achieved strong intra-design detection with Decision Tree and Random Forest preserving high accuracy and recall (over 97.5%). However, leave-one-design-out evaluation exposed dataset-dependent generalization: on an external TrustHub/ISCAS/MIPS/RISC-V dataset, accuracy ranged from 36.99% for Falcon to 73.17% for Kyber, while the PAIR-generated dataset reached perfect scores for Kyber, Dilithium, and HQC but only 60.62% accuracy for Falcon. This study supports incorporating security validation through a purple-team approach, in which red-team adversarial generation and blue-team detection are integrated into the design and deployment process for PQC hardware accelerators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估大型语言模型是否能够通过对抗性提示在密码硬件和后量子密码核心中生成硬件木马。作者提出基于提示自动迭代优化的多智能体框架，在13种对称、公钥和后量子密码实现上获得了较高比例的成功插入，木马多为内部或时间触发型并偏向拒绝服务。机器学习检测器在同一设计内部表现良好，但跨设计泛化评估显示其鲁棒性仍是关键挑战。

articles.title: Calibration of velocity map imaging spectrometers using [2+1] resonance-enhanced multiphoton ionization of xenon
articles.title_zh: 利用氙的[2+1]共振增强多光子电离校准速度映射成像光谱仪
articles.abstract: Velocity map imaging (VMI) converts three-dimensional charged-particle momentum distributions into two-dimensional detector projections, enabling simultaneous retrieval of photoelectron kinetic-energy distributions and angular distributions. Quantitative use of such images requires an experimentally verified conversion from detector radius to electron kinetic energy. Here, we reformulate and extend a xenon calibration workflow based on [2 + 1] resonance-enhanced multiphoton ionization at 249.7 nm. The two resolved Xe+ spin-orbit ionization channels provide narrow calibration markers at approximately 2.77 eV and 1.46 eV. Raw detector images are centred, inverted using Abel-type reconstruction, radially integrated and transformed from pixel radius N to N² to linearize the energy scale. Linear regression of the two calibration points yields a calibration factor of approximately 6.65 × 10 − 5 eV pixel − 2, with a near-zero intercept. The calibrated photoelectron spectrum reproduces the expected xenon fine-structure splitting and provides a practical benchmark for checking VMI focusing conditions, energy resolution and image-processing reproducibility. This work presents a submission-ready calibration protocol suitable for subsequent molecular photoelectron-imaging experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作重新表述并扩展了基于249.7 nm氙[2+1]共振增强多光子电离的速度映射成像校准流程。氙离子的两个自旋轨道电离通道提供约2.77 eV和1.46 eV的窄能量标记，作者通过图像居中、Abel型反演、径向积分和半径平方线性化获得能量标定因子。校准后的光电子谱重现了预期的氙精细结构劈裂，可作为检查聚焦条件、能量分辨率和图像处理可重复性的实用基准。

articles.title: Reentrant Localization Transition in a Quasiperiodic Thue-Morse Chain
articles.title_zh: 准周期Thue-Morse链中的重入局域化转变
articles.abstract: We investigate localization and reentrance in a dimerized Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) tight-binding chain whose on-site energies are given by a quasiperiodic cosine masked by a deterministic Thue-Morse sequence. Working with non-interacting, spinless fermions, we solve the model via exact diagonalization on large Fibonacci sizes and diagnose phases using inverse/normalized participation ratios and the correlation fractal dimension. We identify boundaries separating extended, multifractal (mixed), and localized regimes by constructing a phase diagram in the plane of modulation strength and dimerization ratio. As the quasiperiodic amplitude is increased, the system exhibits reentrant behavior, localizing, partially re-delocalizing into a multifractal regime, and re-localizing, verified via two-size crossings of band-averaged observables and finite-size scaling. We demonstrate that tuning the modulation strength or the SSH dimerization provides control over the critical thresholds. Our results suggest a versatile, randomness-free platform for the deterministic control of transport, enabling switching between conducting, multifractal, and insulating states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了一个二聚化SSH紧束缚链中的局域化与重入行为，其在位能由准周期余弦调制并受确定性Thue-Morse序列掩蔽。作者利用精确对角化、参与比及关联分形维数构建相图，区分扩展态、多重分形混合态和局域态。随着准周期调制增强，体系表现出从局域化到部分再离域再到重新局域化的重入行为，表明无需随机性的确定性结构可用于调控输运状态。

articles.title: Quantum-precision-spectroscopy metrology of vacuum Rabi splitting in plasmon-single-emitter strong coupling
articles.title_zh: 等离激元—单发射体强耦合中真空拉比分裂的量子精密光谱计量
articles.abstract: Strong coupling between plasmonic nanostructures and single emitters enables the generation of hybrid plexcitonic states at the single-photon level under ambient conditions, which is not only crucial for investigating fundamental phenomena in plasmonic cavity quantum electrodynamics but also serves as a cornerstone for the development of room-temperature quantum technologies. However, accurately probing the key parameters of vacuum Rabi splitting (VRS) and coupling constant g in such intrinsically lossy, non-Hermitian single-emitter strong coupling systems remains challenging, severely hindering their applications. This is primarily attributed to substantial plasmonic dissipation and the consequent damping linewidth mismatch between plasmons and emitters. Here we demonstrate that these challenges can be overcome by exceptional point-assisted photonic substrate engineering that spectrally narrows the plasmon mode and enables precise linewidth matching with the emitter. Using a deterministic plasmon-single-exciton strong coupling platform, we achieve quantum-precision-spectroscopy metrology of the VRS and at room temperature, characterized by the measured spectral splitting (SS) faithfully reflecting the intrinsic quantum eigenlevel splitting, with vanishing or perturbatively small systematic error. We attain a relative measurement error as low as ~0.86%, representing a 40-fold improvement compared with conventional SiO2 substrates. Meanwhile, the g value of this strong coupling system is also directly measured with a tiny error of ~0.60%, indicating a roughly 20-fold improvement in accuracy. Our results reveal a previously inaccessible regime of plasmon-single-emitter strong coupling and establish a powerful route towards room-temperature quantum-precision-spectroscopy metrology operating at the single-photon level.

articles.title: Population dynamics and habitat use of cervids in southern Argentine Mesopotamia
articles.title_zh: 阿根廷美索不达米亚南部鹿科动物的种群动态与栖息地利用
articles.abstract: Cervids constitute one of the most representative mammalian groups inhabiting the natural environments of the Argentine Mesopotamia; however, ecological information regarding their population patterns within productive systems associated with natural habitats remains limited. The aim of this study was to analyze the relative abundance, activity patterns, and temporal overlap between the exotic Axis axis and the native Subulo gouazoubira in two characteristic natural environments of southern Argentine Mesopotamia: native forest and riparian forest. The study was conducted in the Protected Natural Area “La Esmeralda” (Entre Ríos, Argentina) using camera traps deployed between July 2022 and January 2024. Relative abundance indices, circadian activity patterns through Kernel Density and STN analyses, temporal overlap coefficients, and population density estimations were calculated. Axis axis exhibited higher relative abundances in both environments, particularly within riparian forests, demonstrating high ecological and temporal plasticity. In contrast, Subulo gouazoubira showed lower abundances and predominantly crepuscular activity associated with environments characterized by greater vegetation cover. Both species were classified as cathemeral; however, continuous analyses revealed important functional differences, with axis deer displaying more flexible and extended activity patterns. Temporal overlap was high in both environments, although more variable within native forests. These findings provide relevant ecological information for understanding the coexistence of native and exotic cervids within the natural environments of the Argentine Espinal.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用2022年7月至2024年1月在阿根廷恩特雷里奥斯省“La Esmeralda”保护自然区布设的红外相机，分析外来轴鹿和本地灰小鹿在原生林与河岸林中的相对丰度、活动节律和时间重叠。结果显示轴鹿在两类环境中相对丰度更高，尤其偏多于河岸林，并表现出较强的生态和时间可塑性。相比之下，灰小鹿丰度较低，活动更多呈晨昏性并与特定栖息环境相关。

articles.title: State-Dependent Model Predictive Control for Nonlinear Vehicle Dynamics with Implicit State-Derivative Coupling and Actuator Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 具有隐式状态导数耦合与执行器动力学的非线性车辆动力学状态依赖模型预测控制
articles.abstract: Controlling nonlinear vehicle dynamics at the limits of handling presents a fundamental modelling challenge: longitudinal tyre-load transfer renders the bicycle equations of motion an implicit ordinary differential equation (ODE) of the form x˙ = f(x, x˙ , u), in which the state derivative appears on both sides through dynamic normal-load coupling. Standard explicit solvers and fixed-point linearisations cannot faithfully capture this structure, causing existing controllers to fail under large deviations from equilibrium. This paper resolves the implicit ODE exactly into a State-Dependent Coefficient (SDC) form by augmenting the state vector with acceleration and actuator states, yielding a globally valid pseudo-linear representation of the full nonlinear vector field. Four controllers of increasing capability are designed and evaluated: a State-Dependent Riccati Equation (SDRE) controller, a fixed-equilibrium linear MPC (LMPC), a linear time-varying MPC (LTV-MPC) that reschedules Jacobian models along predicted trajectories, and the proposed State-Dependent MPC (SDMPC), which replaces every Jacobian evaluation with an exact SDC matrix rebuilt at each recedinghorizon iteration. Performance is assessed across six initial conditions ordered by a validated three-criterion severity score spanning near-nominal drifting to counter-spin reversal. SDMPC is the only controller to stabilise all six conditions, including the extreme counter-spin case that requires a mandatory yaw-rate sign change, demonstrating the decisive advantage of globally exact nonlinear prediction over local linearisation in the drifting regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对车辆在操纵极限附近的非线性动力学控制问题，指出纵向轮胎载荷转移会使自行车模型形成状态导数出现在方程两侧的隐式常微分方程。作者通过引入加速度和执行器状态，将该隐式系统精确转化为状态依赖系数形式，从而得到全局有效的伪线性表示。研究设计并比较了SDRE、固定平衡点线性MPC、线性时变MPC和所提出的状态依赖MPC，旨在提高大偏离工况下的控制精度与鲁棒性。

articles.title: On-Chip Ultrafast Electrons in Asymmetric Nanogaps: a Scalable Platform for Time-Resolved Spectroscopy of Individual Nanosystems
articles.title_zh: 非对称纳米间隙中的片上超快电子：用于单个纳米系统时间分辨光谱的可扩展平台
articles.abstract: Femtosecond-duration and nanometre-size pulses of electrons are emerging as unique probes for ultrafast dynamics at the nanoscale. Such pulses are achievable only in highly sophisticated ultrafast electron microscopes or equally complex setups involving phase-stable few-cycle pulsed lasers and nanotip probes. Here, we show that nanoscale femtosecond pulses of tunnelling electrons can be achieved routinely using any (deep-UV to mid-IR) femtosecond laser in combination with photosensitive asymmetric nanogap (PAN) diodes fabricated via easy-to-scale adhesion lithography technique. The work function difference in PAN electrodes allows generation of electron pulses via strong-field emission without reliance on optical phase stability or external voltage, greatly simplifying and improving sensitivity of the measurements. We apply PANs to measure sub-ps dynamics in individual metal-halide perovskite quantum dots and zinc oxide nanoparticles immobilised inside 10-nm nanogaps and to characterise laser pulses across the entire optical region (266-6500 nm). Short electron pulses in PANs open the way towards scalable on-chip femtosecond electron measurements and novel design approaches for integrated ultrafast nanodevices.

The authors implement broadband resonators as the signal interface, whose wide frequency acceptance mitigates chip-to-chip mismatch and removes the need to retune chips into agreement. articles.title: Physics-Informed Data Augmentation and Leakage-Free Deep Learning for Supercapacitor Capacitance Prediction from Small Experimental Datasets
articles.title_zh: 面向小规模实验数据集的超级电容器电容预测：物理信息数据增强与无泄漏深度学习
articles.abstract: This study introduces a framework that integrates deep learning architectures with an enhanced multi-method data augmentation strategy to predict capacitance in supercapacitor electrode materials. The work addresses the major problem of insufficient experimental datasets in materials science through the implementation of an advanced hybrid augmentation strategy that combines Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE)-like interpolation, adaptive Gaussian noise, mixup augmentation, and constrained feature permutation. The enhanced augmentation strategy effectively converted 99 real experimental samples into over 990,000 high-quality training samples, facilitating robust neural network training and ensuring strong generalization to real test data. Rigorous statistical validation confirmed augmentation quality with an overall score exceeding 88%, demonstrating excellent preservation of physicochemical relationships through Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests (85.7% pass rate), moment matching analysis (87.3%), correlation preservation (89.1%), and Jensen-Shannon divergence similarity (91.4%). The study evaluates multiple deep neural network architectures including a Deep Deep Neural Network (DNN), Regularized DNN, Residual DNN, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU). Comprehensive feature importance analysis was conducted through permutation-based and gradient-based methods, alongside both SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) for interpretability. The ensemble model combining all architectures demonstrated outstanding performance (R 2 = 0.9510, Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) = 65.99 F/g), while the Residual DNN achieved the best individual model performance (R 2 = 0.9502, RMSE = 66.51 F/g). Analysis of feature importance indicated that the voltage window is the primary predictor (permutation importance: 0.8557), while the specific surface area serves as the critical fine-tuning parameter (gradient sensitivity: 0.3838). Comparative analysis yielded significant insights into prediction mechanisms with strong agreement between methods (Pearson correlation: r = 0.847), illustrating that the models operate in alignment with electrochemical theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种将深度学习架构与多方法数据增强相结合的框架，用于预测超级电容器电极材料的电容。为缓解材料科学中实验数据不足的问题，作者结合类 SMOTE 插值、自适应高斯噪声、mixup 增强和受约束特征置换，将99个真实实验样本扩展为大规模训练数据。统计检验表明，增强数据较好保持了物理化学关系与分布特征，从而支持神经网络在真实测试数据上的泛化。

articles.title: Probabilistic inversion with uncertainty quantification for geomechanical finite element models: an application to the Ormen Lange gas field
articles.title_zh: 地质力学有限元模型的概率反演与不确定性量化：在 Ormen Lange 气田中的应用
articles.abstract: Finite Element (FE) modelling of stress and strain, based on distributions of pressure and temperature changes in the reservoir (potentially caused by gas extraction or injection), is widely used to address subsurface risks. However, associated spatial pressure and temperature change distributions typically carry large uncertainties. These forward models are also computationally intensive, and as a result do not allow for many realisations to account for these uncertainties. These models are also a simplification of reality and therefore, the models do not perfectly reproduce observed deformations. Here, we present a novel workflow that integrates existing geomechanical FE models with a probabilistic inversion framework to quantify FE model parameter uncertainties when calibrating against surveillance data. The proposed inversion framework replaces the FE model with a computationally inexpensive physically motivated proxy model. This proxy model is much cheaper to evaluate and as a result allows for numerous repeated evaluations. The inversion problem is solved within a Bayesian framework to enable uncertainty quantification.The probabilistic inversion workflow is applied to the Ormen Lange gas field (offshore Norway) through combining a 3D FE model with seabed displacement data. Applying this framework to the Ormen Lange gas field shows the suitability of the proxy model and robust performance even with limited information available. The workflow also provides additional insights about predicted reservoir displacements and deformations, enabling better decision-making through probabilistic hazard risk assessments, which are otherwise impossible with existing inversion approaches.

articles.title: Observation and Control of the Magnetic Photogalvanic Effect from Strongly Bound Excitons
articles.title_zh: 强束缚激子磁光伏效应的观测与调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photogalvanic effects arising from the quantum geometry of noncentrosymmetric materials are promising for next-generation light-harvesting devices that do not require a built-in electric field. Recent theories predict photogalvanic currents generated in magnetic systems with spin-dependent symmetry breaking as well as by bound exciton states, allowing for potential magnetic field control of the photoresponse and enhanced detection of deep sub-gap signals, respectively. We demonstrate the magnetic photogalvanic effect in a bilayer CrI3 tunnel junction with both magnetic field switching and electric field tuning of interlayer symmetry. By controlling for the polarization and energy of light illumination, we disentangle the shift and injection current contributions and find that the peak response occurs under resonant excitation of strongly bound excitons in CrI3. Our results can be captured within a many-body framework of the photogalvanic effect, while our devices function as tunable, multispectral helicity- and polarization-sensitive detectors that highlight the potential of 2D magnets for future optoelectronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在双层 CrI3 隧穿结中演示了磁光伏效应，并实现了通过磁场切换和电场调节层间对称性来控制光响应。作者通过调控入射光的偏振和能量，区分了位移电流与注入电流贡献，发现响应峰值出现在 CrI3 强束缚激子的共振激发条件下。结果可由光伏效应的多体理论框架解释，并展示了二维磁体在可调、多光谱、螺旋度和偏振敏感光探测器中的潜力。
authors: Xianfan Nie, Tarun Patel, Hyunggeun Lee, Chuangtang Wang, Meixin Cheng, Mingrui Lai, Bowen Yang, Matteo Pennacchietti, Shiyu Liu, Hechang Lei, Liuyan Zhao, Michael E. Reimer, Su Ying Quek, Adam W. Tsen

articles.title: Symmetry-Resolved Second Harmonic Generation in Quantum and Functional Materials
articles.title_zh: 量子与功能材料中的对称性分辨二次谐波产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30584v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Second harmonic generation (SHG) has evolved from a probe of noncentrosymmetric crystals into a symmetry-resolved optical method for identifying order parameters in quantum and functional materials. In particular, polarization-resolved rotational anisotropy (RA) measurements of SHG can connect nonlinear susceptibility tensors to the crystallographic and magnetic point groups of the underlying materials. This capability is especially powerful when the ordered state is weak, spatially confined, multipolar, magnetic, or hidden from conventional linear probe techniques. In this review article, we provide a comprehensive overview of RA-SHG studies across a broad range of condensed matter systems. We begin with basic theoretical background for the multipole origins of SHG radiation, the construction of nonlinear susceptibility tensors, and group-theoretical framework connecting tensor components to order parameters. We then review the applications of RA-SHG to polar materials, magnetic orders, and other hidden electronic materials. Finally, we outline challenges and future research directions for using SHG to reveal, image, and control hidden, intertwined, and nonequilibrium phases in quantum and functional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述讨论了二次谐波产生，特别是偏振分辨旋转各向异性 SHG，如何从非中心对称晶体探针发展为识别量子与功能材料序参量的对称性分辨光学方法。文章概述了 SHG 辐射的多极起源、非线性极化率张量构造，以及将张量分量与晶体和磁点群相联系的群论框架。随后综述了 RA-SHG 在极性材料、磁有序和隐藏电子态材料中的应用，并展望其用于揭示、成像和控制隐蔽有序态的挑战与方向。
authors: Xiaoyu Guo, Chang Jae Roh, Youngjun Ahn

articles.title: Deterministic fabrication of large-area, high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices
articles.title_zh: 大面积、高结晶性氧化物莫尔超晶格的确定性制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Oxide twistronics extends moire engineering beyond van der Waals materials, offering a promising platform for accessing emergent interfacial phenomena arising from the strong coupling of lattice, charge, and orbital degrees of freedom in complex oxides. However, deterministic fabrication of high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices over large lateral dimensions remains challenging due to the three-dimensional bonding network of oxides. Here, we demonstrate a scalable, generalized fabrication strategy that enables the formation of high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices with clean, chemically bonded interfaces and precisely controlled twist angles down to nominal values of 0.1 degree, achieving sub-degree twist-angle accuracy across large contiguous lateral dimensions approaching the millimeter scale. Using NaNbO3 as a model system, we show that the resulting interlayer coupling drives pronounced structural reconstruction that modifies both the phase structure and ferroelectric domain configuration. Synchrotron-based X-ray 3D reciprocal space mapping reveals the emergence of a single-phase state in twisted bilayers, in contrast to the mixed-phase structure observed in single-layer membranes prior to twist assembly. The structural signatures are further consistent with gradual lattice rotation distributed along the thickness direction that may accommodate interfacial shear strain, distinct from reconstruction observed in van der Waals moire systems, which primarily occurs through in-plane stacking rearrangement. This collective lattice response is correlated with twist-dependent nanoscale electromechanical modulations observed by piezoresponse force microscopy. These results establish a scalable materials platform for oxide twistronics and open new pathways towards integrating twist-engineered complex oxides into practical, macroscale device architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种可扩展、通用的制备策略，用于在复杂氧化物中形成大面积、高结晶性的莫尔超晶格。该方法可获得洁净、化学键合的界面，并将扭转角精确控制到标称 0.1 度量级，在接近毫米尺度的连续横向区域内实现亚度级精度。以 NaNbO3 为模型体系，作者发现层间耦合会驱动显著结构重构，改变相结构和铁电畴构型，并通过同步辐射三维倒易空间映射观察到扭转双层中单相态的出现。
authors: Reza Ghanbari, Eli Rodrigues, Young-Hoon Kim, Konnor Koons, Yan Li, Kabelo Lebogang, Yiming Ding, Doug Barefoot, Yueyin Wang, Yin Liu, Hua Zhou, Miaofang Chi, Ruijuan Xu

articles.title: Nonlinear Schrodinger Equations for Dense Bose Fluid and He4 Film at Low Temperatures
articles.title_zh: 低温致密玻色流体与 He4 薄膜的非线性薛定谔方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have derived the nonlinear Schrodinger equation generalizing the Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) equa tion for dilute Bose gas. The derivation is based on the Hartree-Fock time-dependent mean-field theory with an arbitrary intermolecular interaction potential. It is shown that obtained nonlinear Schrodinger equation with appropriate redefinition of coefficients can be used for description of dense Bose fluid at low temperatures. We also present the Schrodinger type equation describing the superfluid component of helium in two fluid hydrodynamics. This approach leads to quantum correction for superfluid component of velocity in two fluid hydrodynamics. We also have derived the nonlinear Schrodinger equation for superfluid He4 film at low temperatures. It is shown that this Schrodinger type equation for superfluid He4 film leads to phonon-roton dispersion relation for elementary excitation at low temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文推导了推广稀薄玻色气体 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程的非线性薛定谔方程，推导基于含任意分子间相互作用势的 Hartree-Fock 含时平均场理论。作者指出，在适当重新定义系数后，该方程可用于描述低温致密玻色流体，并给出两流体流体力学中超流氦组分的薛定谔型方程。该方法引入了超流速度的量子修正，并进一步推导了低温超流 He4 薄膜方程，可导出声子-旋子型元激发色散关系。

articles.title: A Padding Method for Enhanced Encoding of Inorganic Structures with Varying Chemical Compositions
articles.title_zh: 用于增强不同化学组成无机结构编码的填充方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing novel inorganic materials through generative models remains an important challenge for material science, driven by the complexity and diversity of inorganic structures across expansive chemical compositions and structural landscape. The vast combinatorial space of inorganic compounds demands innovative, AI-driven approaches to overcome limitations in generative accuracy and efficiency. To address this, we introduce a novel method that redefines the encoding and generation of inorganic materials by utilizing domain-specific symmetry-aware representation. Our approach not only refines the representation of intricate inorganic structures but also contributes to the field of material discovery by enhancing the precision and stability of generated candidates. Central to our methodology is a novel padding technique that exploits crystal symmetry information to enhance the encoding process. By integrating Wyckoff position length-aware padding into an encoder architecture, we achieve a more robust informed representation of inorganic materials. This symmetry-driven enhancement improves deep learning models to generate stable, previously unexplored inorganic structures with superior accuracy and computational efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce an end-to-end system that leverages the machine learning potential models to seamlessly generate novel, even those unseen in the training data, and stable inorganic materials from initial data to validated output. This pipeline integrates advanced generative models with stability analysis, marking a significant leap forward in the automated exploration and design of next-generation inorganic materials. Our method improved reconstruction accuracy 5.3% in proton conductor data, and generated 63.5% more novel stable inorganic material to baseline model on the perov-5 dataset.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向生成式模型设计无机材料的问题，提出一种利用晶体对称性信息改进结构编码与生成的新方法。核心是引入与 Wyckoff 位置长度相关的填充技术，并将其嵌入编码器架构，以获得更稳健、信息更充分的无机材料表示。该对称性驱动的表示增强旨在提高深度学习模型生成候选无机结构的精度与稳定性，从而促进材料发现。
authors: Thang Dang, Haderbache Amir, Tzanakakis Alexandros, Yoshimoto Yuta

articles.title: Defect-engineered scaling of lead-free ferroelectrics with ultralow-voltage switching
articles.title_zh: 缺陷工程实现无铅铁电体缩放与超低电压开关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling ferroelectrics to nanometer thicknesses remains a central challenge for low-power, nonvolatile electronics, as leakage currents increasingly dominate with reduced dimensions. Alkali-based, lead-free ferroelectrics offer an environmentally sustainable alternative to lead-based systems, yet their scaling is severely limited by leakage arising from volatile alkali constituents. Here, we show that this intrinsic limitation can be transformed into an advantageous degree of freedom through defect engineering. By precisely modulating alkali deficiency during thin-film synthesis, we engineer clustered defect complexes that function as deep trap states, strongly suppressing leakage and enabling robust ferroelectric operation in ultrathin films down to the sub-10 nm regime at voltages below 100 mV. Our results establish defect-enabled scaling as a viable pathway for advancing environmentally benign ferroelectrics toward ultra-low-power, non-volatile electronic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对纳米厚度铁电体在低功耗非易失电子器件中面临的漏电问题，提出通过缺陷工程实现无铅碱金属基铁电薄膜的尺度缩小。作者通过精确调控薄膜合成中的碱金属缺位，构建成簇缺陷复合体，使其作为深能级陷阱显著抑制漏电。由此，超薄薄膜在低至亚 10 纳米厚度和低于 100 mV 电压下仍可实现稳健铁电工作，为环境友好型超低功耗非易失器件提供了路径。
authors: Reza Ghanbari, Jiayue Wang, Harikrishnan KP, Zixiao Shi, Aarushi Khandelwal, Konnor Koons, Eli Rodrigues, Tao Zhou, Martin Holt, David A. Muller, Harold Y. Hwang, Ruijuan Xu

articles.title: Saturated and Anisotropic Magnetostriction in an Altermagnet
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体中的饱和各向异性磁致伸缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetostriction, a fundamental phenomenon bridging magnetism and mechanics, has enabled a broad spectrum of applications. For almost two centuries, it has been mainly investigated for ferromagnets. Regarding the magnetostriction of antiferromagnets (AFMs), limitedly known examples for both conventional collinear AFMs and noncollinear AFMs predominantly exhibit non-saturating magnetic-field dependence. Herein, we report an easily saturated magnetostriction effect in a prototypical altermagnet - MnTe, which is an emerging class of collinear AFMs with special crystal symmetries. For high-quality MnTe single crystals, the magnetostriction saturates under a moderate field of ~0.7 T with an intriguing two-fold-symmetry anisotropy. First-principles calculations reveal that the saturated and anisotropic magnetostriction originates from symmetry-allowed coupling between elastic strain and its Néel order parameter. These findings break the traditional wisdom on antiferromagnetic magnetostriction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了原型交替磁体 MnTe 中易饱和的磁致伸缩效应，挑战了传统反铁磁磁致伸缩通常不易饱和的认识。在高质量 MnTe 单晶中，磁致伸缩在约 0.7 T 的中等磁场下即达到饱和，并表现出具有二重对称性的各向异性。第一性原理计算表明，该现象源于弹性应变与 Néel 序参量之间由对称性允许的耦合。
authors: Zhiyuan Duan, Qiyun Xu, Peixin Qin, Li Liu, Guojian Zhao, Yuzhou He, Xiaoyang Tan, Sixu Jiang, Jingyu Li, Xiaoning Wang, Qinghua Zhang, Wenhui Duan, Yong Xu, Ziang Meng, Peizhe Tang, Chengbao Jiang, Zhiqi Liu

articles.title: Using graph neural networks to predict many-body interactions in amorphous materials
articles.title_zh: 利用图神经网络预测非晶材料中的多体相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many-body interactions govern the complex behavior of many amorphous materials, from metallic glasses to biological tissues, yet are often replaced by pairwise additive frameworks for computational efficiency. Here, we use classical density functional theory (DFT) to study a model soft glass of solvent-free polymer-grafted nanoparticles (PGNs), where the absence of solvent forces grafted chains to uniformly fill the interstitial space, generating strong angular-dependent many-body interactions between the cores. We show that NequIP, an equivariant message-passing graph neural network (GNN), learns the high-dimensional, rugged potential energy landscape of the system and reproduces classical DFT energies across a range of PGN design parameters at four orders of magnitude lower cost. Systematic analysis of GNN hyperparameters offers physical insights into the range, anisotropy, and effective body order of interactions. GNN-driven Monte Carlo simulations reveal locally favored icosahedral-like structures at equilibrium, and strikingly, recover equilibrium structures in agreement with experiments, despite the network being trained only on high-energy, out-of-equilibrium configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用经典密度泛函理论研究无溶剂聚合物接枝纳米粒子软玻璃模型，其中接枝链填充粒子间空间并产生强烈角度依赖的多体相互作用。作者采用等变消息传递图神经网络 NequIP 学习高维复杂势能面，并在多种设计参数下以低约四个数量级的计算成本复现经典 DFT 能量。进一步的超参数分析揭示了相互作用的作用范围、各向异性和有效多体阶数，GNN 驱动的蒙特卡洛模拟还显示出平衡态局域二十面体样结构，并与实验结构趋势相符。
authors: Mehryar Jannesari Ghomsheh, Donald L. Koch, Sarah Hormozi

articles.title: Spin Hall effect in two-dimensional materials with inverted bands and Mexican-hat dispersion
articles.title_zh: 具有反转能带和墨西哥帽色散二维材料中的自旋霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30881v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the spin Hall effect in two-dimensional topological insulators with "Mexican hat" dispersion and a ring-shaped Fermi surface which are formed due to the band inversion. Electron transitions between different isoenergetic contours and the quantum metric of band states play an important role in the transport properties of such materials, since they largely determine the spatial distribution of the electron charges screening the impurity potential and the scattering probability [Phys.B, 719, 417942 (2025)]. Here we study a spin-dependent skew scattering, which is enabled by the second-order scattering processes, and show that the extrinsic spin-Hall current (SHC) can significantly exceed the intrinsic SHC arising from the Berry curvature. Furthermore, due to Mexican-hat dispersion, the SHC exhibits a very unusual dependence on the Fermi energy (E_F). The extrinsic SHC reaches a maximum at some E_F, then decreases with increasing E_F and can even change a sign. This complicated behavior reflects an interplay of energy dependencies of such important factors as probabilities of inter- and intra-contour transitions, as well as different electron velocities in two contours.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察具有能带反转、墨西哥帽色散和环形费米面的二维拓扑绝缘体中的自旋霍尔效应。作者指出，不同等能轮廓之间的电子跃迁及能带量子度量会显著影响杂质势屏蔽和散射概率，从而影响输运性质。研究显示，由二阶散射过程导致的自旋依赖斜散射可使外禀自旋霍尔电流远大于 Berry 曲率引起的本征贡献，并使其随费米能呈现非单调变化甚至变号。
authors: Bagun S. Shchamkhalova, Vladimir A. Sablikov

articles.title: Pure Spin Photocurrent in Altermagnetic Photovoltaic Battery
articles.title_zh: 交替磁光伏电池中的纯自旋光电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets, featuring momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, provide a promising platform for spintronic functionalities beyond conventional ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Here, we propose an altermagnetic spin photovoltaic battery consisting of a nonmagnetic semiconducting layer sandwiched between two altermagnetic electrodes. Using first-principles quantum-transport simulations, we show that a V2Te2O/ZnSe/V2Te2O junction supports a pure spin photocurrent for opposite Néel vectors in the two altermagnetic electrodes, with spin-up and spin-down photocurrents equal in magnitude and opposite in sign. The effect persists under both linearly and circularly polarized light and remains tunable with photon energy and polarization angle. Our results establish a realistic route toward light-driven pure spin-current generation in altermagnetic junctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种交替磁自旋光伏电池结构，由非磁半导体层夹在两个交替磁电极之间构成。基于第一性原理量子输运模拟，作者发现 V2Te2O/ZnSe/V2Te2O 结在两侧交替磁电极 Néel 矢量相反时可产生纯自旋光电流，即自旋向上与自旋向下光电流大小相等、方向相反。该效应在直线偏振和圆偏振光下均可存在，并可通过光子能量和偏振角调控，为交替磁结中的光驱动纯自旋流产生提供了可行方案。
authors: Qiang Li, Shibo Fang, Zongmeng Yang, Xingyue Yang, Jianhua Wang, Rui Peng, Lin Zhu, Shuhua Wang, Dexing Liu, Min Zhang, Dahua Ren, Mai Zhang, Han Zhang, Yee Sin Ang

articles.title: Spin-Spiral Enhancement of Ultrafast Light-Polarization-Robust Magnetization
articles.title_zh: 自旋螺旋增强的超快光偏振鲁棒磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast light-driven magnetization, a frontier in quantum magneto-optics, has traditionally relied on circularly polarized lasers to provide external angular momentum. While increasing efforts have aimed to achieve light-polarization-robust (LPR) magnetization that is insensitive to the form of external light excitation, the underlying mechanism remains largely unclear. Here, we establish the symmetry-constrained rule for LPR magnetization in antiferromagnetic systems. Through real-time time-dependent density functional theory calculations, we observe the strong LPR magnetization in spin-spiral magnets and its suppression in collinear antiferromagnets, confirming our theory. Strikingly, laser excitation induces real-space demagnetization, rotation, and oscillation of atomic spins in spin-spiral monolayer NiI₂, whereas rotation is largely suppressed in conventional collinear antiferromagnets. Our work reveals a novel microscopic pathway for ultrafast magnetization that is independent of light polarization, paving the way for advanced femtosecond spin control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注不依赖入射光偏振形式的超快光驱动磁化，并提出反铁磁体系中光偏振鲁棒磁化的对称性约束规则。通过实时含时密度泛函理论计算，作者发现自旋螺旋磁体中可产生强烈的偏振鲁棒磁化，而共线反铁磁体中该效应受到抑制。以单层 NiI2 为例，激光激发会诱导原子自旋的实空间退磁、旋转和振荡，揭示了一种独立于光偏振的飞秒自旋调控微观机制。
authors: Yirui Lu, Zeyu Jiang, Bing Huang

articles.title: Functional methods for quantum thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子热力学的泛函方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The functional renormalization group provides a nonperturbative and systematically improvable route to constructing density functionals for quantum many-body systems from microscopic Hamiltonians. Here we advance this program by benchmarking functional-renormalization-group density functional theory (FRG-DFT) against the exact thermodynamics of the single-site Bose-Hubbard model. This model provides an ideal testing ground because it is analytically solvable, yet remains subtle in the imaginary-time coherent-state path integral, where a naive continuum treatment generates a spurious self-interaction. We show that a careful Hubbard-Stratonovich derivation identifies the self-interaction correction term that must be included in the FRG-DFT flow to recover the exact thermodynamics. We then systematically compare several closures of the resulting hierarchy of flow equations for the free energy, chemical potential, and connected density correlators over broad ranges of density, temperature, and interaction strength. The benchmark shows that the free energy is comparatively robust, whereas the chemical potential and fluctuation observables provide much sharper diagnostics of the hierarchy closure. A maximum-entropy closure gives the most accurate overall description and reproduces even the low-temperature oscillatory structure of the connected two-density correlator. These results identify two general requirements for functional approaches to quantum thermodynamics: the renormalization group flow equation must retain the equal-time contact subtraction to avoid spurious self-interactions, and any closure of the hierarchy must preserve the statistical consistency of density correlators. This work provides a controlled foundation for deriving ab initio density functionals for quantum many-body systems across condensed-matter, ultracold-atom, and nuclear physics, as well as quantum chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以单点 Bose-Hubbard 模型的精确热力学为基准，检验基于泛函重整化群的密度泛函理论（FRG-DFT）在量子多体体系中的表现。作者指出，在虚时相干态路径积分中朴素连续处理会产生虚假的自相互作用，而谨慎的 Hubbard-Stratonovich 推导可识别出必须纳入流方程的自相互作用修正项。随后，研究比较了自由能、化学势和连通密度关联函数流方程层级的多种闭合方案，发现自由能相对稳健，而化学势和涨落观测量对近似更为敏感。
authors: Sibo Wang, Samuel Degen, Haozhao Liang

articles.title: Complex Magnetic Behavior of the Ce sawtooth chains in CeRhSn₂
articles.title_zh: CeRhSn₂ 中 Ce 锯齿链的复杂磁行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31118v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conflicting reports exist on the ground state of the intermetallic compound CeRhSn₂. This can be rooted in the sawtooth-like arrangement of two inequivalent Ce sites in the unit cell, which suggests potential geometric magnetic frustration. To resolve, we conducted a comprehensive study on high-quality single crystals of CeRhSn₂ by means of magnetization (M), specific heat (Cₚ/T), and resistivity (h̊o). The system exhibits strong magnetic anisotropy, confirming the b-axis as the easy magnetic axis. We establish three successive transitions, an AFM order at TN = 3.65K, a first-order FM order at TC = 1.7K and final transition, at T = 1.5K. The transition temperatures are highly field-directional dependent: in a magnetic field, the lowest transition is immediately suppressed while H parallel b rapidly merges TC and TN into a single second-order transition. Conversely, Hparallel c suppresses the FM order and reduces TN. Additional ab initio calculations affirm the FM ground state of CeRhSn₂. The observation of an enhancement of the Sommerfeld coefficient (γ = 76.5mJ/molḑotK²⁾ may arise from geometric frustration, but it is most consistently attributed to weak Kondo hybridization as frustration cannot be conclusively established through our data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对金属间化合物 CeRhSn₂ 基态存在的争议，利用高质量单晶开展磁化率、比热和电阻率的系统研究。结果显示该体系具有强磁各向异性，b 轴为易磁化轴，并出现三个连续低温转变：3.65 K 的反铁磁有序、1.7 K 的一级铁磁有序以及约 1.5 K 的进一步转变。外加磁场对这些转变具有显著方向依赖性，第一性原理计算也支持铁磁基态；增强的 Sommerfeld 系数可能与几何阻挫相关，但更可能反映复杂磁相互作用。
authors: P. Opletal, J. Fikáček, E. Duverger-Nédellec, A. Thamizhavel, Z. Hossain, R. Tarasenko, V. Tkáč, D. Legut, Bin Shen, P. Gegenwart, J. Custers

articles.title: Interplay of Cl Substitution and He⁺ Irradiation in CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ
articles.title_zh: CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ 中 Cl 取代与 He⁺ 辐照的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31134v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional magnetic semiconductors provide a promising platform for exploring the interplay between disorder, lattice dynamics, and resonant light--matter interactions. Among them, CrSBr exhibits strong in-plane anisotropy and pronounced resonance-enhanced Raman scattering. Here, we investigate the effects of Cl substitution and He⁺ irradiation on the vibrational response of CrSBr using polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy. Cl substitution activates additional phonon modes associated with local symmetry breaking, while He⁺ irradiation introduces distinct defect-related scattering channels and enhanced phonon broadening. The combined effects of alloy disorder and externally introduced defects lead to strong anisotropic reconstruction of the Raman spectra and modification of the nonlinear Raman response under near-resonant 1.96 eV excitation. Power-dependent measurements reveal robust superlinear scaling of both intrinsic and substitution-induced phonon modes, indicating persistent resonance-enhanced electron--phonon coupling even in defect-engineered samples.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用偏振分辨拉曼光谱考察二维磁性半导体 CrSBr 中 Cl 取代和 He⁺ 辐照对振动态响应的影响。Cl 取代激活了与局域对称性破缺相关的额外声子模，而 He⁺ 辐照引入了缺陷相关散射通道并增强声子展宽。合金无序与外部缺陷共同导致拉曼谱的强各向异性重构，并在近共振 1.96 eV 激发下改变非线性拉曼响应；功率依赖测量表明，即使在缺陷工程样品中，增强的电子-声子耦合仍然保持。
authors: Satyam Sahu, Adeel Bukhari, Arijit Kayal, Valerie Černá, Bing Wu, Aljoscha Söll, Gregor Hlawacek, Zdeněk Sofer, Martin Kalbáč, Matěj Velický, Otakar Frank

articles.title: A Self-Evolving Machine-Learning-Based Kinetic Monte Carlo Method for Modelling Thin-Film Growth
articles.title_zh: 一种用于薄膜生长建模的自演化机器学习动力学蒙特卡罗方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31144v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) simulation framework parameterized by automatically sampling machine-learning (ML) for modeling thin-film growth atom by atom. Given an interatomic potential energy function, the KMC algorithm builds an ML-based regression model for rate parameters on runtime, being trained on the local atomic environments encountered during the system evolution. New environments are continuously added to the training set in a self-evolving manner at points where the ML model estimates high uncertainty. As the simulation progresses, the ML model gains confidence, and the quick estimation of rates increasingly overtakes the relatively-expensive nudged elastic band calculations, promoting computational efficiency while retaining high fidelity description of the atomic diffusion kinetics. As a test case, we simulate the sub-monolayer growth of Ag on Ag 111, where we demonstrate adatom islands forming in shapes and densities in accordance with the underlying atomistic interaction model, the theoretical framework, and available experimental results related to thin-film nucleation and growth.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出了一种用于逐原子模拟薄膜生长的动力学蒙特卡罗框架，其速率参数由运行时自动采样训练的机器学习回归模型给出。该方法根据体系演化中遇到的局域原子环境自适应扩充训练集，并在模型不确定性较高处调用较昂贵的爬山弹性带计算，从而在保持原子扩散动力学精度的同时提升效率。以 Ag 在 Ag(111) 上的亚单层生长为测试案例，模拟得到的吸附原子岛形貌和密度与原子相互作用模型、理论预期及相关实验结果相符。
authors: Jyri Kimari, Flyura Djurabekova, Kostas Sarakinos

articles.title: The geometry of the CISS effect
articles.title_zh: CISS 效应的几何学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using scanning tunneling microscopy, and a careful selection of chiral molecules and anchoring groups, we systematically carried out a series of magnetoresistance experiments. We observed a reversal of the signal upon changing the magnetization direction, the molecular chirality, and the molecular orientation. The orientation of the molecules and the magnetization of the substrate are vectors, and by associating an axial vector with the molecule, the observations can be explained. Other recent experiments, among them null experiments showing no CISS related magnetoresistance can be explained using our framework. The physical interpretation is, that the polar electrical polarization of the molecule cannot play a direct role, while the axial magnetic polarization vector operator is a much more realistic candidate. This vector plays an important role in the creation of a magnetic moment in the interface between molecule and metallic lead.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过扫描隧道显微术，并精心选择手性分子及锚定基团，系统开展了磁阻实验。实验观察到磁阻信号会随磁化方向、分子手性和分子取向的改变而反转。作者提出将分子取向和基底磁化视为矢量，并为分子引入轴矢量，从而解释相关实验及部分未观测到 CISS 磁阻的结果；物理上，分子的极性电极化不太可能直接起作用，而界面处的轴向磁极化矢量算符更可能参与磁矩形成。
authors: P. Hedegård, A. Kazimir, C. Lamers, L. T. Baczewski, T. N. H. Nguyen, C. Tegenkamp

articles.title: A charge qubit on solid neon in a spin-qubit compatible circuit QED platform
articles.title_zh: 固态氖上的电荷量子比特：兼容自旋量子比特的电路 QED 平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrons floating in vacuum provide a clean platform for quantum information processing due to their isolation from material defects; electrons on solid neon have emerged as a promising qubit platform for its long coherence times. Here, toward spin-qubit realization, we couple a single electron on solid neon to a magnetic-field-compatible superconducting NbTiN nanowire resonator. We realize a charge qubit and demonstrate microwave readout and coherent control, with Rabi frequencies up to 76 MHz, an order of magnitude larger than in previous studies. Under strong driving, we observe a qubit frequency shift from nonlinear interactions with the intense microwave field. Deterministic electron trapping at an intended position remains challenging due to solid neon surface roughness; we characterize the electron's position from its differential coupling to distinct electrodes. Although not trapped at an intended position, our estimates indicate that spin-qubit demonstrations remain feasible.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向固态氖上电子自旋量子比特的实现，将单个漂浮电子耦合到可在磁场中工作的 NbTiN 超导纳米线谐振器。研究实现了电荷量子比特，并展示了微波读出和相干控制，Rabi 频率最高达 76 MHz，较此前研究提高约一个数量级。在强驱动下，作者观察到由强微波场非线性相互作用引起的量子比特频率位移；尽管固态氖表面粗糙使确定性俘获仍具挑战，位置表征与估算表明自旋量子比特演示仍可行。
authors: J. Wang, Y. Tian, I. Grytsenko, A. Jennings, X. Zhou, H. Terai, D. Jin, E. Kawakami

articles.title: Topological Interstitial-Electron Conductor
articles.title_zh: 拓扑间隙电子导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron transport in solids arises primarily from two mechanisms: freely moving bulk electrons in metals, and gapless boundary states in topological insulators. Here, we report a new mechanism discovered in electrides. The topological interstitial-electron conductors (TIECs) proposed here are insulating electrides, but host interstitial electrons (IEs) distributed within crystal voids that traverse the entire unit cell. Without being tightly bound to real ions, the IEs generally experience low periodic potential barrier along the void channels. As a consequence, by applying a weak electric field sufficient to overcome the IE barriers but far below the system's dielectric breakdown threshold, one can expect that the TIECs would generate a persistent current contributed by the IEs and propagating along the void channels. We identify a family of realistic altermagnetic electrides, A₅X₃ (A = Ca, Sr, Ba, Yb; X = As, Sb), as TIECs. Remarkably, for A₅X₃ materials, the periodic potential barrier of the IEs along the void channels are ultralow, ranging from 13.43 to 67.96 meV per formula unit. This renders our proposal readily accessible to experimental verification. We further demonstrate that when the IEs of A₅X₃ undergo periodic motion along the channels, topological surface states will emerge at the boundary perpendicular to the channel direction, and continuously move across the bulk band gap. This pumping-like behaviour not only corroborates the topological nature of TIECs, but also rationalizes the finite-electric-field induced electronic transport within the band theory. Our findings expand the classification of electronic conductors, uncover unexplored transport properties of electrides, and establish a new material platform for low-power electronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种新的固体输运机制，即拓扑间隙电子导体（TIEC），其出现在具有贯穿晶胞空腔通道的绝缘电子化合物中。尽管整体为绝缘体，分布在晶体空隙中的间隙电子不被实离子强束缚，可在低周期势垒通道中受弱电场驱动形成持续电流。作者识别出一族实际的交替磁电子化合物 A₅X₃（A = Ca、Sr、Ba、Yb；X = As、Sb）作为候选体系，其间隙电子沿空腔通道的势垒很低，表明该概念具备实验可及性。
authors: Tingli He, Xiaoming Zhang, Chaoxi Cui, Yilin Han, Yang Wang, Wei Jiang, Zhi-Ming Yu, Yugui Yao

articles.title: Surface lone-pair polarization probed by quantum-geometric transport in tellurium
articles.title_zh: 用碲中的量子几何输运探测表面孤对电子极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stereochemically active lone pairs are ubiquitous microscopic sources of polarity in molecules and solids, but their collective behavior in crystals is often hidden by symmetry or confined to surfaces. Here we show that quantum-geometry transport provides a sensitive probe of surface lone-pair polarization in trigonal tellurium. This surface polarization appears microscopically as an inversion-odd dipolar component of the crystal potential, which shifts the center of mass of Bloch wavepackets and produces quantum-geometric corrections to their velocity. We describe this lone-pair polar texture through a minimal three-component lattice model, and we show that the resulting linear and nonlinear transport coefficients probe, respectively, the second and first moments of the net polarization field. Because rectified voltages in tellurium flakes are directly proportional to the surface lone-pair polarization, our results provide a microscopic route to understanding and engineering polarization-driven, quantum-geometric electronic devices based on tellurium allotropes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作表明，量子几何输运可作为探测三方碲中表面孤对电子极化的灵敏手段。表面极化在微观上表现为晶体势中的反演奇性偶极分量，可移动 Bloch 波包质心并产生速度的量子几何修正。作者用最小三分量晶格模型描述这种孤对电子极性纹理，并指出线性与非线性输运系数分别探测净极化场的二阶和一阶矩；碲薄片中的整流电压与表面孤对极化直接相关，为设计基于碲同素异形体的极化驱动量子几何器件提供了路径。
authors: Nathanael N. Batista, Wendel S. Paz, Manuel Suárez-Rodríguez, Pierpaolo Fontana, Victor Velasco, Marcus V. O. Moutinho, Chang Niu, Peide D. Ye, Marco Gobbi, Fèlix Casanova, Luis E. Hueso, Caio Lewenkopf, Marcello B. Silva Neto

articles.title: Magnetic domains reconfiguration on the Fe3O4(110) surface across the Verwey transition by Spin-Polarized Low-Energy Electron Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 利用自旋极化低能电子显微术研究 Verwey 转变前后 Fe₃O₄(110) 表面的磁畴重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31252v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have studied the (110) surface of Fe₃O₄ single crystals by means of spin-polarized low-energy electron microscopy (SPLEEM). After preparation by sputtering and annealing a well defined reconstructed surface was achieved, composed of rows aligned in the [010] direction. By acquiring SPLEEM images along different spin directions the vector magnetization was mapped on the surface, both at room temperature and at a temperature well below the Verwey transition. At room temperature, domains were observed with their magnetization aligned along the two <111> bulk easy axes which are in the (110) surface plane. They presented 180ⁱ̧rc, 71ⁱ̧rc and 109ⁱ̧rc Néel-type domain walls. Below the Verwey transition, the magnetization directions changed to regions where the magnetization was oriented along the in-plane [100] and [001] directions. Those observations can be interpreted as the presence of magnetized regions on the surface where the monoclinic c axis is in-plane in the former, and regions where the c is out-of-plane in an oblique direction in the latter. However, the magnetization was at all times within the surface plane, with no out-of-plane component detected.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用自旋极化低能电子显微术研究 Fe₃O₄ 单晶 (110) 表面在 Verwey 转变前后的磁畴结构。经溅射和退火制备后，表面形成沿 [010] 方向排列的重构条纹；室温下，磁畴磁化沿位于 (110) 表面平面内的两个 <111> 体易轴排列，并出现 180°、71° 和 109° Néel 型畴壁。低于 Verwey 转变后，磁化方向转变为面内 [100] 和 [001] 方向区域，可解释为单斜 c 轴取向不同的表面磁化区域，但磁化始终保持在表面平面内。
authors: C. Gutiérrez-Cuesta, A. Mandziak, J. E. Prieto, P. Nita, A. Mascaraque, U. Choudhry, J. Turner, A. Stibor, J. de la Figuera

articles.title: Valley-polarized Orbital and Spin Magnetism Induced by Femtosecond Optical Pulses in Two-Dimensional Semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 飞秒光脉冲在二维半导体中诱导的谷极化轨道与自旋磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate the ultrafast generation of spin and orbital magnetism in a two-dimensional gapped Dirac system with spin-orbit coupling. This system is representative of two-dimensional hexagonal semiconductors, such as transition-metal dichalcogenides that exhibit valley-selective optical selection rules arising from the valley-contrasting magnetic texture of their band structure. Using a time-dependent density-matrix formalism, we demonstrate that circularly polarized laser pulses generate nonequilibrium magnetization under both resonant and multiphoton resonant conditions. We show that the induced spin and orbital magnetic moments can be distinctly controlled via the photon energy and polarization of the driving field. Furthermore, spin and orbital dynamics originate from fundamentally different light-matter coupling mechanisms, leading to qualitatively dissimilar temporal behaviors. The orbital magnetic moment couples directly to the external electric field, resulting in faster dynamics and pronounced Rabi-like oscillations, whereas the spin response develops gradually through spin-orbit coupling. Consequently, orbital dynamics is significantly more sensitive to electron-hole dephasing than the spin response. Our results highlight the importance of properly accounting for orbital contributions in future technologies that utilize femtosecond control of magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者从理论上研究了具有自旋-轨道耦合的二维有能隙 Dirac 体系中，飞秒光脉冲诱导自旋和轨道磁性的超快过程，该体系可代表过渡金属二硫族化物等二维六角半导体。基于含时密度矩阵形式，研究显示圆偏振激光在共振和多光子共振条件下均可产生非平衡磁化。诱导的自旋与轨道磁矩可通过光子能量和驱动场偏振分别调控，且二者源于不同光-物质耦合机制：轨道磁矩直接耦合外电场，响应更快并呈现明显 Rabi 型振荡，而自旋响应则通过自旋-轨道耦合逐渐建立。
authors: M. S. Mrudul, Peter M. Oppeneer

articles.title: Limits of the Non-Linear Generalized Langevin Equation: Cross-Correlations, Irreversibility and Desynchronization
articles.title_zh: 非线性广义朗之万方程的局限：交叉关联、不可逆性与失同步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31297v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The generalized Langevin equation (GLE) is widely used to model complex soft-matter systems, including biomolecular dynamics, by incorporating memory effects and colored noise into coarse-grained descriptions. However, recent results suggest that combining memory with non-linear forces, ubiquitous in soft matter, introduces fundamental analytical inconsistencies. Here, using a simplified model, we investigate the practical numerical consequences of these analytical results. We show that non-linear forces generate cross-correlations with the noise, modifying the fluctuation-dissipation theorem and rendering the noise position-dependent and irreversible. This implies that the commonly assumed reversible Gaussian noise in GLE simulations fails to capture essential features of the microscopic fluctuations. For weak non-linearities, these issues can be partially resolved either by using an iterative optimization of memory or by using microscopically consistent noise, which unexpectedly synchronizes GLE trajectories with the underlying microscopic dynamics. For stronger non-linearities like high barriers or shoulders in the external potential, however, iterative reconstruction fails and we observe desynchronization, indicating that the non-linear GLE no longer correctly reproduces the microscopic dynamics. Our results show in which situations non-linear GLEs can be accurately applied and when they fail, thus providing practical guidance for their application to coarse-grain soft-matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论广义朗之万方程在含记忆效应和非线性力的软物质粗粒化建模中的局限。通过简化模型，作者表明非线性力会与噪声产生交叉关联，从而修改涨落-耗散定理，并使噪声具有位置依赖性和不可逆性。对于弱非线性，可通过迭代优化记忆核或使用与微观动力学一致的噪声部分缓解问题，并意外地使 GLE 轨迹与微观动力学同步；而在强非线性势垒或肩峰等情形下，常规可逆高斯噪声近似会明显失效。

articles.title: Odd-Parity Magnons
articles.title_zh: 奇宇称磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnons, as charge-neutral spin excitations, can transport spin information without Joule heating and therefore offer a promising platform for low-power spintronics. However, in collinear magnets, the effective time-reversal symmetry forbids odd-parity magnon band splitting. Here we propose odd-parity magnons and establish a general mechanism for realizing them in collinear antiferromagnets. We provide a complete spin-point-group classification of odd-parity magnon splitting in two-dimensional collinear antiferromagnets by identifying the leading splitting types and their symmetry-allowed basis functions. This classification serves as a practical guide for searching for odd-parity magnons. We show that breaking effective time-reversal symmetry, for example by circularly polarized light or loop currents, can induce highly tunable p- and f-wave magnon splitting. In bilayer systems, the dynamical modulation can drive a topological magnon phase transition, accompanied by chiral edge modes and an abrupt jump in the magnon thermal Hall conductivity. Material-specific first-principles calculations further demonstrate the feasibility of this mechanism in real van der Waals antiferromagnets. Our study identifies the odd-parity magnons as a new class of spin excitations and provides a theoretical foundation for odd-parity magnons and ultrafast optically controlled topological magnonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出奇宇称磁振子的概念，并建立了在共线反铁磁体中实现它们的一般机制。作者给出二维共线反铁磁体中奇宇称磁振子能带劈裂的完整自旋点群分类，识别主要劈裂类型及其对称允许的基函数，为材料搜索提供指南。研究表明，圆偏振光或环电流等破缺有效时间反演对称性的方式可诱导高度可调的 p 波和 f 波磁振子劈裂；在双层体系中，动态调制还可驱动拓扑磁振子相变，伴随手性边缘模和磁振子热霍尔电导突变，并通过第一性原理计算展示其可行性。
authors: Pu Zhang, Sun-Bo Xie, Junxi Yu, Yichen Liu, Cheng-Cheng Liu

articles.title: Strain-Engineered s-C₃N₆ Monolayer for Efficient Water Splitting: A first-principles study
articles.title_zh: 应变工程调控的 s-C₃N₆ 单层用于高效水分解：第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31447v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting offers a sustainable route for solar-to-hydrogen energy conversion, yet identifying stable, metal-free semiconductors with suitable electronic, optical, and band-alignment properties remains challenging. Here, we investigate the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, and photocatalytic properties of the two-dimensional s-C₃N₆ monolayer using first-principles calculations. Ab initio molecular dynamics and elastic constant analysis confirm its thermal and mechanical stability. Hybrid HSE06 calculations reveal pristine s-C₃N₆ is a direct-band-gap semiconductor (2.62 eV). However, its conduction-band minimum lies below the hydrogen reduction potential, preventing spontaneous hydrogen evolution. To overcome this limitation, we employ biaxial and uniaxial strains (-10% to +10%) to modulate its electronic structure. We find that compressive biaxial strains of -8% and -10% uniquely tune the band edges to straddle the redox potentials, enabling spontaneous overall water splitting. Crucially, these photocatalytically active states remain mechanically and thermally stable. Optical properties calculations show the fundamental gap in both pristine and strained structures is optically dark, with the primary absorption peak in the UV region. Furthermore, a strain-induced mobility mismatch between electrons and holes facilitates efficient charge separation. However, thermodynamic modeling of surface kinetics reveals that the s-C₃N₆ surface binds intermediates strongly, necessitating a co-catalyst to overcome kinetic barriers. Our results establish strain engineering as an effective strategy to tailor band-edge alignment, carrier dynamics, and optical transitions in s-C₃N₆, highlighting its potential for stable 2D photocatalytic water splitting.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用第一性原理计算系统考察二维 s-C₃N₆ 单层的结构、力学、电子、光学与光催化性质。结果表明，原始 s-C₃N₆ 为热力学和力学稳定的直接带隙半导体，但其导带底位置不利于自发析氢。作者通过施加双轴和单轴应变调控能带，发现 -8% 和 -10% 的压缩双轴应变可使带边跨越水氧化还原电位，从而具备自发整体水分解潜力，且相关结构仍保持稳定。

articles.title: Solving models with generalized free fermions II: Path-product expansion and conserved charges
articles.title_zh: 求解广义自由费米子模型 II：路径乘积展开与守恒荷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Free-fermion solvability in quantum spin systems is increasingly understood to be governed by a graph Clifford algebra defined from the frustration graph of the Hamiltonian. When the frustration graph belongs to certain classes, such as the even-hole-free and claw-free (ECF) class, the Hamiltonian is solvable by hidden free fermions: it admits a free-fermion solution although it does not reduce to a Majorana bilinear under the Jordan-Wigner transformation. However, unlike in the Jordan-Wigner case, where each mode is a linear combination of single Majorana fermions, the explicit operator structure of the hidden free-fermion modes -- and that of the local conserved charges -- has remained obscure. In this work, we derive a path-product expansion that expresses each free-fermion mode as a linear combination of path products along induced paths in the extended frustration graph. The expansion is obtained from the generating function of the Krylov basis and yields the modes directly, without using the transfer matrix or the nonlocal conserved charges as input. As an application, the mode decomposition computes infinite-temperature dynamical correlation functions for arbitrary ECF frustration graphs. We further obtain explicit expressions for local conserved charges as linear combinations of path products along induced paths; these charges apply beyond the free-fermion (ECF) class to more general claw-free frustration graphs. We also identify a unified family of generalized conserved charges that contains both the previously known nonlocal conserved charges and these local conserved charges as special cases. For Fendley's original FFD chain with homogeneous couplings and periodic boundary conditions, in a suitable basis, the structure of these local conserved charges exhibits the same Catalan-tree pattern as in the spin-1/2 XXX chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究量子自旋系统中由挫折图 Clifford 代数控制的隐藏自由费米子可解性，特别关注偶洞自由且爪自由图类中的模型。作者推导出一种路径乘积展开，将自由费米子模表示为扩展挫折图中诱导路径乘积的线性组合，从而揭示隐藏自由费米子模及局域守恒荷的算符结构。该方法可直接由 Krylov 基生成函数得到模式，并可用于计算无限温动力学相关量等物理量。
authors: Kohei Fukai, Balázs Pozsgay, István Vona

articles.title: Ab Initio Spinor Kadanoff-Baym Approach to Nonequilibrium Electron, Phonon and Magnon Dynamics in Itinerant Ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 巡游铁磁体中非平衡电子、声子与磁振子动力学的从头算旋量 Kadanoff-Baym 方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work introduces a theoretical framework based on the Kadanoff-Baym equations in spinor space to study ultrafast magnetization dynamics in itinerant ferromagnetic systems from first principles. By incorporating spin-orbit coupling into the ab initio Hamiltonian and generalizing the self-energies to include terms beyond the charge sector, I derive scattering integrals within the Markov approximation and quasiparticle renormalizations for electrons and phonons in the presence of spin-dependent effective interactions within a many-body perturbation theory approach. I explicitly discuss how magnons emerge in this framework, and derive, through suitable approximations, a close and tractable set of equations for coupled electron,phonon and magnon dynamics that can be solved from first principles. This approach allows to treat coherent and incoherent magnetic dynamics on an equal footing, paving the way for a first principles understanding of ultrafast magnetic dynamics and demagnetization, and opening to a truly predictive theory of femtomagnetism in periodic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于旋量空间 Kadanoff-Baym 方程的第一性原理理论框架，用于研究巡游铁磁体系中的超快磁化动力学。该方法在从头算哈密顿量中纳入自旋轨道耦合，并将自能推广到包含电荷以外的自旋相关相互作用，从而推导电子和声子的散射积分及准粒子重整化。作者还讨论了磁振子如何在该框架中出现，并给出可处理电子、声子与磁振子耦合动力学的封闭方程组，为飞秒磁学的预测性理论奠定基础。

articles.title: General-purpose LLMs as Constrained Crystal Composition Generators
articles.title_zh: 通用大语言模型作为受约束晶体组成生成器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The targeted discovery of inorganic materials remains challenging due to the vastness of compositional design spaces and the high cost of exhaustive screening. Task-specific generative artificial intelligence represents a particularly efficient alternative to screening, yet demands tedious collection of training data before providing real benefit. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) have recently shown tremendous potential for the targeted generation of single, optimal materials compositions without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. However, it is unclear whether LLMs generally pose an advantage compared to specialized generative models, in particular in large design spaces. Here, we demonstrate that such models are capable of covering entire regions of the targeted property space effectively and systematically. Using Elpasolite materials as an established benchmark for generative tasks in large chemical spaces, we find that an iterative prompt-and-response framework is able to recover on average 96% of all low-energy Elpasolites in the target region. This performance, driven mainly by iterative in-context learning, surpasses the generative abilities of previous, task-specific models. Our results establish general-purpose LLMs as flexible and accessible components for inverse materials design workflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨通用大语言模型在无任务特定微调条件下生成目标无机晶体组成的能力，以缓解大规模材料组成空间筛选成本高的问题。作者以 Elpasolite 材料作为大化学空间生成任务的基准，构建迭代式提示—响应框架，发现模型能够系统覆盖目标性质区域，并平均找回大部分低能候选组成。结果表明，迭代上下文学习是性能提升的主要来源，通用 LLM 在受约束材料生成中具有潜力。
authors: Hedda Oschinski, Maximilian L. Ach, Konstantin S. Jakob, Christian Carbogno, Karsten Reuter

articles.title: Kohn-Luttinger Superconductivity of Weyl Fermi Arcs in PtBi₂
articles.title_zh: PtBi₂ 中 Weyl 费米弧的 Kohn-Luttinger 超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experimental observations in the noncentrosymmetric Weyl semimetal PtBi₂ indicate unconventional superconductivity hosted by topological surface states -- Weyl Fermi arcs -- with a node at the center of each arc. Focusing on these Fermi arcs, we calculate the electronically mediated pairing interaction using a Kohn-Luttinger approach and find that, in a large region of the phase diagram, the leading superconducting instability has an i-wave symmetry featuring precisely such an intra-arc node. We study the dependence of the leading superconducting instabilities on electronic interaction parameters and chemical potential and show that the i-wave state is robust to changes in the model parameters. Our results provide a possible mechanism for the observation of topological i-wave superconductivity on the surface of PtBi₂ and may have implications for the broader landscape of superconducting instabilities arising from repulsive interactions on the surfaces of Weyl semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对非中心对称 Weyl 半金属 PtBi₂ 表面拓扑态——Weyl 费米弧——上可能出现的非常规超导性展开理论分析。作者采用 Kohn-Luttinger 方法计算由电子相互作用介导的配对相互作用，发现相图中较大区域的主导超导不稳定性呈 i 波对称性，并在每条费米弧中心具有节点。该 i 波态对相互作用参数和化学势变化较为稳健，为 PtBi₂ 表面拓扑 i 波超导的实验观测提供了可能机制。
authors: Reuel Dsouza, Nikolaos Parthenios, Brian M. Andersen, Morten H. Christensen

articles.title: Multiplet-Selective Photoelectron Diffraction from an Altermagnet
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体中的多重态选择性光电子衍射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct real-space probes of altermagnetic order remain scarce. Here we introduce multiplet-selective photoelectron diffraction (PED), a methodology in which different regions of a transition-metal core-level multiplet act as distinct photoemission source waves. Using multiple-scattering calculations for the metallic altermagnet candidate CrSb, we show that selected Cr 3p multiplet features with predominantly Y₁⁺¹ and Y₁⁻¹ character generate robust diffraction asymmetries sensitive to altermagnetic domains. We demonstrate that both circularly and linearly polarized light provide access to the effect, while suitable combinations of domains, light polarizations, and multiplet-energy windows suppress nonmagnetic diffraction backgrounds. The proposed approach can be implemented using standard momentum-resolved photoemission instrumentation and establishes core-level PED as a practical route toward domain-resolved studies of altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出多重态选择性光电子衍射方法，用于直接探测交替磁有序。作者以金属交替磁候选材料 CrSb 为例，通过多重散射计算表明，特定 Cr 3p 核能级多重态特征可作为不同光发射源波，并产生对交替磁畴敏感的稳健衍射不对称性。研究显示圆偏振和线偏振光均可访问该效应，并可通过选择磁畴、偏振和能量窗口来抑制非磁性背景，为畴分辨交替磁研究提供可行实验路径。

articles.title: Discovering Thermodynamically Admissible Dissipation Potentials via Grammar-Based Symbolic Regression
articles.title_zh: 通过基于语法的符号回归发现热力学可容许的耗散势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constitutive laws for inelastic materials must satisfy strict thermodynamic admissibility requirements, yet current data-driven approaches sacrifice interpretability, even when formal guarantees are provided by physics-encoded architectures. We propose a symbolic regression framework for the data-driven discovery of dissipation potentials governing the evolution of internal variables within the Generalized Standard Materials (GSM) formalism. Starting from the Clausius--Duhem inequality, we enforce the thermodynamic requirements, convexity and non-negativity, that the dual dissipation potential must satisfy to guarantee non-negative mechanical dissipation. These requirements are formulated in the general subdifferential setting, encompassing rate-dependent (viscoelastic) and viscoplastic dissipative mechanisms, including potentials with genuine elastic domains, within a unified framework. Candidate potentials are generated by a composition-extended convexity-preserving grammar that guarantees thermodynamic admissibility emphby construction. The framework is validated on synthetic datasets spanning Newtonian, power-law, and Bingham viscoplastic ground truths under process and measurement noise, and on experimental oscillatory shear measurements of a synthetic elastomer across multiple strain amplitudes and frequencies, where the discovered potentials reproduce the amplitude-dependent softening of the dynamic moduli and outperform a calibrated linear Zener baseline.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种符号回归框架，用于在广义标准材料形式下从数据中发现控制内变量演化的耗散势。作者从 Clausius-Duhem 不等式出发，将对偶耗散势所需的凸性与非负性作为热力学可容许条件，并在一般次微分框架中统一处理黏弹性、黏塑性及具有弹性域的耗散机制。候选势函数由保持凸性的扩展组合语法生成，因此可在构造上保证热力学一致性，并在多类合成黏性数据上进行了验证。

articles.title: Nonperturbative renormalization of Haldane pseudopotentials from the exact two-electron spectrum
articles.title_zh: 基于精确双电子能谱的 Haldane 赝势非微扰重整化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Haldane pseudopotentials V|ₘ| provide the effective interaction parameters governing correlated states in the fractional quantum Hall regime. In conventional formulations, these quantities are obtained by projecting the Coulomb interaction onto relative-angular-momentum states within the lowest Landau level, thereby neglecting virtual transitions to higher Landau levels. Here, we formulate a nonperturbative description of effective interactions directly from the exact two-electron spectrum in a magnetic field. By solving the relative-motion problem beyond the lowest-Landau-level approximation, we define renormalized pseudopotentials V^*|ₘ| from the exact eigenenergies and introduce dynamical corrections Δ|ₘ|=V^*|ₘ|-V|ₘ|. The corrections remain systematically negative and depend strongly on both interaction strength and relative angular momentum, reflecting dynamical correlation effects associated with higher-state virtual admixture.
