These findings highlight the dual significance of EMIC waves in facilitating both the parallel heating of cold protons and the perpendicular heating of heavier ions. This study provides novel observational insights into the relationship between ion anisotropy, wave propagation, and energy transfer among multiple species in the inner magnetosphere, contributing to our understanding of plasma heating and radiation belt dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了2019年3月26日由磁层多尺度任务观测到的一次斜传播 H+ 电磁离子回旋波事件。事件发生在质子占优等离子体条件下，波呈左旋偏振且频率低于当地质子回旋频率；1—3 keV 质子的垂直温度各向异性为波传播提供自由能。观测还显示低能质子发生平行加热，氦离子出现增强的垂直加热，而 He²+ 和 O+ 响应较弱，说明 EMIC 波可在内磁层中向多种离子重新分配能量。

articles.title: Al-rich AlGaN multichannel transistors with degenerate semiconductor electrodes
articles.title_zh: 具有简并半导体电极的富铝 AlGaN 多沟道晶体管
articles.abstract: Ultrawide-bandgap (UWBG) Al-rich AlGaN multichannel high-electron-mobility transistors (HEMTs) are promising components for high-power, high-frequency electronics, but their device-level potential is limited by difficulties in forming low-resistance ohmic contacts to 2D electron gases (2DEGs) buried in Al-rich AlGaN superlattices. Here, we demonstrate undoped AlN/Al0.6Ga0.4N/AlN multichannel trigate HEMTs where vertically stacked polarization-induced 2DEG channels are accessed from etched sidewalls by epitaxially regrown highly degenerate n++-GaN (d-GaN) semiconductor electrodes formed via pulsed sputter deposition. The regrown d-GaN acts as an intermediate semiconductor electrode that mitigates the metal–channel injection mismatch while providing 3D access to the buried channels. The devices achieve annealing-free contact resistance of below 1 Ω·mm, breakdown voltages exceeding 3 kV with average breakdown fields reaching 3.8 MV/cm, and power figures of merit approaching 3.2 GW/cm2. These results demonstrate that the regrown highly degenerate semiconductor electrodes are a practical route to low-loss access in UWBG multichannel transistor platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了富铝 AlGaN 超宽禁带多沟道高电子迁移率晶体管中实现低阻接触的一种方案。器件采用未掺杂 AlN/Al0.6Ga0.4N/AlN 多沟道三栅结构，并通过刻蚀侧壁再生长高度简并 n++-GaN 半导体电极，实现对垂直堆叠极化诱导二维电子气沟道的三维接入。实验获得低于1 Ω·mm的免退火接触电阻、超过3 kV的击穿电压和接近3.2 GW/cm²的功率品质因数，表明再生长简并半导体电极有助于超宽禁带多沟道器件的低损耗接入。

articles.title: Domain-Generalizable Emotion Recognition across Social Media, Sitcom Dialogues, and Online Video Transcripts via Large Language Model-Guided Invariant Emotion Explanations
articles.title_zh: 通过大语言模型引导的不变情绪解释实现跨社交媒体、情景喜剧对话与在线视频转录的领域泛化情绪识别
articles.abstract: Emotion recognition models typically assume that training and test data are drawn from the same domain, yet real-world deployment requires generalization across heterogeneous text sources such as social media comments, scripted dialogues, and spontaneous video transcripts. This study investigates whether large language models can improve cross-domain emotion generalization by generating structured, domain-invariant emotion explanations rather than direct classification labels. Using only three publicly available datasets—GoEmotions, MELD, and CMU-MOSEI—we harmonize their label spaces into a unified seven-emotion taxonomy and design a rigorous cross-domain evaluation protocol covering single-source transfer, multi-source domain generalization, and within-domain upper-bound experiments. The proposed framework, LIDER (Large Language Model-Guided Invariant Domain Emotion Recognition), encodes an LLM-generated explanation that separates domain-specific stylistic cues from domain-invariant emotional evidence and fuses it with the original text representation under a training objective that combines classification loss, domain adversarial loss, supervised contrastive loss, and label prototype alignment. Comprehensive comparisons are conducted against traditional deep learning models, pretrained language models, domain adaptation and generalization algorithms, multimodal baselines, and LLM zero-shot and few-shot classifiers. Experimental results show that LIDER achieves an average Macro-F1 of 0.561 across six single-source transfer directions and 0.603 across three multi-source held-out target evaluations, surpassing strong baselines including BERT, RoBERTa, DANN, and IRM. Ablation analyses confirm that removing the domain-invariant explanation, the adversarial loss, or the label prototype alignment consistently degrades cross-domain performance. Error analysis reveals that LLM-guided explanations mitigate surface-level lexical biases and reduce confusion among semantically adjacent emotions such as anger and disgust. A focused case analysis on self-deprecating humor in workplace-related utterances further demonstrates the framework’s ability to disentangle humorous surface forms from underlying negative affect, a challenging scenario that pure text classifiers routinely misread.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注文本情绪识别模型在社交媒体评论、剧本对话和在线视频转录等异构来源之间的跨领域泛化问题。作者使用 GoEmotions、MELD 和 CMU-MOSEI 三个公开数据集，将标签统一为七类情绪，并设计单源迁移、多源领域泛化和域内上界等评估协议。提出的 LIDER 框架利用大语言模型生成结构化情绪解释，区分领域特定风格线索与领域不变情绪证据，并结合分类、领域对抗、监督对比和标签原型等训练目标提升泛化能力。

articles.title: Correlated imaging reveals that soil bacteria respire via cytochrome nanowires secreted by a hybrid type 4 pilus-type 2 secretion system
articles.title_zh: 关联成像揭示土壤细菌通过由混合型IV型菌毛–II型分泌系统分泌的细胞色素纳米线进行呼吸
articles.abstract: A wide range of globally-important environmental redox phenomena and biotechnology applications for bioremediation, bioenergy and bioelectronics, require long-range (>10 µm) extracellular electron transfer (EET) via bacterial surface-displayed “nanowires”. Since 2005, Type IV pili (T4P) and recently cytochrome filaments are proposed to function as nanowires, but direct evidence for either claim is lacking due to lack of methods to directly visualize EET. By developing correlated imaging of metabolic electrons and proteins in individual filaments used for EET, here we show that Geobacter sulfurreducens performs EET to soil-abundant minerals and electrodes via polymeric cytochromes nanowires rather than T4P. In contrast to the long-held belief that EET suppression in T4P mutant strains is due to the loss of T4P conductivity, we find that T4P mutations lower filament stability and impair secretion of cytochrome nanowires. Mutagenesis, in vivo interaction studies, and cryo-electron tomography reveal that G. sulfurreducens combines key components of the T4P system (T4PS) and the Type II secretion system (T2SS) for nanowire secretion and EET, in contrast to monomeric cytochromes translocated solely by T2SS. Our study resolves a long-standing controversy regarding nanowire identity and function, establishing a new class of hybrid T4PS-T2SS machinery that evolved for the secretion of cytochrome nanowires.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对细菌长距离胞外电子传递中“纳米线”的真实组成与功能机制展开。作者发展了可在单根用于电子传递的丝状结构中同时成像代谢电子和蛋白质的关联成像方法，发现Geobacter sulfurreducens主要通过聚合细胞色素纳米线而非IV型菌毛向矿物和电极传递电子。研究还表明，IV型菌毛突变导致电子传递受抑并非因菌毛导电性丧失，而是因丝状结构稳定性下降并影响细胞色素纳米线分泌；该菌结合IV型菌毛系统和II型分泌系统的关键组分来完成纳米线分泌与电子传递。

articles.title: Small-World Organization as a Representation-Dependent Signature of Nonlinear Dynamics in Biological Time Series
articles.title_zh: 小世界组织作为生物时间序列中依赖表征方式的非线性动力学特征
articles.abstract: Small-world topology is typically studied in networks derived from pairwise statistical dependencies, yet it remains unclear whether similar organization can emerge directly from individual time-series representations. Here, we systematically investigate how three widely used time-series-to-matrix mappings, Quantile Graphs (QG), Gramian Angular Fields (GAF), and Markov Transition Fields (MTF), shape the network topology inferred from temporal data. We analyze synthetic stochastic and deterministic signals, including a nonlinear logistic map benchmark, together with a multimodal collection of biological datasets comprising functional magnetic resonance imaging, magnetoencephalography, calcium imaging, simulated microelectrode array recordings, and physiological signals. Time series are transformed into transition matrices and characterized using small-worldness, clustering coefficient, path-based measures, transitivity, and global efficiency. A matched-subject sleep dataset, with simultaneous electroencephalography, electromyography, and respiration recordings, enables controlled cross-modal comparisons. Across all systems, small-world organization consistently emerges, although its magnitude and robustness depend on the chosen representation. QG and MTF yield stronger clustering and more pronounced small-world signatures than GAF, while path-based measures remain comparatively stable. Surrogate analysis confirms that these topological patterns reflect intrinsic temporal organization. These findings show that small-world topology arises as a representation-dependent signature of nonlinear temporal dynamics, linking data-driven network inference with dynamical systems theory across biological scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了小世界拓扑是否能够直接从单个时间序列的矩阵化表征中涌现，而不仅限于由成对统计依赖构建的网络。作者系统比较了分位图、格拉姆角场和马尔可夫转移场三类时间序列到矩阵的映射方法，并应用于合成随机/确定性信号及多模态生物数据。结果显示，不同系统中均可观察到小世界组织，但其强度和拓扑特征受到表征方法显著影响，提示小世界性可作为非线性动力学的表征依赖性标志。

articles.title: Defect-tolerant anti-fatigue titanium alloy via multi-scale heterogeneous interface engineering
articles.title_zh: 通过多尺度异质界面工程实现耐缺陷抗疲劳钛合金
articles.abstract: Additive manufacturing (AM) offers unparalleled design freedom and processing efficiency for titanium alloys, yet widespread adoption is hindered by poor fatigue performance originating from inevitable microvoids. In this study, we break this paradigm by introducing a post-processing strategy based on interface engineering. By exploiting the synergy between AM-induced metastable microstructures and rapid thermal processing (RTP), we construct a multi-scale heterogeneous interface network (MHIN) in a Ti-6.5Al-3.5Mo-1.5Zr-0.3Si alloy. This MHIN architecture delivers exceptional defect tolerance through a "compartmentalized plasticity" mechanism, achieving a high-cycle fatigue (HCF) strength of 955 MPa at 25 ℃ and, remarkably, 704 MPa at 500 ℃, the highest values ever reported for any titanium alloy at these temperatures. This new finding demonstrates that interface engineering can decouple fatigue resistance from void density, providing a generalizable pathway to qualify AM components for safety-critical applications across a wide temperature range.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向增材制造钛合金疲劳性能不足问题的后处理界面工程策略。作者利用增材制造诱导的亚稳组织与快速热处理协同，在Ti-6.5Al-3.5Mo-1.5Zr-0.3Si合金中构建多尺度异质界面网络。该结构通过“分隔化塑性”机制显著提升缺陷容忍度，在室温和500 ℃下均实现极高的高周疲劳强度，表明界面工程可在一定程度上使疲劳抗力与孔洞密度解耦。

articles.title: Visualization of Long-Range Order in Self-Assembled Ion Barriers for Stable Perovskite Tandems
articles.title_zh: 稳定钙钛矿叠层电池中自组装离子阻挡层长程有序结构的可视化
articles.abstract: The arrangement of self-assembled molecules on perovskite surfaces has remained a black box, despite their widespread use across perovskite optoelectronics. All prior understanding has relied on computational simulations that default to random or short-range ordered packing. Here we report the direct visualization of this arrangement at atomic resolution. Scanning tunnelling microscopy reveals that a fully conjugated, planar molecule assembles into regularly repeating arrays of hundreds of molecular units, and complementary techniques confirm that this long-range order is conformally preserved on perovskite surfaces, including the textured silicon in tandems. This nearly square packing aligns with the cubic perovskite lattice and matches grain dimensions, enabling uniform coating. Four carbonyl groups, one at each corner of the molecule, form intermolecular coordination bonds that encircle each molecular unit, creating a supramolecular network that locks the ordered configuration while blocking metal ion migration. Incorporated into perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells, this self-assembled ion barrier achieves a power conversion efficiency exceeding 34.5% (certified steady-state 34.4%) and retains its performance under continuous illumination, light-dark cycling, damp-heat exposure, and thermal shock. The extracted structural parameters, including molecular orientation, intermolecular spacing, π-π stacking periodicity, and lamellar packing distances, provide an experimental benchmark to calibrate future simulations across the field.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究直接观察了自组装分子在钙钛矿表面的排列方式，填补了此前主要依赖随机或短程有序模拟假设的认识空白。扫描隧道显微镜显示，一种全共轭平面分子可形成由数百个分子单元组成的规则重复阵列，并在钙钛矿及纹理硅叠层表面保持构形一致的长程有序。该近方形堆积与立方钙钛矿晶格匹配，分子角部羰基形成分子间配位网络，可阻挡金属离子迁移；用于钙钛矿/硅叠层太阳能电池时实现了超过34.5%的功率转换效率。

articles.title: Influence of Tilt Angle and Feed Rate of tool on Surface Quality in Precision Machining of Zerodur® Optical Mirrors
articles.title_zh: 刀具倾角与进给速度对Zerodur®光学镜面精密加工表面质量的影响
articles.abstract: High-precision optical mirrors made of Zerodur®, a glass-ceramic with near-zero thermal expansion, require optimized machining to minimize sub-surface damage (SSD) and surface roughness. This study investigates the impact of tilt angle (0° and 90°) and feed rate (100–1000 mm/min) on cutting forces and surface quality during 5-axis machining using a 40 mm radius hemispherical diamond tool. Experiments were conducted on a 5-axis CNC machine with dynamometer-based force measurements and surface characterization via chromatic confocal sensing. Results show that surface roughness (Ra/Rt) decreases with lower feed rates at 0° tilt, due to reduced tool vibrations and improved material removal control. At 90° tilt, feed rate variations have negligible effect on roughness, as geometric grain-workpiece interactions dominate. Cutting forces were significantly lower at 0° tilt, indicating reduced mechanical stress. A multi-physical cutting model was developed, integrating tool geometry, dynamic properties, and brittle material removal assumptions for Zerodur®. Forces were calculated from grain contact areas and decomposed into normal/tangential components. Model validation against experimental data demonstrated that the predicted force amplitude ratios are consistent with the experimental measurements, falling within the observed uncertainty bounds. Key findings highlight that 0° tilt yields smoother surfaces due to minimized vibrations, while 90° tilt exhibits roughness independence from feed rate. The model effectively captures tool-workpiece dynamics, offering a framework for optimizing machining parameters to reduce surface roughness and polishing time. Future work may incorporate tool wear and thermal effects for broader applicability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了5轴加工中刀具倾角和进给速度对Zerodur®玻璃陶瓷光学镜面切削力、亚表面损伤风险和表面粗糙度的影响。实验表明，在0°倾角下较低进给速度可降低表面粗糙度并减少刀具振动，而在90°倾角下进给速度对粗糙度影响较小，主要受磨粒—工件几何相互作用控制。0°倾角下切削力显著更低，说明机械应力较小；作者还建立了结合刀具几何、动力学特性和脆性去除假设的多物理切削模型，并与实验结果进行验证。

articles.title: Curvature-assisted minima hopping on Lennard-Jones energy landscapes: reusing quasi-Newton information for escape directions
articles.title_zh: Lennard-Jones能量景观中的曲率辅助极小值跳跃：复用拟牛顿信息以确定逃逸方向
articles.abstract: Global structure optimization in computational chemistry is often limited by the cost of escaping local minima on high-dimensional potential-energy surfaces. Minima hopping addresses this problem by combining short molecular-dynamics escape trajectories with local relaxation and adaptive energy feedback, but its efficiency depends strongly on the initial escape direction. We benchmark a curvature-assisted variant in which the approximate inverse-Hessian information that BFGS and limited-memory BFGS build from the gradients already required for relaxation is recycled as an escape model. This avoids explicit second derivatives and adds no force evaluations before proposing low-curvature escape directions. Lennard-Jones clusters with 60--74 particles provide controlled energy landscapes for comparing conjugate-gradient, BFGS, and limited-memory BFGS minimizers, random and softened random directions, single Hessian modes, multi-mode Hessian combinations, and mixed Hessian-random directions. The results show that dense BFGS curvature information identifies physically meaningful escape subspaces and can reduce repeated local exploration. Single deterministic modes, however, oversample local funnels, and limited-memory curvature information is not reliable enough for direct mode selection. Combining several BFGS modes improves robustness, but the conventional softened random direction with L-BFGS remains the lowest-cost baseline in total force evaluations. The study clarifies when curvature reuse is algorithmically useful: it must provide an inexpensive soft-mode subspace while preserving stochastic diversity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注计算化学全局结构优化中从高维势能面局部极小值逃逸的效率问题。作者评估了一种曲率辅助的极小值跳跃方法，将BFGS和有限记忆BFGS在局部弛豫中已构建的近似逆Hessian信息复用于生成低曲率逃逸方向，从而避免显式二阶导数和额外力评估。对60至74粒子的Lennard-Jones团簇测试表明，稠密BFGS曲率信息可识别有物理意义的逃逸子空间并减少重复局部搜索，但单一确定性模态可能导致对局部区域的过度采样。

articles.title: Remediation of Heavy Metal-Contaminated Soils in Alpine and Arid Mining Regions: Synthesis and Performance of a Multifunctional Amendment
articles.title_zh: 高寒干旱矿区重金属污染土壤修复：多功能改良剂的合成与性能
articles.abstract: Heavy metal (HM) contamination, freeze-thaw (F-T) cycles, and dry, nutrient-poor conditions make the soils in the lead-zinc mining areas of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau even worse, making it harder for plants to grow. To solve these problems, an inorganic-organic composite multifunctional amendment was made using solid waste from the area. The best mass ratio of diatomite, biochar, gypsum, magnesium hydroxide, and soil was found to be 5:6:1:1.45:103. Using this composite amendment improved the soil's physical and chemical properties a lot. The saturated water capacity and water-holding capacity went up by 14.71% and 23.33%, respectively. Also, the cation exchange capacity (CEC), phosphorus retention, and potassium retention capacities all went up by 44.88%, 20.34%, and 100.70%, respectively. Under F-T conditions, the modified soil showed a two- to three-fold improvement in both adsorption capacity and efficiency for different HMs in single and multi-metal systems when compared to the control (CK). The removal efficiency for Pb2+ was especially high, at over 80%. Thermodynamic and kinetic analyses elucidated that the adsorption of Pb2+ and Zn2+ conformed to the Freundlich isotherm, suggesting multilayer adsorption on heterogeneous surfaces as the principal mechanism. Chemisorption processes, like surface complexation and precipitation (which fit the pseudo-second-order kinetic model), were mostly responsible for the immobilization of Pb2+. On the other hand, physical diffusion (which fits the pseudo-first-order model) was mostly responsible for the adsorption of smaller radius ions (Zn2+, Cu2+, Cd2+). Finally, greenhouse pot trials with ryegrass (Lolium perenne L.) confirmed that the amendment not only significantly reduced the bioavailability of heavy metals during F-T cycles but also improved water and nutrient retention, resulting in significant increases in plant height and biomass.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对青藏高原铅锌矿区土壤重金属污染、冻融循环及干旱贫瘠等限制植物生长的问题，利用区域固体废弃物制备无机—有机复合多功能改良剂。优化配比的改良剂显著改善土壤持水、阳离子交换及磷钾保持能力，并在冻融条件下提高多种重金属的吸附容量和效率，其中Pb2+去除率超过80%。热力学和动力学分析表明，Pb2+和Zn2+吸附符合Freundlich等温模型，提示该材料具有应用于高寒干旱矿区土壤修复的潜力。

articles.title: Study on Mechanical Behavior and Damage Evolution of Filled Fractured Sandstone under Freeze-Thaw Cycles: Insights from Macro and Micro Perspectives
articles.title_zh: 冻融循环下充填裂隙砂岩力学行为与损伤演化研究：宏微观视角
articles.abstract: To address the stability deterioration in rock engineering in seasonally frozen regions, this study examines the mechanical response of sandstone under coupled freeze-thaw (F-T) cycles and filled fractures. Uniaxial compression tests were conducted on filled fractured sandstone with prefabricated through-going filled fractures at dip angles of 30°, 45°, and 60°, after being subjected to 0, 20, 40, and 60 F-T cycles. Multi-source monitoring, including acoustic emission (AE), digital image correlation (DIC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) was integrated to analyze energy evolution, deformation and pore structure damage mechanism. The results indicate that F-T cycles degrade the physical and mechanical properties of sandstone, with the strength exhibiting a linear decay as the number of cycles increases. The geometry of fractures exerts a significant controlling effect on damage evolution. Larger fracture dip angles facilitate the concentration and transmission of frost heave stress, driving a pronounced evolution of the pore structure towards larger sizes. T2 spectrum analysis based on NMR reveals a chain evolution pattern: “micropore reduction → small pore increase → large pore expansion → macropore initiation”. The findings provide a quantitative basis and theoretical support for stability evaluation and reinforcement design of rock masses with filled fractures in cold regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨季节冻土区岩体工程中冻融循环与充填裂隙耦合作用对砂岩稳定性的影响。作者对含不同倾角贯通充填裂隙的砂岩进行0至60次冻融循环后的单轴压缩试验，并结合声发射、数字图像相关和核磁共振等多源监测分析能量演化、变形与孔隙结构损伤。结果表明，冻融循环使砂岩物理力学性质退化，强度随循环次数线性衰减；较大裂隙倾角有利于冻胀应力集中与传递，推动孔隙结构向大孔方向演化。

articles.title: Topological Phenomena Protected by Diabolical Textures
articles.title_zh: 由退化点纹理保护的拓扑现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a new class of topological phenomena in inhomogeneous systems arising from the adiabatic spatial embedding of parametrized families of quantum states such as charge pumps and their generalizations. We demonstrate that each topologically distinct class of these "diabolical textures" gives rise to distinct gapped states that are separated by "trap-scaling" critical points. When the texture varies sufficiently rapidly in space, the critical line terminates abruptly, producing an "unnecessary critical" surface. We demonstrate our results using a microscopic model of non-interacting fermions with a spatially embedded Thouless pump. We study its phase diagram comprehensively and establish its stability to arbitrary perturbations, including interactions, in the vicinity of the critical regions. For systems in arbitrary spatial dimensions and global symmetries, we present a framework to systematically classify diabolical textures using Kitaev's Ømega spectrum conjecture.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一类源于非均匀系统中新型空间嵌入结构的拓扑现象，这些结构来自对电荷泵及其推广等参数化量子态族的绝热空间嵌入，作者称之为“退化点纹理”。研究表明，不同拓扑类别的纹理会产生不同的有能隙态，并由具有“陷阱标度”特征的临界点分隔；当纹理空间变化足够快时，临界线会突然终止并形成“非必要临界”曲面。作者通过嵌入Thouless泵的非相互作用费米子微观模型展示结果，并提出了利用Kitaev Ω谱猜想系统分类任意维度和对称性下此类纹理的框架。
authors: Sayantan Mandal, Neelima Pulletikurty, Abhishodh Prakash

articles.title: Non-Perturbative Renormalization Group for Ising-Nematic Criticality: A Closed-Form Nonlocal Ansatz
articles.title_zh: Ising-向列临界性的非微扰重整化群：闭式非局域拟设
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30715v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The two-dimensional metallic quantum critical problem is a long-standing puzzle that is widely believed to hold the key to resolving ubiquitous non-Fermi liquid behavior in strongly correlated electronic systems. In this study, we present a non-perturbative renormalization group (RG) analysis of the metallic Ising-nematic quantum critical point in two dimensions, formulated directly around an intrinsically nonlocal infrared (IR) boson propagator. Rather than treating the anomalous dynamical critical exponent a as a fixed phenomenological parameter, we regard it as an intrinsic component of the fixed-point data to be determined from the internal consistency of the low-energy patch field theory under highly anisotropic scaling dimensions ([k₀]=a+1, [kₓ]=2, [k_y]=1). While the leading two-loop diagrammatics vanish identically due to kinematic pole configurations, our three-loop evaluation reveals a profound structural asymmetry between the sectors: the fermion self-energy and Yukawa vertex receive non-vanishing logarithmic corrections, whereas the corresponding bosonic counter-term remains strictly zero. Consequently, we find that no self-consistent, intersecting fixed-point solution for the exponent a exists within the three-loop truncation, failing to reproduce the physical value of a approx 1.85 observed in quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We conjecture that the cross-linked topology of the four-loop boson self-energy diagrams is exactly marginal and yields the minimal, mandatory bosonic counter-term required to restore multi-sector self-consistency. Our framework establishes a rigid multi-loop matching scheme necessary to uniquely pin down the critical exponent, and uncovers a stable phase space for field anomalous dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对二维金属Ising-向列量子临界点这一与非费米液体行为相关的难题，提出一种围绕内禀非局域红外玻色传播子构建的非微扰重整化群分析。作者不将反常动力学临界指数视为外加参数，而是作为固定点数据的一部分，由低能斑块场论在强各向异性标度下的自洽性决定。两圈图因运动学极点结构而消失，而三圈计算显示费米子自能和Yukawa顶角存在非零对数修正，玻色反项则严格为零，从而揭示了不同扇区之间的结构性不对称。
authors: Hyeon Jung Kim, Kyoung-Min Kim, Ki-Seok Kim

articles.title: Superconductor-"Metal" Transition of One-dimensional Interacting Bosons with Ohmic Quantum Dissipation
articles.title_zh: 具有欧姆量子耗散的一维相互作用玻色子的超导体—“金属”转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The phase diagram of a system of interacting bosons (Cooper pairs) hoping on a one-dimensional (1D) lattice with onsite phase dissipation describing the Josephson tunneling to a nearby diffusive normal-metal electrode is studied. Starting from the system at commensurate lattice filling, it is shown by a combination of analytical techniques that the phase diagram contains two quantum phases: A dissipative Bose-Einstein condensate (D-BEC) or superconductor with long-range phase coherence, and a dissipative Mott insulator (D-Mott) or "metal" with exponentially decaying phase correlations in space and local imaginary-time correlations decaying as the local pairing correlations of the electrode. The D-Mott/metal phase can be described as a 1D array of dissipative boson puddles, weakly coupled by Josephson tunneling. The puddle size roughly corresponds to the length scale beyond which phase slips suppress phase coherence. The dissipative time-dependent Ginsburg-Landau theory phenomenologically used by Sachdev, Werner, and Troyer [Phys. Rev. Lett. bf 92 237003 (2004)] for the superconductor-metal transition in quasi-1D wires is derived from this microscopic puddle picture. Thus, the criticality of the D-Mott/D-BEC transition is shown to belong to the Wilson-Fisher universality class with dynamical exponent zapprox 2. At small doping, the D-Mott/metal phase remains stable due to its finite compressibility, which is computed to leading order in a perturbation expansion of the dissipation strength and the inter-puddle Josephson coupling. At larger doping, using a mapping to a pseudospin chain combined with bosonization, the D-BEC/superconductor phase is the ground state for non-vanishing but arbitrarily small dissipation. Similarities and differences with deconfinement transition of an array 1D bosonic Mott insulators in anisotropic optical lattices are also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了一维晶格上相互作用玻色子或库珀对在现场相位耗散下的相图，该耗散描述其与邻近扩散正常金属电极之间的Josephson隧穿。作者从公度填充出发，结合解析方法表明体系包含两个量子相：具有长程相位相干的耗散玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚/超导相，以及空间相位关联指数衰减的耗散Mott绝缘体或“金属”相。后者可理解为由弱Josephson耦合连接的一维耗散玻色子液滴阵列，液滴尺度与相位滑移破坏相干性的长度尺度相关；研究还从微观模型推导出用于准一维导线超导体—金属转变的耗散时变Ginzburg-Landau理论。

articles.title: Ni-O hybridization-driven electronic reconstruction across the superconducting dome in an infinite-layer nickelate
articles.title_zh: 无限层镍酸盐中由Ni-O杂化驱动并贯穿超导穹顶的电子重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelates has drawn wide interest as a cuprate analogue, yet how the electronic structure evolves with hole doping remains unsettled. Here we map the doping- and temperature-dependent unoccupied states of the La-based infinite-layer nickelate La1-xCaxNiO2 using O K-edge and Ni L-edge x-ray absorption spectroscopy. Superconductivity occurs for 0.18<=x<=0.27. Near x~0.20-0.23, low-energy spectral weight redistributes: Ni3d-dominated states decrease while O2p-hybridized states increase, indicating an orbital-selective crossover in Ni-O covalency. This crossover coincides with a sign reversal of the Hall coefficient and precedes the reduction of the superconducting critical temperature at higher doping. By directly linking transport anomalies and the superconducting dome to a measurable Ni-O orbital reorganization, our results provide a key step toward a unified, orbital-resolved phase diagram for infinite-layer nickelates and a practical route to engineer superconductivity via hybridization control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用O K边和Ni L边X射线吸收谱，绘制了La基无限层镍酸盐La1-xCaxNiO2中未占据电子态随掺杂和温度的演化。结果显示，超导出现在0.18≤x≤0.27范围内；在x约为0.20至0.23附近，低能谱重发生再分布，Ni 3d主导态减少而O 2p杂化态增加，表明Ni-O共价性发生轨道选择性交叉。该交叉与霍尔系数符号反转相吻合，并先于高掺杂下超导临界温度降低，为建立轨道分辨的无限层镍酸盐相图和通过杂化调控超导性提供了依据。
authors: Chi Sin Tang, Shengwei Zeng, Xing Gao, Zhaoyang Luo, Xiongfang Liu, Zhi Shiuh Lim, Saurav Prakash, Ping Yang, Caozheng Diao, Xinmao Yin, Changjian Li, Huajun Liu, Mark B. H. Breese, A. Ariando

articles.title: Bending-like stress induced by solder joint under uniaxial tensile testing in 2G-HTS tapes: Impact and optimization approach
articles.title_zh: 2G-HTS带材单轴拉伸测试中焊点诱发的类弯曲应力：影响与优化方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The reversible stress limit (Rᵣₑᵥ) of second-generation high-temperature superconducting (2G-HTS) tapes is a critical performance indicator, typically characterized through uniaxial tensile testing. In practice, the accuracy of the measured Rrev value is often compromised by stress concentration induced by the voltage tap solder joint. The present study investigates the underlying interference mechanism using integrated experimental and numerical methods. Mechanistic analysis reveals that under uniaxial tensile loading, the local geometric inhomogeneity introduced by the solder joint induces an external, bending-like stress in the vicinity of the solder joint, transitioning from additional tensile stress in the zone adjacent to the joint to additional compressive stress in the zone remote from it. When the solder joint is attached to the front surface of the tape (the side closer to the superconducting layer), the superconducting layer experiences localized additional tensile stress, triggering premature damage and early Ic degradation. Consequently, an optimized back-surface soldering approach is proposed, which positions the superconducting layer in a localized compressive zone. Experimental validation demonstrates that the proposed approach effectively mitigates testing errors for various tape configurations. Notably, for the tape with a copper layer thickness of 5 μm, the measured Rᵣₑᵥ increased from 546 MPa to 734 MPa, corresponding to a 42% increase, and moved closer to the actual value. The findings provide essential insights for the precision characterization of the electromechanical performances (EMPs) of 2G-HTS tapes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注第二代高温超导带材在单轴拉伸测试中可逆应力极限测量的准确性，指出电压引线焊点会引入局部几何不均匀并导致应力集中。实验与数值分析表明，焊点附近会产生类似弯曲的附加应力，若焊点位于靠近超导层的正面，超导层会承受局部附加拉应力，从而提前损伤并导致临界电流过早退化。作者据此提出背面焊接的优化方案，以降低测量干扰并提高Rrev表征可靠性。
authors: Dean Liu, Yue Wu, Haoliang Xiang, Xiaofen Li, Caida Fu, Chiheng Dong, Yue Zhao

articles.title: Terahertz Electrodynamics and Kinetic Inductance of Disordered Titanium-Vanadium Alloy Thin Films
articles.title_zh: 无序钛-钒合金薄膜的太赫兹电动力学与动能电感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30847v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Disordered superconductors represent an important area in modern condensed matter physics, where superconductivity survives even in the presence of strong electron scattering and localization effects. Understanding how disorder modifies the high-frequency electrodynamic response is not only important from physics point of view, but is also essential for developing next-generation quantum detectors and superconducting devices. In this work, we investigate the terahertz electrodynamics of disordered Ti40V60 alloy thin films using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) to understand the relationship between disorder, quasiparticle dynamics, and kinetic inductance. By analysing the complex conductivity, penetration depth and superfluid response, we show that structural disorder can be systematically used to tune the inductive response while maintaining a robust superconducting phase. Unlike conventional nitride superconductors that require tightly controlled reactive growth conditions, Ti40V60 alloys provide a simpler and more adaptable route for tuning the superconducting energy scales directly through the deposition conditions. These findings establish Ti40V60 alloys as a promising material for kinetic inductance detectors and provide useful insights into the electrodynamics of strongly disordered superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用太赫兹时域光谱研究无序Ti40V60超导合金薄膜的高频电动力学响应，重点分析无序、准粒子动力学与动能电感之间的关系。通过复电导率、穿透深度和超流响应的分析，作者表明结构无序可用于调控电感响应，同时保持较稳健的超导相。相比需要严格反应生长条件的传统氮化物超导体，Ti-V合金为通过沉积条件调节超导能标提供了更灵活的途径。
authors: Shekhar Chandra Pandey, Shilpam Sharma, Ashish Khandelwal, M. K. Chattopadhyay

articles.title: Activity-Enhanced Ordering in Fluctuation-Induced First-Order Transitions
articles.title_zh: 涨落诱导一级相变中的活性增强有序化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30887v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fluctuations can drive otherwise continuous phase transitions to first order through the Brazovskii mechanism. We study how these fluctuation-induced transitions are modified in active systems by introducing nonequilibrium spatiotemporally correlated noise. We show that, while the transition remains fluctuation-induced first order, activity systematically suppresses these fluctuation effects, shifting the transition to higher temperatures and rendering it increasingly weakly first order. As a result, ordering is enhanced without inducing a spinodal instability of the isotropic phase, as confirmed by direct numerical simulations. In the strong-activity limit, fluctuation effects disappear and mean-field behavior is recovered. Our results identify activity as a generic control parameter for tuning the strength of fluctuation-induced first-order transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨在Brazovskii机制下由涨落驱动的一级相变如何受到活性非平衡噪声的影响。结果显示，相变仍保持涨落诱导一级性质，但活性会系统性削弱涨落效应，使相变移向更高温度并变得更弱一级。数值模拟证实，活性可增强有序化而不引发各向同性相的自旋odal不稳定性；在强活性极限下，系统恢复平均场行为。

articles.title: Finite-time Scaling with Arbitrary Driving Rates: Bridging the Kibble-Zurek and De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov Limits
articles.title_zh: 任意驱动速率下的有限时间标度：连接Kibble-Zurek与De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pursuit of a universal description for nonequilibrium critical dynamics in quantum many-body systems stands as a central frontier in modern statistical physics. For driven critical dynamics starting far from the critical point, the well-known Kibble-Zurek (KZ) scaling holds only when the driving rate lies below an upper bound. Here we study driven dynamics restricted to the critical region, and show that robust dynamic scaling behavior exists for arbitrary driving rates. We develop a generalized finite-time scaling (FTS) framework, which provides a unified understanding on the driven dynamics for the full range of quench rates, bridging the KZ scaling in the slow-driving regime and the De~Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov (DGP) scaling in the sudden-quench limit. We verify this unified FTS form through numerical simulations in both quantum critical and tricritical points. The good agreement between theoretical predictions and numerical results confirms the generality of our theory. Our work establishes a universal theory for nonequilibrium critical dynamics spanning the full range of driving rates, with broad implications for quantum quench experiments and out-of-equilibrium statistical mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究量子多体系统中受驱临界动力学的普适描述，指出传统Kibble-Zurek标度在从远离临界点出发时仅适用于一定速率范围。作者将驱动限制在临界区域内，提出广义有限时间标度框架，可覆盖任意淬火速率，并统一慢驱动的KZ标度与突然淬火的DGP标度。量子临界点和三临界点的数值模拟验证了该理论形式的普适性。

articles.title: Emergence of spin entanglement with the pseudogap onset in the Fermi-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 费米-Hubbard模型中随赝能隙出现而涌现的自旋纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31240v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite decades of intense theoretical and experimental investigation, the two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model still resists a complete microscopic understanding. Conventional approaches typically probe global observables and locally resolved correlation functions. Here, we develop a complementary perspective based on the measurement of entanglement. Using both an ultracold-atom quantum simulator and numerical simulations based on the dynamical vertex approximation, we find that entanglement is closely tied to the onset of the enigmatic pseudogap regime: spin-singlet entanglement emerges only as the pseudogap sets in and, in contrast to classical correlations, remains confined to nearest-neighbour sites in this regime. Our results, therefore, disfavour purely classical-fluctuation theories of the pseudogap and constrain microscopic models to those that develop nearest-neighbour spin-singlet entanglement at the pseudogap onset.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从纠缠测量角度重新审视二维费米-Hubbard模型，结合超冷原子量子模拟器和基于动力学顶角近似的数值模拟。结果表明，自旋单态纠缠与赝能隙区域的出现密切相关，并且只在赝能隙形成时涌现；不同于经典关联，这种纠缠在该区域内局限于最近邻格点。该发现不支持将赝能隙完全归因于经典涨落的理论，并对相关微观模型提出了约束。
authors: Frederic Bippus, Thomas Chalopin, Gabriele Bellomia, Gergő Roósz, Titus Franz, Antoine Georges, Anna Kauch, Immanuel Bloch, Karsten Held

articles.title: Charged Bose polarons at finite momentum
articles.title_zh: 有限动量下的带电Bose极化子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31255v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charged impurities in quantum fluids have unveiled new classes of strongly correlated many-body states across condensed matter, ultracold gases, and hybrid atom-ion platforms. While previous studies have primarily focused on their ground-state and static properties, much less is known about their finite-momentum behavior, which governs transport, dissipation, and quasiparticle stability. Here, we investigate the momentum-dependent properties of a charged Bose polaron using a diagrammatic approach within second-order perturbation theory, explicitly accounting for the finite-range nature of the ion-atom interaction. We show that the interaction range introduces a characteristic momentum scale at which many-body dressing and dissipation are maximized, leading to a non-monotonic behavior of the damping rate and quasiparticle energy. In the high-momentum regime, we uncover a scaling law Γₚ sim 1/p, signaling the suppression of many-body dressing and the recovery of quasi-free impurity dynamics, in stark contrast to the divergent behavior predicted by contact-interaction perturbative treatments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究量子流体中带电杂质形成的Bose极化子在有限动量下的性质，这与输运、耗散和准粒子稳定性密切相关。作者采用二阶微扰理论的图形方法，并显式考虑离子-原子相互作用的有限程特征。研究发现相互作用程长引入特征动量尺度，使多体包裹和耗散达到最大，导致阻尼率和准粒子能量呈非单调行为；在高动量区，阻尼率呈约1/p标度，显示多体修饰被抑制并恢复近自由杂质动力学。
authors: Grover Andrade Sánchez, Arturo Camacho Guardian

articles.title: Feasibility study of continuous electronic Pomeranchuk cooling with a flavor-degenerate Wigner crystal
articles.title_zh: 利用味简并Wigner晶体实现连续电子Pomeranchuk冷却的可行性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving sub-millikelvin electron temperatures in nanoelectronic devices could unveil new transport phenomena, extend quantum coherence times, and enhance the precision of quantum metrology. However, maintaining such low temperatures continuously remains a long-standing challenge. Here, we propose and simulate an on-chip cooling cycle that harnesses the entropy difference between an electron liquid (EL) and a Wigner crystal (WC) in flavor-degenerate flat-band materials. Cooling is driven by a current through a device with a locally gated region. Within this region, the charge carrier density is tuned such that a WC forms beneath the gate. As carriers transition from an EL to WC phase, their entropy increases, extracting heat and the sliding WC advects this heat along the device. The heat is then released when carriers transition back to the EL phase, which establishes distinct hot and cold regions and a steady temperature gradient over the device. Simulations show net cooling for sufficiently low current densities, typically below 1~nA/μm, whereas Joule heating dominates at higher currents. Within the gated region, we estimate cooling powers of up to 8.4~aW/μm at a bath temperature of 4~mK. Our approach can achieve electron temperatures well below 1~mK under suitable conditions, promising a route towards continuous on-chip cooling in this temperature regime. Our approach applies to any flat-band material with low-energy flavor degeneracy (valley and/or orbital) and low disorder, including gapped Bernal-stacked bilayer graphene, rhombohedral-stacked multilayer graphene, and magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种片上冷却循环，利用味简并平带材料中电子液体与Wigner晶体之间的熵差来实现连续电子冷却。器件中局部门控区域调节载流子密度，使载流子从电子液体转变为Wigner晶体时吸热，并通过滑动Wigner晶体沿器件输运热量，随后在转回电子液体时放热。模拟显示，在足够低的电流密度下可实现净冷却，而较高电流下焦耳热占主导。
authors: Robin J. Dolleman, Ammon Fischer, Lennart Klebl, Alexander Rothstein, Dante M. Kennes, Bernd Beschoten, Florian Libisch, Christoph Stampfer

articles.title: Co-optimization of spin coherence and valley splitting in Si/SiGe heterostructures
articles.title_zh: Si/SiGe异质结构中自旋相干性与谷劈裂的协同优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single electron spins can be used to encode and process information in semiconductor quantum devices. Progress has been hindered by materials challenges, such as the small energy splitting between low-lying valley states and hyperfine coupling to nuclear spins. Here we use density functional theory to optimize the valley splitting and spin dephasing time in realistic Si/SiGe heterostructures. Reductions in the Si quantum well width generally increase the valley splitting. However, in narrow quantum wells, a larger fraction of the electronic wavefunction resides in the SiGe buffer layers, which increases the hyperfine coupling with spinful ⁷³Ge. Our work shows that Si/SiGe heterostructures with 3~--~4~nm wide quantum wells and ⁷³Ge and ²⁹Si concentrations of 50 ppm should support average valley splittings Eᵥ~>~500~μeV and spin dephasing times T₂^* exceeding 15~μs assuming an effective quantum dot area of 700 nm². In addition, sharper Si/SiGe interfaces in general result in larger valley splittings and longer spin dephasing times.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用密度泛函理论优化现实Si/SiGe异质结构中的谷劈裂与自旋退相干时间，以服务于半导体自旋量子比特。结果表明，减小Si量子阱宽度通常可增大谷劈裂，但过窄量子阱会使电子波函数更多进入SiGe缓冲层，从而增强与含自旋的73Ge核的超精细耦合。作者指出，3--4 nm宽量子阱并结合低浓度73Ge和29Si同位素杂质，有望同时实现较大谷劈裂和较长T2*；更陡峭的Si/SiGe界面通常也有利于两者提升。
authors: Peihong Zhang, Xuedong Hu, Saif Ullah, Jason R. Petta

articles.title: What controls the superconducting dome of electron-doped FeSe?
articles.title_zh: 什么控制了电子掺杂FeSe的超导穹顶？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting domes are conspicuous features of the phase diagrams of most unconventional and high-temperature superconductors. The superconducting transition temperature (Tc) of FeSe can be dramatically enhanced with electron doping, but unlike all other high-temperature and unconventional superconductors, its full phase diagram and superconducting dome have yet to be fully explored. Here, we employ a combination of molecular beam epitaxy synthesis, alkali surface doping, in-vacuum electrical transport, and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to investigate the entire superconducting dome of electron-doped FeSe, achieving a fully metallic state where superconductivity is suppressed in the heavily overdoped regime. We discover a robust scaling between Tc and the residual resistivity (h̊o₀) which holds across the entire superconducting dome, suggesting that the evolution of Tc is heavily influenced by the evolution of the elastic scattering rate in the high-Tc electron-doped phase. This in turn suggests that the superconducting dome in electron-doped FeSe appears to be fundamentally different than that of other unconventional superconductors where doping plays the primary role, and may be driven primarily by the sensitivity of the superconductivity to disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过分子束外延、碱金属表面掺杂、真空内电输运和角分辨光电子能谱，系统探测电子掺杂FeSe的完整超导穹顶，并实现了重过掺杂区中超导被抑制的金属性状态。作者发现超导转变温度Tc与残余电阻率在整个超导穹顶范围内存在稳健标度关系。该结果表明，高Tc电子掺杂相中的弹性散射率演化对Tc具有重要影响，暗示电子掺杂FeSe的超导穹顶可能不同于其他非常规超导体。
authors: Paul T. Malinowski, Chad J. Mowers, Yaoju Tarn, Darrell G. Schlom, Brendan D. Faeth, Kyle M. Shen

articles.title: Geometric dependence of critical-current variation in Al/AlOm̊ ₓ/Al Josephson junctions: a model-based analysis
articles.title_zh: Al/AlOx/Al Josephson结临界电流变化的几何依赖性：基于模型的分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Achieving uniform critical current across Josephson junctions is essential for the large-scale integration of superconducting quantum circuits. In this work, we statistically analyzed the variation of the critical current of Al/AlOm̊ ₓ/Al junctions using room-temperature tunnel resistance statistics, and identified the dominant contribution among the modeled sources of the variation based on their dependence on geometry and deposition conditions of junctions. Our model-based analysis reveals that fluctuations in the Al film thickness play the dominant role among the modeled contributing factors. Based on this analysis, we found that, in Dolan-bridge double-angle deposition, adopting a deposition angle of 30-degree for bilayer junctions significantly improves uniformity, yielding a relative standard deviation of 1.2% (0.5%) across a 9.75 mm (1.5 mm) square region.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究Al/AlOx/Al Josephson结临界电流均匀性问题，利用室温隧穿电阻统计数据分析临界电流波动来源。基于模型的分析表明，在所考虑因素中，Al薄膜厚度涨落是主要贡献。作者进一步指出，在Dolan桥双角沉积中，对双层结采用30度沉积角可显著改善均匀性，并在毫米尺度区域内获得较低的相对标准差。
authors: K. Kakuyanagi, N. Teran, H. Toida, S. Saito

articles.title: Eigenstate chaos in the presence of non-Abelian symmetries
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔对称性存在下的本征态混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30798v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) posits that energy eigenstates encode local properties of the microcanonical ensemble. Motivated by recent interest in the physics of non-commuting conserved charges and the non-Abelian ETH, we study chaotic eigenstates in the presence of symmetries described by general compact Lie groups, such as SU(2). By applying non-Abelian symmetry resolution, we develop a non-Abelian microcanonical entropy and relate this entropy to the entanglement entropy of chaotic eigenstates. We find that microcanonical entropy is closely related to the symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy, which differs from conventional entanglement entropy by a universal logarithmic correction. Our results depend on the global Casimir charge, e.g. total spin. At finite charge density, we find a logarithmic enhancement to conventional entanglement entropy. At zero density, we find no such correction to entanglement entropy, but a logarithmic reduction to microcanonical entropy and symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy. We discuss the implications of our approach for non-Abelian eigenstate thermalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕非对易守恒荷和非阿贝尔本征态热化假说，分析具有一般紧致李群对称性系统中的混沌本征态。作者引入非阿贝尔对称性分辨方法，构造非阿贝尔微正则熵，并将其与混沌本征态的纠缠熵联系起来。结果显示，微正则熵与对称性分辨纠缠熵密切相关，并相对于常规纠缠熵存在普适对数修正；这些修正依赖于全局Casimir荷，如总自旋。

articles.title: (Non-)Traversable Quantum Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 可穿越与不可穿越的量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31472v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum phase transitions manifest as an abrupt change in the ground state of a many-body system; yet it is an open question whether this sudden change necessarily precludes a continuous dynamical connection between the two phases. We introduce a classification of quantum phase transitions based on this geometric aspect of the ground-state manifold, that differs from known classifications. By leveraging the framework of counterdiabatic driving, we explicitly construct schedules that dynamically connect one phase to another. This strategy allows us to uncover a large class of quantum phase transitions, where the states on both sides are separated only by a finite geometric distance in the thermodynamic limit. We term such transitions traversable, since exact counterdiabatic driving links the two phases via a finite dynamical protocol in the thermodynamic limit. We show that multiple known transitions fall into this class -- e.g., symmetry-breaking transitions obeying hyperscaling and discontinuous transitions with an enhanced continuous symmetry. We further show the existence of quantum phase transitions that cannot be crossed dynamically even with the help of nonlocal counterdiabatic driving, as they would require divergent amplitudes and frequencies. Geometrically, these nontraversable transitions correspond to an infinite distance separating the two phases of matter; we show that the class comprises continuous transitions exhibiting mean-field universality, and discontinuous transitions arising from the competition between metastable minima. Our geometric classification goes beyond the known taxonomy, is independent of local order parameters and renormalization group fixed points, and has direct implications for the complexity of state preparation and adiabatic quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从基态流形几何结构出发，对量子相变提出一种不同于既有分类的新分类。作者借助反绝热驱动框架，显式构造可在不同相之间实现动力学连接的调度方案，并发现一大类相变在热力学极限下两侧态之间仅相隔有限几何距离。此类相变被称为可穿越相变，因为精确反绝热驱动可用有限动力学协议连接两相；文中也讨论了无法以这种方式动态跨越的量子相变。
authors: Federico Balducci, Paul M. Schindler, Andrea Solfanelli, Marin Bukov

articles.title: Information Bounds on phase transitions in disordered systems
articles.title_zh: 无序系统相变的信息论界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2308.15532v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Information theory, rooted in computer science, and many-body physics, have traditionally been studied as (almost) independent fields. Only recently has this paradigm started to shift, with many-body physics being studied and characterized using tools developed in information theory. In our work, we introduce a new perspective on this connection, and study phase transitions in models with randomness, such as localization in disordered systems, or random quantum circuits with measurements. Utilizing information-based arguments regarding probability distribution differentiation, we bound critical exponents in such phase transitions (specifically, those controlling the correlation or localization lengths). We benchmark our method and rederive the well-known Harris criterion, bounding critical exponents in the Anderson localization transition for noninteracting particles, as well as classical disordered spin systems. We then move on to apply our method to many-body localization. While in real space our critical exponent bound agrees with recent consensus, we find that, somewhat surprisingly, numerical results on Fock-space localization for limited-sized systems do not obey our bounds, indicating that the simulation results might not hold asymptotically (similarly to what is now believed to have occurred in the real-space problem). We also apply our approach to random quantum circuits with random measurements, for which we can derive bounds transcending recent mappings to percolation problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作从信息论视角研究含随机性的多体系统相变，如无序系统中的局域化以及带测量的随机量子线路。作者利用概率分布可区分性的论证，对控制关联长度或局域化长度的临界指数给出界限，并重新推导了安德森局域化和经典无序自旋系统中的 Harris 判据。随后方法被应用于多体局域化；摘要显示其实空间界限与近期共识一致，但在 Fock 空间局域化方面与数值结果的关系呈现出意外特征。
authors: Noa Feldman, Niv Davidson, Moshe Goldstein

articles.title: Long-Lived Coherence between Incoherent Excitons revealed by Time-Resolved ARPES: An Exact Solution
articles.title_zh: 时间分辨 ARPES 揭示非相干激子之间的长寿命相干性：一个精确解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.08162v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the exciton dynamics in an exactly solvable two-band model for semiconductors. The model incorporates light-matter, electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions, and captures exciton formation as well as the transition from the coherent to the incoherent regime. We analyze excitonic polarization, populations and coherences, with special focus on their impact in Time-Resolved and Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (TR-ARPES). For nonresonant pumping with below-gap photon energies, TR-ARPES spectra reveal distinct excitonic replica and quantum beats persisting in the incoherent regime. These are due to a coherence between different species of em incoherent excitons. Such type of coherence is resistant to phonon dephasing, indicating that it follows different dynamics than those governing the coherences considered so far.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在一个可精确求解的半导体双能带模型中考察激子动力学，模型包含光-物质、电子-电子和电子-声子相互作用，并描述激子形成及从相干到非相干机制的转变。作者分析激子极化、布居和相干性，重点讨论其在时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱中的表现。对于低于带隙能量的非共振泵浦，谱中出现可在非相干区域持续存在的激子复制峰和量子拍频，来源于不同非相干激子种类之间的相干性，并且对声子退相干具有较强抵抗力。
authors: Zhenlin Zhang, Wei Hu, Enrico Perfetto, Gianluca Stefanucci

articles.title: Long-Time Limits of Local Operator Entanglement in Interacting Integrable Models
articles.title_zh: 相互作用可积模型中局域算符纠缠的长时间极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.09578v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We explore the long-time behavior of Local Operator Entanglement entropy (LOE) in finite-size interacting integrable systems. For certain operators in the Rule 54 automaton, we prove that the LOE saturates to a value that is at most logarithmic in system size. This bound extends previous work [PRL 122, 250603; Commun. Math. Phys. 371, 651-688] showing LOE grows logarithmically in the early time regime, tłl L, to the late time regime, tgg L . However, the late-time logarithmic bound relies on a feature of Rule 54 that does not generalize to other interacting integrable systems: namely, that there are only two types of quasiparticles, and therefore only two possible values of the phase shift between quasiparticles. We present a heuristic argument, supported by numerical evidence, that for generic interacting integrable systems (such as the Heisenberg spin chain) the saturated value of the LOE is volume-law in system size.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究有限尺寸相互作用可积系统中局域算符纠缠熵的长时间行为。对于 Rule 54 自动机中的某些算符，作者证明局域算符纠缠在长时间后饱和值至多随系统尺寸对数增长，从而将早期时间的对数增长结果扩展到晚期时间。作者指出该界限依赖于 Rule 54 只有两类准粒子及有限相移取值这一特殊性质；数值和启发式论证表明，在海森堡自旋链等一般相互作用可积系统中，饱和值可能呈体积律。

articles.title: Metastable short-range charge order in superconducting CuxTiSe2
articles.title_zh: 超导 CuxTiSe2 中的亚稳短程电荷有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.03176v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In a vast array of materials, including cuprates, transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) and rare earth tritellurides, superconductivity is found in the vicinity of short-range charge density wave (CDW) order. The crossover from long-range to short-range charge order often occurs as quenched disorder is introduced, yet it is unclear how this disorder disrupts the CDW. Here, using x-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS), we investigate the prototypical TMD superconductor CuxTiSe2 and show that disorder induces substantial CDW dynamics. We observe CDW phase fluctuations on a timescale of minutes to hours above the nominal transition temperature while the order parameter amplitude remains finite. These long timescale fluctuations prevent the system from finding the global free energy minimum upon cooling and ultimately traps it in a short-range ordered metastable state. Our findings demonstrate how correlated disorder can give rise to a distinct mechanism of domain formation that may be advantageous to the emergence of superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 X 射线光子相关谱研究原型过渡金属二硫族化物超导体 CuxTiSe2 中无序对电荷密度波的影响。结果显示，无序会诱导显著的电荷密度波动力学：在名义转变温度以上，电荷有序相位在分钟到小时尺度上涨落，而序参量幅度仍保持有限。这些长时间尺度涨落使系统在冷却时难以达到全局自由能最低态，最终陷入短程有序的亚稳态，揭示了相关无序促进畴形成并可能有利于超导出现的一种机制。
authors: Thomas Sutter, Colleen Lindenau, Shivani Sharma, Andrei Fluerasu, Lutz Wiegart, Goran Karapetrov, Anshul Kogar, Xiaoqian M Chen

articles.title: Rhombohedral graphite junctions as a platform for continuous tuning between topologically trivial and non-trivial electronic phases
articles.title_zh: 菱方石墨结作为在拓扑平庸与非平庸电子相之间连续调控的平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.06759v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Manipulating the topological properties of quantum states can provide a way to protect them against disorder. However, typically, changing the topology of electronic states in a crystalline material is challenging because their nature is underpinned by chemical composition and lattice symmetry that are difficult to modify. We propose junctions between rhombohedral graphite crystals as a platform that enables smooth transition between topologically trivial and non-trivial regimes distinguished by the absence or presence of topological junction states. By invoking an analogy with the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, the appearance of topological states is related to the symmetry of the atomic stacking at the interface between the crystals. The possibility to explore both the topological and non-topological phases is provided by sliding the crystals with respect to each other.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出菱方石墨晶体之间的结可作为调控电子态拓扑性质的平台，实现从拓扑平庸到非平庸区域的平滑过渡。作者借助 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型类比，将拓扑结态的出现与晶体界面处原子堆垛的对称性联系起来。通过相对滑移两块晶体，可以探索有无拓扑界面态的不同相区。
authors: Luke Soneji, Simon Crampin, Marcin Mucha-Kruczynski

articles.title: Symmetry and Self-Bound Droplets in Dipolar Molecular Gases
articles.title_zh: 偶极分子气体中的对称性与自束缚液滴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.04634v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent experiments with degenerate molecular gases dressed by elliptically polarized microwave fields have enabled new control of dipolar interactions via engineered anisotropy. We reveal a symmetry structure of the dipolar interaction that generates degeneracies among the interaction parameters, enabling a classification of spatial symmetries and equilibrium shapes of the gases. Exploiting these symmetries, we analyze solutions including beyond-meanfield quantum fluctuations, and develop a complementary variational theory. We map out the phase diagram of self-bound droplets and characterize their widths, energies, and densities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注由椭圆偏振微波场修饰的简并分子气体中可工程化各向异性偶极相互作用。作者揭示了偶极相互作用的对称结构及其导致的相互作用参数简并性，并据此分类气体的空间对称性和平衡形状。在包含超越平均场量子涨落的理论框架下，研究给出自束缚液滴的相图，并表征其宽度、能量和密度。

articles.title: Quantifying robustness and locality of Majorana bound states in interacting systems
articles.title_zh: 相互作用系统中马约拉纳束缚态的鲁棒性与局域性量化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.20538v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Protecting qubits from perturbations is a central challenge in quantum computing. Topological superconductors with separated Majorana bound states (MBSs) provide a strong form of protection that only depends on the locality of perturbations. While the link between MBS separation, robust degeneracy, and protected braiding is well understood in non-interacting systems, recent experimental progress in short quantum-dot-based Kitaev chains highlights the need to establish these connections rigorously for interacting systems. We do this by defining MBSs from many-body ground states and show how their locality constrains their coupling to an environment. This, in turn, quantifies the protection of the energy degeneracy and the feasibility of non-abelian braiding.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作旨在为含相互作用的拓扑超导系统中马约拉纳束缚态的保护机制建立严格联系。作者从多体基态出发定义马约拉纳束缚态，并说明其局域性如何限制其与环境扰动的耦合。由此可以量化能量简并的保护程度以及实现非阿贝尔编织的可行性，尤其服务于短量子点 Kitaev 链等近期实验平台。
authors: William Samuelson, Juan Daniel Torres Luna, Sebastian Miles, A. Mert Bozkurt, Martin Leijnse, Michael Wimmer, Viktor Svensson

articles.title: Simulating fermionic fractional Chern insulators with infinite projected entangled-pair states
articles.title_zh: 用无限投影纠缠对态模拟费米子分数量子陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20697v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Infinite projected entangled-pair states (iPEPS) provide a powerful variational framework for two-dimensional quantum matter and have been widely used to capture bosonic topological order, including chiral spin liquids. Here we extend this approach to emphfermionic topological order by variationally optimizing U(1)-symmetric fermionic iPEPS for a fractional Chern insulator (FCI), with bond dimensions up to D=9. We find evidence for a critical bond dimension, above which the ansatz faithfully represents the FCI phase. The FCI state is characterized using bulk observables, including the equal-time single-particle Green's function and the pair-correlation function, as well as the momentum-resolved edge entanglement spectrum. To enable entanglement-spectrum calculations for large iPEPS unit cells, we introduce a compression scheme and show that the low-lying part of the spectrum is already well converged at relatively small cutoff dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将无限投影纠缠对态方法扩展到费米子拓扑有序体系，通过优化具有 U(1) 对称性的费米子 iPEPS 来模拟分数量子陈绝缘体。作者使用最高 D=9 的键维，发现存在一个临界键维，超过该值后变分态能较可靠地表示 FCI 相。研究通过体内观测量、单粒子格林函数、配对关联函数以及动量分辨边缘纠缠谱来表征该相，并提出压缩方案以便在大单胞 iPEPS 中计算纠缠谱。
authors: Hao Chen, Titus Neupert, Juraj Hasik

articles.title: Electronic Nematicity Revealed by Polarized Ultrafast Spectroscopy in Bilayer La₃Ni₂O₇
articles.title_zh: 偏振超快光谱揭示双层 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中的电子向列性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.01702v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a polarized ultrafast pump-probe study of the normal-state electronic dynamics in bilayer La₃Ni₂O₇ and trilayer La₄Ni₃O₁₀ single crystals at ambient pressure. While both nickelates exhibit density-wave (DW) transitions accompanied by the opening of a quasiparticle relaxation bottleneck, their electronic responses display strikingly different symmetry properties. La4Ni3O10 maintains an isotropic optical response across the entire temperature range. In contrast, La₃Ni₂O₇ exhibits a pronounced twofold (C₂₎ anisotropy in its lowtemperature electronic dynamics. This electronic nematicity, evident in both the relaxation dynamics and the polarization-dependent effective bottleneck energy scales, is strongly modified below 115 K, suggesting coupling or competition with a secondary DW-like instability reported by complementary probes. The presence of macroscopic electronic anisotropy in the bilayer system, and its absence in the trilayer system, suggests a possible relation between electronic nematic correlations and the superconducting normal state in a₃Ni₂O₇ that deserves further exploration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在常压下对双层 La₃Ni₂O₇ 和三层 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 单晶的正常态电子动力学进行了偏振超快泵浦-探测研究。两种镍酸盐都表现出密度波转变及准粒子弛豫瓶颈的开启，但其电子响应对称性明显不同：La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 在整个温区保持各向同性，而 La₃Ni₂O₇ 在低温电子动力学中呈现显著的二重 C₂ 各向异性。该电子向列性在弛豫动力学和偏振依赖的有效瓶颈能标中均可见，并在 115 K 以下发生显著改变，暗示其可能与另一密度波样不稳定性耦合或竞争。
authors: Qi-Yi Wu, De-Yuan Hu, Chen Zhang, Hao Liu, Bo Chen, Ying Zhou, Zhong-Tuo Fu, Chun-Hui Lv, Zi-Jie Xu, Hai-Long Deng, Meng-Wu Huo, H. Y. Liu, Jun Liu, Yu-Xia Duan, Dao-Xin Yao, Meng Wang, Jian-Qiao Meng

articles.title: Integral formula for the propagator of the one-dimensional Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 一维 Hubbard 模型传播子的积分公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.21541v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an exact integral formula for the multi-particle propagator of the one-dimensional Fermi--Hubbard model on an infinite lattice. The proof is based on the nested Bethe ansatz without relying on the string hypothesis. Our formula enables an explicit integral representation of the time evolution of arbitrary finite-particle wave functions and thereby provides a foundation for the exact analysis of nonequilibrium dynamics in the Hubbard model. It can further be applied to related open quantum models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作给出无限晶格上一维费米 Hubbard 模型多粒子传播子的精确积分公式。证明基于嵌套 Bethe Ansatz，且不依赖弦假设。该公式为任意有限粒子波函数的时间演化提供显式积分表示，从而为 Hubbard 模型非平衡动力学的精确分析奠定基础，并可推广应用于相关开放量子模型。
authors: Taiki Ishiyama, Kazuya Fujimoto, Tomohiro Sasamoto

articles.title: Disordering a permutation symmetric system: revivals, thermalization and chaos
articles.title_zh: 扰乱置换对称系统：复现、热化与混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.24453v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This study explores the effects of introducing a symmetry breaking disorder on the dynamics of a system invariant under particle permutation. The disorder forces quantum states, confined to the N+1 dimensional completely symmetric space to penetrate the exponentially large 2^N dimensional Hilbert space of N particles. In particular, we focus on the quantum kicked top as a Floquet system of N qubits, and use linear entropy, measuring single qubit entanglement, to investigate the changes in the time scales and values of saturation when disorder is introduced. In the near-integrable regime of the kicked top, we study the robustness of quantum revivals to disorder. We also find that a classical calculation yields the quantum single qubit entanglement to remarkable accuracy in the disorder free limit. The disorder, on the other hand, is modeled in the form of noise which again fits well with the numerical calculations. We measure the extent to which the dynamics is retained within the symmetric subspace and its spreading to the full Hilbert space using different quantities. We show that increasing disorder drives the system to a chaotic phase in full Hilbert space, as also supported by the spectral statistics. We find that there is robustness to disorder in the system, and this is a function of how chaotic the kicked top is.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察在粒子置换对称系统中引入破缺对称性的无序后，对动力学产生的影响。作者以由 N 个量子比特构成的量子 kicked top Floquet 系统为例，研究原本局限于 N+1 维完全对称子空间的量子态如何渗入 2^N 维完整希尔伯特空间，并用单量子比特纠缠的线性熵分析无序引入后的时间尺度和饱和值变化。在近可积区域，工作讨论量子复现对无序的鲁棒性，并比较经典计算、噪声建模与数值结果；摘要末尾被截断，更完整的热化或混沌结论需查阅原文。
authors: Manju C, Uma Divakaran, Arul Lakshminarayan

articles.title: Spectral properties and coding transitions of Haar-random quantum codes
articles.title_zh: Haar 随机量子码的谱性质与编码相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.07396v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A quantum error-correcting code with a nonzero error threshold undergoes a mixed-state phase transition when the error rate reaches that threshold. We explore this phase transition for Haar-random quantum codes, in which the logical information is encoded in a random subspace of the physical Hilbert space. We focus on the spectrum of the encoded system density matrix as a function of the rate of uncorrelated, single-qudit errors. For low error rates, this spectrum consists of well-separated bands, representing errors of different weights. As the error rate increases, the bands for high-weight errors merge. The evolution of these bands with increasing error rate is well described by a simple analytic ansatz. Using this ansatz, as well as an explicit calculation, we show that the threshold for Haar-random quantum codes saturates the hashing bound, and thus coincides with that for random stabilizer codes. For error rates that exceed the hashing bound, typical errors are uncorrectable, but postselected error correction remains possible until a much higher detection threshold. Postselection can in principle be implemented by projecting onto subspaces corresponding to low-weight errors, which remain correctable past the hashing bound.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察 Haar 随机量子纠错码在非相关单量子位/量子位元错误作用下的混合态相变，重点分析编码系统密度矩阵谱随错误率变化的行为。低错误率时，谱由对应不同错误权重的分离能带组成；错误率升高后，高权重错误能带逐渐合并。作者提出解析拟设并结合显式计算，表明 Haar 随机量子码的阈值达到哈希界，且与随机稳定子码一致；超过该界后典型错误不可纠正，但后选择纠错可持续到更高的探测阈值。
authors: Grace M. Sommers, J. Alexander Jacoby, Zack Weinstein, David A. Huse, Sarang Gopalakrishnan

articles.title: Additivity of disjoint interval entanglement in quasiparticle excited states
articles.title_zh: 准粒子激发态中不相交区间纠缠的可加性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.03651v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate mixed-state entanglement measures, namely reflected entropy, mutual information and logarithmic negativity, for two disjoint intervals in one-dimensional systems excited by a finite number of quasiparticles. While whole system is in a pure state, the two disjoint intervals are in a generically mixed state. To address the problem that natural subsystem bases are generically non-orthonormal in such excited states, we use a general and efficient algorithm that computes these measures directly from the density matrix expressed in an arbitrary non-orthonormal basis. Applying this method to classical, bosonic, and fermionic quasiparticle excitations on a circle, we discover a universal additivity property: in the limit of large momentum differences, the mixed-state entanglement of a multi-quasiparticle state decomposes exactly into the sum of independent contributions. This additivity unifies the entanglement behavior across classical and quantum statistics, with the classical result emerging naturally as a special case. Our findings establish a robust computational framework for mixed-state entanglement in excited many-body systems and reveal a generic decoupling mechanism that governs entanglement distribution beyond the ground state.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究一维系统中有限数目准粒子激发态下两个不相交区间的混合态纠缠度量，包括反射熵、互信息和对数负性。为处理激发态中自然子系统基通常非正交的问题，作者采用一种可直接在任意非正交基密度矩阵上计算这些量的通用算法。应用于圆上的经典、玻色和费米准粒子激发后，研究发现大动量差极限下多准粒子态的混合态纠缠可精确分解为独立贡献之和，从而揭示跨统计类型的普适可加性。

articles.title: Metasurfaces for neutral-atom trapping
articles.title_zh: 用于中性原子俘获的超表面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trapped neutral atoms are one of the leading platforms for quantum information technologies, in particular for quantum computing, but scaling them to array sizes needed for utility-scale quantum computing is a major engineering challenge. Here we review optical metasurfaces as an enabling technology that provides fine control over the phase, amplitude, and polarization of light, with pixel counts far exceeding what is available with spatial light modulators (SLMs) and other active devices. The large pixel counts have recently led to demonstrations of arrays of optical tweezers with hundreds of thousands of sites and arrays of optical bottle-beams with complex three-dimensional trapping profiles. The flexibility and scalability of optical metasurfaces provides a route towards miniaturized, integrated, and highly scalable atomic experiments and instruments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述讨论光学超表面在俘获中性原子量子信息平台中的作用，尤其面向扩展到实用量子计算所需的大规模阵列。超表面能够精细控制光的相位、振幅和偏振，并提供远超空间光调制器等有源器件的像素数量。近期相关技术已实现包含数十万个光镊位点的阵列以及具有复杂三维俘获轮廓的光瓶束阵列，为小型化、集成化和高度可扩展的原子实验与仪器提供了路径。
authors: Chengyu Fang, Minjeong Kim, Mark Saffman, Jennifer T. Choy, Mikhail Kats

articles.title: Quantum Photonic Time Crystals: From Temporal Boundaries to Floquet Light-Matter Interactions
articles.title_zh: 量子光子时间晶体：从时间边界到 Floquet 光—物质相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic time crystals (PTCs) are temporally periodic media whose Floquet spectra can exhibit momentum gaps, parametric amplification, and effective non-Hermitian descriptions, making them an idealized setting for vacuum amplification and nonequilibrium light-matter dynamics. Their classical electrodynamics is now well developed; the quantum side is less so, and this focused review is an attempt to organize what exists. We trace that account from temporal boundaries to homogeneous Floquet media and light-matter dynamics. A single temporal boundary induces Bogoliubov mode mixing and photon-pair creation; in homogeneous bulk media, momentum conservation isolates counter-propagating (k,-k) sectors and yields a two-mode SU(1,1) squeezing structure. Temporal periodicity promotes this to a Floquet problem with band and momentum-gap regimes, compactly described in a fixed Nambu basis. We then relate PTCs to the dynamical Casimir effect and parametric amplification, which share the same pair-creation mechanism but organize it through discrete resonances rather than a momentum-resolved bulk spectrum. We close with light-matter settings: spontaneous-emission decay and modulation-assisted excitation, atom-PTC dynamics, LDOS-based observables and their limits, and finite, dispersive, and experimentally accessible platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该聚焦综述梳理光子时间晶体的量子理论，从单个时间边界延伸到均匀 Floquet 介质及光—物质动力学。单一时间边界可引起 Bogoliubov 模混合和光子对产生；在均匀体介质中，动量守恒将反向传播的模对分离出来，并形成双模 SU(1,1) 压缩结构。时间周期性进一步将问题推广为具有能带与动量隙的 Floquet 谱，并与动力学 Casimir 效应和参量放大中的成对产生机制相联系。
authors: Younsung Kim, Kyungmin Lee, Kun Woo Kim, Bumki Min

articles.title: Optimal transition in underdamped systems with memory
articles.title_zh: 具有记忆效应的欠阻尼系统中的最优跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30897v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optimal finite-time control is essential for energy-efficient operation of nanoscale devices. While existing work has largely focused on transitions between equilibrium states in overdamped systems, many settings of practical interest -- including nanomechanical resonators, biomolecular conformational dynamics, and quantum Brownian motion -- are governed by underdamped dynamics where both particle inertia and frequency-dependent friction (memory) play a non-negligible role. In this study, we analytically and computationally investigate optimal transitions between nonequilibrium steady states (NESS) for an underdamped particle in a moving harmonic trap with general memory kernels. We find that inertia qualitatively alters optimal control in the presence of memory. Compared to the overdamped case, underdamped dynamics break the time-reversal symmetry, making the forward and backward optimal protocols fundamentally distinct. Across the memory-kernel types examined, the asymmetry, rather than the detailed form of the kernel, governs the structure of the optimal strategy. These results offer a unified framework for optimal control in underdamped systems with memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究解析和数值考察具有一般记忆核的欠阻尼粒子在移动谐波阱中不同非平衡稳态之间的有限时间最优控制。与以往多关注过阻尼平衡态跃迁的工作不同，本文纳入粒子惯性和频率依赖摩擦对最优策略的影响。结果表明，在存在记忆时惯性会定性改变最优控制，破坏过阻尼情形中的时间反演对称性，使正向与反向最优协议本质不同；不同记忆核下，主导策略结构的是这种不对称性而非核的具体形式。

articles.title: Universal free-space photonic circuits for polarized structured light
articles.title_zh: 用于偏振结构光的通用自由空间光子线路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traditional linear-optical schemes for implementing discrete unitary transformations rely on multi-channel interferometers, typically composed of regular meshes of beam splitters and phase shifters. These architectures are well-suited to integrated photonics, where scalability and miniaturization are central requirements. In free space, universal transformations of optical modes have often been pursued through propagation in structured or inverse-designed optical systems, offering advantages in terms of addressable optical modes, reconfigurability, and flexible detection schemes. Here, we present a complementary approach: a collinear free-space photonic circuit that implements the standard interferometric paradigm in a Hilbert space of polarized structured-light modes. The circuit exploits spin-orbit coupling between circular polarization and optical modes carrying quantized transverse momentum, so that conventional beam splitters and phase shifters are replaced by structured optical materials acting directly on selected spin-orbit modes. In our demonstration, liquid-crystal metasurfaces serve as mode beam splitters and phase shifters, and we experimentally realize representative gates in a four-mode space. We further show how the architecture generalizes to larger numbers of modes, providing a scalable route to arbitrary unitary transformations in free space. Numerical optimization over random target unitaries supports the universality of the proposed scheme. These results establish a framework for universal free-space photonic circuits encoded in structured light and structured matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种共线自由空间光子线路，在偏振结构光模的希尔伯特空间中实现标准干涉式离散酉变换范式。该方案利用圆偏振与携带量子化横向动量的光学模式之间的自旋—轨道耦合，以结构化光学材料替代传统分束器和相移器，并直接作用于选定的自旋—轨道模式。作者展示了基于液晶超表面的模式分束与相位调控，为自由空间中可重构、模式丰富的通用光学变换提供了补充路线。
authors: Dilip Paneru, Paola Savarese, Alessandro Bisio, Francesco Di Colandrea, Filippo Cardano

articles.title: Sharp periodic Ge concentration modulations beyond the conduction band valley wavevector k₀ in nuclear spin-free Si quantum wells
articles.title_zh: 无核自旋硅量子阱中超越导带谷波矢 k₀ 的尖锐周期性锗浓度调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31358v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic Ge modulations within strained Si quantum wells in SiGe heterostructures offer a route to deterministically enhance conduction-band valley splitting in Si, a key requirement for scalable spin-qubit quantum computing. Efficient enhancement requires modulations in the order of the Si valley wavevector k₀ (9.7 nm⁻¹), corresponding to a period of 0.64 nm and near-monolayer growth control. Using nuclear-spin-free molecular beam epitaxy with ²⁸Si and ⁷²Ge, we demonstrate Ge-modulated Si quantum wells with periods from 2.00 to 0.49 nm, including modulations at k₀ and 2k₀/3. Synchrotron X-ray techniques and scanning transmission electron microscopy reveal laterally homogeneous Ge modulations over micrometer scales, with amplitudes up to 10 at-% and gradients reaching 20 at-%/nm. Two-bands kḑotp simulations suggest deterministic enhancement of valley splittings in steep trapezoidal 2k₀/3 heterostructures, while the effect in k₀₋ₜype quantum wells is much weaker.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 SiGe 异质结构的应变硅量子阱中实现周期性 Ge 调制，以确定性增强硅导带谷劈裂，这是可扩展自旋量子位量子计算的重要需求。作者采用无核自旋的 ²⁸Si 和 ⁷²Ge 分子束外延，制备了周期从 2.00 nm 到 0.49 nm 的 Ge 调制硅量子阱，包括接近 k₀ 和 2k₀/3 的调制。同步辐射 X 射线与扫描透射电镜显示调制在微米尺度横向均匀，模拟表明陡峭梯形 2k₀/3 异质结构可显著增强谷劈裂，而 k₀ 型量子阱效果较弱。
authors: Ivo Rahlff, Carsten Richter, Martin Schmidbauer, Maximilian Oezkent, Thilo Remmele, Michael Hanke, Lars R. Schreiber, Denny Dütz, Sammy Umezawa, Martin Albrecht, Yann-Michel Niquet, Tancredi Salamone, Biel Martinez Diaz, Thomas Schroeder, Jens Martin, Kevin-P. Gradwohl

articles.title: All-Electron Relativistic Fully Self-Consistent GW Study of Heteronuclear Actinide-Containing Diatomics
articles.title_zh: 含锕系元素异核双原子分子的全电子相对论全自洽 GW 研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The fully self-consistent GW (scGW) approximation provides a Green's-function approach that is starting-point independent and offers a favorable cost-to-accuracy balance compared to high-level wavefunction methods. Here, we present an all-electron scGW study of uranium-containing diatomics (UC, UN, UO, and UF), incorporating relativistic effects through the exact two-component (X2C) formalism. We evaluate adiabatic ionization energies as well as electron-attachment and detachment energetics (AEA and VDE), together with equilibrium structures and harmonic vibrational frequencies, and we assess their sensitivity to basis-set choice and relativistic treatment. We find that scGW yields ionization energies and vibrational properties in very good agreement with experiment and high-accuracy theoretical estimates. For AEA and VDE, diffuse basis sets are essential for convergence. UF is a particularly challenging case for scalar relativistic methods because its electron-attachment and vertical detachment energies are strongly affected by spin--orbit coupling, highlighting the need for a variational two-component treatment. These results establish all-electron X2C-scGW as a practical route for accurate actinide-molecule energetics and spectroscopy and motivate future applications to larger uranium-containing systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用全电子全自洽 GW 方法研究含铀双原子分子 UC、UN、UO 和 UF，并通过精确双分量形式纳入相对论效应。作者计算了绝热电离能、电子附着与脱附能、平衡结构和谐振动频率，并评估其对基组选择和相对论处理的敏感性。结果显示 scGW 在电离能和振动性质上与实验及高精度理论吻合良好；对于电子附着和垂直脱附能，弥散基组至关重要，而 UF 尤其需要包含自旋—轨道耦合的变分双分量处理。
authors: Jacob Adamski, Vibin Abraham, Dominika Zgid

articles.title: Dissipative generation of spin squeezing in the resolved vacuum Rabi splitting limit
articles.title_zh: 解析真空 Rabi 劈裂极限下自旋压缩的耗散生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30815v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Harnessing dissipation in the presence of strong symmetries has recently emerged as a promising route for generating entanglement in atomic clocks. However, previous proposals relied on regimes where cavity photons can be adiabatically eliminated, significantly limiting their applicability to experimentally relevant cavity-QED regimes that lie in or near the resolved vacuum Rabi splitting regime. Here we show that symmetry-protected dissipative spin squeezing can be realized even when cavity photons actively participate in the dynamics, extending the experimental relevance of the protocol.
