We study a three-level ensemble of ⁸⁷Sr atoms coupled to an optical cavity in the resolved vacuum Rabi splitting regime and demonstrate that, with smooth ramps of the drive amplitude and detunings, the driven-dissipative dynamics enters a stable low-photon regime in which nonadiabatic cavity excitations and sector-resolving photon leakage can be controlled. Within this low-photon operating window, sector-resolving photon leakage is suppressed and the sector-dependent geometric phase realizes effective one-axis twisting. At the end of the protocol the entanglement can also be efficiently transferred directly onto the long-lived clock states by turning the drive off. For experimentally realistic parameters, we theoretically show that more than 25,dB of squeezing can be generated for 10⁵ atoms, closely saturating the ideal one-axis twisting scaling ξₘᵢₙ² propto N⁻²/³. At fixed cooperativity, the optimized squeezing remains broadly comparable to the unresolved-regime implementation, while the resolved-regime implementation reaches comparable squeezing on a substantially shorter physical timescale. These results establish symmetry-protected dissipative dynamics as a practical route to beyond the standard-quantum-limit performance in optical-clock platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在腔光子不能被绝热消去、并主动参与动力学的解析真空 Rabi 劈裂区，仍可实现受对称性保护的耗散自旋压缩。作者研究耦合到光学腔的三能级 ⁸⁷Sr 原子系综，证明通过平滑调节驱动振幅和失谐，可进入稳定的低光子工作区间，从而控制非绝热腔激发和区分对称扇区的光子泄漏。在该区间内，扇区分辨泄漏受到抑制，扇区依赖的几何相位可实现有效单轴扭转，为原子钟中的纠缠生成拓展了实验适用范围。
authors: Edwin Chaparro, Eric Yilun Song, Diego Barberena, James K. Thompson, Ana Maria Rey, Jeremy T. Young

articles.title: Shallow Electronic State Preparation for Quantum Chemistry with Quantum Monte Carlo Pre-Selection
articles.title_zh: 结合量子蒙特卡罗预筛选的量子化学浅层电子态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31139v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum computers hold great promise for molecular simulation, but noise remains a fundamental obstacle. We introduce a Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) pre-screening procedure that constructs compact, physically motivated Givens rotation ansätze tailored to realistic quantum hardware. By identifying the most important wavefunction contributions early in a QMC simulation, we build circuits that are shallower that conventional alternatives while preserving number symmetry. Benchmarked on Quantinuum System Model H1, QMC-prescreened circuits outperform more complex ansätze under realistic noise conditions. The method offers a practical path toward chemical accuracy on quantum devices, by providing an adjustable trade-off between expressivity and circuit depth to generate shallow circuits suited to current high-noise devices, as well as deeper, more expressive circuits that can be deployed on future lower-noise devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种量子蒙特卡罗预筛选流程，用于构建紧凑且具有物理动机的 Givens 旋转 ansatz，以适配现实量子硬件上的分子模拟。通过在量子蒙特卡罗模拟早期识别波函数中最重要的贡献，所构造线路比传统替代方案更浅，同时保持粒子数对称性。在 Quantinuum System Model H1 的基准测试中，预筛选线路在现实噪声条件下优于更复杂 ansatz，并为在当前高噪声设备及未来低噪声设备上实现化学精度提供了可调的表达能力—线路深度折中。
authors: Eline Welling, Lila Cadi-Tazi, Alex J. W. Thom, Maria-Andreea Filip

articles.title: Representations for multidimensional down-down deconvolution of ocean-bottom seismic data: theory and practical implications
articles.title_zh: 海底地震数据多维下行—下行反褶积的表示：理论与实践意义
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.13123v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multidimensional up-down deconvolution effectively eliminates surface-related multiples from ocean-bottom seismic data. Recently, several down-down deconvolution methods have been introduced as attractive alternatives. Whereas multidimensional up-down deconvolution fully accounts for lateral variations of the medium parameters, the underlying theory of some of the down-down deconvolution methods is essentially based on the assumption that the medium is horizontally layered. Using reciprocity theory, this assumption is circumvented. This leads to representations for either receiver-side or source-side multidimensional down-down deconvolution. Compared with multidimensional up-down deconvolution, receiver-side down-down deconvolution only utilizes the downgoing part of the wavefield that better samples the shallow subsurface, but it is not entirely data-driven. Source-side down-down deconvolution benefits from the better sampled source array, but in the presence of sparsely sampled receivers it requires solving an underdetermined system of linear equations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究海底地震数据中多维下行—下行反褶积方法的理论表示，并与多维上行—下行反褶积相比较。传统上行—下行反褶积能有效去除与海面相关的多次波并充分考虑介质横向变化，而部分下行—下行方法的理论基础依赖水平层状介质假设；作者利用互易性理论绕开了这一限制。研究给出了接收端或震源端多维下行—下行反褶积表示，并指出前者更好利用浅层采样的下行波场但并非完全数据驱动，后者受益于震源阵列采样但在接收器稀疏时需处理欠定线性方程组。
authors: Kees Wapenaar, Matteo Ravasi, Claudio Bagaini

articles.title: Variational quantum algorithm for anion exchange across electrolyzer membrane
articles.title_zh: 用于电解槽膜中阴离子交换的变分量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.01120v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a variational quantum algorithm that solves the one-dimensional diffusion problem with a space-dependent diffusion constant D(x). This problem is relevant for the exchange of hydroxide ions across a two-layer membrane in an alkaline electrolyzer, where the concentration of OH⁻ ion determines the chemical stability for longer time periods. We use 16 to 64 grid points across the membrane, resulting from n=4 to 6 data qubits for the ideal statevector and shot-based quantum simulations implemented using Qiskit. For these qubit numbers, the depth of the parametric quantum circuit has been chosen to ensure sufficient expressibility. The state preparation requires particular attention since the diffusivity D is piecewise constant in the different layers with discontinuities at the interface. Furthermore, we compare different classical optimization schemes with respect to their convergence in the VQA method. We demonstrate the applicability of the quantum algorithm to a problem with non-trivial boundary conditions and jump conditions of the diffusion constant and outline possible extensions of the proof-of-concept application case of quantum computing. Our simulations show that pronounced hydroxide ion concentration gradients, and thus chemical instabilities, can occur only when the ratio of diffusivity in both layers of the membrane exceeds approximately 50.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种变分量子算法，用于求解具有空间依赖扩散系数 D(x) 的一维扩散问题，该问题对应碱性电解槽双层膜中氢氧根离子的交换过程。作者使用 16 至 64 个网格点，即 n=4 至 6 个数据量子位，在 Qiskit 中开展理想态矢量和基于采样的量子模拟，并选择合适的参数化线路深度以保证表达能力。研究特别处理了不同膜层中分段常数扩散率及界面不连续带来的态制备问题，并比较了多种经典优化方案在 VQA 中的收敛表现。
authors: Timur Gubaev, Philipp Pfeffer, Christian Dreßler, Jörg Schumacher

articles.title: QASM-Eval: A Dataset to Train and Evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3 Beyond Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: QASM-Eval：用于训练和评估大语言模型处理超越量子线路的 OpenQASM-3 数据集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30358v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computing remains in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, where the performance is highly constrained to noise. Addressing the limitation often requires hardware-facing capabilities beyond gate-sequence circuit specification, including mid-circuit measurement and classical feedback for quantum error correction (QEC), precise timing control for dynamical decoupling (DD), and pulse-level waveform access for calibration. OpenQASM-3 was introduced to expose exactly these capabilities, providing a hardware-level programming interface. However, despite the rapid progress of large language models in code generation, there is still no dataset specifically designed to train and evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3 programs that involve its advanced hardware-oriented features. To address this gap, we introduce QASM-Eval, the first comprehensive dataset designed to train and evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3. Rather than focusing on quantum algorithm design or reasoning, QASM-Eval explicitly targets the language's hardware-facing features. QASM-Eval comprises an expert-verified test set of 100 tasks and a training set of 4,000 tasks, systematically covering classical logic, timing scheduling, pulse control, and complex real-world workflows. To automatically validate generated programs, we check syntax, quantum states and program timeline using an extended verifier. Our evaluation reveals that while state-of-the-art LLMs struggle heavily in OpenQASM-3 coding tasks, targeted fine-tuning on QASM-Eval yields significant gains. QASM-Eval provides a crucial benchmark and training foundation to accelerate the development of reliable LLM assistants for hardware-facing quantum programming in NISQ era. Data and code: https://github.com/fuzhenxiao/QASM-Eval
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算仍处于噪声中等规模量子时代，许多关键任务需要超越门序列线路描述的硬件级能力，如中途测量、经典反馈、精确定时控制和脉冲级访问。本文提出 QASM-Eval，这是首个面向 OpenQASM-3 高级硬件特性的综合数据集，用于训练和评估大语言模型生成相关程序的能力。该数据集包含经专家验证的 100 个测试任务和 4000 个训练任务，重点不在量子算法推理，而在硬件接口与语言特性的实际使用。
authors: Zhenxiao Fu, Lei Jiang, Fan Chen

articles.title: Mass-Manufacturable Germanium Photodetectors for Beyond-448-Gbps-Class Operation on a Monolithic Silicon Photonics Platform
articles.title_zh: 面向超过 448 Gbps 级单片硅光子平台运行的可大规模制造锗光电探测器
articles.abstract: The explosive growth of artificial intelligence (AI) and high‑performance computing (HPC) workloads is placing increasingly stringent demands on optical interconnects for fast, reliable, and mass‑manufacturable photonic receivers 1–3. Germanium (Ge)-on-silicon (Si) photodetectors have demonstrated impressive bandwidth and responsivity, yet large-signal operation beyond 400 Gbps per wavelength has remained largely inaccessible in foundry-compatible platforms 4–6. Here we show that a mass-manufacturable 300 mm monolithic complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) silicon photonics (SiPh) platform can overcome this limitation. An O‑band Ge‑on‑Si lateral photodetector achieves large‑signal data rates exceeding 448 Gbps per wavelength with four‑level pulse‑amplitude modulation (PAM4) and 520 Gbps with six‑level pulse‑amplitude modulation (PAM6) at a photocurrent of ~2 mA. This performance is enabled by an optoelectronic bandwidth of up to ~215 GHz, near‑unity quantum efficiency, and a record bandwidth-responsivity product exceeding ~217 GHz·A W⁻¹ - more than 2 times higher than the previous best of 108 GHz·A W⁻¹ for waveguide‑coupled Ge photodiodes - while sustaining optical input powers up to 2.8 mW and maintaining sub‑38 nA dark current at -1 V bias. Crucially, these metrics are attained without inductive peaking, avalanche gain, or transimpedance-amplifier (TIA) integration, with uniform high-speed characteristics across a full 300 mm wafer, underscoring production-level reproducibility. The same platform supports high speed depletion mode, travelling wave Si Mach-Zehnder modulators (MZMs) capable of ≥400 Gbps per wavelength operation without digital signal processing (DSP), precision silicon nitride (SiN) wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) filters with sub 1.5 nanometre channel stability, low loss detachable fibre-chip input-output (I/O) (~1 dB per facet), co integrated CMOS circuits using ≥350 GHz class ft transistors, and advanced wafer level packaging features. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first monolithic CMOS silicon photonics foundry platform uniting ≥400 Gbps-class transmitter and receiver functions on a single substrate, providing a scalable foundation for next-generation pluggable, near- and co-packaged (NPO/CPO) optical interconnects in AI/HPC systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能和高性能计算负载的快速增长对高速、可靠且可量产的光互连接收器提出了更高要求。本文展示了基于 300 mm 单片 CMOS 硅光子平台的 O 波段 Ge-on-Si 横向光电探测器，可在每波长超过 448 Gbps 的 PAM4 和 520 Gbps 的 PAM6 大信号条件下工作。其性能得益于约 215 GHz 的光电带宽、接近统一的量子效率以及创纪录的带宽-响应度乘积，表明代工兼容平台有望支持超 400 Gbps/波长的光接收应用。

articles.title: Constraining the astrophysical i process: The ⁸⁷Kr(n,γ)⁸⁸Kr reaction rate
articles.title_zh: 约束天体物理 i 过程：⁸⁷Kr(n,γ)⁸⁸Kr 反应率
articles.abstract: Author(s): S. Uthayakumaar, A. Spyrou, C. Harris, P. A. Denissenkov, D. Mücher, H. C. Berg, J. A. Clark, P. A. DeYoung, A. C. Dombos, B. Greaves, M. Guttormsen, F. Herwig, A. C. Larsen, S. N. Liddick, S. Lyons, J. Owens-Fryar, A. Palmisano-Kyle, G. Perdikakis, A. L. Richard, D. Santiago-Gonzalez, G. Savard, S. Siem, M. K. Smith, W. W. von Seeger, and M. Wiedeking A key goal in nuclear astrophysics is explaining the abundance patterns of the elements in combination with observational astrophysical data and nuclear reaction networks. Although two nuclear reaction pathways—the slow ( s process) and rapid ( r process) neutron capture processes—are known to produce many heavy elements beyond iron, a process at intermediate neutron densities (the i process) has been proposed. This process is an additional pathway that occurs in some stellar environments to explain observed elemental abundances. In this work, the authors utilized a 88 Br beam that was implanted within a γ -ray total absorption spectrometer to produce the compound nucleus 88 Kr through β decay. The authors measured the constrained neutron radiative capture on 87 Kr, showing that it plays an important role in the production of Rb in the conditions of the i process. In addition, the results significantly reduce the uncertainty in the rate of this reaction by determining the γ -ray strength function in the compound nucleus 88 Kr. This work demonstrates that reducing experimental uncertainties in a single neutron-capture reaction can significantly affect comparisons with theoretical predictions of element abundance patterns. [Phys. Rev. C 113, 065801] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 核天体物理的一个核心目标是结合观测数据和核反应网络解释元素丰度模式，除慢中子俘获和快中子俘获过程外，中等中子密度下的 i 过程被认为可解释某些恒星环境中的丰度特征。本文利用植入 γ 射线总吸收谱仪的 ⁸⁸Br 束流，经 β 衰变产生 ⁸⁸Kr 复合核，从而约束 ⁸⁷Kr 的中子辐射俘获反应。研究表明该反应率对 i 过程核合成具有重要影响，有助于改进相关元素丰度预测。

Giri Despite the conventional requirement of simultaneous spatial inversion and time-reversal symmetry breaking for magnetoelectric (ME) coupling, the authors demonstrate here a linear ME effect without long-range magnetic order, evidenced by the lack of magnetic Bragg peaks in neutron diffraction. Remarkably, a novel glassy ME response is also uncovered, closely linked to the cluster-glass state. The coexistence of static linear and glassy ME responses in the cluster-glass regime raises fundamental questions about the nature of symmetry-driven ME coupling in disordered magnetic systems. articles.title: Exact expression for the Berry connection in the projection gauge
articles.title_zh: 投影规范中贝里联络的精确表达式
articles.abstract: Author(s): Trey Cole and David Vanderbilt The Berry connection underlies all of quantum geometry, but suffers from a gauge freedom that frequently impedes practical calculations. A common solution, often used in Wannier construction, fixes the gauge via projection onto localized trial functions, with the Berry connection computed by finite differences in reciprocal space. Here, the authors derive an exact, closed-form expression for the Berry connection in the projection gauge, thereby avoiding finite differences and allowing numerically stable calculations of quantities such as the Chern-Simons axion angle. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 245106] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 贝里联络是量子几何的基础，但其规范自由度常给实际计算带来困难。本文针对常用于 Wannier 构造的投影规范，推导出贝里联络的精确闭式表达式，从而避免在倒易空间中使用有限差分。该结果有助于提升诸如 Chern-Simons 轴子角等量的数值计算稳定性和精度。

articles.title: Machine learning accelerated nonadiabatic molecular dynamics of defect-mediated recombination in alkali metal passivated Cu 2 ZnSnS 4
articles.title_zh: 机器学习加速的碱金属钝化 Cu2ZnSnS4 中缺陷介导复合的非绝热分子动力学研究
articles.abstract: Nonradiative electron–hole recombination mediated by defects is a critical loss mechanism in semiconductors and requires computationally demanding nonadiabatic (NA) molecular dynamics simulations. In this work, we develop a machine learning-accelerated framework to model long-time NA couplings in Cu 2 ZnSnS 4 containing Cu Zn antisites and Cu Zn + Zn Cu antisite pairs, with and without alkali metal passivation. By formulating NA coupling evolution as a time-series prediction problem, we benchmark 37 representative deep learning architectures, including recurrent neural networks, convolutional neural networks, transformers, and hybrid models. Among them, the extended long short-term memory model achieves the best overall performance, yielding an average test set R 2 of 0.98 while maintaining high computational efficiency. This approach enables accurate reconstruction of long-time NA coupling trajectories at a prediction cost reduced by over five orders of magnitude relative to repeated direct first-principles NA coupling evaluations. The application of the framework shows that alkali metal doping systematically reduces the NA coupling strength and accelerates decoherence, with Li exhibiting the strongest suppression of recombination, which is associated with enhanced charge localization and lattice fluctuations. The predicted recombination lifetimes agree closely with first-principles results, validating the reliability of the machine learning approach. This work establishes a generalizable strategy for machine learning-assisted NA dynamics simulations and provides mechanistic insights into defect-mediated recombination processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对半导体中由缺陷介导的非辐射电子—空穴复合，建立了机器学习加速的长时间非绝热耦合建模框架，并应用于含反位缺陷及碱金属钝化的 Cu2ZnSnS4。作者将非绝热耦合演化视为时间序列预测问题，比较了多类深度学习模型，其中扩展长短期记忆模型表现最佳，测试集平均 R2 达到 0.98。该方法可在保持较高精度的同时将预测成本相对于重复第一性原理计算降低五个数量级以上，并显示碱金属掺杂可降低非绝热耦合强度、加速退相干。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Synchrotron x-ray diffraction study of liquid and glassy toluene
articles.title_zh: 液态与玻璃态甲苯的同步辐射 X 射线衍射研究
articles.abstract: We measured the X-ray diffraction data of liquid toluene at several temperatures between 300 and 180 K and those of glasses prepared by liquid quenching and vapor deposition (VD) at 3 K. The VD glasses annealed at 90 and 112 K were also measured at 3 K. Throughout the measurements, we used a custom-made cryostat for VD experiments and a high-energy X-ray diffractometer at BL04B2, SPring-8. The structure factor S ( Q ) of each state was successfully fitted using potential fitting with molecular dynamics simulation and reverse Monte Carlo methods. Interestingly, in both the liquid and glassy states, the most preferred intermolecular structure is not a parallel one, which is the most stable dimer in vacuo , but a T-shaped one in which two hydrogen atoms of a benzene ring point toward the benzene ring of a neighboring molecule. The abundance of the T-shaped and side-by-side structures increases with decreasing temperature and annealing of the VD glass. As one possibility, we propose that the T-shaped structure can constitute the cooperatively rearranging region conceived in the Adam–Gibbs theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究测量了甲苯在 300 至 180 K 间液态以及经液体淬冷和气相沉积制备的玻璃态样品的 X 射线衍射数据，并结合分子动力学势拟合与反向蒙特卡罗方法解析结构因子。结果表明，无论液态还是玻璃态，最偏好的分子间构型并非真空中最稳定的平行二聚体，而是苯环氢指向邻近苯环的 T 形结构。随着温度降低和气相沉积玻璃退火，T 形与并排结构的比例增加，作者提出 T 形结构可能与 Adam–Gibbs 理论中的协同重排区域有关。

articles.title: Physics-informed machine learning model for accurate prediction of electron affinities
articles.title_zh: 用于精确预测电子亲和能的物理信息机器学习模型
articles.abstract: Accurate wavefunction methods such as CCSD(T) can predict chemical and thermodynamic properties of small molecules with near-experimental precision. However, their steep computational cost limits their use for large systems or extensive datasets. In contrast, density functional theory (DFT) is faster and more practical for large molecules but often fails to accurately capture electronic changes with quantitative accuracy. To address these limitations, we have developed a machine learning model for the prediction of electron affinities with physics-based structural features (RDKit and SMARTS) and quantum chemistry-based electronic features (Mulliken charge analysis). These features, which capture both local bonding motifs and global electronic context, are used as input descriptors to an XGBR (eXtreme Gradient Boosting Regressor) model in a ΔML framework. By embedding QM-based electronic features to the ΔML model, our enhanced ΔML+ model attains a mean absolute error of 0.03 eV with respect to G4MP2 values, surpassing conventional chemical accuracy targets while exhibiting markedly reduced dependence on the underlying DFT functional. By analyzing both vertical and adiabatic EAs within the same framework, we highlight the crucial role of geometry relaxation in predictive modeling. Overall, our approach offers an efficient and transferable route to benchmark accurate electron affinity predictions, pointing toward next generation computational protocols that overcome the limitations of standalone DFT.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作开发了用于预测分子电子亲和能的机器学习模型，结合基于结构的物理化学描述符和量子化学电子特征。作者在 ΔML 框架中使用 XGBoost 回归模型，并引入 Mulliken 电荷等量子力学电子信息，使增强模型相对于 G4MP2 参考值的平均绝对误差达到 0.03 eV。该方法在降低对底层 DFT 泛函依赖的同时，提高了垂直和绝热电子亲和能预测的定量可靠性。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: In search of density functional approximations for accurate evaluation of NMR shielding constants for main-group nuclei: Analytic derivatives, benchmarking, and insights from density-corrected density functional theory
articles.title_zh: 寻找用于精确评估主族原子核 NMR 屏蔽常数的密度泛函近似：解析导数、基准测试与密度校正密度泛函理论启示
articles.abstract: Predicting nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) chemical shielding constants (CSCs) remains a great challenge. Being second-order response properties, NMR CSCs impose stringent demands on the accuracy and approximations of theoretical methods, as they are highly sensitive to subtle changes in the electronic structure. In this work, we develop and implement analytic derivatives for gauge-including atomic orbital shielding tensors within a density-corrected density functional theory (DC-DFT) Lagrangian/Z-vector framework. We benchmark the results against the comprehensive NS372 set of main-group CSCs and analyze the method errors in view of density-driven and functional-driven components within the DC-DFT framework, thereby rationalizing when and why substituting the electron density improves NMR shielding predictions. We find that the commonly employed HF-density strategy yields only modest and highly nuclear-dependent improvements in CSC accuracy. In contrast, combining MN15-L electron density with the SCAN0 energy functional can lead to a substantial error cancellation, reducing the overall mean absolute deviation to 5.02 ppm, approaching the accuracy of state-of-the-art double-hybrid functionals while avoiding the computational cost of perturbative correlation treatments. Our results establish DC-DFT as a practical and interpretable strategy for enhancing NMR shielding predictions with lower-rung functionals and offer clear guidance for selecting beneficial density/energy functional pairings for magnetic response properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对核磁共振化学屏蔽常数预测的高精度需求，在密度校正密度泛函理论框架下实现了含规范原子轨道屏蔽张量的解析导数。作者使用主族核屏蔽常数基准集 NS372 评估方法误差，并将误差分解为密度驱动和泛函驱动成分，以解释替换电子密度何时能够改善预测。结果显示，常用的 HF 密度策略提升有限且强烈依赖核种，而 MN15-L 密度与 SCAN0 能量泛函的组合可通过误差抵消显著降低总体偏差。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: On the importance of relativistic corrections to the vibrational averaging of molecular properties: A zeroth-order regular approximation study on selected mercury compounds
articles.title_zh: 相对论修正对分子性质振动平均的重要性：若干汞化合物的零阶正则近似研究
articles.abstract: Relativistic effects play a crucial role in the accurate prediction of spectroscopic properties of heavy-element compounds, yet their impact on vibrational corrections remains insufficiently explored. In this work, we assess the influence of scalar and spin–orbit relativistic treatments on vibrational corrections to electric field gradients (EFGs), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) shielding constants, chemical shifts, and spin–spin coupling constants (SSCCs) for seven mercury(II) compounds: HgCl 2 , HgBr 2 , HgI 2 , Hg(SH) 2 , H 3 CHgCl, H 3 CHgBr, and H 3 CHgI. Calculations were performed within density functional theory using the BHandHLYP functional for EFGs and PBE0 for NMR parameters, combined with the Zeroth-Order Regular Approximation (ZORA) scalar and spin–orbit relativistic approaches. Vibrational averaging employed the QZ4P basis set primarily, with QZ4P-J used for SSCCs, and additional basis-set tests were carried out for HgCl 2 . Our results demonstrate that relativistic effects substantially modify vibrational corrections for all investigated properties and that scalar relativistic treatments alone are generally insufficient. While replacing QZ4P with TZ2P for cubic force constants or property derivatives yields only minor absolute deviations, the relative changes can be significant due to the small magnitude of the corrections. The inclusion of zero-point vibrational effects at the spin–orbit ZORA level consistently improves agreement with experimental data. Methodological investigations further reveal that accurate numerical derivatives require larger step lengths for these compounds than typically assumed, with an optimal value near 0.5 for HgCl 2 . Overall, this study highlights the necessity of incorporating spin–orbit relativistic effects in vibrational corrections for heavy-element spectroscopic properties and provides guidance for robust computational protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作评估了标量相对论和自旋—轨道相对论处理对七种汞(II)化合物分子性质振动修正的影响，涉及电场梯度、NMR 屏蔽常数、化学位移和自旋—自旋耦合常数。计算在密度泛函理论框架下结合 ZORA 相对论方法与振动平均处理进行。结果表明，相对论效应会显著改变所考察性质的振动修正，且仅采用标量相对论处理通常不足以获得可靠结果。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Unraveling the dual nature of covalent and electrostatic binding in americyl capture by a phenanthroline-based covalent organic framework (DAPhen)
articles.title_zh: 揭示菲咯啉基共价有机框架 DAPhen 捕获镅酰离子时共价与静电结合的双重本质
articles.abstract: The separation of minor actinides, especially americium, from lanthanides in spent nuclear fuel remains a critical challenge in nuclear waste management, primarily due to their nearly identical chemical behavior in the trivalent state. To address this, we target the linear dioxo configuration of pentavalent americium (AmO2+), which offers distinct steric and electronic features compared to spherical trivalent lanthanides. This work investigates Am(V) adsorption using a phenanthroline-based covalent organic framework (DAPhen-COF), where the pre-organized N,O-donor environment from the phenanthroline-amidine motif is designed for strong actinide coordination. Multiscale computations show that DAPhen-COF forms a highly stable complex with AmO2+. Density of states analysis reveals strong orbital hybridization between Am-5f and ligand N/O-2p states, underscoring substantial covalent interaction. Topological analysis of electron density confirms the existence of bonds with pronounced covalent character within highly polarized coordination environments, while electrostatic potential analysis verifies complementary electrostatic contributions. Energy decomposition analysis further quantifies the binding as a cooperative interplay between orbital and electrostatic forces. Quantitative adsorption energy calculations further corroborate these findings, revealing that DAPhen-COF exhibits a strong affinity for Am(V) (−151.9 kcal/mol) and clear selectivity over Eu(III), with the most stable configuration arising from cooperative actinide-actinide interactions within the confined COF interlayer space. This study not only sheds light on the unique coordination chemistry of pentavalent americium but also provides a robust theoretical foundation for designing ligand architectures capable of distinguishing actinides from lanthanides based on oxidation-state-specific motifs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向乏燃料中次锕系元素尤其是镅的分离难题，考察了菲咯啉基共价有机框架 DAPhen-COF 对五价镅酰离子 AmO2+ 的吸附。多尺度计算表明，该框架可与 AmO2+ 形成高度稳定的配合物，其预组织化的 N、O 供体环境有利于锕系元素配位。态密度、电子密度拓扑、静电势和能量分解分析共同揭示了 Am-5f 与配体 N/O-2p 轨道杂化所带来的共价作用，以及在极化配位环境中的静电贡献。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: The correlation discrete variable representation revisited
articles.title_zh: 重新审视相关离散变量表示方法
articles.abstract: The correlation discrete variable representation (CDVR) enables efficient quantum dynamics calculation with the multi-layer multi-configurational time-dependent Hartree approach on general potential energy surfaces. It employs a time-dependent quadrature to compute potential energy matrix elements, thereby eliminating the need to refit the potential to a sum of products form. The non-hierarchical CDVR conserves the inherent symmetry properties of tree-shaped wavefunction representations and drastically reduces the number of grid points compared to the original hierarchical CDVR. However, it requires projection on the space spanned by the single-hole functions at each node of the tree, which can introduce unphysical couplings for unconverged basis sets. In this work, the non-hierarchical CDVR is revisited, and a revised approach that avoids explicit projection on the single-hole space is introduced. The computational costs of the revised approach scale favorably with the number of single-particle functions (SPFs): for a tree with three edges at each node and n SPFs at each edge, an n 4 scaling is achieved. Furthermore, a revised scheme that uses artificial SPFs to systematically increase the accuracy of the CDVR quadrature is presented. Computations studying the photodissociation of NOCl, the vibrational states of methyl, and the non-adiabatic quantum dynamics of photoexcited pyrazine demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the revised non-hierarchical CDVR. Notably, for the 24-dimensional pyrazine system, the use of the CDVR does not increase the required wall clock time compared to calculations utilizing the sum of products form of the vibronic coupling model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作重新研究了相关离散变量表示（CDVR）在多层多组态含时 Hartree 量子动力学计算中的应用。CDVR 通过含时求积计算势能矩阵元，避免将一般势能面重新拟合为乘积和形式；非层级 CDVR 可保持树状波函数表示的对称性并减少网格点数，但对单孔函数空间的投影可能在基组未收敛时引入非物理耦合。作者提出一种修订方案，避免显式投影到单孔空间，并获得随单粒子函数数目有利标度的计算成本，同时引入人工单粒子函数以系统改进表示。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Controlling ⟨ S ̂ 2 ⟩ in broken-symmetry density functional theory calculations via constrained optimization
articles.title_zh: 通过约束优化控制破缺对称密度泛函理论计算中的 ⟨Ŝ2⟩
articles.abstract: Accurate determination of magnetic exchange coupling constants ( J ) from density functional theory (DFT) remains challenging, particularly for open-shell systems where broken-symmetry (BS) solutions suffer from spurious spin contamination that systematically exaggerates J values. Several methods have been proposed to address this problem by adjusting the mapping scheme from the DFT energies to the Heisenberg–Dirac–van Vleck effective spin Hamiltonian energies. In this work, we explore a different route by imposing a constraint on the DFT energy that enforces a target value of the spin-squared expectation, ⟨Ŝ2⟩, using a Lagrange multiplier approach. By explicitly controlling the spin character of the electronic state, the method attempts to overcome limitations of standard BS calculations to describe magnetic interactions. As part of the theoretical formulation, we derive analytical expressions for the gradient of the spin-squared expectation value with respect to the spin-resolved density matrices, which are required for the practical implementation of the constraint within a generalized Kohn–Sham scheme. These expressions are general to any single-determinant method and remain valid for arbitrary spin states. We apply the spin-constrained approach to the calculation of J couplings and compare with three energy-difference-based schemes for a set of representative systems, including H 2 He, H 3 He 3 arranged in an equilateral triangle, and a bis( μ -hydroxo) Cu(II) complex. Across all cases, the constrained formulation yields systematically lower and more consistent exchange couplings across different density functional approximations. This work establishes a robust and general route for incorporating spin-state constraints into DFT-based studies of magnetic exchange interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对利用密度泛函理论计算磁交换耦合常数时破缺对称解的自旋污染问题，提出通过拉格朗日乘子约束自旋平方期望值 ⟨Ŝ2⟩ 的方法。与仅调整 DFT 能量到有效自旋哈密顿量映射的策略不同，该方法直接控制电子态的自旋特征，以改善开放壳层体系磁相互作用描述。作者还推导了 ⟨Ŝ2⟩ 对自旋分辨密度矩阵的解析梯度，可用于广义 Kohn–Sham 框架中的实际实现。

articles.title: A Phase Space Signature of Quantum Roaming in Chesnavich's Model
articles.title_zh: Chesnavich模型中量子漫游的相空间特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30872v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Roaming reactions occur when a molecule enters a near-dissociation region, avoids immediate separation, and later forms products by a pathway not controlled by the conventional tight transition-state bottleneck. Classical studies have shown that roaming is best understood in phase space: inner and outer transition-state structures, together with their invariant manifolds, organize trapping, return, and dissociation. The corresponding quantum question is less settled. Can a single quantum resonance carry a recognizable signature of the classical roaming region? We address this question in Chesnavich's two-degree-of-freedom model for the ion--molecule reaction CH₄⁺ⁱ̊ghtarrowCH₃⁺ + H. Resonance states are computed with a complex absorbing potential and analyzed using diagnostics designed to mirror the classical phase-space picture: radial probability weights derived from the tight and outer transition-state structures, radial Husimi projections, angular-momentum channel weights, and coherent-state probes of the classical periodic orbits. One resonance is distinguished from the rest of the computed resonance ensemble. Its wavefunction is concentrated in the projected region between the inner and outer transition-state structures, its radial phase-space distribution is centered at intermediate radius with nearly zero radial momentum, and its angular structure is consistent with a standing rather than a directed rotating component. We interpret this state as a phase-space-localized quantum analogue of classical roaming. The result provides a controlled example in which quantum roaming is identified directly from a resonance wavefunction and its phase-space diagnostics, rather than only from product-state or scattering signatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨分子漫游反应在量子共振态中是否具有可识别的相空间特征。作者以CH₄⁺ → CH₃⁺ + H离子–分子反应的Chesnavich二维模型为对象，利用复吸收势计算共振态，并通过径向概率权重、Husimi投影、角动量通道权重和相干态探针等方法对其进行分析。结果显示，在所计算的共振态集合中存在一个明显区别于其他态的共振，其波函数表现出与经典漫游区域相对应的特征。

articles.title: Spin–orbit effects on the molecular properties of Group 14 tetracoordinate compounds TX 4 (T = Ge, Sn, and Pb; X = H, F, Cl, Br, and I): Natural electron configuration-based rationalization of structural variations
articles.title_zh: 自旋–轨道效应对第14族四配位化合物TX₄（T = Ge、Sn、Pb；X = H、F、Cl、Br、I）分子性质的影响：基于自然电子构型的结构变化解释
articles.abstract: The spin–orbit (SO) effects on the molecular properties of Group 14 tetracoordinate compounds TX 4 (T = Ge, Sn, and Pb; X = H, F, Cl, Br, and I) were systematically investigated using two-component spin–orbit density functional theory with the PBE0 and MN15 functionals. The spin–orbit coupling (SOC)-induced changes in the T–X equilibrium bond lengths exhibit a non-monotonic pattern across the 15 TX 4 compounds, governed by the competition between central-atom p 1/2 contraction and ligand p 3/2 elongation. The natural electron configuration-based spinor occupation inference (NSOI) framework, extended from diatomic to polyatomic systems, accounts for all observed structural variations, including the counterintuitive enhancement of bond contraction from TF 4 to TCl 4 and the crossover from contraction to elongation in PbI 4 . For the TX 2 series, the NSOI framework consistently rationalizes not only the SOC-induced bond length changes but also the bond angle changes, which are interpreted as secondary geometric consequences of changes in bond lengths and X–X interactions. The robustness of the NSOI approach was confirmed with the MN15 functional. The reaction energies for TX 4 → TX 2 + X 2 decrease systematically from Ge to Pb, consistent with the inert-pair effect. Time-dependent density functional theory calculations reveal that SOC activates singlet–triplet mixing, transforming the UV–Vis absorption spectra of heavy-atom TX 4 and providing theoretical reference data for experimentally elusive species such as PbX 4 . In contrast to the structural SO effects, which are attenuated by partial cancellation between central-atom and ligand contributions, the spectral SO effects are more pronounced because singlet–triplet mixing introduces absorption features absent in the scalar-relativistic spectra.

However, the rigorous lower bound is O(LΔ−¹), where L is the adiabatic path length. Al… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 023233] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究绝热量子演化中路径调度对态制备效率的影响。传统绝热演化时间通常随最小能隙的平方反比标度，而严格下界还与绝热路径长度有关；作者提出恒定几何速度调度以更有效地沿量子态路径演化。该方法旨在缩短绝热态制备所需时间并改善实际量子算法中的资源需求。
authors: Mancheon Han, Hyowon Park, and Sangkook Choi

articles.title: Frequency shifts due to relativistic effects and retardation in continuous-variable quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 连续变量量子密钥分发中相对论效应与传播延迟导致的频移
articles.abstract: Author(s): Emanuel Schlake, Jan P. Hackstein, Roy Barzel, Eva Hackmann, Dennis Rätzel, and Claus Lämmerzahl Space-based quantum communication naturally involves satellites and ground stations exchanging optical signals at high altitudes and large relative velocities. Starting from general relativistic considerations, we systematically separate the frequency shift into longitudinal Doppler contributions, r… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 023236] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向空间量子通信中的连续变量量子密钥分发，分析卫星与地面站之间光信号交换时的频率偏移。作者从广义相对论出发，将频移系统分解为纵向多普勒效应、相对论修正和传播延迟等贡献。该研究有助于评估高空高速平台中量子通信协议的实际误差来源与补偿需求。
authors: Emanuel Schlake, Jan P. Hackstein, Roy Barzel, Eva Hackmann, Dennis Rätzel, and Claus Lämmerzahl

articles.title: Restoring the second law to classical-quantum dynamics
articles.title_zh: 在经典—量子动力学中恢复热力学第二定律
articles.abstract: Author(s): Isaac Layton and Harry J. D. Miller All physical theories should obey the second law of thermodynamics. However, existing proposals to describe the dynamics of hybrid classical-quantum systems either violate the second law or lack a proof of its existence. Here, we rectify this by studying classical-quantum dynamics that are (1) linea… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 023238] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论混合经典—量子系统动力学与热力学第二定律之间的一致性问题。已有若干混合动力学方案可能违反第二定律，或缺乏对第二定律成立的证明；作者研究满足线性等条件的经典—量子动力学框架，以修正这一缺陷。该工作为构建热力学自洽的混合经典—量子理论提供了理论基础。
authors: Isaac Layton and Harry J. D. Miller

articles.title: Discrete time crystals enabled by Floquet strong Hilbert space fragmentation
articles.title_zh: 由 Floquet 强希尔伯特空间碎片化实现的离散时间晶体
articles.abstract: Author(s): Ling-Zhi Tang, Xiao Li, Z. D. Wang, and Dan-Wei Zhang Discrete time crystals (DTCs) are nonequilibrium phases of matter that break the discrete time-translation symmetry and are characterized by a robust subharmonic response in periodically driven quantum systems. Here, we explore the DTC, stabilized by the Floquet strong Hilbert space fragmentation, i… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214303] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究周期驱动量子系统中的离散时间晶体相，这类非平衡物态会破缺离散时间平移对称性并表现出稳健的亚谐响应。作者探讨 Floquet 强希尔伯特空间碎片化如何稳定离散时间晶体。该机制为在受驱动多体系统中实现抗热化、长寿命时间晶体行为提供了新的思路。
authors: Ling-Zhi Tang, Xiao Li, Z. D. Wang, and Dan-Wei Zhang

articles.title: Electrically controlled critical behavior of skyrmions in disordered systems
articles.title_zh: 无序系统中斯格明子的电控临界行为
articles.abstract: Author(s): Long Xiong, Meng-Hao Jin, Lei-Lei Nian, Shi-Qian Hu, and Bo Zheng The dynamics of current-driven skyrmions are crucial for applications in spintronics and data storage. However, inevitable random defects in materials introduce uncontrollable factors affecting skyrmion mobility. In this study, we investigate the critical dynamics of current-driven skyrmions under a… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214412] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究含随机缺陷材料中电流驱动斯格明子的临界动力学。由于实际材料中的无序会影响斯格明子的运动能力，作者考察外加电控制条件下缺陷对其迁移和临界行为的作用。该研究与自旋电子学器件和高密度数据存储中斯格明子的可控输运密切相关。
authors: Long Xiong, Meng-Hao Jin, Lei-Lei Nian, Shi-Qian Hu, and Bo Zheng

articles.abstract: Author(s): S. S. Elden and M. Iskin Flat-band superconductors provide a regime in which kinetic energy is quenched, so that pairing is governed primarily by interactions and quantum geometry. We investigate characteristic superconducting length scales in all-flat-band systems under the assumptions of time-reversal symmetry and spatial… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214501] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究平带超导体中的特征超导长度尺度，其中动能被强烈淬灭，配对主要由相互作用和量子几何控制。作者在时间反演对称性和空间对称性等假设下，分析全平带系统的超导关联长度。研究强调量子度量等几何量在决定平带超导性质中的关键作用。
authors: S. S. Elden and M. Iskin

articles.title: Two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy of disordered superconductors in the narrow-band and broad-band limits
articles.title_zh: 窄带与宽带极限下无序超导体的二维相干光谱
articles.abstract: Author(s): Naoto Tsuji We theoretically analyze two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy (2DCS) signals for disordered superconductors in two limits: one is the narrow-band limit with sinusoidal pulse waves and the other is the broad-band limit with delta-function pulses. While the 2DCS signal in the narrow-band limit is rel… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214502] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上分析无序超导体的二维相干光谱信号，并比较窄带极限和宽带极限两种情形。窄带极限采用正弦脉冲波，宽带极限采用δ函数脉冲，从而揭示不同激发条件下光谱响应的差异。该研究有助于利用二维相干光谱探测无序超导体系中的集体激发和非线性动力学。

articles.title: Emergence of charge-imbalanced BCS state and suppression of the nonequilibrium Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov state in asymmetric NSN junctions
articles.title_zh: 非对称 NSN 结中电荷不平衡 BCS 态的涌现与非平衡 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov 态的抑制
articles.abstract: Author(s): Taira Kawamura and Yoji Ohashi We theoretically study nonequilibrium superconductivity in voltage-biased normal metal–superconductor–normal metal (NSN) junctions, focusing on the effects of lead-coupling asymmetry and impurity scattering. Using the Keldysh Green's function technique, we extend the thermal-equilibrium mean-field B… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214504] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从理论上研究电压偏置的正常金属—超导体—正常金属（NSN）结中的非平衡超导性，重点考察引线耦合不对称性与杂质散射的影响。作者采用 Keldysh 格林函数方法，将热平衡平均场 BCS 理论推广到非平衡情形。研究表明，非对称耦合可诱导电荷不平衡的 BCS 态，并对非平衡 FFLO 态产生抑制作用。

articles.title: Emblems of pair density waves: Dual identity of topological defects and their transport signatures
articles.title_zh: 配对密度波的标志：拓扑缺陷的双重身份及其输运特征
articles.abstract: Author(s): Omri Lesser, Chunli Huang, James P. Sethna, and Eun-Ah Kim The pair density wave (PDW) exemplifies intertwined orders in strongly correlated systems. A recent discovery of superconductivity in a quarter-metal state [T. Han et al. , Nature (London) 643 , 654 (2025) ] offers the first experimental system where a pure PDW without uniform superconductivity is sus… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 214505] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论强关联体系中配对密度波（PDW）这一交织序的典型特征，尤其关注纯 PDW 态中拓扑缺陷的性质。受近期四分之一金属态中超导发现的启发，作者分析了无均匀超导成分的 PDW 可能呈现的缺陷双重身份。文章进一步探讨这些缺陷在输运测量中的可观测信号，为识别 PDW 态提供判据。
authors: Omri Lesser, Chunli Huang, James P. Sethna, and Eun-Ah Kim

articles.title: Slave-spin approach to the Anderson-Josephson quantum dot
articles.title_zh: Anderson-Josephson 量子点的从属自旋方法
articles.abstract: Author(s): Andriani Keliri and Marco Schirò We study a strongly interacting quantum dot connected to two superconducting leads using a slave-spin representation of the dot. At the mean-field level, the problem maps to a resonant level model with superconducting leads, coupled to an auxiliary spin-1/2 variable accounting for the parity of the … [Phys. Rev. B 113, 224501] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用从属自旋表示研究连接两个超导引线的强相互作用量子点。平均场层面上，该问题可映射为与超导引线耦合的共振能级模型，并引入辅助自旋 1/2 变量来刻画量子点奇偶性。该方法旨在为 Anderson-Josephson 量子点中的相互作用效应、宇称物理和约瑟夫森响应提供一种简化而可控的描述。

articles.title: Distinguishing impurity-induced bound states from Majorana-like zero-energy peaks in strained CsCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂ by scanning tunneling microscopy
articles.title_zh: 利用扫描隧道显微镜区分应变 CsCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂ 中杂质诱导束缚态与类 Majorana 零能峰
articles.abstract: Author(s): Mingzhe Li, Jiashuo Gong, Huaxun Li, Jiakang Zhang, Yuanji Li, Ruotong Yin, Shiyuan Wang, Guanghan Cao, Dong-Lai Feng, and Ya-Jun Yan Iron-based superconductors offer a versatile platform for exploring topological superconductivity and Majorana zero modes (MZMs), with experimental confirmations in Fe(Te,Se), (Li,Fe)OHFeSe and CaKFe₄As₄ at ambient pressure, as well a… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 224504] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究铁基超导体 CsCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂ 在应变条件下的局域电子态，目标是区分杂质诱导束缚态与可能的类 Majorana 零能峰。作者利用扫描隧道显微镜/谱学对零能附近信号进行空间和能谱表征。该研究服务于铁基超导体中拓扑超导与 Majorana 零模的判别，强调仅凭零偏压峰并不足以作出结论。
authors: Mingzhe Li, Jiashuo Gong, Huaxun Li, Jiakang Zhang, Yuanji Li, Ruotong Yin, Shiyuan Wang, Guanghan Cao, Dong-Lai Feng, and Ya-Jun Yan

articles.title: Short-ranged charge density wave and superconductivity in a 1 T -NbSeTe crystal
articles.title_zh: 1T-NbSeTe 晶体中的短程电荷密度波与超导电性
articles.abstract: Author(s): Zi-Ang Wang, Zichen Huang, Hao Zhang, Guoyu Xian, Senhao Lv, Hui Guo, Haitao Yang, Hui Chen, and Hong-Jun Gao Niobium-based dichalcogenides (NbX₂, where X=S, Se, Te) exhibit tunable intertwining charge density waves (CDWs) and superconductivity, especially NbSe₂ and NbTe₂, which have attracted much attention due to th… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 224505] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究铌基过渡金属二硫族化物 1T-NbSeTe 中电荷密度波与超导电性的共存或相互影响。NbX₂ 类材料因可调的电荷密度波和超导交织行为而受到关注，本文将这一问题扩展到 Se/Te 混合体系。研究重点在于揭示短程电荷密度波的存在及其与超导态之间的关系。
authors: Zi-Ang Wang, Zichen Huang, Hao Zhang, Guoyu Xian, Senhao Lv, Hui Guo, Haitao Yang, Hui Chen, and Hong-Jun Gao

articles.title: Charge order in the half-filled bond-Holstein model
articles.title_zh: 半填充键 Holstein 模型中的电荷有序
articles.abstract: Author(s): Charles Jordan, George Issa, Ehsan Khatami, Richard Scalettar, Benjamin Cohen-Stead, and Steven Johnston We use determinant quantum Monte Carlo to study the half-filled ‘‘bond-Holstein’’ model on a square lattice. We find that the model exhibits a charge-density-wave (CDW) phase transition with a critical temperature Tcdw considerably higher than that of the canonical ‘‘site-Holstein’’ … [Phys. Rev. B 113, 235101] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用行列式量子蒙特卡罗方法研究平方晶格上半填充的“键 Holstein”模型。结果显示，该模型发生电荷密度波相变，且其临界温度显著高于经典“位点 Holstein”模型的对应情形。研究表明，电子—声子耦合方式的差异会显著改变电荷有序的稳定性与相变行为。
authors: Charles Jordan, George Issa, Ehsan Khatami, Richard Scalettar, Benjamin Cohen-Stead, and Steven Johnston

articles.title: Symmetry and topology in a non-Hermitian Kitaev chain
articles.title_zh: 非厄米 Kitaev 链中的对称性与拓扑
articles.abstract: Author(s): Ayush Raj, Soham Ray, and Sai Satyam Samal We investigate the non-Hermitian Kitaev chain with nonreciprocal hopping amplitudes and asymmetric superconducting pairing. We work out the symmetry structure of the model and show that particle-hole symmetry (PHS) is preserved throughout the entire parameter regime. As a consequence of PHS, the top… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 235104] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究具有非互易跃迁振幅和非对称超导配对的非厄米 Kitaev 链。作者系统分析模型的对称性结构，并指出粒子—空穴对称性在整个参数区域内保持。基于这一对称性，文章进一步讨论非厄米体系中拓扑性质及相关边界态的判定。
authors: Ayush Raj, Soham Ray, and Sai Satyam Samal

articles.title: Localization transition in a charge-Kondo circuit
articles.title_zh: 电荷 Kondo 电路中的局域化转变
articles.abstract: Author(s): Zhanyu Ma, Cheolhee Han, F. Pierre, and Eran Sela Charge Kondo circuits consist of metallic islands connected by single-mode quantum point contacts (QPCs). The island's charging energy makes these circuits tunable quantum simulators of various strongly interacting models. Here we propose a circuit that realizes the Kondo effect with effective Lutti… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 235402] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出并分析由金属岛和单模量子点接触构成的电荷 Kondo 电路。金属岛的充电能使这类电路成为可调的强相互作用量子模拟平台。作者设计的电路旨在实现具有有效 Luttinger 液体特征的 Kondo 物理，并研究其中可能出现的局域化转变。
authors: Zhanyu Ma, Cheolhee Han, F. Pierre, and Eran Sela

articles.abstract: Author(s): K. R. Pakuszewski, M. R. Cantarino, I. Romanenko, A. P. Machado, M. M. Piva, G. S. Freitas, H. B. Pizzi, F. A. Garcia, P. G. Pagliuso, and C. Adriano We present a systematic study of the evolution of the band structure in the Fe-based superconductor family BaFe₂−ₓMₓAs₂ (M = Co, Cu, Cr, Ru, and Mn) using polarization-dependent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). Low-substituted samples, with comp… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 245101] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用偏振依赖角分辨光电子能谱系统研究铁基超导体 BaFe₂−ₓMₓAs₂ 中不同取代元素导致的能带结构演化。研究对象包括 Co、Cu、Cr、Ru 和 Mn 等掺杂体系，重点关注低掺杂样品中的轨道选择性变化。结果有助于理解不同化学取代对铁基超导体电子结构、磁性与超导性质的影响。
authors: K. R. Pakuszewski, M. R. Cantarino, I. Romanenko, A. P. Machado, M. M. Piva, G. S. Freitas, H. B. Pizzi, F. A. Garcia, P. G. Pagliuso, and C. Adriano

articles.title: Topological anomalous Floquet photon pump
articles.title_zh: 拓扑反常 Floquet 光子泵
articles.abstract: Author(s): Manshuo Lin, Saeed Rahmanian Koshkaki, Mohsen Yarmohammadi, and Michael H. Kolodrubetz There is a close theoretical connection between topological Floquet physics and cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED), yet this connection has not been realized experimentally due to complicated cavity QED models that often arise. We propose a simple, experimentally viable protocol to realize nonadia… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 245103] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注拓扑 Floquet 物理与腔量子电动力学之间的理论联系，并提出一种更简单且实验上可行的实现方案。作者旨在通过非绝热驱动构造拓扑反常 Floquet 光子泵，以避免复杂腔 QED 模型带来的实验困难。该方案为在光学或腔系统中观测拓扑 Floquet 现象提供了新的路径。
authors: Manshuo Lin, Saeed Rahmanian Koshkaki, Mohsen Yarmohammadi, and Michael H. Kolodrubetz

articles.title: Generic integer and fractional quantum anomalous Hall crystals from interaction-driven band folding
articles.title_zh: 相互作用驱动能带折叠产生的普适整数与分数量子反常霍尔晶体

Such states are referred to as Hall crystals. However, compared to those with integer Hall conduc… [Phys. Rev. B 113, 245105] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究与电荷密度波有序共存的拓扑态，即霍尔晶体，特别关注整数和分数量子反常霍尔情形。作者从相互作用驱动的能带折叠出发，探讨这类态形成的普适机制。该工作有助于理解分数量子反常霍尔态与空间平移对称性破缺之间的联系。
authors: Hongyu Lu, Han-Qing Wu, Bin-Bin Chen, Wang Yao, and Zi Yang Meng

articles.title: Optical Hall absorption sum rule and spectral compensation in time-reversal-breaking moiré and Hofstadter systems
articles.title_zh: 时间反演破缺莫尔与 Hofstadter 系统中的光学霍尔吸收求和规则与谱补偿
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yixin Zhang and H. Huang Optical spectroscopy provides a powerful, contact-free probe of topological quantum states, yet exact constraints on antisymmetric Hall absorption remain much less well developed than their longitudinal counterparts. Motivated by earlier Hall-conductivity sum rules, we formulate the corresponding fi… [Phys. Rev. B 113, L241101] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文建立时间反演对称性破缺体系中反对称霍尔吸收的有限频率求和规则。作者受霍尔电导求和规则启发，将其推广到光学吸收谱，重点讨论莫尔体系和 Hofstadter 系统。研究表明，光谱权重在不同频率范围之间存在受拓扑与对称性约束的补偿关系，为无接触光谱探测拓扑量子态提供理论依据。

articles.title: Classical transport theory for the planar Hall effect with threefold symmetry
articles.title_zh: 具有三重对称性的平面霍尔效应经典输运理论
articles.abstract: Author(s): Akiyoshi Yamada and Yuki Fuseya In recent years, the planar Hall effect (PHE) has become a key probe of Berry curvature and the anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Threefold-symmetric signals under in-plane fields are often attributed to such quantum mechanisms. Here, we establish a purely classical origin for a threefold-symmetric PHE. … [Phys. Rev. B 113, L241106] Published Mon Jun 01, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对平面霍尔效应中常被归因于贝里曲率或反常霍尔效应的三重对称信号，提出一种纯经典起源的解释。作者建立经典输运理论，说明在面内磁场作用下，即使不诉诸量子几何机制，也可能产生具有三重对称性的平面霍尔响应。该工作有助于重新审视平面霍尔效应作为拓扑或量子效应探针时的判据。

articles.title: Emergent Spin‐Glass Behavior in an Iron(II)‐Based Metal–Organic Framework Glass
articles.title_zh: 铁(II)基金属—有机框架玻璃中的涌现自旋玻璃行为

articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕一种铁(II)基金属—有机框架玻璃中的磁性行为展开，重点关注其可能出现的自旋玻璃特征。由于原始摘要仅提供期刊卷期信息，具体实验方法、磁性表征结果和机理解释需查阅原文。该研究可能对理解无序配位框架材料中的磁相互作用和玻璃态磁性具有参考价值。
authors: Chinmoy Das, Soma Salamon, Joachim Landers, Jan‐Benedikt Weiß, Wen‐Long Xue, Pascal Kolodzeiski, Roman Pallach, Heiko Wende, Sebastian Henke

Jin et al. present an electronic fingerprint device capable of simultaneously detecting normal force, slippage direction, and displacement, enabling enhanced human–robot interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向柔性、便携式可穿戴触觉人机界面，提出了一种具有螺旋图案触觉像素阵列的电子指纹器件。该器件能够同时检测法向力、滑移方向和位移，从而提升人机与人机—机器人交互中的触觉感知能力。

articles.title: Quantum-Enhanced Land Classification for Reforestation using Quantum Machine Learning and GIS
articles.title_zh: 基于量子机器学习与 GIS 的量子增强型再造林土地分类
articles.abstract: This work investigates the feasibility of using quantum machine learning for reforestation-suitability classification in the Mumbai region by integrating Quantum Support Vector Machines (QSVMs) with a GIS-based preprocessing pipeline. Satellite-derived indicators---NDVI, rainfall, slope, soil pH, and soil organic carbon---are extracted from Google Earth Engine and labeled using rule-based ecological thresholds. The resulting dataset is standardized, scaled to ([-1, 1]), balanced with SMOTE, and compressed using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to align the feature dimension with the number of qubits. Two quantum kernel models, based on Pauli and ZZ feature maps, are implemented in Qiskit and evaluated against classical SVM baselines under identical preprocessing conditions. On the balanced dataset, the classical SVM achieves an accuracy of approximately 98%, while Pauli- and ZZ-based QSVMs obtain 89% and 77% accuracy, respectively. These results indicate that, although quantum models do not surpass classical SVMs in this setting, well-designed quantum kernels can achieve competitive performance on small, structured geospatial datasets. The study positions QSVMs as complementary tools rather than replacements for classical models and highlights the importance of scaling, class balancing, and PCA--qubit alignment for stable quantum behavior in environmental analytics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作探索将量子支持向量机与 GIS 预处理流程结合，用于孟买地区再造林适宜性分类。研究从 Google Earth Engine 提取 NDVI、降雨、坡度、土壤 pH 和土壤有机碳等指标，并经标准化、SMOTE 平衡和 PCA 降维后输入量子核模型。结果显示，经典 SVM 准确率约为98%，高于 Pauli 和 ZZ 特征映射的 QSVM，但量子模型在小规模结构化地理空间数据上仍表现出一定竞争力。

articles.title: Superluminal Propagation of Light and Anomalous Phase Shift in a Λ-Type Atomic Medium
articles.title_zh: Λ 型原子介质中的光超光速传播与反常相移
articles.abstract: Light-matter interaction between a light field and an atomic medium could be used to manipulate the medium’s dispersive properties, leading to subluminal and superluminal regimes. Utilizing the same idea, this work investigates the propagation of structured superluminal light and anomalous phase shifts in a Λ- type three-level atomic medium, where a structured control field governs the atomic system. The absorption and dispersion properties are modulated by the azimuthal quantum number (ℓ) of the control field. The maxima and minima of the absorption spectrum, along with the corresponding normal and anomalous dispersion peaks, are enhanced with a (2ℓ) dependence on the azimuthal quantum number in the medium. The negative group index and anomalous phase shift vary within the ranges −1000 ≤ ng ≤ −900 and −6.5 × 105 ≤ ϕ ≤ −5.6 × 105 rad, respectively. The corresponding group velocity lies in the range −3.33 × 105 ≤ vg ≤ −3.0 × 105 m/s within the spatial region −2λ ≤ x, y ≤ 2λ. Furthermore, the anomalous phase shift is significantly enhanced in regions exhibiting superluminal behavior, following the (2ℓ) azimuthal quantum number dependence. The findings of this work may have potential applications in optical storage devices, imaging, coding, and the design of advanced photonic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察结构化控制光场作用下 Λ 型三能级原子介质中的超光速光传播和反常相移。作者发现，控制场的方位量子数可调制介质的吸收与色散性质，并使吸收峰、正常/反常色散峰以及反常相移呈现与方位量子数相关的增强。研究给出了负群折射率、负群速度和巨大反常相移的范围，表明该体系可用于调控光传播特性。

articles.title: Valley-polarized transport in graphene induced by asymmetric strain and ferromagnetic modulation
articles.title_zh: 非对称应变与铁磁调制诱导的石墨烯谷极化输运
articles.abstract: In this work, we theoretically investigate the valley-dependent electron transport properties of graphene modulated by two strained regions and a single ferromagnetic stripe based on the Dirac equation and the transfer-matrix method. By constructing a multi-region model, the conductances of the K and K' valleys as well as the corresponding valley polarization are systematically calculated. The effects of the magnetic field strength, the strain-induced gauge potentials, the widths of the strained regions, and the competition parameter λ on the valley-resolved transport behavior are analyzed in detail. The results show that both the conductance and the valley polarization are highly sensitive to the external modulation parameters and the geometric structural parameters. By properly tuning the relative strength and spatial distribution of the magnetic field and strain, an effective control of valley polarization can be achieved. This work deepens the understanding of valley-dependent transport mechanisms in graphene and provides theoretical support for the design of tunable graphene-based valleytronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文基于狄拉克方程和传输矩阵方法，理论研究由两个应变区和单个铁磁条纹调制的石墨烯中的谷依赖电子输运。作者系统计算 K 与 K′ 谷电导及谷极化，并分析磁场强度、应变诱导规范势、应变区宽度和竞争参数等因素的影响。结果表明，电导和谷极化对外部调制与几何参数高度敏感，适当调控磁场和应变的相对强度与空间分布可实现有效谷极化控制。

articles.title: Quantum light gives a 20-fold boost to ultrafast laser processes

articles.abstract: Nonlinear interactions between light and matter are at the heart of some of the most powerful tools in modern optics, but pushing these processes to their limits has long been hampered by a fundamental constraint: the stronger you make the laser, the more likely it is to destroy whatever it illuminates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道围绕量子光在增强光—物质非线性相互作用中的作用展开。传统超快强激光过程受限于样品损伤风险，而量子光可能在不单纯提高激光强度的情况下显著提升相关过程效率。报道指出，这一方向有望为现代光学中的强场和非线性应用提供新的实现路径，具体实验细节需查阅原文。
