articles.title: Diamond quantum sensor could reveal elusive altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 金刚石量子传感器或可揭示难以观测的交替磁体
articles.abstract: For nearly a century, there were two known kinds of magnets. Ferromagnets are the classic magnets that attract metal and keep pictures stuck to the refrigerator. Antiferromagnets hide their magnetism at the atomic scale but are increasingly prized for their technological potential. A third category discovered within the last decade may combine the best qualities of both. Dubbed altermagnets, they could someday help create faster, more energy-efficient electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了继铁磁体和反铁磁体之后近十年来受到关注的第三类磁性材料——交替磁体。交替磁体可能兼具传统磁体与反铁磁体的优势，有望用于发展更快速、更节能的电子器件。文章强调金刚石量子传感技术可能为探测这类隐蔽磁性提供新手段。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Descriptors Base Machine Learning Model for High-Precision (Molecular Property Dipole Moment(μ)) Prediction on QM9
articles.title_zh: 基于物理信息描述符的机器学习模型用于 QM9 数据集中分子偶极矩的高精度预测
articles.abstract: Dipole Moment(µ) is important property which helps to understand how molecules behave and support to design the new material. Therefore, predicting a molecule’s dipole moment property has high importance. In this paper, we introduce a MLP Model based on physics-informed descriptors which help to predict dipole moment µ on QM9 dataset with a test MAE = 0.0231Debye. Our selection of descriptor (atom counts, bond lengths, bond angles, and approximate partial charge) helps this model to learn more and produces highly precise results without using 3D methods. Above mentioned results show this model is fast, precise and accurate alternative to existing 3D − GNN models which are complex and required complete 3D geometry. This model performs better then GNN models such as ALIGNN(MAE = 0.0248Debye), SphereNet(MAE = 0.025Debye), DimNet + + (MAE = 0.030Debye), and SchNet(MAE = 0.033Debye). Performance of our model is near to state of the art model TorchMD − Net(MAE = 0.011Deybe) and PainNN(MAE = 0.012Deybe) which make this model computationally efficient and alternative to 3D − GNN models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于物理信息描述符的多层感知机模型，用于预测 QM9 数据集中分子的偶极矩。模型采用原子计数、键长、键角和近似部分电荷等描述符，在不依赖完整三维几何或复杂三维图神经网络的情况下取得测试 MAE 为 0.0231 Debye 的结果。结果显示，该方法在精度上优于若干典型 GNN 模型，并接近部分先进模型，同时具备较高计算效率。

articles.title: Smart Electric Vehicle Energy Consumption Prediction Using Hybrid Physics–Machine Learning Approach with Route and Weather Integration
articles.title_zh: 融合路线与天气信息的物理—机器学习混合方法用于智能电动汽车能耗预测
articles.abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are becoming a key solution for sustainable transportation; however, accurately predicting their energy consumption under diverse real-world conditions remains a complex challenge. The majority of current methods either only use physics-based models, which are not flexible, or machine learning models, which need large amounts of real-world data. In order to get around these restrictions, this study suggests a hybrid EV energy prediction framework that integrates physics-based modeling with machine learning, while also incorporating real-world environmental and road conditions. The proposed system considers critical factors such as vehicle mass, speed, auxiliary load, and aerodynamic forces, along with road characteristics including slope (uphill and downhill), surface conditions typical of rural and Indian road environments, and varying driving patterns. Additionally, real-time weather parameters such as temperature and wind speed are integrated using a weather API to enhance prediction accuracy. Drive cycle datasets (UDDS, HWFET, and US06) are utilized to simulate realistic driving scenarios, and a synthetic dataset is generated using a physics-based approach combined with controlled variability. A Random Forest regression model is then trained to capture nonlinear relationships and refine energy predictions. The results of the experiments show that the suggested hybrid model, which efficiently estimates energy consumption, vehicle range, and journey length, offers better accuracy and resilience than standalone models. The method is especially well-suited for practical uses in poor nations, where EV performance is greatly impacted by environmental variables and road conditions. With potential uses in intelligent route planning and energy-efficient transportation systems, this study concludes by offering a workable, scalable, and context-aware approach for EV energy prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种电动汽车能耗预测框架，将物理建模与机器学习结合，并纳入真实环境与道路条件。模型考虑车辆质量、速度、辅助负载、空气动力、道路坡度、路面状况、驾驶模式以及温度和风速等实时天气因素。研究利用 UDDS、HWFET 和 US06 驾驶循环模拟实际行驶场景，并通过物理方法生成合成数据，以提高复杂工况下的预测能力。

articles.title: Earthquake Magnitude Estimation Using Machine Learning from Single Station Seismic Data in Rwanda
articles.title_zh: 基于卢旺达单台站地震数据的机器学习震级估计
articles.abstract: Earthquake magnitude estimation is critical for seismic monitoring, particularly in data-constrained regions with sparse station coverage. This study investigates the use of machine learning techniques for rapid and reliable magnitude estimation from single-station seismic waveform data recorded at the HUYE station in Rwanda, located within the western branch of the East African Rift System. A machine learning framework was developed using three-second waveform windows centered on P-wave arrivals. Both raw waveform inputs and physics-informed engineered features were utilized, including logarithmic amplitude, cumulative displacement, signal energy, root-mean-square (RMS) amplitude, signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), dominant frequency, spectral centroid, and band-limited spectral energy (1–10 Hz). Three models were developed and evaluated: a Random Forest regressor, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and a hybrid CNN integrating waveform data with engineered features. Model performance was assessed using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and the coefficient of determination (R²). The Random Forest model achieved the best performance (MAE = 0.274, RMSE = 0.351, R² = 0.684), outperforming both the hybrid model (MAE ≈ 0.278, R² ≈ 0.537) and the standalone CNN (MAE ≈ 0.329, R² ≈ 0.329). Feature importance analysis identified logarithmic displacement, band-limited spectral energy, and spectral centroid as the most influential predictors. Accurate and computationally efficient earthquake magnitude estimation can be achieved using single-station data through physics-informed feature engineering and machine learning. Feature-based models outperform deep learning approaches in data-limited environments, while hybrid models provide complementary improvements. The proposed framework offers a scalable solution for seismic monitoring and early warning systems in Rwanda and similar regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向台站稀疏地区的快速震级估计问题，使用卢旺达 HUYE 台站记录的单台站地震波形数据构建机器学习框架。研究采用以 P 波到时为中心的三秒波形窗口，并结合原始波形与物理信息特征，如对数振幅、累计位移、信号能量、RMS 振幅、信噪比、主频和频谱质心等。比较的随机森林、卷积神经网络和混合 CNN 模型中，随机森林模型表现最佳，摘要给出的指标包括 MAE 为 0.274、RMSE 为 0.351。

articles.title: Theoretical Regime Map of Magnetic MultipoleModes in Coupled Split-Ring ResonatorMetamolecules
articles.title_zh: 耦合开口环谐振器超分子中磁多极模式的理论相图
articles.abstract: This work presents a compact theoretical framework for classifying magnetic multipole regimes in coupled split-ring resonator (SRR) metamolecules. Each SRR is modeled as an effective resonant magnetic element, while the collective response is described through the coupling ratio ḩi=|M|/L, the normalized modal splitting Søₘₑgₐ, the dipolar cancellation factor Γ_D, the reduced quadrupolar indicator Γ_Q, and the toroidal-like circulation factor Γ_T. A reference four-SRR metamolecule is used to distinguish independent SRRs, bright collective dipoles, dark dipole-suppressed states, quadrupolar-like configurations, and toroidal-like magnetic arrangements. The results show that modal splitting is controlled by ḩi, while multipolar behavior appears when the net magnetic dipole is suppressed. The proposed regime map does not replace full-wave electromagnetic simulation, but provides a physically transparent pre-design tool for magnetic multipole engineering in SRR-based metamaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一个紧凑的理论框架，用于分类耦合开口环谐振器超分子中的磁多极响应区间。作者以有效谐振磁元件描述单个 SRR，并通过耦合比、归一化模分裂、偶极抵消因子、四极指标和类环偶极循环因子刻画集体行为。研究表明模分裂主要受耦合比控制，而在净磁偶极被抑制时会出现多极特征；该相图可作为 SRR 基超材料磁多极工程的物理透明预设计工具。

articles.title: Phase Accumulation for Machine Learning Readoutin Graphene Terahertz Resonators
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯太赫兹谐振器中用于机器学习读出的相位累积方法
articles.abstract: This work presents a phase-accumulation-based machinelearning readout for dynamically perturbed grapheneterahertz resonators. Instead of relying on steady-state or peakonlyobservables, the proposed approach integrates the transientphase response to construct physically meaningful features thatcapture both perturbation magnitude and temporal behavior. Aphysics-driven synthetic dataset is generated using a reducedorderdynamic model, incorporating parameter variability andnoise. Multiple feature configurations are evaluated for classificationand regression tasks. The results show that accumulatedphasedescriptors alone are insufficient, but significantly improveperformance when combined with instantaneous features, leadingto enhanced robustness and predictive accuracy, particularlyunder low signal-to-noise conditions. The proposed frameworkprovides a physics-informed pathway for integrating machinelearning into graphene-based terahertz sensing systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于相位累积的机器学习读出方法，用于动态扰动下的石墨烯太赫兹谐振器。方法不只依赖稳态或峰值观测量，而是积分瞬态相位响应，以构建能够反映扰动幅度和时间行为的物理特征。结果表明，单独的相位累积描述符性能有限，但与瞬时特征结合后可显著提高分类和回归任务的鲁棒性与预测精度，尤其在低信噪比条件下表现更好。

articles.title: Tailoring Zeolite/PDMS composite production to improve CO2/N2 adsorption selectivity
articles.title_zh: 调控沸石/PDMS 复合材料制备以提高 CO₂/N₂ 吸附选择性
articles.abstract: Hybrid NaLTA/PDMS composites were produced by incorporating NaLTA zeolite synthesized from calcined kaolin into a polydimethylsiloxane silicone rubber matrix for application in CO₂/N₂ gas separation. Pellet-shaped composites containing different zeolite loadings were prepared and characterized by XRD, FTIR, and SEM analyses. XRD results confirmed the formation of crystalline NaLTA zeolite and indicated the absence of structural changes after adsorption, suggesting a predominantly physisorption process. FTIR spectra demonstrated the successful incorporation of zeolite into the PDMS matrix, while SEM images revealed homogeneous dispersion and favorable interfacial interaction between the inorganic filler and the polymeric phase. Sorption analyses showed that increasing zeolite loading enhanced CO₂ adsorption capacity, with the composite containing 44 wt% zeolite exhibiting the best overall performance. This material reached a CO₂/N₂ selectivity of 58.5 at 1000 mmHg, surpassing values reported for similar zeolite/PDMS systems. Cyclic sorption experiments also demonstrated stable adsorption behavior after consecutive CO₂ and N₂ adsorption steps, indicating the potential applicability of the composite in cyclic gas separation processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将由煅烧高岭土合成的 NaLTA 沸石引入聚二甲基硅氧烷橡胶基体，制备用于 CO₂/N₂ 分离的杂化复合材料。XRD、FTIR 和 SEM 表征证实 NaLTA 晶相形成、沸石成功嵌入 PDMS 且分散均匀，并显示吸附过程主要为物理吸附。吸附测试表明，增加沸石含量可提高 CO₂ 吸附能力，其中含 44 wt% 沸石的复合材料综合性能最佳，在 1000 mmHg 下 CO₂/N₂ 选择性达到 58.5，并表现出较稳定的循环吸附行为。
authors: Regina de Fátima Peralta Muniz Moreira

articles.title: Metabolic strategy underlying resurrection in carpet moss, Hypnum cupressiforme Hedw. subjected to a desiccation-rehydration cycle
articles.title_zh: 卷柏状灰藓在脱水—复水循环中的复苏代谢策略
articles.abstract: In the present study, we investigated comprehensive metabolic divergence, highlighting potential desiccation- and resurrection-related traits in the carpet moss Hypnum cupressiforme Hedw. subjected to a desiccation-rehydration cycle. The high-resolution liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (HRLC-MS) analysis revealed significant metabolic differences between desiccated and rehydrated conditions, reflected in differences in the relative abundances of metabolites, including amino acids, carbohydrates, organic acids, and secondary metabolites. The metabolic pathways linked to amino acid biosynthesis and metabolism, sugar biosynthesis, energy metabolism, and secondary metabolite biosynthesis were significantly enriched in moss upon rehydration. Besides causing a metabolic shift, considerable differences in stress markers, including hydrogen peroxide (H2O2), the superoxide radical (O2•−), and malondialdehyde (MDA), were also observed between the desiccated and rehydrated moss samples. This could be attributed to the enhanced activity of antioxidant enzymes, such as catalase (CAT) and superoxide dismutase (SOD), which effectively scavenged and controlled the overproduction of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in cells. However, no significant difference in photosynthetic pigment concentration was observed in the moss under the treatment conditions. Rehydration triggered a significant surge of metabolites, reflecting the rapid upregulation and reactivation of metabolism, highlighting remarkable resurrection traits in the moss.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用高分辨率液相色谱—质谱分析卷柏状灰藓在脱水与复水条件下的代谢差异，以揭示其耐脱水和复苏相关特征。结果显示，复水后氨基酸、碳水化合物、有机酸和次生代谢物等相对丰度发生显著变化，氨基酸和糖合成、能量代谢及次生代谢物生物合成通路显著富集。研究还观察到 H2O2、超氧自由基和丙二醛等胁迫标志物的变化，并将其与 CAT、SOD 等抗氧化酶活性增强导致的活性氧清除能力联系起来。

articles.title: Calcium Salts of Biobased Anionic Surfactant Result in Hydrophilic, Air-Stable Bilayers by Distorted Hydrogen-Bond Networks
articles.title_zh: 生物基阴离子表面活性剂钙盐通过扭曲氢键网络形成亲水且空气稳定的双层结构
articles.abstract: Biobased hydroxy alkane sulfonate (HAS) caters to the growing demand for anionic surfactants that are eco-friendly, exert mild effects on humans, and remain effective in hard-water containing divalent cations. In contrast to surfaces treated with other surfactants, which become hydrophobic, this study shows that surfaces treated by HAS with C18 hydrocarbon chains (C18HAS) remain hydrophilic after drying owing to bilayer formation. Quartz crystal microbalance with dissipation measurements reveals that the formation of the C18HAS membrane follows the Langmuir adsorption kinetics. The adsorption of water molecules to the C18HAS layer was monitored under various humidity conditions using polarization-modulation infrared reflection absorption spectroscopy, suggesting that the adsorbed water molecules form a disordered hydrogen-bonding network similar to that observed in amorphous ice. Specular X-ray reflectivity data provide quantitative evidence that C18HAS forms a stable bilayer structure over a wide range of relative humidity levels. The modulation of the thickness and scattering length density of hydrocarbon chains with humidity levels can be attributed to the formation of a disordered hydrogen-bonding network. The ability of biobased C18HAS to form persistent hydrophilic bilayers on diverse surfaces highlights broad potential for surface coatings on commonly used materials, such as glass, plastics, and steel to resist organic contamination.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注生物基羟基烷烃磺酸盐表面活性剂，特别是 C18 烃链 HAS 在含二价阳离子硬水条件下的界面行为。与许多干燥后表面变疏水的表面活性剂不同，C18HAS 处理表面因形成双层结构而保持亲水。石英晶体微天平、红外反射吸收光谱和镜面 X 射线反射结果表明，其膜形成符合 Langmuir 吸附动力学，吸附水分子形成类似非晶冰的无序氢键网络，并在宽湿度范围内维持稳定双层结构。

articles.title: Graph Attention-Based Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient for Multi-UAV Cooperative Encirclement and Capture
articles.title_zh: 基于图注意力的多智能体深度确定性策略梯度用于多无人机协同包围与捕获
articles.abstract: Multi-UAV cooperative encirclement and capture is a critical multi-agent decision-making task with wide applications in security surveillance, disaster response and defense systems, requiring real-time spatial coordination to compress an evasive target's maneuvering space. Existing multi-agent deep reinforcement learning methods predominantly use equal-weight state concatenation to build centralized value functions, which fails to capture the time-varying importance of different UAVs and model complex dynamic interactions. This limitation worsens with increasing UAV numbers, and is compounded by inherent reward sparsity and training non-stationarity, severely restricting convergence efficiency and overall performance. To address these issues, this paper proposes a Graph Attention-based Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (GA-MADDPG) algorithm. We formalize the task as a discrete-time partially observable Markov game and design a hierarchical reward function integrating distance progress, angular coverage and safety constraints to alleviate reward sparsity. A dynamic graph structure based on communication constraints represents evolving UAV topological relationships, and a multi-head graph attention network generates attention-aware enhanced states to enable the centralized critic to adaptively focus on critical cooperative relationships. We further integrate layer normalization, asymmetric learning rates and prioritized experience replay to enhance training stability and sample efficiency. Extensive experiments with a team of UAVs and varying target speeds demonstrate that GA-MADDPG significantly outperforms the standard MADDPG baseline, achieving substantially higher encirclement success rates in high-difficulty scenarios where the target possesses a notable speed advantage, as well as markedly faster convergence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向多无人机协同包围与捕获任务，提出基于图注意力的多智能体深度确定性策略梯度算法 GA-MADDPG。针对传统方法难以表达不同无人机时变重要性、动态交互复杂性以及奖励稀疏和训练非平稳的问题，作者将任务形式化为离散时间部分可观测马尔可夫博弈，并设计融合距离推进、角度覆盖和安全约束的分层奖励函数。方法还利用通信约束构建动态图结构，以刻画无人机之间随时间变化的拓扑关系。

articles.title: Comparative Thermophysical and Thermo-Electrical Performance of Single, Binary, and Ternary (GNP–Al₂O₃–Fe₂O₃) Hybrid Nanofluids for Heat Transfer Applications
articles.title_zh: 单组分、二元与三元 GNP–Al₂O₃–Fe₂O₃ 混合纳米流体在传热应用中的热物性与热电性能比较
articles.abstract: The increasing demand for thermal management systems has intensified research into advanced nanofluids with enhanced transport properties. This study experimentally investigates graphene nanoplatelet (GNP), aluminum oxide (Al₂O₃), and ferric oxide (Fe₂O₃)-based nanofluids, spanning single-component, binary (50:50), and ternary hybrid formulations dispersed in deionized water at a fixed volume concentration of 0.1%. The impact of particle composition, particle weight ratio (PWR) and temperature (15–60°C) on electrical conductivity (σ), thermal conductivity (κ), and dynamic viscosity (µ) is systematically evaluated. Nanofluids were synthesized via a two-step method, and their morphology and dispersion characteristics were examined using transmission and scanning electron microscopy. Stability assessments, including long-term observation and viscosity monitoring, confirmed consistent dispersion over extended durations. The results demonstrate that nanoparticle synergy significantly influences thermophysical behavior, with ternary systems exhibiting superior enhancements compared to single and binary counterparts. Notably, maximum improvements of 394.72% in electrical conductivity, 37.50% in viscosity, were recorded at 60°C for the Ternary nanofluid sample A compared to water, while sample D achieved a 27.46% increase in thermal conductivity. To further assess application potential, heat transfer performance was evaluated using thermo-electrical conductivity ratio (TEC), performance enhancement ratio (PER), and figure of merit (Mo) for Ternary nanofluid samples. Empirical correlations for Ternary nanofluid samples were developed to predict property variations with temperature and particle composition, showing good agreement with experimental data. Overall, the findings highlight the strong potential of GNP–Al₂O₃–Fe₂O₃ ternary hybrid nanofluids as next-generation working fluids for high-efficiency thermal systems, including heat exchangers, microchannel cooling devices, and solar thermal applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验研究比较了石墨烯纳米片、氧化铝和氧化铁基单组分、二元及三元混合纳米流体在去离子水中的传输性能，体积分数固定为 0.1%。作者系统考察颗粒组成、质量比和温度对电导率、热导率与动态黏度的影响，并通过电子显微表征和稳定性测试评估分散状态。结果表明，纳米颗粒协同效应显著影响热物性行为，三元体系整体增强效果优于单组分和二元体系，摘要报告的最大电导率提升达 394.72%，热导率也获得明显改善。

articles.title: Selective Phonon-Excitation Controls Transient Magnetization in Monolayer Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
articles.title_zh: 选择性声子激发调控单层过渡金属二硫属化物中的瞬态磁化
articles.abstract: Ultrafast control of transient magnetization in non-magnetic materials is a central challenge for next-generation spintronics. In monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides, optically induced magnetization is typically short-lived due to rapid carrier relaxation, where phonons are conventionally regarded as a dissipative background. Here, we show that phonons can instead act as active control knobs by selectively reshaping non-equilibrium carrier dynamics. Using first-principles momentum-resolved quantum simulations, we demonstrate that excitation of long-wavelength longitudinal acoustic phonons in monolayer MoS2 induces a pronounced asymmetry between electron and hole relaxation. This selectively accelerates electron spin equilibration via Elliott–Yafet-type scattering while leaving hole relaxation relatively slow, leading to a transient enhancement of the total magnetic moment on ultrafast timescales. Our results establish a phonon-enabled route to control spin and valley dynamics, opening new opportunities for manipulating magnetic responses in two-dimensional semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨在非磁性材料中利用声子调控超快瞬态磁化的可能性，重点关注单层过渡金属二硫属化物。基于第一性原理动量分辨量子模拟，作者发现选择性激发单层 MoS2 中长波长纵向声学声子可重塑非平衡载流子动力学，导致电子与空穴弛豫出现明显不对称。该过程通过 Elliott–Yafet 型散射加速电子自旋平衡而相对保持空穴弛豫较慢，从而在超快时间尺度上增强总磁矩，为二维半导体中自旋和谷动力学调控提供了声子驱动途径。

articles.title: Chronic exposure to aflatoxin B1, ochratoxin A, and citrinin in women and children and associated health risk characterization: Blood biomonitoring evidence from rural Bangladesh
articles.title_zh: 孟加拉国农村妇女与儿童黄曲霉毒素B1、赭曲霉毒素A和桔霉素的慢性暴露及健康风险表征：基于血液生物监测的证据
articles.abstract: Dietary exposure to mycotoxins—including aflatoxins (AFs), ochratoxin A (OTA), and citrinin (CIT)—represents an important health risk, particularly in low-resource settings with widespread food contamination. This study investigates mycotoxin exposure among 712 participants (428 women and 284 children) of a cluster-randomized trial in rural Bangladesh, using blood samples collected in 2019. A total of 712 plasma and 578 serum samples were analyzed by ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-MS/MS). Serum aflatoxin B1 (AFB1)-lysine adducts were quantified following enzymatic digestion and solid-phase extraction. To evaluate potential health risks, we estimated probable daily intake (PDI) from blood concentrations of frequently detected mycotoxins. All plasma samples contained at least two mycotoxins, and 84% of participants were co-exposed to at least three mycotoxins. Biomarkers for the main blood-relevant mycotoxins were frequently detected, with OTA and its isomer, 2′R-ochratoxin A (2’R-OTA), found in nearly every sample, CIT in 91%, and Enniatin B (EnB) in 92%, while AFB1-lysine—a biomarker of chronic exposure to the potent carcinogen AFB1—was detected in nearly one-quarter of women and 4% of children with serum samples. Beauvericin was detected in 6% of samples. The PDI of OTA exceeded health-based guidance values for up to 80% of women and 99% of children, while the PDI of CIT was of concern for 12% of women and 27% of children. These findings demonstrate widespread co-exposure to multiple mycotoxins, with OTA, CIT, and AFB1 posing notable risks, underscoring the urgent need for targeted interventions to protect vulnerable populations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用2019年采集的血液样本，评估孟加拉国农村712名妇女和儿童对多种霉菌毒素的膳食暴露情况。通过UHPLC-MS/MS检测血浆和血清中的霉菌毒素及黄曲霉毒素B1-赖氨酸加合物，并由血液浓度估算可能每日摄入量以表征健康风险。结果显示所有血浆样本均检出至少两种霉菌毒素，且多数参与者存在三种及以上毒素的共同暴露，提示当地人群面临显著的慢性复合暴露风险。

articles.title: Characterization of a Heaterless 60 A Hollow Cathode on Krypton and Argon
articles.title_zh: 氪和氩工质下60 A无加热器空心阴极的特性表征
articles.abstract: We present a steady-state current-voltage (IV) characterization of a heaterless version of the 9 kW-class H9 Hall thruster cathode. This work was conducted at Georgia Tech’s High-Power Electric Propulsion Laboratory (HPEPL) in Vacuum Test Facility 2 at operational background pressures of 0.22–0.70 µTorr on krypton and 0.11–0.24 µTorr on argon, with a base pressure of 9.1 × 10− 8 Torr, and mapped steady-state voltage behavior from 5 to 35 A of discharge current on krypton and 5 to 20 A on argon, in both magnetized and unmagnetized configurations. The magnetized configuration produced a higher discharge voltage than the unmagnetized configuration at every paired (current, flow) operating point on both propellants. On krypton, the magnetized-unmagnetized voltage gap ranged from near zero at the highest cathode flow and lowest current to + 39.6 V (+ 148%) at 30 A and 12.39 sccm. On argon, the gap ranged from + 6.0 V at 15 A and 12.39 sccm to + 67.5 V (+ 159%) at 20 A and 15.89 sccm. In both cases, the gap widened with discharge current and narrowed with cathode flow. These results verify reproducible ignition at every tested flow rate, uninterrupted steady-state heaterless operation on krypton and argon and quantify how the applied magnetic field shifts the steady-state operating point at fixed discharge current. The key finding is that the applied magnetic field increases the steady-state discharge voltage at fixed current rather than reducing it, and the effect is systematically larger on argon than on krypton at matched operating conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究对9 kW级H9霍尔推力器阴极的无加热器版本进行了稳态电流—电压特性测试，工质包括氪和氩，并比较了有磁场与无磁场构型。结果表明，在两种工质下，有磁场构型的放电电压普遍高于无磁场构型，且电压差随放电电流增大而扩大、随阴极流量增大而减小。研究验证了该无加热器阴极在测试流量范围内可重复点火并实现稳态运行，为高功率电推进阴极设计提供了实验依据。

Model calculations suggest that the observed anisotropy originates from a Doppler-shift-induced reconstruction of the dispersion of Bogoliubov quasiparticle excitations.

articles.title: Shape Adaptive Radar Cross Section Reduction (RCSR) metastructure for Ku-Band
articles.title_zh: 用于 Ku 波段的形状自适应雷达散射截面降低超结构
articles.abstract: This work realizes an engineered metastructure in Ku-band for radar cross-section (RCS) reduction under different curvature states. The metastructure is designed by periodically embedding octagonal shaped subwavelength EG-PUR resonators within the dielectric matrix to create electromagnetic traps, enabling more than 90% reduction. An angular stability up to 70° for both TE and TM polarizations is achieved. A peak RCS reduction (RCSR) exceeding 20 dB is observed for both co- and cross-polarizations in reference to a completely reflecting surface. Monostatic RCS measurements reaffirm the performance of the metastructure in effectively reducing scattering in 12–18 GHz range. The RCSR remains unaffected under mechanical deformation, confirming its suitability for conformal applications. The proposed design offers a low-cost, lightweight, flexible and corrosion-resistant single window alternative to other conformal RCSR materials, which can easily be mounted on multiple curvature profiles for stealth technology and electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究设计了一种用于 Ku 波段雷达散射截面降低的工程化超结构，可在不同曲率状态下保持性能。通过在介质基体中周期性嵌入八边形亚波长 EG-PUR 谐振器形成电磁俘获结构，实现超过 90% 的散射降低，并在 TE/TM 极化下具有最高 70° 的角度稳定性。实验表明，该柔性、轻质、低成本且耐腐蚀的结构适用于共形隐身和电磁干扰抑制应用。

articles.title: Emulsion-forcespun hollow polymer fibers as functional sorbents for uranium removal from water
articles.title_zh: 乳液辅助力纺空心聚合物纤维作为水中铀去除功能吸附剂
articles.abstract: This study developed hollow amidoximated styrene–acrylonitrile (SAN) fibers using a novel emulsion-assisted solution forcespinning strategy for enhanced uranium adsorption. The fabricated hollow SAN fibers, with their unique core architecture, provided superior surface accessibility and faster mass transfer compared to solid fibers. This resulted in excellent uranium adsorption performance, achieving a maximum capacity of 190 mg g-1, approximately 1.4 times higher than that of solid fibers. This work presents an innovative approach to fabricate high-performance adsorbents for efficient recovery of uranium from aqueous solutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用乳液辅助溶液力纺策略制备了偕胺肟化苯乙烯–丙烯腈空心纤维，用于增强水体中铀的吸附。空心结构提高了表面可及性并加快传质，使其最大吸附容量达到 190 mg g-1，约为空心对照固体纤维的 1.4 倍。该方法为高性能铀回收吸附剂的制备提供了新的思路。

articles.title: Ultrafast holographic imaging reveals electron and magnetic dynamics inside next-generation materials
articles.title_zh: 超快全息成像揭示下一代材料内部的电子与磁动力学
articles.abstract: An extremely fast microscopy method to research the interaction of light and matter makes it possible to study optical processes on very short timescales. To this end, a German–Italian research team is combining holographic imaging with ultrafast spectroscopy in an innovative way. In this manner, even extremely short-lived electronic and magnetic phenomena—which play a major role in the development and application of novel energy materials—can be observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一种将全息成像与超快光谱学相结合的高速显微方法，可用于研究光与物质相互作用中的极短时间尺度过程。该技术能够观测寿命极短的电子和磁现象，这些现象对新型能源材料的开发与应用具有重要意义。该工作展示了超快成像在解析先进材料动态过程方面的潜力。

articles.title: Spin wave signals used in computing boosted more than 5,000 times in Z-shaped path approach
articles.title_zh: Z形路径方法使计算用自旋波信号增强逾5000倍
articles.abstract: A research team from Tohoku University, Shin-Etsu Chemical Co., Ltd., and École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) has invented a new way to efficiently guide spin waves around sharp corners with minimal loss—representing an exciting discovery for energy-efficient computing. Using a two-dimensional magnonic crystal—a copper (Cu) film with a hexagonal array of tiny holes placed on a magnetic garnet film—the team showed through calculations that spin waves travel along a Z-shaped path more than 5,000 times more efficiently than in conventional waveguides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一种高效引导自旋波绕过尖锐转角的新方法，旨在降低自旋波传播损耗并服务于节能计算。研究团队利用二维磁振子晶体结构，在磁性石榴石薄膜上布置带六角孔阵列的铜膜，并通过计算表明自旋波沿Z形路径传播的效率远高于传统波导。该发现为基于自旋波的低功耗信息处理器件设计提供了新思路。

articles.title: Post-Stack Seismic Modelling and Reservoir Mapping in Uzondu Field, Niger Delta Basin, Nigeria
articles.title_zh: 尼日利亚尼日尔三角洲盆地Uzondu油田的叠后地震建模与储层制图
articles.abstract: Post-stack seismic modelling was applied to the Uzondu Field, Niger Delta Basin, to quantitatively delineate reservoir geometry and evaluate hydrocarbon potential. The study integrates 2D seismic data, well logs, and check-shot data to constrain elastic property estimation and improve subsurface characterization. Two hydrocarbon-bearing sandstone reservoirs (Zones A and B) were mapped within the Agbada Formation using seismic-to-well calibration and inversion workflows. Fluid replacement modelling (FRM) based on Biot-Gassmann theory was used to simulate elastic responses under varying saturation conditions, while missing S-wave logs were generated using Castagna’s mudrock relation. AVO modelling and synthetic seismogram generation show improved seismic-to-well correlation after cross-correlation, confirming the reliability of the derived elastic parameters. Quantitative results shows that the reservoir interval is characterized by P-impedance values of ~21,000 to 24,000 ft/s·g/cc, S-impedance values of ~9,000 to 13,000 ft/s·g/cc, density values of ~2.1 to 2.3 g/cc, and Poisson’s ratio ranging from ~0.30 to 0.36. These values are consistently lower than surrounding formations, where P-impedance exceeds ~26,000 ft/s·g/cc, S-impedance exceeds ~14,000 ft/s·g/cc, and Poisson’s ratio is greater than ~0.40. The observed impedance contrasts generate strong reflection amplitudes and clearly define the reservoir top and base between Horizon 1 and 3 as well as Horizon 3 and 4. The lateral continuity of low-impedance zones tells a well-developed, laterally extensive sandstone bodies, while AVO responses demonstrate sensitivity to fluid variations, supporting hydrocarbon presence. The integrated workflow reduces interpretation uncertainty and provides a robust framework for reservoir delineation, facies discrimination, and field development planning in complex deltaic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将叠后地震建模应用于尼日尔三角洲盆地Uzondu油田，以定量刻画储层几何形态并评估含烃潜力。研究整合二维地震资料、测井资料和校正井震资料，在Agbada组内识别并制图两个含烃砂岩储层。流体替换建模、AVO建模和合成地震记录结果提高了井震匹配可靠性，表明目标储层的阻抗、密度和泊松比低于围岩，可用于区分含烃砂岩与周围地层。

articles.title: Strategy of Electron-Withdrawing-Group Peripheralization (SEP) for Designing High-performance Polymer Donors in Organic Solar Cells
articles.title_zh: 用于设计有机太阳能电池高性能聚合物给体的吸电子基团外围化策略
articles.abstract: Organic solar cells represent a promising third-generation photovoltaic technology, yet their efficiency remains constrained by the limited development of high-performance polymer donors (PDs). Here, we propose a universal design strategy of electron-withdrawing group peripheralization (SEP), which can produce pronounced electrostatic potential contrast and enhanced backbone dipoles, thus bringing multiple synergistic effects: (a) significantly reduce binding energy of the materials (24.56 meV for the developed material in this work), making exciton dissociation no longer dependent on the D/A interfaces, (b) improve intrachain charge transport through amplified conjugation-aligned dipoles, and (c) strengthen intermolecular coupling via spatially separated charge centers. Furthermore, based on this strategy, a high-performance polymer donor PBDTT-perp was constructed, which produced high efficiency of 20.13% and excellent stability in layer-by-layer processed binary device, significantly outperforming conventional EWG-centralized analogs (10.72%). More interestingly, the SEP principle is applicable to all reported high-performance materials, which will provide important guidance for the design of next-generation PDs compatible with high-efficiency OSCs architecture.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出吸电子基团外围化策略，用于设计有机太阳能电池中的高性能聚合物给体材料。该策略可增强静电势差和主链偶极，从而降低激子结合能、改善链内电荷传输并增强分子间耦合。基于该策略构筑的聚合物给体PBDTT-perp在层层加工二元器件中实现了20.13%的高效率和良好稳定性，显著优于传统吸电子基团中心化类似物。

articles.title: Numerical Validation of a MOSFET-Based Control Circuit for High-Power Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces for Wireless Power Transfer Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向无线电能传输高功率智能反射面的MOSFET控制电路数值验证
articles.abstract: Intelligent reflecting surfaces (IRSs) have attracted considerable attention because of their ability to dynamically control electromagnetic wave propagation. While most existing IRSs have been developed for low-power communication and sensing applications, their extension to high-power wireless power transfer (WPT) environments remains largely unexplored, as the high induced currents can damage or saturate the sensitive control elements, disrupting their tuning functionality. Here, we propose a metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor-based (MOSFET-based) binary control circuit for IRSs operating at 2.4 GHz that can withstand input power levels exceeding 1 W per unit cell. The control circuit employs a back-to-back MOSFET switching topology with series and parallel capacitors to suppress impedance variations arising from device nonlinearity while maintaining a reflection phase difference of approximately 180 degrees between the ON and OFF states. A theoretical model based on transmission lines is developed and validated against full-wave co-simulations incorporating nonlinear SPICE device models. The dynamic range is evaluated with respect to both the rated current and the reflection phase difference, demonstrating stable operation up to 1.25 W. Supercell-level beam steering is further demonstrated through far-field simulations, confirming active control of the reflection angle via switching pattern reconfiguration. These results establish a foundation for the deployment of IRSs in high-power WPT scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向2.4 GHz高功率无线电能传输场景的MOSFET二进制控制电路，用于智能反射面单元的相位调控。电路采用背靠背MOSFET开关拓扑，并结合串并联电容以抑制器件非线性引起的阻抗变化，同时在开关状态间保持约180度反射相位差。研究建立了基于传输线的理论模型，并通过包含非线性SPICE器件模型的全波协同仿真进行验证，评估其在高输入功率下的动态范围与可靠性。

articles.title: Study of the enrichment of refractory oxidized lead ores from tailings from mining plants via combined electrochemical polarization
articles.title_zh: 通过联合电化学极化富集选矿厂尾矿中难处理氧化铅矿的研究
articles.abstract: Man-made oxidized nonferrous metal ores accumulate in large quantities in mining plants, causing environmental problems and polluting the soil, groundwater, and atmosphere with toxic heavy metals. Traditional flotation is often ineffective and fails to yield acceptable levels of nonferrous metal recovery. This study aims to use refractory oxidized lead ore electrochemical enrichment to increase lead recovery into flotation concentrates to 93–95% from mine plant tailings. Cerussite is the primary lead mineral in the ore. Cathodic voltammetry revealed that cerussite reduction occurs partially through decomposition into Pb2+ ions and through direct solid-phase discharge of mineral particles to elemental lead. To convert the mineral cerussite to an easily floatable sulfide form, the traditional flotation reagent sodium sulfide was used. Under microelectrolysis conditions in a weakly alkaline solution of sodium sulfide, lead cations formed during the solid-phase decomposition of cerussite interact with sulfide ions and form lead sulfides. The electrode mechanisms of cerussite mineral sulfidation were used for the electrochemical enrichment of oxidized lead ore. Sulfidization of ore from the Alaigyr deposit in the Republic of Kazakhstan was carried out in a special electrolyzer with a pulp preparation apparatus. A multifactorial model of lead recovery into sulfide concentrate was obtained, indicating that a high degree of recovery of 98.56% was achieved under the experimentally determined optimal conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对矿山尾矿中难处理氧化铅矿的高效回收问题，探索电化学富集方法以提高铅进入浮选精矿的回收率。研究表明，主要铅矿物白铅矿在阴极过程中可部分分解为Pb2+离子，也可通过固相放电还原为金属铅。利用弱碱性硫化钠溶液中的微电解条件，白铅矿分解产生的铅离子与硫离子生成更易浮选的硫化铅，为氧化铅矿硫化与浮选强化提供了机制依据。

articles.title: Generic thermodynamics of condensates with extremely small superfluid density---Application to UTe2 and hidden second phase transition---
articles.title_zh: 极小超流密度凝聚态的一般热力学：在UTe2及隐藏第二相变中的应用
articles.abstract: Motivated by recent outstanding experimental discoveries on UTe2 via NMR and specific heat experiments, we theoretically explore the thermodynamic signatures of condensates with small superfluid density and characterize their physical properties. We identify the hidden superconducting phase A2 with spin up pairs at lower temperature (T) and field (H) under ambient pressure of UTe2 and show that A2 revives at higher H for all three principal field directions a,b, and c-axis. The phase transition lines from the A1 phase with spin down pairs to the A2 phase in the H-T plane are all horizontal in common, implying a universal physical origin due to the magnetic energy gain in increasing H due to spin up pairs. This multiple phase diagram is extended to these under pressure (P), resulting in a simple picture based on non-unitary spin triplet pairing symmetry 3B3u, which enables us to capture the phase evolutions in the whole H-T-P space.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论研究受UTe2近期核磁共振和比热实验发现启发，探讨超流密度很小的凝聚态热力学特征及其物理性质。作者识别出常压下低温低场区域具有自旋向上配对的隐藏超导A2相，并指出该相在更高磁场下可沿三个主晶轴方向重新出现。研究将H-T相图进一步扩展到压力维度，提出基于非幺正自旋三重态配对对称性的统一图像，以解释UTe2在磁场、温度和压力空间中的相演化。

articles.title: Complex temperature-dependent thermal conductivity in the sawtooth chain magnet Fe₂SiSe₄
articles.title_zh: 锯齿链磁体Fe₂SiSe₄中复杂的温度依赖热导率
articles.abstract: Author(s): Kunya Yang, Feihao Pan, Liran Wang, Chenglin Shang, Ying Zhu, Xiancai Hu, Sanjiang He, Xinrun Mi, Long Zhang, Aifeng Wang, Yisheng Chai, Frederic Hardy, Christoph Meingast, Peng Cheng, and Mingquan He Here, the authors show that spin–phonon scattering can strongly tune phonon heat transport in the frustrated sawtooth-chain magnet Fe 2 SiSe 4 . Resonant scattering of phonons by magnetic excitations produces a broad thermal conductivity maximum in the single- q state, while this scattering is suppressed in the double- q state, yielding a fivefold-enhanced low-temperature peak. The results highlight frustrated magnets as prominent platforms for controlling thermal conductivity. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 174442] Published Fri May 29, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在受挫锯齿链磁体Fe₂SiSe₄中，自旋—声子散射可显著调控声子热输运。单q态中，磁激发对声子的共振散射产生宽的热导率峰；而在双q态中该散射受到抑制，从而形成增强约五倍的低温热导峰。结果凸显受挫磁体作为调控热导率平台的潜力。
authors: Kunya Yang, Feihao Pan, Liran Wang, Chenglin Shang, Ying Zhu, Xiancai Hu, Sanjiang He, Xinrun Mi, Long Zhang, Aifeng Wang, Yisheng Chai, Frederic Hardy, Christoph Meingast, Peng Cheng, and Mingquan He

articles.title: First-principles framework for exchange interactions and red-shifted luminescence of Cr³⁺ ion pairs in strong crystal field environments
articles.title_zh: 强晶场环境中Cr³⁺离子对交换相互作用与红移发光的第一性原理框架
articles.abstract: Author(s): Qinshi Hu, Lingkun Zhang, Anfei Chen, Qianshan Quan, Min Yin, Chang-Kui Duan, and Qiaoling Chen Here, the authors establish a first-principles framework, benchmarked against ruby (Al 2 O 3 :Cr 3 + ) and applied to multiple oxides, for quantitatively determining the ground-state exchange coupling J and emission redshift of Cr 3 + ion pairs in strong crystal-field environments. Redshifts increase along corner, edge, and face-sharing from less than 0.1 to ∼ 0 . 2 eV. The study shows that excited-state electron-phonon coupling and magnetic exchange work synergistically, and these geometry-specific redshift ranges can distinguish genuine pair-related near-infrared centers from other defects. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 195156] Published Fri May 29, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了一个第一性原理框架，用于定量确定强晶场环境中Cr3+离子对的基态交换耦合和发光红移，并以红宝石及多种氧化物体系进行验证和应用。结果显示，红移幅度随共享几何从角共享、边共享到面共享而增大，范围从小于0.1 eV到约0.2 eV。研究指出激发态电子—声子耦合与磁交换具有协同作用，这些几何相关的红移特征可帮助区分真实离子对近红外发光中心与其他缺陷。
authors: Qinshi Hu, Lingkun Zhang, Anfei Chen, Qianshan Quan, Min Yin, Chang-Kui Duan, and Qiaoling Chen

articles.title: Self-consistent Coulomb interactions from constrained dynamical mean-field theory
articles.title_zh: 基于约束动力学平均场理论的自洽库仑相互作用
articles.abstract: Author(s): Antik Sihi, Subhasish Mandal, and Kristjan Haule Here, the authors develop constrained dynamical mean-field theory, a self-consistent first-principles approach for determining screened Coulomb interactions in correlated materials. The method incorporates local vertex corrections within the same many-body framework used to compute electronic spectra, yielding interaction strengths that enable excellent agreement with photoemission experiments across Mott insulators, correlated metals, altermagnets, and unconventional superconductors. [Phys. Rev. B 113, L201116] Published Fri May 29, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者发展了约束动力学平均场理论，这是一种用于确定关联材料中屏蔽库仑相互作用的自洽第一性原理方法。该方法在计算电子谱的同一多体框架内引入局域顶角修正，得到的相互作用强度可使莫特绝缘体、关联金属、交替磁体和非常规超导体等体系的计算结果与光电子能谱实验高度一致。
authors: Antik Sihi, Subhasish Mandal, and Kristjan Haule

articles.abstract: Nature Photonics, Published online: 29 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01918-y Infiltrating a bifunctional spacer between perovskite grain boundaries enables perovskite solar cells with a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.01%, 90% of which is maintained after over 2,000 h of operation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过在钙钛矿晶界间渗入双功能间隔分子，构建全向离子锁定网络以提升钙钛矿太阳能电池稳定性。器件获得经认证的27.01%功率转换效率，并在超过2000小时运行后仍保持90%的初始效率，显示出兼具高效率与长期稳定性的潜力。

articles.title: Noisy quantum learning theory
articles.title_zh: 含噪量子学习理论
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 29 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73693-x Expected quantum advantages in learning unknown system properties usually rely on idealized scenarios. Here, the authors develop a computational complexity framework to rigorously describe situations in which a fault-tolerant quantum computer is available but its coupling to the system of interest is noisy, showing how retaining exponential advantage is nontrivial - but possible.
articles.abstract_zh: 预期的量子学习优势通常建立在理想化条件之上，而真实系统耦合往往存在噪声。作者建立了一个计算复杂性框架，用于严格描述具备容错量子计算机但其与待研究系统耦合含噪的情形，并表明在这种条件下保持指数级量子优势并不平凡，但在特定情况下仍然可能。

articles.title: Yamaji effect in models of underdoped cuprates
articles.title_zh: 欠掺杂铜氧化物模型中的Yamaji效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.13943v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent angle-dependent magnetoresistance measurements in underdoped cuprates have revealed compelling evidence for small hole pockets in the pseudogap regime, including observation of the Yamaji effect in HgBa₂CuO₄₊δ (Chan et al., Nature Physics 10.1038/s41567-025-03032-2 (2025)). A key distinction between theories is their predicted Fermi volumes, measured as fractions of the square lattice Brillouin zone: p/4 per pocket for spin density wave (SDW) versus p/8 for fractionalized Fermi liquid (FL*), where p is the hole doping. We calculate the c-axis magnetoresistance h̊ozz(θ, φ) within the semiclassical Boltzmann formalism for both states, and using the ancilla layer model (ALM) for FL* in a single-band Hamiltonian. The results from the FL^* phase show good consistency with current experimental data. Conversely, the results for the SDW phase are highly sensitive to the ordering momentum along the z-direction. An ordering vector of Q = (π, π, π) yields predictions that starkly disagree with the experiment. The only possibility for agreement within the SDW scenario is to assume an ordering momentum of Q = (π, π, 0). However, even in this specific case, the SDW scenario predicts a marginally smaller Yamaji angle at φ=0 than the FL* theory, and a second Yamaji peak near in-plane angle φ = 45ⁱ̧rc, which was not observed in the experiment. In reality, the Néel ordering vector is likely uncorrelated between adjacent layers, so that there is no coherent interlayer transport of hole-pocket quasiparticles in the SDW scenario, and consequently no Yamaji effect. Our results support the FL* interpretation of Fermi arcs in the pseudogap phase, and establish Yamaji angle measurements as a discriminatory tool between theoretical models.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期角度依赖磁阻实验在欠掺杂铜氧化物赝能隙区发现小空穴口袋的证据，并在HgBa₂CuO₄₊δ中观察到Yamaji效应。作者在半经典玻尔兹曼框架下计算自旋密度波态和分数量子化费米液体态的c轴磁阻，并比较两类理论对费米面体积和角度依赖响应的预言。结果显示FL*相与现有实验较为一致，而SDW相的结果强烈依赖z方向有序动量；其中Q=(π,π,π)与实验明显不符，Q=(π,π,0)才可能接近实验。
authors: Jing-Yu Zhao, Shubhayu Chatterjee, Subir Sachdev, Ya-Hui Zhang

articles.title: Comment on "Spin-1/2 Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet: Machine Learning Discovery of the Spinon Pair-Density-Wave Ground State"
articles.title_zh: 关于“自旋1/2 Kagome海森堡反铁磁体：机器学习发现自旋子对密度波基态”的评论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recent article [Phys. Rev. X 15, 011047 (2025)] utilizes group-equivariant convolutional neural networks to study the ground state of the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet. On the largest finite-size cluster studied to date (N=108), the authors report variational energies significantly lower than other numerical methods, including state-of-the-art density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations. In contrast to previous results suggesting a possible spin-liquid ground state, the authors observe a spinon pair-density-wave ground state. We find that: (i) the reported low energies are artifacts of broken ergodicity in the Metropolis--Hastings sampling, since the single-spin-flip update rule utilized by the authors effectively freezes the Markov chains; and (ii) when ergodic sampling is enforced via spin-exchange updates, the neural network converges to energies significantly higher than existing DMRG results, calling the paper's claims into question.
articles.abstract_zh: 该评论质疑一篇利用群等变卷积神经网络研究Kagome海森堡反铁磁体基态的工作，后者声称在N=108团簇上得到显著低于其他数值方法的变分能量并发现自旋子对密度波基态。作者指出，这些低能量可能源于Metropolis-Hastings采样中单自旋翻转更新导致的遍历性破缺；当采用自旋交换更新以恢复遍历性时，神经网络得到的能量显著高于现有DMRG结果，从而动摇了原论文结论。
authors: Helia Kamal, Dominik Kufel, DinhDuy Vu, Chris R. Laumann, Norman Y. Yao

articles.title: Improving CFT Operators Using Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 利用机器学习改进共形场论算符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite-size effects limit the accuracy with which conformal data can be extracted from lattice simulations of critical systems. While action improvement suppresses some corrections to scaling, it does not address operator-dependent effects arising from imperfect lattice representations of continuum conformal fields. In this work, we propose a data-driven method for improving lattice operators themselves, constructing estimators with enhanced overlap with the corresponding primary operators of the continuum conformal field theory. We identify improved lattice representations of leading spin and energy operators in three two-dimensional critical systems: the Ising model, the q = 3 Potts model, and the dilute q = 3 Potts model. In all cases, the resulting operators exhibit reduced corrections to scaling and yield more accurate estimates of scaling dimensions compared to conventional lattice choices. The code and analysis workflows used to produce these results are made available in an accompanying GitHub repository.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限尺寸效应限制了从临界系统晶格模拟中提取共形数据的精度，而传统作用量改进并不能处理由连续共形场晶格表示不完美所导致的算符依赖修正。作者提出一种数据驱动方法来改进晶格算符，构造与连续共形场论中相应初级算符重叠更高的估计量。该方法应用于二维Ising模型、q=3 Potts模型和稀释q=3 Potts模型中的主导自旋与能量算符，降低了标度修正并提高了标度维数估计精度。
authors: Lior Oppenheim, Snir Gazit, Zohar Ringel

articles.title: Geometry-based Discovery of Calcium Battery Cathodes Accelerated by Foundational Machine-Learned Models
articles.title_zh: 由基础机器学习模型加速的基于几何的钙电池正极材料发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Calcium batteries (CBs) are an attractive post-Li-ion technology, offering the appeal of Ca's natural abundance and high volumetric energy density. However, practical realization of CBs remains limited by the scarcity of positive electrode (cathode) materials that support reversible Ca²⁺ (de)intercalation under electrochemical conditions. To address this challenge, we screen the materials project (MP) database for novel host structures that can intercalate Ca using geometry- and chemistry-based design principles. Specifically, we employ the Voronoi polyhedral volume as a descriptor of site compatibility for hosting Ca in potential frameworks. Further, we down-select candidate structures progressively through criteria including charge neutrality, absence of non-Ca mobile cations, thermodynamic (meta)stability, average voltage, and Ca migration barriers (Eₘ₎ using foundational machine-learning (ML) models. Subsequently, we validate the ensemble-ML-predicted Eₘ in a subset of the final candidates using density functional theory based nudged elastic band calculations. Overall, from an initial pool of 52,945 MP structures, our workflow identifies 37 promising Ca cathode candidates, several of which exhibit favorable combinations of thermodynamic (meta)stability, voltage, and Ca-mobility, marking them as strong candidates for synthesis and electrochemical characterization. Particularly, we identify two Ca cathode candidates with markedly low Ca²⁺~Eₘ (CaSc₂V₂O₈ and CaVSO₄F₃₎, and four cathode candidates with thermodynamically stable charged states (Ca₃₍CoO₂₎₄, Ca₃Mn₄₍TeO₆₎₂, CaVF₅, and CaVSO₄F₃₎. Beyond identifying Ca-cathodes, our work establishes geometry-based descriptors and ML-based workflows as transferable methods for high-throughput screening, enabling the rapid discovery of novel materials for battery and other applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙电池因钙资源丰富和高体积能量密度而具有吸引力，但可逆嵌脱Ca²⁺的正极材料仍然稀缺。作者基于几何和化学设计原则筛选Materials Project数据库，利用Voronoi多面体体积评估潜在框架中钙位点相容性，并进一步根据电荷中性、移动阳离子、热力学稳定性、平均电压和钙迁移势垒等条件逐步筛选候选材料。研究还使用基础机器学习模型预测迁移势垒，并对部分最终候选体系通过密度泛函理论的爬山弹性带计算进行验证。
authors: Dereje Bekele Tekliye, Achinthya Krishna Bheemaguli, Gopalakrishnan Sai Gautam

articles.title: Self-Assembly of Lipid-Biopolymer Periodic Nanostructures on Photonic Length Scales
articles.title_zh: 光子尺度脂质—生物聚合物周期性纳米结构的自组装
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The self-assembly of photonic nanostructures in insects involves chitin, proteins, and lipids. While synthetic photonic systems have been extensively studied, current lipid-based self-assembly systems are limited in periodicity to 68,nm compared to photonic length scales (approx 450,nm) observed in biological organisms. We hypothesise that lipids facilitate how structural colour arises in vivo by acting as templates for the self-assembly of biopolymers via lipidic lyotropic liquid crystal mesophases. Here, we aim to understand and identify how structural colour is produced in insects by the co-assembly of lipids and biopolymers. We study the effect of biopolymers, pH, temperature, surface charge, and stability on lipid vesicles using dynamic light scattering, X-ray scattering, and zeta potential analysis. Using cryo-electron microscopy, we demonstrate that these vesicles interact with the biopolymers and generate periodic nanostructures with periodicities ranging from 700,nm to 1.2,μm (more than ten times larger than for purely lipidic systems) and dimensionalities ranging from 1D to 3D. Our results establish that lipid mesophases and biopolymers can induce reorganisation into ordered nanostructures, overcoming key limitations of periodicities achieved by lipid-only systems, and providing a methodology for recreating the physicochemical mechanisms underlying biophotonic structural colour.
articles.abstract_zh: 昆虫中的光子纳米结构自组装涉及几丁质、蛋白质和脂质，但合成脂质体系的周期尺度通常远小于生物结构色所需的光子尺度。作者假设脂质通过溶致液晶中间相作为模板，促进生物聚合物自组装并产生结构色；他们利用动态光散射、X射线散射、ζ电位分析和低温电镜研究生物聚合物、pH、温度、表面电荷和稳定性对脂质囊泡的影响。结果表明，囊泡与生物聚合物相互作用可形成周期为700纳米至1.2微米、维度从一维到三维的周期纳米结构，显著大于纯脂质体系。
authors: Rushna Quddus, Meron Debas, Stefan Salentinig, Ullrich Steiner, Viola Vogler-Neuling

articles.title: Field-Driven Hybrid Filament Formation Governs Switching in Ta-HfO₂₋Pt Memristors
articles.title_zh: 电场驱动的混合导电细丝形成主导Ta-HfO₂-Pt忆阻器中的开关行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Memristive devices have gained significant attention for their potential in next-generation non-volatile memory and neuromorphic computing architectures. Among emerging candidates, transition metal oxides have proven particularly promising. While the switching mechanism in Ta/HfO₂/Pt devices was long attributed solely to oxygen vacancy based filaments, recent experimental evidence suggests a more complex dual-regime: the diffusion of metal cations also contributes to the formation of a conductive bridge. However, the precise atomistic mechanisms governing this metal cation migration remain poorly understood. Additionally, the role of defects such as oxygen vacancies present in the transition metal oxide in determining the final filament size and shape is also not well understood. Here, we employ molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with dynamic charge transfer to provide a detailed analysis of the atomistic mechanisms governing the co-formation of Ta-cation and oxygen-deficient filaments. We clearly show how varying the initial oxygen vacancy concentrations and spatial configurations within the HfO₂ matrix influences the final morphology and dimensions of the conductive filament. The switching is governed by field-driven formation and rupture of a hybrid Ta-cation-rich, oxygen-deficient filament in HfO₂. Our simulations closely match experiment, validating the model as a robust framework for understanding switching in oxide memristors and guiding designs that reduce cycle-to-cycle and device-to-device variability -- key barriers to high-performance devices.
articles.abstract_zh: Ta/HfO₂/Pt忆阻器的开关机制过去常被归因于氧空位导电细丝，但近期实验证据显示金属阳离子扩散也参与导电桥形成。作者采用具有动态电荷转移的分子动力学模拟，分析Ta阳离子细丝与缺氧细丝共同形成的原子机制。研究重点揭示HfO₂基体中初始氧空位浓度和空间分布如何影响最终细丝的尺寸、形貌和器件开关行为。
authors: Ashutosh Krishna Amaram, Aditya Koneru, Subramanian KRS Sankaranarayanan

articles.title: Helimagnetic Josephson diode effect
articles.title_zh: 螺旋磁约瑟夫森二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the Josephson diode effect in the one-dimensional superconductor/helimagnet/superconductor junctions using the Green's function method. For the spin-singlet s-wave pairing in superconductors, it is found that the necessary conditions for the Josephson diode effect are the nonzero chemical potential and the conical magnetic configuration in the helimagnet. The diode efficiency is strongly dependent on the chemical potential, chirality, tilt angle and exchange coupling in the helimagnet. The high efficiency close to 40% can be obtained for specific parameter values. The sign of the diode efficiency can be tuned by changing the chirality, tilt angle, exchange coupling and chemical potential. The dependence of the diode efficiency on the number of supercells in the helimagnet is also investigated. The characteristics of the supercurrent nonreciprocity and diode efficiency in the junctions are clarified through the symmetry analysis and the energy band calculations. The diode effect for the spin-triplet p-wave pairing in superconductors is also discussed and the nonzero chemical potential is no longer a necessary condition for the Josephson diode effect due to the equal-spin Cooper pair-mediated transport in the p-wave junctions. These results provide a scheme for the Josephson diode effect without spin-orbit coupling, which possesses the potential applications in the design of dissipationless electronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用格林函数方法考察一维超导体/螺旋磁体/超导体结中的约瑟夫森二极管效应。对于自旋单重态 s 波配对，非零化学势与螺旋磁体中的锥形磁构型是产生二极管效应的必要条件，二极管效率强烈依赖化学势、手性、倾角和交换耦合，并可在特定参数下接近 40%。作者还通过对称性分析和能带计算阐明了超电流非互易性，并讨论了自旋三重态 p 波配对情形。
authors: Qiang Cheng, Yu-Chen Zhuang, Qing-Feng Sun

articles.title: Topological Lifshitz transition-induced bipolarity of anomalous Nernst effect in kagome magnet YCo3
articles.title_zh: 拓扑 Lifshitz 转变诱导的 Kagome 磁体 YCo3 中反常能斯特效应双极性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29297v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The kagome lattice, renowned for hosting topological band structures and rich magnetic behaviors, offers an exceptional setting to investigate unconventional transport in magnetic topological systems. Controlling the polarity of the anomalous Nernst effect (ANE) is crucial for designing flexible thermoelectric devices, such as thermopiles, where the ability to switch the thermoelectric voltage sign can dramatically enhance energy conversion efficiency and output. Here, we demonstrate such a bipolar ANE in the kagome magnet YCo3, driven by a temperature-induced topological Lifshitz transition. With a Curie temperature TC~225 K, sizable anomalous Hall and Nernst effects emerge below TC. Supported by the first-principles calculations, the AHE and ANE are suggested to be dominated by the intrinsic mechanism. Furthermore, the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity exhibits a piecewise-linear dependence on magnetization, with an abrupt slope change near 100 K, consistent with the Karplus-Luttinger mechanism. Concurrently, the anomalous Nernst coefficient SAyx reverses its sign around the same temperature, realizing the crucial bipolarity. These anomalies could be interpreted as a topological Lifshitz transition, enabled by the evolution of Co moments that could shift the Fermi level relative to Weyl nodes. Our work reveals YCo3 as a prototypical kagome magnet where temperature and magnetism directly govern both Weyl node topology and the bipolar ANE, opening a pathway to magnetically control thermoelectric output in topological quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道了 Kagome 磁体 YCo3 中由温度诱导拓扑 Lifshitz 转变驱动的双极性反常能斯特效应。材料在居里温度约 225 K 以下出现显著反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应，第一性原理计算表明其主要来源于内禀机制。反常霍尔电导随磁化强度呈分段线性变化，并在约 100 K 附近出现斜率突变，同时反常能斯特系数在相近温度发生符号反转。
authors: Sheng Xu, Yue-Yang Wu, Hao-Ran Bai, Zheng Li, Shu-Xiang Li, Jun-Jian Mi, Tian-Hao Li, Ze-Wei Wang, Ze-Kai Dong, Jiang Ma, Xiao-Bo Wu, Qian Tao, Zhu-An Xu

articles.title: Effective Theory of Fermion Quartet Condensation
articles.title_zh: 费米子四聚体凝聚的有效理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a theory of superconductivity (or superfluidity) based on condensed fermion quartets focusing on the dilute spin-frac12 systems at zero temperature. In the spirit of the Bardeen--Cooper--Schrieffer ansatz, a variational wavefunction is constructed such that, within the so-called ``dilute quartet approximation", it is the ground state of an effective quartic Hamiltonian. For a given two-body interaction in favor of quartetting, the gap parameter is suitably defined and the gap equation is also derived. As to the excited states, an intuitive physical picture based on a sixteen-dimensional ``occupation space" is depicted and the associated eigen-energies are obtained. This theory is applied to compute the superfluid fraction, which is found to be the same as in conventional superconductors, despite the interacting nature of the quartet problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者发展了一种基于费米子四聚体凝聚的超导或超流理论，重点讨论零温稀薄自旋 1/2 体系。借鉴 BCS 变分思想，研究构造了在“稀薄四聚体近似”下对应有效四次哈密顿量基态的波函数，并定义能隙参数、推导能隙方程。该理论还给出基于十六维占据空间的激发态图像，并用于计算超流分数，结果显示其与常规超导体相同。

articles.title: Tetrahedrally ferromagnetic correlations and a glassy-freezing anomaly in the breathing pyrochlore magnet AgInCr₄S₈ with partial A-site disorder
articles.title_zh: 部分 A 位无序呼吸烧绿石磁体 AgInCr4S8 中的四面体铁磁关联与玻璃冻结异常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the chromium breathing pyrochlore sulfide AgInCr₄S₈, a chromium-based thiospinel, by synchrotron x-ray and neutron powder diffraction, dc magnetization, and heat capacity. Diffraction confirms the Fbar43m breathing structure with alternating large and small Cr₄ tetrahedra, a large breathing ratio (d^prime/d = 1.106 at 300 K), and substantial Ag/In intermixing on the A sublattice (sim 16%). No structural transition or magnetic Bragg peaks are detected down to 1.5 K. An enlarged low-angle difference plot between the 1.5 and 20 K neutron diffraction patterns shows a weak broad diffuse-like enhancement, consistent with short-range or frozen correlated moments within the sensitivity of the present data. Susceptibility yields a positive Weiss temperature θW = +92 K and a moment enhancement in 30--60 K, while the magnetic entropy released by sim 30 K approaches a scale of order Rłn 13, together consistent with the development of short-range tetrahedral ferromagnetic correlations and an effective S = 6 cluster-moment picture. A broad susceptibility cusp with ZFC--FC bifurcation and a low-temperature specific heat anomaly near 9 K indicate a phenomenological glassy-freezing anomaly without long-range order. AgInCr₄S₈ provides a benchmark for the interplay of strong breathing distortion and quenched A-site disorder in chromium breathing pyrochlores.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合同步辐射 X 射线、中子粉末衍射、直流磁化率和热容测量，研究铬基硫尖晶石 AgInCr4S8。衍射证实其具有 Fbar43m 呼吸结构、较大的呼吸比以及约 16% 的 Ag/In A 位混排，在低至 1.5 K 未观察到结构相变或磁性布拉格峰。磁化率、磁熵和低温异常表明体系中形成短程四面体铁磁关联，并在约 9 K 附近出现类似玻璃冻结的异常。
authors: Yuya Haraguchi, Masahiro Kitamura, Masaki Gen, Yusuke Nambu, Akira Matsuo, Koichi Kindo, Masaki Kondo, Masashi Tokunaga, Hiroko Aruga Katori

articles.title: Hole-doped superconductivity above 100 K in infinite-layer cuprate thin films
articles.title_zh: 无限层铜氧化物薄膜中 100 K 以上的空穴掺杂超导电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Since the discovery of superconductivity in (La,Ba)2CuO2 (Ref.~i̧tebednorz1986possible), a broad family of structurally distinct cuprate superconductors has been proposed or engineered to elucidate the physics of high-temperature superconductivity~i̧techu2015hole,plakida2010high. Among them, the infinite-layer cuprate has the simplest structure, consisting only of the essential ingredients for superconductivity: CuO₂ square planes separated by spacer ions~i̧tesiegrist1988parent. Despite being proposed nearly 40 years ago, the hole-doped superconductivity via chemical substitution in this compound has not yet been achieved, a fundamental open question in the field. Here, we report the observation of superconductivity in the hole-doped infinite-layer cuprate thin film. Measurements of resistivity and magnetic-field response in Sr1-xRbxCuO2 single-crystal thin films show superconducting transitions with a high onset temperature of 100 K. Hole doping is achieved via the synergistic effect of rubidium substitution and apical oxygen incorporation, as evidenced by structural analysis and transport measurements. As the parent structure of the cuprate family~i̧techu2015hole, hole-doped infinite-layer cuprate provides a unique platform for revisiting key puzzles in cuprate superconductors~i̧te{keimer2015quantum,tsuei2000pairing,armitage2010progress,dagotto1994correlated}, including strange metal~i̧te{proust2019remarkable,taillefer2010scattering} and electron-hole symmetry~i̧te{tohyama2004asymmetry,segawa2010zero,lee2014asymmetry}, while bridging to cuprate-nickelate symmetry~i̧te{li2019superconductivity,zeng2022superconductivity,chow2025bulk,lechermann2020late}.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道了空穴掺杂无限层铜氧化物薄膜中的超导电性，这是长期未解决的无限层铜氧化物化学空穴掺杂问题。作者在 Sr1-xRbxCuO2 单晶薄膜中通过电阻率和磁场响应测量观察到起始温度约 100 K 的超导转变。结构分析与输运结果表明，空穴掺杂来自铷替代与顶位氧引入的协同作用。
authors: Biemeng Jin, Saurav Prakash, Zhaoyang Luo, Shengwei Zeng, Jing-Yang Chung, Xing Gao, Zhi Shiuh Lim, Jiangbo Luo, King Yip, Wei Zhang, Nurul Fitriyah, Shuhan Lu, Taiyu An, Ping Yang, Qian He, Silvija Gradečak, Huajun Liu, A. Ariando

articles.title: Dynamic charges effect on infrared dielectric response of polar materials
articles.title_zh: 动态电荷对极性材料红外介电响应的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predictive modeling of the infrared dielectric function in polar materials is crucial for thermal management and infrared devices design. While the Green-Kubo molecular dynamics (MD) framework provides a nonperturbative route to compute dielectric responses from dipole fluctuations, yet it commonly relies on the fixed-charge approximation that neglects dynamic charge redistribution during atomic motion. Here, we employ a machine-learning neuroevolution potential with dynamic charges (qNEP) combined with Green-Kubo MD to investigate the dynamic charge effect on the infrared dielectric response of rutile TiO₂, a material with large Born effective charges (BEC). Our results show that dynamic charge effects become increasingly important at elevated temperatures and are essential for accurately predicting longitudinal optical phonon features and infrared reflectance. This work establishes that accurate prediction of infrared optical properties in polar materials under thermal excitation requires explicit treatment of dynamic charge evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注极性材料红外介电函数的预测建模，指出传统 Green-Kubo 分子动力学中固定电荷近似会忽略原子运动时的电荷重分布。作者将具有动态电荷的机器学习神经演化势 qNEP 与 Green-Kubo 分子动力学结合，研究 Born 有效电荷较大的金红石 TiO2。结果表明，动态电荷效应在高温下更为重要，并对准确预测纵向光学声子特征和红外反射率至关重要。
authors: Wei-Zhe Yuan, Yangyu Guo, Hong-Liang Yi

articles.title: Synthesizability, hardness, and stacking order in multicomponent transition metal carbides from machine-learned potentials
articles.title_zh: 基于机器学习势研究多组元过渡金属碳化物的可合成性、硬度与堆垛序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multicomponent transition metal carbides are promising for extreme-environment applications, but identifying compositions that are both synthesizable and hard remains challenging. We fine-tune the MACE machine-learned interatomic potential on approximately 28,000 density functional theory calculations spanning the composition space of groups 4-6 transition metals and carbon to predict the thermodynamic stability and elastic properties of multicomponent carbides. The fine-tuned model achieves formation energy errors of ~ 10 meV/atom for thermodynamically relevant structures with only 20% of the training data. We screen over 1500 equiatomic compositions across rocksalt, hexagonal, and hcp prototypes, combining free energy models with elasticity-based hardness surrogates. Synthesizability predictions at 1500degC agree well with experimental reports for both single-phase and multiphase carbides. The group number of the constituent metals governs both stability and hardness. Free energy contributions from short-range order are small, typically a few meV/atom, indicating that a perfectly disordered solid solution provides a reasonable approximation for high-throughput screening. For compositions mixing group 4/5 and group 6 metals, we identify a new family of stacking-ordered phases with formation energies well below those of disordered rocksalt or hexagonal structures. DFT calculations corroborate these predictions and suggest that stacking-ordered phases should be experimentally accessible in multicomponent carbides. This study provides a framework for screening synthesizable multicomponent materials with target properties, identifies promising carbide compositions across the full nine-component space, and reveals a new class of stacking-ordered carbides accessible only in multicomponent compositions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用约 2.8 万个密度泛函理论计算数据微调 MACE 机器学习原子间势，用于预测第 4–6 族过渡金属与碳组成的多组元碳化物的热力学稳定性和弹性性质。作者筛选了 1500 多种等原子比组成及多种结构原型，并结合自由能模型和基于弹性的硬度代理指标评估可合成性与硬度。结果显示，构成金属的族数主导稳定性和硬度，短程有序对自由能贡献通常较小，完全无序固溶体近似在许多情况下是合理的。

articles.title: Alternative origins of polarity in compressively strained SrTiO3-RENiO3 capacitors
articles.title_zh: 压缩应变 SrTiO3-稀土镍酸盐电容器中极性的替代起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Since its original prediction 25 years ago, room-temperature out-of-plane ferroelectricity in compressively strained SrTiO3 remains an ongoing pursuit. In this work, we investigate the structural, electrical and electromechanical properties of highly strained epitaxial SrTiO3 capacitors with rare earth nickelate electrodes. The SrTiO3 layers experience compressive strains up to -3% and exhibit pronounced tetragonality, comparable to that of bulk PbTiO3. Variable-temperature electrical measurements and room-temperature piezoresponse force microscopy reveal butterfly-shaped capacitance-voltage hysteresis and domain-like electromechanical response typical of ferroelectric materials. However, the overall behavior is inconsistent with a stable ferroelectric state. We therefore propose an alternative mechanism for the observed polarity in our samples based on spatially inhomogeneous internal fields. Our first-principles calculations show that such fields may arise from charge discontinuities between the formally charged NdNiO3 layers and charge-neutral SrTiO3 layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察以稀土镍酸盐为电极的高压缩应变外延 SrTiO3 电容器的结构、电学和机电性质，以评估室温面外铁电性的可能性。SrTiO3 层承受最高约 -3% 的压缩应变并表现出显著四方畸变，电学测量和压电响应显微镜显示类似铁电材料的滞回与畴状响应。作者认为整体行为并不支持稳定铁电态，而更可能源于空间不均匀内建电场，第一性原理计算表明该电场可由带电 NdNiO3 层与电中性 SrTiO3 层之间的电荷不连续性引起。
authors: Evgenios Stylianidis, Panagiotis Koutsogiannis, Alexander Lione, Felix Risch, Laura Hechler, Igor Stolichnov, Jorge Íñiguez-González, José A. Pardo, Nicholas C. Bristowe, César Magén, Pavlo Zubko

articles.title: Nanoparticle manipulation with a carbon fiber tip in an electron microscope for μ-SQUID magnetometry
articles.title_zh: 用于 μ-SQUID 磁测量的电子显微镜内碳纤维探针纳米颗粒操控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29550v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a carbon-fiber-tip based nanomanipulation system integrated into a scanning electron microscope for individual nanoparticle (NP) manipulation on a surface. Electrochemically etched amorphous carbon fiber tips with excellent mechanical rigidity and sub-100 nm apex radii effectively reduce the van der Waals adhesion and enable reliable positioning of about 100 nm size NPs with about 100 nm precision. This system combines a piezoelectric bimorph for vertical tip motion, a four-quadrant piezo-tube for two-dimensional fine tip control and a two-dimensional piezoelectric walker for coarse lateral translation. Using this setup, we successfully position single Fe₃O₄ magnetic NPs on micron sized superconducting quantum interference devices for optimal magnetic coupling between them and probe a NP's magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道了一种集成于扫描电子显微镜中的碳纤维探针纳米操控系统，用于在表面上操控单个纳米颗粒。电化学刻蚀的非晶碳纤维探针具有良好机械刚性和小于 100 nm 的尖端半径，可降低范德华黏附并以约 100 nm 精度定位约 100 nm 尺寸颗粒。作者利用该装置将单个 Fe3O4 磁性纳米颗粒放置到微米级超导量子干涉器件上，以优化磁耦合并探测其磁性。
authors: Umesh Chandra Thuwal, Sumanta Maity, Clemens B. Winkelmann, Hervé Courtois, Anjan Kumar Gupta

articles.title: Revealing quantum metric multipoles in magnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4
articles.title_zh: 揭示磁性拓扑绝缘体 MnBi2Te4 中的量子度量多极矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonlinear electronic transport has emerged as a powerful probe of the quantum geometry in topological quantum materials, where the band topology and broken symmetries facilitate power law current voltage responses beyond Ohms law. While nonlinear transport of the second and third orders has been studied in several quantum materials, higher-order transport has so far mainly remained experimentally inaccessible, leaving more detailed features of the quantum geometry unexplored. Here, we observe higher order nonlinear electronic transport up to the seventh harmonic order in multilayer magnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4. We find an even-odd behavior where the odd order nonlinear transport components dominate while the even-order ones are suppressed. Temperature and magnetic field dependent measurements show a strong correlation between the nonlinear transport and the magnetic phases of MnBi2Te4. Through scaling analysis and theoretical calculations, quantum metric multipoles and nonlinear Drude conductivities are identified as the microscopic origins of the nonlinear transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在多层磁性拓扑绝缘体 MnBi2Te4 中观测到最高达第七谐波阶的高阶非线性电子输运。实验发现奇数阶非线性分量占主导而偶数阶分量受到抑制，且非线性输运与 MnBi2Te4 的磁相随温度和磁场变化表现出强关联。通过标度分析和理论计算，作者将这些非线性响应归因于量子度量多极矩和非线性 Drude 电导。
authors: Lars Sjöström, Prasanna Rout, Shahid Sattar, Alexander Tyner, Maurice E. Bal, Ankit Khola, Elias Rasmussen, Khadiza Ali, Arumugum Thamizhavel, Uli Zeitler, Carlo M. Canali, Saroj P. Dash

articles.title: Disentangling Spin Pumping and Two-Magnon Scattering Contributions to Gilbert Damping in YIG/V Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 区分 YIG/V 双层结构中自旋泵浦与双磁振子散射对 Gilbert 阻尼的贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we investigate the magnetic damping and spin pumping response of YIG-based bilayers incorporating vanadium (V) as the normal metal layer via broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) measurements as a function of YIG thickness. We show that the apparent enhancement of the Gilbert damping in YIG/V bilayers cannot be solely attributed to spin pumping. Instead, two-magnon scattering (TMS) plays a dominant role in governing the thickness dependence of the damping in the nanometer regime. By applying a thickness-dependent damping model that accounts for both spin pumping and two-magnon scattering contributions, we successfully disentangle the different relaxation contributions. Our analysis reveals that neglecting two-magnon scattering leads to an overestimation of the spin-pumping contribution and consequently to unphysically large values of the effective spin-mixing conductance. After isolating the intrinsic spin pumping contribution, we extract a thickness-independent effective spin-mixing conductance of gp̆arrowdowⁿarrowₑff = 1.33 × 10¹⁸~mathrmm⁻². These findings provide a more accurate framework for quantifying spin transport parameters in FM/HM systems and emphasize the necessity of accounting for extrinsic damping mechanisms when interpreting spin pumping and inverse spin Hall effect experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过宽带铁磁共振测量，考察含钒正常金属层的 YIG 双层结构中磁阻尼和自旋泵浦响应随 YIG 厚度的变化。结果表明，YIG/V 双层中表观 Gilbert 阻尼增强不能仅由自旋泵浦解释，双磁振子散射在纳米厚度范围内主导阻尼的厚度依赖。通过包含自旋泵浦和双磁振子散射的厚度依赖模型，作者提取出厚度无关的有效自旋混合电导为 1.33 × 10¹⁸ m⁻²。
authors: S. Elkady, A. Tlais, H. Reslan, S. Isber, M. Haidar

articles.title: Finite-temperature micromagnetic model bridging atomic- and macro-scale magnetism
articles.title_zh: 连接原子尺度与宏观尺度磁性的有限温度微磁模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A multi-scale finite-temperature micromagnetic model is presented, based on the Landau-Lifshitz equation and the Bernoulli differential equation. This model accurately reproduces classic Maxwell magnetostatics of paramagnets for high temperatures and accurately reproduces standard micromagnetics described by the conventional Landau-Lifshitz model in ferromagnets. The Landau-Lifshitz-Bernoulli (LLBe) model can, by design, directly couple atomic-scale simulations with micromagnetics and output consistent predictions of bulk magnetic properties at finite temperatures, from below to above the material's Curie temperature. The LLBe model is validated against established solvers: MUMAX3 for zero-temperature micromagnetics, and FEMCE for high-temperature classic magnetostatics. We present an application of the LLBe model by simulating Heat-Assisted magnetic recording on a thin magnetic track with local heating, demonstrating the multi-scale finite-temperature capabilities of the LLBe.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种基于 Landau-Lifshitz 方程和 Bernoulli 微分方程的多尺度有限温度微磁模型。Landau-Lifshitz-Bernoulli 模型在高温下可再现顺磁体的经典 Maxwell 磁静力学，在铁磁低温情形下可还原标准微磁学，并能连接原子尺度模拟与微磁计算。作者将该模型与 MUMAX3 和 FEMCE 等已有求解器进行验证，并以局域加热薄磁道上的热辅助磁记录模拟展示其有限温度多尺度能力。

articles.title: Thickness-driven crossover from conventional to chiral nonreciprocal superconductivity in kagome metal CsV3Sb5
articles.title_zh: kagome 金属 CsV3Sb5 中由厚度驱动的常规到手性非互易超导转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductivity and its potential applications are governed by the symmetry of the superconducting order parameter. In the kagome metal CsV3Sb5, most bulk studies indicate conventional s-wave pairing. However, ultrathin flakes exhibit nonreciprocal transport, in particular a zero-field superconducting diode effect, which requires broken inversion and time-reversal symmetries. Here, using thickness dependent transport measurements, we observe the emergence of non-reciprocal second-harmonic magnetotransport signals and a zero-field superconducting diode effect, accompanied by a pronounced reduction of the out-of-plane coherence length with decreasing thickness. Upper critical field measurements further reveal a dimensional crossover from three-dimensional superconductivity in bulk to two-dimensional superconductivity in thin flakes. These findings indicate a thickness-induced chiral superconducting phase that breaks both inversion and time-reversal symmetries in the two-dimensional limit. Our work not only clarifies long-standing controversies regarding the pairing symmetry in CsV3Sb5, but also establishes thin-flake kagome superconductors as a versatile platform for engineering nonreciprocal quantum devices and exploring emergent topological phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过厚度依赖的输运测量，考察 kagome 金属 CsV3Sb5 从体材料到超薄薄片时超导性质的变化。结果显示，随厚度减小出现非互易二次谐波磁输运信号和零场超导二极管效应，同时面外相干长度显著降低，并发生从三维到二维超导的维度交叉。作者认为这些现象表明二维极限下形成了同时破缺反演和时间反演对称性的厚度诱导手性超导相。
authors: Wei Zhang, Jiangbo Luo, Nikolai Peshcherenko, Zheyu Wang, Chun Wai Tsang, Kwing To Lai, King Yau Yip, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Junxiong Hu, Yang Zhang, Swee K. Goh, A. Ariando

articles.title: Generation of Bloch Points with Controlled Spin Texture Using Geometrical Boundary Conditions
articles.title_zh: 利用几何边界条件生成具有可控自旋纹理的布洛赫点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29672v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bloch points are three-dimensional topological singularities in magnetization that play a key role in topological transformations of spin textures, such as skyrmion creation or annihilation. While topology often enforces the existence of Bloch points in confined geometries like cylindrical nanowires, deterministic control over their position and magnetic configuration remains challenging. Here we demonstrate the generation of Bloch points with controlled spin texture by engineering geometrical boundary conditions in three-dimensional nanomagnets. By introducing a chirality interface between two three-dimensional double-helix nanowires of opposite handedness, forming a kinked, non-collinear structure, we impose competing topological constraints that uniquely define the magnetization configuration surrounding the Bloch point. A saturating magnetic field nucleates head-to-head or tail-to-tail domain configurations at the chirality interface, producing a Bloch-point domain wall with deterministic polarity, circulation and helicity.
